Organization OverviewCompany Description

Help us build the "System of Action" that supercharges global manufacturing teams. QAD is entering a high-velocity era to architect the world's first AI-native, agentic ERP. We are moving beyond legacy "systems of record" to build an autonomous platform where humans and AI work as a tag team to redefine how factories operate. Join us at this pivotal moment to build our next generation platform, lead the next generation of the Adaptive Enterprise and turn global speed into strategy. 

Job Description

Ignite Your Future: Strategic Leadership

Are you a distinguished technical leader ready to own the cross-stack architectural vision for an intelligent, adaptive SaaS platform? Sitting directly above our Senior Staff Engineering roles, you will serve as the chief technical authority for our full stack systems. At QAD, we are redefining the supply chain through a single System of Action that connects people, processes, and data. As a Full Stack Technical Architect, you will bridge high-level strategy with hands-on execution-driving architecture across frontend, backend, microservices, and cloud infrastructure while setting technical standards across engineering teams. 

The Mission: Defining the Platform's Future

You Will Be The Executive Driver In Setting The Technical North Star For The Platform, Translating The Company's Business Strategy Into a Multi-year Engineering Roadmap, And Ensuring Architectural Alignment Across All Product Pillars. You Will Lead And MentorPrincipal-level Engineers, Leverage Executive-level Expertise In Highly Specialized Fields To Innovate At Scale, And Govern The Development Standards For Cloud-native Architectures, Microservices, And Agile Product Development Across All Teams. You Will Be Instrumental In Ensuring The Platform Delivers On Its Core Pillars

- Adaptive Applications: The intelligent backbone powering the manufacturing enterprise. 
 - Champion AI: Agentic AI for manufacturing that drives measurable productivity and growth. 

Your Impact/ What You Will Be Doing

- End-to-End System Architecture: Define, govern, and execute the multi-year technical vision and architectural roadmap across the complete application lifecycle-from modern frontends to resilient backend microservices. 
 - Full Stack Standards & Governance: Establish and enforce enterprise-wide design patterns, API contracts, micro-frontend/microservices blueprints, and code governance standards. 
 - Hands-on Technical Leadership: Conduct deep design reviews, author architectural decision records (ADRs), resolve systemic performance bottlenecks, and write critical reference code. 
 - Next-Gen AI & Platform Integration: Architect robust full stack frameworks that support Adaptive Applications and Agentic AI workflows embedded directly into user-facing enterprise applications. 
 - Cross-Functional & Strategic Alignment: Collaborate with Product Leadership, Engineering Directors, DevOps/SRE, and Senior Staff Engineers to translate complex business objectives into scalable architectures. 
 - Technical Mentorship & Elevation: Mentor Senior Staff, Principal, and Lead Engineers, setting the technical bar and driving engineering excellence across multiple feature pods. 

Core Technical Foundations / What We Are Looking For

- Frontend Architecture: Advanced mastery of modern web frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue. js), micro-frontends, design systems, state management, and web performance optimization. 
 - Backend & Microservices: Deep architectural expertise in distributed systems, REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven designs, and runtimes like Java, Node. js, Python, or Go. 
 - Data & Cloud Infrastructure: Extensive experience with relational & NoSQL databases, message brokers (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and cloud-native architecture (AWS/GCP/Azure). 
 - Core Engineering & Governance: Foundational expertise in Data Structures, System Design, Security (OAuth/OIDC), CI/CD automation, and high-availability design

The Mindset

- Strategic Visionary: Strong conceptual and strategic thinking to understand the most advanced issues and implications, applying this knowledge to define and execute the future direction of the platform. Exercises independent executive judgment in setting organization-wide methods and evaluation criteria. 
 - Organizational Leader: Demonstrates end-to-end responsibility for the architectural and organizational health of the entire function. Capable of driving complex, multi-year solutions and influencing critical company-wide technology choices. 
 - Adaptability & Innovation: Eagerness to rapidly assess and strategically adopt cutting-edge technologies that create a competitive advantage. 
 - Proactive Executive: Takes initiative to anticipate future organizational, technical, and business needs, risks, or improvements without explicit direction, establishing new executive standards where necessary. 

Qualifications

Qualifications & Next Steps

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Experience: 14+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years acting as a Technical Architect or System Architect overseeing multi-team systems. 
 - Location: On-site technical leadership role based in Pune (3-4 days in-office per week). 

Additional Information

Why QAD?

- Structured Mentorship: Benefit from a structured program and training designed for rapid career development. 
 - Inclusive Culture: Join a collaborative and inclusive environment that champions learning, growth, and diverse perspectives. 
 - Ready to step into the future of manufacturing? Apply now and start building a System of Action!

About QAD

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars - Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) - QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days. 

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD's DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work. 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

data.title: Quality Head
data.description:
ONLY FOR PEOPLE FROM TEXTILE BACKGROUND & TEXTILE WORK EXPERIENCE

Company:   Diamond Exports

Location:   Agra, Uttar Pradesh

Industry:   Textiles, Home Textiles & Rugs

Department:   Quality Assurance & Quality Control

Position:   Head of Quality

Experience:   10-15+ Years (Textile Industry)

Job OverviewDiamond Exports is seeking an experienced and highly competent  Head of Quality Assurance & Quality Systems  with extensive experience in the textile manufacturing and export industry. 

The ideal candidate should have direct experience handling international buyers such as  IKEA, Walmart, and other leading global retailers, with a comprehensive understanding of their quality requirements, factory evaluation standards, and audit expectations. 

The primary responsibility of this position is to develop, implement, standardize, and continuously improve a robust, process-driven Quality Management System (QMS) across the organization. 

We are looking for a professional who can build sustainable quality systems, strengthen process controls, establish accountability, and create a culture of preventive quality management rather than relying solely on final product inspections. 

Key Responsibilities1. Quality Management System Development (Primary Responsibility)

- Design, develop, and implement a comprehensive factory-wide Quality Management System. 
 - Establish standardized SOPs, quality manuals, process controls, work instructions, and inspection procedures across departments. 
 - Develop systematic quality checkpoints from raw material procurement through manufacturing, finishing, packing, and dispatch. 
 - Establish clear quality responsibilities, accountability structures, and reporting mechanisms. 
 - Implement effective documentation, record-keeping, traceability, and process-monitoring systems. 
 - Establish preventive quality systems to identify and eliminate potential defects before they occur. 
 - Conduct regular system effectiveness reviews and drive continuous improvements. 

2. Buyer Standards & Factory Compliance

- Ensure adherence to quality requirements of international buyers, particularly IKEA and Walmart. 
 - Possess thorough knowledge of  FCCA (Factory Capability & Capacity Assessment)  and factory audit preparation. 
 - Develop and maintain systems that ensure continuous audit readiness. 
 - Coordinate buyer quality audits, internal audits, external inspections, and corrective action plans. 
 - Translate buyer-specific requirements into practical factory-level operating procedures. 
 - Ensure appropriate implementation of buyer quality protocols throughout production. 

3. Quality Tools & Process Improvement

- Demonstrate practical experience with internationally recognized quality management tools, including: 
 - Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
 - Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA)
 - 5 Why Analysis and Fishbone Diagrams
 - Pareto Analysis and Statistical Process Control (SPC)
 - Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
 - AQL Inspection Standards
 - Risk Assessment and Process Audits
 - PDCA and Continuous Improvement
 - Develop systems for defect analysis, quality trend monitoring, and prevention of recurring nonconformities. 
 - Implement measurable quality KPIs and department-wise performance monitoring. 

4. Sharp Tools & Product Safety Management

- Develop and maintain a comprehensive  Sharp Tools Management System  in accordance with international buyer requirements. 
 - Establish procedures for sharp tool issuance, identification, tracking, reconciliation, and control. 
 - Implement broken needle and sharp object control procedures wherever applicable. 
 - Establish effective lost-tool reporting, incident investigation, and corrective action procedures. 
 - Conduct periodic internal audits to ensure strict compliance with product safety protocols. 
 - Ensure staff training and accountability for all sharp-tool-related procedures. 

5. Manufacturing Quality Control

- Establish and monitor quality standards for raw materials, yarn, dyeing, weaving, finishing, and packing. 
 - Define incoming, in-process, and final inspection procedures. 
 - Develop standardized defect classification, inspection checklists, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Identify recurring manufacturing defects and implement permanent process improvements. 
 - Coordinate closely with production departments to reduce rework, rejection, and customer complaints. 
 - Strengthen first-time-right manufacturing practices. 

6. Internal Audits, Documentation & Traceability

- Develop a structured internal quality audit calendar. 
 - Implement effective audit documentation, compliance tracking, and corrective action verification. 
 - Establish material, production, inspection, and finished-product traceability systems. 
 - Ensure all quality records are accurate, accessible, and maintained in accordance with buyer requirements. 
 - Conduct periodic management reviews of quality performance and system effectiveness. 

7. Team Development & Quality Culture

- Lead, mentor, and develop the QA and QC teams. 
 - Define responsibilities, competency requirements, and performance expectations for quality personnel. 
 - Conduct regular training on SOPs, quality tools, buyer requirements, and product safety. 
 - Work with production and departmental heads to establish a culture of quality ownership. 
 - Drive continuous improvement through structured training, audits, and performance reviews. 

Required Qualifications & Experience
 - Bachelor's degree in Textile Technology, Textile Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Quality Management, or a related discipline. 
 - Minimum 10-15 years of relevant experience in textile manufacturing, home textiles, rugs, or export-oriented manufacturing. 
 - Proven experience managing quality systems for international buyers such as  IKEA and Walmart. 
 - Strong working knowledge of FCCA assessments, buyer audits, and factory quality requirements. 
 - Hands-on experience developing and implementing complete Quality Management Systems. 
 - Thorough understanding of sharp tools management, product safety controls, CAPA, risk assessment, and audit documentation. 
 - Practical knowledge of ISO 9001 principles and internationally recognized quality tools. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, leadership, and cross-functional coordination skills. 
 - Excellent documentation, reporting, and communication capabilities. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance will be evaluated primarily on: 

- Successful development and implementation of a comprehensive, sustainable Quality Management System. 
 - Standardization and effective implementation of SOPs across departments. 
 - Continuous readiness and successful completion of buyer quality audits, including FCCA where applicable. 
 - Reduction in internal defects, rework, rejection, and buyer complaints. 
 - Effectiveness of CAPA, preventive controls, and root cause elimination. 
 - Compliance with sharp tools management and product safety requirements. 
 - Improvement in process discipline, documentation, and manufacturing traceability. 
 - Development of a competent and accountable quality team. 

Ideal Candidate ProfileWe are specifically seeking a  system-oriented quality leader, not merely an inspection-oriented quality manager. 

The ideal candidate must be capable of independently assessing existing factory operations, identifying systemic weaknesses, building practical procedures, implementing strong preventive controls, and ensuring their consistent execution. 

The candidate should demonstrate the ability to transform quality management from a reactive, inspection-dependent function into a  structured, measurable, preventive, and continuously improving system  aligned with the expectations of leading international retailers. 

The ultimate objective is to establish a quality system that functions consistently at every stage of manufacturing, with minimum dependence on individual supervision and maximum process accountability.

data.title: SW QA Engineer – Simcenter X (AltairOne Apps)
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Software QA Engineer to join our Engineering Intelligence team and help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of cloud-delivered engineering applications used by global manufacturers. 

You will work with quality engineers, developers, product owners, and engineering domain experts to define and execute end-to-end workflows across SaaS, OnPrem, and High Performance Computing (HPC) environments. The role combines software quality engineering with engineering simulation workflows, cloud technologies, automation, and complex distributed systems. 

You will play a key role in ensuring that our applications not only function correctly, but also deliver reliable and credible engineering results. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute comprehensive testing: Plan and perform functional, integration, system, exploratory, end-to-end, and performance testing for complex engineering and cloud-delivered applications. 
 - Validate engineering workflows: Test simulation-driven workflows from model setup and execution through solver behavior and result validation, ensuring both functional correctness and engineering credibility. 
 - Build test automation: Develop, maintain, and enhance automated test suites using modern frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar technologies to improve regression coverage and release efficiency. 
 - Test cloud and distributed applications: Validate web-based and cloud-native applications across microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed environments. 
 - Analyze and troubleshoot quality issues: Investigate failures, defects, performance bottlenecks, and unexpected behaviors; perform root-cause analysis and verify fixes. 
 - Work with CI/CD and engineering infrastructure: Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and troubleshoot test environments across Windows, Linux, containers, and Kubernetes-based environments. 
 - Drive quality across the product lifecycle: Collaborate with developers, architects, product owners, and domain experts to define acceptance criteria, identify quality risks, and continuously improve test strategy and coverage. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on software QA/testing experience involving technically complex software, with strong experience in test planning, execution, defect analysis, and validation. 
 - Strong experience with web/UI test automation using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent. 
 - Working knowledge of Windows and Linux/Unix environments, with strong debugging and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Understanding of microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed applications, with exposure to troubleshooting Kubernetes-based environments. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in Agile teams. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with engineering simulation, CAE, CAD, or other scientific/technical software, including understanding of simulation workflows beyond basic tool operation. 
 - Strong understanding of simulation concepts such as meshing, physics modeling, solver configuration, convergence, numerical stability, and result validation. 
 - Experience with API testing using tools such as Postman and performance testing using JMeter, Gatling, or similar. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and testing applications deployed in cloud environments.

Job Description

Job Description Senior Software Engineer -

C++ & Adaptive AUTOSAR (ADAS Vehicle Abstraction Layer)Location [JLR TBSI Bengaluru]Department ADAS Autonomous Driving Software Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer specializing in C++ and Adaptive AUTOSAR to join our ADAS development team. 

In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing the Vehicle Abstraction Layer (VAL). 

Your primary goal will be to decouple highlevel ADAS perception and planning algorithms from the underlying vehicle hardware and communication protocols, ensuring seamless integration, scalability, and safetycritical performance. 

Key Responsibilities Architect & Develop VAL Design and develop robust Vehicle Abstraction Layers that provide a standardized interface for ADAS applications to interact with vehicle actuators (steering, braking, acceleration) and sensors. 

Adaptive AUTOSAR Implementation Develop and integrate software components within an Adaptive AUTOSAR framework, focusing on ServiceOriented Architecture (SOA) and SOMEIP communication. 

C++ Software Engineering Write highperformance, memoryefficient, and MISRAcompliant C++ code (C++141720) optimized for embedded automotive platforms. Communication Protocols Implement and manage data exchange between highlevel ADAS controllers and lowlevel ECUs using protocols such as SOMEIP, DoIP, CANCANFD, and Ethernet. 

Hardware Abstraction Develop drivers and abstraction logic to hide hardware complexity, enabling easier porting of ADAS software across different vehicle platforms. 

Safety & Standards Ensure all software development adheres to functional safety standards (ISO 26262) and automotive coding guidelines (MISRA C++, AUTOSAR). 

Testing & Validation Perform unit testing, integration testing, and HardwareintheLoop (HiL) testing to validate the reliability and timing constraints of the VAL. 

Collaboration Work closely with Perception, Planning, and Control teams, as well as Hardware engineers, to define interface requirements and system specifications. 

Required Technical Skills Programming Advanced proficiency in C++ (C++ 11C++14C++17 preffered) and understanding of lowlevel memory management and concurrency. 

Strong understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns. Middleware Handson experience with Adaptive AUTOSAR stack (e. g. , Vector MICROSAR Adaptive, EB corbos, or similar). 

Architecture Strong understanding of ServiceOriented Architecture (SOA) and the concept of Vehicle Abstraction Layers. Automotive Networking Deep knowledge of SOMEIP, Ethernet communication, and traditional CANCANFD protocols. 

OS Knowledge Experience working with POSIXbased operating systems (e. g. , QNX, LinuxRTOS). Tools Proficiency with Git, CMake, GDB, and debugging tools (Lauterbach, CANalyzer, or CANoe), CICD pipelines. 

Required Skills

C++, Adaptive AUTOSAR, Vehicle Abstraction Layer (VAL), erviceOriented Architecture (SOA), SOMEIP, DoIP, CANCANFD, Ethernet

Supported Skills

Advanced C++ Software Development & Design, Adaptive AUTOSAR & Service-Oriented Architecture, Automotive Communication & VAL Expertise, Embedded Systems, Testing & Integration, Functional Safety & Problem Solving

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer 2
data.description:
About HeyMarvin

HeyMarvin is one of the fastest-growing research platforms in the galaxy. Some of the largest companies (such as Microsoft, Best Buy, LinkedIn, Sonos, and 7-11) use HeyMarvin as their secret weapon for building customer-centric solutions. 

Funded by notable investors like OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and first PayPal board member Scott Banister, HeyMarvin is an AI-native research system that integrates all your customer feedback and research into one central, searchable hub - so anyone can get the answers they need, when they need them. 

We are headquartered in Oakland, CA, with more than 100 passionate employees across three countries. We're united by our mission: To build a future where every strategic business decision is grounded in the voice of the customer. 

For more info, visit www. heymarvin. com. 

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to join a fast-growing, well-funded Silicon Valley-based startup. This role offers a high level of ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to work in a collaborative, high-performance environment with competitive compensation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop and deploy backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency and scalability
 - 
 - Architect Distributed Systems: Design and implement robust microservices using Golang and Django that can handle concurrent processing of high-volume research data (e. g. , video, audio, and large-scale text datasets). 
 - Optimize AI Workflows: Build and refine asynchronous task queues (using tools like Celery or Redis) to manage long-running AI inference tasks without impacting the responsiveness of the user-facing API. 
 - Database Performance: Design and maintain efficient schemas for both relational databases (PostgreSQL) and specialized storage (Vector databases for AI search), ensuring millisecond-level query performance as data scales into the millions of records. 
 - Load Management: Implement caching strategies and rate-limiting to protect service integrity during traffic spikes from global enterprise customers. 
 - Build and operate infrastructure, toolset and deployment pipelines
 - 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Own and automate the provisioning of cloud resources on AWS (using Terraform or CloudFormation) to ensure environments are reproducible and scalable. 
 - CI/CD Optimization: Streamline the path from "code commit" to "production" by building automated testing and deployment pipelines that allow the team to ship multiple times a day with high confidence. 
 - Observability & Monitoring: Implement comprehensive logging, tracing, and alerting (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog) to proactively identify performance bottlenecks and system health issues before they affect users. 
 - Developer Experience: Create internal CLI tools or scripts to simplify the local development environment and improve the velocity of the entire engineering team. 
 - Collaborate with other engineers to create beautiful products
 - 
 - API Stewardship: Design clean, well-documented, and intuitive RESTful or GraphQL APIs that enable frontend teams to build seamless and high-performance user interfaces. 
 - Full-Stack Synergy: Work closely with product designers and frontend engineers to understand the "Jobs to be Done, " ensuring that backend logic perfectly supports complex research workflows. 
 - Technical Mentorship: Participate in rigorous code reviews and architectural whiteboarding sessions, fostering a culture of high-quality code and continuous learning. 
 - Rapid Prototyping: Transition quickly from experimental AI features to production-ready services, balancing speed-to-market with long-term code maintainability. 
 - Handling and owning security and compliance aspects for the software that the team produces. 
 - 
 - Enterprise-Grade Compliance: Build and enforce the technical controls necessary to maintain SOC2, GDPR, or HIPAA compliance, ensuring customer data is treated with the highest level of privacy. 
 - Data Isolation: Implement strict multi-tenant architecture patterns to ensure that sensitive research insights from one organization (e. g. , Microsoft) are never accessible or leaked to another (e. g. , 7-11). 
 - Proactive Security: Conduct regular vulnerability scanning, dependency audits, and security reviews of the codebase to defend against OWASP Top 10 threats. 
 - IAM & Encryption: Manage complex Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles and ensure all sensitive data is encrypted both at rest and in transit. 
Qualifications

- 4-6 years of experience in backend engineering
 - Strong skills in: 
 - 
 - Python (Django)
 - Golang
 - Problem-solving and debugging
 - API development and database management
Good To Have

- Familiarity with DevOps practices (Docker, AWS, CI/CD)
 - Experience building scalable and distributed systems
 - Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently
 - Practical, solution-oriented thinker comfortable in fast-paced, low-process environments

Why Join Us?

Joining HeyMarvin as a Senior Software Engineer means being part of a high-growth, transparent, and empowering environment where your work has direct impact. You'll collaborate with talented teammates, work with modern technologies, and help build a world-class product at the intersection of AI, research, and enterprise software-while having the autonomy to shape both your role and the company's future. 

About The Team

You'll be joining a lean, high-performing team that values ownership, speed, and thoughtful execution. The team operates with minimal bureaucracy and emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and delivering meaningful outcomes. 

Compensation

₹30LPA, plus benefits.

data.title: Digital Manufacturing Engineer – Global Deployment
data.description:
Job Overview

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Digital Manufacturing Engineer - Global Deployment is responsible for driving Weatherford's global digital manufacturing transformation initiatives from the Baroda (Vadodara) facility, which serves as the organization's Digital Manufacturing Lighthouse. The role focuses on developing, piloting, validating, standardizing, and globally deploying advanced manufacturing solutions including MBOM governance, Model-Based Definition (MBD), Product Manufacturing Information (PMI), Creo CAM standardization, Oracle Fusion integration, Industry 4. 0 technologies, automation, machine vision, AI-assisted inspection, and RFID-enabled manufacturing processes. 

Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, RD&E, and Digital/IT teams, the position is responsible for establishing scalable digital manufacturing standards, improving manufacturing execution, enhancing product traceability, supporting compliance with API and ISO standards, and delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, productivity, cycle time, cost, and on-time delivery. The role also drives the replication of successful solutions across Weatherford's global manufacturing network through standardized deployment frameworks, governance models, training programs, and best-practice playbooks. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead digital manufacturing transformation initiatives and Industry 4. 0 programs across global manufacturing facilities. 
 - Own the creation, validation, maintenance, and governance of Manufacturing Bills of Material (MBOM) aligned with Engineering BOMs (EBOM). 
 - Define and standardize routings, digital work instructions, manufacturing processes, and control plans. 
 - Establish MBOM as the single source of truth for manufacturing execution, automation, and quality systems. 
 - Lead the standardization of PTC Creo CAM across all Weatherford manufacturing locations. 
 - Develop and maintain common machining templates, tool libraries, holder libraries, machine definitions, post-processors, and machining strategies. 
 - Establish CAM governance including NC program naming conventions, revision control, approval workflows, and release processes. 
 - Develop, deploy, and maintain Model-Based Definition (MBD) and Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) standards. 
 - Ensure inclusion of GD&T, tolerances, dimensions, datums, material specifications, heat treatment requirements, weld symbols, surface finish requirements, inspection characteristics, and manufacturing notes within 3D models. 
 - Align MBD and PMI practices with ASME Y14. 5, ASME Y14. 41, and applicable ISO standards. 
 - Drive digital thread implementation linking MBD, EBOM, MBOM, CAM, manufacturing execution, and quality processes. 
 - Lead deployment of automation, robotics, machine vision, AI-assisted inspection, and RFID-based inventory and WIP tracking systems. 
 - Integrate automation requirements into New Product Introduction (NPI) and technology transfer activities. 
 - Develop scalable automation architectures and deployment standards for global implementation. 
 - Use Baroda as the pilot location for validating digital manufacturing technologies and standards. 
 - Develop and maintain Baroda Digital Manufacturing Standards, governance models, templates, and replication playbooks. 
 - Coordinate implementation and rollout of proven solutions across global manufacturing facilities. 
 - Support plant teams remotely and onsite during deployment activities. 
 - Monitor adoption, standardization, and digital maturity across all manufacturing locations. 
 - Translate MBOM structures into Oracle Fusion Product Information Management (PIM) item structures. 
 - Configure work definitions, routings, work centers, resources, labor allocations, equipment assignments, and manufacturing master data within Oracle Fusion. 
 - Lead Engineering Change Order (ECO) implementation and revision control activities. 
 - Ensure data integrity across ERP, PLM, manufacturing, and quality systems. 
 - Ensure compliance with API Q1, ISO 9001, HSE requirements, product traceability standards, and corporate governance requirements. 
 - Validate digital and automation solutions against machine safety, cybersecurity, and operational requirements. 
 - Conduct Job Safety Analyses (JSA/JHA) prior to production implementation. 
 - Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, stakeholder communication, and risk mitigation activities. 
 - Develop business cases and ROI justifications for digital manufacturing and automation investments. 
 - Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and KPI reporting systems. 
 - Track and improve productivity, cycle time, throughput, labor efficiency, COPQ, scrap, rework, and on-time delivery performance. 
 - Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, RD&E, Sourcing, Operations, and Digital/IT functions. 
 - Develop training materials, knowledge repositories, and global best-practice documentation. 
 - Train engineers, programmers, and plant personnel on CAM, MBOM, MBD, and digital manufacturing standards. 
 - Champion digital manufacturing adoption and standardization across the organization's global manufacturing network. 

Skills

 - Manufacturing Process Engineering
 - MBOM, EBOM & Manufacturing Routings
 - PTC Creo & Creo NC/CAM Programming
 - CNC Machining (Turning & Milling)
 - Model-Based Definition (MBD) & PMI
 - GD&T (ASME Y14. 5) & ASME Y14. 41
 - Oracle Fusion Manufacturing Cloud & Oracle PIM

 - Manufacturing KPIs, Power BI & Analytics
 - Engineering Change Management (ECO)

 - Machine Vision, AI Inspection & RFID Tracking
 - Digital Thread & CAM Standardization
 - Project & Stakeholder Management

 - Change Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Global Manufacturing Deployments & Standardization
 - Strong Communication, Leadership & Problem-Solving Skills

Qualifications

data.title: Staff Software Engineer Cloud and AI
data.description:
Our Company: 

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You'll Do

We are looking for an exceptional Staff Cloud & AI Platform Engineer to own and independently build a next‐generation enterprise‐scale deployment and orchestration platform. This role goes far beyond traditional CI/CD or infrastructure automation-it sits at the intersection of distributed systems, control‐plane architecture, SRE principles, and applied AI/agentic workflows. 

- Contribute to the design and implementation of a stateful deployment control plane that treats deployments as a continuous convergence problem. 
 - Enable safe, resumable, deterministic, and SLO‐governed rollouts across multi‐cloud, on‐prem, and customer environments. 
 - Implement the practical application of AI agents in DevOps by embedding intelligent decision‐making into deployment workflows. 
 - Apply AI agents for anomaly detection, failure diagnosis, rollout control, and automated mitigation. 
 - Ensure all AI‐assisted workflows preserve correctness, determinism, and full auditability. 

This is a high‐impact individual contributor role requiring deep technical judgment, delivery ownership, and the ability to turn abstract design into production‐grade systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement a stateful deployment control plane with deterministic, resumable execution and rollback support. 
 - Build deployment workflows that reconcile desired vs. actual state using durable control loops. 
 - Support multi‐cloud, on‐prem, and customer environments with a single orchestration framework. 
 - Implement SLO‐governed promotion gates, error‐budget checks, and bounded retry policies. 
 - Enable deployment models including self‐service, wave‐based rollouts, blue‐green, managed updates, and maintenance windows. 
 - Define declarative, extensible workflow schemas with explicit dependencies, retries, and rollback semantics. 
 - Integrate deployment orchestration with CI/CD systems, artifact manifests, entitlement services, and downstream execution systems. 
 - Embed AI‐assisted decision logic into deployment workflows for anomaly detection, failure diagnosis, and rollout control. 
 - Ensure AI‐driven actions remain deterministic, auditable, reversible, and policy‐constrained. 
 - Develop infrastructure and automation frameworks using Terraform, Python, and cloud‐native services. 
 - Embed observability and telemetry into workflows to drive automated validation, retries, and rollback decisions. 
 - Provide hands‐on technical leadership, mentoring engineers and driving platform architecture across DevOps, SRE, and CloudOps teams. 

Who You'll Work With

This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with project team members and architects, and report to the Senior Engineering Manager. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or related field
 - 8+ years of hands‐on experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems. 
 - Proven experience developing and implementation of stateful systems such as control planes, workflow engines, or orchestration platforms. 
 - Experience building or operating enterprise‐scale deployment systems across multi‐cloud, hybrid, or on‐prem environments. 
 - Deep expertise in CI/CD, release engineering, and deployment strategies including wave‐based, blue‐green, and managed rollouts. 
 - Practical experience applying SRE principles such as SLOs, error budgets, promotion gates, and automated rollback. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, with the ability to build long‐running services and automation frameworks. 
 - Hands‐on experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform, and cloud‐native services (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP). 
 - Experience integrating observability and telemetry (metrics, logs, traces) into automated systems for decision‐making. 
 - Demonstrated experience building or integrating AI‐assisted or agentic workflows into DevOps or operational systems. 
 - Ability to design safe, auditable, policy‐constrained automation, especially when applying AI or autonomous decision logic. 
 - Strong technical judgment and communication skills, with experience leading architecture across teams as an individual contributor. 

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. 

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a hands-on engineer with strong systems programming and distributed systems experience to own significant features in the OCI PostgreSQL Data Plane. You will work on complex engineering problems involving database execution, concurrency, persistence, recovery, and failure handling. 

You will contribute to technical designs, implement production-quality software, and collaborate with control plane, storage, networking, and infrastructure teams. This role requires independent ownership of substantial work, sound engineering judgment, and a commitment to operating reliable services. 

Career Level: IC4

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, develop, test, and maintain PostgreSQL Data Plane components using C/C++ and other appropriate languages. 
 - Build and improve capabilities for replication, high availability, failover, backup and recovery, and database upgrades. 
 - Integrate PostgreSQL with OCI storage and infrastructure services, preserving data integrity and durability through failures. 
 - Analyze and optimize query execution, memory utilization, concurrency, and storage I/O performance. 
 - Develop database runtime and agent capabilities for configuration, patching, health monitoring, and lifecycle operations. 
 - Build automated tests, benchmarks, and fault-injection scenarios to validate correctness, scalability, and resilience. 
 - Investigate production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement lasting fixes. 
 - Improve observability, deployment safety, and operational procedures; participate in a rotating on-call schedule. 
 - Own features from design through production rollout, contribute to design and code reviews, and mentor other engineers. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including development of production systems software, databases, or distributed services. 
 - Strong proficiency in C/C++, including memory management, concurrency, multithreading, and debugging. 
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, and distributed systems fundamentals. 
 - Experience with Linux development, troubleshooting, profiling, and performance analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of database internals, including transactions, write-ahead logging, replication, storage, and recovery. 
 - Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with demonstrated ownership of complex engineering deliverables. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing or extending PostgreSQL, including extensions, replication, or storage integration. 
 - Experience with cloud-scale storage, consistency models, crash recovery, and highly available database architectures. 
 - Experience operating multi-tenant managed services and diagnosing performance or reliability issues at scale. 
 - Familiarity with Terraform and infrastructure automation for repeatable test and deployment environments.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer – Python, Robot Framework, Terraform, Virtualization, Proxmox, KVM & Cloud Infrastructure
data.description:
Senior QA Engineer - Python, Robot Framework, Terraform, Virtualization, Proxmox, KVM & Cloud Infrastructure

Exp - 5-6 years

CTC - 15 to 21LPA

We are looking for immediate joiner or 15 days or serving Notice candidates only. 

Job Description

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer with 5-6 years of software and infrastructure testing experience and hands-on expertise in virtualization and cloud technologies. 

In this role, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and readiness of the Cloud suite by validating it across hypervisor and container environments, along with related VM and cloud deployment workflows, through a balanced mix of manual testing and automated verification. 

Technical Skills at a Glance

Virtualization: Proxmox, KVM, VM provisioning, and lifecycle management

Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes (K8s), Huawei Cloud Container Engine (CCE), container deployment, and troubleshooting

Automation & IaC: Python, Robot Framework, Terraform, test automation frameworks

Cloud & Deployment: Cloud virtualization, manual & automated deployment, configuration, and teardown

Quality Engineering: Functional, integration, system, regression, performance, scale, reliability, upgrade, and recovery testing

Platforms & Tools: Linux, shell scripting, CI/CD pipelines, Git, container registries

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Comprehensive Test Execution: Plan and execute functional, integration, system, regression, performance, and reliability testing of the Cloud suite. 

Environment Validation: Validate the cloud suite across Proxmox/KVM hypervisors, virtual machines, Kubernetes (K8s), and container environments (including Huawei CCE). 

Workflow Testing: Test VM and container deployment, lifecycle management, system upgrades, storage integration, and recovery workflows across supported environments. 

Automation & Provisioning: Perform manual validation while building/maintaining test automation using Python and Robot Framework. Use Terraform to provision repeatable test beds. 

Infrastructure Debugging: Verify cloud virtualization and deployment workflows, reproduce defects, and troubleshoot complex issues across the full infrastructure stack. 

Defect Management & Reporting: Document test coverage, publish test execution results, report defects, assess release risks, and collaborate closely with cross-functional engineering teams to drive issues to resolution. 

Required Qualifications & Skillset

Experience: 5-6 years of dedicated QA experience in software, systems, or infrastructure testing. 

Virtualization: Strong hands-on experience with Proxmox and/or KVM, virtual machines, and complete VM lifecycle operations. 

Containers: Proven experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and container workflows. Hands-on experience with Huawei Cloud Container Engine (CCE) is a strong advantage. 

Automation: Proficiency in Python and Robot Framework for building and maintaining test suites. 

Infrastructure as Code: Practical hands-on experience using Terraform for environment provisioning. 

Testing Depth: Proven background testing cloud virtualization along with manual and automated deployment workflows. 

Soft Skills: Exceptional debugging, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.

Reporting to the Supplier Quality Manager, the Supplier Quality Analyst (SQA) executes activities aiming to ensure that all supplied components within their portfolio of suppliers are ready to use when reaching internal or external customers. The SQA is the primary quality contact for assigned suppliers and is responsible for supplier qualification, audits, performance monitoring, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Qualify and audit new and existing suppliers to Husky standards. 
 - Monitor supplier performance and drive improvement actions. 
 - Manage supplier part qualification activities. 
 - Support containment actions, root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation. 
 - Participate in Andon and Clinic activities related to supplier quality issues. 
 - Conduct quality risk assessments for localization and dual-sourcing initiatives. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Supply Chain Quality Management System. 

Critical Capabilities

- Strong knowledge of quality systems, supplier quality management, and auditing. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills using structured methodologies (8D, 5 Why, RCA). 
 - Ability to influence suppliers and drive corrective actions to closure. 
 - Understanding of manufacturing, assembly, and logistics processes. 
 - Strong analytical, project management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Willingness to travel domestically as required. 

Education, Experience & Qualifications

data.description:
Job Description

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

You will be responsible for the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and concept design to hardware/software engineering, simulation, testing, and commissioning. 

Project Engineering: 

- Lead end-to-end project engineering for high-current static generator excitation systems, from requirements review and concept development through detailed design, manufacturing support, FAT, site installation, and commissioning. 
 - Design excitation system electrical and mechanical layouts for high-current applications, typically in the 5, 000 A to 10, 000 A range, including cubicle arrangement, power circuit configuration, cooling provisions, and maintainability requirements. 
 - Perform sizing and selection of excitation system components, including transformers, rectifier bridges, thyristors/diodes, bus bars, disconnecting devices, breakers, protection devices, cooling equipment, controllers, I/O, and auxiliary power supplies. 
 - Develop and review electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, interconnection drawings, general arrangement drawings, BOMs, control logic, system architecture, and network topology documents. 
 - Engineer bus work and high-current power connections, including routing, clearance, creepage, thermal performance, short-circuit withstand, and manufacturability considerations. 
 - Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and system integrators to ensure the excitation system design is practical, cost-effective, manufacturable, and compliant with project specifications. 
 - Support manufacturing quality processes, including inspection plans, assembly reviews, test procedures, nonconformance resolution, and corrective actions for high-current excitation equipment. 
 - Implement control logic from SAMA diagrams, functional descriptions, and project-specific operating requirements. 
 - Configure and integrate communication protocols such as Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850, and DNP3, as applicable. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable IEEE, IEC, NEC, ISO, HSE, and regional grid code requirements. 
 - Manage complete project programs for high-current excitation systems, including engineering deliverables, technical risk, schedule alignment, manufacturing readiness, customer reviews, and cross-functional execution. 

Field Services:

Description

We are seeking a seasoned AI Software Stack Validation Leader to own end‐to‐end system validation, acceptance, and release readiness of a complex, multi‐layer AI software stack spanning frameworks, compilers, runtimes, drivers, firmware, and hardware platforms. The leader will build and scale a high‐impact validation team, architect modern validation infrastructure, and work cross‐functionally with architecture, platform, firmware, silicon, and customer engineering teams.

 - Frameworks / serving layers

 - Runtime, scheduling, memory management
 - Drivers, Firmware and hardware interfaces
 - Define system acceptance criteria that capture correctness, stability, performance, scalability, and regressions across layers. 
 - Drive left‐shifted validation, enabling meaningful coverage well before full hardware. 
 - Establish formal acceptance test plans and measurable exit criteria for each release milestone. 
 - Architect scalable validation environments and test frameworks
 - Drive best‐in‐class practices in automation, regression, stress, scale, and performance validation. 
 - Influence architecture decisions by providing early validation feedback and system risk assessment.

Qualifications

 - Deep expertise in debugging complex cross‐layer issues involving software, firmware, and hardware.

data.title: Principal DFT Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for a Principal HW DFT Engineer who will architect, implement, and validate in-vehicle networking devices as part of NXP's Automotive grade products. You will be responsible for advanced test strategies and implementation, verification and validation of pre/post tapeout of DFT features, overall test coverage improvements, and work closely with RTL and physical team on DFT timing constraints and closures. 

Main Job Tasks And Responsibilities

- Architecture & Strategy: Define and implement advanced DFT strategies, including Scan Architecture, JTAG, Memory BIST (MBIST), and Logic BIST (LBIST)
 - Implementation & Verification: Lead the integration of digital subsystems, perform scan insertion, and generate ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) patterns while ensuring high fault coverage. 
 - Silicon Support: Drive post-silicon validation and debug activities to root cause failures and improve manufacturing test efficiency. 
 - Collaboration: Coordinate with physical design and test engineering teams to ensure timing closure and that test patterns are operational immediately upon silicon arrival. 

Minimum Required Qualifications

- Education: B. S. /M. S. Electrical/Computer Engineering (or similar degrees)
 - Experience: Typically requires 10+ years of industry experience in SoC DFT implementation, verification, static timing closure, test coverage analysis and improvement, and silicon bring-up on ATE
 - Tool Expertise: Proficiency with industry-standard EDA tools from Mentor Graphics/Siemens (Tessent), Cadence, or Synopsys
 - Technical Skills: 
 - DFT - Scan insertion and architecture, ATPG: Proficiency in generating test vectors to detect manufacturing faults like stuck-at, transition, and advanced faults, Built-In Self-Test (BIST): Integration of Memory BIST (MBIST) for embedded SRAM/ROM and Logic BIST (LBIST) for autonomous logic testing, Boundary Scan & JTAG, Test Compression: Implementing techniques to reduce test data volume and application time, which is critical for large System-on-Chip (SoC) designs. 
 - Hardware Design & Implementation - HDL Proficiency: Strong command of Verilog or SystemVerilog for modifying RTL to insert test logic and writing test wrappers. Timing & Constraints: Knowledge of Static Timing Analysis (STA) and creating DFT-specific timing constraints (SDC files) to ensure test logic does not degrade functional performance. 
 - Verification & Debug - Simulation: Conducting gate-level simulations (GLS) and verifying DFT logic for correctness before fabrication. Post-Silicon Debug: Analyzing silicon data from Automated Test Equipment (ATE) to diagnose failures and improve manufacturing yield. 
 - Software & Tool Proficiency - EDA Tool Suites: Mastery of industry-standard tools such as Synopsys TestMAX/DFT Compiler, Mentor Graphics Tessent, and Cadence Modus. Scripting & Automation: Expertise in Tcl, Python, or Perl to automate test insertion flows, run simulations, and parse coverage reports.

Field Application Engineer - Robotics (Mumbai)

Join the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Based at our Mumbai factory, you will install, commission, program and troubleshoot robotic systems at customer sites: industrial robots, cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs. Our range includes Yasaka industrial robots, FAIRINO cobots, and new-age Unitree humanoid robots and robot dogs (quadrupeds). 

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. provides industrial automation, robotics, motion control, mechatronics and pneumatics solutions to OEMs and manufacturers across India. It is headquartered in Navi Mumbai and has offices across the country. 

What You Will Do

• Install, commission, program and troubleshoot robots, cobots and mobile robots at customer sites, including AMR/AGV mapping and navigation. 

• Install and commission AMRs (autonomous mobile robots) and AGVs (automated guided vehicles) at customer sites: mapping, navigation and route setup, fleet configuration, trial runs and handover. 

• Deliver pick-and-place, material handling, palletizing, welding and machine tending applications. 

• Integrate robots with PLC, HMI, servo, vision and other automation systems, and optimise cycle times. 

• Run demos, application trials and customer training. 

• Provide on-site service and support to keep customer operations running. 

• Prepare service and commissioning reports and technical documentation. 

• Work with the sales, design and project teams, and share field feedback with our in-house robot design team. 

Products You Will Work With

Yasaka industrial robots, FAIRINO cobots, and new-age Unitree humanoid robots and robot dogs (quadrupeds). 

What You Will Learn

Robot and cobot programming and integration; real applications in welding, handling, palletizing and machine tending; PLC/HMI/servo integration; project execution and troubleshooting; and AMR and mobile robot deployment. 

Must Have

• Diploma / BE / BTech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics or Automation. 

• 1-4 years in robotics, automation or field application engineering. 

• Basic industrial robot programming knowledge. 

• Strong troubleshooting, communication and customer-handling skills. 

• Willingness to travel to customer sites from the Mumbai base. 

Good to Have

• Knowledge of PLC, HMI, servo, sensors and industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP. 

• Hands-on experience with Yasaka, FAIRINO, Unitree or other industrial robots, cobots, humanoids or quadruped robots. 

• AMR/AGV fleet setup, mapping and navigation; ROS experience. 

• Machine vision, Python scripting or offline robot programming. 

What We Offer

Hands-on work with robots built in-house and with Yasaka, FAIRINO and Unitree platforms, including new-age humanoid robots and robot dogs, principal and OEM training and certifications, a clear path to Senior Application Engineer, Robotics Specialist or Field Application Manager roles, performance incentives, travel support as per policy, paid leave, and statutory benefits.

data.title: Senior Embedded Systems & IoT Engineer (ESP32 / Raspberry Pi)
data.description:
Location: Hyderabad, India (On-site)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 5+ Years

About the RoleWe are looking for a hands-on Senior Embedded Systems & IoT Engineer (Technical Lead) to own the end-to-end development and integration of our IoT ecosystem, spanning ESP32-based embedded systems, Raspberry Pi controllers, connected devices, and cloud infrastructure. The role involves firmware development, hardware debugging, device provisioning, secure OTA updates, system integration, and deployment of reliable connected products. 

You will lead the IoT engineering team while remaining deeply involved in hands-on engineering, working closely with hardware manufacturers and internal cloud, application, and product teams. From defining the IoT architecture and developing firmware to troubleshooting PCBs, integrating electronics, and managing device fleets in production, you will take ownership of the complete IoT engineering lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities1. IoT Architecture & Technical Leadership
 - Own the end-to-end IoT architecture, including cloud services, Control Core, Raspberry Pi-based local master, microcontrollers, connected devices, and peripherals. 
 - Define the architecture and communication mechanisms between cloud systems, local controllers, ESP32 boards, and connected devices. 
 - Lead and mentor the IoT engineering team, including firmware, device integration, and test engineers. 
 - Set technical priorities, review firmware and integration code, and ensure timely delivery of engineering milestones. 
 - Work closely with cloud, mobile application, and product teams to define device APIs, integration standards, and system interfaces. 
 - Drive technical decisions around reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability of the IoT ecosystem. 2. Embedded Firmware Development
 - Develop, modify, maintain, and optimize embedded firmware using C/C++ for ESP32, ESP32-S3, and other microcontroller platforms. 
 - Work with ESP-IDF, Arduino, or PlatformIO for firmware development and debugging. 
 - Implement GPIO control, PWM, UART, I2C, SPI, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and Ethernet connectivity (W5500). 
 - Develop firmware for controlling smart locks, LED lighting, fans, motors, relays, load switches, sensors, displays, and other peripherals. 
 - Implement watchdogs, brown-out detection, fault handling, and recovery mechanisms to ensure reliable device operation. 
 - Manage firmware flashing, configuration, versioning, releases, and testing records. 
 - Debug firmware issues independently and coordinate with the engineering team to resolve complex hardware-software integration problems. 3. Raspberry Pi & Linux System Integration
 - Set up, configure, and maintain Raspberry Pi 5-based controllers running Linux. 
 - Develop and maintain local master services and device integration scripts using Python and/or Node. js. 
 - Integrate GPIO, HAT peripherals, motor drivers, displays, cameras, audio/video equipment, and other connected hardware. 
 - Establish reliable communication between Raspberry Pi controllers, ESP32 boards, and connected peripherals. 
 - Implement local control, device coordination, offline operation, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Troubleshoot Linux, hardware drivers, peripheral connectivity, and system-level integration issues. 4. Hardware Testing & Electronics Troubleshooting
 - Inspect, validate, and functionally test PCBs received from contract manufacturers and hardware vendors. 
 - Identify manufacturing defects, component failures, power supply issues, GPIO faults, communication problems, and wiring defects. 
 - Read and interpret circuit diagrams, schematics, PCB layouts, and component datasheets. 
 - Troubleshoot electronics at board and component level using multimeters, bench power supplies, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. 
 - Validate communication interfaces, sensors, actuators, connectors, and power systems. 
 - Coordinate with hardware manufacturers to resolve PCB design and production issues. 
 - Define repeatable board-level testing procedures, acceptance criteria, and quality-control processes. 5. Device Provisioning, Security & OTA Updates
 - Develop and maintain factory flashing and device provisioning workflows. 
 - Implement device identity, authentication, registration, and pod-binding mechanisms using claim codes, tokens, and device credentials. 
 - Manage firmware signing keys and secure device provisioning. 
 - Implement secure OTA firmware updates, including firmware validation, version management, and rollback mechanisms. 
 - Work with security mechanisms such as TLS, device certificates, secure boot, and signed firmware. 
 - Ensure secure communication between devices, local controllers, and cloud services. 6. IoT Cloud Connectivity & Fleet Management
 - Implement device-to-cloud communication using MQTT, HTTP/REST APIs, WebSockets, and other relevant IoT protocols. 
 - Integrate embedded devices with cloud services and backend APIs. 
 - Develop and maintain telemetry, device heartbeats, status reporting, and remote diagnostics. 
 - Implement fleet monitoring, alerting, logging, and device health management for deployments across multiple locations. 
 - Design mechanisms for handling network failures, offline operation, reconnection, and synchronization. 
 - Collaborate with cloud and application teams on device APIs and the Nova SDK, including door unlock, administrator device control, and kiosk status integrations. 7. Product Assembly & System Integration
 - Assemble and integrate PCBs, sensors, displays, motors, cables, connectors, power supplies, and electronic components into the final physical product. 
 - Perform wiring, cable harness assembly, connector termination, soldering, and cable management. 
 - Integrate smart locks, LED lighting, fans, camera shutters, screens, and other electronic subsystems. 
 - Validate communication and coordination across the complete electronic system. 
 - Perform end-to-end product testing and troubleshoot issues across firmware, hardware, power, wiring, and software integration. 
 - Ensure every assembled product meets functional, reliability, and quality requirements before deployment. 8. Manufacturing, Testing & Documentation
 - Work closely with contract manufacturers and board vendors on hardware bring-up, production testing, and quality assurance. 
 - Define test plans, acceptance criteria, and repeatable end-of-line testing procedures for every board and complete product unit. 
 - Coordinate factory flashing, firmware upgrades, hardware validation, and production releases. 
 - Maintain firmware release records, hardware revisions, test reports, and manufacturing documentation. 
 - Prepare technical architecture diagrams, wiring diagrams, troubleshooting guides, operational runbooks, and engineering handover documents. 
 - Support product deployment, field troubleshooting, and continuous improvement based on operational feedback. Required Skills & Experience
 - 5+ years of experience in embedded systems, IoT product development, electronics engineering, or connected hardware products. 
 - At least 2 years of experience leading or mentoring engineers in a technical capacity. 
 - Strong hands-on experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ for ESP32, ESP32-S3, or similar microcontrollers. 
 - Good understanding of ESP-IDF, Arduino framework, or PlatformIO. 
 - Strong understanding of GPIO, UART, I2C, SPI, PWM, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and Ethernet. 
 - Practical experience with Raspberry Pi and Linux-based embedded systems. 
 - Working knowledge of Python and/or Node. js for device services, scripting, and hardware integration. 
 - Experience with IoT communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/REST, WebSockets, and TLS. 
 - Hands-on experience with OTA updates, device provisioning, firmware version management, and device authentication. 
 - Strong understanding of electronics, circuit diagrams, schematics, PCB layouts, and component-level troubleshooting. 
 - Practical experience using multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and bench power supplies. 
 - Hands-on experience with soldering, wiring, connectors, cable harnesses, and electronic product assembly. 
 - Experience integrating microcontrollers, sensors, actuators, displays, motors, and other peripherals into complete products. 
 - Experience working with hardware manufacturers, contract manufacturers, or PCB vendors. 
 - Strong debugging, problem-solving, technical ownership, and team coordination skills. 
 - Good written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams in India and the USA. 
 - Familiarity with Git and firmware development workflows. Good to Have
 - Experience with STM32, Nordic nRF, RP2040, or other embedded microcontroller platforms. 
 - Experience with ESP32-S3, W5500 Ethernet modules, and custom PCB development. 
 - Experience with secure boot, firmware signing, hardware security keys, and device certificates. 
 - Experience managing large-scale IoT device fleets across multiple locations. 
 - Experience with smart locks, access-control systems, kiosks, or commercial AV equipment. 
 - Familiarity with HDMI switching, cameras, audio systems, and display integration. 
 - Experience with Android Device Owner, Android kiosk mode, or dedicated-device management. 
 - Experience with motor drivers, relays, power electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems. 
 - Experience taking connected hardware products from prototype to manufacturing and field deployment. 
 - Experience building consumer electronics, smart devices, appliances, or other physical IoT products.

The role leads the design and execution of a modern AWS Native Lakehouse platform, ensuring secure, high performance, and self-service access to trusted data across the organization. Platform Strategy

 - Establish scalable, reusable data platform patterns and standards
 - Drive migration from legacy Microsoft based data platforms

Stakeholder Engagement

Qualifications & Experience

 - Athena, Redshift, or similar query engines

The Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) provides a centralized, governed, high performance data foundation built on an AWS native lakehouse architecture. It enables scalable data ingestion, secure data sharing, enterprise-wide data discovery, and flexible analytics consumption across tools and domains.
