data.title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle. 

The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes. 

The ideal candidate is a hands-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data-intensive solutions for regulated or asset-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities. 
 - Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long-term platform direction. 
 - Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans. 
 - Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI. 
 - Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting. 
 - Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers' physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows. 
 - Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer-specific systems of record. 
 - Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption. 
 - Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency. 
 - Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity. 
 - Establish outcome-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact. 
 - Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service-level objectives, and operational readiness. 
 - Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes. 
 - Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness. 
 - Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer-focused engineering culture. 
 - Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required. 
 - Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices. 

First 6-12 Months

The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer-facing teams to confirm the highest-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan. 

Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest-value Unify Energy capabilities.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Principal Software Engineer to lead the design and development of highly scalable, low-latency buy-side ad tech systems. This role is ideal for someone with deep expertise in Golang, real-time bidding systems, and campaign pacing and optimization algorithms, with strong exposure to DSP / performance advertising domains. 

As a technical leader, you will own critical components of the bidding and optimization stack, influence system architecture, mentor senior and junior engineers, and work closely with product, ML, and data teams to drive measurable performance outcomes across large-scale advertising campaigns.

 - Own core systems for deal execution, auction participation, bid shading, and supply path optimization.

- Eight plus years of software engineering experience, with significant depth in ad tech / performance advertising/Building DSP bidder (Buy side).

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. 

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

data.description:
Job Title: Production & Quality Manager (Agro-Processing: Rice, Dal, & Flour Mills)

Location: Rai, Sonipat Haryana

Experience Level: 8-10 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Production & Quality Manager with 8 to 10 years of hands-on experience in agro-processing operations, specifically across rice mills, dal (pulse) mills, and flour (atta/maida) mills. 

In this dual-responsibility leadership role, you will oversee end-to-end plant operations, optimizing daily production yield, reducing downtime, ensuring strict adherence to quality assurance (QA/QC) standards, and managing food safety protocols (FSSAI, ISO, HACCP). 

Key Responsibilities

1. Production & Operational Management

- Oversee daily production targets and processing capacity for rice milling (cleaning, parboiling, husking, polishing, sorting), dal processing (dehulling, splitting, polishing), and flour milling (cleaning, conditioning, roller milling, sifting). 
 - Plan and execute production schedules to meet sales demands while optimizing machine efficiency and yield recovery rates. 
 - Monitor raw material intake (paddy, raw pulses, wheat) and manage yield loss/wastage at each processing stage. 
 - Lead preventive and predictive maintenance schedules for mill machinery (sorters, destoners, hullers, roller mills, plan sifters, dryers, and automated packaging lines) to minimize operational downtime. 
 - Drive continuous improvement (Kaizen/Lean principles) to lower energy consumption, operational costs, and processing losses. 2. Quality Assurance & Quality Control (QA/QC)

- Develop, implement, and maintain Quality Management Systems (QMS) across raw material receiving, in-process milling, and finished product packaging. 
 - Perform grading, moisture testing, grain inspection, purity checks, foreign matter identification, and milling recovery tests. 
 - Ensure strict adherence to food safety standards, hygienic manufacturing practices (GMP), and sanitation protocols (FSSAI, HACCP, ISO 22000).

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 2-5 years of experience in electrical system integration, validation, testing, or qualification. 
 - Strong understanding of electrical schematics, wiring, connectors, PCB assemblies, and embedded electronic systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with electrical test equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power analyzers, signal generators, insulation resistance testers, and data acquisition systems. 
 - Experience in troubleshooting complex electrical and electronic systems. 
 - Familiarity with defence, aerospace, robotics, automotive, marine, or industrial embedded systems is preferred. 
 - Exposure to environmental qualification and EMI/EMC testing will be an advantage.

data.description:
Overview

Jira Platform

Vision

Jira Platform will enable Jira to become the trusted, agent-native system of record and control plane for human and agent teamwork at enterprise scale. 

To Turn This Vision Into Reality, We Propose To Focus On The Three Forces We Believe Will Work Together To Create The Flywheel That Will Be Jira Platform, Helping Drive The Engine That Is Jira

AI TRANSFORMATION: Make Jira the agent‐native system of record and control plane for human+AI teamwork. 

ENTERPRISE READINESS Continue to invest in Enterprise features, and take advantage of the limited-time window due to Project Ascend to bring the world's largest and most demanding enterprises into the Cloud

EFFICIENCY As the underlying platform serving Jira cloud customers, and a growing agentic workload, we need to provide a platform that has sound unit economics, accelerates developer productivity, and delivers world-class reliability. 

Your future team

Jira Scalable Issue Search (JSIS) is a foundational investment in Jira platform, moving structured searches from a database-backed engine to OpenSearch. Operating at approximately 3 billion requests per day, JSIS is one of Atlassian's largest services. Its multi-tenant, distributed architecture positions search to deliver the performance and scale customers expect as Jira grows. 

More than 50 engineers across India and Europe, working alongside product managers, are driving this transformation. At JSIS's scale, every release can affect customers across geographies, making reliability, performance, and customer impact central to the team's decisions. This combination of technical depth and product focus gives the team the capacity to address adoption barriers while improving the search experience. 

The long-term opportunity extends beyond search: JSIS will provide the foundation for federated search across Jira portfolios and, ultimately, a shared search capability across Atlassian products. Building for that future will position the platform to support new search experiences and the higher request volumes anticipated from agentic APIs-turning today's architectural migration into a strategic advantage for the broader ecosystem.

data.title: Manager – SMS E&I
data.company: SHRI MAHAVIR FERRO ALLOYS PRIVATE LIMITED
data.description:
Location: Kalunga, Rourkela, Odisha

Department: SMS - Electrical & Instrumentation

Designation: Manager - SMS Electrical & Instrumentation

Experience: 12-15 Years

Qualification: B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical / Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering

Employment Information: The position is with Envirocare Infrasolution Private Limited, a subsidiary of Shri Mahavir Ferro Alloys Private Limited. While Shri Mahavir Ferro Alloys Private Limited is the parent/group company, all recruitment, employment, payroll, and related HR processes for this role will be managed by Envirocare Infrasolution Private Limited. 

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and technically competent Manager - SMS Electrical & Instrumentation to lead electrical maintenance, instrumentation, automation, and control system activities in the Steel Melting Shop (SMS). The role involves ensuring reliable operation of SMS equipment, minimizing electrical and instrumentation breakdowns, optimizing maintenance practices, and supporting uninterrupted steel production. 

The position will be responsible for planning and executing preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance, managing electrical and instrumentation teams, ensuring equipment reliability, and implementing automation and process control improvements. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in electrical and instrumentation maintenance of SMS equipment, particularly induction furnaces, ladle refining furnaces, continuous casting machines, and associated auxiliary systems. 

Key Responsibilities

A. Electrical Maintenance & Equipment Management

- Oversee electrical maintenance of SMS equipment, including induction furnaces, LF, CCM, EOT cranes, cooling systems, and auxiliary equipment. 
 - Ensure reliable operation of HT/LT systems, transformers, motors, MCCs, PCCs, VFDs, and electrical distribution networks. 
 - Plan and execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities. 
 - Monitor electrical equipment performance and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime. B. Instrumentation & Automation

- Oversee maintenance of PLC, SCADA, HMI, sensors, transmitters, control panels, and automation systems. 
 - Ensure reliable functioning of temperature, pressure, flow, level, and other process measurement instruments. 
 - Monitor and troubleshoot automation systems, control loops, interlocks, and process instrumentation. 
 - Coordinate with OEMs and technical teams for automation upgrades and system improvements. C. Maintenance Planning & Shutdown Management

- Prepare preventive maintenance schedules and annual maintenance plans. 
 - Plan and execute electrical and instrumentation maintenance during scheduled shutdowns. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis of recurring failures and implement reliability improvement measures. 
 - Monitor critical spares, maintenance budgets, and inventory requirements. D. Team Management & Safety

- Lead and supervise electrical and instrumentation engineers, supervisors, technicians, and contractors. 
 - Ensure compliance with electrical safety procedures, LOTO, work permits, and statutory requirements. 
 - Conduct technical training and improve team competency. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable IMS, ISO, and EHS requirements. E. Performance Monitoring & Reporting

- Monitor equipment availability, breakdown frequency, and maintenance costs. 
 - Maintain electrical and instrumentation maintenance records and performance reports. 
 - Identify opportunities for improving equipment reliability, automation, and energy efficiency. 
 - Coordinate with SMS Operations, Mechanical, and other departments for smooth production activities. 

Key Performance Expectations

- Ensure high availability and reliability of SMS electrical and instrumentation equipment. 
 - Minimize electrical, instrumentation, and automation-related breakdowns. 
 - Ensure timely execution of preventive and predictive maintenance schedules. 
 - Maintain reliable operation of PLC, SCADA, VFDs, electrical drives, and instrumentation systems. 
 - Reduce equipment downtime through effective troubleshooting and root cause analysis. 
 - Ensure timely execution of shutdowns and major maintenance activities. 
 - Optimize maintenance costs and critical spare inventory. 
 - Ensure compliance with electrical safety standards and applicable statutory requirements. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical / Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering. 
 - 12-15 years of experience in electrical and instrumentation maintenance within the steel manufacturing industry. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in SMS electrical and instrumentation maintenance. 
 - In-depth knowledge of induction furnaces, ladle refining furnaces, continuous casting machines (CCM), and associated auxiliary systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of HT/LT systems, transformers, motors, MCCs, PCCs, VFDs, and electrical protection systems. 
 - Practical experience in PLC, SCADA, HMI, automation systems, sensors, transmitters, and process instrumentation. 
 - Knowledge of control circuits, interlocks, drives, and industrial communication systems. 
 - Experience in preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance practices. 
 - Experience in shutdown planning, commissioning, troubleshooting, and equipment reliability improvement. 
 - Knowledge of electrical safety, LOTO, earthing, and statutory compliance requirements. 
 - Experience in team handling, contractor management, and maintenance cost control. 
 - Good analytical, problem-solving, leadership, and coordination skills. 

Preferred Experience: 

- Candidates with 12-15 years of experience in SMS Electrical & Instrumentation maintenance in integrated steel plants will be preferred. 
 - Experience in induction furnace, LF, CCM, EOT crane electrical systems, and industrial automation. 
 - Candidates with proven experience in PLC/SCADA systems, VFDs, electrical troubleshooting, and maintenance team management will be given preference.

data.description:
HMI Software Lead Developer- UAV Ground Control Systems (VC++, MFC, Win32)

Location: Hyderabad, India (On-site)

About the Role

We are seeking a highly technical and hands-on Software Lead to take ownership of our core Ground Control Station (GCS) and mission planning applications. In the mission-critical UAV sector, our ground control software acts as the central nervous system for flight operations, telemetry monitoring, and payload management. You will lead a dedicated engineering pod to architect, modernize, and scale our Windows-based applications, ensuring rock-solid reliability for complex flight profiles. 

What You Will Do

- Technical Leadership: Lead the architecture, design, and development of high-performance desktop applications used for UAV mission planning, live telemetry tracking, and payload control. 
 - Core Development: Write, review, and optimize complex multithreaded code using VC++, MFC, and Win32 APIs for Windows environments. 
 - Team Mentorship: Guide a team of software engineers, enforcing rigorous code quality, memory management practices, and peer review standards. 
 - Systems Integration: Interface ground software with UAV flight controllers and communication links using protocols like MAVLink, UDP/TCP, and custom serial interfaces. 
 - Safety & Compliance: Champion aerospace software standards (such as DO-178C guidelines where applicable) to ensure mission-critical reliability and fault tolerance. 
 - Legacy Modernization: Strategically decouple and refactor legacy MFC codebases into modular architectures to support future cross-platform or UI/UX scaling. 

What You Bring

- Experience: 6+ years of hands-on software development with a minimum of 2+ years in a technical leadership or team lead capacity. 
 - Core Stack: Deep, uncompromising expertise in C++, VC++, Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC), and Win32 API. 
 - Concurrency: Strong command of multithreading, asynchronous I/O, IPC, and memory leak profiling in a Windows environment. 
 - Networking: Proven experience with network socket programming (TCP/UDP) for real-time, low-latency data streaming. 
 - Problem Solving: Exceptional debugging skills using Visual Studio tools, WinDbg, and performance profilers. 

- Standout Qualifications (Nice to Have)Prior experience in the aerospace, defense, or UAV industry developing GCS or avionics software. 
 - Familiarity with geographic information systems (GIS), map rendering (GDAL, QtLocation), or 3D rendering (OpenGL/DirectX). 
 - Knowledge of aerospace safety-critical verification processes (DO-178C, DO-330). 

Why Join Us?

You will be directly influencing the software that commands next-generation unmanned aerial systems. We offer a culture of high engineering rigor, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to build products that solve real-world logistical and defense challenges.

Apply job here on LinkedIN. OR

data.title: Manager - Quality Management System (QMS)
data.description:
VACANCY FOR

MANAGER - QMS (Quality Management System and Process Owner)

Company Description: 

Established in 2009, Revata Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturer of high-performance elastomers, sealing solutions, precision-machined components and oilfield products, serving customers primarily in the oil and gas sector. The company's head office and manufacturing facility are located at M. I. D. C. , Bhosari, Pune. Revata is certified to ISO 9001: 2015 and operates its own NABL-accredited material testing laboratory. 

Role Description: 

We are seeking an experienced Manager - QMS to take complete ownership of the company's Quality Management System. The incumbent will build the QMS around the actual flow of an order, from enquiry and contract review through purchase, production and inspection to dispatch. This includes defining what information each department receives, records and hands over, so that orders move through the plant without delays and every failure can be traced to its root cause. 

A key objective of the role is to take the company through API Spec Q1 certification. The role covers the design, implementation and maintenance of the QMS in line with API Spec Q1 and ISO 9001: 2015, including processes, SOPs, forms and formats, internal and external audits, customer QMS requirements and root cause analysis of nonconformities. The position reports to the Director, Operations & Technology, with direct access to the Managing Director on audit results, customer nonconformities and management review. Product inspection and release will continue to be handled by the QC team. 

This is a hands-on role that requires close interaction with all departments and a regular presence on the shop floor. 

Key Responsibilities: 

·            Own and maintain the company-wide QMS in accordance with API Spec Q1 and ISO 9001: 2015, and drive its continual improvement. 

·            Lead the company to API Spec Q1 certification, including the gap assessment against the 10th Edition, the implementation plan and timeline, internal readiness audits and the certification audit. 

·            Map the end-to-end business process from enquiry to dispatch, covering contract review, engineering, planning, purchase, stores, production, inspection and dispatch, and define clear inputs, outputs and responsibilities at each interface between departments. 

·            Prepare and maintain all QMS documentation, including system procedures, work instructions, SOPs, master lists, forms and formats, and ensure they are practical and easy to use on the shop floor. 

·            Establish and manage document and record control, including numbering, revision, approval, distribution, control of obsolete documents and record retention as per API Spec Q1. 

·            Define ownership for every procedure, form and record, and conduct training for each department on its applicable documents. 

·            Ensure contract review is carried out for every purchase order, and establish order-level quality planning, including inspection and test plans, material traceability and the documentation package issued by QC (inspection reports, material certificates and certificates of conformance). 

·            Manage the nonconformance and CAPA system across all departments, lead cross-functional root cause analysis (8D, 5 Why, fishbone) and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions before closure. 

·            Handle customer audits and respond to customer complaints and QMS nonconformities with root cause and corrective action reports within agreed timelines, including completion of customer supplier-qualification questionnaires. 

·            Plan, coordinate and face ISO 9001: 2015 surveillance and recertification audits, as well as API Spec Q1 audits once certification is achieved, and ensure timely closure of all findings. 

·            Plan and conduct internal audits as per the annual audit schedule, ensuring auditor independence. 

·            Prepare inputs for management review, conduct the review with the Managing Director and track action items to closure. 

·            Establish and maintain the risk assessment, contingency planning and management of change (MOC) processes as required by API Spec Q1. 

·            Work with Purchase on supplier evaluation and approval, maintenance of the approved supplier list, supplier performance monitoring and supplier corrective action requests. 

·            Ensure calibration, preventive maintenance, training and competency records are maintained by the respective departments as per the QMS. 

·            Define quality objectives and present a monthly QMS performance report covering nonconformities, CAPA status, customer complaints, audit findings, on-time delivery and cost of poor quality. 

·            Support the ERP implementation team in moving QMS forms and records onto the ERP platform. 

·            Coordinate with the NABL-accredited laboratory, which operates under ISO/IEC 17025, to ensure clear interfaces between the laboratory and the QMS. 

·            Raise nonconformities against any department where required and escalate unresolved issues to the Managing Director. 

Who Should Apply: 

Candidates who have independently established or restructured a QMS in a manufacturing organization under API Spec Q1, IATF 16949 or ISO 9001: 2015, and led it through certification and customer audits. The candidate should have experience in defining cross-functional processes and preparing procedures and formats that are used across departments. 

Experience in a make-to-order, low-volume, high-mix manufacturing environment such as oilfield equipment, valves, sealing products, forgings or precision machining will be preferred. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to present sample procedures or formats prepared by them, with confidential information removed. 

Must Have Qualifications: 

BE / BTech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial or Polymer Engineering, or equivalent. 

10 to 15 years of experience in manufacturing quality, with at least 5 years in a role responsible for the company's QMS. 

Proven experience in establishing a QMS from scratch or restructuring an existing one within the last seven years, including leading the certification audit. 

Has led, or played a key role in, taking an organization through API Spec Q1 or IATF 16949 certification, along with hands-on experience in implementing ISO 9001: 2015. 

Experience in facing customer audits and responding to customer complaints and nonconformities through 8D / CAPA reports. 

Strong skills in process mapping and preparation of QMS documentation. 

Internal auditor training in ISO 9001: 2015, API Spec Q1 or IATF 16949. 

Working knowledge of root cause analysis tools, FMEA and control plans. 

Proficiency in MS Excel for tracking and analysis of quality data. 

Ability to communicate in Marathi or Hindi with shop floor staff, and good written and spoken English for customer communication and documentation. 

Optional / Preferred Qualifications: 

Experience in oilfield equipment, valves, wellhead equipment, elastomer seals, forgings or precision machining industries. 

Experience as Management Representative or Deputy Management Representative for API Spec Q1. 

Experience with API Spec Q1 10th Edition certification, or exposure to the API Monogram Program. 

Lead Auditor certification in ISO 9001: 2015, API Spec Q1 or IATF 16949. 

Exposure to customer-specific QMS requirements of oil and gas operators or OEMs. 

Experience in implementing an ERP-based or digital QMS. 

Exposure to NABL / ISO/IEC 17025 laboratory systems. 

Location: M. I. D. C. , Bhosari, Pune - 411026

Office Timings: Monday - Saturday (8: 30 AM to 5: 30 PM)

Remuneration: CTC will be as per industry standard. 

Interested candidates, please email your resume to revata. hr@gmail. com. 

PLEASE DO NOT CALL THE COMPANY MAINLINE AS NO RECRUITMENT-RELATED CALLS WILL BE ENTERTAINED.

data.title: VP, Engineering
data.description:
We're looking for a VP, Engineering This role is Office Based, Hyderabad Office

Vice President, Engineering

Cornerstone OnDemand | Executive Leadership | Remote-Flexible

About Cornerstone

Cornerstone helps organizations unlock the potential of their people through technology, content, expertise and specialized focus. Its solutions span learning, talent management, performance, recruiting and workforce development, serving millions of users across thousands of organizations worldwide. 

Cornerstone is embarking on a transformative journey to build WorkforceOS, a next-generation, AI-native Human Capital Management (HCM) platform that unifies the employee lifecycle into a single, intelligent operating system for the modern workforce. 

WorkforceOS will connect employee data, skills intelligence, learning, performance, talent and workforce capabilities to help organizations make smarter workforce decisions, develop their people and build the capabilities needed for the future. 

About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Vice President, Engineering to be a founding member of the WorkforceOS leadership team. 

This is an opportunity to define and build the technology foundation for a next-generation enterprise HCM platform. You will own the end-to-end engineering strategy, technical vision, architecture and execution for WorkforceOS, building a scalable, secure, resilient and AI-native platform that can serve global enterprise customers. 

You will have end-to-end ownership of the WorkforceOS engineering organization and technology architecture, with the autonomy to make key technology decisions and establish the engineering practices needed to build and scale the platform. You will partner with Cornerstone's centralized platform teams and engineering organizations across business lines to leverage shared capabilities, drive interoperability and ensure alignment with enterprise technology standards. 

A key aspect of this role will be balancing greenfield platform development with the modernization and reuse of existing Cornerstone technology and capabilities. You will also lead the technology strategy for transitioning customers from legacy HCM platforms to WorkforceOS, ensuring seamless migrations with minimal customer disruption, effort and business impact. 

You will build and lead a world-class global engineering organization spanning application engineering, platform engineering, AI/ML, data engineering, quality engineering, infrastructure and reliability engineering. 

Working in close partnership with Product Management, Design, Data Science and the broader Cornerstone technology organization, you will translate product vision into an exceptional technology platform and customer experience. 

This role requires a strong technology leader who combines architectural depth, engineering excellence, operational discipline and the ability to build and scale high-performing engineering organizations. 

In this role you will. . . 

- Technology Vision & Architecture
 - Define and own the technology vision, engineering strategy and end-to-end architectural direction for WorkforceOS. 
 - Architect and build a modern, cloud-native, API-first and AI-native enterprise HCM platform designed for global scale. 
 - Establish a modular, extensible and interoperable architecture that supports multiple HCM capabilities while enabling a unified employee and administrator experience. 
 - Own architecture decisions across application services, platform services, data architecture, integration frameworks and shared capabilities. 
 - Establish platform foundations that enable rapid product innovation, extensibility, configuration and customization without compromising upgradeability or maintainability. 
 - Drive a balanced technology strategy that leverages and modernizes existing Cornerstone capabilities while introducing new technology and architectural foundations where needed. 
 - Ensure seamless integration with Cornerstone's existing products, enterprise ecosystem and third-party platforms. 
 - Drive technology choices and architectural trade-offs that balance speed to market, scalability, cost efficiency, reliability and long-term maintainability. 
 - Establish architecture standards, design principles, technical governance and engineering best practices for WorkforceOS. 
 - Partner with centralized platform engineering and architecture teams to leverage shared infrastructure and services, drive interoperability and align with enterprise-wide technology standards, while retaining end-to-end ownership of WorkforceOS architecture. 
 - AI-Native Engineering & Innovation
 - Lead the engineering strategy for building AI-native capabilities into WorkforceOS. 
 - Establish the technical foundations for intelligent agents, AI-powered workflows, predictive intelligence, skills inference and personalized experiences. 
 - Drive the integration of large language models, machine learning, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic AI capabilities into enterprise workflows. 
 - Build secure and scalable AI infrastructure, including model orchestration, evaluation frameworks, observability, governance and cost management. 
 - Establish standards for responsible AI, data privacy, security, explainability and human oversight. 
 - Partner with Product Management and Data Science to identify and accelerate opportunities where AI can fundamentally simplify workflows and create differentiated customer value. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-assisted software engineering and modern developer tools to improve engineering productivity, quality and speed. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and translate relevant innovations into competitive platform capabilities. 
 - Engineering Execution & Delivery Excellence
 - Own end-to-end engineering execution and delivery of the WorkforceOS product roadmap. 
 - Establish a high-performance engineering operating model that enables predictable delivery, rapid iteration and continuous innovation. 
 - Partner closely with Product Management to translate product strategy into executable technical plans, milestones and delivery commitments. 
 - Drive engineering productivity through modern development practices, automation, developer platforms and AI-assisted software engineering. 
 - Establish strong engineering disciplines across architecture and design reviews, code quality, testing, continuous integration, continuous delivery and release management. 
 - Drive a culture of engineering ownership, accountability and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure engineering teams can deliver at speed without compromising quality, security or architectural integrity. 
 - Establish appropriate engineering metrics to measure delivery predictability, productivity, quality and customer impact. 
 - Continuously improve engineering effectiveness through automation, standardization, simplification and adoption of modern development practices. 
 - Platform Reliability, Security & Operational Excellence
 - Own the reliability, availability, scalability, performance and operational excellence of the WorkforceOS platform. 
 - Build a secure-by-design platform that meets the requirements of large, complex global enterprises. 
 - Establish robust practices for identity and access management, data protection, encryption, tenant isolation and regulatory compliance. 
 - Drive observability, incident management, disaster recovery, business continuity and service-level objectives. 
 - Ensure the platform is designed for high availability, resilience and predictable performance across global markets. 
 - Establish effective DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and platform engineering capabilities. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in cloud infrastructure efficiency, platform performance and total cost of ownership. 
 - Ensure enterprise-grade security, privacy and compliance requirements are addressed in partnership with Cornerstone's central security and compliance organizations. 
 - Data & Integration Architecture
 - Define the data architecture and engineering foundations that enable a unified workforce data model across WorkforceOS. 
 - Establish robust data ingestion, processing, storage and integration capabilities to support real-time and analytical workloads. 
 - Enable a consistent and extensible data foundation for employee records, organizational structures, skills intelligence, talent and workforce insights. 
 - Drive the development of enterprise APIs, event-driven architecture and integration frameworks. 
 - Ensure seamless connectivity with HRIS, payroll, ERP, identity management and other enterprise systems. 
 - Enable secure data access and interoperability across Cornerstone products and third-party ecosystems. 
 - Partner with Product and Data Science to establish the data foundations needed for AI, analytics and intelligent decision-making. 
 - Establish data governance, quality, lineage and lifecycle management practices that support enterprise-grade workforce data. 
 - Customer Migration & Platform Transformation 
 - Own the engineering strategy and technical execution for transitioning customers from Cornerstone's legacy HCM platforms to WorkforceOS. 
 - Design scalable, repeatable and highly automated migration frameworks that enable seamless customer transitions with minimal customer effort and business disruption. 
 - Develop strategies for data migration, transformation, validation and reconciliation, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, security and continuity throughout the migration lifecycle. 
 - Establish migration tooling, automation, compatibility frameworks and processes that accelerate customer onboarding and reduce migration costs. 
 - Design phased migration, coexistence and cutover strategies that allow customers to transition at scale while maintaining business continuity. 
 - Ensure continuity of critical customer workflows, integrations, configurations, historical data and user experiences during migration. 
 - Build robust validation, monitoring, rollback and recovery mechanisms to minimize migration risks and ensure customer confidence. 
 - Partner with Product Management, Customer Success, Professional Services and other customer-facing teams to define migration approaches that minimize customer involvement and accelerate time to value. 
 - Establish migration success metrics, including migration velocity, automation levels, data accuracy, customer effort, disruption and time to completion. 
 - Drive continuous improvements in migration efficiency and scalability, enabling the business to transition its installed customer base to WorkforceOS at scale. 
 - Engineering Organization & Leadership
 - Build, lead and develop a high-performing global engineering organization from the ground up, with end-to-end ownership across application engineering, platform engineering, AI/ML, data engineering, quality engineering, infrastructure and SRE. 
 - Recruit, develop and retain exceptional engineering leaders, architects and engineers across multiple technology disciplines. 
 - Establish the engineering organizational structure, technical leadership model and operating cadence needed to support WorkforceOS. 
 - Build a strong culture of engineering excellence, ownership, innovation, collaboration and accountability. 
 - Develop strong technical leadership and career progression frameworks, creating opportunities for engineers to grow and take on increasing responsibility. 
 - Establish clear engineering ownership across platform, product domains, infrastructure, data and AI capabilities. 
 - Drive a culture of continuous learning, technical experimentation and adoption of modern engineering practices. 
 - Build an inclusive and globally distributed engineering organization that can scale with the business. 
 - Develop an engineering talent strategy that attracts exceptional talent and creates a high-performance environment. 
 - Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership
 - Work closely with the GM of WorkforceOS to translate business strategy and product vision into technology strategy, investment priorities and execution plans. 
 - Partner closely with the VP of Product Management to jointly drive product delivery, roadmap execution, technical feasibility and customer outcomes. 
 - Establish strong partnerships with engineering and technology leaders across Cornerstone's business lines to drive architectural alignment, platform integration, technology reuse and ecosystem interoperability. 
 - Collaborate with GMs and product leaders across business lines to identify opportunities for shared technology investments, integration and innovation. 
 - Work closely with Cornerstone's CTO, CPO and broader technology leadership to align WorkforceOS with the company's technology strategy, architectural standards and long-term platform vision. 
 - Partner with centralized platform teams to leverage common infrastructure, services and capabilities while maintaining clear ownership and accountability for WorkforceOS engineering outcomes. 
 - Drive effective engineering operating cadences, technical reviews, delivery governance and executive communication. Partner with Sales, Customer Success and strategic customers to address technical requirements, enterprise architecture considerations and complex customer engagements. 
 - Represent WorkforceOS in executive forums, customer engagements and strategic technology discussions. 

You've Got What It Takes If You Have

- 18+ years of experience in software engineering and technology leadership, with significant experience building enterprise-scale software platforms. 
 - 8+ years of experience leading large engineering organizations, including managing senior engineering leaders. Proven experience building and scaling complex, multi-tenant enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - Strong architectural expertise across cloud-native systems, distributed computing, microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture and enterprise integration. 
 - Demonstrated ability to design and deliver highly available, secure and scalable enterprise software. 
 - Experience building AI-enabled platforms or integrating AI, machine learning and generative AI capabilities into enterprise products. 
 - Strong understanding of data architecture, analytics platforms, data engineering and enterprise data governance. 
 - Experience establishing and scaling engineering organizations, technical leadership structures and engineering operating models. 
 - Proven track record of delivering complex, multi-year technology programs with strong execution discipline. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms, DevSecOps, SRE, CI/CD and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Experience with large-scale enterprise platform modernization, customer migrations or technology transformations is highly desirable. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work across organizational boundaries and influence technology decisions in complex, global engineering environments. 
 - Excellent communication, strategic thinking and executive stakeholder management skills. 
 - Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams. 

Leadership Attributes

- Technology Visionary: Able to define the technology foundation for a next-generation enterprise platform and make sound long-term architectural decisions. 
 - Engineering Craftsman: Sets high standards for architecture, software quality, engineering practices and operational excellence. 
 - AI-First Technologist: Understands how AI will transform software development, enterprise platforms and business workflows. 
 - Execution Focused: Converts ambitious technology strategies into predictable, high-quality delivery. Platform Thinker: Balances individual product requirements with reusable platform capabilities, extensibility and long term scalability. 
 - Customer Focused: Understands the importance of customer experience during platform transformation and prioritizes seamless migrations with minimal disruption. 
 - Transformation Leader: Has experience modernizing legacy platforms and executing complex technology transformations while maintaining business continuity. 
 - Organizational Builder: Has demonstrated the ability to build strong engineering organizations and develop exceptional technical leaders. 
 - Business Oriented: Understands the connection between engineering investments, product differentiation, customer outcomes and business growth. 
 - Collaborative Leader: Builds strong partnerships with Product, Design, Data Science and the broader technology organization. 

The Opportunity

This is a unique opportunity to architect and build the technology foundation of a category-defining, AI-native HCM platform. You will shape the engineering organization, platform architecture and technical culture that will power the future of WorkforceOS, while leading the transformation of Cornerstone's HCM technology and customer base onto this next-generation platform. 

Our Culture

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now - is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone - anywhere - to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today. 

Who We Are

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AITM, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People GraphTM, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7, 000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

- Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, JPA/Hibernate, and Test-Driven Development (TDD). 
 - Hands-on experience with ReactJS, Redux, JavaScript, HTML5, and modern front-end development frameworks.

data.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‐throughput, hyper‐scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‐scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‐tolerant, in‐service‐upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‐shedding, throttling, and rate‐limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‐management plans. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems. 

-Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. 

-Design systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down). 

-Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Design performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 

-Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 

-Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. . 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 

-Design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. 

-Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. 

-Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. 

-Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. 

-Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. 

-Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 

-Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.

Planning & Execution:

Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

data.description:
Job Description: Principal Software Engineer - AI Platforms & Knowledge Graphs

Role: Principal Software Engineer - AI/LLM Platforms

Experience: 10-15+ years

Level: Principal Engineer / Technical Architect

Domain: Enterprise AI, Knowledge Graphs, Generative AI, Distributed Systems

About The Role

We are looking for a highly accomplished Principal Software Engineer to lead the architecture, design, development, and evolution of enterprise-scale AI platforms, knowledge graph systems, and intelligent applications. 

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in distributed systems, scalable software architecture, knowledge graphs, Large Language Models (LLMs), and production-grade AI engineering. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring strong engineering fundamentals, architectural depth, and the ability to build, deploy, scale, and maintain complex AI-powered systems for enterprise customers. 

The candidate should have practical experience working with multiple LLMs, understand their capabilities, limitations, and performance trade-offs, and be capable of making informed architectural decisions to deliver reliable, secure, and cost-efficient AI solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Enterprise Knowledge Graph Engineering
 - Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise knowledge graph platforms. 
 - Build knowledge ingestion, entity extraction, relationship mapping, entity resolution, and graph enrichment pipelines. 
 - Design graph data models, ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic relationships. 
 - Develop high-performance graph querying, retrieval, and reasoning capabilities. 
 - Integrate knowledge graphs with enterprise data sources, applications, and AI systems. 
 - Implement GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval, and context-aware search architectures. 
 - Ensure scalability, reliability, data consistency, and performance of graph-based systems. 
 - AI & LLM Platform Engineering
 - Lead the architecture and development of production-grade AI applications leveraging Large Language Models. 
 - Design and implement RAG, GraphRAG, agentic AI, and intelligent workflow solutions. 
 - Integrate and orchestrate multiple proprietary and open-source LLMs, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and other emerging models. 
 - Evaluate LLM capabilities, reasoning quality, latency, context handling, accuracy, cost, and suitability for different use cases. 
 - Develop model-agnostic architectures enabling flexible model selection, routing, and fallback strategies. 
 - Optimize prompt engineering, context management, inference performance, token consumption, and operational costs. 
 - Build LLM evaluation frameworks, monitoring, guardrails, and observability capabilities. 
 - Address hallucinations, retrieval quality, grounding, security, and reliability challenges in enterprise AI applications. 
 - Scalable Systems Architecture
 - Architect highly scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems supporting enterprise workloads. 
 - Design cloud-native, microservices-based, asynchronous, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Build high-throughput data pipelines and low-latency APIs. 
 - Drive performance engineering, horizontal scaling, caching, concurrency, and infrastructure optimization. 
 - Design secure, multi-tenant systems with robust isolation and enterprise-grade availability. 
 - Make architectural trade-offs across performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost. 
 - Production Engineering & Platform Reliability
 - Own the end-to-end engineering lifecycle, from architecture and implementation to production deployment and ongoing maintenance. 
 - Establish engineering standards for CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident management. 
 - Implement observability, distributed tracing, performance monitoring, and operational diagnostics. 
 - Drive system reliability, availability, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues across distributed systems, graph databases, and LLM integrations. 
 - Continuously improve scalability, response times, resource utilization, and infrastructure costs. 
 - Technical Leadership
 - Provide technical direction and architectural leadership across engineering teams. 
 - Lead complex system design discussions, architecture reviews, and technology evaluations. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and establish strong software engineering practices. 
 - Collaborate with product, AI/ML, data engineering, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams. 
 - Translate complex enterprise requirements into robust technical solutions. 
 - Take ownership of critical architectural decisions and long-term platform evolution. 
 - Remain hands-on with design, coding, prototyping, debugging, and performance optimization. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- 10-15+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python, Java, Go, or equivalent backend programming languages. 
 - Demonstrated experience architecting, developing, and maintaining enterprise-scale software platforms. 
 - Hands-on experience building and deploying knowledge graph or graph-based data systems. 
 - Strong understanding of graph databases, graph algorithms, semantic modeling, and knowledge retrieval. 
 - Practical experience building production AI applications using LLMs. 
 - Experience integrating multiple LLM providers and understanding model-specific capabilities, limitations, and engineering trade-offs. 
 - Strong understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and hybrid retrieval. 
 - Expertise in cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with microservices, containers, Kubernetes, APIs, and distributed data processing. 
 - Strong knowledge of system design, scalability, concurrency, reliability, and performance optimization. 
 - Proven ability to independently drive complex engineering initiatives from design to production. 

Preferred Technical Experience

Knowledge Graph & Data Technologies

- Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, RDF, SPARQL, Cypher
 - Ontology Modeling, Entity Resolution, Graph Algorithms
 - Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Graph Databases
 - Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector

Generative AI & LLM Frameworks

- OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Llama, Mistral
 - LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph
 - GraphRAG, Agentic RAG, Hybrid RAG
 - Embedding Models, Reranking, Semantic Search
 - Model Context Protocol (MCP), Tool Calling
 - LLM Evaluation, Observability, Guardrails

Scalable Architecture & Infrastructure

- AWS / Azure / GCP
 - Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
 - Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL
 - Distributed Systems, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture
 - CI/CD, Monitoring, Distributed Tracing
 - High Availability, Fault Tolerance, Performance Engineering

What Makes an Ideal Candidate

We Are Particularly Interested In Engineers Who

- Have built and operated real enterprise-scale systems, not just prototypes or proof-of-concepts. 
 - Have designed knowledge graph platforms and solved real-world challenges around ingestion, retrieval, graph performance, and scalability. 
 - Understand the nuances of different LLMs and know when and why to use a particular model. 
 - Have experience taking AI applications from experimentation to secure, reliable, cost-efficient production deployments. 
 - Can operate comfortably across AI engineering, backend systems, data architecture, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Are strong hands-on engineers who can influence architecture and engineering practices across multiple teams. 
 - Demonstrate deep technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to solve ambiguous, complex engineering problems. 

Success in This Role

Success Will Be Measured By The Ability To

- Deliver robust and scalable knowledge graph and AI platform capabilities. 
 - Improve platform performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Accelerate the development and production deployment of enterprise AI applications. 
 - Establish reusable architectural patterns and engineering standards. 
 - Reduce technical complexity and improve long-term platform maintainability. 
 - Enable engineering teams to deliver complex AI solutions with greater speed and quality. 

Core Keywords: Principal Software Engineer, AI Platform Architect, Enterprise Knowledge Graph, GraphRAG, Generative AI, LLM Engineering, Multi-LLM Orchestration, Agentic AI, RAG, Distributed Systems, Scalable Architecture, Graph Databases, Cloud-Native Systems, LLMOps, AI Observability, Enterprise AI Applications, Technical Leadership.

Position Overview

PayJoy is a mission-driven fintech company and Public Benefit Corporation committed to expanding financial inclusion for underserved consumers in emerging markets. Through ethical lending, transparent products, and innovative smartphone-based underwriting, PayJoy empowers millions to build credit, access essential technology, and achieve upward economic mobility. 

As the Senior Director of Engineering - International Squad, you will be PayJoy's founding engineering leader in India. Unlike other senior director roles at PayJoy that own a specific product domain, this role is intentionally cross-cutting. You will build and lead an international engineering squad that supports the full breadth of PayJoy's product portfolio, drives platform reliability and operational excellence, and owns the technical delivery of region-specific product initiatives for Southeast Asia and Africa. 

This is a greenfield opportunity. You will establish PayJoy's India engineering presence from scratch - hiring the team, setting the culture, defining local processes, and integrating a new site into PayJoy's established global engineering organization. The squad you build will contribute across Consumer products, Finance Engine, Lock platform, Payments, and Infrastructure, partnering closely with engineering and product leaders in the US, Mexico, and Colombia. 

You will operate as a player-coach: deeply technical, strategically minded, and capable of recruiting and mentoring a high-performing team in a new geography. This role demands someone who thrives in ambiguity, can build organizational muscle from scratch, and is energized by the challenge of connecting a new site to an established global engineering culture. 

This position is based in India (Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai). It is a hybrid role with periodic travel to PayJoy's offices in San Francisco and Mexico City. 

Key Responsibilities

Build & Scale the India Engineering Team

- Serve as the founding engineering leader in India, establishing the team from zero and scaling it over multiple quarters.

 - Drive architectural improvements and feature delivery across multiple services and platforms simultaneously. System Reliability & Platform Resilience

- Own and improve the reliability posture of PayJoy's production systems, including uptime, observability, incident response, and post-mortem culture.

 - Drive infrastructure automation, performance optimization, and resilience engineering initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with security and compliance teams to ensure systems meet regional regulatory requirements. Southeast Asia & Africa Product Delivery

 - Build strong cross-site communication practices to overcome time zone and cultural differences. 
 - Provide regular updates to executive leadership on team progress, capacity, and strategic recommendations. 

Qualifications

 - Experience working with distributed, multi-time-zone engineering organizations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate in a cross-product or platform team model, contributing to multiple product lines simultaneously. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable operating in high-growth, fast-changing environments. 
 - Fintech experience is strongly preferred. 
 - Familiarity with Southeast Asian and/or African technology ecosystems, mobile money, or mobile-first product development is a plus.

The Role

You'll design and build an intelligent, highly automated quality engineering system where AI agents help generate tests, execute regression suites, investigate failures, and continuously improve test coverage. 

You'll own the technical foundations that allow our engineering team to ship quickly and confidently without scaling QA headcount alongside product complexity. 

We're looking for a Staff-level engineer with deep test automation expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, and a track record of building systems that make quality an integrated, automated part of software development. 

What You'll Do

1. Build agentic QA systems: Design and implement AI-powered workflows for test generation, automated regression testing, failure analysis, and intelligent bug triage. 

2. Own test automation architecture: Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks covering web applications, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end workflows. 

3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes. 

4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues. 

5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk. 

6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing. 

7. Establish quality observability: Create clear visibility into test reliability, regression trends, release readiness, and overall product quality. 

8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish testing standards, and drive a culture where quality is owned across the engineering organization. 

What We're Looking For

1. Staff-level engineering expertise with deep experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), or Test Automation Architecture. 

2. Strong hands-on programming skills and experience building production-grade test automation frameworks. 

3. Extensive experience automating web applications, APIs, and complex end-to-end workflows. 

4. Expertise with modern testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, or equivalent technologies. 

5. Strong understanding of CI/CD, integration testing, contract testing, regression strategies, and test infrastructure. 

6. Proven experience designing scalable testing systems rather than exclusively writing or maintaining individual test cases. 

7. AI-native engineering habits: You already use AI coding agents extensively and have practical experience applying AI to test generation, automation, debugging, or quality workflows. 

8. Strong systems thinking, including the ability to identify bottlenecks and design automation that removes repetitive QA work. 

9. Experience establishing engineering quality standards and mentoring developers or QA engineers. 

10. Ability to independently own quality engineering architecture while remaining deeply hands-on. 

Nice to have

1. You've built AI-powered testing systems or agentic QA workflows used in real development environments.

data.description:
About The Job

Head of AI, Vertical AI Agents at Tamasha. live - India's Most Exciting Live Entertainment Platform. 

Location : Bangalore. 

Reporting to : Co-Founder. 

Team : AI. 

Type : Full-Time. 

Work mode : Onsite. 

About Tamasha. live

Tamasha. live is one of India's fastest-growing live entertainment and social gaming platforms, trusted by 2. 5 Million+ active users. Built on the belief that entertainment should be immersive, rewarding, and community-driven, Tamasha brings together games, creators, and live experiences in one vibrant ecosystem. Our growing portfolio of apps spans social connection, entertainment, and live gaming : Dosti, DostiPro, MastiPro, FriendChat, Playroom, Openly, Cricsignal, Prabhu ji and Audio Jockey. Now we are building the next layer : vertical AI agents that help people with everyday needs. Each agent is grounded in a domain and earns money from the real value it delivers, not by charging people to chat. 

The Role

You'll own the AI platform that every Tamasha agent runs on, and the business results those agents produce. The job is to make each agent predictable : it stays in character, remembers what matters, gets its domain right, and is safe and compliant, every time. This is a high-visibility role : you will report directly to the Co-Founder and work across Tamasha's multi-app ecosystem. 

What You'll Do

- Build the shared platform : a reusable agent framework, long-term memory, evaluations, guardrails and domain tools. 
 - Set the model strategy. Choose and combine open-source LLMs (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Indic models), using hosted APIs only where they're worth it. Fine-tune (SFT, DPO, LoRA) when it improves quality or cuts cost. 
 - Own unit economics. Lower the cost per conversation with routing from small to large models, distillation, caching and quantised self-hosting. 
 - Make every agent predictable : persona consistency, memory design, accuracy, and safety on sensitive topics. 
 - Build evaluations, offline and online, including red-teaming, tied to conversation-to-transaction conversion and to retention. 
 - Work with domain experts to turn their knowledge into deterministic tools and grounded content. 
 - Protect user data : comply with the DPDP Act, and give users control over what agents remember. 
 - Hire, mentor and grow the AI team, starting with a Staff AI Engineer. 

What You'll Need

- Hands-on approach. 
 - Around 10 years or more in ML or NLP, including shipping LLM or conversational systems to real users at scale. 
 - Hands-on depth in fine-tuning and evaluating open-source models, and in retrieval and memory design. 
 - A track record of cutting inference cost and latency without losing quality. 
 - Experience making model behaviour measurable and reliable through evaluations, guardrails and regression checks. 
 - Business judgement : you choose models and features by their effect on conversion, retention and margin. 
 - Experience leading engineers and explaining trade-offs clearly to founders. 

Why join Tamasha?

- Direct Co-Founder exposure : Report to the Co-Founder. Your work has board-level visibility and real strategic impact. 
 - Data-rich environment : Access to rich behavioural and conversational data across millions of users and multiple apps. 
 - Real ownership : A founding role building one AI platform behind several consumer agents, in a business that rewards solving real problems. 
 - Multi-app ecosystem : Work across apps at different stages : early-stage, growth, and scale, all in one company. 
 - Compensation : No limit for the right person.
