data.title: Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer
data.description:
Remote, full-time role for a Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer based in India. You will own the core platform of an AI-enabled drug-development product, working directly with the founder and a US-based Forward Deployed Engineer. A daily 3-hour overlap with US Pacific Time (typically Indian evenings) is required. 

Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer

Engagement Model: Full-Time / Employer of Record (EOR)

Compensation: Competitive Market Rate (Commensurate with Full-Stack & Multi-Agent AI Depth)

Location: India (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, or NCR preferred)

Target Experience: 5+ years of full-stack software engineering with demonstrable AI/Multi-Agent system depth, including 2+ years building and deploying production LLM / Multi-Agent AI systems. 

About INCEVO LLC

INCEVO LLC is a biopharmaceutical consulting firm delivering end-to-end program leadership, functional expertise, and BD due diligence to help life sciences companies advance therapies from discovery through regulatory approval. INCEVO is pioneering a proprietary AI-enabled drug-development platform- integrating real-time intelligence, regulatory insight, and predictive analytics to accelerate decision-making and de-risk portfolio investments - positioning the firm at the forefront of next-generation biopharma strategy. 

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer to take complete operational ownership of our core platform codebase-from database schemas and asynchronous backend microservices to responsive, highly polished user interfaces. In this high-velocity, high-agency role, you don't just write basic API wrappers; you build resilient, high-throughput systems that turn complex AI capabilities into fast, reliable enterprise product. You will work directly with the founder and our Forward Deployed Engineer to iterate product features, optimize LLM inference speeds, and enforce rigorous engineering standards across our stack. 

Why This Role Matters: As our Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer, you will own the technical engine powering our platform and drive it across the finish line into a polished, hardened, enterprise-ready product that performs flawlessly in live client programs. The domain problem is genuinely novel: orchestrating drug development with AI agents is an unsolved enterprise challenge, and you will build the UI components, backend microservices, and system reliability required to make it seamless for global pharma clients. If you want to architect production-grade agentic AI in one of the most important industries in the world, this is that role. 

What You'll Do

·            Drive Enterprise Production Polish & New Feature Surfaces: Refine, refactor, and expand our core web application (React, Next. js, TypeScript, Tailwind) to elevate it from a functional platform into a high-performance, enterprise-grade product. Own the addition of new UI components, micro-interactions, and backend workflows while maintaining clean, scalable frontend architecture. Translate client program needs into intuitive UI components with minimal friction. Incorporate architectural insights surfaced by our Forward Deployed Engineer from live client deployments to ensure new product surfaces reflect real enterprise client workflow needs. 

·            Architect Low-Latency Agentic Backends: Build and maintain asynchronous REST and WebSocket microservices (FastAPI / Node. js) handling multi-agent state persistence, tool calling, inter-agent orchestration (LangGraph), streaming tokens responses, and parallel data/document ingestion pipelines. Ensure every API endpoint is fast, reliable, and self-documenting. Performance and reliability under concurrent client load are non-negotiable. 

·            Optimize AI & RAG Pipelines: Implement, benchmark, and maintain production vector retrieval pipelines, hybrid search (BM25 + dense vector), evaluation harnesses (Ragas, TruLens), and multi-tier caching structures (Redis / semantic caching). Own execution repeatability and token efficiency across all LLM workflows. 

·            Ensure System Reliability & Observability: Write robust test suites (PyTest, Playwright), implement structured data validation (Pydantic), and build fallbacks and circuit-breakers for when downstream LLM APIs experience latency or outages. Proactively surface system bottlenecks before users encounter them - and translate reliability findings into concrete architectural improvements that make the platform progressively more resilient across every client deployment cycle. 

·            Maintain Engineering Hygiene: Strong Git discipline (atomic commits, clean rebase/PR workflows), structured pull requests, self-documenting code, and end-to-end CI/CD ownership (GitHub Actions). Every commit carries clear context and intentional changes. 

·            Collaborate Asynchronously: Operate autonomously with clear written documentation and maintain a mandatory 3-hour daily overlap with US Pacific Time for daily standup, sprint planning, and real-time collaboration. Work in close partnership with our US-based Forward Deployed Engineer - translating field-validated architectural requirements from live client deployments into platform improvements rapidly and precisely. Own the full handoff from architectural specification to live production code. 

You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have: 

·            Startup Velocity & High Agency: You care deeply about shipping clean, self-documenting code fast and iterating rapidly based on real user feedback. You flag blockers early and propose architectural solutions, not just problems. 

·            5+ Years of Full-Stack Engineering Depth: 5+ years of full-stack software engineering with demonstrable AI/Multi-Agent system depth, including 2+ years specifically spent building, deploying, and architecturally evolving production-grade LLM or Multi-Agent AI systems at enterprise scale. Strong proficiency across TypeScript, React/Next. js, Python (FastAPI/Pydantic), PostgreSQL, and Redis. 

·            Multi-Agent Systems & AI Expertise: Hands-on production experience with modern agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, LlamaIndex workflows), structured JSON outputs, vector databases (Qdrant, Azure AI Search, pgvector), and API integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, NVIDIA NIM). You understand how LLM-based systems fail in production differently from traditional CRUD apps - and you make deliberate architectural decisions that prevent, detect, and recover from those failure modes at scale. 

·            Async & Performance Optimization Mastery: Deep working knowledge of Python asyncio, streaming token consumption, memory management, time-to-first-token (TTFT) reduction, and API rate-limit/retry handling. You know when to reach for a WebSocket versus a polling endpoint and why it matters for perceived performance. 

·            Azure Stack Familiarity: Practical experience with Azure Container Apps, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Blob Storage, and Azure AI Search. Familiarity with Azure AD SSO and Key Vault is a strong advantage. You treat client program data with the same care a regulated pharmaceutical company would. 

·            Engineering Hygiene & IP Security: Strong Git workflow discipline (atomic commits, clean PR reviews, rebase hygiene), full CI/CD ownership via GitHub Actions, and clear written technical communication in English that non-technical stakeholders can act on. You treat INCEVO's codebase, agent architecture, and client program data as proprietary assets - maintaining strict IP security standards at every stage of development, deployment, and offboarding. 

·            Cross-Functional Engineering Collaboration: You work effectively with a US-based Forward Deployed Engineer who owns client-facing deployments and brings real-world architectural requirements from the field. You translate those requirements into platform improvements rapidly and precisely - closing the loop between client reality and core engineering execution. 

·            Biopharma or Life Sciences Context (Significant Advantage): Prior experience building software for pharmaceutical, clinical research, or regulated healthcare environments - including familiarity with clinical data schemas (ClinicalTrials. gov, CDISC), regulatory submission workflows, or GxP system validation concepts - is a meaningful differentiator. The founding team provides full domain context; what we need from you is the technical stack mastery and execution speed. 

Equal Opportunity & Confidentiality

·            Equal Opportunity Employer: INCEVO LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. We believe that building AI systems for high-stakes, complex domains requires diverse perspectives, deep intellectual curiosity, and rigorous engineering standards. 

·            Work Authorization & Intellectual Property: All offers and engagements are contingent upon the successful execution of INCEVO LLC's standard Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and Intellectual Property (IP) Assignment Agreement prior to commencement. For international engagements, employment is administered in full compliance with local labor laws via our authorized Employer of Record (EOR) platform.

data.title: QA Engineer - SDET
data.description:
About Us

Phyllo is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e. g. YouTube, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, etc. ). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators' data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators' data in a simple yet impactful way. Website: https: //www. getphyllo. com/

About The Role

As an SDET, you will take ownership of automation quality for assigned product areas across APIs, SDKs and web applications. You will design scalable automation solutions, strengthen regression coverage, integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines and proactively identify quality risks before they reach production. . 

This is an automation-first, hands-on role. You will build test suites that run on every code change, use AI tools to write and maintain tests faster, and review that AI output with a critical eye. You will work side by side with product managers and engineers to agree on what "working" means before code is written, and coach your team to grow from testers into automation engineers. 

What you'll be expected to do

- Build and own test automation (UI and API)
 - Set the test automation strategy: what to automate, at which level (API, contract, UI), and what to keep for exploratory testing. 
 - Design and maintain API test automation in code, covering functional, schema/contract, negative, authentication and data-accuracy checks against our OpenAPI specs. 
 - Build reliable end-to-end UI test suites using sound design patterns (page objects, stable locators, isolated test data) so tests stay fast and trustworthy. 
 - Run automated tests in CI/CD on every pull request and release, with clear quality gates and fast feedback to engineers. 
 - Use AI coding assistants and agents to draft test plans, generate scripts and test data, and triage failures, and review every AI-generated test as carefully as human-written code. 
 - Verify that data flowing through our APIs is complete, correct and consistent across platforms, including pagination, webhooks and rate limits. 
 - Track and reduce flaky tests, and report quality metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flake rate, pipeline time) that the team acts on. 
 - Work closely with product and engineering
 - Work with product managers early to turn requirements into clear acceptance criteria and test scenarios before development starts. 
 - Partner with engineers on testability, test data and shared ownership of quality. 
 - Reproduce and debug issues using logs, network traces and API responses, and give engineers precise, actionable bug reports. 
 - Explain quality risks and release status in plain language to product, engineering and leadership. 

You'll be a good fit if

- 3-5 years of experience in quality engineering, with at least 2 years building test automation (not only running manual tests). 
 - Hold a BS in Computer Science or have an equivalent combination of technical education and work experience. 
 - Write solid code in at least one language used for test automation: TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or Java. 
 - Have deep hands-on experience automating REST API tests in code (e. g. Playwright, REST
 - Assured, pytest, SuperTest), with a solid grasp of HTTP, OAuth/API-key authentication, JSON schemas and OpenAPI. Postman experience is welcome, but API tests must live in code and CI. 
 - Have built a UI automation framework with a modern tool such as Playwright (preferred), Cypress or Selenium. 
 - Run tests in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar) and work daily with Git, pull requests and code reviews. 
 - Use AI coding assistants regularly in your testing work, and can tell when an AI-generated test is wrong, shallow or passing for the wrong reason. 
 - Are comfortable debugging with logs, browser dev tools and SQL. 
 - Communicate and collaborate clearly, with the confidence to challenge unclear requirements with product managers and engineers. 

Nice to Have

- AI-driven UI testing: Playwright Test Agents (planner, generator, healer) or Playwright MCP used with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot. 
 - AI-assisted API testing: Postman Agent Mode, KushoAI, or Keploy (regression tests generated from recorded API traffic). 
 - Agentic testing platforms: AI-native platforms such as testRigor, mabl, Katalon or QA. tech
 - Contract and schema testing: Pact, Specmatic, or Schemathesis (property-based and fuzz testing from OpenAPI specs). 
 - Testing AI features: Evaluating LLM-powered features with tools such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, LangSmith or Langfuse, including golden datasets and LLM-as-judge scoring. 
 - Performance testing: k6, JMeter or Gatling. 
 - Mobile testing: Appium or similar, for testing SDKs on Android and iOS. 
 - Accessibility: Automated checks with axe or similar, and familiarity with WCAG. 
 - API security: OWASP API Security Top 10 and basic API security testing. 
 - Infrastructure and reporting: Docker, cloud test environments (we run on Google Cloud), and reporting tools such as Allure, TestRail or Xray. 
 - Domain: Familiarity with social and creator platform APIs (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and similar). 

What We Offer

- Hybrid Working Environment: Work both from the office and remotely as needed for a better work-life balance
 - Flexible Hours: Choose to work in the hours you feel the most productive
 - Innovate and Evolve: We're building a high-growth, high-autonomy culture. We rely less on job titles and more on cultivating an environment where anyone can contribute, the best ideas win, and personal growth is driven by expanding impact

What's in it for you?

We invest in our people and believe in hiring for high-potential and humble individuals who can rapidly grow their responsibilities as the company scales. You will infuse insights and ideas into business decision-making, solutions strategy, and the innovation roadmap for each product. 

Do you truly want to make a difference and revolutionize the creator economy through data? If yes, Phyllo is the perfect place for you.

- Master's OR Bachelor's degree in IT/Computer Science/Engineering. and 12 to 17 years of work experience

Required Skills

- Strong Python development skills. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases. 
 - Hands-on experience with Databricks and Apache Spark/PySpark. 
 - Experience building data pipelines and integrating data from multiple sources. 
 - Experience developing or integrating REST APIs. 
 - Working knowledge of NoSQL databases. Hands-on experience integrating APIs with AI agents or AI/ML applications.

Source systems → Databricks/Spark processing → relational or NoSQL storage → Python API → application or AI agent

data.description:
About The Company

If you have ever watched television or enjoyed a movie on your phone or tablet, this experience was likely brought to you through an Ateme solution created by our award-winning engineering teams. 

Ateme (PARIS: ATEME) is the global leader in video delivery, partnering with top content and service providers, and streaming platforms like Netflix. 

Through our cutting-edge R&D and innovation, we enable clients to deliver high-quality video experiences on any device, boosting engagement and revenue. 

Guided by a robust CSR policy, we are committed to making the entertainment and video experience captivating, greener, accessible to everyone, while promoting our employees' well-being and ethical business practices. 

At Ateme, we prioritize innovation, collaboration, empowerment, agility, and diverse contributions. 

Join us and help shape the future of video delivery!

Ateme is looking for a permanent AI Solutions & Automation Engineer to design, develop, and deploy internal tools that reduce repetitive tasks, streamline access to information, and improve team efficiency, particularly across Sales, Pre-Sales, Support, Product, and Operations. 

Your role will sit at the intersection of full-stack development, generative AI, automation, and business understanding. You will work from real business needs to develop reliable, measurable solutions that are easy for teams to adopt. 

Key Responsibilities

- Identify and prioritize use cases: Work directly with business teams to understand their processes, identify low-value or repetitive tasks, and define the expected benefits. 
 - Prototype quickly: Design proofs of concept and usage-focused MVPs, test them with users, and iterate based on feedback. 
 - Develop end-to-end internal tools: Build user interfaces, backend services, workflows, agents, and integrations through to operational deployment. 
 - Connect enterprise systems: Integrate solutions with Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, and other approved data sources while respecting access rights and permissions. 
 - Industrialize solutions: Implement testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, version management, support, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure security and responsible AI: Apply data protection, confidentiality, traceability, human oversight, and risk management requirements. 
 - Measure impact: Define adoption, quality, and operational efficiency metrics with business teams and track the value delivered after deployment. 
 - Build reusable solutions: Document components and agents, avoid duplication, and contribute to a shared architecture that enables solutions to be reused across multiple teams. 

Examples of Solutions you may build

- Assistants for meeting preparation, meeting summaries, and action tracking. 
 - Intelligent search across commercial and technical documentation. 
 - Automation of RFP responses and generation of scoping documents. 
 - Tools to support proposal preparation, opportunity tracking, and consolidation of information from multiple sources. 
 - Support agents capable of suggesting contextualized resolutions and enriching the knowledge base. 
 - Simple internal applications to automate checks, calculations, reporting, and recurring workflows. 

Required Skills and Experience

You hold a Master's degree (Bac+5), engineering degree, or equivalent qualification, and have at least 5 years of relevant experience in application development, automation, or the implementation of AI solutions in an enterprise environment. 

- Full-stack development: Python and/or TypeScript, REST APIs, web applications, databases, and user-focused interface design. 
 - Generative AI and agents: LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, semantic search, tool calling, orchestration, and response quality evaluation. 
 - Integration: OAuth 2. 0 / OIDC, SSO, enterprise APIs and connectors, identity and permission management. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, monitoring, and deployment on cloud or internal platforms. 
 - Product thinking: Ability to start from a business need, define an MVP, balance simplicity and robustness, and support user adoption. 
 - Security & governance: Good practices in data protection, secrets management, auditability, human oversight, and documentation. 

Additionall Skills that would be an advantage

- Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI, or Azure OpenAI. 
 - Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Dataverse, or Fabric. 
 - Agent interoperability protocols and standards, particularly MCP. 
 - Experience in media, video, B2B SaaS, or enterprise software environments. 
 - UX practices, change management, and user training. 

How your work matters

Curiosity, pragmatism, autonomy, and a results-oriented mindset are essential. You enjoy understanding how people actually work, simplifying complex problems, and delivering useful solutions. 

You can clearly explain your decisions, collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, experiment quickly without compromising security, and understand that a solution only creates value when people actually use it. 

Location

We consider different locations in Europe and Asia (our offices locations) but we do not consider 100% remote. This job is not eligible for mobility or relocation opportunities. 

At Ateme, onboarding is much more than a process. It is a complete experience designed to set you up for success: immersive training, regular meetings with your manager and HR, a collaborative culture, and stimulating projects. 

Join us for a rewarding professional journey where your development and success matter. 

Compensation & Benefits

- Compensation based on experience
 - Hybrid working model
 - Bonuses: performance bonus, employee referral bonus, etc. 
 - Access to our internal training platform, including video technologies, Kubernetes, AWS, and more
 - International collaboration with Business, IT, Product, R&D, and Security teams

To learn more about Ateme, visit our corporate website: 

www. ateme. com

The Group Manager should have a strong software engineering background and be technically credible across areas such as modern application development, cloud, DevOps, architecture practices, and emerging technologies such as AI. The role is not expected to be hands-on at an Architect level, but should be able to understand technical decisions, challenge risks and trade-offs, and guide Engineering Managers and technical leaders.

Required

Skills & Experience

Preferred

Position Title: Engineer / Sr. Engineer / Assistant Manager

Location: Udaipur, Rajasthan

OBJECTIVE OF THE ROLE

To lead and manage the production function for wire and cable harness manufacturing operations, ensuring products meet ISO and customer quality standards, driving continuous improvement, line balancing, lean manufacturing, Low cost automation, fixture concept, Poke-yoke, Kaizen, localization initiatives, and effective troubleshooting of process and product quality issues across all manufacturing stages. 

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Production System

- Lead and manage the production function and teams across wire harness manufacturing lines. 
 - Develop, implement, and maintain the production system in compliance with ISO. 
 - Drive internal audits, management reviews, and CAPA (Corrective & Preventive Action) closures for quality non-conformities.

Wire Harness Production

Supplier & Customer Quality

 - Experience driving Localization of components and supplier development for import substitution. 
 - Sound knowledge of ISO, FMEA, SPC, MSA, 7 QC Tools, 8D Problem Solving. 
 - Strong leadership, team management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office, SAP, ERP systems, and quality reporting tools. 

Qualification & Experience

- Diploma / Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics Engineering. 
 - 8-10 years of relevant experience in automotive component manufacturing, with significant exposure to wire harness or electrical/electronic parts quality. 
 - Prior experience in automotive sector Tier-1 organization is mandatory.

data.title: Senior Manager, Engineering(Platform)
data.description:
About Stord

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission. 

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale. 

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord's end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order. 

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures. 

Stord is building the operating system for modern supply chain: a unified platform handling Order Management, Warehouse Management, Transportation, and Consumer Experience for brands doing billions in commerce annually. 

The Platform team sits underneath all of it. The shared services, tooling, and standards Platform owns are what every product team builds on, which means the quality of Platform's work shows up in OMS, WMS, TMS, Commerce, and AI. Stord is in a growth stage, and many of the hard problems that come with it land here. This role leads a single team of about five engineers, expected to expand to multiple teams as scope grows, and also serves as the product lead for Platform. You are the voice of the team to every product engineering group, and you lead the effort to get what Platform builds adopted, working alongside product engineering leaders. 

This role is for a strong engineer who is also a great leader. You were a high-performing IC, you still know what good engineering looks like, and you spend your days close to your engineers and your stakeholders. You can tell when a plan has a hole in it and say so plainly. You get your results through other people and are comfortable never writing the code yourself. You are also a credible advocate who can explain what Platform is building and why to engineers and executives alike, and who earns adoption by listening to customers(other Engineering teams). If you want to shape how an entire tech stack scales and build the team that does it, this role was built for you. 

Why This Role

- Platform sits at the center of every product team, so how well your team executes is visible across the whole stack. 
 - You are the face of Platform and lead the push to get what you build adopted, in partnership with product engineering leaders. 
 - Stord is in a growth stage, and Platform is where many of the problems that make that growth sustainable get solved. 
 - You start with one team of about five engineers and have a real path to leading several as the scope grows. 
 - Solving for real scale is part of the job, and the decisions you make will have to hold up as volume and complexity climb. 
 - You work daily with engineers and with leaders across every product area, so your input shapes priorities across the company. 
 - The stack is multifaceted, with Elixir and TypeScript as the primary languages. 

What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Delivery

- Own the complete people management lifecycle for the Platform team, starting with about five engineers and growing from there. 
 - Stay close to the work. Know what each engineer is building day to day, read the designs and pull requests that matter, and ask the questions that surface gaps early. 
 - Challenge plans and viewpoints directly when they don't hold up, and push the team toward a better answer. 
 - Run planning, standups, and retrospectives that keep the team predictable and moving fast. 
 - Report delivery, quality, risk, and resourcing to engineering leadership on a regular cadence, using measures that keep observations as objective as possible. 

Platform Product Leadership & Adoption

- Act as the product lead for Platform. Define what the team builds, for whom, and why, and own the roadmap as a product. 
 - Be the voice of Platform across Engineering. Communicate what is shipping, what is coming, and how to use it to product engineering teams and leadership. 
 - Lead adoption of Platform products and features in partnership with product engineering leaders. Set adoption goals, track them, and report on progress. 
 - Treat product engineering teams as your customers. Gather feedback regularly, find where they get stuck, and feed it back into the roadmap. 
 - Drive the documentation, migration paths, and enablement material that make adoption easy. 
 - Make the case for retiring legacy approaches, and push teams to move when the Platform path is the better one. 
 - Define success measures for Platform products, such as adoption, reliability, and developer experience, and report on them to leadership. 

People Development & Hiring

- Run weekly 1: 1s focused on growth, feedback, and career development. 
 - Deliver performance reviews, make compensation recommendations, and write promotion cases for your direct reports. 
 - Handle performance issues and hard conversations directly, including the cases where an engineer needs to move on. 
 - Lead the full hiring lifecycle, and sell both the role and Stord to candidates with credible optimism about where the company is today. 
 - Identify and develop future tech leads and managers as Platform expands to multiple teams. 

Technical & Roadmap Ownership

- Own the Platform roadmap and architectural direction across multiple quarters, working with your tech lead and principal engineers. 
 - Turn the needs of product teams into prioritized platform work, and sequence it against competing demands. 
 - Hold quality and velocity together. Set the standards for code review, testing, and release practices that let the team ship fast without regressions. 
 - Hold your team accountable for AI adoption, and replace or significantly improve legacy team processes through AI enablement. 
 - Manage team cost drivers such as tooling, infrastructure, and contractor spend, and flag budget risk early. 

Cross-Team Alignment & Platform Reliability

- Work daily with engineering managers, product leaders, and stakeholders across Product Engineering. 
 - Own the reliability of the platform services your team runs: monitoring, incident response, root cause follow-through, and on-call discipline. 
 - Represent Platform in cross-team planning, keep dependencies visible, and drive consistent engineering practices across teams. 
 - Renegotiate scope and priorities when demand exceeds capacity. 

Required

What We're Looking For

- Engineering management (3+ years): You have led teams of 5+ engineers with a track record of predictable delivery and team development, and you have managed through ambiguity. 
 - Strong engineering background (5+ years as a high-performing IC): You were a strong engineer first. You can read a design or a pull request, reason about it, and challenge it. You do not carry sprint work yourself. 
 - Product ownership of a technical platform: You have owned the roadmap of a platform, tooling, or shared service used by other engineering teams, and have helped those teams adopt it. You can define customers, set priorities, and measure adoption. 
 - Distributed systems and service architecture depth: You can evaluate trade-offs in reliability, scalability, and system design well enough to pressure-test your team's decisions. 
 - Hard conversations and performance management: You have first-hand experience with underperformance, conflict, and difficult exits, and you handled them directly. 
 - Full hiring lifecycle: You have sourced, interviewed, closed, and onboarded engineers, and you can sell yourself and Stord to a strong candidate. 
 - A way to measure your team: You have a repeatable process for assessing team and individual performance with as little subjectivity as possible. 
 - Strong opinions, held with evidence: You are a decision maker. You take a position, defend it with facts, and change it when the facts change. 

Required Soft Skills

- Ownership & Accountability: You own outcomes, not just activities. When your team ships, you take pride. When something breaks, you take responsibility and fix the system. 
 - Strong Communication: You communicate clearly with engineers, PMs, and executives. You translate technical complexity into business language and vice versa. 
 - Delegation & Multiplication: You scale through people, not heroics. You have a history of developing team members and multiplying impact through others. 
 - Navigating Ambiguity: You set direction when requirements are evolving. You build alignment across teams and functions without formal authority. 
 - Balanced Judgment: You balance innovation with pragmatic delivery constraints. You know when to push for quality and when to ship. 
 - Directed AI-Assisted Development: You understand how AI coding tools work as a productivity multiplier and can guide your team's adoption while maintaining quality and independent technical judgment. 

Strongly Preferred

- Experience driving adoption of internal platforms or developer tooling across multiple engineering teams. 
 - Production experience with Elixir or TypeScript, and the appetite to get fluent in both. 
 - Experience leading platform, infrastructure, or shared-services teams whose customers are other engineering teams. 
 - A track record of scaling a team across multiple teams through rising scale and scope without a drop in delivery quality. 
 - Experience operating systems through significant growth in load, usage, or complexity. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with event-driven architecture. 
 - Experience leading incident response and post-incident improvement across multiple teams. 
 - Experience introducing AI-enabled workflows that changed how an engineering team operates. 

What Success Looks Like

- 30 days: You have met with every engineer on the team and with the leaders of each product engineering team. You understand Platform's current roadmap, delivery cadence, and risks, how teams use Platform today, and you have a point of view on what needs to change. 
 - 90 days: You own the team's delivery rhythm, your 1: 1s are producing real development conversations, and product teams trust your status updates and priorities. You have published a Platform roadmap, defined adoption measures, and begun reporting on them. 
 - 6 months: The team ships predictably, and quality and velocity trends are visible and improving. Adoption of key Platform capabilities is rising across product engineering teams, and they see Platform as a partner. You have made a meaningful hire or development move, and you have a plan for expanding to multiple teams. 

About Stord

Stord is a cloud-based supply chain platform that enables brands to compete and grow through end-to-end logistics solutions. We process billions in commerce annually and operate across Order Management, Warehouse Management , Transportation Management, and Consumer Experience. We are backed by leading investors and are rapidly scaling our engineering organization to match our ambitions.

Meet the Team

Join a team that integrates new silicon architecture, support new product development to volume production, perform manufacturing test validation, and system deployment for next-generation high-speed networking products. We work collaboratively across ASIC, optics, hardware, firmware, and manufacturing teams to deliver advanced networking solutions.

You will develop silicon validation and characterization of functional coverage, performance, stress, corner-case, and interoperability testing. Your role involves establishing silicon performance margins and operating limits, and correlating silicon characterization data with system-level behavior. You will support manufacturing failure analysis and containment of silicon, referencing failures originating from subsystems including ASIC, SerDes, Substrate, Packaging, Thermal, Firmware/SDK, and Optics. Additionally, you will influence coverage through ATE, wafer-level, and package-level testing, while working with ASIC design teams, system architects, manufacturing operations, and network systems design. 

Minimum Qualifications

 - 5 years of experience in silicon engineering, ASIC validation, or a related technical domain. 
 - Experience with silicon architecture and performance characterization. 
 - Knowledge of signal integrity and high-speed SerDes. 
 - Experience conducting root-cause analysis from system-level failures to silicon behavior. 
 - Experience with Design for Testability (DFT), scan, MBIST, LBIST, boundary scan/JTAG, and production test methodologies. 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with automated test equipment (ATE), wafer-level testing, and package-level testing.

 - Lead or support structured problem solving for equipment performance issues, including root cause analysis, validation of fixes, and recurrence prevention. 
 - Modify, debug, and validate control logic for engineering changes, process improvements, product changes, and quality initiatives. 
 - Maintain current and accurate program backups for PLCs, robots, CNC systems, HMIs, drives, and related automation equipment. 

Powertrain Manufacturing Systems Integration

- Support integration of plant floor controls with Ford manufacturing systems such as FIS, QWX, QTS, error-proofing systems, WMA, OBL, SMART, VTAG, GPTS, IIoT, and related applications. 
 - Use Factory Information Systems and plant monitoring tools to analyze cycle time, downtime, throughput, fault history, and equipment performance trends. 
 - Support integration of CNC controls, gantries, auxiliary equipment, RFID systems, traceability systems, and complexity management solutions. 
 - Validate PLC logic, station numbering, data collection, Andon functionality, error-proofing logic, and communication interfaces. 

Project Launch and Installation Support

- Review and coordinate controls-related activities for equipment installations, upgrades, commissioning, and launch support. 
 - Participate in controls design reviews, risk assessments, machine safety reviews, and project readiness reviews. 
 - Support cost study, design, build, debug, installation, commissioning, launch, and production ramp-up phases. 
 - Work with internal teams, equipment suppliers, and system integrators to ensure controls deliverables meet Ford standards and plant operational requirements. 
 - Support virtual commissioning activities when applicable to validate control logic and software before physical installation. 

Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement

- Apply lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, 8D, FMEA, DMAIC, 5S, Kanban, Poka-Yoke, Kaizen, and value stream improvement methods to support manufacturing performance. 
 - Use industrial engineering concepts such as constraint analysis, cycle time analysis, and productivity improvement to optimize system throughput. 
 - Capture lessons learned and provide feedback to improve controls standards, component selection, equipment maintainability, and future program execution. 
 - Support standardization of controls practices, machine safety processes, useful life planning, and deviation management. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Training

- Collaborate effectively with production, maintenance, plant electricians, process engineering, safety, IT, quality, suppliers, and plant leadership. 
 - Assist in training manufacturing personnel, maintenance teams, and electricians on controls systems, troubleshooting methods, and safe equipment operation. 
 - Communicate technical issues, risk items, recovery plans, and improvement opportunities clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - For candidates at the higher end of the experience range, provide technical guidance, coaching, and informal mentorship to junior engineers and plant technical teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 
 - 3 to 10 years of controls engineering experience in a manufacturing, powertrain, automotive, machining, assembly, or industrial automation environment. 
 - Hands-on experience troubleshooting and modifying PLC logic, HMI screens, automation systems, robots, drives, sensors, actuators, and industrial communication systems. 
 - Experience with one or more PLC platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Bosch, or equivalent industrial control systems. 
 - Working knowledge of robotic systems such as ABB, FANUC, or similar industrial robots. 
 - Ability to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, controls, and automation prints. 
 - Understanding of industrial communication networks, fieldbus protocols, and plant floor data interfaces. 
 - Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in Ford Powertrain manufacturing, machining lines, engine, transmission, eDrive, battery, or propulsion system manufacturing. 
 - Experience with CNC controls, machining cells, gantries, transfer systems, assembly lines, torque systems, and auxiliary automation equipment. 
 - Knowledge of Factory Information Systems, IIoT, error-proofing, QWX, QTS, WMA, OBL, SMART, VTAG, GPTS, QDAS, PDS, or similar manufacturing IT systems. 
 - Experience with vision systems such as Keyence, Cognex, Zebra, or equivalent inspection and traceability systems. 
 - Knowledge of RFID systems, traceability, complexity management, scheduling logic, and quality operating system strategies. 
 - Understanding of international and regional electrical and machine safety standards, including UL, ISO, IEC, risk assessments, PSS, and integrated safety systems. 
 - Experience with GPDS or equivalent program delivery processes, equipment launch, and manufacturing readiness deliverables. 
 - Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 8D, FMEA, DMAIC, TQM, and Kaizen experience. 

Technical Skills

Skill Area

Expected Knowledge / Experience

PLC and Controls Programming

Siemens, Bosch, or equivalent PLC platforms; logic troubleshooting, modification, validation, and backup management. 

Robotics and Automation

ABB, FANUC, or similar robot systems; robot troubleshooting, path/program support, interlock validation, and automation fault recovery. 

CNC and Motion Systems

CNC controls, machining cells, gantries, servo systems, drives, motion controls, and auxiliary equipment integration. 

Vision and Traceability

Keyence, Cognex, Zebra, RFID, barcode, part tracking, complexity management, error-proofing, and quality data systems. 

Manufacturing IT Integration

FIS, IIoT, QWX, QTS, WMA, OBL, SMART, VTAG, GPTS, QDAS, PDS, Andon, and plant floor data collection systems. 

Industrial Networks

Fieldbus protocols, Ethernet-based industrial networks, communication architecture, device-level troubleshooting, and data interface validation. 

Safety and Compliance

Machine safety, risk assessments, PSS, integrated safety, electrical standards, lockout concepts, and safety circuit validation.

Electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, controls, and automation prints; standards review; design review participation; lessons learned documentation.

Self-starting, self-directed, and accountable for delivering results in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Effective cross-functional teamwork across plant operations, technical teams, suppliers, and leadership stakeholders.

 - Code Excellence & Collaboration: Write clean, maintainable, and highly efficient code, lead rigorous code reviews, and actively collaborate with the team on system design and technical decision-making. 
 - System Optimization: Troubleshoot complex distributed systems issues and optimize performance across the entire tech stack. 
 - Mentorship: Act as a technical pillar for the team, mentoring junior engineers and fostering a culture of rapid experimentation and "failing fast" (and learning faster). 

Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Experience: 7 to 10 years of professional software development experience, specifically within a product-based company where you have navigated rapid scaling. 
 - Core Tech: Expert-level proficiency in Python and Java. 
 - AI/Document Experience: Document parsing experience-extracting structured data from PDFs, HTML, XML, or other unstructured formats. 
 - Database Expertise: Deep hands-on experience with NoSQL databases (specifically DynamoDB) and a solid understanding of data modeling for performance. 
 - Messaging & Integration: Proven experience with Kafka or similar message brokers for building event-driven systems. 
 - Cloud Native: Strong experience with AWS services (Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, etc. ) and building cloud-native applications. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Experience with K8s and advanced Infrastructure as Code tools such as CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation. 
 - Data Engineering: Familiarity with building and maintaining Data Pipelines (ETL/ELT processes) and handling large-scale datasets. 
 - Architecture: Strong understanding of Microservices, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems design. 
 - Mindset & Communication: A proactive, "owner" mindset with the ability to thrive in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment, and excellent communication skills. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

As a Senior Engineering Manager (L6), whether you are leading a "team of teams" focused on hyper-personalizing the Uber Eats feed through cutting-edge ML, or overseeing the distributed compute platforms and payment systems that support millions of global earners, you are building for real-world impact at massive scale. 

This role requires a leader who can navigate high-stakes ambiguity and make hard calls under pressure. You'll be responsible for setting long-term technical vision while managing the weight of decisions that affect global reliability and business outcomes. You won't just follow a playbook; you will help write it by building high-performing teams in an environment where the pace is relentless and the stakes are high. If you lead with clarity, build with heart, and thrive in the "messy" reality of doing big things-this is where you'll make your mark. 

What You'll Do

- Lead and grow a high-performing engineering organization of managers and staff-level ICs, fostering a culture of technical excellence, operational rigor, and continuous learning. 
 - Define and execute the strategic roadmap for your domain, ensuring technical investments align with high-impact use cases and long-term business objectives. 
 - Drive architectural decisions for large-scale distributed systems, challenging your teams to design robust, scalable solutions for batch compute, ML orchestration, or global payments. 
 - Partner deeply across disciplines-including Product, Data Science, Design, and Finance-to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and deliver seamless platform integrations. 
 - Assume complete accountability for the reliability, cost-efficiency, and performance of your systems, establishing metrics that drive measurable impact. 
 - Navigate a diverse set of opinions among global stakeholders, synthesizing different perspectives to drive decisions effectively and unblock execution. 

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in engineering management and 4+ years as a manager of managers. 
 - Proven track record of setting direction for an organization, constructing visions that unify multiple engineering teams and align with primary customer needs. 
 - Demonstrated ability to drive high productivity and a bias to action across direct teams while proactively unblocking dependencies across the larger organization. 
 - Experience coaching managers on crafting team visions and translating high-level strategy into actionable roadmaps and successful outcomes. 
 - Expertise in managing organizational performance, making the hard calls when necessary, and building a reliable bench of the next generation of leaders. 
 - Ability to drive a culture of high accountability for technical decisions, encouraging calculated risks and bets to balance long-term productivity with short-term needs. 
 - Education: Master's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

Preferred Qualifications

- PhD in a technical field with a research or applied focus on large-scale ML systems, distributed computing, or related paradigms. 
 - Domain expertise in Payments, AdTech, or Autonomous Systems, with an understanding of global and regional nuances. 
 - Deep understanding of product experimentation, including the statistical mechanics and analysis needed to challenge experimental results. 
 - Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas to C-level executives and non-technical audiences. 
 - A "Driver" mindset: You are biased toward action, a master disambiguator, and stay resilient through constant change. 

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you. 

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. 

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. 

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

AI agents

Front end

Back end and integration

Architecture and quality

AI engineering

- Strong hands-on AI engineering experience, with agents that have moved beyond experimentation or basic LLM usage into production. 
 - Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts and terminology. 
 - Experience building solutions where agents reason, work toward goals, invoke tools or APIs, and take actions. 
 - Understanding of LLMs and modern generative AI architectures, plus solid data science fundamentals. 

Front end (required)

- Hands-on experience building user-facing applications with React and TypeScript, including Next. js or a similar framework. 
 - Strong HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+), including responsive layouts with Flexbox and Grid. 
 - Experience with a utility or component styling approach such as Tailwind CSS. 
 - Ability to turn Figma designs into pixel-accurate, accessible, cross-browser interfaces. 
 - Experience consuming REST APIs and managing client-side state, loading states, and error handling. 

Back end and integration

- Strong full-stack software development experience across back-end and user-facing development. 
 - Strong Python and Java knowledge, and an understanding of how Python applies to AI-driven solutions. 
 - Experience designing, developing, and consuming APIs. 

Working style

- Comfortable in an evolving environment where requirements and technical approaches change as the team learns. 
 - Strong communication skills, able to discuss technical decisions, trade-offs, and the future of AI with both technical and business stakeholders. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Anthropic's Claude platform, Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG, or workflow tools such as n8n. 
 - Familiarity with Snowflake or other data platforms, and with ServiceNow integrations. 
 - Experience with Node. js, GraphQL, or Django alongside Python and Java. 
 - Cloud and delivery experience: AWS, Docker, CI/CD, and automated testing such as Cypress or Jest. 
 - Experience designing human-in-the-loop approval flows for AI-driven actions.

Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. 

Must have skills : Embedded Product Verification & Validation

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : Bachelors degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering Computer or Electrical Engineering or Automotive Engineering or equivalent technical experience

Summary: 

The Senior Analyst will create and maintain simulation test scenarios derived from real-world system logs and telemetry. The role requires strong diagnostic reasoning, an understanding of complex software architectures and state machines, and the ability to translate observed system behavior into precise, bounded simulation parameters. The Senior Analyst will develop reusable configurations and programmatic rulesets that work reliably across varied automated data pipelines, rather than relying on single-instance scenario creation. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

Perform log-based test generation and maintenance, with a focus on diagnostic accuracy and reproducible simulation scenarios. 

Analyze system logs and real-world telemetry to identify relevant events, infer system states, isolate variables and investigate the causes of observed behavior. 

Define strict inclusion criteria for selecting log events and translate them into bounded simulation parameters. 

Understand how software modules, state machines, environmental physics and simulator configurations interact to produce the behavior under test. 

Define scenario logic using Boolean conditions, geometric constraints and time-based predicates within dynamic 3D environments. 

Develop reusable configurations, test parameters and programmatic rulesets that can be applied in bulk across highly variable automated data pipelines. 

Design boundary-value and edge-case tests, with clear metrics and tolerances that isolate the intended signal while allowing acceptable minor execution variances. 

Maintain scenarios and configurations as system behavior, source logs and simulation inputs change, checking that the intended test conditions remain valid. 

Review scenario definitions and diagnostic findings for clarity, consistency and traceability to the source telemetry. 

Professional & Technical Skills: 

Strong deductive reasoning and analytical judgment to reverse-engineer observed behavior and troubleshoot complex issues. 

Systems-level thinking, with the ability to move from individual scenarios to reusable rules that support large-scale automated execution. 

A structured and detail-oriented approach to defining inclusion criteria, documenting assumptions and checking diagnostic conclusions. 

Clear technical communication and the ability to explain scenario logic, system interactions and findings to a distributed team. 

Systems Architecture & Modular Thinking: Understand complex, interdependent software architectures and state machines, including the interaction of discrete modules, environmental physics and simulator configurations. 

Log Analysis & Diagnostic Troubleshooting: Parse system logs, interpret telemetry, isolate variables and translate real-world events into accurate, bounded simulation parameters. 

Parametric Design & Spatial Logic: Apply Boolean logic, geometric constraints and time-based predicates to dynamic 3D environments. 

Algorithmic Scalability: Design configurations and test parameters that remain reliable across variable automated data pipelines, using programmatic rulesets that can be applied in bulk. 

Robustness & Boundary Value Analysis: Identify edge cases, define suitable tolerances and design metrics that distinguish the intended signal from acceptable minor execution variances. 

Configuration & Visual Logic Tools: Experience with visual node-based logic, such as Unreal Engine Blueprints or Unity, or complex configuration languages such as JSON and XML is beneficial. 

Relevant Backgrounds: Experience in QA automation engineering, data analysis, Tier 3 technical support or systems integration may provide a suitable foundation when supported by the core competencies above. 

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have minimum 7 years of experience in Test and Embedded Product Verification & Validation. 
 - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. 
 - A Bachelors degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering Computer or Electrical Engineering or Automotive Engineering (Systems and Controls), Applied Mathematics, Physics, or equivalent technical experience is required.

data.title: Head of Engineering EHR Integration
data.description:
Head of Engineering: EHR Integration

Pay: ₹80 to ₹120 lakh per year

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India

Type: Full-time

Hours: 12: 30 PM to 9: 30 PM IST

Entity: XpertDox India Private Limited (XIPL)

Department: EHR Integration

On-site or remote: On-site, Monday through Friday

Reports to: Chief Technology Officer

About XpertDox

XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), women's health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers. 

Position Summary

You own the integrations that move every XpertCoding claim from the EHR to submission. That covers the full portfolio of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance, and the reliability of the claims pipeline: scheduled runs, encounter pickup, coding handoff, claim creation, and submission. You decide how failures are detected, who responds, and what changes after an incident. You lead the EHR Integration team and are responsible for its hiring, performance, standards, and code review. The bots and pipelines handle protected health information under XpertDox's SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA controls, and you hold the team to them. This is an architecture and leadership role. The team writes the code. You decide what gets built, how, and in what order, and you review what ships. It is not for someone who wants to spend most of the week building bots, and it is not for someone who has only managed an RPA vendor. 

Key Responsibilities

In this role you will: 

- Own the architecture, roadmap, and delivery of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance. 
 - Own the reliability of the claims pipeline from scheduled run to submitted claim. 
 - Define the monitoring and alerting that surfaces failures in unattended bots the same day they occur. 
 - Own incident response and root cause analysis for integration failures, and close every corrective action. 
 - Set engineering standards for the code: version control, code review, testing, release discipline, and documented configuration changes before they reach production. 
 - Lead the EHR Integration team: hiring, performance, standards, and code review. 
 - Report delivery, risks, and capacity to the CTO on a regular cadence. Required Qualifications

- 10 or more years building production software. 
 - 3 or more years leading a software engineering team with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and delivery. 
 - Has owned production RPA bots or integration pipelines at scale, where failures had direct business impact. 
 - Current architecture ability in Python for production services and integrations. 
 - Production experience with AWS, MongoDB, and SQL databases. Preferred Qualifications

- EHR integration experience: HL7 v2, FHIR, or direct connections to major ambulatory EHR systems. 
 - Experience with applications that handle protected health information or other regulated data. 
 - Daily use of AI coding tools, such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot, to lead and raise the output of an engineering team. 
 - Has built monitoring, alerting, and incident ownership for unattended bots or batch pipelines. Location and Schedule

This role is on-site at the XIPL office in Noida, Monday through Friday, 12: 30 PM to 9: 30 PM IST, to overlap with the Arizona workday. It is not remote and not hybrid. Candidates outside Delhi NCR must relocate to Noida before the start date. Occasional travel to the Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters may be required; XpertDox may sponsor a B2 visa for that travel. 

Compensation

- Base salary of ₹80 to ₹120 lakh per year, commensurate with experience. 
 - Stock options. 
 - Relocation assistance, reimbursed against receipts. Benefits

- Health insurance, provident fund, and leave per XIPL policy. 
 - Company cab service for all Noida employees. To Apply

Apply at https: //careers. xpertdox. com/. 

XIPL is an equal opportunity employer.

Roles & Responsibilities: 

You will break down complex behavioral expectations into well-structured and varied test cases that give full coverage without unnecessary overlap. 

You will translate high-level, abstract engineering requirements into specific, parameterized testing strategies based on the operational design domain. 

You will run tests as a power-user, infer system states, isolate variables and try workarounds to find the root cause of issues. 

You will write very clear bug reports for upstream software engineering teams so issues can be understood and fixed quickly. 

You will coordinate with team members in the US, India, who today work mainly during their local working hours. 

Professional & Technical Skills: 

Test Architecture: Very strong logical structuring skills to design test cases with full coverage and no redundant overlap. 

Domain Translation: Strong understanding of operational design domains and the ability to turn abstract requirements into detailed, parameterized test strategies. 

Black-Box Troubleshooting: Able to analyze system behavior without reading the underlying infrastructure code. 

You have strong skills in isolating variables, inferring system states and testing workarounds. 

You are excellent at writing clear, structured and reproducible bug reports. 

You have a strong ability to think analytically and an independent, structured way of working. 

You are a confident communicator and can work well with teams in different locations. 

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have minimum 9 years of experience in Embedded Product Verification & Validation and minimum 3-year experience in ADAS. 
 - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. 
 - A Bachelors degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering Computer or Electrical Engineering or Automotive Engineering (Systems and Controls), Applied Mathematics, Physics, or equivalent technical experience is required.

data.title: AI Engineer
data.description:
Nexperia is a world-class company in semiconductor development and in-house production. A proven global player with an entrepreneurial mentality. At our core is an 13, 000+ strong international network with a singular focus. Built on passion and commitment to our work, belief in our goals and a drive to succeed regardless of the challenges we face. We support, reward and challenge individuals equally, in a dynamic and energetic environment. 

Nexperia is a world-class company in semiconductor development and in-house production. We form a global network of talent, with passion and performance, perseverance and professionalism. Join TeamNexperia and become part of a leading company that supports, rewards and challenges you equally, in a dynamic environment, working for world-class results. Talk to us today and learn your true capabilities in an energetic company where you will develop and thrive, the Efficiency Company - Nexperia. 

About The Team

Digital Enablement is Nexperia's fast-track enabler of AI & Digital use-cases and platform enablement. We operate as one global practice across Nijmegen, Hamburg, Kuala Lumpur, Seremban and Bangalore, covering digital strategy, cloud and infrastructure, digital factory and enterprise, data, AI and integration. 

Bangalore is where we build and ship the agentic systems that put Nexperia's AI patterns in front of real users: copilots, IDE tooling and internal automation that engineers across the company touch every day. 

About The Role

This is the senior build role for Nexperia's agent engineering practice in Bangalore. You own the architecture of the agents themselves - reasoning, planning, tool-calling and memory - and you own the surfaces people actually use them through: chat UI, IDE extensions, CLI tools and the APIs behind them. 

You work closely with the Integration Architect on how agents connect into IDEs and internal systems, and with the MLOps/eval function on the quality bar an agent has to clear before it ships. 

This is a hands-on role. You are still writing and reviewing code, still debugging orchestration failures when something breaks in production, and still accountable for what ships - not a role that manages from a distance. 

What You Will Do

Architect and orchestrate agents

- Design agent architecture: reasoning loops, planning, tool-calling and memory/context management. 
 - Build multi-step orchestration: task decomposition, tool selection and error recovery. 
 - Partner with the Integration Architect on connecting agents to IDEs and internal systems. 

Ship end-to-end agent products

- Own the build of user-facing surfaces for Copilot-style products: chat UI, IDE extensions and CLI tools. 
 - Build the backend APIs that connect those surfaces to agent and LLM services, including streaming responses, session state and context handling. 
 - Ship integrations into developer tools (VS Code extension API, LSPs, browser extensions) and own deployment of both the frontend and backend components you build. 

Set the bar and take releases live

- Review code and agent designs from the two Junior AI Engineers, and mentor them toward independent ownership. 
 - Define the agent quality bar with the MLOps/eval function before anything ships, and work with that function on the CI/CD, monitoring, versioning/rollback and observability an agent needs once it's live. 

Enable the Spokes

- Own the governance bar for citizen-built agents - what "safe to ship" means for security, data access, cost and quality - in partnership with security/compliance and the Integration Architect. 
 - Publish and maintain the standards - prompting, evals, architecture patterns - that spoke teams build against. 
 - Own the design of the self-service component catalog spokes build on top of, and the support model - office hours, an embedded rotation, or a ticket queue - for citizen developers using it

What You Bring

We have kept this list to what the role truly requires. If this role excites you and you meet most, but not all, of these points, we encourage you to apply. 

Core Requirements

- 1-6 years hands-on building LLM or agent systems. 
 - Strong Python and/or TypeScript; comfortable owning a service end to end. 
 - Hands-on with agent frameworks or SDKs (Claude Agent SDK/MCP, LangGraph, AutoGen) or custom orchestration. 
 - Has shipped an agentic system to production, not just a prototype. 
 - Solid grasp of traditional machine learning/AI (e. g. , classification, regression, clustering, feature engineering) in addition to LLM/agent-based approaches. . 
 - Comfortable designing REST, GraphQL and streaming/WebSocket APIs, and familiar with LLM streaming APIs (SSE/WebSockets) and token-by-token rendering. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise AI/copilot platforms and cloud-native model ecosystems - Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry (model catalog, deployments, and orchestration), and AWS model configuration (Bedrock model access, inference profiles/settings) is a plus. 

Valuable extras

- Strong in React/TypeScript for frontend work, and Node. js or Python for backend work. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins or similar), cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure or GCP) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Observability tooling - Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, or LLM-specific tools like LangSmith or Arize - and familiarity with LLMOps practices: prompt versioning, eval pipelines, cost tracking. 
 - Working knowledge of auth and session management, and awareness of security and compliance considerations for AI systems. 
 - Experience in the manufacturing industry, preferably semiconductor, is a plus. 
 - Experience or interest in developer enablement or platform engineering - documentation, SDKs, or internal tooling built for non-specialist users, not just for your own team. 

Why join us

- Real ownership: you set the architecture and the quality bar for agents that ship to real users, not just a reference design others build from. 
 - A mentoring role with teeth: two Junior AI Engineers are counting on your reviews, and Nexperia measures you on their growth as much as on your own output. 
 - You're measured not only on what the Hub ships, but on how many spoke teams successfully ship agents using what you've published. 
 - Global exposure from Bangalore: you work with the AI and Data Centers of Enablement, the Integration Architect, platform engineering, security and compliance, with visibility up to the CIO and IT Management Team. 
 - A team that values structured thinking, intellectual honesty about trade-offs and good documentation over heroics. 

Talent acquisition based on Nexperia vacancies is not appreciated. Nexperia job adverts are Nexperia copyright © material and the word Nexperia® is a registered trademark. 

D&I Statement

As an equal-opportunity employer, Nexperia values diversity not just because it is the right thing to do but because diverse teams perform better. We are dedicated to being inclusive, and a proof point of this dedication is that we were the main partner of the very first Dutch Paralympic Team NL House during the Paris 2024 Paralympic Games. Our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible to all, and we consider all applicants fairly, as well as providing a safe work environment and reasonable adjustments where requested. 

In addition, we offer our colleagues the possibility to join employee resource groups such as the Pride Network Group or global and local Women's groups. Nexperia is committed to increasing women in management positions to 30% by 2030.

data.description:

Function: Software Engineering

Reports to: Director, Packaging Intelligence

About The Role

Esko is building Agentic AI as a shared platform capability that enables product teams to create reliable AI-powered workflows without independently rebuilding common foundations. The platform team provides reusable capabilities, engineering patterns, and production foundations; product teams retain ownership of their domain applications and customer experiences. 

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role combining line management with substantial direct technical contribution. You will lead and develop the Agentic AI team, help shape the platform's technical direction, and take end-to-end ownership of substantial technical areas. Success will be measured not only by what the team ships, but by the quality, adoption, and leverage the platform creates across Esko. 

You will work closely with product engineering, architecture, cloud platform, security, compliance, product management, and design to translate shared needs and legitimate domain differences into coherent platform capabilities. You will also contribute to Esko's broader AI direction and participate in customer or industry discussions where your technical perspective is valuable. 

What You Will Do

- Lead and develop the Agentic AI engineering team through clear goals, regular feedback, coaching, performance management, career development, and thoughtful allocation of ownership. 
 - Contribute directly to the design, implementation, and operation of substantial areas of Esko's shared Agentic AI platform. 
 - Help shape the platform's technical direction, architecture, interfaces, and engineering quality bar in collaboration with the wider platform and architecture community. 
 - Translate recurring product and engineering needs into reusable platform capabilities, while accommodating legitimate domain differences without creating product-specific forks. 
 - Establish strong engineering practices for reliability, security, observability, evaluation, performance, and compatibility for consuming teams. 
 - Work directly with product engineering teams to support adoption of the shared platform and help them take domain-specific agentic capabilities from exploration into production. 
 - Create an environment in which engineers can experiment, learn, challenge assumptions, and make evidence-based technical decisions while remaining accountable for production outcomes. 
 - Define and use meaningful measures of platform adoption, quality, operational performance, delivery effectiveness, and team development to guide priorities and improvement. 

What We Are Looking For

- Strong production software engineering experience in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language, including designing, building, and operating reliable systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers, including line management, coaching, performance feedback, and creating meaningful technical ownership. 
 - Experience building a platform, API, or shared service used by multiple teams, with sound judgement about abstractions, interfaces, compatibility, and operational responsibilities. 
 - Experience designing or building production AI systems using large language models, tool use, or agentic workflows, together with a practical understanding of their limitations and risks. 
 - A track record of taking uncertain or early-stage technical ideas through evaluation, implementation, and adoption as dependable production capabilities. 
 - Ability to balance platform coherence with legitimate product and domain differences, and to make clear technical trade-offs when needs conflict. 
 - Experience collaborating across product engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, and business functions in a global organization. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineering, product, and leadership audiences.
