data.title: Founding Full Stack Staff Engineer - Frontier Cyber Security
data.description:
Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

ABOUT US

Lean SuperIntelligence (LSI) is an AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity foundation models for enterprises. LSI publicly announced LSI-Offense-1 and LSI-Defense-1 on October 9, 2026, alongside the closing of its initial pre-seed financing. 

LSI-Offense-1 discovers, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to threats. The models improve through an offense-defense feedback loop inside LSI Cyber World Models, simulated enterprise environments that turn attack and defense outcomes into training signals. 

The models are designed for enterprise-controlled deployment, including on-premises and air-gapped environments, with customization on private enterprise data. Access is currently limited to selected design partners. 

Founded by Chandra Khatri, LSI brings together foundation-model builders and security researchers. Its announced backers include investors and angels with AI and security leadership experience at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Zscaler, Commvault and Gruve AI. These affiliations do not imply corporate investment by those organizations. 

Learn more: LSI website | Launch announcement | Financing and model news. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Founding Full Stack Staff Engineer to build the product surface of our frontier security platform, from data model and services through to the interfaces security teams work in every day. 

You will own features end to end: backend services, agent-facing APIs, and the front end where findings, exploit evidence, and remediation workflows are reviewed and acted on. This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad architectural ownership and a direct line to design partners. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own features end to end across data model, backend services, APIs, front end, telemetry, and rollout. 

- Build the interfaces security teams work in daily: finding triage, exploit evidence review, remediation and retest tracking, agent run inspection, and reporting. 

- Design backend services and APIs for scanning, agent execution, evidence storage, and integrations with code hosts, CI/CD, ticketing systems, and cloud accounts. 

- Build product surfaces on top of LLMs and autonomous agents, including streaming output, long-running task state, human approval steps, partial results, and graceful failure. 

- Turn AppSec workflows into product: finding deduplication, severity and reachability context, ownership routing, SLA tracking, and verification that fixes actually close the vulnerability. 

- Design schemas and pipelines for findings, agent trajectories, evidence artifacts, and audit trails. 

- Build multi-tenant foundations including authentication, authorization, RBAC, org and project scoping, audit logging, secrets handling, and tenant isolation. 

- Make agent behavior legible in the interface: what the agent did, what it proved, what it could not, and where a human needs to decide. 

- Own performance, reliability, latency, and cost across the stack, including inference and tool-execution cost surfaced to the user. 

- Set engineering standards for code review, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and secure-by-default patterns, and treat our own attack surface as a first-class concern. 

- Prototype quickly with design partners, put working software in front of practitioners early, and decide what is ready to ship. 

- Partner with security researchers, agent-harness engineers, and product to move research capability into product without losing rigor. 

QUALIFICATIONS

- At least five years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time spent on cybersecurity products. 

- Strong full-stack ability: modern TypeScript and React on the front end, plus backend work in Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, or Rust. 

- Hands-on experience building application-security products, or closely adjacent ones such as code security, vulnerability management, attack-surface management, DevSecOps, offensive-security tooling, or SOC platforms. 

- Working security knowledge across common vulnerability classes, authentication and authorization, and secure design, with the ability to reason about the attack surface of what you build. 

- Experience designing APIs, data models, and asynchronous or long-running workflows. 

- Front-end craft on data-dense technical interfaces, including state management, streaming and real-time updates, and performance under large result sets. 

- Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and production operations. 

- Ability to scope ambiguous problems, make architectural decisions, and raise the bar for other engineers through code and review rather than process. 

- Clear technical writing and comfort working directly with security practitioners and design partners. 

- We value demonstrated ability over formal credentials, certifications, or a fixed number of years of experience. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience building products on LLMs or agents, including tool use, streaming, evaluations, prompt and model versioning, and latency and cost tradeoffs. 

- Product experience in autonomous pentesting, code security, SAST/DAST/SCA, vulnerability management, CTEM, EDR/XDR, or SOC automation. 

- Personal offensive-security depth such as CVEs, bug-bounty findings, advanced CTF performance, or published research. 

- Experience integrating with GitHub or GitLab, CI systems, Jira or ServiceNow, SIEM and EDR platforms, or cloud provider APIs. 

- Experience meeting enterprise requirements such as SSO, SAML, SCIM, audit logging, VPC or on-premise deployment, and air-gapped installs. 

- Experience with real-time systems, websockets, job queues, or event-driven architectures. 

- Design sensibility and the ability to own the user experience for technical workflows without a dedicated designer. 

- Understanding of AI and agent security risks including prompt injection, tool poisoning or misuse, excessive permissions, untrusted content, and sandbox boundaries. 

- Open-source contributions, technical writing, or prior founding-engineer and early-stage experience.

You will lead a team of full-stack engineers, act as the technical voice to US-based stakeholders and customer teams, and stay hands-on in code, reviews and architecture.

 - Own the architecture of Java (Spring Boot) microservices and Angular microfrontends, including service boundaries, API contracts, shell and remote composition, and shared design systems. 
 - Lead design reviews, code reviews and technical decision-making; set coding standards, testing strategy and definition of done. 
 - Stay hands-on: build critical components, prototype solutions, and unblock the team on hard problems.

 - Present architecture, progress and trade-offs clearly to both technical and business audiences. 
 - Communicate status, blockers and change requests in writing with clear, concise updates that a US stakeholder can act on without a follow-up call.

Candidates who do not meet the first three points below will not be shortlisted. 

- Direct USA counterpart exposure: At least 3 years of working daily with US-based clients, product owners or architects, including regular calls in US time-zone overlap, demos, and written status communication. Candidates must be able to describe specific engagements. 
 - Direct customer team collaboration: Proven experience working side by side with customer engineering, QA and business team members on requirements, integrations, UAT and production issues, not only through a project manager. 
 - Microservices and microfrontends as daily work: Hands-on delivery of Spring Boot microservices and Angular microfrontends in production, treated as the normal way of building, not a recent experiment.

 - Team leadership: At least 3 years leading a team of 5 or more engineers, with ownership of design, delivery and mentoring. 
 - Communication: Strong spoken and written English, suitable for customer-facing and executive communication.

- Good to Have
 - Experience with optimisation, forecasting or rule-engine-backed products, or with map and real-time dashboard UIs. 
 - Exposure to open-source, monorepo-based platforms and multi-team release management. 
 - Familiarity with Python-based services that your Java services consume. 
 - Cloud or Kubernetes certification; experience with GitOps. 
 - Prior experience as a technical interface on enterprise accounts in logistics, manufacturing or supply chain. 
 - Behavioural Competencies
 - Clear communicator who can explain a design trade-off to a US product owner and a customer developer in the same week. 
 - Ownership mindset: raises risks early, follows through, and does not wait to be chased. 
 - Calm under production pressure, with a blameless, root-cause-first approach. 
 - Coaches rather than dictates; builds a team that can ship without the lead in every review. 
 - What Success Looks Like in the First Year

Within 90 Days

- Understands the platform, the customer landscape and the delivery rhythm. 
 - Is trusted as the main technical contact by the US counterparts. 

Within 6 Months

- Microservice and microfrontend standards, CI/CD and review practices are documented and followed by the whole team. 

Within 12 Months

- Releases are predictable. 
 - Customer escalations fall. 
 - At least one engineer has grown into a tech-lead role under you.

data.title: Software Development Engineer II,  Now (Tez)
data.description:
Description

Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) - is one of Amazon's largest and fastest-growing businesses, operating across 8+ marketplaces (India, MENA, North America, EU, UK, Japan) and powering adjacent businesses like India Fresh and Healthcare. The platform handles >0. 7MM orders/day, scaling to 2MM by year-end. 

As an SDE2 on the Tez CX PIXEL team, you would work at the heart of Amazon Now's quick commerce platform. IXEL owns the end-to-end in-store shopping experience, from homepage and browse surfaces through personalization, live cart, single cart and checkout, deals and value surfacing, AI-driven merchandising, and geospatial CX. 

The systems are Tier 1, serving 2, 000+ TPS as the canonical worldwide platforms for shopping, ordering, and savings. The role directly impacts conversion, basket size, and checkout completion - the metrics that turn platform growth into revenue. The defining product shift ahead is the adaptive, agentic store - moving from a fixed storefront to one that intelligently composes itself around each customer's habits, context, and intent, making this a compelling charter for an SDE2 looking to drive high-impact, customer-facing systems at scale. 

Key job responsibilities

- You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. 
 - You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. 
 - You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). Your solutions are pragmatic. 
 - You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. 
 - You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). 
 - You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. 
 - You are efficient with resource usage (e. g. , system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc. )
 - You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers

About The Team

We are fast-paced and focussed team made of passionate and ambitious Amazonians who strive to build industry leading products while closely collaborating and having fun. The team is made of multiple Sr. SDEs and are working on first time in Amazon initiatives which will scale beyond India and grocery. The team follows a flexible and collaborative work culture with ample mentoring and guidance from PEs. The team values high ownership, bias for action and insist on highest standards and follows build fast and iterate fast methodology. The team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to business and product roadmap. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
 - 3+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. data.title: Senior/ Lead- DevOps Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Solytics Partners is a Global Analytics firm, recognized with multiple industry awards for innovation and excellence. Our team comprises experts with deep domain knowledge in risk, analytics, AI/ML, AML/FCC, and fraud. By converging this expertise with cutting-edge technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs), we deliver powerful automated platforms and incisive point solutions. 

Our offerings enable clients to streamline and future-proof their risk, AML, and analytics processes, comply seamlessly with global regulations, and safeguard financial systems. Whether it's solving complex challenges or driving operational efficiency, Solytics Partners is committed to empowering organizations with transformative tools to stay ahead in an evolving regulatory landscape. 

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architecture, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, automation, DevSecOps/SecOps, and observability to build and operate highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient platforms for our products. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience designing and implementing production-grade cloud infrastructure and deployment platforms, with a strong understanding of DevSecOps, cloud security, SRE principles, reliability engineering, automation, and security operations. 

This role will work closely with Engineering, QA, Product, Security, Architecture, and client teams to enable fast and reliable software delivery while maintaining the security, availability, performance, and compliance requirements expected in a product development environment. 

The role will also involve client implementations, technical solutioning, environment setup, deployment planning, production rollouts, troubleshooting, and technical discussions with client engineering and infrastructure teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud & Platform Engineering

- Design and manage production-grade Azure infrastructure with focus on scalability, availability, security, and performance. 
 - Build and operate AKS/Kubernetes platforms, including deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, RBAC, secrets, and troubleshooting. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform/Bicep and create reusable infrastructure modules and deployment patterns. 
 - Automate operational and engineering workflows using Python, Bash, or PowerShell. 

DevSecOps & SecOps

- Implement and continuously improve DevSecOps and SecOps practices across the software development and deployment lifecycle. 
 - Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container image scanning, secrets detection, and vulnerability management. 
 - Implement and manage cloud security controls covering IAM/RBAC, Entra ID, Key Vault, network security, private endpoints, NSGs, and secure workload configuration. 
 - Monitor security events, vulnerabilities, configuration risks, and infrastructure anomalies and coordinate remediation with engineering and security teams. 
 - Support security reviews, compliance requirements, audit activities, and production security assessments. 
 - Work with development teams to establish secure-by-design deployment and infrastructure patterns. 

Client Implementation & Delivery

- Lead or support end-to-end technical implementation of Solytics products across client environments, particularly enterprise and regulated environments. 
 - Work directly with client infrastructure, DevOps, security, networking, and application teams to understand environment requirements and implementation constraints. 
 - Own technical activities including environment readiness, infrastructure provisioning, connectivity, deployment, configuration, integrations, security controls, and production go-live. 
 - Troubleshoot complex implementation and production issues and drive them through resolution with internal and client stakeholders. 
 - Prepare implementation documentation, deployment guides, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational handover documents. 
 - Participate in client technical discussions, solution workshops, implementation calls, and production readiness reviews. 

Reliability & Observability

- Build observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Drive high availability, disaster recovery, reliability, performance, and capacity planning for production systems. 
 - Troubleshoot complex cloud, Kubernetes, networking, deployment, security, and production issues. 
 - Participate in RCA/post-incident reviews and implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Establish operational standards, monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices. 

Engineering Enablement

- Enable engineering teams through self-service infrastructure and standardized deployment patterns. 
 - Participate in architecture and design discussions to define scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure patterns. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to platform architecture, DevSecOps, and engineering standards. 
 - Continuously improve automation, deployment processes, infrastructure efficiency, security posture, and operational reliability. 

Communication & Stakeholder Management

- Demonstrate excellent written and oral communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Act as a technical point of contact for DevOps, infrastructure, security, and deployment-related discussions with clients. 
 - Collaborate effectively across Engineering, QA, Product, Security, Architecture, Support, and client teams. 
 - Communicate implementation plans, risks, dependencies, incidents, timelines, and technical decisions clearly and proactively. 
 - Create high-quality technical documentation, implementation plans, architecture notes, runbooks, and incident/RCA reports. 

Key Requirements

- 8 to 12 years of hands-on DevOps / Cloud / Platform Engineering / SRE experience. 
 - Strong hands-on production experience with Microsoft Azure. 
 - Strong production experience with AKS, Kubernetes, and Docker. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and managing production infrastructure using Terraform or equivalent IaC. 
 - Strong CI/CD experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar. 
 - Strong understanding of Linux, networking, DNS, load balancing, TLS, IAM/RBAC, and cloud security. 
 - Strong understanding of DevSecOps, SecOps, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and secure software delivery practices. 
 - Experience with Azure services such as Key Vault, VNets, NSGs, Application Gateway, Load Balancer, Private Endpoints, Azure SQL, Storage, and related cloud services. 
 - Strong scripting/automation skills using Python, Bash, or PowerShell. 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident management, and observability. 
 - Good understanding of SRE, HA/DR, production reliability, and capacity planning. 
 - Experience in enterprise/client implementations, preferably involving regulated or highly secure environments. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong stakeholder management capabilities. 
 - Strong Git and Agile/Scrum experience.

Overview

Mastercard powers the global economy by enabling secure, seamless, and intelligent payments across the world. Behind every transaction is a sophisticated technology ecosystem that processes billions of payment events with speed, resilience, and precision. 

As a Lead Data Engineer within the Data Collection & Engineering (DC&E) organisation, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling Mastercard's next-generation data platforms and analytical ecosystems. You will develop high-performance, cloud-enabled data pipelines that power Mastercard's enterprise data warehouse and lakehouse environments, enabling advanced analytics, business intelligence, regulatory reporting, and data-driven decision making across the organisation. 

This role offers a unique opportunity to solve large-scale data engineering challenges, work with cutting-edge big data technologies, and contribute to a modern cloud transformation programme supporting global payment processing platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering & Development

- Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality, secure, scalable, and resilient data pipelines using Apache Spark, Java/Scala across Hadoop and cloud-native object storage platforms. 
 - Build and maintain batch and near real-time data processing frameworks capable of supporting petabyte-scale workloads. 
 - Develop reusable engineering components and frameworks that accelerate data product delivery while maintaining enterprise standards. 

Architecture & Platform Engineering

- Design and implement a "build once, run anywhere" architecture supporting seamless deployment across on-premises and public cloud environments without code changes. 
 - Implement data lineage, metadata management, data cataloguing, data quality controls, and observability capabilities across the data ecosystem. 
 - Collaborate with architects and platform teams to establish scalable design patterns and engineering best practices. 

Cloud Modernisation

- Contribute to migration initiatives moving legacy ETL and data warehouse workloads from on-premises environments to cloud-native architectures. 
 - Leverage cloud services such as Amazon S3, EMR, Glue, and related data services to improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Drive adoption of modern lakehouse and distributed compute architectures. 

Delivery & Technical Leadership

- Lead end-to-end development activities including requirement analysis, solution design, coding, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers through code reviews, technical coaching, and engineering best practices. 
 - Partner with product owners, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions within committed timelines. 

Operational Excellence

- Troubleshoot complex production incidents and perform root cause analysis to identify and implement long-term remediation strategies. 
 - Ensure compliance with Mastercard's engineering, security, quality assurance, and operational governance standards. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve performance, automation, monitoring, and process efficiency. 

Innovation

- Evaluate emerging data technologies and conduct proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives to determine their applicability within Mastercard's data ecosystem. 
 - Contribute to engineering innovation and continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation. 

Qualifications

Required Experience

- 10-12 years of experience delivering enterprise-scale Data Warehouse, Data Lake, or Data Lakehouse solutions. 
 - Proven experience implementing multiple end-to-end data engineering projects within large-scale distributed computing environments. 
 - Hands-on experience migrating ETL and analytics workloads from on-premises platforms to cloud-native environments. 

Technical Expertise

- Strong development experience using: Apache Spark, Scala or Java, Hadoop ecosystem technologies, Object Storage platforms

 - Strong SQL expertise and experience with Relational and NoSQL database technologies: Oracle/ SQL Server, Cassandra, Dynamo DB etc. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms, preferably AWS: Amazon S3, EMR, AWS Glue, Cloud-native data services

Professional Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Experience operating within Agile delivery environments. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate within geographically distributed and matrix-based teams. 
 - Self-starter with strong ownership, accountability, and execution focus. 
 - Ability to learn emerging technologies quickly and apply them effectively to business challenges. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

 - Understanding of secure, scalable, resilient, and observable software design.

All About You

- Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Clear communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI-assisted engineering tools, including GitHub Copilot and Claude CLI, to improve engineering efficiency is required.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices;

American Express's Global Financial Crimes Surveillance Unit (GFCSU) US Investigation Unit (USIU) is part of the broader Global Risk & Compliance organization, operating within Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFCC), provides end-to-end oversight and support of global financial crimes investigations. In partnership with broader GFCC teams, GFCSU supports the development, testing, implementation and adjudication of transaction monitoring rules, reports, and other tools to detect potential criminal activity. GFCSU and USIU play a vital role in ensuring compliance with key regulations, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, and the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act. data.title: Staff Quality Engineer — Qira AI Platform
data.description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers. 

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world's largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo's continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY). 

This transformation together with Lenovo's world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www. lenovo. com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub. 

About The Role

As a Staff AI Quality Engineer for the Qira AI Platform, you will lead the technical test strategy and architectural validation for Lenovo's cross-device agentic AI ecosystem. You will serve as the technical authority on evaluating non-deterministic systems, designing automated quality platforms that operate across personal computing form factors (PCs, tablets, and smartphones). You will drive non-functional quality standards-ensuring that privacy, security, accessibility, internationalization, and device thermals/battery efficiency are safeguarded-while acting as a crucial release partner alongside Product Management and PMO leads. 

What Will You Do

- Test Automation Architecture: Architect scalable, distributed, cross-platform test automation infrastructure capable of executing synchronized, multi-device end-to-end tests across Windows and Android devices without reliance on UI flakiness. 
 - Agentic AI Quality Frameworks: Design automated evaluation methodologies to validate multi-step agent reasoning, tool-calling graphs, autonomous error recovery, and transactional rollback mechanisms; establish statistical release gates for non-deterministic model behaviors. 
 - Hardware Runtime Resource Profiling: Formulate automated performance and endurance soak suites to benchmark on-device SLM execution against cloud fallback paths, monitoring thermal throttling, memory leaks, and battery draw across hardware device tiers. 
 - Non-Functional Quality Standards: Lead automated verification across non-functional pillars: red-teaming indirect prompt injection vulnerabilities, securing inter-process data barriers, standardizing automated accessibility (screen-reader verbosity, dynamic token streaming), and validating semantic fidelity across international locales. 
 - CI/CD Quality Pipelines Gating: Drive the technical implementation of shift-left gating in continuous integration pipelines, establishing automated failure analytics, regression detection, and flakiness isolation frameworks. 
 - Cross-Functional Peer Leadership: Serve as a core technical gatekeeper alongside Product Management and PMO; establish release acceptance criteria, lead data-informed risk assessments during schedule compressions, and influence platform design for enhanced testability. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field. 
 - 8+ years of progressive software quality engineering, test architecture, and automation experience covering multi-device hardware ecosystems (Windows and Android). 
 - 3+ years of experience leading quality strategy and automated evaluation frameworks for LLMs, agentic AI workflows, or conversational platforms. 
 - Advanced programming and architecture skills in Python, C++, C#, or Java, with a track record of building scalable test harnesses and mock environments for OS IPC, APIs, and background daemons. 
 - Proven experience architecting automated non-functional test frameworks: deep profiling of device performance (NPU/GPU/CPU, battery mA/h, memory), security red-teaming/prompt-injection defense, automated accessibility (WCAG), and i18n semantic evaluation. 
 - Deep technical expertise in CI/CD pipeline architecture, test orchestration, and statistical quality gating. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on expertise implementing and tuning non-deterministic evaluation platforms (e. g. , RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, TruLens) in production pipelines. 
 - Direct experience testing local NPU runtimes and quantized models (INT4/INT8 vs. FP16) on client silicon (Qualcomm, Intel, AMD). 
 - Background designing automated testing for multimodal inputs (synchronized voice injection, screen-capture parsing, synthetic system events). 
 - Demonstrated ability to resolve complex release-gating disputes with Product Management and PMO using objective risk metrics and clear mitigation trade-offs. 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

Job Description Summary

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, performance, and scalability of GE Vernova Grid Software solutions that support transmission, distribution, and energy management operations across utilities worldwide. Leveraging deep expertise in power systems, utility operations, EMS/SCADA applications, and Grid Engineering products, you will lead quality engineering initiatives across complex enterprise software platforms. 

The ideal candidate combines strong software testing and quality engineering capabilities with a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (Power Systems preferred) and hands-on experience validating mission-critical grid applications. You will work closely with product management, development teams, system architects, and domain experts to develop comprehensive test strategies, drive automation adoption, identify product risks early, and ensure high-quality releases for customers operating critical grid infrastructure. 

This role requires strong domain expertise in power systems and utility operations, exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, and a passion for delivering world-class Grid Software products that are transforming the future of energy. 

Responsibilities

Job Description

- Lead quality assurance activities across Grid Software products, ensuring functional, integration, system, performance, and regression testing coverage. 
 - Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and validation approaches for complex EMS, SCADA, DMS, ADMS, GridOS, and power system applications. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, developers, solution architects, and power system engineers to understand business requirements and grid operational workflows. 
 - Apply strong power system domain expertise to validate network modeling, topology processing, state estimation, contingency analysis, outage management, interoperability, and other grid applications. 
 - Drive automation initiatives using modern test frameworks and CI/CD pipelines to improve test coverage, release quality, and execution efficiency. 
 - Design and implement automated functional, API, integration, and end-to-end test suites for enterprise-grade Grid Software products. 
 - Analyze customer-reported issues, reproduce field defects, perform root-cause analysis, and partner with engineering teams to drive resolution. 
 - Validate software performance, scalability, cybersecurity, reliability, and resiliency requirements for utility-grade deployments. 
 - Participate in architecture reviews, requirement reviews, and design discussions to ensure quality is built into products from inception. 
 - Champion quality engineering best practices, shift-left testing methodologies, risk-based testing, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Mentor junior QA engineers and contribute to establishing testing standards, frameworks, and quality processes across teams. 
 - Support customer deployments, interoperability testing, factory acceptance testing (FAT), and system validation activities for utility customers globally. 

Desired Characteristics

Job Description Summary

The Lead Engineer - Instrumentation & Controls is responsible for the engineering, design, and execution support of instrumentation and control systems for Steam Power projects (Boiler, Steam Turbine, Generator, ESP, FGD). The role also supports technical problem solving, design standardization, quality, on-time delivery, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

The engineer is expected to independently execute assigned engineering tasks and standard project scope with limited supervision, while seeking guidance for complex technical decisions. The role requires a strong foundation in Instrumentation & Controls engineering, good coordination capability, and the ability to deliver accurate, timely, and compliant engineering documentation.

- Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a related engineering discipline. 
 - 10+ years of total experience in Instrumentation & Controls engineering for boiler, steam turbine, generator, ESP, FGD or similar industrial process applications.

The role owns delivery across New Product Introduction (NPI), Product cost management (PCM), Fleet, Repair support, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), ensuring solutions meet expectations for safety, quality, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and schedule. This role also requires close integration of Aeromechanics considerations into component design and structural integrity assessment. You will provide technical leadership to a team in a matrixed environment and work closely with cross-functional organizations to deliver robust outcomes for both internal and end customers.

Lead assigned programs end-to-end, owning execution, coordination, and delivery across the engineering lifecycle of the component. Maintain rigor and responsiveness while managing safety, quality, cost, and technical risk.

 - Apply working knowledge of mechanical design, lifing, and interface considerations to component evaluations.

- Guide engineers on daily execution needs, technical priorities, and expected deliverables. 
 - Review work products to ensure completeness, quality, and alignment with engineering requirements. 
 - Coach team members to strengthen technical judgment, ownership, and problem-solving capability. 
 - Promote accountability and collaboration within the team through consistent feedback and open communication.

Build effective working relationships across functions to enable aligned decisions and integrated execution. Engage stakeholders early and communicate technical concerns clearly to manage downstream impacts. 

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional and interfacing teams to ensure deliverables are aligned, reviewed, and completed effectively.

 - Keep internal customers and partner teams informed on decisions that affect their scope, priorities, or deliverables.

Problem Solving, Continuous Improvement and Future-Ready Mindset

Approach problems with structure and discipline, driving practical improvements that make engineering work simpler, faster, and more effective. Support the adoption of modern tools and methods to strengthen execution over time.

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer II, Alexa Connectivity Devices
data.description:
Description

Are you passionate about building reliable, high-quality software that customers can depend on? As a Quality Assurance Engineer II at Amazon, you will play a critical role in ensuring our products meet the highest quality standards before they reach customers. You will design and execute comprehensive test strategies, build automation that scales, and collaborate closely with engineering teams to catch defects early and prevent them from happening in the first place. 

This is a hands-on role where your analytical mindset and technical skills will directly influence product quality. You will own test planning for complex features and services, write automated test cases that provide meaningful end-to-end coverage, and drive continuous improvements to how we measure and deliver quality. If you are a self-starter who thrives on solving problems and making systems more reliable, we want to hear from you. 

Key job responsibilities

Own end-to-end test strategy for device software features and wireless connectivity - defining what to test, how to test it, and what lab infrastructure is needed, even when requirements are ambiguous or evolving across kernel, firmware, and RF domains. 

Create and execute test plans for complex test scenarios including system integration, wireless protocol conformance (Wi-Fi, BLE, Zigbee, Thread, Matter, Sidewalk), power profiling, and hardware-software co-validation across firmware, OS, and connectivity boundaries. 

Design and build Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test rigs and automated test solutions that are maintainable, reusable, and reliable - enabling other engineers to run and extend them independently against real device hardware. 

Develop RF test automation scripts for wireless performance benchmarking, packet error rate measurement, sensitivity testing, and production line calibration support. 

Own power profiling and battery life testing - current measurement, sleep/wake analysis, duty cycle optimization validation using tools such as Nordic PPK2 or Keysight power analyzers. 

Create and maintain protocol conformance test suites for Wi-Fi Alliance, Zigbee Alliance, CSA Matter, and Amazon Sidewalk certification requirements. 

Build regression test infrastructure that runs on every CI/CD build against real hardware targets, integrated with the team's Yocto-based build pipeline. 

Isolate, document, and validate defects with detailed evidence and root-cause analysis across embedded software, wireless stacks, and peripheral interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART), enabling development teams to triage and resolve issues efficiently. 

Represent quality assurance in cross-functional discussions including design reviews, release readiness decisions, and retrospectives - advocating for quality at every stage of the device software development lifecycle. 

Support regulatory pre-certification testing (FCC, CE, BIS, TELEC) for wireless subsystems and device platforms. 

Mentor junior engineers, interns, and contractors - training them on device platforms, test methodologies, and lab tools, and creating documentation that reduces tribal knowledge. 

Proactively identify quality risks, propose solutions, and take on projects that improve testing processes or more accurately measure product quality across the full device software stack. 

A day in the life

You will start your day reviewing test results from overnight automation runs, triaging any new defects and identifying root causes. From there, you might join a design review to assess the testability of an upcoming feature, then shift to writing or refining automated test cases for a current release. You will regularly partner with software engineers and product managers to align on quality priorities and participate in bug triage sessions. Expect to mentor teammates, contribute to retrospectives, and continuously look for ways to make testing smarter and more efficient. 

About The Team

The Alexa Connected Devices Device Software team is a new two-pizza team in Bangalore, India, supporting device software development for Amazon's connected devices portfolio. The team brings deep expertise in operating system fundamentals, embedded systems, wireless connectivity (Wi-Fi, BLE), and sub-gigahertz standards (Zigbee, Thread, Matter, Amazon Sidewalk). 

We are growing and looking for curious, technically strong people who want to make a real impact on how connected device technology serves customers worldwide. 

Basic Qualifications

- 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
 - Experience in manual testing
 - Experience in automation testing
 - Experience scripting or coding
 - Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with at least one automated test framework like Selenium or Appium
 - Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
 - Experience troubleshooting and debugging embedded systems, wireless connectivity stacks, and firmware
 - Experience developing high-quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution for IoT device platforms
 - Experience with test management tools (e. g. , TestRail, Zephyr) and issue management tools (Jira)
 - Experience working closely with embedded software, hardware, and wireless engineering teams to communicate problem impacts and understand technical requirements

data.title: Director - AI Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

GE Vernova's AI Foundry builds the AI that runs and transforms the company: enterprise agents, reusable AI products and process transformations across Power, Wind and Electrification, used by tens of thousands of employees. We are seeking a Director, AI Engineering to lead our India AI Engineering organization, based in Bengaluru, reporting to the Head of AI Engineering. 

You will be accountable for the people, technical capability and delivery of the India organization, and for making India a hub that owns enterprise AI capabilities globally rather than executing work designed elsewhere. Your teams will build production AI applications, agents, reusable AI services, retrieval systems, MCP servers and tools, and the cloud-native infrastructure that runs them at enterprise scale. 

This role pairs organizational leadership with real technical depth. Expect to spend roughly 25-30% of your time in the engineering work: reviewing architectures and code, leading through critical incidents, and prototyping when a path needs to be proven before the team commits to it. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities: 

- Lead approximately 20 engineers, with accountability for hiring, performance, development, retention, engineering culture and delivery. 
 - Grow the organization to the AI Foundry hiring plan while holding a hiring bar consistent with the global team. Personally interview senior candidates. 
 - Develop engineers into Staff, Senior Staff and Principal technical leaders and into first-line managers. Build succession plans for critical roles. 
 - Set clear performance expectations and act on them, including addressing underperformance promptly. 
 - Compete for talent in a crowded market: build GE Vernova's AI engineering presence with universities and the technical community, and own retention of critical talent. 
 - Measure the team on business outcomes (adoption, realized benefit, cycle time), not output. 
 - Default to reuse. Build on and extend shared AI products and services instead of bespoke implementations; retire duplicated capability. 
 - Participate directly in architecture and design reviews for complex AI systems. Review code for new architectural patterns, shared services and high-risk production systems. 
 - Work alongside teams on critical spikes, difficult integrations and major production incidents. 
 - Prototype emerging approaches to de-risk them before teams industrialize them. 
 - Challenge whether GenAI is the right solution, versus deterministic software, workflow automation or traditional ML. 
 - Keep enough hands-on currency to judge technical quality independently of architects and vendors. 
 - Define engineering standards for production AI and enforce them through design reviews, code reviews and release gates, without unnecessary process. 
 - Build evaluation into the development lifecycle: offline and online evaluation of accuracy, groundedness, task completion, latency, reliability and cost, gating every release. 
 - Require observability, tracing, automated testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls and fallbacks in every production system. 
 - Drive AI-native engineering: adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic development tools across the team, with measured productivity and quality outcomes. 
 - Ensure the team complies with Responsible AI, cybersecurity, data privacy, including appropriate handling of controlled technical data. 
 - Build working connectivity with the US team and the global AI Foundry: shared standards, joint design reviews, rotations and protected overlap hours. 

Technical Scope

- AI applications and agents: LLM applications, agentic workflows, MCP servers and tools, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs and tool calling, multimodal applications. 
 - Retrieval and data: RAG, semantic search, embeddings and vector databases, enterprise document and [industrial/time-series] data. 
 - Platform and infrastructure: Python services and APIs, microservices, AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and LLMOps. 
 - Quality, safety and operations: evaluation, observability, testing, security, reliability and cost optimization. 

Required Qualifications

- Masters Degree in Computer Science, Computer or AI Engineering, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML or a related field from an accredited university or college. 
 - 15+ years of relevant experience in software, platform or AI engineering, including 7+ years of experience in leading engineering teams with responsibility for senior engineers and/or engineering managers. 
 - 2+ years leading teams that delivered LLM, RAG or agentic applications into production use by real users, beyond pilots and prototypes. 
 - A hands-on engineering background: has personally designed and built complex production systems, and can still review code and designs at depth. 
 - Strong Python and modern software practices: CI/CD, automated testing, code review. 
 - Deep working knowledge of LLM application architecture: RAG, agents, tool calling, structured outputs and evaluation. 
 - Strong experience with AWS, Azure or GCP, containerized architectures (Docker, Kubernetes) and distributed system design. 
 - Track record of hiring, developing and retaining strong engineers, including growing engineers into senior technical and management roles. 
 - Experience working with stakeholders and teams across time zones, with strong written communication. 

Desired Characteristics

- PhD in a relevant technical field. 
 - Experience building or scaling an engineering organization in India, ideally one with global ownership mandates. 
 - Experience in energy, industrial, manufacturing or other regulated industries. 
 - Recent hands-on use of MCP, agent frameworks, model APIs and AI-assisted development tools. 
 - Experience with Responsible AI, AI governance and export-controlled environments. 
 - Experience with fine-tuning, small language models or inference optimization. 
 - Track record of simplifying architectures, establishing reusable capabilities and reducing technology sprawl. 
 - Executive communication that stays credible with deeply technical engineers. 
 - Technical community leadership: open source, publications, conference talks or university partnerships. 

Additional Information

At GE Vernova, our Hydro Power division stands at the forefront of the hydroelectricity generation industry. We are dedicated to designing, manufacturing, and installing cutting-edge equipment for hydroelectric power plants, as well as servicing and refurbishing existing facilities to ensure optimal performance and longevity. Our turbines and generators account for over 25% of the total installed hydropower capacity worldwide. With a dynamic team of 3, 600 professionals spread across more than 30 countries, we have the energy to change the world. Be part of a team that is not only shaping the energy landscape but also contributing to a more sustainable planet. Join us and make a difference with GE Vernova's Hydro Power business division!

Read more on www. gevernova. com

Job Description

About Position

As a Lead Engineer Control System, you will be responsible for project execution activities on Control System design and working for Hydro Control System COE. 

You will work autonomously and deliver as directed and under supervision of the Main Package Engineer (MPE, Control System COE) for the project or by the Control System Engineering Manager. 

You will perform hardware and software design of the various hydro Control system packages for one or more projects, on own DCS or on 3rd party control solutions. 

Role & Responsibilities

Work on power plant control system design deliverables, networking and cybersecurity solutions involving PLC, IO devices, Server configuration and deployment, network architectures, switch configuration and trouble shooting. Install and configure servers, network managed Switches, Routers & Firewalls, etc. , for a power plant control environment (usually Rockwell, Mark VIe control system). Should be able to define VLANs & Network segmentation. Read processing notice, create Functional Analysis documents and perform SW programming, logics, creation of static and dynamic mimics as per P&ID and standard faceplates using Automation design tools (RS Logix, Studio 5000, FT View, Control ST, Cimplicity, Workstation ST, etc. ), HMI configuration, Alarm display, etc. , simulation testing of software. Perform Soft IO configuration for standard communication protocols prevailing in the industry (Modbus, IEC61850, IEC60870-104, DNP 3, etc. ). Perform interlocking design, wiring principles, etc. testing of control panels at GE Vernova workshop or supplier premises, support FAT, etc. Implement secure design practices in system design and software programming. Day-to-day activities include, but not limited to -

- Perform contract analysis, concept design, reverse engineering, prepare work-statement document. 
 - Document technical data generated for the assigned project. 
 - Review supplier documents (IO list, P&ID, Minfex data of partners) and prepare/update IO list. 
 - Create supplier technical specification for BTS or BTP DCS solution, coordinate with suppliers & do technical follow up. 
 - Prepare/update Logic programs, HMI mimics views as per P&ID and standard faceplates. 
 - Prepare and update OMM document. 
 - Track project schedule and implementation plan. 

Other job needs -

- Undertake occasional short-term travel to customer and supplier premises for technical discussions, design follow-up, testing, FAT, etc. 
 - Perform Site Survey activities, mapping existing systems and compile design inputs. 
 - Prepare de-commissioning and dismantling needs (manuals) for the system. 

Nature of Products/Projects - Power plant control system (BTS or BTP) Partnership - This role calls for cross-functional interface, positioned on control design, with coordination with several process partners and customers. Collaborations include, but not limited to, interface within Engineering functions including Product development (NPI), Supply Chain and Customer facing organizations. Personal responsibilities -

- Deliver trainings programs to internal and external customers. 
 - Work on quality & productivity improvement and cost-out actions. 
 - Perform interface engineering, Site Support. 
 - Development of standards and design practice guides and use in project. 
 - Collaborate with global teams on project execution activities. 

Qualifications

Bachelor of Engineering Degree in Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation/Control from accredited college or university 8 to 14 years of Controls Engineering experience with at least 5 years relevant experience in PLC hardware design and software programming. Should be aware of applicable standards and best practices in DCS design, including HW design, SW logic and User interface (HMI) design, control cubicle design and cybersecurity solutions. Should be aware global Cybersecurity standards such as IEC62443 & NERC-CIP. Tools Expertise - Rockwell Automation/ Mark VIe/Siemens/ABB/Emerson, etc. based Control System tools (RS Logix, Studio 5000, FT View, Control ST, Cimplicity, Workstation ST, SCALA, SICAM) Preferred industry experience - Power, Large EPC, Oil & Gas. Good command over written and spoken English is mandatory for global stakeholder and customer management. 

Desirable

Working experience on Rockwell Automation or Mark VIe based Control System is preferred, however similar experience on other reputed DCS systems like Siemens, ABB, Emerson, etc. is acceptable. Candidate with exposure in Cybersecurity domain will be an advantage. Able to manage and resolve conflicts in a fast-paced project execution environment. Clearly communicate and listen. Guide and motivate fellow team members. 

What Do We Offer?

- Environment: A multicultural & diverse environment with an enthusiastic team and supportive leaders. We have a pleasant and modern work infrastructure at our offices. 
 - Opportunities: We offer career growth opportunities, professional and personal trainings
 - Benefits: We offer a competitive salary with multiple benefits like subsidized meals, medical, accidental & life insurance coverage. We provide home office opportunity and flexible working hours (subject to business and HR approval)

Work model: Hybrid (3days office)

Inclusion & Diversity: At GE Vernova, we believe in the value of your unique identity, background, and experiences. We are committed to fostering an inclusive culture, where everyone feels empowered to do their best work because they feel accepted, respected and that they belong.

data.title: Quality Analyst - Customer Experience Team
data.description:
Quality Analyst (Customer Experience Team)

Job Title: Quality Analyst - Customer Experience Team (CET)
Location: Bangalore( on site)
Job Type: Full-time
Reports To: Quality Lead
Experience: 2-3 years
budget - 25k to 30k

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Quality Analyst to join our Customer Experience Team and take ownership of interaction quality across multiple customer support channels. 

The candidate will be responsible for auditing customer interactions across voice, chat, ticketing and email channels, identifying performance gaps, and converting audit findings into actionable feedback and coaching to improve agent performance. 

The role involves end-to-end ownership of the quality cycle, including audits, critical error identification, agent feedback, calibration, training needs identification and quality reporting. The candidate will work closely with the Training and Operations teams to drive continuous improvement in customer experience. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Audit and Evaluation

- Audit customer interactions across voice, chat, ticketing and email channels against defined quality parameters. 
- Meet agreed monthly audit targets per agent and line of business. 
- Ensure accurate and objective scoring of customer interactions. 
- Record specific validation reasons and clear observations for every failed parameter. 
- Maintain detailed audit records with specific instances and justifications for scores. 

2. Critical Error Management

- Identify and mark critical errors accurately, distinguishing between customer impact and business impact. 
- Apply the fatal error framework consistently. 
- Identify recurring critical errors by agent and parameter. 
- Escalate compliance-related and customer-risk issues to the Quality Lead immediately. 

3. Feedback and Coaching

- Conduct structured one-to-one feedback sessions with agents. 
- Use audited interactions as evidence during coaching sessions. 
- Apply recognised feedback mechanisms and coaching models. 
- Define measurable improvement actions with agents and team leaders. 
- Track performance improvements in subsequent audit cycles. 
- Conduct joint feedback sessions with Operations and Training teams whenever required. 

4. Calibration

- Participate in weekly calibration sessions with Quality Analysts, the Quality Lead and Training team. 
- Maintain scoring consistency within agreed thresholds. 
- Justify audit scores during calibration discussions. 
- Contribute to improvements in evaluation forms, quality parameters and scoring guidelines. 

5. Training Needs Identification (TNA/TNI)

- Identify training needs at agent, team and process levels based on audit findings. 
- Analyse recurring errors and quality gaps. 
- Coordinate with the Training team for appropriate interventions. 
- Differentiate between training gaps, process issues, tool limitations and knowledge gaps. 
- Support refresher and improvement training for low-performing agents. 

6. Reporting and Analysis

- Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly quality reports. 
- Track audit volume, average quality scores, critical error rates and parameter-wise performance. 
- Analyse trends across agents, teams, channels and lines of business. 
- Present quality insights and improvement recommendations to stakeholders. 

7. Process Improvement

- Identify recurring process issues, unclear SOPs and tool-related challenges. 
- Highlight customer pain points through audit observations. 
- Contribute to Voice of Customer (VoC) analysis. 
- Support new-hire nesting by auditing initial interactions and providing timely feedback. 

Qualifications and Skills

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification. 
- 2-3 years of experience as a Quality Analyst in a customer service, customer support or contact centre environment. 
- Hands-on experience in auditing customer interactions across voice, chat or ticketing channels. 
- Exposure to multiple customer interaction channels is preferred. 
- Knowledge of quality management tools, audit processes and quality frameworks. 
- Understanding of quality parameters, critical error frameworks and audit governance. 
- Practical experience in agent feedback and coaching models. 
- Experience in calibration sessions and maintaining scoring consistency. 
- Strong analytical skills and working knowledge of MS Excel, including Pivot Tables and Lookups. 
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
- Strong observation, problem-solving and decision-making abilities. 
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet audit and reporting deadlines. 
- Ability to provide objective feedback while maintaining empathy towards agents. 

Language Requirements

- Proficiency in English and Hindi is mandatory. 
- Knowledge of one additional Indian language will be an added advantage. 

Preferred Candidate Profile

- Immediate joiners preferred. 
- Candidates must have experience in customer service, customer support or contact centre quality. 
- Experience in multi-channel quality auditing is desirable. 
- Candidates with experience working closely with Training teams on TNI, coaching and performance improvement plans will be preferred.

data.title: SOC Engineering Manager (IP Subsystems)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years building and leading teams that deliver subsystems and SoCs that actually ship, not just pass reviews. The difference between a subsystem that integrates cleanly and one that causes months of debug downstream is something you see coming from the architecture phase, and you know how to steer your team away from those cliffs before anyone writes RTL. You are technical enough to review a timing constraint file or debug a CDC violation yourself, but you also know when to step back and let your engineers solve it. Managing remote teams does not intimidate you because you have learned that clarity, trust, and rhythm matter more than proximity. You can sit in a customer call, extract what they actually need from what they say they want, and walk out with a plan your team can execute against. You think in workflows, not just deliverables. Automation, reusable frameworks, and AI-enabled tooling are not buzzwords to you, they are levers you pull to make your team faster and your subsystems more predictable. You push back when a requirement is vague or a timeline does not match reality, and you do it in a way that keeps the relationship intact. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead the architecture, RTL design, integration, and front-end sign-off of DesignWare IP Subsystems from requirements through release
 - Manage a local engineering team in Bengaluru, driving execution across design, verification, and implementation while coordinating with global stakeholders
 - Own customer communication and requirements translation, ensuring deliverables align with what customers actually need and ship on time
 - Drive front-end implementation flows including synthesis timing closure using Fusion Compiler, SpyGlass CDC/RDC checks, low-power architecture, and Formality equivalence checking
 - Work hands-on when needed, reviewing RTL, debugging integration issues, authoring verification plans, or resolving critical bottlenecks in the subsystem lifecycle
 - Champion AI-enabled methods, workflow automation, and reusable engineering practices to improve team productivity, quality, and cycle time across subsystem programs
 - Collaborate across implementation, verification, DFT, and hardening teams to ensure clean handoffs and tape-out readiness

The Impact You Will Have

- Your subsystems will integrate into SoCs powering AI, automotive, 5G, and IoT products used by millions of people globally
 - You will shape how Synopsys subsystems are architected and delivered, setting the standard for quality, predictability, and execution velocity
 - Your team will deliver subsystems that reduce customer integration risk and accelerate their time to market
 - You will build a culture of automation and reuse that makes every subsequent program faster and more reliable
 - Your technical judgment will prevent costly late-stage design issues and keep programs on track through tape-out
 - You will mentor engineers who will go on to lead subsystem and SoC programs themselves
 - Your leadership will directly influence the adoption of AI-enabled workflows and modern engineering practices across the IP organization

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering or related field with 10+ years of overall experience
 - 4 to 5 years managing engineering teams, ideally remote or distributed teams, with a track record of on-time delivery
 - Strong hands-on ASIC or SoC front-end design experience including RTL design, IP/subsystem integration, and taking designs from architecture through front-end execution
 - Deep expertise in at least one or two interface protocols such as AMBA (APB, AXI, CHI), DDR, PCIe, Ethernet, USB, UFS, or UCIe
 - Experience with front-end implementation flows including CDC/RDC checks using tools like SpyGlass or VC SpyGlass, UPF and low-power intent, design/timing constraints, and DFT handoff
 - Proficiency in SystemVerilog, TCL, Perl, or Python for RTL coding, scripting, and automation
 - Exposure to ASIC tape-out process, ideally at least one or two tape-outs, and understanding of how subsystems move through verification sign-off, DFT insertion, and hardening
 - Exposure to AI-enabled tools and automation frameworks applied to design, verification, or execution efficiency is a plus

Who You Are

- You can extract detailed technical requirements from high-level customer specifications and turn them into executable work packages your team understands
 - You motivate engineers by giving them clarity, autonomy, and air cover when things get messy, not by micromanaging their work
 - You understand verification well enough to evaluate test plans, coverage metrics, and debug strategies even if you are not writing testbenches yourself
 - You can explain a complex timing closure issue or a CDC violation to a customer or executive in two sentences without losing the technical nuance
 - You track progress across multiple moving pieces, five programs, three customers, two tool bring-ups, and you know which one needs your attention today
 - You push for automation and reuse not because it sounds good but because you have seen what happens when teams rebuild the same thing three times

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Digital IP Subsystems Team within Synopsys Solutions Group in Bengaluru. This team develops DesignWare IP Subsystem solutions that integrate multiple IP blocks into pre-verified, configurable subsystems, helping customers accelerate SoC development and reduce integration risk. The team works closely with IP design, verification, implementation, and customer engineering teams globally. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, current programs, and roadmap during the interview process. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

 - Transform research prototypes and proof-of-concepts into scalable, secure, reproducible, and production-ready AI applications.

 - Conduct deep technical design and code reviews, providing architectural guidance and validating technical trade-offs before deployment.

 - Hands-on experience deploying and optimizing model serving platforms such as Triton Inference Server, vLLM, TGI, or similar inference technologies. 
 - Advanced experience with AI orchestration frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or related technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of MLOps tooling, experiment tracking, model registries, and lifecycle management solutions such as MLflow and Weights & Biases. 
 - Experience implementing AI solutions across text, image, video, speech, audio, or multimodal domains is considered an asset. 
 - Proven ability to communicate complex technical decisions, performance trade-offs, and architectural recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Strong execution mindset with a focus on operational excellence, scalability, performance, and business impact. 

About The Team. 

The AI Engineering team is responsible for building and scaling enterprise AI capabilities that enable innovation across McCain's business functions. As a Principal AI Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical leader and trusted advisor across engineering teams, partnering closely with AI engineers, software developers, platform engineers, infrastructure teams, data professionals, and business stakeholders. 

This role is positioned at the center of McCain's AI technology strategy, helping establish technical standards, accelerate delivery, and ensure that advanced AI capabilities are built with reliability, scalability, security, and long-term value in mind. 

About McCain. 

Click Here to learn more about McCain and how we provide opportunities to make an impact that matters. 

Leadership principles. 

At McCain, our leadership principles guide how we engage with customers, collaborate as a team, and achieve success. We focus on understanding customer needs, driving innovation, empowering people, and taking ownership to clear obstacles and deliver results. 

AI & Digital Capabilities. 

At McCain, AI and digital capabilities are part of how we work and innovate. We value curiosity toward emerging technologies and the thoughtful, responsible use of AI-enabled tools to improve outcomes as part of our future-ready culture. 

The McCain Experience. 

We are McCain. This statement is a testament to our collective strength and our individual value. Your contributions play a vital role in our success. Our winning culture is rooted in authenticity and trust, empowering us to bring out the best in one another. Here, you'll find opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. Join us and experience why we're better together. 

McCain Foods is an equal opportunity employer. As a global family-owned company, we strive to be the employer of choice in the diverse communities around the world in which we live and work. We recognize that inclusion drives our creativity, resilience, and success and makes our business stronger.
