data.title: QA Engineer – Manual, Automation & AI-Assisted Testing
data.description:
QA Engineer - Manual, Automation & AI-Assisted Testing

Location: Remote

Experience: 5-6 years (flexible for candidates with strong technical expertise)

Working Hours: IST

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Project Manager

Compensation: ₹15-17 LPA (negotiable depending on experience, technical skills, and interview performance)

About the Role

We're looking for a highly skilled, proactive, and detail-oriented QA Engineer with strong hands-on experience in both Manual and Automation Testing to join Meera AI's product engineering team. 

You'll be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, performance, and scalability of our AI-powered SaaS platform through comprehensive testing strategies, automated test development, API validation, database testing, and continuous quality improvement. This is not a manual-testing-only position. We're looking for someone who can independently manage the end-to-end QA lifecycle, write and maintain automation scripts, develop reusable testing frameworks, identify critical defects, and work closely with developers and product teams to deliver high-quality releases. 

We're particularly interested in engineers who embrace modern testing practices, including AI-assisted test case generation, intelligent automation, AI-powered testing tools, and AI-driven defect analysis, to improve test coverage, reduce repetitive manual effort, and accelerate release cycles. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise, analytical thinking, exceptional communication skills, and a high level of ownership. 

What You'll Do

Manual & Functional Testing

- Own end-to-end testing activities across web applications, APIs, backend services, and integrated systems. 
 - Design and execute functional, regression, smoke, sanity, integration, system, exploratory, and end-to-end test cases. 
 - Develop comprehensive test plans, scenarios, and test cases aligned with user stories, business requirements, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Perform positive, negative, boundary, edge-case, cross-browser, responsive, and usability testing. 
 - Support UAT, production validation, and release readiness activities. 
 - Apply risk-based testing and maintain requirement traceability to ensure coverage of critical business workflows. Automation Testing & Framework Development

- Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts for web applications and APIs. 
 - Work with automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, or equivalent tools. 
 - Write automation scripts using Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. 
 - Build and maintain scalable, reusable, and maintainable automation frameworks. 
 - Implement Page Object Model (POM), data-driven testing, reusable utilities, and appropriate test design patterns. 
 - Automate repetitive test scenarios, critical business workflows, and regression suites. 
 - Troubleshoot automation failures, flaky tests, and environment-related issues. 
 - Improve automation coverage, test execution reliability, and regression efficiency. AI-Assisted Testing & Intelligent Automation

- Explore and utilize AI-powered tools to accelerate test case creation, test script development, and defect identification. 
 - Leverage tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Testim, mabl, or similar AI-enabled testing solutions. 
 - Use AI-assisted capabilities for: 
 - Generating test cases from requirements and user stories. 
 - Developing and optimizing automated test scripts. 
 - Identifying missing scenarios, edge cases, and coverage gaps. 
 - Generating synthetic test data. 
 - Analyzing test failures, application logs, and recurring defects. 
 - Improving regression testing efficiency. 
 - Validate AI-generated test cases and scripts for accuracy, security, and maintainability. 
 - Recommend practical opportunities to incorporate AI into existing QA workflows. 
 - Ensure sensitive customer and company data is handled securely when using AI tools. API & Integration Testing

- Perform manual and automated REST API testing using Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, REST Assured, Newman, or similar tools. 
 - Validate API endpoints, request/response payloads, HTTP status codes, authentication, authorization, and error handling. 
 - Test OAuth 2. 0, JWT, JSON/XML data structures, and API response times. 
 - Develop reusable automated API test suites. 
 - Validate integrations between application components, backend services, external platforms, and third-party APIs. 
 - Verify data consistency and error handling across interconnected systems. 
 - Exposure to SOAP APIs is an advantage. Database & Backend Testing

- Perform backend and database validation using SQL queries. 
 - Work with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Validate CRUD operations, transactional workflows, data integrity, constraints, and business rules. 
 - Verify data consistency between UI, API, and database layers. 
 - Test data synchronization and integration workflows. 
 - Identify backend defects, data discrepancies, and transaction failures. 
 - Exposure to MongoDB or other NoSQL databases is an advantage. Performance, Load & Non-Functional Testing

- Perform basic performance, load, and stress testing using JMeter, k6, BlazeMeter, or similar tools. 
 - Validate application response times, API latency, throughput, and behavior under load. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and collaborate with developers to resolve them. 
 - Support scalability, reliability, and basic security testing. 
 - Contribute to accessibility and compatibility testing where applicable. CI/CD & Continuous Testing

- Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar tools. 
 - Work with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows. 
 - Support automated smoke, regression, and API testing during build and deployment cycles. 
 - Investigate pipeline failures and maintain stable automated test execution. 
 - Promote shift-left testing and early defect identification. 
 - Collaborate with developers to improve release quality and deployment confidence. Defect Management & Quality Ownership

- Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, Bugzilla, or similar tools. 
 - Provide clear reproduction steps, screenshots, logs, and supporting technical details. 
 - Collaborate with developers on defect triage, root cause analysis, retesting, and regression validation. 
 - Maintain test execution reports, defect metrics, automation coverage, and QA dashboards. 
 - Identify quality risks and provide recommendations before releases. 
 - Own QA sign-off for assigned features and modules, including documented residual risks. 
 - Continuously improve testing processes, frameworks, and quality standards. Agile Collaboration & Communication

- Work closely with engineering, product management, business analysts, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and release discussions. 
 - Review requirements and identify ambiguities, missing acceptance criteria, and potential testing risks. 
 - Communicate defects, blockers, testing progress, and release risks clearly and proactively. 
 - Maintain comprehensive test documentation and share QA best practices. 
 - Demonstrate independent ownership, accountability, and strong problem-solving capabilities. Required Skills & Experience (Must-Haves)

- 5-6 years of professional software QA experience, with strong hands-on exposure to both Manual and Automation Testing. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Proven experience developing, executing, debugging, and maintaining automated test scripts. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one automation framework such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language: Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. 
 - Strong knowledge of functional, regression, integration, system, smoke, sanity, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Practical experience in REST API testing and API automation. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience validating backend data and business workflows. 
 - Understanding of test automation framework design, test case optimization, and reusable test components. 
 - Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated test execution. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and defect management processes. 
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray, or equivalent. 
 - Ability to independently manage testing activities, identify quality risks, and support production releases. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, documentation, and troubleshooting capabilities. 
 - Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills (10/10 expected), with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice-to-Haves

- Hands-on experience with AI-assisted testing tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Testim, or mabl. 
 - Experience using AI to generate test cases, develop automation scripts, analyze defects, or improve test coverage. 
 - Experience testing AI-powered applications, conversational AI, LLM-based features, or AI-driven workflows. 
 - Familiarity with AI testing concepts such as hallucination detection, response consistency, prompt injection testing, and evaluation of nondeterministic outputs. 
 - Experience with SaaS products, enterprise applications, or high-scale cloud-based platforms. 
 - Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or BlazeMeter. 
 - Familiarity with AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, or containerized test environments. 
 - Knowledge of security testing fundamentals, OWASP principles, and accessibility testing. 
 - Experience with API contract testing, service virtualization, mocking, and test data management. 
 - Experience testing CRM integrations, messaging platforms, or communication APIs. 
 - Exposure to SMS, Voice, WhatsApp, or other customer engagement technologies. 
 - Experience working in fast-paced product development or startup environments. Interview Process

- Round 1: HR screening - communication skills, relevant experience, cultural fit, and initial technical assessment. 
 - Round 2: Technical interview with Engineering / QA Leadership - manual testing, automation frameworks, coding, API testing, database validation, and CI/CD. 
 - Round 3: Final interview with Engineering / Product Leadership - technical ownership, problem-solving, product quality, and team fit. A practical automation exercise or technical assignment may be included as part of the evaluation. 

Why Work at Meera AI?

Joining Meera AI means stepping into a challenging and highly rewarding environment where you'll help build AI-powered outbound and customer engagement innovations from the ground up. 

As an early-stage company with strong financial backing, you'll gain hands-on exposure to the full startup lifecycle-from acquiring early customers to scaling revenue and preparing for future funding rounds. 

You'll have the opportunity to contribute directly to product quality, establish scalable automation practices, explore emerging AI-driven testing technologies, and help shape our quality engineering standards. 

If you're ambitious, technically curious, and want to grow fast, this is the place to do it. 

What We Do at Meera AI

Meera. AI is an AI-powered customer engagement and automation platform designed to help businesses scale conversations, accelerate lead conversions, and drive revenue-without manual outreach. 

We combine AI-driven SMS, Voice, and WhatsApp automation with deep CRM integrations to help businesses create meaningful, revenue-generating customer conversations. 

Work-Life Balance at Meera AI

We foster a healthy work-life balance through strong collaboration and supportive team practices. Employees benefit from direct access to leadership through an open-door policy that encourages transparency and open communication. 

Our Culture & Values

At Meera AI, culture is everything. We look for people who thrive in ownership-driven, collaborative, and honest environments. 

Our core values: 

- Curiosity: We are obsessively curious about possibilities and better solutions. 
 - Trust: We build trust in every interaction and decision. 
 - Empathy: We humanize technology by putting people first.

data.title: Principal/Senior/Software Engineer (AgenticOS)
data.description:
About The Role

PubMatic is looking for engineers with expertise in Generative AI and AI agent development. You will be responsible for building and optimizing advanced AI agents that leverage the latest technologies in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and large language models (LLMs). You will work on developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance Generative AI capabilities and enable our platform to handle complex information retrieval, contextual generation, and adaptive interactions. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI-driven features. Drive end-to-end ownership-from feasibility analysis and design specifications to execution and release-while ensuring quick iterations based on customer feedback in a fast-paced Agile environment. 
 - Spearhead technical design meetings and produce detailed design documents that outline scalable, secure, and robust AI architectures. 
 - Ensure that the solutions are aligned with long-term product strategy and technical roadmaps. 
 - Implement and optimize LLMs for specific use cases, including fine-tuning models, deploying pre-trained models, and evaluating their performance. 
 - Develop AI agents powered by RAG systems, integrating external knowledge sources to improve the accuracy and relevance of generated content. 
 - Design, implement, and optimize vector databases (e. g. , FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate) for efficient and scalable vector search, and work on various vector indexing algorithms. 
 - Create sophisticated prompts and fine-tune them to improve the performance of LLMs in generating precise and contextually relevant responses. 
 - Utilize evaluation frameworks and metrics (e. g. , Evals) to assess and improve the performance of generative models and AI systems. 
 - Work with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to integrate AI-driven capabilities into customer-facing products and internal tools. 
 - Stay up to date with the latest research and trends in LLMs, RAG, and generative AI technologies to drive innovation in the company's offerings. 
 - Continuously monitor and optimize models to improve their performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. 

We'd Love For You To Have

- 2 to 10 years of total experience and strong understanding of LLMs and their underlying principles - transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, and hyperparameter tuning. 
 - Proven experience designing and building AI agents, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, multi-step planning, and agent memory architectures (short-term and long-term). 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen, and familiarity with RAG pipelines that integrate external knowledge sources (documents, databases, APIs). 
 - In-depth knowledge of vector databases and indexing algorithms; practical experience with FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus. 
 - Experience with agent observability, tracing, and guardrails - tools like Langfuse or equivalent - to ensure reliability, safety, and debuggability of agentic systems. 
 - Proficiency in prompt engineering - crafting, iterating, and optimizing complex prompts for context-sensitive, domain-specific LLM outputs. 
 - Familiarity with Evals and other performance evaluation tools for measuring model quality, relevance, and efficiency.

data.title: Software Engineer, Financial Business Insights
data.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About The Team

Our mission is to enable effective financial decisions through reliable data, increased efficiency, and automation. We support Marketing, Sales, Seller, Accounting, Tax, Finance and Strategy (F&S), Finance Operations (FinOps), and Treasury functions across automation, data insights, and process improvements. 

You may work on a wide variety of critical business areas including

Seller Systems - Responsible for building the systems and tooling that make sellers and internal revenue teams at Stripe dramatically more productive and effective. We partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product to deliver a single "plane of glass" selling experience that spans deal creation and modeling, negotiation and approvals, contracting, onboarding, and activation. The Seller Systems team composes first‐party, custom Stripe components with best‐in‐class third‐party business systems to deliver configurable, auditable, and globally scalable workflows. Engineers on Seller Systems build services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, and internal UIs that power seller productivity, reduce time‐to‐activation, improve deal velocity, and enable AI‐driven assistive workflows. Use cases include deal modeling and pricing engines, approval and orchestration platforms, CLM/CPQ integrations, onboarding automation, seller analytics, and AI‐assisted seller tooling. 

Finance Engineering - Responsible for building the robust and scalable infrastructure that powers the company's core financial operations, including payments processing, fund settlement, accounting, and business intelligence. The Finance Engineering team is at the core of Stripe to empower business-critical financial domains including Accounting, Finance operations, Finance and Strategy, and Treasury. Engineers on the Financial Engineering team build platforms, data pipelines, and financial products for the Finance team. The use cases include financial analytics and insights, accounting automation, auditing, financial planning and forecasting, and financial business intelligence. 

Marketing and Sales Systems - Responsible for building the most measurable, cross-channel messaging capability possible, to attract and engage customers. We do this through scalable motions, with the most relevant messaging and increasing reach of our marketing motions. We are a cross-functional team of engineers, analysts, marketers, and product managers that deliver the insights, internal systems and tools that fuel growth at Stripe. 

As part of the Marketing Systems team, you own systems that power go-to-market motions productizing gathered insights and intelligence. This includes building tools that 1/ power better digital experiences, 2/ accelerate customer journey with intelligent orchestrations, 3/ drive smarter decisions with CDP, and 4/ improve marketer and seller productivity. 

What you'll do

We're looking for Software Engineers who want to make an impact on managing money at a global scale with a passion for building ergonomic APIs. You'll play a key role in extending our balance management platform and in building out a new funds accessibility platform leveraged by enterprises and SMBs alike. Our team collaborates with many cross-functional teams - from Infrastructure to Product - at Stripe to deliver innovative solutions that address evolving user needs. 

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain beautiful, robust, and high-performance APIs and services
 - Ensure our infrastructure is extensible, scalable, reliable, and meets service-level agreements for both external and internal users
 - Hide complexity from our users behind simple yet powerful abstractions
 - Partner closely with other engineers, analysts, and scientists to build highly scalable systems, to deliver delightful developer experiences and comprehensive interfaces
 - Build the APIs that power internal stakeholder-facing UI experiences, defining composable data models and durable interfaces
 - Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack with an eye towards improving maintainability over the long term
 - Improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

Minimum Requirements

- 8+ years of experience designing, implementing, and operating large-scale, high-performance APIs and services
 - You have implemented server-side APIs in dynamic languages like Ruby, working with document and relational datastores (especially Mongo and MySQL) and enjoy spelunking through new datasets (especially in systems like Redshift, Presto, or Trino). 
 - Empathetic, collaborative, and user-first mindset in everything you build and have excellent oral and written communication
 - Experience proactively seeking feedback from users, teammates, and subject matter experts
 - The skills to build holistically - from specs and documentation to implementation, testing, deployment, and measuring impact and ability to balance speed, complexity, and scope in service of user needs

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with large-scale financial tracking systems
 - Good understanding and practical knowledge in cloud-based services (e. g. gRPC, GraphQL, Docker and Kubernetes, cloud services such as AWS, etc. )
 - Experience in marketing domain building products that contribute to marketing tech stack
 - Experience with machine learning, recommender systems, product-led growth, or lifecycle marketing
 - Prior experience building distributed systems or a microservices architecture

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. 

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally. 

We look forward to hearing from you. 

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out-and set you apart-especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. 

Apply now

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. 

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Overview: 

The Staff II Software Engineer is a senior individual contributor who provides technical leadership across a platform or domain and drives complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from problem framing through production outcomes. This role translates business priorities into durable architecture, a sequenced technical roadmap, and high-quality implementation. The engineer remains hands-on while setting direction, resolving consequential technical trade-offs, and influencing teams beyond their immediate group. 

The role advances secure, resilient, scalable, and observable systems for Blackhawk Network's customers and internal teams. It strengthens engineering practices through design leadership, mentoring, and clear technical communication. The Staff II engineer also evaluates emerging capabilities, including AI, with a disciplined focus on customer value, security, privacy, regulatory obligations, and responsible adoption. This is an individual-contributor role and has no direct supervisory responsibility. 

Responsibilities: 

Functions

- Set technical direction for a platform or domain, connecting business outcomes to architecture, platform evolution, and a practical multi-quarter roadmap. 
 - Own and shape the technical backlog for the area: identify systemic risks and opportunities, prioritize foundational work, and make progress visible through measurable outcomes. 
 - Lead ambiguous, high-impact initiatives spanning multiple teams; clarify the problem, surface dependencies and risks, align stakeholders, and guide delivery through production adoption. 
 - Design and review architectures for distributed, event-driven, cloud-based systems, documenting key decisions, trade-offs, migration paths, and operational considerations. 
 - Make sound build, buy, and partner recommendations; evaluate technologies, libraries, vendors, and AI-enabled capabilities against business value, total cost, security, privacy, and operational fit. 
 - Deliver and evolve secure, performant, scalable, resilient, and observable services, contributing hands-on code and ensuring sound testing, deployment, release, and rollback practices. 
 - Raise reliability and operational maturity through service health measures, capacity and failure-mode analysis, production readiness, incident learning, and durable corrective actions. 
 - Partner with Security, Privacy, Risk, Compliance, Product, and other stakeholders to embed applicable payment-industry and regulatory requirements in designs and delivery plans. 
 - Contribute to responsible AI adoption within the platform or domain: identify suitable use cases, assess data and model risks, establish appropriate controls and validation, and monitor outcomes before expanding use. 
 - Establish and promote engineering standards and reusable patterns across teams through design reviews, technical documentation, and communities of practice. 
 - Coach and mentor engineers, strengthen technical judgment across the organization, and help teams resolve difficult design and delivery challenges without taking over their ownership. 
 - Communicate technical strategy and material risks clearly to engineering leaders and cross-functional partners; influence decisions through evidence and sound reasoning. 
 - Measure the customer, business, and operational impact of delivered capabilities and use feedback to refine the roadmap. 
 - Perform additional duties as assigned. 

Competencies

- Demonstrated ability to frame and solve complex, ambiguous technical problems that span services, teams, and business functions. 
 - Strong systems thinking: understands how architecture, data, security, reliability, developer experience, and operating cost interact over time. 
 - Makes timely, explainable decisions with incomplete information; weighs reversibility, risk, mitigation, and long-term consequences. 
 - Influences across organizational boundaries without relying on formal authority; builds alignment among stakeholders with differing priorities. 
 - Distills business and technical context into clear requirements, options, decision records, roadmaps, and delivery plans. 
 - Applies strong engineering judgment across design, implementation, testing, deployment, operations, and continuous improvement. 
 - Anticipates security, privacy, compliance, reliability, and scalability concerns and incorporates mitigations early in the lifecycle. 
 - Sets a high bar for technical quality while balancing pragmatic delivery, incremental change, and maintainability. 
 - Develops other engineers through coaching, constructive feedback, thoughtful reviews, and delegation of meaningful technical ownership. 
 - Communicates directly and clearly in writing and verbally, including when explaining trade-offs, uncertainty, and production risk. 
 - Adapts to shifting priorities and technology while sustaining progress on foundational work and longer-term platform health. 

Qualifications: 

Required Technical Skills

- Extensive experience designing and delivering distributed, service-oriented and event-driven systems in production. 
 - Strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, SOLID principles, object-oriented design, and service/API design. 
 - Expertise in Java 17 or higher and Spring Boot 3. 1 or higher, or comparable depth in a modern enterprise programming stack with the ability to work effectively in this stack. 
 - Strong understanding of transactionality, ACID properties, relational data modeling, SQL, and data integrity in distributed applications. 
 - Experience designing for security, privacy, availability, resilience, performance, observability, and operational supportability. 
 - Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, production monitoring, incident response, and safe release practices. 
 - Ability to assess emerging technologies, including AI/ML-enabled systems, for suitability, risk, and responsible use in a regulated or customer-sensitive environment. 

Preferred Technical Skills

- Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL data repositories. 
 - Experience using AWS Cloud Formation to define and deploy infrastructure on AWS; strong knowledge of core AWS services. 
 - Experience in payment systems, financial technology, or other highly regulated, high-availability environments. 
 - Experience with AI/ML platform architecture, AI governance, model or output validation, and production controls. 
 - Experience establishing platform roadmaps, architecture standards, or reusable engineering capabilities across multiple teams. 

Required Education and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field and 10+ years of software development experience, or 12+ years of equivalent practical experience. 
 - Substantial experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership of complex initiatives involving multiple teams, with accountability for architecture and delivery outcomes. 
 - Programming experience in at least one modern software development language and willingness to remain hands-on. 

Preferred Education and Experience

- Experience delivering secure, scalable, resilient services at enterprise scale. 
 - Experience in an Agile or similarly iterative engineering environment. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team or engineering organization. 
 - Experience working with product, security, compliance, risk, and operations partners on technology decisions.

As a system software engineer in the Developer Tools group, you will be developing software that empowers GPU application developers to build outstanding applications that are recognized world-wide. data.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Agentic AI)
data.description:
What makes us Qlik?

A Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly. 

Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in. 

The Senior Automation QA Engineer Role

Qlik is seeking a highly skilled Senior Automation QA Engineer to design and develop automated testing solutions for our Salesforce and NetSuite platforms. 

This role combines strong QA automation engineering with hands-on AI agent development using Playwright. The engineer will use AI agents and modern automation techniques to accelerate testing, improve coverage and reliability, and provide faster quality feedback throughout the software development lifecycle. 

The role also requires a responsible approach to AI development, considering appropriate ethical, privacy, security, fairness, and human oversight principles. 

What makes this role interesting?

The software testing landscape is rapidly evolving, and the biggest challenge we are tackling right now is balancing deployment speed with flawless reliability. You will be at the forefront of solving this by replacing manual bottlenecks with intelligent, AI-driven automation. 

Here Is Why You Will Love What You Do

- Pioneering AI in QA: You get to build and deploy advanced AI agents using Playwright, completely transforming how test creation, execution, and regression testing are handled. 
 - Accelerating development cycles: By seamlessly integrating your automated tests directly into CI/CD pipelines, you will give developers the immediate, reliable feedback they need to build faster. 
 - Elevating the testing framework: Instead of maintaining legacy code, you will design and develop highly reusable automation frameworks and utilities from the ground up, freeing yourself from repetitive maintenance. 
 - Championing ethical AI: You won't just blindly trust AI outputs; you will be the human-in-the-loop. You will apply vital oversight, evaluating AI-generated results to ensure our testing practices remain secure, fair, and highly accurate. 

Here's How You'll Be Making An Impact

Your work will directly influence how quickly and safely we deliver software. By joining us, you aren't just finding bugs-you are engineering a smarter, more efficient way to build products. 

- Driving strategic quality: You will partner closely with developers, product owners, and key stakeholders to identify risks early, shifting quality left and shaping the overall testing strategy. 
 - Transforming defect detection: Your sophisticated, AI-enhanced test scenarios will catch critical issues before they reach production, ensuring rock-solid reliability across our Salesforce and NetSuite environments. 
 - Streamlining QA processes: Your clear, actionable insights from test failures and meticulous tracking metrics will continuously elevate our entire software development lifecycle. 
 - Mentoring through innovation: By introducing AI-assisted testing practices and clear documentation, you will naturally elevate the technical capabilities of the wider team and establish new industry-leading standards. 

We're Looking For a Teammate With

- 5+ years of hands-on QA automation experience. 
 - Strong programming and automation experience with Playwright and Python; experience with Selenium or similar frameworks is beneficial. 
 - Proven experience building AI agents using Playwright for software testing or QA automation. 
 - Good understanding of AI models, LLMs, and AI agent development, including how agents use tools and interact with applications. 
 - Experience with AI/agent technologies such as OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks. 
 - Strong knowledge of Salesforce (Apex, Lightning) and NetSuite (SuiteScript, workflows, or saved searches). 
 - Experience developing end-to-end automation across complex enterprise applications and integrations. 
 - Strong understanding of QA fundamentals, including test planning, test design, regression testing, defect management, and Agile/Scrum. 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD, Jira, and test management tools such as Zephyr. 
 - Understanding of prompt engineering and effective use of LLMs in software engineering. 
 - Awareness of responsible AI practices, including ethical use, privacy, security, fairness, and human oversight. 
 - Performance, load, or security testing experience is desirable. 
 - Salesforce or NetSuite certifications are desirable. 

The location for this role is: 

Bangalore, India

Apply now and help change how the world transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights and turns complex data challenges into new opportunities!

More About Qlik And Who We Are

Find out more about 'Life at Qlik' on social: Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X/Twitter, and to see all other opportunities to join us and our values, check out our Careers Page. 

What else do we offer?

- Genuine career progression pathways and mentoring programs.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Developer Experience
data.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most. 

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships. 

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8, 000 organizations in over 100 countries - moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day. 

About The Role

The Senior Software Engineer - Developer Experience is a hands-on individual contributor focused on improving how engineers build, test, and deliver software across Genesys. You will design and deliver scalable tooling, automation, and development workflows that reduce friction, increase delivery velocity, and improve software quality. You will also help advance Genesys's AI-enabled software development lifecycle (AI-SDLC), applying sound technical judgment as AI capabilities and engineering practices evolve. This role has no direct reports; you will lead through technical ownership, mentorship, and collaboration. 

What You'll Do

Developer Experience & Platforms

- Design and deliver internal developer platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and reusable tooling that streamline code development, testing, and deployment workflows. 
 - Build and improve standardized development environments and paved workflows using GitHub, CI/CD automation, and testing frameworks to reduce setup time and inconsistencies across partner teams. 
 - Improve developer onboarding and day-to-day productivity by creating self-service capabilities, documentation, and paved paths for common engineering tasks. 

AI-SDLC, Automation & Quality

- Implement and continuously improve AI-enabled software development practices, evaluating emerging capabilities and incorporating effective approaches into development, testing, and delivery workflows while maintaining quality, security, and reliability. 
 - Automate build, test, and release processes across the software development lifecycle to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and shorten delivery cycles. 
 - Use software delivery and quality metrics, including build success rates, test effectiveness, lead time, deployment frequency, and change failure rate, to identify bottlenecks, prioritize improvements, and measure impact. 

Engineering Delivery & Adoption

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated understanding of how AI is changing software development, with the ability to evaluate emerging tools and practices, learn rapidly as capabilities evolve, and apply effective approaches to engineering workflows. 
 - Strong hands-on software engineering experience using Python, Java, or another modern programming language, with demonstrated experience designing and delivering production-quality software or developer tooling.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience integrating AI-powered developer tools, code assistants, agents, or automation capabilities into engineering workflows. 
 - Experience working in large-scale SaaS or distributed engineering organizations. 

If you bring many of these capabilities but do not meet every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. We value demonstrated ability, sound engineering judgment, and the capacity to learn as technologies and practices evolve.

- Developer Experience (DevEx)

data.title: Lead Engineer – Bridges – Ahmedabad / / Chennai
data.description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India's valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. 

Understand better who we are by visiting www. systra. in

Context

In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations. 

CTR - Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to detailed design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world. 

CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with the front office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2. 

CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil. 

Missions/Main Duties

- Take responsibility for Rail bridge design, Viaduct & Structure design. 
 - Having experience designing steel bridges and complex bridges. 
 - Assisting in the overall project management from conception to development and project completion
 - Responsible for managing the Engineers of different ranks, liaising with sub-agencies and building relationship with clients, architects, consultants, contractors. 
 - Co-ordinating work between different disciplines. 
 - Prepare reports and calculations in line with International Codes of Practice (AREMA, AASTHO, EURO, BS). 
 - Plan and deliver bridge surveys and inspections including recording of all relevant information
 - Can perform bridge assessment calculation and report. 
 - Manage delivery of projects - take responsibility for budget and resource deployment on projects. 
 - Take responsibility for project delivery to agreed budgets. 
 - Preparation of estimates for work items. 
 - Identify scope change items. 
 - Knowledge of working on big multidisciplinary projects on BIM. 
 - Coordinating work between different disciplines. 
 - Can prepare contractual claims arising out of any change in the contract conditions. 
 - Manage resources at a project level to ensure utilization and productivity is maintained
 - Ensure compliance of the Systra Group policies, particularly on ethics, safety and adherence to company ISO standards. 

Profile/Skills

- BE-Civil + M. Tech in Structural Engineering
 - 10 to 13 years of experience in the relevant field. 
 - Experience with software like Sofistik, Midas, Open Bridge and Oasys. 
 - Actively working towards professional qualification. 
 - Ability to work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary design team. 
 - Ability to complete assigned tasks with minimal supervision and provide support and mentoring to others. 
 - Ability to travel to client sites and other SYSTRA offices will be required. 

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It's not a job - it's a career!

Assets

You're Built for This If

Apply a leaning-forward approach and empirical methods to navigate complexity and uncertainty, ensuring each iteration delivers value and stays aligned with customer and business goals.

Minimize unnecessary technical complexity and avoid overengineering-features, functionality, and integration approaches that do not add value-and drive teams toward peak performance through continuous learning and collaborative execution. Collaborate, challenge, and own technical decisions advocated by business or other groups that do not fit or advance the enterprise ecosystem.

Continuously enhance the engineering operating model to be lean, adaptable, and responsive-guiding and transforming the organization to embrace lean principles and foster a culture of innovation.

data.description:
Our Mission

Who We Are

This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own medium-sized features in our connectors framework from design through production. In this role, you will work independently on diverse problems that require weighing many factors, and you will find simple solutions that keep the framework easy to maintain. You will write the designs for features in your component, rewrite modules with a solid grasp of the overall architecture, and mentor junior engineers along the way. 

What You'll Do

- Own Medium-Sized Framework Features: Take a framework feature from design to production. Examples include checkpoint and resume for long-running syncs, per-credential rate limiting, or write-operation support in the no-code connector framework. 
 - Design Within Your Component: Write functional and design specifications for features in your area of the framework, and argue your design decisions in reviews. 
 - Break Down Ambiguity: Turn vague or complex requirements into simple, well-scoped pieces, and keep making progress when the path is unclear. 
 - Rewrite and Improve Modules: Refactor or rewrite framework modules and services, with a solid understanding of the overall architecture, performance, deployment, and debugging. 
 - Protect Data Accuracy: Make sure the features you build handle deletions, partial failures, and retries without corrupting the identity inventory. 
 - Debug Complex Issues: Fix complicated framework issues and customer escalations, and join support calls alongside senior engineers and PM. 
 - Apply AI-First Practices: Build AI-assisted workflows for your component, and rigorously evaluate AI-generated code and configuration to prevent hallucinations, security gaps, and logic defects. 
 - Practice Secure Engineering: Handle customer credentials, tokens, and tenant isolation correctly in everything you build, and resolve security findings in your area. 
 - Mentor on Quality: Mentor junior engineers on code quality, testing, and documentation. 
 - Deliver on Commitments: Do what it takes, including sensible trade-offs, to deliver on time. 

Nice to Have

- Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms. Familiarity with SCIM or entitlement modeling. 
 - Declarative Integration Frameworks: Experience extending low-code or no-code integration platforms, or transformation languages such as JSONata or JSONPath. 
 - Workflow & Job Orchestration: Experience with distributed job schedulers, queues, or durable workflow engines, such as Agenda, SQS, Kafka, or Temporal. 
 - Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with agents or gateways that run inside customer networks and connect back to a cloud service. 
 - Quality & Observability Tooling: Fluency with Jest or Vitest, contract testing, JMeter for load testing, and monitoring tools such as Datadog. 

Impact

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the connectors framework, you will be a go-to engineer for your area of the platform. The features you own will shape how accurately and reliably identity data reaches our product. Your impact will be measured by the quality and durability of the features you deliver, how well you handle ambiguity, and the growth of the engineers you mentor. 

Qualifications

- Backend Mastery: Deep hands-on experience building enterprise-grade services with Node. js, TypeScript, Express. js, and MongoDB. 
 - Data Sync & Pipelines: Experience building data sync or ETL pipelines that handle idempotency, retries, pagination, and rate limits. 
 - Integration Protocols: Practical experience with REST, SCIM 2. 0, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs, plus OAuth 2. 0 and other enterprise authentication schemes. 
 - Cloud Experience: Experience building and operating services on AWS. 
 - Design Documentation: Able to write clear functional and design specifications that explain trade-offs. 
 - Production Debugging: Experience debugging complicated production issues and customer cases. 
 - Development Processes: Expert understanding of development processes and tools, including issue tracking, source control, and CI/CD. 
 - AI Tooling & Output Verification: Expertise in prompt and context engineering, with peer-review rigor to verify AI output for correctness and security. 
 - Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations. 

Qualifications

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

data.description:
Experience: 9-12 years of software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on experience developing modern React applications

Location: Mumbai | Hybrid

Role Purpose

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Full-Stack Engineering and React SME to provide technical leadership for modern web-based analytics applications across the Analytics Gateway portfolio. 

The role combines hands-on engineering, solution architecture, and technical leadership. The successful candidate will build production applications while establishing reusable engineering patterns, standards and platform capabilities that can be adopted across multiple project teams. 

The individual will be expected to operate across the full application lifecycle, spanning React/TypeScript front-end engineering, Python backend services, API integration, enterprise authentication and authorization, Snowflake connectivity, automated testing, CI/CD, cloud deployment, security and production observability. 

This is not a traditional people-management position or a pure front-end role. It requires a senior engineer who can remain hands-on while acting as a technical SME and design authority across multiple initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

Front-End Engineering

- Design and build scalable, production-grade applications using React and TypeScript. 
 - Establish component-driven UI architectures supporting reusable components, modular development and consistent user experiences. 
 - Implement robust approaches for routing, client and server state, asynchronous data retrieval, error/loading states and caching. 
 - Build responsive, accessible applications supporting desktop and tablet experiences. 
 - Develop data-intensive interfaces using visualization libraries such as Highcharts, ECharts, D3 or equivalent. 
 - Optimize application performance through appropriate use of lazy loading, code splitting, memoization, virtualization, pagination and caching. 
 - Establish reusable design systems, component libraries, and Figma-to-code patterns across multiple applications. 
 - Apply appropriate accessibility standards such as WCAG 2. 1 AA. 

Backend & API Engineering

- Design, develop and maintain backend services using Python with Flask and/or FastAPI. 
 - Design well-structured REST APIs covering contracts, schema validation, versioning, pagination, standardized error handling and API documentation. 
 - Own frontend/backend integration end to end, including API contracts, schema evolution and backward compatibility. 
 - Integrate applications securely with enterprise platforms and cloud data services. 
 - Develop performant data-access patterns for Snowflake and other cloud data platforms, with appropriate consideration for connection management, query performance and caching. 
 - Maintain appropriate separation between presentation, service/business logic and data-access layers. 

Security & Enterprise Engineering

- Apply secure-by-design engineering principles throughout the application lifecycle. 
 - Implement enterprise authentication patterns utilizing SSO, OAuth2/OIDC and/or SAML. 
 - Design application authorization using RBAC and entitlement-based access controls, ensuring protected resources and data permissions are enforced server-side or at the appropriate data/service layer. 
 - Apply OWASP-aligned secure coding practices covering injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication/session risks and dependency vulnerabilities. 
 - Ensure credentials, tokens and secrets are managed securely and never exposed within client-side code. 
 - Participate in SAST/SCA/DAST scanning, dependency management, vulnerability remediation and application-security reviews. 
 - Implement appropriate audit logging and access traceability for enterprise applications. 

Cloud, DevOps & Production Engineering

- Containerize web applications and backend services using Docker. 
 - Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or comparable platforms. 
 - Deploy and support applications on AWS/cloud-based container environments. 
 - Implement structured logging, application/API metrics, performance monitoring and operational dashboards. 
 - Use observability platforms such as Grafana, CloudWatch, AppDynamics, Datadog or equivalent. 
 - Diagnose production issues, perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative improvements. 
 - Establish appropriate environment configuration, dependency management and release/versioning practices. 

Quality Engineering

- Establish automated testing across unit, component, integration, API and end-to-end layers. 
 - Use modern test frameworks such as React Testing Library, Jest/Vitest and Playwright/Cypress or equivalent. 
 - Establish API and frontend/backend contract-testing practices. 
 - Define practical code-quality and test-coverage expectations. 
 - Promote automated quality checks within CI/CD pipelines. 

Architecture, SME & Technical Leadership

- Serve as the React and full-stack engineering SME across multiple analytics initiatives. 
 - Define and maintain reusable reference architectures, application scaffolding, shared components and engineering standards. 
 - Lead technical design and code reviews across internal and partner/vendor engineering teams. 
 - Evaluate architectural options and make pragmatic decisions covering scalability, maintainability, security, performance and delivery complexity. 
 - Set standards covering coding, branching, testing, security, accessibility, documentation and definition of done. 
 - Guide teams on technical feasibility, estimates, engineering trade-offs and build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Identify and manage technical debt, modernization opportunities and dependency/lifecycle risks. 
 - Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing, reference implementations and technical documentation. 
 - Influence teams without direct reporting authority and drive adoption of common engineering standards. 
 - Communicate technical decisions, risks and recommendations effectively to architecture, security, product and senior business stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field required
 - 9-12 years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Approximately 5+ years of substantial hands-on experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript development. 
 - Strong knowledge of React architecture, hooks, component design, routing, state/data management and frontend performance. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and developing backend APIs, preferably using Python/FastAPI. 
 - Proven ownership of end-to-end full-stack applications from architecture and development through testing, deployment and production support. 
 - Strong understanding of REST API architecture and frontend/backend integration patterns. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience integrating applications with relational databases or cloud data platforms. 
 - Experience implementing authentication and authorization for enterprise applications. 
 - Practical understanding of application security and OWASP-aligned secure development practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, Docker and cloud deployment. 
 - Strong automated-testing discipline across frontend and backend services. 
 - Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot application performance and production issues. 
 - Experience conducting architecture/design and code reviews. 
 - Proven ability to establish engineering standards and influence multiple engineering teams. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience working within Agile delivery environments.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own medium-sized features in our connectors framework from design through production. In this role, you will work independently on diverse problems that require weighing many factors, and you will find simple solutions that keep the framework easy to maintain. You will write the designs for features in your component, rewrite modules with a solid grasp of the overall architecture, and mentor junior engineers along the way. 

What You'll Do

- Own Medium-Sized Framework Features: Take a framework feature from design to production. Examples include checkpoint and resume for long-running syncs, per-credential rate limiting, or write-operation support in the no-code connector framework. 
 - Design Within Your Component: Write functional and design specifications for features in your area of the framework, and argue your design decisions in reviews. 
 - Break Down Ambiguity: Turn vague or complex requirements into simple, well-scoped pieces, and keep making progress when the path is unclear. 
 - Rewrite and Improve Modules: Refactor or rewrite framework modules and services, with a solid understanding of the overall architecture, performance, deployment, and debugging. 
 - Protect Data Accuracy: Make sure the features you build handle deletions, partial failures, and retries without corrupting the identity inventory. 
 - Debug Complex Issues: Fix complicated framework issues and customer escalations, and join support calls alongside senior engineers and PM. 
 - Apply AI-First Practices: Build AI-assisted workflows for your component, and rigorously evaluate AI-generated code and configuration to prevent hallucinations, security gaps, and logic defects. 
 - Practice Secure Engineering: Handle customer credentials, tokens, and tenant isolation correctly in everything you build, and resolve security findings in your area. 
 - Mentor on Quality: Mentor junior engineers on code quality, testing, and documentation. 
 - Deliver on Commitments: Do what it takes, including sensible trade-offs, to deliver on time. 

Nice to Have

- Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms. Familiarity with SCIM or entitlement modeling. 
 - Declarative Integration Frameworks: Experience extending low-code or no-code integration platforms, or transformation languages such as JSONata or JSONPath. 
 - Workflow & Job Orchestration: Experience with distributed job schedulers, queues, or durable workflow engines, such as Agenda, SQS, Kafka, or Temporal. 
 - Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with agents or gateways that run inside customer networks and connect back to a cloud service. 
 - Quality & Observability Tooling: Fluency with Jest or Vitest, contract testing, JMeter for load testing, and monitoring tools such as Datadog. 

Impact

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the connectors framework, you will be a go-to engineer for your area of the platform. The features you own will shape how accurately and reliably identity data reaches our product. Your impact will be measured by the quality and durability of the features you deliver, how well you handle ambiguity, and the growth of the engineers you mentor. 

Qualifications

- Backend Mastery: Deep hands-on experience building enterprise-grade services with Node. js, TypeScript, Express. js, and MongoDB. 
 - Data Sync & Pipelines: Experience building data sync or ETL pipelines that handle idempotency, retries, pagination, and rate limits. 
 - Integration Protocols: Practical experience with REST, SCIM 2. 0, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs, plus OAuth 2. 0 and other enterprise authentication schemes. 
 - Cloud Experience: Experience building and operating services on AWS. 
 - Design Documentation: Able to write clear functional and design specifications that explain trade-offs. 
 - Production Debugging: Experience debugging complicated production issues and customer cases. 
 - Development Processes: Expert understanding of development processes and tools, including issue tracking, source control, and CI/CD. 
 - AI Tooling & Output Verification: Expertise in prompt and context engineering, with peer-review rigor to verify AI output for correctness and security. 
 - Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations. 

Qualifications

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

data.title: Chief Testing and Commissioning Expert- BID Position
data.description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems. 

Context

In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water & Environment for public and private organizations. 

Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost-effective and made-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly. 

SYSTRA's unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services. 

SYSTRA India's comprehensive know-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc. ). 

Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork & Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling & Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re-modelling etc. 

Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation. 

Currently, we are bidding for Semi High Speed Rail projects across India. The position of Chief Testing and Commissioning Expert is the key position in these BIDs. 

Missions/Main Duties

- System Integration Strategy & Planning: 📝 Develop the comprehensive Master Testing and Commissioning Plan (MTCP). This includes defining the T&C strategy, budget, schedule, and necessary resources for all railway subsystems (Signaling, Power, Rolling Stock, Telecoms, Track, etc. ) and ensuring their successful technical and operational integration. 
 - Statutory Compliance and Safety Certification: Act as the primary technical point of contact for obtaining Statutory Clearances and Safety Certification from regulatory authorities (e. g. , Commissioner of Railway Safety). This involves managing the preparation and submission of all critical safety dossiers and test reports. 
 - Lead System Integration Testing (SIT): 🔗 Direct the complex interface testing between major subsystems, such as validating the communication and functional response between the Signaling System (e. g. , ETCS), the Rolling Stock (trains), and the Power Supply/Traction system. 
 - Operational Readiness & Trial Run Management: Oversee all stages of trial and dynamic testing, including running trains at maximum projected speeds to validate ride quality, braking performance, and system stability under real-world conditions. This culminates in declaring the line ready for shadow operation. 
 - Defect Management and Resolution: Establish and enforce a rigorous process for managing Non-Conformities (NCs) and defects found during T&C. The expert is responsible for tracking all open items to closure and verifying that corrective actions do not negatively impact other system interfaces. 
 - Handover, Training, and Documentation: Lead the formal Handover Process to the Operations and Maintenance (O&M) team. This includes approving final system manuals, maintenance procedures, and ensuring the operational staff is fully trained and competent to safely run the railway. 

Profile/Skills

- Qualification: Graduate in Engineering with working knowledge of reading, writing and speaking in English [additional marks for PG in Engineering]
 - Minimum Experience: 20 years post minimum qualification in any Rail based Passenger Transit System [additional marks for more experience in any Rail based Passenger Transit System*]
 - Relevant Experience: 5 years' experience for two works of Planning and supervising Trial tests and commissioning of subsystems of Rail based Passenger Transit system and obtaining statutory approvals for Commercial operation as Chief Testing and Commissioning Expert or equivalent position [additional marks for more experience; experience in position one level below allowed with less weightage]
 - Eligible Assignment**(see below): Must have experience of 1 Eligible Assignment as Chief Testing and Commissioning Expert or equivalent position for a full-time continuous deployment period not less than 2 years [additional marks for more Eligible Assignments; less weightage for position one level below]
 - Rail-based Passenger Transit System shall mean
 - High Speed Transit System / Regional Rail Transit System (with operational speed of 160kmh and above) OR 
 - Urban/Suburban/Intercity/Mass Rapid Transit System (MRTS) [excluding LRT with design PHPDT less than 20000/Tram/Monorail Systems]
 - Shall mean experience of working as a personnel of General Consultant / Project Management Consultant / Employer's Personnel in a work / project in a Rail based Passenger Transit System with operational speed of 160 kmph or more comprising: 
 - Construction of Civil structures (at-grade/elevated/underground) AND 
 - Installation of Systems (Track, Rolling Stock, Traction & Power Supply, Signalling)

Including Detailed Design or Proof checking of designs; Bid Process Management; Project and Interface Management; Construction Supervision and System Installations and Testing & Commissioning

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It's not a job - it's a career!

data.title: Group Leader – End of Line (Ball, Lid, Saw & Pack)
data.description:
Hiring for 3D Glass Solutions, Inc. - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About Company

3D Glass Solutions (3DGS) is a US advanced-packaging company using its patented photo-definable APEX® glass technology for RF, photonics, IC and system-in-package devices. Through its Indian entity, 3DGS is building a vertically integrated glass-core substrate and chip assembly plant in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, approved under the India Semiconductor Mission. The assembly team is small today, and the people who join now will select tools, qualify the line and build the teams that run it. 

Job Roles & Responsibilities

- Lead development, optimization and qualification of ball attach (strip and singulated), reflow, cleaning, TIM and lid attach, strip saw singulation, laser marking, AVI/X-ray inspection and bake and dry pack for FCBGA, fcCSP and wbCSP products

- Own combined process and equipment ownership for the module: process windows, tool qualification (SAT, IQ/OQ/PQ), equipment capability and module yield

- Own the end-of-line quality gate: lot acceptance, sampling plans, MSL classification, dry pack, packing/labeling controls and outgoing quality data

- Lead root cause analysis for defects such as missing/double balls, ball voids, coplanarity excursions, TIM voids, lid tilt, chipping, burrs and delamination

- Establish AVI and X-ray inspection strategy, recipes, accept criteria and escape/false-call monitoring

- Qualify solder balls, fluxes, TIMs, lid adhesives, blades and jigs with suppliers

- Build, train and certify the end-of-line team of engineers and technicians

- Drive PM optimization, spares strategy and troubleshooting on ball attach, lid attach, saws, laser markers, inspection and dry pack equipment

Ideal Candidate Profile

- 10+ years hands-on in ball attach, lid attach, singulation, inspection and packing at an OSAT, ATMP or IDM assembly site, owning multiple tool types

- Engineering degree in Mechanical, Materials, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial or a related field

- Part of at least one new line installation, qualification or capacity ramp

- Has trained and certified entry-level engineers and technicians in a multi-tool production environment

- Experience with SPC, DOE, FMEA, process characterization, yield analysis and structured troubleshooting

- Prior leadership of engineers, technicians and cross-functional teams in a production or ramp environment

- Willing to relocate to Bhubaneswar, Odisha

- Strong grasp of solder ball metallurgy, coplanarity, TIM/lid adhesive behavior and J-STD-020 MSL/dry pack requirements

- Experience with strip and singulated flows, large-body lidded FCBGA and outgoing quality gate ownership is highly preferred

In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water & Environment for public and private organizations. 

Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost-effective and made-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly. 

SYSTRA's unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services. 

SYSTRA India's comprehensive know-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc. ). 

Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork & Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling & Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re-modelling etc. 

Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation. 

Currently, we are bidding for Metro Rail projects across India. The position of Chief Quality Assurance Expert (Civil) is the key position in these BIDs. 

Missions/Main Duties

- Quality Management System (QMS): Establish, implement, and continually improve the project's Quality Management System in accordance with national/international standards and client requirements. 
 - Quality Planning: Develop and maintain project-specific quality assurance plans, inspection & test plans, and related procedures for all construction and system activities. 
 - Supervision and Auditing: Lead quality audits and inspections across all project phases, verifying compliance with approved designs, material specifications, and construction practices. 
 - Document Review: Review and approve construction drawings, material approvals, method statements, and test reports for compliance with quality standards. 
 - Contractor Oversight: Monitor and guide contractors, consultants, and suppliers to ensure all works and deliveries meet contractual quality requirements. 
 - Non-conformance Management: Identify, report, and manage non-conformities (NCRs), recommend corrective and preventive actions, and verify closure. 
 - Testing and Certification: Oversee quality testing of materials and systems, ensuring timely certification and acceptance in coordination with laboratories and third-party inspectors. 
 - Training and Awareness: Organize and deliver quality-related training programs for project staff and contractors to promote awareness and compliance. 
 - Reporting: Prepare quality assurance progress reports, audit findings, trend analyses, and recommendations for management and stakeholders.
