 - Risk Management: Proactively identify and mitigate risks related to quality, ensuring timely intervention and resolution. 

Profile/Skills

- Graduate in Civil Engineering

Working across Technical Support, Product Line Management, Hardware and Software Engineering, System Test, Services, and customers, the Principal Engineer serves as a trusted technical authority for product readiness, onboarding, and complex issue resolution.

 - Lead resolution of complex product-introduction issues through cross-functional root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

Test architecture: Define and own the test architecture and automation strategy for the IGA platform, spanning unit, API, contract, integration, UI, and end-to-end testing. 

Frameworks and infrastructure: Design, build, and evolve reusable test frameworks, tools, and test environments that scale across teams and microservices. 

CI/CD quality gates: Embed automated testing deep into CI/CD pipelines. Push for fast, reliable feedback, parallel execution, and fewer flaky tests.

Identity lifecycle (joiner, mover, leaver)

Provisioning and deprovisioning

Access requests and approvals

Certification campaigns

Qualifications

Strong coding skills in one or more of Java, C#, Python, TypeScript, or Go, with solid software design principles. 

Deep experience building automation frameworks with tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, REST Assured, Pact, TestNG/JUnit, or pytest.

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Provenir is the unified Decision Intelligence Platform that gives enterprises full control over end- to-end customer decisioning - to manage risk, drive growth, and transform business outcomes. By consolidating data, AI models, intelligence, agents and governance into a single decisioning environment, Provenir empowers business teams to configure and evolve strategy directly, while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability and regulatory compliance. Trusted by 120+ institutions in 60+ countries, Provenir processes over 4 billion decisions annually - turning architectural coherence into sustained risk performance and measurable value. Ready to solve meaningful challenges, work with enterprise customers, and help shape the future of AI-powered decisioning? Join us. 

The QA Engineer will be responsible for assuring the quality of our products, creating automated tests, and managing builds and continuous integration. You will automate tests for microservices and their related front ends, and manage infrastructure across development and production cloud environments. 

This role goes beyond conventional application testing. Our platform combines graph data stores, graph analytics, machine learning models, and agentic AI workflows - systems whose outputs are probabilistic, whose correctness is contextual, and whose decisions carry regulatory weight. You will help define what "passing" means for components that don't return the same answer twice, and build the harnesses that hold them to it. 

What You'll Do

Core Test Automation

- Build and maintain end-to-end and component test suites using modern browser automation with auto-waiting, trace-based debugging, and parallel execution as the default
 - Shape coverage around the test pyramid rather than the UI - API and contract tests as the primary safety net, with UI reserved for genuine user journeys
 - Embed quality gates directly in CI/CD pipelines - sharded parallel runs, risk-based test selection, and pass/fail criteria that block promotion without manual sign-off
 - Provision ephemeral, containerised test environments on demand through infrastructure-as-code, with synthetic and masked test data generated per run instead of maintained by hand
 - Treat test reliability as a product: track flake rates, quarantine and fix unstable tests, and hold suites to explicit stability and runtime SLAs
 - Use AI-assisted tooling for test authoring, coverage gap analysis, and locator resilience - while owning the judgement call on what the generated tests are actually worth
 - Work shift-left alongside engineers - contributing test coverage with the feature, not after it - and partner on triage to drive issues to root cause

Graph Data and Analytics

- Design and automate validation for graph database layers - schema integrity, relationship correctness, and query behaviour across Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL
 - Build regression coverage for graph analytics outputs: pathfinding, centrality, community detection, and link analysis used in fraud-ring identification and network risk scoring
 - Validate graph ingestion and transformation pipelines for data completeness, deduplication, and referential accuracy at scale

AI/ML and Agentic Systems

- Develop evaluation harnesses for ML model behaviour - accuracy thresholds, drift detection, bias and fairness checks, and explainability outputs required for regulatory review
 - Build automated test suites for agentic workflows: tool-calling correctness, multi-step orchestration, context handling, failure recovery, and guardrail enforcement
 - Design assertion strategies for non-deterministic outputs, including golden-set comparison, semantic similarity scoring, and LLM-as-judge evaluation
 - Establish prompt and model regression testing so behavioural changes are caught before release
 - Validate feature pipelines and training/serving consistency in partnership with data science teams

Process and Platform

- Incorporate best practices into dev/test/deploy processes and recommend improvements
 - Support application onboarding to the defined target operating model to achieve build and release automation
 - Document, track, and escalate issues as appropriate

What's Required

Education: A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field. 

Experience: Proven track record of extensive hands-on experience in automated testing of web applications and services, including designing, developing, and executing automated tests in Python using a modern browser automation framework (Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, or equivalent). 

Qualifications, Strengths And Skills

- Demonstrated understanding of maintainable test architecture - Page Object Model or equivalent patterns - for end-to-end testing
 - Extensive hands-on experience on Python scripting
 - Experience testing web services and REST APIs (Postman, Swagger)
 - Working knowledge of graph databases - Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, JanusGraph or similar - including writing and validating graph queries
 - Exposure to testing AI/ML-backed features, and a clear grasp of why probabilistic systems need different assertions than deterministic ones
 - Scripting experience beyond Python: Unix shell, Ruby, or similar
 - Continuous integration and pipeline-based delivery (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar)
 - Experience with SQL
 - Experience recommending process improvements

Nice to Have

- Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks - LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or comparable orchestration tooling
 - Familiarity with LLM evaluation tooling and practices: golden datasets, rubric-based scoring, hallucination and jailbreak testing, red-teaming
 - Graph analytics libraries such as Neo4j GDS, Apache Spark GraphX, or NetworkX
 - Observability-driven testing - synthetic monitoring, canary analysis, and validation through traces, logs and metrics
 - Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible; microservices, container deployment and service orchestration
 - Cloud APIs (AWS, Azure, GCP)
 - JIRA for issue tracking and escalation

data.title: Lead SDET
data.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. 
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. 

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31. 8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4, 000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. 

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. 

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. 

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. 

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. 

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. 

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. 

The mission -
Where you'll leave your mark?

- Own quality outcomes, not activities - the question is never "how many test cases did you write this sprint, " it's "what quality metric moved and what did you build to move it. "
 - Drive CI pass rate to 90%+ and keep it there - the percentage of pipeline runs that pass without manual intervention
 - Own bug leakage rate - target under 2-3% of bugs escaping QA to staging or production, with a root cause analysis you own for every bug that gets through
 - Build the system that keeps flaky tests out of the suite - preventing flakiness from entering and quarantining it when it does
 - Shape automation coverage at the right layer - E2E where it matters, API where it's faster and more reliable, unit where developers should own it - not just chasing a coverage percentage
 - Stay 50-60% hands-on - writing Playwright TypeScript to evolve the framework, building diagnostic tools that analyse test-run data for flakiness patterns, and reviewing PRs to catch structural problems in AI-generated test code
 - Build AI-native quality infrastructure - systems that use LLMs, agents, and AI tooling to solve quality problems at scale, like pipelines that auto-analyse every PR for risk across security, product, and UX dimensions
 - Deliver engineering-wide quality impact - at least one initiative per quarter that changes how developers or PMs ship, not just how QA tests. Our current guardrail system prevents 90 bugs per month without manual QA; that's the bar
 - Partner and present - sit with product engineers to define quality gates before features ship, and present quality metrics (CI pass rate, bug leakage, flaky test trends) to engineering leadership

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- An engineer who has chosen quality as their specialisation - this is not a pure coding role and not a management role; it lives exactly in between (: 40-50% strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring)
 - Engineering-wide in scope, not QA-internal - you want to improve how the entire engineering organisation thinks about quality, not just how the QA team works
 - AI-native, not AI-assisted - you don't just use Copilot for test authoring; you build quality systems on LLMs and agents, and you can test AI features themselves - validating agent behaviour, checking LLM output quality, and handling non-deterministic systems
 - A test pyramid thinker, not just an E2E automator - with developers now writing feature automation themselves, you push testing responsibility to the developer layer while QA owns integration, workflow, and AI feature quality. A candidate who only thinks Playwright and E2E is too narrow
 - Fluent in the modern stack - Playwright, TypeScript, CI pipelines, and the data behind them
 - Comfortable influencing without authority - defining quality gates with product engineers and changing developer behaviour through systems, not mandates

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
 - Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
 - We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1, 000 annually to help you level up your skills
 - We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
 - Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
 - Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35, 000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. 

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Location: Bangalore (Quarterly visit for 2 weeks)

Function: Software Engineering

Reports to: Director, Packaging Intelligence

About The Role

Esko is building Agentic AI as a shared platform capability that enables product teams to create reliable AI-powered workflows without independently rebuilding common foundations. The platform team provides reusable capabilities, engineering patterns, and production foundations; product teams retain ownership of their domain applications and customer experiences. 

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role combining line management with substantial direct technical contribution. You will lead and develop the Agentic AI team, help shape the platform's technical direction, and take end-to-end ownership of substantial technical areas. Success will be measured not only by what the team ships, but by the quality, adoption, and leverage the platform creates across Esko. 

You will work closely with product engineering, architecture, cloud platform, security, compliance, product management, and design to translate shared needs and legitimate domain differences into coherent platform capabilities. You will also contribute to Esko's broader AI direction and participate in customer or industry discussions where your technical perspective is valuable. 

What You Will Do

- Lead and develop the Agentic AI engineering team through clear goals, regular feedback, coaching, performance management, career development, and thoughtful allocation of ownership. 
 - Contribute directly to the design, implementation, and operation of substantial areas of Esko's shared Agentic AI platform. 
 - Help shape the platform's technical direction, architecture, interfaces, and engineering quality bar in collaboration with the wider platform and architecture community. 
 - Translate recurring product and engineering needs into reusable platform capabilities, while accommodating legitimate domain differences without creating product-specific forks. 
 - Establish strong engineering practices for reliability, security, observability, evaluation, performance, and compatibility for consuming teams. 
 - Work directly with product engineering teams to support adoption of the shared platform and help them take domain-specific agentic capabilities from exploration into production. 
 - Create an environment in which engineers can experiment, learn, challenge assumptions, and make evidence-based technical decisions while remaining accountable for production outcomes. 
 - Define and use meaningful measures of platform adoption, quality, operational performance, delivery effectiveness, and team development to guide priorities and improvement. 

What We Are Looking For

- Strong production software engineering experience in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language, including designing, building, and operating reliable systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers, including line management, coaching, performance feedback, and creating meaningful technical ownership. 
 - Experience building a platform, API, or shared service used by multiple teams, with sound judgement about abstractions, interfaces, compatibility, and operational responsibilities. 
 - Experience designing or building production AI systems using large language models, tool use, or agentic workflows, together with a practical understanding of their limitations and risks. 
 - A track record of taking uncertain or early-stage technical ideas through evaluation, implementation, and adoption as dependable production capabilities. 
 - Ability to balance platform coherence with legitimate product and domain differences, and to make clear technical trade-offs when needs conflict. 
 - Experience collaborating across product engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, and business functions in a global organization. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineering, product, and leadership audiences. 
 - Undergraduate, Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science / Machine Learning / Data Science / Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience in packaging graphics, prepress, CAD, or the wider graphic arts industry. 
 - Experience building or operating multi-tenant SaaS or cloud platform capabilities. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation, observability, security controls, governance, or other production foundations for agentic systems. 

What Success Looks Like

- Delivery of solutions conforming to agreed specifications and architecture that leverage agentic AI to solve valuable customer problems in a way that is explainable and repeatable - resulting in measurable productivity improvements. 
 - Teams across the business ship AI-powered capabilities that solve valuable customer problems by leveraging a shared foundation, rather than "re-inventing the wheel". 
 - Providing adequate space for ideation - and inspiration for team members to try new approaches, technologies and techniques. 
 - Team members are set meaningful, measurable goals - with training and development plans created to facilitate their ongoing personal and career development. 
 - Delivery of initiatives occurs in line with Esko's Software Development Lifecycle and in accordance with company policy and security best practices. 
 - The Agentic AI platform grows as a coherent whole rather than fragmenting into one-off, team-specific solutions. 
 - A class-leading set of capabilities provide a powerful base for Esko cross-functional teams to transform the value of our software using cutting-edge AI technologies.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own medium-sized features in our connectors framework from design through production. In this role, you will work independently on diverse problems that require weighing many factors, and you will find simple solutions that keep the framework easy to maintain. You will write the designs for features in your component, rewrite modules with a solid grasp of the overall architecture, and mentor junior engineers along the way. 

What You'll Do

- Own Medium-Sized Framework Features: Take a framework feature from design to production. Examples include checkpoint and resume for long-running syncs, per-credential rate limiting, or write-operation support in the no-code connector framework. 
 - Design Within Your Component: Write functional and design specifications for features in your area of the framework, and argue your design decisions in reviews. 
 - Break Down Ambiguity: Turn vague or complex requirements into simple, well-scoped pieces, and keep making progress when the path is unclear. 
 - Rewrite and Improve Modules: Refactor or rewrite framework modules and services, with a solid understanding of the overall architecture, performance, deployment, and debugging. 
 - Protect Data Accuracy: Make sure the features you build handle deletions, partial failures, and retries without corrupting the identity inventory. 
 - Debug Complex Issues: Fix complicated framework issues and customer escalations, and join support calls alongside senior engineers and PM. 
 - Apply AI-First Practices: Build AI-assisted workflows for your component, and rigorously evaluate AI-generated code and configuration to prevent hallucinations, security gaps, and logic defects. 
 - Practice Secure Engineering: Handle customer credentials, tokens, and tenant isolation correctly in everything you build, and resolve security findings in your area. 
 - Mentor on Quality: Mentor junior engineers on code quality, testing, and documentation. 
 - Deliver on Commitments: Do what it takes, including sensible trade-offs, to deliver on time. 

Nice to Have

- Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms. Familiarity with SCIM or entitlement modeling. 
 - Declarative Integration Frameworks: Experience extending low-code or no-code integration platforms, or transformation languages such as JSONata or JSONPath. 
 - Workflow & Job Orchestration: Experience with distributed job schedulers, queues, or durable workflow engines, such as Agenda, SQS, Kafka, or Temporal. 
 - Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with agents or gateways that run inside customer networks and connect back to a cloud service. 
 - Quality & Observability Tooling: Fluency with Jest or Vitest, contract testing, JMeter for load testing, and monitoring tools such as Datadog. 

Impact

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the connectors framework, you will be a go-to engineer for your area of the platform. The features you own will shape how accurately and reliably identity data reaches our product. Your impact will be measured by the quality and durability of the features you deliver, how well you handle ambiguity, and the growth of the engineers you mentor. 

Qualifications

- Backend Mastery: Deep hands-on experience building enterprise-grade services with Node. js, TypeScript, Express. js, and MongoDB. 
 - Data Sync & Pipelines: Experience building data sync or ETL pipelines that handle idempotency, retries, pagination, and rate limits. 
 - Integration Protocols: Practical experience with REST, SCIM 2. 0, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs, plus OAuth 2. 0 and other enterprise authentication schemes. 
 - Cloud Experience: Experience building and operating services on AWS. 
 - Design Documentation: Able to write clear functional and design specifications that explain trade-offs. 
 - Production Debugging: Experience debugging complicated production issues and customer cases. 
 - Development Processes: Expert understanding of development processes and tools, including issue tracking, source control, and CI/CD. 
 - AI Tooling & Output Verification: Expertise in prompt and context engineering, with peer-review rigor to verify AI output for correctness and security. 
 - Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations. 

Qualifications

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

At Okta, our motto is "Always On"  and nowhere do we embrace that more than in Technical Operations. We strive to build the most reliable and performant systems on the planet through the skillful use of automation. If you like to be challenged and have a passion for solving large-scale automation, testing, and tuning problems, we would love to hear from you. The ideal candidate is someone who exemplifies the ethics of, "If you have to do something more than once, automate it" and who can rapidly self-educate on new concepts and tools. 

You will work on: 

- Leading the architecture, design and rollout of the internal developer platform which would span CI/CD, tooling, infrastructure as code (IAC) integrations as well as modernization efforts
 - Enhance existing automation for fleet management and build new features as per the needs of the infrastructure platform  
 - Spearhead initiatives and projects that enhance engineer productivity by identifying and mitigating bottlenecks in the development flow
 - Mentoring, managing, and leading a team of SWEs & SREs with a broad range of expertise and experience
 - Triaging and troubleshooting complex production issues to ensure reliability and performance. 
 - Working closely with our stakeholders across the organization to ensure our new capabilities are aligned to our competing constraints of reliability, security, and delivery velocity
 - Partnering directly with recruiting and people ops to hire and retain the best talent in the world
 - Keep sharp eyes on our metrics, including vulnerability scanning and security posture, cloud spend, RPO and RTO, and toil overhead, and ensure our projects are driving our metrics in the right direction
 - Supporting a 24x7 online environment as part of an on-call rotationYou are an ideal candidate if you: 

- Platform-as-Product Mindset: Proven track record of building and scaling internal developer platforms (IDP) that treat internal engineering teams as customers, focusing on reducing cognitive load and improving developer velocity. 
 - Engineering Excellence in Tooling: Deep experience in the "Software" part of SRE-leading teams to build robust, automated tooling for CI/CD orchestration, Kubernetes operators, or self-service infrastructure provisioning (IaC). 
 - Automation First: A history of transitioning teams from manual "toil-heavy" operations to automated, code-driven workflows that interact safely with high-scale cloud production environments. 
 - Are always willing to go the extra mile: see a problem, fix the problem. 
 - Are passionate about encouraging the development of engineering peers and leading by example
 - Have experience managing teams running large-scale production Java/Tomcat and containerized services in AWS (EC2, ECS, KMS, Kinesis, RDS) or other cloud providers.   
 - Have deep knowledge of CI/CD principles, Linux fundamentals, OS hardening, networking concepts, and IP protocols. Minimum Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Qualities: 

- Overall experience 8+ years & 2+ years of engineering management experience leading SWE teams
 -   SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering teams, with the ability to remain hands-on technically. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in AWS and GCP, particularly Amazon EKS, Kubernetes, cloud-native infrastructure, and production operations. 
 - Proven automation experience with Infrastructure as Code (e. g. , Terraform), scripting, and CI/CD, with a strong focus on cloud and Kubernetes security, IAM, and security automation. 
 - Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills, with a BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. #P12775_3245168

 - Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + CommunityWe are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

data.description:
Future Talent: Site Reliability Engineer / DevOps Engineer (Talent Community - India)

The Opportunity

We are always looking for exceptional Site Reliability Engineers (SRE) and DevOps Engineers across India to help us build resilient, highly available, cloud-ready platforms that power mission‐critical systems. While we have a number of roles open with very specific requirements, this dedicated SRE/DevOps Talent Community allows us to connect and engage with strong engineers early. 

By joining our engineering community, you'll gain access to insights into our cloud architecture, engineering culture, reliability practices, and events-and be among the first to move directly into advanced interview stages when a matching role opens. 

What You'll Do (When You Join Us)

Architect & Build

Design, implement, and optimize reliable, scalable infrastructure and cloud environments using Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, CI/CD, IaC, and automation frameworks. 

Build resilient distributed systems, high‐throughput pipelines, observability frameworks, and automated operational tooling. 

Optimize & Enhance

Improve system performance, reliability, and availability by leveraging SLOs, SLIs, monitoring, chaos engineering, performance testing, and proactive incident prevention. 

Implement automation across deployments, scaling, monitoring, and incident response using Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins. 

Collaborate

Work closely with product owners, architects, platform engineers, backend teams, and security teams to build and operate production‐grade systems. 

Participate in solution designs, blameless post‐incident reviews, capacity planning, and operational readiness assessments. 

Mentor & Share

Guide junior engineers, contribute to engineering forums, and participate in internal tech talks or knowledge‐sharing sessions around DevOps/SRE topics. 

What You'll Bring

- Build With Purpose - Start with why. Solve real operational problems with measurable impact. 
 - Customer Driven - Prioritize reliability, uptime, and real‐world performance. 
 - Technically Courageous - Dive deep into failures, distributed systems, and complex infrastructure challenges. 
 - Learn and Be Curious - Stay ahead in cloud, automation, observability, and reliability engineering. 
 - Act as Owner - Treat production as your responsibility. Drive long‐term value and operational excellence. 
 - Lead with data - Use metrics, logs, traces, and experiments to guide improvements. 
 - Dive deep - Investigate issues across systems, networks, containers, and cloud layers. 
 - Build responsibly, deliver incrementally - Prioritize secure, scalable, reliable solutions. 
 - Collaborate to achieve - Communicate openly, work respectfully, and uphold engineering excellence. 

Why Connect Now?

- Skip the Line - Talent community members are prioritized for fast‐track evaluation. 
 - Exclusive Insights - Receive invites to SRE roundtables, cloud architecture sessions, and engineering roadmap previews. 
 - Career Alignment - We reach out only for roles aligned to your strengths-SRE, DevOps, Cloud, Platform Engineering, or Automation. 

How To Join

Upload your CV along with a short note about: 

- Your areas of strength: SRE, DevOps, Cloud, Kubernetes, Observability, Automation, IaC, CI/CD, Performance Engineering. 
 - The type of reliability or automation challenges you enjoy. 
 - Your preferred focus areas: reliability engineering, cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, platform engineering, or deployment pipelines.

data.title: Lead Full-Stack Engineer (1230PM - 930PM IST)
data.description:
Lead Full-Stack Engineer

Location: Pune, India

Model of Work: Hybrid

Working Hours: 12: 30 PM to 9: 30 PM IST, a nine-hour workday that provides overlap with US Central Time stakeholders. 

About Quorum Software

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1, 800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware. com

Be a part of our legacy

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies. 

Who We Are Looking For

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation. 

The Opportunity

Quorum is seeking a Lead Full-Stack Engineer to own the technical design, development, and long-term success of a portfolio of AI-native platforms and operational solutions within Cloud Operations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an engineer who enjoys building products, establishing practical engineering standards, and owning production outcomes. You will serve as the primary technical lead and code owner while partnering with Cloud Operations, engineering peers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders. 

The initial focus is QPOP, the Quorum Platform Operations Portal, an Azure-native internal platform that brings service management, change management, estate visibility, customer relationships, and operational workflows into a unified experience. As the portfolio grows, the role will also deliver governed AI agents, agentic workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 

What You Will Own

- Application architecture and code quality across the assigned portfolio, including module boundaries, integrations, data models, testing standards, and production readiness. 
 - Engineering standards for code review, automated testing, CI/CD quality gates, documentation, observability, security, and an AI-enabled software development lifecycle (AI SDLC). 
 - Technical delivery from design through production support, working with partner teams rather than operating as a standalone contributor. 
 - Repository governance, including code ownership, reusable development patterns, AI-development guidance, prompt and agent assets, evaluation criteria, and review controls. 

What You Will Do

- Deliver full-stack application modules from design through build, integration, verification, release, and ongoing support. 
 - Build workflow integrations with enterprise platforms such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft Entra ID, Salesforce, PagerDuty, Microsoft Fabric, and related internal systems. 
 - Design reliable integration patterns using idempotency, webhooks, retries, reconciliation, failure recovery, and traceable audit records. 
 - Implement enterprise authentication and authorization using OIDC/OAuth 2. 0, Microsoft Entra ID, and role-based access control. 
 - Build metadata-driven forms, service catalogs, request workflows, and rules-driven user experiences. 
 - Design and develop governed AI agents, MCP servers, assistants, and agentic workflows that take approved actions through well-defined tools, permission checks, human approval points, and complete audit trails. 
 - Embed AI-assisted engineering into the SDLC, including planning, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, security validation, and controlled promotion, while ensuring engineers remain accountable for every change. 
 - Deliver applications and infrastructure through GitHub Actions, OIDC, Bicep, and controlled promotion across development, non-production, and production environments. 
 - Create automated unit, integration, API, and end-to-end tests that provide confidence in releases. 
 - Participate in the appropriate production support and on-call rotation, with shared operational ownership across the team. 
 - Document architecture, operational procedures, key decisions, and support requirements as part of normal delivery. 
 - And other duties as assigned. 

Required Qualifications

- Strong hands-on experience delivering production full-stack applications using modern React, Next. js, TypeScript, and server-side APIs. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and long-term ownership of a production codebase, including architecture decisions, engineering standards, code review, and mentoring. 
 - Experience delivering production software through an AI-enabled SDLC using tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline, Roo Code, Windsurf, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Ability to explain how AI-generated code, prompts, agent behavior, and tool integrations were reviewed, tested, evaluated, corrected, secured, and governed before production release. 
 - Experience building enterprise integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous messaging, retries, reconciliation, and failure recovery. 
 - Strong SQL data modeling experience, including schema migrations, entity resolution, and traceable audit records. 
 - Experience implementing enterprise identity and authorization using OIDC/OAuth 2. 0 and role-based access control. 
 - Proficiency with CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code using GitHub Actions and Bicep, Terraform, or comparable technologies. 
 - Strong automated testing experience across unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Production troubleshooting and observability experience across logs, metrics, traces, health checks, dashboards, and alerts. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across international teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Claude Code experience, including planning modes, subagents, repository guidance, hooks, skills, automated evaluations, or headless CI execution. 
 - Experience building and operating LLM assistants or AI agents with tool use, streaming responses, conversation state, evaluations, observability, safety controls, and orchestration of actions against real systems. 
 - Experience designing or consuming MCP servers and working with Anthropic APIs, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, model gateways, or equivalent AI platforms.

As AI workloads increasingly run on-device across CPU, GPU, and NPU architectures, ensuring consistent quality, accuracy, performance, power efficiency, and reliability across a diverse silicon ecosystem is critical. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our AI Validation team. In this role, you will be responsible for validating emerging AI models and experiences on Windows devices, enabling support for new generations of silicon, and building the validation infrastructure that helps Microsoft deliver high-quality on-device AI experiences at scale. 

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with a passion for AI systems, performance analysis, automation, and solving complex cross-hardware challenges. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

- Lead validation of on-device AI models and experiences across Windows platforms and silicon partners. 
 - Evaluate model accuracy, performance, power, scalability, and functional correctness across diverse hardware configurations. 
 - Drive bring-up and readiness of AI models on next-generation silicon platforms, working closely with Microsoft and silicon partner engineering teams. 
 - Develop, enhance, and maintain validation frameworks, automation infrastructure, and performance analysis tools to support evolving AI model architectures. 
 - Build solutions that enable efficient benchmarking and comparison of AI workloads across CPU, GPU, and NPU execution environments. 
 - Analyze telemetry, traces, and validation data to identify regressions, bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities. 
 - Collaborate with AI researchers, platform engineers, silicon partners, and product teams to ensure successful deployment of new AI capabilities on Windows. 
 - Design automated quality gates and validation methodologies that scale across models, hardware platforms, and operating system releases. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of model accuracy, compatibility, performance, and reliability issues. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership within the team through design reviews, best practices, and knowledge sharing. 

AI‐Forward Engineering

- Champion AI‐assisted and agentic engineering workflows across the org; set standards and expectations so teams use AI to move faster without compromising security or quality. 
 - Establish guardrails and best practices for responsible use of AI tools-ensuring correctness, security, privacy, and compliance. 
 - Encourage teams to use AI to: 
 - Accelerate root‐cause analysis and debugging
 - Improve test coverage and validation
 - Reduce toil through automation and repeatable workflows
 - Partner with AI‐forward initiatives across Windows to scale learnings, patterns, and reusable assets. 
Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 8+ years of software engineering experience in systems, platform, validation, AI/ML infrastructure, performance engineering, or related domains. 
 - Strong programming skills in C++, C#, Python, or related languages. 
 - Experience developing automation frameworks, validation infrastructure, or large-scale test systems. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex software and system-level issues. 
 - Experience analyzing performance, telemetry, profiling, or diagnostic data. 
 - Ability to work independently and drive projects from concept to execution. 
 - Experience with AI/ML model validation, benchmarking, or deployment. 
 - Familiarity with Windows AI, ONNX Runtime, DirectML, Windows ML, GenAI workloads, or model optimization techniques. 
 - Experience working with CPU, GPU, or NPU architectures and hardware acceleration technologies. 
 - Knowledge of performance, power, thermal, or scalability analysis methodologies. 
 - Experience collaborating with silicon vendors or platform engineering teams. 
 - Familiarity with model quality evaluation, benchmark development, and AI workload characterization.

data.title: AI Observability Principal Architect
data.description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world's current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies. 

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world's growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all. 

The AI Observability Principal Architect is responsible for defining and delivering end-to-end observability and AIOps capabilities across enterprise applications and platforms. The role focuses on enabling proactive detection, intelligent event correlation, and automated incident response, improving system reliability and operational efficiency. 

This role will lead observability strategy, standardization, and implementation across teams, ensuring clear visibility into system health, business workflows, and performance outcomes. The lead will work closely with SRE, application, infrastructure, and service management teams to embed outcome-driven observability (CUJs, SLIs/SLOs) and drive continuous improvement in incident detection and resolution. 

Assignment Deliverables

- Define and implement observability strategy, standards, and roadmap
 - Establish telemetry framework (logs, metrics, traces) and instrumentation standards
 - Define Critical User Journeys (CUJs) and map Service Level Indicators (SLIs) / SLOs
 - Enable actionable alerting aligned to user/business impact
 - Implement alert-to-incident automation with correct routing and ownership
 - Drive AIOps capabilities: 
 - Event correlation and alert noise reduction
 - Root-cause-based incident generation
 - Predictive detection and anomaly identification
 - Build and optimize observability dashboards for operations and leadership visibility
 - Enable automation and self-healing playbooks for recurring incidents
 - Lead major incident support and post-incident improvements
 - Ensure continuous improvement through observability lifecycle management

Required Skills

- 18+ years experience in IT Operations / SRE / Observability / Platform Engineering
 - Strong expertise in: Observability (logs, metrics, traces, distributed tracing)SRE practices (SLIs, SLOs, error budgets), Incident management and automation
 - Experience in AIOps / Event Management: Event correlation, alert deduplication, noise reduction
 - Hands-on experience with observability platforms and ITSM integrations
 - Strong understanding of: Distributed systems and cloud environments and Telemetry pipelines and data integration
 - Experience in designing automation workflows, runbooks, and self-healing mechanisms
 - Strong stakeholder management and ability to work across application, infra, and operations teams

Nice to Have

- Experience with Azure observability stack / OpenTelemetry
 - Experience with ServiceNow ITOM / AIOps
 - Exposure to AI-driven observability (anomaly detection, predictive analytics)
 - Experience in building executive dashboards and reporting frameworks

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8: 00am to 5: 00pm or 1: 30pm to 10: 30pm. 

What We Can Offer You

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way. 

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace. 

- Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work. 
 - Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration. 
 - Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron's values and business priorities. 
 - Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance. 
 - Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise. 

How To Apply

To be a part of our success, click APPLY to submit your application. 

Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position. 

Privacy and Terms and Conditions

We respect the privacy of candidates for employment. This Privacy Notice sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position through this career site. If you do not consent to the terms of this Privacy Notice, please do not submit information to us. 

Please access the Global Application Statements, select the country where you are applying for employment. By applying, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to the country specific statement. 

Terms of Use

"ENGINE" refers to the Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center, which operates under Chevron Global Technology and Services Private Limited, an affiliate of Chevron Corporation. References to ENGINE in this document are for convenience only and do not denote a separate legal entity. 

This job advertisement is intended to provide a general overview of the role and workplace environment. Role details and outcomes may vary based on business needs and individual performance.

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. Qualifications

Knowledge & Skills

data.title: Program Manager - GeoAnalytics
data.description:
About Us

WRI India, an independent knowledge organisation registered as India Resources Trust, provides objective information and practical proposals to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development. Through research, analysis, and recommendations, WRI India puts ideas into action to build transformative solutions to protect the earth, promote livelihoods, and enhance human well-being. Know more: wri-india. org

Job Highlight

WRI India is seeking a Manager - GeoAnalytics to strengthen the GeoAnalytics team's capabilities in geospatial analytics, software engineering and digital product development. This role will have a dual focus: leading the development and operationalization of Climate Lens, WRI India's integrated climate intelligence and decision-support platform, while managing and contributing to the development of geospatial software applications and analytical solutions across WRI India's programmes. 

The position will combine product management, technical leadership, software development and project coordination. The successful candidate will work closely with research and programme teams to translate complex environmental, climate and urban challenges into robust, scalable and user-oriented digital solutions. 

The role will be responsible for ensuring that analytical methodologies and research outputs are translated into reusable digital products, supported by sound software architecture, reliable data infrastructure and effective user experiences. The candidate will also contribute to building shared technical capabilities, reusable software components and engineering standards within the GeoAnalytics team. 

What You Will Do

The role will be structured around two complementary areas of responsibility. 

- Climate Lens - Digital Product Development and Management (50%)

Lead the end-to-end development, implementation and continuous improvement of Climate Lens, ensuring that it evolves into a scalable and operational climate intelligence platform supporting evidence-based planning, adaptation and investment decisions. 

Product Strategy and Management

- Lead the product development roadmap for Climate Lens, translating the platform vision, strategic objectives and programme requirements into defined product features, development priorities and implementation plans. 
 - Work closely with GeoAnalytics, Cities and other programme teams to identify user needs, define product requirements and translate climate research methodologies into digital workflows. 
 - Define product specifications, functional requirements, user journeys, workflows, wireframes and feature-level development plans. 
 - Coordinate product development activities across research, design, data science and software engineering teams, ensuring alignment between analytical requirements and technical implementation. 
 - Manage product priorities, timelines, resources, dependencies and delivery milestones. 

Technical Development and Integration

- Lead the development and operationalization of Climate Lens 
 - Oversee the development of shared platform capabilities, including climate data integration, climate hazard and vulnerability assessment, risk prioritization, adaptation planning, scenario modelling and decision-support functionalities. 
 - Drive the digital productization of WRI India's Climate Hazard Vulnerability Assessment (CHVA) methodology into standardized, configurable and reusable analytical workflows. 
 - Coordinate the integration of the Urban NbS FinLink finance-search functionality into Climate Lens, ensuring that users can access project assessment and climate finance discovery capabilities across the three geographic applications. 
 - Work with software developers and technical partners to define system architecture, APIs, databases, data pipelines and integration requirements. 
 - Ensure that the platform is modular, interoperable, scalable and designed for future expansion across cities, states and thematic applications. 

Product Quality, Validation and Adoption

- Establish product development processes, including prototyping, technical validation, user acceptance testing (UAT), release management and continuous improvement. 
 - Coordinate pilot testing and stakeholder consultations with government agencies, urban local bodies and other intended users. 
 - Define product performance indicators and monitor platform adoption, user engagement, analytical utilization and institutional uptake. 
 - Translate user feedback and implementation experience into product enhancements and development priorities. 
 - Develop product documentation, user guides, technical specifications and onboarding materials. 
 - Support institutional partnerships, technical presentations and resource mobilization related to Climate Lens. 
 - GeoAnalytics and Software Development (50%)

Lead and contribute to the development of geospatial software applications, data-driven solutions and reusable technology components across WRI India's programmes and projects. 

Application Development

- Design, develop and maintain full-stack web applications, geospatial platforms, dashboards and digital tools to address programme and research requirements. 
 - Develop backend services, APIs and frontend applications using appropriate modern software development frameworks and technologies. 
 - Develop and maintain geospatial data services and workflows using technologies such as PostGIS, GeoServer, GDAL, GeoPandas and Google Earth Engine. 
 - Build reusable software components, libraries and modules that can be applied across multiple WRI India products and projects. 
 - Contribute to the development of open-source, interoperable and publicly accessible digital products, including platforms aligned with Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) principles. 
 - Integrate geospatial analytics, data visualization and AI/ML capabilities into digital applications where relevant. 

Engineering Standards

- Establish and promote good software engineering practices, including coding standards, version control, documentation, code reviews and testing. 
 - Support the implementation of pipelines, deployment processes, cloud infrastructure and application monitoring. 
 - Evaluate emerging geospatial technologies, open-source frameworks and AI-enabled development approaches for their potential application within WRI India. 
 - Mentor and provide technical guidance to developers, research associates and other members of the GeoAnalytics team. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, reusable code repositories and institutional knowledge resources. 

Project Coordination and Collaboration

- Coordinate with programme teams to understand project requirements, define technical scope and ensure timely delivery of analytical and software development outputs. 
 - Manage technical work plans, development milestones, resource requirements and project dependencies. 
 - Provide technical guidance to project teams and support the integration of geospatial and software solutions into programme activities. 
 - Contribute to research publications, technical reports, proposals, presentations and other institutional knowledge products. 

What You Will Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Geoinformatics, Geography, Geospatial Science, Remote Sensing or a related technical discipline. 
 - 6-8 years of relevant professional experience in software development, geospatial technology, digital product development or a related field. 

Potential Salary and Benefits: INR 18, 00, 000 to 24, 00, 000 Annum

"Salary shall be commensurate with experience, skills, and internal parity. WRI India offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package. "

Location: New Delhi

Duration: 1 Year (Extendable based on performance and project requirements)

Start date: As soon as possible

List Of Documents To Be Attached

- Cover Letter
 - Resume

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview purpose. 

How To Apply

Qualified applicants should apply online at wri-india. org career section. All applications must be submitted online through this career portal in order to be formally considered. Only select applicants will be contacted for interview. There will be a writing test conducted with final candidates. Please do not contact program staff directly for this position. 

Kindly note that WRI India's recruitment process does not involve any payment at any stage. Applicants will never be asked to share bank account or financial information as part of the application. All official communication and offer letters are issued only through authorised WRI India email IDs. 

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) @WRI India

WRI India values and promotes diversity, equity and inclusion across all areas of our work and workforce. Integrating these values into our actions fosters a progressive and collaborative culture and can also enhance our impact. It is our responsibility to create a welcoming working environment for people of diverse cultures, backgrounds and experience to learn together. We are responsible for fostering a safe and inclusive workplace where questions, concerns and information about diversity, equity and inclusion are part of our ongoing dialogue and development. 

Learn more about WRI India's commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI). Click Here

People-centric To The Core

We keep our people at the center of everything we do - from a welcoming work environment to benefits and a culture that encourages staff to stay healthy, happy, engaged, and growing. 

Some Of The Non-monetary Benefits That Our Staff Get

Health benefits: We cover health insurance for you and your loved ones for up to INR 8 lakhs

Term Insurance: Our term insurance policy covers life coverage of 50 lakhs per staff member

Employee Assistance program: Promoting mental well-being and supporting staff in achieving a satisfying work-life balance

Health & Nutrition: Personalized diet recommendation from a certified dietitian based on the physical health condition and lifestyle

Flexible work schedule: Alternative work arrangements for all who are eligible by nature of their job

Learning culture: Workshops and trainings to empower staff, encourage new learning opportunities

Rest and Recharge weeks: We encourage staff to take time off to rest, rejuvenate, upskill, and pursue their interests. 

Our leave policy: Avail personal time off at 36 per year, along with public holidays, maternity, paternity, and adoption leaves. 

Equal employment @WRI India

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Azure AI Infrastructure team is looking for passionate engineers to build the largest deep-learning infrastructure service at Microsoft. In this role you will be tasked with building new components to bring the latest innovations in AI Infrastructure onto the Azure ML platform. You will partner with top engineering talent within Azure AI Infrastructure and across Azure to work on cluster orchestration, job scheduling, storage, networking, containerization and operating system integration. Your work will enable various AI languages and run-times on Azure AI Infrastructure to bring distributed deep learning training and inferencing to life. In addition, you will build infrastructure components required to build, deploy, monitor and service highly available and scalable Microsoft Service Fabric and Kubernetes clusters under your care. You will lead development and customer support from the frontline and establish architecture, service excellence guidelines and a high-quality bar. 

Candidates have a track record for delivering engineering and service excellence on a mid-to-large scale service. 

Who are We?

We are engineers on Azure AI Infrastructure. We believe that building a planet-scale AI Supercomputer from the ground-up which addresses the fundamental pain-points of data scientists and AI practitioners and takes AI to the unprecedented scale is an opportunity of a lifetime. If you share the same dream as us, come join us!

What Is Azure AI Infrastructure?

High scale AI workloads are always testing the limits of the infrastructure stack. Large-scale model training and inference with huge data volumes of training data on hundreds-thousands of GPUs make it a true engineering challenge. Azure AI Infrastructure is a globally distributed, multi-tenant service that provides robust, cost-effective AI infrastructure (compute, networking and storage) for AI training and inferencing. By abstracting workloads from underlying infrastructure, Azure AI Infrastructure creates a shared pool of resources that can be dynamically provisioned for full utilization of expensive GPU compute, and enabling data scientists to productively build, scale, experiment, and iterate their models on top of a robust, performant, scalable and cost-effective distributed infrastructure built for AI. In Azure AI Infrastructure, we are constantly seeking to apply the ideas from AI, ML, distributed systems, distributed databases, machine learning, information retrieval, networking, and security. 

Responsibilities

- Work on the architecture, design, and development of the AI Infrastructure services that support large scale AI training and inferencing 
 - Develop, test, and maintain backend services written in C#, Go, Rust, C++, hosted on Kubernetes 
 - Enhance systems and applications to ensure robustness, efficiency, maintainability, low latency, tight cloud security 
 - Provide operational support and DRI responsibilities for the product 
 - Develop and foster a deep understanding of the machine learning systems and concepts and their usage by our customers 
 - Collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists within the team, internal Microsoft Research teams and external enterprises to build better solutions together 
 - Provide vision, expertise, and technical leadership to other team members 
 - Help to grow talent in these areas

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

A master's or bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field

10+ years of experience with coding in one of C#, C or C++, Rust, go

Experience working with the Linux operation system, Kubernetes Networking, SDN, and Kubernetes cluster orchestration

Experience with improving service operations or engineering fundamentals

Collaboration skills

Experience building and shipping production software or services

Preferred Qualifications

Master's Degree or Ph. D. in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python. 

Experience in development in the Kubernetes ecosystem

Experience working on cloud infrastructure including compute, networking, storage, and identity services

Experience in working on Kubernetes Networking and Software Defined Networking systems

Experience in building large scale cloud services, distributed systems, or operating systems

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Job Description

Job Description - SRE Staff Tech Ops Lead

Job Title

SRE Tech Ops Lead

Role Summary

The SRE Tech Ops Lead is responsible for defining, implementing, and governing the enterprise-wide Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) strategy, architecture, standards, and operating model. This role ensures that reliability, availability, scalability, observability, resiliency, and operational excellence are embedded across the software delivery lifecycle and production ecosystem. 

The SRE Architect will work closely with product, engineering, operations, cloud, infrastructure, and leadership teams to establish reliability standards, modernize operational practices, drive automation, and enable measurable service health improvements across the organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and implement the enterprise-wide SRE strategy, framework, governance model, and operating model. 
 - Establish SRE standards, policies, and best practices, including SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, reliability KPIs, and service health scorecards. 
 - Design and govern the end-to-end observability architecture, including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerting, and event correlation. 
 - Define and enforce Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) such as availability, scalability, performance, resiliency, recoverability, and reliability. 
 - Lead production readiness reviews, resiliency assessments, and reliability architecture reviews for business-critical systems. 
 - Architect and promote automation, self-healing, auto-remediation, and runbook engineering to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency. 
 - Conduct SRE maturity assessments and define roadmaps to improve reliability practices across applications and platforms. 
 - Drive shift-left reliability adoption by embedding SRE best practices into the SDLC, testing, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes. 
 - Partner with engineering and support teams to improve incident management, problem management, root cause analysis, postmortems, and continuous service improvement. 
 - Evaluate, standardize, and govern enterprise monitoring, APM, observability, and AIOps tools and platforms. 
 - Establish standards for alert quality, event correlation, noise reduction, and actionable monitoring. 
 - Collaborate with cloud and platform teams to ensure reliable architecture and operational support in Azure cloud environments. 
 - Drive capacity planning, performance engineering, scalability planning, and reliability trend analysis to proactively mitigate production risks. 
 - Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, and advisory support to stakeholders across product, engineering, operations, and leadership teams. 
 - Mentor teams on SRE principles, operational excellence, and reliability-first engineering practices. 

Required Qualifications / Must Have

- 10+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Production Engineering, IT Operations Engineering, or related roles, with strong architecture experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with observability and APM tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Datadog, New Relic, Azure Monitor, or similar platforms. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in SRE operational processes, including: 
 - Application support 
 - Incident management 
 - Problem management 
 - Change management 
 - Release/deployment management 
 - Documentation and knowledge management 
 - Strong experience defining and managing SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, operational KPIs, and service health metrics. 
 - Hands-on experience performing failure mode analysis, resiliency design, risk analysis, and non-functional requirement analysis to ensure robust and reliable system architecture. 
 - Hands-on experience implementing SRE best practices throughout the SDLC lifecycle, including production readiness, release quality controls, and post-incident improvement practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with automation using DevOps and configuration management tools. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting solutions in Azure Cloud. 
 - Coding/scripting experience in one or more languages such as Python, Java, PowerShell, Go, or Shell scripting. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, APIs, cloud-native architectures, and reliability engineering principles. 
 - Experience with high availability, failover design, disaster recovery, backup/recovery, and business continuity planning. 
 - Strong understanding of performance engineering, scalability, and capacity planning.

Preferred Qualifications / Good To Have

data.title: Infrastructure / Platform Engineer
data.description:
Location: India

Type: Full-time, Remote

About Neuphonic

Neuphonic is building the next generation of voice AI, making natural, real-time speech accessible across devices, languages, and applications. 

Our technology enables ultra-low-latency text-to-speech, voice cloning, and multilingual speech generation. We're pushing the boundaries of what's possible with speech models, from high-performance cloud inference to running AI directly on everyday devices without expensive GPUs or an internet connection. 

We're a small, ambitious team of researchers and engineers building technology used by developers and businesses around the world. Our open-source releases have reached millions of downloads, and we're growing quickly. 

Why we're hiring

As our customer base grows, we need to scale our production infrastructure while maintaining the performance, reliability, and low latency that our products depend on. 

We're looking for an Infrastructure / Platform Engineer to take ownership of our cloud infrastructure and inference systems. You'll work closely with our engineering and ML teams to build scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient systems. 

A key part of this role is extending our production support coverage beyond UK working hours. We're hiring in India to help us work towards 24/7 support for our production customers, so we're looking for someone comfortable taking ownership of live systems, responding to incidents, and making independent technical decisions. 

Importantly, this isn't just about keeping our systems running. We want someone who will actively look for ways to improve how we build, deploy, and serve our models, continually experimenting, optimising, and evolving our infrastructure as we scale. 

What You'll Own

- Cloud infrastructure: Build, manage, and scale our production infrastructure across GCP and GPU cloud providers using Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform. 
 - Inference optimisation: Continuously improve inference performance, latency, throughput, GPU utilisation, and infrastructure costs through profiling, experimentation, and iteration, rather than simply maintaining the status quo. 
 - Platform evolution: Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in how we build, deploy, and serve models, and take ownership of implementing improvements. 
 - Production reliability: Monitor critical systems, respond to incidents, and help ensure reliable service for our customers outside UK working hours. 
 - Infrastructure architecture: Make autonomous technical decisions that balance scalability, reliability, performance, and cost. 
 - CI/CD and automation: Improve deployment pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and observability. 
 - Security and enterprise readiness: Support secure infrastructure practices and enterprise deployment requirements. 

What we're looking for

- Strong experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure at scale, ideally supporting applications with significant user traffic. 
 - Hands-on experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and Python. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, monitoring, observability, and production incident response. 
 - A strong understanding of infrastructure performance, scalability, and cost optimisation. 
 - Experience participating in on-call rotations or taking responsibility for production incidents. 
 - A proactive approach to engineering, with experience identifying bottlenecks, experimenting with improvements, and optimising production systems. 
 - Comfortable working autonomously, making architectural decisions, and taking ownership of critical systems. 
 - Based in India and comfortable providing production support during agreed hours that complement our UK and India engineering teams. 

Nice to have

- Experience with AI/ML inference, GPU infrastructure, or vLLM. 
 - Experience hosting audio, speech, or real-time AI applications. 
 - Experience with C++. 
 - Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other security compliance frameworks. 
 - Experience with private cloud or on-premise enterprise deployments. 

Who you'll work with

You'll work directly with our engineering and ML teams, helping shape the infrastructure behind Neuphonic's production models and services. 

We're a small team, so you'll have real ownership and the freedom to make meaningful technical decisions. We value people who take initiative, solve problems independently, and enjoy building systems that work reliably in the real world. 

You'll collaborate closely with our UK and AU/NZ teams, with clear handovers between time zones to help ensure our production customers are supported around the clock.

SCIKIQ is an AI-native data operating platform that turns scattered enterprise data into a clean, governed, AI-ready foundation. Built on a Connect-Curate-Control-Consume methodology, our Data Hub connects data across systems, applies governance and quality by default, and activates it through capabilities like Natural Language Query (NLQ), AI agents, and reusable data products - deployed inside the customer's own AWS, Azure, or on-prem environment.

We're looking for a Full Stack Developer to own features end to end across our platform - from database and API design through to the interfaces our enterprise users rely on. You'll build and integrate frontend and backend components, extend our microservices architecture, and increasingly work alongside agentic AI workflows that power automated insight generation across the product. What You'll Do

 - Genuine curiosity about AI-native development and how agentic workflows change how software is built. 

Why Join SCIKIQ
