Kake is a remote-first company and a people-first global community of senior engineers. Kake engineers are behind some of the world's most innovative products (Brands you've heard!), from Fortune 500 to fast-growing companies. We believe it's not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. Our community spans 45, 000+ engineers across 55+ countries; join a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive (and love eating kake!). 

We're looking for Senior Backend Engineers specializing in TypeScript, Python, or C#, skilled in building high-performance, scalable systems that support millions of users, and committed to solid architectural judgment and engineering best practices. It's a great fit for people who enjoy owning problems end-to-end and collaborating closely with product and frontend teams to ship reliable, well-crafted software. 

What you'll build and own

- Build and ship production backend services end-to-end in TypeScript, Python, or C#, owning your work from implementation through deployment.

Core Requirements

 - Experience with modern git workflows, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure such as GCP, AWS, or Azure. 
 - Strong system-design instincts: data modelling, component architecture, and event-driven thinking. 
 - Comfortable with relational databases and SQL, plus familiarity with NoSQL such as MongoDB or similar. 
 - A genuine bar for clean, testable, robust code, backed by sound testing and observability habits. 
 - Strong problem-solving and debugging skills across distributed systems. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

data.description:
Company: The Alter Office

Website: Visit Website

Business Type: Startup

Company Type: Product & Service

Business Model: B2B

Funding Stage: Bootstrapped

Industry: Software Development

Salary Range: ₹ 8-14 Lacs PA

Job Description

Our Story

At The Alter Office, we build what comes next. We operate as an internal innovation lab, creating stealth products, new business bets, and high-leverage systems designed to unlock disproportionate value for us and our partner company ITW Consulting. 

Our work is not centered around being a conventional service partner. Instead, we focus on building products and platforms that solve complex, strategic problems and create long-term advantage. Where needed, we have stepped in on critical opportunities beyond the usual scope, especially when speed, product thinking, and execution depth mattered most. 

About The Role

We are building a holistic AdTech platform that delivers premium value to both advertisers and publishers, and the backend is where that entire ecosystem actually runs - the ad marketplace, campaign creation, ad-serving decisioning, analytics collection, attribution, and ROAS measurement. 

Concretely, that means large-scale architecture: the ad-serving systems that make real-time decisioning calls at volume, the scalable data platforms that ingest and process billions of events a day, the analytics platforms that turn that data into attribution and ROAS numbers advertisers and publishers trust, and the autonomous AI agents we're building to automate campaign optimization and decisioning across the platform. 

We are looking for a Backend Engineer who wants to be genuinely involved in building these areas out - not just implementing tickets, but understanding the product and system tradeoffs behind them - and who'll grow into owning larger pieces of the platform over time. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain the backend systems and APIs behind our ad marketplace, campaign management, and analytics/attribution pipelines. 
 - Contribute to the scalable data platforms and ad-serving systems that process and act on data at volume. 
 - Help build and maintain the backend infrastructure behind our autonomous AI agents. 
 - Collaborate with product, other backend engineers, and DevOps to ship end-to-end features. 
 - Model and manage data using SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), including caching where useful. 
 - Implement authentication, authorization, and data security practices under senior engineers' guidance. 
 - Write clean, well-documented, well-tested code. 
 - Deploy, monitor, and scale services on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). 
 - Use Docker (and optionally Kubernetes) for containerization of backend services. 
 - Contribute to and help maintain CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Monitor and debug production issues using observability tooling (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). 
 - Participate actively in code reviews and contribute to team development standards. 
 - Work within event-driven or microservices architectures, using tools like GraphQL, WebSockets, or message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) where they fit the problem. 

Requirements

- 2-4 years of professional backend engineering experience. 
 - Deep experience with a backend language and its ecosystem (e. g. , Node. js/Express, Python, Java, Go); comfortable owning services end-to-end in production. 
 - Strong understanding of RESTful API design and asynchronous programming. 
 - Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including basic data modeling. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Git, and modern CI/CD workflows. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure). 
 - Working knowledge of backend security best practices. 
 - Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills. 
 - Comfortable in a fast-paced, agile environment with evolving priorities. 
 - Exposure to monitoring, logging, or performance profiling in production is a plus. 
 - Experience with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) or GraphQL is a plus. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes is a plus.

data.title: Senior CQV Engineer
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area. 

The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals. 

The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities. 
 - Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards. 
 - Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met. 
 - Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success. 
 - Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management. 
 - Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule. 
 - Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e. g. , ASTM E2500, ISPE)
 - Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies. 
 - Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems. 
 - Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design. 
 - Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements. 
 - Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner. 
 - Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews. 
 - Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site. 
 - Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction. 
 - System Startup activities

Working Conditions

- The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities. 
 - Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements. 
 - Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc. 
 - 10-15 year's experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing. 
 - Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects. 
 - Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project. 

Technical Skills

- Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis. 
 - In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations. 
 - Experience with process validation and computer system validation. 
 - Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc. 
 - Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset. 
 - Strong project management and organizational skills. 
 - Effective communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Working closely with the Project Director and Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing engineering design activities and ensuring compliance with industry best practices and UK regulations. 

At WSP, our Design Managers are adaptable professionals who thrive in a variety of situations. Leadership & Management

Personal Attributes

We are looking for an experienced Senior Linux Systems Automation Engineer to join the Cloud Infrastructure team. The role focuses on Linux OS migrations from CentOS to Rocky Linux, infrastructure automation using Ansible, and production Linux system support.

data.title: Python Data Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Senior Python Engineer - Technical Lead

Department: IT Factory

About Business line/Function: The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management. 

Position Purpose

You will be the senior engineer and the technical anchor of the team with global ownership of the application. You will take an application that has been prototyped and tested against synthetic data, harden it for production use on real entitlement data, and take it through integration, user acceptance testing and release. You will then lead the build of the control's execution engine and the subsequent modules. 

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a management one. You will also be the person who sets the standards the rest of the team works to - code review, test coverage, deployment discipline and documentation - and who onboards the engineers who join after you. 

Because the platform handles identity and entitlement data for the bank's corporate and institutional business, evidence and auditability are not optional extras. Every control outcome must be reproducible and every change traceable. You should be comfortable working to that standard. 

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

- To build a web application with three distinct user populations and a sequential approval workflow, integrated with enterprise single sign-on. You will harden the existing prototype, integrate it with live data, take it through UAT and release it to production. 
 - Build a controls execution engine, that executes control rules against the curated data model on schedule, records the outcome of every run, raises findings, routes them through a review workflow and generates the committee reporting packs. 
 - Build workflow and approval services, deterministic state machines implementing multi-stage approval with segregation of duties, record locking and immutable audit trails. 
 - Asynchronous processing - background job execution for long-running tasks such as report generation and campaign creation. 
 - Continuous integration with automated linting, type checking and test execution, artefact publication and deployment to Linux servers. 

Specific Qualifications

Technical Skills: 

- Strong command of modern Python (3. 11+), including type hints and static type checking. Demonstrable experience building and operating production services, not scripts. 
 - Web service frameworks. Production experience with FastAPI, or equivalent depth in Django or Flask with a clear ability to transfer. Familiarity with data validation libraries and automatically generated API specifications. 
 - SQL and relational data modelling, at depth. Strong in SQL - complex joins, window functions, query plans and performance tuning. Design normalised schemas, reason about keys and cardinality, and write set-based logic rather than looping in application code. PostgreSQL experience preferred. 
 - Data pipelines and ETL. Practical experience building ingestion and transformation pipelines: reading from source systems, landing data, transforming it into a curated model, and implementing reconciliation and data-quality checks. You will not own the pipelines day to day, but you must be able to work on them competently and provide cover. 
 - Workflow and state management. Experience implementing approval workflows, state machines or case management, including validation rules and audit logging. 
 - Automated testing as a matter of routine - unit and integration - with meaningful coverage of business logic. Experience with pytest. 
 - Linux and deployment. Comfortable operating on Linux servers: service management, log management, troubleshooting a live application. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and artefact repositories. 
 - Version control and code review. Disciplined use of Git, branch protection and pull request review. Experience reviewing other engineers' work constructively. 
 - Communication in a distributed team. You will work daily with a stakeholder in London and periodically with infrastructure, identity and data-protection teams. Clear written English and the confidence to raise a problem early are essential. 

Nice To Have

- Identity and access management domain knowledge - entitlements, roles, segregation of duties, access recertification, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint. 
 - Workflow orchestration - Apache Airflow, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys. 
 - Front-end capability - server-rendered templating with Jinja2 and HTMX, or a component framework such as Angular. 
 - Asynchronous task frameworks - Celery with Redis or an equivalent broker. 
 - Regulated-environment experience - delivery within a bank or other regulated institution, including change management, security assessment and penetration testing cycles. 
 - Reporting and analytics - designing data models consumed by Power BI or a comparable tool

Behavioral Skills

- 
 - Self-motivated and passionate about delivering exceptional results, with a strong desire to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution. 
 - Platform Thinking & Ownership: Ability to think holistically about the platform, considering the interactions and dependencies between different components and systems. 
Education Level: Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent. 

Location: Mumbai

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union's leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185, 000 employees, including more than 145, 000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group's commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability. 

About BNP Paribas India Solutions

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union's leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions. 

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

data.title: Software Development Engineer III (Mobile)
data.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. 

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver. 

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before. 

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. 
 - Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
 - Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. 

THE ROLE

Software Development Engineer III - Mobile

We're looking for a Software Development Engineer III - Mobile to join our growing engineering team and help build high-performance mobile experiences for Quince customers. In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize React Native applications that deliver fast, reliable, and seamless experiences at scale. 

You will take ownership of complex mobile engineering problems, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and user experience. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and Backend teams to build scalable solutions while contributing to the evolution of Quince's mobile architecture and engineering practices. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who is deeply passionate about mobile performance, enjoys solving complex React Native challenges, and is willing to go beyond standard implementations to deliver an exceptional customer experience. 

Responsibilities

Mobile Application Development

- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance mobile applications using React Native. 
 - Build scalable, reusable, and maintainable components following modern mobile engineering best practices. 
 - Take ownership of complex technical problems across the React Native application stack. 
 - Evaluate and adopt appropriate libraries, frameworks, and architectural patterns as the mobile platform evolves. 
 - Contribute to internal libraries and platform capabilities where existing solutions do not adequately address engineering requirements. 

Performance & Optimization

- Drive mobile performance improvements across rendering, startup time, memory usage, responsiveness, and application stability. 
 - Identify and eliminate unnecessary re-renders and inefficient render cycles. 
 - Optimize large lists and complex UI interactions to deliver smooth experiences across a wide range of devices. 
 - Analyze application performance and proactively identify bottlenecks before they impact customers. 
 - Establish and promote performance engineering best practices across the mobile team. 

React Native & Native Platform Engineering

- Work deeply with React Native internals and modern React Native architecture. 
 - Build and optimize solutions using technologies such as FlashList, React Native Reanimated, React Native Gesture Handler, and Expo. 
 - Investigate complex framework and platform-level issues across iOS and Android. 
 - Work with TurboModules and native platform capabilities when React Native abstractions are insufficient. 
 - Write and debug native iOS and Android code when required to solve performance or platform-specific problems. 

Quality & Reliability

- Develop and maintain comprehensive test cases to ensure application quality and reliability. 
 - Debug complex production and development issues across the mobile stack. 
 - Establish practices that improve application stability, performance, and release quality. 
 - Participate in code reviews and provide thoughtful feedback on architecture, implementation, performance, and maintainability. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Product, Design, Backend, and other engineering teams to define and implement scalable mobile solutions. 
 - Translate product and customer requirements into robust technical designs and implementation plans. 
 - Collaborate across teams to identify technical dependencies, trade-offs, and opportunities for improving the overall customer experience. 
 - Communicate technical decisions and complex mobile engineering concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and help raise the technical bar across the mobile team. 
 - Promote clean coding practices, performance optimization, testing, and engineering excellence. 
 - Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, and long-term mobile engineering strategy. 
 - Stay current with developments in React Native, mobile platforms, and modern application performance techniques. 

Qualifications

Required: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 5-8 years of professional experience in software, frontend, or mobile engineering. 
 - 2+ years of hands-on experience building production applications with React Native. 
 - Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript with a deep understanding of React Native fundamentals. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, rendering, state management, and performance optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience optimizing React Native applications, including render cycles, unnecessary re-renders, memory usage, and application responsiveness. 
 - Experience troubleshooting complex React Native issues and identifying root causes across the JavaScript and native layers. 
 - Experience with modern React Native libraries such as FlashList, React Native Reanimated, React Native Gesture Handler, and Expo. 
 - Proficiency with debugging and profiling tools such as Flipper, React DevTools, and Chrome DevTools. 
 - Familiarity with iOS and Android platform fundamentals and the ability to investigate platform-specific issues. 
 - Experience with TurboModules and writing native iOS/Android code when required. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and a strong bias toward performance, quality, and customer experience. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across functions. 

Preferred: 

- Experience building and scaling consumer-facing mobile applications with a large customer base. 
 - Deep understanding of React Native performance profiling and optimization. 
 - Experience working with the New React Native Architecture, including JSI, Fabric, and TurboModules. 
 - Experience developing native modules or integrating third-party native SDKs across iOS and Android. 
 - Experience with mobile CI/CD, automated releases, and tools such as Expo Application Services (EAS). 
 - Experience with mobile observability, crash reporting, performance monitoring, and analytics. 
 - Experience in e-commerce, retail, or other high-scale consumer applications. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and driving mobile engineering standards across a team. 

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis. 

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom-never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

data.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
About Us

We're rebuilding vertical software with AI - from the inside. 

Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI - products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns. 

You'll ship AI into production against real workflows, real customers, and a P&L you can see move within a quarter. 

We hire people who want scope, speed, and ownership, and who are tired of working on AI that never reaches a customer. If you want to spend the next five years shipping into software that already runs the economy, talk to us. 

Job Description

This is a remote position. 

Embrace Healthcare Group powers some of the most innovative healthcare technology solutions in North America, with a focus on enhancing clinical efficiency and compliance across emergency care settings. 

EPOWERdoc, a leading SaaS platform within the Embrace Healthcare Group portfolio, specializes in Emergency Department Information Systems (EDIS) tailored for hospitals of all sizes. Designed by clinicians for clinicians, EPOWERdoc streamlines emergency room documentation with intuitive workflows, customizable templates, peer-reviewed clinical content, and real-time coding assistance-helping providers reduce documentation time and focus more on patient care. 

We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to build EPOWERdoc's next-generation quality engineering practice, AI-native from day one. This is a hands-on builder role: you'll choose and architect our test automation stack, write much of the code yourself, and use AI coding agents every day to design, generate, maintain, and triage tests. 

You'll also own how we test AI itself. You'll design the evaluation harnesses and guardrails that show EPOWERdoc's AI-powered capabilities are accurate, safe, and dependable enough for an emergency department. You'll partner closely with developers, product managers, designers, and clinical content experts. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead QA strategy: Own the end-to-end quality strategy for EPOWERdoc, defining test plans, risk-based coverage goals, and quality gates for every release. 
 - Architect the QA tech stack: Evaluate, select, and document the tooling for UI, API, performance, accessibility, and security testing, recording each decision and its trade-offs in architecture decision records. 
 - Build automation and expand coverage: Design and maintain scalable test frameworks for web applications, APIs, and integrations. Set standards clear enough that engineers and AI agents can extend them reliably. Use these frameworks to replace manual regression with automated coverage of critical clinical workflows such as triage, documentation, orders, and discharge. 
 - Performance and reliability: Build load, stress, and soak tests that model real emergency department peak volumes, establish performance baselines, and catch regressions before they reach production. 
 - Own CI/CD quality: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so every pull request and build is validated quickly. Use parallel execution and AI-assisted test impact analysis to keep feedback loops short as the suite grows. 
 - Defect management: Work with engineering teams to identify, document, prioritise, and resolve defects early in the development lifecycle, and drive root-cause analysis. 
 - Exploratory testing: Lead exploratory testing of new features and complex clinical user flows, combining human judgement with AI-driven exploration where automation alone adds less value. 
 - Agile partnership: Bring a quality perspective to sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives, including estimates, acceptance criteria, and release readiness. 
 - Quality advocacy: Champion a quality-first culture from code reviews to release management. Report on quality metrics and trends such as escaped defects, flakiness, and test cycle time. 
 - Security and compliance: Ensure testing practices, test data, and the use of AI tools meet HIPAA and healthcare data security standards, with no real PHI in test environments or AI prompts. 

AI-NATIVE QUALITY ENGINEERING

AI is part of how this team works every day. In this role you will: 

- AI-assisted test design: Use LLMs to turn user stories, acceptance criteria, and clinical specifications into test scenarios, edge cases, and boundary conditions, then review and sharpen them with sound test-design judgement. 
 - Agentic test authoring: Use AI coding agents and Playwright's MCP server and test agents (planner, generator, and healer) to create and maintain automated tests. Hold generated code to the same review and quality bar as production code. 
 - Self-healing and failure triage: Apply AI to locator healing, flaky-test detection, and automated failure analysis: clustering failures, summarising likely root causes, and routing defects to the right owner. 
 - Synthetic test data: Make realistic, PHI-free synthetic patient records and clinical scenarios the default for functional, performance, and AI evaluation testing, using tools such as Synthea or LLM-driven generators. 
 - Testing AI features: Design evaluation frameworks for AI-powered EPOWERdoc capabilities. These include golden datasets, scoring rubrics, LLM-as-judge grading calibrated against human review, and regression gates that run whenever a model, prompt, or knowledge source changes. 
 - AI safety and guardrails: Test AI features for hallucination, clinical and coding accuracy, bias, PHI leakage, prompt injection, and graceful failure. Work with clinical experts to define what "good enough for the ED" means in measurable terms. 
 - Measure and share impact: Track how AI changes test authoring time and maintenance effort, and share what works with other Embrace engineering teams. 

THE STACK YOU'LL SHAPE

This is our starting point, not a mandate. You'll own the final decisions and the reasoning behind them. 

- UI and end-to-end: Playwright with TypeScript, including visual regression and automated accessibility checks (axe-core). 
 - API and integration: Playwright API testing, contract testing (for example Pact), and validation of HL7 and FHIR interfaces. 
 - Performance: Locust or k6 for load, stress, and soak testing. 
 - Security: OWASP ZAP and dependency scanning in CI, plus the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications as the baseline for AI features. 
 - AI tooling: AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor), Playwright MCP and test agents, and LLM evaluation frameworks such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, or Ragas, with tracing through Langfuse or LangSmith. 
 - CI/CD and reporting: Tests running on every pull request, with Allure or a similar dashboard for trends, flakiness, and release readiness. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- First 30 days: You understand EPOWERdoc's clinical workflows, existing test assets, and release process. You've proposed the target QA stack and AI-native approach as written architecture decision records. 
 - By 90 days: Playwright smoke and regression suites cover the most critical clinical workflows and run on every pull request. A performance baseline exists for peak load. AI-assisted test authoring is in daily use with measured results. 
 - By 6 months: Manual regression effort is a small fraction of today's. Flaky tests are tracked and trending down. An evaluation harness gates every release of AI-powered features. 

Requirements

- Experience: 5+ years of professional QA or software testing experience, including at least 3 years building test automation, ideally in a SaaS or web application environment. 
 - QA foundations: Solid understanding of QA methodologies, risk-based testing, test design techniques, and software development life cycles. 
 - Programming: Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript and working proficiency in Python. You write test code with the same care as production code. 
 - Test automation: Hands-on experience with modern automation tools, with Playwright strongly preferred (Cypress or Selenium also considered). This includes building scalable frameworks from the ground up, managing test data, keeping suites stable and fast, and a record of well-reasoned tooling decisions.

Want to change the way people watch Live Sports? Passionate about building, owning and operating massively scalable systems? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties - including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Roland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. We move at the speed of live events, shipping fast, iterating constantly, and building across a rapidly expanding set of technologies. And we're doing it at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded owner for Sports experiences, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling experiences to our customers. 

We are a team of builders - from new graduates to seasoned architects - who value ownership, open debate, and learning through experimentation. We make decisions together, move fast, and hold each other to a high bar. If you're a leader who thrives in that kind of environment, read on.

The Live Events Publishing team is part of Prime Video Sports & Linear org, responsible for the end-to-end systems that bring live sports content to customers. We are the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. We build the automation, tooling, and AI-powered capabilities that enable operators and systems to publish content quickly and accurately for events like NBA, Fox Sports, and other major live programming. Our Bangalore team is a growing engineering hub, and this role is central to scaling our impact. 

About the role: As a Software Development Manager on the LEP team, you will lead a team of engineers building and operating the suite of services that fulfill our vision: the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog - enabling sports fans worldwide to discover, purchase, and consume sports content in any format, on any device. data.title: Principal SOC Modeling Engineer
data.description:
The Software (CE-SW) group is responsible for developing and improving the software ecosystem around Arm's next generation architectures and systems. This means working with processors and other hardware technology not yet available to the public. You will join a team of Software Engineers who share a passion for leaving their mark on the future of computing. 

We are looking for software engineers to join the Arm Fast Models team responsible for building high-performance software models of Arm-based systems. These models enable early software development, architecture exploration, and system validation before silicon is available. Members of the modelling team transform hardware designs and specifications into high-performance software representations of hardware systems and components. 

In this role, you will develop functional models of CPUs, system IP, and complete Arm's reference platforms using C++ and SystemC, working closely with hardware and software teams across Arm. 

If you are similarly passionate about innovative technologies, then we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities Include

- Develop, test, and maintain high-performance functional models of Arm system-level IP using C++ and SystemC. 
 - Build virtual platforms representing complete Arm's reference platforms to enable early firmware, OS, and application development before silicon availability. 
 - Collaborate with hardware architects and RTL designers to understand IP specifications and ensure accurate behavioral modelling. 
 - Work with open-source and software engineering teams to enable software bring-up on virtual platforms and diagnose system-level issues. 
 - Integrate multiple IP models to create scalable system-level simulations. 
 - Participate in planning and execution of development roadmaps, working with project managers and global engineering teams. 

Required Skills and Experience

- Minimum 15-20 years of proven experience. 
 - Strong C/C++ programming skills with experience in developing large-scale software systems. 
 - Experience in SoC or IP modelling using C++, SystemC, or TLM. 
 - Good understanding of computer architecture, microarchitecture, and SoC design concepts. 
 - Experience with software development practices including debugging, testing, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience using version control systems such as Git/Gerrit. 
 - Understanding of RISC-based architectures and familiarity with CPU instruction sets. 
 - Ability to work effectively independently and within distributed global teams. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills, excellent written and spoken English. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Programmer's View (PV) modelling and SystemC TLM-2. 0 methodologies. 
 - Knowledge of Arm architecture or Arm system IP (CPU, interconnects, GIC, SMMU, etc. ). 
 - Experience building SoC virtual platforms or full-system simulators. 
 - Background in low-level software, firmware, bare-metal programming, or device drivers. 
 - Experience in supporting to large-scale multi-site software projects. 

Why Join Us

- Work on modern virtual platforms used across the Arm ecosystem. 
 - Experience with hardware validation labs and test farms. 
 - Collaborate with world-class engineers across global Arm teams. 
 - A clear path for career progression, with scope to evolve into technical leadership or management roles. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

data.description:
If interested, share your CV at farheen. akhtar@talentcorner. in or 9036659658

Job Title - Senior Back-End Developer

Location - Bangalore (Whitefield)

Experience - 3 to 5 years

Allocated Budget: 10 - 12 LPA (Non Negotiable)

For This is a senior back-end role - we expect depth in Python and in relational databases, and the ability to run what you build. 

About the Role: 

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Back-End Developer who writes production-grade server-side code. You will design and build the services and data layer behind our applications using Python, with relational databases underneath - all deployed and operated on AWS. This is a builder's role, not a coordinator's. You should be comfortable writing complex SQL by hand, designing REST APIs that other teams depend on, reasoning about performance and failure, and owning your code through testing, deployment and production support. 

What You'll Do: 

• Design, build, and maintain Python (Flask/FastAPI) services and REST APIs consumed by our front ends and partners. 

• Write and optimise advanced SQL - multi-table joins, subqueries, CTEs, and window functions - without leaning on an ORM to do the thinking for you. 

• Model and evolve relational schemas, design indexes, and tune slow queries using EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE. 

• Plan and run schema migrations safely against live data. 

• Handle authentication, authorisation, and the security of the endpoints you expose. 

• Build background jobs, queues, and scheduled work, and make them safe to retry. 

• Write meaningful unit and integration tests for the code and modules you ship. 

• Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot services on AWS, and improve build and release pipelines. 

• Review peers' code, uphold quality standards, and mentor less experienced developers. What

We're Looking: 

• 5+ years of relevant, hands-on back-end development experience. 

• Python - solid backend experience building REST APIs (Flask or FastAPI), not just scripting. 

• SQL - ability to write advanced queries from scratch and reason about how they execute; PostgreSQL and/or MySQL in production. 

• Schema design, indexing, and query optimisation on real data volumes. 

• AWS - practical experience deploying and running workloads (e. g. ECS/Fargate, Lambda, RDS). 

• API security - authentication and authorisation (JWT, OAuth2) and common OWASP risks. 

• Testing - able to write proper unit and integration tests with pytest. 

• Comfort with Git workflows, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. 

This Role Is Not a Fit If. . . 

• You work only in Java and have no Python experience or familiarity. 

• You rely entirely on ORMs and cannot write raw SQL queries yourself. 

• Your Python is scripting and automation only - you have never built and run a production service. • You have never worked with AWS. (Experience on GCP or Azure is a plus, but AWS experience is required. )

• You have never written tests for your own code. 

• You are looking for a role that is mostly front-end work. 

Nice to Have

• Async Python (asyncio) and an understanding of concurrency trade-offs. 

• Queues and background processing - Celery, SQS, or Kafka. 

• Caching strategies with Redis, and knowing when not to cache. 

• Infrastructure as code (Terraform or AWS CDK). 

• Observability - structured logging, metrics, tracing, and useful alerts. 

• NoSQL stores (MongoDB, DynamoDB) alongside relational databases. 

• Enough front-end familiarity (Angular or React) to debug an integration end to end.

data.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (Python Testing)
data.description:
Software Development Engineer Test Engineer (Python Testing)

Experience: 9-12yrs

Location: Bangalore

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Automation Architecture & Hands-On Engineering

○ Architect, scale, and maintain a modular, zero-flake E2E, API, and integration automation framework built on Python 3. 10+ (pytest) and Microsoft Playwright. 

○ Build resilient Playwright automation for complex stateful browser interactions, including interactive canvas and node-graph workflow editors, real-time token-streaming chat interfaces (SSE and WebSockets), multi-tab and multi-user RBAC sessions, Shadow DOM elements, and network route interception and mocking. 

○ Treat test infrastructure as production software by enforcing strict static typing (mypy), fast linting (ruff), strict schema validation (Pydantic), clean design patterns (Page Object, Screenplay, and Fixture factories), and rigorous pull-request code reviews. 

2. Full-Stack Platform, Data & GenAI Quality

○ Validate REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) interfaces, including optimistic concurrency and locking, idempotency, rate limiting, and asynchronous background workflows. 

○ Build automated validation pipelines across heterogeneous data backends, verifying SQL query generation, semantic metric calculations, enterprise ontology graph traversals, cloud object storage ingestion, and vector similarity search retrieval. 

○ Partner with AI Engineers to operationalize automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, DeepEval, LLM-as-a-Judge, and golden dataset benchmarks) measuring hallucination rates, groundedness, context recall, tool-call accuracy, Time-to-First-Token (TTFT), and token/cost regressions. 

3. CI/CD Release Governance, Performance & Security

○ Orchestrate containerized, parallelized (pytest-xdist and Playwright sharding) smoke, contract, and regression suites inside CI/CD pipelines with sub-15-minute PR feedback loops and automated QA to UAT to Production promotion gates. 

○ Drive performance, concurrency, load, and fault-injection testing (Locust and k6) to validate high-throughput agent executions, concurrent workflow graphs, and graceful degradation during upstream LLM or database throttling. 

○ Validate enterprise security boundaries including OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, SAML/SSO, RBAC/ABAC permissions, multi-tenant data isolation, and OWASP Top 10 risks for both Web and LLM Applications (prompt injection, PII leakage, and excessive agency). 

○

4. Engineering Leadership & Operational Excellence

○ Recruit, mentor, and upskill top-tier SDETs, coaching engineers from script-level testing into modern software engineering and system-level architectural thinking. 

○ Partner closely with Product Management, Platform Engineering, and SRE leaders during design reviews to enforce shift-left testability and observability from day one. 

○ Own platform quality SLAs and executive reporting, driving measurable improvements in Defect Escape Rate (DER), Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Automation Stability (>99% non-flaky pass rate), and Release Lead Time. 

COMPLETE TECHNOLOGY LANDSCAPE

Should bring deep hands-on mastery of our core automation stack and strong working fluency across our broader platform ecosystem: 

○ Core Languages & Tooling: Python 3. 10+ (asyncio, typing, uv, Poetry, ruff, mypy), TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+, Node. js), SQL (ANSI SQL, CTEs, analytical queries), Bash / Zsh. 

○ UI & Browser Automation: Microsoft Playwright (Python and TypeScript bindings, BrowserContexts, storageState authentication reuse, Trace Viewer, HAR replay, Network Interception, Canvas and Visual Regression), Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), Axe-core (WCAG accessibility testing). 

○ Python Testing Ecosystem: pytest, pytest-xdist (parallel sharding), pytest-asyncio, Pydantic v2, httpx, aiohttp, requests, Hypothesis and Faker (property-based and synthetic test data generation). 

○ API, Streaming & Contract Testing: REST (OpenAPI 3. x), GraphQL, gRPC / Protobuf, Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Schemathesis, Pact, WireMock. 

○ AI, LLM & Agent Evaluation: DeepEval, RAGAS, LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines, Golden Dataset curation, RAG retrieval metrics (precision, recall, faithfulness, groundedness), deterministic NLP metrics (F1, Exact Match), prompt and model regression harnesses. 

○ Databases, Vector & Storage Systems: PostgreSQL, Cloud Data Warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake), Vector Databases (pgvector, Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone), Graph and Ontology Stores (Property Graphs, RDF), Redis, Cloud Object Storage (Google Cloud Storage, AWS S3, Azure Blob). 

○ Asynchronous & Event Messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery (testing distributed task queues, retries, dead-letter queues, and eventual consistency). 

○ Performance, Load & Resilience: Locust (Python-native distributed load testing), k6, API and LLM latency profiling (p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/second), fault and latency injection. 

○ CI/CD, Cloud & Containers: Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes (K8s), GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GCP / AWS / Azure. 

○ Test Reporting & Observability: Allure Report, ReportPortal, TestRail / Xray, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Langfuse / Arize Phoenix (LLM tracing and diagnostics). 

○ Security & Identity: OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, SAML / SSO, JWT, Multi-tenant RBAC / ABAC, OWASP ZAP, OWASP Top 10 for Web and LLM Applications. 

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

○ 9+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering in Test (SDET) or Quality Engineering, including 3+ years directly managing, mentoring, and scaling SDET teams on complex SaaS, cloud, data, or AI platforms. 

○ Expert-level proficiency designing production-grade Python (pytest) and Microsoft Playwright automation frameworks from scratch, including custom fixtures, parallel execution runners, dynamic state handling, and anti-flake architecture. 

○ Strong experience testing distributed microservices, stateful workflows, real-time streaming APIs, and relational and non-relational data layers. 

○ Proven track record embedding containerized automation suites into CI/CD pipelines to gate multi-environment enterprise releases without slowing developer velocity. 

○ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Direct experience building automated evaluation and regression pipelines for LLM Agents, RAG architectures, Semantic Layers, or Workflow Orchestration platforms. 

• Hands-on experience automating visual canvas or DAG builders (such as React Flow, HTML5 Canvas, or WebGL interfaces) and MCP-based tool integrations. 

• Prior experience building internal developer productivity tools, synthetic test-data platforms, or ephemeral preview test environments on Kubernetes.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager
data.description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Development Team Manager to lead our Active Integration R&D team in Pune. The Active Integration platform features smart and ready to use gateways for SAP Business Suite, Oracle EBS, Opcenter, Product Cost Management and other Enterprise Applications. 

As the Software Engineering Manager, you will lead a highly multi-functional, agile team comprising both local and external/contractor developers.  - Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the development process, driving permanent corrective actions and operational efficiency.

 - Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent.

 - Demonstrated success managing and orchestrating multi-functional, cross-cultural teams across international time zones (e. g. , Europe and India).

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

data.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with 4+ years of software engineering experience to architect, build, and deploy custom Agentic AI applications integrated with our Salesforce ecosystem. In this role, you will bridge modern generative AI technologies (LLM orchestrations, autonomous agent loops, tool calling, and RAG) with enterprise CRM infrastructure. You will design autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents that execute complex, multi-step business workflows, interact directly with Salesforce data and APIs, and safely escalate to human teams when necessary. 

Key Responsibilities

- Agentic Application Architecture: Design, build, and maintain agentic solutions using tools like LangGraph, ADK, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI etc. 
 - Salesforce Integration & Tool Calling: Implement robust REST/SOAP integrations, Webhooks, Platform Events, and Apex Invocable Methods allowing AI agents to query SOQL, update CRM records, and trigger Salesforce Flows autonomously. 
 - Context Grounding & RAG Pipelines: Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines connecting vector stores (e. g. , Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) to supply real-time context to LLMs while mitigating hallucinations. 
 - Workflow Automation & Agent Governance: Define function calling schemas, tool definitions, dynamic planning loops, and fallbacks. Implement safety guardrails, prompt evaluation suites, rate limiting, and seamless human-in-the-loop (HITL) handoffs. 
 - Observability & Reliability: Set up agent monitoring, evaluation metrics, and tracing to track execution paths, latency, context usage, and token costs. 
 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Salesforce Architects, Product Managers, and security teams to translate complex CRM requirements into reliable AI features adhering to enterprise compliance and data governance standards. 

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

- Software Engineering Foundation: 3+ years of professional backend software engineering experience building scalable microservices, REST APIs, and asynchronous message queues. 
 - Agentic AI & LLM Systems: 2+ years of hands-on experience developing production AI agents, autonomous decision loops, multi-agent coordination, and function-calling/tool-use paradigms. 
 - Salesforce Core Knowledge: Proven experience interacting with Salesforce APIs (REST/Composite/Bulk), SOQL/SOSL queries, Connected Apps, OAuth flows, and Apex (Invocable Actions, Triggers). 
 - Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node. js for AI backend systems. 
 - Vector Databases & Embeddings: Direct experience with semantic search, embeddings generation, and vector engines (e. g. , Pinecone, Qdrant, ChromaDB, PGVector). 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Proficiency in cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless computing, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of B2B Sales processes, Partner Relationship Management (PRM), and the end-to-end Opportunity-to-Quote (Q2C) lifecycle. 

The Team

You will be part of a growing, passionate, and dynamic team with an opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects centered on what we believe is one of the most significant mission statements in the world. We also strive to be the most people-centric company ever!. That means we're constantly working to make your experience amazing, and you are part of the team breaking boundaries of what the workplace can be!. 

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

data.description:
About Sirius AI

Sirius AI is a US-headquartered AI consulting services and products company with operations in India. We work with financial services enterprises to deliver data-driven solutions across multiple geographies. Our teams build AI, data-platform, and cloud-native solutions focused on measurable business outcomes. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer with 4-5 years of experience to help build, automate, secure, and operate reliable cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines. The role will work closely with engineering, AI/ML, data, security, and product teams to support development and production environments across AWS and Azure. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure & Automation

- Provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure. 
 - Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform; exposure to CloudFormation, Bicep, or ARM templates is beneficial. 
 - Support environment setup and configuration across development, staging, and production. 
 - Assist with cloud cost monitoring, resource optimization, backup practices, and operational hygiene. CI/CD & Release Engineering

- Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline. 
 - Automate build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows; support safe release practices across environments. 
 - Work with Git-based version control and artifact repositories such as JFrog Artifactory, Nexus, or Azure Artifacts. Containers & Kubernetes

- Build and maintain container images using Docker and deploy containerized applications. 
 - Support Kubernetes workloads on Amazon EKS and/or Azure AKS, including deployments, services, ingress, configuration, and troubleshooting. 
 - Use Helm for packaging and deployment; exposure to Argo CD or Flux CD and GitOps practices is an advantage. Monitoring, Reliability & Incident Support

- Configure and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and logs using Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or Log Analytics. 
 - Investigate application and infrastructure incidents, perform initial root-cause analysis, and document corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Support service reliability through health checks, capacity monitoring, backup validation, and operational runbooks. DevSecOps & Access Management

- Integrate security and quality checks into delivery pipelines using tools such as SonarQube, Trivy, Checkov, AWS Inspector, or Microsoft Defender for Cloud. 
 - Manage application secrets using AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, or HashiCorp Vault. 
 - Follow least-privilege access, secure configuration, patching, and change-management practices; support compliance requirements where applicable. Scripting & AI/ML Platform Support

- Write scripts and automation using Python, Bash, Shell, or PowerShell to reduce manual operational work. 
 - Support infrastructure and deployment needs for AI/ML workloads, including model-serving environments and GPU workloads when required. 
 - Collaborate with AI/ML and engineering teams to improve deployment repeatability, observability, and operational readiness. 

Required Qualifications

- 4-5 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, or a related role. 
 - Practical experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services; willingness to work across both platforms. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code, preferably Jenkins or GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps and Terraform. 
 - Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes; experience with EKS or AKS is preferred. 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and supporting production or production-like environments. 
 - Comfortable scripting in Python, Bash, Shell, or PowerShell. 
 - Understanding of cloud networking, IAM/RBAC, secrets management, and basic security best practices. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Skills

- Exposure to AI/ML or MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Amazon SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, or OpenSearch. 
 - Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux CD. 
 - Exposure to policy-as-code tools such as OPA or Sentinel. 
 - Experience in fintech, BFSI, or other regulated environments. 
 - Relevant certifications such as AWS, Azure, CKA/CKAD, or Terraform Associate. 

What Success Looks Like

- Reliable, repeatable infrastructure provisioning and application deployments. 
 - Faster and safer releases through automation and clear rollback procedures. 
 - Improved visibility into platform health through useful alerts, dashboards, and logs. 
 - Timely incident support, clear documentation, and actionable follow-up improvements. 
 - Effective collaboration with engineering and AI/ML teams.

data.description:
About the Role

As a Lead Developer, you will own and evolve the core platform services that power our AI-driven products. You will design and build production-grade APIs, LLM-based extraction and enrichment pipelines, and agentic workflows - ensuring they are reliable, performant, and scalable. 

You will work closely with AI engineers, front-end developers, and product stakeholders to translate investment use cases into robust back-end solutions. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who combines deep Python expertise with hands-on experience building LLM-driven applications and who thrives in a fast-paced, product-oriented environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain back-end services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI, serving both internal and external consumers. 
 - Build and optimise LLM-based pipelines for information extraction, summarisation, and classification across diverse source types. 
 - Develop and maintain agentic AI workflows using LangGraph, including tool orchestration, multi-step reasoning chains, and feedback loops. 
 - Extend and operate the MCP server layer (FastMCP), enabling seamless integration of AI capabilities into third-party tools and workflows. 
 - Design and maintain data models and query patterns in MongoDB Atlas, leveraging both its document database and vector store capabilities for RAG pipelines. 
 - Build and manage data processing and scheduling pipelines using Apache Airflow, deployed on AWS EKS. 
 - Collaborate with front-end engineers to define clean, well-documented API contracts and ensure efficient data flows. 
 - Implement robust testing strategies (unit, integration, end-to-end) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines for reliable, automated deployments. 
 - Participate actively in agile ceremonies, code reviews, and architectural discussions, contributing to a culture of engineering excellence. 
 - Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve system reliability and performance across the platform. 

Experience

- Years of Experience: 10-17 years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on Python back-end development. 
 - LLM & AI Development: At least 1 year of hands-on experience building LLM-based applications, including one or more of: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent-based systems (e. g. , LangChain, LangGraph), LLM-driven data extraction, or prompt engineering. 
 - Python Expertise: Deep proficiency in Python, including modern async frameworks (FastAPI or equivalent). Strong understanding of Python packaging, dependency management, and best practices. 
 - Database Skills: Experience with MongoDB or similar document databases. Familiarity with vector stores and embedding-based search is highly desirable. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Practical experience with AWS services, containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS), and orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow. 
 - API Design: Proven ability to design, build, and document RESTful APIs that are clean, versioned, and production-ready. 
 - Software Engineering Practices: Strong grasp of version control (Git), testing frameworks (pytest, etc. ), CI/CD pipelines, and agile development methodologies. 
 - Communication: Ability to articulate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Nice to Have

 - Background in processing unstructured data from diverse sources (PDFs, audio, messaging platforms). 
 - Understanding of capital markets, investment research workflows, or financial data.
