data.title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
data.description:
About QualMinds

At QualMinds, we design and develop world-class digital products and custom software solutions for Startups, Scale-ups, and Enterprises. Our engineering teams specialize in Frontend, Backend, Full Stack Development, QA Automation, UI/UX, DevOps, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Agile Delivery. We are passionate about building customer-centric software with the highest standards of quality, scalability, security, performance, and reliability. 

Location: Hyderabad, India

Experience: 8+ years (3+ years in production LLM/agentic systems, with proven multi-agent architecture experience)

Job Summary

We are building multi-agent AI systems for the automotive dealership ecosystem - networks of specialized, collaborating agents spanning customer-facing conversational experiences (voice and chat agents on dealership websites that handle inventory search, payment estimation, trade-in valuation, offers, test drive and service scheduling, and lead capture) and internal business agents (conversational and autonomous operation of campaign management, lead management, offers, payments, reporting, forecasting, and email/SMS marketing - with proactive insights, recommendations, and human-approved actions). 

These are not single-chatbot solutions: you will architect orchestrated teams of agents - planners, retrievers, domain specialists, action executors, and reviewer/critic agents - that coordinate, hand off, and share context to complete complex business workflows reliably. You will own these systems across the entire agentic development lifecycle: use-case scoping, multi-agent architecture and tool design, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement. 

Technical Skills and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Proven experience designing and shipping multi-agent architectures: supervisor/orchestrator patterns, hierarchical and peer-to-peer agent topologies, planner-executor-critic loops, agent handoffs, task decomposition and delegation, shared state/memory design, and failure isolation between agents. 
 - Hands-on with current agent frameworks and SDKs with strong multi-agent support: LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, Pydantic AI, or Vercel AI SDK - including subagents, handoffs, and graph-based orchestration. 
 - Deep experience with frontier model APIs: OpenAI (GPT-5. x, Realtime API), Anthropic (Claude Opus/Sonnet 4. x), Google (Gemini 3. x, Gemini Live); familiarity with open-weight models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral) for per-agent cost/latency routing (e. g. , small fast models for routing/critic agents, frontier models for planning). 
 - Expert in tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP (Model Context Protocol) - designing and building MCP servers that expose business systems (inventory, CRM, campaigns, payments, reporting) as governed agent tools; working knowledge of A2A (Agent2Agent) for cross-platform agent interoperability. 
 - Realtime voice AI: speech-to-speech pipelines (OpenAI Realtime API, Gemini Live, LiveKit Agents, Pipecat), STT/TTS providers (Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Cartesia), barge-in/interruption handling, sub-second latency optimization, WebRTC and telephony integration - including voice agents that delegate to backend specialist agents mid-conversation. 
 - Production RAG and context engineering: vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Vertex AI Search, Pinecone), hybrid retrieval and reranking, context window management across agent hops, shared and per-agent memory (short-term, long-term, episodic), and freshness strategies for fast-changing data (inventory, offers, pricing). 
 - Agent evaluation and observability: LangSmith, Braintrust, Arize Phoenix, Langfuse, or custom harnesses - golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, multi-agent trajectory evals (correct delegation, handoff quality, loop/runaway detection), eval-gated CI/CD; OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions with distributed tracing across agent boundaries. 
 - Guardrails and AI safety: prompt-injection defense, jailbreak resistance, PII redaction, content moderation, inter-agent trust boundaries, human-in-the-loop approval flows for consequential actions (payments, campaign sends, customer messaging), and compliance-aware messaging (TCPA). 
 - Strong Python and TypeScript; modern backend (FastAPI, Node. js) and frontend (React/Next. js) development, including streaming and realtime UX (SSE, WebSockets, WebRTC) and generative UI patterns. 
 - Cloud-native delivery: GCP (Vertex AI, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, IAM, Secret Manager) or equivalent on AWS/Azure; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform; durable execution for long-running agent workflows (e. g. , Temporal) is a plus. 
 - Modern engineering workflow: GitHub (Actions, PR reviews), Jira/Linear, prompt and agent versioning, feature-flagged and eval-gated releases. 
 - Effective daily use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, coding agents, Claude Code, Cursor) and the judgment to review their output critically. 
 - PostgreSQL and modern data tooling; event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka) for agent-triggered and agent-to-agent workflows. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present AI risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior stakeholders. 

Responsibilities

- Architect multi-agent systems end-to-end: decompose business workflows into specialized agents (routing, retrieval, domain reasoning, action execution, review/critique), choose the right orchestration topology per use case, and define agent contracts, handoff protocols, and shared memory/state. 
 - Design and build customer-facing voice + chat agent teams covering the full public website capability surface: inventory search and comparison, finance/payment estimation, trade-in valuation, offer discovery, appointment scheduling, and lead capture/qualification - with low-latency realtime voice, streaming chat, graceful fallback, and human handoff. 
 - Ground all agent responses in live business data with strict accuracy guarantees - no hallucinated prices, VINs, or offers - and implement brand-safe guardrails for public surfaces (prompt injection, jailbreaks, off-topic containment, PII handling). 
 - Build internal multi-agent workflows that operate backend business platforms conversationally and autonomously: campaigns, lead management, offers, payments, reporting, forecasting, and email/SMS marketing - following the insight → recommendation → approved action pattern with specialist agents collaborating under an orchestrator. 
 - Expose business capabilities as MCP tools with role-based permissions, audit logging, and approval policies scaled to action risk (read vs. draft vs. send vs. pay); enforce least-privilege tool access per agent. 
 - Build natural-language analytics: NL-to-SQL/semantic-layer querying, automated forecasting summaries, and scheduled executive digests. 
 - Own evaluation end-to-end: golden datasets per use case, offline regression suites, multi-agent trajectory and delegation evals, eval gates in CI/CD, A/B testing, and production quality monitoring (containment, conversion, CSAT). 
 - Establish LLMOps/AgentOps practices: prompt and agent versioning, per-agent model routing and semantic caching for cost control, token/latency budgets across agent chains, and observability dashboards with cross-agent distributed tracing. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis for agent failures (bad tool calls, wrong delegation, runaway loops, hallucinations, unsafe outputs) with durable systemic fixes and new guardrails. 
 - Partner with Product Owners, Architects, and platform teams to translate business workflows into agent capabilities and clear delivery plans; mentor engineers on multi-agent patterns, context engineering, and evaluation discipline; report AI system health, risks, and trends to leadership with supporting data.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don't want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking. 

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started. 

Your Impact on Our Mission

A Site Reliability Engineer at Zocdoc plays a foundational role in enabling the entire engineering organization to move quickly, safely, and with confidence. Our mission is to design, automate, and operate the infrastructure and tooling that power every build, deployment, and runtime environment across the company. DevOps engineers ensure that systems are secure by default, observable, cost-efficient, and reliable, while reducing friction for developers and minimizing operational risk. 

We strive to eliminate repetitive manual work through thoughtful automation, build standardization, and continuous improvement. We look ahead - anticipating scaling challenges, security needs, and system weaknesses - so that engineers can focus on delivering value to patients and providers without being burdened by infrastructure complexity. 

Above all, the mission of a Site Reliability Engineer is to build resilient systems and frictionless pathways, ensuring that every line of code written at Zocdoc is of exceptional quality and written with minimal effort. We serve as partners, problem-solvers, and reliability advocates who lift the engineering organization through rigorous execution, curiosity, ownership, and a relentless focus on system health and developer experience. 

You'll enjoy this role if you. . . 

- Like working on practical, hands-on DevOps problems
 - Enjoy supporting engineers by improving reliability and automation
 - Thrive in environments where consistency and quality matter
 - Are curious, proactive, and energized by solving operational issues
 - Want to sharpen your skills across cloud, CI/CD, and container systems

Your day-to-day is. . . 

- Executing patching workflows
 - Maintaining CI/CD infrastructure
 - Handling day-to-day support tickets & operational requests
 - Participating in the DevOps on-call rotation
 - Managing and improving our Artifactory instance
 - Running scheduled and automated security scans on container registries
 - Creating and updating base container images used organisation-wide
 - Writing scripts and small automations to reduce manual effort
 - Monitoring system health and responding to alerts
 - Documenting runbooks, standard procedures, and operational workflows

You'll be successful in this role if you have. . . 

- 6+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering
 - Experience with Linux systems, patching cycles, and container internals
 - Familiarity with AWS foundational services and cloud operations
 - Experience with CI/CD tools (TeamCity, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc. )
 - Hands-on knowledge of Docker and image registry management
 - Basic experience with CDK, Terraform or similar IaC tooling
 - Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort operating in on-call environments
 - A bias toward automation, quality, and consistency in execution

Benefits

- An incredible team of smart and supportive people
 - A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
 - Amazing perks - think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc. 
 - Daycare reimbursement
 - The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
 - Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
 - Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
 - Competitive parental leave
 - Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
 - Annual sponsored health check-ups
 - Sponsored counselling and therapy via Betterlyf
 - Competitive PTO
 - Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2022-2026

About Us

Zocdoc is the country's leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc's Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world's leading investors, and we believe we're still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish. 

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. data.title: SRE II
data.description:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) at Equifax is a discipline that combines software and systems engineering for building and running large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that internal and external services meet or exceed reliability and performance expectations while adhering to Equifax engineering principles. 

SRE is also an engineering approach to building and running production systems - we engineer solutions to operational problems. Our SREs are responsible for overall system operation and we use a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad set of problems. Practices such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems, proactive identification, and prevention of potential outages. 

Our SRE culture of diversity, intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Equifax brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big, and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to build an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn, grow and take pride in our work. 

What You'll Do

- Work in a DevSecOps environment responsible for the building and running of large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. 
 - Work closely with development and operations teams to build highly available, cost effective systems with extremely high uptime metrics. 
 - Work with cloud operations team to resolve trouble tickets, develop and run scripts, and troubleshoot 
 - Create new tools and scripts designed for auto-remediation of incidents and establishing end-to-end monitoring and alerting on all critical aspects 
 - Build infrastructure as code (IAC) patterns that meets security and engineering standards using one or more technologies (Terraform, scripting with cloud CLI, and programming with cloud SDK). 
 - Participate in a team of first responders in a 24/7, follow the sun operating model for incident and problem management. 

What Experience You Need

- BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e. g. , physics or mathematics), or equivalent job experience required 
 - 2-5 years of experience in software engineering, systems administration, database administration, and networking. 
 - 1+ years of experience developing and/or administering software in public cloud 
 - Experience in monitoring infrastructure and application uptime and availability to ensure functional and performance objectives. 
 - Experience in languages such as Python, Bash, Java, Go JavaScript and/or node. js 
 - Demonstrable cross-functional knowledge with systems, storage, networking, security and databases 
 - System administration skills, including automation and orchestration of Linux/Windows using Terraform, Chef, Ansible and/or containers (Docker, Kubernetes, etc. ) 
 - Proficiency with continuous integration and continuous delivery tooling and practices 
 - Cloud Certification Strongly Preferred

What Could Set You Apart

An ability to demonstrate successful performance of our Success Profile skills, including: 

- DevSecOps - Uses knowledge of DevSecOps operational practices and applies engineering skills to improve resilience of products/services. Designs, codes, verifies, tests, documents, modifies programs/scripts and integrated software services. Applies agreed SRE standards and tools to achieve a well-engineered result. 
 - Operational Excellence - Prioritizes and organizes one's own work. Monitors and measures systems against key metrics to ensure availability of systems. Identifies new ways of working to make processes run smoother and faster. 
 - Systems Thinking - Uses knowledge of best practices and how systems integrate with others to improve their own work. Understand technology trends and use knowledge to identify factors that achieve the defined expectations of systems availability. 
 - Technical Communication/Presentation - Explains technical information and the impacts to stakeholders and articulates the case for action. Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Troubleshooting - Applies a methodical approach to routine issue definition and resolution. Monitors actions to investigate and resolve problems in systems, processes and services. Determines problem fixes/remedies. Assists with the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures. Analyzes patterns and trends.

data.title: Senior UX Engineer
data.description:
Introduction To Demandbase

Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks - all in one platform. 

As a company, we're as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom. 

About The Role

Demandbase is building toward an AI-first future, where intelligent, agentic experiences help customers understand what matters, make decisions, and take action faster. We are looking for a Senior UX Engineer to help make that future real. 

This is a UX role with deep engineering capability, not a traditional frontend engineering role. You will start with the customer problem and use design, code, and AI to turn ideas into exceptional production experiences. 

You will sit at the intersection of Design, Product, AI, and Engineering, helping us move from concept to high-quality implementation faster. Beyond building experiences yourself, you will create the workflows, patterns, tools, and guardrails that help our Design organization get better experiences into the product with greater speed and fidelity. 

You will also help establish UX Engineering as a new function at Demandbase, bringing UX culture and the voice of the customer closer to our India Product and Engineering teams while partnering deeply with our US-based Design organization. 

What You'll Do

- Build polished, production-ready Demandbase AI experiences from concept through launch. 
 - Start with customer needs and translate design intent into thoughtful, high-quality working experiences. 
 - Partner closely with Design, Product, AI, and Engineering to explore and ship new agentic interaction patterns. 
 - Create workflows that help designers move from ideas and prototypes into production more effectively. 
 - Close gaps between design intent and implementation through hands-on development and structured pre- and post-launch reviews. 
 - Identify experience-quality issues earlier and help teams prioritize improvements faster. 
 - Use AI-assisted development extensively to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, and iteration. 
 - Create reusable components, patterns, tools, and guardrails that improve quality across teams. 
 - Bring strong UX craft and customer advocacy into the India Product and Engineering organization. 
 - Teach and mentor designers and engineers, helping establish durable AI-enabled ways of working. 
 - Help define what great UX Engineering looks like at Demandbase. 

What We're Looking For

- 8+ years of exceptional UX and product judgment, with a strong understanding of customer workflows and needs. 
 - Strong frontend engineering skills and experience shipping complex web applications to production. 
 - Ability to move fluidly between design thinking, interaction design, prototyping, and production code. 
 - Deep experience with modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript. 
 - Highly proficient with AI-assisted development tools and comfortable using AI throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - A builder mindset: curious, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated to make ideas real. 
 - Experience creating reusable systems and patterns, not only one-off implementations. 
 - Strong attention to usability, accessibility, performance, interaction details, and product quality. 
 - Strong communication and influence across Design, Product, and Engineering. 
 - Experience working effectively across distributed and global teams. 
 - A desire to help other designers and engineers become more effective builders. 

What Will Make You Stand Out

- You have built AI-native, conversational, or agentic product experiences. 
 - You can show work where understanding the customer changed what you ultimately built. 
 - You have personally taken an experience from concept or Figma into production code. 
 - You have helped establish a UX Engineering, Design Engineering, or Design Systems practice. 
 - You actively experiment with AI development workflows and can explain where AI helps, where it fails, and how you validate its output. 
 - You have created tools or workflows that made an entire design or engineering team more effective. 
 - You care as much about the shipped customer experience as the original design. 

What Success Looks Like

You will help Demandbase: 

- Ship AI experiences faster with a higher quality bar. 
 - Catch gaps between design intent and implementation earlier. 
 - Build reusable interaction patterns for emerging AI experiences. 
 - Give designers better ways to get their work into production. 
 - Strengthen the partnership between Design, Product, and Engineering across the US and India. 
 - Bring a stronger voice of the customer into the India organization. 

Most importantly, you will help ensure that as Demandbase becomes more AI-first, the experience becomes more useful, understandable, trustworthy, and human. 

Benefits

Our benefits include Group Medical, Personal Accident, and Term Life Insurance for comprehensive protection. Preventive healthcare covers dental, vision, and OPD needs, complemented by strong mental health support. We also provide a fitness benefit, car lease policy, and gratuity for long-term financial well-being. 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase

At Demandbase, we believe in creating a workplace culture that values and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We recognize that everyone brings unique experiences, perspectives, and identities to the table, and we are committed to building a community where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. Discrimination of any kind is not tolerated, and we strive to ensure that every individual has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow, regardless of their gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, background, marital status, genetic information, education level, veteran status, national origin, or any other protected status. We do not automatically disqualify applicants with criminal records and will consider each applicant on a case-by-case basis. 

We recognize that not all candidates will have every skill or qualification listed in this job description. If you feel you have the level of experience to be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply!

We acknowledge that true diversity and inclusion requires ongoing effort, and we are committed to doing the work required to make our workplace a safe and equitable space for all. Join us in building a community where we can learn from each other, celebrate our differences, and work together. 

Unsolicited Submissions

At Demandbase, we value thoughtful partnerships and direct connections with candidates. We're not accepting unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-party recruiting agencies. Any unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed, and no fees will be paid.

• Ship AI/ML-powered features, including LLM and agentic capabilities. 

• Use LLMs and agentic tooling across the SDLC, from design and code generation to testing and debugging.

• Debug production issues, own reliability, and set the engineering standards the rest of the team will grow into.

 - Mandatory (Experience 3) - Must have owned backend architecture end to end, including greenfield builds. Should be able to make early architecture calls and reason clearly about service boundaries, data flow, caching, queueing, failure modes, scalability, and reliability trade-offs under real constraints.

Job Summary

- App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time. 
 - Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability. 

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Application Development

- Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant. 
 - Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs. 
 - Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments. 
 - Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools - such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies - where relevant to the application domain and platform context. 

Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards

- Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt. 
 - Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards. 
 - Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects. 
 - Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design. 

Secure Development & Technology Risk

- Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks. 
 - Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant. 
 - Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities. 
 - Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements. 

API, Integration & Data Engineering

- Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels. 
 - Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability. 
 - Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs. 
 - Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management. 

DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness

- Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes. 
 - Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements. 
 - Use DevOps practices, containerisation or orchestration technologies - such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent platforms - where relevant to improve delivery consistency and application portability. 
 - Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed. 

Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability

- Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments. 
 - Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics. 
 - Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions. 

Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

- Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists. 
 - Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency. 
 - Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt. 
 - Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes. 

Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

- Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs. 
 - Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making. 
 - Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities. 
 - Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity. 

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

- Software Engineering
 - Programming Principles

 - Database Development
 - Distributed Systems
 - DevOps
 - Software Testing
 - Secure Coding
 - Web Application Security
 - Mobile Security

Other Skills

Qualifications

Job Title: Engineering Manager

Role Overview

We are seeking an Engineering Managerto lead the development of security-focused training and evaluation tasks for frontier AI coding models. This role owns delivery, quality, and capacity across multiple pods and is accountable to Google for throughput, task difficulty, quality standards, and on-time batch completion. 

The Engineering Manager acts as the final quality gate, ensuring that vulnerability-based tasks are technically accurate, reproducible, robust against gaming, and aligned with the project's evaluation goals. Run interviews and make hiring decisions against the approved JD. 

Identify and promote high-performing Trainers to Pod Lead roles. 

Forecast headcount needs using throughput and workload data. 

Start hiring waves approximately three weeks ahead of projected capacity requirements. 

Use dashboards and operational metrics to drive delivery and staffing decisions.

Senior software security engineer with overall 10 years of experience

Experience in leading teams against measurable delivery, quality, and schedule targets. 

Strong understanding of CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10 across multiple programming languages and software ecosystems. 

Demonstrated experience reproducing vulnerabilities, reviewing security patches, and evaluating proof-of-vulnerability tests. 

Experience designing or reviewing automated tests, verifiers, CI workflows, or reproducible technical evaluation environments. 

Strong proficiency in at least one major programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift. 

Experience with Git, Linux, Bash, Docker, and common software security tooling. 

Comfortable using dashboards, throughput metrics, quality data, and operational reports to make delivery and staffing decisions. 

Experience managing or mentoring technical teams, including assigning work, reviewing output, giving feedback, and developing team leads. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical risks and project status clearly to clients and internal stakeholders. 

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple pods, priorities, and delivery phases simultaneously.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day. 

Senior Advanced Embedded Engineer

Avionics Embedded Software Verification & Validation

Experience

10+ years CORE DOMAIN

Avionics V&V ASSURANCE

DO-178B/C

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Advanced Embedded Engineer to provide technical leadership in the verification and validation of safety-critical avionics embedded software. The successful candidate will shape verification strategies, strengthen common test architectures and environments, advance automation, and support design assurance and certification activities aligned with DO-178B/C. This role combines deep hands-on engineering expertise with stakeholder leadership and a continuous-improvement mindset. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end software verification and validation activities for avionics embedded software, from planning and test strategy through execution, evidence review, closure, and certification support. 
 - Define and drive reusable test architectures, environments, methods, tools, and processes that improve consistency, quality, scalability, and engineering efficiency across programs. 
 - Interpret and apply DO-178B/C objectives and applicable supplements across planning, verification, traceability, structural coverage, reviews, and certification deliverables. 
 - Provide technical direction for embedded software testing using C, C++, Python, embedded programming techniques, and model-based testing approaches. 
 - Guide the effective use of debuggers, simulators, target hardware, and structural coverage tools such as VectorCAST/VectorCAST Cover, LDRA, TCA, CodeTest, and TRACE32, as applicable to the program environment. 
 - Lead technical reviews, resolve complex verification issues, influence engineering decisions, and identify practical solutions that balance compliance, quality, schedule, and product needs. 
 - Partner with stakeholders within and outside the organization, communicating technical risk, evidence, recommendations, and improvement opportunities with clarity and credibility. 
 - Drive test methodology innovation and test-design automation, including responsible exploration of AI/ML-enabled opportunities where they provide measurable engineering value. 
 - Ideate and lead Velocity Product Development (VPD) initiatives to improve productivity and reuse. 
 - Contribute to change impact analysis, tool qualification, Test Readiness Reviews (TRR), Release for Software (RFS) activities, certification documentation, and SOI #3 audit readiness, as required. 
 - Mentor engineers, promote disciplined engineering practices, and foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, learning, and continuous growth. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - 10+ years of experience in software development, systems engineering, software verification, or a related area, including at least 5 years of hands-on software verification and validation experience. 
 - Strong knowledge of avionics concepts, engineering processes, and the verification and validation of embedded software. 
 - Deep understanding of DO-178B/C design assurance, including planning and certification processes, with working knowledge of applicable supplements. 
 - Very good programming and scripting skills in C, C++, and Python, with practical experience in embedded programming and model-based testing. 
 - Demonstrated experience establishing or improving common test architectures, environments, strategies, tools, and processes. 
 - Hands-on experience with debuggers, simulators, and structural coverage analysis tools used in embedded or avionics software programs. 
 - Proven technical leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, including the ability to guide decisions without relying solely on authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of cockpit display products and the broader avionics product lifecycle. 
 - Knowledge of DO-178B/C and model based design for cockpit display products. 
 - Experience with change impact analysis, including RA and DRAT; tool qualification; TRR; RFS; certification documentation; and SOI #3 audits. 
 - Experience applying automation to verification workflows, test design, evidence generation, analysis, or reporting. 
 - Awareness of emerging AI/ML technologies and the judgment to identify appropriate, governed applications within engineering workflows. 
 - A track record of identifying technical improvements and converting ideas into sustainable engineering practices. 

Leadership Attributes

- Highly motivated, curious, and proactive, with a passion for exploring opportunities and translating them into robust solutions. 
 - A systems thinker who can connect product, software, verification, certification, and business considerations. 
 - Clear and concise communicator who can engage engineers, program leaders, customers, and certification stakeholders. 
 - Committed to technical rigor, collaboration, mentorship, and continuous improvement.

This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere's AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post-silicon environments. 

The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional-safety and high-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL-D, where applicable

- Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare-metal framework. 
 - Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments.

 - Support ISO 26262-aligned requirements-based testing, safety-mechanism validation, fault handling, diagnostic testing, and review/audit readiness up to ASIL-D.

 - Understanding of traceability, configuration/change management, anomaly management, verification evidence, and safety-quality processes.

 - Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication, and systematic debugging skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with bare-metal test frameworks, CPU/Mesh/SoC validation, boot firmware, or post-silicon bring-up. 
 - Experience with safety mechanisms, fault injection, diagnostic coverage, safety evidence, assessments, or audits. 
 - Experience with requirements/test-management tools such as Jira, Polarion, Codebeamer, or TestRail.

data.title: Principal Silicon Validation Engineer
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere's AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post-silicon environments. 

The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional-safety and high-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL-D, where applicable

What You'll Achieve

- Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare-metal framework. 
 - Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments. 
 - Validate framework execution, build/load/boot flows, CPU and memory features, interrupts, timers, coherency, power/reset, error handling, recovery, and multicore configurations. 
 - Own regression execution, monitoring, metrics, CI/CD pipelines, test artifacts, and reporting. 
 - Perform first-level triage; reproduce and classify failures across test, framework, firmware, hardware, configuration, and lab infrastructure. 
 - Develop automation for test execution, log collection, result analysis, failure classification, and reporting. 
 - Maintain reproducible test configurations, tool versions, artifacts, requirements traceability, and objective verification evidence. 
 - Support ISO 26262-aligned requirements-based testing, safety-mechanism validation, fault handling, diagnostic testing, and review/audit readiness up to ASIL-D. 
 - Improve logging, diagnostics, assertions, timeouts, health checks, and failure signatures; identify and resolve flaky tests. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams on testability, debug, framework improvements, defect resolution, and platform bring-up

About You

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
 - 8+ years of experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or functional safety
 - Strong experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or hardware/software integration. 
 - Strong Python, C, or C++ programming, scripting, and AI Coding skills. 
 - Experience building automated test infrastructure, regression suites, and CI/CD workflows. 
 - Experience with test planning, requirements-based testing, defect tracking, result analysis, and reporting. 
 - Experience with ISO 26262 or similar safety-critical standards; ASIL-D validation experience is strongly preferred. 
 - Understanding of traceability, configuration/change management, anomaly management, verification evidence, and safety-quality processes. 
 - Experience with Linux, Git, build systems, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions. 
 - Familiarity with bare-metal software, firmware, boot flows, ARMv8/AArch64 or Cortex-M/R Series Controllers, and CPU/SoC concepts including caches, MMU, interrupts, timers, coherency, exceptions, reset, and power. 
 - Experience analyzing logs, firmware traces, register dumps, crashes, and test results. 
 - Familiarity with DSTREAM, Trace32, OpenOCD, GDB, JTAG, simulation, emulation, FPGA, post-silicon bring-up, or lab automation is a plus. 
 - Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication, and systematic debugging skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with bare-metal test frameworks, CPU/Mesh/SoC validation, boot firmware, or post-silicon bring-up. 
 - Experience with safety mechanisms, fault injection, diagnostic coverage, safety evidence, assessments, or audits. 
 - Experience with requirements/test-management tools such as Jira, Polarion, Codebeamer, or TestRail. 
 - Experience owning hardware or firmware regression infrastructure and resolving flaky or intermittent failures. 

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are passionate about inventing industry leading cloud-native designs that contribute to a more sustainable future. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.

data.title: Lead/Senior SQA Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

Our Mission: 

We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high-value content. 

About Us

Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high-value content - technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives. 

Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services. 

Position Summary

Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Quality Ownership & Technical Leadership

- Own end-to-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment. 
 - Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas. 
 - Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements. 
 - Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality. 
 - Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements. 

Test Strategy & Coverage

- Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly. 
 - Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content. 
 - Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e. g. , S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance. 
 - Perform accessibility testing (WCAG & EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing. 
 - Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases. 

Automation & CI/CD Excellence

- Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium. 
 - Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows. 
 - Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation. 
 - Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing. 
 - Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers. 
 - Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks. 
 - Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage. 

Functional & Workflow Testing

- Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions. 
 - Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows. 
 - Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes. 
 - Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services. 
 - Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle. 

XML and Publishing Validation

- Perform validation of XML-based content processing pipelines. 
 - Verify XML structures (e. g. , DITA maps, topics, etc. ), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms. 
 - Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows. 
 - Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules. 
 - Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats. 
 - Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines. 

Data Layer Testing

- Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures. 
 - Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes. 
 - Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases . 
 - Develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules. 
 - Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories. 
 - Ensure data consistency across systems and environments. 

API and Integration Testing

- Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services. 
 - Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications. 
 - Test webhook-based integrations and event-driven workflows. 
 - Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system-to-system communication. 
 - Perform end-to-end validation across integrated platforms. 
 - Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points. 

Performance and Reliability Testing

- Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads. 
 - Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories. 
 - Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance. 

Collaboration & Execution

- Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams. 
 - Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines. 
 - Contribute to cross-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance. 

Experience And Skills

Mandatory Requirements & Qualifications: 

- Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills. 
 - Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes. 
 - Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management. 
 - Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML-based publishing pipelines. 
 - Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content. 
 - Hands-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts. 
 - Experience testing modern APIs. 
 - Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven, and webhook-based workflows. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems. 
 - Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira. 
 - Minimum of 10 years' experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. . 
 - Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership. 
 - Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision. 
 - Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level. 
 - Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience. 
 - Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Education: MCA / Bachelor's in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent). 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

- Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation. 
 - Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL). 
 - Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG & EAA compliance). 
 - Proficiency with Git and version control systems. 
 - Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms. 
 - Exposure to cloud-based testing environments (AWS/Azure). 
 - Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution. 
 - Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).

data.title: Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering
data.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U. S. More than 2, 000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov's mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov. com. 

OpenGov is seeking a Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering to lead our enterprise systems engineering function in Pune - a player-coach role that combines hands-on ownership of complex integrations with people leadership. You'll remain deeply technical, designing and owning integrations across our enterprise application stack (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce via API) alongside your team, while managing, coaching, and growing the systems engineers who build them. You'll partner closely with Enterprise Technology leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in shaping technology decisions. 

Based in Pune, working closely with US and India-based teams across time zones. 

Position Responsibilities

- Remain hands-on in the design, build, and ownership of complex integrations across enterprise applications (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday) and Salesforce using REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs
 - Manage, coach, and develop a team of enterprise systems engineers, owning performance management, career growth, and hiring
 - Lead project planning and execution across enterprise systems integration initiatives, ensuring on-time delivery and clear stakeholder communication
 - Partner with stakeholders across R&D, GTM, Finance, HR, Security, and IT to prioritize the roadmap and align it to business needs
 - Serve as a key voice - alongside Enterprise technology leadership - in shaping technology decisions, integration patterns, and engineering best practices. 
 - Establish and improve team processes, documentation standards, and operational rigor to support long-term platform stability
 - Serve as a technical escalation point for complex integrations and systems issues
 - Facilitate agile ceremonies for the team, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, to keep delivery predictable and visible

Required

Position Qualifications

- 8+ years in enterprise systems engineering, IT systems engineering, or business systems administration, with hands-on multi-platform integration experience
 - Experience managing or leading technical teams, including performance management and career development
 - Demonstrated experience building integrations using REST, GraphQL, and/or SOAP APIs across different systems, with strong understanding or functional knowledge of scripting languages such as Python
 - Hands-on experience with one or more of: Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce
 - Strong project management skills, with experience planning and delivering cross-functional technical initiatives
 - Strong understanding of IAM concepts and access governance across SaaS platforms
 - Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills
 - BA/BS in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred

- Experience with iPaaS/automation platforms (Workato or similar)
 - Experience managing a distributed team across US and India time zones
 - Experience facilitating Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives
 - Working understanding of serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda or equivalent

Why OpenGov?

A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it's the core of our democracy. 

Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything-from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We've touched 2, 000 communities so far, and we're just getting started. 

A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn't your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune. 

A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within. 

Benefits That Work For You

data.title: Software Engineering Technical Leader | Enterprise AI Platforms, Infrastructure & Automation
data.description:
Meet the Team

In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms & Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale world-class agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform. 

Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement-empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineering Technical Leader in Cisco EAIPI, you will serve as a multi-layered technical authority and system architect. You will design complete and complex frameworks, systems, and platforms that define specifications, interfaces, input/output pipelines, and working parameters for hardware and software compatibility. You will conceive innovative system interfaces and business application prototypes, analyze and eliminate architectural weaknesses, and directly influence the shaping of future products by establishing foundational architecture across multiple systems. 

Rooted in Cisco 'Design Thinking Principles', you will place simplification and User Experience (UX) at the core, championing secure coding practices, user privacy, and software engineering excellence. Partnering across product management, UX design, and multi-functional engineering teams, you will author architectural specifications and technical documentation, resolve critical production bottlenecks, drive product innovation, and continuously optimize software delivery pipelines. 

Responsibilities

Architectural Vision & Complex Problem Solving: Apply specialized technical mastery to solve intricate architectural problems, interpret internal and external business issues, and define industry-leading standard methodologies. 

Cross-Team Leadership & Project Governance: Lead multi-team engineering initiatives from inception through completion, leading workload, technical dependencies, and workstreams holistically. 

Technical Roadmap & Strategy: Shape, influence, and drive the multi-year software engineering roadmap, aligning technical architecture with core business and customer outcomes. 

High-Impact Feature & Framework Delivery: Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of major architectural frameworks, critical platform subsystems, and high-impact features. 

Gold-Standard Code Craftsmanship: Author clean, robust, and highly optimized code and automated test suites that set the gold standard for engineering excellence across the organization. 

Scalability, Security & Reliability by Design: Champion architectural principles centered on steadfast security, substantial scalability, token throughput, and high-availability runtime reliability. 

Threat Modeling & Security Architecture: Drive product threat modeling, identify vulnerability attack surfaces, and enforce zero-trust privacy and compliance standards across platform components. 

Observability & Proactive Risk Resolution: Proactively identify, prioritize, and eliminate systemic risks; design robust observability tooling to monitor telemetry, act on real-time alerts, and optimize runtime performance. 

Production Operations & SRE Governance: Serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for critical production outages, lead blameless postmortems, review RCAs, and govern robust on-call rotations. 

Multi-Component Domain Authority: Serve as a recognized authority on multiple functional components, subsystems, and developer APIs across the broader AI ecosystem. 

Product Sense, Market Awareness & Metrics: Articulate complex design trade-offs, integrate market and competitive dynamics into technical choices, and track product adoption and performance metrics. 

Scoping & Stakeholder Negotiation: Provide accurate project scoping, establish reliable landmark estimations, and negotiate technical trade-offs with multi-functional stakeholders. 

SDLC & Agile Excellence: Advance agile engineering practices, elevate SDLC standards, and establish modern engineering workflows across teams and partner organizations. 

Mentorship & Engineering Culture: Mentor and sponsor senior engineers, tech leads, and peers; develop continuous knowledge sharing through architecture brownbag sessions, technical blogs, and external publications. 

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field + 8 years of related experience; OR Master's degree + 6 years of related experience; OR Ph. D. + 3 years of related experience. 

In-depth conceptual and practical expertise in software engineering, distributed systems, and platform architecture, with a confirmed history of mastering and applying a wide spectrum of modern technologies. 

Mastery of hands-on software development in core languages (e. g. , Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, C++, or Rust) with demonstrated success in designing and shipping enterprise-scale, critically important systems. 

Consistent track record of serving as a technical lead or systems architect for multi-functional engineering teams, authoring technical design RFCs, and establishing engineering standard methodologies across the SDLC. 

Extensive experience in system profiling, distributed debugging, automated testing strategy, and leading high-severity production root cause analysis (RCA). 

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced expertise in Generative AI architectures, Agentic AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, and multi-agent coordination frameworks. 

Deep experience architecting high-throughput, low-latency microservices, event streaming platforms (Kafka), asynchronous state machines, and distributed caching (Redis). 

Proven knowledge of GPU computing infrastructure, CUDA optimization, Triton Inference Server, high-density server architectures, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker). 

Expertise in enterprise identity, security, and access protocols including OAuth 2. 0 / RFC 8693 Token Exchange, Zero Trust architecture, and automated threat modeling. 

Demonstrated experience designing enterprise observability frameworks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk) with automated canary and self-healing deployment pipelines. 

Active technical contributions to open-source software, published whitepapers, patents in AI/systems engineering, or prominent tech talks at world-class industry conferences. 

Outstanding executive communication, negotiation, and partner management skills, capable of influencing senior engineering leadership and product direction. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.title: Engineering Architect - Full Stack / MERN
data.description:
Lead architecture, design and delivery of enterprise-scale MERN applications while remaining deeply involved in solutioning, coding, reviews, performance optimization, cloud-native implementations, and engineering governance. The role balances technical leadership with business and stakeholder engagement. 

Job Description: 

Required Experience: 14-20 Years

Team Management- Yes

Key Relationships: Product, Delivery, Architecture, Security, DevOps / SRE

A senior role accountable for target architecture, engineering practices and delivery governance across a polyglot engineering platform spanning React, TypeScript, Node. js, NestJS, MongoDB/Mongoose, GraphQL Federation, Kafka, Python/FastAPI and n8n-based automation. You set target architecture and engineering standards, and stay close enough to the code to assure designs you approve. You own identity, data, event-driven and AI-assisted engineering architecture, translating strategy into a funded roadmap for the engineering team and its sub-pods. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Define the target technical architecture for the platform, including architecture principles, reference patterns, and the roadmap from current to target state. 
 - Govern architecture decisions through documented decision records, design review, and conformance checkpoints, escalating material trade-offs for approval. 
 - Architect the React/TypeScript frontend, covering component structure, state management, performance budgets, and accessibility standards. 
 - Direct backend service architecture in Node. js/TypeScript (NestJS), including service boundaries, API contracts, resilience patterns, and versioning strategy. 
 - Define the data architecture across MongoDB, covering schema and access-pattern design, indexing strategy, data lifecycle, and integrity controls. 
 - Own the GraphQL Federation architecture: supergraph composition, subgraph boundaries, schema contracts, entity resolution, and breaking-change policy. 
 - Establish event-driven architecture on Kafka, defining topic and event contract design, partitioning, delivery semantics, and schema evolution rules. 
 - Set the identity and access architecture, covering authentication and authorization flows, token handling, session policy, and least-privilege service access. 
 - Guide the Python/FastAPI service architecture, defining where it is the correct tool, its contract and packaging conventions, and its integration with the wider platform. 
 - Scope and constrain n8n usage to workflow automation and integration orchestration, defining the guardrails that distinguish automation workflows from engineered application services. 
 - Own the AI architecture, covering model integration and routing, prompt and tooling boundaries, evaluation criteria, and safety and cost controls. 
 - Assure evidence-based application readiness for Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring applications correctly consume platform-owned Helm charts and GitHub Actions pipelines rather than duplicating them. 
 - Set runtime performance and observability standards, including Azure Cache for Redis caching patterns and Application Insights instrumentation, tracing, and alerting. 
 - Partner with the engineering team and its sub-pods to raise engineering practices, embed the testing strategy across unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end layers, and sustain predictable delivery flow. 

Must Have Skills: 

- Proven technical leadership of an engineering team at Lead Technical Architect or Principal Architect scope. 
 - Deep expertise in TypeScript, React, Node. js, NestJS, MongoDB/Mongoose and Web Components/micro-frontends.

Meet the Team

In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms & Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale world-class agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform. 

Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a relentless focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, uncompromising quality, and developer enablement-empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences.

As a Software Engineer (Senior / Tech Lead level) in Cisco EAIPI, you will serve as an advanced technical professional driving end-to-end software engineering excellence across our flagship AI platforms. Developing software consistent with Cisco 'Design Thinking Principles', you will place simplification and User Experience (UX) at the core while upholding strict secure coding standards, user privacy, and engineering best practices. 

You will take holistic ownership of feature roadmaps, lead project delivery through delegation and technical review, collaborate with product managers and UX designers to build customer-centric solutions, and author comprehensive architectural and user documentation. Additionally, you will champion product innovation, optimize the software development lifecycle, and resolve complex issues across development and production systems.
