Minimum Qualifications-

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field + 7 years of related experience; OR Master's degree + 4 years of related experience; OR Ph. D. + 1 year of related experience. 

Solid conceptual and practical expertise in software engineering and distributed systems, with broad proficiency across multiple technical job families and modern technology stacks. 

Expert-level hands-on coding proficiency in one or more core languages (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, C++, or Rust) with confirmed experience architecting and shipping critically important, enterprise-grade software. 

Consistent track record of independently leading complex technical features, driving architectural design RFCs, and applying agile engineering standard methodologies across the full SDLC. 

Strong background in writing modular, highly testable code, designing automated test suites, and performing comprehensive code reviews. 

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on production experience with Generative AI technologies, LLMs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, or multi-agent orchestration frameworks. 

Experience architecting and scaling high-concurrency microservices, low-latency APIs, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ), and distributed caching (Redis). 

Deep familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure, container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), GPU compute environments (Triton Inference Server, CUDA), and vector databases. 

Expertise in enterprise security patterns, OAuth 2. 0 / Token Exchange (RFC 8693), Zero Trust architecture, and automated threat modeling. 

Hands-on experience with modern observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Splunk, Grafana) and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines (Canary/Blue-Green deployments). 

Exceptional communication, presentation, and multi-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence technical roadmaps and mentor engineering teams. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

data.title: Manager - Structural Engineering
data.description:
Manager - Structural Engineering

We are seeking an experienced Structural Engineering Manager to lead the design, analysis and optimisation of solar mounting structures across diverse geographies. The role owns structural design delivery and quality, ensuring designs are safe, cost-efficient and compliant with Indian codes, and with Eurocodes and U. S. standards where required. The candidate will build, lead and develop a team of structural engineers and designers, combining hands-on technical authority in STAAD modelling and code compliance with people leadership, project coordination and client-facing accountability. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Design and Analysis of Mounting Structures: 

- Lead the design and analysis of solar mounting structures using STAAD, ensuring structural integrity, safety and compliance with applicable codes. 
 - Oversee load analysis, including wind, seismic and snow loads, for project locations across India and, where applicable, to Eurocode or U. S. standards. 
 - Drive design optimisation for structural stability, durability and cost efficiency based on site-specific requirements, and coordinate foundation inputs with geotechnical and civil teams. 

Code Compliance, Quality and Documentation: 

- Ensure designs comply with Indian standards (IS 800, IS 801, IS 456, IS 875) and relevant wind and seismic guidelines; apply Eurocodes and American standards (ASCE 7, AISC) for projects outside India. 
 - Review and approve structural analysis reports, engineering drawings and specifications, and run quality checks and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and safety. 
 - Keep design practices current with industry trends, material advancements and best practices for solar structures. 

Project Coordination and Stakeholder Management: 

- Act as the structural point of contact for project teams, clients and vendors, incorporating site-specific needs and client specifications. 
 - Support field teams and resolve on-site structural issues promptly; coordinate with electrical, procurement and manufacturing teams for seamless project integration. 

Team Leadership and Management: 

- Hire, onboard and develop a team of structural engineers and designers; build a clear structure, roles and succession within the team. 
 - Plan resources across multiple concurrent projects, set priorities, and deliver to agreed schedule, quality and budget. 
 - Set clear goals, give regular feedback, conduct appraisals, and mentor engineers towards greater technical ownership. 
 - Establish design standards, templates, calculation formats and review checklists, and drive automation of repetitive tasks to improve team productivity. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, integrating field and client feedback into design enhancements. 

Skill Requirements

- At least 8 years of experience in structural design, including at least 3 years on solar mounting structures. 
 - At least 2-3 years of experience leading or supervising a team of engineers. 
 - Expert proficiency in STAAD for structural analysis; working knowledge of AutoCAD or SolidWorks. 
 - Strong knowledge of Indian codes (IS 800, IS 801, IS 456, IS 875) and seismic and wind design codes. 
 - Clear written and spoken English, strong review and reporting skills, structured problem-solving and a strong ownership mindset. 
 - Preferred (not mandatory): experience with Eurocodes or U. S. standards (ASCE, AISC), Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) design, and tracker or rooftop structures. 

Education

- Bachelor of Engineering / B. Tech in Civil or Structural Engineering required, Master of Engineering / M. Tech in Structural Engineering preferred

Industry

- Renewables - Solar mounting structures, or Pre-Engineered Buildings / steel structures

data.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Browse and Discovery Platform
data.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.   

Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U. S. , Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. 

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. 

  

What does the team work on?Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. As we strive to influence the future of television globally, including TV advertising, the ongoing success depends heavily on our investment in the Content Management System. With Roku providing millions of movies, episodes, news, and channels, the Content Management System plays a vital role in managing content ingestion, selection, enrichment, and curation. We are seeking engineers capable of developing, designing, and deploying highly scalable, dependable applications, tools, and automation frameworks essential for efficiently handling the vast volume of content in our pipeline. 

  

What is the role?As a Senior Manager of Software Engineering on the Browse and Discovery Platform team, you will own engineering for featured experiences and lead key components of the browse platform. You will lead and grow a team of backend engineers building the services and APIs that connect content, product capabilities, and user experiences across Roku devices. This role requires strong technical leadership in distributed systems, cloud services, and backend architecture, paired with the ability to translate evolving product requirements into reliable, scalable solutions. You will define technical direction, guide architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to deliver new experiences from concept through launch. The successful candidate will balance product delivery with long-term platform development while developing engineers and promoting a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and accountability. 

  

How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain - coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

  

What are the responsibilities of the role?
 - Lead and manage a team of backend engineers, providing guidance, mentorship, and support to foster professional growth and development
 - Own the technical roadmap and delivery of featured experiences and key browse platform services, from design and implementation through launch and ongoing operation
 - Architect and evolve highly available, distributed services and APIs that support content discovery and engaging user experiences at scale
 - Build reusable capabilities for configuring, publishing, scheduling, and delivering featured experiences across Roku devices
 - Collaborate with product management, design, client engineering, and content teams to define requirements, manage dependencies, and deliver new capabilities
 - Drive improvements in service reliability, performance, observability, and operational efficiency while enabling experimentation and rapid product iteration
 - Define and enforce engineering best practices, coding standards, and development processes to ensure high-quality software delivery
 - Conduct performance evaluations, set clear objectives, and provide mentorship to foster professional growth and development across the team
 - Work closely with senior leadership to align engineering efforts with overall business objectives and timelines  What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?
 - 10+ years of software development experience with deep technical expertise in building high-availability, large-scale distributed systems and services
 - 5+ years of experience in a leadership or management role, overseeing engineering teams and driving software development projects from conception to delivery
 - Proven track record of building and managing high-performing engineering teams
 - Strong proficiency in Java or a similar backend programming language, with experience designing and developing APIs and cloud-based services
 - Deep understanding of backend technologies, architecture patterns, and best practices, including microservices, RESTful APIs, message queues, caching, and databases
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
 - Experience operating production services at scale, including performance optimization, observability, and incident response
 - Strong ability to make practical trade-offs and drive programs with autonomy
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
 What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. 

  

What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. 

  

AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku. com. 

  

What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https: //www. weareroku. com/factsheet. 

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku. com.

data.title: Specialist in machine learning engineering
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Specialist in Machine Learning Engineering based in India. 

As a Specialist in Machine Learning Engineering, you will help build, operate, and scale the infrastructure powering advanced AI services and applications. You will work at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineering, distributed systems, and machine learning infrastructure, ensuring that production AI workloads remain reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-efficient. Your responsibilities will span large-scale LLM inference, model serving, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) platforms. You will also drive automation, improve system observability, and optimize GPU resources to enhance performance and availability. Working closely with AI researchers, software engineers, and platform teams, you will contribute to the development of resilient AI infrastructure in a dynamic, hybrid multi-cloud environment. 

Accountabilities

You will take ownership of the reliability, performance, and operational excellence of critical AI infrastructure, helping ensure that large-scale machine learning services operate efficiently in production. Your work will combine hands-on engineering, automation, incident management, and cross-functional collaboration. 

- Operate, scale, and optimize multi-tenant LLM inference, model-serving, VectorDB/RAG, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) platforms across global cloud and GPU clusters. 
 - Establish and monitor Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), automated health checks, and observability dashboards using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, and OpenTelemetry. 
 - Develop automation for deployment rollouts, autoscaling, canary releases, self-healing systems, and disaster recovery to reduce operational overhead. 
 - Optimize GPU utilization and inference performance by improving throughput, latency, model scheduling, batching, caching, and resource allocation using Kubernetes, vLLM, and Ray. 
 - Lead complex production incident responses, conduct root-cause investigations using methodologies such as 5 Whys, and implement long-term solutions to prevent recurring issues. 
 - Collaborate with AI researchers, product developers, and platform engineering teams to conduct production readiness reviews and ensure reliable service delivery. 
 - Participate in a sustainable on-call rotation and continuously improve operational practices, system resilience, and service availability. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering expertise with practical experience operating distributed, cloud-native systems in production environments. You should have a solid understanding of SRE principles, observability, and infrastructure automation, alongside an interest in the challenges of deploying and scaling modern AI workloads. 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with at least 5 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with at least 3 years of experience. 
 - At least 3 years of software development experience using Python, Go, or Java, particularly in building automation tools, infrastructure solutions, or production backend services. 
 - Strong experience operating distributed and containerized production systems using Kubernetes, microservices architectures, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Proven background in Site Reliability Engineering, production operations, distributed systems troubleshooting, and observability. 
 - Practical experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or OpenTelemetry. 
 - Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM inference and serving frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Ray Serve, or KServe is highly desirable. 
 - Familiarity with GPU orchestration, capacity planning, model parallelism, and performance profiling. 
 - Experience managing vector databases, search engines, or distributed caching solutions such as Milvus, Pinecone, or Redis. 
 - Understanding of generative AI architectures, including RAG pipelines, model routing, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent runtimes. 
 - Experience designing highly available multi-region systems, automated remediation solutions, and chaos engineering practices is an advantage. 
 - Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams. 

Benefits

- Fully remote working arrangement. 
 - Full-time employment opportunity. 
 - Opportunity to work on large-scale AI infrastructure and advanced generative AI technologies. 
 - Exposure to distributed systems, GPU computing, and modern machine learning platforms. 
 - Collaboration with experienced professionals across AI research, software development, and platform engineering. 
 - Opportunities for continuous technical learning, innovation, and professional development. 
 - The opportunity to contribute to mission-critical AI services with global reach and impact. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

About Lilly

At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50, 000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly. 

About Technology@Lilly

At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve. 

About The Business Function

The Software Product Engineering (SPE) team is a specialized engineering group that delivers strategic solutions and differentiated capabilities. We take a forward-thinking approach, focusing on an enterprise platform and product mindset, ensuring that the solutions we build can be leveraged across Technology teams for broader impact and efficiency. 

About The Role

Our team builds digital and AI-powered products that improve how employees work and interact with technology at Lilly. We are looking for a Software Engineer - Full Stack Agentic to design, build and operate modern, scalable applications and services across our growing product portfolio. 

The initial focus of this role will be ChatNow, Lilly's conversational AI experience, with the opportunity to help build additional digital and AI-powered products over time. 

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone comfortable working across the technology stack, with particularly strong backend engineering skills. The engineer will work closely with Product Management, Product Design, Product Analytics, QA/QE and other engineers to turn product ideas into secure, reliable and intuitive experiences. 

Responsibilities And Key Objectives

- Design, build and operate full-stack applications, developing scalable backend services and APIs alongside modern, responsive user experiences. 
 - Build backend services and integrations using Python and modern application frameworks, with a focus on maintainability, performance, reliability and scalability. 
 - Develop high-quality user experiences using React, translating product and design requirements into reusable, maintainable frontend components. 
 - Build AI-powered product capabilities, integrating Generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents and related technologies into production applications. 
 - Design and integrate APIs and services that connect applications with enterprise platforms, data sources, AI services and other internal or external systems. 
 - Own software through its lifecycle, from technical design and implementation through automated testing, deployment, observability, troubleshooting and continuous improvement. 
 - Build observable and reliable systems, using application telemetry, logging, metrics and monitoring to understand system behaviour, identify issues and improve performance. 
 - Partner closely across the product team, working with Product Managers, Product Designers, Product Analytics, QA/QE and other engineers to translate product requirements and designs into high-quality, intuitive experiences. 
 - Deliver with a strong eye for detail, ensuring implementations meet product and design intent while maintaining high standards for usability, quality, performance and reliability. 
 - Contribute to engineering standards and practices, including code quality, automated testing, code reviews, security, architecture and technical documentation. 
 - Use AI-assisted software engineering tools and techniques to improve development productivity while maintaining appropriate engineering quality and controls. 
 - Take ownership of complex technical problems, working through ambiguity and helping evolve the architecture as products and requirements grow. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field. 
 - Minimum of 5 years of experience in software engineering, developing and supporting production applications. 
 - Strong backend development experience using Python, including designing and developing APIs, services and integrations. 
 - Strong frontend development experience using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Experience developing and deploying applications on cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS. 
 - Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, including automated testing, source control, CI/CD, observability and secure development. 
 - Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to work effectively with Product Management, Design, Product Analytics, QA/QE and Engineering throughout the product development lifecycle. 

Additional Skills / Preferences

- Experience building applications using Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, agentic AI or related AI technologies. 
 - Experience designing and building scalable APIs, distributed services, asynchronous systems or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience with containers and cloud-native technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with observability and monitoring technologies such as Grafana, Splunk or OpenTelemetry. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, engineering judgement and the ability to take ownership and deliver in an ambiguous, fast-moving product environment. 

Additional Information

- Travel may be required depending on business need. 
 - This role may work with teams and stakeholders across multiple locations and time zo

data.title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member II - Guidewire and React Developer
data.description:
Job Summary

This position works with business stakeholders, solution engineers, product owners, UX designers, and Agile team members to develop, test, and deploy Guidewire PolicyCenter solutions and React-based digital applications. React development is a mandatory capability for this role. The developer uses foundational to intermediate Guidewire configuration and integration skills together with hands-on React, JavaScript or TypeScript, responsive user interface, REST API integration, and automated testing experience. Experience with Guidewire Jutro Digital Platform is a plus. The role follows established coding, design, accessibility, security, and delivery standards and delivers reliable working functionality each sprint with support and guidance from senior developers, solution engineers, or architects. 

Essential Job Functions

- Develops and modifies Guidewire PolicyCenter components and React-based web applications to deliver approved business and digital experience requirements
 - Interprets customer, business, and user experience needs and provides technical input into feasible application solutions and system design
 - Builds reusable React components, screens, forms, and workflows using modern JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or SCSS, and approved component libraries
 - Integrates React applications with Guidewire and enterprise services using REST APIs, JSON payloads, and established authentication and authorization patterns
 - Codes and configures Guidewire programs, objects, components, and packaged software using established standards and conventions
 - Documents implementation details and performs quality checks on Guidewire configuration, React code, API integrations, test evidence, and supporting documentation
 - Delivers working functionality incrementally each sprint and modifies existing code or configuration to meet approved requirements
 - Performs detailed impact assessments across business processes, data, Guidewire applications, APIs, digital channels, and integrations; identifies and raises functional or technical risks
 - Creates unit and component tests and applies Test-Driven Development or Behavior-Driven Development practices where appropriate
 - Supports application implementation, release, environment troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions across Guidewire and React components with guidance
 - Takes ownership of assigned deliverables, communicates status and impediments, and completes issue resolution in a timely manner

Requirements

Guidewire Technical Requirements

- Minimum 3 years of experience in software development, solution engineering, or a related technology field
 - Hands-on experience developing web applications using React and modern JavaScript; TypeScript experience is preferred
 - Working knowledge of React functional components, hooks, props, component composition, state management, routing, reusable design patterns, and front-end error handling
 - Experience with HTML5, CSS3, responsive web design, SCSS or CSS modules, browser developer tools, and cross-browser compatibility
 - Experience consuming REST APIs, handling asynchronous operations, processing JSON payloads, and displaying service data in React applications
 - Experience writing front-end unit and component tests using tools such as Jest and React Testing Library
 - Working knowledge of Node. js, npm, package management, dependency management, build tooling, linting, code formatting, and front-end CI/CD practices
 - Ability to apply accessibility, basic internationalization, performance, security, and responsive design practices to customer- and producer-facing applications
 - Ability to translate approved UX designs or design-system specifications into reusable and accessible React components
 - Experience with Guidewire Jutro Digital Platform or Jutro-based React applications is a plus

Agile Delivery and Collaboration

- Writes and refines user stories with clear technical tasks and acceptance criteria covering Guidewire, APIs, React, and integration changes; estimates work using relative sizing
 - Partners with the Product Owner, UX designers, and team members to confirm that implementation and acceptance tests reflect the intended functionality and user experience
 - Participates in PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, system demos, retrospectives, and Inspect and Adapt activities
 - Commits to team PI objectives and sprint goals, communicates progress and impediments, and owns assigned work items
 - Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration, and continuous deployment to support the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and DevOps
 - Demonstrates integrated PolicyCenter and React functionality to Product and Business Owners and supports iteration and PI System Demos
 - Actively develops T-shaped Guidewire and React skills, participates in Communities of Practice, shares knowledge, and contributes ideas for continuous improvement
 - Works effectively across development, testing, product, UX, architecture, and business partners to improve flow and transparency

Additional Qualifications

- Strong verbal communication, listening, writing, and collaboration skills, with the ability to adjust technical detail for the audience
 - Demonstrated problem-solving skills, including breaking down moderately complex issues, identifying root cause, comparing alternatives, and recommending a viable solution
 - Ability to use data to identify meaningful information, patterns, or conclusions and organize the steps needed to address an issue
 - Strong ownership and accountability for individual deliverables, including timely identification and correction of gaps
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and multiple assignments
 - Foundational knowledge of object-oriented and component-based programming, defensive coding, error handling, version control, databases, SQL, and integrated development environments
 - Working-level understanding of applications within the assigned domain and the flow of data between Guidewire, digital applications, and internal or external systems
 - Broad understanding of insurance concepts, terminology, products, and business processes
 - Ability to share knowledge, provide constructive feedback, and support others in areas of developing expertise

Education and Certification Requirements

- High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field preferred
 - Guidewire Configuration or Integration certification is preferred or expected based on assignment needs
 - Relevant React, JavaScript, TypeScript, cloud, or web development training or certification is preferred

Benefits

Competitive compensation and benefits package: 

- Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
 - Comprehensive benefits package
 - Career development and training opportunities
 - Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
 - Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
 - Private Health Insurance
 - Pension Plan
 - Paid Time Off
 - Training & Development

Note: Benefits differ based on employee level. 

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 340, 000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22. 5 billion in revenues in 2023. 

https: //www. capgemini. com/us-en/about-us/who-we-are/

data.description:
Since 2003, Entrata has evolved from a visionary, student-led startup into a global leader in AI-driven property management technology. Today, we power the industry's most essential operating system, serving owners and residents worldwide through a comprehensive suite of intelligent leasing, payment, and communication tools powered by cutting-edge AI. With a proven track record of sustained growth and a global team of more than 2, 200 employees, we offer the rare combination of established stability and high-velocity innovation. Recognized by the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame and the Utah Business Fast 50, Entrata fosters a culture of radical transparency and entrepreneurial energy. At Entrata, we create an environment where different perspectives are valued and respected. Those perspectives challenge assumptions, strengthen our decisions, and raise the bar as we reshape the global living experience through AI-powered solutions. 

If you're one of the best and brightest, a highly motivated innovator, a fast worker, and a fierce competitor, you might be just the person we're looking for! Entrata's Development department is seeking a Software Engineer - PHP, Node. js, and React (P3) based in India. You will work closely with senior engineers and the engineering manager, designing database schemas and scalable application architecture using PHP, Node. js, Express. js, React, and Postgres. You will also independently own projects and see them through from design to production, providing technical guidance to other engineers. 

Responsibilities will include: 

- Write well-designed, testable, efficient code for PHP and Node. js back-end services and React front-end applications
 - Solve technical problems by working closely with Development Managers, UX, Product Managers, and offshore teams
 - Design high-performance database schemas and application architecture for their products
 - Empower offshore teams to rapidly deliver stable, high-performing, and reliable code. This requires frequent interaction with them by teleconference
 - Review and improve code for quality and design, getting involved in complicated or sensitive code
 - Maintain and optimize Postgres queries, indexes, and aggregation pipelines
 - Own feature delivery across all phases of the development life cycle, including back-end services using PHP, Node. js, and Express. js and front-end interfaces using React
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance on implementation, debugging, and code quality
 - Participate in and advocate for Agile and Scrum activities
 - Prepare and produce releases of software components
 - Handle high-traffic website operations, be proactive with maintenance, and exhibit problem-solving skills to ensure optimal working and performance of the websites
 - Build interfaces and improve existing functionality and application logic
 - Understand standard systems development life-cycle processes and apply Agile methodology effectively on client and internal engagements
 - Apply knowledge of industry trends and developments to improve service to the client and internal projects

Minimum Qualifications: 

- 5+ years of software development experience, including hands-on experience building production applications using PHP, Node. js, Express. js, React, and Postgres
 - Experience working with web-based applications and designing and integrating RESTful APIs
 - Strong proficiency in PHP and JavaScript, including object-oriented programming and design patterns in PHP, asynchronous programming in Node. js, and React components, hooks, and state management
 - Strong Postgres knowledge, including schema design, indexing, and query optimization
 - Demonstrated ability to independently own features from design through production, make technical design decisions, and review code
 - Experience writing automated tests for PHP and Node. js back-end services and React front-end components
 - Strong written and verbal communication
 - Ambitious, dedicated, and a little eccentric
 - Team-oriented, with a willingness to standardize code and architecture and mentor other engineers

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
 - Experience working with offshore teams
 - Experience with TypeScript and SQL databases
 - Experience with transitioning from an older monolith to modern microservices

AI & Operational Fluency: 

- AI Integration: Utilize company-approved GenAI tools to accelerate high-value deliverables

 - Data Governance: Ensures no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models
 - Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains

Entrata is dedicated to creating a workplace where a diverse and inclusive team thrives in an environment free from discrimination. Since 2003, Entrata has evolved from a visionary, student-led startup into a global leader in AI-driven property management technology. Today, we power the industry's most essential operating system, serving owners and residents worldwide through a comprehensive suite of intelligent leasing, payment, and communication tools powered by cutting-edge AI. With a proven track record of sustained growth and a global team of more than 2, 200 employees, we offer the rare combination of established stability and high-velocity innovation. Recognized by the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame and the Utah Business Fast 50, Entrata fosters a culture of radical transparency and entrepreneurial energy. At Entrata, we create an environment where different perspectives are valued and respected. Those perspectives challenge assumptions, strengthen our decisions, and raise the bar as we reshape the global living experience through AI-powered solutions. 

If you're one of the best and brightest, a highly motivated innovator, a fast worker, and a fierce competitor, you might be just the person we're looking for! Entrata's Development department is seeking a Senior Software Engineer - PHP, Node. js, and React (P4) based in India. As part of our Development team, you will act as a technical advisor, team leader, coder, and evangelist. Our Senior Software Engineers design scalable PHP and Node. js services and React applications for the offshore development team, taking ownership of projects, seeing them across the finish line, and advocating for the latest tools, technologies, and best practices. 

Responsibilities will include: 

- Write well-designed, testable, efficient code for PHP and Node. js back-end services and React front-end applications
 - Solve technical problems by working closely with Development Managers, UX, Product Managers, and offshore teams
 - Review and improve code for quality and design through constant evaluation of product code and involvement in complicated or sensitive code
 - Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills
 - Manage the delicate balance between implementation complexity, time to market, and scalability
 - Be team-oriented, with a willingness to standardize code and architecture
 - Demonstrate mastery of database and application architecture best practices, including scalable PHP and Node. js services, maintainable object-oriented code, and reusable React components. Mentor other engineers in architectural and coding practices, as per company coding standards

Minimum Qualifications: 

- 8+ years of software development experience, including hands-on experience building production applications using PHP, Node. js, and React
 - Strong proficiency in PHP and JavaScript, including object-oriented programming and design patterns in PHP, asynchronous programming in Node. js, and React components, hooks, and state management
 - Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs, writing SQL queries, and designing database schemas
 - 8+ years of experience in performance optimization, debugging, and unit testing, with experience across PHP and Node. js back-end services and React front-end applications
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
 - Experience working with offshore teams
 - Experience with TypeScript and SQL databases
 - Experience with transitioning from an older monolith to modern microservices
 - Experience with AWS

AI & Operational Fluency: 

- AI Integration: Utilize company-approved GenAI tools to accelerate high-value deliverables
 - Strategic Oversight: Exercise critical judgment as the "Human-in-the-Loop" by auditing AI outputs for factual accuracy, brand alignment, and the removal of hallucinations
 - Data Governance: Ensures no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models
 - Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains

Entrata is dedicated to creating a workplace where a diverse and inclusive team thrives in an environment free from discrimination. We provide equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, protected veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. 

It's a great place to work! Will you join us?

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Software Engineer | Distributed System + Fullstack (Python,Go, Java) + AI - 4+ years
data.description:
Meet the Team

In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms & Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale premier agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform. 

Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement-empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer in Cisco EAIPI, you will develop software consistent with Cisco 'Design Thinking Principles' with a focus on simplification and User Experience (UX) at its core. You will apply secure coding practices, ensure user privacy, and follow modern software development engineering standards. In this role, you will partner closely with multi-functional teams including design, product management, and core systems architecture to build robust, scalable solutions for our users and enterprise customers. 

You will create technical design documentation for your team, supply to end-user documentation, debug complex software issues across development and production environments, drive continuous innovation, and optimize software engineering and delivery workflows. 

Responsibilities

Technical Execution & Problem Solving: Apply modern software engineering standard methodologies and internal/external technical domain knowledge to enhance platform performance, reliability, and usability. 

Autonomy & Technical Ownership: Work independently with guidance from engineering leaders, resolving optimal technical approaches and architecture to deliver roadmap commitments. 

Feature & Project Leadership: Lead small-to-medium feature development from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and post-launch monitoring. 

Engineering Craftsmanship: Write high-quality, functional, maintainable, and clean code with comprehensive unit and integration tests under minimal supervision. 

Code Quality & Peer Reviews: Perform thorough, constructive code reviews for peers, ensuring code quality, security alignment, and architectural consistency across the codebase. 

Scalability & Performance: Design and write software components that optimize system scale, runtime reliability, token throughput, and release velocity. 

Security & Privacy by Design: Champion secure coding principles, identify threat models, and implement robust privacy and safety standards across features. 

Production Reliability & Operations: Solve complex production issues, participate in on-call rotations, lead blameless postmortems, and author comprehensive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports. 

Component Expertise: Serve as a domain expert (SME) on multiple functional components and subsystems within the platform. 

multi-functional Collaboration: Partner with peer collaborators within and across teams (Product Management, UX/Design, SRE, and QA) to build productive, highly collaborative working relationships. 

Project Delivery & Planning: Coordinate on project timelines, review and refine technical specifications, and communicate landmarks proactively to partners. 

Knowledge Sharing: Share knowledge across teams through internal tech talks, blogs, engineering documentation, and architecture brown-bag sessions. 

Mentorship & Talent Enablement: Act as a trusted technical resource, mentoring junior engineers, peers, and engineering interns to develop a high-performance culture. 

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree + 5 years of related experience, OR Master's degree + 3 years of related experience, OR Ph. D. + 0 years of related experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical STEM field. 

Strong foundational and applied working knowledge in software engineering, with proficiency in modern programming languages, system design, data structures, and algorithms. 

Hands-on coding experience in one or more core languages (e. g. , Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, or C++) with a consistent track record of building, testing, and shipping production-grade software. 

Demonstrated understanding of modern software development life cycles (SDLC), agile engineering practices, CI/CD automation, and version control (Git). 

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with modern AI/ML frameworks, Generative AI APIs, LLM tool integration, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or agentic workflows. 

Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, microservices architectures, or modular SDKs. 

Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), distributed caching (Redis), and relational or vector databases. 

Practical knowledge of observability and telemetry tools (e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Splunk, Grafana) for tracing, logging, and performance profiling. 

Experience with automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, end-to-end, Playwright, pytest) and performance benchmarking. 

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and multi-functional communication skills with a customer-centric mentality. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.title: Senior Product Architect
data.description:
Senior Product Architect - Enterprise Analytics Services

Location: India or United States

Reports To: Director of Engineering - Enterprise Software & Analytics Services (Agile Value Stream Leader)

Position Summary

Qualitrol is building an AI-Native Product Engineering team focused on enterprise analytics services for critical electrical infrastructure. The Product Architect provides technical leadership across multiple product squads, defining architecture while remaining hands-on in specification, software design, implementation, code review, mentoring, and production support. The role guides the evolution of a common enterprise analytics platform deployed from a single code base across cloud-native and customer-managed on-premises environments. 

AI-Native Product Engineering

Our engineers begin with precise specifications rather than source code. Using a Specification-Driven Agentic Software Development Lifecycle, Product Engineers collaborate with AI agents to accelerate architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, and validation while retaining full accountability for engineering judgment, software quality, cybersecurity, and customer outcomes. 

Mission

Lead the architecture, design, development, and lifecycle evolution of Enterprise Analytics Services while establishing technical direction for reusable platform capabilities that serve multiple analytics domains. 

Areas of Stewardship

- Architecture and technical standards
 - Product architecture across multiple Agile squads
 - Specification-driven engineering practices
 - AI-assisted engineering workflows
 - Secure, observable, cloud-agnostic enterprise software
 - API-first and event-driven architecture
 - Technical mentoring and architectural governance
 - Production excellence, reliability, and continuous improvement

Key Responsibilities

- Define and evolve the Enterprise Analytics platform architecture. 
 - Partner with Product Owners to transform end user outcomes into executable engineering specifications. 
 - Lead architectural reviews, technical design sessions, and implementation strategy. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate production-quality software delivery while maintaining human accountability. 
 - Establish reusable architectural patterns, APIs, and shared services. 
 - Drive engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, and engineering standards. 
 - Champion secure-by-design, observable, resilient software. 
 - Mentor Product Engineers and foster technical excellence. 
 - Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance throughout the SDLC. 
 - Support SAFe 6. 0 Agile planning, architecture runway, and continuous delivery. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - 12+ years building enterprise software with significant architecture leadership. 
 - Expertise in C#, . NET, C++, ASP. NET Core, Python, cloud-native development, Kubernetes, distributed systems, plugin-based architectures and API-first design. 
 - Demonstrated success designing software deployable from a common code base across public cloud and customer-managed on-premises environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, observability, multi-tenancy, event-driven architecture, and enterprise software engineering. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams. 
 - Experience with Agile Scrum; SAFe 6. 0 preferred. 
 - Experience with specification-driven development, AI-assisted engineering workflows, or agentic SDLC practices. 

Engineering Principles

- Own products, not features. 
 - Begin with specifications, not code. 
 - AI accelerates engineering; accountability remains human. 
 - Architecture is a shared discipline, guided by clear technical leadership. 
 - Design once. Deploy anywhere. 
 - Security is a design requirement. 
 - Observability is a product capability. 
 - Optimize for customer outcomes. 

Success Measures

- Platform architecture adopted across product squads. 
 - Increased engineering productivity through AI-native engineering practices. 
 - Improved software quality, resilience, and deployment consistency. 
 - Reduced technical debt and accelerated release cadence. 
 - High-performing engineering culture built on ownership and continuous learning. 

Ralliant Corporation Overview

Ralliant, originally part of Fortive, now stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. With a global footprint and a legacy of excellence, we empower engineers to bring next-generation breakthroughs to life - faster, smarter, and more reliably. Our high-performance instruments, sensors, and subsystems fuel mission-critical advancements across industries, enabling real-world impact where it matters most. At Ralliant we're building the future, together with those driven to push boundaries, solve complex problems, and leave a lasting mark on the world. 

About Qualitrol

QUALITROL manufactures monitoring and protection devices for high value electrical assets and OEM manufacturing companies. Established in 1945, QUALITROL produces thousands of different types of products on demand and customized to meet our individual customers' needs. We are the largest and most trusted global leader for partial discharge monitoring, asset protection equipment and information products across power generation, transmission, and distribution. At Qualitrol, we are redefining condition-based monitoring. 

We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Ralliant Corporation and all Ralliant Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Ralliant and all Ralliant Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at applyassistance@Ralliant. com. 

Bonus or Equity

This position is also eligible for bonus as part of the total compensation package.

data.title: Deputy General Manager
data.description:
To lead and manage the Quality Control function for API manufacturing operations, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, cGMP guidelines, ICH guidelines, pharmacopoeial standards and company quality systems. Responsible for analytical quality, laboratory operations, regulatory inspections, method validation, stability studies, data integrity and timely release of raw materials, intermediates and finished APIs. 

- Key Responsibilities
 - QC Laboratory Management

Lead overall QC operations, including Raw Material, In-process, Finished Product and Stability testing. 

Ensure timely analysis and release of raw materials, intermediates and finished APIs. 

Manage QC laboratory manpower, instruments, workload and resources. 

Establish and monitor laboratory KPIs and operational performance. 

Ensure compliance with approved specifications, STPs and analytical procedures. 

- Regulatory Compliance & cGMP

Ensure Compliance With

USFDA requirements (21 CFR Part 210/211, as applicable). 

EU GMP requirements. 

WHO-GMP Guidelines. 

ICH guidelines. 

IP, USP, EP and other applicable pharmacopoeias. 

Ensure laboratory readiness for regulatory inspections and customer audits. 

Lead and respond to QC-related regulatory observations and audit findings. 

Ensure implementation of ALCOA+ principles and data integrity requirements. 

- Analytical Method Development & Validation

Oversee analytical method development, verification, transfer and validation. 

Ensure compliance with ICH Q2 and applicable analytical validation requirements. 

Review and approve analytical method validation protocols and reports. 

Ensure proper handling of analytical method transfer between R&D, QC and external laboratories. 

- Investigation & Quality Systems

Lead And Review

Out of Specification (OOS) investigations. 

Out of Trend (OOT) investigations. 

Laboratory deviations. 

Analytical discrepancies. 

CAPA and change controls. 

Ensure effective root cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions. 

Review laboratory incidents and ensure timely closure of investigations. 

- Stability Management

Oversee stability studies as per ICH guidelines. 

Ensure preparation and approval of stability protocols and reports. 

Monitor stability chambers and temperature/humidity excursions. 

Ensure timely review of stability data and evaluation of product trends. 

- Instrumentation & Laboratory Compliance

Ensure qualification, calibration and maintenance of QC instruments. 

Oversee Instruments Such As

HPLC / UPLC

GC / Headspace GC

UV-Visible Spectrophotometer

FTIR

KF Titrator

Dissolution / Particle Size instruments, wherever applicable. 

Ensure proper handling of computerized systems and audit trails. 

Ensure periodic review of instrument performance and laboratory compliance. 

- Team Leadership & Development

Lead, mentor and develop QC managers, executives and analysts. 

Define responsibilities and performance objectives for team members. 

Conduct training on cGMP, GLP, analytical techniques and data integrity. 

Build a culture of quality, accountability and continuous improvement. 

- Cross-functional Coordination

Coordinate with Production, QA, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Engineering and Supply Chain. 

Support technology transfer and commercial manufacturing activities. 

Ensure timely resolution of analytical issues affecting production and dispatch. 

Provide analytical support during process validation and regulatory submissions. 

- Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Timely release of raw materials, intermediates and finished APIs. 

Reduction in OOS/OOT and laboratory deviations. 

Timely completion of analytical method validation and transfer. 

Zero critical data integrity observations. 

Timely closure of CAPA and change controls. 

Successful regulatory and customer audits. 

Stability study compliance and on-time reporting. 

Instrument uptime and calibration compliance. 

Training effectiveness and team performance. 

- Qualification
 - Sc. in Analytical Chemistry / Organic Chemistry / Pharmaceutical Chemistry. 
 - Pharm in Pharmaceutical Analysis or equivalent qualification preferred. 
 - Experience

15-20 years of experience in Quality Control in the pharmaceutical API industry. 

Minimum 5 years in a senior leadership role (AGM/DGM/GM level). 

Experience In USFDA, EU-GMP And Other Regulated-market Facilities Preferred. 

Strong experience in API analytical testing, laboratory management and regulatory audits. 

- Required Technical & Leadership Competencies

Strong knowledge of API analytical chemistry and pharmaceutical quality systems. 

Excellent understanding of cGMP, GLP and data integrity. 

Expertise in HPLC, GC and analytical method validation. 

Strong investigation and problem-solving capabilities. 

Regulatory inspection and customer audit handling experience. 

Excellent team management, communication and decision-making skills. 

- Key Deliverables

Maintain a compliant and inspection-ready QC laboratory. 

Ensure reliable and timely analytical results. 

Ensure right-first-time laboratory documentation. 

Strengthen data integrity and quality culture. 

Support business growth through efficient QC operations. 

Develop a competent and technically strong QC team.

data.description:
Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer's and partner's needs and solve their challenges. 

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. 

You'll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about-locally and globally. 

Come make an impact every day at Zebra. 

What We're Looking For

As a Principal Software Engineer at Zebra, you will act as a key technical leader and full-stack developer, shaping the future of our enterprise device and cloud solutions. Under consultative direction, you will be entrusted to determine and pursue courses of action essential to achieving our predetermined long-range targets. This is a hands-on, full-stack software engineering leadership role, not a DevOps or IT infrastructure position. We are seeking a master-level engineer who will personally research, architect, design, and write production-grade code for our most complex and real-time cloud solutions. You will also maintain the critical software for our products and systems, acting as a technical leader who builds and delivers enterprise-grade platforms from the ground up. A key aspect of your work will involve performing complex system integration of software and hardware to ensure program consistency and maintain system throughput. Beyond coding, you will develop, validate, and test system structures and user documentation to ensure we deliver robust, high-quality, and well-documented solutions. 

Candidates whose experience is primarily in DevOps, SRE, or cloud administration will not be considered for this position. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Architects, designs, and oversees the development of cloud software solutions for highly complex technical projects, ensuring alignment with business and technical strategies and highly decoupled microservices optimized for distributed cloud environments. 
 - Creates detailed software specifications and leads the technology roadmap process, recommending project approaches and long-term goals
 - Champions innovation and cultivates creativity among team members, fostering an environment that attracts and retains top talent
 - Leads and advises on all aspects of the software development lifecycle, prioritizing quality and continuous improvement
 - Monitors competitor products and development strategies, ensuring the organization's designs exceed industry standards
 - Develops next-generation technologies and solutions in collaboration with other engineering disciplines, anticipating and addressing client needs before the competition
 - Protects intellectual property by analyzing competitor patents and contributing to related organizational initiatives
 - Serves as a thought leader, representing the organization as a spokesperson on specialized projects and programs
 - Establishes formal networks and coordinates efforts across teams and organizational units to achieve shared objectives
 - Acts as a prime consultant and advisor for projects impacting the organization's long-term technical and business goals
 - Provides strategic mentorship to senior engineers and management, fostering knowledge sharing and technical excellence
 - Lead end-to-end development of high-performance cloud solutions, ensuring maximum reliability and system uptime. 
 - Leverage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services to design, deploy, and continuously optimize cloud-native products. 
 - Build low-latency, real-time push notification and messaging systems for enterprise mobile devices and peripherals. 
 - Manage and tune highly scalable databases and storage layers (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, MongoDB, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage) to guarantee data integrity and performance. 

Job Requirements

- Bachelors Degree or Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
 - 10+ years of relevant full stack development experience with a Bachelors Degree or 7+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree
 - Expert hands-on experience in architecture, design, full-stack development, and coding is essential. Experience limited to DevOps will not qualify for this position. 

Key Skills And Competencies

- Expertise in software architecture, system design, and scalable software solutions for enterprise-level applications
 - In-depth knowledge of multiple programming languages, advanced software development methodologies, and adopting GenAI in the Software Development Lifecycle
 - Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and drive complex, high impact projects to completion
 - Strong strategic thinking skills, with a focus on long-term technical and business goals
 - Exceptional innovation and creativity in solving complex challenges and developing novel solutions
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop technical talent, fostering a culture of learning and growth
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience engaging with senior leadership and external customers
 - Familiarity with intellectual property protection, competitor analysis, and industry trends
 - Proven hands-on experience of 10+ years as a Cloud Solutions Engineer with multiple enterprise-grade solutions architected, designed, developed, and delivered. 
 - Proven hands-on experience in architecting and developing highly scalable, multi-tenanted, and real-time solutions. 
 - Proven hands-on experience with microservice architecture, design, and development. 
 - Proven hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Proven hands-on experience with real-time push notifications for mobile devices and peripherals. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes Engine, and others. 
 - Expertise in designing and managing highly scalable databases such as PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and MongoDB. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills, the ability to troubleshoot complex issues, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment. 
 - Strong programming skills in languages such as JavaScript and Java. 
 - Solid understanding of networking concepts, security best practices, and cloud architecture patterns. 
 - GCP Platform Deployment: Leverage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services to design, deploy, and continuously optimize cloud-native products. 
 - Real-Time Systems: Build low-latency, real-time push notification and messaging systems for enterprise mobile devices and peripherals. 
 - Data & Database Systems: Manage and tune highly scalable databases and storage layers (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, MongoDB, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage) to guarantee data integrity and performance. 
 - Data Analytics Integration: Seamlessly integrate analytics and telemetry pipelines into cloud platforms to extract actionable system insights. 
 - AI Integration in SDLC Adaptation: Drive the secure adoption of AI technologies (such as Claude and other LLMs) within the software development life cycle (SDL), ensuring code quality, security compliance, and prompt engineering best practices. 
 - Leadership & Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specs, and mentor junior engineers to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Documentation & Stakeholder Reporting: Maintain comprehensive architectural designs and proactively report on project milestones, risks, and systems health. 

Position Specific Information

- Travel Requirements: Up to 15%
 - Able to Telework?: Hybrid

Physical Demands

- Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting or standing

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. 

Job Posting Statement

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra. com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. 

AI Technology Statement

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

 - Develop processes for identifying flaky tests, infrastructure issues, and application defects.
