data.title: Executive
data.description:
Job Information

Designation: Executive - Automation & Instrumentation

Department: Engineering / Instrumentation & Automation

Industry: Pharmaceutical API Manufacturing

Reporting To: Engineering Manager / Instrumentation Manager / Head of Engineering

Location: Manufacturing Plant

Experience: Typically 3-5 years, depending on plant requirements

Qualification: Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or Automation Engineering

- Job Purpose

To ensure reliable operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, calibration, and optimization of PLC, SCADA, DCS, and industrial instrumentation systems in an API manufacturing facility. 

The role is responsible for maintaining automation systems associated with process equipment, reactors, pumps, compressors, HVAC, chillers, refrigeration, utilities, and other plant equipment. It also supports preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, control-system modifications, process safety, data integrity, and compliance with applicable pharmaceutical quality requirements. 

- Key Responsibilities
 - PLC System Operation and Maintenance

Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot PLC-based automation systems. 

Work with PLC platforms such as Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Mitsubishi, Schneider, or other installed systems. 

Monitor PLC CPU status, input/output modules, communication networks, and field signals. 

Troubleshoot digital and analog inputs and outputs, including 4-20 mA signals. 

Diagnose PLC hardware faults, communication errors, sensor failures, and interlock problems. 

Support PLC program backup, restoration, version control, and approved modifications. 

Coordinate with OEMs and automation vendors for major PLC faults and system upgrades. 

Verify the correct operation of sequence logic, permissives, alarms, and equipment interlocks. 

Maintain PLC hardware, software, and configuration documentation. 

- SCADA System Management

Monitor plant operations through SCADA systems and operator interfaces. 

Maintain SCADA communication with PLCs, remote I/O, field instruments, and plant equipment. 

Troubleshoot communication failures, alarm issues, tag errors, and operator-interface problems. 

Verify process trends, alarm histories, event logs, and equipment status indications. 

Support the configuration of process graphics, tags, alarm limits, and trend displays through approved change procedures. 

Ensure that operator screens accurately represent field conditions. 

Coordinate SCADA software backups, restoration tests, and system maintenance. 

Support authorized user access, audit trails, and electronic records where applicable. 

- DCS Operation and Maintenance

Monitor and maintain Distributed Control System (DCS) hardware and control functions. 

Support DCS controllers, operator stations, engineering stations, communication networks, and I/O systems. 

Troubleshoot process control loops, controller faults, communication errors, and field signal abnormalities. 

Monitor PID control loops and assist in tuning under approved engineering procedures. 

Verify sequence controls, permissives, trips, alarms, and process interlocks. 

Coordinate with process engineering and production teams to resolve control-system issues. 

Maintain DCS configuration backups and approved control-system documentation. 

Support system expansion, hardware replacement, and software upgrades. 

Ensure that changes to control logic are reviewed, approved, tested, and documented. 

- Instrumentation Maintenance and Calibration

Maintain and calibrate instruments used in API manufacturing processes. 

Handle Instruments Such As

Temperature transmitters and RTDs

Pressure transmitters and pressure switches

Differential pressure transmitters

Flow meters and flow transmitters

Level transmitters and level switches

pH, conductivity, and other process analyzers where installed

Control valves, positioners, and actuators

Load cells and weighing systems where applicable

Perform calibration using approved procedures and suitable reference standards. 

Verify instrument ranges, zero and span, accuracy, and output signals. 

Troubleshoot instrument failures, signal fluctuations, drift, and wiring faults. 

Maintain calibration schedules, certificates, and instrument history records. 

Coordinate calibration of critical instruments with quality assurance and metrology teams. 

Investigate out-of-tolerance instruments and assess potential impact on affected processes where required. 

- API Process Equipment Automation

Support automation systems used in reactors, storage tanks, heat exchangers, centrifuges, dryers, condensers, and associated equipment. 

Monitor temperature, pressure, level, flow, agitation, and other process parameters. 

Verify automated sequences, batch steps, equipment permissives, and process alarms.

data.title: Principal Engineer
data.description:
About Foundry

Foundry is GreyOrange's platform for designing and validating automated warehouses. It lets teams go from an early concept to a fully validated solution before anything is built: they model flows, size equipment and robot fleets, lay out the warehouse, and simulate how it will perform. Discrete event simulation (DES) is at the heart of the platform. It lets engineers and customers test thousands of what-if scenarios in minutes instead of days. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the technical direction of our discrete event simulation engine. You will set the architecture and lead the engineering of a high-performance simulator for multi-agent warehouse robotics, and grow it into a fast, accurate, extensible product that customers and partners can build on. 

This is a hands-on role. You will write core engine code, make the key architecture calls, and work closely with product, platform, and robotics teams. The aim is for simulation to be the trusted basis for high-stakes design and sizing decisions. 

What You'll Do

Own the simulation architecture and roadmap

- Define the multi-year technical vision for the simulation engine and how it evolves to meet growing product needs. 
 - Make the core engine decisions: event scheduling, time management, deterministic replay, state representation, and scaling to large fleets and long simulated horizons. 
 - Serve as the final technical authority on simulation design, and represent it in platform-wide architecture reviews. 

Build a world-class simulation core

- Lead development of a high-performance engine, with a focus on throughput, latency, and memory efficiency so that large parameter sweeps run quickly and cheaply. 
 - Model warehouse operations faithfully, including robot navigation and traffic, congestion and resource contention, charging, workstation behavior, and a range of picking and putaway workflows. 
 - Set fidelity standards and calibrate simulation results against higher-fidelity testing and real-world operational data, so customers can trust the output. 

Make simulation an extensible, API-first product

- Design versioned, public schemas and APIs for simulation inputs, job control, real-time streaming, and results, so customers can integrate their own data sources and tools or run simulations headless. 
 - Build a secure plugin architecture so customers and partners can bring their own algorithms and strategies. 
 - Define validation rules that decide when a warehouse design has enough detail to simulate. 

Integrate across the platform

- Work with platform teams on asynchronous job execution, cancellation, and multi-tenant scaling. 
 - Build the real-time and analytics data paths that power live visualization, sizing recommendations, and data-driven insights. 
 - Work with adjacent teams to decide when fast simulation is enough and when a scenario needs deeper, higher-fidelity validation. 

Lead and raise the bar

- Mentor senior and staff engineers. Set standards for performance engineering, testing (determinism, regression, and golden-run suites), observability, and code quality. 
 - Write the design docs, specs, and RFCs that align multiple teams, and turn open architecture questions into decisions. 
 - Engage directly with solutions engineers and customers to understand how simulation drives their decisions, and feed that back into the roadmap. 

What You Bring

Requirement

- 14+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading the architecture of complex, performance-critical systems. 
 - Deep expertise in discrete event simulation: event-queue design, simulation clocks, stochastic modeling, determinism and reproducibility, and validating models against reality. 
 - Strong systems programming skills in Rust, with comfort in async runtimes and high-performance data structures. Working proficiency in Java or a similar JVM language. 
 - Experience modeling multi-agent systems such as robot fleets, vehicles, logistics networks, or manufacturing lines, including path planning, traffic and congestion, and resource contention. 
 - A track record of designing public, versioned APIs and schemas that external developers built on. 
 - Solid distributed-systems fundamentals: job queues, real-time streaming, service-to-service communication, and time-series and analytical data stores. 
 - The ability to drive alignment across several teams through clear writing and sound technical judgment. 

Nice to have

- Experience with WebAssembly runtimes or other plugin and sandboxing architectures. 
 - Background in warehouse automation, AMRs/AGVs, goods-to-person systems, or material-handling simulation tools (e. g. , AnyLogic, FlexSim, Simio, Demo3D). 
 - Experience with simulation frameworks such as DesmoJ or SimPy, or with custom simulation engines at scale. 
 - Experience running large simulation or optimization workloads on cloud infrastructure. 
 - Experience building multi-tenant SaaS products. 
 - Familiarity with operations research, queueing theory, or ML-assisted optimization. 
 - An advanced degree in Computer Science, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. 

What Success Looks Like

- First 90 days: You understand the current simulation platform, its fidelity gaps, and its performance limits. You have published a technical strategy and delivered early wins on performance or correctness. 
 - First 6-12 months: Public simulation schemas and extension interfaces are defined and versioned. Simulation runs as a scalable multi-tenant service. Results are calibrated against real-world data with published accuracy bounds. 
 - Long term: Simulation is the fast, trusted backbone of every design and sizing decision, and customers and partners extend it with their own algorithms and tools. 

Why Join

- Shape a core product from the architecture up, at a point where the big decisions are still open. 
 - Work on hard problems where simulation science, systems performance, and robotics meet. 
 - See your work directly affect how some of the world's largest retailers and 3PLs design and run their warehouses.

data.title: Hardware Developer - Pre & Post Silicon Validation
data.description:
Introduction

India Systems Development Lab (ISDL) is part of IBM Systems world-wide technology development lab. Established in 1996, the Lab is headquartered in India's Silicon Valley and startup hub - Bengaluru, with a strong presence in Pune and Hyderabad. Developers at ISDL deliver technology innovations across the entire Systems portfolio - z Systems, Power / OpenPOWER Systems and Storage. The team here works across the entire stack from processor design, firmware, operating system to software defined storage. The lab also focuses on innovations, thanks to the creative energies of the teams. The lab has contributed over 400+ patents in cutting edge technologies and inventions so far. 

While computing veers towards cognitive, cloud, mobile, social, and security, the lab has significantly contributed to not just new products focused in these areas, but has also ushered in new development models such as Agile, Design Thinking and DevOps. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

- Experience in leading teams on software development of Post-Silicon Validation tools, firmware development, or driver development. 
 - Design and develop algorithms for Post-Silicon Validation of next-generation IBM server processors, SoCs, and ASICs. 
 - Work on coverage closure by developing comprehensive test plans and strategies and drive to achieve coverage goals while interacting with stakeholders, verification teams, and design teams. 
 - Work on processor bring-up activities and own key debugs during the bring-up/power-on phase. 
 - Interface with multiple stakeholders in hardware design teams, lab teams, performance teams, and characterization teams. 
 - Skilled in utilizing object-oriented programming skills in C/C++ and scripting languages like Python/Perl to write complex test scenarios to automate/optimize. 
 - Experience in verifying multi-processor cache coherency and memory subsystems, ensuring seamless operation in complex systems. 
 - Proficiency in emulator environments/FPGA validation is preferred. 
 - Possess excellent leadership skills to enable and empower team members to deliver at a project level. 
 - Demonstrate excellent communication skills. 
 - Experience implementing Agile processes in prior leadership roles. 
 - Eagerness and curiosity to learn and willingness to code and participate hands-on. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- 8+ years expereinece in Pre & Post silicon validation
 - 5+ years experience in technical leadership of software teams
 - Technical Expertise: Very proficient in C programming, Strong Scripting skills. Over 10+ years experience in hands on Software development using C, C++. 
 - Experience in Pre & Pot SiliconValidation: Extensive experience in pre and post silicon validation across ASIC/SoC and/or processor programs. Ownership in full chip functional validation, test plan build and driving development, execution, triage and debug effort by enabling team. Prior collaboration experience with RTL Design, Functional Verification ( Unit/SoC level) teams
 - Computer Architecture Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of computer architecture, including processor core design specifications, instruction set architecture, and logic verification. 
 - Multi-Processor Cache Coherency: Experience in verifying multi-processor cache coherency and memory subsystems, ensuring seamless operation in complex systems. 
 - Operating Systems and Concepts: Atleast 2 years experience with Multithreading, context switching, memory management related development
 - Firmware & Device Drivers: Relevant experience in Firmware, Driver development and validation in PCIE/CXL, DDR is preferred. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Proficiency in X86 and/or ARM architecture 
 - Work experience in RISC V architecture is good to have 
 - IO device drivers, firmware exposure(NIC controller, PCIe device controllers, ASIC FW development experience)
 - Experience in Spike, QEMU simulator is desirable
 - Prior working knowledge in Mambo is good to have
 - Experience in Functional validation using Emulators is desirable 
 - Relevant experience in enabling Automation for execution, triage, debug activities using AI tools and methodology is good to have.

data.title: Deputy General Manager
data.description:
To lead the overall Engineering, Maintenance, Utilities, Electrical, Instrumentation & Automation, and Projects functions of the API manufacturing facility. Ensure reliable plant operations, equipment availability, uninterrupted utilities, GMP compliance, engineering safety, cost optimization, and successful execution of capital projects. 

The DGM will provide strategic and operational leadership to multidisciplinary engineering teams while ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory, statutory, environmental, and safety requirements. 

- Key Responsibilities
 - Mechanical Engineering & Maintenance

Lead preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of all production and utility equipment. 

Ensure reliability of reactors, centrifuges, ANFDs, vacuum dryers, agitated reactors, heat exchangers, condensers, pumps, compressors, and vacuum systems. 

Manage mechanical seals, agitators, gearboxes, bearings, piping, valves, and pressure equipment. 

Develop equipment reliability strategies, preventive maintenance plans, and critical spare-parts policies. 

Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring breakdowns. 

Oversee equipment installation, overhauling, inspection, alignment, and commissioning. 

Ensure mechanical integrity and applicable statutory inspections of pressure systems and other regulated equipment. 

- Utilities Management

Lead operation and maintenance of all critical and non-critical plant utility systems. 

Ensure reliable operation of boilers, thermic fluid heaters, chillers, cooling towers, HVAC, compressed air, nitrogen, and vacuum systems. 

Manage water treatment, DM/purified water systems where applicable, ETP, solvent recovery, and associated environmental infrastructure. 

Monitor utility consumption, efficiency, reliability, and operating costs. 

Ensure preventive maintenance and qualification of critical GMP utilities where required. 

Implement energy conservation, water reduction, and utility optimization initiatives. 

Develop contingency plans for utility failures affecting production and product quality. 

- Electrical Engineering

Manage HT/LT electrical distribution, transformers, switchgear, PCC/MCC panels, DG sets, UPS, and emergency power systems. 

Ensure electrical reliability, preventive maintenance, earthing, lightning protection, and statutory compliance. 

Monitor power consumption, demand management, power factor, and electrical losses. 

Ensure suitable equipment and electrical protection for classified hazardous areas. 

Lead electrical breakdown investigations and reliability improvement programs. 

Coordinate statutory electrical inspections and safety audits. 

- Instrumentation & Automation

Lead maintenance and reliability of field instruments, transmitters, control valves, weighing systems, and sensors. 

Ensure reliable operation of PLC, DCS, SCADA, HMI, and associated automation systems. 

Establish calibration programs and maintain calibration records and equipment history. 

Ensure critical interlocks, alarms, and safety-related control systems are maintained and tested as applicable. 

Support automation upgrades, process control improvements, and system obsolescence management. 

Coordinate computerized-system qualification, access controls, audit trails, and data-integrity requirements with QA and IT, as applicable. 

- Projects, CAPEX & Engineering Development

Prepare and manage annual CAPEX plans, engineering budgets, and long-term plant development plans. 

Lead plant expansion, new production blocks, utility upgrades, equipment replacement, and infrastructure projects. 

Review engineering specifications, equipment datasheets, layouts, P&IDs, and vendor drawings. 

Manage technical bid evaluations, vendor selection, procurement coordination, erection, commissioning, and project handover. 

Ensure projects are executed within approved cost, quality, safety, and schedule requirements. 

Coordinate with Production, QA, QC, EHS, Procurement, Finance, and external consultants. 

Ensure engineering risk assessments, qualification, and validation activities are completed before GMP release, where applicable. 

- GMP, Regulatory & Quality Compliance

Ensure engineering operations comply with cGMP, approved SOPs, and applicable regulatory requirements. 

Maintain engineering documentation, including preventive maintenance records, calibration records, equipment history, utility logs, and qualification documents. 

Support USFDA, EU GMP, WHO-GMP, customer, and internal audits as applicable. 

Manage engineering deviations, change controls, CAPA, and audit observations in coordination with QA. 

Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance activities are completed within approved schedules. 

Maintain compliance with applicable environmental, electrical, boiler, fire, factory, and pressure-system regulations. 

- EHS & Process Safety

Ensure compliance with permit-to-work, LOTO, confined-space entry, hot-work, and contractor safety procedures. 

Participate in HAZOP, engineering risk assessments, process safety reviews, and incident investigations. 

Ensure safe maintenance of equipment handling flammable solvents, corrosive chemicals, and hazardous process materials. 

Monitor engineering safety performance and closure of corrective actions. 

Coordinate emergency preparedness, fire protection, and critical utility contingency planning. 

- Leadership, Budget & Operational Excellence

Lead Mechanical, Utilities, Electrical, Instrumentation, Automation, and Projects teams. 

Establish departmental KPIs, manpower plans, competency matrices, and training programs. 

Prepare annual OPEX and CAPEX budgets and control maintenance, energy, contractor, and spare-parts costs. 

Drive equipment reliability, TPM, 5S, energy conservation, and continuous improvement. 

Establish engineering performance reviews and management reporting. 

Develop successors and strengthen technical competency across engineering functions. 

- Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance area

KPI

Equipment reliability

Equipment availability and reduction in breakdowns

Maintenance

Preventive maintenance completion within approved schedule

Utilities

Utility availability and reliability

Energy

Energy and utility cost per unit of production

Electrical

Reduction in unplanned power interruptions

Instrumentation

Calibration compliance and reduction in instrument failures

GMP

Timely closure of engineering deviations, CAPA, and audit observations

Projects

CAPEX execution against approved budget and schedule

Cost control

Maintenance cost and spare-parts inventory optimization

EHS

Safety compliance and closure of engineering risk actions

- Qualification & Experience

B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline. 

Typically 18-25 years of experience in API, pharmaceutical, bulk drug, or chemical manufacturing. 

Substantial Experience Managing Multidisciplinary Engineering Functions. 

Proven experience in maintenance strategy, utility operations, plant expansion, and CAPEX projects. 

Working knowledge of cGMP, engineering qualification, calibration, change control, and regulatory audits.

data.title: Principal Quality Engineer
data.description:
Principal Quality Engineering

Company: LogiQlink Technologies Private Limited

Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Mode: On-site / Hybrid (Fully remote is not available)

Experience: 15+ Years

About LogiQlink Technologies

LogiQlink Technologies is a technology engineering and software development company specializing in building innovative, scalable, and reliable digital solutions for businesses worldwide. 

Our expertise spans software engineering, mobile and web applications, IoT, embedded systems, cloud technologies, and AI/ML solutions. We work with global clients to solve complex engineering challenges and deliver high-quality technology products. 

We are expanding our engineering capabilities and looking for an experienced Principal Quality Engineering professional to lead the design and implementation of modern quality engineering practices, automation frameworks, and AI-powered testing solutions. 

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on technical leader who can architect, develop, and implement scalable quality engineering solutions across complex software platforms. 

This role goes beyond traditional quality assurance. You will be responsible for building automation frameworks, integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines, developing reliable test infrastructure, and exploring AI-driven approaches to software quality. 

You will collaborate with engineering teams, architects, product stakeholders, and international clients to establish quality engineering standards, improve release reliability, and drive continuous improvement. 

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering skills with deep expertise in test automation, DevOps practices, and modern AI-based testing methodologies. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Engineering Strategy & Architecture

- Design and implement comprehensive test strategies across unit, API, integration, UI, end-to-end, performance, and AI evaluation testing. 
 - Establish scalable testing architectures, quality gates, and engineering best practices. 
 - Define measurable quality metrics, including test coverage, execution reliability, defect leakage, and release readiness. 
 - Identify weaknesses in existing automation systems and implement improvements. 2. Test Automation Framework Development

- Architect and build robust automation frameworks using Playwright, TypeScript, and other modern testing technologies. 
 - Develop reusable components, test fixtures, and maintainable automation libraries. 
 - Implement automated testing for REST APIs, GraphQL services, databases, and distributed systems. 
 - Ensure automation code follows software engineering best practices, including version control, code reviews, and maintainability standards. 
 - Improve test execution speed, reliability, and scalability through parallelization and efficient test design. 3. CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Design, implement, and maintain automated testing pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms. 
 - Integrate automated tests, static analysis, security checks, and quality gates into development workflows. 
 - Develop strategies for continuous testing and automated release validation. 
 - Optimize pipeline performance, execution time, and failure reporting. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineering teams to improve delivery reliability. 4. Test Infrastructure & Data Engineering

- Build and maintain reliable test environments using Docker, cloud infrastructure, and infrastructure-as-code tools. 
 - Implement automated environment provisioning, configuration, and cleanup. 
 - Develop reusable test data generation, seeding, and management solutions. 
 - Ensure deterministic and reproducible test execution across different environments. 
 - Implement secure handling of test data, credentials, and sensitive information. 5. AI-Powered Testing & Automation

- Explore and implement AI-driven quality engineering solutions to improve automation efficiency and coverage. 
 - Develop AI agents and intelligent workflows for test generation, exploratory testing, failure analysis, and defect reporting. 
 - Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into testing and engineering workflows. 
 - Implement controlled and measurable AI-assisted automation with appropriate validation and human oversight. 
 - Evaluate AI testing tools and frameworks for practical engineering use cases. 6. LLM Evaluation & AI Application Testing

- Design evaluation frameworks for applications powered by LLMs, AI agents, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). 
 - Build automated evaluation datasets, regression suites, and validation workflows. 
 - Evaluate AI system behavior for correctness, reliability, security, and performance. 
 - Test prompt handling, structured outputs, tool usage, retrieval accuracy, and edge cases. 
 - Integrate AI evaluation workflows into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous quality assurance. 7. Performance, Reliability & Observability

- Design and implement performance, load, stress, and resilience testing strategies. 
 - Establish monitoring and reporting mechanisms for automation execution and quality metrics. 
 - Analyze failures using logs, traces, execution reports, and other diagnostic information. 
 - Develop processes for identifying flaky tests, infrastructure issues, and application defects. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to improve application reliability and release confidence. 8. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to quality engineering and development teams. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote strong engineering practices. 
 - Conduct technical reviews of automation architecture, frameworks, and implementation. 
 - Work closely with international clients and senior engineering stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions. 
 - Drive adoption of reusable automation frameworks, tools, and engineering standards across projects. Required Qualifications & Experience

- 15+ years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, test automation, or related disciplines. 
 - Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise-grade automation frameworks. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise with Playwright and TypeScript. 
 - Extensive experience in API testing, integration testing, and end-to-end automation. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, object-oriented programming, and maintainable automation design. 
 - Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Experience with Docker, containerized testing environments, and cloud-based infrastructure. 
 - Experience integrating LLMs into engineering workflows, building AI agents, or implementing AI-powered testing solutions. 
 - Understanding of AI/LLM evaluation methodologies, including deterministic and probabilistic testing. 
 - Familiarity with modern DevOps practices, test infrastructure management, and automated quality gates. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 
 - Experience leading technical initiatives and mentoring engineering teams. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience collaborating with international stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Python for automation and AI-related tooling. 
 - Knowledge of SQL, database testing, GraphQL, and contract testing. 
 - Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. 
 - Familiarity with performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with RAG evaluation, AI agent orchestration, and LLM evaluation frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of security testing, authentication, authorization, and data protection practices. 
 - Experience testing distributed systems, microservices, and enterprise applications. 
 - Exposure to enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, MuleSoft, or similar technologies. What We Offer

- Opportunity to work on challenging engineering projects for international clients. 
 - Hands-on involvement in modern automation, AI, and software engineering technologies. 
 - A technical leadership role with the opportunity to influence architecture and engineering practices. 
 - A collaborative environment that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. 
 - Opportunities to develop reusable engineering solutions and contribute to expanding our technical capabilities. 
 - A flexible hybrid working arrangement for eligible candidates. 

Work Location & Arrangement

Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh

This is an Indore-based position. Candidates should be willing to work from our Indore office, with hybrid working arrangements considered based on project requirements and mutual agreement. 

Fully remote applications will not be considered. 

The role may require collaboration with international clients across different time zones. 

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through this LinkedIn job posting with their updated resume. 

We encourage applicants to highlight their experience in automation architecture, CI/CD implementation, AI-powered testing, and technical leadership. 

- Join LogiQlink Technologies and help build the next generation of intelligent, scalable, and reliable quality engineering solutions.

data.title: Assistant General Manager
data.description:
Job Purpose

To lead and manage the complete Engineering Department of an API manufacturing plant, covering Mechanical Maintenance, Utilities, Electrical, Instrumentation & Automation, Projects, and Engineering Compliance. 

The role is responsible for ensuring maximum equipment reliability, uninterrupted plant operations, regulatory compliance, energy efficiency, cost optimization, and safe operation of all plant equipment and utility systems in accordance with cGMP, EHS, and applicable statutory requirements. 

- Key Responsibilities
 - Mechanical Engineering & Maintenance

Lead preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of all mechanical equipment. 

Ensure reliable operation of reactors, centrifuges, ANFDs, dryers, condensers, heat exchangers, pumps, compressors, vacuum pumps, and agitators. 

Oversee maintenance of mechanical seals, gearboxes, bearings, valves, pipelines, and storage tanks. 

Manage equipment installation, alignment, overhauling, inspection, and commissioning. 

Develop preventive maintenance schedules, equipment history records, and critical spare-parts strategies. 

Conduct root-cause analysis of recurring breakdowns and implement CAPA. 

Coordinate statutory inspections and testing of applicable pressure vessels, boilers, lifting equipment, and other regulated systems. 

Ensure equipment integrity and compliance with relevant API, ASME, and other applicable engineering standards. 

- Utilities Management

Lead the operation, maintenance, and performance monitoring of all plant utility systems. 

Ensure uninterrupted supply of utilities to production and quality-control operations. 

Major Utilities Under Responsibility

Boilers and thermic fluid heating systems. 

Chillers, cooling towers, and chilled-water systems. 

HVAC systems, including cleanroom and controlled-area ventilation where applicable. 

Compressed air systems and instrument air. 

Vacuum systems and liquid ring vacuum pumps. 

Nitrogen generation and distribution systems. 

Water treatment, DM water, purified water, and other process-water systems as applicable. 

Effluent treatment plant (ETP), solvent recovery utilities, and associated environmental systems. 

Fire protection systems and emergency utility arrangements. 

Monitor utility consumption, operating efficiency, capacity utilization, and energy costs. 

Ensure preventive maintenance, water quality monitoring, and required utility qualification and documentation. 

Drive energy conservation, water reduction, and utility cost optimization initiatives. 

- Electrical Engineering

Manage electrical maintenance and reliability of plant electrical infrastructure. 

Ensure operation and maintenance of HT/LT panels, transformers, switchgear, PCC/MCC panels, and distribution systems. 

Oversee DG sets, UPS systems, battery banks, emergency power supplies, and power distribution. 

Monitor electrical load, power factor, energy consumption, and electrical losses. 

Ensure preventive maintenance and thermography of electrical equipment. 

Coordinate statutory electrical inspections, earthing, lightning protection, and safety compliance. 

Ensure suitable electrical equipment selection for classified hazardous areas based on applicable standards. 

Manage electrical breakdowns, power failures, and preventive actions to avoid production interruptions. 

- Instrumentation, Automation & Control Systems

Lead maintenance and reliability of plant instrumentation and automation systems. 

Manage calibration and maintenance of pressure, temperature, flow, and level instruments. 

Oversee transmitters, control valves, weighing systems, load cells, sensors, and analytical instruments within engineering scope. 

Ensure reliable operation of PLC, SCADA, DCS, HMI, and associated control systems. 

Maintain interlocks, alarms, emergency shutdown functions, and safety-related control systems as applicable. 

Coordinate calibration schedules, instrument history records, and documentation in accordance with approved procedures. 

Ensure compliance with applicable requirements for computerized systems, audit trails, access controls, and data integrity in coordination with QA and IT. 

Support qualification, validation, change control, and periodic review of automated systems. 

- Projects, Capex & Plant Expansion

Lead engineering projects involving plant expansion, new API blocks, equipment installation, and utility upgrades. 

Prepare annual capital expenditure (CAPEX) budgets, cost estimates, and project execution plans. 

Review engineering drawings, P&IDs, equipment specifications, layouts, and vendor documents. 

Coordinate with process engineering, production, QA, QC, EHS, procurement, and external consultants. 

Manage equipment selection, technical bid evaluations, purchase orders, fabrication, erection, and commissioning. 

Ensure project execution within approved budgets, timelines, quality standards, and safety requirements. 

Lead design reviews, risk assessments, commissioning, and engineering handover. 

Ensure appropriate qualification and validation activities before equipment or systems are released for GMP use. 

- GMP, Regulatory & Compliance

Ensure engineering systems comply with applicable cGMP requirements and approved site procedures. 

Maintain engineering SOPs, preventive maintenance records, calibration records, equipment history files, and utility documentation. 

Support USFDA, EU GMP, WHO-GMP, customer, and internal audits as applicable to the site. 

Manage engineering deviations, change controls, CAPA, and audit observations in coordination with QA. 

Ensure critical utilities and equipment are qualified, maintained, and monitored according to approved procedures. 

Ensure calibration and maintenance activities are documented and completed within approved timelines. 

Maintain compliance with applicable environmental, electrical, boiler, fire, and factory safety regulations. 

- EHS, Process Safety & Risk Management

Ensure safe maintenance practices through permit-to-work, LOTO, confined-space entry, and hot-work controls. 

Coordinate HAZOP recommendations, engineering risk assessments, and process safety reviews. 

Ensure safe maintenance of equipment handling flammable solvents, corrosive chemicals, and hazardous process materials. 

Review mechanical integrity, pressure-system safety, fire protection, and emergency preparedness. 

Investigate engineering-related incidents and implement corrective and preventive actions. 

Promote a strong safety culture among employees, contractors, and service providers. 

- Team Leadership & Cost Management

Lead Mechanical, Utility, Electrical, Instrumentation, Automation, and Project Engineering teams. 

Establish departmental objectives, performance indicators, maintenance plans, and manpower requirements. 

Develop training programs and competency matrices for engineers, technicians, and contractors. 

Prepare annual OPEX and CAPEX budgets and monitor actual expenditure. 

Control maintenance costs, spare-parts inventory, contractor costs, and equipment lifecycle costs.

data.title: VP Engineering
data.description:
The Job in short

You raise the engineering bar across Product & Platform - and you do it from Hyderabad as the senior craft and standards leader for our India superhub. You set what "good" means for how we build software, hold teams to it, and make Hyderabad a place the rest of Engineering takes cues from: talent density, technical judgment, and delivery discipline. 

Meet the job

As VP Engineering, You Own Engineering Excellence For Our Product Development Organisation Globally, With Hyderabad As Your Primary Stage. You Will

- Set and enforce global standards for engineering practice and Secure SDLC - what ships, what gets blocked, and how quality and predictability are measured across product teams. 
 - Be the lighthouse for the Hyderabad superhub: raise the local hiring and performance bar, build Staff+ talent density, and make the hub a visible benchmark for craft and accountability across Engineering. 
 - Own the engineering career framework and learning paths with engineering leadership so progression, calibration, and technical depth are consistent worldwide - and unmistakably strong in Hyderabad. 
 - Act with clear bar authority: advise product engineering leaders on architecture, quality, and delivery, and escalate or stop work when standards, security, or craft are at risk. 
 - Partner with Engineering Operations on developer experience, CI/CD, and AI-assisted workflows so tooling reinforces the bar rather than bypasses it. 
 - Scale excellence through chapters, mentorship, and targeted enablement - only where it hardens standards and talent, not as theatre. 

How about you?

We need a high-caliber engineering leader who has raised the bar in large, multi-site organisations - and who wants Hyderabad to be their proof point. You combine deep technical credibility with the backbone to reset culture where "yes" has outrun "done. "

- 10+ years of engineering leadership, with a proven record raising standards across organisations of 500+ engineers in multiple locations. 
 - Track record of hard resets: hiring bar, performance calibration, architecture/quality gates, and holding delivery pressure accountable to craft - not just running guilds or frameworks. 
 - Hands-on enough to pair in code and credible across web, mobile, and backend when guiding engineers and architects. 
 - Strong product sense: UX, business logic, and non-functionals - you know what good looks like end-to-end. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of career frameworks, engineering standards, and Secure SDLC in financial services or other regulated environments. 
 - Experience building or transforming a major engineering hub (or equivalent multi-site centre of excellence) - attracting senior talent and making that site a magnet, not a cost centre. 
 - Driven AI adoption in real product development, with judgment about where it raises quality and where it does not. 
 - A clear communicator who can set a vision, say no with reasons, and rally leaders around shared standards and commitments.

data.description:
Company Description

About Sopra Steria

Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51, 000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end-to-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5. 6 billion. 

Job Description

The world is how we shape it. 

The role is the technical lead for production operations within an international L1/L2/L3 organisation. They operate an existing AWS platform, understand its components and dependencies, and personally diagnose and resolve complex incidents. They work with the SDM, L1/L2, Build teams and specialist experts. The SDM organises and manages the service; L3 owns technical diagnosis and resolution. The role requires a hands-on Production/SRE profile with proven AWS expertise in production, an end-to-end view of the business application and its flows, and a high level of autonomy from the start to secure operations and prepare transitions. 

Incidents and Service Restoration

- Provide L3 support for complex incidents escalated by L2. 
 - Handle P1/P2 incidents in the crisis bridge and provide technical diagnosis. 
 - Investigate applications and flows end to end: front/back end, APIs, microservices, Kubernetes, middleware, networking, data and AWS services. 
 - Analyse and correlate logs, metrics, events and changes to locate failures. 
 - Understand business consequences and prioritise recovery actions. 
 - Perform appropriate fixes or recovery operations, engage the required experts and verify service restoration. 

Prevention and Operability

- Lead RCA, document causes and define measures to prevent recurrence. 
 - Define probes, metrics, thresholds and preventive checks based on component and flow knowledge. 
 - Challenge Build teams on operability, configurations, observability, resilience and production risks. 
 - Support the operational acceptance of new components. 

Automation and Knowledge Transfer

- Define and evolve technical standards and operating practices. 
 - Standardise and automate recurring operations. 
 - Structure runbooks, documentation and knowledge transfer. 
 - Guide L1/L2 and strengthen their autonomy. 

Technical Skills

- Observability: direct use of Elastic/Kibana and CloudWatch for monitoring, investigation and correlation. 
 - Applications: front/back end, REST APIs/API Gateway, microservices, data flows and dependencies. 
 - Messaging and events: SQS, EventBridge and understanding of interactions with Kafka/Confluent. 
 - AWS infrastructure: EC2, Auto Scaling, IAM, S3/EFS, VPC, Route 53, ALB/NLB, Transit Gateway and cross-account traffic. 
 - Databases: PostgreSQL/Aurora investigation in a production context. 
 - Automation: Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and Bash/Python scripting. 
 - Containers: strong Kubernetes/EKS troubleshooting and end-to-end application understanding. 
 - Data exchange: production data exchange, ideally AWS Transfer Family/SFTP, including exchange and dependency troubleshooting. 
 - Lambda: hands-on Lambda operations and troubleshooting of interactions with other services. 
 - Preferred: AS2, Docker/Helm, GitOps/ArgoCD. Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry can complement observability. Kafka/Confluent skills can be developed with support from the existing team. 

Certifications

- Mandatory: AWS certification, supported by significant and recent AWS production experience. 
 - Preferred: Kubernetes certifications and advanced or professional AWS certifications. 

Required Experience

- Significant, recent AWS production experience. 
 - Operation of business-critical applications and personal handling of major P1/P2 incidents. 
 - Deep expertise in at least one core component, ideally one or two, combined with broad production support coverage and end-to-end understanding of dependencies. 
 - Transfer Family and Lambda are particularly sought; strong production data exchange experience on another solution remains relevant. 
 - Experience assembling, operating and troubleshooting multiple cloud services, including in startup environments. A smaller platform may be relevant if its dependencies and operational challenges are comparable. 
 - Must confirm personal incident actions, architecture and flow understanding, observability tools used and preventive practices, and be able to explain decisions and ask relevant operability questions. 
 - A background focused only on Build, architecture, lift and shift, infrastructure or CI/CD is insufficient. 
 - A mainly Azure profile does not meet AWS requirements. AWS expertise is needed from the start; this assignment is not for learning AWS fundamentals. 
 - Autonomy, production reflexes, analytical thinking, technical decision-making, clear communication and awareness of business impact. 
 - Professional English is required. French is optional. 

Total Experience Expected: 08-10 years

Qualifications

BE/B. Tech

Additional Information

At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences. 

All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, 2-3 days in the office. You will be required to interview in person. 

About SailPoint

SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots. 

Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale. 

About the Role

As a Staff Software Engineer on Human Agentic Fabric team you will act as a senior technical leader architecting, designing, and building highly scalable, resilient distributed systems. In this role, your typical day involves leading significant hands-on backend software development in Java and GoLang, designing event-driven microservices capable of handling massive daily transaction volumes, and collaborating cross-functionally with Product Management and architecture teams to translate complex business requirements into elegant technical solutions. You will champion engineering excellence, set architectural vision, advocate for best practices across teams, and mentor engineers to build high-performance cloud security systems at global scale. 

About the Team

You will join a high-velocity, collaborative engineering team based in Pune, India, working in close partnership with our US-based engineering teams. We are passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges across a modern, multi-tenant SaaS platform built on cloud-native microservices hosted in AWS. Our team fosters a culture of technical rigor, continuous innovation, mutual trust, and ownership, empowering every engineer to make a lasting impact on our core product offerings. 

Roadmap for Success

- 30 days: Complete SailPoint engineering onboarding, configure your development environment, and gain a thorough understanding of the IdentityNow multi-tenant microservices architecture and deployment pipelines. Shadow team members during sprint ceremonies, review architectural documentation, and deliver your first backend code contribution in Java or GoLang following SailPoint's testing and CI/CD standards. 

- 60 days: Partner with Product Management, technical leads, and engineering peers to define technical specifications and architectural designs for upcoming high-throughput service capabilities. Design, implement, and deploy end-to-end microservice enhancements, establishing robust unit and integration test coverage. 

- 90 days: Independently drive the technical design and execution of complex service components across Java and GoLang codebases. Proactively identify performance bottlenecks, optimize database queries and event-streaming pipelines (Kafka, Redis), and lead constructive peer code reviews. 

- 6 months: Define and drive forward-looking technical roadmaps for your service domain, reducing system latency and scaling services to support rapid customer growth. Participate in the engineering on-call rotation to support platform reliability, diagnose complex production escalations, and partner with services teams to review solution architecture. 

- 1 year: Serve as a primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) on distributed systems design, asynchronous workflows, and microservice scalability across the organization. Establish design patterns and coding guardrails across teams, champion AI-assisted engineering practices, and actively mentor junior and mid-level engineers to elevate technical excellence across the Pune engineering hub.

- Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience

- 8+ years of professional software development experience building enterprise-grade software products

- 5+ years of hands-on experience developing software in Java, with demonstrated experience leading engineering initiatives and setting technical direction

- Hands-on proficiency and professional experience developing scalable services in GoLang

- 2+ years of experience architecting and developing web applications and microservices in a high-scale, distributed cloud environment

- Solid hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies (such as MySQL, Postgres, DynamoDB, Aurora, and Hibernate or other ORM frameworks)

- Proven experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures utilizing messaging systems and queues (such as Apache Kafka and Redis)

- Strong background in automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS)

- Exceptional communication and collaboration skills with a proven track record of mentoring engineers and driving cross-functional alignment

AI-assisted engineering: 

Our engineers are expected to use AI development tools as a core part of their daily workflow, not as a novelty. We expect you to use these tools to accelerate delivery, expand your scope, and raise the quality bar, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything that ships under your name. Comfort with prompting, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated code is a baseline expectation for this role.

- Cursor, Claude Code

With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals. Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

Job Description

About the Role: Freshworks is building next-generation AI-driven customer and employee engagement platforms. As a Principal Engineer - Machine Learning on our AI/ML Engineering team, you will drive the architecture and technical strategy for core backend services powering our Agentic AI Platform. You will lead the development of reasoning-driven agents, multi-agent orchestration, and outcome-based workflows that directly power autonomous AI capability across our suite of enterprise products. This role is pivotal in establishing engineering standards, scaling backend infrastructure, and mentoring senior engineers as we expand our agentic capabilities at enterprise scale. 

What You'll Do

- Drive Platform & Runtime Architecture: Lead the architectural design and execution of agent runtime orchestration services, focusing on reasoning, planning, tool invocation, and low-latency execution. 

- Define API & SDK Standards: Design and establish robust, developer-friendly APIs and SDKs that enable internal engineering teams and external ecosystem partners to build, deploy, and manage complex agent workflows. 

- Architect Stateful & Memory Systems: Build and optimize stateful dialog management, shared context systems, and memory services for multi-turn, context-aware autonomous agents. 

- Implement Multi-Agent Communication Protocols: Establish scalable agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, coordination patterns, and shared memory spaces for distributed multi-agent workflows. 

- Lead Cloud-Native Microservices Migration: Drive the transition toward cloud-native, event-driven backend services using modern microservices, service mesh, and event-streaming architectures. 

- Optimize LLM Performance & Cost Efficiency: Design and implement LLM orchestration optimizations-including semantic caching, dynamic batching, token monitoring, and intelligent model routing-to ensure high performance and cost governance. 

- Own Integrations & Observability: Direct the implementation of enterprise RAG pipelines, vector database integrations (e. g. , Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS), and deep LangSmith/OpenTelemetry tracing for end-to-end evaluation and visibility. 

- Drive Technical Excellence & Mentorship: Establish rigorous standards for automated testing (unit, integration, load), tenant isolation (RBAC, multi-tenancy), and provide technical mentorship to elevate engineering capabilities across the team. 

Qualifications

Must Have: 

- Experience: 12-18 years of progressive software engineering and machine learning system development experience, with a track record of architecting scalable enterprise backend systems. 

- Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in Java and Python, with hands-on expertise building production systems using agentic orchestration frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith) and workflow engines (e. g. , Temporal, Airflow). 

- Distributed Systems Expertise: Advanced understanding of event-driven architectures, microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka, AWS cloud infrastructure, and mixed database paradigms (PostgreSQL, Vector DBs). 

- Execute with Excellence: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex architectural bottlenecks, anticipate technical risks, and connect cross-functional dependencies to deliver high-impact engineering initiatives at scale. 

- Lead with Vision & Strategy: Demonstrated capability in translating complex business and AI goals into actionable long-term platform roadmaps while influencing technical decisions across cross-functional engineering partners. 

- Cultivate a Growth Mindset: A track record of identifying innovative tools, challenging assumptions, and driving technical continuous improvement across the broader engineering organization. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with AI-driven planning systems, dialog state tracking, or reinforcement learning feedback loops in production environments. 

- Hands-on experience with enterprise security frameworks, including SSO, OAuth2, RBAC, and multi-tenant data isolation. 

- Active involvement in open-source AI/ML projects or contributions to major LLM/orchestration libraries. 

Additional Information

Please note this is a hybrid role that requires an in-office presence 3 days / week (Tue-Thu). 

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Core Competencies

- A healthier technical foundation: clearer ownership, better observability, fewer repeat incidents, faster safe releases. 
 - A team that attracts and retains strong engineers-and ships modernization milestones on a credible cadence. 
 - A small set of high-confidence AI wins (operations and/or product) with documented guardrails and measurable outcomes. 
 - How you work Systems thinking, decisive prioritization, calm under ambiguity, and executive-ready communication. You raise the bar by clarifying standards, not by adding process for its own sake. 

Preferences

- Domain familiarity with advisor/practice onboarding, compensation, registration/licensing workflows, or fee/billing platforms. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, APIs, event-driven patterns, and pragmatic microservices where they earn their complexity. 
 - Background shaping CI/CD, automated testing strategy, SRE practices, incident learning, and engineering metrics. 
 - Familiarity with model/workflow governance, monitoring, and responsible AI practices in enterprise settings. 
 - Experience with . NET / C# and cloud-native engineering on AWS (compute, data, messaging/integration, identity patterns, observability). 
 - Comfort with Python for automation, services, or data/AI-adjacent workloads.

- Cultivate a Growth Mindset: A track record of identifying innovative tools, challenging assumptions, and driving technical continuous improvement across the broader engineering organization. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with AI-driven planning systems, dialog state tracking, or reinforcement learning feedback loops in production environments. 

- Hands-on experience with enterprise security frameworks, including SSO, OAuth2, RBAC, and multi-tenant data isolation. 

- Active involvement in open-source AI/ML projects or contributions to major LLM/orchestration libraries.

Please note this is a hybrid role that requires an in-office presence 3 days / week (Tue-Thu).

data.title: QA Engineer - Contract
data.description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces-and human experiences-at massive scale. 

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. 

This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location. 

Role Description: 

Plume crafts new-to-planet experiences built on top of the world's best performing home WiFi system. Plume is committed to powering operator services beyond traditional voice, video and data. We believe that the core competitive advantage in the over-the-top era resides in your ability to create new services at high cadence, deploy them at massive scale, and to orchestrate through a common data set. We architected the Plume Platform As a Service (PaaS) precisely with this intent. 

We are looking for experienced Wi-Fi and Platform Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs) to help ensure that the products we deliver meet our customers' quality expectations. The ideal candidate is a talented engineer who demonstrates initiative, adaptability to a challenging environment, strong problem-solving and communication skills, and a solid understanding of QA processes and test automation. 

Responsibilities: 

- Design, document, and execute test plans for Wi-Fi connectivity, performance, stability, and functionality. 
 - Develop and maintain Python-based test automation to improve coverage and reduce regression cycles. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, and system testing across Wi-Fi, networking, and embedded platforms. 
 - Test and troubleshoot 802. 11 protocols, Layer 2/3 networking, routing, VLAN, NAT, DNS, and DHCP. 
 - Reproduce, debug, and root-cause complex field and system-level defects. 
 - Use tools such as Wireshark for packet analysis and network troubleshooting. 
 - Collaborate with software, firmware, and QA teams to define test strategies and deliver high-quality products. 
 - Participate in feature/design discussions and contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes. 

Qualifications: 

- 3 - 5 years of experience in QA, SDET, or Software Test Engineering, preferably in Wi-Fi, networking or IoT. 
 - Strong understanding of Wi-Fi (802. 11) and networking fundamentals. 
 - Hands-on experience with embedded/router platforms and hardware test environments. 
 - Strong Python scripting and test automation skills. 
 - Experience with Wireshark and network troubleshooting. 
 - Familiarity with RDK-B, prplOS, OpenWrt, or similar Linux-based router platforms is a plus. 
 - Knowledge of TR-369/USP, TR-181, TR-069/TR-098 
 - Experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Postman, or similar QA/CI tools is a plus. 
 - Strong debugging, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills. . 

Education: 

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J: COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture. 

Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

data.description:
Company Description Unite Trades & Technologies (UTNT) specializes in material export and technical instruments, serving scientific and industrial communities worldwide. With over 20 years of experience in scientific and laboratory instruments, the team provides integrated solutions, supply, installation, verification, and ongoing maintenance. UTNT designs and delivers monitoring solutions and instrumentation for research and applications in environment, hydrology, water quality, agriculture, glaciology, geotechnical engineering, cryosphere studies, and more. The company focuses on long-term partnerships, offering dedicated technical services to help clients streamline complex instrumentation setups. Backed by strong technical expertise and a professional, efficient team, UTNT supports comprehensive technical business operations for customers and partners. 

Role Description The Test Engineer - Electronics Hardware & Operation role is a full-time, on-site position based in Gurugram. The Test Engineer will plan, design, and execute tests for electronic hardware and related systems used in scientific and monitoring instruments. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing and reviewing test cases, performing functional and regression testing, documenting test results, and identifying, analyzing, and reporting defects. The role involves collaborating with design, production, and service teams to validate hardware performance, support troubleshooting, and ensure instruments meet quality, safety, and operational standards. The Test Engineer will also assist in test procedure optimization, test tool selection, and continuous improvement of testing processes. 

Qualifications

- Strong foundation in test engineering, including experience with electronic hardware and instrumentation. 
 - Ability to design and manage test cases and test plans, with hands-on experience in test execution. 
 - Practical knowledge of testing methodologies, including functional testing for hardware and integrated systems. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related technical field. 
 - Familiarity with laboratory and scientific instruments used in environmental, hydrology, or related applications is an advantage. 
 - Proficiency with measurement tools, test equipment, and basic diagnostic software used for hardware validation. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and clear documentation practices. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical findings effectively. 
 - Willingness to work on-site in Gurugram and support field installations or validations when required. 
 - Validate and test custom PCBs, sensors, and data logging devices against technical specifications. 
 - Diagnose, troubleshoot hardware failures down to component level. 
 - Read and interpret electrical schematics, board layouts, and component datasheets. 
 - Utilize standard lab equipment including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and variable power supplies. 
 - Analyze communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, RS-485 and analog signals. 
 - Should know basic programming in C/C++. 
 - Measure current usage in low power device states / deep sleep modes. 
 - Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related field.

Requirements

 - Experience with Guidewire Jutro Framework (Producer Engage or JDP) is a plus

Agile Delivery and Collaboration

data.description:
Job Summary

Medline India is seeking a Senior Manager - Platform Engineering to lead the platform, reliability, quality, release, ITGC compliance, automation, AI adoption, and engineering enablement capabilities for the Supply Chain Technology portfolio. The role will establish a scalable operating model for shared engineering services, improve availability and delivery predictability, and accelerate modernization of business-critical supply chain platforms, including cloud migration and technical upgrades. 

Job Description

Scope

- Own the strategy, roadmap, operating model, budget inputs, talent plan, and measurable outcomes for Platform Engineering across Supply Chain Technology. 
 - Lead managers, technical leads, and engineers across Platform Services, FinOps, BI analytics, Release Management, ITGC compliance, AI Adoption, Automation, and QA Automation. 
 - Partner with application leaders, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, IT Risk, Product Management, and business stakeholders to prioritize platform investments. 
 - Create clear service ownership, engineering standards, controls, metrics, and escalation paths for services used across the SCT portfolio. 
 - Build a succession and capability-development plan that supports current delivery while preparing the organization for cloud, AI, and automation-led growth. 

Responsibilities

- Platform strategy and services: Own shared platform capabilities, including DevOps, cloud enablement, developer tooling, integration patterns, observability, and reusable services that reduce duplication and improve delivery speed across SCT. 
 - FinOps: Drive cloud cost governance and optimization of cloud infrastructure, as an independent capability or within Platform Services, based on portfolio alignment. 
 - Site reliability engineering: Expand the reliability function from reactive support toward SLOs, error budgets, observability, resilience, capacity planning, incident prevention, problem management, and measurable reliability improvements. 
 - ITGC compliance: Establish dedicated ownership for control evidence, vulnerability remediation, change and access controls, audit readiness, and security certificate management in partnership with Cybersecurity and IT Risk. 
 - AI adoption and engineering productivity: Establish governed AI-assisted engineering use cases, reusable accelerators, adoption metrics, responsible-use controls, and workforce enablement; support customization and upgrades of AI-DLC frameworks. 
 - Performance management and BI: Define meaningful metrics, not only reports, and develop actionable dashboards and insights for availability, performance, capacity, quality, cost, delivery flow, and service health; drive action from trend analysis. 
 - Release management: Standardize release readiness, change governance, deployment controls, rollback planning, cross-team communication, and patch management to improve release predictability across applications. 
 - Automation: Build a dedicated automation capability, including Factory AI and UI-driven automation, to automate build, test, deployment, environment provisioning, operational tasks, compliance evidence, and repetitive support activities. 
 - Quality engineering: Lead quality strategy, test automation, functional and non-functional testing, environment and data readiness, defect prevention, and engineering quality gates. 

Required Experience And Skills

- BE/BTech or equivalent with 15+ years in IT, including significant leadership of platform engineering, application engineering, reliability, quality, or shared technology services. 
 - Experience leading managers and multidisciplinary engineering teams in a global, matrixed enterprise environment. 
 - Demonstrated success with cloud migration and modernization, preferably Microsoft Azure, including architecture, reliability, security, cost governance, and FinOps practices. 
 - Strong knowledge of DevSecOps and CI/CD practices using tools such as Azure DevOps, Git, Jenkins, automated testing, infrastructure as code, and observability platforms. 
 - Working knowledge of API and integration platforms such as Azure API Management, WSO2, plus Java, Oracle, databases, networking, and security fundamentals. 
 - Experience with SRE, SLOs, incident/problem management, release and change governance, quality engineering, test automation, ITGC, audit readiness, and performance management. 
 - Ability to influence senior leaders, translate technical investment into business outcomes, manage competing priorities, and communicate risk, options, and decisions clearly. 
 - Proven ability to hire, coach, retain, and develop high-performing teams and establish clear accountability across distributed groups. 

Success Measures

- Improved platform availability, reliability, recoverability, and incident prevention. 
 - Faster and more predictable releases with stronger automation, quality gates, and rollback readiness. 
 - Reduced technical debt and improved currency of frameworks, platforms, and critical dependencies.
