data.title: Lead, Quality
data.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Difference You Will Make

The Quality Lead plays a critical role in supporting the day-to-day activities of the Aircover Quality program from the Airbnb India (ACC) site. This role sets the standard for excellence in Quality across the Aircover organization and requires a proactive, detail-oriented professional who can operate credibly across both partner-facing and internal audiences. 

Reporting to the Aircover Quality Manager, the QA supports quality performance across the entire partner QA network. Within this remit and without being dedicated to any single team the QA also supports the internal Aircover Claims Experience (ACE) and Service Recovery team, along with their respective stakeholders. 

Across both, the QA partners with internal stakeholders to drive continuous improvement, through transaction monitoring, calibration, root cause analysis, business case development, and reporting, ensuring all assigned work is completed within deadlines. The QA also provides Quality support for new Aircover launches and products, helping stand up monitoring and quality guardrails as the program evolves (e. g. , new coverage, customer segmentation). 

As an ambassador of our brand, you will uphold the highest customer service standards, championing excellence and process optimization across teams and time zones. 

A Typical Day

- Support and monitor the performance of the partner QA team, ensuring their transaction monitoring and audits align with agreed Aircover quality standards, targets, and methodologies. 
 - Conduct spot checks / audit-the-auditor reviews on partner QA outputs and report findings and recommendations to the QA Lead and partner stakeholders. 
 - Lead and participate in calibration sessions with the partner QA teams and internal teams to ensure scoring consistency and shared understanding of quality forms and guidelines. 
 - Analyze, report, and present quality transaction monitoring findings to inform program, regional, and site-level performance. 
 - Identify trends and propose action plans to drive continuous improvement based on QA and Ops dashboard results. 
 - Provide recommendations related to Product, Policy, Process, and People to the appropriate stakeholders, and track/review submitted recommendations monthly with the internal QI team. 
 - Work with partner QA leads and internal stakeholders to close performance gaps, strengthen coaching quality, and improve first-time-right resolution. 
 - Conduct executive escalation root cause analysis in line with targets, providing Product, Policy, Process, and People recommendations to the appropriate stakeholders. 
 - Proactively and on request, design and lead deep-dive projects to enhance service quality and reduce recurrence of high-severity incidents. 
 - Collaborate with key stakeholders, Aircover QAs, and frontline specialists to gain insight into deep dives and executive escalations. 

New Launches & Products

- Provide Quality support for new Aircover launches and product rollouts, including pre-launch readiness and post-launch event QA support. 
 - Help define and stand up quality forms, sampling methodologies, and monitoring guardrails for new coverage, tools, or customer segments. 

Cross-Functional & Program Support

- Identify opportunities to improve the Quality program (e. g. , quality forms/guides, sampling methodologies). 
 - Potentially represent Quality in cross-functional forums such as OCM, BPI, and Training, providing project support. 
 - Engage in ongoing Aircover training, work on a minimum of one claim each month, and stay current with best practices. 

Your Expertise

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience. 
 - 7 plus experience in Quality Assurance, Customer Experience, Claims Operations, or a related operational field. 
 - Experience supporting, managing, or governing Quality programs within Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) environments. 
 - Strong track record of conducting root cause analyses, identifying trends and opportunities, presenting insights to stakeholders and leadership, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Experience developing and leveraging quality reporting, dashboards, and data visualization tools to inform decision-making (e. g. , Tableau, Google Sheets, Excel, Salesforce, or similar platforms). 
 - Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams, including Product, Policy, Operations, Training, and other business partners. 
 - Experience supporting large-scale process improvements, program launches, or operational projects is highly preferred. 

Your Skills

- Deep expertise in Aircover Claims Support: Specialist behavioral expectations and a thorough understanding of Aircover processes, policies, and products (e. g. , Aircare, HDP, HLI). 
 - Partner/Stakeholder Management: Ability to support and influence a BPO partner QA function and internal stakeholders, driving alignment without direct authority. 
 - Analysis & Research: Strong ability to comprehend, analyze, and investigate cases, workflows, and documentation; proficient in root cause analysis, critical thinking, and attention to detail. 
 - Excellence & Accountability: Consistently set and uphold the highest standards for work quality while holding yourself and others accountable. 
 - Collaboration: Skilled at working across cross-functional and cross-site teams to drive alignment and improvements. 
 - Presenting & Influencing: Distill complex ideas into clear, concise insights and engaging, digestible reports and presentations. 
 - Coaching & Feedback: Objectively assess performance, provide constructive feedback, and tailor coaching to different audiences. 
 - Solving Problems: Quickly identify root causes and hidden issues, using logical reasoning and available resources to develop effective solutions. 
 - Calibration & Consistency: Facilitate calibration and maintain scoring consistency across internal and partner QA teams. 
 - Time Management & Prioritization: Efficiently prioritize high-impact work while staying organized across multiple responsibilities. 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. 

How We'll Take Care Of You

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. 

India Annual Pay Range

₹1, 610, 000-₹2, 110, 000 INR

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. 

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb's hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb's Career's Page at careers. airbnb. com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb. com or @ext. airbnb. com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We'll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

data.title: Data QA Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data QA Engineer based in India. 

As a Data QA Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and quality of data delivered to customers across a range of web scraping and AI-assisted projects. You will take ownership of quality assurance from the early stages of project development, translating customer requirements into clear and effective testing strategies. Combining exploratory testing, automated validation, and data analysis, you will identify inconsistencies, detect defects, and help prevent quality issues before they reach production. You will work closely with developers, project managers, QA leadership, and customers to establish measurable quality standards and continuously improve testing practices. Using Python, SQL, and modern testing technologies, you will turn complex data into actionable quality insights. Joining a globally distributed and collaborative team, you will enjoy the autonomy to improve processes and contribute to innovative data solutions. 

Accountabilities

- Translate customer data extraction and web scraping requirements into clear, measurable testing strategies, taking ownership of quality assurance from the beginning of new projects. 
 - Design and execute comprehensive test plans combining exploratory, manual, visual, and automated testing approaches according to project needs. 
 - Perform regular testing cycles on extracted datasets to validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability. 
 - Identify, investigate, document, and report defects with clear reproduction steps and sufficient technical detail to enable developers to resolve issues efficiently. 
 - Apply descriptive statistics, data summaries, and visualizations to assess data quality, identify anomalies, and monitor potential data drift. 
 - Prepare detailed test reports and quality scores, providing internal stakeholders and customers with an accurate understanding of project quality and potential risks. 
 - Clearly communicate testing coverage, limitations, unresolved issues, and remaining risks throughout the delivery process. 
 - Collaborate with project managers and customers to clarify requirements, identify ambiguities, and ensure that expectations are measurable and testable before QA activities begin. 
 - Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of test automation frameworks, focusing on test coverage, reliability, and performance. 
 - Identify and implement improvements to QA processes and tools, including browser extensions, spreadsheet add-ons, and user-interface-based testing solutions. 
 - Work closely with QA leadership, developers, and project managers to maintain high-quality standards while operating with a high degree of independence. 

Requirements

- At least 5 years of professional experience as a QA Engineer or in a comparable quality assurance role, preferably involving software testing, data validation, or data quality. 
 - Strong Python programming skills, ideally with practical experience using Pandas and Jupyter Notebook for data analysis, processing, and validation. 
 - Basic to intermediate SQL knowledge, with the ability to write queries and work confidently with at least one relational database and its associated tools. 
 - Solid understanding of web technologies and protocols, including HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP, and CSS. 
 - Practical experience designing and executing tests for HTTP and REST APIs. 
 - Strong knowledge of test case design, test planning, test execution, and test data management. 
 - Understanding of key data quality concepts, including completeness, accuracy, consistency, reliability, and data drift. 
 - Experience working in Agile development environments, including Scrum or Kanban, and collaborating closely with software developers. 
 - Familiarity with AI and Large Language Model (LLM) tools, particularly their application in generating test cases, accelerating data validation, and improving QA workflows. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to quality ownership. 
 - Ability to quickly understand complex project requirements, learn new technologies, and adapt to changing priorities. 
 - Confidence in maintaining high-quality standards and raising concerns when delivery timelines or project pressures could compromise quality. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. 

Nice To Have

- Working knowledge of Scrapy and other Python-based web scraping frameworks. 
 - Previous experience developing or working with test automation frameworks. 
 - Interest or experience in data science concepts, particularly as applied to data analysis, interpretation, and validation. 
 - Enthusiasm for exploring AI and LLM-powered tools to improve testing efficiency and accelerate data quality assessments. 

Benefits

- Fully Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom and flexibility to work from anywhere in the world, choosing the environment where you are most productive. 
 - Generous Paid Leave: Benefit from 35 days of paid holidays per year, supporting a healthy work-life balance. 
 - International Team: Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, and multicultural team of more than 250 professionals distributed across over 28 countries. 
 - Innovative Technologies: Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies, modern tools, and innovative data extraction solutions. 
 - Flexible Working Environment: Enjoy the autonomy and flexibility to organize your work in a way that supports productivity and personal wellbeing. 
 - Professional Growth: Develop your technical expertise by working on challenging data quality projects alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative environment.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

The Skills You Need

Demonstrated ability to build trust, remove barriers, and help others succeed while maintaining clear expectations and accountability

 - Strong system-level judgment and the ability to guide investigations spanning silicon, boards, embedded firmware, test software, and measurement equipment.

Preferred qualifications

data.description:
Job Description- Lead-Quality Assurance

Position: Lead - Quality Assurance & Quality Control (QA/QC)

Company: Enweigh India Pvt. Ltd

Department: Quality Assurance & Quality Control

Experience: 7-8 Years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance/Quality Control. Experience in EPC, industrial equipment manufacturing, process plants, skid packages, instrumentation systems or power/chemical/oil & gas industries. 

Qualification: B. E. /B. Tech. in Electrical & Instrumentation / Instrumentation / Electrical Engineering

Reporting To: Head - Operations / Operations & Projects

Location: Vasai, Andheri-Mumbai

Employment type- Full Time

Gender-Male/Female. 

We are looking for the experienced and motivated Lead-Quality Assurance having 07-08 years of work experience preferably from Boiler Industry, Process Industry, Chemical, Oil & Ga and Power Industry. 

JOB DESCRIPTION

1. Role Objective

The Lead - Quality Assurance & Quality Control will be responsible for establishing, implementing and maintaining the company's overall Quality Management System and ensuring quality compliance across all project activities, including engineering, procurement, manufacturing, assembly, inspection, testing and project execution. The position will act as the primary quality coordination interface between internal departments, vendors, third-party inspection agencies and clients. 

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

Prepare, review and implement project-specific Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs), Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) and inspection procedures. 

Develop QAPs covering mechanical skids, piping, structural fabrication, electrical panels, instrumentation, cabling and control systems. 

Review client specifications, purchase orders, approved drawings and applicable quality requirements before initiating project activities. 

Ensure compliance with applicable EN standards, CE requirements and other relevant international codes. 

3. Vendor Quality Management & Inspection Coordination

Coordinate with vendors and suppliers for quality requirements, inspections and documentation. 

Review vendor quality plans, inspection procedures, material test certificates and technical documentation. 

Plan and coordinate vendor inspections, stage inspections, pre-dispatch inspections and Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs). 

Ensure inspection requests are raised on time, and inspections are completed as per approved QAPs and project schedules. 

Monitor vendor quality performance and initiate corrective actions wherever required. 

4. Inspection, Testing & FAT

Coordinate and witness mechanical, electrical and instrumentation inspections and testing activities. 

Ensure inspection and testing of fabricated skids, piping, pressure components, electrical panels, instruments and control systems as per QAPs. 

Verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, datasheets and applicable standards. 

Coordinate FAT activities for electrical panels, PLC/control systems, instrumentation and complete skid packages. 

Ensure proper recording of inspection observations, test results and client approvals. 

Ensure timely closure of client and third-party inspection observations before material dispatch. 

5. Quality Documentation & Project Quality Dossier

Prepare, compile, review and maintain complete project-specific Quality Documentation Dossiers

Ensure dossiers are prepared in accordance with client specifications and contractual requirements. 

Ensure final quality dossiers are submitted to clients within agreed project timelines. 

6. Non-Conformance Management & CAPA

Identify, document and manage internal and external Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs). 

Coordinate with concerned departments and vendors for root cause analysis. 

Prepare and implement Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans. 

7. ISO 9001: 2015 - Quality Management System

Maintain and continuously improve the company's ISO 9001: 2015 Quality Management System. 

Ensure proper control of documents and records across departments. 

Coordinate internal quality audits, external audits and surveillance audits. 

Knowledge of applicable European and international standards-

EN standards relevant to mechanical and electrical equipment. 

CE marking requirements and applicable EU directives/regulations. 

EN 60204-1 - Safety of Machinery: Electrical Equipment of Machines. 

IEC 61439 - Low-voltage switchgear and control gear assemblies. 

Relevant ISO standards and project-specific codes. 

Required Skills & Competencies

Strong technical understanding of electrical and instrumentation systems. 

Good understanding of mechanical fabrication, piping, skid manufacturing and assembly processes. 

Hands-on experience in preparation of QAPs, ITPs and quality documentation. 

Experience in coordinating client inspections, vendor inspections and FATs. 

Knowledge of ISO 9001: 2015 implementation and audit requirements. 

Understanding EN standards, IEC codes and CE compliance requirements. 

Ability to interpret engineering drawings, electrical schematics, P&IDs and technical specifications. 

Good communication and coordination skills to interact with international clients, vendors and inspection agencies.

data.title: Lead Security Research Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

As a Lead Security Research Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for vulnerability research, exploit analysis, exposure validation, and vulnerability signature development across the Qualys security platform. You will lead initiatives to identify, validate, and prioritise security risks based on real-world exploitability, helping customers distinguish theoretical exposures from confirmed attack paths. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead vulnerability research initiatives across operating systems, databases, enterprise applications, cloud services, container platforms, and network devices. 
 - Research newly disclosed, N-day, and actively exploited vulnerabilities. 
 - Lead the development of exploit-based exposure validation techniques to confirm real-world exploitability of vulnerabilities. 
 - Review technical designs, research methodologies, and code contributions to ensure quality and consistency. 
 - Partner with Engineering and Product teams to influence roadmap decisions and security content strategy. 
 - Design safe and controlled validation mechanisms that emulate attacker behavior without affecting production systems. 
 - Analyze vulnerability root causes, attack vectors, exploitability conditions, and potential business impact. 
 - Mentor and guide Security Research Engineers on vulnerability analysis, exploit analysis, and signature creation. 
 - Build validation logic capable of determining whether existing security controls such as WAFs, firewalls, EDRs, IPS, and compensating controls effectively prevent exploitation. 
 - Drive automation initiatives for vulnerability research, exploit validation, content generation, testing, and release processes. 
 - Establish best practices, coding standards, and quality guidelines for signature development. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (or equivalent experience). 
 - 8+ years of hands-on experience in vulnerability research, penetration testing, detection engineering, or security research. 
 - Deep understanding of TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, SSH, SMTP, DNS, SSL/TLS, and modern web protocols. 
 - Strong expertise in vulnerability analysis, exploit development, and attack techniques. 
 - Extensive knowledge of operating systems, databases, web technologies, cloud environments, and enterprise infrastructure. 
 - Strong coding background. 
 - Experience with packet analysis, network troubleshooting, and protocol reverse engineering.

 - Excellent written, verbal, and technical communication skills.

Understanding of Lua (preferred), Bash, or Python. 

Knowledge of Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, Oracle, etc. ).

OSCP, CISSP, or SANS GIAC certifications.

Even Better If. . .

data.description:
About the Company

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build and operate the cloud infrastructure that powers enterprise applications and workloads. Our engineers solve challenging problems across compute, networking, storage and distributed systems. 

Host Provisioning Services (HoPS) builds the software that turns physical servers in our data centres into reliable, customer-ready cloud infrastructure. Our services automate server provisioning, configuration, validation, firmware management and recovery. We also enable the introduction of new hardware from companies such as NVIDIA and AMD. 

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Principal Software Engineer to design, build and operate backend services that support the lifecycle of OCI's server fleet. 

You will work at the intersection of distributed software, infrastructure automation and Linux systems. The role involves designing reliable workflows, supporting new hardware platforms and solving production problems across service and system boundaries. 

We value engineers who take ownership beyond their immediate tasks: identifying issues, understanding their wider impact and following them through to a lasting solution. You do not need deep firmware expertise to join the team; strong software engineering foundations, curiosity and a willingness to learn are key. 

Our primary development language is Java. We package services with Docker, deploy using Terraform and monitor service health through Grafana and other observability tools. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop and maintain distributed backend services for server provisioning, configuration, validation, firmware management and recovery. 
 - Own substantial components from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment and production operation. 
 - Build automation that handles failures, timeouts, retries and concurrent operations safely. 
 - Develop services that support new hardware platforms and reliable firmware updates across server fleets. 
 - Improve service reliability, scalability, performance and operability. 
 - Investigate complex production issues across applications, Linux, networking, storage and hardware. 
 - Develop automated tests, validate failure scenarios and plan controlled rollouts with clear recovery procedures. 
 - Participate in on-call support, incident investigation and root-cause analysis, and deliver permanent fixes. 
 - Collaborate across teams on architecture, service dependencies and technical trade-offs. 
 - Provide technical guidance, share knowledge and help other engineers solve difficult problems. 

Qualifications, Skills and Experience

- Strong hands-on experience designing, developing and maintaining production backend software, with proficiency in Java or a comparable programming language. 
 - Experience building and operating distributed systems or infrastructure services. 
 - Understanding of reliable workflow design, including failure handling, retries, recovery and concurrent operations. 
 - Experience with Linux and troubleshooting problems using logs, metrics and diagnostic tools. 
 - Experience automating infrastructure provisioning, configuration, upgrades, validation or recovery. 
 - Sound engineering practices across automated testing, code reviews, integration testing and safe production deployments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to own technical decisions and independently deliver substantial components or services. 
 - Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams. 
 - A proactive approach to production ownership and a willingness to investigate issues beyond an assigned task. 

Additional experience that would be valuable: 

- Cloud control planes, orchestration, Kubernetes operators, distributed storage or fleet management. 
 - Docker, Terraform, Grafana, Python or similar development and infrastructure tools. 
 - Server provisioning, firmware automation, BIOS/BMC, Redfish/IPMI or hardware validation. 
 - GPU, NIC/SmartNIC or NVMe platforms. 
 - Technical mentoring and architecture ownership across services or teams.

data.description:
Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017. Botsync is a Singapore-based robotics and automation company building autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and intelligent orchestration software that transform warehouse and factory operations across APAC. Founded in 2017, we design, manufacture, and deploy intelligent robots - including our MAG series - that handle material movement at scale, so humans can focus on higher-value work. 

Alongside our hardware, we've built syncOS, the industry's first no-code, vendor-agnostic orchestration and fleet management platform that coordinates robots, industrial systems, and workflows across modern facilities - turning weeks-long deployments into hours, without halting production or calling in specialists. 

Today we're still that young, passionate team - just with more like-minded people who've joined us along the way. We're all obsessed with one thing: making robotics and automation simpler, faster to adapt, and more reliable on real factory floors. 

If you love robots, hate inefficiency, and want to build things that actually run in production - you'll fit right in. 

The Role: 

- Own the QC Engineering function end to end for Botsync's AMR portfolio, defining the quality strategy, operating model, priorities, standards, and continuous-improvement roadmap. 
 - Lead, coach, and performance-manage a team of 3-5 QC/Engineering professionals; set goals, allocate work, review outcomes, and build succession and capability plans. 
 - Own workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, training, development, and retention for the QC team in partnership with Talent Acquisition and Engineering leadership. 
 - Translate product, production, and deployment roadmaps into risk-based test strategies, validation plans, resourcing, acceptance criteria, and release milestones. 
 - Establish and govern quality gates across hardware bring-up, software integration, simulation, Factory Acceptance Testing, regression, reliability, safety, and shipment release. 
 - Chair release-readiness and defect-triage reviews, provide the independent quality go/no-go recommendation, and ensure critical risks have accountable owners and mitigation plans. 
 - Act as the final escalation owner for critical quality incidents and factory or customer issues, leading containment, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and effectiveness verification. 
 - Define and track quality KPIs - including first-pass yield, defect escape, test coverage, reliability, rework, and closure cycle time - and present trends, risks, and actions to leadership. 
 - Partner with Engineering, Product and Project teams to eliminate systemic defects and embed prevention into design and production. 
 - Own QC documentation and traceability, including test protocols, FAT evidence, issue logs, release records, engineering changes, and audit-ready records. 
 - Drive test automation, lab and tooling readiness, process standardization, and quality engagement with manufacturing partners in China and Southeast Asia to scale consistent, deployment-ready outcomes. 

What we're looking for: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical/Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 8-12 years of experience in AMR, mobile robotics, industrial automation, or a closely related engineering environment, including experience leading Quality or Engineering teams. 
 - Strong understanding of robot hardware including motor controllers, encoders, LiDARs, sensors, and safety systems. 
 - Proficiency in Linux, ROS, C++, and Python for robotics software integration and troubleshooting. 
 - Hands-on experience with robot system integration, hardware-software debugging, and issue resolution in production environments. 
 - Experience with Factory Acceptance Testing, commissioning, or on-site deployment activities. 
 - Demonstrated experience building and leading a team of 3-5 junior engineers in Quality or Engineering, including participation in hiring, onboarding, coaching, and performance development. 
 - Proven ability to own QC processes end to end, allocate work effectively, handle technical escalations, and coordinate independently with manufacturing partners. 
 - Familiarity with networking and industrial communication protocols such as CAN, Modbus, and related systems. 
 - Willingness and ability to travel regularly to China and Southeast Asia based on business requirements.

Engineering Operations Leadership

 - Own engineering execution from customer specification and order configuration through customer-approval drawings, detailed electrical and mechanical design, bills of material, manufacturing release, as-built updates, and engineering-change closure. 
 - Deliver on-time engineering releases, first-time-right quality, productivity, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction while maintaining compliance with product standards and plant processes. 
 - Establish capacity, workload, outsourcing, and cross-training plans that provide flexible support across low-voltage assembly and busway demand. 
 - Drive operating rhythms for backlog, engineering completion, order complexity, quality defects, change notices, risk escalation, recovery plans, and plant support. 

Product-Line and Technical Leadership

- Serve as the technical and organizational leader for Low Voltage Assembly and Busway engineering. Ensure leaders and teams understand product architecture, application boundaries, configuration rules, electrical and mechanical interfaces, manufacturing constraints, installation dependencies, and test requirements. 
 - For LVA, guide engineering for Magnum PXR and Magnum DS low-voltage switchgear, including rear-access, front-access, arc-resistant, arc-quenching, NRX, OEM, indoor, and outdoor configurations supported by the product line. 
 - Ensure strong LVA knowledge of UL 1558 and UL 891 applications; main, tie, feeder, transition, auxiliary, metering, and control sections; breaker selection and application; horizontal and vertical bus; risers, runbacks, stabs, bracing, grounding and neutral systems; cable and conduit entry; control power; current and voltage transformers; protection, metering, communications, interlocks, automatic-transfer and power-control schemes; one-lines, three-lines, schematics, wiring diagrams, and customer-connection requirements. 

Engineering Systems, Digital Thread, and Continuous Improvement

Business, Plant, and Cross-Functional Leadership

Talent and Organizational Development

Qualifications

- Bachelors/Masters in Electrical engineering or equivalent
 - 15+ years of engineering experience in low-voltage power distribution, switchgear, busway, or related electromechanical products, with substantial experience in Engineer-to-Order, Customer Order Engineering, Customer Order Design, application engineering, detailed design, or requisition engineering. Minimum 5 years of people-leadership experience leading multi-disciplinary electrical and mechanical engineering teams; experience leading leaders or multiple product-line teams is preferred. 

Skills

- Extensive knowledge of ETO order engineering, including specification and drawing review, configuration, feasibility assessment, customer-approval drawings, detailed design, bills of material, manufacturing release, change management, as-built documentation, and plant support. 
 - Demonstrated product knowledge in both Low Voltage Assembly and Busway engineering, or deep expertise in one product line with proven ability to build capability in the other. 
 - LVA knowledge: Magnum PXR and Magnum DS switchgear; front- and rear-access arrangements; arc-resistant and arc-quenching configurations; UL 1558 and UL 891 applications; breakers, bus, risers, runbacks, stabs, bracing, neutral and grounding systems; protection, metering, communication, interlocks, control power, automatic-transfer and power-control schemes; one-lines, three-lines, schematics, wiring diagrams, and mechanical layouts. 
 - Busway knowledge: Pow-R-Way III, Pow-R-Way II, and supported busway offerings; feeder and plug-in busway; straight lengths and fittings; elbows, offsets, tees, crosses, flanges, joints, expansion and phase-transposition sections; transformer taps and throat connections; reducers, adapters, end feeds, end closers, hangers, power takeoffs, plug-in devices, layout drawings, final-field-fit requirements, and equipment coordination. 
 - Working knowledge of copper and aluminum conductor application, bus ampacity, voltage and short-circuit ratings, phasing, orientation, grounding, neutral arrangements, insulation, voltage drop, environmental ratings, clearances, supports, seismic requirements, installation constraints, and field coordination. 
 - Strong understanding of applicable ANSI, IEEE, UL, NEMA, NEC, NFPA, CSA, and IEC requirements, including low-voltage switchgear, busway, arc-resistant, testing, and installation requirements applicable to the supported portfolios. 
 - Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, structure and compartment assembly, breaker and device fitment, bus fabrication and jointing, wiring, inspection, testing, packaging and shipping splits, quality systems, engineering changes, and product lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with BidManager or comparable configuration tools; AutoCAD and AutoCAD Electrical; Inventor or comparable 3D CAD; ENOVIA/3DX or comparable PLM; Design Automation; BIM; MAPICS/AS400; and manufacturing-release or order-management systems. 
 - Proven ability to lead design automation, BIM and digital-thread initiatives, reusable product definition, configuration validation, drawing and BOM automation, busway engineering automation, workflow optimization, and engineering-quality improvement. 
 - Demonstrated application of Lean, DMAIC, Design for Six Sigma, Agile, and continuous-improvement methods; Green Belt or Black Belt certification is preferred. 
 - Ability to evaluate competitor offerings, customer and market trends, product standards, installation practices, and technology developments relevant to low-voltage assemblies and busway.

Principal Engineer - Digital IP Verification (G4)

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated, technically strong, and execution-focused Individual Contributor to lead and deliver first-pass success for complex Digital IP and Subsystem verification programs. The role demands deep expertise in advanced verification methodologies, strong ownership mindset, and ability to collaborate across multi-disciplinary and global teams. 

The individual will work closely with System Architecture, Design, DFT, Mixed Signal, and Validation teams across sites to address verification challenges spanning IP, Subsystem, and full SoC context, leveraging simulation, formal verification, hardware modeling, and pre/post silicon validation techniques. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end verification execution for complex IPs and Subsystems, ensuring high quality and first-pass silicon success
 - Evaluate, adopt, and deploy advanced and scalable verification methodologies to handle increasing design complexity
 - Own verification quality metrics across planning, execution, and closure phases
 - Drive 'Zero Defect' mindset through rigorous process adherence, coverage closure, and defect prevention strategies
 - Analyze existing verification flows and implement improvements to enhance efficiency, predictability, and quality
 - Contribute to and influence technical innovation within the team, including methodology evolution and automation
 - Collaborate effectively across local and global cross-functional teams including Design, DFT, Architecture, and Validation
 - Support pre-silicon and post-silicon validation activities where required

Technical Skills - Must Have

- 10-15 years of hands-on experience in IP or Subsystem verification for complex, multi-million gate designs
 - Strong expertise in HVLs such as SystemVerilog/UVM and proficiency in C/C++
 - Solid understanding of HDLs such as Verilog/VHDL
 - Experience with industry simulators such as VCS, NCSim, ModelSim, or Questa
 - Strong experience in testbench architecture, development, debugging, and verification closure
 - Proficiency in test planning, feature traceability, and functional/performance validation
 - Strong knowledge of assertions (SVA), functional coverage, and regression management
 - Solid understanding of microcontroller architectures (ARM cores) and interconnect protocols such as AHB, AXI, AMBA
 - Experience in memory subsystems including SRAM, Flash, DDR, and memory controllers

Technical Skills - Good To Have

- Exposure to formal verification methodologies and tools
 - Experience with gate-level simulations and verification planning tools
 - Exposure to emulation and pre-silicon validation environments
 - Domain knowledge in automotive, graphics/vision accelerators, high-speed serial interfaces, or networking protocols such as Ethernet

The DevOps Architect - Migration Hub is the strategic owner of the CI/CD, environment management and release governance framework that powers all migration wave delivery across the Hub. Sitting at the intersection of platform engineering and delivery operations, this role designs and governs the DevOps infrastructure that enables concurrent migration teams - across Marketing Cloud Next, Agentforce Revenue Management, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks - to deploy, test, validate and release Salesforce configuration, code and data changes at Hub velocity. 

Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level - defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team. 

This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck - that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window. 

The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model - governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- CI/CD Pipeline Architecture - Hub Standard: Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado - defining the standard pipeline stages (develop → validate → test → UAT → staging → production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release. 
 - Environment Topology Design: Design and manage the Hub environment topology - defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements. 
 - Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance: Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy - including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging - ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled. 
 - Scratch Org Strategy: Design the Hub's Salesforce DX scratch org usage model - defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale. 
 - Deployment Governance & Release Management: Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments - defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves. 
 - Test Automation Framework: Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite - including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests - integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage. 
 - Static Code Analysis & Quality Gates: Implement and maintain static code analysis tooling (PMD, Salesforce Code Analyser, ESLint) as mandatory quality gates within the Hub pipeline - enforcing Apex best practices, Governor Limit awareness, LWC standards and security vulnerability detection before any code progresses to UAT. 
 - Multi-Org & Multi-Track Pipeline Management: Manage the complexity of concurrent multi-org pipelines across 4-5 active migration tracks - designing dependency management, cross-track metadata conflict resolution and coordinated deployment sequencing for shared Salesforce org components. 
 - Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Integrate data migration pipeline execution (ETL job scheduling, bulk load sequencing, reconciliation validation) into the Hub CI/CD framework - ensuring data migration jobs are tracked, versioned, automated and auditable alongside metadata deployments. 
 - Secrets & Credential Management: Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments - including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management. 
 - Monitoring & Observability: Design the Hub's deployment monitoring and observability framework - including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership. 
 - DevOps Engineer Mentoring & Standards: Act as the technical lead and mentor for DevOps Engineers embedded in each migration track - setting development standards, reviewing pipeline configurations, conducting DevOps design reviews and ensuring consistent tooling adoption across all track teams. 
 - Platform Development Contribution: Design and build reusable Salesforce platform components for Hub DevOps tooling - including LWC-based deployment dashboards, Apex utilities for automated org health checks, custom metadata-driven pipeline configuration frameworks and Salesforce Flow automations for release approval workflows. 
 - Continuous Improvement - Hub Feedback: Capture DevOps lessons learned after every migration wave - pipeline failures, deployment blockers, environment contention, test coverage gaps
 - Tooling Evaluation & Adoption: Evaluate and recommend new DevOps tooling, Salesforce release management platforms and automation frameworks - maintaining the Hub's DevOps toolkit at the leading edge of Salesforce delivery practice. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- Salesforce DX & Source-Driven Development: Expert knowledge of Salesforce DX - scratch org management, SFDX project structure, package development model (unlocked packages, managed packages), metadata API formats and CLI operations for automated deployments. 
 - CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on expertise building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments - using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or CircleCI combined with Gearset, Copado or custom SFDX scripting for automated validate-test-deploy workflows. 
 - Gearset or Copado: Deep practical experience with at least one enterprise Salesforce release management platform - Gearset or Copado - including pipeline configuration, org comparison, deployment validation, rollback management and test execution integration. 
 - Git & Branching Strategy: Expert-level Git proficiency - branching model design (GitFlow, trunk-based, environment-branching), merge policy enforcement, PR review standards, release tagging and conflict resolution for Salesforce metadata and Apex code repositories. 
 - Salesforce Environment Management: Proven ability to design and manage multi-org environment topologies for large programme delivery - including sandbox refresh automation, org dependency mapping, data masking for lower environments and environment capacity planning. 
 - Apex & Platform Development: Strong Apex development skills - Triggers, Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, test class authoring, Governor Limit management - required for building Hub DevOps tooling, automated health check utilities and deployment validation components. 
 - Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC-based deployment dashboards, pipeline status monitors, release approval UIs and org health dashboards as internal Hub tooling deployed on the Salesforce platform. 
 - Test Automation: Experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks for Salesforce - Apex test class architecture, code coverage reporting, LWC Jest unit tests, Selenium/Playwright UI tests and data validation scripts integrated into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Static Code Analysis & Security Scanning: Hands-on experience with Salesforce Code Analyser, PMD for Apex, ESLint for LWC and SAST tooling integrated into pipeline quality gates - defining and enforcing code quality and security standards across Hub teams. 
 - Secrets & Credential Management: Experience with vault-based secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, GitHub Secrets, Azure Key Vault) for securely managing Salesforce connected app credentials, API tokens and ETL integration credentials across Hub environments. 
 - Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Understanding of ETL tool scheduling and orchestration - capable of integrating data migration job execution (Informatica, Talend, ADF, MuleSoft) into the Hub CI/CD framework alongside metadata deployments. 
 - Monitoring & Observability: Experience building deployment health dashboards and alerting - using Salesforce native monitoring, GitHub Actions workflow summaries, Grafana, Datadog or similar - for real-time pipeline visibility across concurrent wave deployments. 
 - Platform Security: Knowledge of Salesforce connected app security, named credentials, OAuth flows, IP restrictions and certificate-based authentication as they apply to CI/CD automation and Hub environment access control. 
 - 10-16 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps engineering and Salesforce platform delivery
 - 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce DevOps experience - owning CI/CD pipelines, environment management and release governance for large-scale Salesforce programmes
 - 3+ years of experience designing DevOps frameworks for multi-track, multi-org Salesforce delivery programmes - managing 4+ concurrent release streams
 - Demonstrated experience implementing Hub or programme-level DevOps standards adopted by multiple delivery teams across a shared Salesforce environment
 - Proven track record mentoring and setting standards for DevOps Engineers embedded in track delivery teams
 - Experience integrating data migration pipeline execution into Salesforce CI/CD workflows - ETL scheduling, bulk load automation and reconciliation validation within deployment pipelines

Even Better If. . .

data.title: Senior Systems Engineer / Team Lead
data.description:
Senior Systems Engineer / Team Lead

  

About Armstrong Dematic

Armstrong Dematic is one of India's leading intralogistics and warehouse automation companies. For over 25 years, we have been powering the movement of goods across the country, helping some of India's most trusted brands run their warehouses faster, safer and more reliably. We design and deliver automated warehouse solutions using intelligent robots, Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS), high-speed sortation systems and advanced software platforms. 

India's leading e-commerce, FMCG, retail, automotive and pharma brands trust us with large, mission-critical automation projects. We are 700+ professionals across Nashik, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi and Bengaluru. At Armstrong Dematic, you don't just build systems; you build solutions that move the nation. 

The Role

As a Senior Systems Engineer / Team Lead in our Systems Engineering function, you will lead system validation, technical reviews and risk management for large-scale warehouse automation projects. You will ensure that integrated systems (mechanical, controls and software) meet performance, safety and reliability expectations. The role requires strong ownership across FAT, SAT and system performance validation, along with mentoring junior engineers and driving first-time-right execution. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Review & System Validation

•          Ensure alignment of system design with project requirements and operational expectations

•          Own the validation strategy for the complete system, including mechanical, controls and software interfaces

•          Identify design gaps early and drive corrective actions proactively

2. Risk Assessment & Mitigation

•          Lead system-level risk assessment including functional, operational and safety risks

•          Drive risk mitigation plans with cross-functional teams

•          Ensure closure of critical risks before system deployment

•          Continuously monitor system performance to identify emerging risks

3. FAT / SAT Ownership

•          Own preparation and readiness for FAT and SAT activities

•          Define, review and approve test cases for system validation

•          Lead FAT/SAT execution and ensure first-pass success

•          Analyse test results and drive improvements before final deployment

•          Ensure alignment between system performance and customer expectations

4. Documentation & Reporting

•          Ensure preparation and validation of acceptance test plans for the complete system

•          Maintain structured documentation for validation, risk and compliance

•          Generate technical reports and communicate findings to stakeholders

•          Ensure traceability between requirements, validation and outcomes

5. Cross-Functional & Supplier Collaboration

•          Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Software and Project teams

•          Drive alignment across design, execution and commissioning phases

•          Support issue resolution across the lifecycle, from design to site execution

•          Coordinate with third-party equipment suppliers to align technical specifications, interfaces and testing requirements

6. Safety & Compliance

•          Ensure compliance with safety standards such as ISO 13849, IEC 61508 and OSHA

•          Validate safety mechanisms including emergency stops, interlocks and fail-safe operations

•          Lead safety validation during FAT and commissioning

7. Site Support & Commissioning

•          Travel to project sites (>30%) for commissioning, troubleshooting and validation

•          Ensure system readiness for handover to the customer

•          Support resolution of critical site issues and performance gaps

8. Mentoring & Capability Building

•          Mentor junior systems engineers on validation, risk assessment and technical reviews

•          Establish best practices, checklists and validation frameworks

•          Support knowledge sharing and team capability development

9. Continuous Improvement

•          Drive improvements in validation processes and systems engineering practices

•          Capture learnings from projects and implement standardisation

•          Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies

How Success Is Measured

•          FAT/SAT first-pass success rate

•          Reduction in site issues and rework

•          Risk identification and closure effectiveness

•          System performance stability post deployment

•          On-time validation and readiness

•          Stakeholder feedback and satisfaction

Qualifications

•          Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics, Automation, Production or a related field

•          5+ years of experience in systems engineering or a similar field within automation or industrial projects

•          Strong understanding of warehouse automation, material handling systems and order fulfilment

•          Experience in FAT, SAT, commissioning and system validation

•          Knowledge of controls, system architecture and software integration

•          Proficiency in risk assessment and technical validation processes

•          Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills

•          Ability to work in cross-functional environments and drive technical alignment

Good to Have

•          PLC platforms: Siemens

•          Warehouse systems: WCS/WMS exposure

•          Design and layout tools: AutoCAD

•          Risk and validation: FMEA, test case frameworks, validation protocols

•          Supplier communication: experience working with third-party equipment suppliers on technical specifications and testing

Location & Travel

•          Based in Pune

•          Willingness to travel (>30%) for site commissioning, validation and customer interactions

Open positions: 2

Learn more about us: https: //www. armstrongltd. com/

data.title: SAP FICO Functional Tester
data.description:
SAP FI FUNCTIONAL TESTER

Exp : 2 + Years

Location : Bangalore

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled SAP FI Functional Tester with 4-5 years of hands-on experience in SAP Finance testing. 

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Financial Accounting processes, experience in functional and

regression testing, and the ability to validate end-to-end financial transactions. The role includes preparing and

executing test scenarios, analyzing defects, validating financial postings, and ensuring the quality of SAP FI solutions

across business processes and system integrations. Experience in SAP S/4HANA, retail finance, and testing custom

SAP programs and interfaces is an advantage. 

Key Responsibilities

SAP FI Functional Testing

o Test SAP FI processes including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset

Accounting (AA), and Bank Accounting. 

o Validate end-to-end financial transactions and accounting entries, including document types, posting keys, GL

accounts, company codes, and fiscal periods. 

o Verify account determination, tax postings, exchange-rate differences, and financial document splitting. 

o Execute positive, negative, boundary, and exception-based test scenarios. 

Test Planning and Execution

o Analyze functional specifications, business requirements, and Jira user stories. 

o Prepare detailed test scenarios, test cases, and test scripts; execute functional, integration, regression, and UAT

testing. 

o Maintain execution status, evidence, and defect documentation; identify test coverage gaps. 

o Support test planning, estimation, and regression suite preparation. 

End-to-End Integration Testing

o Test integration between SAP FI and MM, SD, and CO. 

o Validate Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), and Record-to-Report (R2R) processes. 

o Test financial impacts of goods receipts, invoice receipts, sales transactions, and inventory movements. 

o Validate 3-way matching involving Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, and Vendor Invoices, as well as inbound

interfaces and IDocs. 

SAP Data Validation and Defect Analysis

o Validate SAP financial documents using relevant transactions and tables, including ACDOCA, BKPF, BSEG, BSIK, 

BSAK, and applicable MM tables. 

o Analyze posting discrepancies, identify root causes, and validate debit/credit balances, currencies, and

controlling assignments. 

o Collaborate with functional consultants, ABAP developers, and business analysts to resolve defects; retest fixes

and perform impact analysis. 

Custom Program and Interface Testing

o Test custom SAP developments, Z-programs, reports, enhancements, and interfaces. 

o Validate custom financial posting logic, business rules, error handling, exception scenarios, and reconciliation

logic. 

o Perform regression testing after configuration changes, code fixes, and enhancements. 

Test Documentation and Reporting

o Maintain test scripts, execution results, defect logs, and regression suites. 

o Prepare test execution summaries and defect status reports; communicate progress, risks, and dependencies. 

o Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects; support release readiness. 

Required Skills and Experience

o 4-5 years of hands-on SAP FI functional testing experience. 

o Strong understanding of SAP FI business processes and accounting fundamentals. 

o Experience with GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting. 

o Knowledge of document posting, document types, posting keys, GL account determination, and tax postings. 

o Experience in integration testing across SAP FI, MM, SD, and CO. 

o Hands-on experience preparing and executing test cases and managing defects using Jira, ALM, or similar tools. 

o Working knowledge of SAP tables and transaction codes for financial data validation. 

o Ability to interpret functional specifications and translate requirements into test scenarios. 

o Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

o Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Finance and the Universal Journal (ACDOCA). 

o Experience in SAP retail or high-volume transaction environments. 

o Knowledge of SAP MM invoice verification and 3-way matching. 

o Experience testing IDocs, inbound interfaces, and external system integrations. 

o Exposure to custom SAP Z-programs and enhancements. 

o Knowledge of CO-PA, cost centers, profit centers, internal orders, financial reconciliation, and month-end close. 

o Basic understanding of SAP configuration and identifying configuration-related issues. 

Educational Qualification

o Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 

o SAP FI certification or relevant SAP Finance training is an advantage. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on SAP FI tester who understands both test execution and the underlying accounting

impact of SAP transactions. They should be able to independently prepare scenarios, execute end-to-end testing, 

validate financial postings, identify defects, and work closely with functional and development teams to ensure high

quality SAP releases. 

Candidates with strong SAP FI testing experience and a good understanding of financial accounting processes

data.title: Senior Penetration Tester (AWS)
data.description:
Listed on CyberJobs. cc, a job board for cybersecurity jobs from the team behind AITraining. jobs. 

At Offchain, we aren't just building products: we're leading a movement. 

As pioneers in blockchain scalability and security, we're at the forefront of transforming how the world interacts with decentralized applications. We're laying the foundation that will define the next generation of digital commerce, governance, and human interaction. This involves tackling real-world challenges that come with scaling blockchain technology, without compromising on its core principles: decentralization, security and transparency. 

At the center of this vision is our people. Our team is made up of thinkers and doers that embrace new challenges and seek solutions that push existing boundaries. If you're energized by solving unprecedented problems, and believe in the role that decentralized systems will play in creating a more equitable digital future, then we want to hear from you. 

Why Offchain?

Offchain is setting the pace for the entire Ethereum ecosystem. We built the Arbitrum stack that powers Arbitrum One, the most widely adopted Ethereum scaling solution that exists today. 

Arbitrum's ecosystem is undergoing tremendous growth with hundreds of projects and dApps on Arbitrum One today. Over 100 different teams have used Offchain technology to build their own Arbitrum chains. Major players in the space, Robinhood, BlackRock, Ethena Labs, Securitize, Aave, and Apechain are all using the Arbitrum stack. 

Arbitrum's thriving ecosystem wouldn't exist without our advanced technology stack. Arbitrum, Prysm, ZeroDev. These aren't just product names. These are tools that are actively reshaping what's possible on Ethereum and advancing its core infrastructure. 

To top it all off? We're backed by $124 million in funding. We've demonstrated consistent execution with billions in secured value, thousands of supported projects, and infrastructure processing millions of transactions seamlessly. 

The Role

- As a Senior Security Engineer at Offchain, you will emulate the real-world tactics, techniques, and procedures of sophisticated adversaries to surface vulnerabilities across our infrastructure and ecosystem tools. 
 - You'll run hands-on penetration tests, lead red team exercises, and work side-by-side with blue team partners to test, refine, and strengthen detection and response capabilities. 
 - Your efforts will directly shape how Offchain designs, launches, protects, and achieves compliance for the infrastructure that powers millions of users and applications - including key standards such as SOC 2. 

What you'll do

- Conduct comprehensive code audits across a variety of internal applications and infrastructure. 
 - Conduct comprehensive penetration tests across cloud environments (AWS), infrastructure, and backend applications. 
 - Collaborate with detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response groups to review security controls, uncover coverage gaps, and enhance overall detection quality. 
 - Build, maintain, and evolve custom offensive tools, scripts, and automation frameworks to increase assessment speed. 
 - Offer offensive security expertise during incident investigations, including log analysis and root cause reviews. 
 - Keep up with evolving threats, vulnerabilities, and attack methods; share research internally and engage with the wider security community. 
 - Own offensive security projects from start to finish, mentor junior team members, and cultivate a culture of ongoing learning and knowledge exchange. 

What you'll need

- 5+ years of experience in offensive security, penetration testing, red teaming, or a closely related field. 
 - Extensive experience with conducting code audits to identify and remediate security issues. 
 - Experience with binary exploitation. 
 - Mastery of AWS & specific attack techniques and configuration weaknesses. 
 - Strong understanding of adversary tactics and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK. 
 - In-depth knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, and common vulnerability categories. 
 - Proficiency using offensive security tools such as Burp Suite, nuclei and similar frameworks. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or similar languages, with proven experience developing tools or automation. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical details as clear, risk-focused recommendations. 
 - A natural ability to think like an attacker - creative, determined, and skilled at assessing risk across complex systems. 

Nice-to-haves

- Web3 / blockchain security exposure: smart contract auditing, bug bounty hunting (e. g. , Immunefi, Code4rena), or DeFi protocol review. 
 - Familiarity with Ethereum L1 / L2 node architecture and security risks. 
 - Experience in blockchain infrastructure penetration testing. 

Perks

- Remote-first global workforce + NY office
 - Professional reimbursement program (facilitates industry conference attendance, certifications, and more)
 - Medical, dental & vision coverage (US + some other countries)
 - 401k retirement plan + company match (US only)
 - Wellness stipend
 - Home office set up / ergonomic equipment program

data.title: Lead ML Engineer, Wearable Biosignals
data.description:
Wualt is building a smart ring for women's safety and everyday wellness. The ring senses what the body is doing and, when it matters, alerts the people a wearer trusts. We are a funded, pre-launch hardware startup heading into our first field pilots in early 2027. Small team, real hardware, real users, close to the founders. 

THE ROLE

Our ML is what turns a raw sensor stream into a signal someone can rely on. We are looking for one person to own that end to end: the models, the rigor, and a small team, and to carry them from research into a pilot-ready state. You would be the person the founders hand the ML function to. 

EXPERIENCE WE EXPECT (please read before applying)

• 2 to 6 years working directly on physiological or sensor time-series ML. Your hands-on experience must include real biosignals: PPG, ECG, HRV, or accelerometer/IMU data. Depth here matters far more than total years. 

• Solid signal-processing fundamentals: filtering, motion-artifact handling, feature extraction, and knowing why a model fails on real-world noise. 

• Time-series deep learning (CNNs, Transformers, sequence models) and fluent, production-capable Python (NumPy, PyTorch or similar). 

• You have taken at least one model to a deployed or shipped state on messy, real-world data, not just a clean benchmark. 

• You understand honest evaluation: subject-wise splits (LOSO), leakage, calibration, and why a headline F1 can be a lie. 

• This is not a fit for pure LLM or GenAI, pure computer-vision, or general data-science backgrounds with no biosignal work. We screen for the signal experience specifically. 

WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO DO

• Own the ML roadmap and be accountable for pilot ML readiness. Our first field pilots start early 2027; getting the models ready, on real people and on the real device, is your deliverable. 

• Build and validate the physiological models: heart rate and HRV, stress and distress detection, menstrual-cycle phase, and signal quality. 

• Own the on-device and cloud ML path and work shoulder to shoulder with firmware (edge inference on the ring) and the app and cloud teams. 

• Set and hold the bar for rigor: ground-truth datasets, leakage-free evaluation, and no claim about what the product can do that you cannot defend with data. 

• Lead and mentor the ML and science team, and raise the whole function's standard, not just your own output. 

BONUS

• Wearables, health-tech or femtech experience. 

• On-device or embedded ML (we run on an nRF-class MCU, so edge inference matters). 

• A patent, a publication, or a personal project that shows you can't stop thinking about biosignals. 

WHAT YOU GET

• Full ownership of the ML function at a company that is weeks, not years, from putting its product on real people. 

• Hardware you can hold, a pilot on a real timeline, and a direct line to the founders. 

• Competitive salary.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer
data.description:
About the Team & Mission

The ML Platform team maximizes the speed, throughput, and hardware efficiency of our production Large Language Model (LLM) inference stack. As models scale and real-time demand grows, post-training optimization and aggressive server-level utilization are our primary levers for delivering low-latency AI at sustainable infrastructure economics. 

We operate at the intersection of LLM serving engines, post-training compression, and bare-metal accelerator architecture. Our mission is to squeeze maximum compute and memory bandwidth out of every server node-turning heavy foundation models into ultra-fast, cost-efficient endpoints. 

Role Overview

We are hiring a deeply technical Senior / Staff Software Engineer (Individual Contributor) with 8+ years of experience to partner directly with the Leadership in architecting and scaling our LLM inference platform. 

In this high-leverage IC role, you will serve as our primary technical anchor for inference performance. You will own end-to-end serving architecture, drive post-training optimization pipelines, eliminate hardware bottlenecks, and guide engineers through complex systems challenges. 

Key Responsibilities

- Post-Training Optimization: Architect and productionize model compression and acceleration pipelines-including quantization (FP8/INT8/INT4), distillation, and speculative decoding-to slash latency (TTFT/ITL) while preserving model quality. 
 - Hardware & Server Maximization: Drive bare-metal utilization across multi-GPU and multi-node topologies by optimizing memory bandwidth, tensor core occupancy, interconnects, and parallelism strategies (tensor, pipeline, expert, and disaggregated serving). 
 - Inference Engine & Kernel Engineering: Extend modern inference frameworks (such as vLLM or SGLang) and build custom fused kernels and batching schedulers to eliminate compute, memory, and CPU host bottlenecks. 
 - Profiling & Automated Diagnostics: Build deep telemetry, roofline modeling, and automated bottleneck-detection workflows to pinpoint hardware stalls and prevent performance regressions in production. 
 - Technical Leadership: Partner with Leadership to shape our multi-quarter inference roadmap, author high-clarity RFCs and influence hardware capacity decisions. 
 - Mentor Junior Engineers: Level up junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and hands-on systems coaching. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical systems experience. 
 - Experience: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience in high-performance computing (HPC), ML inference systems, GPU programming, or low-latency distributed infrastructure. 
 - LLM Inference Mastery: Proven track record optimizing large-scale LLM serving in production, with a deep understanding of transformer memory footprints, KV-cache mechanics, continuous batching, and latency/throughput trade-offs. 
 - Hardware & Systems Depth: Strong grasp of accelerator microarchitecture (compute vs. memory-bound workloads, roofline analysis, memory hierarchies) and multi-GPU server interconnects. 
 - Programming Proficiency: Expert-level coding skills in C++ and Python, with experience building low-overhead, production-critical systems software. 

Preferred Qualifications

- GPU & Compiler Internals: Practical experience writing or profiling custom accelerator kernels and working close to ML compilers or runtime execution graphs. 
 - Production Compression & Decoding: Track record deploying quantized models or speculative decoding techniques in high-throughput production environments. 
 - Open-Source Inference Familiarity: Experience working inside or contributing to modern open-source LLM serving engines and attention libraries. 
 - Complex Workload Scaling: Background optimizing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing overhead or ultra-long-context inference workloads. 
 - Automated Performance Tooling: Experience building automated benchmarking harnesses, hardware utilization models, or AI-assisted trace debugging tools. 

Why Flipkart?

Flipkart is India's leading e-commerce platform, where innovation meets impact at scale. As part of the AI Solutions team, you will shape the foundational AI infrastructure powering experiences for 500M+ users, millions of sellers, and complex supply chains. Flipkart is part of the Walmart-owned Flipkart Group, which includes Flipkart Wholesale, Flipkart Health+, Cleartrip, Shopsy, Flipkart Travels, and Myntra. Join us to build the platforms that make AI at Flipkart possible.
