data.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world's most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12, 000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog. 

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them. 

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills-and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale. 

About the Team (Job Location - Pune) : 

As an AI Platform and LLMOps Engineer, you will join a fast-paced innovation team at Coursera working on AI enablement for our organization and customers. As an internal focus area, this team builds and maintains the infrastructure & tooling required to drive meaningful AI adoption across the organization, providing a platform for non-technical team members to build and deploy tools and transforming entire business functions into AI-native operating models. As a customer-facing focus area, this team builds custom AI-powered solutions tailored for our enterprise customers supporting them in their journey of AI adoption and upskilling beyond just the content on our platforms. 

You will own the operational backbone that lets our agentic AI systems run reliably in production - from prompt and pipeline versioning to evaluation, monitoring, incident and cost management. You will work closely with a cross-functional team of Software Engineers, AI Specialists and Product Managers - helping turn promising AI prototypes into reliable, observable, and cost-effective production systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain the operational tooling for our LLM-powered systems, including prompt/pipeline versioning, evaluation harnesses, and CI/CD workflows tailored to non-deterministic AI outputs
 - Implement monitoring and observability for production LLM systems - tracking latency, token usage, cost per request, output quality, and drift over time
 - Design and run automated evaluation suites to catch regressions, hallucinations, and quality degradation before they reach customers
 - Manage RAG pipelines and vector store infrastructure, keeping retrieval sources fresh, accurate, and performant
 - Implement safety and compliance guardrails - content filtering, PII redaction, and access controls - in line with enterprise data privacy and residency requirements
 - Own cost governance for LLM usage: caching strategies, model routing, and usage reporting to keep spend predictable as adoption scales
 - Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Senior Engineers to scope operational requirements and translate them into reliable systems
 - Participate in sprint planning, technical grooming, and retrospective discussions

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field

Basic Qualifications

- 4+ years of experience in a software engineering role, with a solid background in Backend Engineering and DevOps fundamentals
 - Hands-on experience operating or supporting LLM-powered systems in production (via APIs, RAG pipelines, frontier/open weight/fine-tuned models)
 - Proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Java, TypeScript or Go, and familiarity with Docker and container orchestration (Kubernetes)
 - Experience implementing APIs, working with SQL and NoSQL databases, and writing automated tests
 - Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), across both managed and self-hosted services
 - Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (e. g. , Terraform) and CI/CD tooling (e. g. , GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
 - Comfort debugging production issues involving non-deterministic systems, with attention to detail and a bias towards reliability
 - Strong belief in engineering quality and building tooling that creates leverage for others

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with LLMOps-specific tooling such as LangFuse, LangSmith, Weights & Biases-style evaluation frameworks, or vector databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector
 - Working knowledge of RAG architectures, MCP implementation & governance, agent orchestration frameworks like LangGraph and LLM Gateways such as LiteLLM, Open Router & enterprise AI ecosystems such as Vertex AI, Bedrock
 - Exposure to prompt management and versioning practices treated as code along with model access management, deterministic guardrails and evals
 - Understanding of AI governance considerations - data privacy, residency, and compliance in enterprise AI deployments
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with a proactive, ownership-driven mindset
 - Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating across engineering, product, and strategy functions

Why Join Us?

- Work at the operational core of Coursera's AI transformation - solving problems that keep real production AI systems reliable, safe, and cost-effective
 - Build hands-on expertise in one of the fastest-growing and most in-demand engineering disciplines
 - Join a supportive, innovative team with a strong culture of continuous learning and improvement

Accountable for everything built, configured, integrated, and deployed across ServiceNow, Dynatrace, Splunk, PagerDuty, GCP BigQuery/Vertex AI, and enterprise agentic decision workflows, the role establishes rigorous DevSecOps practices, Automated Test Frameworks (ATF), CI/CD pipelines, and Service Management as Code (SMaC).  - Access senior executive sponsorship, continuous leadership coaching, and clear pathways for ongoing professional advancement.

- Own platform health, code upgradeability, and release engineering across all environments. 
 - Drive aggressive adoption and expansion of the Automated Test Framework (ATF), establishing continuous regression testing to validate platform integrity. 
 - Accountable for seamless, zero-incident bi-annual family release upgrades and monthly security patching across all ServiceNow instances, telemetry collectors, and AI runtime environments. Platform Reliability, SRE & Operations Engineering

- Partner with the CMDB/CSDM and Platform teams to build robust Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, automated health monitors, and synthetic tests for core enablement platforms.

 - Provide Tier-3/Tier-4 engineering escalation support for platform-related major incidents, ensuring rapid root-cause remediation and long-term bug fixes. Global Capability Hub Engineering Stewardship

- Directly line-manage, inspire, and grow an elite global engineering team across Sydney and the Woolworths India (GCC) Capability Hub.

 - Transition traditional contractor and third-party development workloads into sustainable, highly capable internal engineering squads. 

Capabilities

- Full-Stack & Platform Engineering Mastery: Proven technical depth leading complex engineering squads across ServiceNow (architecture, scripting, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, ATF), Observability engines (Dynatrace, Splunk, PagerDuty), and cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - Applied AI & Data Pipeline Engineering: Engineering leadership in data pipelines (GCP BigQuery, Dataflow, dbt, Cloud Run), model operationalization (Vertex AI, Python, Docker), and automated closed-loop remediation scripts. 
 - DevSecOps & CI/CD Pipelines: Deep expertise establishing GitOps workflows, automated testing frameworks, vulnerability scanning, and infrastructure/service as code. 
 - High-Scale Distributed Delivery: Demonstrated success orchestrating 50+ software, platform, and data engineers within a multi-disciplinary, dual-location (Sydney & GCC Bangalore) operating model. 
 - Technical Debt Elimination: Relentless dedication to Out-of-the-Box (OOTB) engineering principles, avoiding brittle customizations, and executing frictionless platform upgrades. 

Career Experience

- Significant experience (typically 18+ years) in progressive software engineering and substantial engineering leadership background (at least 5 years) leading multi-squad software or platform teams.

data.title: Quality Engineering Manager
data.description:
📌 About Us

Posha is building robot kitchens for the future. 

Our first product, the Posha Countertop was recognized as one of TIME's Best Inventions of 2025 and received rave reviews from The Verge and WIRED for bringing robotics and AI into everyday kitchens. 

We're a fast-growing Series A-funded startup backed by Accel Partners and we're just getting started. 

See it in action: https: //youtu. be/Ubd6NkZOEkM?si=SFex-isehKHzvZs_

🤔 What can I expect from this role?

Posha is one of the rare robotics startups building production-grade consumer robots, with hundreds of units deployed in real homes. 

This role involves working on defining manufacturing quality standards and working with our suppliers for their adherence. 

🔧 What will my work responsibilities look like if I join Posha?

- Own quality assurance and control across all subsystems - sheet metal chassis, plastics, PCBA, induction/thermal, camera and opto-mechanical - through both development and production. 
 - Define quality processes and inspection requirements per part: tolerances, control plans, AQL sampling, FAI, PPAP, acceptance criteria. 
 - Manage non-conformance dispositions end-to-end - root cause, corrective action, supplier follow-through, escalation. 
 - Sit on the factory floor in China with our CM and suppliers to set up the processes that hold quality unit after unit. 

😍 What makes you a match for us?

- 5+ years in manufacturing quality at a hardware product company - hands-on supplier work, not pure inspection. 
 - Strong fundamentals: tolerance stack-ups, GD&T, FAI / PPAP, AQL, control plans, root-cause analysis. 
 - Experience setting up quality processes at a contract manufacturer, not just enforcing existing ones. 
 - Willingness to work in China for extended periods is non-negotiable. Our manufacturing is in Shenzhen / Dongguan. 

🚀 What The World Thinks of Posha

- Posha is comparable to Tesla FSD
 - "Posha is a fairly good sign that the future is closer than I thought" - The Verge
 - Posha's tagline is "See dinner cook itself, and it largely lives up to this. " - WIRED

Why Posha?

- Few organizations offer challenges similar to ours. Building completely autonomous cooking robots requires thinking from first principles and building from ground up. 
 - We believe that Posha is a generational company with the opportunity to alter the trajectory of how food is cooked inside homes today. This opportunity is parallel to how autonomous cars have made an impact. 
 - This role will be at the forefront of this opportunity.

data.description:
About Bazaarvoice

At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product-passionate community & enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever-expanding retail, social & search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands & retailers to gain valuable business insights from real-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products. 

The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long-term loyalty. 

Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers. 

Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. 

It's official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!

Who We Want

Are you ready to combine your talent for crafting solid data systems and enthusiasm for cutting-edge technology to harness the power of data at Bazaarvoice? We're looking for a strong database engineer who thrives on building large-scale, robust, distributed data systems and pipelines, who understands the importance of good software engineering practices to get it done. If you're excited about shaping the future of data at Bazaarvoice, come join us. 

How You Will Make An Impact

We're looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer to join our team. You are a technical leader who excels at both deep infrastructure expertise and platform thinking. You are passionate about reducing developer friction, enabling self-service capabilities, and building reliable, scalable "paved road" solutions that allow engineering teams to ship software faster and more safely. You will drive the evolution of our DevOps capabilities, mentor senior engineers, influence technical strategy, and collaborate closely with engineering leadership and cross-functional teams. This is a high-impact role focused on ownership of critical infrastructure components, CI/CD excellence, and cloud-native solutions. 

What You'll Do

- Design and evolve self-service tools, service templates, scaffolding, and paved-road patterns that embody best practices for engineering teams. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure cloud infrastructure using Terraform (or CloudFormation) at enterprise scale. 
 - CI/CD Mastery: Lead the design and optimization of robust, automated deployment pipelines supporting our "Single Tool Chain" initiative, incorporating GitOps practices. 
 - Kubernetes & Container Orchestration: Architect, manage, and scale our EKS environments, including advanced networking, ingress, resource optimization, observability, and reliability engineering. 
 - Build and enhance developer tooling, platform APIs, and abstractions that significantly improve developer experience and productivity. 
 - Reliability & Automation: Drive improvements in observability, incident response, chaos engineering, and platform resilience. Write production-grade automation in Python, Go, or Java. 
 - Technical Leadership: Provide mentorship to Senior and mid-level DevOps/SRE engineers, drive engineering standards, conduct design reviews, and champion DevOps best practices across multiple teams. 
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as a bridge between Development, SRE, Security, and Operations teams while partnering with engineering leadership on roadmap and technical direction. 

Required Expertise

- Experience: Btech with 10-15+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering roles with a strong focus on large-scale distributed systems and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Coding Proficiency: Strong software engineering skills. You treat infrastructure and tooling as code. Proficiency in Java (for backend services) or Python/Go for tooling and automation is required. Ability to deliver maintainable, tested, production-grade code. 
 - Cloud Expertise: Deep, expert-level experience with AWS (EKS, ECS, S3, Lambda, RDS, ECR, DynamoDB, networking primitives, IAM, etc. ). 
 - Container & Orchestration: Expert knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes (EKS), including advanced topics such as operators, service meshes, ingress controllers, and resource governance. 
 - Platform Tooling: Hands-on experience with developer portals (e. g. , Backstage) and GitOps workflows. 
 - IaC & Tooling: Advanced Terraform (or CloudFormation), Artifactory/Nexus experience, and strong Linux fundamentals. 
 - Software Engineering Fundamentals: Deep understanding of SDLC, clean architecture, design patterns, unit/integration testing, observability, and secure-by-default practices. 
 - Strong familiarity with AI-powered development tools and best practices for using the right model for the right task, including Claude, GitHub Copilot / Copilot CLI, and OpenCode (or similar LLMs) to accelerate infrastructure-as-code generation, automation scripting, code reviews, and platform development. 

Why You'll Love Working with Us?

- Work with cutting-edge tech in an innovative, collaborative environment. 
 - Competitive salary + good benefits (insurance, annual leave, bonuses, referral rewards, and more). 
 - We're Great Place to Work Certified (4 years in a row!). 
 - Hybrid work model (3 days in office - Prestige Tech Pacific, Kadubeesanahalli). 

Why join Bazaarvoice?

Customer is key

We see our own success through our customers' outcomes. 

We approach every situation with a customer first mindset. 

Transparency & Integrity Builds Trust

We believe in the power of authentic feedback because it's in our DNA. 

We do the right thing when faced with hard choices. Transparency and trust accelerate our collective performance. 

Passionate Pursuit of Performance

Our energy is contagious, because we hire for passion, drive & curiosity. 

We love what we do, and because we're laser focused on our mission. 

Innovation over Imitation

We seek to innovate as we are not content with the status quo. 

We embrace agility and experimentation as an advantage. 

Stronger Together

We bring our whole selves to the mission and find value in diverse perspectives. 

We champion what's best for Bazaarvoice before individuals or teams. 

As a stronger company we build a stronger community. 

Discover Life at Bazaarvoice

Want to see our culture in action? Explore our channels to see the bigger picture and meet the teams behind the tech: Global perspective : Head over to our global Linkedin Life Page, Life at Bazaarvoice to see what makes us tick worldwide. 

Regional Teams: Visit our APAC Life Page to see what life is like in our local offices. 

Want an inside look at Bazaarvoice India? > Follow our journey and check out our team reviews on AmbitionBox

Commitment to diversity and inclusion

Bazaarvoice provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants according to their experience, talent, and qualifications for the job without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, disability, sex (including pregnancy, gender stereotyping, and marital status), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military/veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law in every location in which the company has facilities. Bazaarvoice believes that diversity and an inclusive company culture are key drivers of creativity, innovation and performance. Furthermore, a diverse workforce and the maintenance of an atmosphere that welcomes versatile perspectives will enhance our ability to fulfill our vision of creating the world's smartest network of consumers, brands, and retailers. 

Please note that a standard background verification (BGV) forms part of our selection process. This will be conducted with your consent and will strictly focus on information relevant to the role. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Head of AI Engineering & Center of Excellence (CoE)
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Head of AI Engineering

& Center of Excellence (CoE)

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows. 

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development. 

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis's product-platform strategy. 

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities. 

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives. 

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations. 

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks. 

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return. 

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions. 

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration. 

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns. 

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management. 

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability. 

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows. 

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities. 

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance. 

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools. 

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes. 

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience. 

Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance. 

Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans. 

D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI Services

Architect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation. 

Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing. 

Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services. 

Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling. 

Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval. 

Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows. 

E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser Initiatives

Lead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content. 

Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions. 

Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation. 

Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing. 

Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs. 

Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability. 

Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams. 

F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and Governance

Define standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 

Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability. 

Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats. 

Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases. 

Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services. 

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements. 

Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews. 

G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Enablement

Provide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development. 

Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering. 

Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects. 

Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions. 

Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks. 

Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards. 

H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

Translate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures. 

Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability. 

Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits. 

Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs. 

Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership. 

3. Leadership and Decision-Making Expectations

Establish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO. 

Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE. 

Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources. 

Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required. 

Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk. 

Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes. 

Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization. 

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline. 

Typically 15+ years of relevant software engineering, architecture, or technology experience, including substantial practical experience with AI/ML and modern AI application architectures. 

Demonstrated experience leading AI engineering initiatives, architecture practices, technical teams, or enterprise AI programs. 

Strong practical knowledge of LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model evaluation. 

Experience designing production-grade AI services, APIs, orchestration workflows, and reusable frameworks. 

Practical understanding of agentic AI, tool integration, workflow orchestration, and MCP where relevant. 

Experience with Python, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud-based application deployment. 

Experience evaluating AI models and frameworks for quality, latency, cost, security, and operational complexity. 

Knowledge of AI application security, data protection, observability, model lifecycle management, and responsible AI practices. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor architects and engineers, influence technical direction, and establish standards across teams. 

Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to executives, business stakeholders, and engineering teams. 

5. Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an enterprise AI Engineering CoE or equivalent AI enablement function. 

Experience with comparable enterprise AI platforms and cloud-native AI services. 

Experience integrating AI-assisted software development tools into engineering workflows. 

Experience in insurance technology, policy administration, rating, product configuration, or document-intensive enterprise platforms. 

Experience with intelligent document processing, information extraction, rules extraction, or structured-content generation. 

Experience with enterprise knowledge systems, metadata-driven architectures, and reusable platform services. 

Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and production risk management. 

6. Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with the ability to establish a sustainable engineering practice. They can move between architecture design, hands-on problem solving, technical mentoring, organizational enablement, and executive communication. 

The candidate should build systems and teams that scale, establish standards without unnecessary bureaucracy, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical business capabilities. 

Ultimate expectation: Establish an AI Engineering CoE that strengthens Solartis's product-platform strategy, improves engineering effectiveness, accelerates AI adoption, and builds long-term organizational capability.

data.title: Lead Engineer-Hardware Validation Coexistence (AI Glasses)
data.description:
Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it's not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place-to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster. 

Key Responsibilities

We're looking for a Lead Hardware Validation Engineer to lead the AI Glasses System Coexistence validation team. You'll set the technical direction, lead a team of validation engineers, and be the main technical contact for customers and cross-functional stakeholders. Your team will make sure that the main subsystems in our wearable devices (Camera, Audio, Wi-Fi/BT, Display, Sensors, Memory and Power) work together without one disrupting another. You'll also lead the team in using AI tools to speed up scripting, log analysis and failure triage. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership

- Lead, mentor and grow a team of validation engineers: assign work, set priorities, review their output and support their careers. 
 - Plan the team's resources and staffing across several programs and build phases (EVT, DVT and PVT). 
 - Run regular team syncs, technical reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions. 
 - Build a team culture of ownership, technical rigor and continuous improvement. 
 - Help hire and onboard new team members. 

Customer & Stakeholder Communication

- Be the main technical contact with customers, program managers and engineering leadership for coexistence validation. 
 - Present validation plans, status, risks and results clearly in program reviews and customer meetings. 
 - Turn customer requirements and feedback into validation strategies and test plans. 
 - Manage expectations, escalations and trade-offs on schedule, coverage and quality. 
 - Write high-quality reports, executive summaries and closure documents for issues. 

Technical Ownership

- Set the overall coexistence validation strategy for AI Glasses programs. 
 - Define aggressor/victim test matrices and stress scenarios that reflect real use, such as camera capture during Wi-Fi streaming, or speaker playback during captouch use. 
 - Oversee concurrency testing and logging of victim-subsystem metrics (camera image quality, captouch false or missed touches, eMMC throughput and errors, RF sensitivity and desense, audio noise floor). 
 - Lead debugging and root-cause analysis of complex EMI, signal integrity, power integrity, thermal and vibration issues, working with the EE, RF, antenna, mechanical, firmware and software teams. 
 - Work with ODM and contract manufacturer partners on test setup, failure analysis and design changes. 
 - Review schematics and layouts to find coexistence risks early. 

AI-Driven Validation

- Lead the team's use of AI tools such as Claude / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor and Gemini for writing and debugging test automation scripts. 
 - Lead AI-assisted analysis of large device logs (logcat, dmesg/kernel, firmware and RF logs) to find failures, anomalies and coexistence patterns. 
 - Build AI-powered workflows that summarize test results, sort failures into categories, suggest likely root causes and draft bug reports. 
 - Set team standards for checking AI-generated output and for responsible data handling. 

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. 

Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard. 

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21, 000 difference-makers in our workplace. 

Work Experience

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of experience in hardware, system or platform validation for consumer electronics, mobile or wearable devices. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading engineers in a technical lead or people lead role. 
 - Proven experience communicating directly with customers or external partners, including presenting technical results and handling escalations. 
 - Strong practical knowledge of EMI/EMC, RF desense, signal integrity and power integrity testing. 
 - Expert use of lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power analyzers, signal generators and protocol analyzers. 
 - Python scripting for test automation and data analysis. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor or Gemini for scripting and log analysis. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in EE or a related field. 
 - Experience with wearables, AR/VR, smart glasses or other small, highly integrated devices. 
 - Familiarity with wireless technologies (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, GNSS, NFC) and coexistence between them. 
 - Knowledge of camera, audio, display, touch and storage (eMMC/UFS) subsystems. 
 - Experience with Android or Linux-based embedded platforms, ADB and firmware debug tools. 
 - Experience building custom LLM workflows through APIs (for example, the Claude or OpenAI APIs) or with agent-style tools such as Claude Code or Cursor agent mode. 
 - Experience leading teams spread across sites or time zones, and managing ODM or vendor relationships through new product introduction. 
 - Experience setting up validation processes, metrics and dashboards for a whole team. 

Key Competencies

- Leads people and builds a strong team
 - Communicates clearly and confidently with customers and executives
 - Takes a systematic, data-driven approach to solving problems
 - Owns problems from first detection to fix
 - Looks for ways to use AI to make validation more productive
 - Stays effective while schedules and priorities change

Benefits

- Work on cutting-edge Next-generation consumer electronics hardware
 - Work on High-bandwidth data streaming solutions
 - Automated hardware validation and test infrastructure
 - Collaborate with world-class engineers and product teams. 
 - Opportunity to grow as a technical leader in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Quality Engineer with experience in pressure vessel and heat exchanger manufacturing. The candidate will be responsible for fabrication inspection, welding quality, material traceability, NDT coordination, and quality documentation in compliance with ASME Section VIII, Division 1 & 2, and applicable customer requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Carry out stage-wise quality inspections during the fabrication of pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and related equipment. 

- Review engineering drawings, material specifications, approved procedures, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs). 

- Perform incoming material inspection and verify Material Test Certificates (MTCs), material grades, identification, and traceability. 

- Conduct fit-up, dimensional, visual welding, and final inspections as per approved drawings and applicable code requirements. 

- Verify compliance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), and welder performance qualification records. 

- Ensure weld identification, material traceability, and inspection records are maintained throughout manufacturing. 

- Coordinate NDT activities, including RT, UT, MT, and PT, as required by the approved inspection plan and applicable code. 

- Monitor hydrostatic testing and other applicable pressure tests, ensuring approved procedures and safety requirements are followed. 

- Coordinate inspections with Authorized Inspection Agency (AIA) representatives, third-party inspectors, and customer inspectors, as applicable. 

- Prepare and maintain inspection reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), corrective action records, and manufacturing quality documentation. 

- Support preparation and review of the final manufacturing data report and quality dossier, including applicable ASME documentation and the Manufacturer's Data Report (U-1 or applicable form). 

- Ensure inspection hold points and witness points are followed and properly released. 

- Identify quality issues, coordinate root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize rejection and rework. 

- Support ASME U Stamp-related quality activities in accordance with the company's Quality Control System (QCS) and applicable code requirements. 

- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Procurement, and Project teams to resolve quality-related issues and ensure timely inspection clearance. 

Required Qualifications and Experience

- Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. 

- 5-8 years of relevant experience in pressure vessel, heat exchanger, or process equipment manufacturing. 

- Practical experience in fabrication quality control and inspection of welded pressure equipment. 

- Working knowledge of ASME Section VIII, Division 1, and applicable material and welding requirements. 

- Knowledge of welding inspection, WPS/PQR, welder qualifications, NDT, dimensional inspection, and material traceability. 

- Experience in quality documentation, ITP/QAP implementation, NCR handling, and final inspection. 

- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in an ASME U Stamp-certified manufacturing facility. 

- NDT Level II certification in applicable methods. 

- Welding inspection certification such as CSWIP or AWS-CWI. 

- Familiarity with ASME material traceability, pressure testing, and Manufacturer's Data Report documentation. 

- Knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer L6
data.description:
Role Summary

The Staff Software Developer L6 will drive the technical design and execution of our core data platforms and full-stack applications. In this role, you will bridge data engineering (Snowflake, AWS) with full-stack development (Java, Python, UI) while ensuring our applications are highly observable and resilient. As an L6 engineer, you will look beyond individual features to design systems that handle complex data scenarios, lead team technical choices, and safely integrate AI-driven development tools into our daily coding workflows. 

Responsibilities

Technical Design & Execution

- System Design: Design and build reliable, scalable distributed data pipelines and full-stack application architectures across AWS and Snowflake. 
 - Full-Stack Development: Write clean, high-performance code across the entire stack-from Java and Python backends to user-facing UI components. 
 - Solve Ambiguous Technical Challenges: Take vague or complex product requirements and turn them into concrete, well-documented technical designs that the team can execute. 
 - Modernize Data Pipelines: Optimize big data processing systems using Spark, EMR, and Glue to process healthcare data efficiently. AI-Driven Development & Team Mentorship

- Practical AI Adoption: Actively use and promote modern AI development tools (like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code etc) to speed up prototyping, testing, and debugging. 
 - Code Quality & Validation: Establish guidelines so that the team uses AI tools responsibly, ensuring all AI-generated code is thoroughly reviewed, tested, and secure. 
 - Technical Mentorship: Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews and pair programming, helping them level up their engineering practices. 

Observability & Operations

- Build for Reliability: Implement end-to-end observability frameworks (metrics, logs, and distributed tracing) to ensure deep system visibility and quick incident resolution. 
 - Automation: Improve CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code to make deployments seamless and automated. 
 - Security & Healthcare Standards: Ensure all designs and implementations strictly adhere to healthcare data security requirements and HIPAA compliance. 

Qualifications

Core Engineering Experience

- Proven Track Record: 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with experience leading technical designs and engineering choices for a team. 
 - Data Ecosystems: Strong experience with modern cloud data warehouse architectures, advanced SQL performance tuning, and distributed data processing frameworks or managed data integration tools. 

- Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience building scaleable systems utilizing container orchestration frameworks, serverless computing modules, state machine orchestrators, and cloud object storage solutions. 

Polyglot Full-Stack Capabilities

- Backend Mastery: Strong programming expertise in Java and Python for building APIs, microservices, and data scripts. 
 - UI Exposure: Practical experience with modern UI frameworks (e. g. , React or Angular) to effectively connect front-end interfaces with heavy data engines. 
 - Observability Foundations: Practical experience setting up monitoring and tracing platforms (e. g. , Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, or ELK) to manage production health. 

AI & Leadership Qualities

- AI Innovations: Hands-on experience architecting retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, managing vector embeddings, and integrating large language models. 
 - AI Tooling Comfort: Hands-on experience using generative AI tools inside your daily development workflows, with a mature view on where they help and where they introduce risks. 
 - Autonomy: Comfort working independently, setting evaluation criteria for project results, and taking ownership of technical outcomes. 
 - Compliance & Domain: Familiarity with building software in regulated environments (such as healthcare, HIPAA, or finance) is highly preferred

data.title: System Dev Engineer II, AFT Platform Engineering and Services
data.description:
Description

The Amazon Fulfillment Technologies Support Team is looking for a System Dev Engineer II who will join the team which supports all software applications responsible for shipment, item availability, customer promises, shipment optimization and other functions related to fulfillment services process. 

Your problem resolving skill will benefit customers directly, ensuring Amazon is able to meet all its commitments to our customers. 

Primary responsibilities include designing and maintaining systems from in production, troubleshooting, diagnosing and fixing production software issues, developing monitoring solutions, performing software maintenance and configuration, implementing the fix for internally developed code, updating, tracking and resolving technical challenges, build and develop tools which will automate daily operational activities. 

Ideal Candidate should have Experience leveraging generative AI (GenAI) tools and large language model (LLM)-based assistants to accelerate software development, debugging, and operational workflows along with Hands-on experience with AI-assisted code generation, code review automation, or AI-powered incident triage tools

Responsibilities include leading or working alongside development/support teams on Amazon Corporate and Divisional Software projects, updating/enhancing our current software, designing of systems, automation of support processes and documentation of our systems. 

Your solutions will impact our customers directly! This job requires you to constantly hit the ground running and your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success. High Impact production issues often require coordination between multiple Development, Operations and IT Support groups, so you get to experience a breadth of impact with various groups. 

The ideal candidate must be detail oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, able to juggle multiple tasks at once, able to work independently and can maintain professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. You must be able to accurately prioritize projects, make sound judgments, work to improve the customer experience, and get the right things done. 

Key job responsibilities

- This engineer will lead the design and implementation of new tools, pipelines and automation, will work with DevOps Engineers and software development engineers. 
 - Planning and coordinating feature improvements and upgrades around services. 
 - Bring part of the team working on improving our service Operational Excellence and availability for PEAK periods. 
 - Analyzing and improving availability, efficiency, capacity, scalability, security and performance of our services. 
 - Representing Systems while working with internal teams and external partners. 
 - Troubleshooting and resolving problems with production systems as part of our on-call rotation. 
 - Developing, automating and maintaining tools. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate the software release process. 
 - Mentoring Junior Engineers and being part of their design reviews, code reviews and setting architectural direction along with coaching for their career growths. 

A day in the life

As a System Development Engineer, you will maintain, develop and automate AFT tools. You will manage the Operational Excellence of the infrastructure for high availability, monitor security and compliance. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
 - 3+ years of administrative experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering experience
 - 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
 - Experience with networking fundamentals including hands-on experience with load balancers, switches, routers, etc. 
 - Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with distributed systems at scale

data.title: Senior DFX Verification Engineer
data.description:
About the job

Job Description: 

- Develop and execute pre-silicon verification test plans for DFT features of the chip. Develop directed and random verification tests to validate the functionality. 
 - Verify DFT design blocks and subsystems (such as MBIST, high speed IO PHY, fuse, clocks, reset) using complex SV or C++ verification environments. Construct SystemVerilog and/or C/C++ models and test sequence libraries for simulation.

 - Post silicon ATE and System level debug support of the test patterns delivered. Optimize the test patterns to improve the test quality and reduce test costs.

- 10+ year experience in DFT feature verification (such as JTAG, MBIST, SCAN, fuse, IO-PHY loopback testing)
 - Strong background in Verilog, SystemVerilog (SV), SVA, UVM verification methodologies and C++
 - Strong debug skills and experience with debug tools such as Verdi. 
 - Experience with EDA simulation tools like Synopsys VCS, Cadence NCSIM, Verdi
 - Experience with scripting languages like Tcl/Perl/Ruby/Python
 - Working knowledge of Unix/Linux OS, file version control. 

Additional skills: 

- Experience in ATE debug, Synthesis, formal/LEC, or power analysis will be a plus. 
 - Strong analytical/problem solving skills and pronounced attention to details. 
 - Knowledge of STA Constraints for various DFT modes. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication

data.title: Senior SDET
data.description:
About the Company

Backbase powers the financial experiences of many of the world's leading banks. Our engagement banking platform helps banks unify customer data, orchestrate journeys, and deliver personalized experiences across digital channels. 

About the Role

About the role We are building the Customer Lifetime Orchestrator - an omni-channel marketing and customer engagement platform that helps banks engage end customers and influence financial behaviour. As Senior SDET, you own quality for this domain together with the engineering team: test strategy, automation completeness, and the team's ability to execute effectively. This is a hands-on test design and automation role - not a downstream QA handoff. You will partner with Product, UX, and full-stack engineers (web, mobile, backend, AI-assisted features) to shift quality left and scale automation. 

Responsibilities

- Define and execute test strategy and test plans per release (scope, risks, schedule, entry/exit criteria). 
 - Co-author acceptance criteria and Gherkin scenarios with Product; act as quality gatekeeper before releases. 
 - Build and maintain Playwright web E2E tests for real-world customer journeys across engagement channels. 
 - Govern mobile E2E strategy (Android/iOS) with engineers; use device-farm/matrix testing. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD with GitHub Actions (smoke, regression, quality gates). 
 - Manage test environments with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm. 
 - Use Grafana (or similar) to analyse test results and improve feedback loops. 
 - Combine automation with exploratory and manual testing for edge cases; reduce flakiness and improve parallelization. 
 - Coach engineers on TDD, BDD, contract tests, synthetic data, and shift-left practices. 
 - Advocate AI-assisted testing (generation, visual regression, maintenance). 

Qualifications

- 6+ years as SDET or hands-on QA with an automation-first mindset. 
 - Strong test planning and acceptance-criteria design with Product/UX. Required Skills

- Playwright (web), Espresso (Android), XCUITest (iOS). 
 - Java and JavaScript/TypeScript; Angular SPA, mobile, microservices. 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, RestAssured or equivalent). 
 - CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Jenkins), BDD/Gherkin, web and mobile E2E. 
 - Cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Docker/Kubernetes. 
 - Device/browser farms (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, or equivalent). 
 - Git/GitHub, Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence). 
 - Non-functional testing (performance, security, accessibility, localization). 
 - Excellent communication in distributed teams (India, Vietnam, Europe). 

Preferred Skills

- Digital banking, martech, or campaign/engagement management. 
 - Performance testing (k6, Gatling, JMeter). 
 - SaaS or enterprise software testing experience. 
 - AI/ML product testing; XRay, CucumberStudio, SonarCloud, security tooling.

data.title: Software Developer in test (Elite WMS)
data.description:
At Tecsys, the software we deliver keeps hospitals, pharmacies and distributors supplied with what they need, when they need it. Every role here connects to that outcome. 

Why This Role Matters

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) you will join our engineering team in Bengaluru, helping ensure the warehouse management software our customers depend on is reliable, accurate and ready for release. You'll design and maintain test automation frameworks, build Playwright-based UI and API tests, and validate end-to-end warehouse workflows, from receiving and putaway through picking, packing and shipping. By integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, using AI to work more productively, and learning the supply chain domain along the way, you'll turn complex product behavior into clear quality signals, faster releases and stronger customer confidence. 

What You'll Be Part Of

Tecsys is trusted by mission-critical organizations in healthcare and distribution to power resilient, efficient and secure supply chains. We are a global provider of cloud-based, AI-driven software, publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: TCS). 

Three values guide how we work. We earn trust daily by valuing the customer and acting with integrity. We build each other up by recognizing individual strengths and working as one team. And we explore boldly by staying curious and adapting for success. 

You'll join a culture driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and people who challenge what's possible.

Benefits

He / She will be working on multiple projects at the same time, building and managing diverse teams of engineers from different disciplines (in-house & outsourced). 
To succeed, you need to possess a blend of strong leadership skills and technical depth in Payments. You will own the systems that move money between diners, restaurants and payment partners across multiple APAC markets, including payment acceptance, orchestration, settlement, reconciliation and merchant payouts. 
This role is for someone who understands why idempotency matters, what happens when a PSP times out mid-capture, and how a one-cent reconciliation break turns into a finance escalation. You will lead a team of in-house and outsourced engineers, partner closely with Product, Finance, Risk and Compliance, and stay close enough to the code to make sound technical calls. 

Key Responsibilities: • Payments Platform Ownership: Own the end-to-end payments stack including checkout, authorisation, capture, refunds, voids, chargebacks, settlement, and merchant payouts. Lead integrations, onboarding, and ecosystem management with PSPs, acquirers, and gateways such as Stripe, Adyen, and Airwallex, as well as local payment methods across APAC (e. g. , PayNow, GrabPay, QRIS, PromptPay, GCash). • Orchestration & Reconciliation: Drive payment orchestration and smart routing across payment rails (Stripe, Adyen, Airwallex) to improve authorisation rates, reduce costs, and enable failover during outages. Own transaction-level reconciliation, analytics, and reporting across our ledger, gateway/PSP dashboards, reports, and bank statements. • Reliability, Security & Compliance: Set high bars for uptime and correctness with idempotent APIs, clear state machines, and auditable ledgers. Ensure PCI DSS compliance, tokenisation, secure data handling, and partner with Risk/Compliance on 3DS, SCA, and fraud controls. Track payment SLOs and lead incident response. • Delivery and Stakeholder Management: Work closely with Product, Design, QA, Finance, and Operations to sequence work by business value, refine stories, and communicate technical direction clearly to all stakeholders. • Team Leadership: Hire, onboard, coach, and grow in-house and outsourced engineering teams. Provide clear career development, set goals, and drive pragmatic agile execution to deliver value iteratively. • Hands-On Engineering: Stay close to the code, review pull requests, conduct technical design reviews, and debug production issues alongside the team when needed. 

Desired Candidate Specification: • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years as an Engineering Manager in a start-up or scale-up environment. • At least 4 years building or leading payment systems in production (PSP, fintech, marketplace, e-commerce, or food delivery). • Hands-on experience integrating with PSPs, acquirers, or local payment schemes, and deep understanding of money movement (ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation). • Practical knowledge of PCI DSS, tokenisation, and security/compliance best practices. • Proven track record of building and leading hybrid engineering teams (in-house and outsourced). • Strong tech stack knowledge: Java, Spring Boot, Node. js, JavaScript, HTML, MySQL, MongoDB, AWS/GCP, and event-driven microservices architecture.

data.title: Software Development Manager III, EU Off- Selection, EU International Technologies
data.description:
Description

Off-Amazon Selection (OAS) team aims to make worldwide selection discoverable and shoppable for its customers using large language models, and Agentic AI. In EU Off-Amazon Selection (EU OAS), we bring OAS to customers in Amazon's European stores building and owning OAS customer experiences and systems covering for multilingual, multi-currency and multi-country usecases within the constraints of EU regulatory setup. 

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to setup and lead the EU OAS engineering team in Hyderabad. As its founding manager, you will hire a full team comprising of software development, machine learning and support engineers, set the technical direction for EU OAS engineering, and lay its foundations. You will lead your team's work from the first launches to scale across Amazon's European stores, and take on more of OAS as the program grows in the coming years. 

You will build from scratch with a large platform team beside you. EU OAS is part of Localization group, whose platform processes tens of millions of products every day with machine translation, large language models and machine learning quality checks. You will reuse what already works at Amazon scale, partner with its engineers and scientists, and use that head start to make EU OAS bigger, faster. 

The problems are new and hard. Your team will build catalog, discovery and commerce systems that take in product information in many formats and levels of quality, decide what is accurate and eligible to show customers, match it to the Amazon catalog, and help customers discover, evaluate and buy it. 

If you want to build a team and a customer facing product from the start across 10 EU Stores, with the newest AI and a large platform behind you, we would love to talk to you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Hire, develop and lead the founding team, and set a high bar for every engineer you hire and grow. 
 - Own the technical vision, roadmap and architecture for your team's catalog, discovery and commerce systems, from the first launches to scale across Amazon's European stores. 
 - Build and run production systems that use large language models and AI at internet scale. 
 - Run the team AI-native from day one, with engineers using AI coding agents across design, coding, testing and operations. 
 - Own operational excellence, including on-call, health metrics that catch issues early, and regular operational reviews. 
 - Turn ambiguous problems that span teams and time zones into clear plans with owners and dates, and lead the designs, roadmaps and business reviews that set the team's direction. 

A day in the life

You might start the day reviewing the design for a service that checks product data for a new European store, then join a working session with scientists on how a large language model should match products to the Amazon catalog across languages. You will weigh in on architectural trade-offs, and sequence a multi-quarter roadmap against ambiguous requirements. You will invest in your people through 1: 1s, career conversations, hiring, and coaching. In the afternoon you hold one-on-ones and a hiring debrief, and review experiment results with product and science partners worldwide. 

About The Team

EU OAS sits in the larger Localization team that makes Amazon's selection available to customers in their own language across Amazon's stores. The new Hyderabad team will be the dedicated engineering team for EU OAS. Our program and operations teams already work in Hyderabad, and our engineering, science and product teams work from Luxembourg, Paris and other European cities. We build AI-native, with AI coding agents across design, coding and testing, and we build reusable building blocks so each launch makes the next one faster. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
 - Experience leading teams that build and run machine learning, large language model or agentic AI systems in production for large-scale catalog, search, discovery or e-commerce systems

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

We're seeking someone to join our FORT (Operations Technology) team as a Java Software Engineer. Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale, distributed Java applications supporting post-trade asset servicing operations. This Vice President role combines hands-on engineering, technical ownership, stakeholder partnership, and leadership across analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. The VP, Operations Technology, manages technology platforms supporting post-trade asset servicing operations, including corporate actions, income processing, tax services, custody support, and regulatory reporting, helping drive operational efficiency. 

Team Profile

Asset Servicing Technology is a part of Operations Technology that delivers end-to-end technology solutions for corporate actions and asset servicing across ISG and WM. The team supports the complete lifecycle of corporate action events, including notification, elections, entitlement calculation, payment processing, and claims management, through strategic platforms such as GLASS, ASRV, and Scorpio. It also drives platform modernization, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance through the adoption of modern technologies and engineering practices. 

In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. 

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world. 

This is Vice President position that develops and maintains software solutions that support business needs. 

What You Will Do In The Role

- Lead technology projects, manage deliverables, and oversee end-user and vendor interactions. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery in an Agile environment, including requirements clarification, architecture design, implementation, code review, deployment, and system maintenance. 
 - Collaborate with users and technologists to deliver asset servicing regulatory and strategic initiatives. 
 - Support global delivery teams and business operations. 
 - Mentor and lead global development teams. 

What You Will Bring To The Role

- Extensive hands-on experience-minimum 8 years-in software development for distributed transactional systems, including at least 2 years in a managerial capacity guiding teams through technical delivery. 
 - Experience in capital markets or investment banking. 
 - Proven leadership and mentoring abilities. 
 - Strong analytical and design skills; ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. 
 - Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills. 
 - Expertise in service-oriented architecture, Core Java, J2EE, Spring, Spring Boot, middleware (messaging/caching/RESTful services), Unix/Linux scripting, Junit, BDD. 
 - Solid understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, data structures, system resiliency, scalability, and performance. 
 - Demonstrated ability to guide teams in the use of modern front-end frameworks (such as React, Angular, or Vue), advanced JavaScript (ES6+), event streaming platforms like Kafka, Python programming, and relational database technologies (SQL, stored procedures). 
 - Familiarity with cloud-based application development, Agile, and DevOps practices. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience in investment banking or FinTech application development. 
 - Functional/business knowledge of the corporate actions and asset servicing lifecycle, including event processing, client elections, entitlement calculations, income and dividend processing. 
 - Exposure to cloud architectures and public cloud offerings.

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients - helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that's differentiated - and we've done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren't just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80, 000 employees in 1, 200 offices across 42 countries. Join our team and help shape the future of connectivity indoors and outdoors. Together, let's push the boundaries of technology and advance sustainable networks worldwide. 

How You'll Help Us Connect The World

As an AI Automation Engineer, you will design, build, and run the LLM-powered and agentic systems that are changing how we work. You will ship production AI services that automate triage, classification, and decision support for our operations and support teams, and build the AI-driven SDLC tooling that makes our engineers faster-from custom coding-assistant skills and agents to automated evaluation and guardrails. 

This is a hands-on role where you are expected to pair strong backend engineering with practical GenAI skills. You will be based in Bangalore, Karnataka. 

You Will Make An Impact By

- Designing, building, and deploying LLM-powered and agentic workflows that automate triage, classification, and decision support for operational and support teams. 
 - Developing production-grade backend services in Python - REST APIs and async pipelines-with solid prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and evaluation practices. 
 - Partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, well-documented AI solutions. 
 - Building and maintaining AI-driven SDLC automation such as spec-to-code generation, AI-assisted code review, and automated test generation embedded in everyday engineering workflows. 
 - Developing and extending AI coding-assistant tooling for engineering teams, including Claude Code skills and plugins, custom agents, and reusable prompt templates. 
 - Designing evaluation frameworks and guardrails for AI-generated output, using golden datasets, automated and LLM-as-judge scoring, and regression suites so quality is measured, not assumed. 
 - Monitoring and improving model quality, reliability, latency, and cost through observability, guardrails, and feedback loops. 
 - Maximizing token yield without compromising quality by delivering more useful, accepted output per token spent, with every optimization backed by evals that prove quality holds. 
 - Optimizing multi-agent workflows for speed, cost, and token usage through context management, parallel execution, and prompt optimization. 
 - Cutting token waste with tight context curation, prompt caching, right-sized model routing, and concise structured outputs. 
 - Tracking token efficiency as a first-class metric including cost per successful task and tokens per accepted output while setting token budgets for agentic workflows. 
 - Owning the delivery lifecycle in a DevSecOps environment (CI/CD, containerization, and automated testing from first commit to production)
 - Applying secure-by-default practices to every service you ship, including secrets management, access control, and dependency scanning. 

Required Qualifications For Consideration

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Electronics Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 3 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 1 to 2 years building LLM-powered applications that run in production. 
 - Track record of taking AI features from prototype to production, with measurable impact on quality, speed, or cost. 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) including prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and structured outputs. 
 - Practical experience building RAG systems: chunking, embeddings, vector databases (FAISS, Chroma, pgvector), hybrid search, and re-ranking. 
 - Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, the Claude Agent SDK. 
 - Familiarity with LLM evaluation and guardrail techniques: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, red-teaming, and mitigation of hallucination and prompt injection. 
 - Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor. 
 - Strong Python skills, including asyncio, type hints, and testing with pytest. 
 - Experience designing REST APIs with frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask. 
 - Experience with async, event-driven pipelines and queues (e. g. , Celery, Kafka, Redis), plus working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores. 
 - Experience with CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), Docker, Kubernetes. 
 - Working knowledge of secrets management (e. g. , Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), role-based access control, and dependency and container scanning (e. g. , Snyk, Trivy). 
 - Experience with observability tooling (e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Langfuse) for tracing, metrics, and cost tracking of LLM applications. 
 - Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform, preferably AWS. 

You Will Excite Us If You

- Have experience building AI for IT operations or customer support
 - Are experienced in reducing LLM cost and latency at scale through prompt caching, model routing, batching, and context compression
 - Have applied AI tooling to large C/C++ codebases. 
 - Have exposure to telecom or 4G/5G RAN, or a strong interest in learning the domain

data.title: Lead Engineer
data.description:
Lincoln Electric is a high-performance industrial machinery and technology leader who helps customers manufacture and maintain vital equipment and infrastructure. Lincoln Electric's innovative solutions enable higher quality and productivity across a variety of processes including welding, cutting, brazing, machining, process automation, and field repair. The Company leverages proprietary technologies and expertise in materials science, power electronics, automation, and intelligent software to help customers build better and achieve resilience in their operations. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, Lincoln Electric is the essential 'Linc' that keeps the economy running. The Company operates 71 manufacturing and automation facilities across 20 countries and serves customers in over 160 countries. For more information about Lincoln Electric and its products and services, visit the Company's website at https: //www. lincolnelectric. com. 

Location: Chennai

Req ID: 29097

Job Responsibilities

The Lead Engineer - Hard Automation & Special Purpose Machines role recognizes expanded responsibility in translating customer requirements into concept development, leading the design and validation of complex welding automation systems, and ensuring manufacturing-ready execution with delivery accountability. The position extends beyond individual contribution to include technical leadership, cross-functional coordination, project ownership, and team capability development for special purpose welding automation systems. This role places strong emphasis on mentoring and developing junior engineers, providing day-to-day technical guidance, design direction, and best-practice coaching. 

Scope

- Lead hard automation projects by setting technical direction from customer requirements through concept and execution, applying welding system expertise, and mentoring engineers to deliver consistent, high‐quality designs and owing project execution. 
 - Ensure designs emphasize manufacturability, assembly accessibility, and long‐term serviceability by applying DFMA principles, while working closely with manufacturing engineers to resolve fabrication challenges and mentor junior engineers on shop‐floor best practices. 
 - Perform and review structural and static finite element analysis (FEA) to validate safety, stiffness, and load capacity, and mentor junior engineers on analytical methods and interpretation of results. 
 - Own engineering deliverables with accountability for technical quality, cost targets, and on-time delivery, setting execution standards for the team. 
 - Perform detailed mechanical calculations and system sizing to support welding automation equipment design, including selection and specification of gearboxes, electric motors, servo systems, pneumatics, and hydraulics. This includes load and torque calculations, duty cycle assessment, inertia matching, safety factors, thermal considerations, and validation of selections against performance, reliability, and cost targets, while coordinating with controls, electrical, and manufacturing teams to ensure robust machinery execution. 

Job Requirements

- Builds engineering capability through mentoring, technical leadership, and strong design-manufacturing integration. 
 - Reduces rework and late-stage changes through early manufacturability and serviceability focus, reinforced via design reviews. 
 - Improves schedule adherence and execution quality by combining technical ownership with proactive guidance of junior engineers. 
 - Develops creative and robust mechanical design solutions and performs engineering calculations to support equipment sizing, component selection, and overall system performance. 
 - Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering with 10-12 years of experience in hard automation and/or welding automation equipment design. 
 - Strong experience in manufacturing-driven design, including conducting DFMA reviews, with a proven ability to design manufacturable and serviceable mechanical systems with an on time and on quality focus. 
 - Working knowledge of submerged arc welding applications, particularly for pipes, pressure vessels, and growing lines, with the ability to translate application understanding into design concepts.
