data.description:
Job Description

Leads platform projects crossing multiple teams, evolving runtimes or middleware patterns for interoperability and multi-tenant scale. Diagnoses and resolves complex cross-service issues; enforces versioning, compatibility, and safe rollout practices. Drives observability standards, capacity planning, and resilience patterns across several workloads. Produces migration guides and adoption playbooks that raise ecosystem consistency and developer experience. 

Responsibilities

Short Description

We're looking for exceptional engineers to join our team, with a strong foundation in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and modern technologies. This role presents a unique opportunity to design and build innovative, cloud-centric applications from scratch, and make a significant impact on our technical and business strategies. You'll enjoy autonomy and ownership in your work, and be part of a team that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity. Our dynamic and flexible work environment is designed to support and encourage you to excel, and thrive in a culture that fosters innovation and growth. 

Description

About Us: 

At Oracle, we are transforming healthcare by modernizing Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems to empower front-line healthcare professionals. Our mission is to enable them to focus more on patient care and less on administrative tasks, achieving peak efficiency with the support of generative AI and modernized applications. By leveraging the power of generative AI and state-of-the-art applications, we aim to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in healthcare delivery. Our approach to modernization includes investing in cutting-edge AI capabilities, advancing user experience, and offering open APIs that enable customers and third parties to develop innovative, integrated solutions. We are dedicated to creating a seamless and intuitive healthcare experience that benefits patients, providers, payers, and the entire healthcare ecosystem. 

Our Mission: At Oracle Health, we prioritize humans in the healthcare experience-for patients, providers, payers, and the population. We advance healthcare and population-level health by making cutting-edge solutions practical and effective at the practitioner level. Our goal is to enable patients to receive care from anyone, anywhere, on any device by providing practitioners with comprehensive medical information. 

As a Principal Application Software Engineer on our team, you'll be responsible for and will lead efforts in designing and building scalable, distributed, and resilient software components and services to support health care platform, applications, and our end users. We believe in ownership and expect you to think long term, mentor, and empower other engineers. 

Qualifications and Experience: 

Technical Skills: 

- BS degree in Computer Science or related field (MS preferred) 
 - 10+ years distributed service engineering experience in a software development environment 
 - Expert in Java and an exceptional problem solver 
 - Deep understanding of object-oriented design and SDK development, specifically within a cloud environment 
 - Strong skills in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals. 
 - Experience working closely with architects, principals, product and program managers to deliver product features on time and with high quality. 
 - Working familiarity with networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and standard network architectures. 
 - Experience with containers and container orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker) 
 - Good understanding of databases, NoSQL systems, storage and distributed persistence technologies. 
 - Good understanding of Linux 
 - Demonstrable technical leadership and mentorship skills 
 - Knowledge of OCI or AWS, Azure, GCP, Public Cloud SaaS, PaaS Services and/or related technology is a plus 
 - Good to have hands-on experience designing, developing, and operating public cloud service control planes

Functional Skills: 

- Design and implement intuitive and seamless customer experiences. 
 - Proficiency in Agile methodologies, especially Scrum. 
 - Experience using ticket tracking systems such as JIRA. 
 - Ability to quickly translate wireframes into prototypes and production-ready interfaces. 
 - Quick learner with the ability to pick up new languages and technologies. 
 - Self-driven and able to work independently on projects, even as designs evolve. 
 - Passionate about learning and staying updated with new technologies and services. 
 - Strong communication skills, including cross-team collaboration. 
 - Ability to deliver basic functionality and iterate rapidly. 
 - Experience working with geographically distributed teams. 
 - Significant plus: Knowledge of healthcare and experience delivering healthcare applications.

data.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

The Security Central team builds and operates services that help OCI teams understand their security posture, identify risks, and drive remediation across cloud infrastructure. The Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer designs, implements, and optimizes distributed system components, backend services, data pipelines, and integrations with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. 

The role includes owning features and service components from design through production, delivering load and performance tests, and using data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing. Responsibilities include building fault-tolerant paths through redundancy, replication, synchronization, and automatic failover; applying recovery-oriented design principles; and implementing retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. 

Operational ownership includes proactively detecting and mitigating issues through tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authoring runbooks; and participating in incident response and root cause analysis. The role also involves developing automation and Infrastructure as Code for deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance, and implementing security controls for encryption, access management, and remediation while meeting change management, compliance, and documentation standards. 

Close collaboration with security and engineering teams is essential to translate requirements into practical solutions. Contributions include technical design reviews, peer implementation reviews for scalability and reliability, and ongoing improvements to engineering and operational practices. 

This role is ideal for an engineer with strong software development fundamentals, experience with distributed systems, and an interest in building secure, reliable cloud services. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems. 

-Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. 

-Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Implements performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. 

-Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. 

-Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. 

-Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. 

-Implements tests scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 

-Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. 

-Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security. 

-Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management: 

-Maintains automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. 

-Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 

-Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

-Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Continuous Learning: 

-Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. . 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

data.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

The Security Central team builds and operates services that help OCI teams understand their security posture, identify risks, and drive remediation across cloud infrastructure. The Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer designs, implements, and optimizes distributed system components, backend services, data pipelines, and integrations with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. 

The role includes owning features and service components from design through production, delivering load and performance tests, and using data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing. Responsibilities include building fault-tolerant paths through redundancy, replication, synchronization, and automatic failover; applying recovery-oriented design principles; and implementing retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. 

Operational ownership includes proactively detecting and mitigating issues through tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authoring runbooks; and participating in incident response and root cause analysis. The role also involves developing automation and Infrastructure as Code for deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance, and implementing security controls for encryption, access management, and remediation while meeting change management, compliance, and documentation standards. 

Close collaboration with security and engineering teams is essential to translate requirements into practical solutions. Contributions include technical design reviews, peer implementation reviews for scalability and reliability, and ongoing improvements to engineering and operational practices. 

This role is ideal for an engineer with strong software development fundamentals, experience with distributed systems, and an interest in building secure, reliable cloud services. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems. 

-Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. 

-Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Implements performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. 

-Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. 

-Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. 

-Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. 

-Implements tests scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 

-Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. 

-Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security. 

-Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management: 

-Maintains automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. 

-Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 

-Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

-Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Continuous Learning: 

-Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. . 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

data.title: Software Engineer I -Data Infrastructure
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Role

The Data Infrastructure Team is a lean, high-impact group operating in a true founder mode. We are responsible for building and safeguarding all data systems, managing the lifecycle of 500+ production-grade resources across 10+ types of data stores. Our core mission is to build self-serve, automated platforms that ensure our systems are efficient, scalable, and continuously evolving. We don't just operate systems-we invent them. 

What You Will Do

We are looking for enthusiastic, innovative engineers to join our engineering team as Software Engineers (SDE-1). In this role, you'll collaborate with experienced engineers, contribute to real-world projects from day one, and gain exposure to cutting-edge tools and technologies. You'll play a key role in building and optimizing products that reach millions of users globally. you will join one of our many teams to develop robust, well-designed products, implement new updates and features, and solve complex problems that affect our business and our clients. 

- Invent, design, and build self-serve, automated platforms for managing the lifecycle of 500+ production-grade data resources across 10+ data store types. 
 - Drive innovation by engineering foundational tooling for all engineering teams, such as the Database Proxy and the database replication services. 
 - Pioneer and execute complex projects like large-scale, zero-downtime database migrations. 
 - Go deep into technical architecture, distributed systems, protocol-level debugging, and performance optimization to ensure systems are reliable, scalable, and efficient at petabyte scale. 
 - Build and maintain the core foundations for strategic initiatives, including multi-region architecture, sandbox environments, and a comprehensive, Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code platform. 
 - Focus intensely on performance, observability, cost and operability to maintain infrastructure that just works, even when handling ~100 billion queries/day and 10 PB of data transfer. 
 - Write core libraries like middlewares, ORMs, proxies, rate limiters, shard routers (in Python and Go) to support scalability and developer experience. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of projects, from initial design and planning to successful rollout and operation. 

What You Will Have

- 1-2 years experience working with fast growing, top tier product companies
 - Strong coding in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, or Go. 
 - Expert understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design principles and low level design
 - Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively in a collaborative environment
 - Understanding of system design and complex distributed systems
 - Eagerness to learn new technologies and apply them to solve real-world problems. 
 - Bonus points for open source contributions, competitive coding experience, and a strong Computer Science background from a Tier 1 institution. 

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling. com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

Education, Experience & Qualifications

data.description:
Global Sales & Services Operations (GSSO) is the team that helps shape Gartner's mission-critical sales and services priorities and works with sales and services leaders to drive tactical and analytical insights. As an associate on the GSSO team, you'll be at the forefront of the ongoing transformation of Gartner's sales and services teams, which drive approximately $5. 3B in Contract Value (CV). You will partner with business leaders across Gartner to support global sales and services teams comprised of nearly 9, 000 associates who sell to and service every major function across the enterprise

About the Role: 

Marketing Manager, Campaign Excellence will join the Global Marketing team in GSSO. The Global Marketing team is focused on driving topline revenue and increasing seller productivity. The team designs marketing programs to help prospective customers understand how Gartner's insights, advice, and tools can help them achieve the mission-critical priorities that drive organizational performance. The team accelerates sales activity by attracting, engaging and converting prospects through the delivery of compelling Gartner insights and experiences across the buyer journey. 

The Marketing Manager is responsible for leading a team of Campaign Excellence specialists while serving as a strategic partner to Revenue Marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. This role ensures successful planning, execution, and continuous improvement of marketing campaign operations, enabling Revenue Marketing teams to achieve business objectives efficiently and effectively. In addition to people leadership responsibilities, the Marketing Manager directly manages a portfolio of large, complex, and business-critical demand generation campaigns, serving as a player-coach who combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution. 

The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership, operational excellence, stakeholder management, and problem-solving capabilities. They are able to balance day-to-day execution with longer-term process improvements while fostering a high-performing and engaged team. ○ Balance workload and resources across the team to ensure priorities are delivered effectively.

○ Drive initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, quality, and team effectiveness.

data.title: AI DevOps Engineer – Platform & Infrastructure
data.description:
Hiring for PULS Group - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1, 700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure. 

About the Role

You will own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and operations behind the new global PULS website and the company's AI and agent infrastructure. The goal is a reproducible, highly available and secure Azure platform for 21 country sites, with committed uptime targets, defined RPO/RTO and restores that are actually tested. You will work closely with the Cybersecurity Engineer, the web developers and the AI team, GDPR-compliant with EU data residency. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex are part of the everyday toolkit, including for infrastructure code. 

What you'll do

- Build Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep for Azure-native workloads, Terraform where multi-cloud is needed), container setups on Azure Container Apps or AKS, and dev/stage/prod environments with preview deployments
 - Design high availability with replication and failover, committed uptime targets and defined RPO/RTO with regularly tested restores
 - Run load balancing, CDN (Azure Front Door) and caching for 21 country sites, including the China setup
 - Build CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with OIDC instead of stored secrets, rollback, and automated quality gates: tests, SAST/DAST, IaC scans (Checkov, Defender for Cloud) and Core Web Vitals checks
 - Set up logging, metrics, alerting and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry), including integration sync status and cloud cost control
 - Harden and patch, manage secrets in Azure Key Vault, run WAF/DDoS protection and backups, and operate managed PostgreSQL/MySQL with replication and safe migrations
 - Run Claude Code and Codex headless in pipelines with sandboxes and permissions, and deploy MCP servers and the runtime for AI search and the chatbot with the AI team

What you bring

- 4-6+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering on production, customer-facing systems
 - Hands-on Azure: Container Apps or AKS, Azure Monitor, Key Vault and Entra ID
 - Infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform that you wrote and maintained across environments
 - CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with security scanning and automated quality gates
 - Has operated PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar in production: backups, replication and performance tuning
 - Has designed monitoring and alerting and handled real incidents in live operations
 - Works AI-natively: uses Claude Code or Codex daily. Expect live pairing with a coding agent in the interview
 - English at C1 level and comfort working with colleagues in Munich and 21 markets

Nice to have

- Kubernetes depth, global CDN strategies and China deployments
 - Operating LLM/RAG workloads (Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry)
 - FinOps and cloud cost control; WAF/DDoS and hardening in production

Originally posted on: 29 Oct 2026

data.description:
Welcome to Natus Sensory India

We are continuing to grow our business in India and are now looking to expand our team there. Be part of this exciting journey right from the start!

Natus Sensory India are a leading manufacturer of medical devices and software for a range of solutions, including eight sensory nervous systems. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes in target markets through innovative screening, diagnostic and treatment solutions. We manufacture and distribute a range of medical device products used in the diagnosis of human disorders of sensory system and neural pathways. 

Job Function: Engineering

Job Family: Software Engineering

Job Overview

Design, implement, automate, and maintain CI/CD pipelines, build and release processes, infrastructure, and development environments that support medical device software across the software development lifecycle, in alignment with project objectives and established technical guidance. 

Ensure build, deployment, configuration management, and release activities are controlled, secure, traceable, and reproducible, and follow applicable Quality System procedures, design controls, regulatory expectations, and established DevOps and engineering practices. 

Responsibilities

At this role level the preferred candidate is fully proficient in most functional tasks and demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of their area of specialization. Responsibilities include collaborating with team members to solve complex problems, proactively identifying and addressing quality issues, and preventing potential disruptions within their scope of work. The individual is expected to document and present research, recommendations, and complex information in a clear and accessible manner to both internal and external audiences. 

- Contribute actively as a Scrum team member by participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, reviews, retrospectives, and delivery of assigned DevOps, build, and release work. 
 - Collaborate with software, cybersecurity, release, and management stakeholders to define, implement, and continuously improve build, integration, deployment, and release workflows. 
 - Analyze DevOps and infrastructure requirements and translate them into secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable pipeline, environment, and automation designs. 
 - Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Azure DevOps Pipelines, including automated builds, static code analysis, automated test execution, code signing, installer packaging, and artifact publishing for C#/. NET applications. 
 - Administer and maintain Git repositories and workflows on GitHub, Azure Repos, or similar tools, including branching strategies, pull request policies, code review gates, tagging, versioning, and traceability between commits, work items, builds, and releases. 
 - Provision, configure, and maintain Microsoft Azure cloud resources and environments, such as App Services, Virtual Machines, Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, and networking, using infrastructure as code where applicable. 
 - Develop and maintain PowerShell, Bash, or Python scripts to automate builds, deployments, environment setup, diagnostics, and support activities, and maintain Jenkins nodes, build agents, and virtual test environments. 
 - Support deployment and configuration of SQL Server/database components as part of the release process, including migration scripts, backup/restore, environment refreshes, and data integrity checks. 
 - Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or similar tools to support system availability, performance, and incident troubleshooting. 
 - Apply DevSecOps practices, including secrets management, role-based access control, dependency and vulnerability scanning, and secure pipeline configuration, to support cybersecurity, patient data protection, and applicable regulatory or Quality System expectations. 
 - Work effectively across Agile and waterfall software development lifecycle models, adapting build, release, and documentation activities based on project needs and guidance. 
 - Create and participate in reviews of pipeline configurations, scripts, infrastructure changes, release documentation, and tool validation evidence to support high-quality, audit-ready deliverables. 
 - Support technical problem-solving, share DevOps knowledge and best practices with team members, and communicate effectively in an international engineering environment. 

B. E. /B. Tech/MCA or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, with at least 6 years in DevOps, build and release engineering, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure or related software engineering. 

Compensation and Benefits: Along with a competitive salary and performance-based incentives, we offer a comprehensive benefits package starting from day one, including medical insurance coverage for employees and their families, gratuity as per statutory norms, and paid time off in accordance with applicable labor laws. 

Join Natus Sensory today. Confidence in every Sense. 

We Offer

- The role will start as a work-from-home remote position but will turn into a physical presence in an office role in Bangalore. 
 - Minimal travelling: less than 5%
 - Collaborative and international environment with different cultures. 
 - English company language. 
 - Full ownership of testing of features and functionality. 

EEO Statement

Natus Sensory is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

Description

TimeHub is chartered to build a world-class Time & Attendance platform that powers the full lifecycle of time tracking and pay computation for over 1. 8 million hourly associates across Amazon's global operations - spanning Fulfillment Centers, Delivery Stations, Customer Service and other business lines. Our systems sit on the critical path of Amazon operations: every shift worked, every time-off request, every accrual balance, and every paycheck generated flows through our platform. Getting it right matters - accuracy, reliability, and speed directly impact associate trust, pay correctness, and regulatory compliance across 65+ countries. 

Are you a seasoned engineering leader who thrives on building high-performing teams and solving complex, real-world problems at massive scale? We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead an engineering team within TimeHub, owning critical components of the Time & Attendance ecosystem. In this role, you will own a multi-year technical strategy for your team's domain, drive engineering excellence, and partner closely with product management, Amazonian Experience technology, and operations stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes for Amazon's workforce worldwide. You will tackle challenges unique to this space - computing pay accurately across thousands of policy configurations, ensuring sub-second latency for real-time time capture, and scaling systems that process hundreds of millions of transactions weekly. 

Key job responsibilities

- Own the technical vision and architecture for Amazon time-off management and pay policy execution - designing scalable, fault-tolerant systems that compute accurately across thousands of policy configurations and regional regulations. 
 - Build and lead a high-performing team - recruit, coach, and retain top talent; mentor engineers across levels. 
 - Raise the engineering excellence bar - drive best practices in code quality, design reviews, testing strategies, CI/CD, and documentation to ensure long-term maintainability and developer velocity. 
 - Drive operational excellence - own service health, on-call, monitoring, and post-mortem rigor for pay-critical systems. 
 - Define and prioritize the product roadmap - make crisp trade-offs between new capability development, tech debt reduction, and operational hardening in partnership with product, payroll, and compliance stakeholders. 
 - Drive cross-team alignment across TimeHub, Scheduling, DLS, WSTT, PXT, and Operations - removing blockers and ensuring seamless delivery across the time-to-pay pipeline. 

About The Team

We build low-latency, highly scalable policy computation and storage layers that power the full spectrum of Time-Off and Pay processing across multiple businesses and regions. We use cutting edge technologies from AWS and continuously challenge ourselves in building the right solution. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience

Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) builds high-performance GPU platforms for demanding AI, machine learning, and high-performance computing workloads. We are seeking a Senior Software Development engineer to join the Raw Metal Cloud (RMC) team and help deliver reliable, scalable AI infrastructure. 

RMC builds the software platform that manages the AI infrastructure lifecycle, from hardware onboarding and inventory through networking, provisioning, validation, rack certification, and customer handoff. Our work connects physical infrastructure with distributed orchestration services, enabling GPU capacity to become ready for customer workloads efficiently and reliably. 

As an IC4 engineer on the RMC team, you will own the design, development, and operate telemetry services supporting data center telemetry, device management, and hardware lifecycle automation. You will build reliable software that provides visibility into power, thermal, cooling, and device health conditions, helping teams detect issues and improve infrastructure readiness. Your work will help reduce manual intervention, improve infrastructure readiness, and increase the speed and predictability of GPU capacity delivery. 

As an IC4 engineer, you will independently own defined service components from design through production, collaborate with senior engineers on technical decisions, and deliver secure, scalable solutions supporting data center deployments. 

We value clear technical judgment, simple designs, ownership, and collaboration. You will have the opportunity to influence RMC's technical direction, mentor engineers, and build software with a direct impact on OCI's AI infrastructure. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and develop backend services and APIs for collecting, processing, and publishing telemetry from ILOM, Powershelf, PSU, PQM, BMS and related infrastructure devices. 
 - Build reliable telemetry integrations with monitoring platforms and storage services, including Poseidon. 
 - Develop device initialization, configuration, certificate provisioning, and certificate rotation workflows. 
 - Implement device health monitoring and automate device repair workflows. 
 - Build operational tools, dashboards, and alarms to improve troubleshooting and reduce manual effort. 
 - Improve service scalability, availability, and performance through load testing, failure handling, and performance tuning. 
 - Write automated unit and integration tests, review code, and maintain technical documentation and runbooks. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues and collaborate with infrastructure, security, hardware, and operations teams.

 - Strong programming skills in Java, python or a comparable backend language. 
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, concurrency, and distributed systems fundamentals. 
 - Experience developing REST APIs, integrating services, and handling asynchronous data processing. 
 - Working knowledge of relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and query optimization. 
 - Familiarity with Linux, networking fundamentals, TLS, and certificate-based authentication. 
 - Experience with automated testing, Git, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting using logs and metrics. 
 - Ability to translate requirements into maintainable solutions and communicate effectively across global teams. 
 - Experience designing for fault tolerance, concurrency, state management, and recovery in distributed environments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives from requirements and architecture through production delivery. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and across organizational boundaries. 
 - A record of technical ownership, sound engineering judgment, and mentoring other engineers.

- Experience with OCI or another cloud platform, object storage, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Familiarity with telemetry pipelines, monitoring systems, time-series data, and alerting.

Job Title: SAP Ariba Transformation Source to Settle Enablement Testing Specialist

Function: Supply Chain Services

Type of Role: Contractor

About Supply Chain Services

The purpose of the global EY organization is to Build a Better Working World. The insights and services the organization provides help to drive long-term value for clients, people and society and to build trust in the capital markets. An essential function under EY Business Enablement, Supply Chain Services (SCS), is a global team with more than 600 professionals in over 35 countries supporting the EY organization across the globe. This structure helps enable knowledge-sharing across categories and regions, streamlining efforts in seeking innovative suppliers that can provide exceptional client service to maximize SCS's value for the EY organization and the world's supply chain. 

This position is within the Source to Settle Enablement (S2SE) team of SCS. S2SE's purpose is to build optimal source to settle solutions to drive financial success for EY and their clients. S2SE is responsible for managing key lifecycle activities from purchase requisitions to AP processing. 

The Opportunity

EY is undergoing a S2P Gold Standard transformation, scaling a next‐generation digital solutions and operating model across the S2P lifecycle, with AI and data at the core. This includes an implementation of SAP/Ariba Procurement Suite at the core of the digital transformation. 

The SAP Ariba Transformation S2SE Testing Specialist will define, plan and manage testing for business transformation solutions across S2SE, business stakeholders, suppliers, and technology teams. This role will help confirm that business, functional, integration, security and user experience requirements are met before deployment, while supporting quality outcomes and reducing business risk to ensure test scripts integrate appropriately across SCS, EY Business and Finance processing. 

Your Key Responsibilities

As the S2SE Testing Specialist, you will manage end-to-end testing activities for transformation initiatives, including test planning, design, execution, defect management, user acceptance testing, readiness reporting and hyper-care support. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate requirements, manage risks and support go-live readiness. 

- Develop test scenarios, scripts and cases aligned to business requirements, process documentation and expected outcomes. 
 - Coordinate testing across SIT, functional, end-to-end, regression, UAT and security access phases. 
 - Track testing progress, document evidence, monitor risks and support timely resolution of blockers. 
 - Log, track and manage defects using approved tools, including triage support, fix validation and escalation of critical issues. 
 - Collaborate with EY business users, Finance and SCS/S2SE teams to prepare, execute and track UAT activities, including objectives, responsibilities and sign-off. 
 - Produce status reports, dashboards and leadership updates covering progress, defects, risks and go-live readiness. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Strong understanding of testing methodologies, test governance and defect management processes. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholders in a complex transformation environment. 
 - Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to present status, risks and recommendations clearly. 
 - Analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, assess impacts and recommend practical improvements. 
 - Inclusive and collaborative working style, with the ability to engage effectively across global and cross-functional teams. 

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of experience in software/application testing for transformation, technology, or enterprise application programs. 
 - 5+ years of experience leading testing activities for large-scale transformation programs, including test planning, test execution, defect management, UAT coordination, and testing status reporting. 
 - Experience working with cross-functional business stakeholders and technology teams across onshore and offshore delivery models. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication and change leadership

Ideally, you'll also have

- Experience in Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, ERP, Procure to Pay or SAP Ariba environments. Emphasis on S2P platform experience including SAP Ariba Strategic Sourcing Suite, Ariba SLP, Ariba Risk, Ariba Buying, Ariba Invoicing and Ariba Business Network. 
 - Experience with HP ALM, Azure DevOps, JIRA, TestRail or equivalent test management tools. 
 - Experience in Agile, hybrid or large-scale transformation delivery environments. 
 - Testing, Agile or project management certification, such as ISTQB, SAFe, PMP or equivalent. 
 - Microsoft Project to develop and manage plans
 - Microsoft Excel
 - Microsoft PowerPoint
 - Microsoft Visio
 - Excellent oral, written communication and presentation skills in business English
 - Experience with a global, culturally diverse organization. 
 - Experience working collaboratively, virtually and independently. 

What We Look For

We are looking for a collaborative professional who brings structure, quality discipline and practical judgment to complex transformation initiatives. The successful candidate will be comfortable working across teams, managing ambiguity and helping stakeholders make informed decisions that support successful delivery. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Sr Mgr, LMAQ Operations, LMAQ
data.description:
Description

When you attract people who have the DNA of pioneers and the DNA of explorers, you build a company of like-minded people who want to invent. And that's what they think about when they get up in the morning: how are we going to work backwards from customers and build a great service or a great product" - Jeff Bezos. Amazon. com's success is built on a foundation of customer obsession. 

Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decisions get made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of the customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on a Map? Is there a safe place to leave the package at? Can we make an unattended delivery? Would a signature be required? Is the address a commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does the customer have any special delivery preference? What are the other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing the delivery associate's route? Does the delivery associate know the locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside the building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of it all is the underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team capitalizes on Amazon's scale, speed, and ability to invent and simplify to accelerate the data flywheel and curate fresh and authoritative geospatial datasets to improve customer delivery experience. We work closely with tech and science teams on multiple initiatives to automate processes to operate at scale across all regions. 

Amazon is seeking an experienced leader to drive operations related to Maps and Navigation. As a Sr. Operations Manager with the Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) Maps team, you will run manual operations for fixing and deep diving defects related to Maps and Routing managing large teams (700+ member teams). You will partner with program, product, technology and science teams to improve the data quality and tooling and identify strategic long term solutions to improve customer delivery experience. As an operations manager you will focus on improving operational efficiencies and people processes. As a key member of the LMAQ org, you will continually raise the bar on innovation for great customer and delivery experience. You will bring innovation, a strategic perspective, a passionate voice, and an ability to prioritize and execute on a fast-moving set of priorities, competitive pressures, and operational initiatives. You will partner closely with program, product, technology and sciences teams to define operational processes and build innovative and delightful experiences for customers. You must be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and have the ability to break complex problems down into steps that drive operational efficiencies at Amazon speed. You will set the tempo for defect reduction through continuous improvement and drive accountability across multiple business units in order to deliver large scale high visibility/ high impact projects. Excellent communication and writing skills and executive presence to get in front of VPs and SVPs across Amazon will be imperative. You will need to work in a high pace environment with pressing timelines. 

Key job responsibilities

The Successful Candidate Will Be Able To

- Effectively manage customer expectations and resolve conflicts that balance client and company needs.

data.description:
DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a Quality Manager for our Amazon Logistics (AMZL) Last Mile Delivery Experience Team. 

The successful candidate has last mile logistics experience, an interest in and ability to work and think analytically, and manage all the aspects of multi-disciplinary projects and programs. 

Key job responsibilities

Become an subject matter expert for AMZL and customer service processes and systems

Conduct root cause analysis, define corrective actions and ensure they are completed. Dive deep on executive escalations. 

Develop a thorough understanding of customer needs and pain points related to our deliveries, both existing and potential. Produce white papers and present to senior management

Build strong relationships with stakeholders to understand and evaluate business priorities, define shared opportunities and requirements, and establish information sharing mechanisms. Work alongside stakeholders to define and execute innovative solutions for customers while influencing with and without authority. 

Deliver end-to-end continuous improvement programs, projects and initiatives. Develop and produce metrics and reports leading to performance improvement. Lead Kaizens or auditing activities in delivery stations to ensure process implementation. 

About The Team

Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles Last Mile delivery duties in partnership with multiple stakeholders - LM Ops, NOC, CPU, LMAQ etc. We utilize creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers' delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions. 

Key job responsibilities

Own daily and weekly operational performance governance for the cluster - review metrics, identify bottom-performing stations, conduct site Gembas, and drive defect reduction through structured action tracking with clear ownership and timelines. 

Partner cross-functionally with COM leadership, Station Leaders, CRMs, and central ACES Program Managers to diagnose quality gaps, align on root causes, and execute corrective actions through daily DBRs, weekly WBRs, and monthly cluster business reviews. 

Drive on-ground process standardisation and new program rollouts in coordination with L&D and Program teams - including training needs assessment, associate ride-alongs, and best practice sharing across COMs within the zone. 

Manage a structured escalation framework - resolving station-level issues within 24 hours, escalating systemic COM-level issues with proposed solutions within 48 hours, and raising technical/system defects via SIM tickets to Trans SME (NOC) for cross-functional resolution. 

Maintain regular stakeholder cadence with COM, Zonal QM, city managers, and business coaches to identify channel-level opportunities, track program updates, and ensure all recommendations are data-backed and concise for leadership decision-making. 

About The Team

The Last Mile ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence System) Quality team serves as the guardian of quality control and operational excellence within Amazon's last-mile delivery operations. This team is responsible for the adoption, oversight, and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across Amazon Logistics (AMZL), where packages are delivered directly to customers' doorsteps. 

The team's primary focus encompasses quality assurance and control processes throughout the entire package journey within Last Mile Operations. Key responsibilities include monitoring and improving critical performance metrics such as scan hygiene, delivery success rates, bad scan incidents, invalid scans, and various operational parameters including DOT (Delivered on Time), DDS (Daily Delivery Success), EMD (Estimated Missed Delivery), and CPS (Customer Promise Success) metrics. The ACES Quality team operates at multiple organizational levels-Network, Zone, and Cluster-to identify operational process gaps and drive improvements using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies. 

The team's operational model includes deployment of Quality Associates to identified hotspot sites across the network, where they collaborate directly with operations teams to address quality parameters and implement corrective measures. Through systematic auditing, performance tracking via specialized dashboards, and continuous process refinement, the Last Mile ACES Quality team ensures that Amazon maintains its commitment to being Earth's most customer-centric company by delivering exceptional service quality and operational excellence in its final-mile delivery operations. 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

About The Team

The mission of the UI Test team is to ensure best-in-class UI experience for Rubrik products. The team accomplishes this by testing and automating customer workflows, providing UI automation infrastructure for end to end validation and benchmarking, checking usability and user experience and consistency across the features and products. Key stakeholders are product component teams, product management, release managers and end customers. 

The key responsibilities of the team include qualifying new features for production release and leading UI release regression qualification across Rubrik's on-prem and cloud products. We build and use AI-native skills that automate the entire testing lifecycle, starting from generating the UI test plan to executing them in real environments.

 - Release regression testing: 
 - 
 - All released features are regression tested in every release, on a cadence that depends on the product, with both manual and automated UI testing.

 - New features enter the automation backlog after release and are picked up by priority. UI Automation using browser automation frameworks such as Playwright.

 - Solid understanding on data protection, storage, security, virtualization, databases, cloud, kubernetes and generative AI

- Defines and owns the multi-year technical roadmap for on-prem platform architecture, balancing performance, reliability, cost, and manufacturability

data.title: Team Lead - Software Technology
data.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28, 000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As a Team Lead - Software Technology, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for teams designing, developing, testing, and delivering scalable enterprise software solutions. You will guide architecture and engineering practices, mentor software engineers, and drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering, including agentic AI and Microsoft Copilot capabilities. You will report to the Engineering Manager and work on a hybrid schedule in Pune/Noida, India. 

Your Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership across the software development lifecycle, including solution design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance, and support. 
 - Lead architectural and technical design discussions to deliver scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable enterprise software solutions. 
 - Drive practical adoption of AI-assisted software engineering, including Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI solutions, to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows. 
 - Identify, prototype, and scale AI use cases using Python, APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and autonomous or multi-agent workflow patterns while applying appropriate security, privacy, human oversight, and responsible AI controls. 
 - Guide Agile execution through PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, task breakdown, effort estimation, risk identification, and delivery commitments. 
 - Review requirements, technical designs, code, test cases, and user documentation to ensure adherence to engineering standards and quality practices. 
 - Mentor engineers on modern software practices and effective, responsible use of AI coding assistants and automation tools. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Architects, Engineering Managers, QA, UX, DevOps, data, AI, and global development teams to achieve product and program objectives. 
 - Lead troubleshooting, debugging, integration, and resolution of complex technical issues across systems and subsystems. 

The Essentials - You Will Have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of experience in software development, software design, and enterprise application development. 
 - 3+ years of experience in a Technical Lead, Team Lead, or comparable technical leadership role. 
 - 5+ years of experience conducting design reviews, code reviews, and technical assessments. 
 - Mandatory hands-on Python experience for automation, data processing, API integration, prototyping, or AI-enabled application development. 
 - Mandatory practical experience using enterprise generative AI and coding-assistant tools such as Microsoft Copilot or GitHub Copilot in software engineering workflows. 
 - Demonstrated understanding of agentic AI concepts, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation, and safe deployment of AI agents. 
 - Working knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings or vector search, and integration of AI services through APIs. 
 - Ability to apply responsible AI, cybersecurity, data privacy, intellectual-property, and model-risk controls when using AI-generated code or AI-enabled solutions. 
 - Strong experience in software architecture, object-oriented design, system integration, debugging, and enterprise application development. 
 - Experience leading Agile software development teams and participating in SAFe or a similar scaled Agile framework. 
 - The ability to travel up to 10% of the time. 

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

- Experience designing or implementing agentic or multi-agent solutions using frameworks such as Microsoft Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, LangChain, or AutoGen. 
 - Experience building AI-enabled applications on Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, or related data and AI services. 
 - Experience defining AI evaluation criteria, guardrails, observability, cost controls, and adoption metrics for enterprise use cases. 
 - Strong expertise in Java, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and enterprise application design patterns. 
 - Experience with modern UI/UX technologies and enterprise user interface development. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, containerization, virtualization, and modern software delivery approaches. 
 - Knowledge of test automation strategies and development practices such as TDD and BDD. 
 - Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, MES, or consumer products industries. 
 - Demonstrated success influencing technical direction, driving engineering excellence, and developing high-performing engineering teams. 

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes . . . 

- Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm. 
 - Volunteer Paid Time Off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees. 
 - Company volunteer and donation matching program. 
 - Employee Assistance Program. 
 - Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program. 
 - On-demand digital course library for professional development. 
 - and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right person for this or another role.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer - Applications Architect
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Principal Software Engineer - Applications Architect

Principal Engineer - Applications Architect

Worker Type Level Location Number of Positions

Employee L5 Pune 1

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview

Payments Network Technology is seeking a Principal Engineer to provide technical and delivery leadership across payment-network initiatives. This role will connect architecture, release coordination, dependency management, and engineering execution across multiple teams. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Define and evolve architecture for secure, scalable, and highly available payment-network services, predominantly Java based. 
 - Coordinate technical delivery across teams, including releases, dependencies, defect triage, and resolution of cross-cutting issues. 
 - Partner with product and engineering leaders to translate business needs into architecture and implementation direction. 
 - Lead design reviews and drive decisions on APIs, service interactions, data, resiliency, security, and operational readiness. 
 - Identify reuse opportunities and promote common engineering patterns and standards. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leads across teams. 
 - Communicate architecture trade-offs, delivery risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders. 
 - Provide technical or product leadership, mentor team members, and drive decisions across multiple workstreams. 

Essential Skills

- Extensive software architecture and hands-on Java development experience in large-scale systems. 
 - Deep knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture especially Kafka, SQL/NoSQL, and cloud-native platforms. 
 - Experience with secure engineering, DevOps, performance, resiliency, observability, and production-readiness practices. 
 - Ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

All About You

- Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Clear communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams. 
 - Experience leading SOAR (Solution Architecture Review) and driving technical strategy, architecture alignment, engineering excellence, and risk management across multiple teams. 
 - Experience creating and reviewing TADs (Technical Architecture Documents) for large-scale distributed systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, security requirements, resiliency objectives, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Demonstrated experience defining and governing cross-platform architecture, enabling interoperability, reuse, standardization, and consistent engineering practices across multiple products and services. 
 - Experience designing and implementing multi-region resiliency architectures, including active-active and active-passive deployment patterns, disaster recovery strategies, cross-region data replication, failover mechanisms, and business continuity solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed data management, including data replication, consistency models, recovery objectives, and operational considerations across geographic regions. 
 - Champions operability and maintainability as first-class design principles, ensuring observability, monitoring, automation, self-healing capabilities, supportability, and simplified operational management are built into solutions from inception. 
 - Deep understanding of Mastercard Engineering Principles (or equivalent large-scale enterprise engineering standards) and a proven ability to apply them consistently across architecture, software design, deployment, resiliency, security, and operational practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to balance architecture, business priorities, scalability, security, resiliency, and operational considerations while establishing technology direction for multiple engineering teams. 
 - Experience defining architecture guardrails, engineering standards, reference implementations, and reusable patterns that improve consistency, quality, and delivery effectiveness across the organization. 
 - Strong knowledge of reliability engineering practices, including service-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, observability, fault isolation, disaster recovery testing, and continuous resilience validation. 
 - Payments or financial-services domain knowledge is preferred. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Senior Data Systems Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Senior Data System Software engineer: Oracle Database 26ai and client drivers System Test Engineering

Database Product Development | Senior Lead or Principal Level

Role summary This role combines hands-on Oracle database development with component, integration, system, stress, and performance testing. The engineer will build automated test solutions for Oracle Database 26ai, Oracle client drivers, converged database features, and the major Oracle client drivers on Windows and Linux. 

Team and mission

The SHARP VLDB organisation improves the scalability, high availability, reliability, and performance of Oracle Database and cloud services. The team designs realistic, high-volume and highly concurrent workloads that expose product defects and architectural limitations before release. Engineers work closely with database kernel, feature, client drivers, cloud, and support teams to reproduce issues, verify fixes, and strengthen product quality across on-premises and cloud deployments. 

Role at a glance

Primary Focus

Database feature development and cross-platform system test engineering

Target database

Oracle Database 26ai with vector and AI capabilities

Platforms

Windows Server and Linux, including cross-platform compatibility and interoperability

Database areas

XDB, JSON, Oracle Text, SQL and PL/SQL, multitenant and high availability

ODAC scope

ODP. NET Core, Managed and Unmanaged providers and related ODAC components

Client drivers

python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI-C driver and JDBC

Test coverage

Functional, integration, compatibility, upgrade, patch, system, stress, performance and resiliency

Responsibilities

Design and develop production-scale database schemas, data generators, workload drivers, and application logic using SQL, PL/SQL, Python, Java, JavaScript or Node. js, C/C++, and C# as appropriate. 

- Create highly automated end-to-end test suites that simulate large enterprise applications, high concurrency, long-duration operation, mixed workloads, and very large databases. 
 - Review Oracle Database 26ai feature designs and translate functional and architectural requirements into test strategies, coverage matrices, test specifications, and reusable automation. 
 - Validate Oracle Database 26ai vector and AI capabilities, including vector data types, vector indexes, similarity search, hybrid vector and text scenarios, embedding workflows, concurrency, correctness, performance, and upgrade compatibility. 
 - Develop comprehensive coverage for XDB and XML processing, JSON data management and APIs, and Oracle Text indexing, search, synchronization, security, and mixed-workload interoperability. 
 - Test ODAC and ODP. NET components across Windows and Linux, including platform-appropriate ODP. NET Core, Managed, and Unmanaged provider scenarios, connection management, pooling, transactions, data type mappings, high availability, security, and framework integration. 
 - Build a consistent cross-driver test matrix for python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI C, and JDBC to validate feature parity, protocol behavior, data type support, error handling, failover, performance, and backward compatibility. 
 - Exercise client and server combinations across Windows and Linux, including installation, configuration, networking, TLS, authentication, character sets, file systems, process and memory behavior, and operating-system-specific regressions. 
 - Test Release Updates, one-off patches, client upgrades, rolling maintenance, database upgrades, and mixed-version scenarios while preserving data correctness and service availability. 
 - Execute tests on standalone databases, multitenant CDB and PDB environments, RAC and ASM clusters, Data Guard configurations, Exadata, and cloud or Autonomous Database environments as applicable. 
 - Develop monitoring and diagnostics for database, operating system, network, application, and client layers; analyze traces, dumps, logs, wait events, execution plans, memory usage, and performance profiles. 
 - File high-quality defects with reproducible evidence, isolate failures to the responsible layer, collaborate with development teams on root cause, and verify fixes across platforms and client stacks. 
 - Enhance test frameworks based on customer escalations and field defects, and participate in feature reviews, certification exercises, documentation reviews, and quality readiness assessments. Core technical scope

Area

Technologies

Expected coverage

Database features

XDB XML, JSON, Oracle Text, SQL, PL/SQL, Multitenant

Correctness, interoperability, security, concurrency, upgrade and performance

AI and vector

Vector types, indexes, similarity and hybrid search, AI workflows

Accuracy, scale, performance, resiliency and client accessibility

ODAC and . NET

ODP. NET Core, Managed and Unmanaged providers

Windows and Linux component behavior, pooling, transactions, HA and data types

Client drivers

python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI C and JDBC

Feature parity, compatibility, error handling, failover and throughput

Platforms

Windows Server, Linux, RAC, ASM, Data Guard and cloud

Installation, networking, security, resource behavior and lifecycle operations

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Strong Oracle Database development experience with SQL, PL/SQL, schema and physical design, transaction processing, concurrency, diagnostics, and performance tuning. 
 - Experience developing or testing database client applications using at least two of the following: Python, Node. js, C/C++, Java, or C# and . NET. 
 - Practical knowledge of client-server database architecture, Oracle Net connectivity, connection pooling, transactions, data type conversion, error handling, and high-availability behavior. 
 - Strong Windows and Linux engineering skills, including services and processes, networking, file systems, security, automation, resource monitoring, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience designing automated functional, integration, system, stress, or performance tests and diagnosing failures across multiple software layers. 
 - Ability to read feature designs, identify risk areas, create measurable coverage, and produce maintainable test code and clear defect reports. 
 - Experience with source control and continuous integration practices, such as Git, build pipelines, automated regression execution, and artifact management. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across geographically distributed engineering teams. 

Preferred Experience

- Expert Oracle Design/Development/Principal DBAs (OR) Lead/Principal Oracle DB Developers with sound

Oracle DB Application Development cum DBA Full-Life cycle experience ranging from 4-12 years. 

- Oracle Database 23ai or 26ai, AI Vector Search, machine learning or embedding-based applications, and performance evaluation of AI-assisted database workloads. 
 - ODAC, ODP. NET, . NET and . NET Core, Entity Framework Core, ADO. NET, ASP. NET, IIS, Visual Studio, and Windows application diagnostics. 
 - python-oracledb Thin and Thick modes, node-oracledb, OCI C interfaces, JDBC Thin or OCI modes, and cross-driver compatibility testing. 
 - Oracle XDB and XML, native JSON capabilities, Oracle Text, search indexing, document-oriented applications, and mixed JSON relational workloads. 
 - Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard, Multitenant, Exadata, Autonomous Database, Database Cloud Services, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - PowerShell, shell, Python automation, REST APIs, container platforms, orchestration, observability, and infrastructure-as-code tools. 
 - Experience analyzing customer escalations or post-release defects and converting them into durable automated regression coverage.
