Job Description

Senior Data System Software engineer: Oracle Database 26ai and client drivers System Test Engineering

Database Product Development | Senior Lead or Principal Level

Role summary This role combines hands-on Oracle database development with component, integration, system, stress, and performance testing. The engineer will build automated test solutions for Oracle Database 26ai, Oracle client drivers, converged database features, and the major Oracle client drivers on Windows and Linux. 

Team and mission

The SHARP VLDB organisation improves the scalability, high availability, reliability, and performance of Oracle Database and cloud services. The team designs realistic, high-volume and highly concurrent workloads that expose product defects and architectural limitations before release. Engineers work closely with database kernel, feature, client drivers, cloud, and support teams to reproduce issues, verify fixes, and strengthen product quality across on-premises and cloud deployments. 

Role at a glance

Primary Focus

Database feature development and cross-platform system test engineering

Target database

Oracle Database 26ai with vector and AI capabilities

Platforms

Windows Server and Linux, including cross-platform compatibility and interoperability

Database areas

XDB, JSON, Oracle Text, SQL and PL/SQL, multitenant and high availability

ODAC scope

ODP. NET Core, Managed and Unmanaged providers and related ODAC components

Client drivers

python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI-C driver and JDBC

Test coverage

Functional, integration, compatibility, upgrade, patch, system, stress, performance and resiliency

Responsibilities

Design and develop production-scale database schemas, data generators, workload drivers, and application logic using SQL, PL/SQL, Python, Java, JavaScript or Node. js, C/C++, and C# as appropriate. 

- Create highly automated end-to-end test suites that simulate large enterprise applications, high concurrency, long-duration operation, mixed workloads, and very large databases. 
 - Review Oracle Database 26ai feature designs and translate functional and architectural requirements into test strategies, coverage matrices, test specifications, and reusable automation. 
 - Validate Oracle Database 26ai vector and AI capabilities, including vector data types, vector indexes, similarity search, hybrid vector and text scenarios, embedding workflows, concurrency, correctness, performance, and upgrade compatibility. 
 - Develop comprehensive coverage for XDB and XML processing, JSON data management and APIs, and Oracle Text indexing, search, synchronization, security, and mixed-workload interoperability. 
 - Test ODAC and ODP. NET components across Windows and Linux, including platform-appropriate ODP. NET Core, Managed, and Unmanaged provider scenarios, connection management, pooling, transactions, data type mappings, high availability, security, and framework integration. 
 - Build a consistent cross-driver test matrix for python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI C, and JDBC to validate feature parity, protocol behavior, data type support, error handling, failover, performance, and backward compatibility. 
 - Exercise client and server combinations across Windows and Linux, including installation, configuration, networking, TLS, authentication, character sets, file systems, process and memory behavior, and operating-system-specific regressions. 
 - Test Release Updates, one-off patches, client upgrades, rolling maintenance, database upgrades, and mixed-version scenarios while preserving data correctness and service availability. 
 - Execute tests on standalone databases, multitenant CDB and PDB environments, RAC and ASM clusters, Data Guard configurations, Exadata, and cloud or Autonomous Database environments as applicable. 
 - Develop monitoring and diagnostics for database, operating system, network, application, and client layers; analyze traces, dumps, logs, wait events, execution plans, memory usage, and performance profiles. 
 - File high-quality defects with reproducible evidence, isolate failures to the responsible layer, collaborate with development teams on root cause, and verify fixes across platforms and client stacks. 
 - Enhance test frameworks based on customer escalations and field defects, and participate in feature reviews, certification exercises, documentation reviews, and quality readiness assessments. Core technical scope

Area

Technologies

Expected coverage

Database features

XDB XML, JSON, Oracle Text, SQL, PL/SQL, Multitenant

Correctness, interoperability, security, concurrency, upgrade and performance

AI and vector

Vector types, indexes, similarity and hybrid search, AI workflows

Accuracy, scale, performance, resiliency and client accessibility

ODAC and . NET

ODP. NET Core, Managed and Unmanaged providers

Windows and Linux component behavior, pooling, transactions, HA and data types

Client drivers

python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI C and JDBC

Feature parity, compatibility, error handling, failover and throughput

Platforms

Windows Server, Linux, RAC, ASM, Data Guard and cloud

Installation, networking, security, resource behavior and lifecycle operations

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Strong Oracle Database development experience with SQL, PL/SQL, schema and physical design, transaction processing, concurrency, diagnostics, and performance tuning. 
 - Experience developing or testing database client applications using at least two of the following: Python, Node. js, C/C++, Java, or C# and . NET. 
 - Practical knowledge of client-server database architecture, Oracle Net connectivity, connection pooling, transactions, data type conversion, error handling, and high-availability behavior. 
 - Strong Windows and Linux engineering skills, including services and processes, networking, file systems, security, automation, resource monitoring, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience designing automated functional, integration, system, stress, or performance tests and diagnosing failures across multiple software layers. 
 - Ability to read feature designs, identify risk areas, create measurable coverage, and produce maintainable test code and clear defect reports. 
 - Experience with source control and continuous integration practices, such as Git, build pipelines, automated regression execution, and artifact management. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across geographically distributed engineering teams. 

Preferred Experience

- Expert Oracle Design/Development/Principal DBAs (OR) Lead/Principal Oracle DB Developers with sound

Oracle DB Application Development cum DBA Full-Life cycle experience ranging from 4-12 years. 

- Oracle Database 23ai or 26ai, AI Vector Search, machine learning or embedding-based applications, and performance evaluation of AI-assisted database workloads. 
 - ODAC, ODP. NET, . NET and . NET Core, Entity Framework Core, ADO. NET, ASP. NET, IIS, Visual Studio, and Windows application diagnostics.

About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL): AGEL is part of the Adani Group's promise to provide a better, cleaner, and greener future for India. Driven by the Group's philosophy of Growth with Goodness', the Company develops, builds, owns, operates, and maintains utility- scale grid-connected solar, wind farm and energy storage (Hydro PSP and Battery) projects. The electricity generated is supplied to central and state government entities and government- backed corporations. On the back of long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with central and state government entities, AGEL has leveraged its capabilities and expanded its presence across 12 Indian states. With the integration of pump storage and battery storage projects with large solar & wind portfolio, AGEL shall be best placed amongst peers to supply round-the-clock green power to India's grid. The Company continuously adopts and deploys the latest technologies in its projects. With the target of 50 GW renewable energy capacity by 2030, AGEL is driving India on its renewable energy journey. 

Job Purpose: Engineer - Commissioning is responsible for the systematic commissioning of renewable energy systems, focusing on validating and verifying system performance, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring alignment with technical requirements and goals

Responsibilities

Commissioning Plan Formulation and Project Coordination: 

Develops and implements detailed commissioning plans for wind, solar, and hybrid projects, ensuring alignment with engineering specifications and regulatory standards. 

Coordinates with project stakeholders to address all necessary technical aspects and comply with project requirements. 

Gathers information related to connectivity, LTA/GNA, and project commissioning for efficient execution of upcoming renewable energy projects. 

System Testing And Performance Validation

Executes rigorous system testing and validation protocols to confirm that all systems meet performance specifications and function correctly under operational conditions. 

Conducts power performance analysis for wind turbines and ensures the commissioning of turbines as handed over by the project team. 

Ensures 100% turbine healthiness for continuous operation and addresses any discrepancies to maintain optimal performance. 

Technical Issue Identification And Rectification

Diagnoses and resolves technical issues encountered during the commissioning phase, applying advanced troubleshooting methods and collaborating with engineering teams to address root causes. 

Develops and implements effective solutions to technical problems, ensuring all issues are resolved promptly to prevent disruptions. 

Provides technical training to team members and supports in resolving error fault breakdowns for turbines. 

Regulatory Compliance And Safety Assurance

Ensures that all commissioning activities adhere to established industry regulations, safety standards, and project specifications, maintaining high levels of quality and compliance throughout the process. 

Develops a safety culture at sites by ensuring workplace safety and adherence to SOPs, targeting zero accidents and Lost Time Injuries (LTIs). 

Verifies compliance with safety protocols during construction and operation of EHV and 33KV lines. 

Documentation And Reporting

Prepares comprehensive documentation and reports on commissioning activities, including test results, performance data, and compliance verification. 

Maintains detailed records of all commissioning activities, providing essential documentation for ongoing monitoring and regulatory compliance. 

Prepares and submits site-wise budgets for operational and capital expenditure as per the project timeline. 

Collaboration And Business Performance Monitoring

Works closely with engineering teams to coordinate commissioning activities and address technical issues that arise, ensuring effective collaboration and problem resolution. 

Monitors business performance against goals and identifies cost optimization opportunities in running projects. 

Ensures timely closure of audit points and compliance with management systems, contributing to organizational transformation and change management.

Industry Associations

Contractors

Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering is required. 

Strong academic foundation in power systems, electrical machines, control systems, and instrumentation. Proficiency in commissioning procedures and testing methodologies. 

Work Experience

3-4 years of experience in commissioning of power plants or industrial equipment. 

Hands-on experience in equipment installation, testing, and commissioning. Knowledge of safety protocols, quality standards.

data.description:
Job Requirements

This position involves developing PLC and HMI control systems for semiconductor gas/chemical delivery equipment. Responsibilities include designing control logic, system integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The role involves designing control architectures based on customer requirements and leading the improvement of equipment stability and performance, as well as the standardization of automation. 

As a Senior Engineer, Lead the software programming, system design, and technical direction for chemical and specialty gas delivery equipment used in semiconductors. 

Proficient in PLC, HMI, C/C++, Java, and other PC-based languages at an expert level. Hold a technical vision for the assigned product areas in chemical equipment and translate complex requirements into scalable, high-performance, manufacturable solutions. Through cross-team collaboration, they contribute to engineering standardization and reliability and demonstrate technical leadership in both systems engineering and PLC software development. 

Key Responsibilities

PLC Software Development

- Understand PLC Software Development
 - Develop and maintain PLC software based on IEC 61131-3 standards. 
 - Design, program, test, and validate PLC logic for semiconductor gas and chemical delivery systems. 
 - Support Omron, Siemens, and LS PLC platforms. 
 - Develop reusable software modules and engineering standards

HMI & System Integration

- Configure and maintain HMI systems (Pro-face, MXon/M2I). 
 - Implement alarms, diagnostics, state monitoring, and data logging functions. 
 - Integrate PLC, HMI, instruments, motion devices, and network systems. 

System Engineering

- Analyze customer and product requirements and translate them into software and control system architecture. 
 - Define software-hardware interfaces and control philosophies. 
 - Support system design reviews and risk assessments. 

Troubleshooting & RCA

- Investigate field issues and implement corrective actions. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities. 
 - Optimize system performance, reliability, and maintainability. 

Manufacturing & Customer Support

- Support manufacturing, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and startup activities. 
 - Provide technical support during customer escalations. 
 - Develop manufacturing packages and technical documentation. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Quality, Project Management, and Manufacturing teams. 
 - Collaborate with global engineering teams on platform standardization and product improvements. 
 - Participate in engineering change management (ECR/ECO) activities. 

Continuous Improvement

- Drive software standardization and code modularization. 
 - Contribute to technology roadmaps for next-generation control systems. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and share technical best practices

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard. 

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21, 000 difference-makers in our workplace. 

Work Experience

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of PLC software development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with: Omron / Siemens / LS PLC
 - Experience with HMI development (Pro-face, MXon, M2I or equivalent). 
 - Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP/RTU, Profinet, EtherCAT
 - Experience in troubleshooting and debugging industrial automation systems. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively in an international engineering environment

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with semiconductor equipment, gas delivery systems, chemical delivery systems, or process equipment. 
 - Experience supporting customer sites, installation, and commissioning activities. 
 - Experience with SCADA or industrial software platforms. 
 - Knowledge of functional safety and industrial cybersecurity. 
 - Experience leading technical projects or system architecture reviews. 
 - Experience collaborating with global engineering organizations.

We help our clients to promote, implement and manage sustainable development, from pre-feasibility through to planning consent; establish plans and provision for how an area, its accessibility and needs, will develop over time and guide sustainable future development; and develop multi-disciplinary design from concept through to detailed design and construction.

 - Provide engineering support and technical guidance for land development drainage design and associated design activities. 
 - Instructing, supervising and monitoring engineers for various roads drainage related surveys and associated designs as required. 
 - Technical governance of the roads drainage teams output working together with UK technical governance of all deliverables from GCC.

 - Line Manager/ Technical Team Development - PDRs, promotion, training & mentoring. 
 - Excellent inter-personal skills with good technical leadership abilities capable of communicating effectively and lead technical discussions with all parts of the business within GCC and UK. 
 - Strong commercial and strategic capability with a demonstrable track record in having identified and subsequently delivered new business opportunities. 
 - Demonstrate the desire to constantly improve, motivate and encourage others, lead and implement change programmes, inspiring colleagues and drive an innovative and supportive culture. Act as a catalyst for change and bring technical Excellence in Drainage designs. 
 - A broad range of project experience, both within Discipline and multi-disciplinary.

Strong presentation skills, able to lead and facilitate workshops, training sessions and one to one learning. Influential and persuasive internally and externally, encourages open dialogue and feedback.

 - The ability to use or direct and check the use of relevant software including Micro Drainage, Info Drainage, Causeway Flow, Civils 3D and/or PDS.

 - Excellent communication, internal client handling, interpersonal skills and listening skills with the ability to influence and interact with people. 
 - Comfortable leading internal engineering discussions and the experience and ability to understand, evaluate and explain complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical professionals. 
 - A hard-working self-starter with initiative and ability to work within a team environment. 
 - Understand own strengths and impact, adapting behaviors according to different situations and individuals. 
 - Able to work effectively under pressure and Open-minded and intellectually agile. 
 - Act ethically with fairness, honesty and integrity. 
 - You should have demonstrable experience of resource and project management. 
 - You will be aware of current and emerging technologies relevant to climate change and sustainability. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills and with time management and strong organizational skills. 

Qualifications

- Educated to Bachelor / Master's degree level in Water resource, Environment drainage related discipline within Civil Engineering.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced, versatile Full Stack Developer to lead a small engineering team and drive delivery across multiple technology stacks. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable writing production code, architecting systems, and mentoring a team - and who thrives on picking up new tools and technologies as project needs evolve, rather than sticking to a single fixed stack. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications spanning backend services, frontend interfaces, and data layers.

 - Build and maintain backend services in Java and Python, and frontend applications using React JS.

 - Containerize applications with Docker and support deployment on cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP). 
 - Design efficient, well-structured SQL schemas and queries; optimize database performance. 
 - Drive engineering best practices: Git workflows, code review standards, CI/CD, testing, and documentation. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Evaluate and rapidly adopt new tools, frameworks, or languages as project requirements demand. 
 - Participate in technical planning, estimation, and risk identification for projects across the portfolio. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 8-10 years of overall software development experience, with demonstrated full stack delivery.

 - Strong hands-on expertise in Java for backend development. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in React JS for frontend development. 
 - Working proficiency in Python. 
 - Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts, tools, or frameworks (e. g. , applied ML, LLM integration, or data science fundamentals). 
 - Practical experience with Docker for containerization.

 - Strong SQL skills - schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning. 
 - Demonstrated ability to design scalable, maintainable systems (system design fundamentals: caching, load balancing, microservices, API design, etc. ). 
 - Proficiency with Git and standard branching/collaboration workflows. 
 - Expert, daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , Claude, Cursor) to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review. 
 - A polyglot mindset - genuine willingness and ability to pick up new technologies, languages, or frameworks as project requirements dictate. 

Preferred / Nice To Have

- Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. 
 - Experience working in a distributed or GCC (Global Capability Center) setup supporting multiple business units or product lines. 
 - Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery practices. 
 - Prior experience modernizing or rebuilding legacy platforms. 

What We're Looking For

Beyond the technical checklist, we want someone who is curious, adaptable, and comfortable operating across ambiguity - a developer-leader who can go deep on any layer of the stack, guide a small team effectively, and is energized rather than daunted by switching technologies when a project calls for it. 

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies. 

Why Join Us?

Benefits

data.title: Principal Engineer- Backend
data.description:
About CodeRabbit

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship. 

We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge. 

CodeRabbit serves nearly 20, 000 customers and supports approximately 300, 000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1. 5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion. 

Role Overview - Engineering Brain

We're seeking a Principal Engineer to provide technical leadership across our organization. In this role, you'll shape our technical vision, architect solutions for complex problems, and help build a world-class engineering culture focused on developer tooling excellence. 

Key Responsibilities

- Drive technical vision and architecture decisions across multiple teams
 - Design and implement core systems that power our AI code review platform
 - Identify and solve complex technical challenges that impact product scalability and performance
 - Collaborate with engineering leadership to establish technical standards and best practices
 - Mentor engineers across the organization and elevate the technical capabilities of the team
 - Contribute to open source projects that align with our mission
 - Partner with product leadership to translate business requirements into technical solutions

 - Extensive experience building developer tools, platforms, or infrastructure
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud architecture, and system design patterns
 - History of meaningful open source contributions or maintenance
 - Experience mentoring and growing other engineers
 - Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with code review systems and development workflows
 - Familiarity with large language models and their applications
 - Previous experience at a developer tools company
 - Open source contributions
 - Advanced degree in Computer Science or related field

What Sets You Apart

- Technical depth and breadth: You have both specialized expertise and broad knowledge across the stack

 - Systems thinking: You understand how components interact and can anticipate second-order effects

 - Implement unit, integration and automated tests to reduce regression and improve application reliability. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD, infrastructure configuration, deployment, monitoring and post-release support using Azure DevOps.

 - Strong experience with React or Angular and backend development using Python, C#/. NET or Node. js/TypeScript. 
 - Demonstrated experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication, authorization and secure coding practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure application services, data services, Key Vault, monitoring and Azure DevOps. 
 - Experience integrating LLM-based services, RAG or enterprise search into application workflows. 
 - Ability to lead technical delivery, troubleshoot complex issues and communicate design decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

WSP-Aligned Technology Stack

The role will use and support the approved enterprise stack below. Equivalent technologies may be considered only where formally approved through WSP architecture, security and governance processes.

AI services Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure Machine Learning and approved Azure AI services

Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise. 

www. wsp. com

You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

- Maximize collaboration.

 - Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency. 

Health, Safety and Wellbeing

About us

The founding team has aced their respective leadership roles at successful internet startups in India, which are as follows: 

- Ashish: Cofounder, leads technology, Ex CTO Cars24, CTO FabFurnish, Gaadi. 
 - Arun: Cofounder, leads product, Ex Cars24, TravelTriangle, TripFactory, IIM Bangalore. 
 - Chirag: Cofounder, leads business, Ex Oyo, TravelTriangle, IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Roorkee. 
 - Shrawan: VP Engineering, 20+ yrs Tech exp, Ex CTO Millenium Entertainment, One Kosmos
 - Akshat: Director Engineering, 16+ yrs Tech exp, Ex Cars24, L&T, Samsung US, Motorola US. 
 - Rajesh: Director Engineering, 15+ yrs Tech exp, Ex Hike, Foodpanda

Key Responsibilities: 

DevOps / Infrastructure

- Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available infrastructure on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure). 
 - Own CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar) to enable fast, safe, and repeatable deployments. 
 - Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi). 
 - Manage containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE/self-managed). 
 - Set up and maintain observability: logging, monitoring, and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog, New Relic, or similar). 
 - Drive cost optimization, capacity planning, and infrastructure scaling initiatives. 
 - Own incident response for infrastructure/production issues, participate in on-call rotations, conduct RCAs and blameless postmortems. 
 - Automate repetitive operational tasks to reduce manual toil. 

SecOps / Security

- Own the security posture of cloud infrastructure, including IAM policies, network security, VPC/firewall configurations, and secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, etc. ). 
 - Implement and monitor security controls across CI/CD (SAST/DAST, dependency & container vulnerability scanning). 
 - Set up and manage SIEM/logging for security monitoring, threat detection, and alerting. 
 - Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, penetration test coordination, and remediation tracking. 
 - Define and enforce security best practices: least-privilege access, encryption at rest/in transit, key rotation policies. 
 - Drive compliance initiatives (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, GDPR as applicable) and support audits. 
 - Build and maintain security runbooks, playbooks, and internal documentation. 
 - Respond to security incidents, including triage, containment, root cause analysis, and post-incident hardening. 

Must have technical skills

- Proficiency in cloud services (AWS or Google Cloud Platform) and containerization tools like Kubernetes and Docker. 
 - Hands-on experience with: - Linux OS

- Scripting (Shell/Bash/Python)

- Database management (MySQL, MongoDB). 

- Expertise with CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab, Chef/Puppet/Ansible, Maven/Nexus, EKS, GKE) and configuration management tools like Ansible and Terraform. 
 - Deploy and maintain infrastructure using Redis, Elasticsearch, and RabbitMQ for scalable and high-performance applications. 
 - Working understanding of core security concepts: IAM, network segmentation, encryption, vulnerability management, and threat modeling. 
 - Experience with monitoring/observability and log management tools. 

Check if you fit in the role

You Must

- Have 2-5 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Security Operations (or a combined role). 
 - Be experienced with building, deploying, and operating tech infrastructure and applications. 
 - Be skilled in making software updates and fixing issues in deployments. 
 - Have strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred; GCP/Azure acceptable). 
 - Have solid experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Have strong incident management and on-call experience. 

You Can

- Collaborate with different teams to improve and streamline DevOps and security processes. 
 - Bring strong troubleshooting skills for infrastructure, deployment, and security issues. 
 - Coordinate vulnerability assessments and penetration tests, and track remediation. 
 - Bring familiarity with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS) as a strong plus. 
 - Bring prior experience in a fintech, travel-tech, or high-transaction-volume product company as a plus. 
 - Communicate excellently and work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and leadership. 

You Want to

- Drive technical excellence, automation, and a strong security posture. 
 - Grow in a fast-paced environment. 

This role is not ideal for someone who is

- Is not comfortable being available during odd hours / at night for support and incident response. 
 - Has not worked on multiple backend applications independently. 
 - Is not self-motivated to keep up with the rapidly evolving DevOps and security ecosystem. 
 - Is not comfortable with long working hours. 
 - Is not comfortable working 5 days a week from the office in Delhi. 

Important Points: 

- Office Location- Connaught Place, Delhi

data.title: Senior System Development Engineer, Silicon,  Cloud
data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related Information Technology (IT) field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5 years of experience with systems automation, and with systems design and implementation. 
 - 5 years of experience with technical infrastructure (e. g. , deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting), and with reliability of technical infrastructure. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- 8 years of experience working with vendors or customers. 
 - Experience with Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools or chip design. 
 - Experience in working with Go, Python or C++. 
 - Experience in interacting with end users or product aptitude. 

About The Job

Systems Development Engineering (SDE) at Google is a role where you manage services and systems at scale. SDEs creatively put their engineering discipline to use automating the mundane and reducing toil. We don't just write code to fix bugs, but emphasize the development of tools and solutions that fix classes of problems. We know it's hard to control what you can't measure - so we focus on observability: instrumenting first, then turning data into knowledge, and finally knowledge into action. We know that the operational efficiency of Google systems, services, virtual compute environments and the operating systems that power them impact the environment, not just the bottom line. We know that working together we can do more, and that community matters. 

Google brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow. 

Together we engineer and build the infrastructure, tools, access and telemetry for systems that enable orchestration of Google-scale services. Come build things that matter. 

The EDACloud Operations team defines processes for managing incidents to develop automation to ensure upgrades are rolled out safely and slowly. The team builds out monitoring for internal use as well as for the users to understand the state of the service, and debug when there are issues. 

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible. 

Responsibilities

- Participate in on-call activities and manage the systems within the domain and work with the primary responders to help in fixing system issues. 
 - Troubleshoot technical issues, evaluate technical data, and develop recommendations for systems and services, respond to tickets/bugs within team-defined service-level objectives (SLOs), and contribute to systems and services through bug reports and consultation. 
 - Work with customers on defining distributed systems requirements, testing procedures, and proposing solutions. 
 - Set up processes for planning, improving quality, best practices, and maintaining a short response time for user issues. 

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

The team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining mission-critical backend applications and services that support TransUnion's data and analytics platforms. These solutions process large volumes of data in real time and enable reliable, scalable products used by customers across multiple industries. 

This team operates within an Agile Scrum environment and partners closely with Product, Architecture, Data Engineering, QA, and Operations teams to deliver secure, high-quality software. The role reports through the Engineering organization under the Manager of Software Development. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. 

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

The Senior Software Developer is responsible for designing, building, and supporting scalable backend applications that enable business growth, operational efficiency, and product innovation. This role provides technical leadership within the Scrum team while contributing hands-on software development expertise. 

Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise-grade backend applications and services using C# and . NET technologies. 

Lead the implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions that support large-scale data processing and customer-facing products. 

Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical designs and deliverable solutions. 

Drive improvements in software quality through automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices. 

Participate in architecture discussions and make recommendations regarding application design, performance optimization, scalability, and maintainability. 

Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve complex production issues, minimizing business impact and improving system reliability. 

Mentor junior and mid-level developers by sharing technical knowledge, promoting engineering best practices, and supporting professional development. 

Contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, estimation, and release activities within an Agile Scrum environment. 

Develop and maintain REST-based APIs and integrations with internal and external systems to support business workflows and customer solutions. 

Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve development efficiency, application performance, and operational effectiveness. 

Required Knowledge And Experiences

Required Knowledge and Experiences

5+ years of professional software development experience building and supporting enterprise applications, with a strong focus on backend development using object-oriented programming principles. 

Strong understanding of software design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and application architecture, enabling the development of scalable and maintainable solutions. 

Experience working in Agile Scrum environments, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, estimation, and iterative delivery of business value. 

Experience implementing automated testing and CI/CD practices, ensuring software quality, release reliability, and operational efficiency. 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience, providing the foundational knowledge necessary to design and deliver complex software solutions. 

Required Technical Skills

C# and . NET Framework/. NET Core for developing enterprise backend applications and services. 

REST (Representational State Transfer) APIs and Web Services, including designing, developing, and integrating service-based architectures. 

SQL and relational databases (SQL Server preferred) for data access, performance tuning, and application support. 

Git version control and modern development workflows, including branching, pull requests, and collaborative code reviews. 

CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) tools and practices, such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms. 

Preferred Skills

We're also looking for the preferred skills below. Whether you are proficient or could use some brushing up, we're happy to support your career development and growth in: 

Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 

Experience building and deploying containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes. 

Knowledge of SOAP and REST web services and enterprise system integrations. 

Experience working with large-scale data processing systems and high-volume transactional applications. 

Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools, including application performance monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions. 

TransUnion Overview

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our Workforce for Good, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver's seat of their professional development- while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that's why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence. 

Be a part of our Workforce for Good - you'll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

Sr Developer, Applications Development

Hiring for 3D Glass Solutions, Inc. - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About Company

3D Glass Solutions (3DGS) is a US advanced-packaging company using its patented photo-definable APEX® glass technology for RF, photonics, IC and system-in-package devices. Through its Indian entity, 3DGS is building a vertically integrated glass-core substrate and chip assembly plant in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, approved under the India Semiconductor Mission. - Qualify solder balls, fluxes, TIMs, lid adhesives, blades and jigs with suppliers

- Build, train and certify the end-of-line team of engineers and technicians

- Drive PM optimization, spares strategy and troubleshooting on ball attach, lid attach, saws, laser markers, inspection and dry pack equipment

Ideal Candidate Profile

- 10+ years hands-on in ball attach, lid attach, singulation, inspection and packing at an OSAT, ATMP or IDM assembly site, owning multiple tool types

- Engineering degree in Mechanical, Materials, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial or a related field

- Part of at least one new line installation, qualification or capacity ramp

- Has trained and certified entry-level engineers and technicians in a multi-tool production environment

- Experience with SPC, DOE, FMEA, process characterization, yield analysis and structured troubleshooting

- Prior leadership of engineers, technicians and cross-functional teams in a production or ramp environment

- Willing to relocate to Bhubaneswar, Odisha

- Strong grasp of solder ball metallurgy, coplanarity, TIM/lid adhesive behavior and J-STD-020 MSL/dry pack requirements

- Experience with strip and singulated flows, large-body lidded FCBGA and outgoing quality gate ownership is highly preferred

Job Title: Manager Consulting Delivery (QA)

Position: Technical Manager + People Manager for QA/QE

Experience: 14+ Years (minimum 5+ years leading QA/QE teams, with hands-on technical depth)

Category: Quality Engineering / Test Automation / Delivery Management

Shift: General Shift, with overlap with US onsite counterparts as required

Location: Chennai

Position ID: 

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Education Qualification: B. E. /B. Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline

Position Description: 

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Manager and People Manager to lead an enthusiastic QA/QE team with strong AI awareness. Our current model is automation-heavy but still involves a lot of manual intervention. The role requires a clear understanding of the team's current technical challenges and the ability to transform it into a modern, AI-first Quality Engineering team through smarter automation and better engineering practices. 

Every Advantage release must go out on time and certified, with zero escaped regression defects and no last-minute surprises. The leader we want thinks like the client and acts like the client, holding quality to the standard the customer experiences in production, and treats customer delight as the measure of success. 

You will own the transformation of the QA/QE function and treat quality as an engineering discipline, building it into the pipeline, the code and the environment rather than testing it in at the end. You will drive disciplined flaky test management, faster pipelines through test sharding, parallel execution and test impact analysis, ephemeral Cloud environments that are spun up on demand and destroyed once testing is done, and a shift-left and shift-right approach in which production monitoring feeds back into test strategy. You will also strengthen performance and regression engineering so that quality improves with every release. 

You will make release and investment decisions from data such as flake rate, pipeline duration, defect leakage and DORA-style delivery metrics. You will act as a trusted quality advisor to leadership and the client, translating technical quality signals into business risk and release confidence, and balance speed, quality and cost, including cloud environment spend and automation maintenance effort. You will also bring the team along, building the skills, habits and confidence it needs to work this way. 

Your future duties and responsibilities

Responsibilities

Delivery and Release Ownership

- Own on-time, high-quality delivery of Advantage releases with zero regression issues, and be accountable for the quality outcome the customer experiences. 
 - Think like the client and act like the client: view quality from the customer's business perspective, anticipate what matters to them and make release decisions accordingly. 
 - Lead release certification end to end from the QA side, owning readiness assessment, quality gates, exit criteria, go/no-go inputs and sign-off. Step into an RTE-style role when required to coordinate across teams and keep releases on track. 
 - Own QA planning, capacity and delivery commitments across Agile sprints, Program Increments and feature releases, ensuring smooth delivery to UAT and Production and timely resolution of client issues. 

Quality Strategy and Governance

- Own the regression and performance testing strategy and its outcomes, covering scope, coverage, risk-based prioritization and continuous optimization of suites to remove redundancy and improve effectiveness. 
 - Define quality standards, governance and a metrics-driven improvement framework (defect leakage, regression cycle time, automation reliability, pipeline duration, defect detection effectiveness, cost of quality), and use the data to drive decisions. 
 - Set the direction for performance engineering, ensuring workload models, benchmarks and bottleneck analysis give early confidence in scalability and stability before release. 
 - Maintain clear, current documentation in Confluence, including QA strategy, release certification records, runbooks, test environment guides and lessons learned, so knowledge is shared and not held by individuals. 

Technical Leadership and Transformation

- Take ownership of chronic reliability and speed issues such as flaky tests, recurring suite failures and long-running pipelines. Diagnose systemic root causes, set stabilization and optimization priorities, and hold the team accountable for sustained improvement in reliability and execution time. 
 - Periodically audit the automation tech stack, frameworks and tooling, assess fitness, maintainability and cost, and set the direction to upgrade or transform when it is justified. Make these decisions based on value, not change for its own sake. 
 - Lead the transformation of test environments from PDC to Cloud (Azure/AWS), enabling on-demand environments that are spun up for testing and destroyed once done, in partnership with DevOps and with cost optimization in mind. 
 - Champion AI-driven Quality Engineering across test design, automation, failure triage and maintenance, with measurable productivity and cycle-time gains. 
 - Drive continuous testing and quality gates in CI/CD, working with DevOps to make releases faster and more predictable. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, continuously evaluating emerging tools and practices and bringing in those that improve outcomes. 

Stakeholder and People Leadership

- Partner with Product Engineering, Product Management, DevOps and onsite counterparts to surface quality risks early, and escalate risks to leadership with clear mitigation options. 
 - Communicate quality status, delivery risks and improvement plans to senior leadership and client stakeholders through clear presentations and dashboards. 
 - Build and lead a high-performing QA/QE team by setting goals, coaching, developing technical depth and succession, managing performance and fostering a quality-first culture of accountability and ownership. 

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Must-Have Skills

- 14+ years of IT experience, with strong experience leading QA/QE teams and delivering large-scale programs (US state and local government experience preferred). 
 - Proven track record of release ownership and certification with consistently low regression leakage. 
 - Proven experience transforming a QA team into a modern, automation-first and AI-enabled Quality Engineering team. 
 - Strong people management skills, including team building, coaching, performance management, conflict resolution and capacity planning. 
 - Management skills: planning and forecasting, budgeting and cost control, risk and issue management, vendor and partner management, stakeholder and expectation management, and decision-making under pressure. 
 - Hands-on technical depth to guide the team on diagnosing and fixing flaky tests, unstable automation and slow CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience assessing automation tech stacks and frameworks and recommending upgrade or transformation paths. 
 - Large-scale test automation experience. 
 - Test Automation: Selenium WebDriver, Playwright; programming and scripting in Java, Python, JavaScript, SQL. 
 - Test Management: Jira, Xray. 
 - Documentation and collaboration: Confluence, with strong skills in writing and maintaining QA strategies, process documents, runbooks, release certification records and knowledge-base content. 
 - CI/CD and DevOps: Jenkins, GitHub, Cloud (Azure/AWS) DevOps Pipelines. 
 - AI-assisted testing: GitHub Copilot, AI-powered test generation, self-healing and test optimization tools. 
 - Monitoring, observability and code coverage: Grafana, SigNoz, JaCoCo. 
 - Test data management, including data setup, masking and refresh strategies for reliable, repeatable regression runs. 
 - Azure fundamentals for testing environments: on-demand provisioning and teardown, and exposure to PDC-to-cloud migration. 
 - Performance testing: Apache JMeter, LoadRunner or Gatling, with the ability to interpret results and drive tuning recommendations. 
 - Regression strategy and optimization, risk-based testing and API testing (REST/SOAP). 
 - Agile/SAFe delivery experience, including RTE-style release coordination, risk management and stakeholder communication. 
 - Dashboarding and reporting tools: Power BI, Jira dashboards, for tracking quality, delivery and automation metrics. 
 - Presentation and reporting skills: building clear, executive-ready presentations (PowerPoint) and management reports that turn quality data into decisions. 
 - Excel proficiency: advanced Excel (pivot tables, formulas, charts, dashboards) for metrics analysis, capacity and cost tracking, and status reporting. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; partner and multi-geography team management. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Monitoring and observability: Splunk, Dynatrace. 
 - Infrastructure as Code and containers for test environments: Terraform/Bicep/ARM, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS. 
 - Code quality: SonarQube, CAST. 
 - Database testing: Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, data validation. 
 - Accessibility testing: WCAG 2. 1/2. 2, AXE/Evinced Tools. 
 - Service virtualization. 
 - Leading innovation: participating in hackathons and encouraging and enabling the team to participate, turning ideas into practical improvements. 
 - Thought leadership: conference talks, blogs, internal communities of practice or patents. 
 - LLM and agentic testing, plus AI governance for data handling. 
 - Security testing awareness and compliance exposure (StateRAMP/NIST), since these separate government-experienced candidates. 
 - Contribution beyond delivery: experience with DEI practices and CSR initiatives, and similar organizational contributions. 
 - Cloud or testing certifications (Azure, ISTQB, SAFe). 
 - Experience with multi-location, multi-customer, multi-language delivery. 
 - Experience with enterprise ERP/government platforms (financial, procurement, HR systems), since Advantage is in that space.

data.title: Warehouse Automation Manager, Engineering
data.description:
Description

Are you passionate about designing automation solutions that improve how millions of packages move through a fulfillment network? Amazon is looking for a Warehouse Automation Manager to drive innovation and product development for material handling equipment (MHE) across our operations. In this role, you will own the automation roadmap - from early-stage concept engineering and prototype design through vendor development and full-scale rollout. You will research emerging technologies, evaluate cost-effective alternatives, and collaborate with Safety, Maintenance, Process Engineering, and Finance teams to deliver solutions that increase productivity and capacity. If you thrive on turning ideas into real-world systems that operate at scale, we want to hear from you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design and standardize automation prototypes for conveyors, lifts, and other MHE, managing the full lifecycle from concept engineering through implementation and performance qualification. 
 - Build and own the automation roadmap by researching new technologies, benchmarking industry best practices, and evaluating alternative solutions that balance quality, cost, and operational impact. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders - including Safety, Maintenance, Process Engineering, and Finance - to develop material flow layouts and engineering specifications for new and existing facilities. 
 - Lead vendor qualification, development, and management activities including preparation of Requests for Information (RFI), Requests for Quotation (RFQ), and scopes of work, while driving techno-commercial discussions with procurement and project teams. 
 - Leverage generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools and data-driven analysis to identify process improvements, optimize designs, and accelerate solution development cycles. 

A day in the life

You will start your week reviewing progress in business review forums, aligning priorities against the automation roadmap, and adjusting plans based on operational feedback. Much of your time is spent independently - prototyping concepts, analyzing power requirements, and refining engineering specifications - then shifting into collaborative sessions with partner teams to pressure-test designs and resolve technical trade-offs. You will stay connected to the professional community and market trends, bringing fresh ideas back to the team to keep solutions affordable and forward-looking. 

About The Team

Our team is on a mission to strengthen Amazon's automation charter by creating innovative MHE solutions that scale operations across fulfillment buildings. We work at the intersection of mechanical engineering, controls, and product development, turning ideas into systems that move real packages every day. Senior leaders provide strategic vision while team members take ownership of execution, building expertise through self-directed learning and engagement with the broader engineering community. This is a team where your work directly translates into measurable productivity and capacity gains. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
 - Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
 - Experience with Kaizen and Continuous Improvement Process

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
 - Experience in preventative maintenance systems

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards. 

The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills - A simple process that we all are used to on a day-to-day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity

hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands

ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.

future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be!. 

Role Summary/Purpose

AVP, Solution Architect, seeking a Technology Lead/Senior Technical Business Analyst to drive partner onboarding success by leading cross-shore teams focused on partner integration, 

testing, and resiliency. This role ensures integration environments are available and stable, and partners effectively with engineering, infrastructure, and product teams to execute strong

change/release management and production readiness. You will troubleshoot integration issues end-to-end, perform root-cause analysis using logs and data, and coordinate fixes with Agile

delivery teams. The role also includes building and managing testing enablement capabilities such as mock data, test intake workflows, test data management, and communication plans to

improve quality and speed. The ideal candidate brings deep experience with SOAP/REST web services, Java and database fundamentals, SQL/NoSQL technologies, CI/CD (e. g. , Jenkins), cloud

platforms (PCF/AWS), and monitoring tools like Splunk, along with strong Agile execution, stakeholder management, mentorship skills, and flexibility to support critical releases/incidents.

 - testing, and resiliency disciplines in partner onboarding process
 - Influence and collaborate to ensure integration environment availability and effective change manage
 - Analyze integration defects, troubleshoot systems, identify root cause and implement fixes in collaboration with other Agile build teams
 - Develop and manage tools that facilitate testing, including but not limited to mock test data, testing intake requests, and communication plans 
 - Strong technical understanding of Java coding, Database structures, Log analysis, 
 - Infrastructure layer to support the partner onboarding process
 - Mentor and influence up and down the chain of command
 - Participate in Agile scrums with cross-functional teams
 - Participate in agile sprints including planning, daily standups, backlog grooming sessions and reviews
 - Participate in the innovation workshop
 - Participate in regular presentation and update on improvement process and client onboarding progress
 - Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Bachelor's degree and 10 years of technology experience or equivalent leadership program experience including 3+ years experience as technical analyst
 - Strong technical knowledge on integration with 3rd party tools and widgets
 - Critical Thinking and Creativity 
 - Excellence in communication with technical and non-technical peers
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - 5+ years of experience building and consuming web services via SOAP and REST
 - 5+ years of experience in SQL and NoSQL technologies, data modeling, query optimization, caching strategies, and transactional vs eventual consistency trade-offs. 
 - Familiarity with Micro-Frontends and front-end platform governance is a plus. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC (Agile), release/change management, incident management, and production readiness expectations. 
 - AI-assisted development proficiency (e. g. , GitHub Copilot/enterprise LLM tools) to accelerate design, coding, testing, and documentation-used responsibly with security, privacy, and IP considerations. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills; ability to lead cross-team design discussions and drive alignment. 
 - Flexibility to support critical releases/incidents as needed. 
 - Deep Agile expertise
 - Strong cross-functional team player with the ability to work seamlessly across a matrix
 - Organization and partner with global development companies. 
 - Experience with continuous integration environments like Jenkins
 - Experience building and deploying application on Pivotal Cloud Foundry, AWS, or other cloud environments
 - Experience with test data management, test case coverage, and associated maintenance
 - Experience using Splunk (or equivalent)
 - Experience automation and innovation of easing business onboarding problems
 - Ability and flexibility to travel for business as required. 

Eligibility Criteria

Bachelor's degree and 10 years of technology experience or equivalent leadership program experience including 3+ years experience on technical business analyst

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)

data.title: Principal Firmware/Diagnostics Engineer
data.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation. 

Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive. 

Job Description

F5 is seeking an accomplished Principal Firmware/Diagnostics Engineer to lead the development of reliable, secure, and serviceable firmware and diagnostics across the full product lifecycle, from hardware bring‐up and boot loaders through runtime services and field upgrades. As a key member of the Hardware Development Team, you will provide technical leadership and mentoring, drive roadmap execution and elevate engineering excellence, and partner cross‐functionally to deliver platform capabilities that delight customers and meet stringent security and compliance expectations (e. g. , secure boot, code signing, measured boot). This role requires deep expertise in firmware/software design and the ability to influence architecture decisions, ensure design excellence, and foster innovation. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Uphold F5's Business Code of Ethics and promptly report violations of the Code or other company policies. 
 - Act as a technical authority, establishing standards for secure boot, code‐signing, anti‐rollback protections, measured boot, vulnerability remediation, and incident response. 
 - Lead firmware and diagnostics design for new products, including architecture definition, functional specifications, and requirements development. Work with cross-functional teams to align requirements and shepherd PRDs into executable plans. 
 - Assist in the planning of work across boot, board bring‐up, drivers, runtime services, manufacturing/test firmware, and in‐field update mechanisms. 
 - Define telemetry, detection, and recovery strategies for firmware integrity, and align to relevant standards (e. g. , FIPS 140‐3, FedRAMP implications as applicable). 
 - Define automated build, test, and validation, ensuring repeatable releases and traceable artifacts across SKUs. 
 - Drive design for manufacturability, testability, and reliability across all phases of development. Partner with MFG and Global Services to define factory programming, golden images, and resilient upgrade strategies (A/B, recovery partitions). 
 - Research and evaluate emerging technologies to enhance existing products and guide new product directions. 
 - Oversee and mentor engineers, providing technical guidance and reviewing work to ensure quality and efficiency. Serve and guide other team members through challenges, assuring their growth and project success
 - Conduct internal and external technical presentations and disseminate knowledge within the Hardware Development Team. 
 - Develop and maintain schedules for deliverables, ensuring timely and high-quality documentation and testing through holistic ownership over assigned product areas and projects. Provide status, risks, and decisions to leadership; translate technical details into business outcomes. 
 - Interface with suppliers and manufacturing partners for validation and issue resolution. 
 - Support sustaining engineering for legacy products and assist in manufacturing training for new designs. 
 - Participate in design reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of design processes and standards. 

Qualifications: 

Required: 

- Understand and comply with F5 internal processes and requirements. 
 - BS in Computer Science or equivalent required; MS in Computer Science is desirable. 
 - 10+ years of experience in embedded/firmware engineering. 
 - Advanced troubleshooting skills at board and system levels. 
 - Extensive experience in the following: 
 - Arm/x86 platforms, embedded Linux, secure elements, and measured boot pipelines. 
 - C/C++, low‐level debugging, and board bring‐up (oscilloscope/logic analyzer/JTAG). 
 - AMI Aptio V UEFI BIOS, OpenBMC, AMI MegaRAC/SPX, IPMI and Redfish. 
 - Boot architecture (UEFI/BIOS, bootloaders), BMC, PFR, TPM, SPI/QSPI flash, IO peripherals, and runtime firmware. 
 - Buses/protocols (I2C/I3C, SPI, UART, DDR, PCIe, GPIO, PMIC), and memory/storage (NOR/NAND, DRAM, SSD). 
 - Security protocols and knowledge of multiple Platform Root of Trust devices and secure boot mechanisms. 
 - Source code version control tools such as Git and GitLab. 
 - CI/CD and Agile software development. 
 - Prior work with factory programming, golden image workflows, and recovery strategies (A/B, rollback protections). 
 - Exposure to cloud‐connected devices and policy/version orchestration across fleets. 
 - Familiarity with relevant industry standards and compliance requirements. 
 - Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred: 

- Compliance and security standards (e. g. , FIPS 140‐3, NIST SP 800-193).
