data.title: Silicon & Data Automation Systems Software Engineer, Staff
data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering

General Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically strong Staff Engineer, Silicon & Data Automation Systems to help build and expand a growing automation team supporting silicon and system yield engineering, spanning design, DFT, diagnostics, and yield engineering workflows. This role will focus on developing production-grade automation, data pipelines, database-backed applications, and engineering tools that improve the speed, quality, and scalability of complex semiconductor engineering workflows. 

This position is part of a broader effort to increase automation capacity within the silicon engineering organization, beginning with new engineering roles in the Bangalore Design Center (BDC). The engineer will work closely with U. S. -based yield automation leadership and stakeholders, including regular overlap with U. S. Central Time morning hours. 

This is a senior individual contributor role. The successful candidate will build new automation capabilities under architectural guidance, contribute to robust production systems, and use modern AI-assisted engineering practices to increase development velocity and quality. This role requires an AI-first engineering mindset, where LLM-based coding agents and AI-assisted automation tools are used as core productivity multipliers while maintaining strong human ownership of correctness, security, review, and production safety. 

The ideal candidate is a strong Linux, data, database, and automation engineer who can work effectively in complex semiconductor engineering environments. Prior experience with semiconductor engineering domains such as silicon design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, or yield is strongly preferred but not required for candidates with strong automation and data engineering depth. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

Automation Development & Production Engineering

- Design, develop, test, and maintain automation tools that improve silicon and system yield engineering workflows, including data processing, diagnostics, reporting, and operation efficiency. 
 - Build reliable Linux-based automation services, scripts, data loaders, and backend systems used by engineering teams. 
 - Develop production-grade solutions with appropriate logging, monitoring, error handling, alerting, documentation, and operational supportability. 
 - Contribute to systems that are maintainable, fault-tolerant, secure, and suitable for long-running production use. 
 - Debug and resolve automation issues across Linux servers, databases, file systems, scheduled jobs, data feeds, and dependent engineering systems. 
 - Work under architectural guidance to implement new automation capabilities while developing deeper ownership of specific tools, workflows, or data domains over time. 

Data Systems & Database Automation

- Build and maintain data pipelines that collect, transform, validate, and load engineering and manufacturing data across design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, and yield-related systems. 
 - Work with relational databases, SQL, schema design, query optimization, and database-backed automation workflows. 
 - Integrate data from multiple sources, including engineering systems, manufacturing data feeds, logs, reports, and analysis outputs. 
 - Develop tools that make complex data easier to access, validate, monitor, and act upon. 
 - Ensure data quality, traceability, and operational robustness in automation that supports engineering analysis and decision-making. 

AI-Assisted Engineering & Automation Acceleration

- Use LLM-based coding agents and AI-assisted automation tools responsibly as part of day-to-day engineering work. 
 - Apply AI-assisted development practices to improve code quality, accelerate troubleshooting, generate tests, improve documentation, and increase engineering output. 
 - Build or integrate AI-enabled engineering tools where appropriate, including automation agents, internal assistants, MCP servers, and workflow accelerators. 
 - Maintain strong human review and engineering judgment for AI-generated code, SQL, analysis, documentation, and operational recommendations. 
 - Ensure AI-assisted workflows follow appropriate standards for security, correctness, maintainability, and production safety. 
 - Help establish practical patterns for using AI-first development methods in production engineering environments. 

Tooling, Applications & Workflow Integration

- Build backend tools, dashboards, web applications, APIs, command-line utilities, and scheduled automation to support engineering needs. 
 - Use appropriate technologies for the problem, including Python, shell scripting, SQL, Django or similar frameworks, REST APIs, log analytics tools, and enterprise data systems. 
 - Integrate automation into existing engineering workflows without disrupting production operations. 
 - Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to identify manual pain points and convert them into reliable automated solutions. 
 - Create clear documentation, usage guidance, and operational notes so tools can be supported and extended over time. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with engineers across design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, and data domains to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions. 
 - Communicate technical findings, implementation options, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to both software-oriented and semiconductor engineering audiences. 
 - Participate in code reviews, design discussions, troubleshooting sessions, and production readiness reviews. 
 - Collaborate effectively across time zones, including regular overlap with U. S. Central Time morning hours. 
 - Contribute to a growing team culture focused on engineering rigor, accountability, automation leverage, and continuous improvement. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Linux-based development and automation, including shell scripting, server-side troubleshooting, cron or scheduled jobs, file systems, permissions, and operational debugging. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python or a comparable language used for automation, data processing, backend systems, or engineering tools. 
 - Strong experience with SQL, relational databases, data modeling, query development, and database-backed applications. 
 - Experience building automation that processes, validates, transforms, or integrates large technical datasets. 
 - Experience developing production-quality software or automation with testing, logging, error handling, documentation, and maintainability. 
 - Experience using Git or similar version control systems in a collaborative environment. 
 - Practical experience using LLM-based coding agents or AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity. 
 - Ability to review AI-generated work critically and maintain ownership of correctness, security, reliability, and production readiness. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across software, data, database, and Linux environments. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - Ability to work effectively with U. S. -based stakeholders with required time overlap. 

Additional Consideration

- Candidates with strong software, data, or automation backgrounds from non-semiconductor domains will be considered if they demonstrate the ability to learn complex engineering workflows quickly. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with semiconductor design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, yield, or product engineering environments. 
 - Experience working with engineering datasets such as test data, DFT outputs, manufacturing data, diagnostic data, or high-volume silicon or system telemetry. 
 - Familiarity with semiconductor data formats such as STDF, KLARF, wafer maps, lot history, test results, binning, dispositions, or assembly data. 
 - Experience building automation for engineering teams in semiconductor, manufacturing, hardware, or similar domains. 
 - Experience with Oracle, PL/SQL, ODBC, database loaders, schema design, or production database integration. 
 - Experience with Django or similar backend frameworks. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, internal tools, dashboards, reporting systems, or workflow applications. 
 - Experience with log analytics, monitoring, Splunk, or observability tools. 
 - Experience with batch compute, distributed jobs, LSF or grid environments, or multi-server automation. 
 - Experience building or integrating AI-assisted tools, internal agents, MCP servers, or RAG workflows. 
 - Familiarity with responsible AI-assisted development practices, including human-in-the-loop review and secure handling of generated outputs. 
 - Experience working across global teams and time zones. 

Desired Technical Profile

The ideal candidate operates across multiple layers of the engineering stack: 

- Linux: Comfortable diagnosing runtime issues, managing scripts, and troubleshooting production systems. 
 - Data: Able to handle complex, messy engineering data and build reliable transformations with traceability. 
 - Databases: Strong SQL skills with practical understanding of schemas, performance, and data integrity. 
 - Automation: Able to convert manual workflows into robust and scalable systems. 
 - Production Mindset: Builds systems that are observable, maintainable, secure, and resilient. 
 - AI-First Engineering: Uses AI tools to increase output while maintaining full accountability.

What Success Looks Like

Job Description

The Role

Energy, Economy and Environment modelling as part of WSP plc develops and maintains large-scale applied mathematical models that represent the energy, environment and economy, supporting quantitative analysis and policy design. Its integrated modelling tools provide informed, transparent and robust analysis as well as recommendations for its high-profile clients which include the European Commission, national governments, energy regulators and a number of private companies in the energy and transport sectors, financial institutions and strategic consultancies. This role is about supporting the Chief Modelling Engineer to improve the design of the models operations (data collection/harmonisation, database access, HPC computing, model development principles). 

Responsibilities

- Suggest, design, and implement modelling automation routines to improve workflow efficiency in cooperation with the energy and economic modelling teams. 
 - Design and maintain data workflows and quality assurance processes for large modelling databases (inputs, intermediate outputs, and results). 
 - Develop and operate automated data extraction pipelines via APIs to feed models with timely and consistent datasets. 
 - Configure and use HPC/cluster computing and parallel processing solutions to run large-scale simulations and batch model runs. 
 - Develop and maintain internal tools and scripts for workflow orchestration, including scheduling, monitoring, and logging of model runs. 
 - Help develop and maintain internal tools for version control, continuous integration, unit testing, backup and documentation using Git/GitHub and similar applications. 
 - Build dashboards and visual analytics in Power BI or equivalent tools for monitoring model performance, scenario results, and key indicators.

data.title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY- Assurance - Senior - Digital

Role: GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)

Position Details

As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment. 

This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions. 

You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk. 

This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria. 

Responsibilities

- Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows. 
 - Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements. 
 - Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams. 
 - Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across: 
 - Core user journeys and primary business intents
 - Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
 - Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
 - Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)
 - Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e. g. , minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk). 
 - Build reusable evaluation pipelines for: 
 - Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
 - Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
 - Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
 - Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)
 - Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks). 
 - Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling: 
 - batch runs on scenario suites
 - configurable metric definitions
 - reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
 - storage of traces and outputs for auditability
 - Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples): 
 - Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
 - Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
 - Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
 - Training data leakage / memorization probes
 - Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns
 - Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers. 
 - Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows: 
 - tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
 - unauthorized action execution
 - exfiltration via tools/connectors
 - prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)
 - Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts. 
 - Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including: 
 - methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
 - quantitative results
 - qualitative results
 - risk assessment summary and recommended control actions
 - Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go. 

Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification: 

- Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor's or a master's degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments. 
 - 4-7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas: 
 - ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
 - security testing / red teaming
 - building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness. 
 - Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines). 
 - Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing. 
 - Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design). 
 - Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias). 
 - Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
 - Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls. 
 - Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns. 
 - Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring. 
 - Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses. 
 - Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes. 
 - Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards. 
 - Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments. 
 - Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to challenge assumptions constructively ("effective challenge") and influence engineering teams toward remediation. 
 - Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

- Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset). 
 - Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts). 
 - Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants. 
 - Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault). 

Additional skills requirements: 

- Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
 - Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline. 
 - Must have demonstrated project management experience. 
 - Knowledge of firm's reporting tools and processes. 
 - Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask. 
 - Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions. 
 - Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources. 
 - A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors

What We Look For

- A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
 - An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide. 
 - Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. 

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
 - Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
 - The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Software QA Lead
data.description:
Hiring for Cotecna Inspection - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About Company

Cotecna is a global provider of testing, inspection and certification services. Its digital products support customer portals, field inspection, laboratories, compliance records, certificates, document workflows and operational teams across high-stakes global supply chains. The company is strengthening the quality-engineering foundations behind these applications. 

Job Roles & Responsibilities

- Own the automation strategy while remaining hands-on with framework design, test development, debugging and execution across Cotecna's digital products. 
 - Build and evolve maintainable automation frameworks for web and API journeys; framework choice is flexible when the architecture and ownership evidence are strong. 
 - Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and establish reliable quality gates, reporting, triage and release-readiness criteria. 
 - Lead and mentor QA engineers, define standards and review practices, and improve coverage, speed, maintainability and production quality. 
 - Partner with product, engineering and business stakeholders on risk-based testing, defect prevention, go/no-go decisions and post-release improvement. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

- Six to ten years of QA or quality-engineering experience, including at least five years of recent hands-on automation and continued coding or framework work. 
 - Demonstrable ownership of an automation framework built from scratch or substantially architected; scripting only inside somebody else's framework is insufficient. 
 - Hands-on web automation using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or an equivalent, plus API automation using Rest Assured, Postman, Karate or an equivalent. 
 - Personal ownership of integrating automated suites into Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or a comparable delivery pipeline. 
 - Evidence of leading or owning QA for a team, including mentoring, standards and release or production-readiness decisions; quantified team size is preferred. 
 - Mobile automation, performance or security-aware testing, cloud or containers, and regulated or document-heavy systems are useful differentiators. 

Hiring Process

- Internal HM Review
 - Flexiple Interview

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer with a strong background in manual testing to help ensure our product remains reliable, stable, and high-performing. Experience in test automation is highly desirable. In this role, you will also have the opportunity-and expectation-to learn C#. 

This position is perfect for a proactive QA professional who enjoys diving business flows using different approaches for manual testing, creating automated test solutions, and expanding their programming expertise by exploring new paradigms. 

As our new Senior QA Engineer, you will join the Product Division within the Front Office - Axioma Portfolio Optimization team, collaborating closely with engineering teams across multiple global locations.

- Design and automate test cases
 - Perform thorough manual and exploratory testing to validate complex financial systems and edge cases
 - Collaborate with developers, QAs, and product owners to define clear, testable requirements
 - Identify, document, and communicate defects with precision
 - Contribute to maintaining and improving overall product quality
 - Learn and apply C# to support and automate solutions

What We Value

- 3+ years of experience in QA
 - Strong understanding of QA methodologies, tools, and best practices
 - Financial knowledge through education or hands-on experience in complex financial domains
 - Experience testing APIs
 - Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
 - Familiarity with Postman or similiar tools for API testing
 - Good understanding of SDLC and STLC
 - Experience writing test cases, test scenarios, and test plans
 - Understanding of Agile/Scrum processes

Additionaly We Value

- Being proactive and transparent
 - Good communication skills
 - Working with others to leverage the knowledge of everyone on the team
 - Taking responsibility for your work and focusing on effective solutions
 - Trying new approaches to handle both new and existing challenges
 - Learning new skills and enhancing existing ones
 - Continually seeking ways to improve our processes and the way we work
 - Giving and receiving feedback in a way that promotes growth and understanding
 - Fluent in English

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application. 
 - Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work. 
 - Inclusive and diverse company culture 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. 

We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

data.title: QA Automation Engineer - Playwright & TypeScript
data.description:
Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India | Currently Remote, Future Hybrid | Full-time | 1-2 Years' Experience

  

Help build the automation behind tens of thousands of prescriptions every month. 

Script Assist is a growing UK healthtech company developing an interconnected SaaS platform for clinics, pharmacies and patients. 

Our technology supports complex healthcare workflows, from consultations and prescribing through to stock management, dispensing and fulfilment. Tens of thousands of prescriptions move through our platform every month. 

Behind those workflows is a challenging engineering environment: multiple web applications, different organisations, user roles, permissions, configurations and interconnected processes. 

When an engineer changes one part of the platform, the impact can extend across several other systems. 

That's why test automation matters enormously to us. 

We're looking for a hands-on QA Automation Engineer who enjoys writing code, investigating technical problems and developing dependable automated tests using Playwright with TypeScript or JavaScript. 

This is an opportunity to build genuine automation engineering skills while working on complex, production healthcare software alongside experienced QA and development colleagues. 

What makes this opportunity interesting?

•  Real automation engineering. You'll spend your time developing and maintaining automated tests, not simply executing manual test scripts. 

•  Complex, connected applications. You'll work with workflows crossing clinic, pharmacy and patient-facing systems, rather than testing isolated screens. 

•  Meaningful technical development. You'll strengthen your skills in Playwright, TypeScript/JavaScript, end-to-end testing, regression automation, debugging and maintainable test design. 

•  International collaboration. You'll work with colleagues supporting UK healthcare operations and contribute to improving the reliability of a growing SaaS product. 

•  Visible impact. Good automation makes releases safer, identifies defects earlier and gives the engineering team greater confidence to deliver changes. 

What you'll be doing

•  Build Playwright automation: Write, execute, debug and maintain automated UI and end-to-end (E2E) tests using TypeScript or JavaScript and Playwright Test. 

•  Strengthen regression coverage: Automate important functional, integration and regression scenarios covering clinics, pharmacies and patient workflows. 

•  Write maintainable test code: Work with Page Object Model (POM) patterns, reusable helpers, test fixtures, assertions, test data and reliable locators. 

•  Investigate failures: Diagnose broken tests, timing problems, asynchronous behaviour, flaky automation and unexpected application responses. 

•  Validate APIs and workflows: Use REST API testing techniques and tools such as Postman to understand and verify application behaviour. 

•  Collaborate with developers: Reproduce bugs, explain defects clearly, verify fixes and investigate how changes affect related functionality. 

•  Improve automation quality: Use Git, review test execution results and develop your understanding of reliable testing in CI/CD pipelines. 

What we're looking for

We're particularly interested in candidates with: 

•  Approximately 1-2 years of professional software testing experience, including genuine hands-on test automation. 

•  Practical experience personally writing Playwright automated tests using TypeScript or JavaScript. 

•  Understanding of Playwright locators, assertions, automatic waiting, fixtures and Page Object Model concepts. 

•  Experience creating automated functional, regression or end-to-end tests for web applications. 

•  Basic knowledge of REST APIs, debugging, defect reporting and Git. 

•  A logical approach to problem-solving, attention to detail and clear written communication. 

•  The ability to investigate a technical problem, learn from feedback and improve your code. 

You don't need to have designed a complete automation framework or worked in healthcare before. 

  

Particularly useful experience

Experience testing SaaS or B2B web applications, multiple user roles, permissions, REST APIs, complex workflows or configuration-driven products would be beneficial. 

Familiarity with CI/CD, Playwright trace debugging and AI-assisted coding tools would also be useful, although these are not prerequisites. 

What success looks like

You'll become someone the team can rely on to automate a feature, build meaningful assertions, investigate a failing test and explain what the evidence shows. 

Over time, you'll contribute increasingly independently to automated regression coverage and the reliability of the overall test suite. 

Location and working arrangements

We're currently working remotely and plan to introduce hybrid working in Ahmedabad. You must be willing and able to attend the Ahmedabad office when this arrangement is implemented. 

The role requires collaboration with UK-based colleagues and working hours aligned with UK operations, including evening hours in India. The precise schedule will be confirmed during recruitment. 

How we hire

We believe practical engineering ability matters more than an impressive-looking CV. Our selection process is straightforward: 

1.         Apply through LinkedIn and answer a short set of eligibility questions. 

2.         Complete a practical Playwright automation assessment. 

3.         If you're among the strongest performers, attend a technical interview with our senior QA automation colleague. 

If you're currently a QA Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, Software Test Engineer or junior SDET who genuinely enjoys writing automation code, we'd like to hear from you. 

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV and help us improve the reliability of software supporting real healthcare operations.

As the Senior Salesforce Test Automation Engineer, you will lead the expansion of automated quality engineering across our Salesforce ecosystem, with primary ownership for establishing Cypress. io as a scalable, maintainable, and trusted enterprise test automation capability. You will combine hands-on automation engineering with technical leadership, partnering with developers, administrators, product owners, business analysts, release engineering, and quality engineers to improve release confidence, shorten feedback cycles, and reduce reliance on repetitive manual regression testing. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of a Cypress. io automation framework for Salesforce applications, Experience Cloud, integrated web applications, and critical end-to-end business processes. 
 - Define automation architecture, coding standards, repository structure, reusable commands, fixtures, test-data patterns, environment configuration, tagging, and reporting conventions that support maintainability and scale. 
 - Develop and maintain reliable automated suites for smoke, regression, integration, end-to-end, API, and selected component-testing scenarios, balancing UI coverage with faster API-based setup and validation where appropriate. 
 - Create a pragmatic automation roadmap that prioritizes high-risk, high-volume, and business-critical Salesforce journeys and converts the existing regression inventory into a sustainable Cypress test portfolio. 
 - Design resilient approaches for Salesforce-specific automation challenges, including dynamic Lightning DOM behavior, asynchronous processing, authentication, role-based access, complex data dependencies, integrations, and multi-environment execution. 
 - Integrate Cypress execution into CI/CD pipelines and release workflows, including pull-request validation, scheduled regression runs, pre-release quality gates, test result publishing, screenshots, videos, and failure diagnostics. 
 - Establish test observability and quality metrics such as automation coverage, pass rate, execution time, flaky-test rate, defect escape trends, failure causes, and manual effort avoided; use insights to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Build secure, repeatable test-data and credential-management practices across Salesforce sandboxes and connected systems, partnering with platform, security, and DevOps teams to protect sensitive information. 
 - Perform hands-on exploratory, functional, integration, regression, and release-readiness testing when automation is not yet available or when human judgment provides better coverage. 
 - Partner with product owners, business analysts, solution architects, developers, and administrators to make requirements testable and to strengthen acceptance criteria, negative scenarios, risk analysis, and definition-of-done standards. 
 - Troubleshoot failed tests and application defects, distinguish product issues from automation issues, document reproducible evidence, and collaborate with engineering teams through resolution. 
 - Review automation code, mentor quality engineers and developers, provide technical guidance, and promote engineering practices that treat automated tests as production-quality software. 
 - Evaluate Cypress. io capabilities, plugins, Cypress Cloud features, and AI-assisted test authoring; recommend adoption based on security, maintainability, cost, measurable value, and enterprise standards. 
 - Contribute to QA governance, release management, Agile ceremonies, test planning, risk reviews, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of software quality engineering and test automation experience, including 3+ years testing Salesforce solutions in complex enterprise environments. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience building and maintaining Cypress. io automation using JavaScript or TypeScript, with strong understanding of selectors, custom commands, fixtures, network interception, retries, asynchronous behavior, and test isolation. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing an automation framework or materially scaling an existing framework across teams, applications, or release trains. 
 - Strong Salesforce testing experience across Lightning Experience and one or more of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CPQ/commerce, custom Apex and Lightning Web Components, integrations, or platform automation. 
 - Experience with API testing, including REST and GraphQL patterns, authentication, request/response validation, data setup, and combining API and UI tests.

data.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer – Playwright & TypeScript
data.description:
Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India | Currently Remote, Future Hybrid | Full-time | 3-5 Years' Experience

  

Own and improve the automation framework behind a growing UK healthcare technology platform. 

Script Assist develops sophisticated SaaS software connecting clinics, pharmacies and patients across the UK. 

Our platform supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month, with interconnected workflows covering consultations, prescribing, repeat requests, medicine availability, dispensing and fulfilment. 

This creates substantial engineering complexity. 

Our applications must work reliably across multiple organisations, different configurations, user roles, permissions and connected services. A seemingly small application change can introduce unexpected behaviour somewhere else in the platform. 

As we continue developing the product, dependable automated testing is essential to maintaining quality and supporting confident software releases. 

We're looking for a genuinely hands-on Senior QA Automation Engineer to help shape how we test this technology. 

You will take meaningful technical ownership of our Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript automation framework, improving its architecture, reliability, maintainability and integration with our engineering workflows. 

This is not simply a role for someone who can write automated test scripts. We need an engineer who understands why automation becomes unreliable, how to structure it properly and how to improve its effectiveness across a growing software platform. 

Why this role is technically interesting

•  Framework ownership. You'll influence how our Playwright test automation is structured, maintained and extended, rather than simply following an existing pattern. 

•  Complex multi-tenant SaaS. You'll help automate workflows across multiple clinics, pharmacies, applications, organisational configurations and user roles. 

•  Challenging reliability problems. You'll tackle flaky tests, asynchronous workflows, test-data contamination, unreliable selectors, permissions and difficult-to-reproduce failures. 

•  Impact across engineering. Your work will help developers identify regressions earlier, improve CI/CD feedback and give the team better evidence when making release decisions. 

•  Technical leadership without losing the coding. You'll review automation code, help other engineers improve and contribute directly to the framework and important test scenarios. 

•  Real-world healthcare operations. You'll work on technology supporting significant volumes of complex, interconnected healthcare activity. 

What you'll own and deliver

•  Playwright framework architecture: Design, extend, refactor and maintain a robust end-to-end test automation framework using Playwright with TypeScript or JavaScript. 

•  Automated regression coverage: Develop reliable E2E, functional and integration tests across clinic, pharmacy and patient-facing applications. 

•  Reusable test infrastructure: Create effective Page Object Model (POM) abstractions, custom fixtures, utilities, authentication helpers and test-data management approaches. 

•  Test reliability and isolation: Resolve flaky tests, race conditions, state leakage, brittle locators, synchronisation issues and failures caused by parallel execution. 

•  API and permissions testing: Combine UI automation with REST API validation, including testing role-based access and organisational data boundaries. 

•  CI/CD integration: Improve automated test execution in development and release pipelines, including reporting, diagnostics, traces and efficient regression runs. 

•  Engineering collaboration: Work closely with QA engineers and developers to investigate defects, review test code, identify quality risks and improve testing practices. 

•  Continuous improvement: Evaluate automation tools and AI-assisted development techniques, validating their output rather than relying on generated code without scrutiny. 

The experience we're looking for

•  Approximately 3-5 years of professional software testing experience, with a substantial proportion spent writing automated test code. 

•  Strong, recent, hands-on Playwright automation experience using TypeScript or JavaScript. 

•  Demonstrable experience building, extending or materially improving an automation framework, rather than only adding individual test cases. 

•  Practical knowledge of Playwright Test, reusable fixtures, Page Object Model design, reliable locators, web-first assertions and test isolation. 

•  Experience diagnosing intermittent failures and improving automated test stability. 

•  Working knowledge of REST API testing, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated test reporting and debugging tools. 

•  The ability to explain technical decisions, identify trade-offs and write understandable, maintainable automation code. 

•  Confidence reviewing other engineers' work and supporting less experienced QA colleagues. 

We're interested in practical engineering ownership, not simply somebody who has held a senior title. 

  

Experience that would make you particularly interesting

We'd be especially interested in candidates who have worked on: 

•  Multi-tenant B2B SaaS: Applications serving different organisations with separate permissions, configurations and workflows. 

•  Complex end-to-end testing: Business processes spanning multiple applications, services or asynchronous events. 

•  Scalable test architecture: Reusable fixtures, parallel execution, test-data isolation and maintainable automation design. 

•  CI/CD reliability: Improving the speed, diagnostic value and consistency of automated testing. 

•  Technical guidance: Reviewing automation code, establishing better practices or helping other QA engineers develop. 

Healthcare experience is beneficial but not required. 

  

What success looks like

You'll be able to take an unreliable or difficult-to-maintain area of our automated testing and make it measurably better. 

That could mean reducing flaky test failures, improving test isolation, making regression runs more useful, simplifying a framework that has become unnecessarily complicated, or introducing reliable coverage for important workflows. 

You'll help us move towards automation that engineers trust, understand and can extend confidently. 

  

The environment and working arrangement

You'll work with colleagues supporting a UK healthcare technology business, combining independent technical problem-solving with close collaboration across QA and development. 

We're currently operating remotely, with future hybrid working planned in Ahmedabad. Candidates must be willing and able to attend the Ahmedabad office when this is introduced. 

The position requires UK-aligned working hours, including evening working in India. The exact schedule will be explained during recruitment. 

How we assess candidates

Our recruitment process focuses on real engineering ability: 

1.         Apply through LinkedIn and complete the eligibility questions. 

2.         Complete a practical Playwright automation assessment covering test implementation, debugging, reliability and framework design. 

3.         The strongest candidates proceed directly to a technical interview with our senior QA automation colleague. 

If you've worked as a Senior Test Automation Engineer, Senior QA Engineer, SDET or Software Development Engineer in Test, and enjoy both writing code and improving automation architecture, we'd be interested in hearing from you. 

Apply through LinkedIn and help build dependable test automation for a complex, growing healthcare SaaS platform.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30, 000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. 

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking a Cloud DevOps Engineer with hands-on expertise in cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, automation, CI/CD and observability. You will independently manage and improve cloud infrastructure across development and operational environments, with particular focus on Microsoft Azure, Azure OpenAI Services, AWS, AKS/EKS, Kubernetes, networking, security and monitoring. 

The role combines cloud engineering and DevOps with operational responsibilities including incident, problem, change, release and deployment management. You will work closely with development teams to automate delivery, troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application issues, improve reliability and support secure, scalable cloud environments. 

What You'll Do

- Maintain and continuously improve cloud and DevOps infrastructure, including continuous integration infrastructure, build platforms, test systems and development environments 
 - Manage cloud infrastructure end to end, including monitoring, reporting, networking, DNS and security 
 - Build and manage Kubernetes clusters, including Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), with the ability to set up clusters from scratch 
 - Set up and script cloud environments using infrastructure-as-code and automation practices 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins 
 - Establish continuous delivery tooling and procedures covering build servers, automated deployment and configuration management 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform, Ansible and relevant cloud-native technologies such as AWS CloudFormation 
 - Support software rollouts across development, test and production environments 
 - Partner with development teams on infrastructure, scalability, security and automation requirements 
 - Configure and support Microsoft Azure OpenAI Services, including networking, firewall, API Management (APIM) and related generative AI services 
 - Configure and support APIs through the Apigee platform 
 - Monitor applications and infrastructure using tools such as Dynatrace, Instana, Grafana and Datadog 
 - Perform log analysis, including Fluentd-based logging, to identify and resolve application and infrastructure issues 
 - Apply ITIL practices across incident resolution, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management and deployment 
 - Perform root-cause analysis, identify known errors and coordinate corrective actions 
 - Support release and deployment activities within Unix/Linux-based environments 
 - Apply Git branching, tagging and versioning strategies across software repositories 
 - Support build and continuous integration activities using Maven and Gradle 
 - Contribute effectively within DevOps and Agile/Scrum delivery teams

Who You Are

- You have excellent knowledge of cloud platforms and services, particularly Microsoft Azure, AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) 
 - You have hands-on experience managing cloud infrastructure and setting up monitoring and reporting 
 - You have strong expertise in DevOps, automation and CI/CD/CT practices 
 - You have hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes and cluster creation and deployment using AKS and EKS 
 - You understand cloud networking, DNS, security and encryption 
 - You have experience with scripting languages such as Bash, Python or Ruby 
 - You have experience with Terraform, Ansible, AWS CloudFormation, GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins 
 - You understand Git branching, tagging and versioning strategies 
 - You have experience with build tools such as Maven and Gradle 
 - You have strong knowledge of observability and log analysis, with exposure to Dynatrace, Instana, Grafana, Datadog and Fluentd 
 - You understand NoSQL technologies such as Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB and Cassandra 
 - You have practical knowledge of ITIL processes, particularly Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, release and deployment 
 - You have experience using ticketing and work management tools such as Remedy and Jira 
 - You have experience with configuration management and software deployment across multiple environments 
 - You understand Spring application development and the Spring Boot framework 
 - You have practical experience with Microsoft Azure OpenAI Services, networking, firewalls, Azure API Management (APIM) and related generative AI services 
 - You have a good understanding of the Apigee platform and API configuration 
 - You bring analytical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, alongside a collaborative approach to problem solving 
 - You communicate clearly, work effectively within a team and navigate disagreements constructively 
 - Knowledge of Java is beneficial 
 - Microsoft Azure and/or AWS certifications are beneficial 
 - Experience working across international, multi-location teams is beneficial 
 - You are comfortable learning new technologies, working independently and focusing on measurable outcomes 
 - You understand software development and service management processes, including SDLC and ITIL, and can contribute to process improvement and innovation

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

- Exposure to cloud engineering across Microsoft Azure and AWS environments 
 - Opportunities to work with Azure OpenAI Services and related generative AI technologies 
 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes environments using AKS and EKS 
 - Opportunities to contribute across cloud infrastructure, DevOps automation, observability, API management and secure deployments 
 - Collaboration with development, operations and delivery teams in an Agile environment 
 - Experience solving scalability, security and infrastructure automation challenges

What Skills You Will Learn

- Deeper practical expertise in cloud infrastructure automation and infrastructure-as-code 
 - Advanced AKS/EKS and Kubernetes cluster deployment and operational practices 
 - Enterprise implementation of Microsoft Azure OpenAI Services and generative AI supporting services 
 - Cloud networking, DNS, security, firewall and API management practices 
 - Advanced CI/CD and deployment automation using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform and Ansible 
 - Application and infrastructure observability using Dynatrace, Instana, Grafana, Datadog and Fluentd 
 - API configuration and management practices using Azure API Management and Apigee 
 - Cross-functional delivery practices spanning DevOps, Agile and ITIL environments

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

- JavaScript and TypeScript.

 - Optimize for Modern Data Workloads: Design and implement robust algorithms and concurrent platform solutions engineered for modern data pipelines, AI infrastructure, distributed computing, and enterprise analytics. 
 - Resolve Complex System Engineering Challenges: Apply deep root-cause analysis and system-level insight to solve multi-threaded, high-concurrency performance and reliability issues across Linux platform internals. 
 - Cross-Functional Ownership & Leadership: Collaborate across product management, validation, and support teams to align technical roadmaps, establish architectural standards, and drive enterprise product stability. 
 - Elevate Engineering Standards: Mentor high-performing engineering peers, spearhead architecture forums, and foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and customer-first impact. 

What You Bring

- Core Technical Expertise: Deep platform development proficiency in Linux system programming alongside strong hands-on expertise in C, C++, Python, Go, or Java. 
 - Advanced Systems Fundamentals: Mastery of object-oriented design, data structures, multi-threading, synchronization, concurrent programming, and distributed systems architecture. 
 - Domain & Production Insight: proven ability to make strategic architectural decisions, design for enterprise-grade high availability, and support complex production deployments. 
 - Collaborative Leadership & Communication: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of articulating complex system architectures, championing design proposals, and influencing key technical stakeholders. 
 - Location: We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Pure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave. 

What You Can Expect From Us

- Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers. 
 - Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in TechnologyTM, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay AreaTM, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
 - Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good. 

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http: //benefits. everpuredata. com/ for more information. 

Accommodations And Accessibility

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage. com if you're invited to an interview. 

Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team

We're forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn't just accepted but embraced. That's why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership. 

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire. 

Join us and bring your best. 

Bring your bold. 

Pure and simple.

SES has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Engineer. You will be part of a team responsible for

- Portal software design, governing scalable architectural improvements along with team productivity, scalability, simplification and quality improvements
 - Driving architectural alignment and long-term technical strategy across multiple teams. 
 - Leading feature refinements and ensuring end-to-end delivery of high-quality, reliable solutions.

 - Nice to have development experience in React. js
 - Good experience in Architecting and Designing Large scale applications
 - Experience in CI/CD and AWS deployments (EC2, SQS, SNS, Lambda, S3, Aurora, DynamoDB)

 - Advanced knowledge of software development lifecycles; expert knowledge in Agile and Lean methods.

Overview

Core AI is at the forefront of Microsoft's mission to redefine how software is built and experienced. We are responsible for building the foundational platforms, services, programming models, and developer experiences that power the next generation of applications using Generative AI. Our work enables developers and enterprises to harness the full potential of AI to create intelligent, adaptive, and transformative software. 

The Agentic Core Services Team is responsible for building the cloud-native, distributed platform that powers the development, execution, and management of agentic applications at scale. Our mission is to provide the foundational infrastructure and runtime systems that enable developers to build intelligent, autonomous, and enterprise-grade AI agents with confidence and agility. 

In this role, you will help define the future of software and application development. You will shape how developers interact with our platform-from programming models and user experiences to the design of a managed, distributed runtime that orchestrates agent-based AI applications at scale with enterprise-grade guarantees. You'll work at the cutting edge of AI research, collaborating with some of the brightest minds in generative AI, and integrating the latest breakthroughs in multi-modal capabilities (text, audio, video) into real-world agentic applications. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities : 

- Collaborates with appropriate stakeholders to determine user requirements for a scenario. 
 - Drives identification of dependencies and the development of design documents for a product, application, service, or platform. 
 - Creates, implements, optimizes, debugs, refactors, and reuses code to establish and improve performance and maintainability, effectiveness, and return on investment (ROI). 
 - Leverages subject-matter expertise of product features and partners with appropriate stakeholders (e. g. , project managers) to drive a workgroup's project plans, release plans, and work items. 
 - Acts as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) and guides other engineers by developing and following the playbook, working on call to monitor system/product/service for degradation, downtime, or interruptions, alerting stakeholders about status and initiates actions to restore system/product/service for simple and complex problems when appropriate. 
 - Proactively seeks new knowledge and adapts to new trends, technical solutions, and patterns that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 7+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production-grade software and services at scale, with a proven track record of delivering high-impact solutions. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Demonstrated expertise in solving complex technical challenges in one or more domains such as distributed systems, AI/ML infrastructure, developer platforms, or cloud services. 
 - Experience engaging with customers during integration or deployment phases, with a focus on delivering value and incorporating feedback into product evolution. 

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 

- Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

#CoreAIIndiaHiring

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. Description

Love building and leading high-performing engineering teams? Want to own the systems that keep billing accurate and trustworthy for millions of advertisers spending billions of dollars worldwide? Excited to lead the shift from manual financial operations to AI-powered and agentic automation? Then, the Iron Mountain platform team wants you!

Amazon Advertising is one of the fastest-growing businesses within Amazon, empowering Sellers, Vendors, Authors, and Publishers to boost product reach and sales through performance and display advertising. The Iron Mountain platform is the singular system that manages all advertiser billing, invoicing, accounting automation, real-time budgeting, promotions, payments, and Billing Advertiser Experience (AX) - processing multi-billion transactions worth 100x in dollar value daily, worldwide, across all ad products displayed On or Off Amazon. 

Billing accuracy is a critical pillar of this platform. This team owns billing corrections (credits and rebills), offline and alternative payment workflows, and the revenue-integrity mechanisms that make advertising billing transparent and auditable end to end - serving thousands of correction requests each year from partners across Ads Sales, Finance, Accounting, and FinOps. The multi-year roadmap transforms this space into self-service and intelligent automation: AI-driven investigation of billing defects, agentic correction workflows, and advertiser-facing self-service experiences. 

The Iron Mountain team is looking for a Software Development Manager to lead this Bengaluru-based team. You will: 

Lead, hire, and develop a team of 8+ engineers, owning their growth, delivery, and engineering excellence

Own the product and technical roadmap for billing corrections and offline payments - from high-volume manual workflows today to automated, self-service, and agentic experiences through 2027

Drive operational excellence for tier-1 billing systems where accuracy and availability directly protect advertiser trust and Amazon revenue

Shape how GenAI and AI agents interact with financial systems safely - automation with auditability, guardrails, and zero tolerance for monetary error

Partner across Finance, Accounting, FinOps, and ad-product teams worldwide to reduce correction volume at the root cause, not just process it faster

Be a player-coach: technically strong enough to hold the bar in design reviews, while spending your energy on people, roadmap, and delivery

To succeed, you will bring a track record of building strong teams and delivering large-scale distributed systems, comfort operating business-critical financial services, and a forward-looking perspective on how AI transforms financial operations - combined with people-first leadership that grows engineers as fast as it ships software.

We are seeking an experienced  Principal Software Engineer to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform.  - Strong proficiency in C and C++ with experience owning and maintaining compiled software components. 
 - Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies. 
 - Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX.

data.title: Platform Distribution Architect
data.description:
About the Role

Purple Fabric is looking for a Platform Distribution Architect to own how Purple Fabric (PF) and MSOCK are packaged, deployed and delivered to enterprise customers. 

You will shape how our platforms reach customers across multiple public clouds, on-premises environments and different deployment models, including SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed deployments. 

This role combines deep platform architecture expertise with hands-on technical leadership. You will define distribution standards, architect Kubernetes-based deployments and drive CI/CD and release automation, working closely with Product Engineering, DevOps/SRE and Customer Delivery teams to ensure every release is secure, reliable and deployment-ready. 

What You Will Own

1. Distribution Architecture

- Define reference architectures, packaging standards and deployment patterns for Purple Fabric and MSOCK. 
 - Establish repeatable distribution approaches across SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed environments. 2. Multi-Cloud and On-Premises Readiness

- Drive platform compatibility, infrastructure prerequisites, service and quota assessments, and feature parity across AWS, Azure, GCP and customer data centers. 
 - Ensure deployment readiness for restricted and air-gapped network environments. 3. Kubernetes Platform Design

- Architect production-grade Kubernetes deployments across EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift and upstream Kubernetes. 
 - Define cluster topology, networking, security, scaling and upgrade strategies. 4. Infrastructure and Deployment Automation

- Design reusable Infrastructure as Code modules and automated provisioning workflows. 
 - Establish baseline configurations and secure, repeatable deployment processes. 5. CI/CD and Release Automation

- Own distribution pipelines across build, artifact packaging, versioning, promotion and release orchestration. 
 - Design blue-green and canary deployment strategies, automated rollback and release traceability. 6. Self-Service Distribution

- Build standard provisioning workflows, templates, tooling and deployment interfaces. 
 - Reduce manual effort for internal engineering teams and enterprise customers. 7. Upgrades and Migrations

- Architect repeatable upgrade, migration and environment-promotion processes. 
 - Build in validation, recovery and lifecycle automation. 8. Observability and Reliability

- Define telemetry, SLOs, alerting, resilience, capacity and incident-readiness requirements across distributed deployments. 9. Security and Compliance

- Embed DevSecOps practices throughout the delivery pipeline, including SBOMs, image signing and scanning, secrets management, infrastructure hardening and policy as code. 10. Distribution Assurance and Cost Efficiency

- Own certification criteria, deployment acceptance checks, technical documentation and L3 platform escalations. 
 - Guide infrastructure sizing and deployment architecture to improve utilisation and cloud cost efficiency. 11. Collaboration and Technical Leadership

- Partner with Product Engineering on release requirements, DevOps/SRE on operational readiness and Customer Delivery on deployment and handover. 
 - Mentor engineers and lead architecture and design reviews. 

What You Bring

- Multi-cloud architecture: Hands-on architecture and deployment experience across at least two major public cloud platforms - AWS, Azure or GCP - covering networking, compute, storage, identity and security. 
 - Kubernetes and containers: Strong production experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm and cloud-native deployment patterns. 
 - CI/CD and release automation: Proven experience designing build, packaging, versioning, promotion and rollback pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform, Ansible or equivalent provisioning and configuration tools. 
 - Deployment architecture: Experience delivering repeatable deployments across SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed environments, including configuration, upgrades and lifecycle automation. 
 - Observability and reliability: Hands-on knowledge of metrics, logs, tracing, alerting and SLOs, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry. 
 - Programming and scripting: Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Go, Bash or PowerShell. 
 - Core technical fundamentals: Strong understanding of Linux, networking, DNS, load balancing, Git workflows and security fundamentals. 

Good to Have

- Experience deploying enterprise platforms in customer data centers, VMware or bare-metal environments, private clouds such as OpenStack, and air-gapped networks. 
 - Familiarity with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux, and artifact management platforms such as Artifactory, Nexus, Harbor and OCI registries. 
 - Experience building internal tools, CLIs, Kubernetes operators or integrations using Go or Python. 
 - Understanding of FinOps practices, including cloud cost visibility, rightsizing, capacity planning and cost-aware architecture. 
 - Experience delivering platforms in regulated environments with standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or PCI DSS. 

Interested?

If you have experience architecting and automating enterprise platform distributions across cloud and customer-managed environments, we'd like to hear from you. 

- Apply through this LinkedIn job listing or contact the recruiter listed in the accompanying recruitment post.

For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

We are seeking an experienced  Principal Software Engineer to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces. 

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance. 

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system. 

Responsibilities

 - Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies. 
 - Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX.
