data.title: Guidewire QA Engineers
data.description:
About Norima

We are Norima, a North American technology consulting firm with over 20 years of experience, helping businesses engage, understand, serve, and manage their clients through technology. We streamline business processes to improve our clients' bottom lines, strengthen their competitive advantage, and help them engage, understand, manage, and serve customers more effectively. We specialize in banking and wealth management, and insurance transformation, implementations and enhancements. Our team of hundreds of consultants delivers the optimal blend of practical experience, innovative technology talent, and subject matter expertise to their consulting engagements. We are selective about whom we bring onto our high-calibre team, hiring only those who embody and embrace our 3C value system: CHARACTER, COMPETENCE, CONSISTENCY. 

Norima Consulting is expanding our Guidewire practice in India - and we're looking for sharp, passionate talent to grow with us. If you live and breathe Guidewire, we'd love to talk. We're hiring across the full stack of the practice. 

Why Norima: You'll work on meaningful Guidewire programs with global clients, alongside a team that values craft, ownership, and genuine collaboration. No politics. No bureaucracy. Just good people doing great work. 

About The Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Guidewire Quality Assurance Analysts or Engineers to support testing and quality assurance across complex insurance transformation engagements. You will play a critical role in ensuring that Guidewire implementations are delivered with confidence - validating that platform configurations, integrations, and customisations behave as intended, business requirements are met, and defects are identified and resolved before they reach production. 

This role suits a QA professional who brings hands-on experience testing within Guidewire environments and is equally comfortable working within structured test plans and adapting to fast-moving Agile sprints. Whether your background is in manual testing, test automation, or a blend of both, what matters most is your commitment to quality, your ability to think like both an end user and a systems thinker, and your capacity to communicate defects and risks clearly to delivery teams and stakeholders. 

Guidewire certifications are a strong differentiator for this role and are actively highlighted in how we present your profile to clients. If you hold one or more Guidewire certifications, we want to know about them - and we will make sure clients do too. 

DETAILS

- Employment Type: Full-Time Employment
 - Experience: 6+ Years in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, with Guidewire Platform Exposure

Guidewire Platform Experience

Candidates with testing experience across any of the following are encouraged to apply: 

- PolicyCenter - Product Model, Underwriting Workflows, Forms, Rating
 - ClaimCenter - Claim Lifecycle, Coverage Verification, Reserves, Financials
 - BillingCenter - Billing Plans, Payment Schedules, Disbursements
 - Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP) - Cloud-hosted implementations and release validation
 - Integration Gateway / GIF - Third-party integrations, App Events, REST/SOAP API testing
 - Digital Portals - CustomerEngage, ProducerEngage, ServiceRepEngage

DOMAINS WE WORK IN

You may be deployed across any of the following client environments: 

- Property & Casualty, Life, or Group Benefits Insurance
 - Policy Administration, Claims, and Billing Transformation
 - Core Banking Modernization
 - Wealth Management and Investment Platform Delivery
 - Regulatory and Compliance Initiatives
 - Digital and Customer Experience Transformation

Core Responsibilities

- Develop, maintain, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts for Guidewire implementations based on business requirements and functional specifications
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing across Guidewire PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, and/or BillingCenter
 - Validate Guidewire configurations, product model changes, workflow logic, and integration touchpoints against defined acceptance criteria
 - Collaborate with Guidewire BAs and developers to ensure requirements are testable, acceptance criteria are clearly defined, and defects are actionable
 - Log, track, and communicate defects through the full defect lifecycle using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives as an active member of the delivery team
 - Support user acceptance testing (UAT) by coordinating with business stakeholders, preparing test environments, and facilitating sign-off
 - Contribute to test automation efforts where applicable, including development or maintenance of automated test scripts within Guidewire environments
 - Validate data integrity, system integrations, and end-to-end workflows across Guidewire and connected third-party systems
 - Assess and communicate quality risks to project and engagement leads on time
 - Contribute to QA process improvement including Guidewire-specific testing standards, templates, and best practices

Qualifications

Required

- 5+ years of quality assurance or software testing experience in a professional delivery environment
 - Hands-on experience testing within at least one Guidewire product - PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, or BillingCenter
 - Demonstrated ability to design and execute test cases from business requirements and functional specifications
 - Experience testing across multiple layers - UI, API, integration, and data - within complex multi-system environments
 - Proficiency with defect tracking and project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent
 - Familiarity with both Agile and Waterfall testing approaches
 - Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail with the ability to clearly articulate defects and their business impact
 - Solid written and verbal communication skills for working across technical and business stakeholder groups

Preferred

- Guidewire certification at Associate or Professional level - PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, BillingCenter, Cloud, or Integration (actively highlighted in client engagements)
 - Experience testing across multiple Guidewire products - cross-suite knowledge of PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, and BillingCenter is especially valued
 - Familiarity with Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP) release cycles and cloud-specific testing considerations
 - Experience testing Guidewire integrations including third-party data vendors, payment processors, and document management systems
 - Exposure to test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent
 - Experience with API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or SoapUI
 - Understanding of data validation, migration testing, or ETL testing in insurance or financial services contexts
 - Familiarity with performance or load testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner
 - ISTQB Foundation or Advanced certification, or equivalent QA credential

CORE COMPETENCIES

- Platform Testing Depth - Understanding how Guidewire's configuration model, product structure, and integration points create unique testing challenges and risks
 - Testing Rigor - Designing thorough, well-structured test cases that reflect real-world insurance business scenarios
 - Defect Clarity - Documenting and communicating issues in a way that is actionable for developers and meaningful to business stakeholders
 - Systems Thinking - Understanding how Guidewire components, configurations, and integrations interact and where risk is most likely to surface
 - Stakeholder Collaboration - Working effectively with Guidewire BAs, developers, and business users across the full delivery lifecycle
 - Agile Adaptability - Staying effective in fast-moving sprints without sacrificing test coverage or quality standards
 - Risk Awareness - Prioritizing testing effort based on business impact and proactively surfacing quality concerns early

How We Recognize & Support Certification

- Certified candidates are highlighted in client-facing bios, proposal submissions, and engagement staffing profiles
 - Certification support is available for candidates working toward their first or next Guidewire credential
 - Continued learning is encouraged through access to Guidewire Education resources and dedicated study time where engagement schedules allow
 - Your credentials travel with you - as you grow your certification portfolio, so does your value and visibility within our practice

a Note On Automation Experience

Automation skills are an asset but not a requirement for this role. We value strong manual testers who bring Guidewire platform knowledge, insurance domain acumen, and a structured approach to quality. Candidates with a blend of manual and automated testing experience - particularly those who can contribute to both within a Guidewire context - are especially encouraged to apply.

data.title: Engineering Manager - System Design
data.description:
Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Exerce un impact sur les approches, projets et programmes du domaine fonctionnel ou de l'organisation et des méthodes de travail affectées. Influe sur la qualité, l'efficacité et l'efficience de sa propre équipe. Contribue significativement à l'élaboration des priorités. Se fonde sur des pratiques et des politiques professionnelles façonnées par le rôle. Le rôle dispose d'une autonomie modérée, nécessitant un haut niveau de discernement opérationnel. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Effectue l'intégration des composants et des produits. Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. Gère les exigences, les spécifications et les flux de produits et de systèmes. Dirige les activités de validation et de vérification pour l'ensemble du produit/système, comprenant les tests au niveau du système. Responsable de la définition des exigences produits pour les équipes module/composant/sous-traitants et partenaires. Gère l'interface entre les composants et les organisations d'exécution. Responsable de la gestion des transactions de CTQ/Risque au sein des équipes chargées de la conception des composants. Gère la configuration globale du produit et le système de contrôle de la configuration. 
 - Développer des connaissances spécialisées dans sa discipline. Prodigue ses conseils en matière de meilleures pratiques et/ou de qualité. Est conscient des derniers développements techniques dans son propre domaine. Contribue à l'élaboration de stratégies et de politiques, et assure la mise en œuvre dans les limites de son domaine de responsabilités. 
 - Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché. 
 - Fait preuve de discernement pour prendre des décisions ou résoudre des tâches ou des problèmes moyennement complexes dans les domaines de l'exploitation, de la gestion des produits, de la fabrication, de la technologie ou de l'ingénierie. Adopte une nouvelle perspective sur les solutions existantes. Utilise son expérience technique et son expertise en analyse de données pour appuyer les recommandations. Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de sa propre fonction pour l'aider à prendre une décision. 
 - Agit en tant que ressource pour ses collègues moins expérimentés. Peut piloter de petits projets avec des risques et des besoins en ressources modérés. Explique les informations difficiles ou sensibles. S'efforce d'établir un consensus. Développe les compétences de persuasion nécessaires pour influencer les autres sur des sujets relevant de son domaine. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience avancée de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une maîtrise dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Maîtrise d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 6 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité démontrée d'analyse et de résolution des problèmes. Capacité démontrée à diriger des programmes/projets. Capacité à documenter, planifier, lancer et exécuter des programmes. Compétences établies en gestion de projet. Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.

Job Overview

The Senior Software Development Manager will lead the engineering strategy and execution for the digital technology portfolio, with accountability for delivery excellence, platform resilience, engineering productivity and technology modernisation. The role will translate business priorities into a scalable technology roadmap, strengthen engineering standards and capabilities, and ensure the delivery of secure, reliable and cost-effective technology solutions across internal teams and strategic partners.

Enterprise Engineering Strategy & Leadership

- Own the engineering and hosting strategy, aligned with business priorities, security, scalability and customer commitments. 
 - Lead engineering teams and managers, strengthening capability, performance and succession across critical roles. 
 - Define the operating model, workforce strategy and sourcing mix required to deliver at scale.

- Lead the responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering and agentic workflows across development, testing, release and operations. 
 - Establish AI governance covering security, data protection, IP, human oversight and traceability. 
 - Drive measurable improvements in engineering productivity and quality through AI, automation and reusable capabilities.

- Own portfolio-level delivery, release, quality and operational governance. 
 - Establish KPIs across delivery predictability, availability, quality, recovery, security, productivity and technical debt. 
 - Ensure strong service resilience, incident management, disaster recovery and continuous improvement.

- Own engineering budgets, investment planning and technology cost optimisation. 
 - Govern strategic partners and vendors against delivery, capability, SLA and commercial outcomes.

- Partner with Product, Operations, Security, Architecture and Commercial teams to translate business priorities into technology outcomes.

Sustainability

- Oversee corporate governance within the assigned region, ensuring alignment with organizational principles, policies, and regulations. 
 - Promote judicious use of natural resources and adhere to the organization's environment, health, and safety policies, objectives, and guidelines. 
 - Drive the organization's sustainability initiatives, working towards achieving established targets. Anti Bribery Management Systems (ABMS)

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent professional certification. 
 - Master's degree in technology, business or management preferred. Experience

- 15+ years in software engineering/digital technology, including 5+ years in engineering leadership. 
 - Enterprise platform ownership across engineering, cloud, DevSecOps, operations and modernization. 
 - Experience managing budgets, strategic vendors, complex portfolios and senior stakeholders. 
 - Expertise in modern architecture, APIs, data, cloud and Go, TypeScript, Node. js, Rust, Java or . NET. 
 - Experience with LLMs, AI agents and AI-enabled workflows, with security and human oversight. 
 - Strong expertise in Agile, CI/CD, DevSecOps, SRE, architecture governance and secure SDLC. Additional responsibilities

- Drive predictable delivery against portfolio commitments and investment plans. 
 - Strengthen platform availability, recovery, security and customer experience. 
 - Reduce technical debt and cost through modernization, automation and cloud optimization. 
 - Improve engineering productivity and quality through responsible AI and standardized practices. 
 - Build leadership capability, critical-skill coverage and retention of high-performing talent.

Equipment, Validation & Systems

- Coordinate with the Engineering team to ensure all equipment and instruments are in good working condition. 
 - Review Equipment Qualification Reports and ensure activities are completed as per plan. 
 - Coordinate with the team for completion of validation activities and review Validation Reports, Technical Study Reports, etc. 
 - Ensure the ERP system (or similar) is followed throughout the factory in a timely manner and that data is accurate. 

Team Leadership & Coordination

- Motivate subordinates to deliver maximum output, even against stretched targets. 
 - Train the manpower on all relevant aspects and enhance the capabilities of human resources. 
 - Build teamwork, implement kaizen ideas and standard work, and lead projects to reduce waste. 
 - Coordinate with other departments to obtain timely feedback. 
 - Participate effectively in the daily accountability meeting. 
 - Conduct regular meetings with all departments to address gaps. 
 - Maintain proper discipline and good labour relations. 

Compliance, Audits & EHS

- Handle internal and external audits; ensure Good Manufacturing Practice and proper housekeeping on the shop floor. 
 - Be aware of the Quality and EMS Policies and Quality Objectives. 
 - Maintain awareness of QMS, ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820 and ISO 14001 requirements. 
 - Plan for a safe work environment, provide safety equipment and train the manpower on safety matters. 
 - Build a strong safety committee in the departments to maintain and improve safety. 
 - Report EHS activities, concerns, incidents, near misses and accidents. 
 - Comply with and monitor that work practices are according to Lifestyles values and the Ethical Business Conduct Policy. 

This job description is subject to change by the Management to suit changing requirements from time to time. 

About the Company

LifeStyles has a history dating back to 1905 when Eric Ansell first started making condoms in Richmond Australia. 

Today LifeStyles is a Global leader in the sexual wellness sector, comprising a broad range of condoms, personal lubricants, and other related products and other products in over 60 countries. 

The LifeStyles family of brands includes the #1 global non-latex condom brand, SKYN®, Owning a large portfolio of trademarks, LifeStyles manufactures and commercialises its products, under its local heroes such as Mates®, LifeStyles®, Manix®, Unimil®, and Blowtex® and Control. The brands values are centered around sex positivity, pleasure, confidence and inclusivity. 

Outside of branded products, the Company also supports universities, NGOs, and other organizations as part of a broader effort to promote sexual health and prevent the spread of STDs and STIs. LifeStyles owns and operates manufacturing facilities in Thailand, India and Spain, and it employs over 1, 600 teammates globally. 

LifeStyles Healthcare was created on September 1, 2017, when the consortium of Humanwell Healthcare & CITIC Capital private equity purchased the Sexual Wellness division from Ansell. 

As of December 1, 2022, Lifestyles is owned by Linden Capital Partners, a Chicago-based private equity firm focused on the healthcare industry. 

This is an exciting time to join us. We combine century-long history with the opportunity of a new beginning as a stand-alone company - this means a new way of thinking, the opportunity to explore new horizons and the chance to make a mark in an exciting, fresh business. 

LifeStyles Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're looking for a daring opportunity to build brands in this booming & thrilling category, then let's talk. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. 

Discover more about us at: https: //www. linkedin. com/company/lifestyles-healthcare/.

data.title: AI Evaluation Engineer
data.description:
# AI Evaluation Engineer

- Location: ** Pune, Maharashtra
 - Work Mode: ** Work From Office (WFO)(890)
 - Experience: ** 9-12 Years
 - Notice Period: ** Immediate to 45 Days
 - Preferred Candidates: ** Local candidates based in Pune

## Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced AI Solutions Engineer to develop, evaluate, test, monitor, and support AI agents and LLM-powered applications across their development and production lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, and Azure Databricks. The role involves agent orchestration, LLM evaluation, experiment lifecycle management, automated testing, observability, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational reliability. 

This is a client-facing position involving regular interaction with clients and technical teams. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are mandatory, with no compromise on communication quality. 

## Key Responsibilities

### 1. Agent Development & Orchestration

- Design, develop, integrate, and maintain AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and OpenAI-based technologies. 
 - Build Python-based services, REST APIs, and agent integration components using FastAPI and Pydantic. 
 - Work with agent orchestration frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, and Pydantic-AI, where applicable. 
 - Support agent workflow development, integration, testing, and production operations. 

### 2. LLM Evaluation & Experiment Lifecycle

- Design and implement evaluation frameworks to assess agent quality, response accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance. 
 - Develop automated evaluation suites using pytest and custom pytest-based evaluations. 
 - Work with MLflow Evaluation, DeepEval, Ragas, and promptfoo for LLM and agent evaluation. 
 - Manage experiment execution, evaluation results, test iterations, and quality improvement cycles. 
 - Identify performance gaps and support continuous improvement of AI agent outputs. 

### 3. Agent Observability & Tracing

- Implement tracing, monitoring, and observability for agent workflows and LLM applications. 
 - Use OpenTelemetry and OpenInference for telemetry and instrumentation. 
 - Work with Langfuse and LangSmith to trace agent execution, investigate failures, and analyze application behavior. 
 - Monitor agent performance and troubleshoot issues across application and integration layers. 

### 4. Azure AI Stack

- Work with Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry for AI application and agent-related workloads. 
 - Use Azure Monitor and Application Insights for telemetry, application monitoring, diagnostics, and troubleshooting. 
 - Support operational monitoring and performance analysis of Azure-hosted AI solutions. 

### 5. Azure Databricks & Data Operations

- Work with Azure Databricks for data processing, SQL-based analysis, and operational workflows. 
 - Use Unity Catalog for data governance and access management. 
 - Work with Databricks Workflows/Jobs and SQL Warehouses. 
 - Support data-related workflows required for AI agent evaluation and operations. 

### 6. CI/CD, Testing & Version Control

- Maintain source code and version control using Git and GitLab. 
 - Integrate automated tests and evaluation suites into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Support repeatable testing, deployment validation, and release quality checks. 
 - Troubleshoot build, test, and deployment issues. 

### 7. Production Monitoring & Reliability

- Monitor applications and services using Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Kibana, and alerting platforms. 
 - Investigate production incidents, analyze logs and telemetry, and perform root-cause analysis. 
 - Support incident response, issue resolution, performance monitoring, and operational improvements. 
 - Help improve system reliability, observability, and troubleshooting efficiency. 

### 8. Cloud Infrastructure, Containers & Security

- Work with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for containerized workloads. 
 - Understand infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and Bicep. 
 - Apply security and identity management practices using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, OAuth2, Azure Key Vault, and role-based access control (RBAC). 
 - Support secure application access, credential management, and appropriate authorization controls. 

### 9. Client & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Collaborate regularly with clients, engineering teams, and other stakeholders. 
 - Communicate technical issues, evaluation outcomes, incident updates, and resolutions clearly. 
 - Participate in technical discussions and troubleshooting sessions. 
 - Maintain professional communication and timely coordination across teams. 

## Mandatory Skills / Must-Haves

The Following Skills Are Explicitly Mandatory For This Position

- Python
 - LangChain
 - LangGraph
 - OpenAI
 - Azure Databricks

Candidates must also demonstrate excellent communication, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities appropriate for a client-facing engineering role. 

## Nice-to-Have Skills

### Programming & APIs

- FastAPI
 - REST APIs
 - Pydantic
 - pytest

### Agent Orchestration

- OpenAI Agents SDK
 - Google ADK
 - Pydantic-AI

### Agent Observability

- OpenTelemetry
 - OpenInference
 - Langfuse
 - LangSmith

### LLM Evaluation & Experiment Lifecycle

- MLflow Evaluation
 - DeepEval
 - Ragas
 - promptfoo
 - Custom pytest evaluations

### Azure AI Stack

- Azure OpenAI
 - Microsoft Foundry
 - Azure Monitor
 - Application Insights

### Databricks

- Unity Catalog
 - Databricks Workflows/Jobs
 - SQL Warehouses

### CI/CD & Version Control

- Git
 - GitLab
 - Automated testing pipelines

### Production Monitoring

- Grafana
 - Prometheus
 - Azure Monitor
 - Kibana
 - Alerting platforms

### Cloud & Containers

- Docker
 - Kubernetes
 - Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
 - Terraform
 - Bicep

### Security & Identity

- Microsoft Entra ID
 - Managed identities
 - OAuth2
 - Key Vault
 - Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

## Candidate Screening Criteria

- **Experience: ** 9-12 years(relevnat should be 8+yrs). 
 - **Employment stability: ** Minimum 2 years in an organization. 
 - **Notice period: ** Immediate to 45 days. 
 - **Communication: ** Excellent verbal and written communication is mandatory; no compromise. 
 - **Location: ** Local Pune candidates are preferred.

data.description:
About Salesdock

Salesdock is a young, fast-growing company that delivers sales & CRM SaaS software to big brands in Europe, with its headquarters in The Netherlands. We are expanding our team and are looking for a talented Senior Software Tester for our office in Perinthalmanna, Kerala, India. 

About the Role & You

Our ideal candidate (you!) is a talented Software Tester with at least 5 years of experience. You love ensuring top-notch quality and know how to guarantee flawless, bug-free, and highly usable web applications. 

What you bring to the table: 

- At least 5 years of experience in software testing. 
 - Serious skills in regression testing, automated testing, and usability testing. 
 - An eye for detail, a critical mindset, and a passion for software quality assurance. 
 - Excellent English skills (both written and spoken), as we are an international company. 

What We Offer

Are you looking for a new adventure with possibilities to develop yourself, attend software quality assurance conferences, and enjoy a great working atmosphere? Here is what you can expect: 

- A modern office in Perinthalmanna. 
 - Your own MacBook Pro and a lot of responsibility. 
 - Hybrid working: working from home 1 or 2 days a week is no problem. 
 - An excellent salary and 30 holidays a year.

 - Implement backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.

 - Strong understanding of AWS security, encryption, KMS, IAM, auditing, and compliance. 
 - Experience implementing monitoring and observability using Datadog and CloudWatch. 
 - Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, and cloud cost optimization. Certifications

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional preferred. 
 - Additional AWS certifications in DevOps, Security, or Networking are an advantage. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with serverless architectures using AWS Lambda and the Serverless Framework. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS services such as SQS, SNS, SES, and DynamoDB. 
 - Experience with AWS security and governance services, including CloudTrail, AWS Config, Security Hub, and GuardDuty. 
 - Familiarity with AWS migration strategies and hybrid cloud solutions. 
 - Experience with code scanning, infrastructure security scanning, and compliance automation. 
 - Experience conducting architecture reviews and evaluating emerging cloud technologies. 
 - Familiarity with AI-powered development and productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Amazon Q Developer, or similar tools is a plus. 
 - Interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve cloud infrastructure management, DevOps workflows, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency. Soft Skills

- Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across technical teams.

data.title: Senior Manager — Global SAP ABAP & BTP Development Lead
data.description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23, 000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions. 

This role provides leadership for custom application development, integrations, extensions, automation, and innovation capabilities within the SAP ecosystem. The position ensures all enhancements are developed using modern SAP architecture principles while minimizing technical debt and preserving clean-core strategies. As guardian of SAP extensibility and platform innovation, the role enables business differentiation without compromising system stability. The leader drives adoption of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) capabilities to accelerate digital innovation and future scalability. This capability is essential to ensure the transformed ERP environment remains adaptable to evolving business requirements. 

Development leadership

- Lead a global ABAP and BTP engineering team across onshore and offshore, spanning template build, 

deployment wave support, and sustaining engineering. 

- Own the technical backlog, capacity plan, and delivery commitments across product domains, working directly

with functional solution owners and process leads. 

- Set and enforce engineering standards: code quality, performance, security, ATC checks, peer review, unit

testing, and documentation. 

- Establish CI/CD pipelines, transport governance, and release management across the landscape, with quality

gates enforced in the pipeline rather than in review meetings. 

Clean core custodianship

- Own the extensibility decision framework and act as approval authority for any classical modification or in-core

enhancement, with escalation rather than absorption when the standard is challenged. 

- Drive extensions to key-user and developer extensibility, side-by-side on BTP, and released SAP APIs and BAdIs. 
 - Own custom code lifecycle management: inventory, usage analytics, remediation, retirement, and continuous

reduction of the custom footprint. Custom code is a liability with a carrying cost, and you own the trend line. 

- Ensure the landscape stays upgrade-ready so RISE release cycles and innovation adoption remain routine. 

BTP platform ownership

- Own the BTP architecture and its services - Integration Suite, Build, Application Development (CAP/RAP), 

Event Mesh, Workflow, Business Rules, and Datasphere where relevant. 

- Establish BTP governance: subaccount and space design, entitlement management, identity and

authorization, DevOps tooling, and cost transparency by consumer. 

- Build the API and event layer that exposes core business capability safely to satellite applications, partners, 

and AI services. 

- Provide the technical foundation for AI and agent enablement - Joule extensibility, AI Core and AI Foundation

services, and integration patterns that are production-grade rather than demo-grade. 

Reusable assets and enablement

- Build and maintain the golden path: reference architectures, code templates, integration patterns, security

patterns, and shared services that teams consume rather than rebuild. 

- Support deployment waves through interface build, conversion support objects, performance tuning, and

hypercare defect resolution. 

- Partner with security on authorization design, SoD-safe development, and evidence generation through GRC. 
 - Manage system integrator and AMS partner engineering quality, staffing continuity, and adherence to Xylem standards. 

Required

Qualifications

- 15+ years in SAP technical development, with at least 5 years leading global engineering teams. 
 - Deep, current, hands-on ABAP expertise: ABAP for Cloud, RAP, CDS views, OData, AMDP, OO ABAP, and

performance optimization on HANA. You must still be able to read and judge code, not only manage people who write it. 

- Proven SAP BTP delivery: CAP or RAP applications, Integration Suite, Event Mesh, and BTP security and

identity models in production. 

- Demonstrated clean core implementation on S/4HANA, with a track record of reducing custom footprint rather

than simply documenting it. 

- Experience with SAP Fiori and UI5 development and extensibility. 
 - Strong command of ATC, custom code migration tooling, and code quality automation. 
 - Transport and release management at scale across multi-wave global deployments. 
 - Ability to hold an architectural line under business and partner pressure, with the credibility to explain the cost

of an exception in business terms. 

Preferred

- RISE with SAP private or public cloud experience. 
 - SAP Cloud ALM, Signavio, and Datasphere familiarity. 
 - AI and ML integration on BTP, including AI Core, AI Foundation, and Joule extensibility. 
 - Manufacturing or industrial sector complexity: variant configuration, service and installed-base processes plant-level integration. 
 - SAP certification in ABAP Cloud, BTP Developer, or BTP Architecture. 

Success in the First 12 Months

A published and enforced extensibility standard with a measurable reduction in in-core modifications. A BTP

landscape with governed entitlements, identity, DevOps, and cost transparency. A reusable asset library that

teams actually adopt. Transport and release cycles that are predictable and audit-clean. And an upgrade-ready

core, proven by a routine release adoption with no remediation program attached. 

Operating Principles You Will Work Under

- Products, not projects. Persistent teams aligned to value streams, funded by capacity rather than project

cycles, each paired with a business process owner accountable for the outcome. 

- Clean core is non-negotiable. Extensions live on BTP, the core stays standard, and custom code is

governed at the point of creation. 

- Paved road, not toll booth. Golden paths, reference architectures, and reusable patterns, with guardrails

enforced in the pipeline rather than in a design authority meeting. 

- Compliance by default. Controls are designed into the platform and evidenced automatically, so control

integrity holds at deployment scale. 

- Accountable for value, not volume. Success is measured in business process KPIs, adoption, and realized

value, not tickets closed or hours delivered. 

- Intelligent enterprise by design. AI and agent enablement, and the data readiness that makes both credible, 

are owned capabilities. 

- Global template authority, local execution. Template integrity is held centrally through the current

deployment horizon, with a defined path to greater product-team autonomy. 

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

Job Title: Director of Engineering

About The Role

Dash Technologies is a US-headquartered software services company building AI-first solutions for healthcare and enterprise clients. We are looking for a Director of Engineering who can lead both technical engineering excellence and delivery execution in a fast-paced services environment with deep fluency in the US healthcare ecosystem. 

This is the senior-most engineering and delivery role in the organization. It reports directly to the CEO, and the entire engineering and delivery organization approximately 30-40 team members (direct and indirect reports) reports into this role, including 5-10 US-based team members managed remotely from India. The role owns a portfolio of approximately 20 customers, of which five are blue-chip accounts requiring direct engagement with client CEOs and CIOs. The portfolio is approximately 70% US healthcare engagements and 30% other technology engagements. 

This role is a member of the company's leadership team and participates in all monthly and quarterly business reviews. This is not a 9-to-5 job it demands an always-on ownership mindset, with genuine care for customers and an unwavering commitment to delivery. 

This role is responsible for building AI-first engineering capabilities while ensuring high-quality, predictable delivery across multiple US client engagements. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineering leader with strong delivery discipline, proven US healthcare domain experience, and exceptional people and client management skills the ability to build genuine, lasting relationships with team members, clients, and senior client executives is mandatory for success in this role. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership

- 
 - Lead the entire engineering and delivery organization approximately 60 direct and indirect reports, including engineering managers, tech leads, and delivery teams
 - Directly manage 5-10 US-based team members from India, ensuring cohesion, accountability, and performance across geographies
 - Lead architecture, design, and development of scalable, secure, high-quality software systems
 - Establish and enforce engineering best practices across teams
 - Mentor engineering managers, tech leads, and senior developers
 - Ensure strong code quality, system performance, and reliability
Healthcare Domain Leadership

- 
 - Bring a working understanding of the US healthcare innovation value chain providers, payers, MedTech, digital health, and life sciences
 - Guide teams building on and integrating with EMR/EHR platforms or any strong compliance domain experience. 
AI & Innovation

-

 - Build reusable AI accelerators and frameworks to improve delivery efficiency
 - Enable teams to leverage AI-assisted development tools
 - Partner with leadership to define and execute AI-driven service offerings
Delivery Ownership

-

 - Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and escalations
Stakeholder & Relationship Management

-

 - Build strong client relationships and ensure high satisfaction
Resource Management

- 
 - Allocate and optimize engineering resources across projects
 - Ensure the right skills are aligned to the right work
 - Drive high utilization while supporting team growth and development
 - Partner with HR and leadership on hiring and capacity planning
 - Own hiring and establish a structured training and academy program to keep building a new pipeline of talent
Operational & Financial Excellence

- 
 - Own delivery metrics including velocity, quality, utilization, and timelines
 - Maintain a strong focus on delivery efficiency and project margins
 - Identify opportunities for process improvement and cost optimization
 - Support business growth through better delivery capability and client outcomes
Qualifications

- 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred)
 - 15-20 years of experience in software engineering and delivery management within a software services or product development environment
 - Demonstrated experience delivering software for US healthcare clients providers, payers, MedTech, or digital health companies
 - Strong understanding of the US healthcare innovation value chain, including EMR/EHR ecosystems, interoperability (HL7/FHIR), HIPAA/PHI compliance, and clinical and operational workflows
 - Proven track record of successfully managing multiple concurrent software projects for US-based clients
 - Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and AI-assisted development practices
 - Must already be a heavy, daily user of AI tools in their own work - hands-on, everyday AI use is expected from day one (mandatory)
 - Strong understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall)
 - Experience working with cross-functional teams including developers, QA, product management, and operations
 - Experience managing US-based team members remotely from India (mandatory)
 - Excellent leadership, team management, and interpersonal skills - proven ability to build and retain high-performing teams (mandatory)
 - Exceptional relationship-building and client management skills, including comfort engaging directly with C-level client executives (CEOs, CIOs) (mandatory)
 - Willingness and ability to travel to the US 2-3 times per year (valid passport required; US visa or visa eligibility strongly preferred)

-

 - Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills
 - Effective communication and stakeholder management
 - Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
 - Financial and budget management expertise
 - Risk management and conflict resolution
What Success Looks Like - Your First 12 Months

We have clear expectations for this role. Here is what we expect the first year to look like:

-

By 60 Days

-

By 90 Days

-

 - Define how to accelerate the innovation pipeline to produce more qualified leads, proofs of concept (POCs), and proofs of value (POVs), in closer alignment with the sales and marketing teams
By 12 Months

-

 - A bench maintained at approximately 15%, also used for innovation and POC/POV projects

 - Heavy, pervasive use of AI across the team every team member actively using AI in their daily work

You will partner closely with Architects, bringing deep implementation expertise to technical decisions while owning the detailed design, implementation, quality, and operational readiness of complex cloud services. 

You will work on shared platform capabilities such as repository and data services, workflow, search, APIs, and other foundational services used across multiple Esko products. You will remain deeply hands-on while mentoring engineers, solving complex technical problems, and raising engineering standards across the team. 

What You Will Do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable cloud foundation services used across multiple Esko products. 
 - Own the detailed technical design and implementation of complex capabilities, from requirements through production. 
 - Remain deeply hands-on, writing high-quality code and solving complex distributed systems and engineering problems. 
 - Partner with Architects to translate architectural direction into production software, providing implementation feedback and identifying technical trade-offs. 
 - Improve the reliability, performance, observability, testability, and maintainability of platform services. 
 - Lead code reviews, technical problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex production issues. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through automated testing, code quality, design practices, and operational readiness. 
 - Mentor engineers through hands-on collaboration, reviews, and technical guidance. 

Required Experience

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, cloud-native, or large-scale SaaS applications. 
 - Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java/JVM technologies and modern backend frameworks. 
 - Strong experience designing and building REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience translating architecture and high-level designs into detailed technical designs and production-quality implementations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify implementation trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive technical feedback during design discussions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, concurrency, consistency, availability, resiliency, and fault tolerance. 
 - Experience developing and operating scalable applications on AWS or another major cloud platform. 
 - Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and Amazon DynamoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, transactions, indexing, and performance optimization 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Experience diagnosing complex production problems using logs, metrics, distributed tracing, profiling, and performance analysis. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical decisions through design reviews, code reviews, and sound engineering judgment. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with Scala or other functional programming languages and functional programming concepts. 
 - Experience with Kafka, Redis, Akka, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or similar distributed technologies. 
 - Experience building shared cloud platforms or foundation services consumed by multiple products or engineering teams. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy or large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Experience establishing or improving engineering practices within a team or across related engineering teams. 

What Success Looks Like

- Architectural direction is translated into high-quality, scalable, production-ready implementations. 
 - Cloud platform services become more reliable, performant, observable, testable, and maintainable. 
 - Complex engineering problems are resolved with strong technical judgment and effective collaboration with Architects and other engineers. 
 - Engineers around you become more effective through mentoring, code reviews, and hands-on technical guidance. 
 - Engineering standards improve through stronger code quality, automated testing, operational readiness, and disciplined implementation. 
 - You become a trusted technical leader in your area, known for strong engineering judgment, hands-on technical depth, and consistently high-quality execution. 

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Persistent Disk Snapshot Team
data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8 years of experience programming in C++. 
 - 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products. 
 - 5 years of experience building and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage, or hardware architecture. 
 - 3 years of experience with software design and architecture. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. 
 - 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. 
 - 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. 
 - Deep proficiency in C++ with advanced expertise in multi-threaded programming, concurrency control, and low-level system optimizations. 
 - Extensive background in modern cloud storage infrastructure, disaster recovery (DR), data replication protocols, or block storage snapshot methodologies. 

About the jobGoogle's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. 

Persistent Disk (PD) Snapshot team delivers foundational data protection and disaster recovery solutions for Google Cloud's Persistent Disk (PD). We are responsible for PD Snapshots and Instant Snapshots-critical backup primitives ensuring business continuity for global enterprises. While standard PD Snapshots offer highly durable, geo-redundant storage in Google Cloud Storage (GCS), Instant Snapshots provide ultra-fast, in-place checkpoints for rapid recovery. Our mission is to build the most reliable, scalable, and high-performance data protection infrastructure in the cloud, helping customers seamlessly guard against data loss with minimal downtime. 

In this role, you will manage distributed storage and metadata challenges at exabyte scale, directly impacting the reliability and trustworthiness of Google Cloud Platform for millions of users worldwide. Google Cloud accelerates every organization's ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google's cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. 

Responsibilities

- Act as a critical technical leader setting the strategy, roadmap, and architectural direction for Google Cloud's backup and disaster recovery primitives. 
 - Be responsible for managing large, highly ambiguous problems where the path forward is unclear, reducing chaos, and building consensus across multiple cross-functional teams. 
 - Lead the evolution of PD Snapshots and Instant snapshots to support exponential growth, driving multi-quarter initiatives exabyte-scale data routing, metadata isolation, and zero-latency in-place backup mechanisms. 
 - Be a multiplier who advocates product excellence, drives system reliability, and mentors executive and junior engineers alike to achieve ambitious milestones at global scale. 
 - Align stakeholders, peer teams, and executive leaders across PD Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Product Manager (PM) on critical design and integration decisions. 

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.title: Software Dev Senior Engineer
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

  

  

CSE SRE - DBA Focus

Job Description

As a Software Dev Senior Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our Cloud-based services. You will define and enforce reliability standards, drive the adoption of SRE practices across engineering teams, and build the systems and tooling that keep our production infrastructure healthy. We follow a DevOps model: Development and Operations teams are integrated, and the SRE function acts as the reliability layer - setting Service Level Objectives, managing error alerts, and continuously reducing toil through engineering. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead on call response and triage - help design and lead the 24x7 response team for triage and rally engineering to address service degradation, facilitating process and communications along the way
 - Define, publish, and continuously refine Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all critical services, partnering with product and engineering leadership. 
 - Own the error management practices, including monitoring and alerting, and surfacing notable errors to the development team
 - Lead the design and implementation of comprehensive observability platforms - metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing - to ensure full visibility into production systems. 
 - Drive toil reduction initiatives by identifying and automating repetitive, manual operational work, targeting measurable reduction in operational burden across teams. 
 - Design and execute chaos engineering programs to proactively uncover reliability weaknesses in our infrastructure and services before they impact customers. 
 - Lead blameless postmortem culture: facilitate incident retrospectives, extract systemic learnings, and track corrective action items to completion. 
 - Build and improve on-call incident response processes, runbooks, and escalation paths; manage and optimize on-call rotation health to prevent burnout. 
 - Collaborate with platform and application developers to bring new features and services into production using production-readiness reviews and launch checklists. 
 - Champion reliability engineering best practices across the organization, embedding SRE principles into the software development lifecycle. 
 - Mentor team members on SRE philosophy, technical decision-making, code reviews, and cloud engineering best practices. 
 - Participate in roadmap planning, identify areas of improvement, and perform technology evaluation and selection. Required: 

- 5+ years of experience in database scaling performance and reliability, connection pool optimization
 - 5+ years of experience in database HA design and failover strategies
 - 3+ years of hands-on Site Reliability Engineering experience, including ownership of SLOs and error budget management. 
 - 4+ years of experience with Cloud Platforms, GCP CloudSQL required. 
 - Experience with database capacity planning, load testing, and performance benchmarking at scale. 
 - Experience managing other database systems - PostgreSQL, Redis, Etc . 
 - CS Degree or equivalent experience. Preferred: 

- Familiarity with Google SRE principles and the concepts outlined in the Google SRE Book
 - Understanding of the HTTP protocol and experience diagnosing distributed system latency issues. 
 - Experience with instrumentation and management of automated deployments. 
 - Experience resolving customer-facing production issues under time pressure. 
 - Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams
 - Experience in infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK)
 - Experience in scripting using Python, Shell, or a similar language. 
 - Experience with orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes. 
 - Understanding of networking, including routing, naming, security, network performance, and network failure modes. 
 - Experience designing and operating observability stacks (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or equivalent). 
 - Experience with incident management platforms and on-call tooling (e. g. , PagerDuty, OpsGenie).

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

data.description:
Job Description

Associate Platform Reliability Engineer (SRE)

Location: Mumbai / Pune

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Associate Platform Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our global Platform Reliability Engineering team. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of critical front-to-back platforms supporting post-trade processing. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong software engineering foundation, production support experience, and a passion for automation, observability, and reliability engineering. You will work closely with development, infrastructure, and business teams to improve system resilience, enhance operational visibility, reduce manual intervention, and deliver highly available services. 

Key Responsibilities

- Proactively monitor platform health and drive improvements in reliability, performance, availability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Perform incident triage, troubleshooting, communication, and post-incident reviews to minimize business impact and prevent recurrence. 
 - Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to design and implement scalable and resilient solutions. 
 - Build and enhance deployment and observability capabilities, including dashboards, alerts, and service health monitoring using Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry. 
 - Analyze logs, metrics, and distributed traces to proactively identify system bottlenecks and reliability issues. 
 - Support enterprise messaging and event-driven architectures, including Kafka-based platforms and integrations. 
 - Apply capacity planning and availability management best practices to improve platform resilience. 
 - Develop automation to reduce operational toil, minimize manual intervention, and improve service efficiency. 
 - Participate in production support, problem management, release management, and change management activities. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 
 - 3+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Reliability Engineering (PRE), DevOps, Production Support, or Application Support. 
 - Strong programming and scripting experience in one or more languages such as Python, Go, or Java. 
 - Solid understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and system design. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows Server environments. 
 - Experience with modern monitoring and observability practices and tooling. 
 - Strong understanding of observability and reliability concepts, including metrics, logs, traces, SLIs, SLOs, and alerting. 
 - Good understanding of event-driven architectures and enterprise messaging platforms such as Kafka and MQ. 
 - Experience troubleshooting distributed production systems, including APIs, middleware components, and message flows. 
 - Understanding incident management, problem management, root cause analysis, and operational support processes. 
 - Familiarity with source control, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and DevOps practices. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

Observability & Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry and Loki

DevOps & Automation: Git, Ansible and CI/CD Frameworks

Container & Platform Technologies: Docker, Kubernetes

As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.

As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

data.title: SRE Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

The selected SRE and DevOps professional will be responsible for maintaining highly available production systems, managing cloud infrastructure, improving observability, and supporting reliable deployment and operations practices. The role combines hands-on engineering with incident response, infrastructure automation, performance optimization, and continuous reliability improvement. 

The ideal candidate should have experience working in production-critical environments where system availability, quick incident resolution, effective monitoring, and preventive engineering are essential. 

Key Responsibilities1. Site Reliability and Production Operations

- Monitor production systems and maintain service availability, performance, and operational stability. 
 - Participate in production support and scheduled on-call rotations, including the resolution of critical incidents. 
 - Investigate system failures, perform root cause analysis, document post-incident findings, and implement preventive measures. 
 - Identify recurring operational issues and reduce manual intervention through automation. 
 - Improve service reliability using measurable indicators, service objectives, availability targets, and error-budget practices. 
 - Contribute to capacity planning, disaster recovery, high availability, redundancy, and failover strategies. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering
 - Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Work with cloud compute, storage, networking, access management, monitoring, and cloud-native services. 
 - Support containerized applications and manage Kubernetes-based infrastructure, including AKS, EKS, GKE, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Troubleshoot cluster health, application workloads, resource utilization, scaling, networking, and deployment-related issues. 
 - Work with Helm and other relevant deployment tools to maintain consistent application releases. 
 - Infrastructure Automation and DevOps
 - Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. 
 - Support automated infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and repeatable deployment processes. 
 - Work with Git-based development workflows, including GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and improve deployment reliability through automation. 
 - Develop scripts using Python and/or Bash to simplify operational activities and eliminate repetitive tasks. 
 - Monitoring, Observability and Performance
 - Build and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting solutions for production environments. 
 - Work with observability platforms such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Golden Signals(including Latency, errors, traffic, saturation), AWS CloudWatch, and GCP Cloud Monitoring. 
 - Apply the four Golden Signals-latency, traffic, errors, and saturation-to monitor service health and identify performance issues. 
 - Improve distributed tracing and establish meaningful alerts that reflect actual system health and user impact. 
 - Investigate performance bottlenecks across infrastructure, applications, networks, and distributed systems. 
 - Linux, Networking and Security
 - Troubleshoot Linux-based systems and production infrastructure issues. 
 - Apply networking fundamentals, including DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, SSL/TLS, and connectivity troubleshooting. 
 - Follow cloud security best practices for identity and access management, network segmentation, and secrets management. 
 - Support vulnerability remediation, security improvements, and compliance-related activities in collaboration with relevant teams. 

Technical Environment

The role involves cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Terraform, scripting, production support, monitoring, and modern reliability engineering practices. Experience with one major cloud platform is important, while exposure to multiple cloud environments can be beneficial. 

Additional exposure to Go (Golang), OpenSearch, ELK Stack, AI/ML production platforms, Azure AI services, AI Foundry, RAG-based workloads, and enterprise observability frameworks would be advantageous.

We're hiring on behalf of a global SaaS product company that is building its Site Reliability Engineering presence in India. This is the first SRE hire in India, with real ownership of production and a chance to shape the team as it grows. 

About the role

You'll join a global Platform Engineering team operating a multi-product, multi-region cloud platform. This is a production ownership role, not a ticket-based support role. You'll own the reliability, availability, and performance of SaaS products used by customers worldwide. 

What you'll do

- Improve and maintain the reliability and availability of SaaS products, and lead reliability projects
 - Lead incident response, restoring service quickly with sound, risk-aware decisions
 - Diagnose and resolve complex production issues across infrastructure, platform, and application runtime
 - Lead RCAs and blameless post-mortems, and follow actions through to completion
 - Define and implement SLIs/SLOs, with monitoring and alerting that is actionable
 - Reduce operational toil through automation and better system design, with measurable results
 - Partner with product engineering teams so software is observable and operable in production
 - Contribute to platform cost efficiency
 - Mentor engineers and raise engineering practice through pairing and code reviews
 - Participate in a globally shared, compensated on-call rotation, designed to minimise inconvenient hours

What we're looking for

- 6+ years in SRE, Platform, or Software Engineering roles
 - Hands-on production ownership of Kubernetes (AKS) cluster operations
 - Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-native/PaaS services
 - Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
 - Observability and alerting tools such as Datadog
 - CI/CD tooling such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Octopus Deploy
 - Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (Python, PowerShell, Bash, C#, Java, or TypeScript)
 - Experience with systems under high or unpredictable load
 - On-call and incident leadership experience
 - Background in product or SaaS companies, with end-to-end production ownership

Working model

- Hyderabad-based, primarily IST, with some overlap with Australia and UK teams
 - Reports into Platform Engineering leadership in Hyderabad, with global collaboration
