Position Overview

Job Title: Senior Engineer

Location: Pune, India

Corporate Title: AVP

Role Description

As a Senior Engineer in the Channel Security team, you will be a core individual contributor responsible for the hands-on development of our mission-critical platform. You will focus on writing high-quality, scalable code for the backend services that power our real-time channel security capabilities. You will work closely with the Lead Engineer to build, test, and deploy a resilient and performant system

Overview: 

- Corporate Banking is a technology centric business, with an increasing move to real-time processing, an increasing appetite from customers for integrated systems and access to supporting data. This means that technology is more important than ever for business. 
 - Deutsche Bank is one of the few banks with the scale and network to compete aggressively in this space, and the breadth of investment in this area is unmatched by our peers. Joining the team is a unique opportunity to help rebuild the core of some of our most mission critical processing systems from the ground-up. 
 - Our Corporate Bank Technology team is a global team across 30 countries. The primary businesses that we support within Corporate Bank are Cash Management, Securities Services, Trade Finance and Trust & Agency Services. CB Technology supports these businesses through 'vertical' CIO aligned teams and by 'horizontals' such as Client Connectivity, Surveillance and Regulatory, Infrastructure, Architecture, Production, and Risk & Control. 

What We'll Offer You

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you'll enjoy

- Best in class leave policy
 - Gender neutral parental leaves
 - 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
 - Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
 - Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
 - Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
 - Accident and Term life Insurance
 - Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality, scalable backend microservices for the Channel Security platform using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and related technologies. 
 - Partner with the Lead Engineer on solution design and participate actively in code reviews to ensure alignment with architectural principles and maintain high code quality standards. 
 - Implement robust integrations with internal and external systems. 
 - Champion a "shift-left" approach to quality by writing comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for all new features. 
 - Contribute to the operational health of the platform by participating in troubleshooting, and incident resolution as part of our "you build it, you run it" culture. 
 - Collaborate with the DevOps engineer to ensure services are observable, easy to deploy, and meet non-functional requirements for performance and reliability. 

Your Skills And Experience

- Strong, hands-on backend programming experience with the modern Java ecosystem (Java 17+, Spring Boot). 
 - Overall experience of 9-14 years in software engineering, with a strong focus on building robust, scalable banking systems. 
 - Hands-on Experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, or experimenting with LLMs/AI APIs to improve engineering productivity, testing, troubleshooting, or automation
 - Solid understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems principles. 
 - Practical experience with event-driven architecture and messaging systems, specifically Kafka. 
 - Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and an understanding of in-memory data stores/caches (Redis). 
 - A strong commitment to quality with hands-on experience in writing various levels of automated tests (unit, integration, E2E, BDD). 
 - Experience working in a cloud-native environment (GCP preferred) and familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development methodologies. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex issues across multiple services. 
 - A collaborative mindset with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a lean, focused engineering team. 

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. 

How We'll Support You

- Training and development to help you excel in your career
 - Coaching and support from experts in your team
 - A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
 - A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

About Us And Our Teams

Please visit our company website for further information: 

https: //www. db. com/company/company. html

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively. 

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group. 

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Silk Browser, Web Experiences
data.description:
Description

Interested in working on software used by millions of customers every day? Intrigued by the opportunity to contribute to one of the largest open source projects in the world? The Amazon Silk browser team is looking for a strong software development engineer to join our ranks. We are actively building new features using Alexa, machine learning, and other AWS technologies that re-shape the way customers browse, discover, and consume web content. 

We operate like a startup in a big company - our engineers work closely with product management and user experience designers to build best-in-class services and apps. Our engineers are owners who identify, define, and build solutions that delight millions of customers every day. We are building our organization based on smart people, diversity of perspective and experience, and looking for individuals with a "can-do" attitude who love to tackle hard problems. 

What You'll Do

- Be an integral part of an exceptionally talented team. Working in a fast paced environment with rapid feature delivery to our customers. 
 - Brainstorm, build and ship new and exciting features that revolutionize the way people browse the web. You have the opportunity to own a features/experiences from inception to delivery. 

This Team Is a Good Fit For You If

- You are sensitive to customer needs and interested in having a firsthand impact on Amazon's global customer base
 - You truly care about the business results of what you build, not just the elegance of the technology
 - You like to solve interesting technology problems
 - You enjoy collaborating in a diverse team environment
 - You are a passionate learner and motivated to take on new challenges. 
 - You want to have fun; surround yourself with a highly talented pool of engineers that like to solve complex problems, but also enjoy work life balance. 

Key job responsibilities

Design and deliver complex features for Silk browser and WebView across multimodal and TV devices, driving end-to-end ownership from architecture to launch. 

Lead Chromium upleveling and platform migrations, ensuring compatibility and performance across Fire OS and Vega OS platforms. 

Own build system improvements and release infrastructure to improve developer productivity and release velocity for the team. 

Drive operational excellence - including security patch releases, crash rate reduction, and production health monitoring across device families. 

Mentor and grow junior engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, design reviews, and knowledge sharing to raise the overall bar of the team. 

A day in the life

As a Senior SDE in the Silk Browser team, you will dive deep into Chromium internals to solve complex rendering and performance challenges across Fire TV and multimodal devices, collaborate with product, design, and platform teams to understand customer needs and unblock cross-functional dependencies, and architect scalable solutions that work across multiple device families and OS versions. You'll spend time reviewing code from teammates, driving technical decisions that balance long-term code health with near-term delivery, and shipping features that reach millions of users. You'll have the autonomy to identify problems, propose solutions, and see your work deployed to real customers in a fast-paced environment that values both rapid iteration and thoughtful engineering. 

About The Team

Silk is Amazon's Chromium-based web browser built for Fire TV and multimodal devices, optimized for the unique constraints of embedded environments to deliver fast, reliable web experiences on television screens and Echo Show devices. Our team owns feature development, performance optimization, and seamless integration with Amazon's device ecosystem, working closely with product managers, and partner teams to build solutions that delight millions of customers. We foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives strengthen our work, invest in each other's growth through mentorship, and believe that balancing professional achievement with personal fulfillment leads to our best engineering. 

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 8+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
 - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred Qualifications

- 8+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
 - Experience with AI/ML technologies
 - Experience with Chromium Browser technology

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

About Salesdock

Salesdock is a young, fast-growing company that delivers sales & CRM SaaS software to big brands in Europe, with its headquarters in The Netherlands. We are expanding our team and are looking for a senior PHP Developer for our office in Perinthalmanna, Kerala, India. 

About the Role & You

Our ideal candidate (you!) is a skilled senior PHP Developer with at least 5 years of experience in web development. You love well-structured code and know how to build fast, flawless, and maintainable backend systems. 

What you bring to the table: 

- At least 5 years of web development experience. 
 - Serious PHP and/or Laravel skills in your toolbelt. 
 - An eye for detail and a passion for creating robust and secure backend solutions. 
 - Excellent English skills (both written and spoken), as we are an international company. 

What We Offer

Are you looking for a new adventure with possibilities to develop yourself, attend Laravel conferences, and enjoy a great working atmosphere? Here is what you can expect: 

- A modern office in Perinthalmanna. 
 - Your own MacBook Pro and a lot of responsibility. 
 - Hybrid working: working from home 1 or 2 days a week is no problem. 
 - An excellent salary and 30 holidays a year. 
 - A lot of freedom to develop yourself and grow with the company. 

How to Apply & Stand Out

We are lucky to receive many applications, but the ones that truly stand out to us always have a personal touch. At Salesdock, we value authenticity and a real connection. That is why we ask you to submit a personally written motivation letter alongside your resume. 

We are looking for your actual voice, so please write it yourself. Skip the generic templates or AI-generated texts (we can spot them, and they don't tell us who you really are!). Just tell us in your own words what drives you, what you are passionate about in PHP development, and why you would be a great fit for our team. Applications without a personal motivation letter will not be processed. 

We can't wait to read your story!

About the Job

Job Title : Specialist Engineering - (A2)

Location: Onsite

Role Summary

The Specialist Engineering is a hands-on experience in engineering role responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining features within the Tripmatik SaaS platform, which serves Destination Management Companies (DMCs) and travel businesses. 

Reporting to the Process Lead, the Specialist Engineering works closely with Senior Engineers, Business Analysts, Engineers, and other team members to deliver new features, product enhancements, bug fixes, and integrations. 

The role requires strong technical skills in Python (FastAPI), Angular, and PostgreSQL, along with an understanding of Engineering practices, API integrations, and multi-tenant SaaS applications. 

The Specialist Engineering is expected to take ownership of assigned development tasks, follow established engineering standards, and actively use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, code quality, and problem-solving. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Application Development & Maintenance

- Develop, enhance, and maintain application features using Python (FastAPI), Angular, and PostgreSQL. 
 - Implement frontend components, backend services, and database operations based on approved requirements. 
 - Develop REST APIs and integrate frontend components with backend services. 
 - Understand existing application architecture and ensure new development aligns with established design patterns. 
 - Maintain reusable, readable, and maintainable code following coding standards. 
 - Investigate and resolve application defects, performance issues, and production bugs. 
 - Participate in application refactoring and technical improvement initiatives. 
 - Ensure application changes do not negatively impact existing functionality. 

Database & API Development

 - Work with PostgreSQL to manage application data and optimize query performance. 
 - Develop and maintain internal and external REST API integrations. 
 - Implement appropriate validations, error handling, and logging. 
 - Follow secure coding practices for authentication, authorization, and data access. 
 - Ensure tenant-specific data isolation within the multi-tenant SaaS architecture. 

Testing & Code Quality

 - Write and maintain automated tests where applicable. 
 - Identify edge cases and ensure appropriate error handling. 
 - Resolve defects identified during engineering, staging, and production testing. 
 - Participate in code reviews and address review feedback.

Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in software, data or AI/ML engineering, with strong Python capability and hands-on experience building production-grade agentic or LLM applications for real users using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, tool calling and retrieval.

 - Practical experience implementing model-safety controls and adversarial testing, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, data leakage, filtering, redaction, guardrails, spend limits and loop controls. 
 - Experience accessing and deploying models across multiple providers, understanding cost, latency and capability trade-offs, and working with self-hosted or open-weight models, fine-tuning, distillation or prompt optimisation. 
 - Consulting or client-facing delivery experience, including the ability to work with non-technical subject-matter experts to define correct outcomes and translate their judgement into maintained benchmark datasets. 
 - Hands-on OpenTelemetry instrumentation for nested, multi-step agents, including tool-call spans, session and conversation tracing, trace-context propagation across asynchronous workers and queues, and correlation IDs through background processing. 
 - Experience with LLM observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights & Biases Weave; integration with platforms such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Grafana or Datadog; and structured telemetry for token usage, latency and cost by request, application and tenant.

data.title: Member of Technical Staff,  (Bangalore, In-Person)
data.description:
Read This First

We work with unusual intensity: in-person in Bangalore, six days a week, long days, most weekends. That's how we've chosen to build, because in our market speed decides who wins. We say this up front because we want people who feel pulled in, not talked into it. If you want a 9-to-5 (no judgment), this isn't your role. 

What You Get In Exchange

- Top-of-market cash. Extraordinary hours deserve more than an average salary. 
 - Meaningful equity. Significant grants, employee-friendly terms, and liquidity opportunities as we raise. 
 - No commute tax. Support to live near the office, plus dinner there every night. 
 - Founders in the trenches. We work the same schedule we ask of you. 
 - A decade of growth in two years. You'll ship more and own more than anywhere else. 

About Cekura

Cekura (YC F24) builds evals and improvement for voice AI, covering both voice agents and the speech-to-speech models behind them. 

- Voice agents. Teams test before launch, monitor production calls, and improve continuously. When something fails, Cekura reproduces it in simulation, fixes it, tests the fix, and raises a PR. The platform covers simulation, LLM evaluation, red-teaming, drift monitoring, and benchmarking across Vapi, Retell, Pipecat, LiveKit, ElevenLabs and more. 
 - Speech-to-speech models. We give labs benchmarks, data, and RL environments to improve turn-taking, interruptions, naturalness, and tool use in live conversations. 

Customers include Five9, HighLevel, Twin Health, PwC, Deloitte, Jobber, and Jotform. HIPAA, SOC 2, and GDPR are defaults. We're growing fast and backed by top investors. 

About The Role

You'll build the core of Cekura: simulation engines, evaluation systems, benchmarks, RL environments, self-improvement loops, and observability pipelines. We don't split "software engineer" from "AI engineer. " The best problems sit where real-time voice infrastructure, LLM evaluation, RL training, and speech analysis meet. 

What You'll Do

- Simulation engine. Simulate thousands of realistic conversations across voice, chat, and phone, with control over personas, interruptions, noise, and edge cases. 
 - Agent evaluation. Build LLM evaluators, metrics, red-teaming, drift detection, and the autonomous loop that detects, reproduces, fixes, tests, and ships a PR. 
 - Speech-to-speech research. Work with labs to find where models fall short of human conversation, then build the benchmarks, datasets, reward signals, and RL environments that close the gap. 
 - Applied audio. Turn the paralinguistic layer (emotion, tone, silences, hesitations, overlaps) into structured signals, so models are judged on how things are said, not just what. 
 - Real-time voice infra. SIP, WebRTC, STT/TTS, Twilio, Vapi, Retell, LiveKit, Pipecat. Latency and barge-in are first-class problems. 
 - Ship end-to-end and shape the team. Own what you build from design to production, and set the standards a growing team inherits. 

About You

- A strong generalist who wants to work across systems and AI, not stay in one lane. 
 - A strong coder in Python, TypeScript, or Go, with experience in distributed systems, real-time infra, LLM products, or model training and evaluation. 
 - You've run production systems and care about reliability, latency, and correctness. 
 - Sharp instincts about where LLMs and speech models fail, and how to build reliable systems on them. 
 - You like ambiguity, move fast, communicate clearly, and raise the bar around you. 
 - You read the first section twice and you're still here. 
 - Bonus: ex-founder or aspiring one. 

Nice to Have

- LLM evals, agent frameworks, or AI observability. 
 - Voice AI stack experience (Twilio, SIP, WebRTC, Vapi, Retell, LiveKit, Pipecat, STT/TTS). 
 - RL for language or speech models, benchmark building, or speech-to-speech models. 
 - Early-stage startup experience or open-source work. 

This Is Not for You If

- You want a narrow role, a fixed stack, or to work only on models or only on infra. 
 - You need rigid process or heavy structure. 
 - You're optimizing for work-life balance right now. 
 - You don't want to work in-person in Bangalore. 

Why Cekura

- The hardest problems in voice AI, worked on alongside the labs building the models. 
 - A 12-person engineering team post-seed: early enough to matter, funded enough to move fast. 
 - Direct work with founders and a highly technical team. 
 - Top-of-market pay, meaningful equity, all meals at the office, and relocation support.

data.title: Sr. Tech Lead, Prod Dev (RAN, AI-Assisted RCA, Design & Development)
data.description:
Parallel Wireless is transforming its Feature-Validation & Stability organization into a single Prod-Dev team - in the AI era there is no longer a separate "development" vs "validation" team. We are building a group of strong System Engineers who own a problem end to end: understand the complete product behavior, find the actual root cause, and contribute directly to the fix - accelerated by Claude / AI-assisted engineering. 

This is a pro-development, system-level problem-solving role. You will take a field or test issue and drive it the whole way: 

Issue → Reproduction → Cross-layer analysis → RCA → Code investigation → Fix → Validation

You will not stop at "which component failed. " You will name the root cause, prove it, and fix it. 

What You Will Do

- Deep, cross-layer RCA on field and lab issues that span multiple modules, correlating evidence across the full stack: 

→ UE logs

- PHY logs
 - DU / MAC / SCH logs
 - CU / L3 logs
 - Core logs
 - Platform logs
 - RRH logs
 - System logs
 - field issues across EMS / system monitoring. 
 - Reproduce field/customer issues in the lab on production-like (Friendly-Operator) setups. 
 - Investigate code and deliver bug fixes - own the fix through to validation, not just the analysis note. 
 - Field-issue investigation with direct customer / field involvement; feed learnings back into design, regression and stability. 
 - Feature development driven by design/framework gaps and customer-driven requirements. 
 - Use AI tools (Claude / AI-assisted engineering) to accelerate code understanding, log analysis, debugging, correlation and RCA - especially on multi-module problems. 
 - Identify scenarios, improve monitoring/validation coverage, and raise the quality bar before issues reach the field. 

What We Are Looking For

Must-have

- Strong software engineering in C / C++ (and Python for tooling/automation) with the ability to read and fix production RAN stack code. 
 - Solid wireless/telecom system understanding across 2G / 4G LTE / 5G NSA / SA - RRC, S1AP/NGAP, X2/Xn, PDCP/RLC/MAC scheduling, PHY/FAPI, GTP-U, and the core/platform interfaces. 
 - Proven debugging & RCA skills: coredumps/gdb, log/PCAP analysis, memory/crash triage, KPI/counter reasoning. 
 - A system mindset - comfortable reasoning across UE ↔ RAN ↔ Core ↔ Platform ↔ EMS rather than a single layer. 
 - Willingness and aptitude to work with AI tools as a daily engineering accelerator. 
 - Ownership attitude: drives Issue → Fix → Validation to closure. 
 - Good to have
 - O-RAN / disaggregated CU-DU, fronthaul (split 7. 2), PTP/timing, IPsec/transport exposure. 
 - Experience with EMS / OSS, Kibana/KPI monitoring, PM counters. 
 - Prior field / customer-facing deployment or NPI experience. 
 - Scrum / Agile delivery experience

Addional details

What Success Looks Like

You turn an opaque field escape into a named, proven root cause and a merged fix. 

Your RCA is accurate - the cause you name is the one the fix confirms (evidence-cited, instrumented, graded). 

You reduce field escapes and the RCA load on the core development team. 

You grow into a complete-product System Engineer who can design, reproduce, debug and fix across any layer. 

Why join

You will work at the center of PW's Prod-Dev transformation - a "Friendly customer in the lab" operating model - using cutting-edge AI-assisted engineering to solve real, multi-layer telecom problems end to end, with direct customer impact and genuine system ownership. 

Academic Qualification

Relevant Degree in Bachelor of Engineering in computer science, Electronics , Information Technology or relevant field from reputed college/ University

Job Description

The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e. g. , Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm's compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm's liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc. ; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering's 2, 000+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units: 

- Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm's risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
 - The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
 - Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm's financials and a wide range of reporting functions
 - Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
 - Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
 - Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

Summary

The Core Engineering Shared Services AI team operates as an internal forward-deployed AI engineering function, embedding with The Core business teams to identify priority workflows, prototype agentic AI solutions, and productionize cloud-native applications that deliver measurable business impact. This hands-on role combines client-facing problem discovery, rapid engineering execution, production AI architecture, and structured transition to receiving teams that will operate and extend the solutions over time. 

As an AI Application Engineer, you will work directly with internal business and engineering partners to convert ambiguous operating problems into secure, reliable AI products. You will define where agents should act, where they should assist, and where human approval or control gates are required, then design and deliver solutions that are adopted in real workflows and can be supported in production. 

Key Responsibilities

- Rapid Prototyping & Application Delivery: Lead the design, build, deployment, and operationalization of cloud-native AI applications, using modern software engineering practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing to accelerate reliable delivery. 
 - Business Partnership & Solution Architecture: Partner with business and engineering teams to identify high-impact AI opportunities, translate requirements into cloud-optimized architectures, and define scalable data models and technical specifications. 
 - Forward-Deployed AI Engineering: Embed with The Core business teams to map workflows, identify pain points, assess agentic automation opportunities, define control and approval boundaries, iterate with users, and drive adoption through pilots, feedback loops, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Production AI/ML Integration: Build AI applications using LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, prompt and context management, structured outputs, response validation, and evaluation harnesses required for production use. 
 - Cloud, DevOps & MLOps Execution: Apply cloud-native services, secure deployment patterns, observability, lifecycle management, and MLOps practices to ensure applications are scalable, resilient, cost-aware, and supportable. 
 - Knowledge Transfer & Enablement: Document solutions, mentor receiving teams, and support clean transition of application code, integration patterns, data models, and operational practices into long-term engineering ownership. 

Qualifications

- Must have: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field. 
 - Must have: 9+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building, deploying, and supporting robust production applications. 
 - Must have: Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Go, with demonstrated ability to apply sound software engineering, testing, data modelling, and system design practices. 
 - Must have: Proven experience translating complex business requirements into cloud-optimized application architectures, scalable data models, and technical specifications for production delivery. 
 - Must have: Experience operating in a forward-deployed or internal client-facing engineering model, including workflow discovery, stakeholder engagement, rapid prototyping, solution shaping, pilot execution, adoption measurement, and production handoff to receiving teams. 
 - Must have: Extensive experience with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including serverless, containerization, managed services, automated deployment, monitoring, and cloud security standards. 
 - Must have: Experience designing cloud-based AI solution architectures that integrate managed AI services, LLM providers, retrieval and vector search, secure data access, API gateways, event-driven workflows, identity and entitlement controls, observability, deployment automation, and cost and resilience trade-offs across AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Must have: Demonstrated experience integrating LLM or AI/ML capabilities into production applications, including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases or search indexes, prompt templates, context assembly, structured outputs, response validation, evaluation datasets, and model performance monitoring. 
 - Must have: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders, lead cross-functional delivery, and enable receiving teams through documentation, mentoring, and knowledge transfer. 
 - Preferred: Experience building agentic AI systems that decompose tasks, plan multi-step workflows, call approved tools or APIs, maintain state, enforce permission and policy checks, handle failure paths, and produce auditable action trails. 
 - Preferred: Experience implementing agent observability and controls, including trace capture, prompt and tool-call logging, hallucination and policy-violation checks, human-in-the-loop approvals, incident handoff, and post-action summarization. 
 - Preferred: Experience optimizing production AI systems through model selection and routing, prompt compression, retrieval tuning, caching, batching, streaming responses, asynchronous execution, parallel tool calls, latency budgets, cost controls, and quality regression testing.

Job Title: Lead Hardware Engineer

Location: Bangalore, India

Business: Honeywell Aerospace

Role Overview

Honeywell Aerospace is seeking a Lead Hardware Engineer with strong experience in avionics-based product development to lead the end-to-end design and integration of advanced analog / power electronics systems. This role supports aerospace and urban air mobility programs and demands deep technical expertise, systems-level thinking, and leadership capability. The successful candidate will mentor engineering teams, resolve complex technical challenges, and work closely with global stakeholders to deliver high-quality, compliant products across the full development lifecycle. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end development and system integration of advanced power electronics hardware for aerospace and urban air mobility applications. 
 - Define hardware specifications and requirements, ensuring alignment with system, customer, and regulatory needs. 
 - Drive system-level design decisions, addressing complex challenges such as thermal management, EMI/EMC, functional safety, and high-reliability operation. 
 - Conduct hardware and system design reviews with a strong focus on integration, scalability, reuse strategy, DFX considerations, and computing architecture development. 
 - Own and ensure execution of development and verification plans, including electrical, functional, and environmental compliance per DO-160 standards. 
 - Validate design concepts through circuit simulation, prototyping, laboratory testing, and analysis. 
 - Ensure program milestones are met by working closely with project engineers and cross-functional teams. 
 - Support product and module development activities, including trade studies, requirements development, detailed design, analysis, and lab-based testing. 
 - Collaborate with global, multi-disciplinary teams spanning systems, software, programmable logic, and mechanical engineering.

Qualifications

Desired Qualifications and Skills

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or Power Electronics. 
 - 15+ years of hardware engineering experience, with significant exposure to avionics and power electronics product development. 
 - Strong understanding of closed-loop control systems for power converters, including compensator design. 
 - Solid system-level design expertise, with the ability to manage complex interactions across hardware, software, and mechanical domains. 
 - Track record of leading and managing multiple power electronics projects involving analog, digital, and control circuitry. 
 - Experience in EMI/EMC design, including filter design and grounding schema. 
 - Proficiency with Siemens EDA / Mentor Graphics (Xpedition Enterprise Design Flow or equivalent), LT-Spice, Mathcad, and MS Excel.

 - Experience with product-level analog and linear circuit design, including signal conditioning (preferred).

 - Strong knowledge of component selection, derating, and system integration in safety-critical environments. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams. 
 - A results-oriented team player who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is motivated to lead and grow a team of power electronics engineers.

data.title: Senior Technical Consultant – Shift Lead (Power Platform Tenant Migration)
data.description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world's leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people-Kyndryls-that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. 

The Role

The Role: 

As the Power Platform Factory Shift Lead, you will be the on‐shift senior SME accountable for delivering tenant‐to‐tenant Power Platform migrations at enterprise scale, while maintaining strict operational and solution governance. Power Platform tenant‐to‐tenant migration is not "lift and shift"; it requires controlled preparation (solutions, flows, mappings), disciplined execution and careful post‐migration reconfiguration and validation. You will lead engineers through repeatable runbooks to migrate environments and associated assets (Power Apps, Power Automate, connection references and related components), ensuring quality gates, evidence capture and predictable throughput across the 24x7 factory model. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead on‐shift technical delivery for Power Platform tenant‐to‐tenant migrations, ensuring runbook adherence and stable throughput. 
 - Enforce governance and readiness controls: solution packaging standards, dependency checks, environment strategy, identity/connection mapping pre‐reqs. 
 - Coordinate execution steps for tenant‐to‐tenant moves (where applicable) and ensure pre/post actions are completed (export/import, re‐auth connections, enabling flows, updating endpoints). 
 - Own defect triage (broken connections, missing references, permissions/roles, environment settings mismatches, selectively unsupported components) and drive closure. 
 - Coordinate with Entra Apps/Identity disciplines to ensure authentication, app registrations and connector identity prerequisites are in place for successful cutover. 
 - Produce shift‐level status and evidence packs: migration logs, run results, exception register and sign‐off artefacts. 
 - Own shift backlog in the ticketing system; prioritise work to align with cutover schedule and downstream dependencies. 
 - Ensure robust shift handovers with actionable detail and no loss of continuity across the three‐shift model. 
 - Improve runbooks continuously: incorporate learnings, reduce rework and standardise fixes into repeatable operational steps. 
 - Escalate product/tool issues with full diagnostic evidence and clear impact statements. 

Who You Are

Must‐Have (or equivalent experience): 

- Delivered at least one production tenant‐to‐tenant Power Platform migration in a lead/Sr SME capacity, within an enterprise governance context. 
 - Strong hands‐on expertise in Power Platform administration: environments, Dataverse awareness, solution lifecycle, security roles and operational control. 
 - Strong experience with migration mechanics: exporting/importing solutions/apps, moving flows into solutions where required, managing connection references and post‐migration reconfiguration. 
 - Ability to manage runbook‐driven execution in a high‐volume delivery model with quality gates and evidence capture. 
 - Strong troubleshooting capability across Power Apps/Power Automate failures arising from identity/connectors/permissions/environment configuration. 
 - Comfortable leading delivery within a 24x7 three‐shift factory model, including formal handovers and shift reporting. 

Good‐to‐Have: 

- Experience with ALM patterns: source control, pipelines, deployment best practices, environment strategies. 
 - Relevant Microsoft certifications (examples: PL‐200, PL‐400, PL‐600) or equivalent experience. 
 - Exposure to integration patterns (APIs, Azure functions, service principals) and the impact of tenant change on those dependencies. 
 - Familiarity with third‐party tooling that supports Power Platform migration and validation when used in enterprise programmes. 
 - Experience migrating Power Pages / Copilot Studio components where in scope. 

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills: 

- Balances pace with governance: drives throughput without compromising design controls and compliance standards. 
 - Speaks "risk and impact" clearly to programme stakeholders; avoids ambiguous status. 
 - Coaches engineers into consistent delivery habits (templates, checklists, evidence discipline). 
 - Strong dependency management across disciplines: proactively clears identity/app prerequisites. 
 - Handles cutover pressure calmly; creates order from complexity during wave execution. 
 - Operates with a consulting mindset: proposes practical options, makes trade‐offs explicit and documents decisions. 

Typical Deliverables / KPIs: 

- Throughput: environments/assets migrated per shift vs plan. 
 - Defect rate: post‐migration failures per wave (connections, flows, app load issues) and reduction trend. 
 - MTTR: resolution time for migration‐blocking Power Platform defects. 
 - Evidence capture: completeness of run logs, mapping artefacts and sign‐off proof per wave. 
 - SLA: on‐time cutover completion and timely escalation of blockers. 

Shift / Working Pattern Notes: 

- This role operates within a three‐shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility. 

Being You

The "Kyn" in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we're excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging - being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team - is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That's The Kyndryl Way. 

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn't just a job-it's an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health-because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 

From your very first day, you'll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won't just contribute-you'll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. 

We're here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you'll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You'll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities-from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you'll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 

We want you to thrive here-and we're committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what's next. 

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked 'How Did You Hear About Us' during the application process, select 'Employee Referral' and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

data.title: Manager - MLOps
data.description:
About Sirius AI

Sirius AI is a US-headquartered AI consulting and products company with operations in India. We work with financial services organisations across geographies to solve business problems using data, AI and technology. Our teams combine consulting, industry, product and engineering expertise to build practical solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a Manager - ML Ops to lead the design, development and operation of reliable, scalable and production ready machine learning platforms and workflows. The role will work closely with data scientists, AI engineers, software engineers and client stakeholders to take models from experimentation to production and ensure they remain reliable, efficient, secure and well monitored. 

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in MLOps and cloud-native engineering, understands the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, and can lead a team while remaining hands-on in architecture, implementation and technical problem solving. Exposure to LLMOps and the deployment of Generative AI applications will be an advantage. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development and implementation of end-to-end MLOps platforms, processes and deployment pipelines for machine learning solutions. 
 - Build and manage automated workflows for model training, testing, validation, packaging, deployment, versioning and rollback. 
 - Establish CI/CD and CT pipelines for ML systems, enabling repeatable releases across development, staging and production environments. 
 - Deploy and operate models at scale using containerization and orchestration technologies; ensure availability, performance, scalability and reliability. 
 - Set up monitoring for model performance, data quality, model drift, service health, latency and resource utilization, and drive timely remediation. 
 - Partner with data science and AI teams to productions models, improve experimentation-to-production workflows and establish reusable engineering standards. 
 - Build and maintain feature pipelines, data and model registries, metadata tracking, experiment tracking, and model lifecycle management capabilities. 
 - Drive cloud infrastructure and platform practices across environments, with a focus on security, access control, cost optimization and operational resilience. 
 - Define and implement best practices for infrastructure such as code, observability, logging, alerting, incident management, and disaster recovery. 
 - Evaluate and adopt relevant tools, frameworks and architectural patterns to improve the MLOps ecosystem and developer productivity. 
 - Support production deployments of Generative AI and LLM-based applications, including model serving, evaluation, monitoring, prompt/version management and operational controls, where applicable. 
 - Lead, mentor and develop a team of ML Ops and platform engineers; set technical direction, review designs and code, and contribute to hiring. 
 - Work with client and internal stakeholders to understand requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and ensure successful delivery of engagements. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering or a related technical field. 
 - 4-8 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, ML engineering or MLOps, with substantial hands-on experience in productionising machine learning systems. 
 - Strong understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including data preparation, experimentation, training, validation, deployment, monitoring and retraining. 
 - Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation, Develop scalable ML pipelines. 
 - Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry, Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML EZE Paas/Saas
 - Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components. 
 - Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem
 - Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated ML workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Kubeflow or similar. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP and their ML and infrastructure services. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes, including deploying, scaling and managing containerised workloads. 
 - Experience with model serving and lifecycle tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, KServe, Seldon or equivalent platforms. 
 - Proficiency in Python and familiarity with SQL, APIs and software engineering practices such as version control, testing, code reviews and documentation. 
 - Understanding of monitoring and observability tools and practices for applications, infrastructure, data pipelines and deployed models. 
 - Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Helm or Ansible. 
 - Good understanding of security, networking, access management and cost optimisation in cloud-based production environments. 
 - At least 2 years of experience leading or mentoring engineers, managing delivery and coordinating with cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and manage stakeholder expectations. 

Good to Have

- Experience with LLMOps and production deployment of Generative AI applications, including LLM serving, evaluation, observability and performance optimisation. 
 - Exposure to vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and orchestration frameworks used in GenAI applications. 
 - Experience with feature stores, data orchestration and streaming technologies such as Feast, Airflow, Kafka or Flink. 
 - Experience working with financial services, banking, fintech or other regulated environments. 
 - Exposure to model governance, auditability, explainability and model risk management requirements. 
 - Relevant cloud, Kubernetes or MLOps certifications. 

Role Expectations

- Ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with team leadership and delivery ownership. 
 - Comfort working in a consulting and product-oriented environment with multiple stakeholders and evolving requirements. 
 - Willingness to take ownership of platform reliability and production outcomes, not just initial deployment.

We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today's complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. 

Job Description

In HPE Hybrid Cloud, we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Join us redefine what's next for you. 

Zerto drives the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for cutting-edge solutions in data lifecycle management, cyber resilience, replication, ransomware recovery, and seamless migrations. Our mission is to empower businesses with advanced hybrid cloud technologies that ensure data resilience, business continuity, and operational efficiency. With a focus on delivering state-of-the-art solutions, Zerto helps organizations protect, manage, and optimize their data across its entire lifecycle while maintaining robust defenses against evolving cyber threats. By working with customers, we help them reimagine their disaster recovery and data protection strategies, ensuring they achieve their business goals with confidence. Join us to redefine what's next in the hybrid cloud, data protection, and cyber resilience-and for yourself. 

What You'll Do

Roles and Responsibilities

- Be part of a dynamic and growing engineering group working in SCRUM, contributing to the design and evolution of our future products. 
 - Contribute to product architecture and design scalable, high-performing, and testable solutions to meet current and future requirements. 
 - Bring new ideas and drive innovation across both customer solutions and the software development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to share ideas and deliver high-quality solutions for our customers. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and software systems using C# and . NET/. NET Core technologies. 
 - Leverage AI throughout the software development lifecycle, including research, design, coding, code reviews, environment provisioning, deployment, and troubleshooting, to improve developer productivity, code quality, and engineering efficiency, using tools such as GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, Atlassian Rovo, MCP servers, or similar platforms. 
 - Collaborate with virtualization and infrastructure teams to develop and support solutions running on VMware and KVM platforms. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve application, deployment, and environment-related issues across Linux-based systems. 
 - Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry best practices across . NET, virtualization, Storage, Networking , Linux, and AI-assisted software development. 
 - Perform code reviews, debugging, and unit testing, and contribute to automation and quality initiatives. 
 - Analyze performance bottlenecks and recommend improvements to enhance scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and flexibility in driving technical deliverables and project responsibilities. 

What You Need To Bring

Knowledge and Skills

- Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) fundamentals, with experience developing and maintaining mature, large-scale backend systems using one or more modern programming languages such as C#, C++, and Java. 
 - Experience leveraging AI-assisted development and debugging tools such as GitHub Copilot, LLMs, or similar tools for code generation, debugging, testing, code review, and developer productivity. 
 - Excellent software design and architectural capabilities, with a passion for clean code and a good understanding of designing and integrating complex software systems across multiple platforms, with a focus on modularity, scalability, security, and maintainability.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - Accounting Integrations
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT-payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more-in one unified workforce platform. 

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees' payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps-like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Bedrock, and Greenoaks-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes (#12 out of 500)

About The Team

At Rippling, the Accounting Integrations team sits at the critical intersection of product innovation and financial infrastructure. Our mission is to empower finance teams to move from traditional month-end closes to real-time accounting by seamlessly connecting Rippling's platform with the world's most widely-used ERP systems including NetSuite, QuickBooks, and soon Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle, and more. 

We build robust, bi-directional integrations that serve both Rippling's internal products (like Payroll, Spend Management, Procurement, and Travel) and external ERPs used by our customers. These integrations power complex accounting workflows such as journal syncing, reconciliation, audit readiness, and more, enabling our customers to automate the most repetitive and error-prone financial operations. 

As Rippling expands globally and moves upmarket to serve large enterprises, the Accounting Integrations team is at the forefront of unlocking key use cases and supporting new geographies, integrations, and accounting standards. This team also operates in a high-velocity, continuous delivery environment, tackling a wide surface area of capabilities, systems, and support scenarios. 

If you're excited by systems design, love working across product boundaries, and want to build foundational infrastructure that finance teams depend on, the Accounting Integrations team is the place to be. 

About The Role

Rippling is building the future of accounting and we're looking for a Staff Engineer to help make that vision a reality. 

In this high-impact role, you'll be at the center of transforming Rippling's global accounting system leveraging AI-driven solutions and modern engineering practices to unify and scale accounting operations across multiple countries. 

This is a rare opportunity to influence the architecture and design of one of Rippling's core product pillars from the ground up. You'll lead initiatives that span the entire development lifecycle, from defining and scoping new product functionality to rearchitecting critical systems for scale, accuracy, and performance. Whether it's optimizing for complex, multi-country edge cases or introducing AI/ML-based solutions for intelligent data transformation, your work will directly shape the infrastructure powering one of Rippling's largest and fastest-growing markets. 

As a Staff Engineer, you'll be more than just a technical expert. You'll be a thought partner to product, a mentor to engineers, and a strategic voice in shaping Rippling's next billion-dollar vertical. You'll collaborate closely with some of the most talented engineers in the company, working in a fast-moving environment where innovation, autonomy, and ownership are the norm. 

At Rippling, engineers at the Staff level are deeply embedded in product direction. You'll engage directly with users, contribute to go-to-market strategies, and become an expert in the domain. As an early member of this team, you'll also play a vital role in building team culture, process, and technical vision as we scale. 

What You Will Do

- Design and build scalable, data-driven systems that transform, normalize, and reconcile accounting integration across multiple countries, entities, and currencies. 
 - Drive platform evolution by re-architecting critical systems for scalability, reliability, and internationalization enabling accounting operations at scale. 
 - Develop AI- and ML-driven solutions to enhance accuracy, detect anomalies, automate workflows, and minimize manual intervention. 
 - Define and execute a long-term architectural vision for Rippling's global accounting platform, balancing innovation with compliance, stability, and performance. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, finance, legal, compliance, data, and operations teams to deliver cohesive and compliant solutions. 
 - Champion customer-focused engineering, ensuring technical solutions directly drive operational excellence and user impact. 
 - Mentor and lead engineers, fostering high standards of technical quality, thoughtful design, and engineering best practices. 
 - Influence and align stakeholders across multiple teams and time zones, communicating clearly to drive shared product and technical goals. 

What You Will Need

- 8+ years of experience building and scaling production systems (Python, Django, React, MongoDB, AWS). 
 - Proven ability to architect, own, and deliver complex, platform-scale projects end to end. 
 - Strong background in data modeling, system design, and modern architecture patterns. 
 - Experience or keen interest in applying AI/ML for automation and intelligent data systems. 
 - Deep platform sensibility building extensible, compliant solutions for multiple countries. 
 - Track record of modernizing legacy systems and driving large-scale transformation. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Product mindset with focus on impact, reliability, and customer value. 
 - Proactive, growth-oriented approach with passion for solving complex global challenges. 

Bonus: Direct experience or deep interest in accounting workflows (journal entries, reconciliations, book closure). 

The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors, including but not limited to, location, experience, education, training, and business need. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, and/or equity, subject to applicable plan documents and company policy. Successful candidates hired for this role may also be eligible to participate in the company's benefits programs, which may include, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement benefits, and/or paid time off, as determined by company policy.

data.description:
Overview

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our PDX (Application Development and Experiences) organization. This role will contribute to building Modern SaaS AIR, a next-generation AI-native platform, specifically focusing on developing the next generation of Services Paved Road. The ideal candidate will be a technical leader who thrives in solving complex engineering challenges, mentoring others, and driving innovation to deliver world-class solutions. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for overseeing the development of major capabilities and components of Modern SaaS AIR. You will collaborate across engineering, product, design, and other cross-functional teams to ensure seamless delivery of technical solutions that delight our customers. Responsibilities

- Drive end-to-end development of platform capabilities and the AIR Paved Road, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Mentor team members to grow their skills and ensure high-impact delivery. 
 - Collaborate with product teams to deeply understand customer pain points and deliver solutions that meet their needs, reflecting strong engineering practices. 
 - Define and implement best practices for coding, system design, and release management. 
 - Design and develop high-quality back-end systems, APIs (GRPC, REST/OData/GraphQL), and integration tools. 
 - Drive the design of platform components in alignment with modern cloud-native principles (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD). 
 - Identify and prioritize platform improvements to simplify developer experiences, optimize operational efficiency, and reduce technical debt. 
 - Focus on operational excellence, ensuring high availability, disaster recovery, and robust monitoring frameworks. 
 - Encourage and build a culture of innovation and eagerness to explore new technologies in the team. 
 - Ensure operational excellence, designing for low MTTD/MTTR, HADR & fast recovery/self healing. 

Qualifications

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, with strong focus on platform engineering and service-oriented architecture. 
 - Expertise in problem-solving, algorithms, and data structures. 
 - Proficiency in a major programming language, with preference given to Java. Familiarity with jar, war deployment structures is a plus. 
 - Hands-on experience with back-end integration, web services, APIs (GRPC, REST/OData/GraphQL), and data formats (JSON, XML, ProtoBuf). 
 - Strong understanding and experience in cloud native technologies (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD). 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD tools like Jenkins and GitOps processes. 
 - Proven track record of driving projects end-to-end with scrum teams (design → delivery → user impact). 
 - Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration and strong technical leadership. 
 - Deep understanding of operational excellence in software systems, including deployment architecture, monitoring (MTTD/MTTR), incident management, and root cause analysis. 

Preferred

- Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
 - Solid understanding of AWS cloud platforms. 
 - Experience with agile development methodologies like Scrum or Kanban
 - Demonstrated ability to simplify system designs, navigate ambiguity with confidence, and lead innovation initiatives within engineering teams. 

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

data.title: Lead Principal Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

As a Lead Principal Platform Software Engineer, you will drive DevOps and intelligent automation for database services on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), improving reliability and empowering teams through self-service and AI. 

You will build reusable frameworks and operational tools, improve production delivery, and turn complex operational challenges into reliable automation. Working with database experts and distributed engineering teams, you will advance self-service, automated recovery, and AI-assisted operations while mentoring engineers and improving service reliability and efficiency. 

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead initiatives from requirements and design through implementation, testing, production rollout, and ongoing improvement. 
 - Build reusable automation and service integrations using Python, Shell, OCI APIs, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Improve CI/CD pipelines, source control, and release practices through code reviews, automated testing, deployment validation, controlled rollouts, and rollback procedures. 
 - Automate database lifecycle operations, fleet management, and infrastructure changes, with reliable state handling, safe retries, and failure recovery. 
 - Build AI-assisted tools for incident investigation, knowledge retrieval, operational insights, and workflow automation. 
 - Develop self-service tools and dashboards for service health, capacity, and recovery readiness. 
 - Lead complex production investigations and deliver permanent fixes that prevent recurrence and reduce manual intervention. 
 - Ensure secure integrations, appropriate access controls, and production readiness. 
 - Guide cross-team technical decisions, resolve dependencies, and mentor engineers in DevOps, automation, and emerging technologies. 
 - Measure improvements in reliability, recovery time, deployment quality, resource efficiency, and engineering productivity. 

Minimum Qualifications And Experience

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Experience building and operating scalable, cloud-native distributed systems, with an understanding of end-to-end configuration, technical dependencies, and production service behavior. 
 - Strong Python and Shell skills, with experience building maintainable automation frameworks and operational tools. 
 - Experience with Git, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release management. 
 - Experience with infrastructure as code, configuration management, and safe production deployment practices. 
 - Strong understanding of Linux, cloud infrastructure, REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and authorization. 
 - Practical knowledge of Oracle Database, SQL, and database lifecycle operations. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across applications, databases, infrastructure, and dependent services. 
 - Ability to collaborate across functions and distributed teams, influence technical direction, and mentor engineers. 
 - Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly through discussions, design documents, technical proposals, diagrams, and presentations. 
 - Interest in applying AI to operational challenges and the ability to evaluate and adopt new technologies. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with OCI or similar cloud platforms, including networking, identity and access management, APIs, and automation. 
 - OCI DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Terraform, Ansible, or comparable infrastructure and configuration automation tools. 
 - Building or integrating AI-powered tools and agents to automate workflows, support troubleshooting, and improve engineering productivity.

 - Database lifecycle operations-including provisioning, backup and restore, cloning, data masking, performance tuning, monitoring, and Oracle Data Guard-across Autonomous Database and ExaCS, as applicable. 
 - Exadata, RAC, ASM, high availability, and disaster recovery. 
 - Monitoring, logging, alerting, capacity management, and automated remediation. 
 - Experience with OCI KMS and database encryption key management.

Core Skills

- DevOps, SRE, and production troubleshooting 
 - Python, Shell, and automation frameworks 
 - Oracle Database administration, Autonomous Database, ExaCS, and lifecycle operations 
 - Git, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code 
 - Cloud platforms, networking, REST APIs, and service integration 
 - AI-powered tools, observability, and self-service automation

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

data.title: Machine Learning Engineer
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Splunk AI Platform and Services team builds and operates the core runtime and developer infrastructure powering AI across Splunk and Cisco. We run multi-tenant, large-scale LLM inference, VectorDB/RAG, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI DevX services across hybrid multi-cloud environments. 

Sitting at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineering, Distributed Systems, and ML Infrastructure, our mission is to ensure these mission-critical AI workloads remain highly available, scalable, secure, and cost-efficient in production. 

Your Impact

- Scale Core AI Services: Operate and optimize multi-tenant LLM inference, model serving, VectorDB/RAG, and MCP platforms across global cloud and GPU clusters. 
 - Drive Platform Resiliency: Establish and monitor SLOs, SLIs, automated health checks, and observability dashboards (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, OpenTelemetry). 
 - Automate Operations & Toil Reduction: Build automation for seamless rollouts, autoscaling, canary deployments, self-healing, and disaster recovery. 
 - Optimize GPU & Inference Performance: Tune throughput, latency, model scheduling, batching, caching, and resource allocation using Kubernetes, vLLM, and Ray. 
 - Incident Command & Prevention: Lead complex production incident response, conduct 5-Why root-cause analyses, and implement systemic remediations to eliminate repeat outages. 
 - Cross-Functional Enablement: Partner with AI researchers, product developers, and platform teams on production readiness reviews (PRRs) and participate in a sustainable on-call rotation. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in CS/Engineering with 5+ years of relevant experience, or Master's with 3+ years. 
 - Software Development: 3+ years of programming experience in Python, Go, or Java building automation, tooling, or production backend services. 
 - Cloud-Native Operations: Solid experience running distributed, containerized systems in production using Kubernetes, microservices, and CI/CD. 
 - SRE & Observability: Proven background in production operations, distributed troubleshooting, and monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or OpenTelemetry). 
 - Cloud Platforms: Hands-on working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

Preferred Qualifications

- LLM & Inference Frameworks: Hands-on experience with vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Ray Serve, or KServe. 
 - GPU Orchestration: Experience managing GPU scheduling, capacity planning, model parallelism, and performance profiling. 
 - Stateful & Retrieval Data Stores: Experience operating Vector databases, search engines, or distributed cache layers (e. g. , Milvus, Pinecone, Redis). 
 - GenAI Architectures: Familiarity with RAG pipelines, model routing, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent runtimes. 
 - Advanced SRE Design: Track record designing multi-region high-availability systems, automated remediation, and chaos engineering practices. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way.
