data.title: Application Engineer II
data.description:
Are you a frontend engineer who loves crafting elegant, high-performing applications that make a real difference? If you're passionate about Angular, engineering excellence, and building products that users actually love - this could be your next great adventure. Join us in Bangalore and be part of a team where quality, innovation, and collaboration are not just buzzwords - they're the way we work. 

About The Role

You'll be at the heart of developing and maintaining sophisticated in-house insurance products built primarily with Angular. As part of one of our dynamic product teams, you'll contribute to building functionality that generates real, measurable business impact. This is a role for someone who takes pride in their craft, thrives in a collaborative environment, and is excited to shape the future of frontend engineering. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build high-quality frontend applications - Develop, review, and maintain clean, reusable, and performant UI code that adheres to established engineering standards and best practices. 
 - Collaborate across cross-functional teams - Partner closely with product owners, requirements engineers, QA specialists, designers, and backend engineers to deliver intuitive and seamless user experiences. 
 - Shape frontend architecture - Contribute to and influence frontend design decisions, component architecture, and technical standards to ensure applications are scalable, maintainable, and future-ready. 
 - Drive frontend integration and reusability - Integrate APIs and shared services while leveraging reusable UI components, design systems, authentication frameworks, and observability solutions. 
 - Champion engineering excellence and innovation - Advocate for automated testing, accessibility, performance optimisation, and the adoption of modern frontend technologies and Generative AI to continuously improve engineering productivity and quality. 

About The Team

We are a team that believes deeply in engineering excellence - and that great leaders are engineers at heart. We build applications that are carefully designed, thoughtfully implemented, and consistently surpass the expectations of our users. Working hand-in-hand with product owners, we treat quality and stability as first-class deliverables in everything we do. We lead by example, embedding high standards into our processes and fostering a culture where every team member's contribution matters. 

About You

You're a naturally curious and thoughtful professional who thrives in a high-performance engineering environment. Your passion for coding is matched by your commitment to delivering real business value. You believe in continuous learning - whether through self-improvement or by absorbing knowledge from the talented people around you - and you're genuinely excited to contribute to a team that values technical excellence above all else. 

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements

- Proficiency in Angular, HTML & CSS across the entire software delivery lifecycle, with a strong command of modern frontend development practices. 
 - Experience with module bundlers such as Webpack, Node, or Browserify for building and packaging scalable frontend modules. 
 - Hands-on public cloud experience, particularly with Microsoft Azure, and the ability to work confidently within cloud-native environments. 

These Are Additional Nice To Haves

- Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, OpenAPI specification, and Swagger for seamless frontend-backend integration. 
 - Comfort working extensively within an IDE and navigating large, established codebases with confidence and efficiency. 
 - Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and a commitment to writing testable, reliable code. 
 - Experience with design systems and accessibility standards to ensure inclusive and consistent user experiences. 
 - An interest in or exposure to Generative AI tools that enhance developer productivity and engineering workflows. 

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week. 

About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15, 000 employees across the world. 

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability. 

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience. 

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt LtdToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, operating since 2021 and headquartered in Jaipur. We help Indian users buy, sell and trade digital assets securely, and offer OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services. 

About the RoleYou will own the backend services that run the exchange: order flow, wallets, deposits and withdrawals, payments, and internal tools. These systems move real customer funds, so reliability, security and throughput come first. As a senior engineer, you will set engineering standards, lead design decisions, handle production incidents, and mentor mid-level developers. 

Key Responsibilities· Design, build and maintain scalable Node. js services (REST and WebSocket) for order flow, market data, wallets, payments and internal tools. 

· Build correct, high-throughput money-movement logic: balance ledgers, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, using idempotency, atomic transactions and reconciliation. 

· Design schemas and optimise queries on MySQL/PostgreSQL at scale: indexing, partitioning, transactions, replication and slow-query tuning. 

· Use Redis in production for caching, pub/sub, queues, rate limiting and sessions. 

· Build event-driven pipelines with Kafka, RabbitMQ or BullMQ, with retries, dead-letter queues and back-pressure. 

· Integrate with blockchain nodes and RPC providers, liquidity partners, payment gateways and KYC vendors. 

· Apply security by design: OWASP Top 10, secrets management, API authentication, rate limiting, audit logging and access control. 

· Own observability: structured logs, metrics, tracing, dashboards and alerts; lead incident response and blameless post-mortems. 

· Set engineering standards through code reviews, design docs, testing practices and CI/CD. 

· Mentor mid-level developers and work with front-end, DevOps, product, compliance and security teams. 

Must-Have Skills· 6-7 years of backend development, including 4+ years in Node. js with Express, Fastify or NestJS. 

· Deep MySQL or PostgreSQL knowledge: indexing, transactions and isolation levels, replication, and slow-query tuning. 

· Redis in production: clustering, persistence (RDB/AOF), Streams and BullMQ. 

· Message queues: Kafka, RabbitMQ or BullMQ. 

· Docker, Linux and Nginx (reverse proxy, load balancing, TLS). 

· Security: OWASP practices, secrets management, idempotent APIs and audit logging. 

· REST and WebSocket API design for high-concurrency, low-latency systems. 

· Experience running and debugging production systems: monitoring, on-call and incident handling. 

· Proven experience leading code reviews and mentoring developers. 

· Strong ownership, clear written communication and sound engineering judgement. 

Good to Have· Experience on a crypto exchange, fintech, payments or trading platform. 

· Blockchain RPC integration (EVM chains, Bitcoin, Tron, Solana): deposit detection, confirmations and withdrawal broadcasting. 

· Kubernetes and cloud platforms (AWS or GCP). 

· TypeScript across backend services. 

· Matching-engine, order-book or market-data system design. 

· Observability tools: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, OpenTelemetry.

The Applications Development Intermediate Programmer Analyst is an intermediate-level position responsible for the end-to-end design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of enterprise-grade application systems and programs. Working in close collaboration with the engineering leads, product managers, architects, and business stakeholders, the incumbent will contribute to modernizing, scaling, and engineering mission-critical applications across the technology landscape. 

This role requires a proactive developer with strong hands-on experience in Java Full Stack development, relational databases (Oracle), modern front-end frameworks (Angular or React), and familiarity with modern containerization and cloud platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

- Full Stack Application Engineering & Development
 - Design, build, test, and deploy resilient, scalable, and secure full stack software solutions using Java/J2EE (Java 11/17+), Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture. 
 - Develop interactive, responsive, and intuitive user interfaces using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (Angular or React), adhering to UX/UI design guidelines and accessibility standards. 
 - Design, optimize, and maintain relational data models, complex queries, stored procedures, and triggers using Oracle Database; perform query performance tuning and indexing.

 - Identify, triage, and remediate application bottlenecks, bugs, and production incidents to guarantee system uptime, reliability, and low latency. 
 - Conduct vulnerability assessments, static/dynamic code analysis (e. g. , SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx), and remediate security findings in accordance with secure coding standards. 
 - Collaboration, Leadership & Governance
 - Act as a technical advisor and mentor to junior developers and analysts, promoting clean code principles, design patterns, and engineering best practices. 
 - Identify architectural technical debt and propose pragmatic refactoring and continuous improvement solutions. 
 - Exercise independence of judgment and autonomy, operating effectively with limited direct supervision while managing deliverables across sprint cycles. 
 - Risk & Control Adherence: Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct, and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency. 

Qualifications & Skill Requirements

Technical Experience (Mandatory)

Hands-on experience with Spring Framework / Spring Boot (Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security, Spring Cloud). Proven track record building and consuming RESTful Web Services & APIs. 
 - Front-End Development: Demonstrated experience with modern client-side frameworks: Angular (v10+) or React. js. Solid understanding of TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and front-end state management (NgRx, Redux, or Context API). 
 - Database & Persistence: In-depth experience with Oracle Database development (SQL, PL/SQL, indexing, query optimization, execution plans). 
 - Tooling & Engineering Practices: Proficiency with version control systems (Git / Bitbucket / GitHub). Experience with build and dependency management tools (Maven, Gradle, npm/yarn). Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code quality tools. 

Preferred / Good To Have Skills

- Experience with NoSQL databases, specifically MongoDB or document-oriented data storage. 
 - Experience deploying and managing workloads on container platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift or Kubernetes. 
 - Hands-on experience or foundational knowledge of Public Cloud platforms (AWS or Google Cloud Platform / GCP). 
 - Exposure to messaging and event streaming technologies (e. g. , Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or IBM MQ). 
 - Familiarity with financial services domain concepts, regulatory reporting, or transaction processing systems. 

Professional & Core Competencies

- 4+ years of relevant experience in software engineering and application development (experience in Banking / Financial Services is a plus). 
 - Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting capabilities with attention to detail. 
 - Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Adaptability to work effectively in an Agile/Scrum environment under shifting priorities and deadlines.

data.description:
Organisation: AllBridge Technologies

Employment Type: Full-time | Permanent

Experience: 0-1 years

Location: Chennai - On-site

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday | Day Shift

About the Role

AB Tech is seeking an AR/VR & IoT Simulation Developer to design and develop immersive industrial training applications using Unity. 

The role is primarily focused on building VR-based logistics and equipment simulations integrated with physical hardware, such as steering wheels, pedals, gear systems, sensors, controllers, and other IoT-enabled devices. 

The selected candidate will work on realistic training systems for forklift operations, warehouse activities, dangerous goods handling, equipment safety, and other logistics-related processes. 

Key Focus Areas

- Forklift and warehouse equipment VR simulations
 - Dangerous goods handling and safety training
 - Hardware-integrated VR training systems
 - Steering wheel, pedal, gear, button, and controller integration
 - Vehicle physics and equipment behaviour simulation
 - IoT and sensor-based input integration
 - SOP-driven training workflows and assessment systems
 - Multiplayer and collaborative XR training applications
 - Industrial and logistics-focused AR, VR, and XR modules

Key Responsibilities

- Develop immersive AR, VR, and XR training simulations using Unity 3D. 
 - Create realistic forklift, vehicle, machinery, and warehouse equipment behaviour. 
 - Implement vehicle physics, steering, acceleration, braking, gear shifting, collision detection, and equipment control systems. 
 - Integrate physical simulation hardware such as steering wheels, pedals, gear systems, buttons, joysticks, sensors, and microcontrollers. 
 - Establish communication between Unity applications and external hardware or IoT devices. 
 - Develop SOP-driven training sequences, instructions, alerts, violations, scoring, and assessment systems. 
 - Build trainee performance reports and simulation analytics. 
 - Integrate backend APIs for user data, training records, scores, reports, and application configuration. 
 - Develop or support multiplayer VR training experiences. 
 - Implement interactions using XR Interaction Toolkit and OpenXR. 
 - Configure and optimise applications for Meta Quest and PC-VR platforms. 
 - Test, debug, profile, and optimise XR applications for stable performance. 
 - Collaborate with logistics experts, trainers, hardware engineers, UI designers, and 3D artists. 
 - Support simulator installation, calibration, testing, and troubleshooting when required. 
 - Maintain clean, reusable, and well-documented C# code. 
 - Required Technical Skills
 - Working knowledge of Unity 3D
 - Proficiency in C# programming
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles
 - Experience with Unity physics, collisions, rigid bodies, and input systems
 - Basic understanding of vehicle physics and control systems
 - Knowledge of XR Interaction Toolkit
 - Knowledge of OpenXR
 - Familiarity with Meta Quest or PC-VR development
 - Understanding of APIs and backend integration
 - Basic knowledge of Git or other version-control systems
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving abilities
 - Hardware and IoT Skills
 - Candidates should have an interest in or basic experience with: 
 - Steering wheels, pedals, gear systems, and simulator controls
 - Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi, or similar controllers
 - Sensors, switches, encoders, buttons, joysticks, and serial communication
 - USB HID, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, serial, or network-based hardware communication
 - Reading hardware input data and mapping it to Unity controls
 - Calibration and testing of physical simulator components
 - Basic mechanical, electrical, or control-system concepts

Preferred Skills

- Experience developing forklift, driving, machinery, or industrial simulations
 - Knowledge of realistic vehicle physics
 - Exposure to AR Foundation
 - Experience with Unity Multiplayer, Netcode for GameObjects, Photon, or similar frameworks
 - Experience with REST API integration and JSON data handling
 - Familiarity with databases, learning-management systems, or reporting dashboards
 - Knowledge of performance optimisation for standalone VR headsets
 - Experience in industrial safety, logistics, warehouse, or training applications
 - Familiarity with 3D modelling workflows using Blender, Maya, or similar tools

Preferred qualifications: 

- PhD in Electrical Engineering with a focus on VLSI testing, fault tolerance, or reliability. 
 - Experience with advanced technology nodes (5nm/3nm), 2. 5D/3D-IC packaging, or high-speed I/O (SerDes/DDR) testing methodologies. 
 - Experience managing global technical teams and driving vendor engagement. 
 - Ability to drive cross-functional timing closure, power analysis, and IR-drop mitigation for high-frequency designs. 

About The Job

In this role, you'll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You'll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems. 

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what's possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. 

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. 

Responsibilities

- Define and document the comprehensive DFT architecture for multi-core SoCs, including strategies for hierarchical scan compression, Memory BIST (MBIST) for huge memory instances, Functional BISTs, Analog components, Logic BIST, high-speed I/O loopback, and JTAG/IEEE 1149. 1/1500/1687/1838 networks. 
 - Lead the complete DFT lifecycle from RTL planning to pattern handoff, own the schedule, resource allocation, and milestone tracking to ensure zero-defect delivery. 
 - Deploy next-generation DFT methodologies and automation flows to maximize test coverage, while minimizing test time, pattern count, and silicon area overhead. 
 - Collaborate with post silicon team, Physical Design and Power Architects. 
 - Support the post-silicon phase to achieve final Production Release Qualification (PRQ). Mentor senior technical staff, drive vendor EDA tool selection/qualification, and act as the primary technical liaison for DFT matters with stakeholders.

In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Telugu Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Telugu AI training projects. You will review AI-generated Telugu content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and ensure that all contributors follow the expected quality standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Telugu and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Telugu quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Telugu training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check Telugu items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around Telugu wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, Andhra Pradesh vs Telangana usage, and edge cases. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain Telugu project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and Telugu-specific style requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply Telugu language guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Telugu-language projects. 

Your Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mathematics
 - Native or near-native Telugu proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in Telugu writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of Telugu grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, regional variation, and cultural context. 
 - Ability to evaluate Telugu content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong plus.

data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

About the Opportunity

This role offers the opportunity to shape a differentiated verification strategy at the intersection of semiconductor Design Verification, SystemC modeling, Virtual Platforms, and pre-silicon software development. 

This leader will define and execute a reuse-first verification strategy spanning SystemC transaction-level models, RTL, IP, subsystem, SoC, and platform-level validation. The objective is to create a traceable verification asset chain that grows from loosely timed SystemC models through approximately timed models and RTL, rather than rebuilding independent verification environments at each stage. 

The position is part of Renesas' Software First, Simulation First engineering organization. The team develops reusable SystemC/TLM models and integrated Virtual Platforms that enable software development, verification, validation, and product evaluation before silicon availability. Design Verification is the quality and release gate that ensures these virtual products faithfully represent the intended silicon behavior. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive the verification strategy for SystemC models, RTL designs, reusable IP, subsystems, SoCs, and Virtual Platforms. 
 - Lead and develop a global Design Verification organization, including verification leads, engineers, external partners, and project-specific teams. 
 - Establish a common verification architecture that supports reuse of test intent, stimulus, sequences, checkers, scoreboards, assertions, coverage models, and regression infrastructure across SystemC and RTL. 
 - Develop scalable SystemVerilog/UVM environments, including protocol adapters and TLM bridges that connect pin-level UVM interfaces to SystemC/TLM models. 
 - Establish functional-equivalence and timing-correlation methodologies between SystemC LT/AT models and RTL implementations. 
 - Define common verification plans, feature identifiers, test intent, functional and code coverage goals, closure criteria, maturity classifications, and sign-off requirements. 
 - Make verification sign-off an explicit release gate for customer- and software-facing Virtual Platform deliveries. 
 - Drive verification planning and execution from the IP level through subsystem, chip-top, SoC, and full-platform integration. 
 - Establish a risk-based verification approach that balances reusable UVM environments, Python/C++ tests, software-driven validation, formal techniques, and project schedules. 
 - Lead verification of configurable and parameterized IP models across supported configurations, interfaces, and operating modes. 
 - Build CI/CD-based regression systems for automated compilation, simulation, coverage collection, result analysis, release evidence, and quality reporting. 
 - Partner with architecture, RTL design, SystemC modeling, software, validation, methodology, and Product Group teams to define requirements and acceptance criteria. 
 - Lead complex debug and root-cause analysis across models, adapters, RTL, testbenches, firmware, and platform-level environments. 
 - Evaluate and adopt verification technologies that improve quality, reuse, coverage closure, simulation efficiency, and engineering productivity. 
 - Own staffing, organizational development, program planning, partner engagement, execution tracking, risks, dependencies, and executive reporting for the DV function. Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will: 

- Set a clear technical and organizational direction while maintaining delivery accountability. 
 - Balance verification rigor, reuse, schedule, risk, and business priorities. 
 - Build durable methodology without allowing methodology development to block critical product execution. 
 - Develop strong technical leaders and create clear accountability across IP, subsystem, SoC, and platform verification. 
 - Promote collaboration across RTL, SystemC, software, validation, architecture, and product organizations. 
 - Establish a culture of measurable quality, evidence-based sign-off, disciplined debug, automation, and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of experience in semiconductor IP, subsystem, or SoC Design Verification. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading geographically distributed verification teams and multiple concurrent programs. 
 - Deep expertise in SystemVerilog and UVM, including verification architecture, reusable environments, constrained-random testing, assertions, scoreboards, functional coverage, and coverage closure. 
 - Strong knowledge of RTL design and simulation, computer architecture, embedded processors, interconnects, memory systems, interrupts, clocks, reset, and peripheral interfaces. 
 - Proven experience defining verification plans and delivering IP or SoC verification through sign-off. 
 - Experience leading complex debug across RTL, testbench, firmware, interfaces, and system-level environments. 
 - Experience with regression automation, verification metrics, CI/CD, revision control, and release-quality governance. 
 - Strong program-management capabilities, including effort estimation, staffing, schedules, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communication. 
 - Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence architects, design teams, software organizations, Product Groups, executives, and external partners. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience verifying SystemC/TLM-2. 0 models or integrating SystemC models into RTL verification environments. 
 - Experience creating TLM-to-signal adapters, UVM/SystemC bridges, DPI interfaces, or mixed-language simulation environments. 
 - Knowledge of SystemC loosely timed and approximately timed modeling, functional equivalence, timing correlation, and performance verification. 
 - Experience with Python- or C++-based verification and running common tests against both SystemC and RTL implementations. 
 - Familiarity with common SoC protocols and peripheral interfaces such as AMBA AXI/AHB/APB, NoC, PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, USB, SPI, I2C/I3C, eSPI, UART, GPIO, and memory controllers. 
 - Experience with formal verification, emulation, FPGA prototyping, software-driven verification, or post-silicon validation. 
 - Experience verifying configurable or parameterized IP and automating configuration-space coverage. 
 - Familiarity with Virtual Platforms, virtual prototyping, embedded-software enablement, Digital Twin technologies, and pre-silicon application validation. 
 - Experience with commercial simulation, debug, coverage, VIP, regression-management, and formal-verification tools from providers such as Cadence, Synopsys, or Siemens EDA. 
 - Experience building verification teams, developing technical leaders, managing engineering partners, and establishing reusable methodology across multiple projects. 

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose 'To Make Our Lives Easier. ' As the industry's leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system-level know-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog & Connectivity, and Power. 

With a diverse team of over 21, 000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. data.description:
Meet the Team

Our team is dedicated to powering the Cisco Secure Workload platform, a holistic security solution designed to deliver in-depth application workload visibility and protection across hybrid multicloud environments. We function as the architects of Zero Trust micro segmentation, automating policy generation to reduce the attack surface and minimize lateral movement of threats. Our work is critical to the larger picture of cloud-native security, harmonizing inconsistent "islands" of policy controls into a single, effective security model across bare metal, VMs, and containers. We are a highly technical, innovative group with a "cutting-edge" vibe, currently integrating GenAI and eBPF technology to redefine how enterprises manage their application environments. 

Your Impact

- Drive the evolution of workload security by developing and scaling a platform that secures compute instances across on-premises data centers and public clouds. 
 - Lead the implementation of behavior-based application insights and AI/ML driven policy automation to protect critical assets from sophisticated cyberattacks. 
 - Achieve complete visibility into workload interactions and ensuring consistent policy enforcement at scale. 
 - Engineer highly scalable micro segmentation solutions to support large and mega data centers. 
 - Integrate a wide technology stack, including Kubernetes, public cloud security groups, and various Linux distributions, to ensure infrastructure-agnostic protection. 
 - Optimize telemetry collection using eBPF to reduce agent resource consumption and enhance data accuracy. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree with 8 plus years of experience in Python, Ansible, and Golang with micro segmentation or Zero Trust security architectures. 
 - Core Linux/virtualization knowledge (virtual drives, logical/physical volumes) and experience deploying solutions for cloud architectures for AWS, Azure, Nutanix, Open Shift or GCP. 
 - Technical knowledge of Linux distributions (e. g. , Red Hat, Ubuntu, Debian) and their OS kernels
 - Proficiency in managing workloads across heterogeneous environments (Virtual Machines, Bare Metal, and Containers)
 - Experience with multicloud or hybrid cloud deployment options. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with eBPF (extended Berkeley Packet Filter) for network monitoring and security. 
 - Knowledge of GenAI integration for automating security policy management. 
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes, OpenShift, and container orchestration. 
 - Strong analytical skills for behavioral detection and vulnerability analysis. 
 - Collaborative mindset to work across NetSec, DevSecOps, and Cloud Architecture teams. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

data.description:
Job Title: Supply Chain Technology Lead

Work Location: Hyderabad

Position: Fulltime

Summary of role

The Supply Chain Technology Lead provides hands-on technical leadership for the applications, workflows and integrations that support the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) ecosystem. The role owns day-to-day technical delivery and continuous improvement across ERP applications and partner integrations, working closely with Finance, Procurement, Operations, technology teams and vendors. 

Core activities

- Act as the day-to-day technical owner for the P2P application and integration landscape, maintaining a clear technical roadmap aligned with the broader technology strategy. 
 - Lead solution design and technical delivery for enhancements across ERP solutions, procurement workflows, invoice processing, supplier onboarding and partner digital integrations. 
 - Translate business requirements into pragmatic, secure and supportable technical designs within agreed enterprise architecture and engineering standards. 
 - Remain hands-on with solution analysis, design reviews, integration troubleshooting, code and configuration reviews, and the resolution of complex production issues. 
 - Design and improve API, event-driven, EDI and data integration patterns supporting internal systems and external partners. 
 - Build reusable integration and partner-onboarding patterns that improve delivery speed, consistency, transaction traceability and reconciliation. 
 - Improve observability across the P2P estate through effective logging, monitoring, alerting, runbooks and root-cause remediation. 
 - Identify and deliver practical automation opportunities across P2P workflows, including intelligent document processing, exception handling and AI-assisted operations. 
 - Coordinate internal engineers, delivery partners and vendors, setting technical direction and assuring the quality, maintainability and supportability of delivered solutions. 
 - Partner with Finance, Procurement and Operations stakeholders to prioritise work, explain technical options and risks, and support adoption of delivered capabilities. 
 - Embed security, privacy, resilience and data-governance requirements into solution design and operational practices. 
 - Coach developers and technical contributors, progressively building the leadership and architecture capability required to take broader ownership of the Core Systems domain. 

Skills And Experience

- 8-10 years of experience in software engineering, enterprise applications or systems integration, including at least 2-3 years operating as a Senior Developer or Technical Lead. 
 - Strong hands-on capability in full stack custom application design, integration engineering and the support of business-critical systems using Python, react. js, node. js and AWS cloud stack. 
 - Experience with Camunda, Cleo and Netsuite or similar solutions highly desirable. 
 - Experience working with ERP, finance, procurement or supply-chain platforms and an understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes. 
 - Experience leading mid-level and junior developers situated on-site and offshore. 
 - Practical experience with APIs, messaging, ETL, event-driven integration or EDI patterns, including monitoring and production troubleshooting. 
 - Experience delivering solutions across cloud and SaaS environments using modern software development and release practices. 
 - Ability to translate business needs into clear solution designs and make sound technical trade-offs within enterprise standards. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with accountability for seeing issues through from diagnosis to sustainable resolution. 
 - Confidence working directly with business stakeholders, vendors and delivery partners, supported by clear written and verbal communication. 
 - Ability to lead through influence, coach others and balance hands-on technical work with delivery coordination and stakeholder engagement. 
 - Tertiary qualification in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Key Stakeholders

- Within the team: Chief Data & Technology Officer, Core Systems contributors, Data & AI Engineering, Platforms, Digital Resilience and Business Partnering. 
 - Within the business: Finance, Procurement and Operations stakeholders who own P2P processes, priorities, controls and adoption. 
 - Delivery partners and vendors: application, implementation, support and integration partners engaged across the P2P estate. 
 - External partners: suppliers, logistics providers and other connected organisations involved in partner onboarding and transaction flows.

data.title: Sr./Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Design, develop, integrate, and debug embedded firmware for 32-bit ARM-based microcontrollers, including STM32 and NetX90. 
 - Develop embedded software using Embedded C/C++, with strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, memory management, and real-time operating systems. 
 - Develop device drivers and low-level interfaces using I2C, SPI, UART, and other peripheral interfaces. 
 - Develop and integrate industrial communication protocols including PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen, and IO-Link. 
 - Develop embedded web pages and user interfaces using JavaScript and HTML, including configuration and diagnostic features. 
 - Develop, maintain, and validate device configuration and integration files such as GSD/GSDML, EDS, and IODD for PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, and IO-Link devices, supporting PLC configuration and fieldbus integration. 
 - Perform functional testing of fieldbus nodes using industrial PLCs such as Siemens, Rockwell, and similar platforms. 
 - Design and integrate REST APIs for device configuration, diagnostics, monitoring, and communication. 
 - Perform hands-on firmware debugging, optimization, integration, testing, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Collaborate with hardware and system teams for board bring-up, product integration, and validation. 
 - Conduct code reviews and contribute to firmware architecture, coding standards, reusable components, and best practices. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to firmware engineers and support resolution of complex technical issues. 
 - Contribute to project planning, technical estimation, documentation, project metrics, and EIC-Pune initiatives. 
 - Perform product/system-level testing in the Engineering Laboratory while following applicable safety practices and guidelines. 

Who You Are: 

As a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer, you are a hands-on technical contributor with expertise in ARM/STM32, NetX90, Embedded C/C++, device drivers, and low-level interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART). You have strong knowledge of PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen, and IO-Link, including fieldbus testing with Siemens/Rockwell PLCs. Experience in JavaScript, HTML, REST APIs, data structures, debugging, and firmware architecture, with the ability to provide technical guidance and mentoring. You are experienced in developing scalable, reliable, embedded software, collaborating across hardware and software teams to deliver robust and time-critical motion control solutions. 

For This Role, You Will Need: 

- Bachelor of Engineering degree or equivalent in Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, or related field. 
 - 8+ years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience, preferably in industrial automation, motion control, or connected products. 
 - Strong expertise in 32-bit ARM, STM32, NetX90, Embedded C/C++, data structures, algorithms, and firmware architecture. 
 - Hands-on experience in device driver development and low-level interfaces such as I2C, SPI, and UART. 
 - Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols: PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen, and IO-Link, device configuration files like GSD, EDS, IODD etc. 
 - Experience with fieldbus functional testing using PLCs, such as Siemens and Rockwell. 
 - Hands-on experience in JavaScript, HTML, embedded web pages, and REST APIs. 
 - Experience with RTOS/non-RTOS development, debugging, unit/integration testing, and Git-based development. 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with experience in board bring-up, hardware-software integration, and product validation. 
 - Ability to provide technical guidance and mentoring while remaining primarily hands-on as an individual contributor. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, documentation, and problem-solving skills; experience working in a global engineering environment preferred. 
 - Good verbal English communication skills with a neutral accent and a strong commitment to company values, ethics, and continuous learning. 
 - Respect for company values and ethics, with a strong willingness to learn. 

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: 

- Familiarity with PLC-based system integration, fieldbus certification/testing, and industrial product development. 
 - Familiarity with Protocol pre-conformance test environment and process. 
 - Experience in industrial automation, factory automation, motion control, or process control systems. 

Our Offer To You

By joining Emerson, you will be given the opportunity to make a difference through the work you do. 

Emerson's compensation and benefits programs are designed to be competitive within the industry and local labor markets. We also offer a comprehensive medical and insurance coverage to meet the needs of our employees.

We attract, develop, and retain exceptional people in an inclusive environment, where all employees can reach their greatest potential. We are dedicated to the ongoing development of our employees because we know that it is critical to our success as a global company. 

Safety is paramount to us, and we are relentless in our pursuit to provide a Safe Working Environment across our global network and facilities. 

Through our benefits, development opportunities, and an inclusive and safe work environment, we aim to create an organization our people are proud to represent. 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Emerson, we are committed to fostering a culture where every employee is valued and respected for their unique experiences and perspectives. We believe a diverse and inclusive work environment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas and diversity of thoughts, that inspires innovation and brings the best solutions to our customers. 

This philosophy is fundamental to living our company's values and our responsibility to leave the world in a better place. Learn more about our Culture & Values and about Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Emerson .

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

Role Summary

Caterpillar is seeking an engineering leader to manage the team responsible for advancing Remote Flash, Caterpillar's capability for remotely delivering software updates to connected equipment. 

Remote Flash enables software updates to be delivered directly to Caterpillar products without requiring a technician to physically access the machine, helping reduce service effort, improve equipment uptime, and accelerate deployment of software improvements. 

The Remote Flash Team Manager will lead an engineering team responsible for the architecture, development, integration, validation, and deployment of the next generation of remote software update capabilities. The role combines strong people leadership with software and systems engineering leadership across connected products, embedded systems, cloud/back-office services, and Caterpillar product programs. 

The team is entering an important technology transition. The Remote Flash roadmap includes NexGen platforms, 5G integration, enhanced flashing of control ECMs, orchestration of multi-component updates, and continued support for legacy equipment. 

What You Will Do

People and Engineering Leadership

- Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team globally.

 - Build capability in embedded software, connected systems, cloud integration, systems engineering, DevSecOps, validation, and remote software update technologies. 
 - Develop technical leaders and create career growth opportunities within the team. 
 - Foster an engineering culture focused on accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, quality, and continuous improvement. 

Remote Flash Engineering

- Lead engineering delivery of Caterpillar's Remote Flash capabilities across connected products. 
 - Drive development of next-generation remote software update architecture, including NexGen & 5G Radio. 
 - These capabilities are reflected in the current Remote Flash roadmap and architecture work. 
 - Ensure solutions account for Caterpillar's diverse equipment population, embedded controllers, communication technologies, machine architectures, and legacy products. 
 - Guide engineering decisions involving update orchestration, rollback and recovery, software compatibility, cybersecurity, diagnostics, telemetry, and deployment reliability. 
 - Drive system-level design and integration across on-machine software and enterprise/back-office systems. 

Delivery and Operational Excellence

- Own execution of engineering roadmaps from requirements through development, integration, validation, release, and production support. 
 - Establish measurable engineering and operational KPIs for quality, reliability, deployment success, cycle time, and customer impact. 
 - Improve engineering practices through automation, CI/CD, automated validation, modern source control, and effective use of engineering data. 
 - Use field performance and failure data to identify systemic issues and continuously improve Remote Flash reliability. 

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner with product groups, embedded controls teams, connectivity teams, enterprise software teams, cybersecurity, digital product organizations, dealers, and external engineering partners. 
 - Translate product and customer needs into scalable technical capabilities. 
 - Lead technical trade-off and prioritization discussions involving architecture, cost, schedule, risk, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Communicate technical strategy, delivery status, risks, and recommendations to engineering and business leadership. 

What You Have

Required

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Significant experience leading engineering or software development teams. 
 - Experience delivering complex distributed, embedded, connected-product, or cloud-integrated systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead engineers through architecture, development, integration, validation, and production deployment. 
 - Strong technical problem-solving and systems-thinking skills. 
 - Experience working across organizations and influencing technical decisions without relying solely on direct authority. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred

- Experience with embedded Linux, embedded controllers/ECMs, telematics, connected products, or IoT systems. 
 - Experience with OTA or remote software update systems. 
 - Experience with update orchestration, A/B software deployment, bootloaders, rollback/recovery, software signing, or secure software distribution. 
 - Experience with cloud-connected vehicle, machine, industrial, or edge-computing architectures. 
 - Experience with Agile software development, Git/GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevSecOps. 
 - Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams. 
 - Experience with construction, mining, industrial, automotive, or other complex connected equipment. 

Why This Role Matters

Software is becoming an increasingly important part of Caterpillar products. The ability to safely update software remotely at scale reduces equipment downtime and support cost while allowing Caterpillar to deliver improvements more rapidly. 

This manager will build and lead the engineering organization responsible for making remote software updates a reliable, scalable capability across current and future Caterpillar products.

Engineering Manager - Consumer

You will run an engineering team in PropertyGuru's Consumer tribe. You ship on web and app. 

You work alongside strong engineers and bring the judgement to tell a sound design from one that needs more work. 

What Your Team Owns

Core consumer journeys on the website and the mobile app, across our Southeast Asian markets. 

How people find a property, and how they reach an agent. 

A conversion metric that is yours. You are measured on it. 

What You Will Do

Ship: Release to web and app every week. Own the result on both. 

Own the design: Review anything risky before code is written. Set the guardrails. Say no to a weak design and explain why.

Own production: Instrument the flow end to end. Set the alerts. Lead the incident when it breaks.

Grow the team: Hire, coach and promote engineers. Give direct feedback.

You manage a team and still go deep. You can explain why your system is built the way it is, two layers down, with nobody else in the room.

You ask scoping questions before you design. Given an unfamiliar problem, say authentication for a new API, you can reason your way to a sound design.

You are honest with numbers. You know the baseline, how it was measured, and what else changed.

data.description:
About Amgen

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases, and make people's lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what's known today. 

At Amgen, data, analytics and digital capabilities are increasingly central to how we operate, make decisions and deliver medicines to patients. 

A successful candidate for the Director, Operational Analytics Delivery role will combine strong analytics and technology expertise with exceptional operational leadership to manage a large portfolio of analytics products, establish delivery guidelines, translate complex operational data into meaningful business outcomes, develop talent, and shape our analytics strategy. 

What you will do

Let's do this. Let's change the world. At Amgen, data, analytics and digital capabilities are increasingly central to how we operate, make decisions and deliver medicines to patients. 

A successful candidate for the Director, Operational Analytics Delivery role will combine strong analytics and technology expertise with exceptional operational leadership to manage a large portfolio of analytics products, establish delivery guidelines, translate complex operational data into meaningful business outcomes, develop talent, and shape our analytics strategy. 

This vital role will build and lead in India a high-performing clinical trial analytics capability that delivers trusted, scalable, and actionable analytics solutions for Amgen's Global Development Operations organization. 

The role will be responsible for establishing an effective delivery model in India, including developing analytics talent and capabilities, translating business priorities into an integrated analytics delivery portfolio, and ensuring high-quality execution across data, reporting, visualization, advanced analytics, and decision support solutions. The role will work closely with senior and functional leaders to shape Amgen's long-term analytics strategy and delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

Lead Operational Analytics Delivery

- Establish and lead the India-based Operational Analytics Delivery organization, including the operating model, governance and disciplines, and ways of working. 
 - Build capabilities across analytics engineering, business intelligence, product management, data science, and analytics delivery. 
 - Translate strategic business goals into clear product roadmaps and delivery and resource plans, with managing demand through prioritization mechanisms.

 - Resolve organizational roadblocks and escalate risks appropriately to maintain delivery. 
 - Enable transparent portfolio reporting that covers Operational Analytics Delivery progress, risks, mitigations, and business impact / outcomes. 

Build a Product-Oriented Analytics Organization that Drives Business Value

- Shift and champion operational analytics delivery from one-time reports to reusable, scalable products for widespread use across Operations. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders to identify analytics opportunities, deliver clear business insights and actions, promote data-driven decision-making, and define analytics products' adoption, business value, and performance measures. 
 - Identify opportunities to apply advanced analytics, automation, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to operational challenges. 
 - Drive common standards and sustainable support for analytics product development, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management. 

Enable Delivery Excellence and Governance

- Establish and track delivery Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), service levels, quality measures, and business value metrics. 
 - Implement effective demand, capacity, and resource management practices. 
 - Ensure appropriate data governance, security, privacy, quality, and regulatory requirements are incorporated into analytics delivery. 
 - Oversee external partners and vendors where appropriate, including performance, quality, cost, and delivery against agreed outcomes. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in processes, tools, and organizational effectiveness. 

Develop Analytics Talent

- Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing analytics organization. 
 - Establish clear roles, career paths, development opportunities, and succession plans. 
 - Create a culture characterized by accountability, curiosity, continuous improvement, collaboration, and commitment to serving patients. 
 - Build strong global connections to ensure Operational Analytics Delivery operates as an integrated global capability. 

Be a Trusted Analytics Parter to Global Leadership

- Serve as a senior partner to Operations leaders and functional stakeholders globally. 
 - Build trusted relationships across Operations, Technology, Data & Artificial Intelligence, and other enterprise functions. 
 - Influence strategic business priorities and investment decisions through clear articulation of business value, trade-offs, and delivery considerations. 
 - Represent Operational Analytics Delivery in relevant leadership and governance forums. 
 - Communicate complex analytics and analytics products topics clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical senior leaders. 

What we expect of you

We all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is an individual with these qualifications. 

Basic Qualifications

- Doctorate degree, Masters degree or Bachelors degree with 17+ years of clinical development, clinical data management, OR Master's degree and 8 years of analytics, technology, data, or related experience
 - AND 4 years of experience directly managing people and / or leadership experience leading teams, programs, or significant portfolios with directing resource allocation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Significant experience leading analytics, data, digital, or technology delivery organizations in a complex global enterprise. 
 - Experience within biopharmaceuticals, life sciences, manufacturing, supply chain, or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Strong understanding of operational analytics across areas such as manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, process development, and / or operational excellence. 
 - Experience building and scaling analytics teams in India supporting global stakeholders. 
 - Strong executive presence with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and navigate a global organization. 
 - Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex organizational dependencies while maintaining a strong focus on delivery. 
 - Demonstrated success managing a portfolio of analytics products end-to-end, from demand through development, deployment, adoption, and lifecycle management. 
 - Strong knowledge of modern analytics architectures, product-oriented delivery models, data platforms, business intelligence, visualization technologies, and agile ways of working. 
 - Experience with advanced analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and automation, and the ability to identify where these technologies can generate meaningful operational value. 
 - Demonstrated ability to define and use Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and business-value measures to manage performance
 - Demonstrated strong financial and resource-management skills, including workforce planning, portfolio prioritization, and vendor management. 
 - Proven ability to recruit, develop and lead diverse, high-performing technical and analytical teams, with a demonstrated commitment to developing people, fostering inclusion, and building a collaborative global culture. 

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate will be a builder, operator, and analytics leader, bringing the strategic perspective expected of a Director while maintaining a strong orientation toward delivery and measurable business outcomes.

Job Description: Site Reliability Engineer - Platform SupportAbout the Role: 

- Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Systems Operations Engineer
 - Senior Site Reliability Engineer (App SRE) is responsible for driving reliability, automation, observability, and performance for mission critical applications and platforms. 
 - This role blends software engineering excellence with operational expertise to deliver stable, scalable, and resilient services, while reducing toil and shifting operations left across the application lifecycle. 
 - The Senior SRE acts as a technical authority and mentor , partnering with application, platform, and DevOps teams to embed reliability into design, delivery, and operations. 

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of Systems Engineering, Technology Architecture experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Job Expectations

- Partner with application, platform, and business stakeholders to define, implement, and govern SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets , balancing reliability with delivery velocity. 
 - Lead the design and continuous improvement of observability, telemetry, monitoring, and ing, ensuring actionable insights and reduced fatigue. 
 - Identify, prioritize, and implement automation and self‐healing solutions to eliminate operational toil and improve service resilience . 
 - Own and lead production readiness and go‐live activities, including NFR validation, Permit to Operate (PTO), and operational risk assessments . 
 - Provide engineering‐led application production support, acting as an escalation point for complex application and platform issues . 
 - Lead and troubleshoot major incident response (P1/P2/P3), drive in‐depth root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure preventative actions are implemented to achieve long‐term stability. 
 - Influence and guide teams to shift reliability left by embedding SRE practices into design , CI/CD pipelines, and release processes. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and contribute to SRE standards, best practices, and operating models. 
 - Collaborate and consult with technical peers, colleagues, and mid to more experienced level managers to resolve systems support issues and achieve goals

Additional Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of hands‐on experience in production application support engineering, with a strong focus on reliability, availability, and operational excellence. 
 - 5+ years of experience leading and operating production systems in a Site Reliability Engineering, Reliability Engineering role . 
 - 6+ years of experience working with Pega Workflows / PDC 
 - Pega PRPC architecture, rule types and case management with Proficiency in Datatypes. activities , Flows, Report definition , Decision rules etc. 
 - Experience in Debugging via Pega logs , Tracer logs and Hands on Experience in PDC to monitor application health and setup 
 - Manage and support BIX extracts
 - Experience in JVM/Tomcat based application servers
 - Linux commands and Shell script
 - Handle hotfix installation and manual deployment with Knowledge and experience in handling Pega upgrade and tech refresh
 - Understanding of Pega cloud architecture is added advantage
 - 5+ years of experience working with enterprise schedulers and databases, such as Autosys, Oracle, and MS SQL Server. 
 - 4+ years of experience supporting applications on Linux/ Unix
 - 4+ years of experience supporting applications on Kubernetes / OpenShift platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, traces, APM) using tools such as AppDynamics, ThousandEyes, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, and Aternity . 
 - Proven experience providing technical leadership and hands‐on execution in complex enterprise environments. 
 - Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non‐technical stakeholders. 
Desired Qualifications

- Strong scripting and automation skills using Unix/Linux shell, Python, or Ansible. 
 - Experience with cloud and container platforms, including Red Hat OpenShift (OCP) and modern cloud architecture concepts. 
 - Experience working with COTS platforms in regulated or large‐scale enterprise environments.

data.description:
About BlinkRx: 

BlinkRx is rebuilding how Americans access life-changing medicines. Today, only one in five prescriptions for new branded therapies are ever filled. The problem isn't the medicine. It's insurance barriers, affordability challenges, fragmented pharmacy experiences, and inadequate support that keep patients from starting and staying on treatment. Our mission is to change that. 

We built RxOS, the first AI-powered prescription operating system. RxOS connects the largest network of doctors, patients, pharmacies, payers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers, intelligently orchestrating every step to guarantee a seamless prescription journey for every script. 

Our teams solve complex, high-stakes problems at the intersection of artificial intelligence, healthcare operations, logistics, payments, and regulation. The impact is transformative: BlinkRx more than doubles the rate at which patients take their medications and lowers their out-of-pocket expenses by hundreds of dollars every month. 

BlinkRx created and leads a rapidly growing $80+ billion category, with exceptional momentum: 

- Built for scale: Over the past decade, we have invested nearly $1 billion in building the technology and operational platform required to serve patients at scale. 

- Proven growth and economics: We have grown 100% annually for the past five years, are profitable, and support more than 60 pharmaceutical brands. 

- Trusted with category-defining programs: Our technology powers a leading pharmaceutical manufacturer's direct-to-patient platform for its GLP-1 portfolio, providing the infrastructure to expand patient access as demand for these therapies grows. 

We are a dynamic team of technologists and industry experts seeking to build a generational company that delivers a genuine step change in American health.   

Responsibilities
 - Establish and evolve SRE best practices across the organization, including reliability principles, error budgets, incident response, postmortems, and operational readiness standards. 

- Define and drive observability strategy for system health, performance, and reliability, including SLIs/SLOs, alerting quality, dashboards, and service health indicators. 

- Design and implement software-driven solutions within the infrastructure domain, automating manual processes and eliminating operational complexity and toil. 

- Act as a technical leader and force multiplier, helping set priorities and influencing decision-making across core cloud infrastructure, reliability tooling, and platform architecture. 

- Take ownership of large, ambiguous initiatives, driving them from concept to delivery while aligning stakeholders across engineering, security, and product. 

- Combine deep knowledge of software development, infrastructure, and security to improve platform resilience, scalability, performance, and compliance. 

- Proactively identify systemic risks and reliability gaps, recommending and leading platform upgrades and architectural improvements before they become incidents. 

- Partner with engineering teams to improve developer workflows, tooling, and operational maturity, increasing productivity while reducing cognitive load. 

- Provide technical mentorship, architecture guidance, and high-quality design and code reviews for engineers across infrastructure and product teams. 

- Lead by example in documentation and knowledge sharing, ensuring systems and processes are well-understood and not dependent on individual ownership. 

- Participate in and help mature incident response, escalation practices, and post-incident learning across the organization. 

Desired Experience
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. 

- 10+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, infrastructure engineering, or platform engineering roles, with demonstrated impact at scale. 

Reliability & Troubleshooting
 - Expert-level, methodical troubleshooting across the entire stack, from application to kernel to network. 

- Strong command-line proficiency and deep expertise in Linux systems and operating system fundamentals. 

- Advanced understanding of networking concepts including load balancing, proxies, DNS, TCP/IP, NAT, and service-to-service communication. 

Software & Automation
 - Experience working across multiple languages (e. g. , Python, Go, Bash, and familiarity troubleshooting application stacks such as React or similar). 

- Strong track record of automating repetitive and complex operational work to reduce toil and increase reliability. 

- Ability to design and build internal tools (Python or Go) that standardize and scale engineering practices. 

- Comfortable operating in an agile environment, with disciplined testing and quality practices. 

Cloud & Platform Engineering
 - Deep experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, GCP/Azure acceptable), particularly managed services and production-grade architectures. 

- Strong expertise in Kubernetes and container orchestration (EKS, Helm), including lifecycle management and operational best practices. 

- Proven experience designing and implementing observability systems, including metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting. 

- Deep understanding of container technologies, security scanning, secrets management, dynamic configuration, and microservices architectures. 

- Familiarity with service meshes and advanced traffic management concepts. 

Infrastructure as Code
 - Experience designing and maintaining company-wide IaC codebases using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Ansible. 

- Ability to think holistically about infrastructure design, cost, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability. Why Join Us: 

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.   At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.   Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

Job Description: Technical Lead

Role Overview: 

We are seeking a DO-178C Software Engineer responsible for developing and verifying software lifecycle artifacts for avionics software systems. The engineer will work across multiple lifecycle stages defined in DO-178C, including requirements, design, coding, testing, and defect resolution. The role requires strong expertise in embedded software development, requirements-based verification, and lifecycle compliance.

- Develop DO-178C DAL-A compliant avionics software in accordance with DO-178C objectives.

 - Develop High-Level Test Cases (HLT) to verify compliance of software behavior with HLR. 
 - Develop Low-Level Test Cases (LLT) to verify detailed functional behavior defined in LLR.

 - Ensure bi-directional traceability between HLR, LLR, source code, and test cases. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support software integration and certification activities. 

Mandatory Skills

- Solid understanding of the software development life cycle defined in DO-178C, particularly for DAL B/A avionics software. 
 - Proven experience in developing and reviewing software lifecycle artifacts, including HLR, LLR, HLT, LLT, and source code. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in embedded software development using C on STM32/AVR-8 processor families
 - Good knowledge of real-time embedded systems. 
 - Ability to analyze defects, perform debugging, and implement bug fixes. 
 - Good Knowledge of configuration management tools such as git
 - Good organizational abilities. Good interpersonal skills, writing & verbal skills

Desired Skills

- Experience with IEC 61508 for functional safety concepts (including safety lifecycle activities and SIL-oriented verification/validation).

 - Experience with IEC 61784-3 communication profiles for industrial communication safety, including applications targeting the highest SIL level

Familiarity with tool qualification concepts and standard such as DO-330.

Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
