ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

The Role

AMD is looking for a Principal Member of Technical Staff (PMTS) to lead system and solution testing for our growing firmware team. As a key contributor, you will be part of a leading team that drives and enhances AMD's ability to deliver the highest-quality, industry-leading technologies to market. 

The Person

The ideal candidate has an innovative, problem-solving mindset and a keen eye for software engineering, and is diligent and passionate about technology. A successful candidate will bring strong knowledge of computer technologies, technical leadership skills and software engineering expertise, as well as a strong ability to compete effectively in a fast-paced environment while working with different teams of engineers and collaborators. As a technical leader, you will set the quality bar for the team, influence development teams and partners, and mentor the engineers around you. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define the system validation strategy, test architecture and release quality gates for firmware across AMD products. 
 - Validate new firmware and software features for AMD products at a system level before they are released to customers. 
 - Architect scalable automation frameworks and lab infrastructure for multi-node, cluster-scale testing. 
 - Leverage AI tools to accelerate the software validation cycle. 
 - Contribute actively to the day-to-day activities of the system test team in an Agile environment. 
 - Write test plans, review them with all stakeholders to cover the scenarios comprehensively, and execute them efficiently. 
 - Build maintainable, high-quality and effective automated test scripts. 
 - Review and triage test failures, and verify fixes. 
 - Help address customer-reported issues by reproducing them locally and working with peer teams for faster resolution. 
 - Stay informed of software and hardware trends and innovations, especially in firmware, CPUs, GPUs and accelerators. 
 - Debug complex technical issues and collaborate with peer teams. 
 - Develop technical relationships with peers and partners. 
 - Report quality status, risks and release readiness to program leadership. 
 - Mentor senior and junior engineers, and set the team's test engineering standards. 

Preferred Experience

- 15+ years of experience in system testing, validation or test automation, including 5+ years as a test architect or technical lead. 
 - Strong experience in firmware test and automation roles. 
 - Solid understanding of AI tools and how to leverage them in a large-scale distributed environment. 
 - Proficiency in writing automation scripts in Python, and experience with test and performance-testing tools. 
 - Solid understanding of automation frameworks, and fluency in Python. 
 - Prior experience with cloud, security and data center technologies is an added advantage. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills. 
 - Knowledge of operating systems, kernel-mode programming, device drivers, and related technologies and architectures. 
 - Good interpersonal and communication skills. 
 - Ability to write high-quality automation code with keen attention to detail. 
 - Good understanding of the Linux operating system and hypervisors (VMware ESX, KVM). 
 - Experience with software development processes and tools such as debuggers, source code control systems (GitHub) and profilers is a plus. 
 - Track record of defining test strategy and release quality gates, and of building automation frameworks used across teams. 
 - Experience leading customer escalations and influencing development teams and leadership. 
 - Experience testing firmware on CPU, GPU or SoC platforms at scale, including AI workloads on multi-node clusters, is a strong plus. 

Academic Credentials

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent.

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants' needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

The Job in short

At Backbase, we build AI-powered, secure, enterprise-grade digital banking software used daily by millions worldwide. With seamless integration, unified data, agentic AI, and a complete banking suite built for every line of business, you'll be building the next generation of banking. 

As a Senior iOS Engineer, you will drive the AI-native engineering of our product across the software development lifecycle, following and improving our way of working, and refining our best practices. You will lead the team in ensuring our practices are not only best practice and efficient but continually evolving and improving to use AI principles

Meet the job

You will help design, build and maintain one or more capabilities for the Backbase Mobile Platform, working closely with the Principal Engineers. 

You will be part of a multidisciplinary squad that is responsible for delivering an end-to-end solution, from initial concept to fruition in one of our production-ready applications. You will be tasked with addressing complex business requirements and with translating them into technical designs and implementations. You will be expected to deliver high-quality, well-engineered software that is performant, clean and is easy to maintain. 

As a squad member, you will contribute to all aspects of product development, starting from gathering feedback & requirements and implementing actual functionality, to writing tests, documentation and providing product adoption support to colleagues, customers and partners. 

As a Senior Mobile Engineer, you will be working in the Identity team, which builds Identity and Authentication journeys and components for the Backbase mobile banking applications for Retail, Business and Wealth customers. 

You will

- Platform Development: Help design, build, and maintain one or more capabilities for the Backbase Mobile Platform, working closely with the Principal Engineers. 
 - Engineering & Quality: 

Build, improve, and grow SDKs and libraries to revolutionise Identity and Authentication for mobile banking. 

Write clean, maintainable Swift code to create scalable features that other developers can use seamlessly. 

Developing features with native frameworks and cutting-edge Apple technologies, collaborating with others in the squad and other mobile squads to bring in the latest ways to develop. 

Responsible for upholding our engineering standards across the product, proactively proposing and leading initiatives within your squad to improve engineering excellence. 

- Agile & CI/CD: 

Automate testing while working closely with QAs to achieve an 80% minimum unit test coverage using frameworks like XCTest and XCUITest. 

You have a strong engineering culture in all parts of the SDLC, working in Agile practices to deliver a complete product. 

CI/CD practices are part of your mantra, ideally with Bitrise and GitHub Actions. 

- AI-Native Mindset: 

Showing an AI-Native mindset, you will proactively explore, experiment with, and apply AI tools and agentic frameworks (e. g. , code generation, test automation, dev productivity). 

Encourage AI adoption across engineering workflows and product capabilities. 

- Collaboration: Contribute to all aspects of product development, starting from gathering feedback & requirements and implementing actual functionality, to writing tests, documentation and providing product adoption support to colleagues, customers and partners. 

How About You

- Experience: 6+ years of professional experience in native iOS development. 
 - Languages: Strong proficiency in Swift and practical experience with Objective-C. 
 - Domain: Experience developing applications in the FinTech, Banking, or Payments space. 
 - Architecture: Expertise in modern iOS architectural patterns (e. g. , MVVM, VIPER, Clean Architecture) and development frameworks (e. g. , SwiftUI, UIKit, Combine/RxSwift). 
 - Concurrency & Integration: Solid experience integrating with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and asynchronous programming (e. g. , Grand Central Dispatch (GCD), async/await, Combine). 
 - Security & Tools: 

Strong understanding of mobile security best practices (e. g. , Keychain, Biometrics). 

Experience with version control systems like Git. 

- AI/ML Passion: 

You are passionate about embracing AI/ML tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, and Xcode (AI) and you enjoy shaping the product or platform's functionality with AI. 

Bonus Points (Preferred Experience)

- In-depth knowledge of mobile application security and data encryption standards
 - Experience with dependency managers like Swift Package Manager (SPM) or CocoaPods. 
 - Familiarity with mobile analytics, A/B testing, and crash reporting tools (e. g. , Firebase, Crashlytics). 
 - Experience with building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions). 
 - Published one or more iOS applications on the Apple App Store.

data.title: Power Apps Technical Lead — Power Pages & Dataverse
data.description:
Avanade is the world's leading Microsoft expert, helping more than 7, 000 organizations modernize securely and scale AI using Microsoft technology, faster. Founded by Microsoft and Accenture, and operating as Microsoft's Client Zero, Avanade brings deep expertise and proven delivery to simplify complexity, accelerate innovation, and deliver measurable results. 

Together with Accenture, Avanade combines global scale with expertise in AI, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and ERP to design solutions that put people first. With 60, 000 Microsoft professionals worldwide, 165, 000 certifications, and the largest community of Microsoft MVPs, Avanade has spent more than 25 years helping organizations unlock the full potential of people and technology to create lasting impact for clients, employees, and communities. 

Role Summary

Avanade India's Business Applications practice is looking for a Power Apps Technical Lead to own the technical design and build of applications on the Microsoft Power Platform - with Power Pages and Dataverse at the centre of the role. This is a hands-on lead position: you will set the technical direction, make the design calls, write the harder parts of the code yourself, and lead a team of developers through delivery. 

The role is deliberately weighted towards Power Pages and front-end engineering. We are looking for someone who is as comfortable with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Liquid as they are with a Dataverse security model - because externally facing portals are where those two worlds meet, and where most Power Platform projects run into trouble. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end technical design of Power Platform applications - solution architecture, Dataverse data model, security model, integration approach and front-end design - and document the decisions behind them. 
 - Lead the design and development of Power Pages sites: site structure and templates, web pages and web templates, Liquid, forms and lists, page and table permissions, authentication providers and external user access. 
 - Build rich, responsive front-end experiences on Power Pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Bootstrap - custom components, client-side validation, dynamic behaviour and integration with the Dataverse Web API. 
 - Design and build applications in Power Apps - model-driven and canvas apps - including forms, views, business rules, client scripting and app-level performance considerations. 
 - Design and implement Dataverse solutions: tables, columns and relationships, keys, calculated and rollup fields, business rules, and a security model built on roles, teams, business units and row/column-level security. 
 - Develop server-side extensions where required - plug-ins and custom APIs in C#/. NET - and integrate with external systems through REST APIs and the Dataverse Web API. 
 - Build custom controls with the Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) using TypeScript and React where out-of-the-box components fall short. 
 - Lead the development team day to day - task breakdown, technical guidance, code reviews, unblocking developers and holding the quality bar on what ships. 
 - Own ALM and release practice: solution layering and management, environment strategy, source control, deployment pipelines and configuration/data migration between environments. 
 - Set and enforce engineering standards - coding conventions, naming, reusable components, performance patterns, accessibility and security practices for public-facing sites. 
 - Translate functional requirements into technical designs with the functional and business analyst teams, and challenge requirements where a simpler or more sustainable approach exists. 
 - Own non-functional quality: performance and page-load optimisation for portals, caching, scalability, accessibility (WCAG) compliance and security hardening of externally exposed sites. 
 - Support estimation, sprint planning and technical risk identification, and give realistic delivery input to project and client leadership. 
 - Engage client technical stakeholders directly - design walkthroughs, technical discussions and issue resolution - and represent the technical position credibly. 
 - Mentor developers on the team, and contribute reusable components, templates and accelerators back to the practice. 

Qualifications

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 6 - 9 years of overall application development experience, with substantial recent delivery on the Microsoft Power Platform. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building applications with Power Apps - model-driven and/or canvas - taken through to production. 
 - Deep, demonstrable Power Pages (or Power Apps Portals) experience: web templates, Liquid, forms and lists, table and page permissions, web roles, authentication and external-facing site delivery. 
 - Strong front-end web development skills - HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), responsive design and Bootstrap - with the ability to build custom UI rather than only configure out-of-the-box components. 
 - Deep Dataverse expertise: data modelling, relationships, business rules, and a genuine command of the security model - roles, teams, business units, and row- and column-level security. 
 - Experience with the Dataverse Web API and REST integration patterns, including authentication and error handling. 
 - Server-side development capability in C#/. NET - plug-ins, custom APIs and custom workflow activities. 
 - Experience with Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) and TypeScript for custom control development. 
 - Solid ALM discipline: solution management, environment strategy, source control (Git) and automated or repeatable deployments. 
 - Proven experience as a technical lead - owning design decisions, running code reviews, guiding developers and being accountable for technical quality on an engagement. 
 - Ability to work directly with clients and functional teams, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and push back constructively where needed. 
 - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across the full stack - browser, portal runtime, Dataverse and integrations. 

Preferred / Good To Have

- Microsoft certifications: PL-400 (Power Platform Developer), PL-600 (Solution Architect) or PL-200. 
 - Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular or Vue) and build tooling. 
 - Experience delivering high-traffic or public-facing portals, including SEO, CDN and caching considerations. 
 - Familiarity with Azure services that commonly support Power Platform solutions - Azure Functions, API Management, Key Vault, Service Bus or Azure AD B2C for portal authentication. 
 - Experience with Dynamics 365 first-party apps built on Dataverse. 
 - Accessibility experience - WCAG 2. 1/2. 2 conformance and assistive-technology testing. 
 - Experience with automated testing for Power Platform solutions (unit tests for plug-ins, UI test automation). 
 - Experience in a global delivery / SI environment working with distributed teams. 
 - Prior contribution to reusable components, frameworks or practice accelerators.

data.title: Design Manager
data.description:
Company Description Schematic Engineering Industries Private Limited manufactures specialized isolators, glove boxes, and containment equipment that conform to cGMP standards for the pharmaceutical, chemical, and food industries. The company offers an extensive product range for application isolators used in API/bulk drugs and formulations, including sterility testing, capsule packing, micronising, filling lines, and centrifuges. With head offices in Sheffield, UK, and Hyderabad, India, Schematic designs and manufactures isolators tailored to specific end-user requirements. The team also integrates its solutions with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), such as filling line and packaging machines, providing complete containment and process solutions. This environment offers engineering professionals exposure to complex, customized projects and international collaboration. 

Role Description The Design Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for leading the design and development of isolators, glove boxes, and containment systems. The role involves managing a team of designers and engineers, planning design activities, allocating tasks, and ensuring that all projects meet technical, cGMP, and safety standards. The Design Manager will oversee concept development, detailed engineering, and design reviews, coordinating closely with production, quality, and project management teams to ensure seamless execution. They will collaborate with sales and customers to understand user requirements, translate them into practical designs, and adapt solutions for integration with OEM equipment such as filling and packaging lines. Day-to-day responsibilities also include maintaining design documentation, improving design processes and standards, mentoring team members, and supporting continuous innovation in product offerings. 

Qualifications

- Strong mechanical or process equipment design skills, including experience with containment systems or similar engineered products. 
 - Proficiency in CAD tools (e. g. , SolidWorks, Solid Edge, AutoCAD) and familiarity with design documentation, drawings, and BOM management. 
 - Knowledge of cGMP standards, pharmaceutical or chemical process requirements, and safety and compliance considerations. 
 - Demonstrated leadership and team management skills, including task planning, mentoring, and cross-functional coordination. 
 - Ability to manage customer requirements, translate specifications into design solutions, and collaborate with OEM partners. 
 - Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making abilities, with attention to detail and quality. 
 - Effective communication skills for working with international teams and presenting designs to internal and external stakeholders. 
 - Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a related discipline; experience in pharmaceutical engineering or equipment design is an advantage. 
 - Experience in project management, design process improvement, and documentation control is beneficial. Detailed responsibilitiesTechnical ownership•          Review customer URS, order scope, exclusions, process needs and risk classification; establish the design basis and allocate engineering work. 

•          Approve GA, P&ID, calculations, 3D assemblies, fabrication drawings, bought-out specifications and BOMs before release. 

•          Ensure pressure/vacuum, structural, thermal, airflow, ergonomic, lifting and transport calculations are performed to the level required by project risk. 

•          Lead technical decisions for isolator architecture, airflow/pressure cascade, HEPA arrangement, VHP distribution, glove/RTP interfaces, decontamination boundaries and maintenance strategy, with specialist inputs where required. 

Design governance and standardisation•          Maintain standard modules, drawing templates, material specifications, approved components, design checklists and lessons-learned database. 

•          Control design revisions and prevent uncontrolled changes after approval; quantify cost and schedule impact before accepting customer changes. 

•          Drive value engineering without weakening containment, GMP, safety, reliability or lifecycle serviceability. 

•          Review recurring NCRs, FAT punch points and service failures and implement permanent design corrections. 

Team and project delivery•          Prepare engineering schedules linked to project milestones and balance workloads across multiple custom projects. 

•          Conduct concept, 30/60/90-percent and pre-release design reviews; record decisions, owners and closure dates. 

•          Coach engineers in Solid Edge, sheet metal, fabrication, tolerance, hygienic design and design documentation. 

•          Coordinate daily with Projects, Production, QA/QC, Purchase and Automation to remove execution constraints. 

Customer and compliance interface•          Represent engineering in customer design reviews and explain technical solutions, limitations and deviations with evidence. 

•          Ensure compliance with customer URS and applicable cGMP, machinery safety, electrical interface, pressure/vacuum and export-market requirements. 

•          Support FAT/SAT, technical investigations and critical field modifications. 

Cross-functional working and operating discipline•          Work in an engineered-to-order environment where customer URS, layout, process, containment, automation and documentation requirements vary from project to project. 

•          Use SAP and approved document-control systems for BOMs, material status, project records and release control, as applicable to the position. 

•          Follow Schematic's quality system, EHS requirements, confidentiality obligations and change-control process; do not release unapproved drawings, software, documents or commercial commitments. 

•          Coordinate constructively across Sales, Applications, Design, Automation, Purchase, Production, QA/QC, Projects, Service and Finance rather than working as an isolated function. 

Performance measures Measure

Expected evidence

Engineering on-time delivery

Design milestones achieved without delaying procurement or production

Design quality

Reduction in design-origin NCR, rework, cost leakage and FAT punch points

Standardisation

Increasing reuse of verified modules and reduction in engineering hours per comparable project

Change control

No uncontrolled scope/design release; cost and schedule impacts documented

Team capability

Skill matrix improvement, review discipline and successor development

Required experience and competencies•          Strong experience in engineered stainless-steel equipment, preferably pharmaceutical containment, isolators, cleanroom/process equipment or special-purpose machinery. 

•          Advanced 3D CAD and drawing-review capability; Solid Edge preferred. 

•          Working knowledge of stainless-steel fabrication, TIG welding, polishing, seals, filters, instrumentation and pneumatic systems. 

•          Ability to lead customer-facing technical reviews and make risk-based decisions. 

Expected outcomes in the first six months•          Establish a visible engineering plan and review cadence for all active projects. 

•          Identify the top recurring design failures and issue controlled standard corrections. 

•          Release at least one major project to production with documented design-basis and review closure. 

Candidate discussionShortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss one or two relevant projects personally handled, the exact responsibility taken, calculations/drawings/data used, problems encountered, decisions made and measurable result achieved. Samples may be shown only if they do not violate a current or former employer's confidentiality. 

Note: This JD defines the present scope of the role. Project allocation and reporting interfaces may be adjusted according to business requirements, while maintaining appropriate authority and accountability.

data.description:
NFC‐based platforms are at the heart of secure connected experiences across mobile, wearables, automotive, and IoT ecosystems. They span domains such as secure NFC transactions, digital wallets, infrastructure services, platform enablement, and low-level silicon integration. As a Firmware Architect in the NFC Firmware organization, you will contribute to defining and delivering robust firmware architectures that operate close to silicon and enable reliable product execution across multiple NFC use cases. 

This role focuses on platform firmware architecture and execution for PCRM, low-level platform software, tapeout readiness, and post-silicon bring-up, while collaborating across hardware, systems, validation, and firmware development teams. 

We are looking for a hands-on firmware technologist with strong embedded/firmware roots, good understanding of real-time systems and SoC platforms, and practical experience translating system and hardware requirements into clean, scalable firmware designs. 

Your Responsibilities

- She/He shall work as an NFC Firmware Architect and contribute to new product development, debugging, bring-up, and maintenance of NXP's embedded firmware for NFC products. 
 - Define and support firmware architecture for RISC-V/ARM platform. 
 - Derive firmware requirements from system, hardware, PCRM, and customer specifications. 
 - Design firmware sub-systems and low-level software components to meet functional, performance, memory, timing, and power requirements. 
 - Review design and code contributions, provide technical guidance, and help maintain quality of firmware deliverables. 
 - Own one or more firmware modules or platform software sub-systems from design through integration and bring-up. 
 - Define and write firmware design specifications, interface specifications, and low-level platform software documentation. 
 - Support definition of validation and bring-up environments for pre-silicon, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon phases. 
 - Contribute to firmware test strategy at unit, integration, system, and silicon bring-up levels. 
 - Support tapeout readiness activities by reviewing firmware dependencies, register/interface assumptions, boot flows, and hardware-software integration risks. 
 - Closely interact with hardware development teams, system architects, validation teams, and component technical experts to resolve low-level integration issues. 
 - Collaborate effectively with partner teams and ensure firmware architecture considers product, platform, and silicon constraints. 
 - Define firmware design guidelines, development flows, debug approaches, and bring-up checklists for platform software. 

Your Profile

- Mandatory: 
 - 8-12 years of embedded firmware development experience, preferably in SoC, mobile, secure embedded, or RTOS-based embedded systems. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electronics & Communication, Power Electronics from reputed institute with strong academic records. 
 - Embedded software design and development on 8/16/32-bit platforms, preferably RISC-V and ARM architectures. 
 - Excellent C programming skills, exposure to assembly with hands-on development experience. 
 - Must have experience in low-level firmware programming, including boot flows, boot loaders, interrupt handling, memory maps, clocks, power states, SPI/I2C/UART drivers, RF interfaces, and embedded RTOS concepts. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of RTOS, its concepts and usage. 
 - Good knowledge of SoC hardware IP datasheets, register-level programming, hardware-software interfaces, and low-level driver development. 
 - Hands-on exposure to PCRM topics, platform configuration, reset/clock/power management, and low-level initialization flows. 
 - Experience supporting tapeout and bring-up activities, including pre-silicon validation on RTL, FPGA/emulation usage, post-silicon debug, and issue triage with hardware teams. 
 - Exposure to IDEs like LPCXpresso, Keil, Eclipse
 - Experience in using Debuggers. (TRAC32/J-LINK/LPC-LINK)
 - Exposure to change management / configuration management, bug tracking tools. 
 - Hands-on with AI based efficiency gaining tools. 
 - Optional
 - Exposure to C++ / C#, Perl/Python is an added advantage
 - Good understanding of NFC technology. 
 - Personality
 - Excellent analytical, problem solving, debugging skills & influencing skills with go-to attitude
 - Self-motivated, proactive, good verbal and written communication. 
 - Sufficiently mobile and flexible, work location based out of Bangalore
 - Experienced in requirements derivation, low-level design, high-level design, and hands-on implementation in platform firmware domains. 
 - Empathic communicator, able to see things from the other person's point of view and a good team player with cross functional, cross cultural & Global teams
Desired Skill Set

- Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC) for embedded firmware development
 - Knowledge of embedded platforms, low-level platform software, and close collaboration with hardware teams is preferred. 
 - Understanding of tapeout milestones, silicon bring-up planning, debug instrumentation, and hardware-software readiness criteria. 
 - Know-how of smart card Contact less Proximity Standards such as ISO14443, ISO15693, ISO18092, ISO7816 etc. 
 - Near Field Communication Standards.

About The Team

Walmart's Marketplace is the backbone of a thriving ecosystem connecting millions of third-party sellers to hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. Role Overview

Distinguished Engineer is one of the most coveted technical IC titles at Walmart - and this role lives up to it. As a Distinguished Engineer on the Marketplace team within Growth Tech, you will be developing services that helps millions of sellers to leverage Walmart Fulfilment Services. Your world-class expertise in distributed systems, API design, and platform engineering will be paired with a Al-forward mindset. 

This is a high-impact role sitting at the intersection of scale, commerce, and platform engineering. You will own the technical vision and execution for a portfolio of mission-critical, cross-cutting services that enables Seller through Seller Center UI and APIs. You will be the technical standard-setter across all of it.

The Walmart Fulfilment Services team is essential to the Marketplace ecosystem, responsible for designing and scaling the global platform that supports the complete seller fulfilment within Walmart marketplace journey. The team develops robust global workflows, and complex multi-platform integrations connecting cloud microservices, seller portals, and AI-driven analytics. You will own Architecture, design, development and delivery of Seller journey, addressing distributed systems challenges, optimize APIs, and establish architectural standards to enable international marketplace growth.

Solve complex problems considering performance, reliability and scalability

Prototype new solutions rapidly using Al-augmented development workflows and then drive them to production quality

Conduct deep-dive code reviews that raise the technical bar of the team. 

Own the full software development lifecycle for your initiatives involving design, development, testing, deployment, observability

Complex Problem Solving

Challenge technical assumptions early in the design process before they become expensive production mistakes

Navigate ambiguity with confidence by breaking down underspecified problems into structured technical approaches and drive alignment across stakeholders

Design for resilience from first principles. Define and own the platform's non-functional requirements

Instrument systems to be deeply observable and use the signals to drive continuous improvement

Build runbooks and operational playbooks that enable the broader team to operate the services confidently

This role is Al-forward by design and needs someone who actively shapes how it is used and pushes the frontier of what Al-augmented engineering looks like at scale.

Work with engineering leadership to identify and prioritize investments where Al creates the most leverage across teams

Contribute to the broader Walmart engineering community's understanding of how to build and operate Al-augmented systems responsibly

Distinguished Engineers at Walmart lead through technical gravity. Your impact multiplies across teams. 

Raise the floor - your code reviews, design feedback, and written standards lift the quality of every engineer in the team

When a team is stuck on a systems design challenge or a production crisis, you are the person who helps unblock

Your architectural decisions today shape the technical capabilities and codebase for the future

Grow technical depth across the org through tech talks, design reviews, RFCs, and hands-on pairing, you are a force multiplier for technical growth across Growth Tech

Bridge platform and product translate complex technical constraints into clear trade-offs that inform product decisions; translate product ambitions into technically sound, phased engineering strategies

data.description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business-it is our business. We boldly go.

data.title: AI Engineering Lead
data.description:
About Flutter Entertainment

Flutter Entertainment is the world's largest sports betting and iGaming operator with 15. 9 million Average Monthly Players worldwide and an annual revenue of $16. 4 billion in 2025. We have a portfolio of iconic brands , including FanDuel, Paddy Power, Betfair, PokerStars, Sisal, and Sportsbet. 

Flutter Entertainment is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). We're proud to be recognized by TIME as one of the World's Best Companies 2025 - a reflection of the passion and commitment of our colleagues across the globe. 

FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT INDIA

Our office in the heart of Hi-Tech City , Hyderabad, serves as Flutter Entertainment's Global Capability Center (GCC). Now home to 1, 000+ talented colleagues, we are shaping the future of entertainment across critical areas such as Customer Support Operations, Data & Technology, Business Operations (Finance, HR, Procurement), and HR Tech & Analytics. 

Our Values define us. They are - Build Better Together, Own Every Outcome, Stay Curious and Grow, and Raise the Bar Every day. 

They're how we collaborate, grow, lead, and show up for each other every single day. 

Overview Of The Role

Flutter Functions' AI & Automation team is looking for an expert AI Engineering Lead to build and lead a unit of 2-3 AI developers. You will be responsible for the technical vision and execution of Flutter's enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms , using internal data to enhance productivity and decision-making across our global sports betting and gaming operations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role combining AI engineering, architecture, people leadership and cross-functional teamwork . You will shape engineering standards, make key architectural decisions, mentor your team, and help deliver production-grade AI systems serving over 20 million customers across 20+ regulated markets. 

What You Will Do

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Set the technical direction for our enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms, making architectural decisions across LLM inference, agentic frameworks, context engineering, guardrails and system design . 
 - Own the selection, deployment and optimisation of LLM inference systems including AWS Bedrock and LiteLLM , with a focus on model routing, cost, latency and operational excellence. 
 - Design production-grade context pipelines, RAG systems and prompt architectures , establishing patterns, standards and evaluation practices for the team. 
 - Guide architectural decisions around token economics, context limits, latency budgets and capability-to-cost trade-offs . 
 - Establish robust guardrails, security and Responsible AI practices , addressing prompt injection, data leakage, authentication, access control and sensitive data handling across regulated markets. 
 - Make informed technology choices across agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Strands and ADK , and establish scalable orchestration and tool-use patterns. 
 - Own problems end-to-end, from LLM integration and backend services through to user-facing interfaces, APIs and integrations using AWS services, MCP and modern engineering standards . 

People Leadership

- Build, lead and mentor a pod of 2-3 AI developers , supporting their technical and career growth. 
 - Establish engineering standards through code reviews, architectural guidance and continuous technical development . 
 - Lead the team through production incidents, complex technical challenges and post-mortems, driving systemic improvements. 
 - Develop a culture of learning, experimentation, psychological safety and continuous improvement , while encouraging the team to challenge assumptions and take calculated technical risks. 

Collaboration & Delivery

- Partner with product managers and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and prioritise high-impact work. 
 - Collaborate with data scientists and platform engineering teams to integrate AI solutions into Flutter's existing infrastructure. 
 - Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, present architectural decisions to leadership, and influence technical direction across teams. 

TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED

Core Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI or a related STEM field , with 8-12 years of software development experience, including 2-3+ years focused on AI/ML or agentic systems development. 
 - Experience leading or mentoring technical teams , with the ability to establish technical direction and drive delivery through others. 
 - Advanced Python and backend engineering skills, including production experience with FastAPI, Flask and async patterns . 
 - Hands-on expertise with AWS Bedrock, LiteLLM or similar LLM inference platforms , including model routing, API design, cost optimisation and production deployment. 
 - Strong experience in context engineering, RAG and prompt architecture , and ability to evaluate trade-offs and design production-grade solutions. 
 - Deep experience with 2-3+ agentic frameworks , such as LangChain, LangGraph, Strands, ADK or CrewAI , including orchestration, tool use and multi-agent patterns. 
 - Experience designing and implementing guardrails, content filtering and Responsible AI practices in production environments. 
 - Strong AI security fundamentals , including prompt injection, data exfiltration, model misuse, OAuth, JWT and least-privilege design. 
 - Proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or OpenCode , and ability to validate AI-generated code and guide others in their use. 
 - Expert knowledge of software engineering fundamentals , including SDLC, Git, API design, system architecture and collaborative engineering. 
 - Exceptional communication and influencing skills - ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and build consensus without relying on formal authority. 

Highly Desirable Skills

- Full-stack experience across React, TypeScript, backend services and AI integration . 
 - Hands-on experience designing and operating production RAG systems and vector databases , including Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch or Weaviate. 
 - Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its implementation in AI agent systems. 
 - Contributions to AI/ML or agentic open-source frameworks such as LangChain or CrewAI. 
 - Experience in gaming, sports betting, financial services or other heavily regulated environments . 
 - A track record of growing engineers, building high-performing teams or leading technical initiatives that delivered material business impact. 
 - Demonstrated curiosity and thought leadership in AI, with an appetite for emerging technologies and the ability to form and defend informed technology choices. 

Benefits We Offer

- Access to Learnerbly, Udemy, and a Self-Development Fund for upskilling. 
 - Career growth through Internal Mobility Programs. 
 - Comprehensive Health Insurance for you and dependents. 
 - Coverage of OPD Consultations and Full Body health checkup every year. 
 - Well-Being Fund and 24/7 Assistance Program for holistic wellness. 
 - Hybrid Model: 2 office days/week with flexible leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and sabbaticals. 
 - Free Meals, Cab Allowance, and a Home Office Setup Allowance. 
 - Employer PF Contribution, gratuity, Personal Accident & Life Insurance. 
 - Sharesave Plan to purchase discounted company shares. 
 - Volunteering Leave and Team Events to build connections. 
 - Recognition through the Kudos Platform and Referral Rewards. 

WHY CHOOSE US

Flutter is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. We are committed to a fair and inclusive recruitment process where every candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed, with hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential. 

We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future. Here's an opportunity for you to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Flutter Entertainment India. 

If you're passionate about this opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Your skills, experiences, and perspective could make you a great fit for our team.

data.title: Java Engineer – Spring Boot, GraphQL & AWS
data.description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking an experienced Backend Java Developer / Technical Lead with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot microservices, cloud technologies, and modern software engineering practices. 

The role will lead a team of 5+ software engineers while designing, developing, and delivering scalable enterprise applications. The position will focus on Spring Boot microservices, GraphQL APIs, NoSQL DocumentDB solutions, Angular 20 collaboration, Azure Active Directory integration, AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring, and application reliability. 

This role will contribute to business objectives by delivering secure, maintainable, and high-performing applications, improving engineering quality, supporting cloud-native development, and enabling reliable delivery across the software development lifecycle. 

Software Requirements

Required Software Skills

- Java: 7-12 years of professional software development experience with strong Java expertise. 
 - Spring Boot: Hands-on experience with the latest version of Spring Boot for microservices development. 
 - Microservices: Strong understanding of microservices architecture patterns, scalability, reliability, maintainability, service communication, and deployment. 
 - Angular: Working knowledge of Angular 20 and experience collaborating on responsive web applications. 
 - GraphQL: Experience designing and implementing GraphQL APIs for efficient data querying and manipulation. 
 - NoSQL DocumentDB: Experience designing, developing, optimizing, and supporting DocumentDB solutions. 
 - Azure Active Directory: Hands-on experience integrating Azure Active Directory for authentication and authorization. 
 - CI/CD: Strong experience with CI/CD tools and processes, including Bamboo, AWS DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent tools. 
 - AWS: Practical experience managing AWS services, specifically EC2 and S3. 
 - REST APIs: Strong understanding of RESTful API design, integration, security, and support. 
 - Monitoring and logging: Familiarity with Splunk and Grafana for application monitoring, logging, dashboards, alerting, and troubleshooting. 
 - Source control and development practices: Experience with version control, code reviews, testing, documentation, coding standards, and secure software development. 
 - Team leadership: Prior experience leading, mentoring, or managing a team of 5+ software engineers. 

Preferred Software Skills

- Experience supporting application migration projects. 
 - Experience with additional AWS services and cloud-native technologies. 
 - Familiarity with automated testing, deployment validation, rollback, and release-management practices. 
 - Exposure to application performance monitoring, distributed tracing, and production observability. 
 - Experience with modern architecture patterns for resilient, scalable, and maintainable enterprise applications. 

Version And Experience Guidance

- Java experience must align with the enterprise application and Spring Boot versions used in the assigned environment. 
 - Candidates must have hands-on experience with the latest version of Spring Boot applicable to the role. 
 - Angular 20 experience is required as specified in the requirement details. 
 - Specific versions are not prescribed for AWS services, DocumentDB, CI/CD tools, Splunk, or Grafana; candidates should have experience with current, production-supported versions. 
 - Candidates should be able to assess compatibility, support upgrades, document changes, and follow controlled release practices. 

Overall Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 5+ software engineers to deliver high-quality solutions on schedule. 
 - Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable microservices using Java and the latest version of Spring Boot. 
 - Apply microservices architecture patterns to support scalability, reliability, maintainability, performance, and operational resilience. 
 - Design and implement GraphQL APIs for efficient data querying, manipulation, integration, and application access. 
 - Design, develop, and optimize NoSQL DocumentDB solutions based on business and application requirements. 
 - Collaborate with frontend engineers on Angular 20 applications to support responsive, reliable, and high-performing web solutions. 
 - Integrate Azure Active Directory for application authentication, authorization, access control, and secure service interaction. 
 - Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, quality validation, and deployment. 
 - Configure and manage AWS infrastructure, including EC2 and S3. 
 - Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and cloud-native application services. 
 - Configure and monitor applications using Splunk and Grafana. 
 - Investigate and resolve application, integration, performance, deployment, and production issues. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, architects, frontend engineers, infrastructure teams, security teams, and other stakeholders. 
 - Enforce coding standards, security practices, testing standards, documentation requirements, and code-review processes. 
 - Support application migration projects where applicable. 
 - Track delivery progress, risks, dependencies, quality, technical decisions, and implementation outcomes. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies and promote continuous improvement in architecture, engineering practices, automation, and operational support. 
 - Contribute to measurable outcomes such as timely delivery, reduced defects, improved performance, reliable releases, application availability, and efficient resource utilization. 

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages

Essential

- Strong Java development experience. 
 - Understanding of object-oriented programming, design principles, exception handling, collections, concurrency, and maintainable code design. 
 - Ability to develop scalable, modular, testable, and production-ready backend services. 
 - Ability to review code, guide implementation, and enforce Java development standards. 

Preferred

- Experience with additional programming languages used in cloud-native application development. 
 - Familiarity with scripting for deployment, monitoring, automation, and operational support. 
 - Experience developing reusable libraries, shared services, and platform components. 

Databases/Data Management

Essential

- Experience with NoSQL DocumentDB databases. 
 - Ability to design data models, collections, indexes, queries, and access patterns based on application requirements. 
 - Understanding of data consistency, availability, scalability, performance, and data-integrity considerations. 
 - Experience optimizing database queries and application data access. 
 - Understanding of data protection, controlled access, retention, and recovery requirements. 

Preferred

- Experience with additional NoSQL or relational database technologies. 
 - Familiarity with database migration, data validation, indexing strategies, and performance tuning. 
 - Exposure to distributed data patterns, caching, replication, and high-volume application workloads. 
 - Experience supporting database changes through CI/CD and controlled release processes. 

Cloud Technologies

Essential

- Practical experience managing AWS EC2 and S3. 
 - Understanding of cloud-native application development and deployment. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure configuration, access management, connectivity, monitoring, and operational support. 
 - Understanding of scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable cloud application design. 
 - Ability to support applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments. 

Preferred

- Experience with additional AWS services. 
 - Familiarity with containerization, orchestration, serverless services, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Experience supporting cloud migration and application modernization initiatives. 
 - Understanding of cloud cost optimization, resource management, and sustainable application operations. 

Frameworks and Libraries

Essential

- Java and Spring Boot, using the latest applicable version. 
 - Spring-based microservices development. 
 - Angular 20 collaboration and frontend integration. 
 - GraphQL API development. 
 - RESTful API design and integration. 
 - NoSQL DocumentDB development and optimization. 
 - Azure Active Directory integration. 
 - CI/CD tools and practices, including Bamboo, AWS DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent. 
 - Splunk and Grafana for logging, monitoring, dashboards, alerting, and troubleshooting. 

Preferred

- Additional Spring ecosystem components and API-development frameworks. 
 - Libraries supporting authentication, authorization, validation, resilience, observability, and asynchronous processing. 
 - Tools supporting application migration, automated testing, deployment validation, and rollback. 
 - Frameworks supporting distributed tracing, metrics, and production diagnostics. 

Development Tools and Methodologies

Essential

- Experience across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, production support, and maintenance. 
 - Experience leading and mentoring a team of 5+ engineers. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipeline design, implementation, maintenance, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with version control, code reviews, automated testing, defect management, and release processes. 
 - Ability to create technical designs, API specifications, database designs, deployment procedures, operational documentation, and support guides. 
 - Familiarity with Agile delivery practices, iterative development, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Ability to track delivery progress, risks, dependencies, quality, and technical decisions. 
 - Experience applying secure coding standards, architecture practices, and maintainability principles. 

Preferred

- Experience with application migration and modernization projects. 
 - Familiarity with deployment strategies such as rolling, blue-green, or canary releases. 
 - Experience implementing automated quality, security, and performance checks in CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Exposure to DevOps practices, infrastructure as code, containerization, and release automation. 
 - Experience establishing engineering standards, reusable patterns, and development accelerators. 

Security Protocols

Essential

- Hands-on experience integrating Azure Active Directory for authentication and authorization. 
 - Understanding of identity management, role-based access control, permissions, and least-privilege principles. 
 - Ability to secure REST and GraphQL APIs. 
 - Understanding of secure coding, input validation, output validation, credential protection, and secrets management. 
 - Ability to apply security controls across application code, APIs, databases, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS infrastructure. 
 - Awareness of risks related to unauthorized access, insecure APIs, data exposure, vulnerable dependencies, and misconfigured cloud resources. 
 - Ability to follow security, privacy, auditability, and change-control requirements. 

Preferred

- Experience with OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, token validation, and service-to-service authentication. 
 - Familiarity with application security testing, dependency scanning, vulnerability remediation, and security monitoring. 
 - Experience integrating security checks into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Understanding of cloud security controls for EC2, S3, identity, network access, and application services. 

Experience Requirements

- Overall experience: 7-12 years of professional software development experience with strong expertise in Java. 
 - Backend experience: Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, microservices, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, cloud-native development, and enterprise application architecture. 
 - Frontend collaboration: Working knowledge of Angular 20 and experience collaborating on frontend development and integration. 
 - Database experience: Experience with NoSQL DocumentDB solutions, data modelling, query optimization, performance, scalability, and data access. 
 - Cloud experience: Practical experience managing AWS EC2 and S3, with an understanding of cloud infrastructure and application operations. 
 - Security experience: Hands-on experience integrating Azure Active Directory for authentication and authorization. 
 - Delivery experience: Strong experience with CI/CD tools and processes, including Bamboo, AWS DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent tools. 
 - Leadership experience: Prior experience as a technical lead or manager responsible for a team of 5+ software engineers. 
 - Industry preference: Experience delivering enterprise-scale, cloud-native, highly available, or business-critical applications is preferred. 
 - Alternative experience pathways: Equivalent combinations of relevant professional experience, technical leadership, substantial application implementations, open-source contributions, or demonstrable production outcomes may be considered. 
 - Outcome evidence: Candidates should demonstrate contributions to timely delivery, improved application quality, reduced defects, improved performance, reliable production releases, team development, or successful application migration. 

Day-to-Day Activities

data.title: Principal/Senior Software Engineer - Mobile App Monetization (Ad Server)
data.description:
About The Role

PubMatic is seeking an experienced and technically strong Principal Software Engineer to lead the design and development of next-generation Mobile App Monetization capabilities. This role is focused on building high-performance, low-latency, scalable, and privacy-safe systems that help maximize publisher revenue from in-app inventory while improving DSP and buyer spend efficiency. 

The role requires a deep understanding of mobile app advertising, SSP-DSP RTB workflows, OpenRTB mobile signals, SDK/mediation integrations, traffic shaping, QPS optimization, mobile attribution, privacy constraints, and performance advertising. The engineer will work on systems that monetize mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app-open, playable, and video ads. 

The ideal candidate is a seasoned backend engineer with strong ad-tech domain expertise and experience building real-time auction, targeting, decisioning, and optimization systems. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketplace Quality, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, and SRE to build ML-integrated and data-driven monetization systems that improve yield, bid rate, win rate, fill rate, attribution readiness, latency, and reliability across PubMatic's mobile app ecosystem. 

What You'll Do

- Architect and implement scalable backend services powering mobile app monetization, extracting, transforming, and optimizing in-app behavioral data using on-device computation, data aggregation, and differential privacy techniques so that publishers can still deliver targeted ads and measure performance without accessing persistent, individual user identities. 
 - Build and optimize SSP-DSP integration workflows for mobile app inventory, including app bundle validation, device and geo signal handling, privacy-aware user signal processing, bid response handling, loss reason analysis, and DSP-specific troubleshooting. 
 - Design mobile-specific traffic shaping and QPS optimization systems that prioritize high-value in-app inventory based on bid probability, win probability, spend potential, app quality, device signals, geo value, ad format, consent availability, and DSP buying behavior. 
 - Improve runtime handling for Mobile App ad formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app-open, playable, and in-app video, including format eligibility, creative compatibility, response validation, tracking, completion, and reward-callback correctness. 
 - Build capabilities that improve buyer/DSP compatibility for MApp inventory, ensuring buyers receive well-represented, privacy-compliant, format-compatible, attribution-ready, and supply-quality-aware mobile app requests. 
 - Develop systems and diagnostics to improve Mobile App supply quality, including app bundle validation, app store metadata checks, app-ads. txt, sellers. json, SupplyChain object validation, app spoofing detection, invalid traffic indicators, device/geo inconsistency checks, and low-quality partner supply detection. 
 - Support privacy-aware and attribution-ready Mobile App advertising, including ATT/IDFA handling, AAID availability, consent enforcement, COPPA/child-directed treatment, SKAN readiness, MMP signal passing, click/impression tracking, and privacy-safe fallback when user-level identifiers are unavailable. 
 - Partner with MApp SDK and OpenBid/S2S integration teams to define signal-quality standards, request-field expectations, placement/ad-unit semantics, tracking requirements, and partner feedback loops for Mobile App supply. 
 - Build publisher-facing and buyer-facing diagnostics for MApp inventory, including missing-field reports, app quality signals, buyer no-bid diagnostics, fill and eCPM diagnostics, tracking mismatch analysis, attribution readiness, and supply-path quality insights. 
 - Work with DSP Partnerships and Marketplace Quality teams to improve buyer confidence in PubMatic's MApp supply by addressing format compatibility, attribution readiness, privacy eligibility, fraud risk, supply transparency, and app inventory quality. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Publisher teams, DSP Partnerships, Marketplace Quality, MApp SDK, OpenBid/S2S integrations, and SRE to define and execute the roadmap for differentiated Mobile App advertising capabilities. 
 - Champion operational excellence for Mobile App advertising systems through strong observability, reason codes, structured logs, dashboards, alerts, safe rollouts, latency protection, production debugging, and cross-team incident response. 

We'd Love for You to Have

- Five plus years of backend engineering experience, with a proven track record of building high-scale, low-latency systems, preferably in mobile app advertising, SSP, DSP, ad exchange, mediation, mobile SDK, app-install, or programmatic AdTech domains. 
 - Strong knowledge of mobile app inventory signals, including app bundle, app store URL, SDK version, placement type, rewarded indicator, device ID, IDFA, AAID, IDFV, OS version, carrier, connection type, geo, consent status, and ad format metadata. 
 - Familiarity with mobile ad formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app-open, playable, and in-app video ads, including how each format impacts pricing, buyer demand, creative rendering, tracking, and user experience. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile performance advertising concepts such as app-install campaigns, CPI, CPA, ROAS, retention, lifetime value, post-install events, retargeting where allowed, and buyer outcome optimization. 
 - Experience or strong familiarity with mobile attribution and measurement ecosystems, including MMPs, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular, Firebase, SKAdNetwork, Android attribution changes, click tracking, impression tracking, and delayed/aggregated conversion signals. 
 - Strong knowledge of mobile privacy and compliance constraints, including Apple ATT, IDFA availability, Android Advertising ID, SKAdNetwork, Google Privacy Sandbox for Android, COPPA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, TCF, GPP, and do-not-sell/share flags. 
 - Practical knowledge of mobile supply quality and fraud prevention, including app bundle spoofing, SDK spoofing, device spoofing, geo mismatch, VPN/proxy traffic, click injection, click spam, invalid traffic, app-ads. txt, sellers. json, and SupplyChain object validation. 
 - Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset, strong ownership, and ability to work cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, Marketplace Quality, and SRE. 

Bonus Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with mobile monetization SDKs, client-server ad request flows, mediation logic, in-app bidding, server-side bidding, waterfalls, or unified auction systems. 
 - Contributions to open-source AdTech projects such as Prebid Mobile, RTBkit, OpenRTB tools, header bidding libraries, or mobile SDK/ad-serving frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with industry-standard ML model-serving infrastructure designed for real-time inference in high-QPS, low-latency environments. 
 - Understanding of mobile user acquisition, performance DSPs, app-install campaigns, MMP integrations, and attribution platforms. 
 - Experience working with incrementality measurement, retargeting systems, audience segmentation, cohort-based optimization, or privacy-safe targeting for mobile performance marketing. 
 - Exposure to privacy-preserving user ID solutions such as UID2. 0, RampID, publisher first-party IDs, hashed identifiers where allowed, and frameworks such as SKAdNetwork for iOS post-ATT monetization. 
 - Experience with cross-format mobile monetization strategies, including combining rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app-open, playable, and video monetization within the same app session. 
 - Familiarity with real-time analytics pipelines used to measure mobile monetization KPIs such as bid rate, win rate, fill rate, eCPM, revenue, QPS efficiency, timeout rate, attribution feedback, buyer spend, and yield efficiency. 
 - Publications, patents, internal platform leadership, or speaking engagements in mobile monetization, AdTech infrastructure, RTB optimization, privacy-safe advertising, or ML for AdTech. 

Why Join Us?

- Work on high-scale mobile monetization infrastructure that directly impacts publisher revenue, DSP spend, and advertiser outcomes across the in-app advertising ecosystem. 
 - Help shape the future of ML-powered mobile monetization, real-time ad decisioning, traffic shaping, attribution readiness, and privacy-safe performance advertising. 
 - Build systems that improve monetization across premium mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app-open, playable, and video ads. 
 - Collaborate with industry-leading engineers, product teams, machine learning experts, DSP partners, publisher teams, and marketplace quality teams. 
 - Competitive compensation, performance-based incentives, and strong career growth opportunities in a globally recognized AdTech company. 

AI-Enabled Engineering Mindset

We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e. g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc. ) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high-scale, performance-critical environment. 

Qualifications

- Should have a bachelor's degree in engineering (CS / IT) or equivalent degree from well-known Institutes / Universities. 

Additional Information

Return to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. 

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. 

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

The Quality Assurance Lead - Data Fabric (India) is the on-site QA leader for Infor's India-based Data Fabric quality team.  - Test strategy & automation: test design, risk-based coverage, regression suites, and CI/CD-integrated automation (Playwright/TypeScript or equivalent; API/REST testing) across all components. 
 - Data quality & validation: SQL-based validation, ETL/data-integration and data-migration testing, reconciliation, completeness, and accuracy checks across sources and pipelines. 
 - Cloud & architecture: AWS (or equivalent) working knowledge - cloud-native, microservices, and distributed data-processing concepts relevant to how DF is built and deployed. 
 - Application context: SQL and scripting; working familiarity with Java/Spring-based services under test.

 - Tooling: Jira/Zephyr for traceability and test management; GitLab/Jenkins CI. 

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years of QA/testing experience, including demonstrated leadership of a QA team (local/site-level lead, team lead, or equivalent). 
 - Strong hands-on test-automation background (Playwright/TypeScript, Selenium/Java, or equivalent) and API testing. 
 - Breadth across functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing of complex, multi-component platforms. 
 - Strong SQL and data-validation skills; experience testing data quality, ETL, or data integration/migration. 
 - Experience owning regression strategy and CI/CD-integrated quality gates.

data.description:
Job Description

Change the world. Love your job. 

About Team

ASM Auto Group develops safety-compliant automotive MCUs for EV, HEV, traction inverters, onboard chargers, BMS, and body and chassis control. We are at a pivotal moment in automotive technology, and this role offers a chance to work on cutting-edge MCUs with real-world impact. If you want to solve complex technical challenges in fast-growing segments, we encourage you to apply. 

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced AVV technical leader with 5+ years of pre-silicon and post-silicon functional validation experience to own subsystem-level validation strategy for automotive MCUs. You will define functional validation methodology, lead complex root-cause investigations, drive functional bring-up on silicon, and make evidence-based silicon readiness recommendations. You will work as a technical peer with Architecture, Design, RTL Verification, and Firmware teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own functional validation strategy and sign-off for complex subsystems (e. g. , Ethernet MAC, functional safety, clock/reset/power, multicore interactions)
 - Define requirements-to-test traceability, functional coverage closure criteria, and sign-off readiness
 - Architect reusable validation frameworks spanning emulation platforms and silicon test environments
 - Lead first-silicon functional bring-up and silicon functional test execution
 - Lead complex root-cause analysis across firmware, RTL, emulation models, and silicon
 - Validate cross-peripheral interactions with DMA, interrupts, clock switching, and low-power transitions
 - Lead fault-injection campaigns and functional safety validation evidence (ISO 26262)
 - Define pre-silicon to post-silicon correlation and test reuse strategy
 - Architect and maintain automation and CI/CD-integrated regression infrastructure
 - Define and own performance and benchmarking strategy, including throughput, latency, and timing-margin target. 
 - Lead resolution of customer-reported issues through reproduction and root-cause analysis
 - Define fix or workaround recommendations for customers and drive them to closure
 - Lead validation reviews and provide sign-off recommendations
 - Mentor engineers and drive continuous improvement in methodology and tooling

Qualifications

Minimum requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, ECE, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 5+ years of engineering experience working with silicon design and/or validation
 - Experience with digital/embedded design on emulation/FPGA platforms/RTL simulation

Preferred Qualifications

- Work experience with ARM architecture
 - Advanced embedded C and firmware architecture knowledge
 - MCU/SoC architecture understanding (multicore, coherency, boot, power domains)
 - Expert-level peripheral validation, including complex interactions and error recovery
 - Emulation platform experience (QuickTurn, Palladium, ZeBu) and test infrastructure design
 - RTL and waveform debugging for SoC-level issues
 - Deep understanding of ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, and CAN FD / LIN / Ethernet
 - Functional safety subsystem validation and safety-case evidence
 - Complex DMA and bus (arbitration, ordering, timeout) validation
 - SystemVerilog and advanced RTL debugging
 - Track record of building and mentoring validation teams, or publishing technical work
 - Excellent technical communication and documentation skills

About Us

Why TI?

- The future starts here. As a TIer, you'll play a critical role in defining the next era of semiconductor technology and help create the innovations that shape the world around us. 
 - Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture . 
 - At TI, your success goes beyond your work. Take advantage of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being at work and in life, from competitive compensation to extensive health coverage and wellness programs. Learn more about our benefits offerings . 

About Texas Instruments

Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI. com . 

Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment.

data.title: Consultant - OT Data Operations Engineering
data.description:
Company Overview

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best - bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what's next. 

Overview

The GIC Supply Chain team manages end-to-end operations, encompassing planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics. They strategically plan to meet market demands, optimize sourcing, ensure efficient production, and oversee the seamless movement of goods from production to delivery. The team employs advanced analytics throughout these processes, fostering adaptability and operational excellence. This collaborative approach ensures a well-coordinated supply chain that aligns with both organizational goals and dynamic market conditions. This role requires you to operate in 1. 30 pm to 10. 30 pm. 

Key Accountabilities

- Design, configure, and deploy Ignition-based OT Data Operations gateways at the manufacturing edge, including virtual machines, Windows Server environments, plant networks, drivers, tags, MQTT brokers, historians, and security roles. 
 - Implement and standardize sensor-to-signal workflows from PLC/SCADA connectivity through calculations and contextualization into MES and analytics platforms. 
 - Collaborate with MES engineers, solution architects, and site controls engineers to ensure smooth integration of the OT Data Operations layer with TrakSYS MES, existing MQIS capabilities, and future MOM solutions. 
 - Apply and maintain ISA-95-aligned data models for assets, materials, orders, and events, ensuring consistency across plants and use cases. 
 - Partner with IT integration teams to design scalable and supportable integration patterns between OT systems, SAP, PLM, and enterprise analytics platforms. 
 - Support the configuration, performance, and storage strategy of time-series databases, including SQL Server historian, QuestDB, and future platforms. 
 - Define and implement monitoring, alerting, security controls, and operational runbooks for Ignition gateways, MQTT brokers, and associated infrastructure across pilot and production sites. 
 - Support site rollout activities including lab validation, plant commissioning, troubleshooting, infrastructure sizing, and continuous improvement of deployment patterns. 
 - Develop and maintain documentation, standards, playbooks, and training materials in partnership with Digital Controls & IS, Digital Core, plant engineering, and vendor teams to enable scalable deployment and local support. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or IT Engineering from an accredited university. 
 - Experience: 10+ years of experience in Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Systems Engineering, and Data Analytics, including 5+ years of relevant experience in OT Data Operations on Ignition. 
 - Technical Skills: Strong experience in OT/industrial automation engineering, including PLC/SCADA, historians, industrial networks, and manufacturing data integration/MES implementation. 
 - Platform Expertise: Direct hands-on experience with Inductive Automation Ignition, including gateway configuration, tag historian, alarming, MQTT modules, security/SSO, Perspective, and Jython scripting. 
 - Data & Integration Knowledge: Knowledge of ISA-95 modeling concepts, Unified Namespace (UNS), asset hierarchy, and OT-to-IT integration architecture. 
 - System & Connectivity Skills: Hands-on experience with PLC/SCADA connectivity, protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, vendor-specific drivers, scripting/configuration using Python, SQL, and Ignition scripting, and Windows/Linux server environments with virtualization. 
 - Analytical & Technical Capability: Experience with time-series databases/historians, IIoT and MQTT broker technologies, and the ability to read and interpret P&IDs, control narratives, and plant network diagrams. 
 - Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and written/verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical architectures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Industry Experience: Experience working in regulated or highly controlled environments such as food manufacturing, pharma, or CPG

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to MES platforms such as TrakSYS or similar, and integration patterns with SAP or other enterprise systems
 - GCP certification
 - Background in Mathematics or Statistics

ELIGIBILITY

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.
