data.title: Head - Software Delivery
data.description:
Function: Engineering - Internal Tools & Infrastructure

Designation: Head - Software Delivery

Reports To: Vishnu Teja, Co-Founder

Location: Hyderabad (Corporate HQ)

Position Type: Full-time | Leadership | Engineering

Team Size: 16-20

Seats Open: 1

About Keus

Keus is at the forefront of integrating elegant design with state-of-the-art technology in smart home automation and architectural lighting. Our mission is to transcend ordinary living, offering a luxurious smart home experience that is seamless and beyond compare. 

Our philosophy is centered around a design-first approach, where impeccable aesthetics meet unparalleled functionality. At Keus, a cadre of leading Industrial Designers, Electronics and Electrical Engineers, as well as Software Architects, merge their expertise to redefine industry standards and craft bespoke smart home products and solutions that lead the way in innovation. 

We pride ourselves on being the benchmark of sophistication and holistic smart home experiences in India, relentlessly innovating to not only meet but redefine global standards. 

Keus is on an ambitious path of expansion, with 2027 marking our entry into the thriving markets of Mumbai, Bangalore, Delhi and Pune. Our strategy involves directly engaging with Architects, Interior Designers, and leveraging Digital Marketing to enhance our customer reach. 

Discover more about our vision and offerings: 

- Visit our website: www. keus. in
 - Watch us on YouTube: KeusSmartHome
 - Follow us on Instagram: @keussmarthome

Join us in shaping the future of luxurious Smart living. 

Position Overview: 

We are seeking a Head - Software Delivery to own Internal Tools and Infrastructure, the systems every other engineering team build, tests, and ships on. Eight people report into you today, four of them seats you will hire yourself, and one of them lead running Infrastructure. 

Your teams have no direct customers. Their output is the throughput of everyone else. 

As Head - Software Delivery, you are also accountable for how predictably and safely software moves from commit to the devices in our customers' homes - the release cadence, release quality, and engineering health of KEUS as a whole, not only the two teams you run directly. 

Key Responsibilities: 

A. Leading the Team

- Run a team of 5-10 engineers, including a lead who reports to you. You manage Infrastructure through that lead rather than around them. 
 - Hire four engineers into open seats, then make them productive: onboarding, review standards, and the first six months of their growth. 
 - Set direction and hold it. Own the roadmap for both teams, decline work that does not serve it, and explain the reasoning rather than asserting it. 
 - Raise the floor with tooling. Choose and build the frameworks, libraries, and internal services that make the other teams faster and their systems more reliable. This is the main lever your role has on org-wide throughput, and it is the reason Internal Tools exists. 
 - Give feedback close to the event, in both directions. Performance conversations are yours to have, not to escalate. 
 - Stay technical enough to be trusted. Read the code, review the changes that carry risk, and take a shift yourself when something is broken. 
 - Absorb the interruptions. Four other teams depend on you. Shielding your engineers from that queue is part of the job. 
 - Say the unwelcome thing early: a date that will slip, an architecture call going wrong, someone struggling. Late clarity is the expensive kind. 
 - Build the second line. Develop the Infrastructure lead and a future Internal Tools lead so that both teams run without depending on you day to day. 

B. Software Delivery Governance

- Own the release train. Set the org-wide release calendar and cadence across mobile, web, cloud, and device firmware, with explicit release-readiness, go/no-go, and rollback criteria. 
 - Manage cross-team dependencies. Work with Product, Hardware/Firmware, QA, and Manufacturing so that dates committed to Sales and customers are dates that hold. 
 - Measure delivery health. Track DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, time to restore) and report them to leadership on a fixed cadence. 
 - Run incidents properly. Own the incident process and blameless post-mortems; every Sev-1 ends with a tracked corrective action and an owner. 
 - Own the engineering infrastructure budget. Cloud spend, tooling and AI licences, and vendors - reviewed quarterly against usage and value. 

C. Technical Depth We Expect

- Delivery pipeline. CI/CD and release engineering built and operated rather than inherited. You know what makes a pipeline fast, and what makes a release reversible. 
 - Container and cloud systems. Container orchestration in production, cloud infrastructure including its cost model, and a clear view of what to run versus what to buy. 
 - Operability. Observability (metrics, logs, traces) and feature flag systems treated as part of shipping, not as instrumentation added after an incident. 
 - Debugging and architecture. The others bring the hard bug to. Deep debugging across processes, network, and device boundaries, and strong instincts for code architecture that survives contact with a growing team. 
 - Languages in depth. Fluent in several, with a considered view of what each is genuinely good for and why you would pick one over another for a given problem here. 
 - Application structure. How mobile and web applications are actually put together: build and release cycles, state management, API boundaries, and what makes each hard to operate once shipped. 
 - Web frontend, at least in principle. Enough to reason for a frontend change, review it, and hold your end of a design discussion. Depth here is welcome but not required. 

D. Security and Data

Connected devices sit inside customers' homes, so a security gap here is not an abstract risk. We expect this to be something you own by instinct, not something QA catches for you. 

- End-to-end, not point-by-point. You can reason about security across the whole path - device, network, backend, client - and see where a design leaves a gap, rather than waiting for a pentest to name it. 
 - Data security is explicit. What is collected, where it is stored, who can reach it, and how long it is kept are decisions you make and write down, not properties that emerge from whatever the code happens to do. 
 - Secure defaults in the pipeline. Secrets handling, dependency and image scanning, and least privilege access built into the path teams already use, not a separate checklist somebody remembers. 
 - Debugging access is a security surface. Anything that lets an engineer inspect a live system is also a route to production data. You design that access scoped, audited, and revocable from the start. 
 - Compliance is designed in. Partner with Legal so that how we handle customer and household data meets the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 and our contractual commitments. 

E. Working AI-First

You set how your teams use AI, which is a leadership problem before it is a technical one. 

- Own the team-wide setup. Standardise Claude and Cursor across engineering - shared plugins, MCP servers, and configuration checked in and versioned - so every engineer starts with the same capability instead of assembling their own. 
 - Make realtime systems safely inspectable. Build the tooling that lets an engineer debug a running system through those tools without degrading it: read-only by default, sampled rather than firehosed, scoped to what that person may see, and audited. Convenient access to production is exactly where debugging tooling turns into a breach. 
 - Decide what gets delegated to agents, what a human reviews line by line, and what AI does not touch, then write it down rather than leaving each engineer to guess. 
 - Keep code review as the quality gate. Volume rises when a team works this way; the bar cannot come down to meet it. 
 - Build the tooling that makes this safe here: fast tests, reproducible environments, and deploys that are cheap to reverse. 
 - Judge adoption by whether it moves delivery, not by usage. If a workflow is not helping, say so and drop it. 

F. Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Collaboration

- Represent engineering delivery in leadership reviews: what shipped, what slipped, why, and what changes. 
 - Work with Product and Hardware leadership to turn roadmaps into realistic, sequenced delivery plans. 
 - Partner with Service and Customer Support so that field issues and escalations become engineering priorities with clear owners and timelines. 
 - Keep Sales informed of feature availability and release timelines they can confidently commit to customers. 

Key Deliverables

- All four open seats hired and productive within six months of joining. 
 - A predictable release calendar, with committed release dates consistently met. 
 - Faster, reversible releases: measurable improvement in lead time for changes and change failure rate. 
 - Secure-by-default pipeline in place: secrets handling, dependency and image scanning, least-privilege access. 
 - Scoped, audited, and revocable production debugging access for every engineer. 
 - A standardised, versioned AI-first engineering setup adopted across all teams. 
 - Visible, controlled cloud and tooling spend against budget. 
 - A second line of leadership ready across Internal Tools and Infrastructure. 

Key measures of success: 

Delivery Speed

Delivery speed is tracked through Lead Time for Changes, which measures the time from commit to production and is reviewed as a trend against an established baseline. 

Delivery Frequency

Delivery frequency is captured by Deployment Frequency, defined as the number of production releases per team per week. 

Release Quality

Release quality is assessed using Change Failure Rate, the percentage of releases that cause an incident, hotfix, or rollback. 

Reliability

Reliability is measured through Time to Restore, which is the average recovery time for Sev-1 and Sev-2 incidents. 

Predictability

Predictability is monitored via Release Commitment Adherence, the percentage of committed releases that are delivered on the committed date. 

Security

Security is evaluated through Vulnerability Closure, which looks at open critical and high findings along with the closure turnaround time (TAT) against the SLA. 

Developer Productivity

Developer productivity is reflected in Internal Tools Adoption & Developer Experience, measured by the adoption of shared tooling and a quarterly developer survey. 

Cost

Cost is managed through Cloud & Tooling Cost Efficiency, which compares spend against budget and tracks the cost trend per environment. 

People Leadership

People leadership is gauged by Hiring & Team Health, measured by seats filled against plan, retention, and engagement. 

Key Skills & Competencies: 

- Engineering leadership: hiring, coaching, and performance management. 
 - Delivery management and release governance across multiple teams. 
 - Systems thinking across devices, network, backend, and client. 
 - Security-first judgement and data stewardship. 
 - Clear, early, and candid communication with engineers and leadership. 
 - Data-driven decision-making using delivery and reliability metrics. 
 - Commercial awareness: build-versus-buy and cost-conscious infrastructure choices. 
 - Hands-on, practical command of AI-assisted development. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 12-16 years of experience in software engineering, including at least 4 years leading engineering teams. 
 - Several years building and operating production systems, with real ownership of infrastructure or developer tooling. 
 - Experience leading 5-10 engineers, including hiring and performance conversations, not technical direction alone. 
 - Experience leading through other leads (managing managers) and owning delivery across more than one team. 
 - Security judgement you can demonstrate: talk us through how you would attack a system you built, and what you changed once you had. 
 - Opinions about AI-assisted development that come from having done it and seen where it fails. 
 - Experience with IoT, connected devices, or consumer hardware products preferred. 

Good to Have (Bonus, not required): 

- Edge deployment systems. Shipping and updating software that runs on devices in the field, where a bad release is not something you roll back in five minutes. 
 - WebRTC and streaming. Realtime media or data streaming, including session setup, NAT traversal, and what actually degrades first under a poor network. 
 - Deep web frontend expertise beyond the working level above. 

Keus Culture: 

Join a team that is passionate about innovation and excellence. At Keus, we value creativity, collaboration, ownership and a commitment to leading the smart home revolution. 

What Keus Offers: 

- The opportunity to be at the forefront of the home automation industry, building connected products that live in high-end homes. 
 - A dynamic and supportive work environment that values innovation and creativity. 
 - Competitive salary and benefits. 
 - Professional growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding company.

Are you an experienced cloud security and SRE leader ready to own the AI-driven SecOps strategy for a massive global infrastructure? Operating across a large-scale estate of 22, 000+ Windows Virtual Machines and 3, 000+ Microsoft SQL Servers, you will combine Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Zero Trust architecture, and AI-driven automation to ensure our systems remain secure, compliant, and highly available.

Dedicated to the world's tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. As a P3 Lead Engineer reporting directly to the Director of Engineering / Head of Cloud Security, you will have end-to-end strategy ownership for multi-year security roadmaps, autonomous patching frameworks, and AI-driven CVE remediation. Supporting a follow-the-sun model across North America and India, you will serve as a primary technical authority in executive forums, shape Zero Trust adoption, and mentor a high-performing global engineering team. This position offers a high-visibility platform to transform enterprise-level SecOps using modern AI and automation capabilities. 

Key Exciting Responsibilities

- Enterprise AI-SecOps Strategy: Own the AI-driven SecOps strategy and multi-year roadmap across our entire Azure infrastructure, setting architecture standards and defining security investment priorities. 
 - Windows & SQL Server Infrastructure Security: Define and govern enterprise security architecture and exception frameworks across 22, 000+ Windows VMs and 3, 000+ SQL Servers.

 - Azure Governance, WAF & Zero Trust: Own enterprise Azure landing zone security, Azure Policy frameworks, RBAC models, Web Application Firewall (WAF) threat thresholds, and Zero Trust adoption.

 - Cloud Resilience & Global Audit Compliance: Direct DR/BCP strategies, RTO/RPO targets, and compliance execution for ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, NIST CSF/800-53, and CIS Benchmarks, serving as the lead technical stakeholder for security audits. 
 - Security Automation & Global Leadership: Champion security automation using PowerShell, Python, Terraform, and AI Copilots within CI/CD pipelines, while mentoring and leading cross-functional engineering teams across North America and India. 

Essential Skills & Experience

 - Cloud & Security Mastery: Deep technical proficiency in Azure, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, WAF, and the Azure Well-Architected Framework. 
 - Infrastructure & Patch Tooling Expertise: Hands-on experience securing Windows Server and MS SQL Server ecosystems alongside enterprise patch management platforms (Azure Update Manager, NinjaOne, SCCM/MECM, WSUS, PatchMyPC, ManageEngine, Ivanti, or BigFix). 
 - Vulnerability Management & Frameworks: Expert knowledge of CVE scoring, vulnerability scanners (Defender Vulnerability Management, Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7), and regulatory standards (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, NIST CSF/800-53, CIS Benchmarks). 
 - Automation & DevOps: Proficient in PowerShell, Python, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Terraform, and leveraging AI/Copilot tools for DevSecOps automation. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master's degree preferred). 

Bonus Points For

- Certifications: Microsoft AZ-500, CISSP, Security+, or equivalent enterprise security credentials. 
 - Global Team Leadership: Track record of leading, mentoring, and growing global engineering teams across multiple regions and time zones. 
 - Executive Communication: Experience presenting security posture metrics, risk trade-offs, and compliance progress directly to C-suite and executive stakeholders.

data.title: SENIOR/ STAFF / PRINCIPAL ENGINEER — NAND SILICON DESIGN VALIDATION (SDV)
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

ROLE

Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and validation of advanced 3D NAND products. Establish whether silicon meets design intent and datasheet requirements, correlate simulation with measurements, and resolve issues that could affect product qualification, reliability, yield, or SSD/system integration. 

This role provides a unique opportunity to develop end-to-end expertise across advanced NAND products, spanning circuit design concepts, mixed-signal simulations, first-silicon bring-up, silicon debug, product qualification, and manufacturing readiness. Engineers gain broad exposure to analog, mixed-signal, digital, firmware, memory-array, and system-level behavior while working closely with design, verification, firmware, product, and system teams. 

Responsibilities

- Own validation strategies, coverage, and test plans for assigned NAND circuits and functions; define expected behavior, operating corners, and pass/fail criteria from product specifications and design intent. 
 - Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and simulation-to-silicon correlation across voltage, temperature, process, timing, and workload conditions. 
 - Characterize and debug NAND subsystems including reference and bias generation circuits, bandgap references, oscillators, voltage regulators, charge pumps, sensing and page-buffer paths, high-voltage program/erase circuitry, memory-core drivers, control and timing logic, interface circuitry, trim and calibration functions, and firmware-controlled mixed-signal features. 
 - Investigate silicon failures with Design, Verification, Firmware, Test, Reliability, Product Engineering, and SSD/System teams. Form evidence-based hypotheses, design targeted experiments, identify root causes, and drive issues to verified closure through hardware, firmware, test-flow, trim, or workaround solutions. 
 - Convert silicon observations into engineering insight and product decisions by explaining deviations from expected behavior, assessing risk, recommending next actions, reviewing validation evidence, mentoring engineers, and improving reusable validation and debug methodologies. 
 - Proven ability to leverage AI‐assisted (vibe) coding techniques to improve efficiency or automate design and analysis methodologies
 - Leverage AI tools to automate the tools and workflowApplying Artificial Intelligence in workflows to improve build efficiency

Required Qualifications

- BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with experience appropriate to the approved Senior Staff/Principal level. 
 - Strong analog and mixed-signal fundamentals with substantial experience in at least one of the following: 
 - Mixed-signal verification
 - Analog/Mixed-Signal IC design
 - Post-silicon validation and characterization
 - Memory validation
 - Experience with mixed-signal simulation environments, including full-chip, block-level, pre-layout, or post-layout simulations. 
 - Familiarity with Verilog/System-Verilog-based simulation and debug environments. 
 - Ability to derive tests from specifications, assess coverage, debug complex circuit behavior, and explain differences between expected and observed results. 
 - Experience with validation, characterization, data analysis, scripting, or automation using tools such as Python. 
 - Strong technical communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- NAND Flash, SSD, DRAM, or other memory technology experience, including program/read/erase operations, sensing architectures, bias generation, charge pumps, timing/control circuits, reliability characterization, or system-level integration. 
 - Experience with System-Verilog, Verilog-AMS, real-number modeling, SPICE, assertions, functional coverage, or simulation-to-silicon correlation methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, probe stations, source measurement units (SMUs), semiconductor parameter analyzers, automated test equipment (ATE), or similar silicon characterization platforms.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities - from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

data.description:
Overview

Connecting clients to markets - and talent to opportunity. 

With 5, 400+ employees and over 80, 000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets - focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors. 

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth. 

Business Segment Overview

Corporate: Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you'll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies. 

Responsibilities

Position Purpose

The candidate should actively evaluate new products and technologies to build solutions that can streamline business operations. They must be delivery-focused with solid skills in automation of tests for API's and windows services. They will be required to be involved in technical discussions with the Team or Technical Lead. The candidate will be working on the company public REST API's used by our platforms and partners to provide them with full trading functionality including authentication, trading, charting, and much more. 

You'll be an essential part of a highly skilled product team, collaborating with other engineers, tech leads, and QAs to build scalable, high-performing systems used by thousands of clients. 

Technology Ecosystem

- Technologies, Languages & Frameworks: nUnit, C#, . NET Core, Postman, Swagger, RestSharp, Allure, NBomber, OpenSearch, Grafana, Jagger 
 - Architecture: Microservices, Event-driven (Kafka, AMQ), CQRS 
 - Cloud & Infra: Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Rancher, TeamCity, Octopus, Grafana 
 - Databases: MS SQL Server (T-SQL), NoSQL, Postgres 
 - Tooling: GitHub, Visual Studio/Rider, ReSharper

Primary Duties Will Include

- Define automation-first test strategy and quality gates early with product, developers, and BAs, translating requirements into measurable coverage, risk-based priorities, and release criteria. 
 - Own and evolve the automated test architecture (frameworks, patterns, reusable components), ensuring maintainability, scalability, and consistent engineering standards across repositories. 
 - Design and implement robust automated tests (API/service, component, end-to-end, and contract/compatibility), including BDD specifications, test data management, and deterministic execution. 
 - Establish and run performance and reliability testing (baseline, regression, load) and translate results into actionable engineering feedback to improve latency, stability, and user experience.

 - Lead defect prevention and rapid root-cause analysis , including log/telemetry review and failure triage, partnering with engineers to drive fixes and reduce recurrence through systemic improvements.

 - Driving process/tooling improvements and influencing cross-team quality standards through documentation and knowledge sharing. 

Qualifications

- 3+ years of hands‐on experience in Test Automation, with strong proficiency in C# and automation frameworks. 
 - Solid experience testing distributed systems, including RESTful, SOAP, gRPC APIs, Windows services, and messaging platforms such as Kafka or ActiveMQ. 
 - Strong test automation skills , including BDD approaches (preferably SpecFlow/Reqnroll), debugging, code reviews, and building custom automation tools and utilities.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer with 3-6 years of software and infrastructure testing experience and hands-on expertise in virtualization and cloud technologies. 

In this role, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and readiness of the Cloud suite by validating it across hypervisor and container environments, along with related VM and cloud deployment workflows, through a balanced mix of manual testing and automated verification. 

Technical Skills at a Glance

 - Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes (K8s), Huawei Cloud Container Engine (CCE), container deployment, and troubleshooting

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

- Comprehensive Test Execution: Plan and execute functional, integration, system, regression, performance, and reliability testing of the Cloud suite. 
 - Environment Validation: Validate the cloud suite across Proxmox/KVM hypervisors, virtual machines, Kubernetes (K8s), and container environments (including Huawei CCE). 
 - Workflow Testing: Test VM and container deployment, lifecycle management, system upgrades, storage integration, and recovery workflows across supported environments. 
 - Automation & Provisioning: Perform manual validation while building/maintaining test automation using Python and Robot Framework. Use Terraform to provision repeatable test beds. 
 - Infrastructure Debugging: Verify cloud virtualization and deployment workflows, reproduce defects, and troubleshoot complex issues across the full infrastructure stack. 
 - Defect Management & Reporting: Document test coverage, publish test execution results, report defects, assess release risks, and collaborate closely with cross-functional engineering teams to drive issues to resolution. Required Qualifications & Skillset

- Experience: 3-6 years of dedicated QA experience in software, systems, or infrastructure testing. 
 - Virtualization: Strong hands-on experience with Proxmox and/or KVM, virtual machines, and complete VM lifecycle operations. 
 - Containers: Proven experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and container workflows. Hands-on experience with Huawei Cloud Container Engine (CCE) is a strong advantage. 
 - Automation: Proficiency in Python and Robot Framework for building and maintaining test suites. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Practical hands-on experience using Terraform for environment provisioning. 
 - Testing Depth: Proven background testing cloud virtualization along with manual and automated deployment workflows. 
 - Soft Skills: Exceptional debugging, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Engineering Tech Lead - Key Management Systems (QKMS)

Location: Bengaluru

Work Mode: Work from Office

Experience: 8-12 Years

About the Company

Our client is an innovative deep-tech and cybersecurity product company developing next-generation security solutions for organisations across Government, Defence, Banking, Telecom and Critical Infrastructure. The company is focused on building quantum-safe security products to address emerging cybersecurity challenges and protect critical digital assets. 

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Tech Lead - Key Management Systems (QKMS) to lead the architecture, development and engineering execution of a next-generation Quantum Key Management System. 

You will lead a team of backend and frontend engineers while remaining actively involved in technical design, production coding, code reviews and complex engineering challenges. 

The role requires strong Java backend engineering expertise, along with quantum cryptography, security engineering and enterprise-scale platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the architecture, design and development of the Key Management System platform. 
 - Lead and mentor a team of backend and frontend engineers while driving engineering quality and delivery. 
 - Drive backend development using Java, Spring Boot and Spring Cloud microservices. 
 - Work on native C libraries, OpenSSL 3 and PKCS#11-based HSM integrations. 
 - Drive cryptographic key lifecycle capabilities, including key generation, storage, rotation, versioning, revocation and destruction. 
 - Ensure platform security, scalability, high availability and performance. 
 - Drive secure APIs, multi-tenancy, authentication and authorisation using OAuth2, OIDC, JWT and Keycloak. 
 - Oversee database architecture and concurrency management using PostgreSQL. 
 - Work with Docker, Kubernetes and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana and Loki. 
 - Drive threat modelling, secure coding practices and technical problem-solving. 
 - Collaborate with product and customer-facing teams on technical requirements, integrations and proof-of-concepts. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development productivity. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 8-12 years of overall software engineering experience with strong hands-on Java expertise. 
 - Strong experience in Java, Spring Boot and microservices architecture. 
 - Experience designing scalable backend systems and secure REST APIs. 
 - Working knowledge of C programming and native library integrations. 
 - Understanding of cryptography, encryption algorithms and key management concepts. 
 - Experience with key lifecycle management, key rotation, key hierarchies or envelope encryption. 
 - Exposure to HSM integrations, PKCS#11 or OpenSSL. 
 - Experience building secure, multi-tenant enterprise applications. 
 - Knowledge of PostgreSQL, transactions and concurrency management. 
 - Familiarity with OAuth2, OIDC, JWT and Keycloak. 
 - Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and monitoring tools. 
 - Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams while remaining technically hands-on. 

Good to Have

- Experience with KMS, HSM, secrets management or cybersecurity products. 
 - Exposure to Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) or quantum-safe security. 
 - Familiarity with KMIP, commercial HSM platforms, AWS KMS or HashiCorp Vault. 

An Ideal Candidate: 

An engineering leader with a strong Java backend foundation, experience building secure and scalable product platforms, and an understanding of cryptography or security engineering. Someone who enjoys being hands-on with architecture and coding while leading and scaling engineering teams. 

Interested in building next-generation cybersecurity products? We'd love to hear from you! Share your resumes to tbharathi@antal. com and we will speak further!

We're building tomorrow's bank today, which means we need creative and diverse engineers to help us redefine what customers expect from a bank. Envisioning new technologies that are still waiting to be invented and reimagining products that support our customers and help build Australia's future economy. 

CommBank is recognised as leading the industry in IT and operations with its world-class platforms and processes, agile IT infrastructure, and innovation in everything from payments to internet banking and mobile apps. Our Software team are the brains behind Australia's number one banking app, Netbank, Cardless Cash, Comm Sec Pocket and Spend Tracker. We go beyond a passion for web and mobile development, creating reliable APIs at a unique scale in Australia. And you could be a part of that journey. 

Impact & Contribution: 

The CBA technology unit delivers the best digital banking services to Commonwealth Bank customers and to do so is responsible for digital delivery, group data and analytics, technology and technology infrastructure, cyber, fraud, physical security and business resilience for all divisions across CBA. It is also dedicated to delivering the best workplace technology experience for our over 53. 000 people across CBA and focused on providing the latest tools, technology, and resources to enhance the way we work together and empower our people to achieve more for our customers. 

We are looking for an Engineering Senior Manager (Platform, Cloud & Backend Engineering) to lead the design, build and evolution of a greenfield, modern engineering platform and associated backend services. 

This role is suited to an engineering leader with strong technical depth across cloud infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, distributed systems and modern Java-based backend architecture, combined with strong people leadership and delivery capability. 

The primary technical emphasis of the role is Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, Platform Engineering and Java-based distributed systems. A secondary area of capability is Data Engineering, particularly around event-driven architectures, streaming, operational data flows and integration with modern analytical platforms. 

The successful candidate will play a critical role in establishing the technical foundations, engineering practices, platform capabilities and team culture for a new technology landscape. The role will involve significantly more greenfield engineering than maintenance of legacy technologies. 

This role will report into the Engineering Executive Manager under EBB Technology. 

Roles & Responsibilities:

Essential Skills: 

Candidates should ideally have significant experience in engineering leadership roles involving complex, business-critical technology environments. The Senior Engineering Manager should be technically credible, capable of participating in architecture decisions, challenging senior engineers constructively, evaluating technology choices and helping establish pragmatic engineering standards.

IaC, Terraform, Networking fundamentals, Load balancing, DNS, IAM, Secrets management, Backup and disaster recovery, Cloud security, Infrastructure automation.

 - Security and risk: Strong knowledge of defence in depth, secure-by-design approaches, IAM, encryption, secrets management, public cloud obligations, compliance controls and engineering governance.

Job Title: Principal Engineer - Knowledge Management

Location: Bangalore

Business & Team: 

The Chief AI Office (CAIO) drives the bank's AI strategy, platforms, governance, and capabilities to accelerate the safe and scalable adoption of AI across the enterprise. 

The Knowledge Management domain within CAIO creates the cognitive foundation of the bank by transforming business knowledge into trusted, governed, and reusable knowledge products. 

As a Principal Engineer - Knowledge Management, you will work closely with Knowledge Governance & Framework Leads, Knowledge Platform & Engineering Teams, Business SMEs, knowledge owners, product teams, and DHP platform and DevSecOps teams. 

Impact & Contribution: 

You will directly support CAIO's objective of creating the bank's enterprise knowledge capability and trusted knowledge products that accelerate AI-powered transformation across the Group. 

You will enable colleagues, copilots, and AI agents to access trusted, governed, and reusable enterprise knowledge, improving decision-making consistency and productivity. 

You will help transform fragmented business information into reusable knowledge products with clear ownership, lineage, provenance, permissions, and controls. 

You will provide technical leadership for enterprise AI/ML and knowledge platforms and retrieval capabilities that make business policies, procedures, controls, and operational knowledge AI-ready and safely consumable at scale. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

Knowledge Platform Architecture: Own the solution architecture and technical design of core enterprise knowledge and AI/ML platform capabilities, including ingestion, enrichment, knowledge graph, retrieval, APIs, integrations, and lifecycle management. 

AI/ML Platform Development: Lead the architecture and development of scalable, production-grade AI/ML platforms and reusable capabilities supporting enterprise AI, knowledge management, retrieval, and GenAI use cases. 

Ontology & Semantic Architecture: Lead the design and evolution of the enterprise ontology, semantic model, taxonomy, and metadata standards to create consistent knowledge across business domains. 

Enterprise Knowledge Products: Architect and deliver high-quality, AI-ready knowledge products that transform unstructured business knowledge into trusted, governed, and reusable assets.

data.title: Engineering Executive Manager veryday Banking
data.description:
Organization

At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people's financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things. 

Job Title: Engineering Executive Manager - Everyday Banking

Location: Bengaluru

Business & Team: 

Everyday Banking sits at the heart of how millions of customers interact with CommBank every day. Technology enables customers to manage their money simply, safely and reliably, and our engineering teams are central to creating experiences and platforms that customers can depend on. 

We are looking for an Engineering Executive Manager to lead our Everyday Banking engineering organisation in Bengaluru. This is a senior technology and people leadership role with responsibility for approximately 150 engineers across levels. You will create the environment, capability and engineering systems that enable teams to deliver meaningful customer and enterprise outcomes at scale. 

This is not a role defined by geography or by people management alone. You will be an integral member of the Everyday Banking technology leadership community, working across Bengaluru and Australia to strengthen engineering capability, improve technology health and delivery effectiveness, and help shape how the domain turns strategy into outcomes. 

Impact & contribution: 

- Own engineering outcomes - Translate Everyday Banking priorities into clear engineering outcomes and ensure teams understand the customer and business problems they are solving. Stay engaged from intent through execution and measurable value, rather than treating delivery as a hand-off. 
 - Lead a high-performing engineering organisation - Build, lead and inspire an engaged organisation of approximately 150 engineers. Establish clear expectations, strong leadership layers and an environment of accountability, psychological safety, constructive challenge and continuous improvement. 
 - Exercise technology and engineering leadership - Bring credible technical judgement to domain conversations. Understand the architecture, technology health and engineering constraints of the area you lead; challenge decisions constructively; identify systemic issues; and partner with CTLs and senior technical leaders to improve technology direction and execution. 
 - Build engineering excellence - Create engineering systems that improve flow, quality and safe speed. Champion DevSecOps, full-cycle engineering, automation, continuous delivery, observability, reliability, resilience, security and production ownership, using measures to drive sustained improvement. 
 - Improve technology health - Make technical debt, obsolescence, operational risk and engineering friction visible. Work with technology and product leaders to prioritise remediation proportionately, simplify the estate, increase reuse and automation, and avoid short-term delivery choices that create unsustainable complexity. 
 - Create autonomous, accountable teams - Reduce unnecessary dependencies and decision bottlenecks. Establish clear guardrails and decision rights so teams and senior engineers can make sound decisions close to the work while remaining aligned to enterprise standards and domain direction. 
 - Grow leaders and technical capability - Build a strong pipeline of Engineering Managers, Principal/Staff Engineers and future technology leaders. Provide candid coaching and feedback, create meaningful development and succession plans, and establish mechanisms for peer learning, mentoring and technical communities. 
 - Lead through others - Create leverage by developing leaders who can independently own people, technology and delivery outcomes. Deliberately avoid becoming the escalation point or technical dependency for every important decision. 
 - Influence and co-lead globally - Build trusted relationships across Bengaluru and Australia. Bring a point of view, influence without relying on hierarchy, challenge constructively and create shared accountability with Product, Business and Technology partners. Help Bengaluru teams participate in shaping decisions, not simply receiving them. 
 - Drive delivery with engineering discipline - Where you carry delivery accountability, translate priorities into executable plans, manage material dependencies and risks, and deliver predictably while protecting quality, resilience and long-term technology health. Where delivery accountability sits elsewhere, remain an active partner in removing systemic blockers and improving execution. 
 - Accelerate AI-enabled engineering - Drive responsible adoption of AI across the software engineering lifecycle where it improves developer effectiveness, quality, operational efficiency or customer outcomes. Establish appropriate controls, measurement and learning so adoption creates durable value. 
 - Lead risk and operational ownership - Ensure teams understand and own the technology they build and run. Strengthen service health, incident learning, vulnerability management, production readiness, lifecycle management and compliance with security, privacy, resilience and risk expectations. 
 - Shape workforce and capability strategy - Partner with domain and India leadership on workforce composition, location strategy, critical skills, hiring and capability investment so the organisation has the capacity and skills required for the future. 
 - Strengthen the wider Retail Technology community - Contribute beyond Everyday Banking by sharing practices, developing talent, solving common engineering problems and helping Retail Technology India become a distinctive engineering advantage for the Bank. 
 - Reporting lines: 
 - Functional reporting - Everyday Banking Domain Tech Lead / Technology General Manager, with accountability into the domain for engineering outcomes, capability, technology health and execution. 
 - Local reporting - General Manager, Retail Technology India, with accountability for local leadership, talent, culture, workforce health and the broader Bengaluru technology community. 
 - Leadership scope - Approximately 150 engineers across levels and disciplines, led through a layer of senior engineering and people leaders. The exact structure may evolve with the needs of the domain. 
 - Delivery accountability - The role may carry direct delivery accountability for selected outcomes or portfolios. Irrespective of formal delivery ownership, you are expected to actively influence prioritization, dependencies, risks and execution across the domain. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- You will lead a large, diverse engineering organisation spanning multiple crews & squads, engineering leaders and technical disciplines. You will partner closely with the Everyday Banking Domain Tech Lead / Technology General Manager, Crew Tech Leads, Product and Business leaders, Architects, Chief and Principal Engineers, and enterprise technology functions. 
 - The Domain Tech Lead / Technology General Manager remains accountable for the overall technology direction of Everyday Banking. Your role is to translate that direction into a high-performing engineering organisation: bringing a strong technology point of view, shaping engineering choices, challenging where needed, creating alignment across teams, and ensuring strategy becomes measurable customer, technology and business outcomes. 
 - You will also be a senior leader within Retail Technology India, helping build a strong Bengaluru engineering community and ensuring our India teams operate as co-owners of outcomes rather than as a downstream delivery centre. 
 - Your success will be measured by the outcomes and leadership leverage created by the engineering organisation you lead - not by the number of decisions you personally make or issues you personally resolve. 

What success looks like

- Everyday Banking has a strong Bengaluru engineering organisation that is trusted as a co-owner of customer, technology and business outcomes. 
 - Engineering leaders and senior engineers have clear accountability and decision rights; important decisions do not depend on one or two individuals. 
 - Teams deliver valuable change faster and more safely, with measurable improvement in flow, quality, reliability, resilience and developer experience. 
 - Technology health improves over time: operational risk, avoidable technical debt and legacy complexity reduce while reuse, automation and platform leverage increase. 
 - Bengaluru and Australia operate as one technology leadership system, with strong relationships, constructive challenge and shared accountability rather than a sender-receiver model. 
 - The organisation has a visible pipeline of future Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers and technology leaders, supported by deliberate succession and capability plans. 
 - AI-enabled engineering is adopted responsibly where it produces measurable improvement in engineering effectiveness or customer outcomes. 
 - Where the role owns delivery, commitments are met with appropriate transparency and discipline without trading away long-term technology health. 

Key relationships

- Everyday Banking Domain Tech Lead / Technology General Manager
 - General Manager, Retail Technology India
 - Everyday Banking Crew Tech Leads and Engineering Leaders
 - Product and Business leadership
 - Chief / Principal / Staff Engineers and Architecture
 - Retail Technology engineering and platform teams
 - Cyber Security, Risk, Controls, Data and AI teams
 - Enterprise and shared technology services

Essential Skills: 

- Are experienced engineering leaders who have led large, complex organisations through other leaders, ideally at 100+ engineer scale. 
 - Combine strong people leadership with credible technology and engineering depth; you can operate from executive strategy and organisational design through to meaningful architecture and engineering discussions. 
 - Have built high-performing engineering organisations with strong DevSecOps, continuous delivery, automated quality, observability, reliability, resilience, security and operational ownership practices. 
 - Can translate customer and business priorities into engineering outcomes, measures and pragmatic technology choices rather than managing only activity, capacity or milestones. 
 - Have led technology modernisation and simplification in complex estates, including technical-debt reduction, platform evolution, integration simplification and legacy constraints. 
 - Understand modern software architecture, APIs and integration, cloud and platform engineering, distributed systems, data, security, privacy and resilience sufficiently to challenge and guide senior engineers and architects. 
 - Have a track record of building engineering leaders, creating succession and lifting capability at organizational scale - including managing under-performance and giving clear, actionable feedback. 
 - Can influence senior Product, Business and Technology stakeholders through genuine disagreement, making trade-offs visible and maintaining constructive relationships under delivery pressure. 
 - Are comfortable operating in a global, matrixed organisation with split functional and local accountabilities, and can create clarity where formal authority is distributed. 
 - Use data and engineering measures to improve flow, quality, reliability, developer experience, technology health and customer value. 
 - Can make difficult prioritization and investment trade-offs, balancing near-term outcomes with sustainable engineering and total cost of ownership. 
 - Are curious and pragmatic about AI and emerging technology, and can turn experimentation into responsible, measurable engineering value. 
 - Lead with humility, courage and accountability, invite challenge, learn from setbacks and are willing to change their own leadership behavior as the organisation evolves. 

Education Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering

At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people's financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things. 

Job Title: Principal Engineer

Location: Bangalore

Business & Team: Business Banking

Impact & contribution: 

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer who combines deep technical expertise with enterprise-level engineering leadership across modern full-stack platforms. You will shape technical strategy and architecture across customer and colleague-facing applications spanning web experiences, APIs, distributed services, data, cloud, workflow orchestration and AI-enabled capabilities. You will bring authoritative engineering depth across backend, frontend, distributed systems and cloud, while setting direction for scalable solutions using Temporal and durable workflow orchestration. You will champion AI-powered engineering, establish reusable patterns and guardrails, and influence how software is designed, built, tested and operated across multiple teams. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Set and drive technical strategy, target architecture and engineering direction across a portfolio of full-stack capabilities spanning modern web applications, APIs, services, data and AWS cloud platforms. 
 - Provide authoritative technical leadership across . NET/C#, Java/JVM or Node. js/TypeScript ecosystems and modern TypeScript frontends, remaining sufficiently hands-on to validate critical designs, patterns and engineering decisions. 
 - Define architecture for secure, resilient distributed systems at scale, establishing domain/service boundaries, event-driven and asynchronous patterns, consistency models, idempotency, fault tolerance and evolutionary architecture principles. 
 - Shape workflow architecture using Temporal and durable orchestration patterns, establishing approaches for long-running processes, retries, compensation, human-in-the-loop steps, state management, business rules, versioning and auditability. 
 - Lead complex modernisation and simplification across legacy estates through decomposition, API enablement, event-driven integration and cloud migration; establish transition architectures and drive removal of obsolete systems, code and technology debt. 
 - Set engineering expectations for cloud-native delivery, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, DevSecOps, automated quality, observability, SRE, resilience and production readiness, and ensure adoption across teams. 
 - Define and champion responsible AI-powered engineering across the SDLC and shape enterprise GenAI/Agentic AI architectures with robust evaluation, guardrails, security, observability, governance and human oversight. 
 - Lead the most consequential technical and architecture decisions, gain support for technical direction, and ensure execution across engineering, product, architecture, security, platform, data and business stakeholders. 
 - Build engineering capability through standards, coaching and sponsorship of senior technical talent. 

Essential Skills: 

Typically, 15+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial experience as a senior technical leader shaping strategy and architecture across complex enterprise platforms, domains or multiple engineering teams. 

- Expert engineering depth in one or more of: . NET/C# and ASP. NET Core; Java/JVM and Spring Boot; or Node. js/TypeScript and modern server frameworks, with the breadth to govern architecture across heterogeneous technology stacks. 
 - Strong full-stack architecture experience with TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular, including component/platform architecture, performance, accessibility, security and automated quality at scale. 
 - Deep expertise in microservices and distributed systems, API and integration architecture, event-driven systems, messaging, resiliency, scalability, concurrency and data consistency, with evidence of making sound trade-offs at enterprise scale. 
 - Deep data, security and quality engineering knowledge across relational/NoSQL databases, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, OWASP, threat modelling and automated test strategies, with security embedded from the first line of code. 
 - Extensive AWS and cloud-native architecture experience across containers/Kubernetes/ECS, serverless services, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and production observability, including governance, reliability, cost and operational trade-offs. 
 - Strong knowledge of Temporal and durable workflow architecture, including workflows/activities, retries, signals, timers, compensation, versioning and operational patterns for reliable long-running distributed processes. 
 - Strong architecture knowledge of workflow and orchestration patterns, including human-in-the-loop workflows, rules, integrations, security, performance, governance, auditability and operational visibility. 
 - Advanced knowledge of Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures, including RAG, MCP/tool use, structured outputs, evaluation, guardrails, observability and responsible adoption in regulated enterprise environments. 
 - Exceptional architecture judgement and communication, with the ability to simplify ambiguity, make commercially pragmatic technology decisions, influence senior stakeholders and express direction through code, diagrams, ADRs, standards and concise technical narratives. 

Years of Experience: 15+

Qualifications: Bachelor of Engineering, BTech or equivalent qualification, or equivalent relevant industry experience. 

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We're keen to support you with the next step in your career.

data.title: Technical Lead
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Technical Lead- Oracle Testing Managed Services with strong customer communication skills and a good technical understanding of software testing and automation. 

The role will be responsible for managing ongoing customer engagements, leading customer discussions, coordinating automation engineers, and ensuring consistent delivery of Oracle testing services. 

The ideal candidate should be comfortable leading customer calls, understanding Oracle business processes, discussing technical automation requirements, and driving activities across customer and internal teams. 

What You'll Do

- Customer Engagement & Service Management (60%)

Act as the primary point of contact for managed services customers. 

Lead regular customer calls, testing discussions, and service review meetings. 

Understand customer priorities, testing requirements, and upcoming Oracle quarterly updates. 

Communicate testing progress, automation coverage, execution results, risks, and blockers. 

Manage customer expectations and ensure timely follow-up on open action items. 

Proactively identify issues and coordinate resolution with internal teams. 

Prepare and present customer status reports and service performance dashboards. 

Identify opportunities to improve testing coverage and customer value. 

- Technical & Automation Team Management (20%)

Coordinate and manage day-to-day activities of automation engineers. 

Translate customer requirements into clear technical tasks. 

Track automation development, script maintenance, test execution, and defect resolution. 

Understand technical challenges and coordinate with engineers to resolve blockers. 

Prioritize automation activities based on customer requirements and timelines. 

Ensure engineers have the necessary functional inputs and customer clarifications. 

Review automation progress and ensure quality deliverables. 

- Oracle Business Process Understanding (20%)

Develop a working understanding of Oracle Cloud ERP, HCM, and SCM business processes. 

Understand key business flows such as P2P, O2C, R2R, and H2R. 

Translate business requirements into test scenarios and automation requirements. 

Participate in functional discussions with customers and Oracle consultants. 

Help automation engineers understand business workflows and expected test results. 

Understand the impact of Oracle quarterly updates on testing and automation. 

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field. 

5-8+ years of experience in QA, software testing, test automation, or technical project management. 

Experience working with Oracle Cloud ERP, HCM, SCM, or enterprise applications. 

Good understanding of software testing, test execution, defect management, and automation. 

Working knowledge of tools such as Opkey, Selenium, UFT, Tosca, or similar. 

Ability to understand technical discussions and work closely with automation engineers. 

Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 

Experience independently managing customer calls and stakeholder discussions. 

Ability to manage priorities, track activities, and drive accountability. 

Familiarity with JIRA, Smartsheet, or similar project management tools. 

Key Competencies

Strong customer communication and presentation skills. 

Technical understanding of test automation. 

Ability to coordinate and manage technical teams. 

Working knowledge of Oracle business processes. 

Strong problem-solving and ownership mindset. 

Ability to independently manage customer engagements. 

Key Success Measures

Effective management of customer relationships and regular engagements. 

Timely completion of automation and testing activities. 

Proactive identification and resolution of blockers. 

Improved automation coverage and script health. 

Consistent customer satisfaction and service delivery. 

Skills: communication, automation, testing, , oracle erp, , oracle

data.title: Portfolio Lead
data.description:
Company Description

There's nothing like a career at Entain India. We're the technology powerhouse helping Entain - a world leader in sports and gaming - create products and experiences used by millions of customers across the globe. Whether you're an engineer, product owner or customer care professional, unlock a world of new possibilities - for you and the future of sports and gaming. 

Job Description

The Portfolio Lead is accountable for delivery performance across a sub-domain of 4-6 pods (Engineering, Quality, Product). They lead the flow of value from idea to production, ensuring pods deliver with pace, predictability and understanding to outcomes. 

They combine hands-on delivery leadership with AI-augmented ways of working and data-driven decision-making. They do not prescribe a single framework - instead they adapt approaches that best serve each pod's context. 

They partner with Engineering and Product leadership to reduce waste, improve throughput and help pods achieve Autonomy, Accountability and Agreement to value outcomes. 

What You Will Do

Pod Performance & Accountability

You are responsible for pod delivery performance across the sub-domain. 

You will lead and communicate delivery health, risks and performance to leadership

Ensure pods operate as, self-organising units delivering value outcomes

Support pod leads with coaching, facilitation and conflict resolution

Ensure cross-pod agreement on priorities, dependencies and shared goals

Facilitate communication and collaboration between pods to promote knowledge sharing

Problem Solving

You will be an expert; deploy root cause analysis, systems thinking and structured techniques to analyse and guide out resolutions. 

Be an escalation point for cross-pod blockers and systemic impediments

Identify patterns across pods that indicate deeper organisational or process issues

AI-Augmented Delivery

Champion AI agent adoption across pods - including coding agents, test generation, story creation, board health and deployment automation

Identify opportunities where AI can reduce toil, accelerate delivery or improve decision-making

Apply AI to improve delivery effectiveness, including workflow insights, risk prediction, and automation of reporting

Track and demonstrate the impact of AI on delivery performance

Flow & Efficiency

Monitor and improve delivery flow (lead time, cycle time, WIP, throughput) using Kanban and lean principles

Ensure WIP limits are respected and surface ageing items through Board Walks

Identify bottlenecks, ageing work and sources of delay across pods. 

Improve through regular assessment and experimentation. 

Support teams in breaking down work into deliverable, value-driven increments

Agile Ways of Working

Support and evolve the agile operating model for a pod-based environment focused on pace, not ceremony. 

Adapt delivery approaches (Kanban, flow-based, lean) appropriate to each pod's needs

Ensure consistency of practice across pods without being prescriptive

Promote outcome-driven delivery vs output-driven activity

Guide teams to operate with autonomy and accountability

Metrics & Reporting

Define and maintain delivery metrics: cycle time, flow efficiency, lead time of initiative, PDLC compression, dependency reduction, rework rate, team satisfaction, and AI effectiveness

Build dashboards (cumulative flow diagrams, throughput charts, WIP ageing) that provide leadership visibility and lead informed decision-making

Analyse performance data to identify trends, patterns and areas for improvement

Use data to facilitate conversations and coach pods - not just track output

Stakeholder Management

Partner with Engineering and Product leadership at sub-domain level

Represent delivery health and risks in leadership forums

Build trusted relationships that allow fast decision-making

Communicate delivery performance to both technical and non-technical audiences

Commercial Awareness

Understand the commercial context of the sub-domain

Connect delivery decisions to revenue, cost, and customer impact

Support prioritisation trade-offs with a business lens

Capacity Planning

Forecast capacity across pods based on team composition, skills mix and upcoming demand

Identify resourcing gaps and support hiring/allocation decisions

Balance workload across pods to prevent burnout and underutilisation

Support realistic planning by ensuring pods have clear understanding of available capacity

Risk & Dependency Management

Manage risks through regular assessment and execution of controls

Ensure cross-pod dependencies are visible, tracked and managed

Track dependency cost (time blocked, items affected) and lead mitigations such as contract-first development and feature flags

Support issue escalations, ensuring intervention by the dependency escalation protocol

Coach & Capability Development

Provide hands-on coaching at pod level

Build capability in workflow management, flow thinking, estimation, planning, and data-led decision-making

Support teams in understanding and improving their own performance

Strengthen a culture of continuous improvement and learning

Outcome & Value Focus

Align delivery to always ensure outcomes and value. 

Help teams understand the why behind their work and how their outputs contribute to value

Challenge work that does not link to outcomes

Support measurement of delivery against OKRs and value indicators

Centre of Excellence (CoE) Contribution

Be an active contributor to the CoE

Share best practices, delivery insights and improvement opportunities from pods

Support adoption of standards, playbooks and tools

Help evolve delivery practices based on experience

Qualifications

Specialist Experience

You will have 7+ years in delivery/agile roles, with at least 3 years operating across multiple teams simultaneously in a technology environment

Expert in flow-based delivery approaches (Kanban, lean, continuous delivery) - not limited to Scrum

Experience enabling multiple teams/pods simultaneously at scale

Strong understanding of AI tooling and its application to software delivery (coding assistants, automation, intelligent analytics)

Experienced in capacity planning, demand forecasting and resource optimisation across multiple teams

Use data to solve complex problems; can interpret and communicate complex data sets clearly

Previous experience of organisational transformation and change management

Good knowledge of Objectives and Key Results (OKR) strategy

Experience in a regulated industry (gaming, fintech, or similar) desirable

Competencies & Behaviours

You will embody the Maker Dimensions - selecting for capability, not just competence. We are looking for people who are versatile, curious, and able to operate with autonomy in a high-trust environment. 

AI Fluency uses AI tooling; experiments; iterate with AI as a collaborator

Agency & Accountability Owns outcomes, not just tasks; directs itself. 

Systems Thinking Sees patterns across pods and addresses causes, not symptoms

Stakeholder Engagement Builds working relationships across pods and leadership

Improve Performance Raises the bar through data and experimentation

Cross-functional Versatility Comfortable operating beyond their primary discipline

Product Sense Connects their work to customer and outcomes

Build Capability Invests in developing pods, individuals and self

Benefits

Additional Information

At Entain India, We Offer a Package And The Support People Need To Make An Impact. Join Us, And a Great Compensation Package Is Just The Beginning. You Can Expect To Receive Benefits Like: 

- Safe home pickup and home drop. 
 - A regular bonus and great pension. 
 - 24 days annual leave. 
 - Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days. 
 - Life assurance and Income Protection. 
 - Private healthcare and wellbeing support. 
 - INR 3, 000 per month Communication allowance. 
 - Up to INR 16, 000 per year in Crèche expenses (children under 3). 

Equal Opportunities. 

If you need any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we'll support you. 

We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves. 

We're an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis. 

We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally.

data.description:
About Us

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U. S. ) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 725 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts - driving real, measurable results for clients. 

At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture. 

Why We Do What We Do

In the U. S. , consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system. 

Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis' award-winning culture. 

Position Overview

We are looking for a passionate . NET Developer with 2-4 years of experience to design, develop, and maintain scalable applications. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of . NET technologies, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work in a collaborative Agile environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, test, and maintain applications using C#, . NET Core, and ASP. NET MVC/Web API. 
 - Design and build RESTful APIs and backend services. 
 - Write clean, scalable, and efficient code following coding standards. 
 - Work with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver solutions. 
 - Perform code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization. 
 - Develop and maintain database objects, queries, and stored procedures. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions. 

Required Skills

- 2-4 years of experience in C# and . NET technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of . NET Core, ASP. NET MVC, Web API. 
 - Experience with SQL Server and database design concepts. 
 - Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles. 
 - Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery. 
 - Experience with Git/Azure DevOps or other version control tools. 
 - Good understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC). 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Microservices Architecture. 
 - Exposure to AWS Cloud Services. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams. 

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. 

Accessibility Support

We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis. com.

data.title: Product Quality Engineer
data.description:
Role and Responsibilities: New Product Introduction (NPI) & Sustaining Engineering Support

1. Act as the Quality representative within NPI and Sustaining Engineering projects. 

2. Support ongoing project activities by coordinating Quality Plan and Quality Norm planning activities throughout the project lifecycle. 

3. Review and approve design and development deliverables to ensure compliance with quality and regulatory requirements. 

4. Provide guidance and consultation to project teams regarding process, quality, validation, risk management, and compliance-related questions. 

5. Participate in design reviews, risk reviews, verification and validation activities, and design transfer activities. 

6. Support design changes, product improvements, and sustaining engineering initiatives while ensuring product quality and compliance are maintained. 

Product & Supplier Quality Management

1. Ensure suppliers consistently deliver quality parts, materials, and services that meet organizational, customer, and regulatory requirements. 

2. Monitor supplier quality performance using established metrics and drive continuous improvement initiatives. 

3. Lead and support Supplier Corrective and Preventive Action (SCAR/CAPA) activities, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, effectiveness verification, and closure. 

4. Assess supplier process, material, equipment, and manufacturing changes for quality, compliance, and regulatory impact. 

5. Coordinate cross-functional reviews and approvals for supplier changes and ensure timely implementation and closure of change requests. 

Product Qualification & Validation

1. Lead PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) activities for new product introductions and legacy product changes. 

2. Apply risk-based process validation methodologies to ensure robust product and manufacturing processes. 

3. Support qualification and validation activities, including protocol development, execution, reporting, and impact assessments. 

4. Define incoming inspection requirements and acceptance criteria for purchased components and materials. 

cyient. com

5. Develop, execute, and support validation of internal inspection and test methods as required. 

6. Ensure inspection, testing, and validation activities comply with applicable quality standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. 

Continuous Improvement & Quality Excellence

1. Analyse quality trends, supplier performance metrics, non-conformance data, and process performance indicators to identify improvement opportunities. 

2. Drive defect prevention activities through proactive risk assessment and implementation of corrective actions. 

3. Support Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement initiatives across products, processes, and suppliers. 

Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

Collaborates extensively with cross-functional stakeholders, include, R&D Engineers, Post-Market Surveillance team, Risk Management Engineers, Product Support Engineers, Regulatory Affairs Specialists, Quality Manufacturing Engineers, Product Industrialization Engineers, Supplier Quality Engineers, Reliability Engineers, etc. 

Education & Experience: 1. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Biomedical, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

2. 6-8 years of experience in product quality, design quality, supplier quality, manufacturing quality, or quality engineering within medical devices or another highly regulated industry. 

3. Hands-on experience supporting an electromechanical product through NPI, verification/validation, design transfer, production ramp, and sustaining engineering. 

4. Working knowledge of ISO 13485 and ISO 14971, plus applicable regulatory quality-system requirements such as US FDA 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR and EU MDR 2017/745. 

5. Knowledge of applicable standards such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 62366-1, IEC 62304, IEC 62133-2, ISO 15223-1, and packaging/transport standards. 

6. Practical experience with design controls, CAPA, nonconformance, change control, process validation, supplier controls, and complaint or post-market feedback processes. 

7. Proficiency with DFMEA/PFMEA, control plans, MSA/Gage R&R, SPC, process capability, root-cause analysis, sampling plans, and risk-based validation. 

8. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, specifications, test data, tolerance analyses, and component/process capability evidence. 

9. Experience with handheld or portable medical devices containing motors/actuators, rechargeable batteries, PCBAs, sensors, user controls, or fluid/air pathways.
