Nutrabay is India's premier destination for sports nutrition, fitness supplements, and wellness essentials. Operating both as a high-growth multi-brand marketplace and an innovative private-label brand, Nutrabay delivers authentic, lab-tested nutrition products to millions of fitness enthusiasts nationwide. 

As we aggressively scale our private-label portfolio (proteins, amino acids, vitamins, and functional foods), maintaining robust quality standards, rigorous regulatory compliance, and high-performance Contract Manufacturing (CMO) relationships serves as our ultimate competitive moat. 

Role Objective

This hybrid role is designed for a technical operations specialist. You will own the entire operational lifecycle of third-party manufacturing (CMO) partnerships while serving as the primary lead for Quality Control (QC) standards and testing across Nutrabay's private-label business. In this position, you will maintain a zero-compromise product safety program, oversee technology transfers of new formulations, and audit production facilities to ensure every batch of Nutrabay products matches strict analytical and FSSAI standards. 

Key Responsibilities (The 80/20 Split)

1. CMO & 3P Manufacturing Management (45% Weight)

- Production Governance: Manage day-to-day operations across our network of external contract manufacturers (including tableting, capsule filling, powder blending, and packaging plants). 
 - Tech Transfer & Scale-Up: Partner closely with R&D and New Product Development (NPD) teams to successfully transition lab-scale trial formulations into commercial-scale production batches at CMO sites. 
 - Capacity Planning: Monitor contract manufacturer capacities, batch planning, production yields, and schedules to guarantee On-Time-In-Full (OTIF) dispatches. 
 - SLA & Performance Scorecards: Establish and track monthly Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for CMO partners, covering yield loss, process defects, and turnaround times. 

2. Quality Control & Testing Management (35% Weight)

- Testing & Release Coordination: Establish and enforce testing protocols for raw materials (such as whey protein concentrates, plant proteins, and active ingredients) and finished goods. Hold responsibility for managing batch release and rejection decisions based on analytical data. 
 - Laboratory & COA Verification: Standardize Certificate of Analysis (COA) templates. Review and verify laboratory results from third-party accredited labs (e. g. , NABL) for heavy metals, microbial limits, and active ingredient assays. 
 - GMP & Food Safety Compliance: Enforce strict compliance with FSSAI, WHO-GMP, HACCP, and legal metrology standards across all external production lines. 
 - Audits & Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Conduct periodic physical hygiene and process audits at CMO facilities. Lead CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) investigations for any batch failures, active ingredient drift, or shelf-life issues. 

3. Procurement & Commercial Operations (20% Weight)

- BOM Cost Optimization: Analyze Bill of Materials (BOM) cost structures to negotiate conversion costs, raw material pass-through rates, and packaging expenses with CMOs. 
 - Strategic Sourcing: Establish secondary backup vendor networks for high-risk raw materials (e. g. , imported whey, proprietary flavors) to prevent supply disruptions. 
 - Procure-to-Pay (P2P): Seamlessly align procurement plans with contract manufacturer schedules to ensure packaging materials (jars, scoops, labels) arrive just-in-time (JIT) to optimize working capital. 

Core Technical Competencies Required

To be successful in this highly specialized role, candidates must demonstrate technical fluency in: 

- Bulk Powder Blending: In-depth understanding of ribbon blenders, double-cone blenders, particle size distribution, and bulk density parameters. 
 - Analytical Chemistry & Assays: Ability to interpret HPLC, GC, UV-Vis spectroscopy, and protein estimation methods (such as Kjeldahl/Dumas). 
 - Food Safety & Regulation: Comprehensive knowledge of FSSAI standards, allergen management, heavy metal limits, and shelf-life testing protocols. 
 - Packaging Science: Clear understanding of moisture barrier integrity, induction heat sealing, and polymer classifications. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Quality Compliance: Zero (0) market recalls; inbound finished goods rejection rate < 0. 5%. 
 - CMO Delivery (OTIF): ≥ 96% On-Time-In-Full manufacturing dispatch from third-party sites. 
 - Yield & Material Variance: Under 1. 5% variance in raw material-to-finished goods conversion yields at plants. 
 - Audit Adherence: 100% of contract manufacturers maintaining updated GMP/FSSAI certifications and scoring > 90% in annual audits. 
 - NPD Go-To-Market Lead Time: Optimize time elapsed from formula sign-off to first commercial batch dispatch. 

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Food Technology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, or Chemical Engineering. Additional diplomas in Supply Chain or Material Management are highly valued. 
 - Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience spanning both Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) testing protocols and third-party vendor operations within the nutraceutical, sports supplement, or food processing sectors. 
 - System Knowledge: Demonstrated familiarity with Quality Management Systems (QMS), ERP modules (SAP/Oracle/Tally), and advanced analytical reporting tools. 

Role Snapshot

- Role Title: Assistant Manager / Manager - Procurement & 3P Operations
 - Department: Supply Chain & Operations
 - Location: Head Office, New Delhi (Requires travel to partner CMO sites)
 - Focus Split: 80% Contract Manufacturing (CMO) Management & Quality Assurance Oversight | 20% Core Procurement & Commercials
 - Experience Level: 5 to 9 Years (Strongly preferred: Nutraceuticals, Sports Nutrition, Pharma, or Food FMCG)
 - Reporting To: Head of Supply Chain / Founders
 - Location: Delhi NCR (Work from Office)

Why Nutrabay: 

We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence, and be a part of an innovative marketing-and-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry. 

Working with Nutrabay can be fun and a place of unique growth opportunities. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will feel appreciated and valued for the work you deliver. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues. 

About Nutrabay: 

Nutrabay is the largest health & nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers to now, and our family is constantly growing. 

We have built a complex and high-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute towards further advancing the continuously evolving product.

data.description:

Experience: 0 to 2 years · Role: ML QA, Evaluation and Data Quality · Location: Bengaluru | Hybrid

About the Role

Matters. AI builds AI native data security that detects sensitive information across enterprise documents and data. You'll work with our ML team to test whether those models actually get it right. You'll build ground truth datasets, measure model performance, dig into every false positive and false negative, and validate each new model version before it ships. This role suits freshers and early career folks who enjoy finding exactly where and why a system breaks. 

What You'll Do

- Annotate, validate, and review datasets against defined guidelines, and maintain ground truth datasets for evaluation. 
 - Evaluate model outputs and classify every result as a true positive, false positive, or false negative. 
 - Calculate and track precision, recall, F1 score, confusion matrices, and per class performance. 
 - Run error analysis to find recurring failure patterns and classification gaps. 
 - Write and run test cases for new model versions, prompts, rules, thresholds, and classification logic. 
 - Run regression tests across model versions to catch improvements and regressions before release. 
 - Test each stage of the ML pipeline, from OCR and Named Entity Recognition (NER) to rule based processing, LLM analysis, and final classification. 
 - Document results, reproducible failures, and edge cases in clear, traceable reports for ML engineers. 

What We're Looking For

- 0 to 2 years of experience in ML QA, data annotation, data quality, software testing, or NLP. Freshers with relevant academic projects are welcome. 
 - A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related field. 
 - A basic understanding of machine learning and classification. 
 - Comfort with evaluation metrics: precision, recall, F1 score, TP, FP, FN, and confusion matrices. 
 - Working knowledge of Python and SQL for inspecting and analyzing data. 
 - Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to explain findings clearly. 

Nice to Have

- Exposure to NLP, NER, LLMs, or document classification. 
 - Experience with OCR, PII detection, or sensitive data classification. 
 - Experience building evaluation datasets or using annotation tools. 
 - Exposure to regression testing, model comparison, confidence scores, or threshold tuning. 
 - Familiarity with pandas, Git, and basic testing practices.

data.title: Manager-Tech Ops Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

At American Express, we know that with the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. Whether we're supporting our customers' financial confidence, advancing digital commerce, or enabling people to explore the world, our colleagues are constantly redefining what's possible. 

When you join Team Amex, you become part of a global community committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences. We provide opportunities to learn, grow, innovate, and build meaningful careers while fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and integrity. 

Together, we'll lead the way in delivering innovative, secure, and reliable technology solutions that power millions of customer interactions every day. 

Join #TeamAmex and let's lead the way together. 

About Enterprise Identity SRE & Application Support

Enterprise Identity is the foundation of American Express's digital customer experience, enabling secure, seamless, and reliable authentication and authorization across our digital ecosystem. 

The Enterprise Identity Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Application Support organization plays a critical role in ensuring the availability, performance, scalability, security, and operational resilience of mission-critical Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms. 

Our technology ecosystem includes customer authentication and logon services, OAuth-based authorization capabilities supporting Open Banking, customer identity systems of record such as Product Registry and Profile, and advanced authentication and verification capabilities including One Auth, AuthN+, and Verification Services. 

Operating in a highly distributed, always-on environment, our teams support platforms with availability objectives of 99. 99% and above. Through a global follow-the-sun support model spanning the United States and India, we deliver 24x7x365 operational coverage. 

We partner closely with Product, Software Engineering, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Delivery teams to engineer reliability into our platforms, accelerate automation, improve observability, and continuously enhance production stability. 

How Will You Make an Impact in This Role?

- We are seeking a technically accomplished and results-driven Manager Tech Ops Engineering - Enterprise Identity SRE & Application Support to lead a team of engineers responsible for the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of critical customer identity platforms. 
 - This is a hands-on technical leadership position requiring strong expertise in site reliability engineering, modern application architectures, cloud-native technologies, production troubleshooting, observability, and automation. 
 - The successful candidate will combine deep engineering knowledge with strong people leadership to drive operational transformation, reduce production incidents, improve Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Restore/Recover (MTTR), and establish scalable, proactive, and automated reliability practices. 
 - You will serve as a technical leader and escalation point for complex production challenges, working across engineering and business teams to improve system resilience, eliminate recurring issues, and enable reliable delivery of new capabilities. 
 - Beyond managing day-to-day operations, you will help evolve traditional application support into an engineering-driven SRE organization focused on automation, proactive detection, self-healing, and continuous reliability improvement. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & People Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of approximately 8-10 Site Reliability and Application Support Engineers, fostering technical excellence, ownership, accountability, and continuous learning. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership across Enterprise Identity platforms, including application architecture, distributed systems, authentication and authorization services, and supporting infrastructure. 
 - Act as a technical subject matter expert and escalation point for complex production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and system reliability challenges. 
 - Establish engineering standards, operational best practices, and technical development plans to strengthen team capabilities. 
 - Collaborate with senior engineering leaders, architects, product owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to influence technology strategy and operational priorities. 

Site Reliability Engineering & Production Excellence

- Drive the adoption and maturity of SRE principles and practices across mission-critical Enterprise Identity applications and services. 
 - Define, monitor, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and operational reliability metrics aligned with business expectations. 
 - Lead initiatives to achieve high availability, fault tolerance, scalability, and resilience across distributed application environments. 
 - Improve incident detection, diagnosis, and recovery through advanced monitoring, observability, automation, and operational intelligence. 
 - Drive measurable reductions in MTTD, MTTR, repeat incidents, and operational toil. 
 - Identify systemic reliability risks and partner with engineering teams to implement sustainable architectural and application-level improvements. 
 - Champion capacity planning, performance engineering, resilience testing, and proactive production readiness. 

Incident, Problem & Change Management

- Provide technical leadership during high-severity production incidents, coordinating troubleshooting, recovery, communication, and escalation activities. 
 - Guide engineers through complex application failures involving APIs, microservices, authentication workflows, databases, infrastructure, and downstream dependencies. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and blameless post-incident reviews, ensuring corrective and preventive actions address underlying systemic issues. 
 - Establish effective incident response playbooks, runbooks, escalation procedures, and operational knowledge repositories. 
 - Partner with Engineering and Product teams to identify recurring production defects and prioritize permanent engineering solutions. 
 - Ensure effective communication of production health, incident trends, risks, and remediation progress to senior leadership. 

Automation, AIOps & Operational Transformation

- Drive an automation-first approach to production support, reducing manual intervention and repetitive operational activities. 
 - Lead the development and implementation of automation solutions using Python, Java, scripting frameworks, APIs, and orchestration technologies. 
 - Leverage AIOps, intelligent alerting, event correlation, and anomaly detection to improve operational efficiency and incident prevention. 
 - Promote automated diagnostics, remediation workflows, and self-healing capabilities wherever technically appropriate. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, operational tooling, and production release reliability. 
 - Identify opportunities to apply AI-assisted troubleshooting, incident summarization, and operational analytics to accelerate issue resolution. 

Observability, Performance & Cloud-Native Engineering

- Drive end-to-end observability strategies across applications, APIs, microservices, and infrastructure using logs, metrics, distributed tracing, and actionable alerting. 
 - Leverage technologies such as Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, and related monitoring platforms. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues across Java/Spring Boot applications, REST APIs, containerized workloads, and distributed systems. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to improve application instrumentation, service dependency visibility, performance monitoring, and production diagnostics. 
 - Support reliability and operational excellence for applications deployed on OpenShift, Kubernetes, and other cloud-native platforms. 
 - Promote performance optimization, resource efficiency, scalability, and fault-tolerant application design. 

Engineering Partnership, Release Readiness & Resilience

- Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product, Architecture, and Delivery teams throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure production readiness. 
 - Define and validate non-functional requirements (NFRs), including availability, performance, scalability, recoverability, security, and observability. 
 - Participate in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, release planning, and deployment readiness assessments. 
 - Drive operational acceptance criteria and production readiness reviews for new applications, enhancements, and integrations. 
 - Partner with delivery teams to implement safe deployment practices, rollback strategies, and post-release validation. 
 - Contribute to disaster recovery planning, failover testing, business continuity exercises, and resilience validation. 
 - Champion continuous improvement through engineering retrospectives, operational metrics, and reliability-focused initiatives. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Education & Professional Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of experience in software engineering, site reliability engineering, production engineering, or application support for large-scale enterprise applications. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical engineering teams. 
 - Demonstrated experience supporting business-critical, highly available applications in a 24x7 production environment. 
 - Strong experience troubleshooting complex distributed applications and leading technical incident resolution. 

Technical Engineering Expertise

- Strong programming and scripting skills in at least one language such as Python, Java, or Ruby, with the ability to develop automation, diagnostic utilities, and operational tools. 
 - Hands-on experience supporting Java-based enterprise applications, including Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and microservices architectures. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, application dependencies, HTTP/HTTPS, network fundamentals, load balancing, caching, and database connectivity. 
 - Experience with containerized applications and cloud-native platforms such as OpenShift, Kubernetes, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of application troubleshooting, performance analysis, system diagnostics, and production debugging. 
 - Experience implementing or supporting CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and release management processes. 

Reliability, Observability & Automation

- 5+ years of experience implementing or operating application monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and observability solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience with one or more observability platforms such as Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, or equivalent tools. 
 - 3+ years of experience developing operational automation, scripting solutions, or automated remediation workflows. 
 - Demonstrated understanding of SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident response, and toil reduction. 
 - Experience improving application availability, resilience, performance, and operational efficiency through engineering-driven solutions. 
 - Strong experience in root cause analysis, production problem management, and implementation of preventive measures. 

Leadership & Delivery

- Demonstrated ability to lead engineers through high-priority production incidents and complex technical investigations. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience working with Agile teams and tools such as Jira and Confluence. 
 - Ability to translate technical challenges and operational risks into clear recommendations and actionable improvement plans. 
 - Experience collaborating across geographically distributed engineering and support teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

Identity & Security Engineering

- Experience supporting enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), authentication, or authorization platforms. 
 - Understanding of OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JSON Web Tokens (JWT), Single Sign-On (SSO), and related identity protocols. 
 - Familiarity with API security, token lifecycle management, session management, and authentication workflows. 
 - Experience supporting customer-facing identity services in financial services or other highly regulated environments. 

Advanced SRE & Platform Engineering

- Prior experience as a Site Reliability Engineer, Production Engineer, Software Engineer, or technical lead supporting large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Experience designing or improving highly available, fault-tolerant, and horizontally scalable application architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes/OpenShift troubleshooting, container orchestration, and cloud-native operational practices. 
 - Knowledge of infrastructure as code and automation frameworks such as Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience with resilience engineering techniques, including load testing, failover testing, chaos engineering, and disaster recovery validation. 
 - Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, application performance management, and service dependency mapping. 

AIOps & Intelligent Operations

- Experience implementing AIOps capabilities, anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive monitoring, or intelligent incident management. 
 - Exposure to AI-assisted operational tooling, automated diagnostics, and self-healing architectures. 
 - Experience developing automation frameworks or internal tools that improve engineering productivity and reduce operational toil. 

Operational Excellence

- Working knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles, including incident, problem, change, and release management. 
 - Experience with production readiness assessments, operational risk management, and non-functional requirements validation. 
 - Experience establishing reliability dashboards, operational scorecards, and measurable continuous improvement programs. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence engineering practices and drive cross-functional technical initiatives. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express. 

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally: 

- Competitive base salaries
 - Bonus incentives
 - Support for financial-well-being and retirement
 - Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
 - Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
 - Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
 - Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
 - Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
 - Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. 

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‐oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

data.title: Manager-Tech Ops Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

At American Express, we know that with the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. Whether we're supporting our customers' financial confidence, advancing digital commerce, or enabling people to explore the world, our colleagues are constantly redefining what's possible. 

When you join Team Amex, you become part of a global community committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences. We provide opportunities to learn, grow, innovate, and build meaningful careers while fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and integrity. 

Together, we'll lead the way in delivering innovative, secure, and reliable technology solutions that power millions of customer interactions every day. 

Join #TeamAmex and let's lead the way together. 

About Enterprise Identity SRE & Application Support

Enterprise Identity is the foundation of American Express's digital customer experience, enabling secure, seamless, and reliable authentication and authorization across our digital ecosystem. 

The Enterprise Identity Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Application Support organization plays a critical role in ensuring the availability, performance, scalability, security, and operational resilience of mission-critical Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms. 

Our technology ecosystem includes customer authentication and logon services, OAuth-based authorization capabilities supporting Open Banking, customer identity systems of record such as Product Registry and Profile, and advanced authentication and verification capabilities including One Auth, AuthN+, and Verification Services. 

Operating in a highly distributed, always-on environment, our teams support platforms with availability objectives of 99. 99% and above. Through a global follow-the-sun support model spanning the United States and India, we deliver 24x7x365 operational coverage. 

We partner closely with Product, Software Engineering, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Delivery teams to engineer reliability into our platforms, accelerate automation, improve observability, and continuously enhance production stability. 

How Will You Make an Impact in This Role?

- We are seeking a technically accomplished and results-driven Manager Tech Ops Engineering - Enterprise Identity SRE & Application Support to lead a team of engineers responsible for the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of critical customer identity platforms. 
 - This is a hands-on technical leadership position requiring strong expertise in site reliability engineering, modern application architectures, cloud-native technologies, production troubleshooting, observability, and automation. 
 - The successful candidate will combine deep engineering knowledge with strong people leadership to drive operational transformation, reduce production incidents, improve Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Restore/Recover (MTTR), and establish scalable, proactive, and automated reliability practices. 
 - You will serve as a technical leader and escalation point for complex production challenges, working across engineering and business teams to improve system resilience, eliminate recurring issues, and enable reliable delivery of new capabilities. 
 - Beyond managing day-to-day operations, you will help evolve traditional application support into an engineering-driven SRE organization focused on automation, proactive detection, self-healing, and continuous reliability improvement. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & People Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of approximately 8-10 Site Reliability and Application Support Engineers, fostering technical excellence, ownership, accountability, and continuous learning. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership across Enterprise Identity platforms, including application architecture, distributed systems, authentication and authorization services, and supporting infrastructure. 
 - Act as a technical subject matter expert and escalation point for complex production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and system reliability challenges. 
 - Establish engineering standards, operational best practices, and technical development plans to strengthen team capabilities. 
 - Collaborate with senior engineering leaders, architects, product owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to influence technology strategy and operational priorities. 

Site Reliability Engineering & Production Excellence

- Drive the adoption and maturity of SRE principles and practices across mission-critical Enterprise Identity applications and services. 
 - Define, monitor, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and operational reliability metrics aligned with business expectations. 
 - Lead initiatives to achieve high availability, fault tolerance, scalability, and resilience across distributed application environments. 
 - Improve incident detection, diagnosis, and recovery through advanced monitoring, observability, automation, and operational intelligence.

About Us

We believe the future of software development is AI-native - where engineers operate at a higher level of abstraction and quality remains non-negotiable. 

Incubyte is a software craft consultancy where the "how" of building software matters as much as the "what". 

We partner with companies of all sizes, from helping enterprises build, scale, and modernize to early-stage founders bring their ideas to life. 

Our engineers operate in an AI-native development model, using AI as a collaborator across the SDLC to accelerate development while upholding the discipline of software craftsmanship. Guided by Software Craftsmanship and Extreme Programming practices, we build reliable, maintainable, and scalable systems with speed, without compromising quality. If this way of building software resonates with you, we'd like to talk. 

Our Guiding Principles

These principles define how we work at Incubyte. They are non-negotiable. 

Relentless Pursuit of Quality with Pragmatism

We build high-quality systems without losing sight of delivery. 

Extreme Ownership

We take responsibility end-to-end for decisions, execution, and outcomes. 

Proactive Collaboration

We collaborate closely, challenge each other, and solve problems together. 

Active Pursuit of Mastery

We continuously improve our craft and raise our bar. 

Invite, Give, and Act on Feedback

We seek, give, and act on feedback to get better every day. 

Ensuring Client Success

We act as trusted partners and focus on real outcomes, not just output. 

Job Description

This is a remote position. 

Role Overview

As a Software Craftsperson I, you will have 2+ years or experience and will work on well-defined tasks as part of a team, building strong software engineering fundamentals and gradually increasing your independence. 

You'll work closely with experienced engineers, ask questions, seek feedback, and learn the team's ways of working. You'll contribute to building reliable, maintainable software while developing your skills in coding, testing, debugging, tooling, and documentation. 

At Incubyte, AI is part of how we craft software. You'll use AI to explore solutions, learn faster, improve code, write and review tests, debug issues, and get quick feedback - while developing a strong understanding of the fundamentals behind the work. 

Responsibilities

 - Write clear, reliable, and maintainable code by following established team patterns and practices. 
 - Build strong fundamentals in testing, debugging, tooling, and documentation. 
 - Actively seek feedback, learn from code reviews and peers, and apply feedback to improve your work. 
 - Ask questions, understand the "why" behind tasks, and connect your work to customer value.

 - Knowledge of server configuration and deployment infrastructure 
 - Experience using source control, bug tracking systems, writing user stories, and technical documentation

Benefits

Life at Incubyte

We are a remote-first company with structured flexibility. Teams commit to shared rhythms during core hours, ensuring smooth collaboration while maintaining autonomy. Twice a year, we come together in person for a co-working sprint and once a year for a retreat - with all travel expenses covered. 

Our environment is built for crafters: pairing, refactoring, experimenting with AI, and pushing the boundaries of software excellence. We are all lifelong learners, and our work is our passion.

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop ultra-low-latency trading systems in modern C++ (C++17/20)
 - Build and optimize the Order Management System (OMS) - order routing, pre-trade risk checks, execution handling and fills
 - Profile, benchmark, and systematically reduce end-to-end latency across application, kernel, and network layers
 - Write cache-friendly, lock-free, and memory-efficient code - optimizing at the hardware level including CPU pinning, NUMA awareness, memory alignment, and cache utilization
 - Work on kernel bypass and NIC-level optimizations (DPDK, Solarflare)
 - Collaborate with quant researchers to productionize strategies and ensure system reliability, determinism, and correctness under real-time production conditions
 - Build and maintain market data infrastructure - feed parsing, normalization, and distribution to internal consumers 
 - Own the full execution pipeline - from strategy signal through OMS to order on exchange

Required Skills & Experience

C++ Engineering

- Deep expertise in C++ (C++17/20) - lock-free data structures, concurrent programming, templates, move semantics, and RAII
 - Memory management - custom allocators, memory pools, zero-copy techniques, and avoiding dynamic allocation on hot paths
 - Low-latency fundamentals - CPU cache hierarchy, cache-friendly code, false sharing avoidance, memory alignment, CPU affinity, and thread pinning
 - SIMD/vectorization (SSE/AVX) and shared memory IPC for zero-latency inter-process communication
 - Linux systems - kernel tuning for low latency (IRQ affinity, CPU isolation, huge pages), POSIX threading, real-time scheduling (SCHED_FIFO)
 - Profiling and benchmarking - perf, valgrind, flamegraphs, and the ability to systematically identify and eliminate bottlenecks

Trading & Domain Knowledge

- Strong understanding of Order Management Systems (OMS), order lifecycle, and pre-trade risk checks
 - Experience with FIX protocol and/or exchange-native APIs
 - Ability to consume, parse, and process high-frequency tick data (market data handling)
 - Familiarity with NSE trading systems, exchange connectivity, and market microstructure

Preferred (Nice to Have)

- Exposure to time synchronization (PTP/PPS) and hardware timestamping
 - Experience with tick-level simulation and backtesting infrastructure
 - Knowledge of multicast market data - PIM-SM, IGMP
 - Familiarity with FPGA-based acceleration for ultra-low latency execution or market data processing

Candidate Profile

- Obsessed with performance - measures everything, assumes nothing
 - Strong systems thinker who understands the full stack from hardware to application
 - Disciplined and precise - in HFT, bugs are expensive
 - Comfortable working in a small, high-ownership environment with direct impact on live trading
 - Passionate about low-latency engineering, not just trading

Why Join PHNX Securities

- Build performance-critical systems from the ground up
 - Work directly with the Founder and core trading infrastructure team
 - High ownership and real impact on live trading systems
 - Exposure to real exchange-connected environments and live trading
 - Opportunity to shape the firm's engineering foundation

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Education

- Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

Work Perks! - What's in it for you: 

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It's also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm. 

You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world. 

Market Aligned remuneration structure and a highly competitive salary

Fun and Energetic culture: At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself

Work life Balance: We believe in "No Leave = No Life" So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave

Great place to work - Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people

Wellbeing Focus - We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people. 

Paternity Leave: We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family

A career, not a job: We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.

Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.

Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.

We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their Brightness of Future. 

We encourage you to DREAM BIG through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.

data.title: Sales Team Lead
data.description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Sales Team Lead - Inbound SaaS to drive revenue outcomes and scale a high-performing inbound sales team at MyOperator. 

This is a hands-on leadership role where you will manage a team of Business Consultants handling high-intent inbound leads, while actively contributing to deal strategy, closures, and pipeline health. 

You will own monthly revenue (MRR) targets, drive conversion efficiency across the funnel, and build a culture of accountability, speed, and consistent performance. 

About MyOperator

MyOperator is a Business AI Operator and category leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI-powered chatbots & voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform. Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance - all from a single no-code platform. Trusted by 12, 000+ brands including Amazon, Domino's, Apollo, and Razor-pay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement. 

What You'll Own

1. Revenue & Funnel Ownership

- Own and deliver monthly MRR and closure targets for the team
 - Drive conversion across funnel stages: Lead → Connect → Demo → Closure
 - Improve key metrics: connect rate, demo conversion, win rate, revenue per rep
 - Ensure fast TAT (<15 mins) for inbound lead response

2. Team Leadership & Execution

- Lead daily stand-ups, pipeline reviews, and deal strategy discussions
 - Actively support reps in negotiation and closure of high-value deals
 - Monitor individual performance and drive accountability through data
 - Build a high-energy, target-driven team culture

3. Forecasting & CRM Excellence

- Maintain accurate weekly and monthly revenue forecasts
 - Ensure strong CRM hygiene (Zoho preferred) and pipeline visibility
 - Track and optimize lead distribution and follow-up discipline

4. Coaching & Capability Building

- Conduct weekly role-plays, call reviews, and feedback sessions
 - Identify performance gaps and implement structured coaching plans
 - Partner with L&D to improve sales scripts, objection handling, and demos

Product & Sales Context

- Category: AI-powered SaaS / Cloud Communication Platform
 - Includes: WhatsApp API, Voice/IVR solutions, automation workflows
 - Sales involves solution selling, integrations, and API-based discussions (basic level)

Who Should Apply

- 4-8 years of experience in B2B Inside Sales / SaaS Sales
 - Minimum 2 years of team handling experience with revenue ownership
 - Proven track record of achieving monthly revenue targets in inbound sales
 - Experience managing high-velocity sales cycles (≤ 15 days)
 - Strong working knowledge of CRM tools (Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot)
 - Comfortable with data, dashboards, and conversion metrics

Strong Plus

- Experience in SaaS / Cloud Telephony / CPaaS / Communication Tech
 - Exposure to API-based or integration-led sales conversations
 - Experience scaling teams in a high-growth startup environment

Not a Fit

- Candidates primarily from B2C, retail, insurance, or field sales backgrounds
 - Experience limited to account management without closure ownership
 - Exposure only to long enterprise sales cycles (3-6 months+)
 - Individual contributors without team leadership experience

You will work with international engineering teams in a fully remote, asynchronous environment, helping shape the future of secure developer platforms and AI-powered applications.

- Define and drive the technical direction of authentication protocols, including OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and token exchange, across existing applications and modern authentication services.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550, 000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world's biggest brands. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Reliability, you will serve as a hands-on technical leader within the SRE team, guiding senior engineers, influencing product development teams, and ensuring the systems we operate are built to be reliable, scalable, and observable from the ground up. 

You will drive strategic initiatives, mentor others in the practice of SRE, and help define architectural best practices across our platform. This role is pivotal in aligning teams, enforcing high standards, and scaling SRE principles globally within Veeam. 

What You'll Do

Reliability Engineering & Resilience

- Design and evolve infrastructure to be highly available, fault tolerant, and scalable across public clouds (initially Azure, with future expansion plans to other providers). 
 - Establish and maintain SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets that define and enforce reliability objectives. 
 - Lead incident response, analysis, blameless postmortems, and sharing sessions in order to maximize learning across our entire engineering team and driving changes to the entire socio-technical engineering system. 

Observability & Operational Excellence

- Drive adoption of deep observability practices, ensuring telemetry, logs, metrics, and tracing are comprehensive and actionable. 
 - Develop automation and self-healing tools to reduce toil and support Veeam's fleet management strategy. 
 - Participate in on-call rotations and lead operational excellence across the stack. 

Engineering at Scale

- Contribute to infrastructure as code (IaC), CI/CD systems, deployment automation, and scalable config management. 
 - Integrate and extend monitoring and chaos engineering tools to validate reliability assumptions under load and failure conditions. 
 - Implement testing strategies, canary deployments, and release validation pipelines to protect production environments and allow teams to safely deliver new features as quickly as possible. 

Collaboration & Culture

- Embed within product and platform teams to champion reliability from design through delivery. 
 - Contribute to a learning culture focused on continuous improvement and proactive risk management. 
 - Mentor engineers and advocate for DevOps/SRE best practices across global teams. 

What You'll Bring

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in a Software Engineering role with at least 2 years in Site Reliability, Platform Engineering, or similar. 
 - Deep experience building systems on public cloud providers (Azure preferred)
 - Strong programming skills in JS, Node, Typescript, Go, Java, C#, or similar. 
 - Proven track record in delivering monitoring, alerting, and observability tooling (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). 
 - Experience with IaC tools like Terraform/Pulumi, and container orchestration (e. g. , Kubernetes). 
 - Solid understanding of distributed systems, cloud networking, and cloud-native system design. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills across geographies and disciplines. 

Bonus Skills

- Experience working on large-scale B2B SaaS platforms. 
 - Background in chaos engineering, resilience testing, performance testing, load testing, or incident learning programs. 
 - Familiarity with compliance frameworks (e. g. , ISO, SOC 2, GDPR, FEDRAMP/CMMC). 

What You'll Get

- 18 paid vacation days, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares Private medical coverage for you and up to four dependents
 - Life, accident, and disability insurance with enhanced coverage
 - Annual flexible wellbeing allowance for physical and mental wellness
 - Free confidential counselling and coaching via Employee Assistance Program (EAP), including legal and financial advice
 - Meal, fuel, and transportation benefits based on work arrangement
 - Daycare reimbursement and safe cab facility for eligible employees
 - Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O'Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Please note: If the applicant is permanently located outside India, Veeam reserves the right to decline the application.

data.title: Embedded System - FPGA & SoC Performance Engineer
data.description:
About CynLr

Just like a baby's brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to instinctively see & pick any object under any ambience, without any training. (a demo video link). 

Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn't exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to assemble a Smartphone or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment. 

CynLr-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on-the-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO-like micro-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change. 

At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr' s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision-making, and action. 

This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world. 

About the Role: 

Product Design begins as a hypothetical concept. Transforming that concept into a functional Product is a highly creative and experimental process that requires a strong understanding of system-level fundamentals and application-driven trade-offs. 

In FPGA-based embedded systems, the utility and limitations of a product are defined by how effectively the FPGA platform is configured, integrated, and used at the system and application level. Performance, latency, determinism, and I/O capability depend on IP selection, configuration, firmware integration, and system architecture. 

You will be responsible for the application-level design, integration, validation, and deployment of FPGA-based embedded systems. The Product Design team will be your internal customer. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Supporting CynLr's Product Design team with all FPGA application and system-level activities. 
 - FPGA platform configuration and integration using vendor-provided IP cores and reference designs. 
 - System bring-up, validation, and debugging of FPGA-based hardware platforms. 
 - Verification & Validation (V&V)
 - Defining test procedures for FPGA-based systems and firmware
 - Executing tests and validating manufactured PCBs and assemblies
 - Interfacing with vendors (FPGA vendors, IP providers, PCB manufacturers, component suppliers, simulation and service providers) to plan and coordinate successful project execution. 
 - Acting as the FPGA application and system knowledge base for design engineers and freshers joining the organization. 

Team Structure & Career Path: 

This role resides in the Electronics team and is part of the larger hardware team. The role has touchpoints with other teams most notably the Product Design team. We are a startup and there is a tremendous potential to build your own team or grow into a principal engineer role over time in the space or expand into other areas. 

Job Requirements

Below are some key requirements. We expect working knowledge in most areas and deep hands-on expertise in either FPGA or SoC

A. Electronics & System Fundamentals: 

- Strong understanding of digital electronics and system-level architecture. 
 - Solid understanding of register-based systems and memory architectures (DDR, SRAM, Flash). 
 - Working knowledge of power distribution and sequencing for FPGA-based systems. 
 - Understanding of processor and accelerator architectures (ARM-based SoC FPGAs). B. FPGA Application & Platform Development: 

- Hands-on experience with FPGA or SoC-FPGA. 
 - Strong familiarity with FPGA vendor toolchains (Vivado, Quartus, Libero). 
 - Experience configuring and integrating: 
 - Vendor-provided IP cores
 - Memory controllers
 - Communication and data-movement IP Blocks
 - Ability to generate FPGA bitstreams using existing IP and reference designs. C. Embedded Firmware Design & Development: 

- Strong experience in embedded firmware development using C/C++. 
 - Experience developing firmware for ARM cores inside FPGA SoCs
 - Experience with bare-metal or RTOS-based systems. 
 - Ability to develop and debug drivers for memory-mapped peripherals. 
 - Good understanding of boot flows, BSPs, and build systems. D. Interfaces & Communication: 

- Strong working knowledge of communication protocols: 
 - UART, SPI, I2C, AXI
 - Ethernet, USB
 - Experience debugging data flow, latency, and performance issues at the system level. E. Verification and Validation: 

- Adept in using JTAG-based debugging tools. 
 - Experience with system bring-up and validation of FPGA-based boards. 
 - Experience using: 
 - Logic analyzers
 - Oscilloscopes
 - Vendor-provided tools (Vivado, Quartus, Libero)
 - Ability to create and execute test procedures and validation plans. 
 - Ability to debug data flow and performance bottlenecks at the system level. F. Behavioural Tendency: 

Critical Thinking, Available, Responsible, Versatile, Resourceful, Thorough, Attention to Details & "Humble". 

What Will You Do: 

CynLr' s vision system is central in the control loop of the vision guided manipulation platform. The stereo vision system is acquiring at 75 FPS and this means processing must also happen at this speed or higher and the processing method based on neural network is computationally intensive as it involves a high level of successive matrix multiplication. For this the processing is split between multiple processing units FPGA, GPU and CPU based on the type of processing that is required. Your focus will be majorly on the FPGA, working closely with the Product Design team to build and deploy FPGA-based embedded systems at the application and system level. This includes configuring FPGA platforms using vendor tools and IP, developing embedded firmware to control and interface with FPGA logic, bringing up and validating hardware, and debugging system-level issues involving interfaces, memory, and peripherals. You will define and execute verification and validation procedures, support prototypes and manufacturing builds, and ensure reliable system behaviour in real-world use. This role focuses on integration, firmware, and system validation

How Will You Do: 

Though confined to a focused area, the work is pretty much expected to be entrepreneurial with the exact advantages and difficulties of a startup. Since this is a startup and the product will evolve at a rapid pace, the contours of the technology, toolchain & Process will have to constantly adapt to the changes. You will participate in actively contributing in building the process & tool chain too. You will have complete freedom here, but you will be subjected to reviews.

data.title: Frontline Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Frontline Engineer based in India. 

In this role, you will take ownership of product quality and engineering issue resolution, ensuring reliable performance across complex enterprise digital workplace solutions. Combining quality engineering, test automation, and advanced technical troubleshooting, you will play a key role in strengthening product stability throughout the development lifecycle. You will act as the first engineering responder for complex, high-priority issues reported from the field, investigating root causes and translating findings into actionable engineering improvements. Working closely with software engineers, technical program managers, and product stakeholders, you will connect real-world customer experiences with product development. You will also help build scalable testing frameworks, improve system observability, and prevent recurring defects. This is an impactful engineering opportunity within an innovative, collaborative environment focused on continuous improvement, automation, and delivering exceptional customer experiences. 

Accountabilities

- Own quality engineering and test strategy: Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test suites covering functional, regression, integration, and system-level scenarios. 
 - Drive test automation: Develop and improve automation frameworks to increase test coverage, execution speed, and reliability across product release cycles. 
 - Embed quality throughout development: Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews to identify potential issues early and ensure product reliability, usability, and supportability. 
 - Monitor product quality: Track and report key quality indicators, including defect escape rates, regression rates, test coverage, automation pass rates, and release readiness. 
 - Investigate complex field issues: Serve as the engineering first responder for high-priority technical issues, managing investigations and triage from initial assessment through resolution. 
 - Perform advanced technical debugging: Analyze production logs, monitoring platforms, network traces, configurations, APIs, services, and distributed system behavior to identify failure patterns and potential root causes. 
 - Reproduce and document defects: Recreate customer-reported issues in local or shared environments and prepare detailed technical reports containing reproduction steps, logs, configurations, and relevant diagnostic information. 
 - Maintain accurate issue tracking: Identify duplicate reports, link related defects, and maintain structured issue documentation and JIRA workflows to ensure efficient engineering collaboration. 
 - Collaborate on technical resolutions: Work closely with core engineering teams to validate technical hypotheses, isolate failure points, verify fixes, and perform regression testing before closing issues. 
 - Improve systemic product quality: Analyze recurring field issues and customer service request trends to identify gaps in test coverage, diagnostics, observability, and product design. 
 - Close the feedback loop: Translate real-world product issues into actionable improvements, including additional automated tests, enhanced logging, better documentation, and product enhancements. 
 - Support incident management: Participate in incident retrospectives and collaborate with technical program managers and engineering leadership to monitor service-level agreements (SLAs), issue resolution timelines, and corrective actions. 
 - Optimize engineering workflows: Build and contribute to scripts, automation solutions, and AI-assisted workflows that streamline technical investigations and reduce repetitive tasks. 
 - Maintain technical environments: Set up and manage development and testing environments required for reliable issue reproduction, debugging, and validation. 
 - Improve observability and diagnostics: Recommend and implement enhancements to monitoring, logging, user experience signals, and diagnostic capabilities to reduce future field issue volumes. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, with the ability to read, analyze, debug, and understand complex distributed systems and microservices architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience in software quality engineering, including test planning, test case design, test automation, and defect lifecycle management. 
 - Practical experience investigating production environments using application logs, monitoring solutions, and observability platforms. 
 - Solid understanding of APIs, client-server architectures, distributed systems, and modern software development practices. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate ambiguous, complex, and high-priority technical issues using a structured approach. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, enabling effective collaboration with engineering teams, technical program managers, and product stakeholders. 
 - Ability to take ownership of technical investigations, prioritize competing demands, and translate complex findings into clear, actionable engineering documentation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise device management technologies, particularly Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) platforms across Apple, Android, Windows, or similar operating systems. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude, Rovo, or equivalent solutions. 
 - Previous experience in sustaining engineering, frontline engineering, field engineering, or production systems engineering. 
 - Experience designing, developing, or maintaining test automation frameworks and developer productivity tools. 
 - Familiarity with observability platforms, structured logging, and advanced production diagnostics. 
 - Experience working with JIRA and managing structured engineering defect workflows.

data.title: Senior Engineer - Design Validation (Python Automation & RF/Wireless Validation)
data.description:
The Role

In this role, you will develop Python-based automation solutions and perform RF and wireless validation for Silicon Labs' next-generation wireless SoCs and MCUs. You will work across WLAN, Bluetooth, BLE, and Zigbee technologies, ensuring product performance, reliability, and compliance with specifications. 

This is a great opportunity for an engineer who enjoys combining Python automation, RF testing, hardware debugging, and silicon validation, with exposure to the complete product lifecycle, from FPGA-based pre-silicon validation to post-silicon characterization and production readiness. 

Meet the Team

Our Validation Engineering team plays a critical role in ensuring Silicon Labs' wireless products meet their performance and functional specifications. 

The team works closely with Design, RF, Firmware, and Product Engineering teams to validate wireless MCUs and SoCs across RF, baseband, analog, digital, and peripheral subsystems. 

We are responsible for developing automated validation solutions, characterizing silicon performance, debugging hardware and RF issues, and generating data-driven insights that contribute to product datasheets and successful product releases. 

You will collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to validate wireless technologies, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, BLE, Zigbee, Z-Wave, and proprietary wireless protocols. 

Responsibilities

As an Senior Engineer - Design Validation, you will: 

- Develop, maintain, and enhance Python-based automation frameworks for RF and wireless product validation. 
 - Perform RF validation, characterization, and regulatory testing for WLAN, Bluetooth, BLE, and Zigbee products. 
 - Execute pre-silicon validation using FPGA platforms and post-silicon validation at IC, module, and board levels. 
 - Develop automated test scripts for RF performance, functional validation, and temperature-based characterization. 
 - Debug RF performance, modulation, and wireless connectivity issues in collaboration with Design and Firmware teams. 
 - Perform board-level bring-up, hardware debugging, and system-level validation. 
 - Interface with hardware using UART, SPI, I2C, JTAG, SWD, and J-Link. 
 - Work with RF test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, signal generators, signal analyzers, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. 
 - Analyze validation data, develop Power BI dashboards and reports, and support product characterization and datasheet generation. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify root causes, resolve silicon issues, and improve product performance and reliability. Skills You'll Need

- 4-6 years of hands-on experience in Python automation, hardware validation, RF testing, or wireless product validation. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, including automation scripting, debugging, and test-framework development. 
 - Experience with PyTest or similar Python-based test automation frameworks. 
 - Working knowledge of wireless technologies such as Wi-Fi/WLAN, Bluetooth, BLE, or Zigbee. 
 - Experience with hardware communication interfaces, including UART, SPI, I2C, JTAG, and SWD. 
 - Strong understanding of electronics, embedded systems, and hardware-software integration. 
 - Experience in test execution, debugging, data analysis, and validation reporting. 
 - Familiarity with Git or similar version-control tools. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with RF test equipment, including signal generators, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and oscilloscopes. 
 - Experience with FPGA-based pre-silicon validation and post-silicon bring-up. 
 - Exposure to RF PCB boards, wireless MCUs, and SoC validation. 
 - Experience with Power BI, Python data-analysis libraries, or similar reporting tools. 
 - Knowledge of RF characterization, modulation testing, regulatory compliance, and wireless performance measurements. 
 - Experience in temperature-based validation and automated hardware test setups. Education

B. E. /B. Tech. or M. E. /M. Tech. in Electronics & Communication Engineering or a related discipline. 

"Experience with artificial intelligence (AI) powered tools and technologies used to enhance productivity, analysis, and decision-making"

data.title: STAFF R&D/PRODUCT DVL ENGINEER
data.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world. 

About TE

TE Connectivity Ltd. is a $16 billion global technology and manufacturing leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. For more than 75 years, our connectivity and sensor solutions, proven in the harshest environments, have enabled advancements in transportation, industrial applications, medical technology, energy, data communications, and the home. With 80, 000 employees, including more than 8, 000 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 140 countries, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www. te. com

Bu / Function Description

Digital Data & Networks (DDN) Business Unit at TE Connectivity, where we enable high-speed connectivity solutions that power today's and tomorrow's data-driven world. Engineering team is responsible for development of innovative power interconnection solution products which are used in hyperscale computers, AI, Datacenter, Cloud server, and other IT systems, including connector and cable assembly. We engineer and manufacture cutting-edge interconnect solutions that support high-speed data transmission, signal integrity, and power efficiency. 

Roles & Responsibilities

As MGR R&D/PRODUCT DVL ENGINEERING in TE Connectivity's Digital Data & Networks (DDN) Business Unit, you will lead a sustaining engineering team responsible for the continued support and evolution of production parts and products throughout their lifecycle. This includes driving product lifecycle management, product extensions, rapid NPIs, VAVE initiatives, sustainability improvements, material and process changes, and manufacturing location transfers. The role also involves providing technical support to plants, suppliers, and customers to ensure continuity, quality, and cost optimization. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and manage an engineering team responsible for sustaining activities of Connector and Cable assembly product lines. 
 - Serve as a strong technical partner to cross-functional teams, including Program Management, Sales, Field Application Engineering, Operations, Procurement, and Compliance. 
 - Lead team to execute critical engineering projects, including manufacturing transfers, sustaining, product extensions, cost reduction (VAVE), sustainability and rapid New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives. 
 - Represent engineering in customer meetings, project meetings and site visits, providing technical support and insights as needed. 
 - Champion continuous improvement by enhancing product designs and engineering processes to drive efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability. 
 - Empower and coach team members to achieve business goals, while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and professional growth. 

Mandate Skills

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical / electrical, or a related Engineering discipline; advanced degree preferred. 
 - 10+ years of relevant engineering experience, including a minimum of 2 years in a leadership or management role. 
 - Strong foundation in mechanical and electrical engineering principles with proven application in product development. 
 - Working knowledge on NPI, LeanPD. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership in problem-solving, root cause analysis, and conflict resolution. 
 - Prior experience in Power Connectors, Power Cable assemblies, Bus bar designs are highly preferred. 
 - Proven expertise in sustaining engineering and product lifecycle support, including design enhancements, prototyping, testing, and cost/productivity improvements (VAVE). 
 - Hands-on experience with modern design and analysis tools including 3D CAD, modeling, Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T), and simulation tools. 
 - Knowledge of manufacturing processes such as machining, molding, stamping, and plating. 
 - Knowledge of material properties (metal/plastics) and their application in products. 
 - Familiarity with quality tools and methodologies such as FMEA, Six Sigma, DOE, 8D, etc. 
 - Proven capability to recruit, develop, and lead engineering teams. 
 - Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across teams, cultures, and organizational levels. 
 - Highly organized, self-driven, and able to manage multiple competing priorities with minimal supervision. 

COMPETENCIES

- Technical Expertise: Deep functional and domain knowledge in Mechanical/electrical engineering, with a strong foundation in connector and cable assembly technologies. 
 - Cross-Functional Engineering Leadership: Skilled in leading cross-functional teams across product management, design, manufacturing, quality, procurement and supply chain to drive product lifecycle support. 
 - Global Collaboration: Demonstrated success in working with global teams across regions and cultures, ensuring alignment and shared ownership of engineering deliverables. 
 - Talent Development: Committed to building organizational capability through mentoring, training, workforce planning, and succession development. 
 - Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills with a hands-on approach to root cause analysis, risk assessment, and implementing effective corrective/preventive actions. 
 - Execution Mindset: Results-driven and action-oriented, with a track record of delivering high-impact outcomes under tight timelines and shifting priorities.

data.title: QA Engineer 2 -Mobile Apps
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

Role overview

This role combines hands-on manual and exploratory testing with native mobile application automation for PanelSmart. You will assess Android and iOS app changes on representative devices, exercise survey and account workflows, and maintain Appium tests that provide dependable feedback. You will also validate mobile-to-service integration scenarios with the web and backend teams. 

Core technology stack

Core: Appium, Java, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Maven, and Allure. Supporting integration testing: REST-Assured for selected API interactions. 

What you will do

Manual and exploratory mobile testing

- Perform functional and exploratory testing of the PanelSmart mobile app on Android and iOS devices or simulators, as the team's supported matrix requires. 
 - Investigate platform-specific behavior, device and OS differences, permissions, notifications, interruptions, orientation, connectivity, and app lifecycle where relevant. 
 - Test login, password recovery, menus, settings, survey navigation and pause/resume, and questionnaire types and validation rules. 
 - Report reproducible defects with device, OS, app build, setup, steps, expected and actual results, and screenshots or logs; retest fixes. 

Mobile automation

- Build and maintain Appium end-to-end tests in Java using the team's TestNG and Maven framework. 
 - Keep shared driver setup, platform-specific locators, page objects, test data, and utilities readable and reusable. 
 - Automate agreed Android and iOS smoke, sanity, and regression scenarios, including login, menus, survey questions, notifications, and logout. 
 - Use Allure results and captured evidence to diagnose failures and distinguish application defects from device, environment, and test issues. 

Integration and CI

- Validate mobile workflows that depend on backend services, using REST-Assured helpers or API checks where they support the test scenario. 
 - Maintain test data and environment configuration for supported platforms, and coordinate app builds and test readiness with development teams. 
 - Run and maintain the Android and iOS automation workflows, review results, and improve stability, evidence, and feedback. 

Collaboration and quality practices

- Review stories and acceptance criteria for mobile-specific risks, accessibility of controls, and testability across supported platforms. 
 - Use manual and exploratory findings to prioritize new regression automation and focus coverage on high-impact user journeys. 
 - Contribute automation code through Git-based review workflows and communicate quality risks clearly to product and engineering. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Required Experience And Skills

- 3-5 years of hands-on experience with manual functional and exploratory testing of mobile applications. 
 - Experience with Appium-based mobile automation; Java is the primary language in this framework. 
 - Understanding of Android and iOS app behavior, device or simulator testing, and platform-specific test considerations. 
 - Experience with TestNG or a comparable test runner, reusable automation design, and debugging test failures. 
 - Working knowledge of Maven, Git, and collaborative code review practices. 
 - Experience validating API-backed mobile workflows; familiarity with REST-Assured for selected integration tests is useful. 
 - Clear defect reporting and effective collaboration with product, mobile, web, and backend engineering teams. 

Helpful Additional Experience

Experience with device farms, broader mobile CI operations, or approved AI tools for test design and log analysis may be useful as team needs evolve. 

How success is measured

- Manual and exploratory testing identifies platform-specific risks before release. 
 - Agreed critical mobile journeys run reliably on supported Android and iOS targets. 
 - Failures include actionable logs, screenshots, and device and environment details. 
 - Defects and automation failures are triaged promptly, with avoidable flakiness reduced. 
 - Regression automation reflects product changes and priorities across supported platforms.
