data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT-payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more-in one unified workforce platform. 

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees' payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps-like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Bedrock, and Greenoaks-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes (#12 out of 500)

About The Team

The Tax Payment team is powering the tax remittance of $30 billion+ to 5000+ tax agencies. We ensure taxes are paid on the time. We ensure billions of tax payment across 40+ countries get get remitted on time through automated systems. 

We own the end to end lifecycle of tax remittance from salary payout to agency payment and refunds. Our system orchestrate complex tax remittance scenariosacross different countries, currencies, and compliance requirements. 

We've built intelligent engine to plan the tax remittance to maximize the float income and remitt taxes to 5000+ tax authorities without minimal manual intervention while maintaining strict compliance and audit requirements. We're a mission-critical team where reliability is paramount - every line of code directly impacts people's livelihoods. We solve fascinating problems at the intersection of financial systems, international compliance, and large-scale automation, building fault-tolerant pipelines that handle complex scenarios while scaling globally. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the Architecture and Development: Design and evolve the core tax remittance product that moves $30B+ across 40+ countries and 5000+ tax agencies, with reliability and correctness as first principles. 
 - Own Tax Remittance Pipelines: Architect and build end-to-end pipelines that orchestrate the full lifecycle of tax payments - from salary payout to agency remittance and refunds - ensuring payments are timely, accurate, auditable, and compliant. 
 - Scale Distributed Payment Systems: Develop and optimize distributed systems that handle high-throughput, multi-currency tax remittances, agency cut-offs, retries, reconciliation, and failure recovery at global scale. 
 - Drive Technical Excellence: Set the bar for reliability, observability, security, and regulatory/audit readiness in a mission-critical domain where every deployment impacts people's livelihoods. 
 - Cross-Team & External Collaboration: Partner closely with Payroll, Banking, Finance Ops, Compliance, and external payment partners/tax agencies to define roadmaps, de-risk launches, and unlock new geographies and products. 
 - Mentor and Influence: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers across the org, influencing architecture, design reviews, and operational practices to build a high-performance, ownership-driven culture. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 9+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a role leading architecture, designing consumer facing products and building systems. 
 - Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in backend development, distributed systems, and large-scale data pipelines. 
 - Data Pipeline Experience: Hands-on experience with data processing frameworks
 - Scalability and Performance: Deep knowledge of building and scaling real-time, high-throughput systems. 
 - Consumer-Facing Product Development: Experience working on consumer-grade applications with a focus on intuitive user experiences. 
 - Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and debugging skills with a passion for solving complex technical challenges. 
 - Communication: Ability to convey technical concepts to both engineering and non-engineering audiences effectively.

Key Responsibilities

data.title: Principal Engineer, Software
data.description:
This is where  your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride.   

Job Summary

  

We are seeking an experienced software engineering leader to design and deliver scalable, cloud-enabled software solutions that support critical business and customer needs. In this role, you will provide technical leadership across the software development lifecycle, driving architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and delivery of high-quality products. You will collaborate with global cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and leverage modern technologies including . NET, microservices, cloud platforms, and Kubernetes to build reliable and scalable solutions. 

  

What you'll be doing

  

- Plan and deliver defined software projects, including schedules, dependencies, and coordination with development and support teams. 
 - Design, architect, develop, test, and maintain scalable . NET applications, APIs, and microservices. 
 - Develop clean, maintainable code and drive solutions to complex technical and performance issues. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, designers, users, and cross-functional teams to define requirements and architecture. 
 - Evaluate technical concepts and design alternatives with consideration for business objectives, cost, and product needs. 
 - Conduct code reviews, troubleshoot defects, and ensure adherence to engineering standards and best practices. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 
 - Monitor relevant technologies and apply them where they improve product quality and competitiveness. 

  

What you'll bring

  

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, with 12+ years of relevant experience.   
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to solve complex technical problems. 
 - Proficiency in . NET, C#, Web APIs, microservices, Kubernetes, and relational databases such as SQL Server. 
 - Experience with Azure or AWS; knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, or React is desirable. 
 - Strong understanding of database design and development, including SQL Server or other relational databases. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication, collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to align technical solutions with business objectives and cost considerations. 
 - Medical-device software experience is preferred. 

  

  

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

data.title: Platform Engineering Manager
data.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we're looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. 

The Mission

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native SaaS platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a multi-tenant control plane, automation, and platform services that let customers securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. Behind that experience sits a distributed platform responsible for provisioning, fleet management, software lifecycle, zero-downtime upgrades, observability, security, and multi-region operations across globally distributed cloud infrastructure - built to a target of 99. 99% availability, balancing reliability, performance, operational excellence, and infrastructure efficiency at global SaaS scale. 

As a Software Engineering Manager for Managed Gateways Infrastructure, you will own and grow Kong's Bangalore-based engineering team, taking full accountability for this multi-tenant SaaS platform. Kong Cloud Gateways is growing 100% YoY, and as enterprises increasingly adopt AI alongside traditional APIs, this platform becomes an increasingly important part of Kong's API and AI strategy - every improvement in automation, scalability, and operational excellence you drive accelerates new platform capabilities and lets product teams innovate faster. Beyond the technical charter, you play a key role in shaping a dynamic engineering culture - one built on urgency, ownership, and first-principles thinking - as the team scales to match the pace of the business. 

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role - you're expected to stay close to the systems, dig into hard problems alongside your team, and not hesitate to get into the trenches when it matters. 

What You'll Do

- Own and grow Kong's Managed Gateways Infrastructure engineering team in Bangalore - scaling the team's capability, raising the technical bar, and staying hands-on in critical implementations and incidents, not just directing from a distance. 
 - Own the reliability and scalability of a multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure platform serving customers across regions and clouds - every architectural decision has to hold up under multi-tenant load, isolation, and blast-radius considerations, not just single-tenant assumptions. 
 - Drive 4-9s (99. 99%+) availability across Kong's global infrastructure footprint - owning capacity, resilience, and failure-mode design across multi-region, multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP) so Cloud Gateways stays up for customers everywhere, at any scale. 
 - Act as a direct technical contributor when it counts - complex incidents, architecture reviews, and high-stakes implementations that materially move the needle on Managed Gateways' growth and reliability. 
 - Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team building and operating Kong's SaaS infrastructure for Managed Gateways, in direct support of our critical enterprise customer base globally. 
 - Architect and implement robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native systems using technologies like Kubernetes, Golang, and major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Own the complete operational lifecycle end-to-end - infrastructure, reliability, on-call, incident response, and blameless post-mortems - as one integrated engineering charter, not a separate function. 
 - Drive developer delight and operational efficiency through automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways, while proactively preventing technical debt and reducing operational toil. 
 - Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs, and advocate for architectural best practices that keep Managed Gateways performant and resilient as it scales. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, engineering, and support teams to influence roadmap decisions and ensure operational readiness for new features. 

What You'll Bring

The Toolkit: 

- Proven experience leading and managing software engineering teams responsible for infrastructure and reliability in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with a track record of staying technically hands-on rather than purely delegating. 
 - Deep, current expertise in designing, deploying, and operating highly available distributed systems on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - this role needs someone who can still open a terminal and debug production, not just review architecture diagrams. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s) and container orchestration in production environments. 
 - Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for infrastructure automation and service development. 
 - Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage critical incidents personally when needed, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective preventative measures. 
 - Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus. 

The Kong DNA

- Ownership: You take full responsibility for the reliability and performance of systems, driving initiatives from conception to completion. 
 - Urgency: You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision. 
 - Collaboration: You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals. 

Bonus Points

- Experience with open-source contributions or active participation in SRE/cloud-native communities. 
 - Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (e. g. , CKA, CKAD). 
 - Background in companies focused on developer tools, infrastructure software, or API management. 

About Kong

Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic - on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www. konghq. com.

data.title: Director, Data & Agentic AI Engineer
data.description:
Job Purpose: 

- GSK R&D and Digital & Tech's collective goal is to deliver GSK impact, including the acceleration of the discovery and development of medicines and vaccines to patients. The Labs and CMC Tech function is central to this mission, driving the reimagining and business transformation of our global laboratory and CMC processes. We are actively transitioning from managing raw scientific data to generating structural scientific knowledge-the foundation for how R&D will discover future medicines in a technology-enabled ecosystem. 
 - The Labs CMC Data, Agentic and Knowledge Engineering (DAKE) group architects the data, agentic and knowledge foundations upon which critical R&D processes and scientific workflows depend. Crucially, our operating model relies on a hybrid workforce: AI agents function as "digital workers" to execute hands-on engineering tasks. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures. 
 - Reporting into the Director of Data and Agentic AI Engineering (G5), the Associate Director, Data & Agentic AI Engineering, leads the design of production data systems for a team and its domains within Labs & CMC. The role defines the architectural, quality, and governance standards the team and its digital workers apply, leads the team's AI-grade data infrastructure, and mentors junior and mid-level engineers. 

Key Responsibilities

Domain-Level Data and Agentic Engineering

- Design and build production data pipelines for your specific Labs and CMC domain, serving multiple downstream scientific consumers. 
 - Implement, enforce and extend our team's patterns for agent-generated work, defining exactly what digital workers build and remediate autonomously versus what requires human review within your domain. 
 - Integrate digital workers into your team's specific orchestration and observability workflows, applying clear guardrails, tool designs, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Lead the response to significant data quality incidents within your team's purview, from initial detection through to permanent resolution. 

Context & Semantics Layer

- Set the context standards for the team's Labs & CMC domains: how definitions, contracts, classification and lineage are captured in the governed context layer, so humans and digital workers can rely on them. 
 - Actively contribute to the broader Labs and CMC context layer by feeding your team's hands-on operational experience upward to evolve the platform. 

Data Quality & Governance

- Execute data quality and governance standards for your team's domains, encoding them directly into the context layer so both humans and digital workers apply them by default. 
 - Lead local data quality initiatives to achieve measurable outcomes, such as reduced error rates, improved audit readiness, and better downstream AI performance. 

AI Data Infrastructure & Lifecycle

- Extend our AI-grade data infrastructure for your team's specific AI system needs, including novel retrieval architectures, improved real-time data flows, and smart evaluation datasets. 
 - Manage the data lifecycle for AI systems within your domain, including versioning, drift monitoring, and the governance of AI artefacts. 

Platform Engineering & Mentorship

- Design cloud data infrastructure for your team's domains, improve our Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and its deployment reliability. 
 - Build shared platform components used by multiple engineers and digital workers to reduce setup time for new Labs and CMC data projects. 
 - Set and enforce the code and documentation quality standards for your team, written explicitly for a hybrid workforce of humans and digital workers
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, code review, and direct feedback to visibly improve their capability and independence. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of data engineering experience, including significant time leading the design and operation of complex production data systems. 
 - Deep expertise with modern warehouses or lakehouses, orchestration and transformation frameworks, and batch and streaming architectures. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and operating AI agents or substantial LLM-powered tools inside data engineering workflows, including tool design, evaluation, observability and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Experience leading the design of AI-grade data infrastructure for production AI systems, including evaluation datasets, retrieval architectures and real-time data flows. 
 - Experience leading data lifecycle management for AI systems, including versioning, drift monitoring and governance of AI artefacts. 
 - A track record of defining data quality and governance standards for a team or domain that others adopted, with measurable outcomes. 
 - Experience leading cloud data infrastructure design with infrastructure as code. 

Preferred Experience

- Technical lead for one or more data platforms or significant domains, from first build through to scale. 
 - Experience with catalogue, metadata, semantic or lineage infrastructure that AI systems consume. 
 - Experience working within highly regulated industries, such as life sciences, where strict data integrity and auditability are non-negotiable mandates. 

#AGTech

#GSK-LI

Skills

Computer Programming, Data Analysis, Data Architecture Development, Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform, Data Engineering, Data Governance, Data Ingestion, Data Integration, Data Migrations, Data Modeling, Data Transformation, ETL Development, Performance Tuning, Structured Query Language (SQL)

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

data.title: Director - Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Title: Director - Software Engineering

GCL: F

Introduction To Role

Are you ready to lead a full-stack DevOps organization that turns modern science into secure, scalable software used across global R&D? In this role, you will shape and deliver in-house products that help our scientists move faster from discovery to delivery, ultimately improving outcomes for patients. What could you accomplish by combining your cloud-native depth, AI-augmented engineering practices, and leadership to scale critical platforms across the enterprise?

Based in Chennai, you will guide a high-performing, multi-functional team and partner closely with Business Product Owners and collaborators. You will set the engineering bar for quality, security and compliance, drive measurable product outcomes, and cultivate a culture of modern, agile development where automation, observability and continuous improvement are standard. 

Accountabilities

- Product Strategy and Road mapping: Collaborate with collaborators to validate requirements, prioritize features, and define timelines and achievements that deliver clear business outcomes. 
 - End-to-End DevOps Ownership: Lead the full product lifecycle from planning and build through development, testing, launch and operations, ensuring reliability, security, and cost efficiency. 
 - Hands-on Technical Leadership: Give to build and code reviews; act as a senior developer on sophisticated features to unlock velocity and uphold engineering excellence. 
 - Agile Pod Leadership: Drive an agile POD to deliver sophisticated enterprise systems; embed enterprise standards focused on maintaining quality, security, and conformity; foster continuous integration and del ivery. 
 - Performance, Observability and Optimization: Supervise product performance, analyze metrics, and implement improvements using robust logging, monitoring and alerting to raise availability and user experience. 
 - Engineering Culture and Coaching: Mentor engineers, promote cross-team teamwork, and evangelize modern, AI-augmented software practices and rigors. 
 - People Leadership: Develop talent; handle performance, hiring, pay and training decisions; shape a diverse, high-trust team environment that scales. 
 - Collaborator Partnership and Communication: Align engineering roadmaps with business priorities; communicate progress and risks clearly; remove obstacles to delivery. 
 - Risk, Security and Compliance: Uphold security-by-design, identity and access guidelines, and supervised ways of working appropriate to R&D contexts. 

Essential Skills/Experience

- 10+ years of IT experience
 - Experience in crafting and implementing Cloud Native applications
 - 5+ years working with administrating cloud infrastructure, e. g. , Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, 5+ years within Linux and Network administration
 - Experience in Identification/Access Management such as SAML and OAuth
 - Experience working with Database administration, i. e. MongoDB
 - Software development skills in Python, SQL, 
 - Regulatory knowledge, i. e GxP is a merit
 - Should have worked in distributed agile model and continuous integration
 - Analytical skills with attention to detail in quality
 - Experiences in CI/CD pipeline implementation
 - Demonstrate ability to apply technical knowledge to multiple systems and support multiple business groups and applications
 - Superb communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to work with global teams to achieve objectives, phenomenal teammate
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Science, or equivalent degree is helpful. 

Desirable Skills/Experience

- Proven leadership of full-stack product teams delivering enterprise systems at scale
 - Experience in life sciences domain or R&D workflows
 - Expertise with microservices, event-driven architectures, and API design
 - Strong observability practice (logging, metrics, tracing) with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry
 - SRE and operational perfection experience, including reliability patterns and on-call leadership
 - Cost optimization and managing prioritisation in public cloud environments
 - Experience with modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular) and Python frameworks (FastAPI, Django)
 - Familiarity with data privacy, security by build, and regulated environments (GxP)

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash ambitious thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Here, engineering directly accelerates science to patients. You will work alongside diverse experts who unite sophisticated data, machine learning and modern software to translate complex information into practical decisions that move medicines safely and quickly. We bring surprising combinations of talent together to solve hard problems, value courtesy alongside ambition, and give you the scope to learn fast, raise your profile and see your ideas move from prototype to production at scale. 

Lead the team that turns ambitious ideas into reliable products that reach patients faster-take the next step and tell us you're ready to make this impact today!

11-Nov-2026

03-Dec-2026

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. data.description:
Job Title

Senior Automation Engineer

Division

Engineering

Location: 

Pune

Job Summary

The Lead Automation Engineer is responsible for delivery of engineering Automation design outputs for projects and, where requested, bid proposals. They will be responsible for the technical scope of the project/proposal (or, in some cases, a sub-area of the scope). For the scope area for which they are responsible, the Lead Automation Engineer must: 

- Provide leadership to engineers working on that area. 
 - Function as the interface point for customers and, also, the SPX internal organization. 
 - Propose / update the execution strategy within the project life to get the most relevant & efficient team. 
 - Ensure adherence with relevant SPX Flow procedures and practices (e. g. IDEFs)
 - Manage the engineering process to ensure outputs meet schedule, budgetary and quality requirements. 
 - Ensure that the scope delivered from engineering is aligned with contract or proposal requirements (KPIs)

Depending on the scope of the project, the Lead Automation Engineer may be required to undertake engineering design tasks corresponding to their own core discipline and, as such, reference should be made to relevant job descriptions such as Process Engineer, Mechanical Engineer, Automation Engineer, etc. 

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

Lead Automation Engineers are expected to possess relevant experience of engineering design and execution from within the industries which we serve. Duties include, but are not limited to, the following: 

Lead Engineer

The primary role will be to perform the "lead engineer" tasks on projects and proposals: 

- Safety & Environment
 - Ensuring that plant designs are safe. 
 - Ensuring that environmental impacts of designs have been considered appropriately. 
 - Ensuring that relevant reviews, as defined in SPX Flow procedures and, additionally, customer contracts, have been undertaken fully and that resultant actions have been completed. (Example reviews include: Design Reviews, Risk Assessments)
 - Ensuring compliance with local legislation and regulations (for the locality of the plant/process) which apply to engineering design (e. g. EU Machinery Directive)
 - Promoting a safety culture amongst staff, particularly when operating outside of the known office environment (e. g. on customer and supplier sites)

- Management of Engineering Design Process
 - Owning the engineering execution model throughout the project lifecycle, including adapting approach as required to suit changing requirements. 
 - Interpreting contractual requirements, defining design deliverable, and devising an appropriate plan for the design phase of the project
 - Generating and maintaining the time schedule for engineering phase, including consulting with Project Manager to ensure alignment with overall project schedule
 - Identifying resource needs and ensuring that resource managers are kept informed about ongoing changes to requirements. 
 - Establishing and leading engineering team meetings/discussions as required to achieving the project or proposal's engineering design deliverables. Ask for approval to our customers when contractually required or just deliver documentation for information. 
 - Managing team members to meet schedule demands and target on-budget execution (in terms of hours), whilst still ensuring delivery of a thoroughly engineered, complete design. (In other words, the Lead Engineer is required to manage the balance between cost, timescale, and quality). Keep close relationship with Project Manager & Costs Controller to provide updated EAC (Estimation at Completion)

- Design Ownership
 - Ensuring that the design is executed in line with: 
 - Applicable legislation and regulation
 - Customer contractual requirements (or, in case of proposal, RFQ/URS requirements) 
 - SPX references, standards, and best practices, where applicable
 - Ensuring that the output of design team is complete and of a consistent standard. Examples include ensuring that: 
 - Documentation (e. g. P&IDs, FDS, Operating Manuals etc. ) uses the same standards and that these are delivered to a consistent level in terms of content and quality. 
 - A suitable "project equipment catalogue" is established to support item selection. 
 - Consistent approaches are applied for electrical build. 
 - Ensuring all scope elements/sub-systems integrate coherently and that external interfaces are clearly understood and defined. 
 - Ensuring that all design information is captured, stored, and maintained in a suitable structured and accessible location (in line with SPX Flow procedures and practices)
 - Engaging with Supply Chain to support purchasing process (initial specification, review of supplier quotes, etc)
 - Consulting with installation teams to ensure output designs reflect transportation and assembly requirements. 
 - Leading resolution of design issues identified during the installation and commissioning phases. 
 - Coordinate customer automation training when applicable 
 - Communication
 - Ensuring appropriate engineering attendance at customer meetings (as agreed with Project Manager or Bid Process Owner) e. g. : 
 - Pre-contract sales meetings
 - Customer launch/ "kick-off" meetings (for project or proposal) 
 - Intermediate review meetings
 - Commissioning or snag resolution meetings 
 - Ensuring appropriate engineering attendance at internal meetings, as defined by SPX Flow processes, and as agreed with Project Manager or Bid Process Owner) e. g. : 
 - Progress meetings
 - Meetings with 
 - Risk reviews
 - Project reviews
 - Design reviews
 - Leading communication with other SPX Flow stakeholders (e. g. PM, Project Controls, I&C, AM, Engineering resource managers, EHS & Quality). Ensuring that critical information, such as schedule delays, costs to complete. . . are communicated in a timely fashion. 
Project or Proposal Engineering

Depending on scope and scale of the project or proposal, the Lead Automation Engineer may be required to undertake engineering design and execution tasks associated with their core skill base (e. g. process design, PLC coding, etc). Please refer to associated job descriptions for these specific roles for more details. 

Engineering Community Member

As a Leader Within The Engineering Team, The Lead Automation Engineer Will Be Expected To Actively Participate In The Wider Technical Community And Provide Support To Colleagues

- General Technical Support
 - Function as "subject matter expert" in areas where they have appropriate experience and partake in knowledge sharing as required. 
 - Mentoring of recently recruited, or inexperienced, staff
 - Providing general technical support outside of the specific projects/proposals for which they are responsible. Examples include: 
 - Conceptual design guidance during proposal stage
 - Technical review of quotation text prior to bid submission
 - Participating in design reviews as an "external" expert
 - Provide support to conceptual design or feasibility studies. 
 - Continuous Improvement
 - Providing input into continuous improvement initiatives (e. g. tools development, standardisation)
 - Documenting and communicating "lessons learned. "
 - Involvement in knowledge sharing initiatives (e. g. documenting best practices)
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Fluent English - both spoken and written. 
 - Excellent communication skills 
 - Strong knowledge of engineering design & execution 
 - Ability to work with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to work on multiple tasks, within a matrix environment. 
 - Ability and willingness to work within a team and build relationships with colleagues across multiple functions and in geographically diverse locations. 
 - The ability to meet high performance standards in a team whilst maintaining ethics and integrity. 
 - Ability to work on multiple tasks, within a matrix environment
 - Ability and willingness to work and build relationships with colleagues across multiple functions and geographically diverse sites
 - Good analytical/problem-solving skills and attention to detail 
 - Good initiative and ability to work independently
 - The ability to meet high performance standards in a team whilst maintaining ethics and integrity
 - Must have experience with Studio5000 from Rockwell
 - Must have experience with Siemens SimaticNET and TIA Portal
 - Must be proficient with Wonderware InTouch
 - Must have experience with Microsoft Excel
 - Experience with Schneider PLC systems an advantage
 - C++, C#, Visual Studio an advantage

Education And Experience

- Degree level qualification in appropriate engineering discipline (e. g. Electrical) 
 - Automation execution experience, preferably in Food, Beverage, Pharmaceutical and/or other hygienic industries
 - Understanding of control requirements for common hygienic processes (e. g. pasteurisation, CIP) beneficial
 - Experience of working within, and leading, a technically oriented team
 - Full driving license a strong advantage
 - Good level of competence in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
 - Knowledge and experience of Siemens and AB Rockwell programming environments (e. g. S7, TIA Portal, Contrologix) 
 - Experience of Wonderware SCADA and associated products (e. g. InTouch) beneficial
 - SAP experience beneficial

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

In general, this is an office-based job with a considerable amount of time spent at a computer. Ability to travel to other SPX locations and customer sites is a requirement. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

WORKING CONDITIONS

Ability to travel globally up to approximately 30% of the time. 

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

DISCLAIMER

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

SPX FLOW VALUES

SPX Flow employees are expected to behave in accordance with our company values as outlined below. 

QUALITY

Quality encompasses all aspects of SPX's business, and every employee shares the responsibility to prevent the occurrence of any nonconformity relating to product, process, and the quality system. All employees have an obligation to identify and record any such nonconformity, and through designed channels, initiate and recommend solutions.

data.title: Data Centre Engineering Operations (DCEO) Facility Manager
data.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

Key job responsibilities

- Management and leadership of DCEO Engineering Team. Executes vision and goals for the team or department. 
 - Responsible for the overall operation and maintenance (both routine and emergency) of the critical infrastructure supporting IT operations of Data Centers. Has primary responsibility for availability zone of Data Centers. 
 - Managing and developing teams of shift engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance. Is active in the training and/or development of others. 
 - Liaising with internal teams & management groups. Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency
 - Participates in strategic planning projects. Helping in design, build and bring online new Data Centers. Negotiates and rolls out contracts and space. 
 - Assisting & managing relationships with vendors & contractors. 
 - Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility operations and maintenance. Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes. 
 - Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management and reporting. Deliver quality service and ensure all customer demands are met. 
 - Participates in recruiting efforts and performance management of the existing team. Continually raises the bar. 
 - Conducts financial analysis and contributes to financial decisions. Procurement for DCEO related expenditure
 - Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers. 
 - Responsible for asset and inventory management. 
 - Assist in the design and build out of new facilities & multiple projects to increase current facility efficiency. Oversee the build out of Facility-specific infrastructure in existing locations. 

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve. 

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
 - 6+ years of engineering work managing large-scale services experience
 - 3+ years of people management and team development experience
 - Experience operating a mission-critical team or product
 - Experience in engineering work, managing large-scale services
 - Experience maintaining SLAs through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units
 - 6+ years of work in data centers with an emphasis on building and equipment operation experience
 - 3+ years of work in a management position with 5 or more direct reports experience
 - Experience in a management position with 5 or more direct reports
 - Experience working in data centers with an emphasis on building and equipment operation

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Design Quality Engineering, Quality Assurance, Medical Devices, Biomedical Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering, with hands-on experience in design controls, risk management, quality documentation, and regulatory compliance. 

The role involves participating in design and manufacturing reviews, generating and reviewing DFMEAs/UFMEAs, conducting risk assessments, reviewing design and development documentation, managing CAPAs, and ensuring compliance with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA, GMP, and other applicable regulatory standards. 

Candidates should have experience working in Medical Devices, Aeronautics, Automotive, or other highly regulated industries, along with a strong understanding of manufacturing processes, quality systems, technical documentation, and continuous improvement practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Participate in design reviews, manufacturing reviews, and New Product Development (NPD) initiatives as the Design Quality representative. 
 - Support New Product Development and Sustaining Product Development activities to ensure compliance with quality standards and regulatory requirements. 
 - Generate, review, and maintain Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) and Use Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (UFMEA) documentation.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to drive continuous improvement.

- Apply knowledge of manufacturing processes, including metrology, precision machining, grinding, product cleaning, and sterilization.

 - Hands-on experience with DFMEA, UFMEA, risk analysis, and design risk management. 
 - Experience reviewing and approving design and development documentation. 
 - Knowledge of CAPA, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and internal quality audits.

 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite or equivalent productivity tools. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills. Preferred Qualifications

- CQE (Certified Quality Engineer), Lean, or Six Sigma certification. 
 - Advanced knowledge of ISO 14971 and medical device risk management principles. 
 - Hands-on experience with SolidWorks and SolidWorks ePDM. 
 - Familiarity with Oracle R12 and Agile PLM. 
 - Experience supporting FDA and ISO audits in a regulated engineering or medical device environment. 
 - Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, design quality processes, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Detail-oriented with strong analytical, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Travel Requirements

- Willingness to travel up to 10% as required. Physical Requirements

- Ability to sit and stand for extended periods.

data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible for driving business excellence and organization transformation through continuous improvement initiatives, while ensuring compliance with IMS, DISHA, ABEM, and other quality frameworks through regular audits, training, and process management. Additionally, this role will also oversee equipment management strategies, optimize resource allocation, and maintain high standards of operational excellence in line with Six Sigma methodologies.

Lead Business Excellence and Organization Transformation

Integrated Management Systems (IMS) And Audits

Ensure adherence to the 9 standards as outlined in the IMS framework. 

Facilitate communication for internal audits, collate observations, ensure timely closure of findings and manage the recertification process. 

Organize and lead management review meetings to communicate audit findings and drive continuous improvement. 

Coordinate refresher trainings for new joiners on IMS and provide auditor training as needed. 

Oversee surveillance audits conducted by external auditors, such as TUV NORD, and ensure compliance with observations. 

DISHA Process Management

Ensure processes align with DISHA requirements and oversee adherence across operations and maintenance (O&M) teams. 

Audit DISHA processes as documented in the 18 manuals, track compliance, and report KPI achievements to management. 

Govern the accountability framework for DISHA processes and ensure robust implementation. 

Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) for critical equipment, and as needed for non-critical equipment. 

Perform regular FMEA for defined equipment and RCA at the unit level for UTA. 

ABEM And AWMS Compliance

Ensure strict adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) within the ABEM framework. 

Lead preparation for audits based on communications from the business excellence team at the head office, monitor and track the sustainment of ABEM practices within the assigned zone. 

Facilitate 5S activities and ensure they are performed consistently. 

Coordinate with the head office team for QC and 5S audits, acting as the SPOC for audit schedules, planning, and tracking. 

Maintenance And Equipment Management

Conduct periodic reviews of equipment classification to ensure accurate categorization. 

Analyse critical inventory to optimize resource allocation and minimize downtime. 

Maintain a clear distinction between critical and non-critical equipment for prioritized maintenance. 

Business Sustainability

Ensure adherence to IMS, AWMS, DISHA, and CHETNA guidelines to ensure sustainable business practices. 

Prioritize safety of personnel and equipment by enforcing training and adherence to safety protocols. 

Drive initiatives for environmental sustainability and compliance with relevant regulations. 

Foster a culture of continuous improvement and quality management within the department. 

Digitization And Automation

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to enhance operational efficiency. 

Implement process and system improvements by integrating new technologies and adoption of automation solutions. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of digital initiatives.

Operations & Maintenance

Key Stakeholders - External

Auditors

Educational Qualification: 

BE/B. tech or equivalent technical field. 

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

10+ years of experience in quality management, process improvement, or a related field, with a proven track record in leading transformation initiatives. 

Preferred Industry

Experience in manufacturing, automotive, energy, or any industry with a strong focus on operational excellence and quality management systems.

We are seeking a highly experienced and detail‐oriented senior with strong expertise in validating AI/ML models, Generative AI (GenAI) systems, and multi‐agent workflows within GxP‐regulated and quality‐critical environments. - Lead the validation strategy for AI/ML and GenAI-enabled business solutions, ensuring compliance with GxP, CSV, CSA, risk management, and applicable regulatory expectations. 
 - Author and maintain Validation Plans, Validation Strategies, Traceability Frameworks, Acceptance Criteria, and Validation Summary Reports for AI-integrated platforms and use cases. 
 - Define risk-based testing approaches for AI-enabled user workflows, focusing on functional suitability, business process integrity, intended use verification, and compliance requirements.

 - Leverage observability and monitoring frameworks to assess AI system behaviour trends, identify deviations impacting validated state, and support ongoing compliance assessments. 
 - Coordinate defect triage, impact assessment, root cause discussions, and remediation activities while ensuring appropriate documentation and closure in accordance with quality processes. 
 - Manage release governance and stakeholder communications by facilitating validation reviews, compliance sign-offs, deployment readiness assessments, status reporting, and executive-level updates throughout the implementation lifecycle.

 - Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Consulting or client‐facing experience preferred. 
 - Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. 

Must-Have Skills And Attributes

- Strong understanding of Computer System Validation (CSV), Computer Software Assurance (CSA), GAMP 5, and risk-based validation approaches within regulated environments. 
 - Hands-on experience authoring Validation Plans, Validation Strategies, Test Plans, Traceability Matrices, Validation Summary Reports, and release readiness documentation. 
 - Proven experience leading validation activities for AI/ML-enabled, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives. 
 - Expertise in defining risk-based testing strategies, user acceptance criteria, and compliance-focused test approaches for AI-integrated business processes. 
 - Sound understanding of AI/ML system lifecycles, including data ingestion, model deployment, retraining considerations, and operational controls. 
 - Experience overseeing release management, defect management, deviation handling, and change control activities within validated environments. 
 - Knowledge of AI governance, validation documentation, audit preparedness, and regulatory expectations for AI-enabled systems. 
 - Ability to assess and maintain the validated state of AI solutions through monitoring, periodic review, and lifecycle management activities. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across business, quality, product, engineering, and data science teams.

 - Experience in IT project management and validation planning
 - Ability to troubleshoot application issues and recommend solutions
 - Familiarity with change control, deviation handling, and CAPA processes
 - Proven ability to mentor junior staff and lead validation teams
 - Experience in training and cross-skilling resources
 - Strong teamwork and collaboration mindset

Good-to-Have Skills And Attributes

- Understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, and multi-agent architectures. 
 - Familiarity with AI observability and monitoring frameworks, including model monitoring, drift detection, traceability, explainability, and operational risk tracking.

 - Experience validating cloud-hosted AI platforms and solutions deployed on Azure AI, AWS AI/ML, or Google Vertex AI environments.

What We Look For

data.title: Lead Software Development Engineer
data.description:
Senior Software Engineer- DevOps for Workflow Innovation in Barco Control Rooms @Barco

BCR (Barco Control Rooms)

The Barco Control Rooms business unit is making workflow and visualization solutions for the Control Room market since 1994 to help operators collect, visualize and share critical information for optimal mission-critical decision making. Today, we are still the number one choice for control room professionals who want to stay on top of their situational awareness with 12000+ installations for critical infrastructure and critical operations. 

Senior Software Engineer - DevOps for Workflow Innovation @ Barco

We are seeking a hands-on DevOps Engineer to join the Barco CTRL Workflow Innovation team and support the development of a new AI-driven product from the ground up. The ideal candidate must have strong experience in GCP, cloud-native DevOps, and AI/MLOps practices, with proven ability to build reliable platforms, automation, CI/CD workflows, and deployment infrastructure for data and AI product capabilities. You will work with a globally distributed team to enable scalable, secure, and production-ready delivery of intelligent workflow solutions for Barco Control Rooms. 

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer - DevOps in the Workflow Innovation team, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud-native engineering foundation required to develop, test, deploy, and operate AI-driven product capabilities for Barco Control Rooms. This is not a classical DevOps role focused only on build pipelines and deployments; it requires hands-on experience with AI/MLOps, cloud infrastructure, data/AI workloads, automation, observability, and secure production operations. The role will also support deployment patterns where AI capabilities may need to run closer to the operational environment, including Edge AI scenarios, hybrid cloud-edge architectures, and efficient inference workflows for mission-critical control room use cases. You will collaborate with cloud partners, product owners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, and validation teams across locations to enable fast, reliable, and secure delivery of workflow innovation capabilities. 

- Build and maintain cloud-native DevOps and AI/MLOps infrastructure for the Workflow Innovation product on GCP. 
 - Design and implement CI/CD workflows for backend services, data pipelines, AI/ML components, model integration, and GenAI-enabled capabilities. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, environment management, configuration, and deployment workflows using infrastructure-as-code practices. 
 - Enable deployment and operation of AI/ML workloads, including model serving, inference workflows, RAG-based components, vector search services, and related data/AI services. 
 - Support cloud-to-edge deployment and operational patterns for AI capabilities, including lightweight model packaging, inference deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management for Edge AI scenarios. 
 - Establish observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, and cost-awareness practices for cloud-native Data & AI product capabilities. 
 - Support secure handling of product data, secrets, access control, compliance needs, and cloud security best practices. 
 - Work closely with Data & AI engineers and product teams to improve developer experience, release readiness, test automation, and operational reliability. 
 - Guide and mentor fellow colleagues in DevOps, cloud, and AI/MLOps practices while contributing to technical discussions and engineering excellence. 

Qualifications and Experience

Education

We are seeking experience with the following technologies/domains: 

B. Tech. /B. E. /M. E. /M. Tech. in Computer Science/AI Engineering

Experience

- 6-9 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud platform engineering, SRE, AI/MLOps, or related product engineering roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with GCP is required, including relevant cloud-native compute, storage, networking, IAM, observability, and deployment services. 
 - Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for cloud-native applications, backend services, data pipelines, and AI/ML workloads. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI/MLOps practices, including model deployment, model serving, inference workflows, experiment tracking, model versioning, and release automation for AI-enabled product features. 
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code and environment automation using tools such as Terraform, Helm, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Good understanding of cloud security practices, including IAM, secrets management, network security, secure deployment patterns, and least-privilege access. 
 - Experience setting up monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, SLO/SLA-oriented reliability practices, and incident response workflows. 
 - Exposure to data and AI platforms or services such as BigQuery, Vertex AI Vector Search, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, vector databases, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience supporting RAG-based applications, GenAI-enabled services, model APIs, or AI inference platforms is highly desirable. 
 - Exposure to Edge AI concepts, hybrid cloud-edge deployments, on-device or near-device inference, model optimization, and operational constraints such as latency, reliability, connectivity, and resource usage is desirable. 
 - Good programming and scripting experience using Python, Bash, or similar languages, with ability to build automation and internal tooling. 
 - Understanding of DevSecOps practices, automated testing, quality gates, vulnerability scanning, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices. 
 - Ability to collaborate with cloud partners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, product owners, and validation teams across geographies. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset, ownership, operational discipline, and willingness to explore and adopt new technologies in AI, DevOps, and cloud engineering.

data.title: QA Tester
data.description:
The Opportunity

Implements operational goals related to software build, release, deployment, and configuration management, ensuring smooth and stable application implementation. Contributes to the development and refinement of new processes, standards, and operational plans that support efficient software delivery. Manages smaller applications implementation projects and processes, coordinating release schedules, automation improvements, and integration efforts. Works on recurring but varied deployment challenges, requiring the analysis of multiple factors, including system dependencies, infrastructure constraints, and quality assurance measures. Communicates regularly with cross-functional teams, including QA, IT operations, and product teams, ensuring alignment and seamless software delivery. May interact with external partners, vendors, or customers to support implementation efforts and troubleshoot deployment-related issues. 

Position Summary

Functional testers at Avantor validate the systems our customers and partners use to do business with us. That means B2B ordering and account flows, e-commerce transactions, and the web services that tie them together. 

The work is hands-on. Read the requirement, work out what could go wrong, write the tests, run them, and raise what you find with enough detail that a developer can act on it without coming back to ask. 

Most testing here spans more than one system. An order placed on the web front end touches pricing, inventory, customer account data, and downstream fulfilment. Testers who can follow a transaction across those boundaries, rather than checking one screen at a time, do well in this role. 

Key Responsibilities

Test design and execution

- Read requirements and user stories, then write test cases that cover the normal path, the edge cases, and the ways the feature can fail. 
 - Run functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing against web and B2B applications. 
 - Build and maintain test data that reflects real customer and account scenarios. 
 - Test on different browsers and devices where the application calls for it. 
 - Verify fixes and confirm that nothing else broke on the way. 

API and web services testing

- Test REST and SOAP services directly using tools such as Postman or SoapUI. 
 - Check request and response payloads, status codes, error handling, and data types against the contract. 
 - Validate authentication, authorisation, and session behaviour on service calls. 
 - Trace data through service layers to work out whether a defect sits in the front end, the service, or the data behind it. 
 - Write and run SQL queries to confirm what the application actually stored. 

Defects and communication

- Raise defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual behaviour, environment detail, and evidence attached. 
 - Work with developers through triage, retest, and closure. 
 - Report test progress, coverage, and open risk to the QA Manager. 
 - Join sprint ceremonies and raise testability concerns while a story is still being shaped. 
 - Estimate testing effort and flag risk to release dates early. 
 - Identify candidates for automation and work with the automation team to hand them over. 
 - Represent QA in requirement and design discussions with business stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

QA Functional Tester

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years in functional software testing. 
 - Hands-on experience testing web applications, including B2B or e-commerce systems. 
 - Working experience testing REST or SOAP services with Postman, SoapUI, or similar. 
 - Able to write SQL queries to verify data. 
 - Experience with a test management tool such as Jira, ALM, or TestRail. 
 - Writes defects that a developer can act on without a follow-up conversation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise B2B commerce platforms, for example IMCM or comparable customer-facing order and account systems. 
 - SAP exposure, particularly order-to-cash or customer master data. 
 - Familiarity with test automation, enough to read a script and know what it covers even without writing one. 
 - Experience in a regulated industry such as life sciences. 
 - Performance or accessibility testing background. 
 - ISTQB certification or equivalent. 

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. 

Why Avantor?

Dare to go further in your career. Join our global team of 14, 000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science. 

The work we do changes people's lives for the better. It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor. 

We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world. Apply today!

We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/province, or local law. 

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at recruiting@avantorsciences. com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address. 

Privacy Policy

As an AI Data Technical Lead, you will act as a seasoned engineering leader who takes end-to-end ownership, drives software excellence, and actively challenges the status quo. In this role, you will foster a culture of technical mentorship and cross-functional collaboration while designing complex, full-stack software solutions. Blending advanced GenAI engineering, enterprise integration, open-source innovation, and AWS cloud expertise, you will lead the creation of production-grade, highly secure AI agents. Specifically, you will architect and execute multi-agent orchestration systems and data transformation pipelines that convert complex regulatory datasets in a strict GxP-regulated environment. 

The opportunity: 

- Agentic Architecture: Design, deploy, and scale multi-agent orchestration systems and autonomous workflows using cutting-edge frameworks
 - Advanced RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize advanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over massive, heterogeneous datasets (structured and unstructured)

 - Evaluation & Guardrails: Create and implement robust evaluation metrics, observability pipelines, and guardrails for content quality, hallucination reduction, bias mitigation, and safety standards
 - Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize AI inference cost, latency, throughput, token usage, and overall system reliability
 - Security & Access Control: Implement robust access controls, data encryption, user authentication, and prompt injection mitigation across all LLM workflows
 - Collaboration & Best Practices: Document and share reusable agent patterns, prompt libraries, and engineering components across cross-functional technical teams
 - End-to-End Pipeline Delivery: Independently leads the design, build, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines, managing specific data engineering projects autonomously from inception to deployment

 - Stakeholder Alignment & Integration: Partners directly with business units and data scientists to understand data requirements, effectively bridging technical execution with non-technical business needs
 - Strategic Infrastructure Impact: Owns large-scale data engineering initiatives, implementing robust strategies that significantly modernize and strengthen the organization's data infrastructure
 - Complex Data Integration: Manages large, intricate data ecosystems by seamlessly integrating multiple diverse data sources to ensure efficient, secure cross-platform data flows
 - Impact/Strategy: Acts as a technical mentor and aligns development plans with the global strategy. Gets involved in initiatives and tasks reaching outside of regular project scope, gives speeches, shares knowledge in organizational events (e. g. , DevOps Days, Tech Talk), and engages in the organization of knowledge-sharing events

Who you are: 

- Education & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field (Required), along with 10+ years of professional software development experience (Required)
 - Technical Proficiency: Strong full-stack expertise with hands-on experience in LLM frameworks, agentic architectures, and advanced RAG pipelines (Required); familiarity with cloud services and DevOps practices (Preferred)
 - Problem Solving & Ownership: Proactive self-starter who takes ownership of complex architectural challenges, tackles technical debt, and drives end-to-end software delivery (Required)
 - Collaboration & Mentorship: Strong communicator who enjoys mentoring peers, sharing knowledge across cross-functional teams, and bridging technical solutions with business needs (Required)
 - Continuous Improvement: Curious mindset eager to challenge the status quo, adopt emerging AI technologies, and align development practices with global strategies (Required)
 - Strong backend and full-stack skills in Python, R, FastAPI, and modern cloud architectures. Event-Driven & Serverless Patterns
 - Agentic AI and LLM skills, including Agent Frameworks (Example: Strands Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, Bedrock Agents), Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Stores, etc
 - Cloud platforms & infrastructures, including AWS, Terraform, Multi-Architecture Builds, Structured Logging, Distributed Tracing, Metrics / Monitoring, etc

Additional Qualifications: 

- Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the proven ability to engage effectively with both technical audiences (like data scientists) and non-technical business stakeholders
 - Pharma & GxP Compliance: Extensive experience in pharma or biotech, architecting data pipelines that strictly comply with GxP frameworks (GCP/GMP/GVP), data integrity principles, and computer systems validation (CSV)
 - Compliant Data Delivery: Proven capability to build scalable solutions within regulated R&D environments, aligning technical execution with critical Clinical, Regulatory, and Safety milestones
 - Workflow & Data Optimization: Skilled at identifying bottlenecks, eliminating operational silos, and optimizing fragmented workflows to ensure automated, streamlined solutions
 - Regulatory & Life Sciences Background: Demonstrated experience working within a GxP-regulated environment (e. g. , Biotech, Pharma, or Medical Devices). Proven understanding of regulatory data standards, Regulatory Information Management (RIM) ecosystems, and electronic submission frameworks (e. g. , eCTD Modules 1-5, ICH guidelines, 21 CFR Part 11) to ensure AI agent outputs are fully traceable, audit-ready, and compliant

data.title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations. 

Responsibilities

Problems the team works on: 

- Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load. 
 - API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs. 
 - Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems. 

What you'll do: 

- Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time. 
 - Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams. 
 - Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed. 
 - Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work. 
 - Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries. 

What we're looking for: 

- Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production. 
 - A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services. 
 - Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management. 
 - Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production. 
 - A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow. 

Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar. 
 - Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization). 
 - Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. data.description:
About NCR Atleos

NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20, 000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe. 

Job Position Summary

The Supplier Quality Engineer supports the quality performance of assigned suppliers and purchased components used in NCR Atleos products. The role works with suppliers and cross-functional teams to ensure parts conform to drawings and specifications, support new product and localization activities, resolve supplier-related defects, and improve supplier performance through structured problem solving and continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities

- Support quality management of assigned suppliers and parts across mechanical, electrical, and electronic commodities. 
 - Review supplier parts against engineering drawings, specifications, inspection plans, and applicable quality requirements. 
 - Support supplier qualification, process validation, First Article Inspection, and PPAP activities for new or changed parts. 
 - Review key supplier quality documents, including process flow, PFMEA, Control Plan, inspection records, material certificates, and measurement reports. 
 - Investigate supplier-related defects identified during incoming inspection, manufacturing, testing, or field/repair operations. 
 - Coordinate immediate containment, stock segregation, replacement or recovery actions to minimize production and customer impact. 
 - Raise, track, and verify supplier corrective actions using 8D, CAPA, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, and other appropriate problem-solving methods. 
 - Support supplier process, product, and quality-system audits; document findings and follow up closure of corrective actions. 
 - Monitor supplier quality indicators such as PPM, Spills, Incidents and, CAPA closure
 - Work with Engineering, Manufacturing, Incoming Quality, Sourcing, Commodity, Reliability, and suppliers to resolve quality issues. 
 - Maintain accurate supplier quality records, reports, trackers, and evidence required for internal and ISO 9001 quality-system reviews. 
 - Support continuous improvement projects focused on defect prevention, process control, inspection effectiveness, scrap, rework, and supplier performance. 

Qualification Requirements

- Diploma or bachelor's degree in mechanical, Electrical, Electronics & Communication, Manufacturing, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - 2-3 years of experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, Incoming Quality, PPAP, or a related engineering role in a manufacturing environment. 
 - Practical exposure to engineering drawings, part inspection, non-conformance handling, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action follow-up. 

Required Skills And Competencies

- Working knowledge of supplier quality, incoming inspection, quality control, and manufacturing processes.
