data.title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer
data.description:
DryvIQ | Nasuni

Location: Hyderabad, India | Remote (Hyderabad preferred)

Department: Customer Experience / Professional Services

Working Hours: US Eastern business hours (9 a. m. -5 p. m. ET) (7: 30pm IST to 3: 30am IST)

Role Overview

Be the engineer customers trust to solve their most complex enterprise data challenges-and build solutions that scale beyond a single deployment. 

As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer at DryvIQ, part of Nasuni, you will provide hands-on technical leadership across complex enterprise customer implementations. You'll work directly with customers to understand their challenges, design scalable solutions, write production-quality C#/. NET code, and guide secure deployments through successful operation. 

Enterprises need to discover, classify, protect, and govern growing volumes of unstructured content before they can confidently activate that information for AI. DryvIQ helps organizations manage these challenges across cloud and on-premises repositories. 

We're looking for an experienced engineer who combines deep software development expertise with sound architectural judgment, customer consulting skills, and the ability to influence technical outcomes across multiple engagements. 

This is a hands-on engineering and customer-delivery role, not a pre-sales-only or purely advisory position. 

Your Scope and Impact

You will establish technical direction for complex, high-impact customer solutions while developing reusable engineering approaches that improve delivery across engagements. 

You'll independently navigate difficult architecture decisions, guide senior technical contributors, resolve critical implementation challenges, and influence product improvements through insights gained from customer environments. 

Your success will be measured through production outcomes, customer confidence, engineering quality, and the broader impact of the solutions and standards you establish. 

What You'll Do

- Lead technical architecture and implementation across complex enterprise customer engagements, from discovery through validation, and production handoff. 
 - Facilitate customer workshops with IT, security, and business stakeholders; translate requirements into scalable solution designs, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Design, develop, test, and troubleshoot C#/. NET integrations, REST APIs, services, and supported workflows across Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes environments. 
 - Establish reusable integration, testing, security, and troubleshooting patterns that improve reliability and delivery consistency. 
 - Guide complex technical decisions involving supported configuration, customization, integrations, platform limitations, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Architect and optimize solutions for enterprise content discovery, classification, lifecycle management, governance, migration, and policy-driven automation. 
 - Lead resolution of critical issues involving connectors, authentication, permissions, distributed processing, performance, and environments. 
 - Establish validation approaches for content classification, including representative sampling, precision and recall, false-positive and false-negative analysis, and business-owner review. 
 - Partner with Professional Services, Project Management, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to assess delivery risks, guide technical estimates, and identify product improvements. 
 - Mentor engineers, review complex designs and code, and share technical knowledge that raises delivery standards across teams. 
 - Develop and promote responsible AI-assisted workflows for engineering, testing, troubleshooting, and technical analysis, with appropriate security controls and human validation. 

Expected Outcomes and Impact

- Successful, secure, and supportable production environments that meet agreed customer acceptance criteria. 
 - Reduced implementation complexity and faster resolution of recurring technical issues. 
 - Reusable engineering assets that improve delivery consistency and shorten time to customer value. 
 - Improved solution reliability, classification quality, and production readiness. 
 - Stronger alignment between customer implementation needs and Nasuni's product capabilities. 

What You'll Bring

Must-Have Qualifications

- Deep hands-on C#/. NET engineering experience, including modern . NET (. NET 8 or later), REST API development, integration design, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Demonstrated technical ownership of complex enterprise software implementations, including architecture, coding, testing, and operational support. 
 - Production experience with Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes or comparable container orchestration environments. 
 - Ability to make and explain architectural tradeoffs involving scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Experience resolving complex integration or production issues across multiple systems and stakeholders. 
 - Strong customer-facing technical communication, documentation, problem-solving, and collaborative leadership skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise content management, information governance, content classification, or large-scale data migration. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, OneDrive, Purview, or other enterprise content repositories. 
 - Experience with hybrid cloud architectures, distributed workloads, and large-scale file processing. 
 - PowerShell or Python automation experience. 
 - Practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools with clear methods for validating generated code, analysis, and recommendations. 

Ideal Candidate Differentiators

- Has established reusable technical architectures or engineering standards across multiple customer implementations. 
 - Demonstrates measurable improvements in deployment reliability, customer outcomes, or implementation efficiency. 
 - Has influenced engineering or product priorities through recurring enterprise customer challenges. 
 - Builds the capabilities of other engineers while remaining an effective hands-on contributor. 
 - Has developed repeatable, responsibly governed AI-assisted engineering workflows. 

Experience Guidelines

Typically 9-12 years of relevant software engineering, enterprise implementation, or technical consulting experience, including substantial hands-on customer-facing delivery and demonstrated technical leadership across complex engagements. 

Equivalent experience demonstrating comparable ownership, technical depth, and results is welcome. Prior DryvIQ experience is not required. 

AI at Nasuni

AI is used to improve efficiency, decision-making, and engineering outcomes across Nasuni. In this position, you'll apply AI-assisted development, analysis, testing, and automation where they add value, while ensuring that outputs meet security, correctness, quality, and maintainability standards. 

We value engineers who use AI with context, sound judgment, validation, and accountability. 

Location and Working Model

This position is remote within India, with a preference for candidates based near Hyderabad. 

Regular collaboration with global teams and US customers during US Eastern business hours is required. Local working hours vary with US daylight saving time. Periodic customer-site travel to the United States is expected. 

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams-and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. 

As a Vista Equity Partners-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform. 

Our cloud-native technology combines enterprise file services, protection, and data intelligence, enabling organizations to unify information, strengthen security, simplify infrastructure, and activate trusted data for AI. 

With DryvIQ's content intelligence and governance capabilities, we're expanding how enterprises discover, classify, protect, and manage information across complex environments. 

Why Work at Nasuni

Join a global team working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, software engineering, enterprise data governance, and AI readiness. 

You'll have the opportunity to solve meaningful technical challenges for enterprise customers, influence how complex implementations are delivered, and build solutions that improve outcomes beyond individual engagements. 

Our Hyderabad Innovation Center connects talented engineers with global Product, Engineering, and Customer Experience teams. Through Vista Equity Partners' software ecosystem, Nasuni employees can benefit from cross-company learning, professional development, and opportunities to explore AI-driven innovation. 

We value collaboration, accountability, technical curiosity, and continuous improvement. At Nasuni, your work can directly contribute to making enterprise data more accessible, secure, and useful for teams and the AI that supports them. 

This privacy notice relates to information collected (whether online or offline) by Nasuni Corporation and our corporate affiliates (collectively, "Nasuni") from or about you in your capacity as a Nasuni employee, independent contractor/service provider or as an applicant for an employment or contractor relationship with Nasuni.

Experience & Qualifications

- 12+ years of overall ServiceNow/technology experience, including significant technical leadership responsibilities.

 - Experience with IntegrationHub, MID Servers, REST APIs, enterprise endpoint/cloud technologies and high-volume data integrations. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading engineers and owning technical delivery within an Agile Product/POD operating model. 
 - Experience with production support, ATF, upgrades, patches, code migrations, technical-debt remediation and platform modernization.

data.description:

At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. 

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or complete your application, please send an email with your request to the Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap. com. 

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training. 

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy and childbirth), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements. 

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor. 

AI Usage in the Recruitment Process

For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process. 

Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process. 

Company Description

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. 

Build

You'll design and deliver cloud-native features within SAP Logistics Management, using AI as a core method - not an occasional assistant - for building, reviewing, and operating software at scale. Your work will directly improve the reliability and intelligence of freight, warehousing, and supply chain processes for enterprise customers worldwide. 

- Design, implement, and maintain cloud-native features in the SAP Logistics Management product using AI-augmented development methods and modern engineering practices
 - Work with self-governing agent frameworks to investigate, prototype, and evaluate AI bots that reduce repetitive development and operational tasks
 - Review and validate AI-generated code with a quality-first mindset - catching subtle defects, rational gaps, and security risks before they reach production
 - Write precise, unambiguous requirements and acceptance criteria that enable high-quality AI-assisted implementation across the team
 - Contribute to team-wide AI adoption by documenting findings, building reusable prompt patterns and skills, and sharing learnings proactively
 - Participate in release decision processes, SAT testing, and quality engineering activities as a quality owner across the full delivery chain
 - Support security remediation by interpreting OSC/SAST scan findings and spearheading resolution - including AI-assisted triage of security issues
 - Collaborate across Germany, India, and China in an async-first, cross-cultural team model, externalizing knowledge in a form retrievable by teammates and AI tools alike

Bring

4 to 7 Years of Proficiency in at least one backend language (Java, TypeScript, Python, Go, or equivalent) with solid grip of clean code, SOLID principles, modularity, testability, and REST/OData API design

3+ years of professional software engineering experience in enterprise or cloud-native environments, with active daily use of AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Joule, Claude Code, or equivalent)

Has the ability to create prompts. Develops clear and effective prompts for tasks such as code generation, refactoring, debugging, and documentation. Knows how to manage context windows and improve prompts through multiple iterations. 

Test-first instinct: defines acceptance criteria and writes tests before or alongside AI-generated implementation; does not rely on QE gates as the primary defect detection mechanism

Experience with CI/CD pipelines, feature toggle management, automated test coverage, and code quality tooling

Familiarity with cloud platforms (BTP, AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerized/microservice architectures

Strong written English; comfortable with async, cross-cultural collaboration across Germany, India, and China

Fluency in English is required. Experience with SAP BTP, SAP AI Core, or agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, or similar) is a solid advantage. 

Belong

You'll join SAP LGM, a global engineering team actively building AI agents and intelligent logistics applications. You'll work hands-on with agentic AI initiatives, serve as a quality multiplier for the team, and shape how AI-augmented development is practiced at scale. The team values written communication, clear thinking, and knowledge that is legible to both people and AI tools. If you take quality seriously, think in systems, and want to lead from the front on how enterprise software gets built with AI - this is the right place.

data.title: Senior Manager Software Engineering
data.description:
Overview

About Business Unit: 

Platform Services specializes in the implementation, management and evolution of Custom and PeopleCloud solutions, offering end-to-end support for clients. Our team of experts handles platform setup, ongoing management, and strategic enhancements, ensuring that our solutions adapt to changing business needs. From loyalty programs to digital activation, our platforms empower clients to implement campaigns, generate insights, and streamline business activities, all with a focus on seamless integration and continuous improvement. By collaborating with client partners and strategy teams, we create impactful campaigns tailored to each client's unique objectives. 

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 

Responsibilities

What You Will Do

You will lead engineering outcomes across multiple teams and initiatives, balancing business priorities, client commitments, technical strategy, quality, talent development, and innovation. You will promote AI-assisted ways of working and enable leaders and engineers to operate effectively across traditional role boundaries. 

Delivery & Portfolio Leadership

- Own end-to-end delivery of multiple strategic software programs, ensuring predictable execution, measurable outcomes, quality, transparency, and timely management of risks and dependencies. 
 - Lead planning, estimation, engineering, testing, implementation, transition, and production stabilization across build, enhancement, modernization, migration, and maintenance initiatives. 
 - Align capacity, skills, priorities, milestones, and dependencies across teams; make informed trade-offs and call out material risks with clear mitigation options. 
 - Establish outcome-focused governance using delivery health, quality, productivity, customer impact, and operational measures rather than activity alone. 
 - Ensure alignment to engineering standards, security, privacy, compliance, accessibility, documentation, and support-readiness expectations. 
 - Promote continuous improvement through retrospectives, root-cause analysis, reusable practices, automation, and evidence-based decision-making. 

Client & Stakeholder Partnership

- Partner with clients, product leaders, business collaborators, architects, analysts, quality leaders, data teams, and operations teams to understand objectives and shape scalable solutions. 
 - Lead customer workshops, solution discussions, technical presentations, roadmap conversations, and executive governance forums. 
 - Build trusted relationships, establish clear expectations, manage issues constructively, and communicate decisions, trade-offs, risks, and mitigation plans with transparency. 
 - Translate business objectives into technology strategies, investment priorities, capability roadmaps, and measurable engineering outcomes. 
 - Communicate delivery health, key performance indicators, solution risks, quality trends, innovation progress, and strategic recommendations to senior partners. 

AI Strategy, Engineering & Innovation

- Architect model and framework strategy, RAG/knowledge architecture, embeddings/vector search, prompt/context management, tool integration, agent orchestration, memory, guardrails, evaluation and human oversight. 
 - Define and implement an AI adoption roadmap across engineering, analysis, quality, support, knowledge management, and customer-solution use cases. 
 - Identify high-value Generative AI and Agentic AI opportunities, prioritize use cases, sponsor prototypes, define success measures, and scale proven patterns responsibly. 
 - Promote effective use of frameworks and services such as LangChain, LangGraph, Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI, Amazon Q, Kiro, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Apply responsible AI practices covering privacy, security, intellectual property, data handling, model limitations, accuracy, bias awareness, explainability, traceability, and accountable human oversight. 
 - Create an environment that supports responsible experimentation, reusable accelerators, knowledge sharing, and measurable improvement in engineering productivity and customer value. 

Technical Strategy & Engineering Leadership

- Provide architectural direction and technical guidance across enterprise web, API, integration, distributed, data, and AI-enabled solutions. 
 - Guide conversion of high-level designs into detailed designs covering components, APIs, data models, algorithms, schemas, integration contracts, security, resilience, performance, and non-functional requirements. 
 - Partner with architects and technical leads to evaluate solution options and ensure appropriate scalability, security, maintainability, observability, accessibility, and cost effectiveness. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through design reviews, code reviews, architecture governance, quality standards, technical-debt management, performance analysis, and root-cause prevention. 
 - Maintain sufficient hands-on technical awareness to challenge assumptions, assess feasibility, guide complex decisions, and support resolution of critical engineering issues. 
 - Promote modern engineering patterns for C#/. NET, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, React or Angular, APIs, event-driven systems, distributed applications, and data-intensive workloads. 

Quality Engineering & Technical Assurance

- Own the quality strategy across teams, including testability, automation, code quality, data quality, performance, resilience, security validation, and production readiness. 
 - Ensure quality is built into discovery, design, development, and support rather than treated as a separate downstream activity. 
 - Establish appropriate review mechanisms, test coverage expectations, traceability, defect-prevention practices, release validations, and operational acceptance criteria. 
 - Use trends from defects, incidents, customer feedback, and engineering measures to direct corrective and preventive improvements. 
 - Promote AI-assisted test design, review, defect analysis, and knowledge discovery while requiring accountable validation of generated outputs. 

Data, Platforms & Solution Integration

- Guide scalable data modelling, integration, batch and real-time processing, data-quality controls, and performance strategies across enterprise solutions. 
 - Provide oversight for solutions using Oracle, MySQL, DynamoDB, Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent data platforms. 
 - Guide designs involving REST APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, integration platforms, and technologies such as SnapLogic, DataHub, or equivalents. 
 - Ensure data solutions address reliability, lineage, security, privacy, interoperability, and business usability. 

People Leadership & Organizational Capability

- Lead, coach, and mentor engineering managers, technical leads, and engineers across multiple teams. 
 - Build a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, inclusion, collaboration, engineering excellence, continuous learning, and customer focus. 
 - Drive workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, goal alignment, regular feedback, career development, succession planning, recognition, retention, and employee engagement. 
 - Develop future-ready capabilities across software engineering, architecture, quality, data, AI, automation, client engagement, and domain knowledge. 
 - Create clear ownership and decision mechanisms while empowering leaders and teams to implement effectively. 
 - Address performance and team-health concerns fairly, consistently, transparently, and in alignment with organizational policies. 

Flexibility, Automation & Continuous Improvement

- Enable teams to flex across business analysis, architecture, development, quality engineering, data, automation, documentation, and production support based on delivery priorities while preserving role depth and accountability. 
 - Use workflow automation and low-code tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or equivalent technologies to streamline repeatable engineering and business processes where appropriate. 
 - Encourage cross-skilling, communities of practice, reusable assets, structured knowledge management, and movement across adjacent responsibilities. 
 - Continuously improve engineering practices, operating models, collaboration, customer responsiveness, and delivery efficiency using measurable evidence. 

Qualifications

Essential Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 13+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading multiple engineering teams in customer-facing environments. 
 - Demonstrated success delivering complex, enterprise-scale software programs and leading multi-functional teams using Agile delivery practices. 
 - Experience managing engineering leaders and teams while balancing client commitments, technical strategy, delivery outcomes, quality, and people development. 
 - Strong leadership, communication, presentation, stakeholder management, decision-making, organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving skills. 

Core Technical & Leadership Skills

- Strong technical understanding of C#, . NET/. NET Core, REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, object-oriented design, design patterns, and modern web architecture. 
 - Working knowledge of React or Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS, and responsive application design. 
 - Strong understanding of SQL, PL/SQL, relational and NoSQL data modelling, database performance, data integration, batch and real-time processing, and enterprise data platforms. 
 - Ability to guide architecture, engineering standards, application security, performance, observability, quality engineering, automated testing, troubleshooting, and production support. 
 - Experience with Git-based collaboration, peer review, Agile engineering, structured release management, and enterprise change governance. 
 - Ability to connect technology choices to business outcomes, customer experience, delivery risk, talent capability, and long-term maintainability. 

AI & Future Skills

- Strong AI architecture capability across RAG, agentic systems, model evaluation, guardrails, identity, data protection, observability and cost/performance trade-offs. 
 - Demonstrated architecture ownership for a meaningful AI solution from discovery through implementation, evaluation and operational readiness. 
 - Exposure to LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI, or comparable AI frameworks and services. 
 - Ability to define AI strategy, prioritize use cases, guide prototypes, assess feasibility and risk, establish adoption measures, and scale successful practices. 
 - Ability to promote AI-assisted ways of working across analysis, architecture, development, testing, documentation, knowledge management, and support with appropriate controls. 

Desirable Skills & Experience

- Experience leading engineering for CRM, loyalty, marketing technology, customer data, high-volume transaction, or large-scale distributed platforms. 
 - Experience with data and integration technologies such as Redshift, Snowflake, DynamoDB, SnapLogic, DataHub, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Experience using Python, scripting, workflow automation, n8n, low-code/no-code platforms, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience establishing engineering communities, reusable accelerators, knowledge-management practices, or enterprise modernization programs. 
 - Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating successful experiments into governed, repeatable delivery capabilities. 

Personal Attributes

- Strong customer focus, business insight, critical thinking, and an ownership mapproach
 - Excellent leadership, coaching, mentoring, communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management capability. 
 - Collaborative, adaptable, resilient, decisive, and results oriented while remaining open to challenge and new evidence. 
 - Passion for innovation, continuous improvement, inclusive leadership, talent development, and measurable business impact. 
 - Professionalism, integrity, sound judgement, transparency, and accountability in decisions affecting customers, people, and technology. 

Success in This Role

Success is demonstrated through predictable delivery of strategic outcomes, strong client trust, secure and maintainable solutions, measurable improvements in quality and productivity, growth of engineering leaders and teams, responsible AI adoption, and an organisation that can flex across adjacent capabilities without compromising accountability or technical excellence. 

Additional Information

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels. 

Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9, 000 employees around the world. 

Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day. 

- People centricity: We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other. 
 - Collaboration: We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals. 
 - Growth: There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement. 
 - Innovation: We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches. 
 - Flexibility: We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively. 

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers. 

- Act with integrity
 - Work together to win together
 - Innovate with purpose
 - Respect all voices

These pillars and values are our foundation-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose. 

Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

data.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
data.description:
Dorman was founded on the belief that people should have greater freedom to fix motor vehicles. For over 100 years, we have been driving new solutions, releasing tens of thousands of aftermarket replacement products engineered to save time and money, and increase convenience and reliability. Founded and headquartered in the United States, we are a pioneering global organization offering an always-evolving catalog of automotive, heavy-duty and specialty vehicle products. Today, we have more than 3, 800 employees across 29 different locations, with a family of brands that also includes SuperATV and Dayton Parts. Publicly traded under the stock ticker DORM, reaching a revenue of $2. 13 billion in 2025. 

Everyone who works at Dorman is called a Contributor. We need everyone, regardless of role and experience, to contribute to our success. That means everyone has a unique ability to make an impact on the business. We encourage all our Contributors to bring their authentic selves to work. The freedom to pursue new ideas, offer different perspectives, and grow in your career is fundamental to working at Dorman. 

Job Summary

This position is an individual contributor role. This position conducts supplier quality related activities including, supporting new product introduction with existing and new suppliers within Dorman APQP requirements for purchased parts during program development, Acting as technical and quality liaison between Dorman and suppliers. Performing supplier qualification & re-qualification audits, supplier process development & audit, product audits (FAI, SI, PSI). Drive supplier and product quality improvement. The role will work harmoniously together with global cross function team, mainly with engineering, SBU, Lab, and Supply Chain. 

Primary Duties

- Support sourcing team for new supplier selection and drive new supplier qualification activities. 
 - Drive requalification audit of existing suppliers to ensure Dorman's requirement is continuously met by suppliers
 - Participate in second-party and third-party quality management system audits as required
 - Work directly with product groups to ensure product and engineering design specifications are met by suppliers
 - Support product development and reverse engineering functions as required
 - Line readiness review and process audit for new project as required
 - Train suppliers in Dorman's development processes and ensue "speed to market"
 - Facilitates the creation and validation of FAI (First Article Inspection) & OTS(Off The Shelf) samples and PPAP documentation review and approval
 - Drive source inspection activities for 1st shipment of new product
 - Monitor supplier performance and work with product team and quality team to continuously reduce the warranty cost. 
 - Drive and facilitate Continuous Improvement efforts at suppliers to better control of nonconforming products
 - Support supplier related corrective action and prevention actions / 8D follow up and validation of internal and external. 
 - Elimination of repeat of product and process nonconformance through quality engineering activities and drill deep & wide investigations by working together with internal cross functional teams
 - Participate in cross-functional teams as required. 

Qualifications

- Communicate proficiently verbally and written, in English. Experience in a global cross-functional team environment. Working experience in global manufacturing and distribution environment is preferred. 
 - Working knowledge of IATF16949 quality management systems or similar i. e. ISO9001, ISO14001
 - Auditing experience (Internal, Supplier, Corrective Action validation, Product, Process, CSR, WCA, SQP, C-TPAT)
 - Working experience of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC and MSA 
 - Exposure to the Ferrous or Aluminum casting process for automotive casting & machined parts i. e. , timing cover, engine & transmission parts, etc. 
 - Experience with automotive casting development, performing quality audits on automotive casting parts preferred. 
 - Working experience of new supplier project management. 
 - Minimum five (5) years' experience in root cause analysis/problem solving. 8D, 5-Why, DMAIC, DOE. etc. 
 - Working experience of Leading Continual Improvement activities. 
 - Working knowledge of product qualification testing, inspection tools and equipment, and supplier quality activities. 
 - Familiar with automotive vehicle components and knowledge of field failure analysis (FFT) is preferred. 
 - Working knowledge of materials, finishes, and specifications (SAE, ASME, ANSI, etc. )
 - Familiar with knowledge of common parts and one of the following manufacturing processes, such as plastics, stamping, rubber, casting, machining, forging, plating. Familiar with knowledge of electronics/electrical parts and manufacturing process is a plus. 
 - Familiar with GD&T and can understand drawing related with parts of mechanical and/or electrical. 
 - Familiar with checking fixture and know how to conduct check fixture calibration. 
 - Good PC skills including MS Office Suite including Excel, Word, and PPT. Minitab / SAP is preferred. 
 - Physical Requirement: Capability to lift 20 pounds. 
 - Working Conditions: Working Conditions: "this role would require 50% travel to supplier partners across the country for all the activities mentioned above

Education / Experience

- Preferred Bachelor's degree (B. S / B tech) in a technical or quality related field from four-year College or University; and 5 years related experience.

data.title: Principal Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

We're after a hands-on engineer for our Forward Deployed team in Labs & CMC Digital & Tech, building the automation, data pipelines and AI tooling that take manual work out of the lab. You'll typically work closely alongside a Senior Principal Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer on the approach, coordinating with stakeholders as needed, while your own focus stays on turning that direction into working software: quickly, securely, and in a way that still holds up once it's live. As you build experience, you may take on more of that stakeholder relationship yourself, with support and guidance from leadership. Expect a lot of coding, pipeline work and cloud infrastructure, with security and testing built in as you go rather than bolted on at the end. 

Most weeks you'll be deep in one piece of the build: automating a lab workflow, wiring up a data pipeline, or getting an agentic prototype into decent shape, while staying close enough to the rest of the engagement to flag problems before they land on someone else's desk. As you get more experience, you'll be trusted with a bigger slice of the problem yourself, and eventually the whole thing. 

We care about software that scientists actually use. Less manual lab work, fewer errors, better data, medicines and vaccines moving faster through the pipeline. 

Why This Role Exists

Labs & CMC is rebuilding how laboratory science and CMC work gets done, with automation, data and AI doing jobs scientists used to do by hand. Senior engineers typically lead and coordinate the relationship with the business side of that, working in close partnership with the wider team; this role exists to give them the extra hands to actually build what's agreed, while staying closely involved in how the work takes shape. You'll spend most of your time writing code, wiring up pipelines and getting things into production, picking up more ownership of the problem, and potentially of the stakeholder relationship itself, as you grow into the role and build a deeper understanding of what's needed. 

- Turning direction into software: working with a Senior Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer to agree an approach, coordinating with stakeholders as needed, then building it properly rather than knocking together a demo. 
 - Keeping pace: most of what you'll build needs to land in days, not sprints, so you'll want to be comfortable shipping fast and adjusting as scientist feedback comes in. 
 - Automation that actually sticks: wiring up instruments, lab systems and data platforms so what you build is still running after the project wraps up. 
 - Getting the data right: pairing with data engineering so whatever you're building sits on data that's actually trustworthy. 
 - Production-ready by default: security, testing and monitoring go in as you build, not after something's already gone wrong. 
 - Leaving something behind: writing components and patterns that the next engineer, on this engagement or another one, can actually pick up and use. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Working the Problem

- Partner with Product Owners, Product Managers, Business Owners and scientists to understand laboratory and CMC workflows first-hand, clarify the required outcome and identify delivery, data, security or compliance risks early. 
 - Translate the agreed approach into a realistic technical plan, build rapid prototypes using representative laboratory data and incorporate scientist feedback before progressing the solution. 

Building and Shipping

- Design, code and test software, integrations, automation and data pipelines, taking ownership of day-to-day technical decisions within the agreed architecture. 
 - Develop successful prototypes into secure, reliable and supportable production solutions, confirming significant architectural decisions with a Senior Principal Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer or the relevant technical leader. 
 - Coordinate dependencies with internal, vendor and contract engineers, communicate delivery risks promptly and provide clear code, documentation and handover materials. 

Keeping It Secure and Reliable

- Build continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines that enable frequent, controlled and traceable releases. 
 - Implement unit, integration and end-to-end testing, together with dependency scanning, secrets management and least-privilege access. 
 - Apply relevant GxP, data-integrity, privacy and security requirements, documenting technical decisions and obtaining specialist guidance where needed. 
 - Establish production observability using appropriate logging, metrics and alerting tools, and connect solutions with ServiceNow processes to support operational readiness and incident management. 

Cloud Infrastructure

- Provision approved Azure or Google Cloud Platform infrastructure through the central Digital Platforms team, following established architecture, networking, identity, security and cost-management guardrails. 
 - Define infrastructure using Terraform and deploy applications using Kubernetes or Helm, applying appropriate settings for resilience, scaling and cost. 
 - Maintain consistency across development, test and production environments by managing configuration and infrastructure changes through automated pipelines. 

Contributing to Labs & CMC Solutions

- Build and extend workflows and integrations within laboratory orchestration platforms, enabling scientists to manage and track work through connected systems. 
 - Integrate laboratory instruments and systems to automate data capture and reduce manual entry. 
 - Develop AI agents and workflow automation that reduce repetitive scientific and operational tasks. 
 - Partner with data engineers to make laboratory, analytical and inventory data accessible and trustworthy for the solutions being developed. 
 - Build Generative AI capabilities that support activities such as experiment planning, information retrieval and scientific decision-making. 

Building With AI

- Use approved AI-assisted software-development tools and agent workflows, reviewing, testing and validating generated outputs before use. 
 - Reuse existing skills, prompts, components and Model Context Protocol connections, and contribute identified capability gaps to the wider team. 
 - Build AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines and Model Context Protocol integrations, seeking technical guidance for complex evaluation or data-access decisions. 
 - Apply appropriate guardrails, evaluation, traceability and human review to AI-enabled capabilities, particularly where scientific, regulated or GxP-relevant information is involved. 

Working Well With Others

- Escalate Responsible AI, data-integrity, security or validation concerns as soon as they are identified. 
 - Contribute reusable components, agents and engineering patterns to the Labs & CMC library, supported by documentation that enables adoption by other engineers. 
 - Support internal, vendor and contract engineering colleagues with technical problem-solving and knowledge sharing. 
 - Share delivery lessons, recurring risks and improvement opportunities with technical leaders so that they can inform broader engineering decisions. 

What You Bring

Required Experience: 

- 5+ years building software professionally, across full-stack, data or AI/ML work, including some time on systems that actually reached production, not just proofs of concept. 
 - Comfortable taking a reasonably well-defined problem and shipping working software against it quickly. 
 - Solid Python, plus at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or similar. 
 - Hands-on with GenAI patterns, including agents, RAG, prompt engineering and evaluation, not just familiar with the terms. 
 - Some experience with workflow orchestration tools (n8n, Airflow, Temporal) and working alongside data engineers. 
 - DevSecOps basics: CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security scanning built into how you work rather than applied afterwards. 
 - Cloud experience on Azure or GCP, our preferred platforms, including provisioning with Terraform and deploying with Kubernetes or Helm. 
 - Comfortable setting up observability with Grafana, Prometheus or Elastic, and familiar with how ServiceNow fits into incident and change processes. 
 - Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot daily, not occasionally. 
 - Comfortable working closely with a more senior engineer on the shape of a problem, while owning how you build the solution yourself, and ready to take on more of that framing role as you gain experience. 
 - Comfortable working across time zones with a distributed team. 
 - Some exposure to regulated environments, so security, privacy and quality considerations aren't new territory. 

Preferred Experience: 

- A background in pharma, biotech or life sciences. 
 - Instrument integration, robotics or closed-loop experimentation experience. 
 - Familiarity with GxP, computer system validation or data integrity requirements. 
 - Hybrid cloud experience. 
 - A previous stint as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Customer Engineer or Solutions Architect. 
 - Have worked alongside vendor or contract engineers on a shared piece of delivery. 
 - Contributed a pattern or component that someone else actually reused. 

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Engineering or a related subject, or relevant industry experience. 

#AGTech

#GSK-LI

Skills

Agile Methodology, API Management, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Containerization, Database Management, High Availability (Inactive), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Microservices Architecture, Network Security, Operating Systems (OS), System Monitors, Version Control System

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

data.title: Senior Principal Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

Do you bring the engineering judgement to turn complex Medical Affairs opportunities into working digital, data, analytics, and AI solutions? Can you embed directly with business teams, move rapidly from problem framing to proof of concept, and then engineer successful solutions for secure, compliant production use at scale?

As Senior Principal Engineer for Global Medical Affairs Digital & Tech, you will work side by side with Medical Affairs leaders, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and end users to build solutions that improve Measurement, Analytics and Insights. Unlike a role focused only on PoCs and MVPs, this position owns the path from discovery and rapid validation through production deployment, adoption, scaling, and continuous improvement. 

You will focus on high-value opportunities across Data Generation, Scientific Communications, Medical Information, and MSL Engagement. The outcome is not slideware or isolated pilots. It is working, trusted software and analytics that are used in real workflows and deliver measurable Medical Affairs value. 

Why This Role Exists

- Global Medical Affairs needs engineers who can close the gap between business questions, scientific workflows, fragmented data, and scalable technology. This role combines deep customer embedding, rapid engineering, production accountability, and reusable platform thinking so that promising ideas become durable capabilities. 
 - Proves value quickly - frames priority problems and delivers PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at pace using real data and workflows. 
 - Takes solutions to production - engineers validated concepts for secure, reliable, compliant, and supportable use. 
 - Scales what works - expands successful products across therapy areas, regions, teams, and use cases while creating reusable patterns. 
 - Improves decisions and impact - builds Measurement, Analytics and Insights solutions that help Medical Affairs understand performance, identify opportunities, and act. 
 - Oversee Strategic partners - work directly with GSK Tech strategic partners and their engineering teams to ensure solutions are designed, engineering and can be supported in production 
 - environments. 

Key Responsibilities

Embedded Discovery, Prototyping and Value Validation

- Embed with Medical Affairs teams to understand scientific and operational workflows, decision points, user needs, data constraints, and measures of value. 
 - Own high-priority use cases from problem framing through PoC, PoV, and MVP, using short delivery cycles and direct user feedback. 
 - Prototype against representative data and real workflows, testing desirability, feasibility, usability, data quality, and business value before material investment. 
 - Form and defend evidence-based continue, pivot, or stop recommendations with clear implications for investment and scale. 

Production Engineering and Scale

- Own the transition from validated MVP to production, including architecture, engineering, integration, testing, security, controls, deployment, observability, documentation, and support readiness. 
 - Build reliable, maintainable solutions that meet GSK Digital and Tech requirements for privacy, quality, compliance, performance, resilience, and user experience. 
 - Scale successful solutions across therapy areas, regions, and Medical Affairs functions by designing configurable components, reusable services, data products, and reference architectures. 
 - Establish product measures and production telemetry to track adoption, service performance, decision impact, realised value, and opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 - Address technical debt and production issues pragmatically, balancing speed with long-term sustainability and total cost of ownership. 

Measurement, Analytics and Insights Solutions

- Data Generation: build data and analytics products that improve visibility across evidence planning, study execution, evidence generation, data quality, analysis, and reporting. 
 - Scientific Communications: develop measurement and insight capabilities across medical writing, publications, congress activity, content development, scientific dissemination, reach, engagement, and impact. 
 - Medical Information: create analytics and AI-enabled solutions that identify inquiry trends, knowledge gaps, response performance, content needs, and emerging scientific questions while supporting accurate and compliant operations. 
 - MSL Engagement: build solutions that strengthen planning and measurement of scientific exchange, stakeholder engagement, field insights, content use, follow-up, and the translation of field observations into actionable Medical Affairs insights. 
 - Cross-functional impact measurement: connect data across these domains to create trusted metrics, dashboards, analytical products, and decision-support experiences that demonstrate Medical Affairs value and identify where action is needed. 

AI-Native Engineering

- Use AI coding assistants and agent-based workflows for planning, coding, testing, review, documentation, and operational support, applying human judgement and validation throughout. 
 - Apply GenAI, machine learning, natural language processing, knowledge retrieval, and advanced analytics where they are appropriate to the problem and evidence supports their use. 
 - Design human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation approaches, and monitoring so AI-enabled capabilities remain accurate, explainable, responsible, and fit for Medical Affairs use. 

Partnership, Governance and Reuse

- Partner with Medical Affairs Digital & Tech Product Directors, Enterprise Data and AI, architecture, Cyber Security, Quality, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and shared engineering services. 
 - Embed security, privacy, quality, records, Responsible AI, and regulatory requirements from discovery through production rather than treating governance as a late-stage gate. 
 - Distil each engagement into reusable code, data models, agents, prompts, evaluation assets, APIs, patterns, and reference architectures. 
 - Coach product teams and Medical Affairs Digital and Tech colleagues in AI-augmented delivery, analytical thinking, experimentation, and product adoption. 

What You Bring

Required Experience: 

- At least 10 years of full-stack, data, analytics, or software engineering experience, including ownership of production deployments and scaled enterprise solutions. 
 - Strong proficiency in modern software languages, plus experience with at least one modern application development language or framework such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Phyton, or similar. 
 - Experience with data engineering, analytics products, APIs, cloud platforms, modern software engineering, testing, DevSecOps, observability, and production support. 
 - Experience applying GenAI patterns such as agents, multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, evaluation, and responsible human oversight. 
 - Experience in working with senior business stakeholders and end users, translate needs into technical choices, and communicate trade-offs clearly. 
 - Experience delivering technology in a regulated or high-control environment with strong expectations for security, privacy, quality, and compliance. 

Preferred Experience. 

- A master's degree in a related field is advantageous. 
 - Experience building measurement frameworks, data products, dashboards, analytical applications, decision-support tools, or insight-generation capabilities. 
 - Familiarity with Medical Affairs processes across data generation, scientific communications and publications, medical information, field medical or MSL engagement, and impact measurement. 
 - Prior experience in a senior principal engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering, or startup environment. 
 - Track record of scaling a successful solution across multiple markets, business units, or user groups while improving reuse and reducing delivery time. 

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Skills Profile

Capability

G6 expectation

Delivery

Embeds with users, frames ambiguous problems, prototypes quickly, and iterates using evidence and direct feedback. 

Technical Ownership

Engineers validated concepts into secure, compliant, observable, supportable products and remains accountable through adoption and stabilisation. 

Scale and Reuse

Designs configurable, reusable components and patterns that allow successful solutions to expand across functions, therapy areas, and regions. 

Measurement and Analytics

Translates Medical Affairs objectives into trusted measures, analytical products, insights, and decision-support experiences. 

Technical Judgement

Makes sound architecture, data, AI, and engineering decisions with incomplete information while balancing value, risk, speed, and sustainability. 

Customer Partnership

Builds trusted relationships with Medical Affairs leaders, product owners, scientists, analysts, engineers, and operational teams. 

Responsible Innovation

Integrates security, privacy, quality, compliance, and Responsible AI into delivery from the start. 

Capability Building

Leaves teams stronger by coaching colleagues and contributing reusable assets, standards, and ways of working. 

What Success Looks Like

In the first 12 months, the person in this role will have: 

- Owned multiple high-priority Medical Affairs engagements from problem framing through prototype, production deployment, adoption, and measurable value realisation. 
 - Put at least one new Measurement, Analytics and Insights solution into production and established a credible path to scale across additional teams, therapy areas, or regions. 
 - Improved decision-making or operational performance in one or more priority domains: Data Generation, Scientific Communications, Medical Information, or MSL Engagement. 
 - Established clear product metrics and production monitoring covering adoption, data quality, service performance, user experience, and realised business value. 
 - Contributed reusable engineering, data, analytics, or AI assets that materially accelerate subsequent Medical Affairs solutions. 
 - Built strong trust with Medical Affairs and Tech stakeholders as an embedded technical partner who delivers working outcomes, not only recommendations. 

About Global Medical Affairs And Medical Digital & Tech

Global Medical Affairs generates and communicates scientific evidence to support informed decision-making, demonstrate product value, and enable high-quality scientific exchange with healthcare professionals. Its work spans evidence and data generation, scientific communications and publications, medical information, field medical and MSL engagement, and the measurement of Medical Affairs impact. 

Global Medical Affairs Digital & Tech enables this mission through secure, compliant, user-centred digital, data, analytics, and AI capabilities across therapy areas, regions, and central functions. The team partners with Medical Affairs to modernise workflows, connect data, generate actionable insights, improve stakeholder experiences, and scale solutions that deliver measurable scientific and business value.

data.description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently. 

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally. 

Job Description

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers' systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations. 

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists. 

Key team values: 

- Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
 - Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
 - Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
 - Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay aheadAbout the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365. 

- Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc. ) for multi-tenant SaaS environments. 

- Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven). 

- Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles. 

- Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems. 

- Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability. 

- Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization. 

- Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization. 

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built. 

You will be successful in this role if you: 

- Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer. 

- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

- Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture. 

- Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives. 

- Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers. 

- Are able to make data-driven decisions. 

- Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from. 

- Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push. 

Qualifications

We are looking for: 

- 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements. 

- 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants. 

- Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices. 

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems. 

- Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns. 

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns. 

- Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e). 

Technical Skills and Experience: 

- Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc. ). 

- Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling). 

- Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing. 

- Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs. 

- Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production. 

- Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms. 

- CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 

- OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking). 

- Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin). 

Additional Information

What You'll Get: 

- Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
 - Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes. 
 - Career development and mentorship

data.title: Vice President, Critical Engineering Manager  North - Critical Site Operations
data.description:
About This Role

About Workplace Operations

Workplace Operations oversees the firm's Facilities Management, Hospitality, and Critical Site Operations functions. The team includes BlackRock employees and outsourced professionals across the globe, all focused on delivering a consistent, high-quality experience for BlackRock employees and visitors. 

The India Northern Region Critical Site Operations Engineering Manager supports the real estate team with site selection, critical systems design, and commissioning for offices and data centers across the India region. Because these facilities operate around the clock, the role is responsible for helping manage risk and maintain continuous uptime. This position also coordinates with design and construction, facilities management, engineering operations, and IT operations, to ensure the readiness, reliability, and integrity of mission-critical infrastructure designs throughout India. In addition, the successful candidate should be able to apply AI to strengthen and enhance BlackRock's design standards. The successful candidate will also be a key stakeholder for the design and construction of the new India Headquarters in New Delhi. 

This role requires a strong understanding of how mission critical systems operate and the ability to work closely with consulting engineers on mission-critical design. This includes knowledge of electrical switchgear, transfer switches, backup power systems, and HVAC operations. The successful candidate will also help oversee BlackRock's IFM provider, JLL, along with other critical service providers supporting data center and facility infrastructure systems. 

Responsibilities

- Oversee the engineering design and operation of mission critical infrastructure systems and equipment across offices and data centers. 
 - Manage critical systems throughout the India Northern region. 
 - Lead MEP design, construction, and operational budget management. 
 - Ensure compliance with BlackRock design standards, operating procedures, methods of procedure, and emergency response protocols for mission-critical environments. 
 - Use AI-assisted design tools, such as generative layout engines, to develop and assess optimized HVAC, piping, and lighting layouts based on building geometry and space constraints. 
 - Apply predictive AI simulations to evaluate energy use, optimize equipment sizing, and assess system performance under multiple scenarios. 
 - Leverage AI-powered models to check designs against current building codes and standards, including Building Code, ASHRAE, and NEC, and identify non-compliance automatically. 
 - Manage site-based MEP and IT Life Cycle Management (LCM) projects. 
 - Perform ongoing assessments of infrastructure system operational readiness. 
 - Review and enhance preventive and predictive maintenance procedures for all critical infrastructure systems. 
 - Ensure 24/7/365 coverage and effective emergency response for infrastructure and IT equipment failures. 
 - Partner with Global Critical Engineering and Global Technology teams to provide expertise on design objectives, operational performance, and infrastructure systems that support efficient and maintainable operations. 
 - Provide remote technical support for India facility operations. 

Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, facilities engineering, Data Center Operations, or other equivalent related life experience preferred. 
 - Ten years of building engineering design management, facilities management, data center management, or related experience. 
 - Strong knowledge of mission critical cooling systems, power systems, mechanical systems, and fire suppression systems. 
 - Familiarity with AI-driven MEP plugins or generative design workflows. 
 - Project management skills. 
 - Knowledge of Electrical/Arc Flash Safety (NFPA 70E)
 - Electrical or HVAC licenses would be a plus. 
 - Working familiarity with Microsoft Office, Outlook, Cad/BIM Platforms, and Integrated Work Maintenance Management System (IWMS) software. 
 - The candidate must be available for travel, weekend work, and available for emergency problems on a 24/7/365 basis. 

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. 

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person - aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. 

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work - enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. 

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. 

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment - the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. 

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers. BlackRock. com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. 

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

data.description:
Job Title - Development Manager

We are now looking for a

Development Manager to lead a team of developers and to own the technical direction, architecture and quality of the solutions we build. In this role you will combine hands-on technical leadership with people leadership, driving the design, development and continuous improvement of modern applications that create value across KONE. You will also be responsible for driving CI projects, Lean Six Sigma Projects and Innovation programs in the department. 

You will be the technical anchor of the team - setting coding standards, resolving complex technical and performance issues, and making sure our solutions are scalable, secure and maintainable. We are looking for someone with strong knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform and practical experience applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) in development projects, who can guide the team in adopting these technologies effectively. 

This role will report to the GEC Development Portfolio Lead. 

Requirements for the candidate: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Computer Science, Mechanical, EEE, Information Technology or a related field). 
 - 8+ years of work experience in Engineering, including 2+ years in a technical lead or development management role. 
 - Proven experience leading, mentoring and growing a team of developers in an agile environment. 
 - Strong knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse and Power Platform connectors). 
 - Hands-on experience applying AI in development projects - for example generative AI, Copilot / AI-assisted coding, machine learning services or intelligent automation. 
 - Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, APIs and integration, and cloud platforms (preferably Microsoft Azure). 
 - Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (e. g. C#/. NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) and familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience owning the full software development lifecycle, including performance tuning, security and technical documentation. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to resolve complex technical and performance issues. 
 - Excellent communication skills in both spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 

Key responsibilities: 

- Lead, coach and develop a team of software developers, setting clear goals and supporting their technical and professional growth. 
 - Own the technical architecture of the solutions, making key design decisions and ensuring they are scalable, secure, performant and maintainable. 
 - Take an active, hands-on role in coding, code reviews and establishing and enforcing coding standards and best practices. 
 - Identify, troubleshoot and resolve technical and performance issues across applications and environments. 
 - Drive the adoption of the Power Platform and AI-based approaches to accelerate delivery and improve solution quality. 
 - Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including architecture, design and operational guides. 
 - Plan and manage the delivery of development work, balancing scope, quality and timelines in close collaboration with stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate with product owners, architects, business stakeholders and other teams to translate requirements into robust technical solutions. 
 - Ensure solutions follow KONE security, data and compliance standards throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Promote continuous improvement, innovation and knowledge sharing within the team and across the wider organization. 

Qualities we are looking for: 

- A hands-on technical leader who leads by example and stays close to the code. 
 - Strong ownership and accountability, with a focus on quality and long-term maintainability. 
 - A collaborative mindset and the ability to build trust within the team and with stakeholders. 
 - Curiosity and a passion for learning, especially around emerging technologies such as AI and low-code platforms. 
 - A structured, pragmatic problem-solver who stays calm under pressure. 
 - A coaching and mentoring attitude that helps others grow. 

Key performance measures: 

- On-time delivery of development commitments. 
 - Software quality, measured by production defects. 
 - Application performance and reliability (availability and mean time to resolve incidents). 
 - Effective adoption of the Power Platform and AI in development, with measurable gains in delivery speed or efficiency. 
 - Completeness of technical documentation and compliance with KONE security, data and coding standards.

Now you have a great opportunity to join a team of skilled colleagues, work in a global environment, and being part of our journey which supports our new strategy!

Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice.
