At Cytiva, one of Danaher's 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives-and we're all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. 

You'll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher's system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact - innovating at the speed of life. 

Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies. 

At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us - working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career. 

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. 

The Sr Director, R&D Bangalore is responsible for leading a large R&D team comprised of multiple engineering disciplines to deliver Research, Product Development and Life Cycle projects in support of Bioprocessing applications, in partnership with global Cytiva Business Units. 

This position reports to the Chief Technology Officer - Cytiva Innovation and is part of the Global Cytiva CTO organization leading the team located in Bangalore, India and will be an on-site role. At Cytiva, our vision is, to advance future therapeutics from discovery to delivery. 

What You Will Do

- Partner with global Cytiva Business Units and senior technical leaders to deliver research, product development and life cycle programs, aligning priorities, resources and execution with customer and business needs. 
 - Systems Engineering Leadership: Establish robust practices for complex instrument platforms integrating hardware, software and data analytics, including architecture, risk management, and system-level verification and validation.

 - Technology Roadmaps: Shape next-generation platform strategies with Business Units, identifying opportunities in data-driven bioprocess control, additive manufacturing and digital twins.

 - Talent Development: Attract, develop and retain scientific and technical talent, building future capabilities and career paths aligned with organizational growth. 
 - Regional Leadership: Lead cross-Danaher India R&D Board charters aligned with strategic priorities and contribute to region-for-region initiatives as a Cytiva India Leadership Team member. 
 - Operational Excellence: Embed Danaher Business System (DBS) principles to deliver high-quality R&D programs efficiently and ethically. 

Who You Are

- 15-20 years of R&D experience, including 10+ years of relevant industry leadership, particularly in systems engineering, preferably in bioprocessing or life sciences; advanced degree in engineering or a related scientific discipline preferred. 
 - Proven ability to lead large, complex, cross-cultural teams through change, fostering collaboration and high performance across global organizations. 
 - Demonstrated success in product or program delivery, systems engineering and scientific innovation, spanning new product development, lifecycle management and strategic programs with internal and external partners. 
 - Strong business acumen, translating strategy into investment and resource priorities, with expertise in structured development, toll-gate reviews and alignment across quality, manufacturing, supply chain and commercial functions. 
 - Ability to anticipate trends and navigate ambiguity, shaping technology strategies that apply AI, software and advanced analytics to bioprocessing challenges. 
 - Strong global influencing skills and enduring stakeholder relationships, translating customer needs and scientific challenges into impactful solutions and aligning priorities across geographies and Business Units. 

Travel Requirements

data.description:
About the Role: 

Take your software engineering career to the next level as a Senior Product Software Engineer. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and troubleshooting software programs. Your technical skills and innovative mindset will contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, making a significant impact on user experience and satisfaction. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead Software Development: Take the lead in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software applications to meet project requirements. 
 - Design Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define design specifications and details, taking into account diverse perspectives. 
 - Effective Communication: Regularly communicate project updates, progress, and challenges to stakeholders and team members. 
 - Technical Documentation: Prepare detailed technical specifications and requirements documents to guide the development process. 
 - Performance Optimization: Identify bottlenecks and optimize software programs to improve overall performance and efficiency. 
 - Application Design: Lead the design of innovative and user-friendly software applications that align with customer needs and industry standards. 
 - Testing Strategies: Create comprehensive testing routines and procedures to ensure the reliability and accuracy of software applications. 
 - Applied Problem Solving: Utilize mathematical principles and statistical approaches to solve intricate problems in scientific or applied fields within software projects. 
 - Issue Resolution: Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve complex information technology issues that may arise during development. 
 - Data Preparation: Prepare and preprocess data for analysis, ensuring its accuracy and readiness for use in software applications. 
 - Technical Support: Provide technical support to end-users, including assistance with software maintenance, troubleshooting, and usage queries. 

Skills: 

- Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test the software, and resolve any software-related issues. 
 - Software Development: The ability to design, write, test, and implement software programs, applications, and systems. This includes understanding various programming languages, software architecture, and software testing methods. It also involves problem-solving capabilities to fix software issues and improve functionality. 
 - Programming: The ability to design, write, test, debug, and maintain the instructions, also known as code, that a computer must follow to execute a task. This skill often involves various programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++. 
 - Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and ultimately choosing and implementing the most effective course of action. 
 - Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them down into smaller parts, and understand how these parts work together. 
 - Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process, often in software or product development. It involves the ability to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality. 
 - Agile: The ability to swiftly and effectively respond to changes, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and flexibility. In the context of project management, it denotes a methodology that promotes adaptive planning and encourages rapid and flexible responses to changes. 
 - Source Code Repository: The ability to effectively use a source code repository, a file archive, and a web hosting facility where a large amount of source code, for software or for web pages, is kept, either publicly or privately. This skill involves the ability to manage and track changes to code, identify and fix issues, merge code from different branches, and collaborate with other developers. 
 - Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate a relational database, a type of database that stores and organizes data in a structured way and where data is logically interrelated. This skill often requires proficiency in SQL, database management systems, and an understanding of database design principles. 
 - APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage Application Programming Interfaces, which constitute the set of protocols and tools used for building application software. This skill includes the capacity to create and maintain high-quality API documentation, implement API security practices, and understand API testing techniques. Additionally, having this ability means understanding how APIs enable interaction between different software systems, allowing them to communicate with each other. 
 - Design: The ability to create, conceptualize, sketch, and implement layouts, structures, and plans either for aesthetic or functional purposes. This could be used in various contexts such as architecture, fashion, graphics, interior, and more. It involves creativity, problem-solving, and strategic thinking. 
 - Framework: The ability to understand, utilize, design, and develop complex structures and systems in various contexts such as programming, project management, or business strategy. This ability requires critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. 
 - Documentation: The ability to create, manage, organize, and maintain important information and documents in various physical and digital formats. This skill may include preparing reports, managing files, storing data, and keeping records organized and updated for easy retrieval and understanding. 
 - Advanced Technology Adoption and Utilization: AI Tool Proficiency: Evaluate and optimize AI tool usage for team efficiency and productivity; AI Output Validation: Establish validation standards and review processes for AI-generated code; Responsible AI Usage: Lead responsible AI initiatives and establish team best practices; and Agentic Workflow Design: Design and optimize AI agent workflows for team efficiency. 

Competencies: 

- Analytical Skills
 - Inclusive Collaboration
 - Drive to Perform
 - Accountability
 - Functional Expertise
 - Operational Expertise

Our Interview Practices

data.description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application. 

YOUR MISSION: 

About the Organisation & Role: 

You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing & fulfilment and post-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. Through a portfolio of commerce platform capabilities, the organisation enables seamless omnichannel experiences while supporting efficient, scalable, and resilient commerce operations across the global digital ecosystem. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain production-grade backend services for payment capabilities that power payment processing, authorization, tokenization, fraud prevention, and transaction orchestration across digital commerce channels. You will work closely with Tech Leads, Product Owners, Payment Service Providers (PSPs), Risk & Compliance teams, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and low-latency payment solutions that enable seamless, reliable, and compliant customer checkout experiences. . 

What you will do: 

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable services supporting payment authorization, capture, refunds, tokenization, fraud prevention, and transaction lifecycle management across digital commerce channels. 
 - Build and enhance API-first, event-driven, and SFCC-integrated payment solutions that enable secure transaction processing, payment gateway integrations, token management, fraud detection, and real-time payment status updates. 
 - Support the delivery of seamless and secure customer payment experiences by ensuring payment workflows operate consistently across channels, devices, regions, and currencies. 
 - Integrate SFCC payment services with payment gateways, PSPs, OMS, ERP, fraud platforms, tax services, customer systems, and other enterprise applications to enable seamless end-to-end payment processing. 
 - Collaborate with Tech Leads, Product teams, and payment partners to deliver roadmap commitments. 
 - Drive technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions within the team. 
 - Ensure applications and services are production-ready through effective observability, monitoring, performance optimization, reliability engineering, security compliance, and operational readiness practices. 
 - Mentor junior engineers, perform code reviews, and help establish engineering standards and best practices. 
 - Utilize AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate development and strengthen code quality. 
 - Support PCI-compliant payment architectures, security controls, tokenization strategies, and fraud mitigation capabilities to protect customer transactions and sensitive payment data. 

YOUR TALENT: 

- 7+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and operating scalable, highly available, customer-facing digital commerce and payment platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of payment capabilities, including payment authorization, capture, refunds, voids, tokenization, payment instruments, and transaction lifecycle management. 
 - Strong understanding of design patterns, data structures and algorithms, with practical experience applying them to real-world use cases. 
 - Solid knowledge of payment processing workflows, including payment authorization, settlement, refunds, partial captures, chargebacks, token management, and transaction reconciliation. 
 - Expertise in backend engineering, API design, microservices, event-driven architectures, and scalable integration patterns using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with Payment Service Providers (PSPs) and payment gateway integrations such as Adyen, Cybersource, Stripe, Worldpay, PayPal, or equivalent enterprise payment solutions. 
 - Strong hands-on software engineering experience with modern microservices architectures using Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Experience designing and building high-throughput, low-latency services supporting payment authorization, transaction processing, tokenization, refunds, fraud checks, and settlement workflows. 
 - Experience with performance engineering, load testing, and capacity planning for mission-critical payment services, particularly during peak sales events and seasonal trading periods. 
 - Experience designing graceful degradation and fallback mechanisms that help sustain payment processing continuity during third-party provider outages or downstream system disruptions. 
 - Strong observability and operational excellence practices, including monitoring, distributed tracing, alerting, log analysis, and root-cause analysis for payment failures, authorization latency, transaction declines, settlement issues, and fraud alerts. 
 - Strong ability to mentor engineers, review payment integration designs, conduct code reviews, and drive sound technical decisions and engineering standards. 
 - Experience using coding agents, LLMs, or AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery, testing, code quality, and developer productivity. 

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination. 

At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play. 

PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22, 000 employees worldwide.

At PUMA, technology plays a critical role in enabling exceptional consumer, digital, and business experiences across global markets. Our engineering teams build and operate the platforms, products, and services that power PUMA's digital ecosystem, supporting consumers, business users, and operational teams worldwide.

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. data.description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently. 

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally. 

Job Description

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers' systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations. 

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists. 

Key team values: 

- Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
 - Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
 - Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
 - Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay aheadAbout the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365. 

- Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc. ) for multi-tenant SaaS environments. 

- Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven). 

- Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles. 

- Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems. 

- Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability. 

- Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization. 

- Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization. 

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built. 

You will be successful in this role if you: 

- Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer. 

- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

- Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture. 

- Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives. 

- Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers. 

- Are able to make data-driven decisions. 

- Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from. 

- Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push. 

Qualifications

We are looking for: 

- 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements. 

- 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants. 

- Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices. 

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems. 

- Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns. 

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns. 

- Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e). 

Technical Skills and Experience: 

- Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc. ). 

- Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling). 

- Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing. 

- Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs. 

- Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production. 

- Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms. 

- CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 

- OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking). 

- Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin). 

Additional Information

What You'll Get: 

- Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
 - Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes. 
 - Career development and mentorship
 - A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heartPlease be advised that Jitterbit does not: 

- Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms. 
 - Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact. 
 - Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process. 
 - Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages. 

Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

data.title: Lead - Supplier Quality
data.description:
Roles & Responsibilities

- Supplier Qualification & Approval - Evaluate, audit, and qualify new suppliers based on technical capability, quality systems, manufacturing capacity, and customer requirements. 
 - Supplier Quality Audits - Conduct supplier process, system, and product audits using ISO 9001, IATF 16949 (where applicable), VDA 6. 3, and customer-specific requirements. 
 - Incoming Quality Management - Establish incoming inspection standards, sampling plans, acceptance criteria, and control methods for PCBAs, PCBs, electronic components, mechanical parts, and electromechanical components. 
 - Supplier Defect Management - Identify, contain, and resolve supplier-related defects, including PCB fabrication defects, component failures, solderability issues, dimensional deviations, and material nonconformities. 
 - Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Action - Drive supplier 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone, CAPA, and RCCA activities, ensuring verified root causes and effective permanent corrective actions. 
 - Supplier Performance Monitoring - Track supplier PPM, incoming rejection rate, SCAR closure, audit scores, quality cost, and recurring defects through supplier scorecards and periodic reviews. 
 - NPI & New Part Qualification - Support new product introduction through supplier process validation, First Article Inspection (FAI), sample approval, PPAP/APQP documentation, and qualification builds as applicable. 
 - Supplier Process Capability & Improvement - Evaluate SPC, Cp/Cpk, process variation, control plans, PFMEA, and inspection systems to improve supplier process capability and prevent defects. 
 - Electronic Component Quality & Traceability - Ensure component authenticity, lot traceability, date-code control, MSL compliance, ESD protection, shelf-life management, and counterfeit component prevention. 
 - Supplier Change Management - Review and approve supplier changes involving materials, components, manufacturing processes, tooling, locations, and alternate parts before implementation, following customer approval requirements. 
 - Cross-Functional Quality Coordination - Coordinate with SCM, Engineering, Production, NPI, IQC, Test, and Customer Quality teams to resolve material quality issues and minimize production interruptions. 
 - Supplier Development & Continuous Improvement - Lead supplier improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and defect-prevention techniques to improve quality, delivery, and process consistency. 
 - Quality Documentation & Compliance - Maintain supplier audit reports, inspection standards, control plans, FMEA, material certificates, deviation approvals, and quality records to meet applicable ISO, IATF, and customer requirements. 
 - Supplier Risk & Escalation Management - Identify critical supplier risks, single-source dependencies, repeated quality failures, and material obsolescence; implement mitigation plans with SCM and Engineering. 
 - Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) Reduction - Track supplier-related scrap, rework, sorting, line stoppages, and customer complaints; drive corrective actions to reduce quality costs.

 - Test Equipment Qualification & Validation - Ensure equipment calibration, GR&R where applicable, repeatability and reproducibility, measurement-system validation, golden-board verification, and preventive maintenance.

data.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
data.description:
About Onit

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions. 

We're a team of innovators using AI at the core to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we're looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech. 

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we'd love to meet you. 

Responsibilities

- Own delivery on AWS, and on Google Cloud and Azure where products run there: Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, container images, and the Jenkins and GitLab pipelines that promote a service from sandbox to production. 
 - Shape clusters for production workloads, including compute, autoscaling, worker processes, load balancing, and shared data services such as relational databases, cache, and object and file storage. 
 - Automate virtual machine and host configuration with Ansible, including build agents, bastion hosts, and supporting services that sit beside Kubernetes. 
 - Keep configuration and secrets safe across environments and cloud accounts. Secrets stay encrypted and access stays limited to the environments that need them. 
 - Lead releases and production incidents. Diagnose failed deploys, capacity problems, and dependency failures with the service owner, and close them with a change in infrastructure, charts, playbooks, or the pipeline. 
 - Bring new services, including AI platform components, onto the same release, security, and observability bar as the core products, on whichever cloud they run. 
 - Own observability and cost: metrics, logs, and traces that show whether a release is healthy, and a clear view of spend by environment and cloud. 
 - Hold the security baseline on the platform: identity and access, policy and runtime controls, image and dependency hygiene, and patch cadence for clusters, nodes, and hosts. 
 - Advance disaster recovery and environment consistency so failover and drift are operating practice, not a side project. 
 - Set patterns other engineers can follow, and review risky changes to shared infrastructure before they land. 

Requirements

- 8+ years of experience in DevOps, site reliability, or cloud platform engineering, with several of those years leading production infrastructure. 
 - You have led Kubernetes platforms on AWS across more than one account, including production changes you owned through the incident. You have also operated workloads on Google Cloud, Azure, or both. 
 - You have standardized Terraform, Helm, and Ansible that other people can apply, including environment layout and secrets handling. 
 - You have run a real deploy path for many services and understand how image build, configuration, secrets, and load-balancer registration fit together. 
 - You can diagnose an unhealthy release: scheduling, health checks, worker backlog, and a deploy that does not become ready. 
 - You treat IAM, network boundaries, and secrets as part of the design, and you have operated cloud key management or an equivalent. 
 - You have run databases, cache, and shared storage under Kubernetes, including backup and a tested restore. 
 - You lead by setting the pattern and reviewing the risky changes, and you can pair with an engineer shipping infrastructure for the first time. 

Skills

- Cloud: AWS (EKS, ECR, VPC, ALB/NLB, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache, S3, EFS, SQS/SNS, IAM/IRSA, KMS, CloudWatch). Working knowledge of Google Cloud and Azure for the products that run there. 
 - Kubernetes: EKS, Helm, workloads, autoscaling, pod disruption budgets, resource sizing, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Delivery: Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and Git. Helm releases and Ansible playbooks across many environments. 
 - Secrets: SOPS or equivalent, with cloud key management. No plaintext credentials in configuration. 
 - Data: PostgreSQL, Redis or Valkey, and object and shared file storage in production, including backup and restore. 
 - Observability: metrics, logs, and traces (Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Fluent Bit, CloudWatch, or equivalent) and cloud cost visibility. 
 - Security: IAM, network controls, policy-as-code, image and dependency scanning, and node and host patching. 
 - Networking: load balancers, ingress, and API gateway patterns in front of Kubernetes services. 

Benefits & Perks That Support You

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond: 

Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members. 

Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually. 

Family Support: Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement. 

Income Protection: 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance. 

Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident. 

Tax-Advantaged Accounts: Flexi, NPS. 

Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community. 

Our Commitment to Applicants

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we're looking for. 

Onit Values

Customer First - Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs. 

Purposeful Innovation - Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise. 

Win as One - Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly. 

Intentional Growth - Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That's what we do. 

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you'll get flexibility that's real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters-and so do you. 

# Software Engineer III

## About the role

We are looking for a Software Engineer III with 6-10 years of experience to help us build and improve reliable software delivery and cloud solutions. You will work with engineering partners to automate infrastructure and release processes, strengthen platform reliability, and support the development of scalable services. This role combines software development, cloud engineering, and operational problem-solving. 

## What you will do

- Design, develop, and maintain automation and software solutions using Python, Go, or Java. 
 - Build and improve continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools. 
 - Create and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform. 
 - Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot containerized applications and services on Kubernetes. 
 - Work with cloud services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure. 
 - Use databases to support application and platform needs, including configuration, performance, and reliability considerations. 
 - Collaborate with engineering, operations, and product partners to plan work, resolve technical issues, and deliver maintainable solutions. 
 - Apply sound engineering practices, including code reviews, testing, documentation, and secure handling of configuration and secrets. 
 - Explore and use artificial intelligence (AI) tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to support development, troubleshooting, and productivity, applying appropriate judgment when reviewing their output. 

## What you will bring

- 6-10 years of professional experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, or a related field. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins. 
 - Practical experience building and managing cloud infrastructure with Terraform. 
 - Experience with one or more major cloud platforms: GCP, AWS, or Azure. 
 - Proficiency in at least one of Python, Go, or Java, with the ability to write clear, maintainable code. 
 - Experience deploying or supporting workloads on Kubernetes. 
 - Working knowledge of databases and the ability to investigate application or data issues. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate clearly with technical partners. 
 - A collaborative approach to planning, code reviews, and delivery. 
 - understands and delivers planned development and operations using Agile methodologies. 

## Preferred qualifications

B. Tech or M. Tech, experience across multiple cloud platforms, supporting production systems, or improving deployment automation is valuable. Relevant certifications in cloud platforms, Kubernetes, Terraform, or software development are also welcome. 

Company Overview

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry - because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg. com. 

UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process. 

Disability Accommodation in the Application and Interview Process

For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email UKGCareers@ukg. com

IPQC - In-Process Quality Control

Ensure process compliance and defect prevention during SMT, THT, Assembly, Testing stages. Experienced in In-Process Quality Control (IPQC), process monitoring, patrol inspection, first piece approval, defect analysis, SPC, MSA, PFMEA, CAPA, root cause analysis, process audits, quality documentation, and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives. Proficient in using precision measuring instruments and ensuring compliance with ISO 9001/IATF 16949 quality standards. "

 -

SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application. 

YOUR MISSION: 

About the Organisation & Role: 

You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing & fulfilment and post-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. Through a portfolio of commerce platform capabilities, the organisation enables seamless omnichannel experiences while supporting efficient, scalable, and resilient commerce operations across the global digital ecosystem. 

As a Quality Engineer, you will build and validate the test execution for payment and transaction processing capabilities across omni-channel commerce platforms. You will be responsible for creating the functional and automation test scripts and execution. Working closely with the Lead engineer, Product Owner and Engineering Manager, you will ensure that the delivered omni-channel commerce capabilities meet the requirements to provide superior consumer experience. 

What you will do: 

- 
 - Develop and maintain automated test frameworks and quality engineering solutions for Payments, Checkout, and Transaction Processing platforms across omni-channel commerce ecosystems. 
 - 
 - Develop robust automated tests for payment workflows, including authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, voids, chargebacks, tokenization, and payment reconciliation. 
 - 
 - Validate seamless payment experiences across channels and customer touchpoints, including credit/debit cards, digital wallets, gift cards, BNPL, and alternative payment methods. 
 - 
 - Validate payment processing, fraud prevention controls, transaction routing, tax calculations, promotions, and checkout integrations to ensure secure, accurate, and reliable customer experiences. 
 - 
 - Build and maintain API, integration, and contract testing suites for integrations with payment gateways, fraud management platforms, tax providers, financial systems, OMS, and third-party payment service providers. 
 - 
 - Collaborate with the Product Owners and Lead Engineers to define the testing approach, quality strategy, test automation roadmap, acceptance criteria, and risk-based validation for payment capabilities. 
 - 
 - Ensure payment solutions meet PCI-DSS, security, compliance, performance, reliability, and scalability requirements through comprehensive functional, integration, regression, and non-functional testing. 
 - 
 - Partner with engineering teams to support continuous testing, observability, production validation, and quality monitoring across the payment lifecycle. 

YOUR TALENT: 

- 
 - 4+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or Software Quality Assurance, with a strong focus on enterprise-scale payment platforms, checkout systems, transaction processing, fraud prevention, or digital commerce solutions. 
 - 
 - Understanding payment lifecycle concepts, including authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, voids, chargebacks, tokenization, and reconciliation, and how these contribute to accurate and reliable transaction processing. 
 - 
 - Experience validating payment orchestration and transaction routing logic, including payment gateway selection, alternative payment methods, fraud screening, tax calculations, currency handling, and payment failure recovery workflows. 
 - 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Java and test automation frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, REST Assured, Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent technologies. 
 - 
 - Understanding transaction integrity, concurrency, idempotency, and data consistency patterns, with the ability to design test strategies that validate duplicate payment prevention, transaction accuracy, and financial data consistency under high-volume loads. 
 - 
 - Proven experience in API testing, contract testing, integration testing, and end-to-end validation across payment gateways, fraud management platforms, OMS, tax providers, financial systems, and third-party payment service providers. 
 - 
 - Knowledge on omnichannel payment and checkout journeys, including support for credit/debit cards, digital wallets, gift cards, Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), alternative payment methods, and multi-channel transaction flows. 
 - 
 - Experience in Test Data Management, including the creation and maintenance of payment-specific test data, tokenized payment methods, and financial transaction scenarios. 
 - 
 - Experience in cross-browser testing and tooling (BrowserStack or equivalent). 
 - 
 - Experience in device compatibility testing across mobile OS versions and device types, with a focus on mobile checkout and payment experiences. 
 - 
 - Experience using coding agents, LLMs, or AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery, test automation efficiency, and developer productivity.

Every day, we seek to improve financial security for people. Joining our Information Technology Applications team means you will be a part of a passionate and supportive team that believes what we do matters to our clients and investors. 

Data Test Engineer works closely with data engineers, application developers, product owners, data stewards, analysts, and other stakeholders in an agile environment. In addition to defining, documenting, automating, and executing tests for enterprise data platforms and data-centric applications, they will be involved in sprint planning, daily scrum meetings, development validation, release readiness, and product deployment. They will contribute to both manual and automated test case creation and execution across data pipelines, services, APIs, database objects, reporting layers, data integrity controls, and applications that consume or manage enterprise data. 

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Quality & Test Engineer II / SDET II to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data testing and automation solutions, ensuring data quality across enterprise data platforms and related applications, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and trusted data products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Participate in all phases of the Agile development process, providing input into analysis, design, development, estimation, planning, support, and retrospectives. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for enterprise data platforms, data pipelines, APIs, backend services, and data-centric applications. 
 - Collaborate with data engineers, developers, product managers, business analysts, data stewards, and platform teams to understand requirements and define test strategies. 
 - Implement automated test cases to validate source-to-target mappings, ETL/ELT workflows, data transformations, data quality rules, reconciliations, and business logic. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, system, and data validation testing using automation tools and repeatable test data approaches. 
 - Ensure test coverage across multiple layers, including ingestion, transformation, storage, APIs, data services, reporting/analytics, UI applications, metadata, and database objects. 
 - Analyze test results, identify data defects, investigate root causes, and work closely with engineering teams to resolve data quality and application issues. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in data testing processes, automation frameworks, tools, quality gates, and delivery methodologies. 
 - Contribute to best practices in test automation, data quality engineering, test data management, and enterprise quality engineering. 
 - Prepare and deliver status reports on testing progress, data validation coverage, automation execution, defect metrics, and quality trends to stakeholders. 
 - Communicate risks, blockers, data quality concerns, release readiness, and quality trends proactively to project managers and leadership. 
 - Maintain dashboards and test execution reports in tools like JIRA, Zephyr/TestRail, CI/CD pipelines, or data quality platforms for real-time visibility. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 4-7 years of experience in software testing, data testing, data validations, orchestration tools, and automation, with at least 2+ years focused on enterprise data platforms, data warehouses/lakehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, or data-centric applications. 
 - Strong programming and scripting skills in Python and SQL; experience with C# or another object-oriented language is a plus. 
 - Hands-on experience building automated tests using frameworks such as PyTest, Behave, Robot Framework, Playwright, Selenium, or similar tools. 
 - Experience with API and service testing using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, Karate, or equivalent automation libraries. 
 - Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and version control tools such as Jenkins, TeamCity, GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or similar. 
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Advance SQL skills and hands-on experience validating data in relational databases, data warehouses, cloud data platforms (Preferred Snowflake), or data lake environments. 
 - Experience validating ETL/ELT pipelines, source-to-target mappings, schema changes, data lineage, data reconciliation, data completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and referential integrity. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and the ability to investigate complex data issues. 
 - Good to have experience with ETL tools, data quality, observability, or transformation tools such as dbt tests, fivetran, soda, ADF, airflow, astronomer, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar. 
 - Good to have experience/exposure to performance testing for data pipelines, database queries, APIs, batch jobs, or large-volume data processing. 

Candidate Requirements

- Demonstrated experience interfacing with clients and stakeholders to develop functional, technical, and data validation test cases and communicate status updates. 
 - Strong domain experience in enterprise data platforms, data engineering, data warehousing, financial services data, sales data, marketing data, or analytics applications. 
 - Proven ability to learn and deliver solutions in multiple programming languages and technical environments required for data test automation, including Python and SQL. 
 - Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Data Development Life Cycle, Agile methodologies, and release management practices required. 
 - Prior experience as QA/SDET/Data Test Engineer on medium to large application or data platform projects, with emphasis on SQL, data pipelines, API/services testing, data validation, and modern web application technologies. 
 - Strong troubleshooting & analysis skills and capability to work on multiple projects simultaneously across data platforms and application teams. 
 - Ability to deliver enterprise-level automation solutions that enable in-sprint automation, repeatable data validation, and continuous quality checks. 
 - Ability to work independently to drive QA and data testing practices while providing clear status reporting to stakeholders. 
 - Proactively investigates test failures and data discrepancies, logs issues clearly with evidence, and follows up with engineering teams asynchronously. 
 - Ability to work with stakeholders to prioritize the book of work based on business risk, data criticality, quality trends, and release timelines. 

Soft Skills

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills with clear, concise, and actionable status reporting. 
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment with multiple data and application delivery workstreams. 
 - Strong ownership and accountability mindset with a focus on data accuracy, reliability, and stakeholder trust. 

Core Values

- Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication and collaboration skills with all levels of management. 
 - Strong organizational skills including the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and meet frequent deadlines. 
 - Demonstrated proactive approach to problem-solving with strong judgment and decision-making capability. 
 - Highly resourceful and collaborative team-player, with the ability to also be independently effective and exude initiative and a sense of urgency. 
 - Exemplifies our customer-focused, action-oriented, results-driven culture. 
 - Forward looking thinker, who actively seeks opportunities, has a desire for continuous learning, and proposes solutions. 
 - Ability to act with discretion and maintain complete confidentiality. 
 - Dedicated to the firm's values of non-negotiable integrity, valuing our people, exceeding client expectations, and embracing intellectual curiosity and rigor. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field.

data.description:
About The Role

Navan's GOS engineering team builds the shared platform and capabilities that help teams across Navan develop, evaluate, deploy, and operate AI-powered products safely and at scale. The team focuses on reusable AI services that reduce repetitive manual workflows, along with model and provider integrations, evaluation and observability, guardrails, and a strong developer experience. 

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of 5-10 full-stack engineers. You will translate business and product needs into a clear technical strategy, balance near-term delivery with long-term platform investments, and create an environment where engineers can do their best work. 

What You Will Do

- Lead and Develop the Team: Manage, coach, and grow a team of 5-10 engineers. Set clear expectations, hold regular one-on-ones, provide actionable feedback, and support career development. 
 - Set Technical Direction: Guide architecture and engineering trade-offs for shared AI services and platform capabilities, with a focus on scalability, security, reliability, and ease of adoption. 
 - Drive Delivery: Turn strategy into realistic roadmaps, milestones, and ownership. Manage dependencies and risks while helping the team deliver measurable product and platform outcomes. 
 - Gather and Clarify Requirements: Work closely with Operations, SRE, Security, Data Science, Legal, and engineering teams across Travel and Expense to understand problems, resolve ambiguity, and define clear requirements. 
 - Raise the Quality Bar: Establish practices for AI evaluation, observability, privacy, safety, cost management, and operational readiness. Use data and production feedback to improve the platform. 
 - Build Strong Partnerships: Communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Coordinate cross-team initiatives and create alignment around shared priorities. 
 - Scale the Organization: Identify staffing needs, lead hiring and onboarding, and improve engineering processes as the team and its responsibilities grow. 

What We Are Looking For

- Experience: 7+ years of software engineering experience building scalable systems, including at least 2 years of direct engineering management experience. 
 - Technical Depth: Strong knowledge of distributed systems, APIs, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure. Experience with AI or machine learning platforms, large language model applications, or developer platforms is valuable. 
 - Engineering Judgment: Ability to evaluate architecture, make practical trade-offs, and guide teams through complex technical and operational decisions. 
 - Leadership and Execution: A record of building healthy teams, managing delivery across competing priorities, and holding a high bar for quality and ownership. 
 - Communication: Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical concepts, decisions, and risks to different audiences. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Good to Have

- Knowledge of the travel domain, including corporate travel, booking, servicing, or expense workflows. 
 - Strong product knowledge and a product-minded approach to connecting platform investments with customer and business needs. 
 - Experience working with varied stakeholders to gather requirements, reconcile competing needs, and turn ambiguous problems into an executable plan. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and a record of simplifying complex technical or business challenges. 
 - Hands-on exposure to large language models, model providers, retrieval systems, evaluations, observability, or AI governance. 
 - Experience building shared capabilities that are adopted by multiple product and engineering teams. 

Navan uses AI-assisted Automated Employment Decision Tool (Metaview) to assist with evaluating resumes against job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by human recruiters and hiring managers. 

Human oversight: Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application. 

- Your rights: If you prefer to have your application reviewed without AI assistance, you may request a human evaluation by entering your email here. Your decision to do so will not affect how your candidacy is evaluated. 

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about our processing of personal data, and your rights.

You'll be instrumental in fostering a collaborative team culture, driving consistency in our data conversions, and contributing to the growth of both your team and our global function.

Who You Are

Our Values

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

data.title: Senior Principal Engineer
data.description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work. 

Senior Principal Engineer

Technical Lead / Architect, TechGrove AI Engineering Pod

You are the kind of engineer other engineers want to build with. You have spent your career going deep on production systems, and you have reached the point where your judgment shapes architectures, raises teams, and makes hard problems look simple. This is the most senior technical seat in the pod, and it is unapologetically hands-on. 

As Technical Lead and Architect, you own the architecture for an OpCo's modernized applications and set the engineering bar the whole pod builds to. You operate as a player/coach: designing complex systems, writing meaningful code, and running rigorous reviews of work produced by both engineers and AI agents. You treat agentic development as a first-class part of the architecture, not a novelty, and you define how the pod gets the most out of it without ever compromising quality or security. 

If you want your decisions to matter, your code to ship, and your standards to lift an entire team, this is built for you. 

About the PodA TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan's AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match. 

A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan's India-based TechGrove. 

What You Will Do
 - Own the architecture: Define and own the end-to-end software architecture for the pod's applications, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, resilient, and cloud-native across AWS and Azure. 
 - Own the frontend architecture: Set the frontend architecture: state management, a scalable library of reusable components, design-system integration, and the patterns, standards, and performance budgets the pod builds against. 
 - Lead the technical direction: Serve as the highest technical authority and escalation point in the pod. Set design patterns and standards, and make confident architectural decisions amid ambiguity. 
 - Stay hands-on: Operate as a player/coach. Make significant code contributions, lead complex designs, and deliver thorough code reviews of work from both engineers and AI agents. 
 - Lead AI-native development: Define how the pod uses agentic tooling such as Claude Code across the SDLC, establishing patterns for AI-assisted design, implementation, testing, and review that maximize velocity while protecting quality and security. 
 - Set the quality bar: Define and enforce engineering excellence: clean code, Domain-Driven Design, modern design patterns, Twelve-Factor principles, meaningful test coverage, and application security. 
 - Build secure and reliable systems: Embed secure-by-design principles and cloud-native observability so applications run fast, stay available, and stay safe in production. 
 - Mentor and raise the team: Coach senior engineers, grow the technical capability of the team (human and agentic), and foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. 
 - Partner with the OpCo: Work with the OpCo's technical leadership and existing teams to align architecture with their landscape, integrate with existing systems, and transfer knowledge. What You Bring
 - Experience: 10+ years in software engineering, with significant time in Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or Architect roles leading the architecture of complex, production systems. 
 - Production experience on BOTH AWS and Azure (required): You have personally designed, built, and run production software on both AWS and Azure. This dual-cloud depth is essential: you are the technical authority who sets cloud architecture regardless of which target cloud an OpCo runs on. Hands-on depth includes containers (Docker/Kubernetes), serverless (Lambda and Azure Functions), and Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform. 
 - Architectural depth: Deep command of modern architectural patterns (microservices, event-driven, distributed systems), DDD, and design patterns, with a record of turning business objectives into technical solutions at enterprise or B2B scale. 
 - Hands-on technical depth: Current, real coding ability. A player/coach who contributes code, leads design, and delivers thorough reviews, including of AI-generated work. 
 - AI-native engineering: Demonstrated fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development tooling (Claude Code or similar) and a clear, practiced approach to architecting and delivering software in an AI-native team. 
 - Modern tech stacks: Hands-on production experience with at least two of: . NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java. 
 - Frontend architecture: Deep expertise in modern frontend architecture with React. js and Next. js: state management, scalable and reusable component design, design-system strategy, and frontend performance at scale. 
 - DevSecOps: Strong command of CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and modern DevSecOps practices. 
 - Communication and leadership: You align technical and business stakeholders, lead under competing priorities, and bring calm and clarity to fast-moving teams. Nice to Have
 - Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS at scale. 
 - A track record leading application modernization or re-platforming of large enterprise or B2B applications. 
 - GenAI architecture experience: RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, multi-agent frameworks, MCP servers and tools, context engineering, and vector databases. 
 - Experience leading embedded or client-facing engineering teams. 
 - Working knowledge of GCP, in addition to AWS and Azure. What Success Looks Like
 - First 90 days: You understand the OpCo's landscape, have set the architectural direction and engineering standards, and the pod is shipping against them with a clean, AI-native workflow. 
 - First 6 months: The architecture is proven in production, quality and delivery metrics are trending up, and the team's technical capability, human and agentic, has visibly grown under your leadership. Why TechGrove, Why Banyan
 - Permanent home, long-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip. 
 - Real ownership: You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the "what"; the pod owns the "how. "
 - AI-native by default: You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build. 
 - Variety with stability: Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you. 
 - Growth and excellence: A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time. Should You Apply?We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that. 

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes. 

Beware of Recruitment Scams

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.   

Protect yourself by following these steps: 

- Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware. com email address. 
 - Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process. 
 - If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond - instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware. com and/or report it to the platform where you received it. Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

The Senior Architect in Delivery leads architecture and technical direction for multi-team Azure programs across applications, platforms, and data. You connect client goals to scalable designs, guide delivery across teams, and shape modernization work so it delivers measurable results. 

At this level, you influence architecture beyond a single project. You set direction across engagements, work with business and technology leaders, raise the bar on delivery quality, and promote reusable patterns. You mentor architects and senior engineers, support strategic pursuits, and turn working solutions into repeatable delivery models.

Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership

- Lead architecture and technical strategy for Azure modernization and transformation programs that span multiple teams and workstreams.

 - Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and help teams adopt effective practices at program scale. 

Delivery and Consulting Excellence

 - Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, and risks at program scale, and explain options in terms of value, cost, risk, and time-to-impact.

 - Help define delivery approaches, working agreements, and documentation practices that keep 3Cloud and client teams aligned across locations and time zones. 
 - Support effective use of Agile at scale by ensuring architecture and backlog structure enable incremental delivery, clear definitions of done, and data-informed adjustments based on telemetry and feedback. 
 - Apply a consulting mindset by anticipating client needs, proposing options, and tying solutions to clear results and adoption, and handle challenge and pushback by explaining trade-offs in simple, direct language. 
 - Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, streamline delivery processes, and drive measurable business value. Commitment to continuous learning and adoption of new digital capabilities is required. 
 - Proven success operating within large, matrixed consulting organizations and navigating the scale, complexity, governance, and pace of a Global System Integrator (GSI) environment. Ability to manage competing priorities, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and consistently deliver results in a fast-paced, performance-driven setting.

data.title: Lead Golang Engineer
data.description:
Lead Golang Platform Engineer

Domain: Fintech / Trading & Capital Markets

Experience: 6-8+ Years

Work Mode: To be confirmed

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Golang Platform Engineer to own the stability, performance, and reliability of mission-critical backend platforms supporting real-time market data, transactions, portfolio systems, and enterprise integrations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on distributed systems, production incident management, performance optimization, and platform ownership rather than feature development alone. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own production stability and act as the L3/L4 escalation point for backend and middleware systems. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents, latency spikes, Kafka lag, database contention, and memory issues. 
 - Drive non-functional requirements (NFRs), including performance, throughput, high availability, fault tolerance, and resource efficiency. 
 - Design and optimize distributed systems and event-driven microservices using Golang, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Redis. 
 - Ensure reliable event processing through idempotency, offset management, retries, dead-letter queues, event replay, and backpressure handling. 
 - Optimize PostgreSQL queries, indexing, partitioning, connection pooling, and Redis caching for high-performance workloads. 
 - Build configurable, rule-driven workflows and high-performance backend services. 
 - Improve observability through logging, tracing, metrics, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Lead vendor knowledge transfer, take ownership of legacy codebases, and establish backend engineering standards. 
 - Mentor engineers on production debugging, distributed systems, and code quality. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 6-8+ years of backend engineering experience, preferably in fintech, trading, or transaction-heavy systems. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Golang, including concurrency, context propagation, runtime behavior, and memory profiling. 
 - Strong production experience with Apache Kafka, including consumer groups, rebalancing, offset management, and lag diagnostics. 
 - Proven expertise in PostgreSQL performance tuning and database optimization. 
 - Experience troubleshooting live production incidents and driving permanent corrective actions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, fault tolerance, and high-throughput APIs. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of non-functional requirements (NFRs), performance benchmarks, and production reliability. 

Good to Have

- Experience with low-latency trading platforms, exchanges, or regulated financial systems. 
 - Production exposure to Kubernetes and Redis performance optimization. 
 - Experience with WebSockets, streaming systems, ClickHouse, and Grafana. 
 - Familiarity with CockroachDB or other distributed databases. 
 - Experience taking over vendor-built or legacy platforms. 

Ideal Candidate

Someone who can remain calm during critical production incidents, diagnose complex distributed-system issues, optimize runtime performance, and take end-to-end ownership of platform reliability while providing technical guidance to the backend team.

data.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
data.description:
Level AI is a Mountain View-based conversational intelligence company building the AI platform that powers modern contact centers. Our systems analyze millions of customer interactions to surface insights, automate quality assurance, and drive real-time agent guidance. We work at the frontier of applied speech and language AI, and our research directly shapes products used by enterprise customers every day. 

We are looking for a Principal AI Research Engineer to set the technical direction for our most ambitious AI initiatives. You will lead research on large language models, speech understanding, and retrieval systems-then translate that research into production capabilities at scale. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of cutting-edge research and real-world deployment, and who can raise the technical bar across the entire AI organization. 

What You'll Do

- Define and drive the research roadmap for core AI capabilities spanning LLMs, ASR/speech understanding, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic systems. 
 - Design, train, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art models, taking them from prototype to robust, production-grade systems.

 - A track record of taking research from idea to deployed, scaled product-not just publications, but shipped impact. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in Python and a major deep learning framework (PyTorch preferred), with strong software engineering fundamentals.

Nice to Have

data.title: Staff Engineer – Observability Platform

Who Are We?

Postman is the world's leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500, 000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. The Observability team sits at the center of Postman's engineering ecosystem. Success in this role means creating the visibility, insights, and operational intelligence that enable every engineering team at Postman to build and operate reliable products with confidence.

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We're building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. 

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. 

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes.
