data.title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations. 

Responsibilities

Problems the team works on: 

- Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load. 
 - API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs. 
 - Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems. 

What you'll do: 

- Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time. 
 - Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams. 
 - Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed. 
 - Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work. 
 - Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries. 

What we're looking for: 

- Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production. 
 - A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services. 
 - Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management. 
 - Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production. 
 - A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow. 

Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar. 
 - Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization). 
 - Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. Company Description Intervalve® Poonawalla Pvt Ltd. , an integral division of the Poonawalla Group, is a specialized valve manufacturer recognized for precision design and high-quality standards. data.title: Agentic Engineering Lead (L3/L4)
data.description:
Agentic Engineering Lead (L3/L4)

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring engineering leaders who deliver enterprise modernization and AI solutions with agents as the primary workforce and people as architects, reviewers and client partners. OptiSol is a Claude partner and works with AWS and Microsoft Azure. You will lead squads (formed per client engagement) and chapters (skill communities of 10-20 engineers) working on our iBeam (agentic application and data modernization), elsAi Foundry (agent governance and orchestration) and client solutions with agents embedded in them. 

This is a full-time role in the Build & Modernize and Data & AI business units. The level is L3 (Squad Lead / Chapter Lead) or L4 (BU Lead / Engineering Manager), decided by your scope and leadership depth. 

LOCATION

Chennai, Madurai or Coimbatore (Hybrid)

EXPERIENCE

L3: 5+ years. L4: 8+ years. This is indicative only, and enterprise depth matters more than years. 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST YEAR

- Your squads deliver enterprise modernization with agents doing the bulk of the build, under clear governance and human review. 
 - Engineers on your team grow into proficient Agent Engineers and are Claude-certified. 
 - Client CIOs and architects trust you with the solution architecture, not only the delivery. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Run delivery on an agentic SDLC

- Lead your squad so that BA, Dev and QA agents do the build work while people own intent, specification, review and acceptance. 
 - Own the instructions, skills and guardrails the agents run on, and the human-in-the-loop review queue that keeps their output trustworthy. 
 - Follow and improve OptiSol's Agentic SDLC SOPs, including the iBeam SOPs for application and data modernization. 
 - Track outcomes that matter: delivery against commitments, defects and rework, and cost per outcome including token spend. Architect solutions with agents in them

- Design solutions where agents are used to build the system and where agents run inside it. 
 - Define how the agentic layer is built, deployed, monitored and governed in the client's own cloud or on-prem environment. 
 - Choose models, SDKs and cloud combinations per client constraint, and defend the trade-offs. Lead enterprise engagements

- Work with client CIOs, enterprise architects, security teams and business owners from discovery through go-live. 
 - Run architecture reviews, solution walkthroughs and proofs of concept, and support proposals and estimates that reflect agent-assisted productivity. 
 - Spot modernization and AI opportunities inside accounts and bring them to business leadership. Build the bench

- Coach developers to become proficient Agent Engineers and field-deployed engineers (FDE), and support their Claude certification. 
 - Hire, assess and grow engineers using hands-on, practical evaluations rather than self-assessment. 
 - Turn what your squad learns into reusable skills, patterns and accelerators for iBeam and elsAi Foundry. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Enterprise delivery depth: 5+ years (L3) or 8+ years (L4) of software, data or AI engineering, with delivery on enterprise projects involving legacy estates, integrations, compliance and scale, and real stakeholder engagement with client IT, business owners, security and procurement. 
 - Claude-first, hands-on: you build with Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK as your normal way of working, and can show real work such as specifications, skills, instructions, agents and evaluations you wrote. GitHub Copilot fluency is welcome. 
 - Clear thinker and communicator: you turn ambiguous business problems into precise specifications and explain trade-offs to a CIO in plain words. 
 - Deep in one area, credible across several: depth in application engineering, data engineering or AI/ML, plus enough breadth to guide teams outside your home stack. We do not screen on a checklist of technologies. 
 - Leader of people: you have led squads or teams, mentored engineers, and held a delivery commitment with a client. 
 - Cost and governance instincts: you treat token cost, security, auditability and human review as design inputs, not afterthoughts. 
 - Legacy modernization exposure (strong advantage): experience modernizing Oracle Forms, PowerBuilder, . NET, Java, or Oracle and Sybase to Postgres. TECHNICAL AREAS YOU SHOULD BE COMFORTABLE WITH

- Agents in the build: run an end-to-end agentic SDLC with specification, BA, Dev and QA agents, human review and CI/CD. Engineer context, skills and instructions, and measure agent quality with evaluations. 
 - Agents in the solution: decide where an agent belongs and where deterministic code is better. Design tools and MCP servers, workflows versus autonomous agents, and state and memory. 
 - The agentic layer: build, deploy and operate orchestration, observability, versioned instructions and skills, identity and permissions, audit trails, cost controls and human-in-the-loop gates. 
 - Agent SDKs: integrate the Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK and Microsoft agent frameworks, and choose between them. Use open protocols (MCP, agent-to-agent) so no vendor SDK becomes a lock-in. 
 - Models and clouds: combine Anthropic Claude (direct API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry), Azure OpenAI and Gemini per client estate, weighing data residency, private networking, IAM, quotas, latency and cost. 
 - On-prem and open-weight models: design for clients that need sovereign or on-prem models, benchmark open-weight models against a frontier baseline, and route work between them. 
 - Client-environment deployment: run the platform inside the client's cloud, VPC or on-prem network, with the client's repositories, ticketing and CI/CD, and with security and compliance sign-off. 
 - Model-agnostic design: keep models swappable behind a gateway so cost, capability and policy changes do not force a redesign. L3 VS L4 - HOW THE LEVEL IS DECIDED

L3 (Squad Lead / Chapter Lead): You lead one squad on an engagement or one chapter of 10-20 engineers. You run the agentic SDLC hands-on, tune agents and skills, and own squad outcomes. You design and defend the solution architecture for an engagement, act as technical lead with client architects and delivery owners, and coach developers to become proficient Agent Engineers. You contribute to pre-sales, proposals, PoCs and agent orchestration. 

L4 (BU Lead / Engineering Manager): You lead a business unit, or several squads, chapters or a client portfolio. You set the delivery model and standards across squads and own governance and cost per outcome. You set reference architectures, model and cloud strategy, and approve high-risk designs. data.title: Manager Threat Research (Integration-Detections)
data.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you will not just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve - you will help lead the change. Our global team is made up of people who thrive on solving complex problems, moving quickly, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights, and International Data Corporation MarketScape. What matters most is the work behind these recognitions: delivering real outcomes for customers through award-winning innovation such as our Aurora Platform. 

If you are looking for meaningful work, smart teammates, and the opportunity to make a real impact in a high-growth company that is redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you. 

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. 

We are looking for a Manager - Detection Engineering, XDR to lead detection development activities and help achieve our mission of End Cyber Risk. 

The Manager - Detection Engineering, XDR plans and directs all aspects of detection development activities within their team. This includes ensuring that engineering projects, initiatives, and processes are aligned with the organization's established policies and objectives. 

The Manager reports to a Senior Manager of Research and Development and works closely with Research and Development Leadership, Product Management, and Security Services (S2) to ensure the team is building what our customers and users need in a timely manner. 

This is a detection development team responsible for building generalized detections across multiple telemetry sources, including endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and email, to provide broad Extended Detection and Response (XDR) coverage for customers. Managers may also have specialized subject matter expertise within the technical areas their teams support. 

SCOPE OF ROLE

- Generate and manage the day-to-day work for the team. 
 - Work with the Product Team to define and deliver the six-month roadmap. 
 - Contribute to longer-term planning and strategy in partnership with the Director. 
 - Provide direction, clarity, and support to the team to ensure detection development activities remain focused on organizational and customer needs. 

In This Role, You Will

Team Leadership and Detection Development

- Manage teams responsible for delivering high-quality, innovative detection content spanning multiple telemetry sources. 
 - Work collaboratively with architects, developers, Product Managers, data engineers, and security analysts. 
 - Support the team by providing direction, clarity, and removing obstacles. 
 - Instill the Foundations of Research and Development within the team by living them on a daily basis. 
 - Set and maintain a high technical bar for detection quality, coverage, and false-positive rates across the team's output. 
 - Ensure teams are highly motivated, performing well, and delivering work on time. 
 - Ensure each team is clear on the objectives and goals they are striving to achieve. 
 - Work with team members to deliver key features. 
 - Build collaborative relationships with other teams and stakeholders within the organization. 

Product Roadmap and Detection Strategy

- Execute the Product roadmap. 
 - Work with the Product Team to define and deliver the six-month roadmap. 
 - Work with Architects to define and execute on the company's technical roadmap. 
 - Drive detection coverage expansion across telemetry sources, ensuring breadth and depth of XDR detection capabilities. 
 - Champion cross-telemetry detection strategies that maximize coverage while minimizing false positives across diverse customer environments. 
 - Own detection quality metrics and continuously raise the bar on precision, recall, and mean-time-to-detect. 
 - Represent the team's work to senior leadership with data-driven reporting on detection coverage, efficacy, and operational impact. 

Detection Development Lifecycle

- Oversee the full detection development lifecycle, from research and hypothesis through implementation, testing, tuning, and retirement. 
 - Establish and enforce rigorous peer review processes for all detection content before production deployment. 
 - Ensure the team delivers high-quality detection content across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and email telemetry. 
 - Ensure detection development processes and engineering initiatives remain aligned with organizational policies and objectives. 

Team Execution and Delivery

- Remove blockers preventing teams from getting their work done. 
 - Make sure each team is clear on the objectives and goals they are striving to achieve. 
 - Support the team in delivering key features and detection capabilities. 
 - Drive continuous development process improvements. 
 - Continuously improve team velocity and delivery predictability. 
 - Lead Agile development practices across the team. 

Research and Development Responsibilities

- Implement the Research and Development Department and Team Responsibilities. 
 - Ensure teams are following Information Security Management System (ISMS) regulations, including: Secure Coding Practices Acceptable Use
 - Establish and maintain processes that support technical excellence and secure detection development. 

People Development and Mentoring

- Develop the careers of team members. 
 - Mentor each team member and help them grow their technical and leadership skills. 
 - Establish career development plans and achievable goals for direct reports. 
 - Conduct regular one-on-ones. 
 - Provide career and personal development coaching. 
 - Build a culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence. 
 - Maintain a clear history of learning and skills development across the team. 
 - Regularly help detection developers develop their skills in a variety of ways. 
 - Support and mentor individuals toward senior and lead roles. 

Administrative and Financial Responsibilities

- Manage employee compensation and vacation time. 
 - Manage and approve conference and training budgets. 
 - Participate in helping set and manage the Directorate-level budget. 
 - Apply strong financial management skills to team and organizational responsibilities. 

Recruitment

- Lead recruitment efforts for the team for both full-time and co-op employees. 
 - Be a key contributor to planning, hiring, and recruitment strategy for the team. 
 - Maintain a high hiring bar by assessing candidates for both depth of security knowledge and breadth of cross-domain thinking. 

We're Looking For Someone With Experience In

- 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on detection engineering, threat detection, or security analytics at scale. 
 - 3+ years of management or team lead experience in a cybersecurity or detection engineering role, with demonstrated success building and scaling high-performing teams. 
 - Deep understanding of diverse telemetry sources, including: Endpoint and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) Network and Network Detection and Response (NDR) Cloud, including Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Cloud Workload Protection Platform (CWPP) Identity Provider (IdP) telemetry Email security
 - Hands-on experience normalizing and correlating signals across diverse telemetry sources. 
 - Proven track record of developing detection content using correlation rules, behavioral analytics, and machine learning-based approaches across heterogeneous data sources in production environments. 
 - Expert-level familiarity with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Extended Detection and Response (XDR) platforms and query languages such as Splunk Processing Language (SPL), Kusto Query Language (KQL), SQL, Sigma, or equivalent. 
 - Ability to evaluate detection efficacy through metrics-driven approaches. 
 - Strong knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and demonstrated experience applying it to detection coverage mapping, gap analysis, and prioritization. 
 - Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell, with the ability to build tooling and automation for detection development workflows. 
 - Experience leading Agile development teams, preferably with formal Agile training. 
 - Track record of continuously improving team velocity and delivery predictability. 
 - A clear history of technical influence, such as public conference talks, published research, open-source contributions, patents, or similar contributions. 
 - A clear history of learning and skills development. 
 - Experience regularly helping detection developers develop their skills and mentoring individuals into senior or lead roles. 
 - Professional security certifications are required, such as CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, GCED, GREM, or OSCP. 
 - Permanently located in Bengaluru, India. 

Nice To Have

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field. 
 - Formal Agile training. 
 - Experience with machine learning-based detection approaches. 
 - Experience building and managing generalized detection capabilities across multiple telemetry sources. 
 - Experience with cross-telemetry detection strategies and XDR coverage. 
 - Experience with detection quality metrics, including precision, recall, and mean-time-to-detect. 
 - Experience with technical research, public speaking, published research, open-source contributions, or patents. 

Do not meet all the requirements? That is okay. We still encourage you to apply. We have many opportunities and are always looking for strong talent. 

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. 

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace United States, Best Places to Work United States, Great Place to Work Canada, Great Place to Work United Kingdom, and Kununu Top Company Germany. Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10, 000 customers worldwide and more than 2, 000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains a trusted name in the industry. 

Our Values

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and value the unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. By protecting sensitive data and working to end cyber risk, we contribute to an industry that serves the greater good. 

We celebrate diverse perspectives through our Pack Unity program and encourage employees to participate in or create new alliances. 

We also believe in corporate responsibility and have joined the Pledge One Percent movement to give back to our communities. 

All Employees Receive Compelling Compensation And Benefits Packages, Including

- Equity for all employees
 - Flexible annual leave, paid holidays, and volunteer days
 - Training and career development programs
 - Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance equal to three times compensation, and personal accident insurance
 - Fertility support and paid parental leave

Arctic Wolf is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under applicable law. We are committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, and inclusive environment. 

Security Requirements

- Conduct duties in accordance with Arctic Wolf information security policies, standards, processes, and controls
 - Background checks are required for this position
 - This role may require access to information protected under United States export control laws and regulations

Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!

Who Are We?

For 115 years, L'Oréal, the world's leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world. 

For more than a century, L'Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L'Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty. 

Today, L'Oréal includes more than 2, 000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future. 

Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L'Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure. 

A Day in the Life of O+O Engineering lead!

We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Engineering Lead to join the L'Oréal Hyderabad Tech Hub. In this strategic role, you will act as the key technical bridge between our global O+O CTO organization in Paris and the delivery teams in Hyderabad, while animating the platform engineering teams across zones in ITH. 

Your core mission will be to contribute to, roll out, and drive the adoption of existing or in-progress O+O standards, platforms, and AISDLC . . . 

You will collaborate closely with global teams to ensure successful implementation, continuous improvement, and local alignment.

In this role, You will. . 

Be Responsible For The Following

As O+O ITH Engineering lead, you will lead the software execution layer of our Beauty Tech and Online & OmniSales ambition for the programs delivered in India Tech Hub. Your role will be to turn project visions into robust, secure, scalable applications & platforms that can be activated globally by our brands, markets, and partners. You will directly contribute to accelerating our insourcing strategy, strengthening our engineering excellence, and building sustainable systems capable of supporting omnichannel, personalized experiences with strong business impact. 

You will lead the implementation of the platform engineering spirit, tooling and patterns into our ITH squads, in alignment with our Global CTO technological strategy. 

In This Position Your Main Mission Will Be

- Engineering mission and leadership:

 - As well as to the continuous improvement, deployment, and local enforcement of standardized delivery processes, tools, and best practices across all O+O (Online + Offline) programs. 
 - Platform Engineering: 
 - Drive the adoption and scaling of the AI SDLC framework within ITH, integrating AI-driven tools and automation across software development phases in alignment with global guidelines. 
 - Support innovation by leveraging generative AI and machine learning capabilities provided by global platforms to accelerate delivery cycles and improve code quality. 
 - Deploy Group solutions for End-to-end observability & Smart Ops
 - Drive the roll-out, adoption, and local improvements of existing global platforms (such as the IDP - Internal Developer Portal ) for tracking and analyzing Value Creation. 

- Architecture and industrialization: 
 - Contribute to architecture choices and engineering standards to ensure performance, resilience, security, scalability, and maintainability in modern, distributed cloud environments. 
 - Be the Gatekeeper for architectural decisions & tracking in partnership with the Global CTO team
 - End-to-end delivery: 
 - Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from design to production release, accelerating the transformation of ideas, AI use cases, and product innovations into solutions deployed at scale. 
 - Monitor key engineering metrics, team velocity, and delivery efficiency using standard tooling, providing transparent insights to leadership in both Hyderabad and Paris. 

- Transformation through GenAI: Make GenAI a concrete lever for engineering productivity and quality by scaling development copilots, test automation, documentation assistance, assisted refactoring, and the continuous improvement of delivery practices. 
 - Operational excellence: Strengthen DevSecOps, SRE, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code practices to ensure fast, safe, frequent deployments and a high level of availability for critical services. 
 - Culture and talent: Build a demanding engineering culture based on clarity, ownership, simplicity, and impact, while attracting, developing, and retaining technical talent as part of an insourcing and team scale-up strategy. 
 - Cross-functional partnership: 
 - Act as a strategic partner to Product, Architecture, Data, Design, and application domain teams to turn business needs into clear, well-arbitrated technical decisions that create value for brands and markets. 
 - Ensure seamless collaboration and alignment between local delivery execution in Hyderabad and global architectural standards defined by the O+O CTO team in Paris. 
What are we looking for?

- Experience: 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or delivery management role within a matrix organization. 
 - Tech Skills
 - Proficiency in GCP and Azure environments with ability to design & implement cloud native architectures
 - Good knowledge of web development technologies & architectures (React, Vue, Node )
 - DevSecOps : ability to design end-to-end CICD pipelines : tests, build, security audit (Checkmarx ), code quality audit (SonarQube ), Infra as Code ( Terraform )
 - Vector, Hybrid and Graph RAG and their usual databases (Pinecone, Neo4j, TigerDB, GraphDB, PostgreSQL+pgvector). Re-ranking strategies, retrieval pipelines, Hybrid Symbolic & Neural systems
 - Tool calling, agent orchestration ( LangGraph / Langchain / Langsmith, MCP / MCP-UI, DSPy, A2A, A2UI)
 - Data Engineering (Delta Architectures, Lambda Architectures, Medaillon pattern, BigQuery, Databricks Lakehouse, Dagster / Airflow / Prefect)
 - MLOps (VertexAI, MLFlow)
 - Leadership style
 - Ability to navigate a matrix organization, influence and collaborate with peers (Marketing, Product, Design, Advanced Engineering)
 - Calm, clear, and demanding - in the best sense
 - Able to simplify without being simplistic
 - Respected by senior engineers and product leaders
 - Comfortable making and explaining hard trade-offs
 - Mindset
 - You believe that simple systems are hard to build, but worth it
 - You optimize for long-term leverage, not short-term heroics
 - You care deeply about craft, but even more about impact
 - Collaborative, structured, results-oriented, and adaptable. 
 - Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent English communication skills; capable of navigating a matrix organization with dual reporting lines between local management (India) and global leadership (Paris). 
What's In It for You?

- Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future-ready careers. 
 - A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup. 
 - Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive. 
 - Holistic wellbeing offerings - personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best. 
 - Reward and Recognition opportunities, long-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L'Oréal's collective success. 
 - L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment

Good to know: The Recruitment Process

- Interview with HR
 - Technical Interview
 - Interview with the hiring manager

We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That's the beauty of L'Oréal.

data.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer

Level AI is a Mountain View-based conversational intelligence company building the AI platform that powers modern contact centers. Our systems analyze millions of customer interactions to surface insights, automate quality assurance, and drive real-time agent guidance. We work at the frontier of applied speech and language AI, and our research directly shapes products used by enterprise customers every day. 

We are looking for a Principal AI Research Engineer to set the technical direction for our most ambitious AI initiatives. You will lead research on large language models, speech understanding, and retrieval systems-then translate that research into production capabilities at scale. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of cutting-edge research and real-world deployment, and who can raise the technical bar across the entire AI organization. 

What You'll Do

- Define and drive the research roadmap for core AI capabilities spanning LLMs, ASR/speech understanding, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic systems.

What You'll Bring

- Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent research experience; typically 7+ years applying ML/AI in production settings. 
 - Deep expertise in modern deep learning, with strong command of LLMs, transformers, and at least one of speech/ASR, NLP, information retrieval, or multimodal modeling. 
 - A track record of taking research from idea to deployed, scaled product-not just publications, but shipped impact. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in Python and a major deep learning framework (PyTorch preferred), with strong software engineering fundamentals.

Nice to Have

Why Level AI

 - Join a small, high-caliber team where your technical decisions shape the product and the org. 
 - Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits.

data.description:
The Role

You'll own quality end to end, from setting the benchmark to acting on customer feedback. Today about 6-7% of products are returned for quality reasons, and your job is to bring that down.  - Set the QC standard for new launches and sign products off before mass production
 - Run incoming, in-process and pre-shipment inspection, with the authority to hold or release
 - Build supplier scorecards and run regular quality reviews
 - Manage inspection agencies and testing labs, and keep certifications current (BIS, food-contact, child-safety)
 - Work with CX, Product, Design and Sourcing to turn customer feedback into fixes
 - Lead and grow the quality team

- 4-8 years in quality for physical consumer products: houseware, kitchenware, kids' products, appliances, electronics or similar
 - MBA preferred
 - A track record of reducing returns, complaints or field failures, with numbers
 - Hands-on with supplier audits, inspections, root-cause analysis and corrective actions
 - Has set QC standards or signed off new product launches
 - Business-minded and data-driven, weighing quality against cost and speed

data.title: Principal Engineer, EDG SSD Hardware
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

Key Responsibilities

SSD Hardware Architecture and Development

- Lead end-to-end SSD hardware architecture, design, validation and productization. 
 - Own schematic design, component selection, PCB stack-up, placement, routing and design reviews. 
 - Define hardware requirements covering performance, power, thermal, reliability, form factor and manufacturability. 
 - Drive high-speed interface design and validation for PCIe, NVMe, ONFI, NAND and other relevant interfaces. 
 - Lead controller, NAND, DRAM, PMIC, clock, power-delivery and peripheral device integration. 
 - Develop hardware solutions for standard form factors, including M. 2 and BGA, as well as customer-specific automotive and embedded form factors. 
 - Champion an AI-first engineering mindset across SSD hardware design, validation, debug, and product execution. 
 - Apply AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate schematic reviews, component/BOM analysis, design-rule and DFM checks, requirements analysis, technical documentation, and engineering data analysis. 
 - Develop and deploy Python-based automation and AI-assisted workflows for repetitive hardware engineering tasks, including test-data processing, log analysis, validation reporting, failure triage, and design checks. 
 - Leverage Generative AI and agentic workflows to capture engineering knowledge, lessons learned, design guidelines, failure history, and reusable debug methodologies. 

Automotive Hardware Requirements

- Exposure to ASIL standards. 
 - Translate customer and system-level automotive requirements into hardware design and validation specifications. 
 - Design for extended automotive operating temperatures, typically including −40°C to +85°C or +105°C, depending on the product and application requirements. 
 - Ensure the design meets applicable automotive reliability expectations for: Temperature cycling and thermal shock High-temperature operating life Mechanical shock and vibration Humidity and moisture resistance Board-level solder-joint reliability Power cycling and extended mission-profile operation
 - Support component qualification and product-level assessments aligned with applicable AEC-Q100, AEC-Q104 and AEC-Q200 expectations. 
 - Apply appropriate design margins and derating guidelines for voltage, current, temperature and component lifetime. 
 - Address automotive power-transient, brownout, reset, power-loss protection and startup/shutdown sequencing requirements. 
 - Evaluate system-level EMC and ESD risks and support compliance testing against applicable automotive customer and regional requirements. 
 - Support requirements related to long product lifecycles, component traceability, controlled BOMs, PCN management and obsolescence planning. 

Functional Safety and System Robustness

- Collaborate with systems, firmware and functional-safety teams to support product development aligned with ISO 26262. 
 - Contribute to hardware safety analysis, including: Hardware Failure Mode and Effects Analysis FMEDA inputs Diagnostic coverage assessment Single-point and latent-fault evaluation Safety mechanism definition and validation
 - Familiarity with Automotive SPICE development and traceability expectations is preferred. 

SI/PI, Thermal and Mechanical Engineering

- Own signal-integrity and power-integrity analysis for high-speed interfaces, NAND channels, clocks and critical power rails. 
 - Correlate pre-layout and post-layout simulations with laboratory measurements. 
 - Optimize PCB stack-up, impedance control, return paths, via structures, power distribution and decoupling. 
 - Partner with mechanical and thermal teams to evaluate heat spreading, thermal-interface materials, airflow, enclosure constraints and junction-temperature margins. 

AI & Engineering Automation

- Demonstrated exposure to AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows, with a strong mindset toward adopting AI to improve engineering productivity and quality. 
 - Ability to leverage tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude/Claude Code, or equivalent AI platforms for engineering analysis, documentation, scripting, automation, and technical problem-solving. 
 - Identify and implement opportunities to apply AI and automation across the hardware development lifecycle, including design reviews, PCB/DFM checks, validation, data analysis, debug, and reporting.

data.title: Associate Technical Lead, DevSecOps
data.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and. . . To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale-faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. 

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA's product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. ▪ Experience with container and API security platforms (Aqua, Prisma Cloud, Sysdig, Snyk). 

▪ Experience with SIEM platforms (Splunk, Sentinel, Chronicle) and security orchestration (SOAR).

Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years

data.title: AI Engineer- Team Lead
data.description:
Description

What We're Looking For

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to join our AI engineering team in Hyderabad. The team is new and built around strong early-career engineers - what it needs now is senior craft alongside them. 

Our goal is to automate expert work for two audiences. Internally, we build AI systems that let teams across the company produce more and better work in less time. Externally, we build custom AI solutions for enterprise customers - bespoke enrichment pipelines, data feeds, and automated workflows shaped around a specific customer's problem. The internal tools we build usually become the foundation of what we sell. 

AI engineers and software engineers build and jointly own our solutions. You will work alongside them from problem framing and prototyping through production and iteration, and help set the engineering bar for a team that is still forming it. 

What You'll Do

Build and ship AI systems

- Design, build, and operate LLM-powered agents and multi-step workflows - tool use, planning, state and memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and sensible recovery when a step fails. 
 - Build forward-engineering agents: systems that take an ambiguous customer or business input and produce working technical output - queries, configurations, enrichment logic, briefs - that internal teams and customers then rely on. 
 - Take solutions into production and keep them healthy - deploy, monitor, and optimize for reliability and cost together. 

Get the quality right

- Do prompt engineering properly: task decomposition, context design, structured outputs, tools and schemas, and the right model for each step. We treat prompts as engineering artifacts - versioned and reviewed like code. 
 - Build evaluation into the work - golden datasets, regression suites, and the metrics that matter for each workflow: accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rate, latency, and cost per unit of work. 
 - Know when an LLM is not the answer, and when retrieval, a classical model, or plain deterministic code is better. 

Lift the team

- Mentor early-career engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussion. Most of the team is within a year of graduating and learns fast when it is taught well. 
 - Help set the standards the team works to - testing, prompt and evaluation conventions, observability, and what "done" means for an AI feature. 
 - Work with product managers, platform engineers, and the teams who use what we build, across several time zones - translating fuzzy requirements into a technical approach with the trade-offs stated plainly. 

What You'll Bring

- 4-9 years in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or a related technical role, including hands-on experience taking AI-powered applications into production. 
 - A system you have built and operated where an LLM did real work - and a clear sense of how you knew it was working, what broke, and what you changed. 
 - Strong Python and solid software engineering fundamentals, with a good understanding of API design and integration patterns. 
 - Practical experience with agent and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP-based tooling, or equivalent) and with frontier model APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable). 
 - Working knowledge of RAG, vector and keyword search (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or equivalent) for grounding models in proprietary data. 
 - A solid grounding in traditional ML alongside the generative side - classification, clustering, embeddings, feature engineering, and standard evaluation methodology - and the judgment to pick a classical model when it is faster, cheaper, and more predictable than a prompt. 
 - Experience with at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), containers, and CI/CD. 
 - Some experience mentoring or technically guiding less-experienced engineers. 
 - Clear communication and comfort with ambiguity - a working prototype that proves the idea, then the engineering to make it durable. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or an equivalent degree. 

Nice to Have

- Large-scale LLM enrichment or classification pipelines, where cost and quality per document both matter. 
 - A background in NLP, information retrieval, or media and text analytics. 
 - Transformers, fine-tuning, PyTorch or TensorFlow; or computer vision and speech-to-text in production. 

Why This Role

The team is new, the problem space is genuinely unsolved, and the work goes straight into the hands of people who depend on it daily. You will shape how a team builds AI systems rather than maintain someone else's decisions. 

You do not need every item on this list. If you are strong across most of it and curious about the rest, we would like to hear from you. 

What We Offer: 

- Enjoy flexible paid time off options for enhanced work-life balance. 
 - Comprehensive health insurance tailored for you. 
 - Employee assistance programs cover mental health, legal, financial, wellness, and behaviour areas to ensure your overall well-being. 
 - Complimentary Calm App subscription for you and your loved ones, because mental wellness matters. 
 - Energetic work environment with a hybrid work style, providing the balance you need. 
 - Benefit from our family leave program, which grows with your tenure at Meltwater. 
 - Thrive within our inclusive community and seize ongoing professional development opportunities to elevate your career

Where You'll Work: Hyderabad

When You'll Join: As per the Offer Letter. 

Our Story

At Meltwater, we believe that when you have the right people in the right environment, great things happen. 

Our best-in-class technology empowers our 27, 000 customers around the world to make better business decisions through data. But we can't do that without our global team of developers, innovators, problem-solvers, and high-performers who embrace challenges and find new solutions for our customers. 

Our award-winning global culture drives everything we do and creates an environment where our employees can make an impact, learn every day, feel a sense of belonging, and celebrate each other's successes along the way. We are innovators at the core who see the potential in people, ideas and technologies. Together, we challenge ourselves to go big, be bold, and build best-in-class solutions for our customers. We're proud of our diverse team of 2, 200+ employees in 50 locations across 25 countries around the world. No matter where you are, you'll work with people who care about your success and get the support you need to unlock new heights in your career. 

We are Meltwater. We love working here, and we think you will too. 

"Inspired by innovation, powered by people. "

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Meltwater is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: At Meltwater, we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity and strive to provide a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment. data.description:
About The Company

Who are we?

Myntra is India's leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we've always believed in disrupting the ordinary. 

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We're bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit. 

Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in. 

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us. 

From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us. 

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities. 

At Myntra, we are building a next-generation AI-native platform that fundamentally changes how software is developed, maintained, and optimized. Our team operates at the intersection of distributed systems, developer tooling, and applied machine learning. We are creating an ecosystem of autonomous coding and operational agents capable of seamlessly integrating into engineering workflows from writing code to triaging live production incidents. 

The Role

We are seeking a highly hands-on Technical Lead to architect our core agentic infrastructure. In this role, you will go beyond basic API wrappers to build the deep foundational systems that make autonomous agents reliable at scale. You will own the agent evaluation harness, design complex context-assembly pipelines, and build out the Skill Library that safely steers LLMs toward accurate, deterministic outcomes. 

You should be a systems-thinker who deeply understands how Large Language Models operate under the hood, and who has a proven track record of bringing specialized agents to production. You will lead by example, writing foundational code while guiding a team of top-tier engineers. 

What You Will Do

- Design the Agent Harness & Infrastructure: Architect and optimize the execution and evaluation harnesses for our agents. You will build the robust sandboxing, tracing, and benchmarking systems required to test agent reliability, latency, and tool-use accuracy before they hit production. 
 - Architect Dynamic Context Systems: Design the data pipelines and retrieval architectures that build rich, real-time context for our agents. This includes integrating codebase structures (ASTs, dependency graphs), operational telemetry, and historical logs into manageable context windows. 
 - Build Production-Grade Agents: Design and implement intelligent agents capable of understanding codebases, generating code, self-debugging, and executing complex software engineering tasks. 
 - Develop & Steer Agent "Skills": Design the centralized "Skill Library" a suite of modular, strictly typed tools and APIs. You will implement the guardrails and steering mechanisms that force LLMs to use these skills predictably, minimizing hallucinations and infinite loops. 
 - LLM Optimization & Deep Tuning: Deeply analyze LLM behavior to optimize multi-agent orchestration. You will utilize advanced prompting, fine-tuning, state management, and cognitive architectures (e. g. , ReAct, Plan-and-Solve) to improve agent reasoning. 
 - Model Integration & Optimization: Integrate various foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models like Llama 3). Optimize for latency, context window management, and cost-efficiency using advanced prompting, RAG, and fine-tuning techniques. 
 - Technical Leadership: Drive technical decision-making, establish engineering best practices, and mentor a high-performing team of software and AI engineers. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Education & Experience: 6 to 8 years of software engineering experience, with at least 1-2 years leading complex, high-impact technical projects or teams. 
 - Programming Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Python (and preferably Go, C++, or Java), with a strong track record of writing scalable, production-grade systems. 
 - Systems Design: Strong background in distributed systems, microservices, and building secure, scalable backend architectures. 
 - Agentic & AI-Native Knowledge: 
 - Deep understanding of agentic architectures (ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, LLM Compiler, etc. ). 
 - Strong grasp of LLM primitives: prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases (e. g. , Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant), and semantic search. 
 - Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-backed applications, specifically utilizing agentic workflows, function calling/tool use, and stateful multi-agent systems. 
 - Problem Solving: A strong hacker mentality with a rigorous engineering mindset capable of bridging the gap between experimental AI research and reliable production software. 
Preferred Qualifications (What Will Make You Stand Out)

- Specialized Agent Deployment: You have successfully built and deployed operational agents in a previous role (e. g. , On-Call Agents for PagerDuty/Datadog integration, Performance Analysis Agents, or autonomous Code-Gen/Debugging agents). 
 - Deep Harness Expertise: You have built custom LLM evaluation frameworks or have deep experience with tools like LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, or prompt-tracking harnesses to measure and improve agent drift. 
 - Context Engineering: Advanced knowledge of context-window optimization, Knowledge Graphs, vector databases, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applied to highly technical data (codebases, logs, metrics). 
 - Steering & Guardrails: Experience developing constrained execution environments and programmatic guardrails that safely steer non-deterministic models into predictable software workflows. 

Why Join Us?

- Impact: You will be establishing the architectural foundation for an entire platform of autonomous workers. 
 - Engineering Culture: We value deep technical rigor, fast execution, and a "show, don't tell" hacker mentality. 

Required Skills

artificial intelligence, architecture, deployment

Job Title

Senior Solution Architect - Service Platform

Job Description

ServiceNow Solutions Architect

Enterprise ServiceNow architecture, platform governance, custom application development, integration, CMDB/CSDM maturity, and transformation delivery

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions across the enterprise. The architect will translate business requirements into practical platform architectures, guide delivery teams, establish governance standards, and ensure the platform supports automation, service quality, security, and measurable business value. 

This role is suitable for a senior ServiceNow professional who is both architecture-oriented and hands-on: comfortable leading workshops, designing integrations, reviewing scripts and custom applications, advising stakeholders, and mentoring developers and administrators. 

Role Scope

- Primary modules and domains: ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, App Engine, Service Portal, Service Catalog, SPM, EAM, FSM, and custom application development. 
 - Core architecture themes: Platform roadmap, governance, scalable workflows, automation frameworks, integrations, data quality, CMDB/CSDM maturity, security, compliance, performance, and upgrade-safe solution design. 
 - Delivery environment: Enterprise Service Management, Agile/Scrum delivery, DevOps practices, cross-functional implementation teams, and global enterprise stakeholder groups. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture and Solution Design

- Design end-to-end ServiceNow solutions based on business requirements, enterprise architecture principles, and platform best practices. 
 - Create solution designs, technical specifications, integration points, data mapping documentation, architecture decisions, and implementation guidance. 
 - Define scalable platform architectures, workflows, automation frameworks, security models, and governance standards aligned to business objectives. 
 - Ensure solutions are secure, performant, maintainable, upgrade-safe, and compliant with internal standards and industry practices. 

Requirements, Workshops, and Stakeholder Advisory

- Lead technical workshops and requirements-gathering sessions with business and IT stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate with product owners, process owners, business analysts, project managers, developers, administrators, and enterprise architects. 
 - Translate business needs into user stories, technical designs, platform patterns, data requirements, and implementation plans. 
 - Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership and client stakeholders. 

Platform Governance, Roadmap, and Best Practices

- Develop and maintain ServiceNow architectural standards, roadmaps, governance practices, coding standards, and design review processes. 
 - Stay current with ServiceNow releases, platform capabilities, AI-enabled features, and new modules; recommend adoption where there is clear value. 
 - Drive platform optimization, technical debt reduction, customization rationalization, performance improvement, and upgrade readiness. 
 - Identify architectural risks early and recommend mitigation plans across delivery, data, integration, licensing, and supportability dimensions. 

Custom Application Development and Automation

- Design and oversee custom applications, scoped apps, workflows, catalog items, portals, forms, automation, and enhancements within ServiceNow. 
 - Provide hands-on guidance for JavaScript, Glide APIs, GlideScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Actions, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and App Engine patterns. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to custom applications, workflows, integrations, security, and platform behavior. 
 - Guide teams on when to configure, extend, integrate, or avoid customization to preserve long-term platform health. 

Integration, Data, and Migration

- Design integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, eBonding, MID Server, middleware, import sets, transform maps, and event-driven patterns. 
 - Define data migration, synchronization, mapping, validation, error handling, monitoring, and reconciliation approaches. 
 - Ensure integration designs preserve data integrity, security, reliability, observability, and performance. 
 - Work with automation and scripting technologies such as JavaScript, Python, and PowerShell where relevant to integration or migration delivery. 

CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, and Operations

- Define and mature CMDB and Common Service Data Model strategy, including CI classes, service models, ownership, lifecycle governance, and relationship quality. 
 - Support Discovery, Service Mapping, ITOM, Service Graph, and related operational data initiatives across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. 
 - Improve CMDB health, data quality, reconciliation, service visibility, and operational decision-making. 
 - Partner with operations teams to align platform architecture with incident, problem, change, request, asset, and service management processes. 

Project Delivery and Team Leadership

- Successfully deliver ServiceNow projects in a lead architecture or technical leadership role. 
 - Collaborate with project managers, Agile delivery managers, Scrum Masters, and team members to manage timelines, dependencies, risks, and priorities. 
 - Handle multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously and adapt to changing business priorities. 
 - Provide mentorship, code/design review, technical direction, and knowledge transfer to ServiceNow developers and administrators. 

Quality, Testing, and Documentation

- Define testing strategies covering unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, performance validation, user acceptance, and release readiness. 
 - Use or guide ServiceNow Automated Test Framework where appropriate to improve release confidence and regression coverage. 
 - Maintain clear architectural documentation, design specifications, integration contracts, decision logs, runbooks, and platform standards. 
 - Support post-implementation validation, defect resolution, continuous improvement, and operational handover. 

Required Experience And Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience may be considered. 
 - ServiceNow experience: Minimum 5+ years of ServiceNow platform experience with at least 2-3 years in an architect, lead consultant, or technical lead role; for senior enterprise roles, 10+ years of ServiceNow architecture/consulting experience is preferred. 
 - Overall IT experience: 10+ years is strongly preferred; 15+ years is ideal for global enterprise transformation or principal architect roles. 
 - Implementation depth: Demonstrable hands-on experience in ServiceNow implementations, custom application development, integrations, and enterprise module rollouts. 
 - Architecture track record: Proven experience designing and implementing ServiceNow modules, custom applications, workflows, integrations, data models, and platform governance. 
 - Problem solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for complex business requirements, custom applications, integration issues, and platform performance concerns. 
 - Delivery discipline: Solid project management, prioritization, risk management, and multitasking skills across multiple projects or workstreams. 
 - Communication: Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, leadership, mentoring, and interpersonal skills.

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.

Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company's main facilities, generally at the customers' or suppliers' locations.

About Tradl AI

Tradl AI is building India's first AI broker, with our own foundation model for quant-reasoned trading decisions in natural language. 

93% of retail traders in India lose money - emotion, poor timing, no systematic risk management. Most "AI trading tools" are thin wrappers that hallucinate on numbers. We're building the opposite: a foundation model for real-time quant analysis, paired with integrated broking on our own license, cash and F&O. 

Live today: AI screening chatbot, strategy builder (Sensibull × AI), option chain analytics (IV skew, GEX, gamma), live pattern detection, position risk copilot, and in-house charts with our edge model. 

Next: AI backtesting, Scalper Max, and broking. 

We've closed a seed round from marquee investors, and the founding team brings deep markets experience - systematic investments at Goldman Sachs, business leadership at a major credit platform, crypto, and investment banking. We're squarely in the 0-to-1 journey, keeping the team small and the bar high. 

What We're Looking For

- 5-8 years building production software, with a track record of owning systems end to end - from ambiguous problem statement to running in production. 
 - Strong architecture and system design. You've made real tradeoffs at scale and lived with the consequences. 
 - Distributed systems experience: service decomposition, event-driven architecture, message queues, caching, failure modes. 
 - Deep in at least one of Go, Python, C++, or Rust, and comfortable moving between them. 
 - Production cloud experience - AWS preferred, containers and orchestration included. 
 - Engineering judgment. You reach for the simple solution first and you know when correctness beats cleverness. 

Bonus Points

- You've been early at a 0-to-1 startup. You know what it costs and you want to do it again. 
 - 1+ year managing or mentoring engineers. 
 - You've shipped AI/LLM-powered products to real users - and dealt with the evaluation, latency, and cost problems that come after the demo. 
 - Analytics or data platform experience - pipelines, warehousing, large-scale query workloads. 
 - Fintech, trading, or real-time market data experience. 

Why Join

You'll own the hardest and most differentiated part of the product, on a small team where your architectural decisions stick. Direct line to the founders, real scope, and problems nobody in the Indian market has solved yet.

To manage the Noodle or Chocolate Manufacturing lines of the factory with regard to Electrical & Automation Maintenance and ensuring No unplanned downtime. Propose and implement work processes, procedures and technical resources relating to the electrical & automation team. 

Lead and coordinate the electrical & automation team and maintain competencies, motivation and performance to achieve the teams mission and objectives.

data.title: Charting/WebGL Engineer
data.description:
About TRADL AI

TRADL AI is building India's first AI trading co-pilot for 100M+ traders. 

Today, we convert natural language into verified, code-backed stock intelligence - no hallucinations, no black boxes. Tomorrow, we're building the full stack: real-time chart intelligence, autonomous research agents, and portfolio-aware execution. We're turning what institutional desks spend millions on into a conversation anyone can have. We're live, growing fast, and the hardest technical problems are still ahead of us. 

We're live, growing fast, and the hardest technical problems are still ahead of us. 

We are building the engineering team that will scale this from hundreds to hundreds of thousands of concurrent traders. 

Why This Role Exists

We're building our charting engine from zero. Native WebGL2. Sub-millisecond candle rendering at any timeframe. 100+ indicators computed on the fly. 50+ drawing tools. Multi-chart layouts. And an AI canvas layer that lets our models overlay pattern detection, support/resistance, anomaly flags, and annotations directly on the same surface as the price data. This role owns that engine. 

What You'll Own

- AI-Charts Engine: Native charting system built ground-up in WebGL2 (or SciChart. js if the tradeoffs line up). 
 - Indicator Library: 100+ technical indicators computed in real time. Optimized math running in Web Workers so the main thread never blocks. 
 - Drawing Tools: 50+ drawing primitives - trend lines, Fibonacci, Elliott Wave, annotations, zones. 
 - AI Canvas Overlay: pattern detection, automated S/R, volume anomalies, earnings overlays. Build the rendering system that lets them paint on the chart in real time, without stalling the price feed. 
 - Performance: Sub-100ms rendering at production scale. GPU-accelerated. No dropped frames during market hours

What We're Looking For

- 4-8 years in frontend or graphics engineering, with production-scale WebGL/WebGL2 or Canvas2D experience. 
 - 3+ years at a startup - you've shipped under pressure and owned outcomes. 
 - High-performance JavaScript and TypeScript fluency. 
 - Web Workers - you know how to offload computation without the coordination overhead eating your gains. 
 - Working knowledge of financial chart types - candlestick, Heikin-Ashi, Renko and the data structures behind them (OHLCV, tick data, time-series aggregation). 

Bonus Points

- Rust + WASM compilation for compute-heavy paths
 - SciChart. js or direct experience with commercial charting SDKs
 - SVG overlay systems composited over Canvas/WebGL
 - GPU-accelerated rendering, shader programming
 - Experience with TradingView, Highcharts Stock, or similar platforms at scale
 - You've either built a custom charting system before or reverse-engineered one and believed you could do it better.

FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200, 000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. 

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations.

We are looking for a talented and motivated Software Engineer to join our Buyside Services Engineering team. In this role, you will serve as an individual contributor responsible for building, enhancing, and maintaining a suite of industry-leading products that power FactSet's Portfolio Services and Managed Services business. 

You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product Development, Analytics Engineers, and Team Leads to deliver high-quality, performant, and scalable software solutions that drive transparency, data integrity, and operational efficiency for our clients. 

The Buyside Services Engineering team drives the evolution of workflow and process monitoring tools that are critical to FactSet's managed and co-sourced operating model offerings.

- End-to-end transparency from client data integration to processed data consumption

Through continuous innovation and dedicated expertise, we empower clients to focus on their core competencies while we ensure the integrity, timeliness, and quality of their analytical operations. 

What You'll Do

- Design and develop new features and enhancements

 - Collaborate with Product Development to understand business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions

- Experience with service-oriented architecture and microservices design.

What's In It For You

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

data.title: Software Development Engineer
data.description:
About Tradl AI

Tradl AI is building India's first AI broker, with our own foundation model for quant-reasoned trading decisions in natural language. 

93% of retail traders in India lose money - emotion, poor timing, no systematic risk management. Most "AI trading tools" are thin wrappers that hallucinate on numbers. We're building the opposite: a foundation model for real-time quant analysis, paired with integrated broking on our own license, cash and F&O. 

Live today: AI screening chatbot, strategy builder (Sensibull × AI), option chain analytics (IV skew, GEX, gamma), live pattern detection, position risk copilot, and in-house charts with our edge model. 

Next: AI backtesting, Scalper Max, and broking. 

We've closed a seed round from marquee investors, and the founding team brings deep markets experience - systematic investments at Goldman Sachs, business leadership at a major credit platform, crypto, and investment banking. We're squarely in the 0-to-1 journey, keeping the team small and the bar high. 

What We're Looking For

- 3-5 years building production software, with a track record of shipping features end to end and owning them after they ship. 
 - Solid system design fundamentals. You can break a problem down, weigh the tradeoffs, and defend the choice you made. 
 - Distributed systems experience: services, APIs, event-driven architecture, message queues, caching, failure modes. 
 - Deep in at least one of Go, Python, C++, or Rust, and comfortable moving between them. 
 - Production cloud experience - AWS preferred, containers and orchestration included. 
 - Engineering judgment. You reach for the simple solution first and you know when correctness beats cleverness. 

Bonus Points

- You've been early at a 0-to-1 startup. You know what it costs and you want to do it again. 
 - You've shipped AI/LLM-powered products to real users - and dealt with the evaluation, latency, and cost problems that come after the demo. 
 - Analytics or data platform experience - pipelines, warehousing, large-scale query workloads. 
 - Fintech, trading, or real-time market data experience. 

Why Join

Real ownership on a small team, code in front of real traders within weeks, and problems nobody in the Indian market has solved yet. Direct line to the founders and room to grow fast.

data.title: Head of Quality Assurance
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Head of Quality Assurance (QA) to play a

crucial "player-coach" role within our Global Delivery function. You will architect the end-to-end

quality governance and test strategy across all client engagements while actively setting up

cutting-edge AI evaluation frameworks and driving hands-on quality gates. This role transitions

our quality ownership from an informal project-level setup into a dedicated, full-time leadership

function. In this role, you will eliminate defect leakage into UAT or production, safeguard project

margins, champion our AI/LLM testing narrative during high-stakes client pitches, and mentor a

high-performing team of QA professionals. 

Key Responsibilities

Defining Strategy & Governance

● Define, institutionalize, and own the end-to-end QA strategy, testing standards, defect

management workflows, and quality gates across all active delivery engagements to

ensure enterprise-grade consistency. 

● Establish standardized metrics for defect density, test coverage, automation ROI, and

release stability across parallel delivery streams. 

Architecting AI Evaluation Frameworks

● Act as the primary authority and hands-on implementor for setting up our AI evaluation

framework-including curated test datasets, accuracy benchmarks, guardrail/safety

testing, and automated regression suites for AI agents. 

● Implement protocols for prompt evaluation, vector database validation, model drift

monitoring, and safety benchmarking for LLM-driven applications. 

Test Automation & Release Sign-Off

● Drive test automation strategies integrated directly into modern CI/CD release pipelines

(Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab). 

● Serve as the final authority on release readiness, conducting formal quality sign-offs prior

to UAT handover and production go-live. 

Risk Mitigation & Margin Protection

● Actively dive into quality data to identify risk factors, preventing defect leakage into

production, eliminating costly rework, and protecting project margins. 

● Manage defect triage processes, root-cause analyses (RCA), and preventative action

tracking across delivery teams. 

Client Engagement & Pre-Sales Support

● Partner with Pre-Sales and Architecture teams to articulate our QA and AI safety

strategies in client RFPs, pitches, and technical workshops. 

● Serve as the primary quality Subject Matter Expert (SME) during client steering

committees and executive governance reviews. 

Audit & Compliance Governance

● Collaborate closely with Corporate Quality to maintain alignment with enterprise

governance bodies, ISO/CMMI compliance standards, and regulatory audits. 

● Drive continuous quality improvement initiatives across all project teams. 

Leadership & Mentoring

● Mentor and guide QA engineers and test leads by leading by example, fostering a culture

of continuous process improvement, automation excellence, and AI-first quality practices. 

● Manage QA effort estimation, capacity allocation, and resource planning for new project

onboarding and pre-sales proposals. 

Qualifications & Candidate Profile

Must-Have

● 8-10+ years of experience in Quality Assurance and Software Testing, with at least 4-5

years of dedicated team leadership or engineering management experience. 

● Mandatory hands-on expertise in AI/MLOps and AI testing, including experience with

prompt evaluation, vector database validation, guardrail/safety testing, and LLM

application benchmarking. 

● Deep, practical knowledge of modern test automation frameworks (e. g. , Selenium, 

Playwright, Cypress, REST Assured) and integration with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub

Actions, GitLab). 

● Proven track record in establishing quality gate governance, risk-based test planning, 

defect metrics tracking, and executing formal release sign-offs. 

● Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex

quality data into actionable business strategies for leadership and client stakeholders. 

Strongly Preferred

● BFSI Domain Expertise: Deep domain exposure in Banking, Financial Services, 

Insurance, or Lending enterprise platforms. 

● Pre-Sales & RFP Leadership: Direct experience collaborating with pre-sales teams, 

contributing to complex RFP responses, and pitching quality strategies to prospective

clients.

LNT/L-TD/1894367

Knowledge & Posting Location

Electronic Circuit Design Electronic Instrumentation Test Development Test Automation Software Configuration Management DFT Communication Protocols Firmware Test Coverage Measurement and Meterology MES Test Data Management Team Building
