Bachelor of Engineering (BE)

Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities : 

- Test Strategy & Development - Define and implement test strategies for PCBA and electronic products covering In-Circuit Test (ICT), Functional Circuit Test (FCT), and Flying Probe Test based on product complexity, test coverage, volume, and customer requirements. 
 - ICT Program Development - Develop, debug, validate, and optimize ICT programs for component presence, value, polarity, shorts, opens, analog parameters, and manufacturing defects using platforms such as Keysight, Teradyne, SPEA, or equivalent. 
 - Functional Test Development - Design and develop FCT solutions to verify PCB functionality, electrical performance, interfaces, communication protocols, firmware, and product-specific operating parameters. 
 - Flying Probe Test Development - Develop and optimize Flying Probe Test programs for prototypes, NPI builds, low-volume production, and PCBAs where dedicated ICT fixtures are not economical or practical. 
 - Test Fixture & Hardware Design - Lead fixture design, bed-of-nails development, interface hardware, test adapters, wiring, switching circuits, and mechanical integration to ensure repeatability, maintainability, and safe operation. 
 - Test Coverage & Quality Improvement - Establish test coverage requirements, identify undetected defect risks, optimize fault detection, and improve test effectiveness using defect data, boundary-scan methods, and design-for-test (DFT) reviews. 
 - NPI & New Product Introduction - Lead test readiness during NPI, including DFT reviews, testability assessment, prototype debugging, engineering validation, test correlation, and production release approval. 
 - Test Debugging & Failure Analysis - Analyze ICT, FCT, and Flying Probe failures; distinguish genuine PCB defects from false failures; perform root-cause analysis with Design, Process, Production, and Quality teams. 
 - Test Equipment Qualification & Validation - Ensure equipment calibration, GR&R where applicable, repeatability and reproducibility, measurement-system validation, golden-board verification, and preventive maintenance. 
 - Test Cycle-Time Optimization - Reduce test cycle time, improve throughput, minimize false failures and retesting, and align test capacity with production requirements and takt time. 
 - Test Software & Automation - Develop or oversee test sequences, scripts, drivers, communication interfaces, automated data acquisition, and test result logging using suitable programming tools and test platforms. 
 - Firmware & Communication Testing - Integrate firmware programming and validation, including UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, USB, and other product-specific interfaces where applicable. 
 - Test Data & Traceability - Implement unique PCBA serial-number traceability, automatic test-result capture, failure-code mapping, and integration with MES, ERP, and production databases.

About Officeworks: 

Officeworks' purpose is "we bring big ideas to life at low prices". It's how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders. 

We are Australia's leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create, and Geeks2U.

Title: Senior AI Engineer

Function: Technology

Location: Bengaluru

About the Technology Function: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- Exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - Supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems
 - Being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitise the Officeworks business
 - Joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production. 

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Orchestration and Execution: 

- Decompose Product Orchestrator specifications into functional tasks for technical agents. 
 - Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, test generation, documentation and design workflows. 
 - Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity. 
 - Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle. 

Quality Control and Commit Gate: 

- Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change. 
 - Perform fast, accurate code and test reviews to ensure correctness, specification alignment and standards conformance. 
 - Owns end-to-end quality assurance accountability by designing agent test coverage and evaluation logic. 
 - Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks. 
 - Identify when agent workflows are insufficient and apply direct engineering intervention to resolve technical issues. 

System Design and Non-Functional Excellence: 

- Own architectural fit and system design judgement across the features delivered by the pod. 
 - Ensure non-functional outcomes, including performance, scalability, resilience and security, are met across all releases. 
 - Lead production incident resolution within the pod across touched platform domains. 
 - Contribute to domain design decisions as a consulted partner to the Solution Architects. 

Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to serve as context layers for future agent runs. 
 - Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers. 
 - Continuously refine and optimize agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods. 
 - Mentor engineers on test design, defect triage and quality engineering practice across the pod. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Leadership and Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility and execute workstreams. 
 - Architecture Teams: Consult with Domain Architects and Solution Architects on domain design, system architecture and escalation pathways. 
 - Capability and Platform Specialists: Collaborate with Context Engineers, Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and Associate Platform Engineers to align on shared context, security standards and tooling. 
 - Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities. 

What success looks like: 

- Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes. 
 - Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams. 
 - Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact. 
 - Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor: 

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. 

We begin with customer: 

- We start with our customer' needs in every decision. 
 - We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions. 
 - We listen, learn and continuously improve. 

We do the right thing: 

- We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet.

data.description:
About Officeworks: 

Officeworks' purpose is "we bring big ideas to life at low prices". We are Australia's leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create and Geeks2U. We begin with customers-our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia, from households, students, small to large-sized businesses, governments, and schools. 

About the Data and AI Hub: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- Exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - Supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems
 - Being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitise the Officeworks business joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Associate AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms and supports by orchestrating AI agents to produce code, tests, and documentation, ensuring features across Officeworks' digital properties are built and maintained efficiently. The role is a full stack engineering role and bridges feature development and quality assurance by directing agent workflows and conducting critical reviews before code is committed to production. 

In addition to feature development, the role contributes to the ongoing operation, maintenance, and support of Customer Platforms systems in production. This includes monitoring system performance and health, identifying and resolving production issues, supporting incident and defect resolution, and implementing fixes and enhancements to ensure the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of digital platforms

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Workstream Orchestration: 

- Run single or paired agent workstreams across coding, test generation, and documentation workflows. 
 - Translate technical and product specifications into precise, structured instructions for AI agents to execute. 
 - Apply platform context, base coding standards, and security policies to every agent execution. 
 - Monitor parallel agent tasks and confirm that generated outputs satisfy specified functional requirements. 

Code Review and Quality Assurance: 

- Perform rigorous reviews of agent-generated code, automated tests, and technical documentation. 
 - Design and execute test cases across unit, integration, and end-to-end scenarios, extending beyond AI-generated coverage where gaps exist. 
 - Evaluate generated code for functional correctness, security vulnerabilities, performance, and architectural fit. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects to resolution, escalating severity and blockers to Senior AI Engineers where required. 

Documentation and Shared Context Management: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to ensure context repositories effectively feed subsequent agent runs. 
 - Identify and resolve missing, outdated, or ambiguous context in shared repositories that negatively affects agent accuracy. 
 - Log technical decisions and specification updates to maintain end-to-end trace abilities for system workflows. 

Operational Support and Issue Resolution: 

- Support the investigation and resolution of production issues across the platform domains managed by the pod. 
 - Participate in on-call support rotations as required to maintain platform reliability and system availability. 
 - Support release verification and post-deployment checks to confirm features perform as tested before hypercare handover. 
 - Track runtime anomalies or recurring defects and feed learnings back into context documentation and agent guidance. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to translate specifications into executable agent workflows and deliver features in continuous flow. 
 - Platform and Architecture Specialists: Work with Context Engineers, Solution Architects, and Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers to align work with base contexts, security policies, and review frameworks. 
 - Operations and Enablement Teams: Collaborate with Platform Engineers, Associate AI Agent Operations Engineers, and the AI Enablement Manager to leverage shared tools, continuous integration pipelines, and observability platforms. 
 - Vendor and External Partners: Engage with external vendor support and technology partners as directed to resolve tooling issues or platform integration requirements. 

What success looks like: 

- Delivery Velocity and Quality: High review pass rate on submitted code and test artefacts, with minimal defects escaping to production environments. 
 - Capability Progression: Demonstrated growth in independent review judgement, prompt engineering literacy, and agent orchestration. 
 - Artefact Currency: High accuracy and completeness of shared context repositories and technical documentation contributed to the pod. 
 - Operational Resilience: Timely response to and resolution of domain incidents, maintaining reliable and secure platform performance. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor: 

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 3+ years of software engineering experience, with exposure to full-stack delivery, cloud-based systems, and hands-on software testing or quality assurance. 
 - Tooling Literacy: Practical experience utilizing AI-assisted coding and agent tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex) to build and test software. 
 - Full Stack Capability: Foundational knowledge across front-end, back-end, and integration technologies (e. g. , JavaScript/TypeScript, Node. js, React, REST APIs). 
 - Quality Engineering: Hands-on experience designing and executing test cases (unit, integration and end-to-end) and documenting defects to resolution, not just familiarity with testing principles. 
 - Software Quality: Understanding of software testing principles, including automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing practices. 
 - Specification and Logic: Ability to interpret functional specifications, construct precise logic instructions, and review generated code for correctness. 
 - Collaboration and Process: Familiarity with modern continuous integration and delivery pipelines (CI/CD), Git version control, and continuous flow delivery models. 
 - Practical experience in software testing, quality assurance or test automation. 
 - Understanding of functional, integration and regression testing, with awareness of performance, resilience and security considerations. 
 - Ability to create and execute automated tests for assigned features and integrations, identify defects and support release verification. 
 - Exposure to Playwright, Postman, BrowserStack or equivalent tools. 

Preferred: 

- Retail and Commerce Exposure: Familiarity with modern omnichannel commerce platforms or digital retail environments. 
 - Observability Frameworks: Exposure to cloud logging and observability tooling such as Sumo Logic or Datadog. 
 - Cloud Technologies: Basic exposure to Amazon Web Services (AWS) or serverless cloud architecture patterns.

data.title: Network Switch Platform Test Engineer (PoE & Automation)
data.description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. 

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today's complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. 

Job Description

What You'll Do: 

- Validate networking switch platforms through functional, regression, interoperability, and reliability testing. 
 - Design and execute PoE tests covering IEEE 802. 3af/at/bt behavior, power negotiation, classification, allocation, power budgets, multi-port stress, and overload scenarios. 
 - Test copper and fiber interfaces across product-supported speeds-from multi-rate and 100 Mb/s through 1G, 10G, 25G, 40G, 100G and, where applicable, higher rates up to 800G. Validate link bring-up and recovery, auto-negotiation, FEC, channelization, MTU, VLAN, and LACP. 
 - Measure throughput, latency, packet loss, and interface error behavior. 
 - Validate platform and chassis behavior, including hardware bring-up, packet path, LEDs, route-engine behavior, boot/BIOS, and memory subsystems, as applicable. 
 - Translate market, hardware, and software requirements into test plans and Python automation for new features, typically within a few days. 
 - Maintain feature test automation and integrate suites into CI/CD pipelines where applicable. 
 - Analyze failures using logs, packet captures, counters, and platform diagnostics; work with development teams to identify root causes. 
 - Collaborate across hardware, firmware, and software teams to define coverage for new features and releases. 
 - Prepare test reports, defect summaries, and release quality metrics. 
 - Explore practical AI-assisted workflows that improve engineering efficiency and test delivery. 

What You'll Bring

Required qualifications and skills

- Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related field. 
 - Hands-on experience testing networking products, platforms, switches, interfaces, PoE, or closely related networking systems. Relevant platform testing on adjacent networking products, such as routing or security platforms, is also applicable. 
 - Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and how networks operate. 
 - Hands-on Python test automation, including the ability to translate feature specifications into repeatable tests and adapt scripts as requirements change. This role focuses on feature test automation; deep ownership of a standalone tooling platform is not required. 
 - Demonstrated technical depth in at least one relevant area, such as PoE, interfaces/optics, or platform/chassis validation. The complementary area can be learned on the job; experience in both is an advantage. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux, shell scripting, and Git. 
 - Strong debugging and communication skills in hardware/software integrated environments. 
 - Willingness to work in a hybrid, lab-dependent environment and attend the office more than two days in a week when business or testing needs require it. 

Good to have

- Experience across both PoE and interface/optics validation, including PoE standards, certification workflows, and power measurement setups. 
 - Knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 features such as VLAN, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP, QoS, IGMP, and routing basics. EVPN/EVPN-VXLAN familiarity is useful. 
 - Familiarity with pytest or unittest, API/CLI automation, log parsing, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Experience with traffic generators such as IXIA, Spirent, TRex, or equivalent tools. 
 - Experience with SNMP, NETCONF/RESTCONF, gNMI, or telemetry validation. 
 - Experience with campus topologies, interoperability testing, and enterprise endpoints such as IP phones, wireless access points, and other PoE devices. 
 - Practical use of AI-assisted engineering workflows. 

How Success Is Measured

- High, repeatable automation coverage for PoE, interfaces, and platform regression. 
 - Reduced manual test-cycle time and stronger release confidence. 
 - Earlier detection and clear diagnosis of platform and interoperability defects. 
 - Stable test infrastructure that supports frequent product releases.

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing. 

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have - whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division. 

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

data.description:
QA Engineer - Data, DevOps & AI

Location: Bengaluru, India

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

Experience: 3-7 years

Business Area: AI & Data Engineering

Team: Corporate Data Cloud Data Products

Employment Type: Full-time

About The Role

We are seeking a QA Engineer with strong data-testing and automation capabilities to join the Corporate Data Cloud team. You will assure the quality and reliability of cloud-based data and AI solutions through data validation, test automation, CI/CD integration, and foundational testing of Generative AI and Agentic AI applications. 

The role requires close collaboration with Data Engineering, Platform, DevOps, Product, and Business teams to embed quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute test scenarios and test cases based on business and functional requirements. 
 - Validate end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformations, integrations, and business rules. 
 - Perform data quality, reconciliation, regression, integration, and large-volume data testing. 
 - Develop and maintain automated test frameworks using Python, PyTest, Cucumber, or equivalent tools. 
 - Use advanced SQL and Snowflake to validate data and perform root-cause analysis. 
 - Integrate automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Support Git-based development practices, deployment validation, configuration checks, log analysis, and release verification.

data.title: QA Tester
data.description:
The Opportunity

Implements operational goals related to software build, release, deployment, and configuration management, ensuring smooth and stable application implementation. Contributes to the development and refinement of new processes, standards, and operational plans that support efficient software delivery. Manages smaller applications implementation projects and processes, coordinating release schedules, automation improvements, and integration efforts. Works on recurring but varied deployment challenges, requiring the analysis of multiple factors, including system dependencies, infrastructure constraints, and quality assurance measures. Communicates regularly with cross-functional teams, including QA, IT operations, and product teams, ensuring alignment and seamless software delivery. May interact with external partners, vendors, or customers to support implementation efforts and troubleshoot deployment-related issues. 

Position Summary

Functional testers at Avantor validate the systems our customers and partners use to do business with us. That means B2B ordering and account flows, e-commerce transactions, and the web services that tie them together. 

The work is hands-on. Read the requirement, work out what could go wrong, write the tests, run them, and raise what you find with enough detail that a developer can act on it without coming back to ask. 

Most testing here spans more than one system. An order placed on the web front end touches pricing, inventory, customer account data, and downstream fulfilment. Testers who can follow a transaction across those boundaries, rather than checking one screen at a time, do well in this role. 

Key Responsibilities

Test design and execution

- Read requirements and user stories, then write test cases that cover the normal path, the edge cases, and the ways the feature can fail. 
 - Run functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing against web and B2B applications. 
 - Build and maintain test data that reflects real customer and account scenarios. 
 - Test on different browsers and devices where the application calls for it. 
 - Verify fixes and confirm that nothing else broke on the way. 

API and web services testing

- Test REST and SOAP services directly using tools such as Postman or SoapUI. 
 - Check request and response payloads, status codes, error handling, and data types against the contract. 
 - Validate authentication, authorisation, and session behaviour on service calls. 
 - Trace data through service layers to work out whether a defect sits in the front end, the service, or the data behind it. 
 - Write and run SQL queries to confirm what the application actually stored. 

Defects and communication

- Raise defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual behaviour, environment detail, and evidence attached. 
 - Work with developers through triage, retest, and closure. 
 - Report test progress, coverage, and open risk to the QA Manager. 
 - Join sprint ceremonies and raise testability concerns while a story is still being shaped. 
 - Estimate testing effort and flag risk to release dates early. 
 - Identify candidates for automation and work with the automation team to hand them over. 
 - Represent QA in requirement and design discussions with business stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

QA Functional Tester

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years in functional software testing. 
 - Hands-on experience testing web applications, including B2B or e-commerce systems. 
 - Working experience testing REST or SOAP services with Postman, SoapUI, or similar. 
 - Able to write SQL queries to verify data. 
 - Experience with a test management tool such as Jira, ALM, or TestRail. 
 - Writes defects that a developer can act on without a follow-up conversation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise B2B commerce platforms, for example IMCM or comparable customer-facing order and account systems. 
 - SAP exposure, particularly order-to-cash or customer master data. 
 - Familiarity with test automation, enough to read a script and know what it covers even without writing one. 
 - Experience in a regulated industry such as life sciences. 
 - Performance or accessibility testing background. 
 - ISTQB certification or equivalent. 

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

The work we do changes people's lives for the better. It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor. 

We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world. Apply today!

data.title: BPO Quality Analyst for Travel Process
data.description:
Role Description : Quality Analyst - Travel Process (BPO)

The Quality Analyst will play a critical role in driving service excellence within a high-volume BPO environment by monitoring, evaluating, and improving customer interactions across Voice, Chat, Email, and Back-office channels. This full-time, on-site role is based in Noida and focuses on ensuring adherence to client requirements, compliance standards, process guidelines, and customer experience expectations. 

The incumbent will conduct quality audits, evaluate agent performance against defined KPIs, identify behavioral and process gaps, and deliver actionable feedback to Customer Experience (CX) associates. The role requires close collaboration with Operations, Training, Team Leaders, and Client Stakeholders to improve agent effectiveness, customer satisfaction (CSAT), quality scores, and operational performance. 

Key responsibilities include preparing and presenting quality reports, calibrating with internal and client teams, conducting root cause analysis, supporting process improvement initiatives, tracking quality trends, reducing repeat errors, and driving continuous improvement through coaching and data-driven insights. The Quality Analyst will also ensure alignment with Startek's customer-centric and empathy-driven service framework while contributing to overall business and client objectives. 

Requirements : 

- Minimum 2-4 years of experience in BPO Quality Analyst (QA), preferably in the Travel, Customer Service, Hospitality, or Airline domain. 
 - Strong understanding of BPO quality frameworks, audit methodologies, quality scorecards, and performance management processes. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of the 7 Quality Control (QC) Tools and their application in process improvement and defect analysis. 
 - Experience in conducting transaction monitoring, quality audits, RCA (Root Cause Analysis), calibrations, and feedback/coaching sessions. 
 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and engage frontline teams. 
 - Proficiency in MS Excel, reporting dashboards, and quality analytics. 
 - Familiarity with travel industry processes, reservations, ticketing, booking platforms, GDS tools (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo), and customer service best practices will be an added advantage. 
 - Working knowledge of KPI metrics such as CSAT, NPS, FCR, AHT, Compliance, Accuracy, and Quality Scores. 
 - Ability to work in rotational shifts and a dynamic client-driven environment. 
 - Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Certifications in Six Sigma, COPC, Lean, Quality Management, or Process Excellence will be preferred. Compensation : 

CTC: Up to ₹50, 000 per month, plus additional company benefits as per policy.

data.title: Sr. SW Engineer - SDET - Automation, GenAI tooling, API Testing
data.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. 

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale - tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. 

Join Visa and do work that matters - to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. 

Job Description

Visa Cloud Platform team is responsible for building frameworks and systems to automate infrastructure provisioning and application deployment tools that Visa developers will use to deploy and run their code. Our mission is to make the process seamless for developers to get their code to customers. We are testing and automating the platform and make it easy to deploy, supervise, scale and debug applications. 

You will play a critical role in designing and implementing test solutions across all testing phases. You will design and implement automation frameworks from scratch, develop AI‐assisted test solutions, and integrate them deeply with CI-CD pipelines. This role requires strong ownership of design and implementation while applying standard engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. 

Responsibilities - What You'll Do

- Own the design and implementation of AI tooling, AI agents, and MCP server components to support QA activities such as intelligent test generation, failure analysis, and defect insights. 
 - Design, build, and maintain automation frameworks from scratch for UI and API testing
 - Hands‐on automation using Selenium, Playwright, Robot Framework, and API automation using RestAssured
 - Integrate automation frameworks and AI tooling into CI-CD pipelines to enable fast, reliable quality feedback
 - Write clean, well‐structured, and maintainable code using Java and-or Python
 - Participate in unit testing, code reviews, and continuous integration
 - Apply engineering best practices, coding standards, and security considerations in all deliverables
 - Collaborate with development, DevOps, and SRE teams to embed quality‐by‐design practices
 - Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager. 

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. 

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications: 

- 3+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree

Preferred Qualifications

- 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e. g. M. E/M. Tech etc. , )
 - 3-7 years' experience in software engineering, with a strong emphasis on test automation or test platform development. 
 - Experience developing AI or GenAI‐based solutions, AI agents, or internal engineering platforms
 - Hands on experience in test design and execution based on business scenarios. 
 - Strong communication with ability to collaborate with global teams. 
 - Strong experience building automation frameworks from scratch
 - Hands‐on expertise with Selenium, Playwright, Robot Framework, and RestAssured
 - Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, version control, and DevOps practices
 - Familiarity with cloud‐native and microservices‐based systems
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

data.title: Software Engineer - Infotainment Testing with Python Automation
data.description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive

We're a global, multi-disciplinary team that's putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career. 

- Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
 - Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
 - Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Infotainment Test Engineer with strong Python programming skills to join our Automotive Software Engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for validating next-generation automotive infotainment systems, designing automated test frameworks, executing functional and integration testing, and ensuring high-quality software delivery for automotive products. 

What You Will Do

- Design, develop, and execute test cases for automotive infotainment systems. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation frameworks using Python. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Validate multimedia, connectivity, navigation, HMI, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Android Auto, and Apple CarPlay features. 
 - Analyze software requirements and create comprehensive test plans and test strategies. 
 - Debug issues, perform root cause analysis, and work closely with development teams for resolution. 
 - Execute test campaigns on actual hardware platforms and simulators. 
 - Track, report, and manage defects using defect management tools. 
 - Participate in Agile development processes, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Generate test reports, quality metrics, and release sign-off documentation. 

What You Need To Be Successful

- 3 to 6 years of experience in Automotive Infotainment Testing. 
 - Strong programming and scripting experience in Python. 
 - Good understanding of test automation frameworks and test methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience in validating infotainment features such as Media, Connectivity, Navigation, Bluetooth, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, Voice, and HMI. 
 - Experience with automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or Ethernet. 
 - Knowledge of Linux and Android-based infotainment platforms. 
 - Experience using test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, ALM, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

Bonus Points If You Have

- Experience with Robot Framework, PyTest, or other Python-based automation frameworks. 
 - Exposure to Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) processes. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation integration. 
 - Experience with CANoe, CANalyzer, or Vector tools. 
 - Understanding of embedded systems and automotive software architecture. 
 - Exposure to cloud-connected vehicle services and OTA testing. 
 - Knowledge of ISO 26262 and automotive cybersecurity concepts. 

What Makes You Eligible

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or related field. 
 - 3 to 6 years of relevant experience in Automotive Infotainment Testing. 
 - Proven experience in Python-based test automation. 
 - Strong understanding of automotive software quality processes and testing lifecycle. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and global engineering environment. 

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package
 - Opportunities for professional growth and development
 - Collaborative and dynamic work environment
 - Access to cutting-edge technologies and tools
 - Recognition and rewards for outstanding performance through BeBrilliant
 - Work from Office environment with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite Five days a week. 

You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you - all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want. 

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology

Ever since the 1920s, we've been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected. 

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today's most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world's ever-evolving needs and demands. We are continuously searching for exceptional QA Automation Engineers across India to help us deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable software solutions. While we may not have an immediate opening today, this dedicated QA Talent Community helps us engage with top testing professionals early.

Skip the Line

Upload your CV along with a short note about: 

- Your QA and automation experience.

data.description:
The Opportunity

Hitachi Energy is a pioneering technology leader that is helping to increase access to affordable, reliable, sustainable, and modern energy for all. We help to power your home, keep the factories running, and our hospitals and schools open. Come as you are and prepare to get better as you learn from others. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and plug into a team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. 

Our Indian Operations Centre (INOPC) is a competence center with around 3000+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, functional system testing, installation supervision, and commissioning. Over the last decade, INOPC has evolved to become the largest engineering hub serving more than 40+ countries across different energy sectors. 

This position caters to Grid Automation commissioning team overseeing the installation and commissioning of Bay level secondary equipment's. Manage completion of all commissioning activities efficiently and cost-effectively and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Review and verify engineering design documents and prepare project-specific engineering deliverables. 
 - Analyze customer specifications to develop reliable and optimized SCADA and Substation Automation solutions. 
 - Ensure designs meet customer requirements while optimizing cost, quality, and technical performance in line with engineering standards. 
 - Utilize proven engineering practices and standard solutions to improve efficiency and reduce engineering effort. 
 - Deliver engineering documentation on time while maintaining compliance with quality standards and project schedules. 
 - Participate in customer, consultant, and design review meetings to resolve technical issues and clarify requirements. 
 - Provide technical support to project management teams for customer clarifications, change requests, and technical discussions. 
 - Support manufacturing and production teams by resolving engineering-related issues and minimizing production delays. 
 - Act as a technical interface with customers, effectively presenting and explaining automation and control system solutions. 
 - Ensure customer requirements are translated into practical, compliant, and cost-effective engineering designs. 
 - Contribute to successful execution of multiple projects while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction, quality, and schedule adherence. 
 - Maintain effective communication and collaboration with internal stakeholders, customers, and project teams. 
 - Demonstrate the ability to work independently while contributing effectively in a team environment. 

Your Background

- Bachelor's degree/Diploma in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Approximately 3-8 years of experience in SCADA, Substation Automation, System Architecture Design, and Engineering of medium to large utility projects ranging from 66 kV to 765 kV. 
 - Strong knowledge of Substation Automation Systems (SAS) and conventional control systems. 
 - In-depth understanding of automation systems for transmission and distribution substations. 
 - Knowledge of Hitachi Energy products and solutions, along with awareness of competitor products and technologies. 
 - Working with knowledge of automation system architectures and communication networks. 
 - Experience with engineering and design tools such as: AutoCAD, E3 Series, MicroStation, MS Visio
 - Knowledge of substation communication protocols and SCADA integration concepts. 
 - Experience in engineering design reviews, customer interactions, and technical discussions. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and resolve technical challenges. 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. 
 - Strong customer focus with commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement. 
 - Flexible, proactive, and capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously.

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride. 

You assist in planning, developing and execution of capital projects, technical development, feasibility perspectives of engineering-related activities in the supply chain and capital-expense project execution to support growth, world-class manufacturing and productivity with the highest level of quality, safety and environmental requirements. You help ensure sure that Mondelēz business and innovation processes in project management and Mondelēz standards in execution are followed. 

How You Will Contribute

The role supports capital project execution, and you will be accountable for the quality of the results and execution of capital projects using Mondelēz standards, and business and innovation processes in project management. You will help define and deliver the capital and technical agenda during the development phase of capital investments with stakeholders so that accurate budgets, plans and fit-for-purpose technical solutions are provided and develop the capital budget according to the contract and forecast cash flow. You will also help ensure that applicable engineering developments and standards are properly implemented, and support the development and implementation of state-of-the-art processes and equipment strategies to optimize resources, harmonize assets and rollout best practices. 

What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in: 

- Engineering or operations
 - Working effectively and under pressure to meet deadlines
 - Analysis
 - Project management

More About This Role

Lead the electrical and automation engineering project a the site, ensuring reliable, safe, and efficient execution of all electrical systems and automation system for new capacity expansion. 

What you need to know about this position: 

Experience

5-6 years of progressive experience in electrical and automation engineering within a manufacturing environment (FMCG/food & beverage preferred). 

PLC / SCADA

Strong knowledge of PLC programming (Rockwell / Siemens), SCADA/HMI design, industrial networking (Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCPIP), and instrumentation. Shall have sound knowledge of batch processes and Pack-ML Standards. 

Electrical

Solid understanding of power distribution, motor control, and electrical protection systems. MCC panels and Drives. 

Instrumentation

Good knowledge of instruments, selection, and Calibration processes, including legal meteorology. 

Digital and Cybersecurity

Digital mindset, familiar with Digital applications for factory operations. 

OT infrastructure - Networks, Network management, Server, Virtual Environment, Cybersecurity tools and Secure Remote access tools. 

Process and Equipment Safety. 

Hands-on knowledge of Process Safety and Equipment Safety Standards (SIL and PL). To design and validate the safety of the equipment and processes. 

Leadership

Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams in a fast-paced operational setting. 

Project Mgmt

Experience managing capital projects (>$500K electrical/automation scope). 

Communication

Ability to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders; strong written and verbal English. 

Education / Certifications: 

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 

Job specific requirements: 

Electrical Systems

- Own the design, BOQ preparation, installation, commissioning, all electrical systems across for new capacity expansion & Plant projects. 
 - Ensure compliance with local electrical codes, MDLZ engineering standards, and relevant safety regulations (e. g. , NFPA 70E, IEC, local statutory requirements). 

Automation for plant projects

- Design and implementation of automation and control systems, including PLCs (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, etc. ), SCADA/HMI, VFDs, servo drives, instrumentation, and industrial networks for new capacity expansion. 
 - Support in plant digital manufacturing roadmaps. 

Project Delivery

- Lead electrical and automation scope for capital projects - from concept and design through FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning, and handover. 
 - Manage external contractors, system integrators, and OEMs to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to specification. 
 - Prepare and manage project budgets, schedules, and risk registers for the E&A scope. 

People Leadership

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of electrical and automation technicians/engineers. 
 - Build technical capability through structured training, mentoring, and skills-gap assessments. 
 - Foster a culture of safety, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team. 
 - Coordinate with Site Automation team, SSAL and the Electrical Maintenance team for project shutdown and integration planning. 

Safety & Compliance

- Champion electrical safety practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), arc-flash risk assessments, and safe work permits. 
 - Ensure all electrical and automation work complies with MDLZ Global Engineering Standards, local regulations, and insurance requirements. 
 - Maintain up-to-date electrical single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and automation documentation.

data.title: Founding Engineering Lead, Autonomous Drone Docks
data.description:
The Filia builds autonomous docks that let drones live on industrial and defence sites: launching, landing with centimetre precision, recharging and logging every flight, with no crew on site. Our docks are built for India first: 48 °C summers, dust, monsoon, cold and high-altitude sites, and any approved Indian drone rather than one brand. 

The design is complete and validated in simulation, our first engineers are building the prototype in Delhi, and we're working with drone makers, energy and defence partners on first deployments. We're now looking for the person who will lead engineering with us. 

What you'll own

You'll be the technical lead across the whole dock and part of the founding team. Day to day that means: 

- System architecture: owning how the dock works as one system, the interfaces between subsystems, and the trade-offs between them
 - Drone integration: precision landing, the dock-to-drone link, and flight testing across different drone makers
 - Batteries and charging: charging strategy across drone battery types, battery safety and health, and the dock's own reserve power
 - Thermal and cooling: keeping batteries and electronics in their safe window from 48 °C desert heat to sub-zero, high-altitude sites
 - Mechanical and enclosure: the structure, the roof mechanism, sealing against dust and monsoon, and design for manufacture
 - Power electronics, controls and firmware: bringing the dock's electronics and software together into something that works in the field
 - Testing and qualification: taking the dock from prototype through environmental testing to first live sites
 - Team: leading and reviewing the work of our mechanical, thermal and power engineers, and hiring the team as we grow

You might be right for this if

- You've built something real that moves, flies or runs on its own, and can show it: a product, a research platform, a competition drone or vehicle
 - You understand systems end to end, from batteries and power to mechanics, thermal and software, and you're deep in at least one of them
 - You've worked hands-on with flight or robotics systems (ArduPilot, PX4, ROS, embedded control)
 - You like owning outcomes end to end, and you start things before you're asked
 - You've led a team, formally or not, through something hard: a student team, a lab project, a product launch
 - You want to build infrastructure India needs, and you're energised by the pace of a small founding team

Background matters less than proof. Strong candidates often come from IIT, DTU, NSUT, IIIT, BITS or similar programmes, from student drone, robotics and Formula Student teams, or from drone, robotics and EV companies, but what we look at first is what you've built. 

What we offer

- A founding role with meaningful equity and a competitive salary
 - Real ownership of a product with deployments lined up
 - A small, fast team based in Delhi, working with India's drone ecosystem

To apply

Apply with your resume or LinkedIn profile, and make sure it links to something you've built (GitHub, video, paper or write-up). We'll follow up with shortlisted candidates.

data.title: Head – Energy & Power
data.description:
Job Description

As Head - Energy & Power, you will provide strategic, technical, and operational leadership for the Energy & Power business and build a high-performing engineering capability that supports complex power and energy projects/programmes. 

The role will be accountable for building engineering capability, delivering technical excellence, aligning with the lead region's business needs, supporting GCC and business growth, and ensuring high-quality delivery across Energy (oil & gas, LNG, midstream, thermal) and Power Generation (hydro, renewables, nuclear), Transmission & Distribution, substations, HV/EHV systems, HVDC, grid infrastructure, renewable energy integration, and associated power engineering disciplines. 

This is a high growth build-from-the-ground-up opportunity. You will lead a young, engineering and deliver hands-on while establishing credibility with the lead region, and grow it into a full-scale engineering practice. You will work closely with technical leaders, regional Leaders, and multidisciplinary teams to build a scalable Energy & Power capability and position the organisation as a trusted engineering partner. This role reports directly to Head - GCC Canada. 

Responsibilities

- Provide leadership for the Energy & Power engineering practice, establishing clear priorities for growth, capability development, quality, and delivery, in alignment with the lead region. 
 - Provide leadership and strategic oversight for the delivery of complex Energy & Power projects and programmes across the full lifecycle, from feasibility and concept through detailed engineering and execution. This covers both Energy (gas compression and processing, midstream infrastructure, gathering systems, LNG, and thermal generation) and Power (generation, transmission & distribution, substations, and grid infrastructure). Ensure the right leadership, engineering capability, and governance are in place at mobilisation, with clear accountability for technical excellence, quality, risk, commercial performance, and client outcomes. 
 - Lead and develop engineering, process, and CAD capabilities across Energy (oil & gas, LNG, biomass/biofuels, alternate fuels) and Power (nuclear, hydro, and renewables generation; transmission & distribution, substations, HV/EHV systems, HVDC, cable systems, power systems, and grid integration). 
 - Establish and maintain strong technical governance, engineering assurance, quality assurance, and technical risk-management practices, ensuring solutions are fit for purpose, meet applicable client, contractual, statutory, regulatory, and technical requirements, and that significant engineering risks are identified, escalated, and appropriately addressed. 
 - Build a strong technical team and leadership structure by developing SMEs, discipline leads, and emerging technical leaders. Drive workforce planning, mentoring, succession planning, career development, and technical communities of practice, building sustainable engineering capacity aligned with business demand. 
 - Champion technical excellence, innovation, and standardisation, promoting effective adoption of engineering tools, digital solutions, automation, and industry best practices. 
 - Drive collaboration across onshore, offshore, regional, global, and multidisciplinary teams, enabling effective knowledge sharing, skills deployment, and integrated project delivery. 
 - Develop and maintain senior relationships with regional leaders across Power Generation, Power Delivery, Energy & Process, and Nuclear, acting as a trusted partner. 
 - Provide technical leadership for work-winning and major bids, including support for solution development, resource strategies, technical proposals, bid reviews, and client presentations in collaboration with lead region. 
 - Partner with regional business-development and senior leadership teams to identify growth opportunities, new services, and emerging markets within Energy & Power. 
 - Ensure engineering activities appropriately apply relevant international, regional, and national codes and standards (e. g. , IEC, IEEE, CSA, NBC, NERC), CIGRE guidance, and utility/client specifications. 
 - Represent the organisation at relevant industry forums, conferences, and professional bodies, strengthening external technical profile and market credibility. 
 - Foster a culture centred on safety, quality, collaboration, inclusion, innovation, and technical excellence. 

Qualifications

- Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Power, or Chemical/Process Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Professional registration (e. g. , Chartered Engineer/PE) is a plus, along with eligibility to pursue P. Eng. 
 - 15+ years of experience in the Energy and Power sectors (including Transmission & Distribution), with 5+ years of leadership experience. 
 - Strong technical, commercial, and strategic understanding of the Energy sector, including oil & gas, LNG, biomass, biofuels, thermal generation, and emerging low-carbon solutions, with insight into project lifecycles, regulatory environment, market drivers, and client priorities. 
 - Strong understanding of multiple Power-sector disciplines, ideally including transmission & distribution, substations, HV/EHV systems, HVDC, cable systems, power systems, grid and renewables integration, and nuclear and hydro generation. 
 - Working knowledge of relevant tools and software, such as AutoCAD, SP3D, BIM, and power-systems software like ETAP or PSS®E. 
 - Proven "builder" mindset, with experience setting up and scaling engineering teams from an early stage. This includes defining structure, processes, quality standards, and ways of working, and recruitment, talent development, succession planning, and developing technical leaders, within a consultancy, utility, EPC, or engineering environment. 
 - Hands-on, player-coach leadership style: willing to contribute directly to project delivery and technical reviews and lead by example, while building trust and credibility with the lead region and coaching and upskilling early-career engineers and CAD teams into higher-value engineering work. 
 - Proven experience providing technical governance, engineering assurance, and technical risk oversight for complex infrastructure programmes. 
 - Strong working knowledge of relevant international, regional, and national codes and standards (e. g. , IEC, IEEE, CSA, NBC, NERC), CIGRE guidance, and utility/client engineering requirements. 
 - Experience working with geographically distributed or global engineering/delivery teams. 
 - Strong commercial awareness, with experience supporting bids, proposals, work-winning, and strategic client development, and the ability to engage and influence senior clients, project directors, business leaders, utilities, developers, and asset owners. 
 - Strong leadership presence, with the ability to balance people, technical, delivery, client, and commercial priorities. 

BGV: 

- Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification ("BGV") check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India. 
 - Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process - including documents uploaded - is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner". 

About Us

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

With approximately 4, 000 talented people across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than 73, 000 globally, in 550 offices across 40 countries, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

At "WSP" we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise. 

www. wsp. com

We are

- Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future. 
 - A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking. 
 - A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues. 

Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose. 

Working with Us

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. 

Our Hybrid Working Module

With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model. 

- Maximize collaboration. 
 - Maintain product quality and cultural integrity. 
 - Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency. 

Health, Safety and Wellbeing

Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our "Making Health and Safety Personal" initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years. 

Inclusivity and Diversity

WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background. 

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. 

Join our close-knit community of over 73, 300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far. 

With us, you can. 

Apply today. 

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES: 

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation - no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

data.title: Electrical Technical Lead Engineer
data.description:
The group you'll be a part of

There is an opening for the role of Electrical Engineering Technical Lead Engineer. This position is based out of Bangalore, directly reporting to the leader of WETS (Wet Equipment Technology Solutions) Electrical Engineering team of LIGHT. This individual shall collaborate with engineers in India, Europe and United States and on new product development of WETS product lines. 

Eligibility Criteria

- 
 - 
 - Bachelors in Electrical/Electronics Engineering with a minimum 8 exp. or Masters in Electrical Engineering with a minimum 6 Yrs Exp. 
Primary Responsibilities

- 
 - Develop Functional Requirement Specifications for various Electro-Mechanical systems. 
 - Selection of Electrical & Electronics OEM components and materials for Power distribution, I/O Controllers, Sensors, Cables, PCBs etc. 
 - Create and Release system level Electrical engineering drawings & bill of materials using Engineering Change Management process. 
 - Work on Electrical/Electronic engineering CAD tools for circuit design & simulations. 
 - Perform various circuit analyses like De-rating & Stress analysis, Power analysis & Logic compatibility analysis etc. 
 - Define project schedule, work breakdown structure and milestones to drive concept to production lifecycle. 
 - Study and recommend corrective/ permanent solutions for technical challenges/new products. 
 - Define test procedures, and participate in assembly, build and test verification
 - Well versed with Part life cycle management, Obsolescence management activities. 
 - Conduct and drive Design reviews to get buy-in from all cross functional teams. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers. 
Mandatory Skills

- 
 - Proficient in system level understanding of Electro-Mechanical Sub-systems (Semi-conductor/Automotive/Aerospace), Control systems and/or Industrial Automation. 
 - Proficient in Electrical/Electronic Circuit concept design & development with safety interlocks & various circuit analyses. (Circuit analyses include De-rating & Stress analysis, Power analysis & Logic compatibility analysis etc. )

Job Title

Manager, Software Development

What does a great "Technical Engineering Manager" do?

A great Technical Engineering Manager provides technical and people leadership for teams building scalable, secure, and reliable backend services for modern banking platforms. This role translates business objectives into technical strategy, leads architecture and delivery across distributed systems, and establishes strong engineering practices. 

The Technical Engineering Manager works closely with product, architecture, DevOps, SRE, and engineering teams to deliver Java-based microservices and event-driven solutions. The role also focuses on developing engineering talent through coaching, mentoring, structured technical reviews, and capability-building initiatives. 

What You Will Do

- Lead and manage a team of backend engineers responsible for designing, developing, and supporting critical banking platform services. 
 - Provide technical direction for Java, Spring Boot, and Quarkus-based microservices. 
 - Translate business requirements and product objectives into scalable technical architecture and delivery plans. 
 - Drive architecture and design decisions across distributed backend systems. 
 - Define event-driven architecture patterns using Kafka, including idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, backpressure, and error handling. 
 - Own integration strategies across REST and gRPC interfaces for internal and external systems. 
 - Guide database design, data modelling, performance optimisation, and migration strategies for PostgreSQL-compatible databases. 
 - Establish engineering standards for coding, testing, observability, security, documentation, and production readiness.

 - Mentor engineering leads and individual contributors through regular coaching and technical development plans. 
 - Support workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance development, and succession planning for the engineering team. 
 - Promote reusable engineering patterns and automation to improve delivery speed, consistency, and quality. 
 - Collaborate with product, business, architecture, security, and operations stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.

What You Will Need To Have

- Minimum 14 years of experience in software engineering, including significant experience in technical leadership and engineering team management.

 - Proven experience designing and delivering distributed, scalable, and production-grade backend systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, domain-driven design, API design, and system integration. 
 - Hands-on expertise in Kafka and resilient event-driven architecture patterns. 
 - Strong experience designing and integrating REST APIs. 
 - Deep understanding of SQL, relational database design, performance tuning, and schema migration.

 - Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift. 
 - Experience establishing CI/CD, automated testing, observability, secure coding, and production-readiness standards.

What Would Be Great To Have
