data.title: Manager Account Analytics
data.description:
Overview

About Business Unit: 

Powerful predictors of the future - our Analytics team seamlessly blends data science and business intelligence to provide unparalleled foresight for our platform offerings. They turn insights into actionable results for our clients by collaborating with senior team members and staying ahead of market trends, powered by our data assets. By using new-age analytic tools and emerging technologies, the team cultivates a dynamic learning environment for curious minds to thrive. 

How You'll Make An Impact

The Manager, Account Analytics Development is a hands-on technical leader. You will personally design and build the most technically demanding parts of our AI capability, and you will hire and develop the engineer who works alongside you. This is a small, senior team - today a VP and a Lead. You will be the third member, and the first person you hire will report to you. 

We already run AI agents in production that generate analyst-grade SQL against our analytics environment. That foundation works. What comes next is harder, and it is the reason this role exists. 

What You'll Build

Interpretation. Systems that take the output of an analysis and produce business-relevant interpretation - what the numbers mean for this client, in this category, given what we know about their objectives. This is the distance between a query result and an insight, and closing it requires reasoning, not summarization. 

Client knowledge. A knowledge system that accumulates and organizes what the organization understands about each client: their business, their category, their measurement history, and Epsilon's relationship with them. It has to serve both people and agents, and it has to compound with use rather than decay into a stale wiki. 

Media investment planning. Analytical tooling that supports budget allocation and media investment planning - putting scenario and optimization capability directly in the hands of client teams. 

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 

Responsibilities

Architecture and Systems Design

- Own the architecture of our AI capability: how agents are scoped, how they compose, and where the boundaries sit between tools, context, and model reasoning. 
 - Design evaluation before you design the solution. Define how we will know an agent is correct, how we detect regression in a non-deterministic system, and where human review belongs in the loop. 
 - Establish the engineering standards - source control, testing, documentation, deployment - that let a three-person team ship reliably today and a larger team ship reliably later. 

Hands-On Delivery

- Write production code. 
 - Prototype quickly to resolve technical uncertainty, then make the explicit call about what graduates into a supported system and what gets discarded. 
 - Take personal ownership of the components carrying the highest technical risk rather than delegating them. 

Team Leadership

- Hire, onboard, and develop your first direct report at senior engineer level. 
 - Set technical direction and raise the quality bar through design review and code review. 
 - Absorb technical scope currently carried by the VP and become a person the wider analytics organization brings its hardest problems to. 
 - Promote engineering discipline, documentation, code quality, and knowledge sharing across the team. 

Business Partnership

- Work directly with analytics leads and client teams, most of whom are US-based, to find where automation and AI create real leverage - and where they do not. 
 - Translate loosely specified business problems into system designs, and explain those designs credibly to non-technical partners. 
 - Balance experimentation against the reality that these tools enter client-facing workflows and have to keep working. 
 - Your work will be evaluated by the level of usage and adoption by the rest of the Analytics team and the ability of the tools you and the team develop to drive greater efficiency and insights

Qualifications

- 8+ years building software or data products, including leading technical design on complex, ambiguous projects. 
 - Strong Python and advanced SQL. You are comfortable both in a substantial codebase and in an analytical data warehouse. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and shipping LLM-based systems in production - agents, tool use, orchestration, structured outputs - not prototypes or prompt experimentation alone. 
 - Systems thinking. You can take an ambiguous capability such as "interpret this analysis" and decompose it into components, interfaces, and failure modes, then explain why you drew the boundaries where you did. 
 - A considered point of view on evaluating non-deterministic systems, and practical experience applying it. 
 - Working familiarity with marketing measurement - attribution, incrementality, media mix modeling, campaign performance - sufficient to judge whether an automated interpretation is analytically sound. You will not be building measurement models; you will be building systems that reason about their output. 
 - Experience mentoring or leading engineers, whether or not you have held a formal management title. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline. 

Additional Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Preferred Technical Experience

- Agentic development environments - Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar - used as a daily working tool rather than tried once. 
 - Databricks, Greenplum or PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, or comparable analytical platforms. 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and disciplined code review practice. 
 - Building knowledge management or retrieval systems that stay accurate as they grow. 
 - Integrating applications with APIs, databases, and enterprise platforms. 
 - Marketing analytics, media, or adtech background. 
 - Working with data under client confidentiality and governance constraints. 

How You Work

- You are opinionated about design and you change your mind when the evidence says to. 
 - You are comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room and equally comfortable being wrong in it. 
 - You would rather ship something useful and imperfect than design something elegant that never lands. 

Additional Information

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels. 

Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9, 000 employees around the world. 

Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day. 

- People centricity: We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other. 
 - Collaboration: We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals. 
 - Growth: There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement. 
 - Innovation: We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches. 
 - Flexibility: We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively. 

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers. 

- Act with integrity
 - Work together to win together
 - Innovate with purpose
 - Respect all voices
 - Empower with accountability

These pillars and values are our foundation-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose. 

Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

data.title: Assistant Manager – Mechanical (Cryogenic Systems, Pressure Vessels & Piping)
data.description:
About Astrobase Space Technologies

Astrobase Space Technologies is an early-stage Bengaluru company building a two-stage orbital launch vehicle. Our engine is a LOX-methane full-flow staged-combustion engine. The Astrobase Propulsion team is looking for experienced and passionate professionals who turn engine plans into flight engines delivered on time and within budget. 

Job Overview

The Assistant Manager / Manager - Mechanical will be responsible for

leading the engineering, design, and execution support activities for cryogenic

systems, pressure vessels, station piping, and associated infrastructure used

in rocket stage test facilities, launch pads, and other critical aerospace ground

systems. The role requires extensive experience across the complete

engineering lifecycle, including concept development, basic engineering, 

detailed engineering, manufacturing support, installation, testing, 

commissioning, and operational readiness. 

The successful candidate shall provide technical leadership for the design

and implementation of complex cryogenic facilities, ensuring all systems meet

stringent safety, reliability, operability, and performance requirements. 

Working from the Head Office, the position will require periodic travel to

project sites to support construction, installation, testing, commissioning, 

troubleshooting, and final acceptance activities. 

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

To lead the engineering and implementation of cryogenic systems, pressure

vessels, and station piping infrastructure from concept through

commissioning, ensuring safe, reliable, compliant, and operationally robust

mechanical systems that support rocket stage testing, launch operations, and

critical aerospace infrastructure. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Design Leadership

- Lead concept, basic, and detailed engineering activities for cryogenic

systems, pressure vessels, station piping, utility systems, and associated

mechanical infrastructure. 

- Develop and review engineering deliverables including PFDs, P&IDs, 

equipment specifications, piping layouts, material specifications, 

engineering calculations, and design documentation. 

- Ensure designs satisfy operational, safety, maintainability, and

performance objectives. 

- Drive design optimization and value engineering initiatives to improve

reliability, constructability, and lifecycle performance. 

- Provide technical direction for engineering studies, design reviews, and

system integration activities. 

Pressure Vessel & Piping Engineering

- Lead engineering activities related to cryogenic storage systems, pressure

vessels, transfer lines, process piping, vent systems, filling systems, and fluid

distribution networks. 

- Review mechanical designs for pressure containment, thermal performance, 

stress requirements, operability, and safety. 

- Support vendor evaluation, technical bid assessments, design reviews, and

manufacturing oversight. 

- Ensure proper material selection for cryogenic service and demanding

operational environments. 

Codes, Standards & Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure compliance with applicable national and international regulations, 

codes, and industry standards. 

- Maintain strong working knowledge of: 
 - ASME BPVC
 - ASME B31 Series
 - PESO Requirements
 - SMPV Rules
 - IBR Requirements
 - EN Standards
 - Relevant aerospace and cryogenic system standards
 - Establish engineering review and validation processes for critical mechanical

systems. 

- Ensure all deliverables are compliant with statutory, client, and project-specific

requirements. 

Testing, Qualification & Commissioning Support

- Define qualification, testing, and acceptance requirements for pressure

vessels, piping systems, and cryogenic infrastructure. 

- Support development of testing procedures, commissioning plans, and

operational readiness activities. 

- Participate in factory acceptance tests, site acceptance tests, pressure testing, 

leak testing, performance testing, and commissioning activities. 

- Ensure engineering intent is maintained throughout fabrication, installation, 

testing, and commissioning stages. 

- Review and resolve technical issues arising during execution and operational

trials. 

Construction & Site Engineering Support

- Provide engineering support during fabrication, installation, erection, and

commissioning activities. 

- Conduct site inspections and review implementation against approved

engineering documentation. 

- Evaluate field modifications, deviations, and non-conformances and provide

appropriate engineering solutions. 

- Interface with contractors, vendors, consultants, and execution teams to

ensure successful implementation of mechanical systems. 

Leadership & Project Coordination

- Coordinate with Civil, Electrical, Instrumentation, Controls, Safety, 

Procurement, and Operations teams. 

- Lead technical reviews and support project planning, scheduling, and risk

management activities. 

- Mentor engineers and designers while promoting engineering best practices

and standardization. 

- Support development of departmental procedures, specifications, and

engineering guidelines. 

Technical Expertise

- Cryogenic Storage and Distribution Systems
 - Pressure Vessel Engineering
 - Process and Station Piping Systems
 - Rocket Stage Test Facilities
 - Launch Pad Fluid Systems
 - Cryogenic Transfer and Loading Infrastructure
 - Mechanical System Integration
 - Equipment Specification and Selection
 - Stress and Thermal Considerations
 - Testing and Qualification Procedures
 - Commissioning and Operational Readiness
 - Engineering Documentation and Design Reviews
 - Safety and Regulatory Compliance
 - Multidisciplinary Engineering Coordination

Software Proficiency

- AutoCAD
 - SolidWorks/ Autodesk Inventor Knowledge required. 
 - CAESAR II (Preferred)
 - PV Elite (Preferred)
 - ANSYS (Preferred)
 - Microsoft Office Suite

BASIC QULAIFICATION

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering; Master's Degree preferred. 
 - Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in pressure vessels, cryogenic systems, 

industrial gases, LNG, aerospace ground systems, energy, or process industries. 

- Demonstrated experience in concept, basic, and detailed engineering of pressure

vessels and piping systems. 

- Strong understanding of cryogenic fluid handling systems and associated safety

requirements. 

- Proven experience supporting projects from engineering through installation, testing, 

and commissioning. 

- Strong working knowledge of ASME, PESO, SMPV, IBR, EN, and applicable

industrial standards. 

- Experience in technical reviews, vendor management, qualification testing, and

multidisciplinary engineering coordination. 

- Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Willingness to travel to project sites as required. 

WHY WORK WITH US?

At Astrobase, we believe in the power of human ingenuity and collaboration to push

the boundaries of space exploration. As a team member, you'll be: 

- Creating History: Join us in developing cutting-edge launch vehicles, playing a

pivotal role in transforming space access and shaping the future of space

exploration. 

- Collaborating with Experts: Work alongside ISRO scientists and industry

veterans with decades of experience in designing India's iconic space missions

like Chandrayaan 3

- Growth Opportunities: As Astrobase scales, you'll have the chance to take on

leadership roles and be part of an expanding organization driving change in the

Indian space sector. 

- Pioneering Space Technology: Your contributions will not only impact Astrobase

but also influence the global space ecosystem. Be part of something larger than

yourself. 

Astrobase is an equal-opportunity employer; we hire on skills, merit and experience.

data.title: Lead Full-chip STA and timing signoff Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Full Chip SoC Timing Lead in ASIC/SoC design implementation and timing closure. The ideal candidate will lead full-chip timing activities from synthesis through place-and-route, signoff, and tapeout for complex SoCs in advanced technology nodes. This role requires deep expertise in STA, timing constraints, MMMC flows, SI/crosstalk analysis, ECO closure, and cross-functional collaboration with RTL, PD, CTS, DFT, power, and signoff teams. 

The Person

You have excellent communication and presentation skills, demonstrated through technical publications, presentations, trainings, executive briefings, etc. You are highly adept at collaboration among top-thinkers and engineers alike, ready to mentor and guide, and help to elevate the knowledge and skills of the team around you. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead full-chip timing closure for complex SoC/ASIC designs across all modes and corners. 
 - Own and drive timing signoff from synthesis to final tapeout. 
 - Develop, validate, and maintain timing constraints including SDC for full-chip and block-level integration. 
 - Perform and review static timing analysis (STA) for setup, hold, recovery, removal, clock gating, and async paths. 
 - Drive MMMC timing methodology and ensure robust timing convergence across PVT corners. 
 - Work closely with physical design teams on floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing, and post-route timing optimization. 
 - Analyze and resolve timing violations related to datapath, clock path, cross-talk, noise, OCV/AOCV/POCV, derates, and variation effects. 
 - Lead timing ECO strategies and execute closure with minimal impact to power, area, and performance. 
 - Collaborate with RTL/design teams to identify architectural or logic changes required for timing improvement. 
 - Coordinate with IP/block owners for timing budgeting, interface timing closure, and hierarchical timing signoff. 
 - Ensure signoff quality using industry-standard tools and methodologies. 
 - Drive correlation between implementation timing and signoff timing. 
 - Lead tapeout readiness reviews and provide timing risk assessment to program leadership. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and define best practices for timing methodology and closure. 

Preferred Experience

- 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics / Electrical Engineering / VLSI / Microelectronics / Computer Engineering. 
 - 12+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC/SoC timing analysis and timing closure. 
 - Strong expertise in full-chip STA and timing signoff for large-scale SoCs. 
 - Proven experience in advanced technology nodes (such as 7nm, 5nm, 3nm or similar). 
 - Strong knowledge of synthesis, place-and-route, extraction, and signoff flows. 
 - Experience with timing budgeting and hierarchical/full-chip integration. 
 - Solid understanding of clocking architecture, CDC implications, and timing exception handling. 
 - Ability to debug complex timing issues and drive closure under aggressive schedule targets. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants' needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

data.description:
About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We're the Operations Partner trusted by 2, 300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700, 000+ LPs on platform, we've built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we're reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1, 000+ employees strong, we're building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. 

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you're energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U. S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. 

About The Team And The Role

We're hiring the founding Engineering Manager for Web Reporting, a new squad in India that will build Juniper Square's next-generation web reporting product. 

Web reporting is one solution that serves GPs, LPs and fund administrators, delivered wherever each of them works. The team will build it AI-first and headless from day one: reporting logic and data exposed through APIs and agent-ready interfaces, so the same infrastructure can power our web UI, the investor portal, customer integrations and AI agents. The EM will help shape how AI changes both the product and how the team builds the Web reporting domain. 

The squad sits in the Reporting domain alongside our existing PDF Reporting team in North America. You'll work closely with the Reporting product manager, design, and the data platform team, and you'll be the engineering lead for web reporting in India. 

What You'll Do

- Build the team. Hire, onboard and grow a squad of 5-7 engineers. Set the bar, the culture and the operating rhythm for a brand-new team. 
 - Deliver the web reporting roadmap. Own execution from tech design through launch. Plan sprints, manage scope and dependencies, and ship predictably against roadmap milestones. 
 - Lead technical direction. Build, review and approve tech designs for the new system. Juniper Square is a Python shop with React frontend and a Redshift-backed data warehouse. Push on data modeling, performance at scale, correctness of financial numbers, and security. 
 - Make AI part of how the team works. Use AI coding and design tools to raise team throughput. Help evaluate where LLMs belong in the product, such as AI-assisted report templating, and where deterministic logic must stay. 
 - Partner across time zones. Work with product, design, PDF Reporting and the data platform team in North America. Keep a few hours of daily overlap with Pacific time and make decisions and status visible in writing. 
 - Own quality and operations. Set standards for testing, observability and incident response. Financial reports go to investors, so accuracy is non-negotiable. 
 - Develop people. Run 1: 1s, give direct feedback, write performance reviews and build career paths for every engineer on the team. 

What We're Looking For

- 12 years in software engineering, including 3+ years directly managing an engineering team of 5 or more. 
 - A track record of building or scaling a team: you've hired engineers, onboarded them and kept them. 
 - Strong technical judgment across web applications and data. You can review designs for Python services, React/TypeScript frontends and SQL-heavy data pipelines, and spot the weak points. 
 - Experience with data-intensive or financial systems: reporting, analytics, dashboards, or products where the numbers must be exact. 
 - AI-forward in practice. You use AI tools in your own work every day and have brought them into a team's workflow. You can name specific results, not just experiments. 
 - You've worked well with distributed teams, ideally with stakeholders in North America. 
 - Clear, direct written and spoken English. You flag risks early and bring a recommendation along with the problem. 

Bonus points

- Private markets domain knowledge: private equity, real estate, venture or credit funds, fund administration, or investor reporting. 
 - Background in financial or investor reporting, such as capital account statements, capital call and distribution notices, or fund performance reporting. 
 - Hands-on experience with Redshift or a similar cloud data warehouse, or with semantic layers and BI tools. 
 - You've shipped a product feature that uses LLMs in production, including evaluation and guardrails. 
 - You've been the first engineering manager on a new team or in a new location.

Job Role - AI-Native Full Stack Developer

About The Role

We are changing how we build data governance and data quality tools. Instead of long requirements cycles, we work in very short loops: talk through a need, build it, show it, and improve it the next day. 

You will work directly with a manager to build new features and functionality, with an AI coding agent such as Claude Code /Github CoPilot or Codex as the primary coder. You stay in control: you direct the agent, judge what it produces, and own what ships. 

What you will build

You will extend our self-service data quality product, which takes a business user from connecting a dataset to a data governance dashboard. 

What you will do

- Build and ship new features across the full stack, using an AI coding agent as your main way of writing code. 
 - Integrate the application with Collibra and Soda through their APIs. 
 - Meet with a manager every day and show working, incremental progress. 
 - Turn short conversations into working software, without waiting for formal requirements. 
 - Review, test and correct what the agent produces, so that it is reliable and secure. 
 - Deploy your own work and keep it running. 
 - Keep the agent productive with good instructions, context and project structure. 

What you need

- Mid-level full stack development experience, across front end, back end and databases. 
 - Real, day-to-day experience building with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex or Github CoPilot 
 - A full understanding of how to code and deploy using AI, from first prompt to running in production. 
 - Enough engineering judgment to spot when the agent is wrong, and to fix it. 
 - A track record of working quickly and showing progress in small increments. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating applications with third-party platforms through REST APIs, ideally Collibra and Soda. 
 - Strong Python with FastAPI or similar, and React. 
 - Clear communication, and comfort working directly with a technical lead with little process around you. 

Nice to have

- Experience with data quality, data governance or data-heavy applications. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL databases such as Snowflake, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and MySQL. 
 - Experience with Docker, Microsoft Entra ID sign-in (MSAL) and automated testing (pytest, Vitest). 
 - Experience building agentic or LLM-based features. 

Our stack

Python and FastAPI on the back end, with SQLAlchemy and pandas. React and Vite on the front end, with Microsoft Entra ID sign-in. Soda and Collibra integrations, Snowflake and other SQL sources, and Docker. 

How we will measure success

- Visible progress every day. 
 - New features turned around in days, not months. 
 - Working software in front of users, not long requirements documents. 

How to stand out

Show us something you built with an AI coding agent, and tell us how you directed it, what it got wrong, and how you deployed it.

About The Role

Position Title : Vice President, Audit Quality Assurance & Improvement Program (QAIP)

Corporate Title: Vice President, Internal Audit

Reporting to : Director of Audit Quality Assurance

Location : MGS - Bengaluru

Job Profile

Position Details / Job Summary

The Vice President, Audit Quality Assurance & Improvement Program (QAIP) position is within the Global Internal Audit function, reporting to the Director of Audit Quality Assurance. The position is responsible for execution of the QA plan and deliverables, assessing departmental conformance with Audit Methodology and auditing standards, and driving continuous improvement of processes, procedures, and quality throughout the audit department. The role will provide QA coverage across the global audit portfolio, spanning a broad range of business, credit, model, operational, technology, and regulatory risk areas, and will support both Global and Americas QA reviews. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Execute the quality assurance plan, performing reviews of audit planning processes, risk assessments, audit execution, audit issue validations, and other/thematic topical reviews. 
 - Maintain knowledge of audit quality assurance and improvement program and the audit portfolio including industry trends and best practices, business risks, control frameworks, management strategy, banking/regulatory practices; understand the business' products, systems, and processes. 
 - Continuously improve audit practices and methodology based on knowledge of best practices, industry standards and regulations and present areas and opportunities for alignment. 
 - Develop and execute QA testing programs designed to effectively assess the department's conformance with audit methodology, industry standards and regulatory requirements. 
 - Challenge audit teams on work performed, including appropriateness of scope, risks and controls identified, risk ratings, controls testing (design and operating effectiveness), sampling, sustainability, and conclusions. 
 - Influence management to understand impact of QA findings and obtain agreement with limited management involvement. 
 - Develop QA reports with the ability to contextualize findings to support rating and communicate improvement opportunities to the audit teams and audit management. 
 - Perform ongoing monitoring of open QA issues, escalate potential delays, and appropriately validate the closure of action plans in line with procedures. 
 - Partner with audit teams as a trusted advisor to support high-quality work products. 
 - Proactively escalate potential issues impacting delivery and manage deliverables, anticipating risks or challenges and evaluating alternatives/solutions. 
 - Proactively communicate issues, articulating the relevance of root causes across audit quality assurance reviews, and anticipate emerging issues that impact the department's risk profile, audit methodology and audit practices. 
 - Act as a leader, developing and promoting a workplace culture that values diversity of thought, promotes integrity and creates an atmosphere that supports coaching and fosters accountability. 

Education, Licensure, Years of Experience (and type of work experience): 

- Minimum of seven years of relevant internal audit experience in the financial services / banking industry
 - Bachelor's degree, preferably in accounting, finance, or related business discipline, at an accredited college or university. Advanced degrees are highly desirable. 
 - Professional auditing certifications, such as the CIA, CPA, CISA, CISSP, are highly preferred. 

Skills And Experience

- Strong understanding of risks and controls across banking businesses and support functions, including areas such as credit, model, market, liquidity, operational, technology, and regulatory compliance risk. Strong understanding of audit practices, methodology, and global audit standards. 
 - Experience with data analytics and artificial intelligence in executing audit or quality assurance activities. 
 - Experience reviewing audit workpapers and issue validations for sufficiency of evidence, quality of documentation, and conformance with audit methodology. 
 - Ability to influence stakeholders and challenge the status quo, including managing conflicts and issue resolution. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Strong project management skills and ability to coordinate/integrate efforts across multiple groups within audit. 
 - Highly motivated, takes initiative / self-starter, problem solver, solution oriented. 

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Job Description

About the Role

The Engineering Manager position entails the leadership of MCO global product development teams across the entirety of the software development life cycle. Key responsibilities encompass ensuring the quality of team outputs and optimizing customer experiences, along with maintaining strict adherence to coding standards and promoting automation initiatives. Moreover, the role involves mentoring and guiding engineers, proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks, and facilitating effective communication between engineering and other stakeholders. The manager oversees deployment processes, monitors system performance, and provides decisive technical leadership during incidents. Ultimately, this role aims to uphold the highest standards of professionalism and innovation in MCO software development practices. 

Job Requirements

Experiences and Skills

- 10+ years of experience (including up to 3 years in management) product development. 
 - Strong java full stack engineering experience in a product development environment
 - Maintain hands-on involvement with coding approximately 20% of the time
 - Expertise in architecture & design reviews, system design, code reviews, customer issues, troubleshooting, defect triage, etc. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to resolve complex issues. 
 - Demonstrates resilience and flexibility, consistently adapting while managing priorities with efficiency
 - A strong willingness to learn and a growth mindset. 
 - Excellent communication and servant leadership skill
 - Possess knowledge and experience of agile development methodology. (Scrum, AGILE and KANBAN)
 - Experience in a product driven SAAS or financial services company is a plus. Architect experience is a plus. 

Responsibilities

Job Responsibilities

- Own the effectiveness of the Scrum Agile process and adherence to good agile practices for the team. 
 - Be responsible for the quality of the teams' outputs and the customer experience of our products. 
 - Lead product development teams through all stages of the SDLC. 
 - Hands-on participation in all technical activities including architecture & design reviews, code reviews, coding, troubleshooting, defect triage
 - Define and enforce coding standards and best practices within the engineering team. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate product requirements into technical specifications. 
 - Conduct code reviews and ensure high code quality and adherence to engineering standards. 
 - Drive Automation in the engineering teams
 - Drive continuous improvement in development processes and tools to increase efficiency and quality. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers to foster their technical growth and career development. 
 - Identify technical risks and challenges early in the project lifecycle and propose mitigation strategies. 
 - Act as a technical liaison between engineering, product management, and other stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate with Platform Test teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of software products. 
 - Oversee deployment and release processes to ensure smooth and reliable product launches. 
 - Monitor system performance and address technical issues promptly to maintain product stability. 
 - Provide technical leadership during incidents and outages, facilitating root cause analysis and resolution. 
 - Foster a collaborative and innovative engineering culture focused on delivering high-quality software products

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
data.description:
Senior Software Development Engineer L4

Who We Are

Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building. 

Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare's greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve. 

Who You Are

As a Senior Software Development Engineer L4, you independently solve complex technical problems and deliver reliable, scalable software that supports Inovalon's products and clients. You bring strong software engineering fundamentals, a deep understanding of the software development life cycle, and the ability to design, build, test, and improve solutions in a collaborative team environment. You help strengthen product quality by partnering with engineering and product management, contributing to continuous improvement, and supporting secure, well-documented releases. 

What You'll Do

- Design, implement, unit test, and validate software solutions by following defined engineering processes and quality standards. 
 - Write high quality, testable code that meets the team's Definition of Done and supports reliable, scalable software products. 
 - Apply a test-first approach to development where possible, creating automated unit, system, and acceptance tests to improve quality and maintainability. 
 - Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and test plan reviews to strengthen technical decisions and ensure software quality. 
 - Own assigned integration, testing, deployment, and defect resolution tasks, including fixes for internally identified and customer-reported issues. 
 - Partner with product management to scope, estimate, and refine product enhancements and technical work. 
 - Support end-of-iteration demonstrations and actively participate in change management as business and technical priorities evolve. 
 - Contribute to retrospectives and continuous improvement efforts by identifying impediments, increasing team accountability, and improving problem-solving practices. 
 - Write and maintain documentation covering program logic, development, testing, changes, and corrections. 
 - Participate in an on-call rotation to respond to critical issues outside standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, in line with defined SLAs. 

What You'll Need

- Minimum 5 years of experience in software development using one or more programming languages, data structures, and algorithms. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology, or equivalent combination of education and experience required. 
 - Minimum 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. 
 - Advanced design, debugging, and coding skills. 
 - Ability to build secure applications and follow established security standards. 
 - Strong communication, organization, and teamwork skills. 
 - Demonstrated personal integrity and the ability to earn trust from others. 
 - Ability to learn quickly, seek feedback, and apply new knowledge to expand technical depth and improve performance as the role evolves. 
 - Ability to influence cross-functional partners, collaborate effectively through design and code reviews, and work constructively through differing technical perspectives. 
 - Ability to adapt to changing business and technical priorities, adjust approach as scope changes, and remain focused on delivery outcomes. 
 - Ability to generate practical, creative solutions to technical problems and apply best practices to improve software quality, scalability, and team effectiveness. 
 - Ability to interpret technical information, evaluate tradeoffs, and use sound reasoning to solve complex engineering problems. 
 - Nice to have: Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience preferred. 

Our Shared Commitments

- Maintain compliance with Inovalon's policies, procedures and mission statement
 - Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon's Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position
 - Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer

Work Environment

- This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law. 

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e. g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

If you don't meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth. 

Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement. 

To review the legal requirements, including all labor law posters, please visit this link

To review the California Consumer Privacy Statement: Disclosures for California Residents, please visit this link

Work Location: If the US position is listed as remote, employees who reside within a 40-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).

Cores Post‐Silicon Validation (Security)

- THE ROLE

The AMD Cores Validation team is looking for a highly motivated engineer to drive post-silicon validation of CPU security features across next-generation x86 processor products. The engineer will be responsible for validating architectural and microarchitectural security capabilities, developing security-focused test methodologies, executing validation plans, and driving complex debug activities from first silicon through production readiness. 

This role provides an opportunity to work closely with Architecture, Design, Firmware, Security, and Product Engineering teams to ensure robust implementation of processor security technologies. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans for CPU security features. 
 - Validate architectural security capabilities including: 
 - Secure Virtual Machine (SVM)
 - SEV / SEV-ES / SEV-SNP
 - Memory encryption technologies
 - Secure Boot
 - Trusted execution and attestation mechanisms
 - Speculation and side-channel mitigation features
 - Virtualization security extensions
 - Design directed and stress workloads to verify security functionality, robustness, and corner-case behavior. 
 - Perform silicon bring-up and feature enablement on pre-production platforms. 
 - Debug failures spanning: 
 - CPU cores and microarchitecture
 - Microcode (uCode)
 - BIOS/Firmware
 - Security processors and firmware
 - Analyze logs, machine check data, MSRs, traces, and hardware debug information to isolate root causes. 
 - Collaborate with Design, Architecture, Security, and Firmware teams to drive issue resolution. 
 - Develop automation infrastructure to improve validation efficiency, coverage, and regression execution. 
 - Track validation coverage, defect metrics, and readiness criteria for product milestones. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
 - Strong understanding of computer architecture and x86 processors. 
 - Good knowledge of operating systems internals and virtualization technologies. 
 - Familiarity with processor security concepts such as: 
 - Encryption
 - Authentication
 - Secure boot flows
 - Trust chains
 - Isolation mechanisms
 - Virtualization security
 - Experience with silicon validation, system validation, or hardware validation. 
 - Strong debug and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Proficiency in Python, C/C++, or scripting languages for automation. 
 - Experience working in Linux and Windows environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience in CPU cores post-silicon validation. 
 - Experience validating security IPs or processor security features. 
 - Knowledge of SEV, SNP, TSME, SME, Secure Boot, PSP/ASP architectures, or trusted execution technologies. 
 - Understanding of cache hierarchy, memory management, coherency protocols, and microarchitectural behavior. 
 - Familiarity with microcode, BIOS, firmware, and platform bring-up flows. 
 - Exposure to security testing methodologies including penetration, negative, and adversarial validation approaches. 
 - Experience with post-silicon debug tools, JTAG, trace, and performance monitoring infrastructure.

data.title: Senior Software Test Automation Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

As a Senior Software Test Automation Engineer, you will design, develop, and evolve modern test automation solutions that improve software quality, engineering velocity, and test coverage. This is a highly hands-on engineering role focused on Playwright, TypeScript, API automation, CI/CD, and AI-enabled quality engineering. 

You will work closely with software engineers, product teams, and QE leaders to build scalable, maintainable automation and embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. You will also explore and apply Agentic AI, LLM-based testing, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test analysis to modernize traditional quality engineering practices. 

The successful candidate is a strong software engineer who understands testing deeply and can translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, reliable QE solution

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable UI and API automation frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript. 
 - Develop robust automated tests covering functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end scenarios. 
 - Define and implement automation architecture, coding standards, reusable components, and testing patterns. 
 - Partner with developers and product teams to establish testability, acceptance criteria, and automation strategy early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable reliable, repeatable execution. 
 - Analyze automation failures, identify root causes, and improve test reliability and maintainability. 
 - Reduce flaky tests through effective synchronization, resilient locators, test isolation, test data management, and failure diagnostics. 
 - Develop reusable automation utilities, libraries, skills, and tools that can be leveraged across teams and applications. 
 - Apply Agentic AI and LLM capabilities to areas such as automated test generation, test case optimization and coverage analysis, AI-assisted test maintenance, self-healing or resilient automation, failure analysis and root-cause identification, test data generation, requirements-to-test traceability, intelligent regression selection, and LLM/AI application testing and evaluation. 
 - Explore and implement AI agents, MCP-based integrations, and AI-assisted QE workflows where they provide measurable value. 
 - Develop or contribute to evaluation strategies for AI-powered applications, including LLM response validation, hallucination detection, prompt evaluation, rubrics, golden datasets, and quality metrics. 
 - Participate in architecture and code reviews and provide technical guidance on automation best practices. 
 - Troubleshoot complex automation, environment, test-data, and integration issues. 
 - Contribute to performance, reliability, and scalability testing as needed. 
 - Monitor automation effectiveness using metrics such as coverage, execution time, stability, defect detection, and maintenance effort. 
 - Mentor other engineers and promote modern automation and quality engineering practices. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging testing technologies and AI capabilities and identify opportunities to improve QE productivity and quality. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. 
 - 5+ years of software test automation or quality engineering experience, with strong hands-on engineering experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Playwright. 
 - Strong programming experience with TypeScript and/or JavaScript. 
 - Strong understanding of UI, API, integration, and end-to-end automation. 
 - Experience designing or contributing to test automation frameworks and architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of software development practices, Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD. 
 - Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab. 
 - Experience with API testing and tools/frameworks such as REST, Postman, Playwright API, or equivalent. 
 - Strong understanding of test design techniques, test strategy, test coverage, and risk-based testing. 
 - Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex automation failures and identify root causes. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills. 

Agentic AI / AI Testing Experience

- Generative AI / LLM application testing
 - AI-assisted software development or test automation
 - AI agents / Agentic AI workflows
 - MCP or similar agent-to-tool integration frameworks
 - AI-generated test cases or test scripts
 - LLM evaluation and testing
 - Prompt engineering and prompt evaluation
 - RAG testing and evaluation
 - Hallucination and factuality testing
 - Golden datasets and evaluation datasets
 - Rubric-based evaluation
 - AI-powered test maintenance or self-healing automation
 - AI-based failure analysis or test-result summarization
 - Experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI coding/testing assistants

Required Qualifications

- Experience with Playwright using TypeScript at enterprise scale. 
 - Experience migrating automation from Selenium to Playwright. 
 - Experience with BDD/Gherkin and translating requirements or acceptance criteria into automated tests. 
 - Experience with API automation and contract testing. 
 - Experience with performance/load testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-based test environments. 
 - Experience with AWS, Azure, or other cloud platforms. 
 - Experience with test management and defect tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, qTest, or equivalent. 
 - Experience building reusable internal automation libraries, tools, AI agents, or developer/QE skills. 
 - Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM application architectures. 
 - Experience establishing quality metrics and automation effectiveness measures. 

Key Competencies

- Hands-on engineering mindset
 - Automation architecture
 - Strong coding and debugging
 - Problem solving
 - Quality engineering mindset
 - AI/Agentic AI curiosity and experimentation
 - Continuous improvement
 - Technical leadership
 - Collaboration and communication
 - Ability to work independently with minimal guidance

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we're getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. 

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

data.description:
The Role

As a Senior Research Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the integrity and accuracy of our Fixed Income data and analytics. Working closely with Fixed Income Methodology Analysts, Product Managers, and Engineering teams, you will design and implement robust validation checks that uphold the quality of our production environments. Your strong analytical background will enable you to review production code critically, ensuring methodologies are correctly translated into system processes and that models perform effectively. 

You will be responsible for developing quality assurance frameworks, monitoring data health, and validating new data content and analytics to maintain high standards throughout the entire data lifecycle. Additionally, you will manage client escalations by performing detailed root cause analysis and collaborating with internal teams to resolve issues efficiently. 

This role requires a proactive individual with a strong understanding of Fixed Income markets, data science tools, and end-to-end data processes to help drive data accuracy, reliability, and insightful analysis. . 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain a comprehensive QA framework for Fixed Income data and analytics, including monitoring data processes, data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness. 
 - Consistently improve upon existing model validation and QA processes, with an eye toward automation, efficiency, and robustness. Leverage Data Science, AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs) where possible to enhance analysis and generate actionable insights. 
 - Create and implement validation strategies for new data sets and analytical outputs, integrating these checks seamlessly into production environments. 
 - Oversee the full lifecycle of vendor data-from ingestion through to analytics and insights production-to ensure all outputs meet defined quality and accuracy standards. 
 - Validate the accuracy and integrity of Fixed Income calculations, metrics, and models to ensure they align with established methodologies. Collaborate closely with Quantitative Analysts, Product Managers and Engineering teams to understand methodologies, resolve issues, and drive continuous improvements. 
 - Handle client escalations by conducting thorough root cause analysis and facilitating timely communication and resolution with relevant stakeholders. 
 - Maintain a deep understanding of Morningstar's Fixed Income data models and infrastructure, ensuring end-to-end data quality from collection to reporting. 

Requirements

Education & Experience: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. 
 - Minimum 3 years of experience as a Research Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar role within Fixed Income or Financial Services.

Technical Skills

- Required: Proficiency in SQL
 - Preferred: Proficiency in coding and reviewing production-level code in at least one statistical modeling language (Python or R) for validation and quality assurance purposes.

data.title: Senior Associate-Digital Transformation
Lead Engineer – Control Applications
data.description:
1. Position SummaryWe are hiring a Lead Engineer to run control application development across our products for renewable energy plants: today the Energy Management System (EMS), the battery energy storage (BESS) controller, and the power plant controller (PPC), and new control products as the portfolio grows. This is a hands-on role: you will design, write, and commission control software for solar PV, wind, and BESS projects yourself, while guiding a team of junior engineers and reviewing their work. The role suits someone who has programmed and commissioned PLC- and IPC-based control systems on real sites and can read and review wiring and network connection diagrams. This role would be expected to implement control logic in IEC 61131-3 languages and supporting code in Python and C++, and you will be accountable for the quality and timely delivery of the team's work. 

2. Key ResponsibilitiesControl Application Development·            Control logic development: Design, write, and test control logic in IEC 61131-3 languages (Structured Text, Function Block Diagram, Ladder Diagram, Sequential Function Chart) for the PLCs and IPCs in our EMS, BESS controllers, and power plant controllers. 

·            Plant control functions: Implement active and reactive power setpoint control, ramp-rate limiting, power factor and voltage control, frequency response, curtailment, and BESS charge/discharge and state-of-charge management, in line with the applicable grid codes. 

·            BESS controller: Own the BESS controller application, including coordination of the battery management system (BMS), power conversion system (PCS), and auxiliary systems, along with safety interlocks, protections, and alarm handling. 

·            New products: Take on control applications for new products and customer requirements as the portfolio grows. 

·            Supervisory & edge applications: Write Python and C++ applications for data acquisition, protocol gateways, and diagnostics. 

·            EMS control code: Define how the control functions in the EMS should behave, and write and review the C++ and Python code that implements them. 

·            Reusable libraries: Build and maintain standard function block libraries, project templates, and coding guidelines, so each new project starts from the same base. 

Hardware, Networks & Integration·            PLC/IPC hardware: Select and configure PLCs, IPCs, remote I/O, and communication modules for each project. 

·            Wiring & network diagrams: Read, prepare, and review wiring diagrams (I/O, power, panel) and network connection diagrams. Check panel drawings, I/O lists, and cable schedules against the control design. 

·            Industrial networking: Design and configure plant control networks: managed switches, VLANs, ring topologies (RSTP/MRP), fibre links, routers, firewalls, and IP addressing. 

·            Field device integration: Integrate inverters, BMS/PCS, energy meters, protection relays, weather stations, and trackers over industrial protocols and field buses such as Modbus RTU/TCP, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, OPC UA, PROFINET, PROFIBUS, EtherCAT, CANopen, and EtherNet/IP. 

Testing, Commissioning & Support·            Testing & validation: Plan and run simulation tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT), and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) tests to check control logic against functional and grid compliance requirements. 

·            Site commissioning: Lead site acceptance testing (SAT) and commissioning at plant sites, and troubleshoot I/O, communication, and control faults on site. The role involves travel to project sites. 

·            Operational support: Handle L2/L3 support, root-cause analysis, and remote troubleshooting for plants in operation. 

Team Leadership & Technical Ownership·            Team lead: Plan, assign, and track the work of junior engineers in the control application team, with clear deliverables and dates, while carrying your own share of the development work. 

·            Mentoring & reviews: Guide junior engineers on control logic, hardware configuration, networking, and commissioning. Review their control logic, code, and designs, and give clear feedback. 

·            Quality of deliverables: Review and approve control logic, I/O lists, network drawings, and test documents before they go to projects or customers. 

·            Planning & estimation: Estimate effort, give technical input for proposals and tenders, and agree schedules and resourcing with project managers. 

·            Stakeholder interface: Coordinate with the electrical design and project management teams, customers, and OEM vendors. You and your team own the implementation of the EMS and controller software, including changes to screens and features, and its quality through testing and release. 

·            Front-end work: Plan and review changes to the EMS user interface carried out by team members. 

Documentation & Standards·            Documentation: Prepare and maintain control philosophies, functional design specifications, I/O lists, signal and communication lists, test procedures, and as-built documents. 

·            Standards & compliance: Follow IEC 61131-3, the applicable grid codes and connectivity regulations, and industrial cybersecurity practice such as IEC 62443. 

·            Version & change control: Keep all control software and configuration files under version control and record every change. 

3. Required Qualifications·            Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics & Instrumentation, Control Systems, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 

·            Experience: 4+ years of hands-on work in control software implementation, including PLC/IPC programming and commissioning. 

·            Leadership: Has led a small team or mentored junior engineers on project deliverables. 

·            PLC & IPC: Has programmed, configured, and commissioned PLCs and IPCs on at least one major platform, including on live installations. 

·            IEC 61131-3: Expert in writing and reviewing control logic in IEC languages (ST, FBD, LD, SFC) using standard IEC 61131-3 development tools. 

·            Control systems: Sound understanding of control systems and feedback control (PID loops, setpoint and ramp control, plant control behaviour), enough to judge whether someone else's control logic is designed correctly. 

·            Programming: Strong experience in Python and C++, enough to write production code for supervisory, gateway, or data-handling applications and to review code written by others. 

·            Wiring & network diagrams: Can read, interpret, and review wiring diagrams, panel drawings, and network connection and architecture diagrams. 

·            Networking & protocols: Hands-on work with industrial network equipment (managed switches, routers, firewalls, media converters) and with protocols and field buses such as Modbus, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, OPC UA, PROFINET, or EtherCAT. 

·            Renewable energy: Has worked in the renewable energy sector on solar PV, wind, BESS, or hybrid projects, and understands how these plants operate and connect to the grid. 

·            Tools: Uses Git, network and protocol analysers such as Wireshark and Modbus test tools, and a structured approach to testing. 

4. Preferred Qualifications·            Plant controllers: Power plant controllers (PPC), grid compliance testing, or EMS for utility-scale or C&I plants. 

·            SCADA/HMI: SCADA/HMI development on industrial SCADA platforms. 

·            Platforms: Linux, Docker containers, and edge or cloud-connected control architectures. 

·            Web dashboards: Familiarity with web-based dashboards or HMIs. 

·            Cybersecurity: Industrial control system cybersecurity and IEC 62443. 

·            Modelling: MATLAB/Simulink or plant simulation for testing control logic. 

·            Certifications: Vendor PLC/IPC certifications or industrial networking certifications. 

5. Core Skills & Competencies·            Finds and fixes faults quickly, in the lab and on site. 

·            Delegates well and helps junior engineers grow. 

·            Communicates clearly with customers, vendors, and other engineering teams. 

·            Takes ownership of quality and deadlines. 

·            Works safely on site, including electrical safety and lockout/tagout. 

·            Willing to travel to project sites for commissioning and support. 

6. What We Offer·            A lead role building control applications for renewable energy plants and energy storage systems. 

·            The chance to build and grow a control engineering team. 

·            Hands-on work with current PLC/IPC platforms, energy storage, and grid integration. 

·            Technical ownership of the control applications you and your team deliver.

data.title: Digital Analytics Tagging QA Specialist (Web & Mobile App)
data.description:
Position Summary : 

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Digital Analytics Tagging QA Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end testing, quality assurance, and validation of analytics tagging implementations and marketing pixels across both Web (desktop & responsive/mobile web) and Mobile Applications (iOS & Android). The ideal candidate will bridge technical development and business reporting by ensuring that web data layers, tracking beacons, and mobile SDK events collect flawless, highintegrity data. This position requires hands-on expertise with tag management systems (Adobe Launch / Experience Platform Data Collection, Google Tag Manager), web data layers, conversion/media pixels, cross-browser/cross-device cloud testing platforms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs), network debugging proxies (Charles Proxy, Fiddler), and mobile debugging tools (AEP Assurance)

Key Responsibilities : 

Tagging QA and Validation (Web & Mobile App): • Cross-Platform Tag Validation: Test and validate digital analytics tags and tracking pixels across responsive websites, single-page applications (SPAs), and native mobile apps (iOS & Android) to ensure complete data accuracy. • Web Data Layer Testing: Validate web data layer architecture and objects (e. g. , W3C digitalData, Adobe Client Data Layer adobeDataLayer, Google dataLayer) across all page types, DOM states, asynchronous event pushes, and single-page navigation. • Pixel & Conversion Tracking QA: Validate third-party marketing, conversion, and media pixels (e. g. , Google Ads, Floodlight, Meta/Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, affiliate networks) to verify trigger logic, conversion deduplication, and parameter mapping. • User Journey & Funnel Verification: Verify analytics events, custom dimensions/metrics (eVars, props, events, context data, event serialization), and network payloads across key user funnels (search, browse, product detail, cart, multi-step checkout, and order confirmation). • Release & Regression QA: Execute comprehensive regression testing on analytics implementations for routine sprint releases, major website overhauls, marketing campaign launches, and mobile app store updates. Debugging, Troubleshooting & Environment Emulation: • Cross-Browser & Cross-Device Cloud Testing: Actively utilize cloud testing platforms such as BrowserStack and Sauce Labs to validate tag firing, pixel latency, and data layer stability across extensive device, OS, and browser combinations. • Network Traffic & Proxy Inspection: Use proxy tools like Charles Proxy and Fiddler to inspect HTTP/HTTPS network requests, validate request headers, analyze POST/GET beacons, and verify query parameters sent to analytics collection servers. • Mobile App Tag Inspection: Use Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) Assurance (Project Griffon) and mobile developer logs to validate mobile SDK event dispatching, lifecycle metrics, offline event queuing, and flush behavior. • Browser DevTools Analysis: Leverage browser Developer Tools (Console, Network, Application/Storage) and browser extensions (Omnibug, Adobe Experience Platform Debugger) to inspect JavaScript errors, cookies, local storage, and tag sequencing. • Defect Triage & Isolation: Isolate, reproduce, and log technical defects related to missing beacons, duplicate firing, incorrect variable bindings, race conditions, and data discrepancies between front-end actions and analytics reports. Platform Expertise & Tag Management: • Analytics Platforms: Validate implementations in Adobe Analytics (Analysis Workspace, Report Suites) and Google Analytics (GA4 / Firebase Analytics), ensuring metrics align with business reporting expectations. • Tag Management Systems (TMS): Work within enterprise tag management tools-specifically Adobe Launch (AEP Data Collection Tags) and Google Tag Manager (GTM)-to inspect rules, data elements, extensions, and trigger conditions across Dev, Staging, and Production environments. • Architecture Alignment: Review both client-side and server-side tracking implementations to verify schema compliance, payload integrity, and technical alignment with data governance guidelines. Documentation, Test Governance & Reporting: • Test Artifacts: Develop, maintain, and execute detailed QA test plans, test cases, tagging validation checklists, and Requirement Traceability Matrices (RTM) mapped to Solution Design References (SDR) and tracking specifications. • Documentation & Evidence: Maintain organized QA documentation, including Charles session logs, network HAR files, console logs, and step-by-step defect reproduction notes. • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate QA status, data discrepancies, tracking risks, and edge-case behaviors clearly to product owners, marketing managers, and data engineering leads. Cross-Functional Collaboration: • Engineering & Product Partnership: Collaborate closely with front-end web developers, mobile iOS/Android engineers, and analytics implementation teams to review tagging specifications and resolve implementation blockers prior to deployment. • Agile Team Participation: Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Backlog Grooming, Retrospectives), providing QA effort estimations and flagging tagging dependencies early. • Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing: Provide technical guidance and share tagging QA best practices, debugging workflows, and tool adoption across testing and analytics teams. 

Required Skills & Qualifications Technical Skills: 

3+ years of relevant experience as a Digital Analytics Tagging QA Specialist (Web & Mobile App).
