data.title: Lead Enterprise Risk Engineer
data.description:
Equiti is a pioneering fintech firm and world-class provider of multi-asset fintech products - from liquidity solutions to in-house tech hubs to online trading platforms. With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institutional brokerage services in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. 

At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We're on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility. 

Think finance is stuffy? Think again. 

At Equiti, we're building fintech with a purpose: making wealth tools accessible to everyone. As we continue to grow, we're on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our Technology department would like to welcome a hands-on

Lead Enterprise Risk Engineer in our office in Bengaluru, India

As Lead Enterprise Risk Engineer, you lead the engineering of Equiti's shared risk infrastructure: one realtime, auditable decision layer that every product surface plugs into, across KYC, onboarding, trading, stocks, wealth and payments. Your goal is to keep fraud, financial crime and abuse losses as low as possible without adding friction for good clients. Reporting to the Group Head of AI Labs, you partner with product, Compliance and Risk teams across the Group. 

In fintech and wealthtech, fraud losses, chargebacks and regulatory penalties go straight to the P&L, and a single AML failure can put a licence at risk. You will build a central risk and decision engine that consumes data from every team and provides the rules, sanctions screening and interventions they all rely on, so risk decisions are consistent, real time and auditable. 

This is a build-led role. You set the architecture and stay close to the code, guide a team of risk-focused engineers, and act as the independent technical challenge point for platform and architecture changes that affect risk. 

Responsibilities

Risk Decisioning Platform

- Own the design and build of a sanction-grade, real-time risk decisioning engine that blends rules and ML scoring into a single decision API used across Equiti's products. 
 - Deliver a self-serve rules engine so risk analysts can author, test and roll back rules without an engineering deploy. 
 - Build velocity, limits and enforcement controls that are highly available and fully auditable, so every decision can be traced for regulators and auditors. 

Fraud & Financial Crime

- Own the device and session intelligence layer, including build-vs-buy decisions. 
 - Partner with Data Science to deploy and govern fraud models (account takeover, synthetic identity, mule detection, payment fraud, promo abuse), with confirmed outcomes feeding back into rules and models. 
 - Deliver sanctions and PEP screening and AML transaction monitoring in partnership with Compliance, tuned to keep false positives low. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead and mentor a team of risk-focused engineers, and set the team's technical standards, priorities and roadmap. 
 - Provide independent technical challenge on platform and architecture changes that affect risk. 
 - Report on control effectiveness and risk posture at governance forums, and build strong relationships across Technology, Risk, Compliance, Data Science and Audit. 

Experience Requirements

- 8+ years in software or data engineering, including 4+ years building fraud, financial crime or risk systems in financial services or a similarly regulated environment. 
 - Proven experience building and running real-time, low-latency decisioning or scoring services in production. 
 - Hands-on experience with rules engines and ML models in production: feature pipelines, model serving and monitoring. 
 - Working knowledge of sanctions, PEP screening and AML transaction monitoring regulatory requirements and control design. 
 - Strong technical grounding in SQL and Python, cloud data platforms such as Databricks, and BI and visualisation tools. 
 - Experience with streaming and event-driven architectures for real-time data. 
 - A track record of building monitoring, alerting and dashboard solutions. 
 - Technical leadership experience: mentoring engineers, setting standards and growing technical talent. 
 - Experience providing independent architecture or technical design challenge, and the credibility to influence senior technology, risk and compliance leaders. 
 - Degree in a relevant technical, risk or quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to Have

- Background in brokerage, trading, wealth or payments. 
 - Experience integrating third-party device intelligence or fraud detection providers. 
 - Graph or network analytics for mule and linked-account detection. 
 - Experience working with regulators across multiple jurisdictions. 
 - Familiarity with model risk management frameworks. 

Perks

Each of our offices has its special perks; be it 'no ties', free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy - but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you're sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more. 

The benefits you can expect at your Equiti workplace include: 

- Competitive salary package
 - Medical insurance coverage for employees and family members
 - Smart working options
 - Employee wellness initiatives
 - Company lunch in the office
 - Regular company events

With energy, drive, and imagination, there's no limit to where your career can go at Equiti. With a diverse workforce and geographical spread of offices, we strongly support career development initiatives as well as provide a range of opportunities for professional and life experiences. 

Equiti is an equal opportunity employer. 

"Equiti" refers to a group of companies consisting of seven regulated financial services companies licensed to operate in the respective jurisdictions of their incorporation, in addition to our tech and marketing hubs. Equiti has presence in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

data.description:
Company Overview

Dynatech Tools & Devices (Bengaluru) Pvt Ltd is a high-precision manufacturing company serving the aerospace and machine tool sectors from Bangalore, India. With over three decades of machining excellence, Dynatech produces critical components and assemblies that meet demanding industry requirements. Equipped with the latest machining technologies, Dynatech is committed to advancing precision engineering and offering a dynamic environment for professionals in manufacturing. 

Role Description

The Quality Manager will oversee all quality assurance and quality control activities across manufacturing operations. This role involves developing, implementing, and maintaining quality management systems aligned with AS9100 and ISO9001 standards, ensuring compliance with customer and regulatory requirements, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The Quality Manager will lead inspection and testing processes, manage audits, and mentor the quality team to achieve organizational objectives. 

Key Objective

To ensure effective implementation of AS9100D requirements, achieve zero-defect manufacturing wherever practicable, improve customer satisfaction, and maintain consistent product quality across all manufacturing operations. 

Location

Aerospace Park, Devanahalli, Bengaluru, India

Responsibilities

- Establish, implement, and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with AS9100D requirements. 
 - Ensure compliance with customer-specific, statutory, regulatory, and aerospace industry quality requirements. 
 - Monitor and control incoming material inspection, in-process inspection, and final product inspection. 
 - Implement First Article Inspection (FAI) as per AS9102, wherever applicable. 
 - Ensure proper material identification, product traceability, and configuration management. 
 - Manage supplier evaluation, approval, audits, and supplier quality performance. 
 - Handle customer complaints, quality issues, non-conformities, and corrective/preventive actions. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions. 
 - Plan and conduct internal audits; coordinate external certification and customer audits. 
 - Control special processes, product safety, counterfeit parts prevention, and FOD prevention. 
 - Monitor rejection, rework, scrap, and customer complaint trends; implement improvement plans. 
 - Prepare and monitor quality objectives, KPIs, and performance reports. 
 - Collaborate with Production, Purchase, Stores, Design, and Engineering departments to resolve quality related issues. 
 - Identify employee training requirements and ensure quality awareness and competency. 
 - Prepare and maintain quality manuals, procedures, inspection reports, and documentation. 
 - Participate in management review meetings and drive continual improvement initiatives. 
 - Lead and guide the QA/QC team to achieve organizational quality objectives. 

Required Experience & Competencies

- Bachelor's degree (BE/BTech) in Mechanical, Production, Aerospace, or related engineering discipline. 
 - 8-12 years of relevant experience, preferably in aerospace manufacturing.

Job Title: Instrumentation Engineer

Job-type: Full-time, on-site

Location: Nagercoil

JOB SUMMARY: 

We are seeking an experienced Instrumentation Engineer who will be responsible for developing, programming, commissioning and maintaining industrial automation and control systems. Your role will involve PLC programming, HMI development, SCADA integration, servo configuration, machine automation and troubleshooting of industrial equipment. 

The candidate will also be responsible for implementing automation solutions, integrating sensors, actuators, motors and control systems, conducting system testing and ensuring reliable machine operation. You will also collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop and optimise automated manufacturing and testing solutions. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

A. PLC Programming and Control Systems- Develop, modify and maintain PLC programs using Ladder Logic and Structured Text (ST). 

- Configure and program PLC controllers for industrial machinery and automated production systems. 

- Develop control logic for motors, sensors, actuators, servo drives and other automation components. 

- Perform PLC debugging, testing and optimisation to ensure accurate machine operation. 

- Work with different PLC platforms, including Siemens, Mitsubishi and other compatible automation systems. 

B. HMI and SCADA Development- Develop and configure Human Machine Interface (HMI) applications for industrial automation systems. 

- Design operator interfaces, control screens, alarms, monitoring dashboards and system parameters. 

- Integrate PLC systems with SCADA platforms for real-time monitoring, data acquisition and process control. 

- Implement data logging, reporting and traceability features for industrial applications. 

- Troubleshoot communication and integration issues between PLC, HMI and SCADA systems. 

C. Industrial Automation and Machine Commissioning- Develop and implement automation solutions for manufacturing, assembly and testing processes. 

-Configure servo motors, drives, gantry systems and motion control applications. 

- Participate in machine installation, commissioning, testing and validation. 

- Integrate robotic systems, including FANUC robots, with automated production and inspection processes. 

- Conduct functional testing and performance verification of automated machinery. 

- Identify operational issues and implement corrective measures to improve system reliability. 

D. Instrumentation and System Integration- Work with industrial sensors, transducers, measurement devices and control instruments. 

- Integrate electrical, mechanical and automation components into industrial control systems. 

- Work with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus and Ethernet-based communication. 

- Configure and troubleshoot communication interfaces between controllers, drives, sensors and monitoring systems. 

- Assist in testing and verification of measurement and control systems. 

E. Testing, Troubleshooting and Performance Optimisation- Conduct system testing, validation and performance analysis for automated equipment. 

- Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, SCADA, servo and machine control-related issues. 

- Analyse operational data and identify root causes of equipment failures or performance issues. 

- Implement corrective and preventive measures to minimise machine downtime. 

- Perform testing and verification of automated systems involving vibration, noise, airflow, leakage and other process parameters. 

- Maintain technical records, test reports and commissioning documentation. 

F. Engineering Projects and Technical Collaboration- Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, software and design engineering teams to execute automation projects. 

- Support the development of prototypes, proof-of-concept systems and customised automation solutions. 

- Participate in technical discussions, project planning and design reviews. 

- Prepare PLC documentation, control logic diagrams, system configurations and technical reports. 

- Guide junior programmers and share knowledge on PLC programming, troubleshooting and automation practices. 

- Research and evaluate new automation technologies and recommend suitable improvements. 

Expected Outcomes: - Reliable and efficient PLC-controlled automation systems. 

- Successful machine commissioning and integration. 

- Improved production efficiency and reduced equipment downtime. 

- Accurate monitoring, testing and data logging through HMI and SCADA systems. 

- Effective integration of robotic, servo and instrumentation systems. 

- Timely completion of assigned engineering projects in accordance with technical specifications and quality standards. 

Qualifications Required: Educational Qualification: 

Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (B. E. /B. Tech) in Instrumentation and Control Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Mechatronics or a relevant engineering discipline. 

Diploma in Instrumentation, Electrical, Electronics or Mechatronics may be considered based on relevant technical experience. 

Technical Skills: 

1. Strong knowledge of PLC programming using Ladder Logic and Structured Text. 

2. Experience with Siemens TIA Portal, Mitsubishi GX Works and/or any other PLC programming platforms. 

3. Knowledge of HMI development using GT Designer, Vijeo Designer or equivalent platforms. 

4. Understanding of SCADA systems, industrial automation and process control. 

5. Knowledge of servo motors, servo drives and motion control systems. 

6. Understanding of industrial sensors, actuators, measurement instruments and control systems. 

7. Knowledge of industrial communication protocols, particularly Modbus and Ethernet-based communication. 

8. Experience in machine commissioning, PLC debugging and system troubleshooting. 

9. Familiarity with robotic automation and machine vision systems. 

10. Understanding of industrial testing, validation, root cause analysis and performance optimisation. 

Professional Experience Required1. Approximately 2-4 years of relevant experience in PLC programming, instrumentation, industrial automation or machine control systems. 

2. Practical experience in developing, debugging and commissioning PLC-based automation systems. 

3. Experience in HMI development and SCADA integration. 

4. Hands-on exposure to servo motor configuration, motion control and automated machinery. 

5. Experience in industrial testing and automation projects involving manufacturing, assembly or testing equipment. 

6. Exposure to integration of robotics, sensors, measurement systems and industrial communication protocols. 

7. Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues and work with multidisciplinary engineering teams. 

Preferred Additional Competencies- Experience in Siemens, Mitsubishi and other industrial PLC platforms. 

- Knowledge of FANUC robotics and automated vision inspection systems. 

- Exposure to EV battery assembly and motor testing applications. 

- Knowledge of HVAC testing, vibration analysis, noise measurement and airflow testing.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Platform Authentication
data.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 

- Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role

As a Staff Software Engineer on GitLab's Authentication team, you'll be the technical lead for how every user, application, token, and automated agent proves who it is on GitLab. com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. 

We're an OAuth 2. 0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for millions of users. We also accept identity from enterprise identity providers through Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). Behind that sit more than ten token types and several session methods that grew inside the Ruby on Rails monolith. You'll help us move this work onto GATE, GitLab's new authentication and authorization platform. GATE exchanges external credentials for short-lived tokens at the edge through a Secure Token Service written in Go. You'll set our technical direction, lead the hardest protocol and migration work yourself, and help senior engineers own the rest. 

Our Projects Include

- OAuth across Cells: Making OAuth clients, grants, and tokens work when users and organizations live in different cells
 - Global identities: One user identity that works across organizations and cells
 - Token consolidation: Reducing the number of token types and moving token issuance and validation out of the monolith
 - Identity for artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workloads: OAuth for Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, workload identity federation, and service identities with narrow scopes

What you'll do

- Own the technical direction for authentication protocols at GitLab, including OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, SAML, and token exchange, across the Rails monolith and GATE services. 
 - Write and drive design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) for multi-quarter work, then break that work into increments that ship behind feature flags. 
 - Lead migrations that must not break existing customers: token formats, client and grant state, and session behavior on GitLab. com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. 
 - Be hands-on in the most complex parts of the code, in Ruby on Rails and Go, and review the designs and merge requests of other engineers. 
 - Agree interface contracts with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams, and keep them current as the architecture changes. 
 - Treat authentication as a security and availability boundary: threat-model new flows, add rate limits and abuse controls, and lead the technical response to authentication incidents. 
 - Mentor senior and intermediate engineers on the team and raise the protocol and security knowledge of the whole group. 
 - Work asynchronously with engineers in India, Europe, and the Americas, with most decisions made in writing. 
 - Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it. 

What you'll bring

- Significant experience building and running production authentication or identity systems at scale, with technical leadership across teams that moves unclear problems to written decisions and shipped code. 
 - Deep, hands-on knowledge of OAuth 2. 0 and OIDC: authorization code with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE), refresh token rotation, token exchange, client registration, scopes, and JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) with signing keys and key rotation. 
 - Working knowledge of SAML 2. 0 single sign-on and enterprise identity integration (LDAP, System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), or similar). 
 - Strong production experience in Ruby on Rails or Go, willingness to work in both, and experience with careful refactors, feature-flagged rollouts, and backward-compatible migrations in large, long-lived codebases. 
 - A security mindset. You think about token theft, replay, revocation, and blast radius before you think about elegance. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS) systems, including data isolation and performance under high request volume. 
 - Clear, concise written English and comfort working in an all-remote, asynchronous company. 
 - Optional experience: authentication libraries (Doorkeeper, Devise, or OmniAuth), passkeys or multi-factor authentication, workload identity, gateways or policy engines, AI agent authentication, or multi-region architectures. Contributions to identity standards or open source identity projects are also welcome. 

About The Team

The Authentication group is part of the Security Platform stage, alongside Authorization, GATE Core, GATE Infra, Secrets Manager, and other security teams. We own sign-in, single sign-on, OAuth, and personal and service tokens. Our work touches every GitLab customer, and much of it is on the critical path for Cells and for GitLab's AI agent platform. 

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
 - Flexible Paid Time Off 
 - Team Member Resource Groups
 - Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
 - Growth and Development Fund
 - Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. data.title: Founding Delivery Lead - AI Training Data (Healthcare & LifeScience)
data.description:
Founding Delivery Lead - AI Training Data (Healthcare and Life Science) - Grayde. ai In-person, Bangalore | Full-time | 6+ years of experience

About Grayde

Grayde. ai is a life science AI data company. We provide annotation, model evaluation, and fine-tuning datasets for AI models being built in pharma, biotech, and medical devices - delivered by credentialed domain experts under ISO-certified quality systems. 

We're early stage. This is a founding operations hire. 

The role

This is a 0 → 1 role. 

You own everything between the signed contract and the delivered dataset. 

That means building and running the specialist network (freelance annotators who work on the projects): sourcing, credentialing, onboarding, performance tracking, fraud controls, and retention. 

It means designing the quality systems: calibration tasks before any specialist works on a live project, creating training materials and checklists, multi-layer QA pipelines, inter-rater reliability checks, and specialist rating and rewards. 

It means running delivery: project planning, risk tracking, client communication, and invoicing. And it means owning project P&L - estimating correctly, allocating resources, and protecting margin. 

You'll build a team from scratch - owning training, assignment and performance management. 

What you'll own

Specialist network: Sourcing, vetting, and credentialing domain experts from around the world to work on the project. Onboarding and training before any live project. Retention and referrals. 

Quality systems: Calibration tasks, multi-layer QA pipelines, inter-rater reliability measurement, and client feedback that closes back into contributor training. 

Project delivery: Planning, timelines, risk tracking, batch delivery, and client communication from contract to invoice. You're the client's point of contact once the contract is signed. 

P&L and operations: Project estimation, resource allocation, and margin tracking. SOPs, tooling, process compliance, and building the delivery team as the business scales. 

What we're looking for

- 6+ years running delivery or operations at an AI data, annotation, or managed services company in the healthcare/life sciences industry
 - A degree in a field related to medicine or life sciences
 - Someone with excellent communication skills and high agency who is self-driven
 - Experience with stakeholder management and coordinating between different teams
 - Someone who has used AI tools actively to build processes and solve operational problems
 - Team management experience

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer with 3-6 years of software and infrastructure testing experience and hands-on expertise in virtualization and cloud technologies. 

In this role, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and readiness of the Cloud suite by validating it across hypervisor and container environments, along with related VM and cloud deployment workflows, through a balanced mix of manual testing and automated verification.

- Virtualization: Proxmox, KVM, VM provisioning, and lifecycle management

8 to 10 years related experience in the test equipment development and support field. 

Competencies

FCT equipment development

·              Hands-on experience in the design, development, integration, and commissioning of PCB Functional Circuit Test (FCT) equipment, including new test, calibration and automation equipment. 

·              Experience in developing test fixtures and test beds for PCB assemblies, including DUT interfacing and reliable electrical contact. 

·              Ability to translate PCB schematics, hardware requirements, and product specifications into test points, test coverage, diagnostic routines, and acceptance criteria. 

·              Experience integrating NI hardware, test instruments, power supplies, switching systems, and fixtures into a complete test station

·              Experience in test fixture validation, equipment calibration, repeatability checks, and test system troubleshooting. 

·              Experience in debugging hardware-software integration issues and optimizing test cycle time. 

·              Application of FMEA and Root Cause Analysis to fixture and test-process failures, including identification of safety risks. 

·              On-site test station commissioning, safety verification, production operator training (including safe operation), and handover to manufacturing. 

  

LabVIEW, Test Automation & Instrumentation

·              Strong hands-on experience in LabVIEW development and automated test system programming. 

·              Experience with modular LabVIEW development, state machines, error handling, and reusable test modules. 

·              Familiarity with test sequencing, instrument control, data acquisition, and automated pass/fail evaluation. 

·              Knowledge of test data logging, report generation, and production traceability. 

·              Experience with NI hardware and drivers, including NI-DAQmx, digital/analog I/O, and instrument communication. 

·              Working experience with equipment like Oscilloscope, Function generator, DMM, Logic Analyzer etc. 

·              Good understanding of embedded systems concepts & communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, USB, Modbus etc. 

·              Working experience with Python. 

.               CLD (Certified LabVIEW Developer) certification from NI is preferred. 

Equipment Safety and EH&S

·              Working knowledge of equipment safety requirements and the ability to apply them when working with test stations and fixtures. 

·              Ability to recognize and control electrical hazards (live voltages, stored energy, grounding and isolation, safe power-up and discharge) in test stations and fixtures

·              Ability to identify and design out mechanical hazards such as pinch points, crush points, sharp edges etc. and to correct them in the test fixtures. 

·              Experience with safeguards such as guarding, interlocks, emergency stops, safe enclosures, and clear warning labels

·              Experience preparing for and supporting EH&S reviews, including documenting hazards and addressing review findings before release

·              Commitment to delivering equipment that is safe for operators, maintenance staff, and the product, and that is verified safe before handover to manufacturing

data.title: Principal Software Engineer (Cyber-Security)

data.title: ADAS Senior Architect
data.description:
Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it's not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place-to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster. 

- Key Responsibilities Define the ADAS/AD system architecture from scratch - functional, logical, software and deployment views - from customer requirements through to start of production. 
 - Translate OEM feature requirements and ODD definitions into system requirements, architecture specifications and interface control documents. 
 - Select and justify the sensor set (camera, radar, lidar, ultrasonic, GNSS/IMU) and design sensor placement, calibration and time-synchronization strategy. 
 - Architect the perception, sensor fusion, localization, planning and control pipeline and its partitioning across SoC cores, accelerators and safety MCU. 
 - Lead compute platform selection and software mapping on ADAS SoCs such as NVIDIA DRIVE Orin/Thor, Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride and Renesas R-Car, including performance, latency and memory budgets. 
 - Define the middleware and communication architecture (AUTOSAR Classic/Adaptive, ROS 2, DDS, SOME/IP) including diagnostics, logging, cybersecurity and OTA update hooks. 
 - Embed functional safety (ISO 26262), SOTIF (ISO 21448) and cybersecurity (ISO/SAE 21434) into the architecture - safety goals, ASIL decomposition, freedom from interference and redundancy concepts. 
 - Own architecture trade-off studies, technical risk registers and design reviews; guide teams of engineering teams across various locations. 
 - Support pre-sales: solution proposals, effort estimation, technical presentations and RFQ responses for new ADAS programs. 
 - Mentor architects and lead engineers, and contribute to Quest Global reusable IP, accelerators and reference architectures. 

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard. 

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21, 000 difference-makers in our workplace. 

Work Experience

Preferred Qualifications

- B. Tech/ BE/ M. Tech/ ME/ PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a related field. 
 - Experience 12 to 18 years, with at least 5 years in an ADAS/AD architect role. 
 - Track record of architecting at least 2 live ADAS programs from scratch through to SOP or customer release. 

Key Skills Required [ADAS Senior Architect] -

Must have

- Complete knowledge of building an ADAS architecture from scratch across application, middleware and platform layers. 
 - In-depth knowledge of ADAS sensors - GNSS/IMU, cameras, radars, lidars and ultrasonic sensors - including their physical modalities, failure modes and limitations. 
 - Hands-on experience with L2/L2+ features such as Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Keeping Assist, Lane Centering, AEB, Traffic Jam Pilot, Highway Pilot and Automated/Smart Parking. 
 - Working knowledge of at least one ADAS SoC - NVIDIA, Qualcomm or Renesas - including toolchains, accelerators and software deployment. 
 - Experience with sensor fusion and synchronization methods (hardware timestamping, PTP/gPTP, time alignment) for L2+ driving. 
 - Knowledge of automotive middleware stacks for communication, diagnostics (UDS/DoIP) and cybersecurity. 
 - Applied knowledge of ISO 26262, ISO 21448 (SOTIF) and ASPICE in architecture work. 
 - Strong C++ and Python skills and experience with model-based architecture tools (Enterprise Architect, Cameo/Capella, SysML). 

Good to have

- Experience with machine learning and computer vision approaches - CNNs, BEV and transformer-based perception, occupancy networks - and deployment tooling (TensorRT, SNPE/QNN). 
 - Knowledge of at least one automotive RTOS (QNX, AUTOSAR OS, SafeRTOS) and hypervisors. 
 - Exposure to L3 architectures - fail-operational design, redundancy and UN R157 (ALKS). 
 - Familiarity with Euro NCAP / Bharat NCAP protocols and EU GSR requirements for ADAS. 
 - Exposure to data-driven development - data logging, replay, scenario-based testing and simulation (CARLA, CarMaker).

data.title: Senior Staff Data Platform Software Engineer (Java Distributed Systems & Kafka)
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Overview

Job Description

The Data Platform group builds highly scalable, high‐performance platform capabilities for data‐in‐motion and backend storage systems. Our customers operate at massive scale, pushing the boundaries of data volume, throughput, and concurrency. We are looking for a seasoned IC5 Senior Staff Engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems and Data Lake architectures to drive next‐generation platform innovation. 

Role Summary

As an IC5 Senior Staff Engineer, you will architect and deliver large‐scale distributed platform components, lead complex technical initiatives, and define engineering best practices. You will bring strong leadership, hands-on engineering depth, and the ability to design and operate reliable, scalable, and high‐performance data systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect, design, and build high‐performance distributed systems and platform components. 
 - Build distributed systems data ingestion solutions with strong emphasis on scalability, quality, and operational excellence. 
 - Deliver high‐quality, clean, modular, and reusable code while enforcing engineering best practices (code reviews, unit testing, automation, design reviews). 
 - Build foundational libraries, frameworks, and tools focused on modularity, extensibility, configurability, and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams to refine requirements and deliver end‐to‐end solutions. 
 - Provide technical leadership for projects with significant complexity and risk. 
 - Research, evaluate, and adopt new technologies that enhance platform capabilities. 
 - Troubleshoot and diagnose complex production issues across distributed systems. 

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

Experience Level

- 15-20 years of hands‐on engineering experience in distributed systems, data platforms, or large‐scale backend infrastructure. 

Core Engineering Expertise

- Strong fundamentals in distributed systems architecture, design patterns, and algorithms. 
 - Deep programming expertise in Java, including JVM internals, memory models, and garbage collection. 
 - Proven experience in JVM performance tuning, profiling, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks. 
 - Strong understanding of concurrency, networking, sockets, OS internals, and performance optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience building and operating large‐scale distributed systems. 
 - Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL. 

Distributed Systems Expertise

- Experience with large‐scale deployments of distributed systems. 
 - Deep knowledge of replication, fault-tolerant, and HA strategies. 
 - Experience working in DevOps environments to operationalize distributed platforms. 
 - Strong expertise in designing and architecting platforms using: 
 - Kubernetes (workload deployments, upgrades, monitoring and maintenance)
 - Apache Iceberg (tables, catalogs, schema evolution, metadata management) is a plus
 - Apache Kafka (high‐scale clusters, topic/partition strategies, HA) is a plus
 - Apache Flink (stateful stream processing, exactly‐once semantics) is a plus
 - Apache Spark (batch & streaming jobs, optimization, partitioning) is a plus
 - Expertise in data formats such as Parquet, ORC, and Avro, along with compaction and governance strategies. 
 - Ability to build scalable, fault‐tolerant ingestion and transformation workflows. 
 - Experience integrating Data Lakes with analytics engines, query services, or ML platforms. 

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U. S. data.title: Technical lead Engineer - Java Backend (XDR Platform)
data.description:
Engineered for Speed. Built for Global Scale. 

Hexnode is a global force in Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) and cybersecurity, trusted in 100+ countries to secure millions of devices across Apple, Windows, Android, macOS, Linux, and tvOS. Evolving rapidly into a comprehensive platform encompassing XDR, IdP, and DEX, we maintain an industry-leading release pace of 100+ features annually. We combine the momentum of a hyper-growth company with the mission-critical impact of an enterprise leader. 

Job Overview

We are looking for a Technical Lead Engineer to drive the backend architecture and development of our next-generation XDR platform. In this role, you will lead the design of highly scalable, low-latency backend services that ingest, process, correlate, and analyse security telemetry from millions of endpoints. This position perfectly balances hands-on engineering, system architecture, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration. 

Key Responsibilities

Own the architecture, design, and implementation of mission-critical backend services powering the XDR platform. 

Design and build highly scalable, fault-tolerant, low-latency distributed systems capable of processing massive volumes of concurrent security events. 

Develop cloud-native microservices with a strong emphasis on reliability, scalability, observability, and raw performance. 

Lead technical design discussions, make critical architectural decisions aligning with long-term platform goals, and mentor/coach engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing. 

Collaborate closely with Product Management, Security Research, Endpoint Engineering, DevOps, and QA teams to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions. 

Continuously improve platform performance through deep JVM tuning, database optimization, caching strategies, and asynchronous processing. 

Define and enhance engineering processes around CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment, real-time monitoring, and incident response. 

Required

8+ years of deep experience in Java software engineering, with a proven history of building and scaling enterprise-grade applications. 

Strong expertise in distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native architectures (AWS experience is highly preferred). 

Deep understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases (e. g. , PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Redis). 

Hands-on experience with Elasticsearch (or other Lucene-based search engines) and Big Data frameworks (Kafka, Spark, Flink) is a major plus. 

Proficiency in scripting and automation tools to streamline development and deployment pipelines. 

Exceptional communication, technical documentation, and stakeholder management skills, alongside a genuine passion for mentoring technical teams. 

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

Benefits

Comprehensive Healthcare Insurance

Flexible Time Off

Wellness Programs

Professional Development Opportunities

Generous Leave Policies

data.title: Tibco Lead
data.description:
Greetings from Mastek, 

We have exciting multiple immediate opportunities for the role-skillset of Tibco Business Events. Sharing below the details, please apply if you are interested. 

Role - Tibco Business Events Lead

Job Location - India Offshore (Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Trichy, Gurgaon, Noida, Ahmedabad)

Experience - 8-10+ years

ROLE SUMMARY

Lead the offshore BE engineering pod that analyses, refactors, tests, deploys and stabilises client's BusinessEvents applications during the 5. 5. 0 6. 4. 0 HF2 (JDK 25) upgrade, including the Coherence new cluster provider redesign. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1 Plan and assign work by pattern group, complexity, criticality, wave, environment (DEV / QA / PTEST / PROD / DR) and acceptance criteria; own reference CDD designs for each pattern. 

2 Review scanner findings and remediation: Coherence Ignite/FTL/AS4 CDD redesign, backing-store migration (be-storedeploy), @id / Instance. getByExtId key-based lookup changes (6. 1. 1+), deprecated catalog functions, state models and timers, bundled be. jar files using BE internal APIs, and JDK 25-certified JDBC drivers (replace ojdbc6/8). 

3 Enforce engineering quality across DEV, QA, PTEST, PROD and DR: Jenkins/Artifactory builds, BE 6. 4 . tra/Hawk configuration for TIBCO Administrator, code reviews, defect resolution, removal of credential files from repos, and technical documentation. 

4 Support production cutovers, parallel-run (5. 5 vs 6. 4) output comparison, discrepancy analysis, performance and failover tuning, hypercare, sign-off and controlled 5. 5 retirement. 

REQUIRED CAPABILITIES

TIBCO BusinessEvents 5. x/6. x (rules, rule functions, decision tables, state models, CDD, object management, cluster/cache providers, backing store); Oracle Coherence and Apache Ignite; Java (JDK 8 25); TIBCO EMS; Oracle JDBC; TIBCO Administrator / Hawk; Jenkins; Git; code review; performance tuning; cluster failover; offshore team leadership. 

Nice to have: TIBCO BE Decision Manager / WebStudio, ActiveSpaces 4 or FTL.

data.title: Battery Management Systems Engineer
data.description:
Technical Specialist - Power Electronics & BMS

Immediate Hiring

Experience: 8-14 Years

Location: Peenya, Towards Yeshwanthpur, Bangalore - 560058

Department: Power Electronics

Qualification: BE/B. Tech - EEE/ECE (ME/M. Tech preferred)

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Technical Specialist - Power Electronics & BMS to lead the development of Battery Management Systems (BMS) for ESS, EV and automotive applications. 

The candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in BMS architecture, battery safety, lithium-ion battery technologies, power electronics and battery pack integration, along with experience in leading engineering teams and managing end-to-end product development. 

Key Responsibilities

Lead BMS architecture, development and battery safety strategy. 

Review schematics, PCB layouts and hardware validation reports. 

Drive prototype bring-up, testing, validation and product release. 

Manage engineering teams, project planning, resource allocation and technical reviews. 

Handle battery pack integration, troubleshooting and field issue resolution. 

Ensure compliance with EV/ESS battery safety standards. 

Coordinate with customers, suppliers and certification agencies. 

Drive DFMEA, reliability engineering, root cause analysis and design improvements. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

BMS Development: AFE, CMU, Cell Balancing, SOC, SOH, SOP and Battery Protection Algorithms. 

Battery Technologies: Lithium-ion batteries, battery pack design and thermal management. 

Battery Safety: AIS-156, IEC 62619, UL 1973 and battery safety standards. 

Battery Integration: Contactors, pre-charge circuits, current sensing and insulation monitoring. 

Power Electronics: DC-DC converters, SMPS and inverter topologies. 

Hardware Design: Schematic review, PCB layout review and hardware validation. 

Testing: EMI/EMC, battery pack validation, qualification and failure analysis. 

Communication Protocols: CAN, RS485, Modbus and Ethernet. 

Reliability: DFMEA, derating and root cause analysis. 

Tools & Technologies

Altium Designer

OrCAD

LTspice

Oscilloscopes, Battery Cyclers, Power Analyzers, DMM and Data Loggers

MS Office

Ideal Candidate Profile

8-14 years of experience in BMS development for EV, ESS or automotive applications. 

Must have completed or worked hands-on on at least one BMS development project. 

Strong understanding of BMS architecture, battery pack integration and battery safety. 

Experience in technical leadership, customer interaction and team mentoring. 

Critical Screening Criteria

Mandatory

Actual BMS Development Project Experience

Candidates with only battery testing, battery manufacturing, embedded software or general power electronics experience without hands-on BMS project exposure should not be considered a direct match.

data.title: AI & Automation Lead
data.description:
AI & Automation Lead - Job Description

About the role

This is a hands-on role. The AI & Automation Lead personally designs, builds and runs the AI-enabled pipelines and custom workflows that power creative production at Publicis Production India. They are both the brain and the doer. 

Role purpose. To transform how creative production gets made by building practical, AI-enabled automation across our full deliverable scope: web banners, social media assets (with a large share of moving image and video), DSPs/IVA, Rep Triggered Emailers/Approved Emailers, and agency-produced print such as flyers, OOH and DOOH. 

The Lead brings a deep, working understanding of creative agency deliverables: how they are built, the tools and file formats involved, and where time is lost between master asset and final output. They identify the opportunities, write the code, stand up the pipelines and prove the value in live production, while maintaining creative quality, brand integrity and appropriate human oversight. 

They work closely with Production, Operations, Technology, Quality and client-facing teams, and equip production artists with the tools and workflows they need to deliver faster. 

Key responsibilities

A. AI & automation strategy and roadmap

- Develop and own the AI and Production Automation strategy for Publicis Production India, aligned with business priorities and global technology direction. 
 - Build and maintain a prioritised automation roadmap across our deliverables: web banners, social and video assets, DSPs/IVA, Rep Triggered Emailers/Approved Emailers, and print, OOH and DOOH. Cover the stages in between: master asset creation, adaptation and versioning, localisation, audio and transcription. 
 - Ground the roadmap in hands-on knowledge of how each deliverable is built today, so priorities reflect real production effort rather than theory. 
 - Prove ideas quickly with working prototypes, then take the ones that work through validation, deployment and scale. B. Hands-on solution development and deployment

- Personally design, code and deploy custom pipelines and workflows that support our business scope, for example: 
 - Master-to-variant resizing and versioning for banners and social assets
 - Video versioning, localisation, subtitling and voice-over pipelines
 - Template-driven generation of DSPs/IVA and Rep Triggered Emailers/Approved Emailers from approved source files
 - Print and OOH/DOOH adaptation, preflight and packaging checks
 - AI-assisted QC: spec, copy, claims and reference checks against source material
 - Write production-grade code in Python and/or JavaScript/Node, use Adobe scripting (ExtendScript/UXP), and integrate AI models and APIs (LLMs, image, video and voice generation) along with workflow tools. 
 - Select the right models, platforms and APIs, in collaboration with the Automation Architect and technology teams. 
 - Make solutions reliable, secure, maintainable and integrated with existing production systems, with documentation, support models and monitoring. 
 - Stay hands-on through deployment, troubleshooting live issues and refining tools based on production feedback. C. Production workflow understanding and redesign

- Sit with production teams to map existing workflows end to end: briefs, master files, tools used, file handoffs, review rounds and final packaging. 
 - Bring a working understanding of agency tools and formats, including Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere), Figma, HTML5 banners, video codecs and delivery specs, email HTML, print-ready PDF and DOOH specs. 
 - Assess automation potential based on volume, effort, repeatability, complexity and feasibility, and redesign workflows with AI and human review at the right stages. 
 - Build reusable components that work across disciplines, clients and markets instead of one-off fixes. D. Commercial accountability and value realisation

- Build business cases for automation initiatives covering effort, expected time savings, capacity release and financial benefit. 
 - Baseline production hours, turnaround times and quality before deployment, and track actual results after. 
 - Report regularly on adoption, realised savings and return on investment. E. Governance, quality and responsible AI

- Apply AI governance principles and responsible-use guidelines in coordination with global technology, security, legal and client teams. 
 - Make sure AI-enabled workflows meet brand, creative, technical and regulatory requirements, including medical, legal and regulatory review where content is regulated. 
 - Build human-in-the-loop controls, quality checks and escalation paths directly into the pipelines. 
 - Identify technology, data, IP and brand-safety risks and put controls in place. F. Stakeholder management and adoption

- Act as the bridge between production and technology, translating production needs into working solutions. 
 - Drive adoption through demos, training and hands-on support for production artists. 
 - Encourage teams to surface automation opportunities and build a culture of continuous improvement. 
 - Represent the India capability in global AI, automation and production transformation forums. G. Capability building

- Equip production artists with the right tools, scripts and workflows, and coach them on using them well. 
 - Share knowledge through documentation, walkthroughs and training so automation skills spread across production teams. 
 - Leverage global Publicis technology capabilities and reusable platforms where they fit. Must-have experience and skills

- 8-12 years of experience, with a significant portion spent in a creative agency, production house or ad-tech environment. 
 - Complete, working understanding of creative agency deliverables and their workflows: web banners, social media and video assets, DSPs/IVA, Rep Triggered Emailers/Approved Emailers, and print, OOH and DOOH. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of production tools and file formats: Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere), Figma, HTML5/CSS/JS banners, email HTML, video formats and codecs, and print-ready PDF and colour specs. 
 - A proven track record of personally building automation that runs in live production. Candidates should be able to show working examples, code or pipelines they built themselves. 
 - Strong coding skills in Python and/or JavaScript/Node, with experience in Adobe scripting (ExtendScript or UXP) and tools such as FFmpeg. 
 - Practical experience applying GenAI in production: LLM APIs, image, video and voice generation, and building workflows or agents around them. 
 - The ability to explain technical solutions to production artists and business stakeholders, and to coach others on the tools they build. Please note: this is a hands-on role. Candidates whose recent experience is mainly managing automation teams, without building the solutions themselves, will not be considered. 

Nice-to-have

- Pharma or life sciences content experience: Veeva CLM, Veeva Approved Email, and medical, legal and regulatory (MLR) review workflows. 
 - Experience with dynamic creative and templating platforms, such as Flexitive, Celtra, Bannerflow or Storyteq, or After Effects templating tools. 
 - Experience with workflow and integration tools (n8n, Make, Power Automate) and project systems such as Workfront. 
 - Familiarity with DAM systems and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP). 
 - A portfolio, GitHub or demo reel showing production automation work. What success looks like in the first year

- First 90 days: production workflows mapped across all deliverable types, a prioritised automation backlog agreed, and at least one working pipeline built and running in live production. 
 - By 6 months: several pipelines in daily use across banners, video, DSPs/IVA, emailers or print, with baseline and post-deployment metrics tracked. 
 - By 12 months: measurable reductions in production hours and turnaround time, reusable components adopted across accounts, and production artists confidently using the tools built for them.

data.title: Engineering Manager(React.js+Node.js)
data.description:
Company Description

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4, 000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3. 5 lakh (350, 000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings. 

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India's leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus. 

Job Description

We're looking for a Senior Technical Architect to own the technical direction of our platform across web and backend systems. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set architecture standards, guide a team of 10-20 engineers, and run multiple concurrent initiatives without letting delivery timelines slip. You'll be expected to bring an AI-native mindset to how we build - using modern AI tooling to accelerate development, raise quality, and rethink how problems get solved. 

What You'll Do

- Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture across frontend, backend, and infrastructure, balancing scalability, performance, and cost. 
 - Lead a team of 10-20 engineers across multiple parallel projects, ensuring each ships on time and at quality. 
 - Prioritize the technical roadmap against business needs - making clear trade-offs on what to build, defer, or drop, and communicating the reasoning to stakeholders. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentorship: review designs, unblock engineers, set coding and review standards, and grow the team's capability. 
 - Drive an AI-native approach to engineering - integrating AI tooling into the SDLC (code generation, review, testing, documentation) and identifying where AI can improve the product itself. 
 - Partner with Product and Line of Business teams to translate requirements into sound, deliverable technical plans. 
 - Own project management discipline across teams: estimation, risk management, dependency tracking, and timeline ownership. 
 - Maintain engineering health - technical debt, system reliability, security, and observability. 

Technical Stack & Expertise

A strong candidate must demonstrate depth across the full stack: 

Backend & Services

- Strong server-side proficiency ( Node. js / Java / Python / Go) and RESTful + event-driven service design. 
 - Microservices architecture, API gateways, and service-to-service communication patterns. 

Data & Streaming

- Apache Kafka - event streaming, producers/consumers, partitioning, and stream processing at scale. 
 - Clickstream data pipelines - capturing, processing, and analyzing high-volume user-event data. 
 - MySQL (and relational data modeling, query optimization, indexing, replication) - plus exposure to NoSQL stores (Redis, MongoDB, Cassandra/DynamoDB). 
 - Data warehousing and analytics pipelines (e. g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, or equivalents). 

Frontend

- Modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React / Angular / Vue) and responsive, performant UI architecture. 

Cloud, Infra & DevOps

- Cloud platforms (AWS / GCP ), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Caching, CDN, load balancing, and high-availability design for high-traffic consumer systems. 
 - Observability and monitoring (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting). 

AI-Native Tooling

- Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tooling across the SDLC, and a clear view on applying AI within the product. 

Qualifications

What You Bring

- 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong full-stack foundation across modern web frameworks, backend services, databases, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Proven track record architecting and delivering large-scale, high-traffic systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading teams of 10-20 engineers and running multiple projects simultaneously without compromising timelines. 
 - Strong prioritization instincts - able to align technical decisions with business outcomes and defend trade-offs. 
 - Hands-on fluency with AI-native development tooling and a clear point of view on applying AI across the engineering lifecycle. 
 - Excellent leadership, mentorship, and stakeholder-communication skills. 
 - Solid project management capability (Agile/Scrum or equivalent). 

Nice to Have

- Experience in travel-tech, e-commerce, or high-scale consumer platforms. 
 - Experience setting up team-wide AI tooling, standards, or governance. 

Additional Information: Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

data.description:
About Woodside Energy

We are a global energy company, providing reliable and affordable energy to help people lead better lives. Join our team at Woodside Global Solutions in Bengaluru where talent, digital expertise, and operational excellence converge to solve complex energy challenges, accelerate change, and reimagine business capabilities to support Woodside's global operations and our role in the energy transition. 

Founded in 1954, Woodside established the liquefied natural gas (LNG) industry in Australia 40 years ago and supplies customers around the globe. 70 years on, Woodside continues to be driven by a spirit of innovation and determination. 

At Woodside, we know great results come from our people feeling valued, getting the support they need to reach their full potential and working in a psychologically and physically safe work environment. We believe in nurturing talent and providing opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement. 

Refer to our corporate website for more information about our different locations and projects: What We Do

About Woodside Global Solutions

Woodside Global Solutions in Bengaluru is being built as a hub of excellence, to drive innovation, digital transformation, and global collaboration. 

Working as one Global team, the Woodside Digital team is a trusted partner driving transformation within the organisation. We are bold in our ambitions and resolute in our actions. Through cutting-edge AI, robust cyber security, and advanced data solutions we drive innovation and influence every part of our business. 

We are looking for talented professionals who are passionate about technology and eager to make a global impact, helping to shape the future of Woodside together. 

About the role : 

The Lead Software Engineer is a highly capable technical leader across the full development lifecycle (requirements to operation) and entire technology stack (front-end user interface to the back-end data access patterns). They lead teams by example to deliver value from complex and ambiguous requirements, set a high bar for engineering quality, and influence technical outcomes beyond their immediate work. They lead software design and implementation of significant features or whole systems, mentor others through example, and take accountability for the long term health, security, and performance of software platforms. 

This role is agile team based and requires both leadership and expert level hands-on coding skills. They will be a problem solver, an expert coder, a mentor of others and someone passionate about driving continuous improvement and quality in a dynamic product environment. 

Duties & Responsibilities: 

• Lead the team in design, build, and evolution of complex applications and platforms across multiple languages, cloud services and platforms. 

• Champion software quality by holding a high bar in code reviews, testing practices, and prevention of regressions. 

• Act as a technical steward by setting and enforcing code standards, maintaining consistency, and owning critical components or services. 

• Lead solution design for domains or systems, evaluating trade offs in cost, scalability, performance, and requirements, documenting solutions, providing clarity where it is lacking. 

• Lead secure by design reviews and ensuring the team's security maturity and overall system safety. 

• Actively lead the decomposition of complex problems/requirements into implementable work tasks. 

• Lead operations related discussions with other software engineers and stakeholders to influence product or technical direction based on system behaviours in production. 

• Provide structured evaluation of new technologies and contribute to platform patterns and ways of working. 

Skills & Experience: 

Required Experience / Essential Skills

• Typically, 10+ years of experience in software engineering roles after formal academic studies with senior engineering experience including formally mentoring other developers

• Expert proficiency as a full-stack web developer in Typescript, React, Node. js, HTML, CSS and front-end build tools and bundlers (npm, Vite, Webpack). 

• Expert proficiency in designing and provisioning AWS cloud native solutions. This must be in cloud native serverless technologies (not just EC2 and containers) using such services as API Gateway, AppSync, Lambda, S3, SNS+SQS, DynamoDB, Aurora etc. There is no hand-off for infrastructure as code (Cloudformation, CDK) to other teams - your product team does it all!

• Data modelling and database design of both AWS SQL and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, Aurora, PostgreSQL RDS). 

• High proficiency in RESTful and GraphQL API design with examples of design leadership provided. 

• High proficiency with Git branching and conflict resolution. Experience managing Github repositories and establishing CI/CD workflows. You will have led creating Github Actions pipeline previously. 

• Demonstrated prior responsibility for software architecture, ability to provide commentary in architecture reviews, security practices, performance optimization techniques, operational support. 

• Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, ability to handle multiple priorities and construct work of others. 

Required Qualifications: 

• Bachelor's degree in software engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 

• Relevant professional certifications are highly desirable, such AWS Developer and Solution Architect. 

• Postgraduate qualifications (e. g. Master's degree) are advantageous, particularly where they support the design and development of software solutions. 

Please apply Woodside, we value people with diverse experiences and backgrounds, as they provide unique perspectives that help us innovate. 

Recognition & Reward: 

- What you can expect from us: 
 - Commitment to your ongoing development, including on the job opportunities and formal programs
 - Inclusive parental leave entitlements for both parents
 - Values led culture
 - Flexible work options
 - Generous annual leave, sick leave and casual leave
 - Cultural and religious leave with flexible public holiday opportunities
 - A competitive remuneration package featuring performance-based incentives with uncapped Employer Provident Fund

Woodside is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce culture, which is supported by our Values. Inclusion centres on all employees creating a climate of trust and belonging, where people feel comfortable to bring their whole self to work. We also offer supportive pathways for all employees to grow and develop leadership

data.title: Senior Manager-ServiceNow & Digital Assurance
data.description:
Company: Novo Global Business Services (GBS)

Your impact begins here

Set the direction for ServiceNow and Digital Assurance at Novo, and keep more than 1, 000 GxP, financial and business-critical systems trusted, compliant and ready for inspection. You will turn ServiceNow, AI and automation into simpler processes, better user experiences and measurable business value for colleagues across Global IT, CMC, PS, NNI and IO. Your leadership gives colleagues technology they can rely on, so they can focus on work that reaches people living with serious chronic diseases. 

What You'll Bring

- You are a strategic, people-centric and outcome-focused leader who connects technology, assurance and business priorities, and who can build trust in a highly regulated, global environment. 
 - 10+ years of relevant experience in enterprise technology, digital platforms, Digital Assurance, quality, risk, compliance or digital transformation. 
 - Proven leadership experience with responsibility for people, capabilities, products, services or large-scale transformation. 
 - Strong understanding of ServiceNow or comparable enterprise workflow platforms, including strategy, product roadmaps, governance, adoption and value realisation. 
 - Experience with Digital Assurance, risk-based validation and assurance, quality and compliance by design, and regulated technology environments. 
 - Strong understanding of AI, including generative and agentic AI, intelligent automation, responsible AI and data-driven transformation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead complex, cross-functional transformation in a global organisation. 
 - Experience managing strategic suppliers, investments, budgets and external delivery partners. 
 - A bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant discipline. rong executive communication, and the ability to challenge complexity constructively while balancing innovation, speed, quality, risk and business value. 

Useful, But Not Essential

- Experience in pharmaceuticals, life sciences, healthcare or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Certifications in ServiceNow, ITIL, GAMP/CSA, product management, risk, quality or AI governance. 

What You'll Do

You will lead multidisciplinary teams and shape how ServiceNow and Digital Assurance deliver value across Novo. Your work will include: 

- Defining and driving the strategy and roadmap for ServiceNow and Digital Assurance, aligned with enterprise and business priorities. 
 - Leading, developing and inspiring high-performing teams, building future-ready capabilities across ServiceNow, AI, automation, Digital Assurance, risk and product leadership. 
 - Driving adoption and value from ServiceNow through enterprise workflow transformation, standardisation, simplification, reuse and scalable digital capabilities. 
 - Modernising Digital Assurance with risk-based assurance, quality and compliance by design, automated testing, reusable controls, continuous monitoring and audit readiness. 
 - Shaping and accelerating the responsible adoption of generative AI, agentic AI and intelligent automation, with the right governance and human oversight. 
 - Establishing governance across portfolio priorities, architecture, quality, risk, service performance, investments and value realisation, and overseeing suppliers and partners for performance, innovation, commercial value and capability transfer. 
 - Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes in adoption, operational excellence, compliance, resilience, cost efficiency and stakeholder experience. 

Who You'll Work With

You will lead the ServiceNow, Integration and Compliance unit in Enterprise IT & Quality. The unit is responsible for ServiceNow platform services, system integrations, compliance, validation and test management of 1, 000+ GxP, financial and business-critical systems. These systems undergo inspections by global regulatory authorities such as the FDA and MHRA. 

Your services support Global IT, CMC, PS, NNI and IO, so you will work closely with senior stakeholders across business, technology, quality, compliance, risk, architecture, data and AI, as well as strategic partners. You will bring these perspectives together, create clarity on priorities and help teams move at pace while keeping the trust that regulators and colleagues expect. 

What You Can Expect Here

You will lead in a global, regulated environment where your expertise is valued and your voice shapes decisions across business, technology, quality and risk. You will have room to build new capabilities in ServiceNow, AI, automation and Digital Assurance, and to grow your own leadership through complex, cross-functional transformation. 

You will be trusted to take ownership and supported to perform at your best, with clear expectations and a culture that rewards results. You will work alongside colleagues who are curious about emerging technology and who challenge convention to serve customers better. 

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn ServiceNow, AI and Digital Assurance into trusted, scalable progress for Novo, apply for the Lead-ServiceNow & Digital Assurance role by 25th November 2026. Lasting health starts now, and the technology behind it matters. 

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Company Description Wondr Diamonds is an innovative diamond brand focused on high-quality, ethically sourced, and technologically advanced diamond products. The company combines modern manufacturing practices with strict quality controls to deliver precision-crafted jewelry and gemstones. Wondr Diamonds values reliability, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement in its production processes. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, embrace new technologies, and support a culture of safety and excellence. The organization offers opportunities for professional growth within a fast-evolving manufacturing environment. 

Role Description The Technical Head Manufacturing will lead and oversee end-to-end manufacturing operations at Wondr Diamonds' facility in Coimbatore. This is a full-time, on-site role responsible for planning, organizing, and optimizing production activities to meet quality, safety, and efficiency targets. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing production schedules, supervising manufacturing teams, ensuring adherence to GMP and internal standards, and driving operational excellence initiatives. The role involves analyzing performance data, resolving technical and process issues, coordinating with cross-functional teams (such as quality, maintenance, and supply chain), and implementing continuous improvement projects. The Technical Head Manufacturing will also support capacity planning, technology upgrades, and training programs to strengthen the overall manufacturing capability. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Manufacturing

 In-depth knowledge of end-to-end diamond jewellery manufacturing processes. 

 Technical troubleshooting of casting, setting, polishing, and finishing defects. 

 Establishment of manufacturing SOPs and technical process standards. 

 Product engineering and manufacturing feasibility assessment. 

CAD & Product Engineering

 Technical review of CAD designs for manufacturability and structural integrity. 

 Metal weight optimization and design feasibility. 

 Identification of technical flaws in prong dimensions, stone setting, and metal thickness. 

Casting & Metal Processing

 Expertise in gold casting, alloy composition, burnout cycles, and casting parameters. 

 Troubleshooting porosity, shrinkage, and casting defects. 

 Optimization of casting yield and metal recovery. 

Diamond Setting & Finishing

 Strong technical knowledge of prong, pavé, micro-setting, channel, bezel, and invisible

setting. 

 Understanding of stone tolerances, setting geometry, and stone security. 

 Troubleshooting stone breakage, loose stones, and finishing defects. 

Production Planning & Process Optimization

 Production planning, capacity utilization, and process-wise productivity. 

 WIP management, bottleneck identification, and lead time reduction. 

 Implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and continuous improvement. 

Quality & Loss Control

 Quality standards, inspection systems, and root cause analysis. 

 Control of gold wastage, metal recovery, and diamond loss. 

 Reduction of rejection, rework, and manufacturing costs. 

Team Management

 Leadership of production supervisors, craftsmen, setters, and technical teams. 

 Technical training, skill development, and performance management. 

Key Performance Indicators

 Production efficiency and plan adherence

 On-time delivery

 First-pass yield and rejection rate

 Labour productivity

 Casting yield

 Gold recovery and wastage

 Diamond loss and reconciliation

 Manufacturing lead time

 Cost per gram / piece

Qualification & Experience

 Diploma / Degree in Jewellery Technology, Jewellery Manufacturing, or Mechanical

Engineering

 10 + years of experience in diamond jewellery manufacturing. 

 Minimum 5 years in a senior production leadership role. 

 Strong hands-on technical expertise in CAD/CAM, casting, diamond setting, polishing, and

product engineering. 

 Proven track record in technical troubleshooting and process optimization. 

Ideal Candidate

A technically proficient, hands-on manufacturing leader with deep expertise in diamond jewellery

production, strong analytical abilities, and a proven ability to improve quality, productivity, and manufacturing profitability.
