Firmware Engineer 5 Duties of Position: (Include specific duties and responsibilities) The person should perform the following in his role: 

- Architect Open BMC Solutions: Lead the design and implementation of Open-BMC distributions tailored for hyper scale hardware, including hardware abstraction layers and D-Bus interfaces. Responsible for defining the overall system architecture, choosing the security framework (Root of Trust, SPDM), and ensuring the BMC integrates seamlessly with BIOS and cloud-scale fleet management
 - Hyper scale Collaboration: Partner with Hardware and Systems teams to define firmware requirements for OCP (Open Compute Project) compliant servers and storage enclosures. 
 - Modern CI/CD Integration: Drive automated testing and continuous integration workflows for firmware, ensuring high-velocity deployments without sacrificing stability. 
 - Security & Root of Trust: Implement and maintain platform security features, including Secure Boot and hardware Root of Trust (RoT) integration. 
 - Full-Stack Ownership: Manage firmware development from low-level boot loaders (U-Boot) to high-level management APIs (Redfish/gRPC). 
 - Production Support: Provide expert-level debugging for critical issues identified in hyper scale data centre, utilizing remote telemetry and crash dump analysis. 
 - Participate in firmware code development and code review process
 - Provide weekly status updates to key stake-holders on development status Qualifications Required: (Education, experience, skills, etc. Please be specific) BS/MS/BE/BTech or ME/MTech in EE, CS, or CE with 12 to 15 years of relevant firmware experience. 
 - Open-BMC Framework: Expert-level knowledge of D-Bus, Systemd, and Bitbake/Yocto Project within the OpenBMC ecosystem. 
 - Modern Management APIs: Deep experience with Redfish, MCTP, PLDM, and PDRs. 
 - Linux Systems: Linux kernel development, device tree configuration, and driver development for X86 and ARM platforms. Hardware Protocols: Advanced troubleshooting of I2C/I3C, SPI, eSPI, PCIe/VDM, and PMBus. 
 - Languages: Expert C/C++ (specifically modern C++ used in OpenBMC) and Python/Go for automation. 
 - Cloud-Scale Tooling: Experience with Git, Gerrit, Jenkins, and containerization (Docker) for firmware build environments. 
 - Hardware Bring-up: Experience with Aspeed AST2500/AST2600 (the industry-standard BMC chips) and low-level debugging using JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. BMC rebranding. Linux Socket programming and IPC, Shell scripting Knowledge in GPUs, Linux drivers development
 - Knowledge and development experience in Web scripting, test Automation scripts Software security, Knowledge in SATS
 - Process development & Documentation System debugging, Firmware testing (Unit, Acceptance) and Validation
 - Hyper scale Experience: Proven track record of shipping firmware for Hyper-scalar data centre products (AWS, Azure, Meta, or Tier 1 OEMs). 
 - Strong history of working with Open-BMC; experience replacing proprietary stacks (AMI, Avocent) with open-source alternatives is highly preferred. 
 - Comprehensive understanding of modern server topology, including CPUs (Intel/AMD), GPUs, and NVMe storage. Experience implementing Cerberus, Titan, or similar hardware security protocols. Ability to represent the company in industry forums (OCP) and collaborate with geographically distributed open-source contributors.

data.title: Principal Engineer, S/W QA Cyber Security
data.description:
Additional Locations: N/A

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we'll give you the opportunity to harness all that's within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we'll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you'll be supported in progressing - whatever your ambitions. 

About The Role

The Principal Cybersecurity Quality Engineer is a senior individual contributor and subject matter expert responsible for providing independent Quality oversight and technical leadership for product cybersecurity activities across the medical-device product lifecycle. This position partners with Quality, R&D, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Global Product Cybersecurity, Regulatory Affairs, Design Assurance, Post-Market Quality, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure cybersecurity risks and deliverables are appropriately identified, assessed, controlled, verified, documented, and maintained. 

The role supports new product development, sustaining engineering, product changes, third-party software and component assessments, vulnerability management, and post-market cybersecurity activities. The individual will also strengthen organizational cybersecurity capability by developing consistent approaches, reusable knowledge assets, and technical expertise within the Quality organization. 

Your Responsibilities Will Include

- Serve as the Quality subject matter expert for product cybersecurity activities across new product development, sustaining engineering, product changes, remediation, and integration programs. 
 - Provide independent Quality review and approval of cybersecurity plans, assessments, reports, and other lifecycle deliverables in accordance with applicable Quality System requirements. 
 - Review cybersecurity risk analyses, threat models, security architectures, attack-surface assessments, and risk-control strategies for completeness, consistency, technical adequacy, and traceability. 
 - Ensure cybersecurity risks, requirements, controls, and verification evidence are appropriately connected across design controls, software lifecycle documentation, system requirements, and product risk-management files. 
 - Review Software Bills of Materials, MDS2 documentation, cybersecurity reports, penetration-test results, static and dynamic analysis results, vulnerability assessments, and security verification evidence. 
 - Assess the cybersecurity quality impact of design changes, software changes, third-party software updates, operating-system changes, supplier changes, and other product lifecycle changes. 
 - Provide Quality oversight for cybersecurity verification and validation strategies, including acceptance criteria, test coverage, traceability, anomaly handling, and objective evidence. 
 - Support product vulnerability assessments and Post-Market Vulnerability Reviews, including evaluation of potential safety, quality, compliance, and product-security impacts. 
 - Support post-market cybersecurity investigations, remediation plans, corrective actions, and escalation activities, as applicable. 
 - Partner with Global Product Cybersecurity and project teams to interpret and consistently apply internal cybersecurity procedures, work instructions, standards, and regulatory expectations. 
 - Support cybersecurity content needed for regulatory submissions, notified-body reviews, internal audits, external inspections, and responses to regulatory questions. 
 - Identify Quality and compliance gaps, communicate risks clearly, and influence appropriate mitigation and escalation decisions. 
 - Lead complex cybersecurity quality initiatives that may span multiple projects, product families, divisions, or geographic locations. 
 - Develop and improve cybersecurity quality review methods, templates, checklists, playbooks, metrics, and reusable knowledge assets. 
 - Monitor cybersecurity quality trends and recommend process, training, governance, or capability improvements. 
 - Mentor engineers and cross-functional team members in cybersecurity risk management, design controls, documentation quality, and lifecycle expectations. 
 - Support development of independent cybersecurity subject matter experts and help establish a sustainable cybersecurity Quality capability. 
 - Represent Cybersecurity Quality in technical reviews, governance forums, communities of practice, and cross-functional decision-making bodies. 
 - Maintain current knowledge of evolving medical-device cybersecurity regulations, standards, guidance, technologies, threats, and industry practices. 
 - Perform other related duties as assigned. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Significant professional experience in cybersecurity, software quality, design assurance, product security, systems engineering, software engineering, or another relevant technical field. 
 - Experience working with software-enabled products in a regulated product-development environment. 
 - Demonstrated experience with cybersecurity risk assessment, threat modelling, vulnerability evaluation, security requirements, or secure product-development practices. 
 - Working knowledge of software development lifecycle and design-control principles. 
 - Experience reviewing complex technical documentation and determining whether evidence is complete, traceable, technically sound, and compliant. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical work independently and make risk-based recommendations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence decisions across functions and organizational levels without direct reporting authority. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex cybersecurity risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively within a global, cross-functional, and matrixed organization. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Experience in the medical-device, healthcare technology, pharmaceutical, aerospace, automotive, or another safety-critical regulated industry. 
 - Experience with medical-device cybersecurity, software quality assurance, design assurance, or product-security quality oversight. 
 - Knowledge of medical-device design controls, software lifecycle processes, and product risk management. 
 - Experience with threat modelling, security architecture review, vulnerability assessment, penetration-testing review, static application security testing, or dynamic application security testing. 
 - Experience reviewing SBOMs, third-party software components, open-source software, commercial software, and software supply-chain risks. 
 - Experience supporting post-market vulnerability reviews, cybersecurity investigations, vulnerability remediation, CAPA, or other corrective-action processes. 
 - Experience supporting regulatory submissions, audits, inspections, or regulatory inquiries involving cybersecurity or device software. 
 - Experience developing organizational processes, templates, metrics, training, or reusable cybersecurity knowledge assets. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers or developing technical subject matter experts. 
 - Professional certification such as CISSP, CSSLP, CISM, GIAC, or an equivalent cybersecurity or quality credential. 

Leadership And Expectations

- Acts as a recognized technical authority in cybersecurity quality. 
 - Operates with substantial independence in defining approaches and resolving complex or ambiguous problems. 
 - Provides technical direction for complex, high-risk, or highly visible cybersecurity quality matters. 
 - Influences cybersecurity quality decisions across multiple functions, projects, product families, or business units. 
 - Develops scalable methods, frameworks, and practices rather than limiting contributions to individual project execution. 
 - Anticipates emerging cybersecurity risks and recommends appropriate organizational responses. 
 - Coaches and mentors engineers while building sustainable technical capability. 
 - Communicates cybersecurity quality risks and recommendations clearly to technical and business leadership. 
 - Balances technical rigor, patient safety, regulatory compliance, product quality, and business needs. 

Requisition ID: 636429

Boston Scientific transforms lives through innovative medical technologies that improve the health of patients around the world. As a global medical technology leader for more than 45 years, we advance science for life by providing a broad range of high-performance solutions that address unmet patient needs and reduce the cost of healthcare. Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions. data.description:
If you're passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide's Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, "on your side" goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we're looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care. 

Position Summary

We are seeking an Azure Infrastructure Engineer to join a cloud platform engineering team responsible for building, automating, securing, and supporting Azure infrastructure used by enterprise application teams. This role is grounded in the standard work currently performed across Azure engineering team, including Azure subscription and resource group buildout, Azure DevOps and deployment automation, storage and file-share engineering, security remediation, networking and connectivity support, and operational/on-call ownership. 

The ideal candidate is a hands-on infrastructure engineer who can partner with application teams, architecture, security, and operations teams to deliver reliable Azure platform capabilities while improving automation, guardrails, and supportability across the environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build, configure, and support Azure subscriptions, resource groups, shared infrastructure, and application environments across development, test, and production use cases. 
 - Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Azure DevOps pipelines, deployment automation, and PowerShell-based tooling used to provision and update Azure infrastructure at scale. 
 - Engineer and support core Azure platform components such as virtual machines, storage accounts, Azure Files and Blob Storage, App Services, application gateways, Key Vault integrations, load balancers, and related platform services. 
 - Partner with application teams during working sessions to deploy infrastructure, enable application hosting patterns, resolve platform blockers, and improve deployment consistency. 
 - Support networking and connectivity needs for Azure-hosted workloads, including firewall requests, DNS coordination, private endpoint connectivity, and cross-environment access patterns. 
 - Improve Azure security posture through policy guardrails, App Service and storage remediation, RBAC-based access patterns, key and credential lifecycle management, and collaboration with security and compliance stakeholders. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues related to logging, monitoring, authentication, storage access, deployment pipelines, and Azure service configuration, and drive issues through to resolution. 
 - Participate in on-call rotations and operational support for Azure platform services, including incident response, change implementation, and platform reliability work. 
 - Contribute to modernization, migration, and platform-improvement efforts by breaking down work, refining implementation approaches, and helping create scalable solutions for repeated engineering needs. 

Required Qualifications

- Experience engineering and supporting Microsoft Azure infrastructure in an enterprise environment, including resource groups, virtual machines, storage services, networking, access controls, and shared platform components. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps, YAML-based deployment patterns, service connections, and automation using PowerShell or similar scripting languages. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, connectivity, logging, monitoring, and deployment workflows. 
 - Experience implementing or supporting secure access patterns such as RBAC, Key Vault-based secret handling, federated credentials, private endpoints, and policy guardrails. 
 - Ability to work directly with application teams and cross-functional partners to understand requirements, guide implementation decisions, and deliver practical infrastructure solutions. 
 - Ability to manage work in a structured way across change control, implementation tasks, and operational follow-through in a production environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting Azure application gateways, IIS-hosted workloads, storage-account modernization, and file-share access remediation. 
 - Experience with enterprise migration or modernization efforts involving Azure environment buildout, shared platform enablement, or cross-team delivery. 
 - Familiarity with compliance, security-review, or regulated-environment expectations for Azure platform engineering work. 
 - Experience participating in an on-call rotation for cloud infrastructure or platform operations. 

What Success Looks Like

- Azure environments are delivered with repeatable automation and clear deployment patterns. 
 - Application teams can move faster because common infrastructure needs are easier to provision, troubleshoot, and support. 
 - Security and operational issues are identified and remediated quickly through strong engineering ownership and practical platform guardrails. 
 - The engineer can independently own work items while collaborating effectively across platform, security, architecture, and delivery stakeholders. 

Job Description Summary

Nationwide is a leading insurance and financial services provider committed to delivering extraordinary care to its customers. With a growing presence in India, our technology teams play a vital role in driving innovation and supporting global operations. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!

As a Technology Support Engineer, you'll support and maintain applications and infrastructure across all environments. You'll perform a variety of technical services in support of applications and infrastructure and play a vital part in fulfilment of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes. You'll collaborate with individuals across teams to execute tasks and contribute recommendations based on operational observations, production and test performance/environments and end user needs/requirements. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Executes work in adherence with IT Service Management best practices. 
 - Identify, design, and assist in implementing opportunities to standardize operational environments. 
 - Applies secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities. 
 - Design and develop standard, repeatable production runs; create job control language and schedule scripts. 
 - Execute process improvements through optimization and implementation of new operational features. 
 - Provides consultation and support to delivery teams in their release activities. 
 - Ensures currency of data in configuration management tools and maintain contract license usage. 
 - Provides data-driven decisions by delivering operational metrics and by analysing operational data to identify trends, potential problems, and continuous improvement recommendations. 
 - Delivers operational overview documentation and metrics with insights and analysis. 
 - Maintains operational knowledge of platforms, technologies, and applications. 
 - Coordinate responses to service disruptions and communicate root-cause analysis. 
 - Drive research of end user issues and execute Level II and III technical support. 
 - Coordinates with Level III support to assist in mitigating incidents and validation of change activities involving hardware and software. 
 - Serves as technical and process escalation for team members. 

Qualifications & Experience

May perform other responsibilities as assigned. 

Education

Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, or other related degree. Technology experience or non-traditional technology certificates can be substituted for an undergraduate degree. 

Experience

Four years or more of technology experience developing and implementing a routine solution. One or more years of experience using basic levels of troubleshooting to fix a problem. Understanding of system management processes and tools.

data.title: EDA Simulation Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a hands-on EDA Simulation Automation Engineer to join our AI-native product development team at onsemi. The role sits at the intersection of power semiconductor module simulation and engineering automation: you bring deep, practical experience running electrical, thermal, and mechanical simulations across industry-standard EDA tools, and you partner with our software and AI agent engineering team to codify that expertise into repeatable, automatable workflows. Today, every design cycle waits on a few subject-matter experts to configure tools, run simulations, and extract KPIs by hand. Your job is to break that bottleneck by defining standardized inputs, outputs, and KPI extraction logic that our platform can orchestrate and scale across engineers, teams, and products. You will also identify where commercial EDA tool licensing or concurrency limits constrain simulation throughput, and research, evaluate, or build custom and open-source alternatives that can be integrated into the platform's automation pipeline. 

Success Expectations

You would become the platform's trusted domain authority for simulation configuration, execution, and KPI extraction - defining clear, documented automation contracts for each supported EDA tool, validating that automated and agent-driven simulation runs match expert-derived results, and steadily expanding the set of tools and KPIs the platform can orchestrate without manual SME intervention on every cycle. 

Responsibilities

- Own hands-on simulation execution for power module characterization across electrical, thermal, and mechanical domains using tools such as Ansys Discovery, Q3D, HFSS, IcePak, Mechanical, OptiSLang, Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, Calibre (DRC/LVS/PEX), SIMetrix/SIMPLIS, and PLECS. 
 - Define and validate KPI extraction logic from raw simulation outputs, including loop inductance, on-resistance (RDS(on)), switching energy, junction temperature (Tj, max), thermal resistance (Rth), and power-cycling lifetime. 
 - Design standardized, parameterized test-bench definitions and post-processing rules that convert raw tool outputs into compliance-ready KPI values. 
 - Document tool-specific configuration, input/output file schemas, and scripting hooks (Python, tool APIs, batch/command-line modes) so engineering can automate configuration, dispatch, and result ingestion for each tool. 
 - Partner with software and SDET engineers to build and validate simulation regression pipelines, ensuring automated or agent-driven runs reproduce trusted, manually-derived golden results. 
 - Capture and formalize simulation best practices, known-good configurations, and troubleshooting knowledge that today lives only with individual SMEs, so it can be reused across teams and products. 
 - Support AI agent tool-calling integrations for EDA tools by defining safe, well-scoped automation boundaries, required parameters, and expected outputs for each tool. 
 - Research, evaluate, and prototype custom or open-source alternatives to commercial EDA tools where per-seat licensing or concurrency limits throttle agentic, parallelized simulation throughput, and propose where such alternatives can safely substitute or supplement licensed tools. 
 - Review and sign off on automated simulation results and generated KPI/compliance reports against domain expectations before release certification. 
 - Collaborate with model-generation and layout/GDS teams to ensure electrical and thermal models feeding simulations remain accurate and traceable. 
 - Provide simulation domain expertise during project scoping, test-suite definition, and requirements-to-KPI mapping discussions. 

Qualifications

- 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience running simulations for power semiconductor or power module design, with direct, practical use of at least two or three of: Ansys Discovery, Q3D, HFSS, IcePak, Mechanical, Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, Calibre, SIMetrix/SIMPLIS, or PLECS. 
 - Solid understanding of power module electrical, thermal, and mechanical characterization and the KPIs engineers derive from each (parasitics, loop inductance, resistance, thermal resistance, junction temperature, lifetime/reliability metrics). 
 - Practical experience configuring simulation inputs (parameters, test benches, boundary conditions) and interpreting/post-processing raw simulation outputs into engineering KPIs. 
 - Scripting ability in Python sufficient to automate tool configuration, batch execution, and output parsing. 
 - Working knowledge of GDS/layout-based design flows and how layout, parasitic extraction, and model generation feed downstream simulation. 
 - Ability to translate tribal SME knowledge into clear, documented, repeatable procedures that a software or AI agent engineer can implement without deep tool expertise. 
 - Comfort researching and evaluating open-source, custom-built, or alternative simulation/extraction methods to work around commercial tool licensing or concurrency bottlenecks. 
 - Strong attention to detail in validating automated results against known-good manual runs, with a rigorous approach to signing off on release-quality simulation data. 
 - Good collaboration and communication skills to work closely with software engineers, SDETs, and AI coding agents on a shared automation roadmap. 

About Us

onsemi (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world's most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world.

https: //www. onsemi. com/careers/career-benefits

Join us and build for travelers everywhere. 

Introduction To The Team

This role is under Platform Quality team & We are looking for high performing individual contributor who has worked prior on or willing to work on Scalable internal tools & utilities creation for developer productivity enhancement. 

Must have developed Internal or industry standard based web or native app test automation solution which is highly stable & scalable. 

In This Role, You Will

- Design, develop, and maintain robust test automation frameworks, internal tools, and utilities that leverage AI/ML‐enabled solutions to enhance developer productivity and accelerate release cycles. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and optimized code using strong knowledge of software design principles, data structures, design patterns, and computer science fundamentals across multiple tech stacks including native mobile apps, web, and APIs. 
 - Investigate and perform root cause analysis (RCA) of test failures and system issues, using deep understanding of the surrounding systems, logs, and monitoring to design and implement durable fixes. 
 - Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‐enabled solutions that improve test coverage, failure detection, and feedback loops, while ensuring reliability, observability, and maintainability of these solutions in production workflows. 
 - Utilize and refine industry‐standard test automation frameworks, CI/CD workflows (such as GitHub Actions), and operational tooling (such as RCP/MCP servers, Datadog, Splunk) to continuously improve quality and efficiency. 
 - Collaborate across teams to identify and resolve inefficiencies in code, tools, and processes, driving cross‐organizational improvements, documenting major technical initiatives (including RCAs), and sharing learnings with broader groups. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience. 
 - 5+ years of relevant professional experience. 
 - Professional software development or test automation engineering experience, including building and debugging applications and internal tools, with strength in at least one programming language and exposure to multiple technology implementations. 
 - Working knowledge of industry‐standard testing and monitoring tools for automated and distributed systems, and the ability to interpret system behavior and logs to perform effective RCA of failures. 
 - Ability to design and implement code and framework changes that improve stability, reliability, and test effectiveness across services or components, including familiarity with CI/CD workflows and observability tooling. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing software, automation frameworks, or internal tools in at least two programming languages (such as Java and Python), including designing and maintaining test automation systems or high‐usage internal utilities from scratch. 
 - Proven ability to apply design patterns for scalable, maintainable systems and frameworks, including system design (low‐level design), API design, and data modeling for test and tooling platforms. 
 - Demonstrated impact in selecting appropriate technologies and architectures to solve business and quality needs, connecting team goals to broader business outcomes and identifying project‐level business problems with corresponding technical solutions. 
 - Familiarity with AI‐driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML‐enabled solutions that improve test automation, developer workflows, or quality insights. 
 - Experience operating test automation and internal tooling at scale, including optimizing CI/CD pipelines, observability (Datadog, Splunk), and reliability for multi‐service or cross‐platform environments.

data.description:
Who We Are

- Charles River Development (CRD) is the FinTech division of State Street. Together with State Street's Middle and Back-office services, Charles River's cloud-based Front Office technology forms the foundation of the State Street Alpha® Platform, the first front-to-back solution in the industry. 
 - Our vision is to be the world's leading investment platform, shaping the future of the industry and driving new levels of technology-led innovation, resiliency, efficiency and growth for investors and the people they serve. 
 - CRD Engineering organization is innovating and transforming the platform by moving away from monolithic software to utilising next generation cloud-based technology that leverages Microsoft Azure, Kafka, Snowflake, etc. 
 - Industry momentum has seen CRD grow over 135% in headcount over the last 5 years, and we continue to grow. As a digital innovation leader, we invest into our solutions, processes, systems, and talent. 
 - As a part of our talent growth strategy, CRD Engineering is actively hiring in Dublin as we are investing in growing our European presence. Our senior leadership team will be hosting in-person interview panels during our recruiting drive in the late September 2024. 

Summary

- Work as a senior member of automation center of excellence team to execute the overall quality plan for Charles River's products. Provide support and assistance to customers and other teams within Charles River. 
 - The candidate should be a sharp automation framework engineer with strong problem-solving skills and a solid automation test framework building foundation. This role requires a talented, detail oriented, enthusiastic individual who is passionate about quality with the ability to grasp tough issues quickly and deliver well engineered, high-quality solutions. 
 - We are looking for a strong software engineer to build out the next generation of our software test automation framework and infrastructure as part of our Quality Assurance Infrastructure team. The candidate will be responsible for developing, delivering and supporting the software infrastructure that enables automated product validation. This position provides services for planning and the execution of central automated regression runs for all product departments. In addition, this candidate is responsible for maintaining and expanding the labs which host both automated and manual testing as well as conducting staging and certification of the product media during the ship-stage of a release. 
 - Financial services industry experience is preferred. 

Responsibilities

- Work closely with the scrum master, product owner, architect, business analysts, product specialists, developers and other project team members to assist in carrying out the software quality responsibilities of the Scrum team
 - Expand the test automation framework capabilities needed to comprehensively test business requirements for all products and services
 - Create pipelines to execute automated functional, integration, regression, and performance tests
 - Maintain automated and manual test script libraries for functional, integration, regression, and performance testing
 - Align with the Software Development Life Cycle practices, comply with Information Security and Data Governance practices
 - Interpret results of automation tests and document software defects in issue tracking system; proactively communicate issues with developers and other project team members
 - Provide testing leadership by identifying opportunities for improvement in the Scrum team's QA methodology, innovate by researching and recommending new approaches to automation of testing, including use of Artificial Intelligence
 - Adhere to a testing schedule to ensure efficient and effective product delivery
 - Actively participate in the agile software development process by adhering to the CRD Scrum methodology including attending all daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives
 - Participate in "testathon" activities as required by releases
 - Guide and mentor junior staff in best practices and proper creation of automated test scripts. 

Qualifications

Education: 

B. S. degree (or foreign education equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, and Physics or other technical course of study or Business with an MIS background. MS degree strongly preferred. 

- Experience: 
 - 10-12 years of experience in building test automation frameworks in enterprise world and in a process driven technology environment
 - Demonstrated experience programming with JAVA, SQL and shell scripting languages such as PowerShell and Bash
 - Demonstrated experience implementing automation framework with industry standard tools like Rest Assured, Playwright, Azure SDK, Kafka SDK, Cosmos DB, Swagger, Silk4Net, FlaUI, Talend strongly preferred
 - Demonstrated experience implementing and executing automation test scripts against web, native/desktop applications, APIs and batch applications. 
 - Experience with creating and updating on-demand pipelines and experience with relevant tools TeamCity, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo CD is preferred
 - Demonstrated experience using test cases, scripts, and automated test tools for verifying requirements on multi-tier applications
 - Demonstrated ability translating business requirements into comprehensive functional and technical test plans
 - Knowledgeable in one or more CRD functional areas is a plus
 - A minimum of 3 years working with an Agile development methodology strongly desired
 - Effective written and verbal communication.

data.title: Principal, Software Engineer
data.description:
About The Team

Run Time Platforms (RTP), a division of Global Technology Platform (GTP), builds the core products and platforms that enable application teams to deploy, operate, and scale services consistently across Walmart's runtime environments. RTP's mission is to reduce operational complexity and accelerate delivery by providing secure-by-default, reliable, and standardized runtime capabilities-so teams can focus on building customer and associate experiences rather than reinventing infrastructure. 

Within RTP, the Service Registry & Service Mesh team provides the foundational connectivity layer for modern distributed systems. We build and operate platforms that make it easy for services to find each other, communicate securely, and be governed consistently across clusters, environments, and markets. Our work underpins service-to-service communication for a large fleet of microservices and supports high-throughput, latency-sensitive workloads. 

What You'll Do

Lead the technical strategy and architecture for the service mesh platform (e. g. , Istio or equivalent) across multi-cluster, multi-environment deployments. 

Drive design and implementation of traffic management, resiliency patterns, and secure service-to-service communication (mTLS, authZ/authN, policy). 

Build and evolve platform capabilities for onboarding services at scale (templates, golden paths, automation, self-service workflows). 

Partner with application, SRE, security, and network teams to define standards for service connectivity, identity, and zero-trust posture. 

Own performance, reliability, and scalability goals for the mesh control/data plane; define SLOs/SLIs and operational runbooks. 

Establish observability standards (metrics, logs, traces) and enable end-to-end visibility across services and clusters. 

Provide hands-on technical leadership for incident response, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation. 

Evaluate and introduce new mesh capabilities (ambient/service-less patterns, gateways, WASM/extensibility, multi-tenancy) with clear ROI. 

Mentor senior engineers, raise engineering rigor (design reviews, technical docs, testing strategy), and influence org-wide adoption. 

Represent the team in architecture forums; communicate trade-offs and align stakeholders on platform roadmaps. 

What You'll bring

15-20 years of industry experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems and platforms. 

Deep expertise in Kubernetes/container orchestration (cluster architecture, networking, upgrades, multi-cluster, RBAC, admission, controllers/operators). 

Strong hands-on experience with service mesh technologies (Istio preferred; Linkerd/Consul/App Mesh acceptable), including: 

Traffic management (routing, retries/timeouts, circuit breaking)

Security (mTLS, cert management, identity, policy)

Gateways/ingress/egress patterns and service discovery

Control plane operations and upgrade strategies

Strong understanding of cloud-native networking (CNI, Envoy/L7 proxies, DNS, east-west traffic, gateways, load balancing). 

Proven track record of designing for reliability and scale: SRE principles, SLOs, capacity planning, and failure-mode analysis. 

Experience building platform tooling and automation (GitOps, CI/CD, Helm/Kustomize, Terraform or similar IaC). 

Proficiency in at least one systems language (Go preferred; Java/Scala/Python acceptable) and experience building operators/controllers is a plus. 

Deep observability experience (Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing) and ability to translate telemetry into action. 

Strong security mindset (zero trust, least privilege, secret management) and experience partnering with security/compliance teams. 

Excellent communication skills-able to drive alignment across engineering orgs and influence without authority. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people

data.title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
data.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. 

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. 

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical. 

Job Summary

The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users. 

As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation. 

In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company. 

You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community. 

As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

- Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
 - Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
 - Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
 - Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
 - Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
 - Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
 - Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
 - Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
 - Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
 - Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
 - Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations

What we are looking for in you

- A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds. 
 - A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions. 
 - Python software development experience, with large projects
 - Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems. 
 - Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code. 
 - Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
 - Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
 - Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
 - Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
 - Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
 - Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
 - Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
 - A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
 - Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
 - Happy to work within distributed teams
 - Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. 

- Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
 - Personal learning and development budget of USD 2, 000 per year
 - Annual compensation review
 - Recognition rewards
 - Annual holiday leave
 - Maternity and paternity leave
 - Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
 - Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
 - Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. 

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

data.title: Team Member-Cell Quality
data.description:
Responsibilities

Quality Management & Assurance

- Ensure adherence to quality standards and specifications throughout the solar cell manufacturing process. 
 - Develop, implement, and monitor quality control plans, inspection methodologies, and testing procedures. 
 - Drive in-process quality checks and final product audits to ensure compliance with customer and regulatory requirements. 
 - Lead quality improvement projects to reduce defects, enhance yield, and improve process capability. 

Process Monitoring & Control

- Analyze quality trends, process deviations, and manufacturing parameters to identify improvement opportunities. 
 - Monitor key quality KPIs such as yield, defect density, scrap rates, reliability performance, and customer complaints. 
 - Collaborate with production and process engineering teams to establish robust process controls. 

Defect Analysis & Corrective Actions

- Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for quality failures, product non-conformities, and customer complaints. 
 - Implement CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions) to eliminate recurring quality issues. 
 - Utilize quality tools such as 8D, Fishbone Analysis, FMEA, SPC, Six Sigma, and Statistical Analysis techniques. 

Reliability & Product Performance

- Support reliability testing and validation activities to ensure product performance and long-term durability. 
 - Monitor cell efficiency trends and performance metrics to achieve quality and yield targets. 
 - Coordinate failure analysis activities with relevant stakeholders and laboratories. 

Supplier & Incoming Quality Management

- Review incoming material quality and collaborate with suppliers to resolve quality concerns. 
 - Conduct supplier performance assessments and quality improvement initiatives as required. 
 - Ensure compliance of raw materials with defined specifications and standards. 

Audits & Compliance

- Ensure adherence to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and other relevant quality management systems. 
 - Participate in internal, external, customer, and certification audits. 
 - Maintain quality documentation, SOPs, process records, and audit readiness. 

Stakeholder Management

- Work closely with Production, Process Engineering, Maintenance, Technology, and Supply Chain teams. 
 - Support product qualification, process transfers, and new technology implementation projects. 
 - Mentor and guide team members on quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement methodologies. 

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

- Prepare and present quality dashboards, reports, and performance reviews to management. 
 - Lead Kaizen initiatives focused on manufacturing excellence and operational efficiency. 
 - Drive a culture of quality awareness and continuous improvement across the manufacturing organization. 

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

- B. E. /B. Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Chemical, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - M. Tech/MBA in Operations, Quality, or Manufacturing Management will be an added advantage. 

Experience

- Minimum 4-6 years of experience in Solar Cell Manufacturing, Semiconductor, Electronics Manufacturing, or High-Technology Manufacturing industries. 
 - Hands-on experience in solar cell manufacturing processes, defect reduction, yield improvement, and quality management systems.

Job Description

Do you want to lead the integration backbone that connects systems, data, and business processes across the enterprise?

As Tech Lead for our API & Integration team, you'll drive the technical direction of a critical integration landscape built on the Azure integration stack. You'll shape integration architectures, set engineering standards, and lead by example in code-balancing new integration development with the stabilization and evolution of existing interfaces to ensure reliability, scalability, and security. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who enjoys designing clean APIs, building resilient event and message-driven integrations, and guiding teams through complex system landscapes-turning connectivity challenges into robust, well-governed Azure solutions. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
 - Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD. 
 - Technical direction for the product area. 
 - Contribute to coordinating cross team dependencies and integration points. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Contribute to the feature definition and review. 
 - Generate concepts and facilitate concept selection. 
 - Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks. 
 - Helping with estimation and sprint planning.

Skillset: Golang with service mesh platform (e. g. , Istio or equivalent)

Experience range: 11 to 16 years

About the team

Run Time Platforms (RTP), a division of Global Technology Platform (GTP), builds the core products and platforms that enable application teams to deploy, operate, and scale services consistently across Walmart's runtime environments. RTP's mission is to reduce operational complexity and accelerate delivery by providing secure-by-default, reliable, and standardized runtime capabilities-so teams can focus on building customer and associate experiences rather than reinventing infrastructure. 

Within RTP, the Service Registry & Service Mesh team provides the foundational connectivity layer for modern distributed systems. We build and operate platforms that make it easy for services to find each other, communicate securely, and be governed consistently across clusters, environments, and markets. Our work underpins service-to-service communication for a large fleet of microservices and supports high-throughput, latency-sensitive workloads. 

What You'll Do

Lead the technical strategy and architecture for the service mesh platform (e. g. , Istio or equivalent) across multi-cluster, multi-environment deployments. 

- Drive design and implementation of traffic management, resiliency patterns, and secure service-to-service communication (mTLS, authZ/authN, policy). 
 - Build and evolve platform capabilities for onboarding services at scale (templates, golden paths, automation, self-service workflows). 
 - Partner with application, SRE, security, and network teams to define standards for service connectivity, identity, and zero-trust posture. 
 - Own performance, reliability, and scalability goals for the mesh control/data plane; define SLOs/SLIs and operational runbooks. 
 - Establish observability standards (metrics, logs, traces) and enable end-to-end visibility across services and clusters. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership for incident response, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new mesh capabilities (ambient/service-less patterns, gateways, WASM/extensibility, multi-tenancy) with clear ROI. 
 - Mentor senior engineers, raise engineering rigor (design reviews, technical docs, testing strategy), and influence org-wide adoption. 
 - Represent the team in architecture forums; communicate trade-offs and align stakeholders on platform roadmaps. 

What You'll bring

- 12-18 years of industry experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems and platforms. 
 - Deep expertise in Kubernetes/container orchestration (cluster architecture, networking, upgrades, multi-cluster, RBAC, admission, controllers/operators). 
 - Strong hands-on experience with service mesh technologies (Istio preferred; Linkerd/Consul/App Mesh acceptable), including: 
 - Traffic management (routing, retries/timeouts, circuit breaking)
 - Proficiency in at least one systems language (Go preferred; Java/Scala/Python acceptable) and experience building operators/controllers is a plus. 
 - Security (mTLS, cert management, identity, policy)
 - Gateways/ingress/egress patterns and service discovery
 - Control plane operations and upgrade strategies
 - Strong understanding of cloud-native networking (CNI, Envoy/L7 proxies, DNS, east-west traffic, gateways, load balancing). 
 - Proven track record of designing for reliability and scale: SRE principles, SLOs, capacity planning, and failure-mode analysis. 
 - Experience building platform tooling and automation (GitOps, CI/CD, Helm/Kustomize, Terraform or similar IaC). 
 - Deep observability experience (Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing) and ability to translate telemetry into action. 
 - Strong security mindset (zero trust, least privilege, secret management) and experience partnering with security/compliance teams. 
 - Excellent communication skills-able to drive alignment across engineering orgs and influence without authority. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

data.title: Software QA Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

This role plans and executes complete software testing, develops simulated input/output and function-testing programs, investigates difficult and sometimes complex defects, and delivers decision-ready reports to the U. S. -based engineering team. The engineer works with limited supervision, coaches lower-level test professionals, and improves reusable test coverage and release qualification practices. Strong CODESYS Structured Text capability is expected. 

Responsibilities

- Independently lead functional, regression, integration, system, failure-mode, and recovery testing across ESP, HPS, PCP, LACT, and choke applications. 
 - Develop risk-based test plans and traceable cases from requirements, control narratives, I/O documents, alarm lists, procedures, and release changes. 
 - Create simulated testing programs and reusable test harnesses for supported input/output types, device states, signals, sequences, and functions. 
 - Use CODESYS and IEC 61131-3 Structured Text to build or modify simulation logic for normal, abnormal, boundary, fault, communications-loss, and recovery scenarios. 
 - Validate calculations, controls, interlocks, alarms, state transitions, trends, reports, historian data, communications, user interfaces, and data integrity. 
 - Produce test reports with pass/fail status, test case, expected result, actual result, evidence, defects, and remaining risks. 
 - Investigate and reproduce difficult or complex defects across application, controls, configuration, communications, data, and environment layers. 
 - Lead overnight release validation and regression testing, prioritize findings, and provide a complete handoff before the U. S. workday. 
 - Coach and review the work of lower-level QA professionals and promote consistent test evidence, defect quality, and reporting standards. 
 - Recommend improvements to test coverage, simulation, automation, test data, and defect-prevention practices. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, instrumentation, automation, or a related field. 
 - Typically 3-5 years of relevant software QA, industrial automation, controls, SCADA, or production-software experience, with demonstrated ability to work at a senior professional level. 

Job Requirements

- Demonstrated ability to manage testing projects or processes independently with limited supervision. 
 - Proven ability to design simulated I/O and function-testing programs and validate behavior without relying solely on live equipment. 
 - Strong experience with requirements traceability, defect lifecycle management, root-cause investigation, and release qualification. 
 - Ability to distinguish software defects from configuration, communications, data, controls, and operational issues. 
 - Strong technical writing skills and ability to communicate pass/fail, expected versus actual behavior, evidence, impact, and actions. 
 - Ability to coach and review lower-level professionals while maintaining personal accountability for overnight results. 
 - Ability to work independently during Kochi off-hours aligned with U. S. Central Time coverage and provide a reliable written handoff. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Ownership and sound judgment when working with limited supervision. 
 - Analytical persistence when isolating difficult or intermittent problems. 
 - Clear, factual, and concise communication across time zones and disciplines. 
 - Constructive coaching and willingness to review and improve others' work. 
 - Rigor, consistency, and commitment to traceable evidence. 

Technical Competencies

- Advanced knowledge of functional, integration, regression, system, failure-mode, and release testing. 
 - Strong CODESYS and IEC 61131-3 Structured Text programming skills for simulation, virtual I/O, test utilities, or control validation. 
 - Working knowledge of PLC, HMI, SCADA, RTU, VFD, industrial networks, and device communications. 
 - Experience analyzing application logs, SQL or historian data, communication traces, and automated test results. 
 - Familiarity with test-management, issue-tracking, Git, scripting, API, or comparable engineering tools. 

About Us

Every day, the oil and gas industry's best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success. 

We Power the Industry that Powers the World

Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success-now and in the future. 

Global Family

We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work. 

Purposeful Innovation

Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better. 

Service Above All

This drives us to anticipate our customers' needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

data.title: QA Engineer
data.description:
Quality Assurance

Royal York Property Management is hiring a full-time QA Engineer to own manual testing for in-house web portals before changes go live. The role focuses on test cases, staging checks, mobile testing, CRM sync verification, clear bug reporting and release go or no-go decisions. 

About Royal York Property Management

Royal York Property Management is based in Ontario, Canada and works in the real estate sector. The company says it manages clients' investment properties with the same dedication and care it would apply to its own properties, with a focus on clients, tenants and meticulous property management standards. 

About The Role

This QA Engineer role owns testing for in-house web portals before changes go live. The work begins when a developer marks a change ready to test and ends when the change is live and checked on production with a read-only test account. 

Day to day, the role involves reading what a change is meant to do, writing test cases, testing on a staging copy across desktop and mobile, checking that data reaches CRM correctly and logging clear bugs with steps to reproduce. Once a fix is ready, the QA Engineer retests it and gives the final go or no-go before release. 

The person works closely with developers and the product owner, and sometimes with recruiters who report problems. The first 60 days include building a regression checklist for core flows such as apply, interview, AI evaluation, status change and CRM sync, offer and onboarding. 

Someone will do well in this role if they are disciplined about written test records, curious enough to check data behind the screen and confident enough to explain release risk plainly when an urgent change could affect real candidates. 

What you will do

- Own manual QA for every change to the different portals before the change reaches live users. 
 - Pick up changes when a developer marks them ready to test, read what the change is meant to do and create practical test cases for staging. 
 - Test each change across desktop and mobile views, check relevant data behind the screen and confirm that CRM receives the expected status or data changes. 
 - Review open bugs with developers and the product owner, retest fixes and make clear go or no-go recommendations before release. 
 - Keep the regression checklist current as the portals change, especially around apply, interview, AI evaluation, status change, CRM sync, offer and onboarding flows. 
 - Reduce bugs found after release by at least 50% within the first 3 months by catching defects before they reach live users. 
 - Ensure every change that goes live has a written test record within 1 working day of being marked ready, including what was tested, on which devices and whether it passed or failed. 
 - Learn the two portals, the staging and production release flow, the main candidate and recruiter user journeys and how CRM sync affects real users. 
 - Build and run a regression checklist for the core flows covering apply, interview, AI evaluation, status change and CRM sync, offer and onboarding. 
 - Show a measurable drop in post-release bugs and establish a reliable release-testing rhythm that developers and the product owner can trust. 
 - A successful QA Engineer catches defects before users see them, writes bugs developers can reproduce immediately and makes release risk clear without slowing the team unnecessarily. 
 - People struggle when they only click through the visible page, skip data and CRM checks or sign off on urgent releases without understanding the effect on real candidates. 
 - The role is full-time and hybrid, working Monday to Friday with daily collaboration with developers and the product owner and occasional contact with recruiters reporting issues. 
 - The person will handle urgent release requests, bulk score recalculations, CRM status changes, mobile-only defects that are hard to reproduce and vague bug reports from recruiters. 

What we are looking for

- Candidates must have at least 2 years of manual quality assurance experience testing web applications before release. 
 - Candidates must have experience writing test cases from a change description and keeping a written test record showing what was tested, on which device and whether it passed or failed. 
 - Candidates must have experience writing bug reports with clear steps to reproduce so that a developer can act on the report without asking follow-up questions. 
 - Candidates must have experience retesting fixed defects and making a clear go or no-go recommendation before a release. 
 - Candidates must be able to test web changes across desktop browsers and mobile browsers, including different screen sizes where layout or responsive behaviour may fail. 
 - Candidates must be comfortable checking a saved database row to confirm that the data shown on a web page has been stored correctly. 
 - Candidates must be comfortable reading an API response to confirm that data moving between systems matches what the user sees on the page. 
 - Candidates must be able to build and run regression checks for core flows such as applying, interviewing, evaluation, status changes, offers and onboarding. 
 - No formal QA certification is required for this role. 
 - English - strong written working proficiency is required for test cases, bug reports and communication with developers, the product owner and recruiters. 
 - Candidates must be able to explain release risks in plain written English when a change may affect live users, CRM statuses or candidate communications. 
 - Candidates must be able to ask recruiters for useful reproduction details such as screenshots, screen recordings, phone model, browser and time of issue when a mobile defect is unclear. 
 - Candidates must be legally authorised to work as an employee from the country where they will perform this remote role. 
 - Candidates must be willing to complete standard pre-employment verification of identity, work authorisation and employment history if requested. 
 - Candidates must be able to work remotely on a computer for the full Monday to Friday schedule and test changes across desktop and mobile devices during the working day. 
 - Candidates must be available to work full time Monday to Friday, 9: 00 AM to 5: 00 PM EST. 

Nice to have

- Experience testing business applications or SaaS products with user logins and role-based access is preferred. 
 - Experience with recruiting software or HR software and Property Management is an advantage. 
 - Experience testing integrations involving CRM is preferred. 
 - Basic automation experience using Playwright is an advantage. 
 - Basic automation experience using Cypress is an advantage. 
 - Basic test automation experience using PHPUnit in a Laravel or PHP application is an advantage. 
 - A post-secondary qualification in computer science, information technology, software engineering or a related technical field is preferred. 
 - Equivalent practical QA experience on web applications may be considered where the candidate can show strong test case writing and defect reporting. 
 - Study or training in software testing, web development or information systems is relevant to this role. 
 - An ISTQB Foundation Level certification or equivalent software testing certification is an advantage. 
 - Candidates should be able to show a track record of preventing defects from reaching live users through structured test cases, regression checks and careful retesting. 

What we offer

CAD $10, 000 to $20, 000 per year. 

Benefits

- Paid sick days

Schedule

Full-time employee role with a hybrid work model. The regular schedule is Monday to Friday, 9: 00 AM to 5: 00 PM EST. 

What happens next

Our recruitment partner will be in touch with you about your application. 

If you meet the requirements for the role, they will send you a link to an online video interview that you complete in your own time - there is no appointment to book and nothing to install. 

Your completed interview is then shared with us to review alongside your application, and we will let you know what happens next. 

See All Open Roles

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
At Tecsys, the software we deliver keeps hospitals, pharmacies and distributors supplied with what they need, when they need it. Every role here connects to that outcome. 

Why This Role Matters

As a Site Reliability Engineer you will join our Network and Security Operations Center (NSOC), a team at the heart of platform reliability for our mission-critical SaaS environments. You'll respond to incidents, keep day-to-day operations running smoothly, and lead improvements and automation that cut repetitive work and technical debt. By finding the root cause of recurring issues and fixing them for good, you'll make our platform more dependable for the healthcare and distribution customers who rely on it, and leave a lasting impact on the team. 

What You'll Be Part Of

Tecsys is trusted by mission-critical organizations in healthcare and distribution to power resilient, efficient and secure supply chains. We are a global provider of cloud-based, AI-driven software, publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: TCS). 

Three values guide how we work. We earn trust daily by valuing the customer and acting with integrity. We build each other up by recognizing individual strengths and working as one team. And we explore boldly by staying curious and adapting for success. 

You'll join a culture driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and people who challenge what's possible. 

Requirements

What You'll Do

- Respond to and resolve P1-P4 incidents during your day hours, working closely with the NOC team across North America and India 
 - Dig into repeat incidents to find the root cause and put fixes in place so they don't come back 
 - Handle recurring operational work, including onboarding and offboarding requests and monitoring changes 
 - Run regular backup checks and infrastructure reliability checks 
 - Build automation and improvements that reduce manual effort and technical debt for the team 
 - Contribute to projects that leave a lasting impact, such as our backup architecture redesign, which strengthens how we protect backups from a security perspective 
 - Develop tooling and automation on top of AWS and Azure to continuously reduce the need for manual intervention. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field 
 - Strong background with at least 3+ years of experience working in a technical SaaS environment 
 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, AWS and Azure at scale 
 - Hands-on expertise with Infrastructure as Code and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, or similar) 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred, Jenkins acceptable) and monitoring and observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent), including metrics, alerting and dashboards 
 - Experience with monitoring and alert handling 
 - Solid incident management experience, including on-call rotations, escalations, and postmortem

Benefits

- Benefits (Insurance and access to learning platform) and vacation from day one 
 - Flexible work environment
 - Regular Employee Engagement initiatives 
 - Room to learn, stretch and take on new challenges 
 - Collaboration with global teams 
 - We foster an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. 

If this role fits what you are looking for, apply today. If you are not actively searching but want to hear more, we are glad to talk

Apply today and discover what you could build, solve, and achieve with Tecsys!

data.description:

 - Write clean, maintainable code aligned with SOLID principles and front-end best practices

 - Understanding of hybrid UI solutions and experience transitioning applications from one framework to another

At N-able, our mission is to protect businesses against evolving cyberthreats with an end-to-end cyber resilience platform to manage, secure, and recover. Our scalable technology infrastructure includes AI-powered capabilities, market-leading third-party integrations, and the flexibility to employ technologies of choice-to transform workflows and deliver critical security outcomes. Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life: 

Financial wellness

We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs. 

Physical wellness

We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness. 

Personal wellness

We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life. 

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.
