data.title: Software Development Engineer, RBS Tech
data.description:
Description

Are you excited about building the future of Retail Automation powered by Generative AI?

Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enriches ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination, where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow; and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops intelligent automation powered by GenAI, LLM and Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of highly complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. 

Why join us

We believe in "Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History" value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you love designing elegant abstractions for messy real world problems, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you get a kick out of seeing your code improve the shopping experience for millions of customers worldwide, we definitely need you. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too. 

About The Role

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands, customer obsession is part of our company DNA. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer II to join the SAMAI team and help us push the boundaries of what's possible with Generative AI in retail automation. As an SDE2, you will not just write code, you will architect systems that think. You will design scalable, distributed platforms that orchestrate LLM powered agents, build robust pipelines that process millions of data points daily, and make critical design trade offs that directly influence a multi billion dollar business. You will work at the intersection of Generative AI, distributed systems and real world business impact. Every system you build will be tested against the unforgiving scale of Amazon's catalog, hundreds of millions of ASINs, dozens of marketplaces and billions of customer interactions. You will collaborate closely with Applied Scientists and senior engineers to turn research into production systems that work at scale. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges. 

If you enjoy designing and building GenAI powered platforms, highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come join us!

Work/Life Balance

RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal and Senior Engineers from RBS Tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'Reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications. And on a team building Gen AI systems every day, the learning opportunities are endless. 

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for a sharp, experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e. g. , system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc. ). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new team-mates on how your team's software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture. 

About The Team

We are building SAMAI, our Gen AI powered automation platform that is redefining how RBS delivers at scale. SAMAI harnesses the power of LLMs, agentic AI workflows and ML to automate complex retail business processes end to end. Think of it as the brain behind RBS's next generation automation, orchestrating intelligent agents that can reason, act and deliver outcomes that previously needed hundreds of human hours. We are not just using Gen AI as a feature; we are building a platform that makes GenAI the foundation of retail operations. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language
 - Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
 - Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: Sub System Test Engineer – IXL - Railway Infrastructure
data.description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you'd make an extraordinary addition to our vibrant international team. 

We are looking for a Sub System Test Engineer: IXL - Railway Infrastructure

Work assignments: 

Responsibility for the test execution/management of mass transit or main line rollouts of Interlocking (IxL) projects for CBTC/ Non-CBTC signaling Systems as part of large-scale railway infrastructure projects. Ensuring economic success and (internal) customer satisfaction for IxL domain in CBTC/ Non-CBTC application projects Carrying responsibility for the lab data testing scope. Representation of the Test Team within a project when communicating to internal stakeholders, whilst reporting to the line management (test manager/group lead). Ensuring compliance with defined procedures/processes. 

Exploration of further business opportunities: 

Identification and exploitation of additional business opportunities during project implementation, e. g. identifying Change Requests or extending the scope towards project needs. 

You'll make a difference by: 

- Preparation of test checklist specific to project and Develop test specification / test cases as per IXL design requirement specifications. 
 - Responsible for data lab testing of IxL Sub-systems in Test lab using real and simulated test environments. 
 - Review / verification of all documents related to Lab data testing. 
 - Evaluation of project, customer, rolling stock and internal requirements towards implementing suitable project specific test cases and test documentation. 
 - Detailed knowhow on functional aspects of IxL and its interface with other subsystems like ATC and ATS with CBTC/non-CBTC. 
 - Knowledge about testing and commissioning process and Strategy. 
 - Work with development team to identify and capture test cases, ensure version management
 - Knowledge of test automation for IxL testing
 - Setting up test environments, writing test scripts and implementing test cases/scenarios. 
 - Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned people. 
 - Reviewing test logs and results to identify failures, raising CFXs in the change and defect management tool, participating in CCB meetings, and providing test inputs. 
 - Interfacing/Clarification with senior test engineer, test manager, System Manager/Sub PM, Validation, RAMS and project teams. 
 - Interfacing with HQ teams towards tooling requirements, developing/adapting templates/schematics, and parameterization. 
 - Able to support installation and tests activities/teams onsite if required. 
 - Understanding other subsystems like ATS, ATC, Communication and Diagnostic Systems. 
 - Knowledge of Projects Support functions (RM/DM/CM) and Quality Management. 

Essential Soft and Hard skills for IXL Functional Tester: 

- Basic Knowledge of Linux. 
 - Experience with VMware. 
 - Networking knowledge. 
 - Troubleshooting skills for the Test Environment. 
 - Ability to understand and implement IP addressing, subnetting, interface configuration, routing principles, and gateway setup. 
 - Fundamental understanding of server environments, including ESXi and Windows. 
 - Practical experience with Siemens products, particularly WKII, R9k, TGMT, and TG200, will be an added advantage. 

You'll win us over by: 

- Degree in electrical or electronics engineering. 
 - Professional experience of minimum 5 years in railway transportation systems (Main line / Mass Transit) with the focus on testing in IXL sub-system (CBTC / Non CBTC). 
 - Performed hands on testing activities for IXL subsystem besides understanding of operational scenarios, requirements, and interfaces. 
 - Experience with Functional testing, lab testing, test setups. Experience with Integration tests and SAT would be an added advantage. 
 - Proficient English essential both written and oral, knowledge of German/Spanish is an asset
 - Independent and structured approach to work. 

Join us and be yourself!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. 

This role is based in Pune, where you'll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come. 

We're Siemens. A collection of over 312, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow. 

Find out more about Siemens careers at: www. siemens. com/careers & more about mobility at https: //new. siemens. com/global/en/products/mobility. html

 - Good communication skills. Must be fluent in the English language.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, And Other Characteristics

- Communication skills

data.description:
About Us: 

Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12, 000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world. 

Job Description: 

Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business. 

At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we've grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city's Top 150 Privately Held Companies. 

What truly sets us apart is our culture-rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results. 

In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services-providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide. 

Our culture is built on: 

- Ownership - Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment. 
 - Flexibility - A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time. 
 - Empowerment - Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact. 
 - Learning and Growth - Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development. 

Career Development and Global Exposure

At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You'll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you'll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive. 

If you're ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment-where long-term stability meets start-up agility-and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we'd love to hear from you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Engineer - Controls with 8+ years of experience in the design, development, modification, migration, integration, and implementation of PLC and HMI/SCADA systems for discrete machinery and equipment. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen-Bradley (Rockwell Automation), and Beckhoff automation platforms. Experience in printing, paper converting, packaging, textile, or other machinery/OEM industries is highly preferred. 

The engineer should be able to take a systems approach to understand the overall machine design, mechanical functions, electrical architecture, control philosophy, safety systems, and automation requirements, and develop robust PLC and HMI programs ensuring the overall functional quality and performance of the machinery/equipment. 

The role will be responsible for the interface between electrical hardware, PLC software, HMI/SCADA, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, and machine-level automation. 

Technical Skills

PLC & HMI Platforms

Strong hands-on experience in one or more of the following platforms, with the ability to work across multiple automation platforms: 

- Siemens S7-1200 / S7-1500 PLCs
 - Siemens Comfort Panels / Unified Comfort Panels
 - Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation PLCs
 - ControlLogix
 - CompactLogix
 - Beckhoff PLC / IPC-based control systems
 - TwinCAT 3
 - EtherCAT
 - Experience with HMI/SCADA development and integration across Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms. 

PLC & HMI Development

- Hands-on experience developing PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on URS, functional specifications, and client standards. 
 - Ability to understand and develop PLC programs using: 
 - Ladder Logic
 - Function Block Diagram
 - Structured Text
 - Sequential Function Chart
 - Develop machine sequences, interlocks, alarms, permissives, recipes, diagnostics, and operator interfaces. 
 - Interface PLC programs with HMI/SCADA systems. 
 - Experience in modifying, debugging, migrating, and optimizing existing PLC/HMI programs. 
 - Experience with machine-level automation and discrete manufacturing applications. 
 - HMI scripting/programming experience using JavaScript, C#, or similar technologies is an added advantage. 

Siemens Automation

- Strong hands-on experience with Siemens S7-1500 PLCs. 
 - Experience with TIA Portal V15. 1 or above. 
 - TIA Portal V17/V18/V19 or later experience preferred. 
 - Siemens Comfort and Unified Comfort HMI development. 
 - PLC/HMI programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, and debugging. 
 - Experience with Siemens drives and motion systems is preferred. 

Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation

- Hands-on experience with Allen-Bradley PLCs. 
 - Experience with ControlLogix and/or CompactLogix platforms. 
 - Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix programming experience. 
 - Allen-Bradley HMI experience using FactoryTalk View is preferred. 
 - Experience with Rockwell drives, I/O, communication networks, and motion systems is an advantage. 

Beckhoff Automation

- Hands-on experience with Beckhoff PLC/control systems. 
 - Experience with TwinCAT 3 programming and development. 
 - Knowledge of EtherCAT communication and distributed I/O systems. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff IPCs, motion control, servo systems, and drives is preferred. 
 - Experience developing machine control applications using Structured Text is an advantage. 

Industrial Communication & Networking

Good understanding of industrial communication protocols and networking, including: 

- PROFINET / PROFIBUS
 - EtherNet/IP
 - EtherCAT
 - AS-i
 - CAN / CANopen
 - DeviceNet
 - Modbus TCP/RTU
 - OPC UA
 - Other industrial Ethernet and fieldbus protocols

Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and integrate PLCs, remote I/O, drives, HMIs, sensors, and other automation devices over industrial networks. 

Drives, Motors & Motion Control

- Knowledge of selection and application of motors, motor controllers, VFDs, servo drives, and motion-control systems. 
 - Understanding of: 
 - Motor horsepower
 - Torque
 - Speed range
 - Gear ratios
 - Reduction ratios
 - Acceleration/deceleration
 - Experience with Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Beckhoff drives is preferred. 
 - Basic understanding of servo positioning and motion-control applications. 

Instrumentation & Control Components

Good understanding of selection and application of industrial control components, including: 

- Sensors for flow, pressure, level, temperature, position, speed, counters, motion, vision, etc. 
 - Digital and analog sensors
 - Proximity and photoelectric sensors
 - Encoders
 - Transducers
 - Solenoid valves
 - Relays
 - Contactors
 - On/Off control devices
 - Analog I/O and signal conditioning
 - A/D and D/A conversion
 - I/P and P/I conversion

Understanding of sensor characteristics such as accuracy, precision, response time, repeatability, reliability, range, and environmental/temperature effects. 

FAT, SAT & Commissioning

- Develop automation test cases and procedures for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). 
 - Participate in FAT/SAT with customers and project teams. 
 - Hands-on experience in machine installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and start-up. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, I/O, communication, and machine sequence issues. 
 - Experience with remote commissioning and troubleshooting tools. 
 - Willingness to travel to customer sites for commissioning and project support. 

Standards & Compliance

Working knowledge of applicable industry codes, standards, and regulations such as: 

- ANSI
 - ISA
 - NEC
 - NEMA
 - NFPA
 - OSHA
 - UL

Experience working with machine safety systems and safety PLCs is an added advantage. 

Tool Skills

Mandatory / Core

- Siemens TIA Portal - V15. 1 or above
 - Siemens S7-1500 PLC
 - Siemens Comfort / Unified Comfort HMI
 - Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Studio 5000
 - ControlLogix / CompactLogix
 - Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
 - EtherCAT

Preferred

- TIA Portal V17+
 - FactoryTalk View
 - Siemens / Rockwell / Beckhoff drives and motion systems
 - OPC UA
 - Industrial Ethernet networking
 - HMI scripting / C# / JavaScript
 - EPLAN or similar electrical engineering tools

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline. 
 - 8+ years of experience in industrial automation and controls engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in PLC and HMI programming. 
 - Experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms is strongly preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience developing PLC/HMI programs from scratch. 
 - Experience in machinery/OEM applications is highly preferred. 
 - Experience in printing, packaging, paper converting, textile, or other discrete machinery industries is an advantage. 
 - Experience in machine commissioning and customer-site support is preferred. 

Key Result Areas

- Configure automation hardware and software according to project design specifications. 
 - Develop PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on machine automation requirements. 
 - Integrate Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff automation platforms with machine hardware and control systems. 
 - Ensure optimal performance, reliability, quality, and responsiveness of PLC/HMI applications. 
 - Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, motion, I/O, and industrial communication issues. 
 - Follow software development, change-management, and version-control procedures. 
 - Maintain proper documentation of PLC/HMI software and project changes. 
 - Manage assigned projects and deliver according to agreed schedules and scope. 
 - Communicate project progress, technical issues, and risks to project stakeholders. 
 - Support FAT, SAT, machine start-up, commissioning, and customer acceptance. 
 - Provide technical support to internal teams and customers as required. 

Soft Skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Logical and systematic approach to problem-solving. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. 
 - Ability to understand complex machine sequences and identify key technical issues. 
 - Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. 
 - Strong customer-facing and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and changing project requirements. 
 - Willingness to learn and work across multiple automation platforms. 

Travel

Occasional domestic and/or international travel may be required, up to 15%, for customer meetings, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project support. 

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a multi-platform Controls Engineer with strong practical experience in: 

Siemens + Allen-Bradley + Beckhoff

with hands-on capability in: 

PLC Programming → HMI Development → Drives/Motion → Industrial Communication → Machine Integration → FAT/SAT → Commissioning

Experience with OEM/discrete machinery, particularly printing, packaging, paper converting, or textile machinery, will be a strong advantage.

data.title: VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring
data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - 3, 000 Tideans globally
 - Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide. 

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny. 

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide. 

As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring You Will

- Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
 - Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
 - Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
 - Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
 - Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
 - Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
 - Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
 - Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
 - Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
 - Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment. 

What We Are Looking For

- Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
 - Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
 - Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development 
 - Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
 - Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
 - Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
 - Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

What You'll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

- Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options. 
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office. 
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. 
 - All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. 
 - Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide. co email address. 
 - Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. 

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide. co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy. 

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Education And Work Experience

Hazelcast is hiring one on-site Technical Account Manager (TAM), L3 for the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) engagement. You will lead complex escalations, make practical recommendations about architecture and product lifecycle, work directly with RBI technology and security teams, guide L1/L2 engineers and coordinate Hazelcast support through an approved resolution. The role begins after Go-Live and formal RBI sign-off. The initial assignment is at least one year; any extension during the five-year contract will depend on RBI's call-off or extension decision. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Investigate and resolve escalated Hazelcast component issues. Lead root-cause analysis for P1, recurring and critical incidents with Hazelcast support, keep stakeholders informed and track permanent corrective actions through closure. When an incident closes, make sure the knowledge base captures the cause, permanent fix and lessons learned. 
 - Coordinate Hazelcast support cases for product bugs, patches and escalations; promptly notify RBI of critical defects or security vulnerabilities and track remediation and closure status
 - Recommend, configure and validate RBI-approved Hazelcast designs for high availability, resilience, throughput and scalability in line with Hazelcast guidance, working with L2 and developers on complex workflow, connector, integration and performance issues. 
 - Plan and carry out approved UAT, pre-production and production updates with impact and risk analysis, approved operating procedures, test and rollback plans, execution in approved maintenance windows and post-change validation. 
 - Advise RBI security teams on Hazelcast hardening; assess releases and patches and maintain upgrade, adoption and infrastructure-lifecycle roadmap recommendations. 
 - Work with RBI's performance-monitoring team to establish baselines, diagnose bottlenecks and implement tuning and configuration improvements with measurable before-and-after results. 
 - Perform capacity planning and sizing and conduct periodic capacity and utilization reviews, including annual audits and corrective recommendations for threshold breaches. 
 - Maintain senior-level operating procedures and technical documentation; guide L1/L2 teams through knowledge sharing, current industry trends, best practices and thoughtful automation. 
 - Provide senior oversight for complex or escalated service requests, authorizations, coordination issues and configuration-backup concerns, while the L2 TAM owns routine handling. Help keep the agreed roles and responsibilities (RACI) and escalation matrix current, join remote, OEM and on-call coverage, and contribute to quarterly service-level reporting and RBI certification. The team supports unlimited cases, with response targets of 30 minutes initially and 1 hour ongoing for P1; 1 hour and 2 hours for P2; 4 hours and 8 business hours for P3; and 8 hours and 2 working days for all other cases. 

WHAT YOU HAVE

- Graduate qualification such as BE, BSc, MCA or equivalent; an engineering background is preferred. 
 - At least 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years designing, implementing and upgrading Hazelcast or the directly relevant OEM product. 
 - Advanced Hazelcast architecture, configuration, high-availability, resilience and distributed-caching expertise, including security hardening and lifecycle management across UAT, pre-production and production. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of complex production incidents, P1 root-cause analysis, permanent corrective actions and OEM engineering/support escalations. 
 - Strong performance-tuning, capacity-planning, sizing, throughput and scalability skills supported by measurable validation. 
 - Ability to work with RBI stakeholders, developers and L1/L2 teams; communicate recommendations and approved decisions clearly and produce strong operating procedures, configuration records, root-cause analysis reports, roadmaps and knowledge-transfer guidance. 

Be prepared to share degree records, project dates, relevant experience and evidence of your Hazelcast or OEM association so Hazelcast can support RBI's approval process.

data.description:
About JIFFYAI

Who We Are

JIFFYAI is an AI-powered intelligent automation company specializing in digital transformation for the financial services sector, particularly wealth management. Launched in 2018, it offers a no-code, full-stack hyper automation platform that enables enterprises to rapidly build and deploy customized applications, automate complex workflows, and integrate systems without traditional coding. Key solutions include unified investor onboarding, seamless account servicing, advisor universal desktops, next-generation AI agents, data warehousing, and AI-powered notetakers, designed to boost advisor productivity by over 40%, reduce onboarding and servicing costs by 30-50%, and deliver personalized client experiences while ensuring compliance and data security. With pre-built modules for quick deployment (often in weeks), robust integrations, robotic process automation (RPA), and intelligent document processing, JIFFYAI serves marquee clients, earning industry recognitions such as Star Performer in Everest Group's Intelligent Document Processing PEAK Matrix. The company's mission emphasizes responsible innovation, bridging human ingenuity with machine intelligence to drive efficiency, growth, and positive social impact through initiatives like workforce upskilling. 

Success in the Role

As an SRE Engineer at JIFFYAI, you will be responsible for maintaining the health, availability, and performance of our multi-tenant platform and associated cloud infrastructure. You will collaborate with Engineering, DevOps, and Cloud Platform Implementation teams to ensure end-to-end reliability for ~100 microservices built on diverse technologies. This role is ideal for an operations-focused engineer with strong foundations in infrastructure, cloud services, observability, and automation. 

Role Responsibilities

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize cloud-native workloads hosted on AWS EKS, RDS, MongoDB Atlas, S3, Elasticache, OpenSearch, and EFS.

 - Manage and optimize CI/CD pipelines using ArgoCD and Jenkins for seamless deployment of Go, Java, Node. js, and Python-based services. 
 - Participate in BCP, capacity planning, infrastructure scaling, and performance tuning for microservices. 
 - Respond to production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and automate incident response. 
 - Enhance system observability with Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenSearch-based logging. 
 - Implement Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform and maintain compliance with policies. 
 - Contribute to SLOs, SLAs, and error budgets for critical services. 
 - Collaborate with developers to shift reliability left and ensure best practices across the SDLC. 

Experience & Skills Required

- 2-3 years of hands-on experience in SRE, DevOps, or Cloud Operations. 
 - Strong experience with AWS services (EC2, RDS, EKS, IAM, VPC, S3). 
 - Solid understanding of Kubernetes (EKS): deployments, scaling, troubleshooting. 
 - Familiarity with ArgoCD, Jenkins, and GitOps workflows. 
 - Practical knowledge of Terraform for infrastructure provisioning. 
 - Experience working with Containers, Linux systems, bash scripting, and basic networking concepts. 

Nice To Have Skills

- Experience with distributed systems monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana). 
 - Exposure to DBs, Grafana, OpenSearch etc. 
 - Awareness of SRE principles (SLIs, SLOs, incident management). 

Benefits & Perks

What are the benefits and perks of working at JIFFYAI?

- Work with a dynamic team on a modern tech stack powering global customers. 
 - On-site collaboration at our Trivandrum (Technopark) office. 
 - Opportunity to grow with a product company investing in AI, automation, and DevOps maturity. 
 - Inclusive team culture with periodic upskilling opportunities and technical mentorship. 
 - One of the best performance-based compensation plans, rewarding impact to the company. 
 - Working with the best-in-class talent.

For more information, please visit www. tvsmotor. com. 

Job Purpose

• As the FGL for Vehicle Dynamics within Chassis Systems, lead the development and optimization of vehicle dynamic performance for NPD - Commercial Mobility Business products covering 3W and 4W vehicles. 

• Own the ride, handling, stability, steering response, braking integration and overall chassis dynamic targets, ensuring alignment with customer usage, safety, durability, weight, cost and regulatory requirements. 

• Work cross-functionally with design, simulation, testing, vehicle integration, manufacturing, quality, purchasing, service and supplier teams to deliver robust, validated and platform-reusable solutions. 

• Drive current-product problem solving, new-product delivery and future technology readiness for Vehicle Dynamics within 3W and 4W Chassis Systems. 

Looking for 12+ years of experience

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the definition, deployment and achievement of vehicle dynamics targets across 3W and 4W product lines, covering ride comfort, handling, steering feel, braking feel, stability, controllability and chassis integration. 

• Translate customer, market, regulatory and program requirements into measurable chassis and vehicle-level dynamic performance targets. 

• Lead vehicle dynamics architecture decisions and technical sign-offs in coordination with Frames, Suspension, Steering, Brakes, Wheels & Tyres, Vehicle Integration, CAE, Testing and Controls teams. 

• Define technical requirements and ensure designs meet QCD expectations including performance, durability, safety, weight, manufacturability and cost targets. 

• Review simulation methods, virtual validation outputs and physical test results for ride & handling, stability, braking integration, steering response, K&C, durability and vehicle-level correlation. 

• Establish and maintain test procedures, design guidelines, SOPs, DVPs and DFMEA inputs related to Vehicle Dynamics and Chassis System integration. 

• Lead objective data analysis and correlation with subjective evaluation feedback to enable faster convergence of vehicle performance maturity. 

• Drive problem-solving initiatives for current products, field concerns and development issues related to ride, handling, stability, braking response and chassis behavior. 

• Lead value engineering and standardization initiatives across platforms, minimizing variety while ensuring appropriate product differentiation for 3W and 4W applications. 

• Manage multiple development programs, prioritize deliverables and drive timely technical decisions in alignment with program milestones. 

• Ensure compliance with applicable safety, homologation and internal engineering standards for vehicle dynamic performance. 

• Mentor and develop engineers in vehicle dynamics, structured validation, data analytics, cross-functional issue resolution and career development. 

• Manage external interactions with suppliers, test agencies and technology partners for vehicle dynamics components, instrumentation, validation and benchmarking support. 

Key result measures / metrices

Vehicle dynamics target achievement against approved DVP / technical targets

Ride, handling, stability and braking integration validation closure

Issue resolution for development, current product and field concerns

QCD adherence for vehicle dynamics deliverables across programs

Platform standardization and variety reduction in chassis dynamic solutions

Compliance to safety, homologation and internal engineering standards

• DVP, DFMEA, SOPs, Design Reviews and Problem Solving

data.title: Director of Engineering, KYX
data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - 3, 000 Tideans globally
 - Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found. 

You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains. 

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide. 

As Director of Engineering, KYX you will

- Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines. 
 - Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius. 
 - Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring. 
 - Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework. 
 - Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access. 
 - Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member. 
 - Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated. 

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment. 

What We Are Looking For

- Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain. 
 - Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation. 
 - Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live. 
 - Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions, 
 - Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality. 
 - Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap. 
 - Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus. 

What You'll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

- Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options. 
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office. 
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. 
 - All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. 
 - Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide. co email address. 
 - Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. 

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide. co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy. 

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer (Platform/DevOps Engineering)
data.description:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world's leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit  www. saviynt. com. 

This is a Principal position within the  Platform Engineering organization. Our core mission is to build the foundational, core common layer across Saviynt engineering, consolidating and centralizing scattered platform tools, workflows, and infrastructure primitives. Wearing a dedicated Platform Engineering hat, this role will proactively find opportunities to eliminate operational friction and standardize capabilities into a seamless, unified developer experience. 

A primary focus of this role is designing, developing, implementing, rolling out, and supporting our Internal Developer Platform (IDP), fitting all foundational tooling into a cohesive, self-service ecosystem. You will build and implement "golden paths" for developers, creating self-serve platforms embedded with essential security and operational guardrails. Crucially, you will act as a partner across engineering-working closely with developers, Embedded SREs (E-SREs), and Central SRE teams-while actively evangelizing platform products to accelerate adoption throughout the organization. 

WHAT YOU BRING

- 
12+ Years of experience across the Software Development lifecycle with a focus on platform engineering, DevOps, and cloud-native infrastructure. 

- 
Proven IDP build experience: you have shipped or significantly contributed to a Backstage or Port portal (or equivalent) used in production. 

- 
Deep Kubernetes expertise across EKS and AKS, including multi-tenant cluster design, Helm, Kustomize, and Crossplane. 

- 
Experience with multi-tenant SaaS fleet management, cell-based architectures, and ring/canary deployment strategies. 

- 
Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) or Python for building production-grade CLIs, custom operators, or platform backends. 

- 
GitLab CI + ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts pipeline implementation experience-building CI/CD-as-a-service for engineering teams. 

- 
Terraform / OpenTofu module authoring at scale-module registry design, state management, and refactoring large IaC codebases. 

- 
Background in developing Backstage plugins or contributing to open-source developer platform ecosystems. 

- 
Practical application of workload identity, SPIFFE/IRSA, and cloud-native zero-trust network architectures. 

- 
Implementation of OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno for policy-as-code within production-grade Kubernetes clusters. 

- 
Proficiency in FinOps methodologies and tools such as Kubecost or cloud cost exposure APIs. 

- 
Experience managing Kafka or AWS MSK as a multi-tenant platform capability. 

- 
Proven platform-first mindset with a history of centralizing scattered tooling into core foundation layers, evangelizing platform adoption, and collaborating effectively across developers, Embedded SREs, and Central SREs. 

- 
Professional exposure to identity security frameworks, SaaS delivery, and high-compliance operational environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP). 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOINGInternal Developer Platform (IDP) & Developer Portal

- Take ownership of key aspects of the IDP architectural lifecycle, from service catalog creation to automated, self-service environment provisioning. 

- Construct and manage a centralized developer hub featuring TechDocs, software catalogs, and seamless integrations with GitLab, Jira, and cloud management consoles. 

- Develop and implement "golden-path" templates to rapidly deploy new microservices equipped with Kubernetes configurations, observability tools, and automated security guardrails. 

- Champion and evangelize the adoption of platform products across engineering units using developer feedback, usage analytics, and active outreach. 

Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture & Fleet Operations

- Design and support cell-based deployment patterns and progressive ring-deployment strategies across multi-tenant and single-tenant customer fleets to isolate tenant workloads and limit blast radiuses. 

- Automate continuous zero-downtime release deployments globally while providing platform abstractions that support multi-region SaaS deployments. 

Platform-as-a-Service on Kubernetes

- Design and supervise multi-tenant Kubernetes environments on AWS EKS and Azure AKS, ensuring a unified cluster management experience for internal users. 

- Produce modular Helm libraries and infrastructure compositions that mask underlying cloud complexities for product development teams. 

- Enforce robust isolation and access control policies that reflect our multi-tenancy security framework at the namespace level. 

- Maintain high availability through automated cluster lifecycle operations, including seamless scaling and blue/green deployment rotations. 

GitOps, CI/CD, and Delivery Infrastructure

- Drive the evolution of CI/CD-as-a-service by providing standardized pipeline templates via GitLab CI and ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts for effortless team consumption. 

- Deploy GitOps methodologies to establish default rollback capabilities, continuous drift detection, and transparent audit trails across environment workflows. 

- Incorporate supply-chain security measures, such as container signing and SBOM creation, directly into our core delivery infrastructure. 

API Gateway, Traffic Management & Edge Infrastructure

- Manage edge, ingress, and service-to-service communication infrastructure (API gateways, service mesh), incorporating built-in mTLS, rate limiting, distributed tracing context propagation, and circuit breaking as platform primitives. 

- Configure global load balancing and edge protection (CDN/WAF) as standardized defaults across developer paths. 

Infrastructure Automation & IaC

- Curate a centralized Terraform / OpenTofu registry for multi-cloud resources that adheres to stringent FinOps and security standards by default. 

- Enable self-service infrastructure provisioning via Kubernetes-native workflows by implementing advanced provider compositions (Crossplane). 

- Engineer custom Go-based CLI tools and operators to automate critical platform tasks, including cost tracking and credential rotation. 

Platform Observability, FinOps & Resilience

- Launch a unified observability suite using Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry to provide teams with essential self-service performance metrics. 

- Establish logging and distributed tracing as foundational platform primitives, integrated automatically through standard developer paths. 

- Create detailed FinOps reporting mechanisms and real-time cost anomaly guardrails to enable precise cloud expenditure attribution for teams and tenants. 

- Integrate chaos testing and automated disaster recovery (DR) failover verification to meet strict enterprise SaaS uptime requirements. 

Platform Security & Compliance Guardrails by Default

- Integrate zero-trust principles and workload identity into the platform fabric using short-lived credentials and cloud-native network policies. 

- Utilize policy-as-code (OPA, Gatekeeper, Kyverno) and admission controllers to enforce security standards at the cluster level without impeding development velocity. 

- Streamline secrets management by providing a secure, automated, self-service platform capability. 

- Build compliance-as-code into CI/CD pipelines to automatically generate audit trails and SBOM documentation required for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP certifications. 

Event-Driven & Messaging Infrastructure

- Manage shared messaging infrastructure systems like Kafka and AWS MSK, delivering topic provisioning and schema management as a robust platform service. 

- Construct reusable patterns and scaffold templates that allow product teams to easily implement event-driven architectures from within the IDP. 

Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us!

Security & Compliance
This role requires adherence to Saviynt's information security and privacy policies and procedures, including annual security training. 

Saviynt is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome everyone to our team.   All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

data.description:
Full Time

Hyderabad

Product Quality & Release Lead

apply now

We are seeking a proactive and hands-on Product Quality & Release Lead to take ownership of product quality, testing, release readiness, and QA execution for our AI SaaS product. 

This role is ideal for someone with strong QA fundamentals who is ready to take larger ownership in a fast-moving startup environment. You will work closely with the founders, developers, and a small QA team made up of full-time team members and part-time contractors. 

Your primary responsibility will be to ensure that everything built by the engineering team is properly tested, verified, documented, and ready for release. You will help us create a lean, practical, and cost-conscious QA process that balances manual testing, automation, regression testing, bug tracking, and release readiness. 

This is a hands-on role where ownership, speed, clarity, and practical judgment matter more than years of experience. 

Job Title

Product Quality & Release Lead

Tech Stack

JavaScript / TypeScript + AWS

Experience Level

2+ years

Location : 

Hyderabad

Joining

Immediate or as per the availability

Annual Salary Range

Competitive

What will you do?

- Own product quality and release readiness from build completion to production release. 
 - Work closely with the engineering team to understand features, fixes, builds, and release priorities. 
 - Read product and technical documentation and convert it into test cases, QA plans, acceptance checks, and release checklists. 
 - Plan and execute end-to-end testing for key product flows across the web application. 
 - Coordinate QA work across full-time team members and part-time contractors. 
 - Create and maintain test cases, regression test suites, bug reports, and QA documentation. 
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and track bugs with clear reproduction steps, screenshots/videos, severity, and expected outcomes. 
 - Verify bug fixes and ensure resolved issues do not create regressions. 
 - Own regression testing, smoke testing, and pre-release validation before major releases.

 - Identify high-value areas for automation to reduce repetitive manual testing and control QA costs. 
 - Work with developers or automation contractors to support automated smoke, regression, API, and browser testing where useful. 
 - Test the product experience around AI workflows, including UI behavior, loading states, error handling, retries, session behavior, data saving, and system reliability. 
 - Triage customer-reported bugs after launch, reproduce issues, prioritize fixes, and ensure recurring issues are added to regression coverage.

- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or any relevant field. Equivalent practical experience is also welcome.

 - Basic understanding of automation testing and where automation can reduce manual QA effort. 
 - Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript-based products is preferred. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-hosted applications, especially AWS-based environments, is a plus.

 - Comfortable working directly with developers, founders, and product stakeholders. 
 - Ability to prioritize bugs based on user impact, launch risk, and business importance. 
 - Startup mindset with strong ownership, accountability, urgency, and comfort with changing priorities. 

Good to have -

- Prior experience coordinating a small QA team or external QA contractors. 
 - Experience with automation testing using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Jest, or similar tools. 
 - Experience with API testing using Postman or similar tools. 
 - Experience with CI/CD-based testing workflows. 
 - Exposure to AI SaaS products, LLM-based products, chat-based workflows, or agent-based platforms. 
 - Experience testing products before launch or during early-stage product development. 

What do we offer?

- A supportive and flexible workplace that promotes work-life balance, recognizing and appreciating your contributions. 
 - The autonomy to embrace, explore, and experiment with your ideas. 
 - An inclusive environment where your individuality is highly valued, fostering open dialogue and diverse perspectives. 

Additional Benefits

- Cross-functional exposure to diverse teams, enabling a holistic understanding of all business functions. 
 - Engaging social events that foster camaraderie and networking opportunities with various startups. 
 - A fantastic problem-solving team that criticizes and gels along, creating a better version of every idea.

data.title: Lead Verification Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Verification & Validation Engineer

Location: Bengaluru / Chennai

Company: Epiroc Mining India Pvt Ltd

Job Description: 

We are looking for an experienced and forward-thinking Senior Verification & Validation Engineer to join our high-performance applications team. 

The role requires strong expertise in Python-based test automation, combined with hands-on experience in system and machine-level validation of mining, drilling, construction, automotive, or industrial equipment. 

In addition to verification and validation responsibilities, the candidate will act as a technology catalyst, identifying opportunities and transforming innovative ideas into practical, scalable solutions using AI-assisted testing, Digital Twin technologies, automated test systems and simulation. 

The ideal candidate should be capable of developing scalable automation frameworks, validating integrated systems on machines and test rigs, and driving new approaches that improve test coverage, quality, speed, and engineering efficiency. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Automation & Software Verification

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, integration, performance). 
 - Develop Python-based test scripts and custom automation frameworks. 
 - Use tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, and other libraries for automation of UI/embedded systems. 
 - Define test strategies, create comprehensive test plans, and manage test cases using Jira or equivalent tools. 
 - Perform debugging, log analysis, and root cause investigation for complex issues. 
 - Integrate test automation with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps). 

System / Machine Validation

- Conduct hands-on validation tests on machines, simulators, test benches, and integrated systems. 
 - Validate end-to-end workflows on mining/drilling equipment and ensure system compliance with functional & safety requirements. 
 - Perform hardware-software integration testing, including sensor, I/O, hydraulics, engine, and actuator interactions. 
 - Analyse machine performance, check system response behaviour, and document deviations or improvement needs. 
 - Ensure adherence to Epiroc's validation standards, safety practices, and field-testing guidelines. 
 - Ability to define test strategies, create detailed test plans, and manage test case repositories using tools like Jira. 
 - Skilled in troubleshooting and root cause analysis of complex issues. 
 - Experience with debugging tools and version control systems (e. g. , Git). 
 - Strong communication skills to work with cross-functional teams including developers, system engineers, and product owners. 
 - Ability to lead testing discussions, reviews, and defect triages. 
 - Passion for quality advocacy and mentoring junior team members in testing best practices. 

Required Skills and Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in relevant engineering fields (e. g. , Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science) with 3 to 8 years of professional experience. Proficient in Python with the ability to develop test scripts and automation frameworks. Experience in C++, PLC- based systems is an asset. 
 - Experience with automation tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, and related test libraries. Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban), including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative, team-based environment. Familiarity with communication protocols like CAN, J1939, LIN, and Ethernet is an advantage. 
 - Experience using Git for version control, CI/CD practices, and tools within the Azure DevOps ecosystem. Familiarity with automated deployment pipelines and versioning best practices. Excellent customer-facing skills with a proactive approach, capable of understanding client needs and delivering customized solutions

Nice to Have: Previous experience in heavy machinery in mining, construction, or automotive control systemsSelf-starter with curiosity to learn and an exploratory mindsetExperience with Docker containersStrong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication and teamwork skills. 

Agile certifications - such as Scrum MasterEnthusiastic, positive minded and able to work well in an international client environmentGood interpersonal, communication and analytical skillsTeam player - open-minded and flexible

AI-Assisted Testing and Engineering - Identify practical opportunities to use AI in verification, validation, and engineering workflows. Explore AI-assisted approaches for test-case generation, log analysis, defect identification, test prioritization, and test-result interpretation. Develop proof of concepts and convert promising AI ideas into usable engineering solutions. Support the implementation of intelligent test automation and data-driven validation approaches. Apply analytical and machine learning concepts to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential failures from test and machine data. Evaluate emerging AI tools and recommend suitable applications within verification and validation activities. Promote the responsible use of AI with appropriate focus on data quality, traceability, security, and engineering validation. 

Digital Twin and Virtual Validation -

Develop or support Digital Twin, simulation, and virtual validation environments for machine and system testing. Connect system models, simulated components, automation frameworks, and real machine data to improve validation coverage. Use Digital Twin environments to test system behaviour, operational scenarios, faults, and edge cases before machine-level testing. Automate test execution across simulated, virtual, and physical test environments. Analyse differences between simulated and actual machine behaviour and support model improvement. Drive the reuse of simulation assets and automated test components across projects. 

It all starts with people. The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support. 

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future. Learn more at www. epiroc. com

An overview of this role

As an Engineering Manager on GitLab's Authentication team, you'll build and lead a team of engineers in Bangalore who own how users, applications, tokens, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents sign in to GitLab. At GitLab, we see our team as our product. You'll need to be technically credible in authentication protocols such as OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML). Your main focus will be hiring well, growing your engineers, and helping the team deliver on commitments that other parts of GitLab depend on. You'll guide your team's work on OAuth across Cells, global identities, token consolidation, and moving authentication out of the Ruby on Rails monolith onto GATE, GitLab's new authentication and authorization platform. You'll manage these multi-quarter programs with fixed deadlines and many dependent teams. 

What you'll do

- Hire, onboard, and grow a team of senior and intermediate engineers in Bangalore, working with talent acquisition during a high-volume hiring period. 
 - Own delivery for your team's part of the authentication roadmap: plan in milestones, track risks early, and communicate clearly when a date is at risk and what would change it. 
 - Work with your Staff Engineer and Product Manager to turn architecture decisions into shippable, feature-flagged increments. 
 - Protect your team's focus. Manage requests from other teams through one intake path, and make trade-offs visible to leadership. 
 - Coordinate with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams across India, Europe, and the Americas. 
 - Make sure the team runs what it builds, including on-call coverage, incident response for authentication issues, rate limits, and production readiness for new services. 
 - Build a team culture where security comes first, decisions are written down, and code review is thorough and kind. 
 - Give clear, regular feedback, run career conversations, and handle performance issues early. 
 - Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it. 

What you'll bring

- Significant experience as an engineering manager of backend or platform teams, including hiring and growing senior engineers. 
 - A background as an engineer in identity, authentication, or security systems, with enough depth in OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, SAML, and JSON Web Tokens to review designs and ask probing questions. 
 - Experience delivering complex, multi-team programs against fixed dates, including migrations that must not disrupt existing customers. 
 - Experience running production services, including on-call coverage, incident response, and reliability work. 
 - Working knowledge of Ruby on Rails or Go. 
 - Experience building a new team or growing one quickly while keeping the hiring bar high. 
 - Clear, concise written English and comfort leading a team in an all-remote, asynchronous company across time zones. 

About The Team

We're part of the Security Platform stage, alongside Authorization, GATE Core, GATE Infra, Secrets Manager, and other security teams. You'll partner closely with our existing Authentication engineers in Europe and the Americas.
