· Fareportal is the number 1 privately held online travel company in flight volume. 

· Fareportal partners with over 500 airlines, 1 million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies worldwide. 

· 2019 annual sales exceeded $5 billion. 

· Fareportal sees over 150 million unique visitors annually to our desktop and mobile sites. 

· Fareportal, with its global workforce of over 2, 600 employees, is strategically positioned with 9 offices in 6 countries and headquartered in New York City. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a high-performing Engineering Manager (Mobile) with comprehensive, end-to-end requirement-to-delivery experience. In this role, you will transition from individual contribution to managing a high-caliber team of mobile engineers, including Team Leads and Staff Engineers. 

You will own the technical architecture, cross-platform development, native modules, UI styling frameworks, and API integrations for our iOS and Android applications. As a delivery and people leader, you will be entirely responsible for the "Concept-to-Store" lifecycle, ensuring our mobile booking engines scale to handle peak OTA traffic with maximum uptime. 

Core Responsibilities: 

Delivery, Architecture & Technical Strategy

End-to-End Requirement to Delivery Ownership: Take total accountability for the mobile roadmap from initial product requirement scoping to final store deployment. Ensure predictable sprint velocities and on-time delivery across multiple parallel tracks. 

Architectural Governance: Oversee and approve client-side mobile architectures. Guide the team on when to leverage cross-platform modules (React Native) versus writing native performance bridges (Swift/Kotlin). 

API & Data Orchestration Strategy: Enforce robust security and performance standards for data layers interacting with RESTful APIs, GraphQL (Apollo Client), and real-time WebSockets. Ensure seamless optimization for low-bandwidth environments. 

MarTech Ecosystem & Routing: Oversee the integration and performance impact of Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs like AppsFlyer/Branch), customer engagement platforms (e. g. , CleverTap, Braze), and ensure flawless execution of complex deep linking/universal links across the booking funnel. 

Release Train, CI/CD & OTA Updates: Orchestrate continuous delivery and automated release tracks using Fastlane and GitHub Actions. Manage Over-The-Air (OTA) update strategies (e. g. , CodePush or EAS Update) to rapidly deploy JavaScript bundles and hotfix critical production bugs without waiting for Apple/Google store review cycles. 

App Store Ecosystem & Policy Governance: Act as the final gatekeeper for App Store Connect and Google Play Console. Navigate complex store review guidelines, manage rejection appeals, and ensure the app stays compliant with evolving platform policies. 

Scalability & Traffic Spikes: Design robust, high-concurrency client architectures capable of handling sudden, massive traffic surges typical of B2C flash sales, holiday booking rushes, and flash marketing events without degradation. 

Leading Elite Mobile Teams & Culture

Managing High-Performer Dynamics: Successfully lead, inspire, and retain an elite team of highly skilled developers. Turn divergent technical opinions among senior engineers into unified architectural decisions. 

Product & Stakeholder Partnership: Act as the strategic counterpart to Product Managers and UX/UI Leads. Translate business requirements into technical roadmaps, negotiate sprint scopes, and ensure engineering deliverables align tightly with OTA business KPIs (conversion rates, booking funnel optimization). 

Engineering Craftsmanship: Promote a high-standard engineering culture focused on code quality, thorough documentation, reusable UI component libraries, and automated testing (Jest, Detox, Appium). 

Technical Debt & ROI Management: Strategically balance feature delivery with technical debt. Advocate for engineering refactors by translating technical gains (e. g. , modularization) into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders. 

Talent Cultivation & Growth: Run quarterly performance reviews, establish clear individual career ladders, and mentor team leads. Design rigorous interview loops to attract top-tier mobile talent in a competitive market. 

Advanced Competency Standards

Security, Compliance & Data Protection

PII & Payment Data Security: Demonstrate a strong understanding of best practices for securing Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Payment Card Industry (PCI) data within mobile clients, guiding the team on safe payment processing and data tokenization without acting as the primary compliance officer. 

Data Localization & Privacy: Architect storage and transmission strategies that respect regional data localization laws and data-at-rest encryption requirements. 

WebView & Boundary Hardening: Mitigate advanced WebView vulnerabilities-including Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and script injection-ensuring strict security controls over hybrid features. 

Network & Authentication Security: Mandate certificate pinning across native and cross-platform network layers. Manage complex token lifecycles and secure token exchanges (OAuth, JWT) seamlessly across native/web boundaries. 

Reliability, Observability & Performance

React Native Performance Tuning: Optimize React Native-specific bottlenecks, including JS thread blocking, memory leaks, bridge traffic reduction, and Hermes engine tuning to ensure native-like 60fps scrolling and fast TTI (Time to Interactive). 

Telemetry Infrastructure: Establish expert-level implementation of Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and logging tools (e. g. , Sentry, Datadog, New Relic). 

Actionable Insights: Transform raw error metrics, crash logs, and latency telemetry into clear, prioritized technical backlogs that actively improve app stability and user retention. 

Production Guardrails: Define, monitor, and defend strict operational SLAs, targeting a >99. 9% crashfree user rate and optimized app launch velocities. 

Global Accessibility (a11y): Ensure the application meets WCAG guidelines and supports native screen readers (VoiceOver/TalkBack), maintaining an inclusive booking experience for all users. 

Required Technical Skills & Stack

UI & Core Frameworks: React Native, Redux/React Query/MobX, JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS-in-JS, Tailwind CSS, and React Native StyleSheet. 

Native Development Platforms: iOS (Xcode, Swift, Objective-C, UIKit/SwiftUI, Core Data) and Android (Android Studio, Kotlin, Java, Android SDK, SQLite/Room). 

API Integration & Networking: RESTful APIs, GraphQL (Apollo Client), WebSockets, Axios, and RTK Query. 

Infrastructure, OTA & MarTech: CodePush / Expo Application Services (EAS), AppsFlyer, Branch, Firebase, or similar MMP/Engagement SDKs. 

Testing & Automation: Jest, Detox, Appium, XCTest, Espresso, Fastlane, and mobile CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , GitHub Actions). 

Qualifications

Experience: 10+ years of professional software development experience, with a minimum of 3 years specifically in Engineering Management directly leading mobile teams. 

Proven Scale: Proven experience managing large scale D2C app development in a B2C organization. Domain Expertise: Experience in the travel domain would be helpful but is not mandatory. 

Education: Engineering degree from a Tier 1 college.

OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

YOUR ROLE

Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team that is an integral part of R&D, working on cutting-edge Camera Image Sensor SoC products targeting Automotive, Industrial, Mobile, Security, and Machine Vision applications. 

As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating high-speed interfaces used in Camera Image Sensor SoCs from FPGA prototyping through silicon bring-up and production qualification. Your mission will be to ensure that interface functionality, performance, compliance, interoperability, and robustness meet product specifications under various operating conditions. 

In this role, you will be responsible for validating high-speed interfaces across Camera Image Sensor SoCs, focusing on MIPI protocols, DisplayPort, SerDes-based connectivity, protocol compliance, and system-level validation. The role requires a strong understanding of protocol architecture, embedded systems, hardware validation, and automation using Python. 

Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration. 

To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs. 

You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team. 

Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Experience: 5 - 10yrs
 - Validate end-to-end functionality of high-speed interfaces implemented in Camera Image Sensor SoCs. 
 - Develop comprehensive validation plans and test strategies for: 
 - MIPI CSI-2 / D-PHY / C-PHY
 - DisplayPort (DP/eDP)
 - Proprietary SerDes interfaces
 - Verify protocol compliance (CTS) against applicable industry specifications. 
 - Validate interface operation across multiple speeds, lane configurations, and low power profiles. 
 - Execute interoperability testing with host processors, ISP platforms, FPGA platforms, and validation boards. 
 - Perform stress, corner-case, and robustness testing. 
 - Validate error handling and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Execute compliance and certification activities. 
 - Automate test execution, log collection, analysis, and reporting. 
Your Skills & Experiences

- Object-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
 - Version management tools (git, svn)

 - Embedded electronics / computing (real time)
 - Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, Logic Analyzers, Protocol Analyzers, etc. )
 - Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI, DP, eDP
 - Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
 - Notions in image processing would be an adding competency.

data.title: Validation Lead
data.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Validation Lead - Autonomous Driving & ADAS to lead the end-to-end verification and validation (V&V) of our autonomous driving systems, from component-level testing to integrated vehicle validation. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in ADAS and autonomous driving validation, simulation environments, embedded automotive systems, and safety-critical software testing. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for defining validation strategies, building scalable testing frameworks, leading validation teams, and ensuring that RoshAi's autonomy solutions meet performance, reliability, safety, and production-readiness requirements. 

The role involves close collaboration with autonomy architects, perception, planning, control, hardware, functional safety, and vehicle integration teams to deliver robust Level 2+ to Level 4 autonomous driving capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Validation Strategy & Technical Leadership

- Define and own the end-to-end verification and validation strategy for ADAS and autonomous driving systems, including Level 2+ to Level 4 functions. 
 - Develop comprehensive validation plans covering perception, sensor fusion, localization, prediction, planning, control, and vehicle interfaces. 
 - Establish validation methodologies, acceptance criteria, performance benchmarks, and quality gates aligned with system requirements and Operational Design Domain (ODD). 
 - Lead validation activities throughout the product development lifecycle, from initial development to vehicle deployment. 
 - Drive test automation, continuous validation, and improvements in testing efficiency and coverage. 

2. Simulation, MiL, SiL & HiL Validation

- Lead the design, development, and execution of validation frameworks across: -Model-in-the-Loop (MiL)

-Software-in-the-Loop (SiL)

-Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL)

-Vehicle-in-the-Loop (ViL)

-Real-world vehicle testing

- Develop and execute scenario-based testing using simulation platforms such as CARLA, IPG CarMaker, dSPACE, NVIDIA DRIVE Sim, or equivalent tools. 
 - Define test scenarios covering normal operations, edge cases, sensor failures, environmental variations, and safety-critical situations. 
 - Establish automated regression testing frameworks integrated with CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Ensure consistency and traceability between simulation results and real-world vehicle performance. 

3. Autonomous Driving System Validation

- Lead system-level and subsystem-level validation of the autonomy stack, including: -Perception: Object detection, classification, tracking, and environmental understanding. 

-Sensor Fusion: Camera, LiDAR, Radar, and multi-sensor integration. 

-Localization: Positioning accuracy, mapping, and localization robustness. 

-Prediction & Planning: Behaviour prediction, decision-making, path planning, and trajectory generation. 

-Control: Lateral and longitudinal control, vehicle dynamics, and trajectory tracking. 

-Vehicle Integration: Drive-by-wire, braking, steering, throttle, and communication interfaces. 

- Define measurable KPIs for functional performance, latency, reliability, robustness, and system safety. 
 - Identify performance limitations, integration defects, and critical failure modes through structured validation. 

4. Vehicle Testing & Field Validation

- Plan and lead validation activities on prototype vehicles, test tracks, proving grounds, and controlled operational environments. 
 - Develop test procedures for autonomous driving functions, including obstacle avoidance, emergency braking, lane keeping, automated navigation, and fallback operations. 
 - Validate vehicle behaviour across different road conditions, traffic scenarios, environmental conditions, and operational constraints. 
 - Coordinate with vehicle integration, hardware, and deployment teams for test readiness and execution. 
 - Lead issue investigation, root-cause analysis, defect tracking, and closure of validation findings. 
 - Establish effective processes for test data collection, log analysis, scenario replay, and field performance evaluation. 

5. Functional Safety, Compliance & Quality

- Ensure validation processes align with applicable automotive standards and engineering practices, including: 
 - ISO 26262 - Functional Safety
 - ISO 21448 - Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF)
 - ISO/SAE 21434 - Automotive Cybersecurity
 - Automotive SPICE (ASPICE)
 - Develop safety-related validation scenarios covering fault injection, system degradation, fallback strategies, and minimal-risk conditions. 
 - Maintain requirements traceability, test coverage, validation reports, and supporting evidence for safety assessments. 
 - Collaborate with functional safety and system architecture teams to support safety cases and design reviews. 
 - Drive compliance with internal engineering quality standards and customer validation requirements. 

6. Test Automation, Tools & Data Analytics

- Design and improve automated testing frameworks for autonomy software and embedded automotive systems. 
 - Develop Python/C++-based test scripts, validation utilities, and automated reporting tools. 
 - Establish data-driven validation processes using vehicle logs, simulation outputs, and test results. 
 - Define dashboards and metrics to monitor test coverage, defect trends, regression performance, and release readiness. 
 - Support integration of validation workflows with CI/CD, cloud-based simulation, and large-scale data processing environments. 

7. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Lead, mentor, and develop validation engineers and test automation specialists. 
 - Allocate validation activities, establish priorities, and ensure timely execution against project milestones. 
 - Collaborate closely with autonomy architects, software development teams, hardware engineers, and technical program managers. 
 - Participate in technical design reviews to ensure system requirements are measurable, testable, and verifiable. 
 - Communicate validation progress, technical risks, defect severity, and release-readiness assessments to engineering leadership. 
 - Drive a culture of engineering quality, technical accountability, and continuous improvement. 

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Experience

- 10+ years of experience in automotive software validation, ADAS, autonomous driving, or safety-critical embedded systems, including at least 3 years in a technical lead or validation leadership role. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in system-level validation of ADAS or autonomous driving functions. 
 - Proven expertise in MiL, SiL, HiL, and vehicle-level testing methodologies. 
 - Strong understanding of autonomous driving architecture, including perception, sensor fusion, localization, planning, and control. 
 - Proficiency in Python and C++ for test automation, debugging, and validation framework development. 
 - Experience with ROS/ROS 2, embedded Linux, and automotive software integration. 
 - Strong knowledge of automotive communication protocols such as CAN, CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, and diagnostics. 
 - Experience validating embedded automotive ECUs, sensor interfaces, and drive-by-wire systems. 
 - Testing & Validation Expertise
 - Hands-on experience with simulation and validation tools such as CARLA, IPG CarMaker, dSPACE, Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, MATLAB/Simulink, or NVIDIA DRIVE Sim. 
 - Experience developing automated test frameworks and scenario-based validation environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of requirements-based testing, test design, coverage analysis, defect management, and traceability. 
 - Experience with performance analysis, vehicle log analysis, fault injection, and root-cause investigation. 
 - Familiarity with Git, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, and software quality assurance practices. 

Leadership & Delivery

- Demonstrated experience leading validation teams and managing complex automotive testing programmes. 
 - Ability to translate system requirements into validation plans, test strategies, and measurable acceptance criteria. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex system-level issues. 
 - Excellent communication, technical documentation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional coordination skills. 
 - Experience managing validation deliverables, technical risks, and release-readiness reviews. 
 - Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience in Level 3/Level 4 autonomous driving development and validation programmes. 
 - Exposure to autonomous vehicle retrofit solutions, industrial autonomous vehicles, or off-highway autonomy applications. 
 - Experience with ODD-based validation, scenario coverage analysis, and safety-critical edge-case testing. 
 - Knowledge of ISO 26262, SOTIF, ASPICE, and automotive cybersecurity requirements. 
 - Experience with NVIDIA Jetson/DRIVE platforms or other automotive compute platforms. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-based simulation, large-scale test automation, and data analytics. 
 - Experience working with automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, autonomous mobility companies, or robotics organisations. 

What We Expect

We are looking for a technically strong validation leader who goes beyond executing test cases and takes complete ownership of validation strategy, system quality, and release readiness. 

The successful candidate should be capable of building validation frameworks from the ground up, challenging system assumptions, identifying critical failure scenarios, and working closely with engineering teams to ensure that autonomous driving solutions perform safely and reliably in real-world environments.

Job Title: Verification & Validation Engineer

Location: Bengaluru / Chennai

Company: Epiroc Mining India Pvt Ltd

Job Description: 

We are looking for an experienced and forward-thinking Senior Verification & Validation Engineer to join our high-performance applications team. 

The role requires strong expertise in Python-based test automation, combined with hands-on experience in system and machine-level validation of mining, drilling, construction, automotive, or industrial equipment. 

In addition to verification and validation responsibilities, the candidate will act as a technology catalyst, identifying opportunities and transforming innovative ideas into practical, scalable solutions using AI-assisted testing, Digital Twin technologies, automated test systems and simulation. 

The ideal candidate should be capable of developing scalable automation frameworks, validating integrated systems on machines and test rigs, and driving new approaches that improve test coverage, quality, speed, and engineering efficiency. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Automation & Software Verification

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, integration, performance). 
 - Develop Python-based test scripts and custom automation frameworks. 
 - Use tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, and other libraries for automation of UI/embedded systems. 
 - Define test strategies, create comprehensive test plans, and manage test cases using Jira or equivalent tools. 
 - Perform debugging, log analysis, and root cause investigation for complex issues. 
 - Integrate test automation with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps). 

System / Machine Validation

- Conduct hands-on validation tests on machines, simulators, test benches, and integrated systems. 
 - Validate end-to-end workflows on mining/drilling equipment and ensure system compliance with functional & safety requirements. 
 - Perform hardware-software integration testing, including sensor, I/O, hydraulics, engine, and actuator interactions. 
 - Analyse machine performance, check system response behaviour, and document deviations or improvement needs. 
 - Ensure adherence to Epiroc's validation standards, safety practices, and field-testing guidelines. 
 - Ability to define test strategies, create detailed test plans, and manage test case repositories using tools like Jira. 
 - Skilled in troubleshooting and root cause analysis of complex issues. 
 - Experience with debugging tools and version control systems (e. g. , Git). 
 - Strong communication skills to work with cross-functional teams including developers, system engineers, and product owners. 
 - Ability to lead testing discussions, reviews, and defect triages. 
 - Passion for quality advocacy and mentoring junior team members in testing best practices. 

Required Skills and Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in relevant engineering fields (e. g. , Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science) with 3 to 8 years of professional experience. Proficient in Python with the ability to develop test scripts and automation frameworks. Experience in C++, PLC- based systems is an asset. 
 - Experience with automation tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, and related test libraries. Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban), including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative, team-based environment. Familiarity with communication protocols like CAN, J1939, LIN, and Ethernet is an advantage. 
 - Experience using Git for version control, CI/CD practices, and tools within the Azure DevOps ecosystem. Familiarity with automated deployment pipelines and versioning best practices. Excellent customer-facing skills with a proactive approach, capable of understanding client needs and delivering customized solutions

Nice to Have: Previous experience in heavy machinery in mining, construction, or automotive control systemsSelf-starter with curiosity to learn and an exploratory mindsetExperience with Docker containersStrong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication and teamwork skills. 

Agile certifications - such as Scrum MasterEnthusiastic, positive minded and able to work well in an international client environmentGood interpersonal, communication and analytical skillsTeam player - open-minded and flexible

AI-Assisted Testing and Engineering - Identify practical opportunities to use AI in verification, validation, and engineering workflows. Explore AI-assisted approaches for test-case generation, log analysis, defect identification, test prioritization, and test-result interpretation. Develop proof of concepts and convert promising AI ideas into usable engineering solutions. Support the implementation of intelligent test automation and data-driven validation approaches. Apply analytical and machine learning concepts to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential failures from test and machine data. Evaluate emerging AI tools and recommend suitable applications within verification and validation activities. Promote the responsible use of AI with appropriate focus on data quality, traceability, security, and engineering validation. 

Digital Twin and Virtual Validation -

Develop or support Digital Twin, simulation, and virtual validation environments for machine and system testing. Connect system models, simulated components, automation frameworks, and real machine data to improve validation coverage. Use Digital Twin environments to test system behaviour, operational scenarios, faults, and edge cases before machine-level testing. Automate test execution across simulated, virtual, and physical test environments. Analyse differences between simulated and actual machine behaviour and support model improvement. Drive the reuse of simulation assets and automated test components across projects. 

It all starts with people. The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support. 

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future. Learn more at www. epiroc. com

Preferences

 - Assess analyst decisions on customer risk profiling, transaction analysis, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity identification

 - Drive quality calibration discussions, ensuring consistency in interpretation of policies across teams
 - Support process improvements, SOP updates, and audit readiness initiatives.

 - Minimum 6 years of AML experience in Crypto/TMS/ EDD /processes, with: 
 - Proven track record as a strong performer, consistently meeting/exceeding quality and productivity benchmarks. 
 - Mandatory exposure to training and coaching analysts, including conducting knowledge sessions, providing structured feedback, and driving performance improvement.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Title

Software Engineer

Location

Bangalore/Hyderabad

About Us

Ingersoll Rand is a global provider of mission-critical flow creation, life science and industrial solutions. Ingersoll Rand's Global Engineering & Technology Center (GEC) in Bangalore, A GREAT PLACE TO WORK CERTIFIED WORKPLACE is driven by an ownership mindset and entrepreneurial spirit, has been a beacon of innovation for over 19 years, embodying our purpose to "Make Life Better" for our employees, customers, shareholders and the planet. 

The Engineering & Technology center has expertly supported a diverse range of industrial products, offering deep expertise in core and digital engineering space. By cultivating a sense of inclusion, belonging and respect, and a collaborative culture, the GEC has fostered the most talented and capable engineers, thereby playing a pivotal role in driving Ingersoll Rand's purpose and strategic focus areas. 

Job & Division Summary

The Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, testing, and validation of industrial automation and control systems using Structured Text and Ladder Logic programming languages. The role develops PLC based and automation solutions on platforms including Rockwell Automation, Phoenix Contact, Schneider, Emerson, and Siemens. Working closely with project and controls engineering teams, the Software Engineer delivers safe, reliable, maintainable, and customizable automation systems that meet project requirements, applicable standards, and customer expectations. 

This role reports to Jose Maldonado, Engineering Manager located at Lone Star Turbo, Houston, Texas, USA. 

Responsibilities

- Develop and test PLC and HMI applications for industrial automation and control systems. 
 - Create control system design documentation such as I/O lists, interface documents, network architecture, and cause & effect charts. 
 - Develop software solutions that meet customer requirements, project specifications, and company guidelines. 
 - Apply Lone Star Turbo programming guidelines to PLC and HMI software development projects. 
 - Conduct software testing, debugging, and validation activities to verify functionality and performance. 
 - Ensure compliance with customer specifications, industry standards, and company best practices. 
 - Participate in continuous improvement initiatives found on software quality, standardization, efficiency, and reliability. 
 - Collaborate with project engineers and controls engineers throughout the project lifecycle. 
 - Communicate effectively while working remotely with global engineering teams. 

Mandatory Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Minimum of 5 years of experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, or control system software development. 
 - Hands-on experience with one or more PLC platforms including Rockwell, PLCnext, Modicon, and Siemens. 
 - Experience programming using Structured Text, Ladder Logic, Function Blocks, or similar industrial automation programming languages. 
 - Knowledge of PLC hardware architectures, industrial instrumentation, analog and digital I/O systems, motor controls, and variable frequency drives. 
 - Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, P&IDs, control panel drawings, and network architecture documentation. 
 - Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work directly with customers and cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong proficiency in English and ability to communicate with global stake holders. 
 - Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. 

Desired Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Controls Engineering or Computer Engineering with strong background in software development for industrial PLCs and HMIs. 
 - Experience developing PLC based control systems using platforms such as Rockwell ControlLogix/CompactLogix, PLCnext, Modicon, and Siemens, with programming in Structured Text and Ladder Logic. 
 - Experience developing HMI and SCADA systems using platforms such as Factory Talk, Ignition, or Wonderware, including alarm management, historian integration, device communications, and operator interface design. 
 - Experience in Factory Acceptance Testing, Site Acceptance Testing, and commissioning of industrial automation systems. 
 - Understanding of control system fundamentals including PID control, interlocks, permissives, state machines, and process automation concepts. 
 - Familiarity with electrical and control panel design principles, instrumentation, and field device integration. 
 - Experience with software standardization, reusable code libraries, and automation architecture development. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

data.description:
About Us: 

Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12, 000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world. 

Job Description: 

Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business. 

At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we've grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city's Top 150 Privately Held Companies. 

What truly sets us apart is our culture-rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results. 

In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services-providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide. 

Our culture is built on: 

- Ownership - Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment. 
 - Flexibility - A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time. 
 - Empowerment - Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact. 
 - Learning and Growth - Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development. 

Career Development and Global Exposure

At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You'll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you'll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive. 

If you're ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment-where long-term stability meets start-up agility-and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we'd love to hear from you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Engineer - Controls with 8+ years of experience in the design, development, modification, migration, integration, and implementation of PLC and HMI/SCADA systems for discrete machinery and equipment. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen-Bradley (Rockwell Automation), and Beckhoff automation platforms. Experience in printing, paper converting, packaging, textile, or other machinery/OEM industries is highly preferred. 

The engineer should be able to take a systems approach to understand the overall machine design, mechanical functions, electrical architecture, control philosophy, safety systems, and automation requirements, and develop robust PLC and HMI programs ensuring the overall functional quality and performance of the machinery/equipment. 

The role will be responsible for the interface between electrical hardware, PLC software, HMI/SCADA, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, and machine-level automation. 

Technical Skills

PLC & HMI Platforms

Strong hands-on experience in one or more of the following platforms, with the ability to work across multiple automation platforms: 

- Siemens S7-1200 / S7-1500 PLCs
 - Siemens Comfort Panels / Unified Comfort Panels
 - Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation PLCs
 - ControlLogix
 - CompactLogix
 - Beckhoff PLC / IPC-based control systems
 - TwinCAT 3
 - EtherCAT
 - Experience with HMI/SCADA development and integration across Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms. 

PLC & HMI Development

- Hands-on experience developing PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on URS, functional specifications, and client standards. 
 - Ability to understand and develop PLC programs using: 
 - Ladder Logic
 - Function Block Diagram
 - Structured Text
 - Sequential Function Chart
 - Develop machine sequences, interlocks, alarms, permissives, recipes, diagnostics, and operator interfaces. 
 - Interface PLC programs with HMI/SCADA systems. 
 - Experience in modifying, debugging, migrating, and optimizing existing PLC/HMI programs. 
 - Experience with machine-level automation and discrete manufacturing applications. 
 - HMI scripting/programming experience using JavaScript, C#, or similar technologies is an added advantage. 

Siemens Automation

- Strong hands-on experience with Siemens S7-1500 PLCs. 
 - Experience with TIA Portal V15. 1 or above. 
 - TIA Portal V17/V18/V19 or later experience preferred. 
 - Siemens Comfort and Unified Comfort HMI development. 
 - PLC/HMI programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, and debugging. 
 - Experience with Siemens drives and motion systems is preferred. 

Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation

- Hands-on experience with Allen-Bradley PLCs. 
 - Experience with ControlLogix and/or CompactLogix platforms. 
 - Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix programming experience. 
 - Allen-Bradley HMI experience using FactoryTalk View is preferred. 
 - Experience with Rockwell drives, I/O, communication networks, and motion systems is an advantage. 

Beckhoff Automation

- Hands-on experience with Beckhoff PLC/control systems. 
 - Experience with TwinCAT 3 programming and development. 
 - Knowledge of EtherCAT communication and distributed I/O systems. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff IPCs, motion control, servo systems, and drives is preferred. 
 - Experience developing machine control applications using Structured Text is an advantage. 

Industrial Communication & Networking

Good understanding of industrial communication protocols and networking, including: 

- PROFINET / PROFIBUS
 - EtherNet/IP
 - EtherCAT
 - AS-i
 - CAN / CANopen
 - DeviceNet
 - Modbus TCP/RTU
 - OPC UA
 - Other industrial Ethernet and fieldbus protocols

Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and integrate PLCs, remote I/O, drives, HMIs, sensors, and other automation devices over industrial networks. 

Drives, Motors & Motion Control

- Knowledge of selection and application of motors, motor controllers, VFDs, servo drives, and motion-control systems. 
 - Understanding of: 
 - Motor horsepower
 - Torque
 - Speed range
 - Gear ratios
 - Reduction ratios
 - Acceleration/deceleration
 - Experience with Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Beckhoff drives is preferred. 
 - Basic understanding of servo positioning and motion-control applications. 

Instrumentation & Control Components

Good understanding of selection and application of industrial control components, including: 

- Sensors for flow, pressure, level, temperature, position, speed, counters, motion, vision, etc. 
 - Digital and analog sensors
 - Proximity and photoelectric sensors
 - Encoders
 - Transducers
 - Solenoid valves
 - Relays
 - Contactors
 - On/Off control devices
 - Analog I/O and signal conditioning
 - A/D and D/A conversion
 - I/P and P/I conversion

Understanding of sensor characteristics such as accuracy, precision, response time, repeatability, reliability, range, and environmental/temperature effects. 

FAT, SAT & Commissioning

- Develop automation test cases and procedures for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). 
 - Participate in FAT/SAT with customers and project teams. 
 - Hands-on experience in machine installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and start-up. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, I/O, communication, and machine sequence issues. 
 - Experience with remote commissioning and troubleshooting tools. 
 - Willingness to travel to customer sites for commissioning and project support. 

Standards & Compliance

Working knowledge of applicable industry codes, standards, and regulations such as: 

- ANSI
 - ISA
 - NEC
 - NEMA
 - NFPA
 - OSHA
 - UL

Experience working with machine safety systems and safety PLCs is an added advantage. 

Tool Skills

Mandatory / Core

- Siemens TIA Portal - V15. 1 or above
 - Siemens S7-1500 PLC
 - Siemens Comfort / Unified Comfort HMI
 - Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Studio 5000
 - ControlLogix / CompactLogix
 - Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
 - EtherCAT

Preferred

- TIA Portal V17+
 - FactoryTalk View
 - Siemens / Rockwell / Beckhoff drives and motion systems
 - OPC UA
 - Industrial Ethernet networking
 - HMI scripting / C# / JavaScript
 - EPLAN or similar electrical engineering tools

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline. 
 - 8+ years of experience in industrial automation and controls engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in PLC and HMI programming. 
 - Experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms is strongly preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience developing PLC/HMI programs from scratch. 
 - Experience in machinery/OEM applications is highly preferred. 
 - Experience in printing, packaging, paper converting, textile, or other discrete machinery industries is an advantage. 
 - Experience in machine commissioning and customer-site support is preferred. 

Key Result Areas

- Configure automation hardware and software according to project design specifications. 
 - Develop PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on machine automation requirements. 
 - Integrate Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff automation platforms with machine hardware and control systems. 
 - Ensure optimal performance, reliability, quality, and responsiveness of PLC/HMI applications. 
 - Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, motion, I/O, and industrial communication issues. 
 - Follow software development, change-management, and version-control procedures. 
 - Maintain proper documentation of PLC/HMI software and project changes. 
 - Manage assigned projects and deliver according to agreed schedules and scope. 
 - Communicate project progress, technical issues, and risks to project stakeholders. 
 - Support FAT, SAT, machine start-up, commissioning, and customer acceptance. 
 - Provide technical support to internal teams and customers as required. 

Soft Skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Logical and systematic approach to problem-solving. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. 
 - Ability to understand complex machine sequences and identify key technical issues. 
 - Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. 
 - Strong customer-facing and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and changing project requirements. 
 - Willingness to learn and work across multiple automation platforms. 

Travel

Occasional domestic and/or international travel may be required, up to 15%, for customer meetings, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project support. 

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a multi-platform Controls Engineer with strong practical experience in: 

Siemens + Allen-Bradley + Beckhoff

with hands-on capability in: 

PLC Programming → HMI Development → Drives/Motion → Industrial Communication → Machine Integration → FAT/SAT → Commissioning

Experience with OEM/discrete machinery, particularly printing, packaging, paper converting, or textile machinery, will be a strong advantage. 

Barry-Wehmiller is committed to creating a people-centric workplace where employees can bring their best selves to the work they do and grow through meaningful career opportunities. 

At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work-therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.

Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8 years of experience with software engineering, machine learning infrastructure, computer architecture, distributed computing, people management, debugging tools, communication. 
 - Experience with people management, and building infrastructure to improve performance of Machine Learning (ML) systems and applications. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Experience with Performance Optimization, Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) Programming, High Performance Computing, Large Language Model, Open Source Contributor. 
 - Experience with the Machine Learning infra and frameworks and with GPU or Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) performance analysis. 
 - Experience in building agentic workflows for performance debugging and optimization. Ability to generate ideas and resolve ambiguity. 
 - Experience with Machine Learning (ML) frameworks such as TensorFlow, JAX, and PyTorch, Keras. Experience with ML Inference frameworks such as vLLM, SG Lang, Pathways and in open-source software development, including experience in releasing and supporting open-source projects. 

About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way. 

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. 

Our team is focused around driving continuous improvements to the machine learning software/hardware stacks through providing insightful performance debugging for workloads and custom kernels. We provide insights by summarizing different views of captured profile data - such as trace timelines, memory usage, Compiler profiles, ML graph summaries

The ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc. ) and Google Cloud. Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world. 

We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing. Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud's Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers. 

Responsibilities

- Learn and build an intuitive understanding of existing data collection, analysis, and visualization workflows with deep introspection across Frameworks, Accelerated Linear Algebra (XLA) and runtime stack. 
 - Support new and exciting ML paradigms (such as horizontal scaling for upcoming TPU chips) by making contributions across the end to end stack and analysis tools. Partner with ML Stack leads to understand model optimization use cases and bring debugging to feel native in 3P environments (VSCode, Cursor, Grafana, etc. ). 
 - Work with OSS ML inference frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang to provide insights in Xprof about performance improvement opportunities. 
 - Partner with other teams that own various parts of the ML stack to understand performance optimization use cases. Work with OSS ML inference frameworks such as TorchTPU, vLLM, SGLang to provide insights into performance bottlenecks. 

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.title: Head of Trading Infrastructure
data.description:
- Careers
 - Head of Trading Infrastructure

Head of Trading Infrastructure

Open

We are now launching a dedicated institutional venue: a single-access platform that lets high-net-worth individuals, dealer desks, professional traders, large trading firms, and HFT shops execute across the exchanges and liquidity sources we connect to, all through one fast, deterministic, fully auditable system. We're looking for a leader to take ownership of that platform from the ground up. You will set the technical direction, drive the performance and reliability engineering, design the risk and control layer, and grow the team that builds it. The goal is institutional-grade execution infrastructure measured against the standards set by venues like CME and Nasdaq: fast, predictable, resilient, traceable, and ready for regulatory scrutiny from day one. 

The people who thrive in this role have spent their careers close to the matching layer, at exchanges, brokers, prime brokers, market makers, HFT firms, clearing houses, or large market infrastructure providers and are equally comfortable in an architecture review and a board-level conversation. 

What You'll Own

Platform direction

Shape the multi-year technical roadmap for the full execution path: client gateways, pre-trade controls, routing and matching, exchange connectivity, market data, post-trade processing, replay, and recovery. 

Liquidity aggregation and routing

Build the layer that consolidates books and depth across connected venues and the routing logic that decides where and how each order works, splitting, sweeping, and selecting venues with awareness of price, fees, and latency, all within tight, predictable time budgets. 

Venue connectivity

Stand up resilient, low-overhead links to multiple exchanges: unified symbology and order-state mapping, rate-limit and throttle handling, clean reconnection and failover, and a consolidated market-data feed across sources. 

Client access

Design the interfaces our institutional and HFT clients trade through, FIX/FIXP/SBE, binary, and REST/WebSocket, tuned for deterministic order entry and friendly to co-located, latency-sensitive flow. 

Latency and determinism

Drive tail-latency work end-to-end so that p99 and p99. 9 hold steady even when markets are at their most violent. 

Risk and protection

Architect the control layer that keeps both clients and the platform safe, including pre-trade validation, fat-finger and price-collar guards, self-trade prevention, throttling, position and margin limits, cancel-on-disconnect, kill switches, and emergency stops. 

Audit and compliance readiness

Engineer deterministic replay, complete audit trails, sequence recovery, and disciplined production governance so the platform stands up to regulators across jurisdictions. 

Standardization

Bring one coherent architecture and API contract across spot, margin, perpetuals, futures, options, unified accounts, portfolio margin, and institutional access. 

Engineering rigor

Set the bar for performance work, benchmarking, packet-level tracing, replay-based validation, and a real production-certification process, and own architecture reviews, incident learnings, resilience testing, and capacity planning. 

The team and the partners

Hire, mentor, and grow a strong engineering group across low-latency systems, distributed systems, market data, connectivity, and risk; and work shoulder-to-shoulder with product, compliance, security, risk, and regional regulatory teams. 

What We're Looking For

- 15+ years in trading or market-infrastructure technology, exchanges, HFT, market making, brokerage/DMA, clearing, liquidity aggregation, or similar. 
 - 5+ years leading senior engineers and/or owning the architecture of a mission-critical trading platform. 
 - A genuine grasp of how electronic markets work under the hood: matching and crossing, the full order lifecycle, market-data design, cross-venue consolidation, routing and best execution, trade capture and reconciliation, and recovery. 
 - Deep, hands-on command of C++ on Linux, plus networking, concurrency, lock-free design, memory and cache behavior, binary protocols, and tail-latency tuning. 
 - A track record of shipping systems that are resilient, observable, replayable, and auditable in regulated or institutional settings. 
 - The range to move between executive strategy and low-level technical detail, and the communication skills to carry both engineering and business stakeholders. 

Nice to Have

Any Of The Following Will Stand Out

- Multi-venue connectivity, liquidity aggregation, smart order routing, or DMA / prime-brokerage platforms
 - Matching engines, OMS/EMS, and post-trade or clearing systems
 - FIX / FIXP / SBE / OUCH / ITCH and other binary market protocols
 - Multicast market data and replay pipelines
 - PTP / IEEE 1588 timing, DPDK, RDMA, and FPGA-aware designs
 - Pre-trade risk and market-access control frameworks
 - High-availability design and disaster recovery for trading systems
 - Audit and trade-surveillance tooling
 - Co-location / cross-connect setups and onboarding of latency-sensitive clients

Job function: 

Qualcomm's QCT System Software Architecture team is helping build power efficient, embedded, next-generation system-on-chip solutions to enable advanced features in areas such as Mobile, Auto, XR and VR. data.title: Staff GTM AI Engineer
data.description:
Procore Technologies is the leading technology partner for every stage of construction. We empower construction teams to drive efficiency and mitigate risk through actionable AI & data-driven insights. For over 20 years, we have been transforming the industry with purpose-built solutions for construction professionals and we're looking for talented people to help us build together. 

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to build the AI agents that power Procore's go-to-market (GTM) teams. You'll join our GTM AI Engineering team and work with sellers and sales leaders to give each of them an assistant that knows their context and does real work on their behalf. You'll build it end to end, from the agent runtime to the app sellers use. Your strengths in Python, React, TypeScript, and production AI systems will drive your success. 

This is a hands-on role: you'll write and ship production code every week. 

You'll report to the Senior Manager, GTM AI Engineering and will be based in our Bengaluru office. 

What You'll Do

- Build agents sellers rely on. Ship agents that handle multi-step sales workflows reliably, giving sellers more time with customers. 
 - Partner with sellers. Find the problems worth solving with sellers and sales leaders, then own the solution from prototype to production. 
 - Scale the agent runtime. Develop durable runtimes in Python with LangGraph on AWS that grow from one use case to dozens without downtime. 
 - Give agents the right context. Design memory and context systems that give agents what they need while enforcing access controls and data privacy. 
 - Build the seller-facing app. Develop the interface where sellers see what matters across their accounts and put their agents to work. 
 - Make quality measurable. Create evals and observability that prove agent accuracy and improve it over time. 
 - Raise the bar. Set technical direction, mentor engineers across teams, and lead adoption of AI-native engineering. 

What You Bring

- 8+ years of software engineering experience and a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical work experience
 - Strong full-stack engineering skills in Python, React, and TypeScript
 - A track record of shipping LLM-powered applications or agents to production, not just prototypes
 - Hands-on work managing agent state, memory, and context across long-running workflows
 - Experience building and running secure, high-availability systems
 - Proven judgment navigating ambiguity, with the ability to set engineering priorities, explain technical trade-offs to non-technical and executive audiences, and build consensus
 - Nice to have: AWS, LangGraph or similar agent frameworks, Slack apps, Salesforce, Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka or Temporal, and sales domain experience.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineering - Cloud Practices - Service Leader
data.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

What You Will Do

At Digital Technology & Operations, you will contribute to the transformation of our company, the transport industry, and society at large. 

You Will

Be part of the Site Reliability Engineering unit team within Digital Excellence and IT Operations & Quality function. IT Operations & Quality provide safe, secure and cost-effective IT landscape for the company to execute, securing industrial uptime and quality management. 

As a Service Leader for Site Reliability Engineering Cloud Practices you will be reporting to the Service Area Manager of SRE Excellence. In this role you will operate in a global context, having a number of interfaces, including Volvos infrastructure partners and other strategic suppliers. You will belong to a newly formed team so you have possibilities to influence and steer the direction of the role. 

Your future team

You will work with other dedicated Service Leaders responsible for other services provided to the Volvo Group from the Site Reliability Engineering unit and IT Operations & Quality

In This Role, You Will

- Act as the practice authority for cloud operations within SRE and AOM for services in SRE team scope. 
 - Define, govern, and evolve cloud operational practices and patterns for AOM and SRE Services 
 - Design operating models, processes and supporting material for running SRE and AOM on Cloud applications 
 - Define and follow up accountability for "You build it you run it" Cloud based Digital products 
 - Enable consistent adoption of services across Digital Product teams 
 - Align cloud operations with Enterprise Architecture, Security and Platform teams 
 - Optimize Application services running on Cloud, such as SRE and AOM 
 - Ensure service compatibility and compliance with cloud operational standards 
 - Ensure consistent supplier adoption of cloud practices 
 - Drive resilience, scalability, and cost‐optimization initiatives 
 - Align cloud operations for digital products with SRE principles 
 - Support Run & Build teams with cloud expertise 
 - Recommend corrective actions for cloud risks and inefficiencies 
 - Track and report service adoption and outcomes 
 - Contribute to service development initiatives 
 - Ensure service compliance with enterprise, architectural, Cross functional and security standards

Who are you?

Do you dream big? We do too, and we are excited to grow together. In this role, you will bring: 

Required Competencies And Experience

You hold a university or master's degree, or have equivalent qualifications in a relevant field. With 5-10 years of experience in governing Cloud and SaaS solutions, you bring a strong service-oriented mindset and a solid background in IT governance and service management. 

You have extensive knowledge of Application Operations Management (AOM) and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), along with a good understanding of Agile ways of working. You are experienced in directing, planning and monitoring outcome-based services, and in managing suppliers and stakeholders effectively. 

You have worked in a global environment, including functional management, and are confident steering projects and programmes. Knowledge and experience of ITIL and SIAM will help you succeed in this role. 

A skilled communicator and presenter, you can engage and influence a wide range of audiences. You are fully proficient in English and comfortable working across international teams. 

Ready for the next move?

You get an opportunity to work together with highly skilled colleagues in an exciting, global environment which provides opportunities to develop both professionally and personally. You will work in close collaboration with various stakeholders inside as well as outside the Volvo Group. 

At Volvo Group we are actively working to establish teams that will take maximum advantage of the strengths inherent in differences in knowledge, experience, age, gender, nationality etc. 

Hiring manager : Janne WALMU

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. 

Who We Are And What We Believe In

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group's leading brands and entities. 

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100, 000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 

Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations (DTO) is a new division. The organizational set up is structured around domains, digital products with functions for digital excellence to deliver outstanding customer experience. 

Joining the new DTO division means being part of a fast-moving digital product-oriented organization where teams truly own what they build from idea to delivery. In DTO, we work in agile, cross-functional teams, mastering the latest technology, and creating outstanding digital experiences that make a real difference for our colleagues and Volvo Group customers around the world. We put people first and build our culture on trust, passion, customer success, change, and performance. If you want to grow, collaborate across functions and entities, and help shape the future of digital products within Volvo Group, DTO is a great place to be. 

In some countries and for specific positions within Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations, background checks may be required, in accordance with local laws & regulations. If this is applicable to the role you have applied for, you will be informed.

data.description:
- Careers
 - Senior Software Architect

Senior Software Architect

Open

Summary

We are hiring a Senior Software Architect to own the technical design of the systems Delta6Labs builds across exchanges, wallets and custody, trading infrastructure, and the white-label core that underpins our client deployments. You will report to the CTO / VP of Engineering & Product Development and work across every squad without owning any of them. 

What you will own

System and platform architecture

- Design end-to-end architecture for new platforms and major subsystems from context and constraints through service decomposition, data models, integration contracts, and deployment topology. 
 - Design high-throughput, low-latency paths order matching, order-book and market-data distribution, risk checks, liquidity routing against explicit written latency, and throughput budgets rather than hopeful
 - Design wallet and custody architecture: hot, warm, and cold segregation, MPC and multi-signature schemes, key lifecycle and rotation, withdrawal approval and limit flows, and integration with providers such as
 - Own data architecture relational modeling, event schemas and their evolution, caching strategy, analytical and time-series stores, retention, and data-residency requirements across jurisdictions. 
 - Define non-functional architecture explicitly: availability and latency targets, failure domains and blast radius, degradation behavior, capacity headroom, and disaster-recovery design with real RPO and RTO figures. 

Reuse, the white-label core and technical strategy

- Own the architectural line between the reusable platform core and client-specific extension so customization happens at configuration and extension points rather than by forking, and one client's requirement does not become everyone's regression. 
 - Design tenant isolation, configuration, and feature-flag models that let us onboard a new client without re-architecting, and ship a fix to one without endangering the rest. 
 - Maintain reference architecture and reusable building blocks for our recurring product shapes - CEX, derivatives, wallet, and launchpad, so each engagement starts from proven ground rather than a blank
 - Own the technology radar with the CTO: what we standardize on, what we pilot, what we deliberately retire, and the honest build-versus-buy calls on custody, market data, compliance, and infrastructure. 
 - Produce the architectural roadmap for paying down structural debt and sequence it so remediation lands alongside delivery rather than competing with it. 

Security and compliance by design

- Threat-model high-value flows authentication, withdrawals, key operations, privileged and admin access, third-party callbacks, and design controls in from the start rather than bolting them on after an audit finds
 - Own the architecture of authentication, authorization and tenancy boundaries, secrets and key management, least privilege, and tamper-evident audit trails. 
 - Architect integration with compliance and analytics vendors - KYC/AML (SumSub, Veriff), blockchain analytics (Chainalysis), sanctions screening - including failure and fallback behavior for when a vendor is down and onboarding cannot simply stop. 
 - Set the architectural standards and review criteria for smart-contract work, and act as our technical counterpart in external audits and penetration tests. 

Client solutioning and pre-sales engineering

- Translate client requirements - often expressed commercially or in regulatory language into architectures that are buildable, supportable, and honestly estimated. 
 - Lead technical discovery and solution design for new engagements: constraints, integrations, jurisdictional requirements, non-functional targets, and the assumptions everything else rests on. 
 - Support pre-sales with architecture walkthroughs, feasibility assessments, effort and risk shaping, and RFP responses, and say clearly when a request is technically unwise before it becomes a commitment. 
 - Represent Delta6Labs credibly in front of client CTOs, security teams, and auditors, and leave them more confident than when the meeting started. 

Technical leadership without direct authority

- Write documents that carry decisions design docs, RFCs, and architecture decision records that state the problem, the options, the trade-offs, and the reasoning clearly enough that an engineer can build from them and a successor can understand them in two years. 
 - Run the architecture review practice: review significant designs before they are built and critical code after and give feedback that improves the design rather than merely signaling seniority. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and tech leads toward architectural thinking and grow the next generation of architects deliberately rather than by accident. 
 - Build consensus across squads, Product, QA and DevSecOps - in this role, you will need to be persuasive far more often than you get to be decisive. 
 - Stay hands-on: prototype the risky part, benchmark the assumption, and debug the incident nobody else Architecture that is never validated in code is speculation. 

What you must bring

- 12+ years building production software, including 5+ years as an architect, principal engineer, or equivalent senior technical authority. 
 - A portfolio of systems you personally designed that reached production and stayed there, with the ability to explain the constraints, the trade-offs you chose, and what you would do differently now. 
 - Deep distributed-systems expertise: service decomposition, event-driven architecture, streaming and messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar), consistency and consensus trade-offs, idempotency, and designing for partial failure as the normal case. 
 - Genuine hands-on depth in at least one of C++, js/TypeScript, or Python, databases with the fluency to read and reason across the others. 
 - Demonstrated architectural ownership of a high-throughput, low-latency, or high-transaction-volume platform in fintech, payments, trading, exchange, or a comparable domain. 
 - Proven, hands-on production experience in at least one of the following two domains: 
 - Crypto / blockchain: building or architecting exchanges, wallets and custody, on-chain integrations, node infrastructure, transaction lifecycle, and settlement across major chains (e. g. Bitcoin, Ethereum/EVM, Solana), with a working understanding of consensus, finality, gas/fee mechanics, and smart-contract interaction. 
 - HFT / trading infrastructure: developing matching engines, order-management and execution systems, market-data feed handlers, pre-trade risk checks, and exchange/FIX connectivity, with a track record of measuring and optimizing tail latency (microsecond to low-millisecond) and throughput under real market load. 
 - Strong data architecture skills: relational modeling and query performance at scale, caching, schema, and event evolution, and choosing appropriately between relational, time-series, analytical and NoSQL
 - Deep API and integration design experience - REST, WebSocket, including versioning, contracts, rate limiting and authorization models fit to hand to a third party. 
 - Strong cloud and infrastructure architecture competence: AWS or GCP, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, and cost-aware design. 
 - Security architecture instincts appropriate to systems holding customer funds: threat modeling, authentication and authorization, key and secret management, least privilege, and auditability. 
 - Exceptional written This role produces documents other people build from; if you cannot write a clear design doc, you cannot do this job. 
 - The judgement and composure to defend a technical position with senior engineers and to explain risk plainly to executives, clients, and auditors. 
Education

B. E. / B. Tech / M. C. A. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent practical experience considered. 

Nice to have

- Smart-contract architecture and audit experience, including upgradeability patterns and known failure
 - Experience with custody and key-management systems: MPC, multi-signature, HSMs, or providers such as
 - Financial-systems fundamentals: double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, fee engines, market-data normalization, and regulatory reporting. 
 - Prior architect experience in a product-and-services organization with a multi-tenant or white-label delivery model and client-facing technical responsibility. 
 - Working knowledge of standards relevant to fintech and digital assets: OWASP, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and AML/KYC obligations. 
 - Open-source contribution, published technical writing, or conference speaking in distributed systems, fintech or blockchain. 

Note: Interested candidates may send their resumes to recruitment@delta6labs. com. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

data.description:
Role Summary

- Lead the engineering, coordination, implementation, testing and commissioning of integrated IBMS and ELV systems for mission-critical/data centre environments. 
 - Provide technical leadership across ELV, Security, BMS, EPMS and CPM, ensuring system architecture, interfaces, drawings, sequences and point lists are aligned with project requirements. 
 - Act as the senior technical interface between client, consultant, design teams, vendors, system integrators, MEP disciplines, IT/networking and site execution teams. 
 - Drive design reviews, technical submissions, FAT/SAT, integrated testing, commissioning and final handover. Key Responsibilities

- Review project specifications, employer requirements, design briefs, basis of design, approved architecture and applicable standards. 
 - Develop and review overall IBMS architecture, network architecture, control philosophy, system integration and redundancy strategy. 
 - Lead coordination of BMS/DDC, EPMS/Power Monitoring, CPM/critical power monitoring, CCTV, Access Control, PAS/PA, Fire Alarm interfaces, security and other ELV systems as applicable. 
 - Review equipment schedules, I/O lists, points lists, cause-and-effect matrices, control sequences, alarm philosophy, graphics philosophy and interface documents. 
 - Coordinate BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, Modbus RTU, SNMP, OPC and other required protocols/interfaces with system vendors. 
 - Review and approve technical submittals, datasheets, compliance statements, BOQs, MTOs, network diagrams, SLDs, panel layouts, cable schedules and shop drawings. 
 - Ensure dual network paths, controller redundancy, server redundancy, switch redundancy and power redundancy are incorporated wherever required by the project design. 
 - Coordinate with electrical, HVAC, mechanical, fire, IT/networking and civil/structural teams to resolve interface and installation constraints. 
 - Lead technical meetings with vendors and contractors and close design/RFI/technical observations within agreed timelines.
