 - Plan and witness FAT, SAT, pre-functional checks, functional testing, integrated systems testing (IST) and end-to-end cause-and-effect testing. 
 - Review testing scripts, method statements, commissioning procedures and test evidence and ensure closure of punch points. 
 - Monitor site installation quality, addressing deviations from approved drawings and specifications. 
 - Support cybersecurity and network segregation requirements for OT/IBMS systems in coordination with IT/network/security teams. 
 - Review vendor performance, technical compliance, procurement requirements and long-lead equipment requirements. 
 - Lead as-built documentation, O&M documentation, training and final handover activities. System-Specific Expertise

- ELV: CCTV, Access Control, PAS/PA, structured cabling, security systems and associated network/integration requirements. 
 - BMS: DDC controllers, HVAC monitoring/control, sensors, actuators, valves, dampers, AHUs/PAHUs/FWUs, chillers/CDUs and associated sequences. 
 - EPMS: Electrical meters, protection/monitoring interfaces, power quality, ATS/UPS/generator/switchgear monitoring and electrical alarms/statuses. 
 - CPM: Critical power monitoring, critical equipment interfaces, alarms, trends, energy/power parameters and integration with IBMS/SCADA. 
 - IBMS/SCADA: Servers, virtual machines, databases/historian, operator workstations, graphics, alarms, reports, trends, integration gateways and redundant architecture. Drafting & Design Coordination Skills

- Ability to provide drafting direction to L2/L3 engineers and ensure drawings are technically accurate, coordinated and ready for submission. 
 - Working knowledge of AutoCAD is required; exposure to Revit/BIM and Navisworks/clash coordination is an added advantage. 
 - Ability to review IFC, construction and as-built drawings and provide clear technical comments for correction. 
 - Ability to verify drawings against BOQ, equipment schedules, point lists, approved architecture, specifications and vendor technical submittals. 
 - Good understanding of drawing standards, layer management, equipment tagging, legends, revision control and drawing submission procedures. 
 - Ability to identify drawing clashes, missing interfaces, incorrect equipment locations, cable routing constraints and constructability issues during design review. 
 - Experience in multidisciplinary drawing coordination with electrical, HVAC, architectural, structural, fire and IT/networking disciplines. 
 - Ability to review EPMS and CPM layouts covering meters, electrical panels, communication gateways, network connectivity and monitoring interfaces. 
 - Ability to review BMS/DDC layouts, HVAC equipment connectivity, sensor/actuator locations, control panel interfaces and field device layouts. 
 - Good understanding of coordinated ELV layouts including CCTV, Access Control, PAS/PA, structured cabling, security systems and associated containment. 
 - Ability to guide preparation of IBMS architecture, system block diagrams, network topology, panel connectivity, control schematics and detailed system layouts. 
 - Strong ability to review and technically validate AutoCAD/BIM drawings prepared by design and drafting teams. Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Controls, Automation, Computer or related engineering discipline. 
 - Typically 10-15+ years of relevant experience, with significant experience in IBMS/BMS/ELV/EPMS projects and preferably data centre or mission-critical facilities. 
 - Strong experience in engineering, design review, vendor management, testing and commissioning. 
 - Hands-on understanding of BMS/SCADA, networking and industrial communication protocols. 
 - Ability to independently review technical documents and lead multidisciplinary technical coordination. Key Deliverables

- Approved system architecture and design documentation. 
 - Technical submittals, BOQ/MTO and coordinated shop drawings. 
 - Approved point lists, sequences, interface matrices and testing procedures. 
 - FAT/SAT/IST completion and closure of observations. 
 - As-built documentation, O&M manuals, training and successful system handover.

data.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) – Embedded Firmware / SIL – Senior Engineer, GJFA 6 Level 1
data.description:
Key Responsibilities: 

- Analyze firmware requirements, architecture, C/C++ source code, design principles, and existing test procedures to identify test scenarios, establish expected behavior, and develop automated tests with clear requirements traceability
 - Adapt C/C++ firmware and its operating system and hardware interfaces to support host-based SIL execution
 - Develop and maintain Python test scripts, reusable libraries, hardware simulations, and test utilities within the existing SIL framework, extending the framework to support additional subsystems and products
 - Develop positive, negative, boundary-condition, and fault-injection tests covering functional behavior, interfaces, fault handling, recovery, and state transitions, including timeouts, sequencing, and concurrency-related behavior within SIL capabilities rather than assuming target-equivalent execution timing
 - Run tests, assess results, reproduce defects, and investigate failures throughout the firmware, interface adaptations, simulations, framework, and test code to distinguish product defects from test-environment issues
 - Integrate tests with Azure DevOps (ADO), GitHub, and CI workflows
 - Collaborate with embedded software, systems, architecture, verification, and quality engineers to improve testability
 - Develop repeatable, isolated tests with reliable setup and cleanup, clear assertions, versioned firmware and test configurations, review records, and retained results to support regression testing and use in formal verification
 - Improve framework reliability, simulation fidelity, execution efficiency, and test coverage; identify differences between simulated and target behavior that could affect test validity

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
 - 8-10 years of relevant experience grounded in hands-on embedded software/firmware development; experience limited to general software automation or SDET work is not a substitute for this foundation
 - Strong embedded C/C++ firmware development experience and understanding of firmware architecture, design principles, microcontrollers, peripherals, hardware interfaces, platform software, and abstraction layers
 - Hands-on experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS) and OS abstraction concepts
 - Demonstrated ability to learn new programming languages and tools, and willingness to build Python proficiency for test automation, framework extensions, and hardware simulation

 - Good understanding of real-time system fundamentals, including scheduling, interrupts, concurrency, timing behavior, communication interfaces, and fault handling

 - Knowledge of risk-based verification, requirements traceability, configuration management, and objective test evidence

 - Experience improving an existing test automation framework

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.description:
Job Summary

Lead Quality Engineer role for a global organization in the Asset and Wealth Management domain responsible for designing and executing robust test strategies across hybrid work environments. The role focuses on automation frameworks and continuous integration using tools such as Jenkins and Gitlab ensuring reliable delivery of Python based services and APIs. The candidate will collaborate with cross functional teams in day shift operations driving consistent quality for digital platforms tha

Responsibilities

- Drive end to end quality engineering strategy for Asset and Wealth Management platforms ensuring that automation and validation activities align with regulatory expectations and client centric investment outcomes. 
 - Design and implement scalable automation frameworks using Python Playwright PyTest and RestAssured to validate web interfaces backend services and integration layers across hybrid work settings. 
 - Coordinate continuous integration and continuous testing pipelines in Jenkins and Gitlab optimizing build verification suites and test execution stages to reduce defects escaping into production environments. 
 - Guide test planning and risk based coverage design for complex portfolio management trading and advisory workflows emphasizing accuracy of calculations reporting integrity and resilience under market stress scenarios. 
 - Collaborate with product owners business analysts and engineering teams to refine acceptance criteria and translate Asset and Wealth Management domain rules into clear test cases and reusable automated scripts. 
 - Monitor and analyze test metrics including defect trends test pass ratios pipeline stability and environment reliability using results to recommend targeted improvements to application architecture and team processes. 
 - Coordinate root cause analysis for critical incidents across digital channels and advisor tools partnering with developers and operations teams to prevent recurrence and strengthen automated regression suites. 
 - Maintain version control discipline in Gitlab repositories by organizing test assets enforcing branching guidelines and reviewing merge requests to protect the reliability of shared automation frameworks. 
 - Mentor fellow quality engineers on best practices in Python based automation Playwright and PyTest usage API validation with RestAssured and continuous integration optimization to uplift overall team capability. 
 - Partner with security and compliance stakeholders to incorporate nonfunctional checks and data protection scenarios into quality engineering practices supporting safe handling of client portfolios and personal information. 
 - Coordinate test data design strategies that reflect diverse investor profiles product mixes and advisory scenarios ensuring that automated validation mirrors realistic Asset and Wealth Management usage patterns. 
 - Document quality approach test strategies and automation standards in a clear and reusable manner so that distributed hybrid teams can consistently apply shared practices across releases and programs. 
 - Engage in regular day shift ceremonies such as refinement and release readiness reviews to provide data driven quality assessments that inform go live decisions and long term product roadmaps. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate strong experience in Python programming for test automation including creation of modular frameworks reusable utilities and maintainable test suites tailored to financial domain scenarios. 
 - Bring deep hands on expertise with Playwright and PyTest to validate user journeys functional rules and cross browser behaviors for client and advisor facing Asset and Wealth Management applications. 
 - Show proven ability to design and execute API test suites using RestAssured validating business logic data consistency and error handling for portfolio services and advisory integration endpoints. 
 - Possess practical experience configuring and maintaining Jenkins and Gitlab pipelines for continuous integration and continuous testing including job orchestration artifact management and report publication. 
 - Offer substantial domain understanding of Asset and Wealth Management including portfolio construction order flows compliance checks and investor reporting so that test scenarios reflect real world usage. 
 - Apply solid skills in source control management and collaborative development workflows ensuring reliable evolution of test assets and coordinated contributions across hybrid distributed teams. 
 - Exhibit strong analytical and communication capabilities to interpret complex financial requirements discuss quality implications with stakeholders and convert them into precise automated and manual tests.

data.title: Sr Quality Assurance
data.description:
Syniverse is the world's most connected company. Whether we're developing the technology that enables intelligent cars to safely react to traffic changes or freeing travelers to explore by keeping their devices online wherever they go, we believe in leading the world forward. Which is why we work with some of the world's most recognized brands. Eight of the top 10 banks. Four of the top 5 global technology companies. Over 900 communications providers. And how we're able to provide our incredible talent with an innovative culture and great benefits. 

Who We're Looking For

As a Sr Quality assurance (QA) engineer you will be in charge of designing and developing the QA management systems and tools of the organization. Define test requirements and automate test procedures to help create and maintain an exceptional user experience for Syniverse's customers. 

The ideal candidate will be responsible for conducting tests before product launches to ensure software runs smoothly and meets client needs, while being cost-effective. 

Some Of What You'll Do

Scope of the Role: 

- Direct Reports: This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports

Key Responsibilities

- Verify component, system integration and application level features and functionality to ensure our reliability, accuracy and performance reaches our standards for quality. 
 - Verify, deploy and maintain automated test cases. 
 - Contribute to existing tools, frameworks and related solutions. 
 - Improve our delivered product quality across our entire platform and applications. 
 - Assist with the team's test effort from planning and organization to execution and delivery. 
 - Develop effective test strategies. 
 - Work with team members to keep testing at the forefront of our SDLC. 
 - Drive further adoption of unit/integration/system testing using cucumber and selenium or any other automation tool, metrics to monitor code coverage, bug prevention strategies, and other quality measures. 
 - Partner with Software Developers, Product Managers, and other Test Engineers to identify the components of the system to be automated. 
 - Duties and Requirements Specific to "Software Development Engineer in Test": Plan, design, develop, verify, deploy and maintain automated test cases. 
 - Increase and improve our automated test coverage. 
 - Leverage new open source solutions to build new tools that test things in new ways. 
 - Write moderately complex code to test systems. 

Experience, Education, And Certifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or similar technical field 
 - 5 years using test automation frameworks ie: Cucumber, FitNesse, TestNG, and Selenium 
 - 5 years' experience with Source Code Management like CVS, Git or SubVersion 
 - 3+ years of experience writing tests in Java and/or JUnit development. 

Why You Should Join Us

Join us as we write a new chapter, guided by world-class leadership. Come be a part of an exciting and growing organization where we offer a competitive total compensation, flexible/remote work and with a leadership team committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and transparent organizational culture. 

At Syniverse connectedness is at the core of our business. We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion among our employees is crucial to our success as a global company as we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people who want to help us connect the world. 

Know someone at Syniverse?

Be sure to have them submit you as a referral prior to applying for this position. 

Pay Transparency

In accordance with applicable pay transparency requirements, Syniverse will provide information regarding the salary range or compensation for this position during the recruitment process and prior to any compensation discussions.

data.description:
Company Profile

Lennox (NYSE: LII) Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member's contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us. 

Responsibilities

Job Description

- Design and develop cloud-connected IoT software and embedded/edge components, with C++ as the primary language. 
 - Build services for device onboarding, telemetry ingestion, device management, and command/control workflows. 
 - Develop distributed, real-time communication components integrating Edge, HTTPS, and REST APIs. 
 - Own successful implementation and delivery of software products and components throughout the product lifecycle, on time and with high quality. 
 - Assure proper technical requirement definition with internal and external customers, marketing, manufacturing, and other support groups. 
 - Lead technical design and architecture reviews, and participate in prototyping activities. 
 - Collaborate with Architecture, Embedded, Mobile Apps, IT, Hardware, QA, Manufacturing, Technical Support, and Operations teams. 
 - Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements. 
 - Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization's intellectual property and to better address customer needs. 
 - Mentor and train other engineers. 
 - Having Open mindset to work with legacy network libraries in IoT domain 
 - More curious to learn any Open Source libraries

Experience & Languages

- 10+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on IoT and embedded systems. 
 - Proficiency in C++ developing distributed, real-time applications. 
 - 5+ years of experience with multithreaded application development and debugging. 
 - 5+ years of experience with socket-level TCP and UDP development in C/C++, using modern debugging tools. 
 - Strong understanding of software design principles and best practices; ability to develop unit-test-driven software components. 

Cloud & IoT

- Strong understanding of IoT architectures, protocols, and standards: MQTT, WebSockets, HTTPS, REST APIs, JSON/XML. 
 - Experience with cloud IoT services such as Azure IoT Hub and AWS IoT Core.

data.title: Lead Full-Stack Engineer
data.description:
About EduBridge

EduBridge Learning is one of India's largest workforce skilling companies. Our Product & Learning Solutions team builds the products that power learning and careers at scale: an AI-powered language learning app, a job readiness assessment platform, an international careers platform and career services tools. Our learners are young people starting their careers across India. 

Why This Role

We are building a new AI-powered product from the ground up, launching in 2027. You will lead its development from the first line of code to paying customers. 

•        Own the architecture and the engineering decisions from day one. 

•        Write the core code yourself, and set the standard the rest of the team follows. 

•        Mentor and grow the junior developers who build alongside you. 

•        Work directly with the President of Product & Learning Solutions and the product team. 

What You Will Do

1. Lead the build

•        Design the architecture: services, data model, APIs, environments and deployment. 

•        Turn product requirements into a technical plan with honest estimates, and flag risks early. 

•        Write and own the core backend, frontend and integration code. 

•        Take the product to its first release, then ship a release every month after launch. 

2. Set engineering standards

•        Run code reviews on every change before it is merged. 

•        Set up testing, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and clear documentation. 

•        Build multi-tenant architecture with row-level security, so every customer organisation sees only its own data. 

•        Make security and data privacy, including DPDP compliance, part of every release. 

3. Mentor and grow the team

•        Guide junior developers and interns through pairing, reviews and clear feedback. 

•        Break work into tasks they can own, and help them become independent. 

•        Build a team culture where quality, ownership and shipping on time are normal. 

4. AI and integrations

•        Integrate large language models, speech and voice APIs, and machine learning models into production features. 

•        Build AI features that are reliable, measurable and affordable to run at scale. 

•        Integrate third-party systems and data sources cleanly and securely. 

5. Work closely with product

•        Work in two-week sprints with weekly demos, tracked in Linear. 

•        Present progress at our weekly product reviews, straight from the work. 

•        Partner with design and product to make sure what we ship is what users need. 

Your First 90 Days

•        By day 30: understand the product requirements and our current systems, and agree the architecture and engineering plan. 

•        By day 60: core modules running in a staging environment, with code review, testing and deployment standards in place for the team. 

•        By day 90: the first release live, and junior developers shipping features independently under your review. 

What You Must Have

•        8 to 12 years of full-stack development experience. 

•        At least 3 years leading development as a tech lead or lead engineer, including mentoring developers. 

•        Built at least one product from scratch to production, and scaled it with real users. 

•        Strong backend skills in Node. js or Python, and frontend skills in React or Next. js. 

•        Deep PostgreSQL experience: schema design, performance and row-level security. Supabase or an equivalent platform is a plus. 

•        Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS architecture. 

•        Hands-on experience integrating AI or LLM APIs into live products. 

•        Strong grip on security, CI/CD, cloud deployment and production monitoring. 

•        Clear communication with product, leadership and junior engineers. 

Good To Have

•        Experience in EdTech, HRTech or B2B SaaS. 

•        Speech, voice or real-time audio integrations. 

•        Mobile experience with React Native or Flutter. 

•        Working knowledge of data privacy rules such as India's DPDP Act. 

•        Analytics dashboards and reporting for business users. 

•        Experience with Linear, Jira or similar sprint tools. 

How To Apply

Email Rajita. S@edubridgeindia. in with your resume and links to products you have built or led, or your GitHub. Use the subject line: Lead Full-Stack Engineer. 

Role Details

Role: Lead Full-Stack Engineer

Industry Type: E-Learning / EdTech

data.title: Software Eng Manager
data.description:
Job Description

Honeywell is looking for an experienced Engineering Manager - Data Center Software to lead a multi-disciplinary software engineering organization developing next-generation control and supervisory solutions for Data Center applications. 

The manager will lead approximately 30 engineers organized into 6 Scrum teams delivering embedded PLC/controller software, supervisory software, controller configuration and programming tools, control strategies, Web UI and PC-based engineering/user interfaces. 

The role requires a strong combination of people leadership, technical depth, product engineering discipline and execution excellence. The successful candidate will work closely with software architects, product management, offering management, system engineering, quality and global engineering teams to turn Data Center requirements into scalable, secure and product-grade solutions. 

Honeywell's internal Data Center definition extends beyond software alone to integration across BMS, HVAC, power, cooling, fire detection/suppression and security infrastructure

Responsibilities

Engineering & People Leadership

- Lead, mentor and develop an engineering organization of approximately 30 engineers across 6 Scrum teams. 
 - Build a strong technical leadership structure through architects, technical leads and Scrum/product engineering leads. 
 - Own resource planning, competency development, hiring, onboarding and succession planning. 
 - Establish clear accountability for delivery, engineering quality and technical excellence. 
 - Coach engineers and technical leaders and create an environment that promotes innovation, ownership and continuous learning. 
 - Develop expertise in Data Center automation, controls, embedded systems and supervisory software across the organization. 

Product Development & Execution

- Own end-to-end software execution from requirements through architecture, implementation, verification, release and product maintenance. 
 - Drive predictable delivery across multiple Scrum teams while managing technical dependencies between controller, supervisor, tools, UI and control-strategy teams. 
 - Establish engineering plans, milestones, risks, dependencies and release readiness criteria. 
 - Ensure solutions progress beyond prototypes and proof-of-concepts into maintainable, testable and commercially deployable products. 
 - Establish appropriate Agile practices, CI/CD, automated testing and engineering metrics. 
 - Drive defect reduction, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement. 

Technical Leadership

The candidate should be technically capable of reviewing and challenging designs covering: 

- PLC and embedded controller architecture
 - Real-time/control software
 - Supervisory and distributed control software
 - PLC/controller programming and configuration tools
 - Control strategy development
 - Web applications and Web UI
 - Windows/PC engineering applications and GUI
 - IP networking and distributed systems
 - BMS and industrial communication protocols
 - Cybersecurity and secure software engineering

The internal Data Center architecture already uses controller, network, supervisor and tooling layers, including PLC/unitary controllers communicating over BACnet/IP to supervisory and engineering-tool components. 

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner with Product/Offering Management to translate market problems into an executable product roadmap. 
 - Work closely with architects to drive architecture, technology selection, design reviews and technical-debt management. 
 - Collaborate with system, hardware, firmware, QA, cybersecurity and application engineering teams. 
 - Engage global engineering stakeholders and customer-facing teams to resolve critical technical and delivery issues. 
 - Participate in technical and product readiness reviews. 

Required Technical Skills

Core Software Engineering

- Strong background in C/C++ for embedded/controller development. 
 - Experience with languages such as C#, Java and/or Python for supervisory systems, engineering tools or automation. 
 - Strong knowledge of object-oriented design, design patterns, APIs and distributed systems. 
 - Multi-threading, IPC, synchronization and network programming. 
 - Windows and/or Linux application development. 
 - REST APIs and modern service-oriented application architecture. 

Controls & Embedded

- PLC/controller architecture and programming. 
 - Embedded software/firmware development. 
 - Real-time control concepts. 
 - I/O, sensing, actuator and equipment-control concepts. 
 - Control-loop and sequencing concepts. 
 - Development and deployment of reusable control strategies. 
 - IEC 61131-3 concepts/languages such as Structured Text, Function Block Diagram and Ladder Diagram are highly desirable. 

Building & Data Center Automation

- Building Management Systems / Building Automation Systems. 
 - HVAC and cooling control. 
 - Supervisory control systems. 
 - Data Center cooling/control applications. 
 - Integration with electrical/power and other facility subsystems. 
 - BACnet/IP and Modbus; knowledge of additional industrial protocols is desirable. 

These capabilities match Honeywell's internal Data Center requirements, which identify BMS, HVAC, power distribution, cooling, networking, DCIM integration and relevant security/industry standards as core knowledge areas. 

Networking & Cybersecurity

- TCP/IP and Ethernet networking. 
 - Routing, VLANs and multi-subnet deployments. 
 - TLS, certificates, authentication and authorization. 
 - Secure coding and threat-modeling fundamentals. 
 - Product cybersecurity and vulnerability-management lifecycle. 

Multi-segment and multi-IP-subnet supervisory/controller deployments are explicitly part of the proposed Data Center architecture. 

UI & Application Technologies

Working Knowledge Of Technologies Used To Build

- Browser-based/Web UI
 - PC/Windows GUI applications
 - Dashboards and visualization
 - Configuration and engineering tools

Candidates do not need to be the primary UI developer but should be capable of making sound engineering and architectural decisions across the whole software stack. 

Leadership Competencies

- Proven experience leading 25-40 person engineering organizations or comparable multi-team organizations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to simultaneously manage 5+ Agile/Scrum teams. 
 - Strong engineering judgment and ability to make difficult scope, schedule and quality trade-offs. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively with senior engineering and business leadership. 
 - Strong problem-solving and escalation-management skills. 
 - Ability to operate successfully across geographically distributed teams. 

Qualifications

Education : 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics/Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Control Systems or a related engineering discipline

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

data.title: Principal Software Development Engineer - Rust
data.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. 

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the Sr. Director of Software Engineering in the Platform Convergence department. In this role, you will design and scale high-performance backend services to drive the evolution of our converged platform. You will collaborate across teams to build robust distributed systems while mentoring engineers to uphold technical excellence. 

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

- Design and build a low-latency, high-throughput data forwarding plane using Rust and async/await models for efficient service-oriented infrastructure
 - Develop distributed, scalable systems with a heavy focus on concurrency, fault tolerance, and messaging
 - Implement and maintain gRPC-based APIs and services to integrate forwarding plane capabilities with control and orchestration layers
 - Optimize system performance through deep profiling across kernel-space and user-space
 - Drive technical excellence through code reviews, architectural discussions, documentation, and mentoring junior engineers

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. 
 - You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution. 
 - You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact. 
 - You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust. 
 - You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

data.title: GPU Infrastructure Engineer / HPC Engineer
data.description:
Build and operate large?scale GPU compute pods to deliver predictable, high?throughput, low?latency training and inference services across 10K GPU cluster. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Implementation

Stand up multi?pod GPU clusters (rack/power/cooling layouts; TOR/leaf connectivity; IB/Ethernet host configs). 

Implement GPU partitioning (MIG/vGPU profiles) and quota policies for multi?tenant environments. 

Integrate cluster schedulers (Slurm/Kubernetes) with GPU device plugins, node feature discovery, and accounting/quotas. 

- Operations

Own day?2 operations across firmware/driver/DCGM/NVML lifecycles; execute change windows with zero/low downtime. 

Capacity planning (GPU/CPU/Memory/NIC) and bin?packing strategies for heterogeneous GPU SKUs. 

- Performance & Optimization

Tune NCCL/UCX, GPU clocks/persistence, GPU Direct Storage, NUMA/locality, and CUDA runtime parameters. 

Drive benchmarking and acceptance (HPL, HPL?AI, MLPerf?like internal suites); track perf regressions with SLOs. 

- Reliability & Incident

Lead P0/P1 incident response for GPU, CUDA, or scheduler issues; perform root?cause and preventative actions. 

Act as the primary technical lead during production outages, coordinating cross-functional teams across Networking, GPU Operations, Platform Engineering, Storage, and Application teams to restore services within SLA targets. 

Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for network, GPU, CUDA, NCCL, RDMA, and scheduler-related failures, identifying underlying causes and implementing preventive and corrective actions. 

Collaborate with platform and GPU engineering teams to resolve issues impacting CUDA jobs, Kubernetes scheduling, Slurm workload management, GPU resource allocation, and large-scale AI training environments. 

Define golden images; implement node remediation (cordon/drain/reimage) and auto?healing workflows. 

- Security & Compliance

Enforce GPU tenancy isolation (MIG, cgroup/device cgroup, mpsd), secure drivers/containers, SBOM and image scanning. 

- Documentation & Enablement

Publish runbooks, performance baselines, and application tuning guides for LLM training and inference. 

Experience & Educational Requirement

BE/B-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics & Communication

NVIDIA Certified Professional (AI Infrastructure); Linux (RHCE/LPIC) preferred. 

Relevant Experience

- 7-12 years building/operating HPC/AI GPU clusters at scale; deep CUDA/MIG/vGPU expertise. 
 - Proven with H100/B?series class GPUs, Slurm and/or Kubernetes device scheduling; NCCL/UCX performance tuning. 

Tools / Tech

- CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN, TensorRT; 2. DCGM/NVML, nvidia-smi; 3. Slurm, K8s (device plugin, DaemonSets, NFD); 4. Helm/ArgoCD; 6. GPUDirect Storage; 7. Prometheus/Grafana; 8. ELK/Splunk.

data.title: Supply Chain Development Manager
data.description:
Description

Supply Chain Development Manager (APAC)

Department: Supply Chain Management

Reports To: VP-Supply Chain

Location: Remote (India) with Regional Travel

Industry: Power & Distribution Transformers, Electrical Equipment, Energy Infrastructure

Company Description

Sanmina Corporation is a global manufacturing & services company that supports diversified

Customers with innovative products and manufacturing services. More details can be found at

https: //www. sanmina. com/

Business Unit Description

The Power & Energy business is currently based out of a Greenfield facility in Houston, US. 

It's geared up to provide a unique solution in a distribution transformer space designed &

Engineered in technical collaboration with Sanmina's Technology Partner from Europe. 

The opportunity is for a seasoned supplier quality professional with a robust track record of

success and a strong technical foundation in developing & managing regional supply base

to cater to the facilities & customers that are based globally. 

Job Purpose

The Regional Supplier Quality Manager (SQM) - Mechanicals & Electro mechanicals is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuous execution of the supplier quality management strategy across regional supply chains for transformer manufacturing. This role ensures that all mechanical components (e. g. , tanks, radiators, insulation materials, structural steel) and electromechanical assemblies (e. g. , tap changers, bushings, control cabinets, sensors, cooling systems etc. ) meet rigorous reliability, safety, and regulatory standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Supplier Qualification & Auditing
 - Supplier Quality Management System Audit: Lead comprehensive supplier quality audits (VDA 6. 3, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 as applicable) for prospective and active suppliers across the region. 
 - Component Qualification: Manage the approval process for new mechanical and electromechanical components using APQP and PPAP methodologies (or equivalent industry frameworks). 
 - Technical Capability Assessment: Evaluate supplier manufacturing processes, welding quality (e. g. , ISO 3834 / AWS D1. 1), non-destructive testing (NDT), surface treatment/coatings (C5-I/M ISO 12944 environments), and electromechanical integration. 
 - Supplier Quality Performance & Continuous Improvement
 - KPI Tracking: Monitor, report, and drive improvement on key supplier metrics: Supplier Parts per Million (PPM), On-Time In-Spec (OTIS), First Pass Yield (FPY), and Non-Conformance Report (NCR) closure rates. 
 - Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Actions: Lead formal non-conformance investigations using 8D, 5-Why, and Fishbone methodologies. Ensure root causes are identified and permanent corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) are verified. 
 - Supplier Development: Drive continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, Six Sigma) with strategic suppliers to improve yield, reduce lead times, and mitigate quality risks. 
 - Engineering & Technical Alignment
 - Design for Manufacturability (DFM): Interface between Global Sourcing, Site Procurement, Engineering, and Suppliers to review engineering drawings, GD&T, material specifications, and tolerance stack-ups. 
 - Special Process Validation: Oversee validation of critical mechanical and electromechanical processes, including structural welding, hermetic seal integrity, galvanizing/painting, transformer tank pressure testing etc. 
 - Inspection & Test Plans (ITP): Define and approve critical-to-quality (CTQ) parameters, factory acceptance tests (FAT), and source inspection plans at supplier facilities. 
 - Regional Sourcing Strategy & Quality Governance
 - Risk Management: Maintain regional supplier quality risk matrices, identifying critical component failure modes (FMEA) and establishing risk mitigation strategies. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Global Sourcing Managers, Plant Manufacturing Engineering, and Plant Quality teams to align supplier strategies with overall production schedules and cost targets. 
 - Standardization: Harmonize supplier quality standards, audit tools, and incoming quality control (IQC) procedures across regional manufacturing plants. 

Qualifications & Skills

Educational & Technical Requirements

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or related engineering field. 
 - Experience: 15+ years of Quality Assurance experience in heavy manufacturing, power transmission & distribution, transformers, or industrial equipment sectors. 
 - Subject Matter Expertise: 
 - Deep technical understanding of transformer mechanical components (tank fabrication, conservator systems, radiator/cooling assemblies) and electromechanical units (on-load/off-circuit tap changers, high-voltage bushings, control panels, monitoring instruments). 
 - Strong knowledge of international standards: IEC 60076, IEEE C57, NACE, ISO 9001, ISO 3834, AWS D1. 1, ISO 12944. 

Certifications (Preferred)

- Certified Quality Auditor / Manager (ASQ CQA, CQE, or CQM)
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
 - VDA 6. 3 Process Auditor certification
 - NDT Level II (VT/PT/MT/UT) or International Welding Engineer (IWE) / CWI is a strong plus
 - Coating Inspection NACE Level 2 or Higher

Core Competencies & Soft Skills

- Problem Solving: Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in 8D, FMEA, SPC, and Root Cause Analysis. 
 - Auditing & Compliance: Proven ability to audit complex industrial supply chains and enforce rigorous quality standards. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills to manage regional cross-cultural supplier relationships and internal executive communication. 
 - Travel Willingness: Ability to travel up to 40%-50% regionally for supplier visits, audits, and source inspections.

data.title: Sr Advanced SW Architect
data.description:
Job Description

Honeywell is looking for a highly experienced Software Architect - Data Center Controls & Software to define the software system architecture for an integrated portfolio spanning PLC/embedded controllers, supervisory systems, controller programming/configuration tools, control strategies, Web UI and PC GUI applications. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership position. The architect will define architecture and design, guide approximately 30 engineers across 6 Scrum teams, resolve complex cross-component technical problems, and drive technology from concept/prototype through production-quality, scalable productization

The role is particularly important because the target system spans controller, network, supervisor and engineering-tool layers, which is reflected in Honeywell's existing Data Center architecture work. 

Responsibilities

System Architecture

- Define end-to-end software architecture across: 
 - PLC/embedded controllers
 - Controller runtime
 - Control strategies
 - Supervisory software
 - Controller programming/configuration tools
 - Web UI
 - PC/desktop GUI
 - Northbound APIs and external integrations
 - Establish well-defined interfaces between embedded, supervisory, tool and UI components. 
 - Define deployment architecture, data models, APIs, communication models and extensibility mechanisms. 
 - Define architecture for scalability, availability, reliability, performance and maintainability. 
 - Conduct architecture and detailed design reviews. 
Technical Leadership

- Provide technical direction to the team. 
 - Mentor technical leads and senior engineers. 
 - Develop architecture guidelines, reference implementations, reusable frameworks and design patterns. 
 - Review critical code/designs and personally investigate difficult cross-system problems when necessary. 
 - Facilitate technical decisions where multiple teams have competing constraints. 
 - Prevent unnecessary technology fragmentation across Scrum teams. 

Productization

A major expectation is toturn technology into a product, not merely create an architecture. 

The Architect Will

- Convert customer/use-case requirements into system requirements. 
 - Develop architecture and executable proof-of-concepts for high-risk areas. 
 - Establish production architecture and component boundaries. 
 - Define scalability and performance targets. 
 - Define diagnosability, logging and serviceability. 
 - Design upgrade, configuration and backward-compatibility mechanisms. 
 - Integrate cybersecurity into the architecture. 
 - Enable automated verification and CI/CD. 
 - Drive deployment/reference architectures. 
 - Support field issues and feed learning back into the architecture. 

This product orientation is especially relevant to Data Center systems where Honeywell's internal materials describe monitoring and diagnostics, predictive maintenance, optimization and enterprise dashboard integration spanning equipment through facility-level software. 

Required Technical Skills

Embedded & Controls

- Advanced C/C++. 
 - Embedded Linux and/or RTOS. 
 - Multithreading and concurrency. 
 - PLC/controller runtime architecture. 
 - Real-time systems. 
 - Hardware abstraction and I/O frameworks. 
 - Control application execution. 
 - IEC 61131-3 programming concepts. 
 - Control strategy design, sequencing and reusable control libraries. 

Supervisory & Distributed Systems

- Distributed system architecture. 
 - Supervisory control/BMS architecture. 
 - Client-server and service-oriented architecture. 
 - REST APIs and asynchronous messaging. 
 - High availability and fault handling. 
 - Data acquisition, historization, alarming and event management. 
 - Large-scale device/controller integration. 

Protocols & Networking

Strong Knowledge Of

- BACnet/IP
 - Modbus TCP
 - TCP/IP
 - Ethernet
 - IP routing/subnetting
 - HTTP/HTTPS
 - TLS and PKI

Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus and LonWorks, secure software design, Linux/network application development and distributed/scalable system design is consistent with existing Honeywell software architecture expertise in Building Automation. 

Engineering & Configuration Tools

- PLC/controller configuration concepts. 
 - Graphical programming/configuration environments. 
 - Device discovery and commissioning. 
 - Firmware/software download. 
 - Backup/restore and configuration management. 
 - Offline engineering versus online/connected workflows. 
 - Version compatibility and migration. 

Web / PC Applications

Solid Architectural Understanding Of

- Modern Web UI architecture, such as React/Angular-class SPA technologies. 
 - REST/WebSocket communication patterns. 
 - Windows desktop/PC GUI architecture. 
 - Data visualization and dashboards. 
 - UI-to-supervisor/controller interaction patterns. 

Software Architecture

Demonstrated Expertise In

- SOLID principles and design patterns
 - Domain-driven/modular design
 - API and interface design
 - Event-driven architecture
 - Distributed systems
 - Scalability and performance engineering
 - Observability and diagnostics
 - Compatibility/versioning
 - Testable architectures

Cybersecurity

- Secure-by-design architecture. 
 - Threat modeling. 
 - Authentication and authorization. 
 - Certificate/PKI architecture. 
 - Secure boot/update concepts for embedded platforms. 
 - Vulnerability remediation. 
 - Secure communication between controllers, supervisors, tools and cloud/enterprise systems. 

Data Center Domain Knowledge

The ideal candidate should understand or rapidly develop expertise in: 

- Data Center HVAC
 - Chillers and chiller plant
 - CRAH/CRAC systems
 - Cooling towers and pumps
 - Air-side/economizer control
 - Liquid cooling/CDU systems
 - Power and energy monitoring
 - BMS
 - DCIM integration
 - Data Center redundancy and availability principles

Honeywell's internal Data Center role definition similarly expects knowledge spanning HVAC, power distribution, cooling, physical security/fire safety, BMS and DCIM integration. 

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

- 5+ years of experience in software architecture and development
 - Mastery level knowledge in design principles, architectural patterns, and coding standards
 - Expert in multiple programming languages and technologies
 - Ability to work under minimal supervision and lead indirect reports by influence

WE VALUE

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
 - Strong leadership and management skills
 - Proven ability to drive successful software development projects and initiatives
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
 - Passion for innovation and continuous learning
 - Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving capability

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

data.title: Head - IQAC - GO/JC/4831/2026
data.description:
Job Details

Job Title: Head - Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC)

Job Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Work Model: Work from Office

Job Level: Head / Senior Leadership

Employment Type: Full-time

Candidate Expectations

Total Experience: 15+ years preferred. 

Relevant Experience: Significant experience in institutional quality assurance, accreditation, academic administration, quality frameworks, and institutional ranking processes within higher education. 

Candidate Location: Chennai preferred; candidates willing to relocate may be considered. 

Mandatory Skills

Leadership of IQAC or institutional quality assurance functions. 

NAAC accreditation processes, assessment, and documentation. 

Institutional ranking frameworks and data management. 

Academic and administrative quality audits. 

Outcome-based education, academic quality metrics, and continuous improvement. 

Preparation of institutional reports, evidence repositories, and performance dashboards. 

Stakeholder coordination and team leadership. 

Preferred Industry: Universities, higher education institutions, medical colleges, engineering institutions, and multidisciplinary educational institutions. 

Leadership Expectations: Ability to lead institution-wide quality initiatives, coordinate accreditation and ranking activities, and establish robust quality assurance and governance mechanisms. 

Education & Certification

Mandatory: Ph. D. or postgraduate qualification in a relevant discipline, as appropriate to the institution's requirements. 

Preferred: Ph. D. with substantial experience in higher education administration, academic quality assurance, or institutional governance. 

Good to Have: Training or certifications related to NAAC accreditation, NBA accreditation, quality management systems, academic auditing, outcome-based education, or institutional assessment frameworks. 

Additional Preference: Experience in multidisciplinary institutions covering Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education. 

Detailed Job Description

Role Overview

The Head of IQAC will be responsible for establishing, leading, and strengthening the institution's internal quality assurance framework. The role will oversee institutional quality processes, accreditation readiness, NAAC-related data and documentation, institutional ranking submissions, academic and administrative audits, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

The position will work closely with senior management, academic leaders, department heads, faculty, and administrative teams to ensure institutional performance is measured, documented, evaluated, and improved in line with applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

Institutional Quality Assurance & Governance

Develop and implement institution-wide quality assurance policies, frameworks, procedures, and annual quality plans. 

Lead the functioning of the Internal Quality Assurance Cell and establish mechanisms for continuous academic and administrative improvement. 

Define quality indicators, monitoring systems, review mechanisms, and accountability structures across departments. 

Ensure quality initiatives are aligned with institutional objectives and applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements. 

NAAC Accreditation & Assessment

Lead institutional preparedness for NAAC accreditation, assessment, and applicable quality assurance processes. 

Coordinate the collection, verification, consolidation, and presentation of data and supporting evidence required for accreditation. 

Oversee preparation and review of relevant institutional submissions, including the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR), Self-Study Report (SSR), and other applicable documentation. 

Track accreditation criteria, performance indicators, evidence gaps, and improvement requirements. 

Coordinate with academic and administrative departments to ensure accurate, consistent, and timely submissions in accordance with applicable guidelines. 

Institutional Rankings & Performance Data

Lead institutional ranking-related data collection, validation, analysis, and submission activities for relevant national and other applicable ranking frameworks. 

Coordinate with departments to compile verified information relating to academics, research, faculty, student outcomes, infrastructure, outreach, and institutional performance. 

Establish centralised data repositories and evidence-tracking mechanisms to improve data accuracy, consistency, and auditability. 

Analyse ranking performance, identify gaps, and recommend initiatives to strengthen institutional outcomes. 

Monitor ranking criteria, submission timelines, and applicable framework updates. 

Academic Quality & Continuous Improvement

Monitor academic quality indicators, teaching-learning processes, curriculum delivery, assessment practices, and student outcomes. 

Promote outcome-based education, programme outcome mapping, feedback mechanisms, and academic quality enhancement initiatives, where applicable. 

Facilitate internal academic audits, administrative audits, and periodic departmental reviews. 

Identify performance gaps and coordinate corrective and preventive action plans. 

Encourage evidence-based decision-making and a culture of continuous quality improvement. 

Data Management, Documentation & Reporting

Establish standardised processes for data collection, validation, documentation, and record maintenance. 

Develop dashboards and institutional reports to track quality indicators, accreditation readiness, ranking performance, and improvement initiatives. 

Ensure the availability of reliable supporting evidence for audits, assessments, accreditation reviews, and ranking submissions. 

Implement document control, version management, and evidence verification practices. 

Present periodic quality performance reports and improvement recommendations to institutional leadership. 

Stakeholder Coordination & Capacity Building

Work closely with senior management, academic leadership, faculty, department coordinators, and administrative teams on quality-related initiatives. 

Establish departmental quality coordinators and define clear responsibilities for data submission, verification, and compliance. 

Conduct awareness sessions and capacity-building programmes on accreditation criteria, documentation standards, quality metrics, and institutional ranking requirements. 

Facilitate internal quality review meetings and monitor the closure of agreed action items. 

Build institution-wide ownership of quality assurance and accreditation readiness. 

Regulatory Compliance & Quality Audits

Monitor applicable quality assurance and accreditation requirements relevant to the institution and its academic programmes. 

Coordinate internal reviews to assess compliance with prescribed academic, administrative, and documentation standards. 

Ensure timely identification, escalation, and closure of quality-related gaps. 

Maintain readiness for external assessments, inspections, audits, and accreditation visits. 

Coordinate with relevant institutional departments to ensure consistency between submitted data, supporting evidence, and official records. 

Strategic Planning & Institutional Improvement

Translate accreditation and ranking findings into measurable institutional improvement plans. 

Benchmark institutional performance against relevant peer institutions and applicable quality frameworks. 

Recommend process improvements, governance mechanisms, and digital tools to strengthen quality management. 

Track implementation of improvement initiatives and report progress to institutional leadership. 

Contribute to long-term institutional planning through quality analytics and performance insights. 

Key Skills

Mandatory Skills

IQAC leadership and institutional quality assurance. 

NAAC accreditation and related documentation. 

Institutional rankings and performance data management. 

Academic and administrative quality audits. 

Data validation, evidence management, and institutional reporting. 

Quality indicators, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement. 

Stakeholder coordination and institutional governance. 

Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration. 

Good-to-Have Skills

Exposure to NBA accreditation and other applicable programme-level accreditation frameworks. 

Experience in multidisciplinary universities offering Medical/Healthcare and Engineering programmes. 

Knowledge of outcome-based education, programme outcome assessment, and academic quality frameworks. 

Experience with institutional dashboards, data analytics, and digital documentation systems. 

Exposure to national ranking frameworks, benchmarking, and institutional performance improvement. 

Research, academic administration, and university-level governance experience. 

Other Specific Remarks

Candidates should have substantial experience in institutional quality assurance, accreditation, and ranking-related activities, rather than general academic administration alone. 

Demonstrated ownership of NAAC-related data, documentation, assessment readiness, and institutional quality processes is preferred. 

Strong expertise in data accuracy, evidence validation, reporting, and coordination across academic and administrative departments is essential. 

Candidates should be capable of leading institution-wide quality initiatives and presenting performance insights to senior leadership. 

Experience in a university or large multidisciplinary higher education institution will be an advantage. 

Candidates with exposure to both Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education are preferred. 

The role requires a detail-oriented, process-driven leader with strong analytical, documentation, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities.

In SimCorp, we help some of the biggest financial institutions in the world be successful by simplifying their accounting, operations, and investments. We do this through IT systems, processes, and financial knowledge. High quality, performing, secure, and cost-effective software is at the core of what we do. The AI Platform team owns that foundation: a compliant, standardized, secure, and user-friendly agentic ecosystem that domain teams can leverage when building their AI features. 

The team's recent deliveries and current focus include preparing Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo for production, publishing the Agent Development Stack, implementing evaluation, trust, safety and guardrails, progressing multi-agent orchestration, and exploring MCP for SimCorp One APIs.

What You Will Be Responsible For

The Lead Software Engineer (DevOps) at SimCorp, at the IC5 grade, is responsible for

DevOps best practices and the Azure cloud ecosystem for AI enabled software solutions. This role requires a strong mix of hands-on engineering, architectural thinking, and leadership to ensure both immediate delivery and long-term sustainability. You will be part of a scrum team working closely with Product Owner and business stakeholders. The Lead Software Engineer takes ownership of key engineering projects, provides technical guidance to junior engineers, and ensures that software is delivered on time and within scope. This position requires strong problem-solving skills, expertise in software engineering practices, and the ability to work in a collaborative and fast-paced environment. 

We work team-based, so your primary responsibility is as a team member. You need to make sure the team delivers on its commitments, that it's a good place to work for you and your teammates, and that it continuously improves. 

Daily tasks are for example:

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above.

 - Sound understanding of Azure cloud services, infrastructure, pipelines, scalability and architecture

As a person, you have the following traits: 

- Taking ownership. Comfortable taking the lead on tasks. 
 - Earn trust, think big, and take calculated risks. 
 - You collaborate with team members to work towards common goals. 
 - Solid problem-solving skills and comfortable questioning assumptions and as-is. 
 - Exhibits a consistent approach and a creative mindset. 
 - Thrives in a collaborative environment and values teamwork
 - Like to have fun at work and positivity comes easily to you
 - Excellent English verbal and communication skills

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.

 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
