data.title: Senior Agentic Workflow Engineer
data.description:
HRS As a Company

HRS, a pioneer in business travel, aims to elevate every stay through innovative technology. With over 50 years of experience, their digital platform, driven by ProcureTech, TravelTech, and FinTech, transforms how companies and travelers Stay, Work, and Pay. 

ProcureTech digitally revolutionizes lodging procurement, connecting corporations and suppliers in a cutting-edge ecosystem. This enables seamless efficiency and automation, surpassing travelers' expectations. 

TravelTech redefines the online lodging experience, offering personalized content from selection to check-in, ensuring an unparalleled journey for corporate travelers. 

In FinTech, HRS introduces advancements like mobile banking and digital payments, turning corporate back offices into touchless lodging enablers, eliminating legacy cost barriers. The innovative 2-click book-to-pay feature streamlines interactions for travelers and hoteliers. 

Combining these technology propositions, HRS unlocks exponential catalyst effects. Their data-driven focus delivers value-added services and high-return network effects, creating substantial customer value. 

HRS's exponential growth since 1972 serves over 35% of the global Fortune 500 and leading hotel chains. 

Join HRS to shape the future of business travel, empowered by a culture of growth and setting new industry standards worldwide. 

BUSINESS UNIT

You'll join HRS's Product & IT organization, in the team that builds the AI agent layer for our global sales organization. Our goal: give Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Learning & Development, and leadership teams trusted AI agents that work directly inside the tools they use every day, such as our CRM, Microsoft 365, and our data platforms. The foundation is already in place. A central AI gateway on AWS gives every agent secure, audited access to approved AI models, and a dedicated platform engineer builds and maintains the secure connections into our core business systems. That lets you concentrate on building agents that solve real business problems for our teams worldwide. We are deliberately not a single-vendor shop: we build on Microsoft Copilot Studio, n8n, Dify, and other cloud-native agentic workflow engines, with the platform for each use case selected based on the agent capabilities it requires. 

POSITION

As Senior Agentic Workflow Engineer (all genders), you are the lead architect and builder of HRS's growing portfolio of AI agents and agentic workflows. You define the multi-agent architecture and the development standards the team follows across platforms, and personally drive the delivery of production-grade agents that account executives, sales operations managers, and customer success teams use every day - in Microsoft Teams and beyond. 

Our central AI gateway connects agents to approved AI models, and our platform engineer (a separate role) owns the detailed technical integrations into Dynamics 365, Dataverse, SharePoint, OneDrive, and our other data systems. That leaves your focus on what makes agents valuable: design, orchestration, quality, and scale. You will mentor the mid-level engineer, set the technical bar, and make sure every agent ships as a reliable, well-governed product, whichever platform it runs on. 

CHALLENGE

- Architecture and delivery standards: Define the platform-agnostic multi-agent topology, conversation and workflow design principles, naming conventions, guardrail patterns, and release standards the team follows across all engines. 
 - Multi-agent framework: Design the orchestrator and sub-agent structure, handoff protocols, context passing, and fallback behaviors, including cross-platform communication via open standards like MCP and A2A. 
 - New use cases: Lead design and delivery of agents for pipeline queries, opportunity stage updates, forecasts, opportunity creation, approval workflows, and AI-generated content across a growing sales and customer-facing backlog. 
 - Enterprise data access: Partner with the platform engineer to define tool, API, and connector contracts for Dynamics 365, Dataverse, SharePoint, OneDrive, SAP, Clay, AWS data products, and internal APIs. Enforce governed interfaces only: no direct database access, no free-form SQL, no plaintext credentials. 
 - Guardrail framework: Define and implement RBAC, DLP controls, prompt-injection defenses, output validation, and audit logging standards for every agent on every platform. 
 - Release management: Own versioning, regression testing, and staged rollout to production, including human approval gates for write-back actions, and sign off on every production promotion. 
 - Mentoring: Guide the mid-level engineer through architecture advice, reviews, and structured onboarding, building a team that delivers independently. 
 - Stakeholder translation: Work with sales and sales operations to scope use cases, define acceptance criteria, and manage delivery expectations. 

FOR THIS EXCITING MISSION YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH

- Experience: Typically 7+ years in software, automation, or integration engineering, with a track record of shipping AI agents or agentic workflows that real users rely on in production. 
 - Agent platforms: Proven experience deploying production agents, including multi-agent orchestrator/sub-agent architectures, on at least one agentic engine (e. g. Copilot Studio, n8n, Dify, Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock Agents, LangGraph). Production experience on multiple platforms is a strong plus. 
 - M-shaped profile: Deep agentic engineering expertise plus broad knowledge of enterprise systems such as CRM (e. g. Dynamics 365), ERP (e. g. SAP), Microsoft 365, and cloud data platforms. 
 - Agentic AI patterns: Deep understanding of orchestrator/sub-agent design, prompt engineering, RAG, tool/function calling, MCP, agent memory, and evaluation. 
 - Platform judgment: Clear view of each platform's strengths and limits, designing every agent to make the most of where it runs. 
 - API fluency: Confident with REST, JSON, webhooks, and OAuth 2. 0 / service principals; consumes APIs, connectors, and MCP servers and specifies precisely what agents need from the platform team. 
 - Governance: Solid knowledge of identity and RBAC (e. g. Entra ID), DLP, secrets management, environment and solution lifecycle, and CI/CD for agents. 
 - Compliance: Understanding of GDPR and EU data residency for agent data handling. 
 - Mentoring: Proven ability to coach engineers and uphold quality standards across a team. 
 - Design and documentation: Strong skills in architecture decision records, conversation and workflow specs, and runbooks. 
 - Certifications (a plus): Microsoft PL-400 or AI-102, AWS, or platform-specific equivalents. 
 - Communication: Fluent English, verbal and written, able to lead discussions with technical and business stakeholders.

The Technical Architect - Automotive Cloud successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex, enterprise-grade Salesforce solutions for automotive clients operating across OEMs, authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers. Technologies include Salesforce Automotive Cloud, Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management, Salesforce APIs, Apex/LWC, Agentforce, and DMS/telematics integrations.

Employment Type: Full-time

1. Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Physical Design Lead with 12+ years of experience in ASIC/SoC Physical Design implementation and leadership. 

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in end-to-end physical design implementation, from floorplanning and power planning to placement, clock tree synthesis, routing and physical signoff. 

The candidate will be responsible for leading physical design activities for complex SoC/ASIC projects, driving timing closure, optimizing power, performance and area (PPA), and ensuring successful implementation and signoff across advanced technology nodes. 

The role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on experience with industry-standard EDA tools, and the ability to manage cross-functional teams and drive project execution. 

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Physical Design Implementation

- Lead end-to-end physical design implementation for complex ASIC/SoC designs. 
 - Drive the complete physical design flow, including: 
 - Floorplanning and partitioning. 
 - Power planning and power grid implementation. 
 - Placement and optimization. 
 - Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS). 
 - Global and detailed routing. 
 - Post-route optimization. 
 - Physical verification and signoff. 
 - Review design specifications and implementation requirements. 
 - Drive physical design methodologies and ensure adherence to project guidelines. 
 - Ensure successful implementation of large and complex design blocks and full-chip designs. B. Timing Closure and Optimization

- Own timing closure activities across pre-route and post-route stages. 
 - Work closely with STA teams to resolve setup and hold violations. 
 - Analyze critical timing paths and drive timing optimization strategies. 
 - Optimize timing through cell sizing, buffering, placement optimization and routing improvements. 
 - Handle timing constraints, clock uncertainty, latency and skew-related issues. 
 - Drive multi-mode multi-corner (MMMC) timing closure. 
 - Collaborate with RTL and synthesis teams to address RTL-level and synthesis-related timing bottlenecks. 
 - Ensure timing signoff requirements are met across all operating corners. C. Clock Tree Synthesis and Routing

- Lead clock tree synthesis implementation and optimization. 
 - Optimize clock skew, insertion delay, latency and clock transition. 
 - Handle clock distribution challenges in complex SoC designs. 
 - Drive routing optimization and congestion management. 
 - Resolve signal integrity and crosstalk-related issues. 
 - Optimize routing for timing, power and area. 
 - Handle antenna violations, routing DRCs and connectivity issues. D. Power, Performance and Area Optimization

- Drive PPA optimization across the physical design flow. 
 - Analyze and optimize power consumption, performance and silicon area. 
 - Handle IR drop and electromigration analysis and closure. 
 - Optimize power distribution networks and power grid implementation. 
 - Work on dynamic and leakage power optimization. 
 - Collaborate with design teams to improve overall implementation efficiency. 
 - Ensure design compliance with power and reliability requirements. E. Physical Verification and Signoff

- Drive physical design signoff activities. 
 - Ensure closure of DRC, LVS, antenna and physical verification violations. 
 - Work on signal integrity and parasitic extraction analysis. 
 - Drive IR drop and EM signoff. 
 - Coordinate with STA and physical verification teams for final signoff. 
 - Ensure all implementation requirements are met before tapeout. F. Advanced Technology Node Experience

- Drive physical design implementation across advanced technology nodes. 
 - Work on technology-specific implementation challenges and methodologies. 
 - Experience with FinFET-based technologies and advanced process nodes. 
 - Understand technology-dependent challenges related to routing, congestion, power delivery and timing closure. 
 - Work with foundry-specific design rules and implementation guidelines. G. Technical Leadership and Team Management

- Lead and mentor a team of physical design engineers. 
 - Allocate tasks, monitor project progress and ensure timely execution. 
 - Drive technical reviews, design reviews and implementation signoff. 
 - Provide technical guidance for complex physical design challenges. 
 - Collaborate with RTL, STA, DFT, verification and architecture teams. 
 - Drive methodology improvements and implementation efficiency. 
 - Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies. 
 - Participate in customer interactions, technical discussions and project planning. 
 - Ensure delivery quality and adherence to project milestones. 3. Required Technical Skills

- 12+ years of experience in ASIC/SoC Physical Design. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in end-to-end physical design implementation. 
 - Expertise in floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing and physical signoff. 
 - Strong experience in timing closure and optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with multi-mode multi-corner (MMMC) implementation. 
 - Strong understanding of STA fundamentals and timing constraints. 
 - Experience in power planning, IR drop and EM analysis. 
 - Good understanding of signal integrity, crosstalk and parasitic effects. 
 - Experience with physical verification, DRC, LVS and antenna checks. 
 - Experience working on complex SoC designs. 
 - Strong debugging, problem-solving and technical leadership capabilities. 4. EDA Tools

Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: 

Physical Design: 

- Synopsys ICC2
 - Synopsys Fusion Compiler
 - Cadence InnovusStatic Timing Analysis: 

- Synopsys PrimeTime
 - PrimeTime SIPhysical Verification: 

- Siemens Calibre
 - Synopsys IC ValidatorPower Integrity: 

- Ansys RedHawk
 - Cadence VoltusParasitic Extraction: 

- StarRC
 - Quantus5. Preferred Skills

- Experience in advanced technology nodes such as 16nm, 7nm, 5nm, 3nm or below. 
 - Strong exposure to FinFET technology. 
 - Experience in large-scale SoC and full-chip physical design. 
 - Knowledge of low-power design methodologies and UPF. 
 - Experience in hierarchical physical design and block-level integration. 
 - Exposure to ECO implementation and metal-only ECOs. 
 - Knowledge of Tcl, Python or Perl scripting. 
 - Experience in customer-facing technical discussions and project delivery management. 
 - Experience in leading teams of 5-15+ engineers. 6. Education

B. E. /B. Tech/M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, VLSI or a related discipline. 

7. Expected Candidate Profile

The candidate should demonstrate: 

- Strong technical ownership of the complete physical design flow. 
 - Proven experience in leading physical design implementation for complex ASIC/SoC projects. 
 - Ability to independently debug and resolve complex timing and physical design challenges. 
 - Experience in managing and mentoring physical design teams. 
 - Ability to interact with customers and drive technical discussions. 
 - Strong understanding of advanced-node implementation challenges. 
 - Accountability for project execution, quality and tapeout deliverables.

Our team creates products are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS.

Role:   Senior Consultant - Lead Java & AWS Integration Engineer / Architect (Energy Trading)

Location: India

Work Model: Remote

  About capSpire: 

capSpire is a rapidly growing global consulting and solutions company with ten offices in key markets worldwide. Renowned for our people-first, entrepreneurial, and collaborative culture, we have been consistently recognised as a Great Place to Work. As a vendor-independent consultancy, capSpire partners with major energy and commodity companies, offering deep technical and industry expertise to deliver practical solutions. 

Role Overview: 

We are expanding our delivery capability in India and are looking for a senior Java and cloud integration engineer, who will also act as technical lead and architect, to join a team supporting a European energy trading client's post-trade transformation programme. You will design, build and support event-driven integration and trade processing services around an Endur ETRM platform, using Spring Boot, Kafka, AWS Kinesis, AWS Lambda and AWS EKS, and deliver the infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines that underpin them. You will own the technical design of these services, lead the India-based engineers, and work closely with onshore architects and with business and technical stakeholders in the UK and Europe. In addition, you will be supporting the growth of capSpire's Energy and Commodities technology practice.

- Design, develop, test and support hybrid (on-premises/cloud) integration services for bidirectional data exchange between the Endur ETRM system and surrounding applications, using Spring Boot, AWS Kinesis and AWS Lambda. 
 - Build and enhance trade processing services that enrich, transform and route incoming trades, based on Spring microservices running on AWS EKS (Kubernetes) together with AWS Lambda and Kinesis.

 - Lead the redesign and modernisation of existing components where needed, for example moving to event-sourcing and stream-processing patterns, and plan safe migration paths from legacy systems.

 - Represent the offshore team in design forums and technical governance with the client and onshore architects, and evaluate new tools and technologies.

 - Prepare and maintain solution design, technical and operational documentation. 
 - Mentor and develop engineers in the India team, give technical presentations and share knowledge with the wider onshore/offshore delivery team.   Key Requirements: 

- Solution Architecture: Strong experience designing distributed, event-driven and microservice-based systems, including integration patterns, cloud architecture on AWS, data flow design, security (e. g. OAuth2) and resilience. 
 - Technical Leadership: Proven ability to lead engineering teams, set standards, run design and code reviews, and guide delivery with limited supervision.

 - AWS Cloud: Practical experience designing and running solutions on AWS, in particular Kinesis, Lambda and EKS, including hybrid on-premises/cloud integration. 
 - Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD: Proficiency with Terraform, AWS CDK and Azure DevOps Pipelines; experience with Jenkins, Sonar, Git and GitHub Enterprise. 
 - Messaging and Streaming: Expertise in Apache Kafka (Streams, Connect, Confluent Schema Registry/Avro) and familiarity with RabbitMQ; good understanding of event-driven, event-sourcing and stream-processing patterns. 
 - Containers and Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Database Development: Strong SQL skills across Oracle (PL/SQL) and MS SQL Server (T-SQL), including data modelling and query performance tuning. 
 - Integration Standards: Experience with REST, SOAP and XML/JSON-based interfaces; knowledge of FIX/FIXML is desirable. 
 - Testing and Quality: Experience with JUnit, Mockito and integration testing, and with code review practices. 
 - Front-end Development (desirable): Working knowledge of JavaScript, React, HTML5/CSS, single-page applications and OAuth2 for internal tools and client portals. 
 - Endur ETRM (desirable): Exposure to integrating external systems with Endur, its data model or interfaces (e. g. Connex, OpenComponents). 
 - Domain Knowledge: Understanding of the trade lifecycle and post-trade processing (trade capture, enrichment, confirmation, clearing, settlement and reconciliation) in energy, commodities or financial markets. 
 - Excellent interpersonal skills and stakeholder management. 
 - Good written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - Strong organisational and analytical skills and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team in a fast-paced environmentPreferred Requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent experience. A Master's degree is desirable. 
 - 12+ years of professional software development experience with Java and Spring, including at least 4 years building cloud-native solutions on AWS.

 - Experience in energy trading, commodities or investment banking IT, ideally in post-trade or trade processing areas. 
 - Experience across the full SDLC, from requirements gathering and design through build, testing, deployment and support. 
 - Worked as part of a cross-cultural/geographical team with onshore stakeholders, including flexibility to work hours that overlap with UK/European business hours and to support release windows when necessary. 
 - Worked as part of a project team structure and delivered results with limited guidance. 
 - An AWS certification (e. g. AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional) is desirable. 
 - Ability to travel to client or onshore locations for limited periods as per project requirement. Our Impact: 

- We serve a diverse client base, including some of the most influential players in the energy and commodities market.

capSpire offers an enriching environment that values diversity and fosters professional growth. Join a team where innovation, collaboration, and client-centricity are at the core of what we do. 

We offer:

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Job Opening: QA Engineer / Software Tester

Experience: Minimum 1 Year of Full-Time Professional Experience (Mandatory)

Qualification: Diploma / BCA / B. Tech / B. E. / B. Sc. IT/CS / MCA or equivalent

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Location: Jaipur (Jagatpura)

Hiring Team : 97831 95666

Job Description

We are hiring a hands-on QA Engineer / Software Tester who can independently test web applications, identify defects, investigate technical failures, and ensure production readiness. 

We need a technically capable professional who understands both functional testing and the underlying application environment. The candidate must be comfortable working with developers, executing existing test suites, reviewing server logs, and validating releases without constant supervision. 

This is not an internship, trainee, or entry-level learning position. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Manual, Functional & Regression Testing

- Independently plan and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, sanity, and end-to-end testing. 

- Test authentication, forms, dashboards, payments, subscriptions, APIs, and business workflows. 

- Create test cases, test scenarios, and reproducible bug reports. 

- Verify fixes and conduct regression testing before release approval. 

- Identify edge cases and negative test scenarios. 

2. Responsive & Cross-Device Testing

- Test websites on real Android/iOS devices, tablets, and desktops. 

- Validate responsive layouts across different screen sizes, orientations, and browsers. 

- Identify UI inconsistencies, overflow, broken components, and interaction failures. 

- Use Chrome DevTools and browser debugging tools effectively. 

3. Automated Tests & Code Quality

- Execute and troubleshoot existing unit, integration, and automated test suites. 

- Working knowledge of at least one testing framework such as Playwright, Cypress, Jest, Vitest, or PHPUnit. 

- Run and interpret ESLint, TypeScript ("tsc"), build, and test commands. 

- Investigate failing tests and distinguish application defects from test/environment issues. 

- Maintain or extend basic automated test cases when required. 

4. API & Database Testing

- Independently test REST APIs using Postman or equivalent tools. 

- Validate authentication, authorization, request/response payloads, status codes, and error handling. 

- Execute basic SQL queries in MySQL or PostgreSQL to verify data correctness. 

- Test invalid inputs, permission boundaries, and failure scenarios. 

5. Server Logs & Troubleshooting

- Work with basic Linux commands and SSH. 

- Inspect Nginx and Apache access/error logs. 

- Analyze application logs, browser console errors, and network requests. 

- Investigate HTTP 4xx/5xx responses, timeouts, and failed API calls. 

- Provide relevant log evidence and probable causes in defect reports. 

6. DevOps & Release Validation

- Work with Git, GitHub, branches, pull requests, and CI/CD pipelines. 

- Understand development, staging, and production environments. 

- Review failed builds, deployment logs, and automated pipeline results. 

- Understand Docker basics, environment variables, and common deployment issues. 

- Perform pre-release and post-deployment smoke testing. 

- Report release readiness, unresolved defects, and deployment risks. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

- Minimum 1 year of full-time professional software testing experience. 

- Strong hands-on manual, functional, responsive, and regression testing. 

- Practical experience with test-case design, defect tracking, and bug reproduction. 

- Browser DevTools debugging and network inspection. 

- REST API testing with Postman. 

- Basic SQL knowledge. 

- Ability to execute automated tests, lint checks, TypeScript checks, and builds. 

- Basic JavaScript/TypeScript understanding. 

- Linux command-line and Nginx/Apache log inspection. 

- Git and CI/CD workflow familiarity. 

- Clear technical communication and defect documentation. 

Preferred Skills

- Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium automation. 

- Experience testing Next. js, React, Laravel, PHP, or WordPress applications. 

- Jest, Vitest, or PHPUnit. 

- Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel, AWS, or similar environments. 

- Accessibility and basic performance testing. 

- Basic understanding of application security testing. 

Experience Requirements

- At least 12 months of verifiable full-time professional QA/testing experience. 

- Internship, industrial training, academic projects, and certification courses will not count toward the minimum experience. 

- Candidates must demonstrate practical experience testing production or staging applications. 

- Must be capable of working independently with minimal supervision. 

What We Expect

We are not looking for someone who simply clicks through a website and reports that something is not working. 

We expect a QA professional who can: 

- Identify and reproduce defects independently. 

- Investigate errors using browser tools, API responses, test results, and server logs. 

- Document expected versus actual behavior with evidence. 

- Validate fixes without introducing regressions. 

- Clearly communicate whether a release is ready, blocked, or requires further investigation. 

Ownership, technical curiosity, attention to detail, and independent problem-solving are essential. 

Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical technical assessment covering functional testing, responsive testing, API debugging, automated test execution, and basic server-log analysis. 

Only candidates meeting the mandatory professional experience and technical requirements should apply.

data.description:
Location: India

Function: Engineering / Cloud Platform

Reports To: Sr. Engineering Manager

Are you. . . 

- Interested in building automation that ensures the reliability and quality of foundational cloud services? 
 - Passionate about software engineering, API testing, distributed systems, and building quality into CI/CD? 
 - Excited about solving complex testing challenges across a growing SaaS platform?

If so, we'd love to meet you. 

Why Esko?

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25, 000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation. 

Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence. 

About The Role

As an SDET on the Cloud Platform team, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of the foundational services that power Esko's cloud products. 

You will work closely with software engineers, architects, and DevOps engineers to build automated testing for platform capabilities such as data and repository services, workflow, search, identity and access management services. 

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys writing code, understanding how distributed systems behave, finding difficult failure scenarios, and building automation that helps engineering teams release with confidence. 

What You Will Do

- Design, develop, and maintain automated tests and test frameworks for cloud platform services and APIs. 
 - Build API, integration, contract, regression, system, and end-to-end tests for distributed services. 
 - Test complex platform behaviors including data integrity, asynchronous workflows, service interactions, authentication and authorization, and failure scenarios. 
 - Build performance, scalability, and reliability tests for critical platform services. 
 - Integrate automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast feedback to engineering teams. 
 - Develop test infrastructure, test data, mocks, and tooling needed to test complex cloud services. 
 - Investigate failures across distributed systems using logs, metrics, traces, and other diagnostic information. 
 - Partner with software engineers and architects to improve testability and build quality into the software development lifecycle. 
 - Contribute to automation standards, testing practices, and continuous improvement across the Cloud Platform team. 

Required Experience

- 5+ years of experience in SDET, Quality Engineering, Software Engineering, or Test Automation roles. 
 - Strong programming skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or another modern programming language. 
 - Hands-on experience building automated tests for REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications. 
 - Experience with API, integration, regression, and system-level testing. 
 - Good understanding of distributed systems and common testing challenges such as asynchronous processing, retries, failures, and service dependencies. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively with software engineers, architects, product managers, and DevOps engineers. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized applications. 
 - Experience with performance and load testing using JMeter, Gatling or equivalent. 
 - Experience with API contract testing and testing event-driven or asynchronous systems. 
 - Experience debugging distributed systems using observability tools, logs, metrics, and traces. 
 - Experience with Playwright, Selenium, or other UI automation frameworks. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will: 

- Establish performance testing and baseline metrics for critical platform services to identify performance regressions early. 
 - Increase automated coverage of API, integration, reliability, and performance scenarios. 
 - Identify defects and failure scenarios earlier in the development lifecycle. 
 - Improve CI/CD quality gates and reduce dependence on manual regression testing. 
 - Become a trusted engineering partner who helps teams design more testable, reliable, and scalable platform services. 

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes. 

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers.

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

Non-Functional Testing

Observability & Debuggability

Test Data & Environment Management

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments

Collaboration & Growth

Qualifications

Technical Skills

 - Exposure to:

data.title: Manager of Enterprise Open Source Sales Team
data.description:
Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors. 

We are profitable and growing our global enterprise sales organisation. We are hiring regional sales team managers in Europe, Middle East, India, Asia, ANZ, Africa, Latin America, Central America and North America, each of whom will lead a team of five to ten enterprise sales representatives. 

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave. 

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application. 

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1, 000 colleagues in 70+ countries and over $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company. 

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence. 

In building our sales team, we look for five things: 

- Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
 - High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
 - Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
 - Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
 - Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools. 

The successful candidate will carry an annual team bookings quota within their territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagements or, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness in managing their team. They will need to coach, mentor and lead by example. Their sales representatives are expected to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise. 

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open sales team manager roles in every region. 

What your day will look like

- Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
 - Allocate portions of territory and accounts to sales representatives on your team
 - Identify and prioritise new logo accounts in your territory for account-based marketing and prospecting
 - Ensure that sales representatives have high quality account plans for existing accounts and priority prospects
 - Monitor new pipeline development by your team, through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
 - Support contract closure to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
 - Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
 - Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
 - Ensure your team maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
 - Represent the company, its solutions and software

What we are looking for in you

- Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
 - Leadership and management skill
 - Experience of open source technology and solutions
 - Detail oriented with effective planning, organisation and reporting skill
 - Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
 - Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
 - Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
 - Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
 - Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional Skills Of Interest

- Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
 - Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. 

- Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team meetings in person
 - Personal learning and development budget of USD 2, 000 per year
 - Annual compensation review
 - Recognition rewards
 - Annual holiday leave
 - Maternity and paternity leave
 - Employee Assistance Program
 - Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
 - Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. 

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Role: Principal Software Engineer

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Principal Embedded Software Engineer to join our team designing, developing, integrating and validating firmware for the latest Arm-based SoC platforms. 

Our team works across a broad range of SoC firmware technologies, with particular emphasis on memory subsystems, coherent interconnects, high-speed and low-speed I/O, platform initialization and system bring-up. We are especially interested in engineers with expertise in these areas, including experience working across simulation, emulation, FPGA and silicon environments. 

The role combines technical leadership and ownership of complex engineering deliverables with hands-on, low-level software development, integration, testing and debugging. You will work closely with hardware architects, silicon designers and software engineers to solve challenging system-level problems and drive technical decisions. 

If you are passionate about developing innovative technologies and enjoy working at the intersection of hardware and software, we would like to hear from you. 

Required Skills And Experience

Extensive experience in embedded systems and low-level firmware development, supported by a broad understanding of SoC architecture and platform software, is essential. 

We are particularly interested in candidates with deep expertise in one or more of the following areas: 

- SoC memory subsystems, including LPDDR or HBM, with experience in memory controller and PHY integration, initialization, training, bring-up and debugging. 
 - Platform firmware development, particularly UEFI firmware using EDK II, including hardware discovery, configuration and boot services. 
 - Trusted Firmware-A (TF-A), including secure boot, platform initialization and low-level firmware interactions. 
 - SoC interconnects and I/O subsystems, including coherent interconnects, PCIe, Ethernet and associated hardware initialization and bring-up. 

In addition to the above specialisms, the successful candidate will demonstrate: 

- Extensive familiarity with Arm system architecture, operating system fundamentals (preferably Linux), bootloaders and device drivers. 
 - Excellent C programming skills, with demonstrated ability to develop substantial new functionality and diagnose complex hardware/software interactions. Familiarity with Arm assembly language is desirable. 
 - Strong technical leadership skills, including the ability to make architectural and implementation decisions, resolve complex technical problems and guide other engineers. 
 - Experience collaborating across hardware and software teams to integrate, debug and validate complex SoC platforms. 
 - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including strong written and spoken English. 

Nice To Have Skills And Experience

- Experience leading teams of software engineers, including technical mentoring or line management. 
 - Familiarity with open-source development practices and upstream contribution processes. 
 - Experience with software development lifecycle methodologies, including Agile. 

In Return

You will have the opportunity to learn about the latest Arm architecture features, working closely with highly skilled engineering teams on ground-breaking technology. You will be empowered to continually identify and roll out improvements to our ways of working. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

data.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to operate and improve the services that manage SmartNICs across our cloud infrastructure. You will help ensure the reliability of card provisioning, configuration, deployment, health monitoring, and recovery throughout the hardware lifecycle. 

This role combines software engineering, systems troubleshooting, and production operations. You will work closely with software, networking, firmware, hardware, and data center teams to keep a large distributed fleet healthy and available. 

Responsibilities

- Operate and improve services responsible for SmartNIC discovery, provisioning, configuration, upgrades, and decommissioning. 
 - Define and track service-level objectives for management services and fleet operations. 
 - Build observability for card health, lifecycle transitions, firmware rollout progress, configuration consistency, and failed operations. 
 - Troubleshoot issues across management services, Linux systems, networking, firmware, and hardware interfaces. 
 - Develop automation to detect unhealthy cards, collect diagnostics, and perform safe remediation. 
 - Improve firmware and software deployments through staged rollouts, health validation, rollback mechanisms, and controlled concurrency. 
 - Design reliable lifecycle workflows that handle retries, partial failures, timeouts, and interrupted operations. 
 - Participate in on-call rotations, respond to production incidents, and drive corrective actions through blameless incident reviews. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to address recurring failures and improve serviceability, resilience, and operational readiness. 
 - Maintain runbooks and recovery procedures, and validate them through failure testing and operational exercises. 
 - Plan for fleet growth, management-service capacity, and operational scalability. 

Required Qualifications

- Experience in site reliability engineering, systems engineering, production engineering, or distributed infrastructure operations. 
 - Strong Linux troubleshooting skills, including processes, memory, storage, networking, and system logs. 
 - Programming experience in Python, shell scripts or another language used to build production services and automation. 
 - Understanding of distributed systems, APIs, asynchronous workflows, and failure recovery. 
 - Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, and packet-level troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Ability to investigate problems that span software and hardware boundaries. 
 - Clear communication and effective coordination during production incidents. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with SmartNICs, DPUs, network interface controllers, or hardware management platforms. 
 - Familiarity with firmware lifecycle management, device boot sequences, PCIe, drivers, and out-of-band management. 
 - Experience operating large hardware fleets in cloud or data center environments. 
 - Understanding of network virtualization, bare-metal infrastructure, and control-plane services. 
 - Experience designing safe fleet-wide changes with rate limits, canary deployments, and failure containment. 
 - Familiarity with hardware diagnostics, telemetry, and coordination with data center operations. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

data.title: Lead Engineer – CAD Digital Verification
data.description:
Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB) is the leading innovator in low-power wireless connectivity, building embedded technology that connects devices and improves lives. Merging cutting-edge technology into the world's most highly integrated SoCs, Silicon Labs provides device makers the solutions, support, and ecosystems needed to create advanced edge connectivity applications. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Silicon Labs has operations in over 16 countries and is the trusted partner for innovative solutions in the smart home, industrial IoT, and smart cities markets. Learn more at www. silabs. com. 

The Role

In this role, you will develop, enhance, and support CAD tools and EDA simulation flows that enable efficient and reliable verification of Silicon Labs' semiconductor products. You will work on automation, simulation methodologies, and verification infrastructure to improve engineering productivity, design quality, and overall development efficiency. 

This is a great opportunity for an experienced CAD or Design Verification Engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, developing automation solutions, and working closely with design and verification teams to enable high-quality ASIC and SoC development. 

Meet the Team

Our CAD - Digital Simulation team develops and maintains the tools, methodologies, and infrastructure that support digital simulation, design verification, formal verification, and low-power verification across Silicon Labs' engineering teams. 

You will collaborate closely with RTL designers, Design Verification engineers, CAD teams, and EDA vendors to develop scalable verification solutions, improve simulation efficiency, and support advanced semiconductor design methodologies. 

Responsibilities

As CAD Digital Verification Engineer, you will: 

- Develop, deploy, and maintain CAD tools and EDA flows supporting Design Verification, Formal Verification, Low Power, Functional Safety, and Coverage Analysis. 
 - Work closely with RTL design and verification teams to understand technical requirements, identify challenges, and develop solutions that improve engineering productivity. 
 - Develop and optimize automation scripts using Python, Perl, Tcl, Bash, and shell scripting to streamline simulation builds, testbench generation, and verification workflows. 
 - Support ASIC/SoC simulation environments, including RTL simulation, gate-level simulation (GLS), and UVM-based verification flows. 
 - Collaborate with EDA vendors such as Cadence, Synopsys, and Siemens EDA to integrate new capabilities, debug tool issues, and resolve simulation bottlenecks. 
 - Support verification engineers in debugging complex simulation failures, analyzing functional and code coverage, and improving verification efficiency. 
 - Develop reusable and scalable CAD methodologies and automation solutions to improve verification quality and reduce turnaround time. 
 - Participate in technical discussions, project planning, and roadmap reviews while providing regular updates on tool enhancements and deployment activities.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 7+ years of relevant industry experience, or a Master's degree with 5+ years of experience.

data.title: Senior Director - Design Assurance & Product Management
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centered on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Domain focus: Function head for cyber security product management and Design Assurance across the Cyber Architecture and Solutions portfolio. 

Job Purpose: 

Serve as the quality, governance and product authority for Cyber Architecture & Solutions. You are accountable for ensuring every security solution Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs and builds meets the required quality, compliance and operational standard before it reaches the global managed service vendor - the independent quality gate between what Cyber Architecture and Solutions produces and what the vendor is asked to operate. You own the Cyber Architecture and Solutions governance framework, the security product portfolio, vendor governance for the managed service as a whole, and the programme capability that delivers all Cyber Architecture and Solutions change. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining accountability while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles, and the primary Cyber Architecture and Solutions interface to internal audit, regulators and the second and third lines of defence. 

About the team: 

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles. 

What makes this role different. The defining tension is that you assure against standards you do not own. Architecture writes them; you verify independently and make binding pass-or-fail calls on vendor handover readiness - and that separation has to survive pressure from programmes with deadlines and from architects who will not welcome the finding. You are also the executive accountable for a vendor operating more than 30 platforms, where the operational risk is real but the levers are contractual rather than direct. Expect audit and regulatory scrutiny of the governance framework you own, and be ready to evidence a governance function of yours that withstood it. 

Key responsibilities: 

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following: 

- Define, own and continuously improve the Cyber Architecture and Solutions governance and quality framework - the assurance process, the pass or fail criteria for vendor handover and the exception regime - applying the design standards owned by the Architecture function rather than authoring them. 
 - Own and operate the independent design assurance process, making binding pass or fail determinations on vendor handover readiness with no compromise on quality. 
 - Lead a 17-role function spanning Design Assurance, Security Product Management, and vendor and portfolio governance, sustaining a culture of rigour, independence and delivery. 
 - Own the Cyber Architecture and Solutions security product portfolio: product roadmaps for every capability under Cyber Architecture and Solutions's remit, full lifecycle management from introduction through evolution to decommission, prioritised against GSK's cyber risk appetite. 
 - Hold ultimate commercial accountability for vendor governance across the managed service - performance, SLA, escalation and commercial levers, and oversight of platform support as it transitions to the OTO model - with day-to-day governance delegated to the Associate Director for vendor governance. 
 - Own Cyber Architecture and Solutions security risk and exception management at the most senior level: assess complex architectural risk exceptions, maintain the Cyber Architecture and Solutions risk register, and escalate material unmitigated risk with unambiguous clarity. 
 - Own Cyber Architecture and Solutions-wide metrics and security posture reporting, and present authoritative performance evidence to the CISO, ExCo and Board-level risk committees. 
 - Lead Cyber Architecture and Solutions engagement with internal audit, external regulators and the second and third lines of defence, evidencing design quality and governance effectiveness. 
 - Own portfolio intelligence and investment analytics so prioritisation decisions are evidence-based rather than loudest-voice. 
 - Protect the independence of assurance when it is commercially or politically inconvenient. 
 - Own the function's budget and the security tooling spend envelope it governs, and defend the consolidation savings committed in the annual plan against the renewal calendar. 
 - Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements. 
 - Set the technology and opportunity investment agenda for the portfolio - what to adopt, what to pilot and what to retire, including AI-enabled capability - and hold the evidence that justifies each decision. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- 20+ years in cyber security, including 7+ in senior leadership in a regulated environment leading leaders across geographies - domain focus: function head for cyber security product management and Design Assurance across the Cyber Architecture and Solutions portfolio
 - End-to-end product management of cyber security products - threat-led use-case definition, business case and investment, roadmap, vendor evaluation and selection, onboarding, adoption and value tracking, renewal and decommission - running capabilities as products with outcome KPIs (coverage, adoption, efficacy, cost per capability)
 - Building and leading a cyber security product management practice with domain product owners for each domain group, each mirrored to a Security Solution Engineering squad working in parallel, and technical deep dives proving product efficacy and integration
 - Leading an independent Design Assurance practice and governing a security managed service - binding pass or fail decisions on handover readiness made against standards owned by the Architecture function and never by you, supported by drift detection, QBRs and EBCs. 
 - Leading AI adoption across the portfolio and assurance - AI-enabled tool evaluation, assurance of agentic solutions and AI-driven lifecycle automation from intake to decommission

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Architecture literacy to make binding quality judgements on expert architecture output they do not own, expressed as non-conformance to a specific standard clause
 - Delivering enterprise security tool rationalisation with quantified savings, sequenced against renewal dates, with automated utilisation and renewal analytics
 - Evidencing design and product governance to internal audit, external audit and regulators, producing decisions, approvals and exceptions on demand
 - Credibility with Board-level risk committees, presenting assurance outcomes, portfolio performance and residual risk directly
 - Commercial acumen - multi-year vendor contracts, TCO and cost-to-serve modelling
 - Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Typical tools and technologies: Product portfolio and roadmap platforms, vendor performance, SLA and commercial governance, design assurance methodology and assurance register, AI-assisted and agentic lifecycle automation, ServiceNow, Power BI for portfolio and assurance analytics, GxP-compliant documentation and audit evidence management. 

#AGTech

Skills

AI for Cybersecurity, Application Security, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Cybersecurity, Data Security, Design Assurance, Global Team Management, Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, ML Security, Network Security Design, Operating Systems Security, Product Management, Product Portfolios, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Strategy Transformation, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Vulnerability Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB) is the leading innovator in low-power wireless connectivity, building embedded technology that connects devices and improves lives. Merging cutting-edge technology into the world's most highly integrated SoCs, Silicon Labs provides device makers the solutions, support, and ecosystems needed to create advanced edge connectivity applications. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Silicon Labs has operations in over 16 countries and is the trusted partner for innovative solutions in the smart home, industrial IoT, and smart cities markets. Learn more at www. silabs. com. 

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Software Architect to shape the architecture of embedded software, Wi-Fi protocol stacks, low-level firmware, and Linux drivers for our next-generation Wi-Fi ICs. 

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the architectural foundations of advanced wireless connectivity - balancing execution today with a forward-looking vision of where our overall system, spanning both software and hardware, should be tomorrow. 

As part of a collaborative group of architects, you will work across execution, planning, and long-term strategy: defining architectures, guiding designs, and shaping the direction of our technology to align with evolving Wi-Fi standards and product needs. 

Responsibilities

Execution

- Own software architecture and design, and guide implementations to align with architectural direction. 
 - Debug complex system-level issues and provide solutions with architectural insights. 
 - Perform code reviews from an architectural and system perspective to ensure scalability, performance, and maintainability. 

Planning

- Collaborate with engineering managers on JIRA top-level split, estimation, and backlog structuring to ensure feasibility and alignment with architectural goals. 
 - Provide technical input on schedules, dependencies, and integration risks. 

Broad and Long-Term Vision

- Shape the long-term architectural vision for embedded software, Wi-Fi protocol stacks, and Linux drivers. 
 - Contribute to Wi-Fi specifications and standards and track industry trends to influence product direction. 
 - Drive strategic architectural initiatives that position Silicon Labs as a leader in wireless connectivity. 
 - Advocate for open-source/Linux engagement, including upstream contributions where valuable. 
 - Ensure rigor in software quality by driving unit testing, functional testing, continuous integration, and verification practices across the team. 

Skills you'll need: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field preferably IIT/NIT/BITS/IISc
 - 12+ years of professional software development experience, including significant experience in an Architect role, with a strong focus on embedded systems, communication stacks, or Linux kernel drivers. 
 - Proven ability to define and evolve software architectures for complex embedded systems, making thoughtful trade-offs across performance, power, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Strong knowledge of software architecture and design patterns, with the ability to apply them pragmatically to achieve the best architecture without unnecessary reinvention. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in documenting and communicating architectures and designs in a clear and structured way for engineering teams and stakeholders. 
 - Ability to provide logical reasoning and lead technical conversations, building consensus around the best architectural and design choices, and influencing across architects, engineering teams, and leadership. 
 - Deep experience in system-level thinking and HW/SW partitioning, including designing software for complex SoCs and hardware accelerators. 
 - Deep expertise in Wi-Fi protocols or other communication stacks. 
 - Solid understanding of Linux kernel architecture and device drivers, including upstreaming practices. 
 - Hands-on proficiency in C development and low-level debugging at system and driver layers. 
 - Strong exposure to CI/CD pipelines, integration testing, and performance benchmarking frameworks. 

The following qualifications will be considered a plus: 

- Contributions to open-source projects (Linux kernel, networking stacks, etc. ). 
 - Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS) alongside Linux. 
 - Knowledge of security in embedded software, including secure boot, cryptography, and trusted execution environments. 
 - Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience collaborating in iterative development environments. 

Benefits & Perks

Not only will you be joining a highly skilled and tight-knit team where every engineer makes a significant impact on the product; we also strive for good work/life balance and to make our environment welcoming and fun. 

- Equity Rewards (RSUs) 
 - Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) 
 - Insurance plans with Outpatient cover 
 - National Pension Scheme (NPS) 
 - Flexible work policy 
 - Childcare support. 

Silicon Labs is an equal opportunity employer and values the diversity of our employees. Employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications and job-related criteria without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

data.title: Mgr, Quality/Training Strategy, GO-AI Operations Integration
data.description:
Description

The Manager, Quality & Training Strategy owns how GO-AI defines, measures, and improves the quality of annotations delivered to Amazon Robotics and Worldwide Operations science teams. You will own the quality model for an AI and ML annotation workforce: how accuracy is measured, how measurement scales across use cases and demand, and how quality standards reflect the customer's perception of the output they receive. You operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business, providing defect insights to Operations while representing the customer's view of quality. 

As GO-AI evolves, this role ensures that quality measurement keeps pace with how annotations are consumed by data scientists inside an ML product development lifecycle, and increasingly alongside model-generated output. You lead a team of program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica, and you apply an up-to-date understanding of AI capabilities to identify and drive use cases that improve operational metrics. 

Key job responsibilities

- Own the GO-AI quality model. Define how annotation accuracy is measured for each use case so that published metrics reflect the customer's perceived quality of the output. 
 - Own quality KPI definition and governance across 70+ use cases, including target baselining, process capability assessment, and the standards applied to new and ramping workforces. 
 - Define the quality measurement strategy, including how coverage and depth of measurement scale with demand, risk, and cost of quality. 
 - Lead deep dives on any degradation of customer-consumed quality metrics, drive to root cause through standardized mechanisms, and publish findings and corrective actions to senior leadership through weekly and monthly business reviews. 
 - Operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business. Partner with Customer Tech Programs on customer quality and speed expectations, and with Operations business unit leaders on defect insights and remediation. 
 - Translate ML customer needs into quality standards. Understand how annotations feed model training and evaluation so that quality definitions match how data scientists consume the output. 
 - Maintain a current understanding of AI capabilities and how they function. Identify and drive use cases where AI tooling improves quality, speed, and experience. 
 - Lead and develop a geographically distributed team of 6 to 8 program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica. Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career growth, and team structure. 

About The Team

GO-AI is a technology enablement organization that accelerates the development and enhances the performance of AI-based robotic and automation solutions for Amazon Robotics (AR) and key Worldwide Operations programs. We combine human expertise with machine learning to produce high-quality training data, validate model outputs, and continuously improve AI system performance across many annotation programs and a large global workforce. 

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of team management experience
 - 5+ years of program or project management experience
 - Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
 - Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
 - Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
 - Experience with tools/systems to analyze data including Excel, Access, SQL or other data management systems
 - Experience managing programs across multiple geographies and cultures

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in AI/ML operations, data annotation, or ML data quality. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent process improvement certification
 - Experience designing measurement or audit frameworks at scale
 - Experience applying GenAI or LLM-based tools to improve operational metrics
 - Experience operating as an independent quality assurance function alongside an operations organization

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals

Delivery & Execution Excellence

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

Non-Functional Testing

Observability & Debuggability

Test Data & Environment Management

Incident & Operational Support

Collaboration & Growth

Qualifications

Technical Skills

Key Expectations

Why Husky?
