data.description:
TESTOPS ENGINEER - AGENTIC AI

Location: XenonStack office, Sector 75, STPI, Mohali (Chandigarh Tricity), work from office

Experience: 2-8 years | Employment: Full time, XenonStack Private Limited | Team: AgentOps / Agentic AI Engineering

Role Level: X2 - Workflow

About Xenonstack

XenonStack is a Data and AI Foundry for Agentic Systems, enabling enterprises to design, deploy, operate, and scale intelligent agents across digital and physical environments. We build enterprise-grade platforms across the agentic stack: 

- Akira AI - Reasoning and agent orchestration. 
 - ElixirData - Agentic analytics intelligence. Explainable, decision-centric analytics for measurable business outcomes. 
 - NexaStack - Agentic infrastructure automation. Secure, compliant AI deployment across cloud, edge, and on-prem. 
 - MetaSecure - Trust, compliance and defense. Continuous assurance with AI-BOMs, risk scoring, and agentic security. 

Our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to AI + Human Intelligence by making agentic systems reliable, responsible, and enterprise-ready. 

About The Role

We are looking for a TestOps Engineer - Agentic AI with strong expertise in Python automation, LLM evaluation, agentic workflow testing, and CI/CD integration. 

You will design and maintain shared evaluation infrastructure, golden datasets, automated quality gates, and regression frameworks for AI agents across ElixirData, ElixirClaw, and NexaStack. 

This is an engineering-focused TestOps role, not a traditional manual QA position. You will build the testing systems and enable engineering teams to test their own components. 

ROLE MISSION

Make every AI agent release measurable, repeatable, reliable, and safe to ship through automated evaluations, statistical quality measurements, and continuous regression testing. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain reusable evaluation harnesses for LLM-powered agents and agentic workflows. 
 - Integrate offline evaluations for prompts, models, tools, and retrieval into CI/CD release gates. 
 - Measure agent quality, reliability, latency, and execution cost against defined thresholds. 
 - Create and version golden datasets, synthetic conversations, and edge-case scenario libraries for customer workflows. 
 - Validate agent trajectories, tool selection, execution sequences, and tool arguments. 
 - Develop contract tests for MCP servers, APIs, and external tools used by agents. 
 - Handle non-deterministic AI behavior using repeated evaluations, pass@k scoring, and statistical thresholds. 
 - Implement LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations and calibrate results against human-labelled datasets. 
 - Conduct adversarial testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and policy violations. 
 - Execute regression evaluations during model, prompt, provider, and dependency upgrades. 
 - Establish release quality gates and validate releases against agreed quality and safety thresholds. 
 - Convert production incidents into automated regression tests and maintain shared quality dashboards. 
 - Provide reusable test templates and evaluation playbooks to engineering teams. 

How We Work With Ai

AI is part of the daily workflow at XenonStack, not an add-on. 

- At our Mohali/Chandigarh office, AI tools are open for use: coding assistance, test generation, evaluation design, debugging, documentation, and research. 
 - When working on a client's data or environment, follow the client's compliance and information security policy. Use only approved tools and never expose client data, code, credentials, or configurations to unapproved AI services. 
 - Every AI-generated test, evaluation result, and recommendation must be reviewed, validated, and understood before use. 
 - Come ready to discuss your AI testing stack, how you evaluate non-deterministic outputs, and how you prevent unsafe agent behavior. 

What Success Looks Like

- 100% of agent releases go through automated evaluation gates. 
 - Every active customer workflow has a versioned golden dataset with agreed scenario coverage. 
 - Every production incident is converted into a regression test within 5 days. 
 - Zero critical AI safety findings reach production. 
 - All engineering pods adopt the shared evaluation harness rather than maintaining separate testing scripts. 
 - Quality dashboards provide measurable visibility into agent reliability, latency, cost, and evaluation results. 

Must-have Skills

- Python and test automation: Strong Python programming, pytest, reusable test framework development, API testing, automated regression testing, and Git. 
 - LLM evaluation frameworks: Hands-on experience with DeepEval, Promptfoo, Ragas, LangSmith, or equivalent evaluation tools. 
 - Agentic AI: Understanding of RAG, LLMs, tool calling, agent execution trajectories, and agent frameworks. 
 - Agent integration testing: Experience validating APIs, MCP servers, tool contracts, and multi-step agent workflows. 
 - Evaluation techniques: Golden datasets, synthetic test generation, pass@k, statistical thresholds, repeated runs, and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. 
 - CI/CD and release engineering: Integrating automated evaluations into CI/CD pipelines and enforcing release quality gates. 
 - AI safety testing: Knowledge of prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, adversarial scenarios, and policy validation. 
 - Engineering fundamentals: Debugging, root-cause analysis, test coverage, reproducibility, and maintainable automation code. 

Good-to-have Skills

- LangChain, LangGraph, or other agent orchestration frameworks. 
 - Claude, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, or other LLM providers. 
 - Multi-agent system testing and agent-to-agent interaction validation. 
 - Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native deployment environments. 
 - AI observability, tracing, quality dashboards, and production monitoring. 
 - AI security, red-teaming, responsible AI, and governance frameworks. 
 - Experience with model and prompt versioning, benchmarking, and cost optimisation. 

CANDIDATE PROFILE

- 2-8 years of experience in QA Automation, SDET, MLOps, or related engineering roles, including hands-on LLM evaluation. 
 - Proven experience developing Python-based automation frameworks and integrating them into CI/CD workflows. 
 - Practical understanding of LLM applications, RAG systems, tool calling, and agentic AI architectures. 
 - Ability to evaluate non-deterministic systems using statistical metrics rather than relying only on binary pass/fail checks. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline; demonstrated hands-on experience is equally important. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, debugging, communication, and cross-team collaboration skills. 

We value engineers who build scalable testing systems rather than simply execute test cases. Be ready to explain how you evaluated an AI agent, designed golden datasets, handled inconsistent outputs, and prevented regressions from reaching production. 

Traditional manual QA experience alone is not sufficient for this role. 

HIRING PROCESS

Pre-screening assessment (about 10 minutes, at application) → Technical interview → Face-to-face technical assessment at our Mohali office → HR and Leadership round → Background verification → Offer. 

TERMS

- Location: Work from our Mohali (Chandigarh Tricity) office. 
 - Full time; immediate joiners or short notice periods preferred. 
 - Background verification (BGV) is mandatory. 
 - Compensation as per company policy and budget band. 

How We Work

We value deep work, clarity, and execution over activity. You will be expected to clarify, plan, execute, and escalate with options, not wait to be told. Ownership sits with the individual, and outcomes are measured, not effort. 

OUR VALUES

Agency - Be self-directed and proactive | Taste - Sweat the details and build with precision | Ownership - Take responsibility for outcomes | Mastery - Commit to continuous learning and growth | Impatience - Move fast and challenge inertia | Customer Obsession - Always put the customer first

WHY JOIN US

- Build evaluation and testing infrastructure for enterprise-grade Agentic AI platforms. 
 - Work on LLM evaluation, agent reliability, AI safety, and production-grade quality engineering. 
 - Collaborate with AgentOps, engineering, security, and observability teams. 
 - AI-first environment: work alongside the agentic platforms we build. 
 - Great Place to Work-Certified, 14+ years, headquartered in Mohali.

data.title: Non-Functional Test Engineer
data.description:
Job Summary

Non Functional Test Engineer role in a hybrid work model for an airport operations and airlines domain project focusing on performance reliability and resilience testing for critical aviation applications. The engineer will design and execute non functional test strategies using automation AI test generation tools and API testing to ensure high quality systems that support safe and efficient air travel operations across global stakeholders. 

Responsibilities

- Define comprehensive non functional test strategies and plans that validate performance reliability scalability and security of airport operations and airline applications in alignment with business goals and regulatory expectations. 
 - Design detailed test scenarios using advanced AI test generation tools to increase coverage reduce human error and accelerate identification of bottlenecks across complex aviation workflows. 
 - Develop robust automated test suites for performance and resilience including load stress endurance and capacity tests that provide clear metrics on system behavior under realistic airport passenger and flight volumes. 
 - Implement API testing frameworks that validate response time throughput data consistency and error handling for critical integrations among booking systems airport operational control systems and airline services. 
 - Coordinate end to end non functional test execution in a hybrid work model ensuring smooth collaboration between onsite and remote stakeholders and maintaining consistent communication and documentation. 
 - Analyze performance test results using structured methods to identify root causes of latency resource contention and stability issues and translate findings into practical tuning recommendations for engineering teams. 
 - Collaborate closely with application architects and developers to define non functional requirements capacity targets and service level objectives that reflect real world airline and airport operational demands. 
 - Create clear reusable test data strategies for non functional testing that simulate flight schedules passenger profiles baggage volumes and operational events without compromising privacy or compliance. 
 - Prepare concise dashboards and reports that present key non functional quality indicators trends and risks to project managers product owners and domain experts enabling informed decision making. 
 - Establish and refine automation standards for non functional tests to improve repeatability maintainability and integration into continuous integration and delivery pipelines across aviation platforms. 
 - Validate system behavior under failure scenarios by orchestrating component outages network disruptions and degraded services to ensure graceful recovery and minimal impact on airport and airline operations. 
 - Support defect triage for non functional issues by prioritizing based on customer impact operational risk and regulatory considerations and by driving timely resolution with technical teams. 
 - Mentor peers on non functional testing practices tools and domain specific scenarios sharing knowledge about aviation processes so the entire team can deliver higher reliability outcomes. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate strong experience in using AI test generation tools to design complex non functional test scenarios enhancing coverage and reducing test design cycle time in fast paced delivery environments. 
 - Apply practical expertise in test automation frameworks to create maintain and execute performance and reliability test suites that integrate seamlessly with existing build and deployment pipelines. 
 - Use deep hands on skills in API testing to validate functional and non functional aspects of services including response time throughput error handling and security behavior for aviation integrations. 
 - Bring proven domain experience in airport operations encompassing passenger handling flight turnaround baggage operations and resource allocation to design realistic performance test scenarios. 
 - Exhibit solid understanding of airline business processes such as reservations ticketing check in boarding disruption management and loyalty programs to align non functional testing with actual use cases. 
 - Possess strong analytical abilities in interpreting performance metrics logs and traces enabling quick isolation of capacity constraints configuration issues and architectural limitations. 
 - Show capability to work effectively in a hybrid model managing time collaboration tools and documentation practices to maintain transparency and continuity across distributed teams. 
 - Maintain familiarity with industry standards and good practices related to non functional quality performance security and reliability in mission critical transportation and travel systems.

Senior Wireless QA Engineer

What makes our team unique? We work in a highly collaborative, international environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged. Our site fosters a culture of learning, where team members are empowered to solve real-world problems and make meaningful contributions to the success of Silicon Labs. We take pride in developing solutions that transform industries and improve lives through technology.

Responsibilities

Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems that ensure the health of AWS data centers. Operating across Australia & New Zealand, India, North Asia, and Southeast Asia, APAC CDS manages 41 leased/owned sites and supports global follow-the-sun operations. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines: deployments (control systems in new data centers), projects (controls capital improvement works at live sites), and service (control systems at live sites), with additional specializations in colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, program management, and coordination. 

As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms. 

To be successful in this team, you will also have: 

- Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
 - Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
 - Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
 - Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed

Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade colocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.

 - Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Essential Skills/Experience

Minimum Requirements: 

- BS (or equivalent experience) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, computational sciences or a related quantitative field. 
 - Extensive experience (typically 12+ years) building and deploying data science and ML solutions, including considerable recent hands-on experience (typically 2+ years) with LLM-based and agentic applications in production. 
 - Demonstrated track record of setting technical direction and leading complex, multi-functional AI delivery through influence.

- Generative AI and LLMs: prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning (including parameter-efficient methods), distillation, and model selection and cost/latency optimisation.

data.title: Senior Manager - Design Assurance & Product Management
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Domain focus: Design Assurance practice delivery across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains. 

Job Purpose: 

The delivery management layer in the Design Assurance practice, between the Principals and the analysts. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against demand, track findings to closure across the practice, and manage the assurance throughput and turnaround metrics the function is judged on. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load. 

About the team: 

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles. 

What makes this role different. The delivery management layer between the Principals and the analysts in a practice judged on throughput and turnaround, not just rigour. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against incoming demand, drive findings to closure across every domain, and run the governance reporting and audit evidence packs. Workflow automation in ServiceNow is how the practice scales, and improving it is part of the role. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load, so this is not a pure coordination job. 

Key responsibilities: 

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following: 

- Manage the demand pipeline across two Principals and the domain analysts, and decide what gets expedited - including telling a programme director that their review will not be. 
 - Manage assurance throughput, turnaround and SLA metrics the function is judged on, and escalate capacity pressure before turnaround slips quietly. 
 - Drive findings and time-bound conditions to closure across all domains, chasing the ones that stall and escalating aged items by name. 
 - Develop the analyst team's domain depth and progression, in a practice where most reviewers arrive strong in one domain and need two. 
 - Own the quality of what the practice produces - review rigour, finding clarity and closure discipline - and correct it at the individual level when it drops. 
 - Carry a review caseload alongside the management load, so technical credibility with the Principals is maintained. 
 - Manage the analyst team's day-to-day workload, quality and development across their domain specialisms.

Job Description - API Test Architect & Test Solution Lead

API Modernization | Microservices | Healthcare | Quality Engineering

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced API Test Architect & Solution Lead to lead the quality engineering strategy, architecture, and implementation for large-scale API modernization and microservices transformation programs within the healthcare domain. 

The role will be responsible for defining the end-to-end API testing architecture and modernization validation strategy for enterprise services being transformed from legacy/monolithic platforms into modern RESTful APIs and microservices. 

This is a customer-facing technical leadership role requiring strong expertise in API testing, test automation architecture, microservices, legacy-to-modern API parity validation, CI/CD integration, healthcare data validation, and AI-assisted Quality Engineering. 

The Solution Lead will work closely with enterprise architects, API developers, product owners, business teams, DevOps teams, and QA engineering teams to ensure modernized services meet functional, integration, data integrity, performance, security, and release-readiness requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

API Test Architecture & Solutioning

- Define the enterprise API Quality Engineering architecture, strategy, standards, and implementation roadmap for API modernization programs. 
 - Design scalable and reusable API automation frameworks supporting hundreds of APIs and thousands of test scenarios. 
 - Establish standardized testing approaches using Cucumber, TestNG, REST Assured, Gradle, Git/Bitbucket, Jenkins/Udeploy, and automated reporting. 
 - Define framework architecture with clear separation of: 
 - Test data
 - Test logic
 - Configuration
 - Validation utilities
 - Reporting
 - Environment management
 - Build reusable automation components, utilities, libraries, and common validation capabilities that can be adopted across multiple projects. 
 - Establish traceability across requirements → feature files → test data → automated execution → defects → results. 

API Modernization & Microservices Validation

- Lead testing strategy for migration of legacy enterprise services to REST APIs and microservices architecture. 
 - Define legacy-versus-modernized service parity testing to ensure business functionality and data behavior remain consistent during modernization. 
 - Establish baseline request/response datasets from legacy services and compare them against modernized API responses. 
 - Design automated comparison capabilities for: 
 - Request/response validation
 - JSON/XML payload comparison
 - Schema validation
 - Field-level comparison
 - Business-rule validation
 - Data transformation validation
 - Database/backend validation
 - Error and exception handling
 - Validate service decomposition and interactions across distributed microservices. 
 - Develop testing approaches for synchronous and asynchronous service integrations. 
 - Define regression strategies that allow modernization teams to continuously verify functional parity during incremental migration. 

API Functional & Integration Testing

- Define comprehensive API testing coverage including: 
 - Functional testing
 - Integration testing
 - Contract testing
 - Schema validation
 - Positive and negative testing
 - Boundary testing
 - Authentication and authorization validation
 - Error handling
 - Data integrity validation
 - Regression testing
 - End-to-end service validation
 - Establish API test scenarios based on OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, GraphQL schemas, interface contracts, business requirements, and legacy system documentation. 
 - Define reusable test-data strategies using Excel, generated datasets, synthetic data, and approved production-like samples. 
 - Drive automation-first testing while identifying scenarios requiring specialized or exploratory validation. 

Healthcare Domain Validation

- Provide Quality Engineering leadership for healthcare enterprise services supporting areas such as: 
 - Member and eligibility
 - Provider
 - Claims
 - Benefits
 - Enrollment
 - Accumulators
 - Authorization
 - Payments
 - Clinical and administrative integrations
 - Ensure modernization testing validates critical healthcare business rules and cross-system data integrity. 
 - Support testing of healthcare interoperability and data exchange services where applicable, including FHIR/HL7-based APIs and healthcare integration patterns. 
 - Ensure appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare test data and alignment with organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements. 

Automation Framework Engineering

- Architect and enhance BDD-based API automation frameworks using: 
 - Cucumber
 - TestNG
 - REST Assured
 - Java
 - Gradle
 - Define reusable feature files, step definitions, API clients, assertion libraries, data utilities, and comparison utilities. 
 - Develop configurable validation mechanisms capable of supporting different APIs without extensive custom coding. 
 - Establish coding standards, framework governance, peer reviews, and reusable engineering patterns. 
 - Optimize automation suites for parallel execution, maintainability, stability, and faster regression cycles. 

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate API automation into Jenkins/Udeploy CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Define automated quality gates for builds and deployments. 
 - Enable API regression suites to execute across development, QA, integration, staging, and release environments. 
 - Establish mechanisms for: 
 - Pipeline-triggered execution
 - Environment configuration
 - Test-data management
 - Parallel execution
 - Failure diagnostics
 - Automated reporting
 - Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to enable continuous testing and shift-left quality engineering. 

Reporting & Quality Metrics

- Define enterprise-level API Quality Engineering reporting using: 
 - Cucumber Reports
 - JSON Reports
 - HTML Reports
 - Execution Logs
 - CI/CD dashboards
 - Establish metrics for: 
 - API automation coverage
 - Functional coverage
 - Regression coverage
 - Pass/fail trends
 - Defect leakage
 - Modernization parity
 - Execution stability
 - Release readiness
 - Provide technical insights and quality recommendations to engineering leadership and customer stakeholders. 

AI-Assisted Quality Engineering

- Drive adoption of GitHub Copilot and GenAI-assisted engineering across the API testing lifecycle. 
 - Use AI assistance for: 
 - Requirement and API specification analysis
 - Test scenario generation
 - Test case generation
 - Gherkin/feature-file generation
 - REST Assured automation development
 - Code refactoring
 - Test-data generation
 - Coverage-gap identification
 - Failure analysis
 - Leverage OpenAPI specifications, GraphQL schemas, legacy documentation, and existing test assets as inputs for AI-assisted test design. 
 - Define appropriate human review and governance practices for AI-generated test assets. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through intelligent automation and reusable accelerators. 

Technical Leadership & Customer Engagement

- Act as the technical solution lead and architecture point of contact for API Quality Engineering. 
 - Engage with customer stakeholders to understand modernization objectives, current-state architecture, quality risks, and target-state requirements. 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into testing architecture, solution approach, implementation roadmap, effort estimates, and delivery plans. 
 - Conduct architecture reviews and technical solution presentations with customers and engineering leadership. 
 - Lead technical discussions across development, architecture, DevOps, business, and QA teams. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and QA leads and provide technical direction across distributed teams. 
 - Identify testing risks, dependencies, technical constraints, and mitigation strategies early in the modernization lifecycle. 

Required Technical Skills

API & Microservices: REST APIs, RESTful services, Microservices Architecture, JSON, XML, OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL, API contracts, service integration patterns

API Automation: REST Assured, Cucumber BDD, TestNG, Java, Gradle

Framework Architecture: Reusable automation framework design, modular architecture, custom assertion utilities, schema validation, response comparison, test-data management

DevOps: Jenkins, Udeploy, Git, Bitbucket, CI/CD integration, continuous testing

Testing: API functional testing, integration testing, contract testing, regression testing, legacy-to-modern API parity testing, data validation, negative testing

Reporting: Cucumber Reports, JSON/HTML reporting, execution logs and CI/CD quality reporting

AI-Assisted Engineering: GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted test analysis, scenario generation, Gherkin generation, automation development and coverage analysis

Healthcare: Strong understanding of healthcare enterprise systems and preferably experience with claims, member, provider, eligibility, benefits, authorization, payments, or healthcare interoperability services. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience leading enterprise API modernization or monolith-to-microservices transformation programs. 
 - Experience architecting API automation frameworks used across multiple applications or programs. 
 - Experience with legacy-to-modern service comparison/parity validation. 
 - Knowledge of cloud-native architectures, containers, Kubernetes, API gateways, and service discovery is desirable. 
 - Exposure to service virtualization, mocking, contract testing, and API performance testing. 
 - Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7 is advantageous. 
 - Experience implementing AI/GenAI-assisted Quality Engineering practices. 
 - Strong customer-facing solutioning, architecture presentation, estimation, and stakeholder-management capabilities. 

Experience

- 13+ years of overall experience in Quality Engineering, testing, software engineering, or related disciplines. 
 - 7+ years of strong API testing and automation experience. 
 - 5+ years in a Test Architect, Solution Architect, QE Architect, Technical Lead, or equivalent technical leadership role. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading complex API modernization, microservices, integration, or digital transformation programs. 
 - Prior experience in healthcare or health insurance programs is strongly preferred. 

Expected Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be able to take an enterprise modernization requirement such as: 

Legacy Enterprise Services → Modern APIs → Microservices

and independently define the corresponding: 

Current-State Assessment → Test Strategy → API Test Architecture → Legacy Baseline → Modern API Validation → Automated Parity Testing → CI/CD Integration → Regression Strategy → Quality Gates → Production Readiness

The candidate should combine hands-on API automation architecture expertise with solutioning and customer-facing leadership, rather than functioning only as a test manager or delivery manager.

data.description:
About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options. 

There's never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About The Role

DriveWealth is seeking a hands-on Senior QA Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team supporting post-trade platforms: clearing, custody, settlement, and the back-office systems that follow trade execution. This role is embedded within a product engineering team and focuses on scalable automation, high-quality releases, and stronger testing practices across the SDLC. 

The ideal candidate has strong technical automation experience and prior exposure to post-trade processing, reconciliation, and margin products in a broker-dealer or clearing environment. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks using Java, Cucumber (BDD), and RestAssured
 - Build and execute automated tests across API, event/messaging (Kafka, queue-based integrations), and data layers, with UI coverage where applicable
 - Validate end-to-end post-trade workflows, including trade settlement, positions and cash, corporate actions, options lifecycle (exercise, assignment, expiration), margin, asset transfers (ACATS), and cost basis/tax lots
 - Design and automate reconciliation tests between DriveWealth systems and clearing/custodian platforms, validating positions, balances, and transactions Validate downstream outputs such as trade confirmations, statements, and regulatory reports (e. g. , CAT/FINRA)
 - Create test plans, scenarios, and regression suites for financial systems, including migration and parallel-run validation
 - Build and maintain CI/CD test pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
 - Performance Testing experience
 - Analyze test results, troubleshoot defects, and improve test coverage
 - Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Compliance teams on testing strategy and quality improvements
 - Participate in test reviews, bug triage, and production issue analysis

You Bring

- 8+ years of QA experience in financial services, with direct exposure to post-trade, clearing, or back-office platforms
 - Strong hands-on programming in Java
 - Automation experience with Cucumber/BDD and RestAssured
 - Experience testing REST APIs and event-driven systems (Kafka; RabbitMQ or SQS a plus)
 - Strong SQL (Postgres) skills for data validation and reconciliation
 - Working knowledge of post-trade concepts: settlement cycles, corporate actions, margin, options lifecycle, and books-and-records requirements
 - Experience with AWS, Git, and Jenkins
 - Familiarity with JIRA and test management tools (Allure TestOps)

Special Knowledge (Nice To Have, But Not Required)

- Playwright and TypeScript for UI automation
 - Experience with a clearing system conversion or platform migration
 - Exposure to FIX protocol, crypto asset workflows, or data tools such as Databricks

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: Hyderabad, IN

- This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team. 
 - If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations. 

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions. 

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays. 

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment. 

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company. 

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise. 

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience. If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

data.title: Data Security Engineering Lead
data.description:
About Astellas

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas. com (https: //www. astellas. com/en)

Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact. 

Purpose And Scope

Engineer and run the Microsoft Purview platform that protects Astellas' most sensitive data. As Data Security Engineering Lead, you will turn approved protection requirements into working sensitivity labels, data loss prevention and classification controls, keep them accurate as the business and its use of AI evolve, and lead the Astellas team that takes over day-to-day operations from our implementation partner. 

Responsibilities And Accountabilities

- Scope: Microsoft Purview data security capabilities across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Windows endpoints, browsers, and Microsoft 365 Copilot and other AI tools, in a single global Microsoft 365 tenant. 
 - Information Protection: Design, configure and maintain sensitivity labels and label policies, container labels, client-side and service-side auto-labeling, and encryption (Rights Management and Message Encryption), keeping the label scheme simple enough for employees to apply correctly. 
 - Data Loss Prevention: Build and tune Purview DLP policies across email, collaboration, endpoint (via Defender for Endpoint) and browser channels, and extend protection to Copilot and AI tools using Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) for AI. Configure policy tips, user notifications and business-justification overrides. 
 - Classification & Detection: Turn crown-jewel and use-case inputs from the Data Protection Policy & Engagement Lead into accurate detection, using custom sensitive information types, exact data match, document fingerprinting and trainable classifiers. Validate coverage with Content Explorer and Activity Explorer, and reduce false positives using feedback from the business and the Insider Risk team. 
 - Policy Lifecycle & Operations: Run policy change control from simulation to enforcement and rollback; triage and escalate DLP alerts; configure approved exceptions with expiry dates; and monitor user overrides, reporting patterns back to policy owners. 
 - Integration & Automation: Send Purview alerts and audit data to Microsoft Sentinel and ServiceNow with the Security Operations and platform teams; automate configuration, reporting and testing with Purview PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; and work with the Insider Risk team to share data loss and insider risk signals, align detections and Adaptive Protection, and use joint findings to tune policies. 
 - Service Ownership: Own service levels, performance metrics and the operations and engineering runbook; lead knowledge transfer from our implementation partner; and become the Astellas operations owner for the platform by mid-2027. 
 - Platform Leadership: Own the Microsoft Purview data security platform roadmap and provide input to licensing decisions; oversee our implementation partner's engineering delivery and quality; and lead and mentor the Astellas engineers and analysts who take over day-to-day operations. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology or a related field. 
 - 10+ years in security engineering or operations, including 4+ years hands-on with Microsoft Purview data security (Information Protection, DLP and data classification) in a production Microsoft 365 environment. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional initiatives with global stakeholders and overseeing external partners or vendors, including leading or mentoring a team. 
 - Experience building custom sensitive information types and tuning DLP policies to reduce false positives at enterprise scale. 
 - Hands-on experience with Endpoint DLP and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. 
 - PowerShell scripting, with working knowledge of KQL and Microsoft Graph. 
 - Ability to explain technical behavior clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with exact data match, document fingerprinting or trainable classifiers. 
 - Experience protecting Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI tools with DSPM for AI. 
 - Experience integrating Purview with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR and ServiceNow. 
 - Experience with Zscaler CASB and Data Security products. 
 - Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or other regulated industries. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (SC-401); SC-200 or SC-100 a plus. 

Working Environment

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas' Responsible Flexibility

What awaits you at Astellas?

- Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide. 
 - Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day. 
 - Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare. 
 - A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions. 

Our Organizational Values and Behaviors

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do. 

Behaviors: We come together as 'One Astellas', working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution. 

Category Digital Infrastructure & Cybersecurity

Astellas is committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment. 

EOE including Disability/Protected Veterans

data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible for executing daily preventive and corrective maintenance tasks to ensure the optimal functioning of various BOP systems. This role will plan and document maintenance activities, manage environmental compliance, and verify financial transactions through site measurements. Additionally, this role will ensure equipment health through regular inspections, manage on-site personnel and PPE usage, and coordinate with quality departments to maintain system integrity. 

Responsibilities

Lead Mechanical BOP

Maintenance Execution And Asset Reliability

Execute daily preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective maintenance (CM) activities to ensure the reliability of DM Plant and HVAC, Fuel systems (Light Diesel Oil), Firefighting systems, CW (Cooling Water) duct systems, RO and sea intake systems. 

Execute maintenance activities during opportunity-based shutdowns. 

Execute painting, and refurbishment activities of major spares. 

Perform the closure of notifications and orders after work completion, ensuring all tasks are completed to the required standard. 

Maintenance Planning, Documentation, And Project Execution

Implement seasonal maintenance plans, corrosion prevention plan and rolling plans. 

Execute scrap collection and disposal to the store, maintaining environmental compliance. 

Execute document maintenance activities meticulously for future reference and continuous improvement. 

Take site measurements for bill verifications to ensure accurate and fair financial transactions. 

Execute CAPEX projects and ensure timely completion. 

Create reservation slips for the issue of materials from stores and manage the return of balance spares. 

Equipment And Site Management

Monitor the healthiness of equipment through regular field visits and inspections and report any abnormalities on the site to the Team Lead promptly. 

Attend to leakages in fire fighting and gas systems. 

Manage the day-to-day attendance of business associates, ensuring the proper use of PPEs and the healthiness of tools and tackles. 

Execute trials of equipment to validate performance and compliance with specifications. 

Coordinate with the quality department for duct coating systems. 

Monitor the healthiness of Sacrificial Anodes and ICCP systems for CW ducts. 

Business Sustainability

Implement and follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department. 

Maintain a strong focus on the safety of personnel and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols. 

Conduct Tool Box Talks (TBT) to reinforce safety awareness and operational procedures among the team. 

Uphold 5S standards in the assigned area to promote a clean and efficient work environment. 

Ensure site-related safety compliances are met and followed rigorously. 

Follow SOPs, SMPs, and JSAs to maintain high safety and operational standards. 

Digitization And Automation

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency. 

Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals/strategy. 

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas. 

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Chemistry

Operations

Fire & Safety

Admin

CHEP helps move more goods to more people, in more places than any other organization on earth via our 347 million pallets, crates and containers. We employ approximately 13, 000 people and operate in 60 countries. Through our pioneering and sustainable share-and-reuse business model, the world's biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact. 

What does that mean for you? You'll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. You'll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You'll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our Hybrid Work Model. 

Job Description

As a Cloud Architect, you will provide technical leadership for our cloud infrastructure, platform engineering and security architecture. You will lead a team of Cloud and Security engineers, define the cloud roadmap, and ensure our platforms are secure, scalable, reliable and cost-effective. This role partners closely with engineering, security and data teams to drive cloud-native adoption and operational excellence. 

Key Responsibilities May Include

- Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure for machine learning workflows, including data storage and bespoke frameworks supporting the BRIX platform. 
 - Develop and implement automated CI/CD pipelines to ensure regular, reliable deployment of models into production using containerization tools to manage and package devices. 
 - Implement monitoring and logging solutions to maintain high availability and performance of machine learning models, applications, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Contribute to automation efforts for infrastructure processes, including configuration management and provisioning to enhance operational efficiency and scalability. 
 - Support Brambles' Serialization and Asset Digitization programs by setting up and maintaining IoT and Edge platforms, ensuring seamless integration with cloud services. 
 - Ensure best practices in version control and documentation processes, contributing to the clarity and standardization of cloud operations. 
 - Research and implement best practices for cloud infrastructure management, such as GitOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), enhancing the team's capabilities. 
 - Mentor and support the Cloud Engineering team by sharing knowledge and staying up to date on emerging cloud technologies, driving continuous improvement and innovation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and govern scalable, highly available and cost-efficient cloud architectures supported by clear documentation and standards. 
 - Lead cloud security architecture, embedding Zero Trust, encryption, policy-as-code and compliance controls across all environments. 
 - Evaluate, onboard and standardise cloud technologies and platforms across Kubernetes, data, and CI/CD ecosystems. 
 - Drive Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/GitOps) and automation standards across cloud, containerised and serverless platforms. 
 - Establish monitoring, logging, tracing, and reliability practices to ensure platform health and operational excellence. 
 - Lead and mentor a team of Cloud and Security Engineers, fostering technical excellence and DevSecOps best practices. 

Key Performance Measures

- Well-Architected Infrastructure: Maintain high availability, cost efficiency and resilience across public cloud environments. 
 - Secure Design Principles: Achieve zero critical security drift through automated policy enforcement, shift-left security, and compliance readiness. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Professional Exp : 7+ years of experience in Cloud, DevOps, and Infrastructure Engineering, with proven team management and technical leadership experience. Hands-on expertise in Databricks for unified data analytics and processing. 
 - Cloud & IaC : Proven expertise in architecting and operating large-scale, multi-tenant cloud environments on AWS, with exposure to Azure and GCP considered a plus. Extensive experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and driving automated deployments through GitOps-based delivery models. 
 - Containers & Orchestration : Extensive experience architecting and operating production-grade Kubernetes (EKS) environments. 
 - Security & Networking : Deep understanding of software security, Identity Federation (OIDC/SAML, Okta), zero-trust architecture, PKI/certificates, and network encryption. 
 - Systems & Data Architecture : Strong knowledge of distributed systems, real-time data pipelines (Kafka, CDC), data warehousing, and client-server architectures.

Education & Qualification : Bachelor's in Computer Science/Engineering, or a Master's in Computer Applications/Science preferred. 

Key Challenges & Core Mindset

 - Tooling Selection: Balance cutting-edge technical capability with long-term maintainability when selecting tools to add to the stack.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform
data.description:
The salary range for this role is $5, 000 - $9, 500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle{{{{~}}}}

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation{{{{~}}}}

For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5, 000 - $9, 500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work. 

About the Role{{{{~}}}}

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on{{{{~}}}} the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through. 

This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes{{{{~}}}} new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery. 

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust - your platform is what their work composes with. 

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own. 

What You'll Do{{{{~}}}}

- Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes{{{{~}}}} new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones. 
 - Own the event-driven platform between the security services{{{{~}}}} the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability - so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it. 
 - Integrate the platform end-to-end{{{{~}}}} scanners → finding system-of-record → tickets → metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering. 
 - Own delivery of the security gates - SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning{{{{~}}}} scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery. 
 - Build agentic security workflows{{{{~}}}} CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers - tooling other engineers actually adopt. 
 - Build the triage-to-remediation automation{{{{~}}}} validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop - reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations. 
 - Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own. 
 - Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own. 

What We Look For{{{{~}}}}

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience. 
 - Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days. 
 - Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python. 
 - Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven or message-based systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar){{{{~}}}} contracts, idempotent consumers, replay, back-pressure. 
 - Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipeline tooling - jobs, shared templates, runners - GitLab CI at fleet scale is a strong plus. 
 - Hands-on web application security knowledge{{{{~}}}} the OWASP Top 10 in real code - able to find these issues, fix them yourself, and encode the detection so they stop recurring. 
 - Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tooling (e. g. , Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, gitleaks), including tuning them to a signal-to-noise ratio developers will tolerate. 
 - Demonstrated AI-forward engineering{{{{~}}}} you actively use AI tooling (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and have built agentic workflows that other engineers adopted. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes as deployment targets for the services you build. 

Preferred Knowledge and Skills{{{{~}}}}

- Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending, especially with systems in cardholder-data or regulated scope. 
 - Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 as they apply to software development and change management - the platform you build is what produces that evidence. 
 - Software supply-chain integrity{{{{~}}}} SBOM pipelines, dependency governance, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA). 
 - Familiarity with policy-as-code and admission control (OPA, Kyverno, conftest) - your gates compose with the cluster's runtime policy-enforcement layer. 
 - Exposure to bug bounty or external vulnerability report triage - enough to know what the automation you build has to get right. 
 - Experience with threat modeling at a system level. 

About You{{{{~}}}}

- You measure yourself by other teams' code - a fix you shipped is good; a vulnerability class that stopped appearing across the fleet is better. 
 - You'd rather ship a gate than publish a policy - you know that enforcement changes behavior and documents do not, and you build the enforcement so well that engineers want to keep it. 
 - You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. 
 - You're not bound by convention - your success-and much of the fun-lies in developing new ways to do things. 
 - You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. 
 - You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. 
 - You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. 
 - You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. 

Sezzle's Technology Stack{{{{~}}}}

- Languages{{{{~}}}} Golang, Typescript, Python
 - Frontend{{{{~}}}} Typescript - React and React Native
 - Backend{{{{~}}}} Golang
 - Database{{{{~}}}} MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
 - DevOps & Cloud{{{{~}}}} AWS, Kubernetes
 - Version Control{{{{~}}}} Git
 - CI/CD{{{{~}}}} Gitlab
 - Testing{{{{~}}}} Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
 - Open Source{{{{~}}}} Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Restlessly reinventing since 1911, we are not only one of the largest corporate organizations in the world, we're also one of the biggest technology and consulting employers, with many of the Fortune 50 companies relying on the IBM Cloud to run their business. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

- Develop Database Solutions: Plans, analyzes, designs, and constructs databases, implementing industry standards and best practices for database security. Analyzes and defines database and information security requirements.

data.description:
Summary

MathWorks has a hybrid work model that enables staff members to split their time between office and home. The hybrid model provides the advantage of having both in-person time with colleagues and flexible at-home life optimizations. Learn More: https: //www. mathworks. com/company/jobs/resources/applying-and-interviewing. html#onboarding. 

MathWorks is seeking an engineer to help develop and deploy a production engineering solution for Model-Based Design. The role combines strong software development skills with practical engineering expertise to translate real-world development processes and needs into reusable tools, automation, and system capabilities. 

The role will focus on creating scalable solutions that integrate the MathWorks toolchain into end-to-end engineering pipelines, spanning requirements, system and software design, modeling, simulation, verification and validation, code generation, quality assurance, reporting, and continuous integration. The engineer will help establish standardized and automated processes while providing the flexibility needed to adapt them to different engineering organizations, development environments, and tool infrastructures. 

A key aspect of the role is connecting product development with practical production engineering, identifying repeatable engineering patterns and turning them into robust, maintainable capabilities that can be deployed broadly. These environment may support development processes governed by industry standards such as ISO 26262 and DO-178C, where traceability, consistency, verification evidence, configuration management, and engineering rigor are critical. 

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with Model-Based Design and the MathWorks toolchain, strong software development skills, and an understanding of production engineering processes and practices for developing complex or safety-critical systems. 

MathWorks nurtures growth, appreciates inclusivity, encourages initiative, values teamwork, shares success, and rewards excellence. 

Responsibilities

- Design and develop reusable software components, process automation, tools, and frameworks that enable engineering teams to implement consistent and scalable development processes. 
 - Develop extensible and maintainable software architectures that provide standardized operational capabilities while allowing configuration and extension for different engineering organizations, programs, and development environments. 
 - Apply software engineering best practices including modular architecture, source control, automated testing, continuous integration, documentation, release management, and maintainability to ensure production-quality solutions. 
 - Integrate the MathWorks toolchain with engineering infrastructure, including source control, CI/CD systems, requirements systems, test environments, build pipelines, and other development tools. 
 - Identify repeatable engineering patterns and practices and translate them into reusable workflow capabilities rather than one-off solutions. 
 - Collaborate across MathWorks development, consulting, and application engineering teams to incorporate relevant product capabilities, engineering practices, and field experience into the deployment solution. 
 - Contribute to the evolution of the offering, including architecture, requirements, feature development, examples, documentation, testing, deployment approaches, and technical roadmap. 

Minimum Qualifications

- A bachelor's degree and 6 years of professional work experience (or a master's degree and 3 years of professional work experience, or a PhD degree, or equivalent experience) is required. 

Additional Qualifications

- Strong Experience with Simulink and Model-Based Design. 
 - Strong MATLAB scripting and programming experience. 
 - Software development in C or C++ for real-time and embedded applications. 

In addition, experience in the following areas would be advantageous: 

- Development of software tools for engineering and/or scientific applications. 
 - Software certification processes and standards such as ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, DO 178C, etc.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
The salary range for this role is $5, 000 - $9, 500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle{{{{~}}}}

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation{{{{~}}}}

For this senior development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5, 000 - $9, 500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience. 

Working Hours{{{{~}}}}

This role operates on a fixed schedule of 6{{{{~}}}}00 AM to 2{{{{~}}}}00 PM EST. While the position is based in India, the team operates primarily in the United States, supporting Sezzle's operations across the U. S. and Canada. Candidates must be available to consistently work during these EST hours. 

About the Role{{{{~}}}}

We are seeking a talented and motivated best-in-class Senior Site Reliability Engineer. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. 

As a Senior SRE with Sezzle, you will have a high degree of autonomy and authority to identify and resolve problems you see in our infrastructure, deployments, operational workload, and overall systems. 

You should consider yourself a DOer to be a good fit for this role. We expect you to bring a deep well of experience to play, and with AI tooling, you should be a force for scaling in the organization. 

What you'll do{{{{~}}}}

- Architect, upgrade, design, and build scalable infrastructure solutions leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, RDS (MySQL/Postgres), and modern distributed patterns. 
 - Help drive the infrastructure team's roadmap, leading us to higher levels of reliability, recoverability, and scalability. 
 - Drive capacity planning, benchmarking, and work with the team to stress test our systems, find bottlenecks, and prepare for further growth in the business. 
 - Define, maintain and enforce SLAs and alerts across our infrastructure. 
 - Lead the teams towards stronger signal anomaly detection, better, more flexible alerting. 
 - Help Lead Sezzle's AI enablement efforts, identifying opportunities to apply AI and automation to enhance infrastructure reliability, developer productivity, and internal tooling. 
 - Build in consistency and scalability across a distributed microservices architecture while maintaining performance and reliability. 
 - Establish and evolve engineering best practices for observability, security, and CI/CD across teams. 
 - Mentor engineers and champion a culture of learning, innovation, and operational excellence. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally to translate business goals into technical roadmaps and deliver results that matter. 

What We Look For{{{{~}}}}

- 6+ years of professional software engineering or infrastructure engineering experience, including significant SRE and backend experience. 
 - Deployed significant changes to a production application or infrastructure configuration in the past 30 days. 
 - Strong proficiency in Golang, with experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs. 
 - Expertise with SQL-based RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and experience optimizing schema and queries for performance at scale. 
 - Proficiency in observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic). 
 - Solid understanding of distributed systems design patterns (e. g. , transactional outbox, event-driven architecture and stream processing, queues). 
 - Demonstrated ability to bring new ideas forward, influence decisions, and lead complex technical initiatives. 
 - Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

Preferred Knowledge and Skills{{{{~}}}}

- Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, mainly AWS Aurora RDS, both MySQL and Postgres. 
 - Experience with data engineering, data pipelines and data warehousing. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deploying containerized microservices in Kubernetes. 
 - Familiarity with AI developer tooling like Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor and using it to be a more productive engineer. 
 - Track record of shipping commercial APIs and data-driven applications in high-growth environments. 
 - Proven leadership in guiding technical direction, improving system reliability, and scaling high-traffic services. 

About You{{{{~}}}}

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. 
 - You're not bound by convention - your success-and much of the fun-lies in developing new ways to do things
 - You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. 
 - You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. 
 - You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. 
 - You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. 

Sezzle's Technology Stack{{{{~}}}}

- Languages{{{{~}}}} Golang, Typescript, Python
 - Frontend{{{{~}}}} Typescript - React and React Native
 - Backend{{{{~}}}} Golang
 - Database{{{{~}}}} MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
 - DevOps & Cloud{{{{~}}}} AWS, Kubernetes
 - Version Control{{{{~}}}} Git
 - CI/CD{{{{~}}}} Gitlab
 - Testing{{{{~}}}} Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
 - Open Source{{{{~}}}} Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.
