data.description:
Vacancy Location Manager

Location: Lucknow, India

Lead safe, efficient and consistent food production

Tempeh today is looking for an experienced Location Manager to plan, manage and optimize production activities at our food manufacturing facility in Lucknow. 

In this role, you ensure that production runs safely, efficiently and consistently, while meeting quality standards, food-safety regulations and customer requirements. You combine strong operational knowledge with leadership skills to manage production teams and drive continuous improvement. 

Your role

As Location Manager, you oversee daily production operations, coordinate people and resources, and monitor production performance. You work closely with different departments to achieve production targets, maintain quality standards and improve operational efficiency. 

You play a key role in ensuring smooth production processes, effective teamwork and compliance with food-safety and workplace-safety requirements. 

Your responsibilities

As Location Manager, you: 

- Manage production operations: Plan and supervise daily, weekly and monthly production activities, ensuring production targets, quality standards and delivery schedules are met. 
 - Lead and develop your team: Manage production staff, shift supervisors, operators and contract workers. Allocate manpower, machinery, materials and other resources effectively, while supporting employee training, performance monitoring and development. 
 - Monitor production performance: Track production output, productivity, yield, wastage, downtime and efficiency. Monitor raw-material and packaging-material consumption to minimize waste. 
 - Ensure food safety and compliance: Maintain compliance with GMP, HACCP, food-safety, hygiene and workplace-safety requirements, as well as applicable food-manufacturing laws and company policies. 
 - Maintain operational standards: Oversee cleaning, sanitation, line clearance and changeover procedures. Ensure machines and production areas are operated and maintained according to SOPs. 
 - Coordinate across departments: Work closely with Quality Assurance, Maintenance, Stores, Procurement and Dispatch teams to ensure smooth production operations. 
 - Resolve production challenges: Investigate production issues, deviations, breakdowns and process losses, and implement corrective actions. 
 - Drive continuous improvement: Support new product trials, process improvements and production scale-up, while identifying opportunities to reduce costs and increase productivity. 
 - Maintain documentation and reporting: Keep accurate production records, batch documentation, SOPs and required reports. Prepare regular production reports and communicate operational performance to senior management. 

Who we are looking for

You are an experienced production professional with strong leadership skills and a hands-on approach to managing food manufacturing operations. You understand the importance of quality, safety and efficiency, and know how to translate production plans into daily operations. 

You Bring

- A Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Food Technology, Food Science, Production, Mechanical Engineering or a related field. 
 - Typically 10 years of experience in food manufacturing, including relevant supervisory or management experience. 
 - Strong knowledge of food production processes and manufacturing operations. 
 - Working knowledge of GMP, HACCP, food safety, hygiene and quality systems. 
 - Experience in production planning, manpower management and KPI monitoring. 
 - Good problem-solving, leadership, communication and organizational skills. 

What We Offer

- The opportunity to build a new B2B food category in India
 - A key role in developing and optimizing our production operations in India
 - An entrepreneurial and international working environment
 - Close collaboration with production, R&D, quality and supply chain
 - A competitive salary package
 - Room for initiative, ownership and professional growth

What success looks like

Your focus is on maintaining reliable production operations while continuously improving performance. Key areas include: 

- Achieving production targets and delivery schedules. 
 - Maintaining consistent product quality and food-safety standards. 
 - Improving productivity, yield and operational efficiency. 
 - Reducing wastage, downtime and process losses. 
 - Developing production teams and maintaining effective operational coordination. 

About Tempeh Today

Tempeh today produces tempeh in India and works with food companies to develop nutritious, plant-based products for Indian and international markets. We combine expertise in tempeh with local partnerships to support scalable food solutions. 

Interested?

Do you want to lead food production operations and contribute to the growth of Tempeh today in India? Send your CV and motivation to hello@tempeh. today.

data.title: Principal Engineer - Design Verification
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

We are seeking a diligent SoC/MCU Verification engineer to join our team at Renesas. The Verification engineer will be responsible for performing various verification tasks including Test Plan creation, Testcase creation, Coverage closure, Requirements traceability and Gate Level Simulation. They will also review system requirements and track quality assurance metrics. Ultimately, the role of the Verification Engineer is to ensure that our products, applications, and systems work correctly, safely & securely. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Drive Verification R&D team driving technical execution and best in class methodologies used in the design of advanced microcontrollers and microprocessors. 
 - Work closely with system architects to understand high level specifications to be able to verify them. 
 - Work with various EDA vendors to deploy next generation tools 
 - Build strong collaboration with other R&D teams such as RTL, DFT, digital IP, PD, Design Enablement, Emulation, and Validation to achieve project milestones 
 - Promote continuous improvement to design techniques to ensure 'Zero Defect' chips 
 - Collaborate with SME's and key leaders in architecture, systems, emulation, SoC design, software, physical design, and IP teams developing key technical networks to influence overall design improvements and verification methodologies 
 - Responsible for developing detailed Technical SoC verification execution plans, progress reports and tracking milestones, managing technical risks, and providing mitigations to meet schedule quality and costs commitments. Communicate across technical teas as well as provide executive level presentations 
 - Complete ownership for SoC verification quality sign-offs ensuring all deliverables for team hand-offs. 
 - Drive best in class verification methodologies collaborating with global internal and external SME's and developing adoption and compliance processes. Including, driving key innovation strategies which significantly impact efficiency and quality for overall R&D and ROI

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in electronics engineering. 
 - 14+ years of experience in SoC Verification domains and have working knowledge of industry standard EDA toolkits. 
 - Experience in Microcontroller and Microprocessor architecture & Interconnect
 - Experience in protocols like AHB/AXI, Memory (ROM, RAM, Flash, MRAM) and memory controllers. 
 - Advanced knowledge of Verilog, System Verilog, C/C++, Shell. 
 - Good knowledge in scripting like Perl, TCL or Python is a plus 
 - Proven experience in testbench design and development using UVM methodology for IP/Subsystem and SOC. 
 - High proficiency in Metric Driven Verification concepts, functional and code coverage. 
 - Expertise in directed and constrained random methodologies. 
 - Good knowledge of formal verification methodologies and assertions. 
 - Experience with debugging of designs pre- and post-silicon, in simulation and on the bench. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skill. 
 - Must have worked on complex, multi-core SoC's with extensive interconnects and a large range of peripherals. 
 - Fair domain knowledge of clocking, system modes, power management, debug, security and other architectures is a must. Preferred/Plus Qualifications

- Exposure to formal verification and hybrid formal‐simulation flows
 - Experience with low‐power verification
 - Familiarity with Medium‐speed or communication IPs, such as: 
 - CANXL, CANFD, LINFLEX, UART, FLEXRAY
 - Interconnect fabrics
 - Security, debug, or safety‐critical IPs
 - Experience delivering reusable, production‐quality VIPs used across multiple SoCs

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. Lead substantial engineering work within a X3 squad, delivering maintainable modern capabilities while protecting X3 behaviour, upgradeability and operational continuity.

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.

- Strong software engineering experience delivering cloud-native SaaS platforms and distributed systems using modern programming languages such as Rust, TypeScript/Node. js, Go, Python, Java, or C#, with a track record of building secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready services. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, including service decomposition, synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns, event-driven architectures, resiliency engineering, fault tolerance, scalability, observability, eventual consistency, and failure-recovery strategies. 
 - Deep experience designing, developing, and evolving API-first platforms, including REST, GraphQL, event-driven integrations, service contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, security controls, and integration governance. 
 - Experience designing and operating solutions using relational databases and document databases, including data modeling, performance optimization, scalability, reliability, migration strategies, and operational support. 
 - Strong cloud-native engineering experience across containers, orchestration platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, telemetry, secure software supply chains, reliability engineering, release management, upgrade strategies, disaster recovery, and rollback mechanisms.

 - Experience defining domain boundaries, service ownership models, integration contracts, extensibility frameworks, and modernization patterns that improve maintainability, scalability, and customer continuity. 
 - Strong understanding of modern web application architecture, including React, TypeScript, component-based design, state management, accessibility, responsive design, browser performance optimization, and browser-to-service integration patterns where relevant to the domain.

Modern Platform Skills for this Role

- Own service and API contracts, event-driven integrations, and domain boundaries within the assigned area, ensuring scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, and backward compatibility. 
 - Design and operate distributed services using modern SaaS engineering principles, including observability, performance management, fault isolation, resiliency patterns, capacity planning, and reliability engineering.

Preferred Skills

- Experience modernizing legacy business applications, ERP platforms, batch-processing systems, data migration solutions, reporting platforms, or other enterprise software environments. Legacy X3 technologies and 4GL experience are beneficial but not required. 
 - Experience building modern web applications using React, Next. js, TypeScript, design systems, micro-frontends, accessibility frameworks, and advanced user experience patterns. 
 - Experience with event-driven systems, messaging platforms, distributed data architectures, performance engineering, platform engineering, and production operations at SaaS scale. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted software development practices, including code generation, automated testing, code review workflows, security validation, traceability, and regression management. 
 - Experience operating global-scale SaaS platforms with strong reliability, observability, security, compliance, and operational governance requirements. 

Senior Software Engineer Hiring Signal

- Senior Software Engineers are expected to design, build, and operate distributed SaaS platforms, own domain-level architecture decisions, drive modernization initiatives, mentor engineers, and deliver reliable cloud-native services using technologies such as Rust, TypeScript, Go, Python, Java, or C#, while leveraging X3 domain knowledge to accelerate transformation rather than as a prerequisite for hiring. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 6+ years of software engineering experience delivering commercial products. Degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, engineering or a related field. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- Substantial slices reach production predictably with tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback plans. 
 - Technical debt and coupling are reduced in the owned area without breaking supported customer behaviour. 
 - Code reviews, estimates and incident learning improve squad flow and engineering quality. 
 - Less experienced engineers deliver safely with useful coaching and examples. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Collaborates with Product, Principal/Staff Engineers, Software and Automation Engineers, Architects, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services and domain specialists in Europe/North America. Owns outcomes from India with deliberate overlap for design and production conversations. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Takes ownership, raises risks early, gives kind and precise feedback, and keeps learning visible. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Break outcomes into sound designs, vertical slices and estimates; deliver production-quality code across services, APIs, UI or data paths. 
 - Make day-to-day technical decisions on component boundaries, GraphQL contracts, PostgreSQL access, observability, test strategy and safe rollout. 
 - Analyse legacy dependencies and contribute to retain, wrap, translate, rebuild or retire decisions with evidence. 
 - Review code and designs, support incident resolution and improve the squad's automation, documentation and delivery flow. 
 - Pair with and mentor Software Engineers while learning from Principal Engineers and Architects. 

Decision ownership: 

Implementation design and sequencing inside the squad, technical risk escalation, test and observability approach, and readiness of owned work for review and release. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerization and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

data.title: Test Lead
data.description:
Job Description: SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)

Experience: 5 to 10 years (relevant experience of at least 5 to 7 years)

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to design, build and scale automation frameworks across UI, API, data and performance testing. The ideal candidate combines strong coding skills with deep testing expertise and is comfortable working with modern automation tools, AI assisted testing solutions and cloud based environments. 

Must Have Skills

Languages and Frameworks

Java, JavaScript, Python, Selenium, Playwright, TestNG, Pytest, BDD/Hybrid Frameworks

- Core Languages: Proficient in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or Python for building automation solutions
 - Test Frameworks: Hands on experience with frameworks such as TestNG, PyTest, BDD framework or Hybrid framework, with the ability to build, scale and maintain automation frameworks end to end
 - Tools: At least one open source tool such as Selenium or Playwright, with Playwright being preferred
 - Coding Expertise: Excellent hands on coding expertise

Testing Expertise

UI, API, ETL, Data Pipelines, Microservices

- UI Testing: Well versed with UI/Web testing using BDD frameworks such as Cucumber/SpecFlow and tools such as MABL
 - API Testing: Knowledge of REST APIs along with tools such as Postman, Insomnia or Mocha, with automation using RestAssured
 - Data Validation: Experienced with ETL workflows and data pipeline validation, ensuring accuracy and integrity across complex data flows and transformations

Test Management and Strategy

Test Management, Test Strategy

- Testing Strategies: Well versed with all STLC phases and best test practices, including functional and non-functional tests
 - Test Management Tools: Hands on working knowledge of tools such as Jira, ALM and TestRail
 - Project Methodology: Working knowledge of project methodologies such as Agile, Kanban, etc. 

AI Driven Testing

AI Assisted Tools, AI Solutions

- AI Testing: Experience with testing AI powered solutions
 - Agentic AI: Experience with agentic based solutions such as MCP, RAG and prompting, including testing and developing similar solutions
 - Expert using GitHub Copilot and Claude Code. 

Cloud, Infrastructure and CI/CD

AWS, SQL, CI/CD Integration

- Cloud Exposure: Working knowledge of AWS/Azure services relevant to test environments
 - SQL Proficiency: Uses SQL to query, validate and debug data with confidence
 - Databases: Knowledge of relational and non-relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and DynamoDB
 - CI/CD Integration: Integrates test suites into pipelines such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions and GitLab CI

Good to Have Skills

Domain Knowledge, Debugging and Distributed Systems

No Code Tools, Domain Knowledge, Root Cause Analysis, Log Analysis, Performance Testing

- Distributed Debugging: Exposure to Power BI, Splunk, Grafana or other monitoring and reporting tools
 - Root Cause Analysis: Strong diagnostic skills for complex, multi system issues, tracing failures across services, logs and data layers
 - Industry Experience: Candidates with a Pharma background would be preferred
 - No Code/Low Code Tools: Knowledge of no code and low code tools such as MABL and Test Complete
 - Performance Testing: Validates system behaviour under load; experience with performance and stress testing tools such as K6, JMeter, etc. 

Experience Requirement: 5 to 10 years, in an SDET role

data.description:
Job Description: 

About Us

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. 

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. 

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. 

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. 

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Global Business Services

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. 

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. 

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services. 

Process Overview*

EIT is a centralized group within Global Risk Management responsible for independent testing of operational processes within the eight lines of business and enterprise control functions at Bank of America to ensure the company is in compliance with domestic and international laws, rules and regulations, and that risk and controls procedures are operating effectively. 

Job Description*

The Sampling & Test Development associate is responsible for designing and supporting high-quality manual and automated testing solutions through effective sampling, data validation, and governance practices. This role collaborates with Test Owners, Front Line Units, data partners, and Test Execution teams to ensure accurate data sourcing, sound sampling methodologies, and test structures that support automation. 

The associate independently acquires and validates data from internal and external sources, documents testing procedures and sampling requirements, and resolves issues related to data procurement, sample design, and test development. The role is accountable for maintaining data integrity, implementing changes to sampling requirements, and ensuring accurate tracking of testing activities within the System of Record (SOR). 

Responsibilities*

- Partner with Test Owners, Front Line Units, data providers, and Test Execution teams to develop and enhance manual and automated testing approaches. 
 - Gather, validate, and document data requirements, ensuring accurate sample populations and alignment with test objectives. 
 - Incorporate appropriate sampling methodologies and governance requirements into test plans and execution strategies. 
 - Evaluate and coordinate pilot testing activities, providing recommendations to improve test effectiveness and quality. 
 - Design, maintain, and update sampling procedures, test scripts, and support documentation. 
 - Drive test structures and methodologies that enable automation and scalable testing solutions. 
 - Participate across the testing lifecycle, including intake, planning, execution, reporting, and issue remediation, providing subject matter expertise and guidance. 
 - Analyze, manipulate, and summarize large data sets to support testing activities and deliver high-quality results. 
 - Identify and resolve data sourcing, sampling, and test design issues while maintaining data integrity and compliance standards. 
 - Maintain accurate test status, milestones, and deliverables within the System of Record (SOR). 
 - Lead initiatives focused on process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency. 
 - Escalate and drive resolution of areas requiring process refinement, policy updates, or procedural enhancements. 
 - Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships to support effective test execution and risk management objectives. 

Requirements: 

Education details: 

Graduates or Post-Graduates in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Statistics. Tech/B. E. /B. Sc. (Statistics)/B. C. A. /M. C. A/M. Sc. (Statistics)

Experience Range: 6-8 yrs

Certifications (if Any): 

- CRCM, CAMS, FRM, CRISC, CISA
 - SQL, SAS, Python
 - PCEP / PCAP Python Certification
 - Microsoft Power BI Certification
 - Alteryx Designer Certification
 - PMP, Agile, or Scrum Certifications
 - DB2, Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server
 - Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word
 - JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint
 - Enterprise Data Warehouse

Foundational skills*

- Extensive experience in Audit, Testing, Quality Assurance, Risk, and Compliance functions, with Compliance or Risk-related certifications considered an advantage. 
 - Strong expertise in sampling methodologies, test design, test execution, and quality assurance frameworks, with the ability to translate business objectives into comprehensive testing requirements. 
 - Advanced technical proficiency in SQL, SAS, Python, Alteryx, Tableau, Cognos, MicroStrategy, Power BI, and other business intelligence and analytics platforms. 
 - Hands-on experience sourcing, validating, and analyzing data from diverse environments including DB2, Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server, Hadoop, Hive, and enterprise data warehouses. 
 - Strong understanding of data warehousing, data mining, data acquisition, and automation concepts, with a proven ability to identify and implement efficiency improvements through automation. 
 - Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, including data analytics, Pivot Tables, Power Query, Lookups, dashboards, and reporting solutions. 
 - Demonstrated project management capabilities with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities, meet service level agreements (SLAs), and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Exceptional analytical, critical-thinking, research, and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently solve complex business and technical challenges. 
 - Strong business acumen and extensive functional knowledge, coupled with the ability to assess risk, evaluate control effectiveness, and drive operational excellence. 
 - Excellent verbal, written, and business communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders and effectively engage with senior leadership. 
 - Proven ability to build strong partnerships, collaborate across multiple lines of business, and influence stakeholders to achieve strategic objectives. 
 - Self-motivated, adaptable, and highly organized professional capable of working independently with minimal supervision while maintaining a strong team-oriented mindset. 
 - Strong attention to detail, issue management, time management, quality focus, and commitment to continuous improvement. 
 - Demonstrates courage, accountability, and sound judgment while navigating complex business, regulatory, and operational environments. 

Work Timings: 12: 30 to 21: 30

Job Location: GIFT City / Mumbai

Job Description: 

About Us

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. 

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. 

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. 

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. 

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Global Business Services

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. 

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. 

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services. 

Process Overview*

Retail Credit Operations (RCO)

Supports clients and investors with vehicle or home loans -from the time a loan closes to the time it's paid off. Functions include home loan servicing, mortgage default activities through liquidation and servicing for specialty products like vehicle loans, Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) and Balance Assist. Functions include: Mortgage Servicing Administration, Mortgage Payments & Accounting, Mortgage Solutions, Default Operations & Specialized Oversight, Post Sale & Default Services, Centralized Mortgage Portfolio Services, Specialty Product Servicing. 

The team performs the reviews on data validation & recorded calls for FLU partners transparency into adherence with current policies, procedures to ensure alignment with applicable laws, rules, and regulations. It conducts reviews on control areas covering multiple Mortgage & Vehicle Servicing Operations functions. In-line and postproduction at both the associate and process level. Standardized & approved checklists to ensure consistency. Results are available to Quality Assurance and Front-Line Unit (FLU) Partners on the completion near real time and are retained in a centralized reporting site. 

Job Description*

This role is part of Enterprise Independent Testing (EIT) - Retail Credit Operations (RCO) Testing. EIT is a control function that performs independent testing to ensure robust governance and appropriate oversight process is in place. It assesses that controls are effective, complete, and appropriate through our risk management process - Identify, Measure, Monitor and Control. Testing is performed on controls set in various stage of product life cycle for Home Loans, Mortgage and Vehicle Servicing Operations, Financial Center Operations, and others, to determine the effectiveness, applicability, completeness, accuracy and timeliness for various activity performed by RCO teams.

data.title: Software Automation Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Create and maintain dependable automated checks that protect X3 customer behaviour and give X3 squads fast feedback on every change, release and migration asset. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Professional experience in software testing or automation and a willingness to write production-quality code. 
 - Working knowledge of one automation language and tools for API, UI or service testing. 
 - Foundational understanding of enterprise business workflows (ERP or similar), Agile delivery, CI/CD and source control. 
 - Basic SQL/data validation and REST/SOAP integration testing, with interest in batch and migration workflows. 
 - Interest in GraphQL, PostgreSQL/data paths, Web/Syracuse, observability and cloud operations. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes. 
 - Good English communication, attention to detail and a habit of recording evidence. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Build automated API, event, integration and regression checks into CI/CD; validate compatibility and migration reconciliation, keep failures diagnosable, and learn the team's secure artifact, telemetry and rollback practices. 

Preferred Skills

- TypeScript/JavaScript, Playwright/Cypress, API contract testing or SQL Server/Oracle. 
 - Sage X3, ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance testing experience, including L4G/4GL or Crystal Reports. 
 - Performance, accessibility, security or migration testing exposure. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 2+ years in software testing, quality engineering or development, with practical automation experience. Degree, diploma or equivalent experience in computing or engineering is desirable. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- Stories have relevant automated checks and clear, reproducible evidence. 
 - Regression suites remain reliable and useful as components, APIs and customisations change. 
 - Defects are found earlier, described precisely and linked to customer impact. 
 - The engineer steadily expands domain knowledge and contributes to safer release and migration practice. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Software Engineers, Senior Automation Engineers, Product, Cloud Support/L3, Security and Customer Services in a distributed squad, with India-based execution connected to Europe/North America overlap. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Is curious, precise, open to feedback and willing to learn the domain behind the test. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid - 3 days a week in office)

About Us

Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building a finance, accounting, payroll and expense management** solution****s** that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending. 

Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed. 

We're investing heavily in AI - building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time. 

The Impact You'll Make

- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution. 
 - Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking). 
 - Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context. 
 - Build evaluation frameworks - both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) - so we can measure whether agents are improving. 
 - Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals. 
 - Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform. 
 - Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring. 
 - Work with engineers and stakeholders to identify high-value workflows, ship quickly, and iterate on real usage data. 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production. 

Technical Skills

- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code. 
 - Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling. 
 - Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e. g. , MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day. 

Leadership & Ownership

- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams. 

Mindset & Collaboration

- Growth mindset - curious, always learning, and open to feedback. 
 - Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes. 
 - Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted. 
 - Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling. 
 - Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching. 
 - Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure. 

What to Expect

- We value humility and collaboration - we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. 
 - We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code - including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Develop automated UI, API, GraphQL, integration and regression tests from clear risks and acceptance criteria. 
 - Maintain test data, environments, diagnostics and documentation so failures can be reproduced and fixed efficiently. 
 - Contribute tests to CI/CD quality gates and help identify flaky, missing or redundant coverage. 
 - Learn X3 processes, metadata and customisation patterns so automation reflects real customer outcomes. 
 - Participate in defect analysis, release verification, upgrade checks and rollback rehearsals. 

Decision ownership: 

Test implementation for assigned stories, defect evidence, coverage recommendations and escalation of quality or environment risks. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

data.title: Sr. Product Test Specialist
data.description:
Job Summary

Serve as a senior product test specialist in a hybrid work model applying deep expertise in Selenium Core Java and cards and payment systems to validate complex transaction processing platforms. Design and execute robust automated test solutions that improve product quality reduce defects in production and ensure compliant secure and reliable payment experiences for customers worldwide. 

Responsibilities

- Design and implement comprehensive automated test suites using Selenium and Core Java to validate complex cards and payment features across multiple applications and interfaces. 
 - Develop detailed test strategies and plans that cover functional regression integration and end to end testing for transaction processing and settlement workflows in the payment ecosystem. 
 - Create reusable test frameworks and utilities that standardize automation practices improve maintainability and accelerate test execution for card authorization and clearing processes. 
 - Analyze detailed business and technical requirements for cards and payment products and translate them into clear test scenarios and data conditions that reflect real world customer usage. 
 - Execute automated and targeted manual tests on day shifts in a hybrid work environment while coordinating closely with onshore and offshore colleagues to align on priorities and timelines. 
 - Identify document and track defects with precise technical details and collaborate with developers and product teams to drive timely resolution and prevent recurrence. 
 - Validate transaction processing on the TPH platform by executing structured test cycles that confirm data integrity reconciliation accuracy and adherence to regulatory and compliance guidelines. 
 - Monitor and optimize test execution results by reviewing logs analyzing failures and fine tuning scripts to increase stability accuracy and coverage of critical card payment journeys. 
 - Collaborate with product owners business analysts and architects to clarify requirements refine acceptance criteria and ensure that test coverage aligns with customer expectations and service level objectives. 
 - Support production readiness assessments by providing clear test evidence coverage metrics and risk based recommendations that help stakeholders make informed release decisions. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement by evaluating new automation tools proposing enhancements to current frameworks and sharing best practices that strengthen the quality culture across teams. 
 - Mentor junior testers by reviewing their test cases suggesting improvements in automation design and guiding them on effective techniques for cards and payment testing. 
 - Ensure strict adherence to company quality standards and security practices while focusing on reliable payment experiences that build customer trust and support safe digital commerce at scale. 

Qualifications

- Apply extensive experience of eight to twelve years in testing complex enterprise applications to design robust test approaches suited to high volume payment scenarios. 
 - Demonstrate strong hands on proficiency in Selenium for web based test automation including building modular scripts managing test data and integrating with execution pipelines. 
 - Use solid Core Java skills to develop automation frameworks custom utilities and reusable components that enable efficient validation of card transactions and payment flows. 
 - Bring proven exposure to cards and payment processing including concepts such as authorization clearing settlement interchange and dispute handling to design realistic test cases. 
 - Utilize practical experience with TPH or similar transaction processing hubs to validate message flows posting logic and reconciliation between upstream and downstream systems. 
 - Communicate effectively with cross functional stakeholders through clear defect reports concise status updates and well structured test documentation suited to hybrid collaboration. 
 - Adapt quickly to evolving product features regulatory changes and security requirements in the payments domain while maintaining a strong focus on risk based testing and customer impact. 
 - Prefer prior experience in additional cards and payments platforms or schemes as a nice to have background that broadens perspective on global payment standards and industry practices.

Job Description

The Opportunity

- Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare. 
 - Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. 
 - Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats. 

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys' IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy. 

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers. 

Role Overview

The Principal Architect, Network Observability & AI will join the Data Insights and Visualization team to contribute to the intersection of business intelligence (BI), telemetry visualization, and modern artificial intelligence. This role will contribute to the development of generative, conversational, and agentic AI capabilities into our existing telemetry platforms and new initiatives. By exploiting the advanced features of our commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) tools alongside custom, home-grown solutions, you will transform raw network data into immediate, actionable insights for our business and operational value teams. 

What Will You Do In This Role

- Architect unified dashboard platforms that convert complex telemetry into simplified, AI-driven visual scores for leadership and operational teams. 
 - Design, build and deliver end-to-end telemetry analytics and interactive dashboards that combine network flow, metrics, logs, traces, and business context to reduce time-to-insight and time-to-resolution. 
 - Design, build and deliver high-throughput telemetry pipelines that correlate multi-vendor syslog, SNMP, streaming telemetry, and VPC flow logs into cohesive telemetry lakes. 
 - Develop agentic AI agents and AIOps components that continuously analyze streaming telemetry to detect anomalies, and surface proactive recommendations to stakeholders. 
 - Embed AI-driven insights into visualizations and web applications so executives, product leaders, SREs and network engineers receive role-appropriate, actionable views. 
 - Build reusable visualization components, templates, and libraries to support routers, switches, firewalls, wireless, SD‐WAN, and core application observability. 
 - Contribute to telemetry data quality improvement, and performance measurement initiatives for critical network components. 
 - Provide technical mentoring and project leadership to local peers. 

Primary Skills (must-have)

- Strong communicator who can translate technical analysis into clear, concise presentations for peers, managers, and executives. 
 - Strategic architectural mindset with deep technical expertise in multi-source correlation, and a proven track record of mentoring engineering teams on pipeline construction. 
 - Collaborative team player able to coordinate cross-functional work and deliver on time. 

Primary Skills (must-have)

- Exposure to large global network infrastructures (routers, switches, LAN, SD‐WAN, firewalls, wireless). 
 - 6+ years leading network monitoring, network telemetry, or network observability project using tools such as LogicMonitor, Thousand Eyes, Big Panda, Dynatrace, NetBrain, Grafana Cloud, Zscaler ZDX, or similar. 
 - Subject expertise and experience working as primary contributor on projects with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks, or building conversational interfaces (chatbots) that translate user intent into structured queries (SQL, API calls, or platform-specific query languages). 
 - 6+ years architecting enterprise-scale network monitoring or observability architectures, integrating network telemetry platforms with IT Service Management (ServiceNow API) and incident correlation engines. 
 - 6+ years building observability and data normalization across complex telemetry types (logs, metrics, traces, flows) and proactive alerting/AIOps integration. 
 - 8+ years developing complex multi-source data pipelines using data engineering tools such as Dataiku, Databricks. 
 - Proven experience building actionable dashboards and role-based views for executives, product owners, and engineers. 
 - Experience embedding visualizations in web applications and building reusable visualization components. 
 - Proficiency with one or more general-purpose programming languages and web frameworks JavaScript (React/Vue), Python (Django/Flask), Java, or similar. 
 - 4-year college degree majoring in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Business Intelligence, or similar. 

Secondary Skills (nice To Have)

- Engineer or specialist level developer certifications (AWS, Python, SQL) or equivalent hands-on experience. 
 - Familiarity integrating agents with ITSM/incident platforms (ServiceNow or similar) and network automation tools (Ansible, or similar). 

Who We Are

We are known as Merck & Co. , Inc. , Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing , bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world. 

What We Look For

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us-and start making your impact today.

About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www. gf. com. 

Summary Of Role

Leads the global Hardware Engineering organization for GlobalFoundries' MIPS Custom Silicon business, responsible for delivery of custom MCUs, MPUs and Sensor SoCs. Owns all front‐end and back‐end hardware engineering functions, including RTL Development, Design Verification, DFT, and Physical Design, and is accountable for execution quality, predictability, and scalability across multiple customer programs and platforms. 

Acts as a senior technical and execution leader, partnering with Product, Software, Program Management, Manufacturing, and Customer organizations to deliver high‐quality silicon from architecture through production ramp. 

Essential Responsibilities

- Lead and scale the global hardware engineering organization covering RTL, DV, DFT, and Physical Design for custom silicon programs. 
 - Own hardware execution strategy for MIPS‐based MCUs and radar SoCs, ensuring predictable delivery across multiple concurrent customer engagements. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering standards, design methodologies, quality metrics, and best practices across all hardware disciplines. 
 - Partner with Product Management and Systems Architecture to translate customer and platform requirements into executable hardware roadmaps. 
 - Drive cross‐functional alignment with Software, Program Management, Manufacturing, Test, and Quality teams to ensure end‐to‐end silicon readiness. 
 - Ensure designs meet automotive‐grade quality, safety, performance, power, and cost targets. 
 - Build, develop, and retain senior technical leaders; ensure strong succession and capability depth across regions. 

Core Competencies

- Executive leadership of large, global hardware engineering organizations
 - Deep expertise in SoC development flows (RTL → DV → DFT → Physical Design)
 - Delivery of automotive and safety‐critical silicon
 - Engineering execution excellence and predictability at scale
 - Strong cross‐functional and customer‐facing leadership

Other Responsibilities

- Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering (Master's or PhD preferred). 
 - 20+ years of semiconductor industry experience with significant leadership responsibility in SoC hardware engineering. 
 - Proven record of delivering complex custom silicon products into production. 
 - Experience leading multi‐site, globally distributed engineering teams. 

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard. 

As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities. 

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

data.title: Associate Director - Design Assurance & Product Management - Independent Design Assurance
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Domain focus: Independent Design Assurance across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains, including Cryptography and AI Security. 

Job Purpose: 

Lead the Design Assurance practice, an eight-role team, as the most senior independent reviewer in Cyber Architecture and Solutions. You own the assurance methodology, review standards and assurance register, and manage reviewer capacity against demand. Accountable for pre-production architecture review, technical consultation and BAU design assurance. 

About the team: 

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles. 

What makes this role different. You lead an eight-person practice that issues binding go/no-go determinations on tools before they reach production - and you assure against architecture standards written elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions, which you do not own and must not rewrite. That separation is what makes the review worth anything, and it will be tested by programmes with committed go-live dates. Coverage spans every Cyber Architecture and Solutions domain including Cryptography and AI Security, so you need enough architecture literacy to arbitrate a finding in a domain you have never personally built in. The practice is subject to internal audit and regulatory inspection, and the assurance register and finding classification are yours to defend. 

Key responsibilities: 

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following: 

- Lead the Design Assurance practice of eight and own its capability plan across every Cyber Architecture and Solutions domain, including Cryptography and PQC and AI Security. 
 - Issue binding go/no-go determinations on tools before production, and own the consequences when a programme with a committed date does not get the answer it wanted. 
 - Approve the assurance methodology, review standards and the Critical, High, Medium and Low classification scheme, and defend both under audit. 
 - Verify against architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions and write none of them, because that separation is what makes the assurance opinion worth anything. 
 - Manage reviewer capacity and tiering so high-risk designs get full review and low-risk change moves through pattern-based self-attestation with sampling. 
 - Assure vendor-delivered designs to exactly the same standard as internally delivered ones, including configuration handed over under the managed service model. 
 - Own pre-production architecture review, technical consultation and BAU design assurance across the estate. 
 - Feed recurring findings back to the architecture domains as standards gaps rather than reviewing the same defect repeatedly. 
 - Own assurance throughput, turnaround, first-time-pass and defect escape metrics, and defend them under challenge. 
 - Lead the practice's response to internal audit and regulatory inspection, including the evidence that reviews operated rather than merely existed. 
 - Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- 15+ years in cyber security, including leading technical or specialist teams - domain focus: independent Design Assurance across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains, including Cryptography and AI Security
 - Leading an independent design assurance practice - methodology, review standards and assurance register - issuing binding go/no-go decisions on tools pre-production and in BAU
 - Protecting independence from architecture under programme pressure - verifying against standards owned elsewhere, never writing them, and assuring vendor-delivered designs to the same standard as internal ones
 - Sponsoring automation of review intake, evidence capture, drift checks and reporting, managing reviewer capacity against demand and feeding recurring findings back as standards gaps
 - Assuring AI-enabled tools and agentic solutions against AI security standards, and using AI to accelerate review and evidence captureAssuring AI-enabled tools and agentic solutions against AI security standards, including the evidence standard an AI-assisted review must still meet

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Architecture literacy to challenge senior architects' designs without owning the standards
 - Evidencing assurance to internal audit and regulators, including GxP documentation standards - using automated evidence capture and reporting
 - Developing and leading a team of senior reviewers and analysts
 - Executive stakeholder influence - holding a contested finding with senior leaders
 - Experience defending an assurance opinion to an audit committee or a regulator when the first line disagreed with it. 
 - Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Typical tools and technologies: Design assurance methodology, review standards and assurance register, finding classification and assessment scoring, architecture review tooling, SABSA or TOGAF reference models, ServiceNow workflow, Power BI for assurance metrics, GxP-compliant documentation and evidence management. 

#AGTech

Skills

AI Agent Security, AI for Cybersecurity, Application Security, Central Authentication Service (CAS), Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Cryptography, Data Security, Design Assurance, Identity Access Management (IAM), Independent Decision-Making, Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, ML Security, Operating Systems Security, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Vulnerability Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. Qualifications

- Strong AWS and team management and leadership skills, with a track record of building, coaching and scaling high-performing engineering teams
 - Proven engineering management experience, including setting technical direction, defining standards and delivering complex platforms and products

 - Hands-on software development experience, ideally building distributed systems, APIs and agentic or AI-driven platforms on AWS
 - Deep expertise with AWS services (e. g. Lambda, ECS/EKS, Bedrock, SageMaker, RDS/NoSQL, IAM, networking, security) and infrastructure as code (e. g. CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform)

data.title: Servicenow Tester
data.description:
Position Description

Role: ServiceNow Tester

Exp: 6-12yr

Location: Hyderabad

Role Description: 

Assures release quality before go live. One generic profile covers all six towers - ITOM is the only squad where a specific literacy add on is genuinely useful, not a full named specialism. Ensure the quality and reliability of ServiceNow solutions by performing functional, integration, regression, and UAT testing, validating configurations and customizations against business requirements. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design test plans and test cases against acceptance criteria
 - Author and maintain ServiceNow ATF automation
 - Coordinate regression testing and UAT
 - Triage and manage defects through to resolution
 - Maintain test evidence for audit and acceptance sign off
 - Feed quality risks and patterns back into squad retrospectives
 - Design and execute test cases, test scripts, and test plans for ServiceNow applications. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, and UAT testing. 
 - Validate ServiceNow configurations, workflows, integrations, and enhancements. 
 - Log, track, and retest defects in collaboration with development teams. 
 - Support test automation using ServiceNow ATF. 
 - Prepare test results, defect reports, and quality metrics. 

Must Have Skills & Experience

- 3+ years of software testing experience with 2+ years in ServiceNow testing. 
 - Experience testing ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, or GRC. 
 - Hands on experience with ServiceNow ATF, defect management, and test methodologies. 
 - Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and tools such as JIRA or Azure DevOps. 
 - Strong analytical, problem solving, and communication skills. 

Desired \Good to have Skills: 

- Basic infrastructure/network literacy - useful to sanity-check ITOM Discovery and Service Mapping results, not just UI-level ATF flows
 - Experience testing AI-assisted or agentic workflows, including exception and failure-path scenarios

Preferred Certifications: ServiceNow CSA, CIS, ISTQB

Your future duties and responsibilities

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Together, as owners, let's turn meaningful insights into action.

Your work creates value. You'll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise. 

You'll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You'll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

Come join our team-one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

data.title: Java Product Architect
data.description:
Denodo is a leader in data management. The award-winning Denodo Platform is the leading data integration, management, and delivery platform using a logical approach to enable self- service BI, data science, hybrid/multi-cloud data integration, and enterprise data services. Realizing more than 400% ROI and millions of dollars in benefits, Denodo's large enterprise and mid-market customers across 30+ industries have received payback in less than 6 months. For more information, visit www. denodo. com . 

We are a fast-growing, international organization with teams across four continents and we work with a cutting-edge technology, but that's not all we have to offer. At Denodo, we are like a family and it is of the utmost importance to us that we help support your professional growth every step of the way

Job Description

We are looking for engineers for our Technology team, to work as Java Product Architect. 

In this role, you will be part of the department in charge of developing the Denodo Platform. You will join one of the teams that develop and maintain some of the Denodo Platform modules and its associated tooling and extensions, with the possibility of moving to another team in the future based on your interests and skills, and even being able to become a team leader. As part of the product development, you could work in many different areas, such as connectors to integrate sources, execution engine, query optimization, cache engine, monitoring and resource management, management of the environments where the servers and tools of the platform are installed, automatic deployments (including cloud environments), task scheduling and parallel execution, self-service data discovery, client tools, etc. 

The technologies and external tools with which you will work or interact are also very diverse. For example, different types of databases (relational, multidimensional, parallel, document-oriented, etc. ), Big Data sources, SaaS sources, Web Services, message queues, technologies related to authentication and authorization (Identity Providers, SAML, OAuth, Kerberos, Vaults, etc. ), cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), web technologies (both backend and frontend), indexing and search engines (Lucene, Elasticsearch), business intelligence tools, workflow management tools, version control systems, and many others. 

Good remuneration in line with the candidate's experience and knowledge, plus variable remuneration. 

Job Responsibilities & Duties

- Initially, you will receive training on the Denodo Platform at the user level to understand the product that Denodo develops. 
 - You will also receive training on the development process used in Denodo and the tools involved in it (Redmine, Git, Jenkins, Sonar, automated test frameworks, etc. ). 
 - After the initial training, you will join a team in charge of developing and maintaining one of the modules of the Denodo Platform and its ecosystem. You will receive training specific to the development of that module. 
 - Your main task will be the development of new features and the maintenance of existing ones. An important part of our development process is the design and implementation of automated tests. 
 - Creation and maintenance of the product documentation. 

Desired Skills & Experience

We need people meeting the following requirements: 

- BS or higher degree in Computer Science. 
 - At least 10+ years of experience in Software Development. 
 - Experience leading technical teams; or strong experience in designing and developing complex features affecting the architecture of software products. 
 - Programming experience with Java SE and Java/Jakarta EE. 
 - Knowledge of Design Patterns. 
 - Knowledge and experience in development Lifecycle and Version Control (pref. Maven and git). 
 - Knowledge of SQL and relational database design. 
 - Good written communication skills in English. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Team worker with a positive attitude. 

We value knowledge and/or experience in the following (these are not required): 

- Experience in Agile software development Methodologies. 
 - Experience developing in distributed application environments.
