data.title: Sr Principal SoC DFT Engineer
data.description:
About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www. gf. com

Introduction

GlobalFoundries is seeking a Senior Principal SoC Design-for-Test Engineer to serve as a senior technical authority for complex custom SoC designs. The successful candidate will define DFT strategy and architecture, solve critical problems of exceptional complexity, drive scalable innovation across programs, and influence cross-functional technical direction from concept through high-volume manufacturing. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define DFT strategy, architecture, methodology, and signoff criteria for complex SoCs and multiple interdependent technical areas. 
 - Lead high-impact DFT initiatives spanning planning, risk management, execution, manufacturing readiness, silicon quality, and test cost. 
 - Architect scalable solutions for scan and ATPG, compression, memory test and repair, logic BIST, test access, boundary scan, IJTAG, and mixed-signal test. 
 - Establish readiness and signoff frameworks, close critical risks, and provide evidence-based recommendations to engineering and program leadership. 
 - Solve critical DFT problems of exceptional complexity and establish reusable approaches across products and teams. 
 - Lead cross-functional resolution of issues involving architecture, RTL, DV, PD, firmware, product engineering, manufacturing test, and post-silicon teams. 
 - Drive DFT innovation, automation, and technical tradeoffs while mentoring senior engineers and influencing customers, partners, and senior stakeholders. 

Other Responsibilities

- Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs

Required Qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 10+ years of relevant experience; or bachelor's degree with 15+ years of relevant experience. 
 - Exceptional mastery of SoC DFT and demonstrated recognition as a senior technical authority across programs or technical areas. 
 - Expert-level experience with scan and ATPG, compression, memory test and repair, test clocking and access, boundary scan, and hierarchical DFT. 
 - Experience defining DFT implementation, verification, readiness, and signoff criteria across IP, subsystem, partition, and SoC levels. 
 - Experience across the silicon lifecycle, including architecture, RTL integration, physical implementation, pattern generation, tapeout, silicon bring-up, and high-volume manufacturing. 
 - Deep understanding of fault models, test coverage, diagnosis, outgoing quality, test time, manufacturing risk, and test cost. 
 - Experience with major DFT EDA toolchains (prefer SNPS) and automation using Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, or equivalent languages. 
 - Demonstrated ability to solve exceptionally complex problems, lead across organizational boundaries, influence senior stakeholders, and communicate technical and business tradeoffs. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with advanced DFT methodologies such as hierarchical ATPG, streaming scan, logic BIST, scan diagnosis, cell-aware test, or lifecycle test. 
 - Experience with memory repair, NVM test, eFuse, IEEE 1149. 1 boundary scan, IEEE 1687 IJTAG. 
 - Experience with low-power, tester-correlation, silicon-debug, and high-reliability DFT requirements. 
 - Track record of developing reusable DFT architectures, automation, reference flows, and signoff methodologies across multiple SoC programs.

Position Overview: We are seeking a forward-thinking Cyber Defense Monitoring (CDM) Level 3 to help lead our transition toward an AI-driven, agentic Security Operations Center (SOC). Unlike a traditional analyst role, this position requires an engineering mindset. In addition to daily SOC operations, you will actively look for opportunities to improve processes, assist in writing and maintaining automation scripts, and support the development of automated playbooks. This role is a stepping stone for bridging core cyber defense operations with modern automation and engineering practices. 

You will act as the senior escalation point for complex threats while dedicating significant time to engineering autonomous workflows, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into investigation pipelines, and applying data science principles to threat detection. 

Automation, AI & Agentic SOC Engineering

- Build the Agentic SOC: Design, train, and deploy AI-driven autonomous agents capable of performing tier-1 and tier-2 triage, context gathering, and initial containment without human intervention. 
 - SOAR & Playbook Engineering: Architect and write complex automation playbooks utilizing Python, REST APIs, and modern SOAR platforms to streamline incident response lifecycles. 
 - Data Science & Machine Learning: Apply data analytics and ML models to massive security datasets to identify anomalous behaviors, reduce false positive rates, and improve the fidelity of SIEM alerts. 
 - Detection as Code (DaC): Implement software engineering best practices (CI/CD pipelines, version control, automated testing) for the deployment and management of security rules and detection logic. 
 - Continuous Optimization: Proactively identify bottlenecks in current SOC workflows and engineer programmatic solutions to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR). 

Cyber Defense Operations

- Advanced Escalation & Response: Serve as the final technical escalation point (Level 3) for the more complex and severe security events, directing the triage of advanced persistent threats (APTs). 
 - Threat Hunting & Intel: Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts across the enterprise and integrate actionable threat intelligence into automated defense mechanisms. 
 - Security Stack Oversight: Oversee the health, tuning, and strategic direction of core monitoring tools (SIEM, EDR, NDR), ensuring they generate high-quality data for our automation engines. 

Qualifications & Skills

- Advanced proficiency in scripting and programming languages (e. g. , Python, Go, or PowerShell) with a strong understanding of interacting with RESTful APIs and JSON/XML data structures. 
 - Experience working with LLMs, prompt engineering, AI orchestration frameworks (like LangChain), and foundational data science tools (Pandas, Jupyter, SQL). 
 - 5+ years of progressive experience in a SOC or Incident Response environment, with deep knowledge of network protocols, operating system internals (Windows/Linux), and adversary tactics (MITRE ATT&CK). 
 - Hands-on experience architecting workflows in leading SOAR platforms (e. g. , Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Torq, or Tines). 
 - BA/BS in Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Security (non-tech degrees acceptable with appropriate levels of Information Security job experience and/or certifications)
 - A blend of security and engineering certifications such as GCIA, GCFA, AWS Certified Security / Machine Learning, or relevant SANS automation courses (e. g. , SEC573, SEC540).

data.title: Director - AI Engineering
data.description:
Voyager (94001), India, Bangalore, Karnātaka

Director - AI Engineering

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent along with our deep experience in machine learning, position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. 

Team Description: 

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our Generative AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products by composing powerful, safe and explainable AI capabilities such as agentic workflows, and shared services such as guardrails, observability and evals coupled with foundational model power of open-weight and proprietary frontier models. The team is also delivering capabilities on top of the platform to optimize the software development life-cycle to dramatically enhance developer productivity and model-development life cycle to improve time-to-market of machine learning models. 

In this role, you will: 

- Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. 
 - Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. 
 - Make high judgment build-vs-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, Nemo Guardrails, PyTorch and more. 
 - Invent and introduce state-of-the-art LLM optimization techniques to improve the performance. scalability, cost, latency, throughput of large scale production AI systems. 
 - Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. 
 - Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state-of-the-art in AI. 

The Ideal Candidate: 

- You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good. 
 - Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production. 
 - You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands-on when necessary and lead by example. 
 - You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven. 
 - You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enable you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss. 
 - You are a resilient trail blazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics or Engineering
 - At least 3 years of people leadership experience
 - At least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
 - At least 6 years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms including AWS, Google Cloud or Azure

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Master's or Doctoral Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or related field
 - 5+ years of experience managing and leading an engineering team
 - 8+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms including AWS, Google Cloud or Azure
 - 8+ years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, such as LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails and Memory. 
 - Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to peers

data.title: Technical Team Leader – Electrical Commissioning (CxA)-Datacenter
data.description:
FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full-service integrated technology consultancy and professional services to the built environment. 

We partner with clients to improve asset performance, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios. 

Job Description

We are seeking an Electrical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to spearhead the commissioning delivery team for hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects. 

This role will provide strategic technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0-L6, with particular emphasis on L3 Energization, L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST). 

Key Responsibilities

- Spearhead and mentor a team of 15-20+ commissioning leads and engineers, fostering technical excellence and professional development. 

- Establish and own the electrical commissioning strategy, planning, execution and technical governance framework. 

- Champion L3/L4/L5 commissioning delivery, including energization, FPT, IST and failure-mode testing protocols. 

- Provide comprehensive technical oversight across HV/MV/LV systems, substations, transformers, switchgear, generators, UPS, batteries, ATS/STS, busway, PDU/PMDC and EPMS/SCADA infrastructure. 

- Review and validate SLDs, protection schemes, coordination studies, load-flow/short-circuit/arc-flash studies, SOO and commissioning test scripts for technical accuracy and compliance. 

- Lead and oversee FAT/SAT, primary and secondary injection testing, protection verification, load-bank testing and integrated systems testing activities. 

- Validate seamless electrical integration with BMS, EPMS, mechanical and fire/life-safety systems to ensure operational coherence. 

- Drive resolution of commissioning issues through rigorous RCA, maintain risk registers, manage punch lists and ensure technical close-out compliance. 

- Serve as the senior technical interface with hyperscale clients, CxA teams, consultants, contractors, OEMs and utilities, ensuring clear communication and stakeholder alignment. 

- Champion electrical safety culture, LOTO protocols, energization and switching procedures throughout the commissioning lifecycle. 

Requirements

- 15+ years overall electrical engineering/commissioning experience. 

- 8+ years data-center or mission-critical electrical commissioning experience. 

- Proven leadership of at least 3-4 complete L3/L4/L5 commissioning cycles. 

- Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs in hyperscale projects. 

- Experience managing 15-20+ engineers/technicians. 

- Strong hands-on knowledge of HV/MV/LV, protection, generators, UPS, EPMS/SCADA and integrated testing. 

- Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, TIA-942, IEC, IEEE, NETA, NFPA 70/70E/110 and applicable local codes. 

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent. 

- Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills

Qualifications

Preferred Certifications

NETA III/IV | CxA/CBCP | CDCP/CDCS | Uptime Institute ATD or equivalent

Ideal background: Hyperscale/colocation data centers, substations, power generation, semiconductor, pharmaceutical/life sciences, or other mission-critical facilities. 

Location: New Mumbai

- Values Balance and Inclusion: We celebrate diversity, foster collaboration, and ensure every voice is heard-while maintaining a strong commitment to work-life balance.

data.title: Sr Offensive Security Engineer
data.description:
What You'll Do

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Offensive Security Engineer to join our Threat Management & Security Operations organization. In this hands-on role, you will think and operate like an adversary - continuously finding, exploiting, and helping remediate real-world weaknesses across First Advantage's products, cloud infrastructure, networks, and people. You will design and execute penetration tests, red and purple team engagements, and adversary emulation exercises that validate our detection and response capabilities and measurably reduce enterprise risk at-scale. 

This role partners closely with Security Operations, Threat Intelligence & Hunt, Vulnerability Management, Application Security, DevOps, and Product teams to turn offensive findings into prioritized, business-aligned remediation. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building custom tooling, chaining exploits across complex environments, and communicating impact clearly to both technical teams and executive leadership. 

Responsibilities

- Penetration Testing: Plan, scope, and execute internal and external penetration tests across web and mobile applications, APIs, cloud (AWS/Azure), networks, and infrastructure using real-world attacker techniques. 
 - Red & Purple Teaming: Design and run adversary emulation and red team engagements that combine multiple attack paths to accomplish objective-based goals, and partner with the SOC, Threat Intel & Hunt, and Detection Engineering on purple team exercises to validate and improve detection coverage. 
 - Exploit Development & Chaining: Identify, validate, and safely exploit vulnerabilities - including chaining lower-severity issues into high-impact attack paths - and demonstrate tangible business impact in production-representative environments. 
 - Adversary Emulation: Model real-world threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework to test and strengthen organizational resilience, detection, and response. 
 - Findings & Remediation: Review and validate findings for accuracy, prioritize real-world exploitability and business risk, create remediation tickets, and partner with engineering teams to drive fixes and coordinate retests within policy SLAs. 
 - Tooling & Automation: Build and maintain custom scripts, tooling, and automation to scale offensive testing, and help operationalize continuous/autonomous testing platforms across the environment. 
 - Reporting & Communication: Produce clear, decision-ready reports and executive summaries that translate technical findings into risk and business impact for technical stakeholders, GRC/Audit, and executive leadership. 
 - Incident Response Support: Support incident response and threat hunting efforts by providing offensive expertise, attack-path context, and adversary insight. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the maturity of the offensive security program - developing repeatable methodologies, playbooks, and metrics that demonstrate progress over time. 

What You Will Need To Be Successful

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in offensive security, penetration testing, red teaming, or a closely related security engineering role. 
 - Demonstrated expertise across multiple domains: web/mobile application, API, network, infrastructure, and cloud (AWS and/or Azure) penetration testing. 
 - Strong understanding of exploitation and post-exploitation techniques, attack-path chaining, and objective-based adversary emulation. 
 - Proficiency with industry-standard offensive tooling such as Burp Suite Professional, Nmap, Metasploit, and Kali Linux, along with vulnerability scanners. 
 - Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (e. g. , Python, Go, PowerShell, Ruby, or Bash) to build custom tools and automation. 
 - Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and hands-on experience mapping engagements to adversary TTPs. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings to both technical audiences and executive leadership. 

What You May Need To Be Successful

- Advanced offensive certifications (e. g. , OSEP, OSCE3, CRTO, GXPN) and a track record of original security research, CVEs, or responsible disclosures. 
 - Experience with cloud-native attack techniques and container/Kubernetes (EKS/AKS) and serverless security testing. 
 - Experience operating or evaluating continuous/autonomous pen testing and breach-and-attack-simulation platforms. 
 - Familiarity with detection engineering, SIEM/EDR platforms, and building purple team feedback loops into SOC content. 
 - Knowledge of compliance and security frameworks relevant to our environment. 
 - Experience mentoring junior engineers and helping mature an offensive security program. 

Why Join Us at First Advantage?

At First Advantage, team members are united around a noble purpose: helping organizations to safeguard their workplaces and manage risk. The company's culture is shaped by its core values - Authenticity, Curiosity, Integrity, Teamwork, Customer-Inspired - empowering team members to bring their best ideas forward, collaborate across departments, and make a real impact. 

First Advantage offers a variety of culture programs and benefits designed to enhance employee experience and development.

We have great people here and are looking for more. Come join us!

We will never ask you to make a payment, purchase equipment, transfer money, or provide financial account information to obtain employment. data.description:
Job Overview

Arm is seeking a visionary and technical leader for a Staff Structural Test Verification/Simulation Engineer role in Bangalore. In this high-visibility position with 10+ years of experience, you will spearhead structural test, design-for-test (DFT), and test verification methodologies across advanced, world-class Arm products. You will act as a technical authority, ensuring flawless manufacturing test quality, high silicon yield, and robust fault coverage. 

Key Responsibilities

- DFT Verification Leadership: Define and drive the comprehensive pre-silicon verification and simulation strategy for advanced logic and memory test architectures. 
 - Logic Diagnostics & ATPG: Drive the simulation of ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) patterns and logic diagnostics flows to guarantee fault coverage and defect detection. 
 - Memory Diagnostics & MBIST: Drive the simulation of MBIST (Memory Built-In Self-Test) controllers, memory repair algorithms, and memory diagnostics architectures. 
 - Tool & Standard Integration: Utilize industry-standard test methodologies and EDA tools (ICL, PDL, Tessent, and TetraMAX) to validate DFT insertions, boundary scan, and scan compression logic. 
 - Silicon Validation & Yield Debug: Bridge pre-silicon simulation with post-silicon testing, collaborating closely with manufacturing and test engineering teams on silicon validation and yield debug to root-cause failures and optimize test efficiency. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Experience: 10+ years of extensive experience in design-for-test (DFT), structural test verification, or test engineering for complex ASICs/SoCs. 
 - Core DFT Skills: 
 - Expert-level understanding of Logic Diagnostics and ATPG pattern verification/simulation. 
 - Deep expertise in Memory Diagnostics and MBIST pattern verification/simulation. 
 - Ecosystem & Tool Proficiency: Hands-on mastery of industry-standard DFT languages and tools, including ICL (Instrument Connection Language), PDL (Procedure Description Language), Siemens Tessent, and Synopsys TetraMAX. 
 - Post-Silicon Execution: Demonstrated track record in silicon validation, ATE pattern bring-up, and yield debug for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. 
 - Methodologies & Coding: Strong background in hardware verification languages (SystemVerilog/UVM) and scripting automation (Python, Perl, or Tcl). Preferred Skills & Leadership

- Exceptional technical leadership, mentoring skills, and ability to drive cross-functional engineering execution across global sites. 
 - Deep knowledge of advanced process nodes (sub-7nm/5nm/3nm) and low-power DFT challenges.

The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0-L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST). 

This position is site-centric and requires hands-on leadership through Integrated Systems Testing, including failure mode and fault tolerance validation, ensuring systems meet design intent, availability objectives and operational readiness requirements in line with Uptime Institute, IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of 15-20+ leads and commissioning engineers. 

- Own mechanical commissioning strategy, planning, execution and technical governance. 

- Lead L4/L5 commissioning, including FPT, IST, failure-mode and concurrent-maintainability testing.

- Lead commissioning of HSD/fuel systems, including bulk/day tanks, transfer systems, filtration, leak detection and generator auto-fuelling interfaces.

- Manage commissioning issues, RCA, risk registers, punch lists and technical close-out. 

- Act as senior technical interface with hyperscale clients, CxA teams, MEP contractors, consultants and OEMs.

Requirements

- Proven leadership of at least 2 complete L2 to L5 commissioning cycles. 

- Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs of hyperscale datacenter projects. 

- Experience managing 15-20+ Cx engineers. 

- Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, chilled-water systems, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, BMS/controls, fuel systems, fire protection and utilities.

- Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA and applicable local codes/standards.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Own the hardest engineering outcomes in X3 and turn architecture direction into working, supportable product capabilities. Set the technical bar across squads while remaining close enough to the code, evidence and customer impact to make sound decisions. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Expert understanding of distributed systems architecture, including domain-driven design, service decomposition, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, scalability, resiliency engineering, fault tolerance, consistency models, disaster recovery, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Extensive experience defining and governing API-first and event-driven platforms, including REST, GraphQL, messaging architectures, service contracts, versioning strategies, backward compatibility, integration governance, and ecosystem extensibility. 
 - Strong engineering and architecture expertise across relational databases and document databases, including platform-scale data modeling, performance optimization, reliability, replication, migration strategies, data lifecycle management, and operational resilience. 
 - Deep experience leading cloud-native engineering initiatives encompassing containers, orchestration platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, platform engineering, secure software supply chains, observability, reliability engineering, security architecture, upgrade strategies, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes. 
 - Demonstrated success leading complex modernization initiatives, balancing legacy constraints, customer continuity, platform evolution, technical debt reduction, and long-term architectural sustainability. 
 - Proven ability to evaluate and govern AI-assisted engineering practices, ensuring appropriate human review, traceability, security controls, testing strategies, and operational safeguards. 
 - Exceptional communication and influence skills, with the ability to align engineers, architects, product leaders, operational teams, and executives around complex technical decisions, risks, investments, and trade-offs. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Shape platform capabilities as strategic products that enable engineering velocity, operational excellence, ecosystem extensibility, and long-term scalability across multiple squads and domains. 
 - Define and govern service boundaries, domain ownership models, API contracts, event architectures, distributed systems patterns, and platform standards that remain sustainable as the organization scales. 
 - Establish organization-wide engineering expectations for secure software delivery, supply-chain security, identity and access management, secrets management, policy enforcement, infrastructure automation, observability, reliability, and operational readiness. 
 - Drive adoption of OpenTelemetry-compatible observability, reliability engineering practices, SLOs, performance management, capacity planning, resilience testing, incident learning, and recovery strategies across engineering teams. 
 - Provide technical leadership for platform engineering capabilities, including containers, orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, developer experience improvements, automation, self-service engineering capabilities, and FinOps optimization where appropriate. 
 - Define and govern compatibility, upgrade, migration, deprecation, recovery, and rollback strategies that protect customer continuity, partner investments, operational stability, and long-term platform evolution. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and technical leaders, establish engineering standards, review architectural direction, and influence cross-functional technical decision-making across the portfolio. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience modernizing large-scale ERP, enterprise business applications, batch-processing platforms, reporting platforms, or complex legacy systems. Legacy X3 technologies and 4GL experience are valuable context but are not required. 
 - Deep understanding of ERP, manufacturing, distribution, finance, supply-chain, commerce, or operational workflow domains, including platform modernization, migration, reconciliation, and business continuity. 
 - Experience leading platform engineering, SaaS infrastructure, cloud platform transformations, developer-experience initiatives, or internal platform product development. 
 - Experience designing extensible ecosystems, marketplace architectures, partner enablement platforms, metadata-driven platforms, migration factories, or highly configurable enterprise applications. 
 - Experience delivering regulated, highly available, enterprise-scale SaaS platforms with strong requirements for reliability, security, compliance, privacy, auditability, and operational governance. 
 - Experience influencing engineering organizations through architecture governance, technical strategy, technology roadmap definition, engineering excellence programs, and senior technical mentorship. 

Experience And Qualifications

- Typically 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant ownership of architecture, platform strategy, distributed systems design, and cross-team technical leadership for large-scale cloud-native products. 
 - Demonstrated success leading major modernization, transformation, platform, or SaaS initiatives that span multiple teams, business domains, and technology stacks. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Recognized as a trusted technical leader capable of balancing customer outcomes, business priorities, engineering quality, operational excellence, and long-term architectural sustainability. 

Provide your feedback on BizChat

Expected outcomes / success measures

- A small number of agreed architecture decisions and transition states guide delivery without blocking squads. 
 - Modern components and contracts reduce coupling, runtime dependency and support effort while preserving customer behaviour. 
 - Critical releases and migration waves have repeatable quality, observability and rollback evidence. 
 - Engineers make more decisions locally because standards, examples and mentoring are clear. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Architects, Product Management, Engineering Managers, Principal and Senior Engineers, Automation, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services, partners and Europe/North America domain experts. India delivery is a first-class ownership centre with planned Europe/North America overlap and clear hand-offs across time zones. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Acts as a calm technical role model, makes uncertainty visible, develops talent and chooses the simplest safe path that improves customer and business outcomes. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Own cross-squad technical strategy for a significant modernisation outcome, from current-state discovery through a viable transition state and measurable exit criteria. 
 - Make and record decisions on domain boundaries, GraphQL contracts, componentisation, data-path simplification and legacy-runtime reduction. 
 - Lead difficult implementation, incident, performance and migration problems; decide when to retain, wrap, translate, rebuild or retire a capability. 
 - Set engineering standards for secure coding, testing, observability, deployment, upgrades and rollback, and ensure they are adopted rather than merely documented. 
 - Coach senior and developing engineers, grow technical leadership in India and across the distributed squad network, and challenge designs constructively. 

Decision ownership: 

Technical direction within the assigned portfolio, cross-squad trade-offs, exception escalation, transition-state design and acceptance of engineering evidence. Escalates product, legal, security or commercial policy decisions with a clear recommendation. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerization and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

data.title: Staff Engineer, Cloud Platform
data.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description. 

About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. 

  

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. 

About the Role

We're hiring a Staff Engineer to join JumpCloud's Cloud Platform organization, with a focus on observability and FinOps. 

You'll own the questions that matter most as we scale toward 99. 99% availability: can we see what's happening across the platform, how fast do we recover when something breaks, can we survive a regional outage, and are we spending enough to run it all? This is a hands-on staff role. You'll set the technical direction for observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and cloud cost, write the code and AI-driven automation that make it real, and work closely with engineering, customer support, finance, and leadership. 

What You'll Be Doing
Observability

- 
Set the technical direction for observability across JumpCloud's cloud platform: metrics, logs, traces, and events, on AWS and GCP. 

- 
Build and run our observability stack (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), including standard instrumentation libraries and collectors that teams adopt by default. 

- 
Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with service owners, and build the dashboards and burn-rate alerts that hold us to a 99. 99% SLA. 

- 
Cut alert noise. Make sure every page is actionable, routed to the right owner, and backed by a runbook. 

- 
Shorten detection and recovery times (MTTD and MTTR) by improving tracing, correlation, and incident tooling. 

- 
Manage observability cost itself: cardinality, log volume, sampling, and retention, so visibility grows without the bill growing with it. 

FinOps

- 
Own cloud cost visibility: tagging standards, cost allocation by team and service, and showback reports that engineers actually read. 

- 
Find and deliver savings through right-sizing, autoscaling, spot capacity, storage tiering, idle-resource cleanup, and data-transfer reduction. 

- 
Shape our commitment strategy (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, committed-use discounts) with finance, based on real usage data. 

- 
Build automation and guardrails, such as budget alerts, anomaly detection, and policy-as-code checks, that catch waste before it ships. 

- 
Define unit economics, like cost per customer or per device, and make cost a normal input to design reviews. 

- 
Partner with finance on forecasting and budgeting, and explain cloud spend clearly to leadership. 

Incident Management and AI-Driven Automation

- 
Own the incident management process end to end: severity levels, on-call rotations, escalation paths, communication, and the tooling behind them. 

- 
Lead major incidents as incident commander or senior escalation point, and keep customers and leadership informed. 

- 
Run root cause analysis (RCA) for significant incidents, and drive the follow-up actions to completion so issues don't repeat. 

- 
Build AI agents that correlate alerts, logs, traces, and recent changes to find the likely root cause automatically. 

- 
Build self-healing automation and AI agents that detect and fix known issues before they escalate or reach customers, with safe guardrails and human approval where it matters. 

- 
Measure and improve incident health over time: MTTD, MTTR, repeat incidents, and on-call load. 

Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery

- 
Own JumpCloud's business continuity (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) strategy for the cloud platform. 

- 
Define RTO and RPO targets with product and leadership, and design the architecture to meet them. 

- 
Design and build the DR site and recovery environment across AWS and GCP, including data replication, backups, failover, and failback. 

- 
Plan and run regular DR tests and failover drills, document the results, and close the gaps they reveal. 

- 
Keep DR runbooks, recovery automation, and BCP plans current, and support audit and customer requests for evidence. 

Across Everything

- 
Write production-quality Go or Python for tooling, exporters, data pipelines, and automation. 

- 
Work closely with customer support teams: turn support tickets and escalations into monitoring, alerts, and fixes, and give support the visibility they need to answer customers quickly. 

- 
Partner with product engineering teams on reliability, recoverability, and cost-aware design. 

- 
Write design docs, review architecture across engineering, and mentor engineers on observability and cost-aware design. 

We're Looking For

- 
10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years in platform, SRE, or infrastructure roles running 24/7 SaaS systems at scale. 

- 
Observability depth: You've designed and run observability at scale with Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry. You know how to instrument services, set meaningful SLOs, and build alerts people trust. 

- 
FinOps track record: You've cut cloud spend in a measurable way, and you can show the numbers. You're comfortable with AWS Cost Explorer, CUR, Kubecost, or similar tools, and with commitment planning. 

- 
Strong coding skills: You've built production tooling and automation in Go or Python, not just dashboards and scripts. 

- 
AWS, GCP, and Terraform: strong hands-on production experience with both AWS and GCP, and with Terraform for infrastructure as code. Production Kubernetes experience is expected. 

- 
Incident management: You've owned on-call and incident processes, led major incidents, and run RCAs that led to lasting fixes. 

- 
AI and automation: You've built automation for incident response or remediation, and you have hands-on experience building AI agents or LLM-based tools for root cause analysis or auto-remediation. 

- 
BCP and DR: You've designed and tested disaster recovery for production SaaS systems, including RTO and RPO targets, DR sites, replication, and failover drills. 

- 
Engineering and customer focus: You have a software engineering background and have worked closely with customer support teams to resolve issues and reduce customer impact. 

- 
Staff-level influence: You've driven change across multiple teams without direct authority, and you can get engineers to care about both reliability and cost. 

- 
Clear communication with engineers, finance, and leadership. You can turn usage and cost data into a simple story and a clear decision. 

- 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. 

- 
A strong team player who lives our core values: building connections, thinking big, and getting 1% better every day. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 
FinOps Certified Practitioner, or hands-on experience applying the FinOps Framework. 

- 
Experience with cost tools such as CloudHealth, Vantage, Cloudability, or AWS Compute Optimizer. 

- 
Experience building cost and usage data pipelines (AWS CUR, BigQuery billing export, Athena) and reporting on top of them. 

- 
Experience running observability in-house at scale (Prometheus/Thanos/Mimir, Loki, Tempo) and weighing that against SaaS vendors. 

- 
Experience with eBPF-based monitoring, continuous profiling, or real user monitoring. 

- 
Experience negotiating or managing vendor contracts for observability or cloud spend. 

- 
Open-source contributions, published writing, or conference talks on observability or FinOps. 

Where you'll be working/Location: 

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. 

  

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.   

  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed. 

  

Language: 

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.   Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. 

  

Why JumpCloud?   

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You'll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We're out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You'll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.     

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to "Build Connections. " To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed. " - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.   Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.     

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

  

Scam Notice: 

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. 

  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud. com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud. com with the subject line "Scam Notice"  

  

#BI-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https: //jumpcloud. com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

data.title: Lead Technical Onboarding Engineer
data.description:
About Neo4j

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world's largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. 

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. 

Our Vision

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. 

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we're disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. 

About The Job

You will play a critical, hands-on role in guiding enterprise customers through the foundational stages of their deployment journey. As a player-coach and technical anchor for a focused four-person onboarding team, you will split your time between directly delivering complex customer onboardings and serving as the day-to-day technical escalation point and mentor for three fellow engineers. 

Sitting at the intersection of technical architecture and customer delivery, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production-ready ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, steering customers through critical infrastructure milestones-including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration. 

For fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self-managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deploy secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud architectures. 

Responsibilities

Hands-on Technical Onboarding (~70-80%)

- Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to define success criteria, milestones, architecture patterns, and risk mitigation strategies. 
 - Guide the provisioning of Neo4j AuraDB environments and self-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures using PrivateLink, Private Endpoints, and peering. 
 - Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption-at-rest protocols, and enforce least-privileged access through enterprise SSO (OIDC/SAML) and RBAC configurations. 
 - Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise customer development teams on Neo4j driver optimisation, connection pooling, and retry logic. 
 - Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools (logs and metrics) and deliver best-practice guidance on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning. 
 - Produce high-quality technical deliverables-including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and runbooks-to ensure smooth operational handoffs. 

Technical Mentorship & Team Escalation (~20-30%)

- Serve as the senior technical point of escalation for the onboarding team, unblocking colleagues on complex customer architectures and troubleshooting edge-case issues. 
 - Pair with and mentor team members through design reviews, architecture discussions, and customer engagements to continuously elevate collective technical execution. 
 - Help balance day-to-day account coverage across the team to maintain consistent onboarding velocity and delivery quality. 
 - Synthesise field insights, lessons learned, and reusable blueprints to iterate and optimise our core onboarding methodologies, tooling, and onboarding automation. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e. g. , Onboarding Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Platform Engineering, or Technical Consulting), with informal or formal experience acting as a technical lead, mentor, or escalation point. 
 - Proven track record of operating in a hands-on "player-coach" capacity-comfortable rolling up your sleeves on implementation while guiding peers. 
 - Hands-on experience architecting and deploying production workloads in at least one major cloud ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Deep technical proficiency in core enterprise networking (VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints). 
 - Demonstrated experience configuring Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, alongside configuration management tools (e. g. , Ansible). 
 - Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container services). 
 - Hands-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j) and proficiency in query performance tuning (e. g. , Cypher optimisation). 
 - Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk) and enterprise data integration/ETL/CDC tools. 
 - Exposure to cloud compliance standards (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and multi-region/data residency deployment patterns.

data.title: QA Manager -Systems,Ccompliance & Ccustomer Quality
data.description:
Company Description Tastel Fine Food Pvt. Ltd. is a growing food company focused on delivering high-quality, safe, and compliant products to customers. The organization emphasizes robust systems, strong quality standards, and continuous improvement across its operations. Team members collaborate closely across production, compliance, and customer-facing functions to maintain consistent product excellence. The company values integrity, accountability, and a proactive approach to food safety and regulatory adherence, creating an environment where quality professionals can significantly influence outcomes. 

Q: Are you willing to work on-site in Karad full-time, including shift coverage when needed?

Q: Have you maintained BRCGS, IFS or FSSC 22000 or Any other GFSI and faced certification audits?

Q: Are you a certified Lead Auditor BRC issue 9?

Q: Have you worked with Acidified Hot-Fill sauces category in your previous organizations?  

Q: Are you considered a 'process authority' in any of your previous stints?

Q: Have you worked abroad?

Q: Have you dealt with international customer communications directly?

Q: Have you worked in the export oriented Food Processing space?

QA Manager - Systems, Compliance & Customer Quality

Tastel Fine Food makes ready meals, sauces and meal kits for international retail and food-service customers in Australia, the UK, Europe, the Middle East and the USA. Our Karad plant is certified to global food-safety standards and is audited regularly by customers. 

We are looking for a QA Manager who will own our quality systems, customer complaints, RCA/CAPA and audit readiness. You will make sure no product leaves the plant without a real, documented hold-and-release decision. 

Food safety system and audits

Maintain HACCP and the food-safety system to BRCGS, IFS and FSSC 22000 standards. 

Lead preparation for certification, customer, kosher, halal and regulatory audits; close findings on time with evidence. 

Run internal audits and Gemba walks, and keep a single NC tracker accurate and current, with owners, target dates and verified closure

Be a part of execution & hands on approach to problem solving

Training, team and governance

Train QA, QC and production staff, and measure whether the training works: tests, line audits, defect rates. 

Lead and develop the QA team. Follow company processes for hiring, onboarding, approvals and spending. 

RCA/CAPA

Own every NCR from first response to verified closure. 

Send a preliminary response within 24 hours with a structured RCA plan, the data to be collected, and any questions. 

Lead RCA with proper tools (5-Why, fishbone, 8D) and evidence: test data, photos, batch records, line and shift details. 

Write CAPAs that are specific, measurable and dated, with an owner and a check that they worked. Track complaint trends. 

Pest control, hygiene and vendors

Manage pest control and fumigation contractors: written agreements, approved POs and vendor effectiveness checks. 

Approve and audit suppliers; raise supplier NCRs when the root cause is incoming material. 

Export compliance and suppliers

Manage container inspection, stuffing checks and fumigation (MBR/ALP) to each destination's rules, with ISPM-compliant certificates. 

Approve and audit suppliers of ingredients and flexible packaging based on Export destination compliance standard

Good to have

BRCGS, IFS or FSSC 22000 Lead Auditor certification; a Better Process Control School or thermal-process validation course. 

Experience handling US, UK, EU or Australian supermarket customers. 

Knowledge of export requirements: container fumigation, ETO-free spices, EU pesticide limits, Spices Board and EIC documentation. 

Exposure to kosher or halal certification and allergen validation. 

Must have

B. Tech/M. Sc in Food Technology, Food Science or Microbiology. 

10-14 years in food QA, with 4+ years managing QA for export or international retail customers. 

- Hands-on experience with shelf-stable pouch products (hot-fill/pasteurised or retort), including thermal process records, seal integrity and incubation testing. 
 - A proven record of structured RCA/CAPA (8D, 5-Why, fishbone) that customers accepted. 
 - Experience running positive release, AQL sampling and finished-product inspection. 
 - Experience maintaining BRCGS or IFS and leading the plant through certification and customer audits. 
 - Strong written English for customer communication; working knowledge of Marathi and Hindi. 
 - Organised, with strong Excel/tracker skills; you follow through to closure without reminders. 
 - ERP/ SAP proficiency.

data.title: Software Engineer | GO Programming, Cloud-Native, PPPOE/IPOE, Microservices, DHCPV4/DHCPV6 | 8-14 Years
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Control Plane team builds Cisco's cloud-native Broadband Network Gateway - the carrier-grade subscriber-management brain that runs as microservices on the SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) / Kubernetes platform and interworks with IOS-XR, Silicon One-based User Plane Functions (UPFs). We power some of the world's largest residential and business broadband deployments, serving millions of subscribers with strict availability and scale requirements. We value technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer on the cnBNG Control Plane, you will own the design, delivery, and end-to-end quality of carrier-grade subscriber-management features in a cloud-native architecture. You will build session-handling, CP-UP separation, redundancy, and scale capabilities that keep millions of subscribers online across Silicon One-based UPFs - and own their unit, integration, system, and scale validation with automation-first practices. You will mentor junior engineers and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging. The successful candidate will independently own a significant Control Plane feature area and its unit/integration/system/scale validation and automation, deliver production-quality code and tests, lead sophisticated investigations across CP and Silicon One UPFs, and provide evidence-based release recommendations - while influencing design, mentoring, and using AI-assisted tools responsibly with security and engineering accountability. 

- Design, develop, and maintain cnBNG Control Plane microservices (C/C++/Go) on the SMI/Kubernetes platform, interworking with IOS-XR / Silicon One-based User Plane Functions. 
 - Implement and enhance subscriber-management functionality: PPPoE/IPoE session bring-up, DHCPv4/DHCPv6 (server/proxy/relay), Prefix Delegation, RADIUS/AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, IPAM, subscriber policy, and QoS. 
 - Develop and harden CP-UP separation over the State Control Interface - session programming, state download/replay, and reconciliation between the Control Plane and Silicon One UPFs. 
 - Build features for scale and high availability: cluster upscale, N: M and geo/warm redundancy (SRG), CP-GR switchover, and subscriber-session continuity during CP-UP communication failures. 
 - Own quality end-to-end: write unit tests and component/integration tests; design and execute system, regression, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability tests for your features. 
 - Develop reusable, scalable test automation (Python; pyATS/Genie or equivalent) and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 
 - Build and maintain containerized/virtual/cloud-based test environments (Docker, Kubernetes, SMI) and validate subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, upgrade/rollback, process-restart, and subscriber-churn scenarios. 
 - Optimize control-plane performance, memory, and convergence for millions of subscribers across large UPF fleets. 
 - Develop and maintain gRPC/REST APIs and YANG/OpenConfig models, plus CLI and model-driven telemetry for configuration and operational visibility. 
 - Troubleshoot sophisticated, distributed issues across CP, Silicon One UPFs, and the SMI/Kubernetes stack; drive RCA using logs, traces, core dumps, RADIUS transactions, and telemetry. 
 - Manage code with Git; participate in code reviews; collaborate with Test Engineering on feature, scale, and HA validation. 
 - Work with architects, DE/DT leads, and PLM to deliver features across the release lifecycle (BC/CC, AC/EC, DEVELOPING, FCS). 
 - Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for code generation, unit/automation test creation, static analysis, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation - validating AI-generated output responsibly. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. 
 - Experience in systems/embedded or cloud-native software engineering for networking products. 
 - Strong programming in C/C++ and/or Go on Linux; Python for test automation and scripting. 
 - Experience writing unit, integration, system, and scale/performance tests, and building automation (pyATS/Genie or equivalent) integrated into CI/CD and regression pipelines. 
 - Solid understanding of IP networking and subscriber/broadband protocols: PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, RADIUS/AAA, PPP, L2TP. 
 - Knowledge of Cisco Silicon One (SiOne) NPU-based User Plane Functions (UPFs) - data-plane/forwarding architecture, CP-to-UPF programming, and how subscriber sessions map to NPU forwarding. 
 - Cloud-native fundamentals: Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and service meshes. 
 - Experience building and consuming gRPC/REST APIs and data models (YANG, protobuf). 
 - Distributed-systems concepts: high availability, redundancy, state reconciliation, and scale. 
 - Strong Linux skills; experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - AI-assisted engineering is a must: use of AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with BNG/CUPS, CP-UP separation, SRG geo/warm redundancy, or 5G/BNG converged-core architectures. 
 - Experience with SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) or similar cloud-native telco platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Silicon One platform families (Cisco 8000 / ASR 9000 / NCS) as User Planes. 
 - Scale/performance characterization and traffic/subscriber-simulation tools (IXIA/Spirent). 
 - Databases/caching for network state (SQL/NoSQL, key-value stores, etcd); AAA/policy, IPAM at scale, and QoS. 
 - Telemetry, NETCONF/RESTCONF/gNMI, OpenConfig; Aha/Jira API suites. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

data.title: Senior Software Automation Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Lead automation and quality engineering for a X3 squad, turning customer and migration risks into fast, reliable evidence that supports confident releases. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Strong automation programming in TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Python or comparable languages. 
 - Experience with UI, API, GraphQL, integration, data and end-to-end test design. 
 - Strong SQL/data validation, REST/SOAP integration and batch or migration workflow testing. 
 - CI/CD, containers, test data, observability and defect analysis in a cloud-native environment. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes. 
 - Ability to explain quality risk and evidence in clear English across time zones. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Automate contract and event-integration checks, secure pipeline controls, release/upgrade/rollback evidence, and migration reconciliation. Make failures observable and useful to developers; apply container or orchestration test environments when relevant to the suite. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL, Crystal Reports, SQL Server/Oracle or Web/Syracuse testing. 
 - Working X3 domain knowledge and understanding of metadata, customisation and upgrade risk. 
 - Contract testing, performance testing, accessibility, security or chaos/resilience testing. 
 - Migration comparison tooling, synthetic monitoring or golden customer datasets. 
 - Cloud environments and partner certification. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 6+ years in quality engineering or software automation, with ownership of automation for a substantial product area. Degree or equivalent experience in computing, engineering or a related discipline. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- The squad has a trusted regression signal for the highest-risk customer and migration paths. 
 - Quality gates run consistently in delivery pipelines and failures are diagnosed promptly. 
 - Migration and upgrade evidence supports predictable go/no-go, hypercare exit and rollback decisions. 
 - Manual regression effort and escaped defects reduce without reducing meaningful coverage. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Software Engineers, Senior/Principal Automation Engineers, Product, Architects, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services and migration/partner teams across India, Europe and North America. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Challenges weak evidence respectfully, follows risk to impact and helps the whole squad own quality. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Design and implement maintainable automated tests across UI, API, GraphQL, data, integration, performance and operational journeys. 
 - Own risk-based regression for an X3 domain or platform capability, including legacy-modern equivalence and customisation behaviour. 
 - Integrate tests into CI/CD quality gates and make failures diagnosable, actionable and visible to the squad. 
 - Support migration waves, upgrades and rollback rehearsals with repeatable evidence and clear exit criteria. 
 - Coach Software Automation Engineers and partner with developers early in design and implementation. 

Decision ownership: 

Test design and automation approach for owned scope, risk-based coverage, evidence quality and release recommendations within agreed programme guardrails. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.
