Job Title: Principal Architect - Data & AI (AI-Ready Data)

Location: Bangalore / Mangalore - Hybrid

Type: Full-time

Why MResult?

Founded in 2004, MResult is a global digital solutions partner trusted by leading Fortune 500 companies in industries such as pharma & healthcare, retail, and BFSI. MResult's expertise in data and analytics, data engineering, machine learning, AI, and automation helps companies streamline operations and unlock business value. As part of our team, you will collaborate with top minds in the industry to deliver cutting-edge solutions that solve real-world challenges. 

Website: https: //mresult. com/

LinkedIn: https: //www. linkedin. com/company/mresult/

What We Offer

At MResult, you can leave your mark on projects at the world's most recognized brands, access opportunities to grow and upskill, and do your best work with the flexibility of hybrid work models. Great work is rewarded, and leaders are nurtured from within. 

Our values - Agility, Collaboration, Client Focus, Innovation, and Integrity - are woven into our culture, guiding every decision. 

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Principal Architect - Data & AI to lead the design and implementation of modern, scalable, AI-ready enterprise data platforms, and to be the senior-most builder on the team and a technical partner to the BU lead. 

You will drive the evolution of traditional data platforms into AI-native, intelligent, and autonomous data ecosystems, enabling trusted enterprise data for analytics, Generative AI, and AI agents. You will set technical direction across multiple products and client engagements, define the standards everyone builds against, and stay hands-on with the hard problems. 

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms (AWS and Azure), Data Architecture, Agentic AI, and Data Governance, with strong hands-on experience in Snowflake and Databricks. This includes building intelligent data solutions using Snowflake Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Databricks Mosaic AI, and Agent Bricks, and building LLM/agentic systems from primitives with rigorous evaluation. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Direction & Org-Level Decisions

- Set technical direction across multiple platforms, products, and client engagements: architecture, standards, and the reusable patterns the team builds on. 
 - Make org-level calls: build vs. buy, primitives vs. framework, what becomes a shared internal capability, and what will not go into production without explicit client sign-off. 
 - Lead empirical technical investigations (failure-mode studies, reproducibility, cost/quality trade-offs) and turn them into defensible, client-facing points of view. 2. AI-Ready Data Architecture & Strategy

- Define and implement enterprise AI-ready data architectures across Snowflake, Databricks, and cloud ecosystems (AWS and Azure). 
 - Architect scalable Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, and Data Lake solutions, including multi-store data design across warehouse, streaming, and operational stores. 
 - Establish architectural standards for data quality, metadata management, lineage, governance, security, cost, and observability. 
 - Design semantic layers, business ontologies, and governed data foundations supporting RAG, enterprise knowledge retrieval, and agentic AI applications. 3. Agentic AI for Data Engineering

- Design, develop, and deploy AI agents that automate data engineering activities: ETL/ELT code generation, pipeline development and optimization, automated monitoring, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, failure remediation, schema evolution, and metadata-driven orchestration. 
 - Build multi-agent workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or equivalent frameworks, and from primitives where frameworks add unnecessary abstraction. 
 - Integrate agents with enterprise data platforms, orchestration tools, APIs, and CI/CD pipelines, with human-in-the-loop controls and operational guardrails. 
 - Define evaluation and observability standards for LLM/agentic systems covering reproducibility, calibration, and cost. 4. AI Agents for Data Quality & Governance

- Architect AI-powered data quality and governance agents for automated profiling, quality rule generation, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and remediation recommendations. 
 - Develop intelligent solutions for metadata discovery, data classification, PII identification, lineage analysis, impact assessment, and policy compliance. 
 - Integrate agents with Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon Catalog, Collibra, Microsoft Purview, or equivalent governance platforms. 5. Snowflake Cortex AI & Agent Development

- Build enterprise AI solutions using Snowflake Cortex AI and Cortex Agents, leveraging Cortex Analyst for natural-language analytics, Cortex Search for semantic retrieval, and Cortex AI Functions for intelligent data processing. 
 - Build RAG applications, governed semantic models, and agents that interact with Snowflake pipelines, tasks, stored procedures, and enterprise services. 
 - Implement agent orchestration, security, evaluation, observability, and production deployment best practices. 6. Databricks Lakehouse & AI Agents

- Own data platform architecture on (Azure) Databricks: medallion architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog governance, cluster policy design, pipeline scalability, job orchestration, and Terraform-based infrastructure provisioning. 
 - Design and implement AI agents using Databricks Mosaic AI, Agent Bricks, AI/BI Genie, Vector Search, and MLflow (including MLflow-based model lifecycle management). 
 - Integrate agents with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow pipelines, and Databricks Workflows, with multi-agent orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and scalable production deployment. 7. Technical Leadership & Solution Architecture

- Stay hands-on: write the hard parts, prototype risky ideas, and prove approaches with real code and real measurements before the team commits. 
 - Lead solution design, architecture reviews, proofs of concept, and production implementations for enterprise Data & AI transformation initiatives. 
 - Develop reusable AI accelerators, reference architectures, engineering frameworks, and best practices. 
 - Own security and reproducibility in regulated contexts. 
 - Collaborate with Data Engineering, AI/ML, Platform Engineering, Security, and Governance teams. 
 - Support RFP responses, technical proposals, solution estimations, and customer architecture discussions, and represent technical strategy to senior stakeholders and clients. 
 - Multiply the team: set the engineering bar and mentor architects, Senior SDEs, and SDEs. Required Skills

- Systems Design & Python: Mastery of Python and systems design, with a track record of architecting production systems that others build on. Strong SQL, PySpark, and distributed data processing. 
 - Enterprise Data Platforms: Strong hands-on expertise in Snowflake, Databricks, Data Lakehouse, Data Warehousing, Data Modeling, ETL/ELT, streaming, and multi-store data design. 
 - Databricks: Production experience with (Azure) Databricks architecture: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, cluster policy design, job orchestration, Terraform provisioning, and Databricks AI (Mosaic AI, Agent Bricks, MLflow, AI/BI Genie, Vector Search). 
 - Snowflake AI: Hands-on experience with Snowflake Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, semantic models, and AI-powered data applications. 
 - Agentic & Generative AI: Proven ability to build AI agents, multi-agent systems, RAG applications, LLM tool calling, and agent orchestration, both from primitives and with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and MCP, and to evaluate them rigorously (reproducibility, calibration, cost). 
 - Data Quality & Governance: Experience with data quality frameworks, data observability, metadata management, lineage, cataloging, access controls, and governance platforms such as Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon Catalog, Collibra, and Microsoft Purview. 
 - Cloud & Engineering: Broad and deep cloud architecture across AWS and Azure (GCP a plus), covering distributed systems, security, and cost, along with Git, CI/CD, DevOps, infrastructure as code, and production monitoring. 
 - Architectural Judgment: Strong opinions, loosely held, grounded in first principles: can derive the trade-off rather than cite the trend, with deep skepticism of unnecessary abstraction. 
 - Influence & Communication: Influences without authority; sets standards, writes the specs and docs others follow, and translates technical work into client-facing strategy. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience delivering production-grade AI agents for data engineering, data quality, and governance automation. 
 - Exposure to enterprise semantic layers, knowledge graphs, business ontologies, and AI-ready data foundations. 
 - Experience in regulated industries such as Pharma / Life Sciences, Healthcare, Banking, or Insurance (pharma experience strongly valued). 
 - Supply chain and inventory operations domain depth: demand planning processes, MRP logic, inventory parameters, and how planning decisions translate into data requirements, enough to engage supply chain stakeholders credibly without hand-holding. Certifications

Snowflake, Databricks, or Professional-level cloud architecture certifications (AWS / Azure) are valued, but they are never a substitute for demonstrated depth. 

Expected Outcomes

- Adoption of AI-ready enterprise data architectures and clear technical standards across products and client engagements. 
 - Production-grade AI agents that improve data engineering productivity, automate data quality and governance processes, and enhance platform reliability. 
 - Reusable accelerators and reference architectures on Snowflake and Databricks, enabling secure, scalable, and governed enterprise AI adoption. 
 - A stronger engineering team, with a higher engineering bar and growing Senior SDEs and SDEs. Ideal Candidate Profile

A hands-on Principal Architect combining deep enterprise data and cloud architecture expertise with practical Agentic AI implementation experience. The candidate can architect, build, and deploy AI agents on Snowflake and Databricks, reason from first principles about trade-offs, lead complex Data & AI transformation initiatives, and take intelligent data solutions from proof of concept to production, while representing that work credibly to senior clients. 

Manage, Master, and Maximize with MResult

MResult is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment free of discrimination and harassment. 

Take the next step in your career with MResult - where your ideas help shape the future.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 

About The Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. 

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer for our data pipeline service to build and work on data pipelines that moves data from various sources to data warehouses. The work is very diverse - all the way from patching software to building new connectors operating on our global Kubernetes compute clusters. 

You will be responsible for ensuring the technical excellence for your team and owned services, by contributing to the code, reviewing code, contributing to architectural design and mentoring your junior colleagues. You will understand the key values that make our product great, and implement those values in the many small decisions you make every day as a product designer. 

This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team

Technologies You'll Use

Java, SQL, Cloud Data Warehouses, AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle, Grafana

What You'll Do

 - Mentoring and guiding junior staff
 - Create and contribute to an environment that is geared to innovation, high productivity, high quality and customer service

 - Ability to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, and internal chatbots) to support researching, authoring, reviewing, and synthesizing various SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, Postmortems, Test Plans, and Proposals

Bonus Skills

- Experience in data processing (ETL, ELT) and/or cloud-based platforms

 - Experience with Kubernetes and Docker
 - Expertise with database management systems and storage systems. 

Perks And Benefits

We also use applied technology expertise to serve the defense, material handling, aerospace, science, and renewable energy industries.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Since year 2003, Oceaneering's India Center has been an integral part of operations for Oceaneering's robust product and service offerings across the globe. This center caters to diverse business needs, from oil and gas field infrastructure, subsea robotics to automated material handling & logistics. 

Our multidisciplinary team offers a wide spectrum of solutions, encompassing Subsea Engineering, Robotics, Automation, Control Systems, Software Development, Asset Integrity Management, Inspection, ROV operations, Field Network Management, Graphics Design & Animation, and more. 

In addition to these technical functions, Oceaneering India Center plays host to several crucial business functions, including Finance, Supply Chain Management (SCM), Information Technology (IT), Human Resources (HR), and Health, Safety & Environment (HSE). 

Our world class infrastructure in India includes modern offices, industry-leading tools and software, equipped labs, and beautiful campuses aligned with the future way of work. At Oceaneering India Center, we take pride in "Solving the Unsolvable" by leveraging the diverse expertise within our team. Join us in shaping the future of technology and engineering solutions on a global scale.

Job Information

Job Code: 00194005

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

About The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead AI Application Engineer to join our core AI team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying advanced Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications across high-throughput, real-time streaming environments . You are an engineer's engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3-4 years. This is an exceptional opportunity for an individual who thrives on building sophisticated, production-grade Autonomous AI systems and wants to make a significant impact. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Architecture & System Design

- Architect and operationalize end-to-end autonomous agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, dynamic tool-calling, reflection, planner-executor loops, and persistent state management). 
 - Design robust LLM runtime infrastructure, including hybrid retrieval architectures (Advanced RAG, graph-based context grounding, vector databases, re-rankers, semantic routing). 
 - Establish scalable evaluation, guardrail, and observability frameworks (latency optimization, cost governors, hallucinations/drift detection, alignment checks, red-teaming). 
 - Make high-stakes architectural decisions regarding model topologies (proprietary frontier models vs. distilled/fine-tuned SLMs, LoRA, quantization, self-hosted vs. managed endpoints). 

Hands-On Execution & Prototyping

- Lead from the front: write high-leverage production code, design critical framework primitives, and rapidly de-risk zero-to-one concepts via functional PoCs. 
 - Bridge cutting-edge research and production engineering, ensuring systems are resilient, fault-tolerant, secure, and performant at scale. 

Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence

- Partner directly with the Head of AI, Product leadership, and VP-level stakeholders to chart the AI technology roadmap and identify transformative capability unlocks. 
 - Lead the exploration and application of Large Language Models, Agentic AI and Generative AI, venturing into new areas within these fields. 
 - Represent the company's AI thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical papers, conferences, or industry forums. 

Other Responsibilities

- Architect, Design and Build robust, scalable, and efficient AI systems leveraging a variety of AI/ML, data science, deep learning, and agentic AI frameworks. 
 - Drive the integration of complex Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, ensuring seamless interaction and optimal performance. 
 - Design and implement scalable and efficient AI/ML systems, architectures, and pipelines that can handle large volumes of data and deliver accurate and timely results. 
 - Regularly self-educate while mentoring and provide technical leadership to other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence. 

Who We Are Looking For -

- Experience: 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years actively building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI applications in production. 
 - Core Engineering & AI Building: Hands-on builder capable of independently architecting, coding, and deploying custom AI tools, autonomous agents, and bots from scratch. 
 - Programming Mastery: 8+ years writing production-grade code in Python or similar languages with deep expertise in scalable software design, APIs, and microservices. 
 - Agentic Frameworks & Tools: Deep proficiency with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Auto-GPT, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination. 
 - LLMs & Fine-Tuning: Practical experience with frontier models (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and custom agentic tool-calling workflows. 
 - ML/DL Foundations: Background in training, tuning, and running models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn in high-throughput environments. 
 - Inference & Acceleration: Familiarity with inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI) and cloud ML infrastructure (NVIDIA GPUs, TPUs). 
 - Data & Memory Infrastructure: Experience building low-latency vector search indices, in-memory caching layers, streaming pipelines (Kafka/Flink), and NoSQL datastores to power real-time agent context and memory. 
 - Education: Master's or Ph. D. in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience). 

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

- Autonomous Execution: Proven track record as a senior IC who takes total ownership-from zero-to-one prototyping to production rollout. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP environments with modern containerized deployment (Kubernetes, Docker).

What do you need for this opportunity?

Must have skills required: 

Financial Services, Grafana, htmx, production system, Prometheus, Celery, Django ORM, Django Rest Framework, Django systems, REST, Data Modelling, PostgreSQL, Python

A financial services provider is Looking for: 

Backend Engineer (Python / Django)

Position

Experience: 5+ years

Department: Product & Engineering

Reporting to: Senior Product & Engineering Lead / Head of Product & Technology

About the role: 

We are looking for a backend engineer who thinks before they build, designs systems as carefully as they write code, and takes ownership of what they ship. You will work on a large, business-critical Django platform that handles financial operations, client onboarding and the APIs behind our mobile and web products. 

The platform is mature and performs well, and it has grown quickly. The next step is architectural: shaping it into a well-structured modular monolith, with clear boundaries between business domains, external integrations and shared services, while it keeps running in production. You will take on parts of that work end to end and ship features alongside the team. 

How We Work, And What We Expect

You own it

- You own the systems you work on, from design through production and beyond: if it breaks at 2 a. m. , you want to know why, and you make sure it doesn''''t happen again. 
 - Don''''t expect to be told what to do. You spot problems, risks and improvements yourself, raise them, propose a solution and follow it through. 
 - You think about what happens next: more clients, more data, more integrations, a provider that goes down. You design for scale and failure, not just for today''''s happy path. 

Plan first, then build

- Before significant work, you write a structured implementation plan: the problem, the options you considered, the chosen design, how it''''s split into phases, the risks, how it will be tested and how it can be rolled back. 
 - Your plans make expectations clear to everyone: what will be delivered, in what order, and how we''''ll know each phase is done. 
 - While you build, you keep a build tracker up to date, so anyone can see where each phase stands without asking. 

AI-assisted, human-owned

- We use AI coding assistants throughout our workflow, from investigation and planning to implementation, tests and documentation. 
 - You stay accountable for every line: you review and understand what the AI produces, verify it against the real system, and keep client data and credentials out of prompts. 

What You''''ll Do

- Turn problems into written, phased implementation plans, agree them with the team, then deliver them phase by phase with a build tracker. 
 - Define and implement a modular architecture for a large Django codebase: business domains, integrations and shared services, each with a clear public interface that other modules use instead of reaching into its internals. 
 - Move models and code between Django apps in production with zero data loss and minimal downtime, planning database changes so that old and new code can run side by side. 
 - Consolidate external integrations into well-tested clients with consistent timeouts, retries, logging and safe handling of repeated callbacks. 
 - Put guardrails in place so the architecture holds: automated boundary checks in CI, tests around code before it is refactored, and clear conventions for new modules. 
 - Design and build REST APIs used by mobile and web clients, including authentication, protected actions and correct per-user data scoping. 
 - Design and tune background processing: queue routing, concurrency limits, and tasks that stay correct under retries and duplicates. 
 - Own deployments and production support for your areas, using metrics and logs to find root causes, not just symptoms. 
 - Review code and share knowledge with other engineers on design, testing and safe database changes. 

What You''''ll Need

Python and Django

- 3+ years of professional Python, with at least 2 building and running production Django systems. 
 - Deep knowledge of the Django ORM: query optimisation, avoiding N+1 queries, transactions and row locking (select_for_update). 
 - Django REST Framework: authentication (including JWT), custom permissions, throttling, and designing APIs that mobile clients depend on. 

Problem solving, system design and planning

- You can take a vague problem, investigate it, and break it into a clear plan with phases, risks and trade-offs, and explain it in writing. 
 - Solid system design thinking: data modelling, consistency, concurrency, failure modes, and how a design behaves as load and data grow. 
 - Examples you can walk us through of problems you solved and systems you owned, including what went wrong and what you changed. 

Architecture and refactoring

- Experience with, or a strong understanding of, modular design in Django: module boundaries, service interfaces, and keeping modules out of each other''''s internals. 
 - Understanding of safe database changes on live systems: expand/contract migrations, and moving models between apps (for example with SeparateDatabaseAndState). 
 - Refactoring incrementally, behind tests, while the system stays in production. 
 - Sound judgement on when to extract, when to consolidate, and when to leave working code alone. 

Data, background jobs and infrastructure

- PostgreSQL: indexing, schema changes on large tables, and connection pooling. 
 - Celery and Redis: queue routing, retries, idempotent tasks, and knowing when work must run one at a time. 
 - Docker and Docker Compose, image-based deployments, and comfort working on Linux servers. 
 - Writing thorough tests with pytest, including for code that had none. 

Integrations

- Integrating third-party systems of every kind: REST and SOAP APIs, direct database connections, and inbound webhooks and callbacks. 
 - Building integrations that move money correctly: idempotency, reconciliation, and handling providers that time out after completing the work. 

Nice to have

- A structured AI-assisted development workflow you can walk us through, from planning to implementation: for example, AI-drafted implementation plans broken into phases with code snippets, a build tracker per phase and for the whole project kept up to date as the work is built, and how you review and verify the output. 
 - Leading a larger refactor or migration in a production system. 
 - Experience in financial services: brokerage, asset management, banking or payments. 
 - Experience with mobile money, core banking or capital-markets integrations. 
 - Observability with Prometheus, Grafana and Loki. 
 - Server-rendered Django templates with HTMX. 
 - Handling sensitive personal data securely and in line with regulatory requirements. 

Our stack

- Python
 - Django
 - Django REST Framework
 - PostgreSQL
 - Celery
 - Redis
 - Docker
 - pytest
 - HTMX
 - S3-compatible storage
 - Prometheus
 - Grafana

data.description:
Product Engineer- Evaluations (Product + Engineering)

Website: ai. joshtalks. com and voicearena. com

Location: Gurugram

About us

Josh Talks AI builds and licenses audio datasets to leading AI labs. We've been deliberately quiet for the last year and just built. The product has earned the right to be expanded; we are now hiring the people who will own what gets built next. 

About the role

This is an Evaluations PM + Engineer role. You will own how we measure the quality of our speech, voice, and image data, and of our customers' models: ASR, TTS, speech-to-speech (S2S), and voice agents. You will define what "good" means for each dataset and model, build and run the evaluations yourself, and turn the results into clear decisions for the product, research, and business teams. 

You don't hand evaluations off. You plan them, run them end to end, and own the outcome. 

What you'll do

Evaluation product ownership

- Own the evaluation roadmap across ASR, TTS, S2S, and voice-agent models. 
 - Work with research, product, and business teams to understand use cases and define what quality means for each one. 
 - Turn quality goals into clear evaluation plans: test sets, metrics, pass/fail thresholds, and timelines. 
 - Prioritise which models, languages, and use cases to evaluate first, based on impact. 
 - Share results through clear reports and dashboards, and make go/no-go recommendations on model releases. 
 - Track model quality over time and flag regressions early. 

Hands-on evaluation (done by you)

- Run end-to-end evaluations of ASR, TTS, S2S, and voice-agent models yourself. 
 - Set up and run open-source and in-house models locally and on cloud GPUs for inference. 
 - Integrate and run models from different vendors and customers through their APIs (batch and streaming), and compare them fairly. 
 - Manage cloud GPU instances (GCP/AWS/Azure) to run large-scale evaluation and inference jobs efficiently. 
 - Build and curate evaluation datasets, including multilingual, Indian-language, noisy, and real-world audio. 
 - Design and run human evaluations: listening tests, rating guidelines, annotator training, and agreement checks. 
 - Write reproducible evaluation pipelines in Python and automate recurring benchmarks. 
 - Analyse errors to find failure patterns and feed them back to the research and data teams. 
 - Benchmark in-house models against third-party and open-source models. 

What we're looking for

Skills

- Hands-on evaluation of ASR, TTS, S2S, or voice/LLM agent models. 
 - Strong Python, with Pandas/NumPy, Hugging Face, and audio libraries (librosa, torchaudio). 
 - Running ML model inference (PyTorch / Hugging Face) on GPUs. 
 - Working with third-party model APIs (REST, WebSocket/streaming). 
 - Cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure), including GPU instances. 
 - Evaluation metrics, test-set design, and statistical significance. 
 - Designing human evaluation studies and rating guidelines. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, and explaining results to technical and non-technical people. 
 - Strong ownership, and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving team. 

Nice to have

- Experience fine-tuning speech models (ASR, TTS, or S2S). 
 - Experience with Indian languages, code-mixed, or low-resource speech data. 
 - Familiarity with Whisper, NeMo, pyannote, ESPnet, or commercial speech APIs. 
 - Experience evaluating LLMs or voice agents (ASR → LLM → TTS pipelines). 
 - Experience building evaluation dashboards or automated regression testing. 

Why join us

- Own how quality is defined and measured for speech AI used at scale. 
 - Work closely with research and product, and directly shape which models ship. 
 - High ownership and real impact from day one.

data.title: DMTS ITP AI Architecture and Delivery
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

The Distinguished Member of Technical Staff (DMTS) for ITP (Innovation, Technology and Products) AI is one of the company's important distinguished technical leadership positions, accountable for turning ITP's AI priorities into production-grade solutions that accelerate technology development, silicon design, product development, and engineering execution across ITP. This role is central to Micron's mission to make AI foundational to how ITP innovates and develops technology and products, amplifying its people and unlocking durable competitive advantage through solutions that are deployed, adopted, and delivering value. 

Position Summary

The ITP AI DMTS is a hands-on technical architect and execution leader in Artificial Intelligence. This individual will work closely with subject matter experts (SMEs) across ITP to understand engineering workflows and pain points, translate those needs into practical AI architectures, and work alongside implementation teams seeing through to production deployment. The role directly advances ITP's goal to redesign engineering from specification to qualification, enabling more design IDs, faster execution, and first-pass qualification with best-in-class quality. 

The DMTS will be accountable alongside implementation teams for delivery of outcomes, partnering directly with internal customers to ensure solutions are adopted and deliver measurable business impact, including ITP's broader goal of significantly faster time-to-market. Success in this role will be measured primarily by the number of AI systems successfully rolled out into production and the business value they deliver. The individual will drive disciplined execution against quarterly objectives while bringing applied innovation to every solution, ensuring Micron continues to lead in how AI is used across engineering. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture and Execution

- Partner with SMEs across ITP to understand engineering workflows, data, and constraints, and translate them into scalable, implementable AI architectures. 
 - Define technical designs, solution blueprints, and implementation plans that move AI use cases from concept to production. 
 - Lead hands-on technical execution, including architecture reviews, build decisions, integration, and deployment readiness. 
 - Establish reusable architecture patterns, platforms, and standards that accelerate delivery across ITP. 
 - Translate the ITP AI roadmap into concrete quarterly deliverables with clear milestones, owners, and success criteria. 
 - Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to keep programs on schedule. 

Customer Partnership and Production Delivery

- Own delivery of AI outcomes end to end, from requirements through production rollout and adoption. 
 - Work closely with internal customers across technology development, silicon design, product engineering, and manufacturing to prioritize the use cases with the highest business impact. 
 - Drive the rollout of production AI systems, ensuring quality, reliability, scalability, security, and supportability. 
 - Partner with cross-functional engineering and IT teams to integrate AI solutions into existing tools, data, and workflows. 
 - Track and report adoption, performance, and business impact of deployed solutions, including improvements in velocity, quality, and cost. 
 - Continuously improve deployed systems based on customer feedback and operational data. 

Applied Innovation

- Drive innovation that becomes deployable capability, applying advances in GenAI, agentic AI, machine learning, scientific AI, and semiconductor-focused AI to real ITP problems. 
 - Rapidly prototype and evaluate new approaches, scaling those that prove value into production. 
 - Bring emerging AI technologies and industry practices into ITP where they can measurably improve engineering outcomes. 

Technical Leadership and Influence

- Drive disciplined execution against objectives set each quarter, translating the ITP AI roadmap into measurable, quarter-over-quarter results. 
 - Serve as a trusted technical advisor to ITP leaders on AI architecture, delivery priorities, and investment trade-offs. 
 - Lead cross-functional teams through complex technical challenges requiring exceptional expertise and creativity. 
 - Mentor senior technical staff, principal engineers, architects, and engineers 
 - Build and strengthen Micron's AI technical community and talent pipeline. 

How Success Is Measured

- Number of AI systems rolled out into production across ITP. 
 - Customer adoption and sustained usage of deployed solutions. 
 - Measurable business impact, including faster time-to-market, improved quality, and engineering productivity gains. 
 - Delivery against quarterly objectives and committed milestones. 
 - Innovation output, including new IP and novel solutions that reach deployment. 

Minimum Qualifications

- MS or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field. 
 - 15+ years of experience in advanced AI research, AI platform development, machine learning, semiconductor or related technical domains. 
 - Demonstrated record of technical innovation translated into production systems with measurable business impact. 
 - Deep expertise in multiple AI disciplines, such as Generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, AI infrastructure, scientific AI, reinforcement learning, and AI safety and governance. 
 - Significant experience architecting, building, and deploying large-scale AI or software systems into production. 
 - Exceptional communication and executive influencing skills. 
 - Proven ability to drive technical outcomes across organizational boundaries without direct authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Expertise in AI with a good record of publications, patents, open-source contributions, or industry recognition. 
 - Experience applying AI within semiconductor technology, EDA, manufacturing, product development, scientific computing, or high-performance computing environments. 
 - Demonstrated success creating and scaling enterprise AI platforms and capabilities. 
 - Experience leading AI transformation efforts within global organizations. 
 - History of mentoring senior technical talent and developing future technical leaders. 
 - Distinguished engineer experience, or equivalent technical leadership accomplishments. 

About Micron Technology, Inc. 

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities - from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain. 

Job Description

We are seeking a visionary and highly technical AI Go-To-Market (GTM) Engineer to sit at the core of our revenue engine. This is not a traditional operations role; it is a hybrid of software engineering, data science, and revenue strategy. You will be responsible for architecting an AI-first GTM ecosystem that bridges the gap between Sales, RevOps, Marketing, and Customer Success. 

Your goal is to ensure that every individual in our GTM organization and every piece of our technology stack is augmented by Artificial Intelligence. You will build the bridges that allow us to generate more pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and eliminate administrative friction, all while optimizing our tech spend. 

Responsibilities

- AI Architecture & Custom Integration
 - Design, code, and deploy custom AI integrations from scratch to connect our CRM, Sales Engagement platforms, and other technology stack components. 
 - Build proprietary internal LLM-based tools to automate account and contact enrichment, outbound messaging for early and middle of the funnel prospects. 
 - Develop agentic workflows that handle routine administrative tasks (e. g. , CRM data, meeting summaries, and follow-up scheduling) across the revenue organization. 
 - Revenue Ecosystem Optimization
 - Partner with RevOps and Marketing Ops to audit the existing tech stack, identifying redundancies where AI can replace high-cost, low-utility third-party vendors. 
 - Implement predictive modeling to identify high-intent pipelines and provide Sales with real-time "Next Best Action" recommendations. 
 - Ensure data integrity across all platforms, creating a "single source of truth" that AI models can leverage for accurate forecasting. 
 - Cross-Functional Efficiency
 - Collaborate with Customer Success to build AI-driven retention loops and automated renewal triggers. 
 - Consult with Marketing leadership on AI-driven content distribution and performance marketing automation to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC). 
 - Act as an internal consultant, training GTM teams on how to effectively "prompt" and utilize deployed AI tools to maximize their individual output. 

Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in Marketing/Revenue Operations or GTM Engineering. Deep understanding of the "Leads-to-Revenue" funnel and "Best-in-Class" SaaS ecosystems. 
 - Ability to write and maintain production integrations - Python, JavaScript, html, or equivalent - connecting AI agents to CRM, MAP, and sequencing tools via APIs. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to ship working code, not just configure no-code tools. 
 - Deep working knowledge of the modern B2B GTM stack - specifically Salesforce (as CRM and data hub), Clay, Claude, Outreach, Gong or Chorus, etc
 - Proven track record of consolidating tech stacks and reducing vendor spend without sacrificing performance.

If someone says "we need 20 opportunities per quarter at 20% win rate and $75K ASD, " you should immediately know where AI can compress that funnel.

 - Demonstrated ability to build prompt libraries, training datasets, and refinement workflows for AI agents - treating agent training as a discipline, not a one-time setup. 
 - Strong opinions on when AI should replace human effort versus augment it - and the judgment to know that bad AI automation destroys deals faster than no automation at all. 

Additional Information

data.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200, 000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. 

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations. 

Your Team's Impact

You'll be joining a growing, distributed team within FactSet's Developer Enablement & Automation organization. The team focuses on the workflows, tooling, and shared infrastructure that power FactSet's engineering communities - helping engineers ship software with confidence. 

FactSet's ecosystem spans a wide range of teams and technologies. This role focuses on integrating and supporting a centralized CI/CD pipeline platform that brings consistency and governance to how software is built, tested, and deployed - without slowing teams down. 

The work is less about building from scratch and more about making the right pieces fit together on a scale. Good engineering judgment is as important as technical skill: the platform needs to be consistent where it matters and flexible enough to support the teams that rely on it. 

What You'll Do

- Build a centralized CI/CD platform to support a diverse portfolio of applications with varying build tools, test frameworks, and deployment targets
 - Identify and implement extension points that accommodate existing build requirements
 - Define and enforce standardized quality gates (linting, testing, security checks) while preserving team flexibility
 - Collaborate directly with application teams to surface requirements and ensure the pipeline fits their needs
 - Support deployments across an internal PaaS platform, Kubernetes/ArgoCD, and AWS
 - Help shape the long-term vision of the platform and what good engineering workflows look like at FactSet

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years with solid experience as a software engineer with a strong focus on CI/CD, developer tooling, or platform engineering at a comparable seniority level
 - Experience working with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins or Travis CI and an understanding of how to design pipelines that scale across many teams and applications
 - Deep familiarity with the software packaging lifecycle ecosystem - you understand how these applications are built, tested, and what good looks like across different build toolchains
 - Familiarity with containerized deployments and cloud environments (Kubernetes, AWS, or similar)
 - An instinct for where standardization helps and where it hurts - you know the difference between a guardrail and a roadblock
 - Familiarity with Linux - you should be able to navigate the Linux file system via a CLI and understand Linux operating system concepts like package managers. 

Additional/Desired Skill

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach - you'll need to engage with application teams, understand their constraints, and build solutions that earn adoption rather than demanding it 
 - A genuine passion for developer experience and enabling engineering teams to move faster with more confidence
 - Experience with modern CI/CD vendors and pipeline-as-code approaches
 - Familiarity with internal developer platforms or PaaS-style deployment environments
 - Experience driving tooling adoption across a large engineering organization
 - Broader experience with developer enablement concerns such as shared libraries, scaffolding, or local development environment standardization
 - Familiarity with Python, Bash and Typescript
 - Familiarity with the Harness Developer Platform

Must be fluent in English

Company Overview

FactSet (NYSE: FDS | NASDAQ: FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8, 200 global clients, including over 200, 000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees' Choice Award winner. Learn more at www. factset. com and follow us on X and LinkedIn. 

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

data.title: Senior Manager, AI CoE
data.description:
Senior Engineering Manager - AI CoE

About Redwood

Redwood Software helps the world's largest enterprises automate mission-critical business processes. Our platforms support complex enterprise workloads across ERP systems, business applications, cloud infrastructure, and on-premises environments. 

Redwood is building reusable AI infrastructure, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and platform services that enable enterprise-ready AI features across its product portfolio. 

Role Mission

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead the engineering team responsible for delivering Redwood's shared AI platform and agentic capabilities. 

You will translate the AI strategy into an executable engineering roadmap, build a high-performing team, and ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, observable, and commercially valuable AI systems. The role requires sufficient technical depth to guide architecture and challenge engineering decisions while remaining accountable for people's leadership, execution, team health, and delivery outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead one or more engineering teams responsible for AI platform services, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and product integrations. 
 - Translate business and product priorities into a clear engineering roadmap, delivery plan, and team-level objectives. 
 - Recruit, onboard, manage, and retain engineers with the skills required to build production-grade AI and agentic systems. 
 - Establish clear ownership, performance expectations, decision-making responsibilities, and development plans across the team. 
 - Drive predictable execution through effective planning, dependency management, risk identification, and operational readiness. 
 - Partner with senior individual contributors to guide architecture and technical direction without becoming a bottleneck for engineering decisions. 
 - Ensure consistent engineering practices across AI evaluation, observability, model governance, security, reliability, performance, and cost management. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Data, Legal, and product engineering teams to deliver enterprise-ready AI capabilities. 
 - Balance shared platform investments with customer-facing requirements and immediate product priorities. 
 - Monitor delivery, quality, platform adoption, incidents, operational performance, and engineering effectiveness. 
 - Establish an engineering culture focused on ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer outcomes. 
 - Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance discussions, and career development planning. 
 - Communicate engineering progress, risks, dependencies, and investment requirements to senior stakeholders. 
 - Maintain sufficient technical involvement to understand architectural risks, challenge decisions, and support critical engineering outcomes. 

Scope and Expected Impact

- Own engineering outcomes for a critical AI platform domain or multiple related engineering teams. 
 - Convert broad strategic priorities into measurable plans, milestones, and delivery commitments. 
 - Make organizational, staffing, prioritization, and delivery decisions with medium- to long-term impact. 
 - Create alignment across senior engineers, Product, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders. 
 - Improve delivery predictability, platform adoption, engineering quality, and operational reliability. 
 - Scale the organization through clear ownership, repeatable engineering practices, and strong technical leadership. 
 - Ensure the team can deliver effectively without depending excessively on any single individual. 

Must Have Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 2+ years in an engineering people-management or team-leadership role. 
 - Experience leading one or more engineering teams responsible for complex software products or platform services. 
 - Demonstrated experience hiring, managing performance, coaching engineers, and supporting career development. 
 - Track record of delivering enterprise SaaS, cloud, distributed systems, platform, ML, or AI products into production. 
 - Strong working knowledge of generative AI, agentic architectures, LLM-based applications, orchestration, and production deployment considerations. 
 - Understanding agent workflows involving tool use, retrieval, enterprise data, APIs, memory, guardrails, and human oversight. 
 - Experience managing technical roadmaps, delivery risks, dependencies, incidents, quality, and operational performance. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, cloud-native systems, automated testing, CI/CD, security, and observability. 
 - Ability to guide technical decisions and architecture discussions while empowering senior engineers to own implementation. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical and business trade-offs to senior stakeholders. 
 - Experience working effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to operate with high autonomy and manage ambiguity in a product or high-scale technology environment. 

Strong Plus

- Experience establishing or scaling an AI platform, agentic engineering team, Center of Excellence, or developer platform function. 
 - Hands-on exposure to LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or custom agent orchestration frameworks. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation platforms, model gateways, vector databases, prompt lifecycle management, or AI observability tools. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI, model governance, privacy, compliance, and enterprise security requirements. 
 - Experience in enterprise middleware, workflow orchestration, ERP, automation, or integration platforms. 
 - Experience balancing greenfield platform development with the modernization of existing enterprise products. 
 - Experience working in regulated, security-sensitive, or high-availability environments. 

What Success Looks Like

- Builds a healthy, appropriately staffed engineering team with clear responsibilities and strong technical ownership. 
 - Delivers AI platform and agentic capabilities predictably while maintaining security, reliability, quality, and cost discipline. 
 - Creates measurable adoption of shared AI capabilities across Redwood's product engineering teams. 
 - Establishes clear engineering standards for AI evaluation, observability, governance, and production readiness. 
 - Improves team effectiveness, delivery predictability, and operational performance. 
 - Develops capable engineers and reduces organizational dependency on individual contributors. 
 - Provides senior stakeholders with a clear, evidence-based view of progress, risks, dependencies, and investment requirements. 

If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

We're looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success - and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.

Partnering with Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, and other cross-functional teams, the position ensures products and processes consistently meet customer, internal, and applicable quality requirements.

 - Lead Incoming Quality activities, including inspection standards, sampling plans, acceptance criteria, non-conforming material control, and incoming quality performance monitoring.

Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most. 

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

We are seeking a full-stack Senior Software Engineer (individual contributor) to join our Voice Platform team to help build and operate scalable, network-facing cloud services that power communications for Genesys Cloud contact centers worldwide. This is a great opportunity for an engineer who is strong in Java and Spring Boot on the backend, comfortable building React front-ends, and experienced with Python and AWS, who enjoys building reliable microservices and well-designed APIs end to end.

You will work across the full stack - backend microservices, serverless components, and front-end UIs - collaborate closely with senior engineers, and grow your skills in distributed systems and production operations. data.description:
About Us

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here. 

Position Overview

The Penetration Tester is a critical member of the Application Security team, focused on identifying, validating, and resolving security vulnerabilities across our cloud infrastructure and applications. You will lead technical security assessments, including application-layer and network-layer penetration testing, to ensure all information assets are secured against evolving threats. This role is vital for maintaining our security posture and ensuring remediation efforts are effectively prioritized and executed. 

Key Responsibilities

- Perform comprehensive manual and automated application-layer penetration tests to identify vulnerabilities, adhering to industry standards and internal methodologies. 
 - Conduct network-layer penetration tests encompassing all components supporting network functions and operating systems. 
 - Validate segmentation and scope-reduction controls at least annually and after any significant changes to ensure isolation of the Cardholder Data Environment (CDE). 
 - Triage and validate vulnerabilities reported through bug bounty program. 
 - Document and risk-rate all findings, providing actionable remediation guidance to engineering and product teams. 
 - Verify the correction of exploitable vulnerabilities through re-testing and post-remediation assessments. 
 - Collaborate with external 3rd party security firms on penetration testing and threat hunting exercises. 
 - Ensure all security assessments and remediation activities meet compliance and regulatory obligations (e. g. , PCI DSS, SOC). 

Qualifications

- Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing, ethical hacking, or application security engineering. 
 - Deep understanding of common web-based attacks (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, XXE, etc. ) and how to mitigate them at the application level. 
 - Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Go, Ruby, or Bash to automate security tasks. 
 - Comprehensive knowledge of network protocols and security concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, TLS, and IPSEC. 
 - Strong experience with security testing tools (e. g. , BurpSuite Enterprise, SAST, DAST, and IAST). 
 - Working knowledge of OWASP security fundamentals and API identity/access management (OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, JWT). 
 - Ability to work with high autonomy and communicate technical security findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Relevant information security certification(s) such as OSCP, CEH, OSWE, or CISSP. 

Bonus Qualifications

- Direct experience managing or triaging a public bug bounty program (e. g. , HackerOne, BugCrowd). 
 - Experience leveraging Slack/ChatOps to automate security tasks or reporting. 
 - Experience with cloud orchestration and Infrastructure as Code (e. g. , Terraform, Google Deployment Manager). 
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tooling like Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC2, or CCPA. 

Know More About Us Here

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.

 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace.  - Ability to work independently and collaboratively as a member of an Agile product team.

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or related field.

data.title: Social Team Lead
data.description:
Pattern is one of Australia's leading e-commerce digital agencies, awarded Australia's Best Digital Agency at the NORA Awards. We are also the largest seller on Amazon globally, representing brands across all product categories. 

Our team is data-driven, collaborative and ambitious, working across digital marketing, e-commerce consultancy and marketplace management. We support professional development with structured training and development plans in the first 12 months. 

Pattern is expanding, and we are looking for a Social Team Lead to lead our India-based social assistants in Pune. You will own the team's social workload, across paid social builds and social commerce, and drive the AI and automation initiatives that help our Australian and Indian social teams deliver more, faster and with fewer errors. This role suits a proactive leader and innovator with a genuine curiosity for AI and process improvement. 

What is the day in the life of a Social Team Lead?

Team leadership

- Line-manage the two Social Assistants: 1: 1s, delegation, capacity planning, quality checks, career development and performance reviews. 
 - Manage and allocate the team's ad build workload across all clients, acting as the first point of contact for Account Managers on build requests, timelines and capacity. 
 - Ensure briefs are actioned within agreed SLAs and quality check builds before Account Manager QA, so campaigns go live with no errors. 
 - Create and maintain playbooks so best practice is applied consistently across accounts and team members. 
 - Flag capacity risks early, especially in the lead-up to peak, and recommend solutions. 

AI and automation

- Own the social team's AI and automation roadmap: identify manual, repetitive work, prioritise what to build and deliver it (e. g. automated ad briefing, ad builds, reporting, pacing alerts, bulk updates, AI-assisted optimisation). 
 - Run and improve the automated ad briefing workflow (client content calendar to Asana), including tagging the right builders and keeping briefs and calendars in sync. 
 - Build and maintain automated workflows and alerts (e. g. Claude with the Supermetrics connector, n8n, Launchpad/Payload) that cut manual effort and errors, starting with Meta and expanding to other platforms. 
 - Track and report the hours saved by each automation, reviewed monthly. 
 - Drive adoption of internal and AI tools across the team, and document every automation in the Social AI Bible (what it does, how to run it, who owns it) so it can be reused. 
 - Feedback to the tech team on internal tool feature requirements, and ensure all tools follow Pattern's data privacy and client data requirements. 

Paid social execution and optimisation

- Execute and optimise paid social activity across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and Reddit, including budget and KPI/results tracking. 
 - Monitor campaign performance, look for opportunities to scale and improve results, and make recommendations. 
 - Support TikTok Shop and social commerce delivery, including shop and product catalogue setup, Shop ads (GMV Max) builds and optimisation, and affiliate creator campaigns, working with the AU team as Pattern's social commerce offering grows. 
 - Stay across platform updates and social trends, and share relevant learnings with the team. 

Reporting, process and collaboration

- Partner with Analytics and Account Managers to turn reporting (Looker Studio, Supermetrics) into decisions and recommendations. 
 - Keep refining processes to improve efficiency without losing quality. 
 - Work closely with the AU-based Social team, communicating clearly across time zones on progress, blockers and timelines. 

Skills And Qualifications

- At least 5 years' experience in social media, paid social or performance marketing (social commerce experience a plus), ideally within an agency. 
 - Team management experience. 
 - A proven track record of using AI tools (e. g. Claude) and automation or workflow tools (e. g. n8n) to remove manual work, with examples of time saved. 
 - Proficient in social ad managers including Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and Reddit. 
 - Excellent analytical skills, including budget management, data interpretation and attention to detail, with experience in Supermetrics, Looker Studio, Google Analytics and Google Suite. 
 - Experience with Asana or similar project management tools. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, and comfortable working with an Australian team across time zones. 
 - Marketing, Communications and/or Social Media university graduate. 
 - Experience working with retail or e-commerce brands (desirable). 

Desired Traits & Competencies

- Game Changers - look at problems with an open mind, share new ideas, and actively pursue improvements to Pattern's processes and outcomes, especially through AI and automation. 
 - Data Fanatics - understand problems through data, draw unbiased conclusions that lead to actionable solutions, and keep tracking the effects (e. g. hours saved, error rates). 
 - Partner Obsessed - clearly explain the status of work to Account Managers and clients, listen to expectations and deliver results that exceed them. 
 - Team of Doers - uplift team members and recognise their contributions, take initiative, and hold themselves accountable to the team and to partners. 
 - Builds delivered within agreed SLAs, with minimal errors reaching Account Manager QA. 
 - Measurable hours saved per week from automation initiatives, reviewed monthly. 
 - Every automation documented in the Social AI Bible with a clear owner. 
 - Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples. 
 - Bring examples of automations or AI workflows you have built, and the time they saved. 
 - Be ready to talk about how you have led and developed a team. 
 - Focus on how you would make a difference at Pattern. 

Why should I work at Pattern?

Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference. We are a company full of talented industry experts that evolves quickly and often, we set big goals and work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern family. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Senior IT Architect
data.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. 

A Day in the Life

The Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) enables Medtronic's global technology strategy, delivering secure, scalable, and modern digital solutions that support business operations and patient-focused innovation. Within the IT Architecture function, this role focuses on the ServiceNow platform, driving enterprise architecture, platform modernization, automation, and adoption of advanced capabilities including AI-powered solutions, configurable workspaces, and system integrations. 

This full-time position is based onsite in Nanakramguda, Hyderabad, India. The role partners closely with enterprise architects, business stakeholders, platform administrators, developers, and external partners to advance the ServiceNow ecosystem and support enterprise technology initiatives. 

As a ServiceNow Architect, you will lead the technical direction of the ServiceNow platform, defining scalable architecture, governance standards, and integration strategies. This role combines platform leadership, solution design, and stakeholder engagement to ensure ServiceNow capabilities align with business and technology objectives while supporting ongoing modernization and automation efforts. 

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned: 

- Define and maintain ServiceNow platform architecture, standards, and roadmap aligned with enterprise technology strategies. 
 - Design scalable, secure, and sustainable ServiceNow solutions supporting performance, integration, and compliance requirements. 
 - Lead implementation and configuration of ServiceNow applications, modules, and platform capabilities. 
 - Design and oversee integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, and related technologies. 
 - Establish and enforce platform governance, coding standards, architectural guardrails, and security best practices. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, and technology teams to translate requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Create and maintain architecture blueprints, technical documentation, configuration standards, and implementation guidelines. 
 - Mentor ServiceNow developers and administrators through technical leadership, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. 

Required Knowledge and Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree with 8+ years of IT experience OR Master's degree with 6+ years of IT experience, including ServiceNow platform architecture, design, and implementation. 
 - 2+ years of experience as a ServiceNow Platform Architect leading enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions. 
 - Active ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification. 
 - Experience leading ServiceNow customization, development, configuration, and integration initiatives. 
 - Experience with ServiceNow architecture, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, AJAX, and platform scripting. Nice to Haves: 
 - ServiceNow Certified Application Developer, Certified Implementation Specialist (HR, Customer Service Management, or IT Service Management), or ServiceNow Architect certification. 
 - Experience developing and maintaining ServiceNow architecture blueprints and platform governance frameworks. 
 - Experience building custom Service Portal widgets, pages, Configurable Workspaces, and Flow Designer solutions. 
 - Experience with ServiceNow AI Search, Now Assist, Predictive Intelligence, and platform optimization initiatives. 
 - Experience implementing REST integrations, IntegrationHub spokes, OAuth authentication, and Single Sign-On solutions. 

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 





Recruitment Fraud Alert

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind: 

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic. com email addresses. 

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate. 

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments. 

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic. com. 

Benefits & Compensation

Role Summary

We're looking for a Senior Manager to lead a blended AI engineering team building the agentic AI platform and the marketing solutions that run on top of it. This is a delivery-leadership role: you own the roadmap, execution, and quality bar for a team of platform engineers, applied-AI solutions builders, and data engineering - turning cutting-edge agentic AI into reliable, production systems that marketing and analytics teams depend on every day. 

You will operate at the intersection of platform and product: hardening the agentic infrastructure (LLM orchestration, retrieval, tool/MCP integration, deploys, reliability) while making sure the AI solutions built on it deliver real marketing outcomes. You'll grow the people on your team, set a high engineering bar, and partner across a global AI organization.

Platform & infrastructure

- Own delivery and reliability of the agentic AI platform: LLM orchestration, retrieval/RAG pipelines, tool and MCP integration, model routing, and evaluation.

 - Set technical direction with your senior engineers; make the hard architecture calls and unblock the team (design-level involvement; not expected to write production code day-to-day). 

Applied AI solutions

- Lead the team that builds AI agents and workflows for marketing use cases (analytics, paid media, content-to-intent, executive reporting) on top of the platform.

People leadership & delivery
