data.description:
Lead Software Engineer - AI and . Net

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

In SimCorp, we help some of the biggest financial institutions in the world be successful by simplifying their accounting, operations, and investments. We do this through IT systems, processes, and financial knowledge. High quality, performing, secure, and cost-effective software is at the core of what we do. To build, maintain and operate this software, engineers are essential to us. 

SimCorp's AI & Insights area is building the foundation for the agentic future of investment operations: Running SimCorp agents, leveraging partner agents, and integrating with clients workflows. The AI Platform team owns that foundation: a compliant, standardized, secure, and user-friendly agentic ecosystem that domain teams can leverage when building their AI features. 

The team's recent deliveries and current focus include preparing Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo for production, publishing the Agent Development Stack, implementing evaluation, trust, safety and guardrails, progressing multi-agent orchestration, and exploring MCP for SimCorp One APIs. 

You will be working with a team located in Noida/Hyderabad in India and Copenhagen, Denmark. The Product Development team functions as a center of enablement for artificial intelligence (AI), providing knowledge and guidelines to other teams, as well as working hands on implementing and operating solutions with AI. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

The Lead Software Engineer at SimCorp, at the IC5 grade, is responsible for leading and driving the design, development, and implementation of complex software solutions. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop high-quality software that meets business requirements and technical specifications. The Lead Software Engineer takes ownership of key engineering projects, provides technical guidance to junior engineers, and ensures that software is delivered on time and within scope. This position requires strong problem-solving skills, expertise in software engineering practices, and the ability to work in a collaborative and fast-paced environment. 

We work team-based, so your primary responsibility is as a team member. You need to make sure the team delivers on its commitments, that it's a good place to work for you and your teammates, and that it continuously improves. 

Daily tasks are for example: 

- Developing plugins and tools for generative AI models, Agentic AI solutions. 
 - Going from proof-of-concepts to high quality, production ready solutions. 
 - Integrating AI functionality with modules and Agents developed by other teams
 - Lead the design and development of software solutions, ensuring they meet business needs and technical requirements
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment
 - Collaborate with product management, design, and quality assurance teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of software solutions
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring high-quality solutions that are scalable, reliable, and performant
 - Ensure adherence to software development best practices, including coding standards, testing, and documentation
 - Take ownership of key features and components, driving their design and implementation from concept to delivery
 - Continuously assess and improve engineering processes, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality
 - Participate in code reviews, ensuring that the team follows best practices and maintains high standards for software quality

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. 

- 7+ years of hands-on experience with . NET technologies (C#, Microsoft . NET). 
 - Experience in building AI solutions (preferably 2+ years), with a passion for Agentic AI and associated projects will be an added advantage. 
 - Experience with generative AI tools like OpenAI for Azure, protocols like A2A/MCP plugins & function calls for example through MAF. 
 - Comprehensive understanding and practical experience with application architecture, covering both frontend and backend systems
 - Proficiency in working with Azure and Azure DevOps. 
 - Experience with Agile development methodologies, as well as DevOps and CI/CD practices

As a person, you have the following traits: 

- Taking ownership. Comfortable taking the lead on tasks. 
 - Earn trust, think big, and take calculated risks. 
 - You collaborate with team members to work towards common goals. 
 - Solid problem-solving skills and comfortable questioning assumptions and as-is. 
 - Exhibits a consistent approach and a creative mindset. 
 - Thrives in a collaborative environment and values teamwork
 - Like to have fun at work and positivity comes easily to you
 - Excellent English verbal and communication skills

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application. 
 - Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work. 
 - Inclusive and diverse company culture
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. 

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering in the Federal and Sovereign Clouds department. As a passionate engineer you will work with a team of cloud architects in building scalable, high performance backend applications for our cloud engineering org. You will play a pivotal role in enhancing our multitenant architecture and global footprint for the world's largest cloud security platform. 

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

- Designing and implementing scalable, high-performance backend services and APIs 
 - Ensuring code quality by writing and maintaining unit, integration, and performance tests; monitor, debug, and optimize system performance 
 - Mentoring junior engineers, fostering their growth, and upholding best practices through active participation in code reviews 
 - Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated solutions and contribute to Agile/Scrum processes like sprint planning and retrospectives

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. 
 - You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution. 
 - You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact. 
 - You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust. 
 - You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose. 

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

About Northern Trust

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24, 000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

The role combines production engineering, Azure platform operations, DevOps automation, infrastructure as code, observability, and incident management. The engineer will partner with application, infrastructure, security, and business teams to reduce operational risk and deliver resilient services. 

Major Duties

- Operate and support Azure-hosted applications and services, with emphasis on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), networking, Azure Service Bus, Key Vault, Managed Identity, SQL Managed Instance and related platform services. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform; apply reusable modules, version control, peer review, and automated deployment practices. 
 - Build and improve CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps, including automated testing, deployment controls, release readiness, and rollback practices. 
 - Define, monitor, and improve service reliability through SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, availability targets, error budgets, capacity planning, and performance tuning. 
 - Create actionable monitoring, dashboards, and alerts using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics/KQL, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues across pods, nodes, scaling, connectivity, certificates, identities, dependencies, and Azure resources; lead incident response, root cause analysis, and preventive actions. 
 - Automate repetitive operational tasks and implement self-healing capabilities using Python, PowerShell, or shell scripting. 
 - Support disaster recovery, patch validation, access reviews, audit activities, on-call escalation, and continuous service improvement. 
 - Communicate service health, incident status, reliability trends, risks, and remediation plans clearly to technical teams and management. 

Knowledge / Skills Required

- Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure, especially AKS, Azure networking, Service Bus, Key Vault, Managed Identity, SQL Managed Instance, and Azure monitoring services. 
 - Advanced Terraform skills, including modules, state management, environment configuration, code review, and CI/CD integration. Working knowledge of ARM or Bicep is beneficial. 
 - Practical DevOps experience with Git, GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps, CI/CD, GitOps, Docker, release automation, and deployment strategies. 
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes operations, container orchestration, ingress/service networking, autoscaling, resource management, resilience, and high availability. 
 - Observability expertise across metrics, logs, traces, alerting, KQL, latency, throughput, CPU/memory, p95/p99, pod scaling, node utilization, and dependency performance. 
 - Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or shell scripting for operational automation and troubleshooting. 
 - Working knowledge of incident, problem, change, and service management practices; familiarity with ServiceNow and workload schedulers such as Control-M is useful. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, collaboration, and written/verbal communication skills. 

Experience Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 6-8 years of relevant experience in SRE, DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering. 
 - Demonstrated experience operating business-critical workloads on Azure and administering AKS/Kubernetes environments. 
 - Proven experience delivering infrastructure automation with Terraform and implementing CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Hands-on experience with production monitoring, incident response, root cause analysis, performance optimization, disaster recovery, and reliability improvement. 
 - Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, or DevOps certifications are preferred. 

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with. 

About Our Pune Office

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3, 000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe. 

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10, 000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

data.description:
Job Description - Head of CSSD

Continental Hospitals | Hyderabad

About Continental Hospitals

Continental Hospitals is a leading multispecialty tertiary and quaternary care hospital located in the Financial District, Gachibowli, Hyderabad. With 585 beds, 50+ medical specialties and advanced healthcare infrastructure, the hospital is committed to delivering high-quality, evidence-based and patient-centric care. 

Accredited by Joint Commission International (JCI) and NABH, Continental Hospitals offers advanced clinical services supported by 16 modular Green Operation Theatres, 90 single-room ICU beds and comprehensive critical care facilities. The hospital provides a dynamic environment for clinical excellence, patient safety and continuous improvement. 

Position Details

- Position: Head - Central Sterile Services Department (CSSD)
 - Location: Continental Hospitals, Hyderabad
 - Department: CSSD
 - Experience: 8-12 years, including at least 3 years in a leadership role
 - Industry: Multispecialty / Tertiary Care HospitalsEducational Qualification

- B. Sc. / M. Sc. in Microbiology, Life Sciences, Nursing or other relevant discipline. 
 - Specialized CSSD training or certification will be preferred. Job Purpose

To lead and manage the Central Sterile Services Department, ensuring effective decontamination, cleaning, disinfection, packing, sterilization, storage and distribution of medical and surgical instruments across all clinical departments, in compliance with hospital quality standards and infection prevention protocols. 

Key Responsibilities

1. CSSD Operations & Management

- Oversee end-to-end CSSD operations, including receiving, cleaning, disinfection, packing, sterilization and distribution of instruments. 
 - Ensure uninterrupted availability of sterile surgical instruments and supplies for all operating theatres and clinical departments. 
 - Establish and monitor standard operating procedures. 
 - Ensure effective turnaround time for instrument sets and surgical trays. 2. Quality & Infection Control

- Ensure compliance with NABH, JCI and applicable infection control standards. 
 - Monitor sterilization cycles, biological indicators, chemical indicators and physical parameters. 
 - Maintain sterilization records, traceability and documentation. 
 - Coordinate with Infection Control, Quality and Nursing teams for audits and corrective actions. 3. Equipment & Process Management

- Manage autoclaves, ETO sterilizers, washer disinfectors, ultrasonic cleaners and other CSSD equipment. 
 - Ensure preventive maintenance, calibration and validation of equipment. 
 - Monitor equipment performance and coordinate breakdown maintenance. 4. Team Leadership

- Lead, train and supervise CSSD technicians and support staff. 
 - Prepare duty rosters and manpower plans. 
 - Conduct competency assessments and regular training. 
 - Ensure adherence to safety protocols and departmental discipline. 5. Inventory & Cost Management

- Monitor inventory of sterile supplies, packing materials and consumables. 
 - Ensure optimal utilization of resources and minimize wastage. 
 - Coordinate with Procurement, Stores, OT and Nursing departments. 
 - Monitor departmental budgets and operational costs. 6. Audit & Reporting

- Maintain departmental MIS and performance dashboards. 
 - Monitor turnaround time, sterilization failure rates, rejected packs and equipment downtime. 
 - Conduct internal audits and implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Report departmental performance and critical issues to hospital management. Essential Experience & Skills

- Minimum 8 years of experience in CSSD operations within a multispecialty hospital. 
 - At least 3 years of experience independently managing CSSD operations in a leadership capacity. 
 - Experience in high-volume OT and tertiary-care hospital environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of sterilization techniques, infection control and instrument management. 
 - Experience in NABH/JCI audits and quality compliance. 
 - Proven ability to manage teams and complex departmental operations. Preferred Candidate Profile

- Currently working as CSSD Head / CSSD Manager / Senior CSSD In-charge in a reputed multispecialty hospital. 
 - Experience in 300+ bedded tertiary-care hospitals preferred. 
 - Exposure to transplant, cardiac, neuro, robotic and advanced surgical OT services will be an advantage. 
 - Candidates from standalone clinics, small nursing homes and diagnostic centres will not be considered. Key Performance Indicators

- Sterilization compliance and failure rate. 
 - Instrument turnaround time. 
 - OT instrument availability. 
 - Sterilization traceability and documentation. 
 - Audit compliance. 
 - Equipment uptime. 
 - Inventory control and consumable utilization. 
 - Staff competency and training compliance. Candidate Preference: We are particularly interested in professionals currently heading CSSD operations in established multispecialty hospitals, with proven experience managing high-volume OT requirements and maintaining NABH/JCI standards.

Job Description

The Solution Architect is responsible for designing technology solutions within the Solution Delivery function across a global engineering and professional services organisation of over 75, 000 employees, as a member of a global team of Solution Architects. 

The role designs solutions primarily in support of corporate functions, while also supporting engineering and digital fee-earning business areas where required. Solutions may range from SaaS platforms requiring integration with enterprise systems through to bespoke applications developed to meet WSP's specific business requirements. 

The role converts business needs into secure, scalable, supportable and cost-effective designs, predominantly on Microsoft Azure, that align with Enterprise Architecture and WSP policy and are approved through the Cloud Design Review Board (CDRB).

Requirements & Solution Design

 - Scalability & Performance - Design systems for growth, resilience and reliability. 
 - Integration & Data Movement - Define API, integration, data movement and orchestration patterns across applications, SaaS platforms and enterprise systems. 
 - Operational Design - Define monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, support handover to service management, and plan for lifecycle and decommissioning. 

Technology Selection & Cost Efficiency

Governance, Risk & Quality

Take designs through CDRB approval, meeting the requirements of the cloud, security and workplace (Entra ID / directory services) teams, and keep delivery aligned with the approved design.

 - Application Modernisation - Guide the transition of legacy applications to supported, cloud-native and maintainable architectures.

data.title: Member of Technical Staff - Kernel/BSP
data.description:
About Wind River

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. 

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company's software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We've achieved recent 5G milestones including the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone. 

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world. 

About The Role

As a Member of Technical Staff on the Wind River Linux team, you're the senior technical anchor for a safety-critical embedded Linux platform - and this is a build-and-decide role, not a keep-it-running one. You own the architecture-level calls across the Yocto build system, Linux kernel, and multiple BSPs; you drive where we go upstream; and you build the engineering workflows the whole team runs on. Yes, you'll keep the platform solid - but the reason this role exists is to move it forward: the tooling migration, the AI-native engineering stack, the upstream strategy, and the cross-layer problems no single track owner can close. 

You're the person the team leans on when a problem spans the kernel, the BSP, the build system, and a customer's field deployment all at once - and the one who decides how we solve that class of problem for good, not just this once. 

What You'll Do

Linux Kernel & Low-Level Development

- Drive determinism, real-time (PREEMPT_RT), and reliability improvements that hold up under safety-critical scrutiny - you set the technical bar here. 
 - Debug the deepest kernel, driver, networking, and boot issues across ARM/x86 (and PPC/RISC-V where relevant) with GDB, JTAG, ftrace, and perf. 
 - Own kernel maintenance across LTS lines as the baseline - backports, CVE remediation, -stable rebases, local-patch discipline - and, more importantly, decide the strategy that shrinks that burden over time. 

Multi-BSP & Yocto Build System

- Own the Yocto/OpenEmbedded architecture - layers, templates, recipe design, and the build-farm topology that produces the release matrix. 
 - Serve as the technical expert across multiple BSPs (Intel x86, ARM/Zynq MP, NXP i. MX, TI, NVIDIA Tegra, and the growing edge-AI board set): machine configs, kernel provider resolution, layer architecture, and platform bring-up.

data.title: AI Product Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

This role provides technical and delivery oversight across the IAIS (Industry AI Solutions) portfolio of AI / GenAI / Agentic AI solutions. The Product Engineering Lead assesses, solution by solution, whether each is being built as per the roadmap, at the expected quality, architecture and readiness, and then carries the best practices, reusable patterns and lessons from one solution to the others. 

The role sits at the intersection of product, engineering and delivery. It works with IAIS Product Managers on what the roadmap commits to, with solution delivery teams and architects on how it is being built, and with program governance on how progress is reported. When a delivery team hits an operational or technical problem, this role brings the right expertise and the proven fix, so the team keeps moving. 

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Review & Roadmap Conformance

- Review multiple IAIS solutions concurrently through a structured review cadence (design, build-progress, release-readiness and post-release reviews), judging each against its roadmap commitments, scope, timelines and quality bar. 
 - Detect drift early: identify slippage, scope creep, architectural deviation, dependency gaps and technical debt, and agree corrective actions with the Product Manager and delivery lead. 
 - Track portfolio health through a consistent set of delivery and engineering KPIs (roadmap adherence, release predictability, quality and defect trends, incident and cost trends) and publish a portfolio view for program governance and senior stakeholders. 

Technical Assurance

- Assess solution architecture and engineering practice for scalability, security, integration (including hyperscaler services), observability and maintainability. 
 - Apply AI / Agentic AI readiness checkpoints (evaluation metrics, guardrails and responsible-AI checks, quality gates, deployment and ops readiness) so that releases are repeatable and ship with confidence. 
 - Review operational risk: hallucination and quality issues, latency and token cost, data and integration failures, and production stability for solutions already live. 

Best-Practice Translation & Enablement

- Identify what works in one solution (architecture patterns, evaluation approaches, prompt/agent design, LLMOps and CI/CD practices, accelerators) and translate it into reusable playbooks, reference architectures and standards for the other solutions. 
 - Spread learning across teams by running communities of practice, review forums and targeted coaching for delivery leads and engineers on GenAI / Agentic AI engineering and delivery. 
 - Help teams solve operational problems as and when they arise by pointing them to proven solutions, bringing in subject-matter experts, and capturing the resolution for the wider portfolio. 

Stakeholder & Team Leadership

- Work with IAIS Product Managers and delivery leads to align roadmap, technical feasibility and delivery priorities, and to surface cross-solution dependencies and shared-platform needs. 
 - Guide and mentor the solution delivery leads and architects across the portfolio; set expectations on delivery discipline and engineering quality, and give feedback on their performance. 
 - Escalate clearly: raise risks and decisions with options and recommendations to program governance and senior leadership. 

Qualifications

Must have

- BE/B. Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field; MBA / PG is a plus. 
 - 12+ years in IT services, product engineering or platform delivery, with a progression through developer, architect and delivery roles; has led or overseen more than one solution or team at a time. 
 - Strong technical grounding, enough to challenge architecture, code quality and engineering practice credibly: APIs and microservices, data pipelines, CI/CD, containers, observability and security. 
 - Working knowledge of at least one major hyperscaler's cloud and AI services and how they integrate with enterprise systems. 
 - Working knowledge of GenAI / Agentic AI solutions in production: LLM integration, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation and guardrails, LLMOps. 
 - Experience running review and governance mechanisms (design reviews, stage gates, release-readiness checks) across several concurrent programs. 
 - Proven ability to codify and transfer best practices across teams, such as playbooks, standards and reference architectures. 

Good to have

- Experience in a product-company or product-engineering environment, working with product managers on roadmaps and releases. 
 - Experience with LLMOps/MLOps, model-evaluation tooling and agent interoperability standards (e. g. MCP). 
 - Hyperscaler AI certification(s) and/or PMP / Scrum / SAFe certification. 
 - Exposure to responsible-AI, data privacy and compliance requirements for enterprise AI. 

Expected Impact

- Solutions across the IAIS portfolio are built as per roadmap, with early detection of drift and fewer late surprises. 
 - Consistent engineering quality and release readiness across solutions, rather than strong in some and weak in others. 
 - Best practices and lessons learned travel quickly between solutions, reducing rework and raising team capability. 
 - Delivery teams resolve operational and technical problems faster because proven fixes and experts are readily available. 
 - Stakeholders have a single, credible, KPI-driven view of portfolio delivery health. 

Skills

Solution Portfolio Review, Roadmap Conformance Tracking, Technical Assurance, GenAI / Agentic AI Architecture Understanding, Hyperscaler / Cloud Integration, Best-Practice Codification, Delivery Governance, Technical Problem Solving, Coaching & Mentoring, Product-Engineering Partnership, Risk/Issue Management, KPI & Metrics Reporting, Stakeholder Management

data.title: ADAS Architect - Simulation, Data & Verification Platform
data.description:
About The Team

You will join a focused team of domain experts building a greenfield, in-house L2+ ADAS software stack for Indian road conditions, covering four-wheelers and two-wheelers. The team designs and owns the complete architecture, algorithms, and tooling, from first principles through to deployment on automotive-grade ECUs. Engineers here shape foundational technical decisions, work directly with experts across perception, fusion, driving functions, motion control, and simulation, and see their work carried from concept to vehicle. 

Role purpose

The Simulation, Data & Verification Platform Architect defines and builds the engineering platform on which every ADAS algorithm in the organization is developed, verified, and released. This is not the integration or configuration of an existing framework: the role creates, from the ground up, a proprietary simulation engine and developer application, the automated verification and reporting system that runs on it, and the data platform that feeds both, from recorded vehicle data through labelling to cloud-scale execution. 

The platform is the primary evidence base for every function, before and after vehicles are available. Its correctness, determinism, and traceability directly determine the credibility of every result the organization reports. The role calls for a senior architect with deep software engineering skill, strong automotive domain understanding, and a record of building platforms that entire engineering teams depend on. 

Key Responsibilities

Simulation engine and developer application

- Architect and build a proprietary simulation engine that executes any algorithm component delivered as a host-agnostic C-API library, discovering the component's ports and configuration at run time rather than through hand-written integration. 
 - Define the execution model: closed-loop simulation, deterministic resimulation against recorded data, and pure replay as distinct, well-defined modes; multi-rate scheduling; and multi-component pipelines in which any stage can run live, stubbed, or injected from a recording. 
 - Design and build the interactive developer application: timeline and transport control, 2D/3D scene view, signal plots, port and message inspection, layer-based visualization contributed by each component as plug-ins, and side-by-side comparison of runs. 
 - Guarantee traceability: every value displayed or reported is traceable to the recording, message, build, and configuration that produced it, and the headless command-line interface produces answers identical to the GUI. 
 - Establish determinism as a measured property: bit-exact resimulation within and across processes, and tracked, explained differences across builds and machines. 
 - Provide process isolation, timeouts, and crash capture so that a failing component never takes down a run or a campaign. 
 - Integrate external simulators and scenario tools (e. g. , CarMaker, CARLA, esmini) through codecs and adapters, without coupling any algorithm component to a specific tool. 

Automated verification and reporting framework

- Design and build, from zero, the automated test framework that runs scenario campaigns on the simulation engine: scenario definitions with machine-checkable acceptance criteria, parameter sweeps, and NCAP-based and India-specific scenario libraries. 
 - Build automated reporting for every campaign: per-scenario verdicts with evidence, function KPIs, coverage against requirements, trend and regression tracking, and drill-down from any failed case to the exact moment in the recording. 
 - Implement regression gates in CI that block a change when a KPI, scenario outcome, or determinism check regresses. 
 - Link verification results to requirements so that traceability and coverage reports are generated automatically, never maintained by hand. 

Data platform: recordings, storage, labelling, and cloud execution

- Define the recording data model and formats (e. g. , MCAP, MDF4, rosbag), including embedded schemas and provenance (vehicle, sensor set, software build, configuration, and scenario identity). 
 - Architect storage and data management for large volumes of vehicle recordings: ingestion from test vehicles, indexing, metadata and search, retention, dataset versioning, and access control. 
 - Establish labelling and annotation pipelines for ground truth: tool selection or development, auto-labelling, quality control, annotation specifications, and management of external annotation vendors. 
 - Build scenario extraction and mining from recorded data, turning field drives into reusable, parameterized test scenarios. 
 - Architect cloud and cluster execution of resimulation and scenario campaigns at scale (thousands of runs), including job orchestration, containerization, cost control, and reproducibility of every run. 

Technical leadership

- Own the technical roadmap of the platform and make build-versus-buy decisions with clear justification. 
 - Set engineering standards for the platform: code quality, testing, documentation, and backward compatibility of interfaces. 
 - Work with algorithm, perception, test, and integration teams as internal customers, and with the ECU-in-the-Loop Test & Release Architect so that SIL, HIL, and vehicle results share one reporting system. 
 - Mentor engineers and, as the platform grows, build and lead the team around it. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree (PhD a plus) in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related discipline. 
 - 7-15 years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years architecting simulation, SIL/HIL, data, or verification platforms for ADAS, autonomous driving, or robotics. 
 - Demonstrated design and delivery, from scratch, of a simulation or resimulation platform adopted as the primary development and regression tool of an engineering organization. 
 - Expert-level C++ (C++17) and Python: C ABIs, dynamic library loading, plug-in architectures, cross-language bindings, and performance-critical, multi-threaded code on Windows and Linux. 
 - Experience building desktop engineering applications with rich visualization (e. g. , Qt, Dear ImGui, OpenGL/Vulkan, or equivalent). 
 - Deep knowledge of recorded-data formats and large-scale handling of automotive sensor data (camera, radar, lidar, vehicle bus). 
 - Hands-on experience with ground-truth labelling and annotation workflows for ADAS data, including quality metrics. 
 - Proven experience with cloud or cluster execution (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, containerized batch workloads) for simulation or data processing at scale. 
 - Strong knowledge of build, packaging, and CI (CMake, Conan or equivalent, and modern CI systems). 
 - Experience with schema-driven interfaces (e. g. , Protocol Buffers) and long-term interface versioning. 
 - Working knowledge of ADAS function behaviour, NCAP test protocols, and scenario-based testing (ASAM OpenSCENARIO / OpenDRIVE). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building a scenario-mining or data-driven test-generation pipeline from fleet or test-vehicle data. 
 - Experience with auto-labelling using offline perception models. 
 - Experience with verification in regulated contexts (ISO 26262, ISO 21448 SOTIF, ASPICE) and with tool qualification. 
 - Contributions to open-source simulation, robotics, or data tooling. 
 - Experience leading or growing a platform team. 
 - Advanced use of AI-assisted software development tools to accelerate platform development. 

Key competencies

- Ability to explain complex trade-offs clearly to engineers and leadership to drive technical decisions. 
 - Architectural judgement: designs that stay simple as components, functions, and data volumes grow by orders of magnitude. 
 - Uncompromising rigor in determinism, traceability, and reproducibility: a result that cannot be traced is not accepted as a result. 
 - A product mindset toward internal tools: engineers adopt the platform because it is the fastest way to work, not because it is mandated. 
 - Ownership from first design to organization-wide daily use, without reliance on handoffs. 
 - Ability to build new systems where architecture and processes are still being defined, and to make them the reference for the organization. 
 - Clear technical communication with engineers, architects, and management. 

L&T Company Overview / About Us

L&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer-focussed approach and the constant quest for top-class quality have enabled L&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades. 

Given L&T's capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well-established capabilities in L&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics & Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design & Manufacturing (ESDM). The focus products under Automotive Electronics are ADAS, Electrification & Connectivity related products.

data.description:
Creative Technologist, AI Studio

Workflow Automation

- Generative AI

The Opportunity

Adobe's AI Studio partners with the world's leading brands to produce campaign creative at scale. Creative Technologists are the builders at the center of that production engine - designing and maintaining the automated workflows that allow our Creative Designers to move faster, produce more, and focus on what only humans can do. 

As Creative Technologist, you will architect and operate the technical infrastructure behind AI Studio's creative production workflows. You bring deep hands-on fluency in ComfyUI, Weavy, and other node based design apps. and you know how to stitch those tools together into production-grade systems that scale. You are equally comfortable in a technical build session and a customer conversation , and you take personal ownership of the reliability and quality of everything you ship. 

What You'll Do

Build and Operate Production Workflows

- Design, build, and maintain automated creative production workflows. 
 - Architect end-to-end pipelines that integrate generative AI outputs into brand-compliant, activation-ready creative assets. 
 - Develop and maintain reusable workflow components, node libraries, and prompt templates that accelerate production across the team. 
 - Optimize pipelines for throughput and consistency, enabling high-volume variant production across formats, channels, and aspect ratios. 
 - Monitor workflow performance, diagnose failures, and continuously improve reliability and output quality. 

Collaborate with Creative and Operations Teams

- Partner closely with Creative Designers, Motion Designers, and Content Operations Leads to translate campaign briefs into automated production pipelines. 
 - Serve as the technical bridge between creative intent and workflow execution - ensuring that automated outputs meet the quality bar set by the creative team. 
 - Document workflows, configurations, and best practices so the full team can build on and maintain your work. 
 - Contribute to a growing internal knowledge base of workflow patterns, prompting strategies, and tooling integrations. 

Partner with Customers and Inform the Product

- Engage directly with customer counterparts to understand technical requirements and configure workflows that meet their brand and production standards. 
 - Present workflow logic and capabilities clearly to non-technical stakeholders, translating complexity into confidence. 
 - Provide structured feedback on Adobe tools and adjacent tools to help inform Adobe's product roadmap. 
 - Stay current on emerging tools and techniques - and bring what's working back to the team. 

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in creative technology, workflow automation, or a related technical role - agency, in-house, or production studio environments all translate well. 
 - Hands-on proficiency with ComfyUI, including custom node development, pipeline design, and troubleshooting. 
 - Fluency in Adobe Creative Cloud; working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and related tools as workflow inputs and outputs. 
 - Solid understanding of generative AI models, image generation pipelines, and prompt engineering best practices. 
 - Ability to read and write code sufficient for workflow scripting and automation - Python, JavaScript, or equivalent is a strong plus. 
 - Experience integrating APIs and third-party tools into production pipelines. 
 - Strong communication skills across creative, technical, and business audiences. 
 - A high bar for quality and a sense of ownership over the systems and outputs you build. 
 - Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities and tight timelines. 
 - Experience in digital marketing, campaign production, or creative operations is a strong plus. 

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 

Let's Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create. 

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more. 

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe. com.

data.description:
IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters-at the Moment of ServiceTM. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge. 

At IFS, we're flexible, we're innovative, and we're focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society's greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust. 

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view. 

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world. 

We're looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference. 

If you want to change the status quo, we'll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS. 

Job Description

About IFS Logistics

IFS Logistics helps enterprise shippers connect transport data, manage carrier spend and automate execution. The product began as 7bridges and is now part of IFS, with a small team building and running it. 

The role

We are hiring two Tech Onboarding Engineers for six-month fixed-term roles, starting as soon as possible. You will connect carriers and providers, bring customer data into the platform and help named customers reach production while the core squads continue building longer-term foundations. 

The work is hands-on integration engineering. You will deal with ERP exports, shipment files, invoices, APIs and third-party feeds that are rarely as clean or stable as their documentation suggests. 

The goal is not simply to process more onboarding work. When the same manual step appears repeatedly, you will turn it into a template, configuration option, self-service tool or well-defined product change. By the end of the contract, the platform should need less manual onboarding than it did when you joined. 

This is a genuine six-month engagement with no implied permanent conversion. 

What you'll work on

- Connect new carriers and providers through APIs and file feeds, including credentials, testing and go-live support. 
 - Map, clean and validate customer ERP exports, shipment files and invoices into our data model. 
 - Own onboarding tasks for named customers against clear delivery dates. 
 - Support the Product Operations team as they onboard customers and handle master data management. 
 - Diagnose failures involving authentication, pagination, rate limits, schema changes and poor source data. 
 - Convert repeated manual steps into reusable templates, configuration or self-service tooling. 
 - Document integrations and failure modes so the core squads can support them after the contract ends. 

Qualifications

What we're looking for

- Around two to five years of hands-on software or integration engineering experience. 
 - Python and enough SQL to investigate data properly. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, authentication, pagination, retries and rate limits. 
 - Confidence working with inconsistent third-party data, including missing fields, changing schemas and bad encodings. 
 - A track record of automating repeated work rather than quietly absorbing it. 
 - The ability to run a technical working session with a customer's team and communicate data problems clearly. 
 - Regular use of AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude, with a reliable process for checking output. 
 - The ability to organise your own work and become productive quickly in a time-boxed engagement. Nice to have

- Logistics, freight, parcel or supply-chain data experience. 
 - BigQuery, dbt or comparable data-warehouse tooling. 
 - EDI or carrier and 3PL integrations. 
 - Previous onboarding or implementation engineering in a SaaS company. Tech stack

Python and Django REST, TypeScript, Node and React; BigQuery, dbt, Cube Cloud and Superset; Pub/Sub and Datastream; GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform and GitLab CI/CD. We use Cursor and Claude for development, Notion for specifications and Jira for delivery. 

What success looks like in the first six months

- The named customers assigned to you are live on time. 
 - New carrier and provider integrations are running with their known failure modes documented. 
 - At least two previously manual onboarding steps have become self-service or automated. 
 - The permanent squads have a clear, usable handover for every integration you owned. Why we're hiring now

Customer and carrier onboarding demand is higher than the core squads can absorb while they improve the platform itself. These roles provide immediate delivery capacity and turn the lessons from current onboardings into better tooling for the next ones. 

Additional Information

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

Job Title: Sr. /Jr. Business Analyst Tester

Department: ITG FRS

About Business line/Function: Under BNP Paribas IT Group, ITTF FRS is the IT framework encompassing Projects & Systems of Finance and RISK functions, with a strong focus on efficiency, proximity, agility and time-to-market. 

FRS is a worldwide organizational model that will contribute to tackle major challenges of the Group's transformation of today and tomorrow, building the best offering to the Finance and Risk Community through a progressive rotation to new technologies and best practices. The FRS organization is the outcome of several convergences: between the Project & Systems teams of Group Finance, CIB Finance and RISK and their related IT teams. 

FRS is part of the IT Group organization (ITG in Europe and ITO overseas) with a threefold sponsorship by ITG, Finance and RISK (CIB-ITO; RISK Solutions and ITG-FIT). 

Position Purpose: Shared Data Ecosystem (SDE) is an ITG-FRS department hosting various applications relating to the "filière unique program" in charge of collecting Accounting and Risk data from local entities in an unique stream. 

The beneficiary wishes to receive a service agreement to participate in a new project for an existing tool, ASTERIA. This project aims to build a full non regression test set and carry on the automatization of tests via Robot Framework tool. 

ASTERIA is used for data consolidation purposes. It allows the production of final templates requested by the different regulators while meeting all their requirements. 

ASTERIA respond in an industrialized manner to the need of coordination and multi-source data collection. It helps producing complex regulatory reporting to regulators via internal data validation workflow and several types of integrated controls

ASTERIA application is getting bigger every year and as for now no specific tool is used yet to perform non regression tests. 

The team evolves into a dynamic, international working environment that listens to "new ways of working". 

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

The prerequisite for this mission is a high level of English. 

As a Business Analyst on this project, you will participate in every non-regression test campaign with the Paris BA team. You will also carry on implementing Robot Framework with the new functionalities developed and finally you will be in charge to set up all our test sets into a dedicated tool. 

- Implementation of the non-regression test: 
 - Build strong skills on ASTERIA
 - Find the appropriate tool, authorized by BNP Paribas, to set up our non-regression test
 - Write the test strategies
 - Run the test campaign
 - Participate to functional tests: 
 - Participate to the test of the full application
 - Defining a full test strategy
 - Implement in Robot Framework: 
 - Decrease the backlog of pending test creation
 - Writing new test

- SQL

Experience in Finance/ Accounting domain as a Business Analyst

Contribute to overall FRS as directed by Team and Department Management.

You're rigorous, you know how to adapt. You can take initiatives and work as a team and collaborate across the board. 

You are capable of analysis as well as synthesis and are organized. You have the ability to work in English and produce high quality deliverables. 

If, by the way, you are customer-oriented and have an impact, then this job is done for you!

This position will enable you to interact with a large number of IT Group stakeholders, as well as with all the Group's businesses, entities and reporting channels. 

You will strengthen your project management skills by being a major project player, multi-actor and multi-stream, but also develop your financial management knowledge. 

Other competencies

- Computer knowledge

Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)

BNP Paribas is the European Union's leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185, 000 employees, including more than 145, 000 in Europe. data.title: Data Center PMS - Project Technical Lead
data.description:
Job Description

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

You will lead the engineering, development, integration, testing, and commissioning of advanced Data Center PMS/ECMS solutions for AI-ready, mission-critical facilities with onsite generation and complex electrical distribution systems. 

- Review customer specifications, SLDs, protection schemes, AI workload profiles, generator operating philosophy, and power management requirements. 
 - Design PMS/ECMS architectures, DCS control strategies, network topologies, and system integration approaches for high-density data center electrical infrastructure. 
 - Develop, configure, and tune Ovation DCS databases, control logic, graphics, alarms, trends, displays, and operator interfaces for PMS applications. 
 - Engineer advanced load management functions including AI peak demand control, priority-based load shedding, load restoration, load sharing, islanding, black start, bus transfer, and demand management. 
 - Develop complex load bus management schemes for multiple electrical buses, generators, transformers, switchgear lineups, UPS/BESS interfaces, and critical/non-critical load groups. 
 - Engineer and validate multi-generator synchronization, load sharing, generator sequencing, spinning reserve logic, and transitions between grid-connected, islanded, and backup operating modes. 
 - Integrate generators, switchgear, substations, transformers, protective relays, RTACs, meters, UPS, BESS, renewable energy systems, and utility/grid interfaces. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot IEC 61850, Modbus, OPC UA, DNP3, and related communication protocols used for power system automation and electrical asset integration. 
 - Prepare engineering deliverables including PMS philosophy, FDS, logic narratives, cause-and-effect matrices, I/O lists, communication documents, simulation plans, and test procedures. 
 - Execute simulation, FAT, SAT, system integration, commissioning, startup, performance tuning, and customer acceptance testing for PMS/ECMS systems. 
 - Lead system power-up, redundancy testing, communication verification, functional testing, failure-mode testing, and validation of electrical operating scenarios. 
 - Coordinate with customers, consultants, vendors, project teams, and subcontractors while ensuring compliance with project requirements, quality standards, industry codes, and mission-critical uptime expectations. 

Who You Are: 

You should be able to assume responsibility for the outcomes of others . Promotes a sense of urgency and establishes and enforces individual accountability in the team. You should be able to deliver messages in a clear, compelling, and concise manner. Actively listens and checks for understanding. Sets aggressive goals and has high standards. You should be consistently one of the top performers. Pursues everything with energy, drive, and the need to finish as per business needs. 

For This Role, You Will Need: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Instrumentation & Control, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Five (5) to Twelve (12) years of experience in PMS, ECMS, EMS, DCS, SCADA, microgrid, or power system automation projects. 
 - Strong understanding of data center electrical infrastructure, AI/high-density load behavior, onsite power generation, UPS/BESS systems, and grid-connected or islanded operating modes. 
 - Hands-on experience developing, configuring, testing, and tuning DCS-based PMS or load management applications. 
 - Knowledge of demand control, priority-based load shedding, load restoration, load sharing, bus load management, generator sequencing, and spinning reserve logic. 
 - Experience with synchronization of multiple generators and operation of electrical systems across grid-connected, islanded, standby, and black-start scenarios. 
 - Strong knowledge of electrical power generation, distribution, protection, metering, switchgear, transformers, substations, and control systems. 
 - Ability to interpret SLDs, protection drawings, control schematics, communication architectures, I/O lists, and cause-and-effect requirements. 
 - Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as IEC 61850, Modbus, OPC UA, DNP3, and related automation networks. 
 - Hands-on experience in simulation, FAT, SAT, commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, and performance tuning for mission-critical power control systems. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and customer-facing skills with the ability to lead technical discussions and resolve complex site issues. 
 - Willingness to travel for project execution, commissioning, customer acceptance testing, and site support. 

Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart: 

- Deep experience with Data Center PMS/ECMS, microgrid, hybrid EMS, and DCS/SCADA solutions for mission-critical or high-availability facilities. 
 - Practical understanding of AI data center power behavior, including fast load ramps, high-density compute loads, power quality impacts, and coordination between utility supply, onsite generation, UPS, BESS, and critical load blocks. 
 - Proven expertise in developing and tuning advanced load management applications, including AI peak demand control, priority-based load shedding, load restoration, bus load management, power sharing, and islanding logic. 
 - Hands-on experience with multi-generator synchronization, generator sequencing, spinning reserve, black start, load sharing, and transitions between grid-connected, islanded, and backup power modes. 
 - Experience with Emerson OvationTM, SEL RTAC, protective relay integration, IEC 61850 engineering, and equivalent IED/substation automation architectures. 
 - Strong knowledge of AIS/GIS substations, switchyards, medium-voltage and low-voltage switchgear, generator controls, AVRs, synchronization systems, and utility/grid interconnection requirements. 
 - Experience integrating UPS, BESS, renewable sources, backup generation, fuel systems, meters, protection relays, and electrical monitoring devices into centralized PMS/ECMS platforms. 
 - Working knowledge of IEEE, IEC, NEC, NFPA, data center reliability practices, utility grid codes, and mission-critical electrical safety requirements. 
 - Knowledge of industrial cybersecurity principles for DCS, SCADA, substation automation, and mission-critical power control systems. 
 - Experience leading simulation, digital testing, integrated FAT, SAT, commissioning, performance tuning, and customer acceptance testing for complex PMS/ECMS projects. 
 - Ability to develop software design documentation, control narratives, test scripts, failure-mode scenarios, and validation plans for load management and generator control functions. 
 - Familiarity with programming or scripting languages such as C, C++, Python, or structured control logic used in automation and power management applications.

data.title: AI Automation Engineer
data.description:
JoVE is the world-leading video platform for scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1, 000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Harvard, MIT, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. 

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on AI Automation Engineer to build and manage integrations, automations, and internal tools that connect Salesforce, HubSpot, and internal business systems. You will own the cross-platform engineering layer, ensuring seamless data flow, transformation, and synchronization across systems. The ideal candidate combines strong Python programming, API integration, workflow automation, database management, and practical AI engineering experience to turn business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 

Responsibilities

- Develop integrations between Salesforce, HubSpot, and internal systems using REST APIs. 
 - Build n8n workflows for data synchronization, enrichment, lead routing, and automation. 
 - Write Python scripts for data processing and automation. 
 - Develop AI-powered tools using Claude and Open AI APIs. 
 - Build database-backed dashboards and reporting tools. 
 - Own projects from requirements gathering through deployment and improvement. 

Requirements

- 5-6 years of experience in software, data, automation, or integration engineering. 
 - Minimum 2 years of experience in RevOps, GTM, or business systems. 
 - Strong Python programming and REST API integration skills. 
 - Hands-on production experience with n8n automation workflows. 
 - Experience building applications using OpenAI or Claude APIs. 
 - Strong SQL and database knowledge (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or BigQuery). 
 - Familiarity with Salesforce and HubSpot data models. 
 - Knowledge of Git, Docker, environment management, and deployment. 
 - Ability to independently manage projects from requirements to production. 

Benefits

- A competitive compensation package. 
 - We are fully remote!
 - You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education. 
 - Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. 
 - Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

data.description:
ADAS Architect - Front Safety Functions

Department

ADAS Algorithms - Driving Functions

Location

Bengaluru

Employment type

Full-time, permanent

Experience

7-15 years

About The Team

You will join a focused team of domain experts building a greenfield, in-house L2+ ADAS software stack for Indian road conditions, covering four-wheelers and two-wheelers. The team designs and owns the complete architecture, algorithms, and tooling, from first principles through to deployment on automotive-grade ECUs. Engineers here shape foundational technical decisions, work directly with experts across perception, fusion, driving functions, motion control, and simulation, and see their work carried from concept to vehicle. 

Role purpose

The Front Safety Architect leads the concept, architecture, and algorithm development of forward-facing safety functions: Autonomous Emergency Braking (AEB), Forward Collision Warning (FCW), Lane Departure Warning (LDW), and Front Cross-Traffic Alert (FCTA). The role spans the full development lifecycle, from requirements and algorithm design through simulation-based validation, embedded implementation, and in-vehicle tuning. 

Key responsibilities

- Define the functional architecture for the Front Safety function family, including a shared critical-object-selection core and arbitration of warning and braking requests. 
 - Design and implement algorithms for critical object selection, threat assessment, and multi-stage intervention (warning, brake prefill, partial and full braking). 
 - Develop lane departure warning logic that is robust to degraded , missing, and non-standard lane markings. 
 - Develop cross-traffic alert logic for junction and turning scenarios. 
 - Derive stakeholder, system, and software requirements with measurable acceptance criteria, and ensure full traceability to verification. 
 - Define scenario catalogues for validation, covering NCAP protocols and India-specific traffic situations. 
 - Validate functions in closed-loop simulation and through resimulation of recorded vehicle data. 
 - Implement production-grade algorithms in C++ and support integration on target ECUs. 
 - Scale functions across four-wheeler and two-wheeler variants from a common architecture. 
 - Define and track KPIs: detection rate, false-activation rate, warning time, and speed reduction. 
 - Contribute to safety analysis in line with ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 (SOTIF). 
 - Author technical proposals and roadmaps for Front Safety functions. 
 - Provide technical guidance, design reviews, and mentoring. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree (PhD a plus ) in a relevant discipline. 
 - 7-15 years of experience in ADAS algorithm development. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of AEB, FCW, LDW, or cross-traffic alert functions. 
 - Strong knowledge of collision-avoidance methods. 
 - Experience with object selection under real sensor limitations. 
 - Working knowledge of Euro NCAP / Bharat NCAP protocols and UN R152, UN R130. 
 - Working knowledge of ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 (SOTIF). 
 - Proficiency in C++ and Python. 
 - Experience with CarMaker , CARLA, or similar simulation environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with ADAS SoCs such as TI Jacinto/TDA or Renesas R-Car. 
 - Experience designing shared object-selection or arbitration layers. 
 - Experience with two-wheeler ADAS or mixed traffic. 
 - Patents or publications in collision avoidance. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted software development tools. 

Key competencies

- Ability to explain complex trade-offs clearly. 
 - First-principles problem solving. 
 - Ownership from concept to vehicle. 
 - Comfort building new systems. 
 - Experimental and evidence-driven mindset. 
 - Clear cross-functional communication. 

L&T Company Overview / About Us

L&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer- focussed approach and the constant quest for top-class quality have enabled L&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades. 

Given L&T's capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well-established capabilities in L&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics & Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design & Manufacturing (ESDM). The focus products under Automotive Electronics are ADAS, Electrification & Connectivity related products.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

PMTS SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER

The Role

As a member of Circuit Technologies (CT) Team, you will architect, develop, and lead the DFT Design and Integration of cutting edge DFT structures including SCAN, ATPG, MBIST, BSCAN. In this role, you will work with the lead SoC/chiplet and IP architects to define future DFx architectures and contribute to product specifications, micro-architecture specifications, performance, and power trade-offs. The role will work from early concept development through the development phases to final production. 

THE PERSON: 

In this role, you will collaborate with a network of expert architects and designers around the world where collaboration and communication skills are critical to the success of this role, and excellent organization skills are essential. You will approach sophisticated problems with a firm methodology and problem-solving technique and conduct experiments and analysis to formulate recommendations and next steps for other colleagues, and SOC/chiplet and IP design teams located in across multiple time zones and geographies. You will formally present your findings to co-workers, teams, and customer engineering teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop next-generation SoC/chiplet and IP debug and observability solutions that enable secure, scalable, and robust silicon bring-up, validation, and post-silicon debug. 
 - Partner with architecture and SoC/chiplet and IP design teams to define and execute a comprehensive Design-for-Excellence (DFX) strategy spanning debug, test, validation, reliability, and manufacturability. 
 - Collaborate with technology, silicon validation, product engineering, and manufacturing teams to establish DFX architectures that support both functional operating modes and manufacturing test requirements. 
 - Drive cross-functional alignment on DFX requirements, use cases, and end-to-end implementation flows across AMD engineering organizations. 
 - Evaluate and deploy AI-driven methodologies to streamline DFX planning, insertion, verification, coverage analysis, and implementation, improving quality, consistency, and scalability while reducing manual effort and time-to-deployment. 
 - Define metrics, methodologies, and automation frameworks to ensure DFX solutions meet product quality, testability, debug, and production readiness objectives across multiple programs and technology generations. 

Preferred Experience

- 10+ years of experience in SoC/chiplet and IP design, DFX architecture, or related silicon development disciplines. 
 - Strong understanding of DFX implementation and integration within complex, large-scale SoC/chiplet architectures. 
 - Deep knowledge of DFT methodologies and infrastructure, including scan, ATPG, MBIST, JTAG 1149. x/boundary scan, and advanced debug and test features. 
 - Solid understanding of SoC clocking, reset, power management, and low-power design architectures. 
 - Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse engineering teams and disciplines.
