data.title: Materials Sourcing/Production Manager - Linen
data.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. 

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver. 

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before. 

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. 
 - Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
 - Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. 

THE ROLE

Material Sourcing / Production Manager - Linen (India)

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Fiber Inventory & Quality Control

- Oversee linen fiber inventory levels to ensure adequate supply for spinning schedules while minimizing waste and overstock. 
 - Inspect and verify that only quality fiber-meeting specified micron, length, and color consistency standards-is released into the spinning process. 
 - Implement checkpoints to catch non-conforming fiber before production begins, preventing downstream defects. 
 - Coordinate with sourcing and warehouse teams to maintain accurate inventory records and proper storage conditions for raw linen. 

On-Time Delivery (OTD) Management

- Own fiber OTD performance, tracking delivery timelines from suppliers to spinning mills and flagging potential delays. 
 - Prolinenly manage production schedules to ensure fiber is available when needed, communicating risks to cross-functional partners. 
 - Resolve supply interruptions by expediting shipments or reallocating inventory as necessary to meet production deadlines. 
 - Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for supplier lead times and delivery reliability. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Coordinate with planners and production team to align fiber availability with production demand and spinning schedules. 
 - Collaborate with R&D, Product Development, and Sourcing teams to support seamless production handoffs. 
 - Provide input on fiber purchasing decisions based on production capacity, lead times, and quality performance history. 
 - Escalate production blockers (e. g. , fiber shortages, quality holds) with recommended solutions to meet OTD goals. 

Spinning & Production Support

- Partner with spinning mills to ensure fiber lots are processed according to technical specifications and quality expectations. 
 - Monitor fiber consumption during spinning to identify discrepancies, yield loss, or quality deviations. 
 - Work upstream with suppliers to align fiber bale composition, lot sizing, and traceability for smoother mill integration. 
 - Maintain clear documentation of fiber lots, test results, and production flow to support traceability and continuous improvement. 

QUALIFICATIONS

- Education: Degree in Textile Engineering, Material Science, Supply Chain, or a related field. 
 - Production Experience: Proven experience managing raw materials in a textile or apparel production environment, preferably with linen or other luxury fibers. 
 - Quality Focus: Strong ability to assess fiber quality and enforce standards before spinning. 
 - Inventory & OTD Acumen: Demonstrated skill in tracking inventory levels and driving on-time delivery performance. 
 - Analytical Skills: Ability to use data to monitor fiber usage, identify yield issues, and improve production flow. 
 - Collaboration: Experience working with spinning mills, suppliers, planners, and internal production teams to resolve issues quickly. 

Preferred: 

- Experience with linen fiber grading, testing, or lot management. 
 - Knowledge of spinning mill operations and fiber-to-yarn conversion. 
 - Familiarity with inventory management systems or ERP tools. 
 - Understanding of sustainable fiber sourcing and production practices. 

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis. 

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom-never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

data.title: Advance Quality Planning Engineer
data.description:
Your Job: As a Design AQP Engineer at Molex, you will lead Advanced Product Quality Planning (AQP/APQP) activities for new product designs and design changes from concept through production launch. You will ensure robust manufacturability, compliance with customer and regulatory requirements, and predictable quality performance by managing design risks, verification activities, quality deliverables, and corrective actions. 

Our Team: You will be part of the DSS Quality Team (AQP), You will partner with Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, Procurement, Program Management, and global technical teams. Together, the team develops reliable, manufacturable products by applying structured quality planning, design verification, supplier collaboration, and continuous-improvement methods. 

What You Will Do

- Lead AQP/APQP activities for assigned design programs from concept through production launch and initial production. 
 - Develop, maintain, and close design-quality deliverables, including DFMEA, Design Verification Plans and Reports (DVP&R), control plans, Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) packages, and engineering-change documentation. 
 - Facilitate cross-functional design reviews, DFMEA workshops, DVP&R reviews, and design-gate assessments to ensure deliverables are complete and risks are addressed. 
 - Translate customer, regulatory, safety, and product requirements into clear design-verification and validation plans. 
 - Support dimensional analysis, tolerance assessments, GD&T reviews, prototype builds, and testing to validate designs against functional and manufacturing requirements. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis of design and test failures using structured methods such as 8D and 5-Why, document findings, and drive corrective and preventive actions to closure. 
 - Support supplier selection, Supplier Risk assessments, sourcing decisions, and supplier PPAP activities for design components. 
 - Track and communicate program-quality metrics, including PPAP status, open DFMEA actions, verification progress, and risk-mitigation plans, to program leadership. 
 - Guide and mentor engineers in quality tools, technical documentation, problem solving, and design-quality practices while demonstrating ownership and cross-functional leadership. 

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Manufacturing, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - 6-8 years of Quality engineering experience, including at least 3-4 years executing APQP/AQP or equivalent product-quality planning in design-focused programs. 
 - Demonstrated experience with DFMEA, PFMEA, control plans, DVP&R, PPAP, and design-verification processes. 
 - Strong knowledge of GD&T, tolerance analysis, design for manufacturability (DFM), and root-cause analysis methods. 
 - Experience applying quality tools such as 8D, 5-Why, FMEA, statistical process control (SPC), and measurement system analysis (MSA). 
 - Familiarity with CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, or CATIA and familiarity with PLM or QMS systems. 
 - Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence without direct authority, and drive consensus and results. 
 - Experience collaborating with global stakeholders to resolve technical issues and implement sustainable corrective actions. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to manage competing priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and drive projects independently with a strong bias for action. 
 - Demonstrated leadership, initiative, and ability to coach or mentor engineers on technical skills and documentation. 

What Will Put You Ahead

- Advanced degree (MS) in a relevant engineering discipline. 
 - ASQ CQE or CQA, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, or formal APQP/PFMEA certification or training. 
 - Experience in automotive, electronic equipment, heavy equipment, aerospace, or another highly regulated manufacturing industry. 
 - Experience in PCB manufacturing and knowledge of signal-integrity parameters. 
 - Supplier-quality, supplier-development, and sourcing-collaboration experience. 
 - Experience using Excel, Minitab, Power BI, or similar tools for data analysis and quality reporting. 
 - Experience leading value-improvement or continuous-improvement initiatives across global engineering and manufacturing teams

Who We Are: 

As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading-edge

data.title: Manager Data Science
data.description:
Manager - Data Science

About Doceree

Doceree is the world's only AI-powered Operating System for healthcare marketing. We aim to be a catalyst for change, improving healthcare by enabling more meaningful interactions with HCPs. Our patented AI brings deeper context to every HCP touchpoint-understanding who HCPs are, what they're exploring, how they engage, and when they make decisions, all in a privacy-compliant way. With this enriched context, every message becomes clearer, more relevant, and more likely to drive better healthcare outcomes. 

In our journey of 5 years, we have earned four patents for innovation and even won a Silver award at the Cannes Lions, one of the world's top advertising honors. Over the years, we've also had the opportunity to work with 115+ pharma companies and collaborate with 30+ media publications, 150+ EHR platforms, 2, 000+ publisher networks, and 35+ hospitals and health systems. Our ecosystem connects us with more than 6 million verified doctors worldwide. Today, Doceree operates across 25+ countries, with teams based in New Jersey, London, and India. 

Our Core Belief

Technology can connect the fragmented healthcare ecosystem to deliver information when it is most needed to improve patients' outcomes. 

We are expanding our footprints across the globe and enhancing our services, offering, and developing new products and solutions to address the unmet needs of industry. Doceree is operating in 22 countries currently with offices in US, UK and India. 

Website http: //www. doceree. com/

Social media link https: //www. linkedin. com/company/doceree/

About The Job

Position Title: Manager Data Science

Department/Function: Product & Engineering

Job Scope: India

Location: Noida, India

Work Setting: WFO

Purpose of the Job

We are looking for a hands-on Data Science Manager to lead a small, high-impact team of Data Scientists while continuing to contribute technically. This is not a coordination-only management role. You will help shape modeling approaches, review code and experiments, unblock productionization, and improve the operating cadence of the team. 

The role sits at the intersection of machine learning, healthcare data, and programmatic advertising. You will oversee work spanning attribution and lift measurement, probabilistic identity, audience quality, benchmarking and evaluation, forecasting, engagement/CTR modeling, and other applied ML problems as the portfolio evolves. 

You will also partner closely with Product, AI Engineering, Data/Platform Engineering, and external data partners as Doceree builds a more unified foundation for clinical-intent signals, HCP identity, anonymized patient-level data, claims-derived outcomes, and activation identifiers. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of 3-5 Data Scientists across senior and junior levels; set clear expectations, provide regular technical feedback, and help build a high-quality hiring pipeline as the team grows. 
 - Remain hands-on: frame problems, inspect data, prototype and review models, challenge assumptions, review code/SQL, and step into difficult technical work when needed. 
 - Own delivery discipline for the Data Science portfolio: translate product and business asks into well-scoped ML work, maintain Jira hygiene, drive prioritization and estimates, surface dependencies and risks, and ensure projects reach measurable outcomes rather than stopping at notebooks. 
 - Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to define success metrics, experimental designs, model acceptance criteria, and rollout plans for DS-driven capabilities. 
 - Guide the design and validation of models across classification, ranking, uplift/causal measurement, identity resolution, recommendation, anomaly detection, forecasting, audience scoring, graph-based methods, and related applied ML techniques. 
 - Establish stronger standards for offline evaluation, backtesting, holdouts, experimentation, calibration, monitoring, retraining, and post-launch measurement; ensure model performance is tied to business impact. 
 - Work with AI Engineering and platform teams to productionize models as reliable services, pipelines, APIs, and features that can be consumed by Daily Command and other Doceree products. 
 - Help define the analytical and feature requirements for a unified clinical-intent data foundation linking HCP-level signals, anonymized patient populations, claims/outcomes data, and identity/activation mappings; partner with data engineering on implementation rather than treating the DS team as the sole owner of platform engineering. 
 - Build a strong technical culture around reproducibility, peer review, documentation, feature quality, experiment tracking, model observability, and pragmatic MLOps. 
 - Communicate model behavior, trade-offs, limitations, and business implications clearly to senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. Qualifications Requirement: Experience, Skills & Education

- 7+ years of experience in Data Science / Machine Learning, including meaningful ownership of production ML systems and at least 1-2 years of technical leadership, team leadership, or player/coach management. 
 - B. Tech / M. Tech / MS / Ph. D. in Computer Science (From Tier 1 College), Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. 
 - Deep grounding in applied machine learning and statistics, including model validation, experimentation, causal/uplift methods, feature engineering, bias/leakage detection, calibration, and evaluation under noisy real-world data. 
 - Strong Python and SQL skills, with hands-on experience using modern ML libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow and large-scale data tools such as Spark, Snowflake and/or Databricks. 
 - Experience taking models from problem definition through data preparation, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration in production. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage multiple DS workstreams, work effectively with Product Managers and Engineering, and bring structure to ambiguous or changing requirements. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to review technical work rigorously while coaching scientists at different levels of experience. Preferred Candidate

- Deep experience in programmatic advertising / AdTech, PharmaTech, healthcare analytics, or life sciences data. Candidates with strong AdTech backgrounds should understand concepts such as auctions, DSP/SSP ecosystems, identity, audience targeting, campaign telemetry, measurement, and experimentation. 
 - Experience with healthcare data such as claims, Rx, HCP/NPI identity, EHR-derived signals, patient-level de-identified datasets, attribution, or treatment/brand lift measurement. 
 - Experience with identity resolution, graph-based modeling, recommendation/ranking systems, causal inference, media measurement, audience modeling, or marketing optimization. 
 - Comfort working with cloud data and ML infrastructure on AWS and with modern MLOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of GenAI/LLM systems is useful, but this role is intentionally weighted toward classical ML, statistics, experimentation, and data science depth rather than LLM application engineering. 

Doceree India Benefits

Below are the competitive benefits that will be provided to the selected candidates basis their location. 

- Competitive Salary Package
 - Generous Leave Policy
 - Flexible Working Hours
 - Performance-Based Bonuses
 - Health Care Benefits

Doceree DEI Vision & Mission

Doceree DEI (Diversity, Equity & Inclusion) is to create and sustain a one team culture globally with a mission to provide equal opportunity to people from diverse social, cultural, physical and psychological backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, age, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or gender identity or expression of an otherwise qualified individual, or membership in any other class protected by applicable law. 

Doceree fosters an inclusive culture by inculcating a sense of belonging within our ONE team through appropriate behaviours, policies and systems, while also being fair to one and all. 

To support this Doceree has taken formal strides with a 5C model and 4E's pledge, to ensure, encourage and exhibit our commitment to DEI, and move towards our DEI vision. Please click to know more details - Doceree Progresses Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in the Workplace -

As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world - like AI and IoT. Bangalore, IND

You'll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible-while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Job Summary

The New Product Manufacturing Engineer supports the introduction of new products from design through manufacturing readiness and production release. This role partners closely with Design Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and Suppliers to develop robust manufacturing solutions, ensure build readiness, and resolve issues during development and early production phases. 

NPME candidate will work independently on moderately complex assemblies or modules while receiving technical guidance for higher-risk decisions and broader program strategy. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, implement, and release new product Bills of Material (BOMs) for simple to moderately complex assemblies. 
 - Support development and execution of manufacturing, test, and sourcing strategies for new products in collaboration with senior NPMEs. 
 - Develop, validate, and release Operation Method Sheets (OMS) and related build/test documentation
 - Participate in design reviews, providing Design-for-Excellence (DFx) feedback to improve manufacturability, cost, quality, and cycle time. 
 - Support virtual build activities, including basic 3D model review, Master Layout (MLO), and early manufacturing validations. 
 - Execute and support change control processes, including ECRs, NSRs, ESWs, and related documentation. 
 - Perform managed build activities for assigned assemblies or modules. provide hands-on manufacturing floor support as needed
 - Document manufacturing issues and assist with root cause analysis and corrective actions. 
 - Provide technical support to manufacturing sites and suppliers during development and early production. 
 - Manage and execute tasks within assigned programs, including milestone tracking, documentation, and resource planning
 - Capture lessons learned and incorporate improvements into future release

Leadership

- Works independently with minimal supervision on medium to complex NPI scope
 - Learns from and seeks guidance from senior engineers and technical leads
 - Lead small to medium projects with manageable risk and resource requirements
 - Demonstrates accountability for assigned work and follows through on commitments
 - Collaborates effectively within cross-functional teams

Problem Solving & Impact

- Solves manufacturing and NPI problems using established engineering methods and sound judgment. 
 - Analyzes data to identify issues and supports corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Directly impacts manufacturing readiness, build quality, and schedule adherence for new products. 
 - Early engagement helps reduce downstream manufacturing disruptions and rework. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Electrical, or related Engineering discipline. 
 - 2-4 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, NPI, or a related engineering role. 
 - Working knowledge of: 
 - Manufacturing processes and DFM principles
 - BOM structures and engineering documentation
 - Change control processes (ECO, NSR, and ESW workflows)
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Ability to manage assigned tasks, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a fast‐paced, cross‐functional environment. 
 - Willingness to learn and grow technical and manufacturing expertise. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting modules or assemblies through development and early production. 
 - Familiarity with OMS development, virtual builds, or manufacturing validation activities. 
 - Exposure to machining, sheet metal, casting, molding, or similar manufacturing processes. 
 - Experience working with global manufacturing sites or suppliers. 
 - Proficiency with common engineering and collaboration tools (e. g. , CAD viewers, PLM systems, Microsoft Office). 
 - Ability to read mechanical drawings and basic electrical or pneumatic schematics

Full time

Assignee / Regular

Yes

data.description:
Job Description

We're looking for a seasoned Software Architect with deep expertise in cloud-native enterprise systems and Generative AI. You will define and deliver scalable, secure, and production-grade GenAI architectures - including multi-agent, RAG, LLMOps and AgentOps systems - and lead cross-functional teams to build and operate them. This role combines hands-on technical leadership, systems thinking, and strong stakeholder management. 

Key responsibilities

Architecture & System Design

- Design scalable, modular, and cloud-native architectures for GenAI applications(microservices, event-driven, serverless). 
 - Define system boundaries, data flows, orchestration, and integration patterns forLLMs, vector DBs, embedding services, and tool integrations. 
 - Produce architecture artifacts ( Layered Architecture Diagrams, C4 Models, DFDs, Class, Sequence, ER & Use Case diagrams, different types of blueprints, APIcontracts, design and trade-off decisions). 
 - GenAI & Agentic Systems
 - Architect and deliver Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, NaturalLanguage to SQL Flows, fine-tuning strategies, multi-modal capabilities, and tool-augmented agents. 
 - Design agent orchestration and multi-agent frameworks enabling planning, reasoning, and secure tool invocations, implement and design Agent prototypes andCommunication Protocols. 
 - Define prompt engineering standards, memory models(episodic/semantic/procedural), and context management. 

LLMOps & AgentOps

- Define and implement model lifecycle pipelines: training, fine-tuning, validation, deployment, rollback, and monitoring. 
 - Build AgentOps processes for agent lifecycle, behavior tracking, governance andperformance optimization. 
 - Automate CI/CD for models, agents and services (MLflow, TFX, BentoML, custompipelines). 

Integration, Security & Compliance

- Integrate GenAI services with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) usingsecure, scalable interfaces. 
 - Ensure secure access controls, data privacy, encryption, and compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2). 
 - Define responsible AI practices: bias mitigation, explainability, audit trails, andoutput governance. 
 - GenAI security - classify, encrypt & sign data/models; enforce least-privilege withshort-lived creds and CI/CD security gates; telemetry, drift/hallucination alerts, kill-switch & runbooks. 
 - Agentic AI security - provable agent identity/attestation, tool allowlist + human gatefor high-risk actions; ephemeral scoped tokens, sandboxed execution, and replayable audit traces. 

Observability, Ops & Cost Optimization

- Define telemetry, tracing, and logging for models and agents; monitor performance, drift, hallucination rates and user feedback loops. 
 - Build dashboards, alerts and runbook guidance for operational health. 
 - Design systems for cost efficiency (autoscaling, spot instances, serverlesschoices) and support FinOps practices. 

Leadership, Collaboration & Documentation

- Lead cross-functional teams (product, data science, AI engineers, platform)through architecture reviews, workshops, and technical decisioning.

 - Mentor engineers and evangelize best practices across the organization.

Job Purpose

To ensure the safe placement, inspection, testing, and commissioning of all electrical systems in the hotel and plant room machinery, ensuring their smooth and efficient operation. 

Prime Function

Oversee the installation, testing, and maintenance of electrical systems and plant room machinery, coordinating with relevant vendors and management to ensure that all systems are fully operational, safe, and compliant with standards.

Understanding and Oversight of Electrical Systems

Generator and Plant Room Machinery Management

 - Oversee the testing and commissioning of bus duct systems, verifying that all parameters adhere to established standards. 
 - Take handover of chillers, pumps, and all plant room machinery, ensuring their technical parameters align with design specifications. 

Operational Testing and Maintenance

 - Regularly monitor the operation of all pumps and systems, ensuring they function according to design parameters. 
 - Fully engaged in the testing and commissioning of all major plant machinery, ensuring that all parameters meet operational needs. 
 - Conduct daily inspections of the plant room area, reporting progress and issues as they arise. 
 - Routinely check each floor's electrical work, ensuring quality and safety, and coordinate with electrical vendors to understand the cable routing and distribution panels. 

Documentation and Record-Keeping

- Take responsibility for the handover of all systems, ensuring that they are operational and that all relevant documentation, including drawings and technical readings, is properly recorded. 
 - Create and maintain service trackers for each system, updating history cards regularly. 
 - Feed daily technical readings into the HLP sheet and maintain utility and waste management records.

 - Follow up on pending work, ensuring a smooth handover to the next shift. 
 - Oversee the proper handover of tools and ensure logbooks are signed by senior managers and shift-in-charge personnel. 
 - Ensure that all major breakdowns during shifts are resolved before shift change, continuing the shift if a reliever is unavailable. 
 - Perform the rotational/ specific shifts as and when the operational requirements and DOE allocations. 
 - Emergency Response:

Vendor Coordination and Support

- Provide support to vendors during their visits to the hotel, maintaining control over all contracted work according to established policies and procedures. 
 - Manage the logbook of received materials, maintain the stores, and oversee the procurement process, raising purchase requests (PR) as needed. 

Safety and Compliance

- Ensure compliance with safety protocols, including confined spaces permits, hot work permits, risk assessments, and working at heights permits.

 - Ensure all utilities have updated history cards and that all electrical safety procedures, including lockout/tagout, are followed.

Planned Preventive Maintenance

- All the machine & equipment should undergo periodic preventive maintenance as per schedule approved by DOE or Hotel Managenment aligning with the brand standard.

 - All necessary local compliance to be reviewed and followed as per requirement. 

Public Area and Plant Room Operations

Company Description Medha Servo Drives Pvt Ltd (MSDPL), established in 1984 and headquartered in Hyderabad, India, is a global leader in railway technology and electric propulsion systems. The company designs and delivers traction motors, converters, train control management systems, energy optimization solutions, onboard electronics, safety and signalling systems, and fully assembled bogies. Medha's expertise extends beyond rail to heavy-duty road and off-road electric vehicles and marine applications, serving customers in more than 50 countries. Role Description The Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) Programmer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Hyderabad. The role involves developing, modifying, and optimizing CMM programs to inspect mechanical components and assemblies according to engineering drawings and specifications. Responsibilities include setting up parts on the CMM, performing dimensional measurements, analyzing results, and preparing clear inspection reports for quality and engineering teams. The CMM Programmer collaborates with production and quality control to resolve dimensional issues, support root cause analysis, and recommend corrective actions. The role also includes maintaining calibration integrity of the CMM equipment, updating measurement routines as designs change, and ensuring compliance with internal and external quality standards. 
Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong skills in using Gauges for dimensional verification and shop-floor checks. 
 - Candidates should possess practical Quality Control skills for monitoring product conformity and supporting corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Candidates should possess solid Measurements and Inspection skills for interpreting engineering drawings and verifying geometric tolerances. 
 - Candidates should possess hands-on Calibration skills for maintaining measurement equipment accuracy and traceability. 
 - Proficiency in CMM programming (e. g. , using common CMM software platforms) and experience with 2D/3D CAD models. 
 - Ability to read and interpret GD&T as per international standards and apply it in inspection planning. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and documentation accuracy. 
 - Diploma or bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Experience in a precision manufacturing, automotive, rail, or heavy engineering environment is an advantage. 
 - Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in cross-functional teams on-site.

data.title: Senior Architect – Data Engineering (Databricks)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Architect - Data Engineering (Databricks) based in India. 

The Senior Architect will play a strategic role in designing and delivering large-scale, modern data engineering solutions using the Databricks Lakehouse platform. This position combines deep technical expertise, enterprise architecture, consulting, and business leadership to address complex data challenges and accelerate digital transformation. You will lead major data architecture initiatives, guide engineering teams, and advise clients on building scalable, secure, and high-performance data platforms. Working closely with business leaders and technical stakeholders, you will translate organizational objectives into innovative data and AI solutions. You will also contribute to business development, lead pre-sales engagements, and oversee complex migration and modernization projects. This is an exciting opportunity to shape data engineering strategy, drive technological innovation, and deliver measurable business value in a collaborative consulting environment. 

Accountabilities

- Data Architecture & Engineering: Design, develop, and oversee large-scale enterprise data architecture solutions using Databricks and its ecosystem, including Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog, and Apache Iceberg. 
 - Databricks Center of Excellence: Contribute to the development and growth of the Databricks practice by establishing technical standards, sharing expertise, promoting best practices, and leading strategic platform initiatives. 
 - Technical Leadership: Provide architectural direction and technical guidance to data architects and engineering teams, ensuring solutions align with client objectives, business requirements, scalability, and performance expectations. 
 - Client Advisory & Digital Transformation: Act as a trusted technical advisor to clients, guiding them through data strategy development, digital transformation, and the adoption of modern cloud-based data platforms. 
 - Pre-Sales & Business Development: Lead complex Databricks pre-sales engagements as a Solution Lead or Lead Architect. Develop tailored technical proposals, solution architectures, statements of work (SOWs), and strategic recommendations based on client requirements. 
 - Project Delivery & Modernization: Lead large-scale Databricks implementation, migration, and modernization engagements, overseeing delivery teams of data architects and engineers to ensure successful project outcomes. 
 - Migration Strategy: Drive the transformation of legacy data warehouses into modern Databricks Lakehouse architectures, ensuring efficient migration approaches, platform optimization, and business continuity. 
 - Project & Risk Management: Oversee project planning, budgeting, deliverables, timelines, dependencies, and risks while maintaining alignment with client expectations and executive stakeholders. 
 - Innovation & Technology Strategy: Identify emerging technologies, tools, and architectural approaches in data engineering, cloud platforms, and AI/ML to develop future-ready solutions aligned with client needs. 
 - Practice Growth & Market Development: Collaborate with data leadership teams across sales, recruitment, account management, consulting, and operations to expand market presence and strengthen client relationships. 
 - Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing: Mentor technical professionals, develop engineering capabilities, and promote a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning. 
 - Business Value & Client Outcomes: Ensure that technical decisions and architectural recommendations deliver measurable business value, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen clients' competitive positioning. 

Requirements

- At least 10 years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related technology disciplines. 
 - Minimum of 6 years of extensive hands-on experience with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and Unity Catalog. 
 - Strong expertise in designing and implementing enterprise-scale data architectures and modern data engineering solutions. 
 - Deep understanding of Databricks platform capabilities, including data engineering, governance, security, and Lakehouse architecture. 
 - Mastery of Big Data platforms, cloud data warehouses, and object-oriented programming principles. 
 - Strong knowledge of NoSQL databases, container management technologies, and AI/ML tools. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and delivering data and AI platform solutions that address complex business requirements and generate measurable business value. 
 - Proven experience leading large-scale data migration and modernization initiatives, particularly transforming legacy data warehouses into Databricks Lakehouse platforms. 
 - Experience managing multiple complex Databricks implementation and delivery projects, including technical leadership and team coordination. 
 - Ability to translate business needs into customized data platform architectures and scalable technical solutions. 
 - Experience leading pre-sales and business development activities, including solution design, technical proposals, client presentations, and SOW development. 
 - Strong consulting and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior executives, business leaders, and technical teams. 
 - Excellent project management capabilities, including risk management, budgeting, resource planning, delivery oversight, and executive-level communication. 
 - Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to guide multidisciplinary engineering teams and foster technical excellence. 
 - A business-oriented mindset, combining strategic thinking with hands-on technical expertise and a focus on client outcomes. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic consulting environment. 
 - Preferred: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional certification. 
 - Preferred: Demonstrated experience leading multiple complex Databricks architecture, implementation, and modernization engagements. 

Benefits

- Remote working opportunities within India. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing Databricks Center of Excellence and contribute to strategic data engineering initiatives. 
 - Exposure to large-scale enterprise projects involving modern data platforms, cloud technologies, and AI/ML solutions. 
 - Opportunity to work with major international clients across diverse industries. 
 - Involvement in high-impact digital transformation, data modernization, and cloud migration projects. 
 - Opportunities to influence technical strategy, architecture decisions, and business development initiatives. 
 - Collaborative environment bringing together experienced consultants, architects, and engineering professionals. 
 - Opportunities for professional growth, technical leadership, and continuous learning. 
 - Access to a culture that values innovation, ownership, authenticity, curiosity, and employee well-being. 
 - Opportunity to develop expertise and visibility within a specialized, expanding technology practice. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

data.title: Back End Developer (AI Infrastructure)
data.description:
About The Role

What if the code you write could directly power the AI systems shaping how millions of people interact with technology? We're looking for Back End Developers in Mumbai to design, build, and optimize the server-side systems and APIs that drive cutting-edge AI products - from data pipelines and model-serving infrastructure to scalable microservices that handle real-world traffic at scale. 

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. Whether you're a seasoned engineer looking for meaningful project work or a strong developer ready to apply your skills to AI-adjacent infrastructure, this is your chance to build things that matter. 

- Organization: Alignerr
 - Type: Hourly Contract
 - Location: Remote
 - Commitment: 10-40 hours/week

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain robust back end services, APIs, and data pipelines
 - Build scalable, high-performance server-side architecture to support AI training and inference workloads
 - Write clean, well-documented, and testable code following engineering best practices
 - Integrate with databases, message queues, cloud services, and third-party APIs
 - Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability as usage grows
 - Collaborate asynchronously with distributed teams of engineers, researchers, and product leads
 - Troubleshoot production issues, conduct code reviews, and contribute to architectural decisions
 - Work independently on task-based and project-based assignments on your own schedule

Who You Are

- Proficient in one or more back end languages - Python, Go, Java, Node. js, Rust, or similar
 - Solid understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and distributed systems
 - Experienced with relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, etc. )
 - Comfortable working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
 - Familiar with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex systems independently
 - Self-motivated, reliable, and effective when working asynchronously without close supervision
 - Clear communicator who can document decisions and collaborate across time zones

Nice to Have

- Experience building infrastructure for machine learning or AI systems
 - Familiarity with data processing frameworks (Apache Kafka, Spark, Airflow, or similar)
 - Background in performance optimization, caching strategies, or high-throughput systems
 - Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices
 - Experience with serverless architectures or event-driven design patterns
 - Contributions to open-source projects or a strong portfolio of personal/professional work

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI infrastructure projects alongside leading research labs
 - Fully remote and flexible - set your own hours and work from anywhere
 - Freelance autonomy with access to meaningful, technically challenging work
 - Build systems at the intersection of software engineering and artificial intelligence
 - Collaborate with a global network of talented engineers and researchers
 - Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

data.description:
At Brevo, we're not just building a CRM. With our technology, we're helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. 
From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection. 

As a certified B Corp, we're proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance. 

Today, more than 500, 000 businesses across 180 countries-from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin-trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches. 

In 2024, we reached €179M ARR with nearly 1, 000 team members worldwide. And we're just getting started!

PushOwl is an e-commerce SaaS product serving more than 50, 000 customers globally, primarily across the US and Europe. Leading brands such as Levi's, Louis Vuitton, Tissot, Chanel, and L'Occitane use PushOwl to engage customers and drive revenue through targeted marketing. 

Today, PushOwl is fully integrated into Brevo's e-commerce business. As part of Brevo, one of the world's leading CRM and marketing platforms, PushOwl contributes to a broader vision for connected, omnichannel marketing experiences for Shopify merchants. 

By combining PushOwl's ecommerce expertise with Brevo's wider product ecosystem, technology, and global reach, we are helping businesses engage their customers more effectively across the customer journey. 

You'll join a small pod, sometimes with a PM and sometimes without, and own features end-to-end. From a fuzzy idea on Monday to something live and learning by Friday. No waiting for perfect specs. No handing off the hard parts to someone else. 

What You'll Own: 

- Owning ecommerce features or product lines like Email/SMS/RCS end-to-end, from fuzzy idea to live in production
 - Writing backend services in Python and Go, plus the bits of PHP still around
 - Touching the frontend when the feature needs it
 - Talking to users, prototyping fast, and deciding what's good enough for v1
 - Making scope and trade-off calls inside the pod, then sanity-checking them with the wider team
 - Carrying the product thinking for yourself
 - Pushing for quality where it matters (reliability, performance), without gold-plating

What We're Looking For: 

- 5+ years of direct experience shipping something a real user touched, and you can speak to why it mattered to them, not just how you built it
 - Strong in Python and Go. Comfortable around PHP. Willing to work on the frontend when needed
 - SaaS or B2B background; you understand multi-tenant products and customer workflows
 - Have a coding agent as a daily driver, not weekend tinkering. You know where AI helps and where it gets in the way
 - Strong product instincts: opinions you can defend, and the humility to change them when data says otherwise
 - Comfortable in small autonomous teams with little process
 - Clear writer. Matters a lot in a distributed setup
 - Nice to have: ecommerce background, early-stage experience, or familiarity with email / CRM / marketing automation

This role is for you if: 

- You'd rather build the tool than wait for it
 - You've shipped in ambiguous environments and enjoyed it
 - You want to use AI to drive real business outcomes, not just build cool tech
 - You're obsessed with quality and craft, and you're figuring out how AI changes both

This role is not for you if: 

- You need detailed specs and clear boundaries to be productive
 - You haven't built AI tools into how you work
 - You struggle to express your reasoning clearly in writing
 - You'd rather specialise narrowly than be useful across the stack

Whoever you are, wherever you're from, if this role speaks to you, we'd love to hear from you. 

At Brevo, we're proud to be an AI-first company. Still, every application is carefully reviewed by a member of our team. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Technical Lead - CDM Team
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Technical Lead to spearhead the Central Design Methodology (CDM) Team to drive the development, deployment, and continuous improvement of R&D organization's design (EDA/CAD) methodologies and processes for IP and SoC development across Analog/Mixed-Signal (AMS), Digital, and RF design domains. This role is pivotal in defining, developing, and deploying cutting-edge tools, flows, recipes, methodologies, design-processes, gate-checklist that improve PPA, design efficiency and productivity, quality, reuse, robustness and time-to-market across multiple product lines. 

This role requires deep technical expertise in semiconductor Chip design methodologies, strong leadership skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with R&D design functions/components (AMS, Digital, RF, PD, DV, DFT, Emulation/Validation) and EDA vendors. 

Key Responsibilities

Methodology & Process Leadership and Strategy

- Define and execute the roadmap for design (EDA/CAD) tools, flows, recipes, methodologies, design-processes covering Analog, Mixed-Signal, Digital, and RF IP and SoC development. 
 - Collaborate with R&D design functions/components (AMS, Digital, RF, PD, DV, DFT, Emulation/Validation) to align methodologies with organizational goals. 
 - Establish standardized baseline for design, verification, implementation, signoff, release processes and quality gate-checklist across R&D design functions/components. And drive continuous improvement from that. 
 - Drive methodology adoption and ensure alignment with organizational quality, reliability, productivity and schedule goals. 
 - Lead the evaluation, bring-in and deployment of next-generation design technologies and new capabilities, automation solutions, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. 

Design Flow, Methodology and Process Development

- Architect, implement and maintain standardized and scalable end-to-end Chip design flows for: 
 - Analog and Mixed-Signal design
 - Digital front-end and back-end design and implementation
 - RF design and integration
 - DFT design and integration
 - IP development, reuse and manage
 - Full-chip SoC integration
 - Verification, Emulation/Validation
 - Develop process for quality gate-checklist, signoff and design release (cross-functional design hands-off). 
 - Evaluate and integrate EDA tools, automation frameworks, scripting solutions. 
 - Establish flow interoperability across multiple EDA platforms and foundry technologies. 
 - Establish best practices for design reuse, verification, release and signoff. 

Automation and Infrastructure

- Lead the development of automation frameworks, scripts, and infrastructure to improve engineering efficiency. 
 - Drive implementation of reusable design kits, PDK integration methodologies, verification environments, and regression systems. 
 - Develop dashboards, metrics, and analytics to measure design quality, productivity, and methodology compliance. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner and closely work with R&D Design Functions/Components (AMS, Digital, RF, PD, DFT, DV, Emulation/Validation) to develop their TFM, Recipe and Design-process and PPA push. 
 - Work closely with EDA vendors and foundry partners to influence tool capabilities and resolve methodology challenges. 
 - Support project teams during methodology & process deployment, training, and issue resolution. 
 - Ensure seamless integration of analog, mixed-signal and digital IPs into complex SoCs. 

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

- Stay ahead of industry trends in semiconductor design methodologies. 
 - Drive adoption of advanced techniques such as machine learning-based design optimization, cloud-enabled design environments, and AI-assisted verification. 
 - Champion efficiency improvements in design cycle time, PPA and quality metrics. 

Key Success Metrics

- Improved PPA of the Chips (IP/SoC). 
 - Improved design productivity and reduced development cycle time. 
 - Increased IP reuse and methodology adoption across projects. 
 - Enhanced first-pass silicon success rate. 
 - Reduction in design and verification turnaround time. 
 - Improved design quality and signoff robustness. 
 - Successful deployment of automation and methodology innovations. 
 - Team growth, engagement, and technical excellence. 

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

- Strong understanding of: 
 - Analog and Mixed-Signal design, verification and signoff tool, flow, methodologies (TFM) and design-process
 - Digital design, verification and signoff TFM and design-process
 - RF design, verification and signoff TFM and design-process
 - Design-for-Test (DFT) TFM
 - IP qualification, reuse, release and management frameworks
 - Hands-on expertise in EDA tools (Cadence, Synopsys, Mentor, etc. ) and scripting (Python, TCL, Perl). 
 - Proven track record in IP and SoC development methodologies and processes from concept to silicon. 
 - Experience with documentation & issue tracking process (Confluence/JIRA), revision control systems (LSF), workflow automation, and large-scale compute (HPC) environments. 

Education & Experience

- Master's or Ph. D. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering or related field. 
 - 15+ years of experience in semiconductor design methodologies & processes with exposure to AMS, Digital, and RF domains. 
 - 5+ years of experience leading methodology, EDA, CAD, design enablement, or related technical teams. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in developing Central CAD Methodologies for large design organizations. 
 - Knowledge of advanced process nodes (FinFET, RF CMOS, SiC, GAN/GAS, etc. ). 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML applications in EDA.

data.title: Software Engineer (AI Training)
data.description:
About The Role

What if the code you write could directly shape how the next generation of AI understands and generates software? We're looking for Software Engineers in Jaipur to build, evaluate, and improve AI-generated code - helping train AI systems to think like real developers. 

You'll write solutions, review AI outputs, and provide the expert-level feedback that makes AI coding assistants smarter, safer, and more reliable. This is hands-on engineering work at the frontier of AI development - not theoretical, not bureaucratic, and not boring. 

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can write clean code and explain your reasoning, we want to hear from you. 

- Organization: Alignerr
 - Type: Hourly Contract
 - Location: Remote
 - Commitment: 10-40 hours/week

What You'll Do

- Write, debug, and optimize code across a range of languages, frameworks, and problem domains
 - Review and evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, efficiency, readability, and best practices
 - Identify bugs, logic errors, security issues, and performance bottlenecks in AI outputs
 - Provide structured, detailed feedback explaining why code works - or doesn't
 - Design challenging coding prompts and edge-case scenarios to stress-test AI capabilities
 - Compare and rank multiple AI-generated solutions based on engineering quality
 - Work independently and asynchronously - fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

- Proficient in one or more programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Go, TypeScript, or similar)
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
 - Able to read, write, and reason about code with clarity and precision
 - Strong problem-solving instincts and a systematic debugging approach
 - Clear written communicator - you can explain technical decisions in plain language
 - Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

- Experience across multiple languages or tech stacks (full-stack, backend, systems, data engineering)
 - Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, LLMs, or prompt engineering
 - Background in code review, technical writing, or mentoring junior developers
 - Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps, or distributed systems
 - Competitive programming, open-source contributions, or side projects that demonstrate your craft
 - Advanced degree in Computer Science or related discipline

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
 - Fully remote and flexible - set your own hours and work from anywhere
 - Freelance autonomy with intellectually stimulating, high-impact work
 - Directly influence how AI writes, understands, and reasons about code
 - Sharpen your own engineering skills by evaluating diverse problems daily
 - Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. EnCharge's robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today's best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. EnCharge AI launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems. 

About the Role

Job Title: Staff / Senior Staff CAD & Methodology Engineer (Digital Implementation & Signoff)

Location: [ Bangalore Hybrid / INDIA Remote]

Role Overview

We are an ambitious AI hardware startup building next-generation accelerators with massive compute density. To achieve aggressive Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) targets on accelerated tapeout schedules, we require a robust, highly automated, and heavily optimized physical implementation and signoff flow. As a Staff / Senior Staff CAD & Methodology Engineer, You will be the resident expert in Innovus and Tempus, responsible for developing, debugging, and continually accelerating our RTL-to-GDSII and timing signoff flows. You will work closely with Physical Design and STA leads to eliminate bottlenecks, automate manual tasks, and push the limits of EDA capabilities at advanced process nodes. 

Responsibilities

- Flow Architecture & Automation: Architect, develop, and maintain a highly automated, robust, and scalable physical design and signoff flow from synthesis through GDSII, optimized for AI accelerator architectures. 
 - Innovus Methodology: Drive advanced physical design methodologies in Cadence Innovus. Optimize recipes for floorplanning, placement, Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS), routing, and power grid implementation to squeeze out maximum PPA.

data.title: Senior Python Software Engineer – IoT & Systems Integration | Primarily Equity
data.description:
# Primarily Equity Based CTC - EQUITY 1. 5 CR for top candidates

## About Omokai

Omokai (German Based) is building an AI-powered intelligence and orchestration layer for autonomous systems, including robots, drones, UAVs, UGVs, USVs, and distributed sensor networks. 

Our mission is to make complex autonomous systems accessible through natural language, enabling humans to communicate with and coordinate fleets of intelligent machines as naturally as they communicate with other people. 

Founded by the former Head of AI at Amazon, Omokai is a Germany-based AI startup building at the intersection of Applied AI, Generative AI, Robotics, Autonomous Systems, and Physical AI. 

We are developing technology that connects advanced AI with real-world autonomous machines, with a strong emphasis on security, reliability, and human oversight. 

## Compensation & Location: 

Please read this section carefully before applying. 

Omokai is an early-stage startup, and this is a primarily equity-based opportunity. 

- Equity: Can be higher or lower based on your expertise and experience. 
 - Cash compensation: Basic comp given. 
 - Location: Based in Nagpur, Maharashtra. 
 - Long-term opportunity: Move to Germany or middle east in next 1-2 years. 
 - Benefits: Accomodation and access to advance AI tools provided

We are looking for someone who understands the risks and rewards of early-stage entrepreneurship and is motivated by building meaningful technology and creating long-term value. 

## The Opportunity: 

We are looking for a strong, hands-on Python Software Engineer with experience in IoT, device integration, backend systems, and distributed applications. 

You will help build a hardware-agnostic software platform that connects, controls, and coordinates different types of machines-including robots, drones, autonomous vehicles, and IoT devices-through a single interface. 

- Design and build the core software infrastructure connecting different hardware systems. 
 - Develop device integration, real-time communication, and multi-device orchestration capabilities. 
 - Work alongside dedicated robotics and drone engineers handling hardware-specific functionality. 
 - Take significant ownership of software architecture, development, and technical decisions. 
 - Work directly with the founder, with opportunities to grow into a technical leadership role. You do NOT need to be a robotics or drone expert. We are primarily looking for an excellent software engineer who knows how to connect different systems and make them work together. 

This is an early-stage, high-ownership opportunity for someone who enjoys building technology from scratch. 

## What You Will Build

- Unified Device Integration: Build a hardware-agnostic software layer to connect robots, drones, autonomous vehicles, sensors, and other IoT devices through common interfaces. 
 - APIs & SDK Integration: Develop reusable adapters to integrate different manufacturers, hardware platforms, and communication protocols. 
 - Real-Time Communication: Implement bidirectional communication for commands, telemetry, device status, and event handling. 
 - Concurrent Device Control: Develop Python applications capable of communicating with and controlling multiple machines simultaneously. 
 - Mission Orchestration: Build software to execute, schedule, monitor, and coordinate tasks across multiple connected machines. 
 - Event-Driven Workflows: Enable actions on one machine to trigger operations on other machines, including task dependencies and execution tracking. 
 - Device & Mission State Management: Track device availability, command acknowledgments, task execution, mission progress, and operational states. 
 - Reliable Distributed Systems: Handle connectivity issues, timeouts, reconnections, failures, retries, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Backend Infrastructure: Develop scalable Python backend services, APIs, messaging infrastructure, and modular software components. 
 - Software Architecture: Design clean, extensible systems that support adding new hardware without rewriting the core platform. 
 - Testing & Debugging: Build simulations, mock-device integrations, automated tests, and tools for troubleshooting distributed systems. 
 - Cross-Team Integration: Collaborate with robotics, drone, and AI engineers to integrate their capabilities into the central platform. Most importantly, you will spend the majority of your time writing code, building integrations, debugging systems, and developing working software-not managing people or preparing presentations. 

# Who We Are Looking For

Preferred experience: 4-10 years of relevant software development experience. 

## Must-Have Qualifications: 

Strong Python & Backend Engineering

- Excellent Python programming skills, including OOP, modular design, and software engineering fundamentals. 
 - Strong experience with asynchronous programming (asyncio), concurrency, multithreading, or multiprocessing. 
 - Experience building backend services, REST APIs, and real-time applications. 
 - Ability to design maintainable, scalable, and extensible software architectures. IoT & Device Integration

- Practical experience integrating IoT devices, connected hardware, industrial equipment, or external systems. 
 - Experience working with hardware/software APIs, SDKs, and communication protocols. 
 - Good understanding of MQTT, TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, WebSockets, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience sending commands to devices, receiving responses, processing telemetry, and handling real-time events. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot networking, communication, and integration issues. Distributed Systems & Orchestration

- Understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous workflows. 
 - Experience managing concurrent operations across multiple devices, services, or independent systems. 
 - Understanding of task scheduling, state machines, task dependencies, and execution state management. 
 - Ability to implement reliable communication, timeouts, retries, failure handling, and reconnection logic. 
 - Ability to design common interfaces that abstract differences between underlying systems. Engineering Mindset

- Strong debugging, problem-solving, and system design abilities. 
 - Comfortable with Linux, Git, and software development tools. 
 - Ability to independently understand and integrate unfamiliar APIs, SDKs, and technologies. 
 - Comfortable collaborating with robotics, hardware, and AI specialists. 
 - Hands-on engineer who enjoys building, experimenting, and shipping working systems. Startup Mindset

- Strong ownership mentality and ability to work independently. 
 - Comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and fast-paced development. 
 - Pragmatic approach to balancing speed, reliability, performance, and cost. 
 - Genuine interest in IoT, robotics, autonomous systems, and AI. 
 - Willingness to learn new technologies and grow with an early-stage company. 

## Good-to-Have Qualifications

IoT & Infrastructure

- Experience with industrial IoT, smart devices, connected vehicles, industrial automation, or device management platforms. 
 - Experience with FastAPI, Redis, PostgreSQL, Docker, or message brokers. 
 - Familiarity with edge computing, embedded Linux, Raspberry Pi, or NVIDIA Jetson. 
 - Experience with device discovery, provisioning, or remote device management. Robotics & Autonomous Systems

- Familiarity with ROS/ROS 2, MAVLink, MAVSDK, PX4, or ArduPilot. 
 - Experience integrating robots, drones, autonomous vehicles, or remotely operated equipment. 
 - Exposure to multi-robot coordination, fleet management, mission planning, or autonomous task execution. 
 - Experience with robotics simulation or hardware-in-the-loop testing. AI & Advanced Systems

- Experience integrating AI/ML models or LLMs with external applications or physical devices. 
 - Familiarity with agentic workflows, AI-driven automation, or intelligent task orchestration. 
 - Experience building workflow engines, distributed task schedulers, or complex event-driven applications. 
 - Experience with C++ or other systems programming languages. 
 - Previous startup experience or experience building products from scratch. Important: You do not need prior robotics, drone, or autonomous fleet management experience. We already have domain specialists. What matters most is your ability to build reliable Python software that integrates different devices, manages communication, and coordinates their operations. 

How to Apply: 

We are especially interested in seeing what you have actually built. 

Please share: 

- A brief introduction and why you are interested in Omokai. 
 - Your GitHub, portfolio, or examples of Python software you have personally developed. 
 - Details of relevant IoT, device integration, backend, distributed systems, or real-time communication projects. 
 - Your specific technical contributions to those projects. 
 - Your current location and availability. 

You do not need an impressive CV or robotics experience. We would rather see a well-engineered Python application that connects and controls multiple devices than a long list of technologies on your résumé. 

You can also reach out via linkedin to: https: //www. linkedin. com/in/omoka-c-b388aa3a1/

If you enjoy building complex software systems from scratch, integrating different technologies, and solving challenging real-world engineering problems, we would love to hear from you. 

- Join Omokai and help build the next generation of intelligent autonomous systems.
