data.title: Staff Quality Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Quality Engineer based in India. 

The Staff Quality Engineer will serve as a strategic technical leader responsible for driving quality engineering excellence across a core product area within a distributed software engineering organization. This role goes beyond traditional software testing, combining hands-on technical expertise with strategic planning, cross-functional leadership, and quality governance. You will define and influence testing strategies, strengthen automation practices, and ensure quality initiatives are aligned with broader engineering and business objectives. Working closely with engineering leaders, product managers, developers, and quality teams, you will promote shared accountability for software quality throughout the development lifecycle. You will also champion innovative AI-powered testing solutions, improve performance and scalability validation, and proactively mitigate technical risks. This is an opportunity to shape engineering standards, mentor technical talent, and drive continuous improvement in a fast-paced, remote-first SaaS environment. 

Accountabilities

- Quality Strategy & Technical Leadership: Act as the primary quality engineering authority for an assigned product pillar, establishing testing standards, processes, and technical direction while ensuring consistency across product modules. 
 - Early SDLC Engagement: Participate in requirements refinement, sprint planning, RFCs, and design reviews to identify testability concerns, integration risks, and potential quality issues before development begins. 
 - Business & Engineering Alignment: Collaborate with Engineering Directors and Product Managers to align quality initiatives with product objectives, engineering priorities, and key performance indicators (OKRs), including delivery velocity and system reliability. 
 - Quality Ownership & Risk Management: Take end-to-end responsibility for quality across the assigned product area by identifying automation gaps, resource constraints, technical weaknesses, and release risks. Escalate critical issues and coordinate appropriate corrective actions. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Represent the product pillar in cross-module leadership discussions, coordinate dependencies between engineering teams, and promote standardized testing strategies, tools, and best practices. 
 - Performance & Non-Functional Testing: Design and lead performance, load, and scalability testing strategies to ensure applications and distributed systems can handle enterprise-level workloads, concurrency, and data volumes. 
 - AI-Driven Testing Innovation: Promote the adoption of AI throughout the testing lifecycle, collaborating with internal tooling teams to implement and standardize AI-powered solutions for test generation, intelligent failure analysis, and pipeline optimization. 
 - Test Automation & Engineering Excellence: Develop and maintain complex end-to-end (E2E) automation scripts, contribute test code, and review developer-written unit and integration tests to identify coverage gaps. 
 - Testing Frameworks & Coverage: Establish best practices for unit, functional, and acceptance testing frameworks. Develop strategies to improve test coverage and integrate quality requirements into release gates. 
 - Automation Reliability: Work closely with automation enablement specialists to address framework limitations, eliminate flaky tests, and improve the reliability and efficiency of automated testing pipelines. 
 - Resource Allocation & Prioritization: Strategically allocate quality engineering resources, prioritize critical user journeys, and coordinate team efforts around high-impact product initiatives. 
 - Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing: Coach and mentor Feature Quality Engineers and developers on advanced testing principles, automation practices, and quality engineering methodologies while encouraging technical ownership across teams. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Drive improvements in testing processes, engineering collaboration, and quality standards while promoting a culture in which software quality is a shared responsibility rather than solely a QA function. 

Requirements

- 8-12+ years of professional experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), or a related technical discipline. 
 - Proven experience leading quality engineering initiatives across multiple teams, product modules, or complex software environments. 
 - Deep technical expertise in programming languages, testing tools, and automation frameworks, particularly Python, Pytest, Playwright, and TypeScript. 
 - Strong experience designing and implementing comprehensive automated testing strategies across unit, functional, integration, acceptance, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in performance, load, and scalability testing for complex distributed systems. 
 - Experience evaluating build-versus-buy decisions and designing or implementing custom solutions based on industry-leading testing practices. 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, test architecture, quality engineering methodologies, and release management. 
 - Ability to assess technical and release risks, balance delivery timelines with quality requirements, and optimize testing execution without compromising engineering velocity. 
 - Practical experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or AI-powered solutions within software testing is a strong advantage. 
 - Experience contributing to AI-driven testing frameworks, internal engineering tools, or intelligent automation solutions is preferred. 
 - Familiarity with API and web application UI automation tools such as Gherkin, Cypress, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience deploying, installing, and configuring applications on cloud-based infrastructure; AWS experience is an advantage. 
 - Strong technical problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to identify complex quality challenges and develop scalable solutions. 
 - Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to represent engineering initiatives and align cross-functional teams. 
 - High emotional intelligence, maturity, and active listening skills, with an openness to feedback and different perspectives. 
 - Demonstrated ownership, humility, and accountability, including the ability to recognize risks, request support when necessary, and share credit for collective achievements. 
 - Strong mentoring and leadership capabilities, with a collaborative approach to empowering engineers and improving team performance. 
 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced, evolving, and remote-first technology environments. 
 - Fluency in written and spoken English. 
 - Willingness and ability to participate in scheduled on-call rotations and respond to production alerts when required. 

Benefits

- Fully remote working arrangement within India. 
 - Full-time employment opportunity in a global, remote-first technology organization. 
 - Opportunity to collaborate with talented engineering professionals across multiple countries and disciplines. 
 - Exposure to innovative AI-powered technologies, advanced automation frameworks, and large-scale SaaS platforms. 
 - Opportunity to influence engineering strategy, establish quality standards, and drive organization-wide improvements. 
 - Strong emphasis on professional development, technical expertise, and continuous learning. 
 - Collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values diverse perspectives, innovation, and individual contributions. 
 - Opportunity to work closely with experienced engineering leaders and product teams. 
 - Autonomy and ownership in shaping technical initiatives and introducing new approaches to quality engineering. 
 - Opportunity to contribute to products and infrastructure supporting a global customer base. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. Description

Lead a new India-based embedded and firmware engineering team for Just Walk Out's edge devices: the cameras, sensors, RFID, gates and networking hardware in our stores, and the device-side software that connects them to the cloud. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll manage 8-12 engineers, set technical direction across firmware, embedded Linux and embedded Android, and partner closely with the US engineering team that owns this charter today. 

Key job responsibilities

- Hire, coach and develop a high-judgment team of embedded, firmware and edge software engineers, and build an inclusive, high-ownership culture as the team grows in India
 - Own the technical roadmap, delivery and operational excellence for your team's firmware and embedded software, from requirements and architecture through release and field support
 - Set engineering standards across the embedded stack: firmware and RTOS/bare-metal code, embedded Linux and Android, drivers and board bring-up, secure boot and OTA updates, and on-device diagnostics
 - Own the device-to-cloud boundary with cloud teams: provisioning and identity, connectivity, telemetry and remote management, including the device's AWS IoT / embedded-Linux connectivity stack
 - Build the test infrastructure, staged rollouts and telemetry needed to ship firmware safely across a large fleet of deployed devices
 - Lead the response to field issues, telling firmware from hardware, connectivity or sensor faults, and drive root cause and lasting fixes
 - Drive execution with the US engineering team, product and program management, hardware/ODM partners, and cloud, data and UI/UX teams across time zones

A day in the life

You might start with 1: 1s and a design review, helping an engineer reason through an OTA rollback path or a latency budget on a constrained target. Later you agree scope for the next release with product and the US partner team, and re-plan the sprint because a hardware revision changed what's possible. In the afternoon you join your engineers on a field issue affecting a few devices at one store, get them the telemetry and a plan, and keep the fix moving. 

About The Team

Just Walk Out builds the technology behind checkout-free shopping: the devices, networking and cloud software that let shoppers walk out without stopping to pay. . This India team will take direct ownership of part of that charter, working closely with the US engineering team, hardware partners and the operations teams who rely on what we ship. 

About AWS

Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. 

Mentorship & Career Growth - We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
 - 7+ years of software engineering experience, including embedded systems or firmware development
 - Experience leading the development of embedded, real-time, or hardware-interfacing systems delivered on physical hardware

Preferred Qualifications

data.title: Senior Technical Release Manager
data.description:
About Sureify

Sureify is dedicated to modernizing the life insurance and annuity industry. We provide cutting-edge digital solutions that empower insurers to easily engage with, sell to, and service their customers. Our mission is to drive meaningful digital transformation by offering scalable technology that enhances customer engagement and streamlines carrier operations. Sureify's products deliver the advanced digital experiences that life insurance carriers, agents, employees, and consumers now expect in this rapidly evolving technological landscape. At Sureify, we cultivate a culture that prioritizes innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Release Manager to join our Hyderabad office. This role will be responsible for managing all production releases across our enterprise platform and customer-specific solutions. Unlike traditional release roles, this position serves as a Technical Release Governor in a complex hybrid environment consisting of both multi-tenant products and multi-instance siloed environments. 

As we scale our carrier customer base, we are looking to adopt best of the breed release practices. You will be the single point of accountability for replacing high-intensity manual interventions in releases with a systematic, technically rigorous process. You will ensure releases are delivered with quality, predictability, and efficiency while bridging the gap between engineering, QA, product, and client support teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Release Lifecycle Leadership: Own and manage the end-to-end release lifecycle for all production deployments, including core platform production updates and customer-specific customizations. Define, document, and enforce release management processes and standards. Create and maintain the release calendar, ensuring transparency and alignment across teams. 

Technical Gatekeeping: Conduct deep-dive release readiness reviews. You will audit "Release Manifests" by validating steps such as SQL migrations or PDF template migrations, Temporal workflow versioning, Kafka schemas, and AWS resource configurations. A good overall understanding of deployment architecture in AWS is essential for this role. 

Environment Governance: Manage "Instance Parity" across our AWS multi-instance architecture to prevent "Environmental Drift" and ensure customer-specific secrets and variables match our global standards. 

Cross-Functional Orchestration: Facilitate formal "Go/No-Go" decisions by tracking a global checklist that includes technical and non-technical readiness. 

Risk Mitigation: Identify, document, and mitigate technical sequencing risks (e. g. , database locks or stateful workflow conflicts) associated with production releases. 

Continuous Improvement: Monitor release performance, generate and provide metrics and reports and drive the transition from manual coordination to Automated Production Quality Gates within our release pipelines. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

10+ years of overall technical experience, with a background in software engineering, SRE, or backend operations. 

5+ years of direct release management experience in a complex, enterprise hybrid SaaS environment (Multi-tenant & Multi-instance). 

Cloud-Native Expertise: Expert-level knowledge of AWS (EKS, RDS, Secrets Manager, IAM, S3, MSK) and the ability to audit infrastructure-level configurations. 

Stack Fluency: Demonstrated familiarity with Typescript, PHP, Go-lang, and Node. js ecosystems. You must understand the deployment nuances of each. 

Modern Orchestration: Hands-on experience or strong knowledge of Temporal (stateful workflows) and Kafka (event streaming). You understand the risks of deploying to "in-flight" asynchronous processes. 

Database Proficiency: Strong proficiency in MySQL and Postgres, specifically in auditing complex migration scripts and data sequencing. 

Containerization Mastery: Deep understanding of Kubernetes (K8s) manifest auditing and deployment patterns (Canary, Blue-Green, or Rolling Updates). 

Communication & Gravitas: Excellent stakeholder management skills with the professional authority to enforce discipline and halt releases if technical or business criteria are not met. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience in the insurance or financial services domain (or other regulated industries). 

Knowledge of security, compliance (SOC2/ISO), or audit processes as they relate to release operations. 

Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or CloudFormation. 

Familiarity with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles such as Error Budgets and SLIs/SLOs. 

Why Join Sureify?

At Sureify, you'll be part of a collaborative, innovation-driven culture where your expertise will directly influence the quality and success of products, transforming the life insurance landscape. You'll work alongside passionate technologists and industry experts, tackling complex challenges with cutting-edge technologies while helping shape the future of digital insurance. 

Our Guiding Principles

Our products are for nothing if their creators are not fulfilled in their work. We want our employees to flourish at Sureify. We do not fawn over status or titles; instead, we honour effort and intelligence. The best idea wins, no matter which colleague proposed it. We do not shortcut our mission with overblown claims or false promises. Sticking to the truth is both a strategy and a principle for us. 

Sureify is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

data.title: Quality Manager - Cable
data.description:
Job Description

Location: Udaipur, Rajasthan

Experience: 6-10 Years

Qualification: B. E. /B. Tech in Electrical/Electronics/Electrical & Electronics/Mechanical/Production Engineering or relevant qualification

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Quality Manager - Cable Manufacturing to lead Quality Assurance, Quality Control and QMS activities. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring compliance of raw materials, manufacturing processes, cable and wire harness products with BIS, ISO, IS, IEC, UL and other applicable national/international standards, customer specifications and regulatory requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Manage and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) as per ISO and applicable requirements. 
 - Ensure quality control of incoming raw materials, in-process production and finished goods. 
 - Establish and monitor inspection, testing, quality plans, process controls and acceptance criteria for cables and cable assemblies. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable BIS standards, BIS licence requirements, IS/IEC/UL and other relevant standards. 
 - Coordinate and manage BIS, ISO, customer, internal and third-party audits, including preparation and closure of audit observations/non-conformities. 
 - Monitor cable quality parameters and other applicable characteristics. 
 - Handle customer complaints, NCR, CAPA, 8D and root cause analysis and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Ensure proper control and disposition of non-conforming raw materials, components, in-process and finished products. 
 - Monitor calibration and verification of measuring, inspection and testing equipment. 
 - Manage supplier quality, incoming material inspection and supplier corrective actions. 
 - Review inspection reports, test reports, quality records, traceability documents and other QMS documentation. 
 - Analyze rejection, rework, scrap, process defects and customer complaints and drive continual quality improvement. 
 - Coordinate with Production, Purchase, Engineering, R&D and other departments for effective implementation of quality requirements. 
 - Support product validation, testing, customer approvals and regulatory/certification activities. 

Skills Required

- Strong knowledge of Cable Manufacturing, Testing and Quality of cables. 
 - Good knowledge of QMS, ISO, BIS compliance and applicable IS/IEC/UL standards. 
 - Experience in incoming, in-process and final inspection and testing. 
 - Strong knowledge of NCR, CAPA, 8D, Root Cause Analysis and Corrective/Preventive Action. 
 - Experience in handling BIS, ISO, customer and third-party audits. 
 - Knowledge of supplier quality management and customer complaint handling. 
 - Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, cable specifications, wiring diagrams, BOMs and technical documents. 
 - Good documentation, analytical, problem-solving and team-management skills. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office and quality documentation systems. 

Preferred Industry

Candidates with experience in Cable Manufacturing, Electrical & Electronic Products, Industrial Automation, Automotive, Railway, Aerospace, Defence, Instrumentation or related manufacturing industries will be preferred. Experience in BIS-certified manufacturing, cable testing, QMS implementation, certification audits and customer-specific quality requirements will be an added advantage.

Position Title: Attack and Penetration Testing Manager

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation

As part of our Cyber Security team, you shall perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing. You shall also perform in-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations. 

The opportunity

As a Manager in the Cyber Security Team, you will contribute technically to client engagements and services development activities. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen client's relationships. You will also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. 

You will be responsible for overall client service quality delivery in accordance with EY quality guidelines & methodologies. You will need to manage accounts and relationships on a day-to-day basis and explore new business opportunities for the firm. Establishing, strengthening and nurturing relationships with clients (functional heads & key influencers) and internally across service lines and proactively will also be a part of your day-to-day activities. You will assist in developing new methodologies and internal initiatives and help in creating a positive learning culture by coaching, counselling and developing junior team members. 

In line with EY's commitment to quality, you'll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY's quality standards, by reviewing the work provided by junior members. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing. 
 - Execute red team scenarios to highlight gaps impacting organizations security postures. 
 - Ability to work both independently as well as lead a team of technical testers on penetration testing and red team engagements. 
 - Provide technical leadership and advise to junior team members on attack and penetration test engagements. 
 - Identify and exploit security vulnerabilities in a wide array of systems in a variety of situations. 
 - Perform in-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations. 
 - Execute penetration testing projects using the established methodology, tools and rules of engagements. 
 - Convey complex technical security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences including executives. 
 - Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
 - Build strong internal relationships within EY Advisory Services and with other service lines across the organization. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

Client responsibilities: 

- Provide guidance and share knowledge with team members and participate in performing procedures focusing on complex, judgmental and/or specialized issues. Work with the team and the client to create plans for accomplishing engagement objectives and a strategy that complies with professional standards and addresses the risks inherent in the engagement. 
 - Brief the engagement team on the client's environment and industry trends. Maintain relationships with client management to manage expectations of service, including work products, timing, and deliverables. Demonstrate a thorough understanding of complex information systems and apply it to client situations. 
 - Use extensive knowledge of the client's business/industry to identify technological developments and evaluate impacts on the client's business. Demonstrate excellent project management skills, inspire teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members, and use current technology/tools to
 - enhance the effectiveness of deliverables and services. Understand EY and its service lines and actively assess what the firm can deliver to serve clients. 
 - Assist Partners & Senior Managers in driving the business development process on existing client engagements by gathering appropriate resources, gaining access to key contacts & supervising proposal preparation. 
 - Create innovative insights for clients, adapts methods & practices to fit operational team needs & contributes to thought leadership documents. 
 - Practice secondment for developing new methodologies. 
 - Facilitate discussions / knowledge sharing with key client personnel and contribute to EY thought leadership. 
 - Plan & schedule client engagements. Determine and deploy the right team with adequate skill sets for executing engagements and periodically review status of engagements and work products. 
 - Demonstrate strong project management skills
 - Maintain a strong client focus by effectively serving client needs and developing productive working relationships with client personnel. Stay abreast of current business and economic developments and new pronouncements/standards relevant to the client's business. 
 - Demonstrate industry expertise (deep understanding of the industry, emerging trends, issues/challenges, key players & leading practices)
 - Review status updates and prepare management presentations
 - Actively contribute to improving operational efficiency on projects & internal initiatives. 

People responsibilities: 

- Identify buyers, influencers & stakeholders in existing client engagements and build strong relationships. 
 - Display teamwork, integrity and leadership. Work with team members to set goals and responsibilities for specific engagements. Foster teamwork and innovation. 
 - Drive performance management for self and team. 
 - Driving the quality culture agenda at GD
 - Manage the performance management for the direct reportees, as per the organization policies
 - Training and mentoring of project resources
 - Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Graduates /BE / M Sc (Stats, Maths, Computer Science) / MBA with background in computer science and programming /MCA with minimum 8 years of work experience in penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, web application penetration tests, wireless, social engineering, and Red Team assessments. 
 - Any two of the following certifications: CISSP, OSCP, OSWP, GPEN, GWAPT, OSCE, OSEE, GXPN Network Security certifications (C|EH, Security+, SANS, ISACA, product certifications). 
 - Quality Management training/certification (e. g. ITIL, Six Sigma, TQM)
 - Knowledge of Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems. 
 - Deep understanding of TCP/IP network protocols. 
 - Deep understanding and experience with various Active Directory attack techniques. 
 - Understanding of network security and popular attacks vectors. 
 - An understanding of web-based application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10). 
 - Experience with manual attack and penetration testing. 
 - Experience with scripting / programming skills (e. g. , Python, PowerShell, Java, Perl etc. ). Updated and familiarized with the latest exploits and security trends. 
 - Experience to lead a technical team to conduct remote and on-site penetration testing within defined rules of engagement. 
 - Familiarity to perform network penetration testing in stealth manner. 
 - Understanding of software security, network security, and information technology management technologies and principles
 - Knowledge of vulnerability management, patch management, and configuration management best practices

Ideally, you'll also have

- Project management skills
 - Certifications: CREST
 - Demonstrable flair for technical writing, including engagement reports, presentations and operating procedures

What We Look For

- Who can perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing and provide analysis for the testing results. 

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. 

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. 

Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 

Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

We  operate  with  a  flat  structure,   high  autonomy,   and  a  strong  bias  toward  engineers  who  take  full  ownership  of  what  they  build,   from  architecture  to  production  behavior. 

The  Role

Our  current  sprint  on  building  autonomous  system  for  complex  problems,   across  software  engineering,   data  science,   and  AI  research  involves  building  harness,   execution  substrate  and  evaluation  system,   and  each  is  designed  to  run  inside  a  customer's  environment  rather  than  ours. 

This  role  owns  the  coding  agent:   a  system  that  takes  an  objective,   works  directly  on  a  repository,   verifies  its  own  changes,   and  produces  a  record  of  what  it  did.   The  codebases  are  large,   old,   thinly  tested  and  load-bearing,   and  the  agent  runs  inside  the  customer's  network,   usually  without  internet  egress. 

What'll  you  work  on:   

- The  agent  architecture  and  its  tool  surface  for  software  work,   including  retrieval,   editing,   builds,   tests,   static  analysis  and  version  control. 
 - Verification,   so  that  a  change  is  established  as  correct  before  a  human  sees  it. 
 - Long-horizon  execution  across  multi-file  refactors  and  migrations,   with  checkpointing,   recovery  and  self-correction. 
 - The  authorisation  and  rollback  model  governing  what  the  agent  may  do  and  how  it  is  undone. 
 - Integrations  with  the  engineering  estate  the  agent  operates  in,   and  the  observability  tooling  used  to  debug  and  audit  it. 
 - Evaluation  suites  built  from  real  repository  tasks,   and  the  behavior  tuning  that  follows  from  them. 

You  will  work  closely  with  our  research  team  on  evaluation  design,   post-training  and  interpretability  of  agent  behavior. 

What  We  Are  Looking  For

This  is  a  developer  tooling  role  as  much  as  an  AI  role.   The  agent  is  only  as  capable  as  the  tools  and  integrations  it  is  given,   so  depth  here  matters  more  to  us  than  anything  else. 

- Deep  experience  with  developer  tooling  and  IDEs.   Editor  and  IDE  internals  or  extensions,   language  servers  and  LSP,   code  intelligence,   refactoring  engines.   You  have  built  things  engineers  use  every  day. 
 - Code  intelligence  and  program  analysis.   ASTs  and  tree-sitter,   static  and  dataflow  analysis,   symbol  indexing  and  code  search,   call  graph  and  dependency  resolution,   codemods  and  automated  migration  tooling. 
 - Build  systems  and  CI/CD.   Bazel,   Gradle,   Maven,   Make  and  similar,   incremental  and  hermetic  builds,   artifact  and  dependency  management,   pipeline  design  across  Jenkins,   GitLab,   GitHub  Actions  or  equivalents,   including  self-hosted  and  offline  deployments. 
 - Observability.   Distributed  tracing,   structured  logging,   OpenTelemetry,   and  building  the  replay  and  inspection  tooling  that  makes  non-deterministic  systems  debuggable. 
 - Integrations  engineering.   Git  hosting  APIs,   ticketing  and  workflow  systems,   enterprise  auth,   and  the  reality  of  working  against  self-hosted  software  several  versions  behind  current. 
 - Agentic  systems  in  production,   not  prototypes.   You  know  the  current  framework  landscape  (ReAct-style  agents,   LangGraph,   LangChain,   Semantic  Kernel)  and  where  each  one  stops  working. 
 - Strong  backend  fundamentals.   Advanced  Python,   APIs  and  services,   sandboxing  and  containerisation,   databases  and  data  pipelines,   cloud  and  on-premise  infrastructure. 
 - You  reason  about  performance,   reliability,   cost,   safety  and  interpretability  as  one  connected  set  of  constraints. 
 - You  make  good  calls  in  the  gray  area,   and  you  are  comfortable  when  problems  are  loosely  specified  and  ownership  is  assumed  rather  than  assigned. 
 - Experience  building  evaluation  datasets  or  frameworks  for  AI  systems  is  a  plus. 
 - Compiler  background,   large  monorepo  work,   or  legacy  modernisation  programs  are  a  plus. 
 - Prior  exposure  to  alignment,   interpretability  or  safety  tooling  in  production  settings  is  a  plus. 

We  move  quickly  and  expect  candidates  to  do  the  same.   We  value  substance  over  polish  and  execution  over  rhetoric.

Si vous avez les qualités, de la motivation, de l'autonomie ou le leadership pour diriger des équipes, il existe des postes adaptés à vos aspirations et à vos compétences d'aujourd'hui et de demain. 

Fiche De Poste

The Intermediate Application Developer will be part of a team that is responsible for modernizing a legacy system and converting it to a Cloud based application. This application is used by UPS Operations on a daily basis world wide. 

Full stack development experience; experience in Java, Angular and SQL; familiarity with Angular 16+, Containerization Technologies, and CI/CD, Git, and Maven. Experience with GCP and Azure DevOps preferred. 

- Experience with Agile Development

Good written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to design solutions for complex problems
 - Must be a team player who shows initiative and is detail-oriented

The Intermediate Application Developer applies the principles of software engineering to design, develop, maintain, test, and evaluate computer software that provide business capabilities, solutions, and/or product suites. Provides systems life cycle management (e. g. , analyses, technical requirements, design, coding, testing, implementation of systems and applications software, etc. ) to ensure delivery of technical solutions is on time and within budget. They will research and support the integration of emerging technologies, provide knowledge and support for applications' development, integration, and maintenance and develop program logic for new applications or analyzes and modifies logic in existing applications. They will analyze requirements, tests, and integrates application components and ensure that system improvements are successfully implemented. They may focus on web/internet applications specifically, using a variety of languages and platforms and define application complexity drivers, estimates development efforts, creates milestones and/or timelines, and tracks progress towards completion. 

The Intermediate Application Developer provides specific functional expertise that is theoretical and conceptual in nature. This expertise is typically acquired through a combination of university education and experience within a field. They may have responsibility for supervising others in the capacity of a "player coach" but primary focus is individual expertise. Particularly at higher levels, sophisticated subject matter expertise is a requirement for success. 

The IntermediateApplication Developer applies in-depth conceptual and practical knowledge in own job discipline and basic knowledge of related job disciplines, solves complex problems related to own job discipline by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and builds consensus. Regularly acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience. Works independently, receives minimal guidance. 

Agile Engineering Best Practices

- Stays current on industry trends and serves as an expert on the software development lifecycle and agile engineering practices, coaching others when needed. 
 - Recommends and plans for application of agile methodologies vs. traditional methodologies, based on comparison of various approaches to achieve the most effective development outcome. 
 - Identifies appropriate agile engineering practices (e. g. , Extreme Programming techniques such as pair programming and test driven development) and coaches others in applying in software development projects. 

Project Management

- Integrates timelines and milestones across projects, identifying areas of synergy or dependency. 
 - Determines actual or potential gaps in resourcing for projects and recommends strategies to mitigate. 
 - Evaluates the progress of projects and makes adjustments (e. g. , to task order or timeline) to keep the project on track. 

Troubleshooting

- Conducts a deep review of data and issues to quickly reveal the root cause of problem. 
 - Recommends interim and long-term solutions to complex problems to ensure successful resolution. 
 - Executes solutions to complex problems; guides the analysis of a problem all the way to a successful resolution. 

Application Development/Programming

Creatively tests and maintains software applications and related programs and procedures by using a variety of software development tools following design requirements of customer. 

System and Technology Integration

Possesses knowledge of features and facilities for integration, and communication among applications, databases and technology platforms to bring together different components and form a fully functional solution to a business problem. 

Technology Advising/Consulting

- Gains insight into how customers utilize technology for their competitive advantage and applies this knowledge to suggest areas for improvement. 
 - Conveys the right information to the correct parties to ensure that proposals for improvements are given the proper consideration and technical issues are resolved in a timely manner. 
 - Contributes to product development by identifying industry change, listening to customer needs, capturing feedback and communicating that feedback to the business. 

Qualifications

- Experience with C#, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Couchbase, JFrog, Azure DevOps and Visual Studio
 - Experience with Cloud technology is a plus
 - Experience with Ready API is a plus
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 - Ability to work independently and in a team environment
 - Time Management
 - Detail oriented
 - Bachelor's Degree or International equivalent
 - Bachelor's Degree or International equivalent in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics or related field - Preferred

Type De Contrat

en CDD (Fixed Term)

data.title: Guest Experience Manager
data.description:
Guest Experience Manager bnbme Holiday Homes | Dehradun, India | On-site | Full-time

ABOUT

bnbme is a hospitality-first short-term rental company with homes in Dubai, Riyadh, Munich and London, and our operations hub in Dehradun. We look after guests the way a great hotel does, and we use technology and AI to do it faster and better. 

THE ROLE

You'll own the guest journey from first enquiry to post-stay, and lead the team that delivers it. Today that means running every stage hands-on. Over the coming months, automation will take over enquiries and first responses, and your focus shifts to designing the guest experience, growing in-stay revenue and making every stage a WOW moment. 

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- The full guest journey: enquiry, booking, pre-arrival, check-in, the stay, check-out and post-stay
 - In-stay upsells: set up and grow excursions, spa, airport transfers and other add-ons, from finding partners to pricing and delivery
 - The guest team: shifts, training, weekly coaching and hiring
 - Automation: decide what our AI guest assistant handles, work with Tech to launch it, and check its answers every week
 - Online check-in: ID, guest details, deposits and access sorted before every guest travels
 - Reviews: collect them, reply to every one, recover low scores, and fix the root cause so the same issue doesn't happen again, updating the SOP where needed
 - Channel standing: win and keep quality badges on Airbnb, Booking. com and other channels, and prevent penalties and suspensions
 - Direct and repeat bookings: turn happy guests into returning guests
 - A live guest dashboard, with every KPI tracked digitally
 - Escalations: complaints, refunds, compensation, safety and VIP guests stay human-led, and you own them
 - Day-to-day coordination with our Facilities team in Dubai, so every home is guest-ready

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

- Weighted review score across all channels, with at least half of all guests leaving a review
 - Guest issue resolution time
 - Additional revenue per booking

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Must-haves: 

- 5+ years in guest relations, front office or guest experience in hotels, serviced apartments or holiday homes
 - 2+ years leading a guest-facing team, including shifts and coaching
 - You've set up or grown upsells (tours, spa, transfers)
 - Strong written English
 - Confident with Airbnb, Booking. com and guest messaging tools
 - Comfortable with numbers and tracking KPIs
 - Based in Dehradun and able to work on-siteNice-to-haves: 

- You've built AI agents or automations in Claude or ChatGPT
 - Experience in pricing or revenue management
 - Knowledge of the Dubai short-term rental market
 - 
OUR VALUES Passion, Make it happen, All in, Win-win, Work-life harmony, Loyalty, Growth, WOW guest experience.

data.title: Wlan testing and network engineer
data.description:
Company Description Sify Technologies Limited is a Fortune India 500 company and one of India's most comprehensive ICT service and solution providers. With AI at the core of its solutions, Sify supports the evolving digital economy and the technology needs of businesses of all sizes. Its infrastructure includes 14 state-of-the-art data centers, one of the largest MPLS networks in India, and strong partnerships with global technology leaders. Over 10, 000 businesses across multiple sectors rely on Sify's integrated data center, network, and security services from more than 1, 700 cities in India. Sify also has an international presence in North America, the United Kingdom, and Singapore, offering candidates exposure to a global technology environment. 
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai for a WLAN Testing and Network Engineer. The role involves designing, configuring, and maintaining wireless LAN and network infrastructure to ensure reliable, secure, and high-performance connectivity. Daily responsibilities include executing WLAN test plans, validating network performance, conducting root-cause analysis, and resolving connectivity and security issues. The engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement network changes, optimize architectures, and support upgrades and migrations. The role also includes creating technical documentation, monitoring network health, and adhering to security and compliance standards. 
Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong Network Engineering and Network Design skills for planning, implementing, and optimizing wired and wireless infrastructures. 
 - Candidates should possess solid Network Administration skills to configure, monitor, and manage routers, switches, access points, and related devices. 
 - Candidates should possess advanced Troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve performance, connectivity, and configuration issues in complex environments. 
 - Candidates should possess Network Security skills to implement secure configurations, access controls, and best practices for WLAN and enterprise networks. 
 - Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related field are preferred. 
 - Industry certifications such as CCNA/CCNP, CWNA/CWNP, or equivalent are beneficial. 
 - Experience with WLAN testing tools, network monitoring platforms, and ticketing systems is an advantage. 
 - Strong analytical and documentation skills, along with the ability to work collaboratively in on-site teams in a fast-paced environment.

We are looking for a Hardware and Software Developer. The role is multifaceted - SoCV testbench Infrastructure, Bare-metal boot, Silicon Bringup Tools and CPU/SOC/GPU test frameworks. It involves a detailed understanding of the nVidia CPU, GPU, SOC system and boot architectures. The tools and technologies are complex and involve code that coordinates many IPs in the overall SOC. A key part of NVIDIA's strength is our development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of delivering new technology to the market. Renesas is a global semiconductor leader shaping the backbone of next‐generation automotive, industrial, cloud, and IoT innovation. The company's footprint spans more than 30 countries, enabling deep customer proximity and a uniquely global innovative engine. As Japan's semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real‐world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence. For ambitious problem‐solvers who want to work on meaningful, systems‐level challenges with huge industry leverage, Renesas offers the scale, stability, and strategic clarity of a market leader-paired with the transformative momentum of a company reinventing how the world computes, connects, and electrifies. 

Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division's (India for India) mission is to grow India market. We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications. 

Job Description

- Responsible for managing the development of New Products (Industrial and Automotive) and delivering on all program commitments from inception through execution to tape out and start of production. 
 - Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and resource allocations to ensure on-time project completion within budget constraints while maintaining high quality 
 - Drive cross-functional teams including design, test, product engineering, validation, marketing, systems, applications, operations, planning, various factories, and vendors as Program Manager to meet project milestones and objectives.

 - Drive execution initiatives and process improvements at the functional, cross functional and business group level 
 - Monitor and report on project progress, including key performance indicators and metrics, to senior management and stakeholders. 

Responsibilities may include: 

- Collaborate and work in a team environment with Design, Applications, Test, Marketing, Manufacturing, Quality and Reliability in all aspects of new product development, production release to accomplish goals and objectives

 - Work with failure analysis (FA) to determine root cause of any reliability and qualification failures 
 - Knowledge of statistics and tools (example: Spotfire) to analyze large amounts of characterization data and determine and set production test limits and predict yield data 
 - Work with process and package technology development to develop and qualify technologies for new product development 
 - Work closely with the global manufacturing facilities to address customer specific product quality, yield management and cost reductions issues on mature products. Scope of work could include product spins and derivatives

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering

- 7+ years of hand`s on technical program/project management experience leading cross functional teams to develop broad market or custom Power/Analog/ Mixed-Signal products for commercial, industrial or automotive applications with at least 10 years of experience working in the Semiconductor domain

- Solid understanding of Semiconductor Manufacturing, Development and Management

- Ability to work in a team setup comprising of other functional groups

- Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery

- Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships

- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment

- Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

- Strong problem solving, verbal and written communications skills

- Ability to multiplex between projects and be able to maintain project schedules

- Familiarity with JEDEC / AEC Qualification standards

- Familiarity with ATE tester platforms (Teradyne / Eagle)

- Knowledge of statistics and tools (example: Spotfire) to analyse large amounts of characterization data and determine and set production test limits and predict yield data

- Knowledge of back-end semiconductor processes like Wafer Fabrication, Bump, Packaging, Assembly and Test is an asset. 

- Working experience in a high-pressure environment, competing priorities and tight turnaround times. 

- Strong communication, presentation, and leadership skills; Ability to lead technical discussions and summarize outcome for executive level status reporting. 

- Proficient with industry standard project management tools such as MS Project, Jira, SharePoint, DFMEA, Root Cause Analysis , Confluence, Microsoft OneNote

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

As a Software Engineering Technical Leader, you will provide technical leadership for key software integration, deployment, and customer enablement initiatives while working closely with architects, senior technical leaders, engineering teams, strategic customers, and ecosystem partners.

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments

Collaboration & Growth

Qualifications

Technical Skills

 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

data.description:
Acceldata is reimagining the way companies observe their Data!

Acceldata is the pioneer and leader in data observability, revolutionizing how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive insights into various key aspects of data, data pipelines and data infrastructure across various environments. Our platform empowers data teams to manage products effectively by ensuring data quality, preventing failures, and controlling costs. 

About The Role

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Engineering Manager to lead an engineering team of 15-20 engineers. This is a techno-managerial role responsible for delivering high-quality software while ensuring the team is productive, engaged, and aligned with business goals. This role is responsible for managing a team that works on building the next generation of Acceldata's platform and products and owns the responsibility to ship the key features of the product on-time. 

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will work closely with Engineering Leadership to build the product strategy, reviewing the product roadmaps, track the engineering progress and plan the releases. You will play a key role in hiring, coaching the team members, providing technical guidance and ensuring engineering excellence across the team. 

What You'll Do

- Guide architecture and design decisions. 
 - Review technical proposals and trade-offs. 
 - Establish engineering best practices. 
 - Ensure scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability. 
 - Partner with senior engineers and architects on technical strategy. 

People Leadership

- Build a strong engineering team. 
 - Guide the team, resolve conflicts and remove blockers. 
 - Conduct performance reviews and career development discussions. 
 - Build a healthy and inclusive team culture. 

Project & Delivery Management

- Own execution of engineering roadmaps. 
 - Ensure projects are delivered on time and with quality. 
 - Manage project planning, resource allocation, risk assessment, and dependency management across multiple initiatives. Balance technical debt with feature delivery. 
 - Drive engineering productivity and predictability. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Product Managers on roadmap planning. 
 - Collaborate with Design, Customer Success, Sales, and Support teams. 
 - Align engineering efforts with business objectives. 
 - Communicate status, risks, and priorities to stakeholders. 

Operational Excellence

- Define engineering processes and metrics. 
 - Improve CI/CD, testing, observability, and release management. 
 - Manage incident response and postmortems. 
 - Monitor team health and delivery metrics. 

What We're Looking For

- 14-18 years of hands-on software engineering experience with deep expertise in backend systems and platform engineering. 
 - 6+ years of experience in managing a high performance team of 20+ engineers 
 - Experience designing complex systems around data, applications, and enterprise-scale workloads. 
 - Strong programming expertise in Java, Scala, Golang, or similar backend technologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, and Apache Kafka, along with NoSQL databases (e. g. , Cassandra, MongoDB, HBase, DynamoDB). 
 - Strong experience working within the Big Data ecosystem, including technologies such as Hadoop, HDFS, Hive, YARN, Iceberg, Trino, and Airflow, is highly preferred. 
 - Expertise in project planning, resource allocation, risk assessment, and dependency management 
 - Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to balance technical depth with people leadership and business priorities. 
 - Exceptional problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with engineering leaders, architects, product leaders, and executives. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with large-scale data platforms, analytics systems, or data infrastructure products. 
 - Experience building observability, monitoring, reliability, or platform engineering solutions. 

Why Join Us?

- Build products that solve some of the most challenging problems in Data and AI Observability. 
 - Influence the architecture and technical direction of a category-defining platform. 
 - Work on large-scale distributed systems serving some of the world's largest enterprises. 
 - Collaborate with a world-class engineering team focused on innovation and technical excellence. 
 - Enjoy significant ownership, autonomy, and opportunities to shape the future of the company and its products. 

We care for our team

- Mentorship & Growth
 - ESOPs
 - Medical and Life Insurance
 - Paid Maternity & Parental Leave
 - Corporate Uber Program
 - Learning & Development Support

Acceldata for All

We are a fast-growing company, solving complex data problems at scale. We are driven by strong work ethics, high standards of excellence, and a spirit of collaboration. We promote innovation, commitment, and accountability. Our goal is to cultivate a healthy work environment that fosters a sense of belonging, encourages teamwork, and brings out the best in every individual. 

Why Acceldata?

Acceldata is redefining data observability for enterprise data systems. Founded by experts who recognized the need for innovative monitoring and management solutions in a cloud-first, AI-driven environment, our platform empowers data teams to effectively manage data products. We address common challenges such as scaling and performance issues, cost overruns, and data quality problems by providing operational visibility, proactive alerts, and monitoring reliability across the various environments. 

Delivered as a SaaS product, Acceldata's solutions have been embraced by global customers, such as HPE, HSBC, Visa, Freddie Mac, Manulife, Workday, Zoominfo, GSK, Oracle, PubMatic, PhonePe (Walmart), Hersheys, Dun & Bradstreet, and many more. S9 Trucks is a technology-driven logistics and digital freight marketplace that connects customers, transporters and truck drivers through an integrated platform. We are looking for a skilled Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in converting Figma UI/UX designs into responsive, high-quality, production-ready web applications. Key Responsibilities: 

1. Figma to Frontend Development

- Convert Figma UI/UX designs into pixel-perfect, responsive web pages and applications.

 - Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers to implement designs accurately and suggest technical improvements. 
 - Optimise frontend performance, usability, accessibility and cross-browser compatibility.

2. Backend Development

- Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services using Node. js and Express. js.

 - Authentication, authorisation and API security.

 - Route visualisation, distance calculations and location-based services. Database Management

About dunnhumby

dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3, 000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers. 

Tesco Media

Tesco Media is the ultimate media partner to brands. Built on unrivalled customer insight, it's a media owner with soul, scale, and storytelling power. Tesco Media helps brands and agencies connect meaningfully with customers, drive creative effectiveness, and grow at the point of purchase. 

About the Role

We are looking for an Technical Architect to join our engineering organization and help shape the future of our SaaS platform. Our platform powers retail media solutions for global retailers and CPGs, enabling end-to-end advertisement campaigns across e-commerce sites, in-store channels, and social media platforms. 

This role is pivotal in defining architectural guardrails, frameworks, and patterns that enable multiple squads to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure solutions. You will combine hands-on technical depth with the ability to influence and align engineering managers, lead engineers, and product leaders. This is not an ivory-tower role - you will actively partner with teams, ensuring architecture decisions are practical, business-aligned, and execution ready. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Architectural Leadership: Define and evolve application architecture in line with business and product strategy for a global retail media SaaS platform. 
 - Set Guardrails: Establish repeatable patterns for microservices, APIs, identity/auth, observability, and data flows. 
 - NFR Ownership: Ensure non-functional requirements (scalability, reliability, resiliency, observability, security, maintainability) are embedded into design decision. 
 - Cross-Squad Influence: Collaborate with multiple squads (frontend, backend, BFF, platform services) to align on architectural choices. 
 - Tech Evaluations: Lead structured assessments of new tools and frameworks (e. g. , OPA, SpiceDB, caching, API gateways) and guide adoption. 
 - Decision Frameworks: Move teams away from ad-hoc debates by creating clear frameworks for architectural decision-making. 
 - Mentorship: Partner with engineering managers and lead engineers to strengthen design-level thinking and technical maturity. 

What We're Looking For

- Strong hands-on expertise across modern application architecture
 - . NET Core, C#, REST APIs, microservices. 
 - Event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka, or similar). 
 - Databases (Postgres, SQL Server, caching strategies with Redis or Couchbase). 
 - Identity & authorization frameworks (Auth0, OPA, SpiceDB, OpenFGA). 
 - Observability platforms (New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana). 
 - Cloud-native experience (GCP preferred; AWS/Azure acceptable). 
 - An understanding of AI-enabled application patterns and workflow orchestration frameworks. 
 - Awareness of emerging AI and agentic workflow technologies and their application across retail media, advertising, analytics, and SaaS platforms, with the ability to assess their architectural implications and business value
 - Strong track record of embedding NFRs into platform and product design. 
 - Excellent communicators can simplify trade-offs for both engineers and business stakeholders. 
 - Experience influencing without authority and driving closure across multiple teams. 
You'll Thrive If You. . . 

- Enjoy solving complex technical and organisational challenges. 
 - Can balance long-term architectural vision with practical delivery needs. 
 - Build strong partnerships across engineering, product, and business teams. 
 - Take ownership and drive continual improvement in technology standards and practices. 

India Benefits

- Comprehensive medical insurance of INR 500, 000 covering employees and eligible dependents, with dental and vision benefits included. 
 - Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover, with coverage levels linked to employee grade. 
 - Retirement benefits including Provident Fund, Gratuity, and voluntary National Pension Scheme (NPS). 
 - Employee Assistance Programme, Indian Health Organisation (IHO) membership, and wellbeing resources through the Wellness Hub. 
 - Internet allowance, office commute support, work-from-home kit, subsidised meals, and Early Friday each month. 
 - 25 days annual leave plus 10 public holidays, birthday leave, maternity, paternity and adoption leave provisions. 

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work. We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process. data.title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
data.description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. 

NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team's transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. 
 - Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. 
 - Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done. 
 - Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model. 
 - Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes. 

What We Need To See

- Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks. 
 - Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track. 
 - 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering. 
 - High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team's traditional capacity. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes. 
 - Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland. 
 - Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL. 
 - Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software. 

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you.
