Job Purpose

The purpose of this job is to plan Area Sales Manager and business growth with the Lead (UBS) and meet stated targets considering local variances and competitive dynamics. 

Create and manage Home Loan sales at respective region to develop new relationships by originating leads from and manage Ultratech Channels like (Ultratech Depots, Dealers, and Ultratech Business Solution Dealers) through SRO / RO. 

To identify and develop new locations, micro market for Informal and small ticket Home Loan. 

To develop and manage a team of Senior Relationship Officers and Relationship Officers across the area mapped to develop business: The product portfolio includes Home Loan This role takes joint approval decisions with Risk counterpart as per approval matrix, and partners with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure portfolio health. 

It supports business profitability by identifying and addressing underperformance, adopting/ proposing process improvements, capitalizing on channel optimization opportunities, etc. It serves as a point of escalation for specific cases/ exception handling and supports the removal of bottlenecks at the regional level. It also drives cross-selling across ABHFL and ABFSG products/ solutions in the region as per agreed zonal plans and unique client requirements

Job Context & Major Challenges

Key Aspects: 

Part of the Aditya Birla Capital Limited, Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited (ABHFL) is registered with the National Housing Bank as a housing finance company under the National Housing Bank Act, 1987. The company offers a complete range of housing finance solutions such as home loans, home improvement and home construction loans, balance transfer and top-up loans, loans against property and construction finance. The company acquired its license on 9th July 2014 and has aggressive growth plans. 

ABHFL has grown at a steady rate while reporting good asset quality despite challenges in the operating environment. While the industry is dominated by five large groups, there has been an emergence of segment like Small Ticket Home Loan and self-employed borrowers, given the high potential in these segments. Despite increased focus by banks, HFCs have been able to maintain their share in the mortgage market and is poised for rapid growth and plans to grow 5X (40, 000 Cr) in the next 5 years. This shall take ABHFL within the top 5 percentile of HFCs in the country. 

The ABHFL Sales organization works broadly with 3 customer segments retail (individual) customers, institutional customers (for retail and institutional loan consumers) and builders (for both retail tie-ups and construction finance), with a major share of the business coming from retail customers. Client segments can also be divided into Salaried and Self-employed, with both of these having very different preferences and needs. 

Job Context

Key Aspects: 

The UBS vertical provides long-term Home Loan by originating leads through UltraTech Channels and Open Market customers for Small ticket Home Loan and Informal Lending. 

Providing housing finance (to buyers), Loan against Property, Commercial Property Purchase, Lease Rental Discounting and Construction Finance (to builders) solutions, ABHFL caters to a diverse range of customer segments through its various service offerings. Additionally, being predominantly retail driven, the business is characterized by high volume of loan transactions and customer relationships. As a result, ABHFL business performance is strongly impacted by people, process and organizational efficiencies, alongside core business drivers such as product/ solution quality, channel and customer relationship management and risk management. 

Key Challenges

To create a sales operating plan with the team, considering local factors impacting business, such as competitor presence, existing relationships, new prospect opportunities, etc. , aimed at achieving sales targets

To grow market share as a new brand against established competition, overcoming competitive pressures to create book of desired size for the branch/ city

To constantly upgrade financial & operational know how of self and team members on industry dynamics, effective negotiation and relationship building, and efficient loan processing for maintaining lasting relationships with customers while ensuring portfolio health and profitability

To ensure loan conversion/ sanction/ utilization percentages are high and an appropriate sourcing funnel is built to meet targets

To ensure credit quality and effective portfolio selection/ pre-screening thereby minimizing potential NPAs

To ensure compliant sales operations at all times, despite sales pressures and market cycles

Enabling Skill Sets & Qualifications

Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include business and commercial acumen, team management and communication, execution skills, product-market understanding, and operations integration & controlling skills. 

Education & experience required to fulfil this profile are a postgraduate with minimum 6 - 8 yrs of total sales experience in the Banking/ NBFC space, of which at least recent 3 - 4 yrs experience should be in HFC sales. 

Key Result Areas

KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

KRA1 Branch Sales Planning & Management Work with Regional Sales Manager on devising the branch sales plan and team approach for achieving targets, considering product-environmental factors, competitive forces and local trends, and cascade the same to the branch team(s)

Track industry and market developments, scanning the local market and competitive offerings on a periodic basis

Oversee end to end branch operations and performance, covering all aspects such as sourcing, effectiveness, governance, productivity, channel management, etc. 

Report on and direct teams basis emerging trends and opportunities

Manage day-to-day branch operations and administration

Provide data for, compile and review periodic MIS reports for disbursements, profitability, NPAs, market expansion, etc. and communicate to Regional Sales Manager - ABHFL as well as to team members

KRA2 Customer Acquisition/ Engagement Identify local business growth opportunities, drive expansion and new customer acquisition initiatives to create a book of targeted size

Work closely with team members, hand-holding critical/ complex transactions to ensure favorable closure with customer satisfaction

Communicate sales targets and provide team members clarity on business goals, role expectations, product characteristics and USPs to enhance effectiveness of sales efforts

Track cases in the complaint tracker/ escalations received, liaising with relevant stakeholders as required to drive satisfactory closure

Deploy efforts/ initiatives in consultation with Regional Sales Manager ABHFL, arising from customer satisfaction survey and resulting NPS (Net Promoter Score), targeting identified focus areas

Propose and deploy approved solutions and schemes to drive sales and enhance profitability, ensuring dual focus on sales expansion and cost optimization

Serve as a point of escalation and manage customer complaints/ grievances effectively, intervening especially for key relationships

KRA3 Operational Effectiveness To drive adoption of efficient business processes/ operations across the Customer Lifecycle (Sourcing, Approval, Servicing, Collections)

Manage local distribution across channels, interfacing with senior/ critical partners/ stakeholders as required for smooth operations

Drive process efficiencies and faster TATs through interfacing with stakeholders across processes and functions (Risk, Operations, Sales Governance) and efficient operations

Drive high performance by reinforcing focus on business and sales growth objectives, effective client engagement, monitoring sales operations and productivity metrics, and providing support and guidance as required

Drive the implementation of improved processes and best practices in order to enhance operational effectiveness, productivity and overall business impact

KRA4 Cross-Selling across ABC products Drive activities and initiatives in the team as per cross-selling strategy agreed with Regional Sales Manager ABHFL

Drive alignment to the adopted Cross-Selling strategy by supporting team members with requisite communications, training, guidance, etc. as required

KRA5 Team and Internal Stakeholder Management Guide and develop team members for enhanced customer acquisition and engagement efforts, helping them achieve superior performance standards and handholding where required

Nominate teams for relevant technical and behavioral trainings/ seminars and work on self-development initiatives

Proactively liaise with internal stakeholders for smooth cross-functional coordination and alignment towards achievement of business objectives

KRA6 Portfolio & Risk Management Work with the Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure adherence to risk management and control mechanisms

Support risk and review process through the credit approval process and by reviewing the loan sanctioning, disbursement process and documentation to ensure controlled operations

Review financial risk via analysis of city/ branch operations MIS and Data Analytics reports

Drive compliant Sales Operations and sound risk management via partnership with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams, and necessary communication and guidance drive timely PDD closures and collections

As part of Relationship Maintenance with institutional customers, review reports on client accounts, business performance, etc. and liaise with Risk while guiding team on delinquency cases

Train and guide the team for alignment with adopted early alert strategies to reduce NPA risks and losses

Ensure systematic MIS on NPAs and credit trends, providing inputs on possible risks that could impact portfolio quality

Description

Join our Global Specialty Fulfillment Central Operations team as a Program Manager I where you'll drive operational excellence for our quick commerce business in North America. In this high-impact role, you'll serve as the operational performance owner for the North America geographical region, identifying and eliminating defects that impact customer experience while collaborating with multiple stakeholders to optimize processes. You'll have the freedom to develop innovative solutions that reduce operational costs, eliminate quality issues, and enhance overall performance metrics. 

This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of operations and strategic business improvements. You'll develop expertise in quick commerce business nuances specific to the North American market while exercising a high degree of ownership in identifying more efficient ways of working. Your analytical abilities will be crucial as you deep dive into operational data, identify root causes of performance issues, and implement effective solutions that directly impact customer satisfaction across North America. 

Key job responsibilities

Own operational performance metrics for the North America region, conducting regular deep dives into data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement Identify and eliminate operational defects leading to negative customer experiences through root cause analysis and implementing preventative measures Partner with North American operations teams to understand daily performance challenges, diagnose bottlenecks, and develop strategies to reduce quality issues and business waste Represent Central Operations in business stakeholder meetings focused on North America performance, effectively communicating operational status, challenges, and proposed solutions Transform raw data into clear documentation, requirements, and actionable insights that drive process improvements across the North American organization

A day in the life

A day in the life Your day begins with an in-depth analysis of the previous day's operational defects in North America, using data to identify patterns and root causes. You'll collaborate with North American operations teams to understand the current day's performance status and potential challenges. Throughout the day, you'll brainstorm strategies to reduce operational costs and business waste specific to the NA market, represent Central Operations in business calls with North American stakeholders, and coordinate with the central CO team to provide necessary support where needed. Description

How does Amazon know whether it is delivering faster than the competition? That question is answered by the Speed Measurement and Analytics team within Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT), and as a Business Intelligence Engineer I on this team, you will help build the answer. You will own data pipelines, dashboards, and analytical deep-dives that feed into Pulse, the team's benchmarking product that tracks competitive delivery speed across 10+ geographies worldwide. Your work will directly inform how Amazon invests in speed improvements across Worldwide Stores. If you are curious, analytical, and energized by turning large-scale data into clear, actionable insights, this is a great opportunity to grow your career while shaping decisions that matter. 

Key job responsibilities

- Build and maintain data pipelines, ETL jobs, and data models that power competitive delivery-speed benchmarking across your assigned geography or horizontal function, ensuring data freshness, accuracy, and completeness.

 - Collaborate with Product Managers, Program Managers, and peer Business Intelligence Engineers to align data definitions, standardize metrics, and support the onboarding of new geographies into the benchmarking platform.

You will start your day checking pipeline health and dashboard accuracy for your assigned geography, then move into writing or refining SQL queries that feed the latest benchmarking signals into Pulse. You might spend part of the afternoon investigating a data discrepancy flagged by a regional lead, or meeting with a Product Manager to scope a new competitive analysis. The Speed Measurement and Analytics team sits within Amazon's Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) organization. Our mission is to give Worldwide Stores a single, trusted view of how Amazon's delivery speed compares to competitors globally. data.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Digital Verification Engineer to take on a Technical Leader role within our Imaging verification team. The candidate will drive verification strategy and closure for complex digital IPs in imaging and automotive subsystems, mentor junior engineers, and act as the technical point of contact for verification across cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end verification strategy, planning, and closure for one or more complex IPs/subsystems. 
 - Architect and review UVM-based verification environments, ensuring reusability and scalability across projects. 
 - Drive functional and code coverage closure; define coverage models and identify verification gaps early in the cycle. 
 - Lead protocol-level verification efforts (e. g. , I3C, MIPI, AMBA), including VIP evaluation, integration, and debug. 
 - Apply the use of formal verification techniques (e. g. , JasperGold) to complement simulation-based verification, particularly for FSM and control-logic-heavy blocks. 
 - Review test plans, testbenches, and verification collateral authored by team members; provide technical guidance on methodology and debug approaches. 
 - Interface with design, architecture, DFT, and software teams to clarify specification ambiguities and drive design-for-verification practices. 
 - Identify and resolve spec ambiguities/errata; work with IP/protocol working groups where applicable. 
 - Mentor and technically guide junior verification engineers; support their ramp-up on tools, methodology, and protocols. 
 - Drive process improvements: regression infrastructure, debug efficiency, coverage methodology, and verification reuse. 
 - Communicate verification status, risks, and closure plans to management and stakeholders. 
 - Support root-cause analysis of silicon/post-silicon issues traced back to verification gaps, where relevant. 

Required Skills

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (VLSI specialization preferred). 
 - 5-7 years of experience in digital design/IP verification, with demonstrated ownership of verification closure for at least one complex IP or subsystem. 
 - Strong expertise in System Verilog and UVM methodology - testbench architecture, sequences, scoreboards, and reference models. 
 - Proven experience with functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion-based verification (SVA); ability to define coverage models from specification. 
 - Hands-on experience with industry-standard simulation tools (VCS, Xcelium, or Questa) and debug tools. 
 - Experience with formal verification tools and methodology (e. g. , JasperGold) for FSM, connectivity, or control-logic verification. 
 - Solid understanding of one or more protocols such as I3C, I2C, SPI, AMBA, MIPI-CSI, or similar interconnect/interface standards, including VIP-based verification. 
 - Strong scripting skills (Python, Perl, or TCL) for automation, flow development, and regression management. 
 - Ability to read and interpret design specifications, RTL, and identify verification risk areas independently. 

Preferred / Good To Have

- Experience mentoring or technically leading a small team of verification engineers. 
 - Exposure to mutation testing or other coverage-quality assessment techniques. 
 - Familiarity with low-power verification (UPF/CPF) and Gate Level simulations. 
 - Experience working with EDA vendors (e. g. , Cadence, Synopsys) for tool/methodology support and issue resolution. 
 - Prior contribution to internal verification methodology documents, guidelines, or reusable verification IP (VIP) development. 
 - Experience working in a globally distributed team environment. 

Soft Skills

- Strong technical leadership and mentoring ability. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous or under-specified requirements. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills - able to present technical status and risk clearly to management. 
 - Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive closure under deadlines. 
 - Collaborative approach to working with design, architecture, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML assisted verification techniques to improve verification productivity and efficiency. 

What We Offer

- A technical leadership track with visibility into IP-level and subsystem-level verification strategy. 
 - Opportunity to shape verification methodology, including formal and protocol verification practices. 
 - Mentorship and people-development opportunities within a growing team. 
 - Exposure to advanced verification domains including formal verification and next-generation Security IP and systems. 
 - Collaborative, cross-functional work environment with global teams. 

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. 

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 

To discover more, visit st. com/careers.

Experience with ML Inference frameworks such as vLLM, SG Lang, Pathways and experience in open-source software development, including experience in releasing and supporting open-source projects. 

About the jobLike Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way. 

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. 

Our team is focused around driving continuous improvements to the machine learning software/hardware stacks through providing insightful performance debugging for workloads and custom kernels. We provide insights by summarizing different views of captured profile data - such as trace timelines, memory usage, Compiler profiles, ML graph summariesThe ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc. ) and Google Cloud. Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world. 

We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing. data.title: Staff Engineer, CPU Core Verification
data.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities. 

At Tenstorrent, we build open, state of the art compute for real workloads and real developers. You will own CPU core‐level verification, shaping how our out‐of‐order RISC‐V CPUs behave in silicon. 

This role is hybrid, based out of Bangalore, India. 

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting. 

Who You Are

- You bring 8+ years in CPU verification or closely related digital design. 
 - You know high‐performance out‐of‐order CPU microarchitecture in depth. 
 - You work comfortably with RTL, waveforms, logs, and complex debug scenarios. 
 - You communicate clearly across design, DV, emulation, and post‐silicon teams. 

What We Need

- Plan and drive functional verification for CPU core features and complex microarchitectural scenarios. 
 - Develop UVM, assembly, and C/C++ based stimulus, functional models, and coverage for ISA, RISC-V extensions, and un-core components. 
 - Debug simulation and emulation regressions using RTL understanding, waveforms, and logs to identify and resolve issues efficiently. 
 - Build and enhance coverage models, testbenches, and debug infrastructure to improve verification quality and coverage closure. 
 - Collaborate with design, validation, and test teams to support bring-up and delivery of robust CPU cores and clusters. 

What You Will Learn

- How Tenstorrent designs and validates high‐performance RISC‐V CPU cores and clusters. 
 - Techniques for spanning pre‐silicon, emulation, and post‐silicon verification with shared stimulus. 
 - Ways to scale coverage, debug, and infrastructure across multiple CPU programs. 
 - How open hardware and software fit into Tenstorrent's broader compute roadmap. 

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

data.title: Product Security Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Product Security Engineer with a strong background in software development, software testing, and security engineering to embed security into the product development lifecycle. The role will work closely with Product Engineering, QA, DevOps, and Product Security teams to identify, assess, and remediate security risks across products. 

The ideal candidate should be able to understand code, design and execute security tests, identify vulnerabilities, and work directly with development teams to implement effective security controls. 

Key Responsibilities

- Integrate security practices into the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) from design through release. 
 - Perform security reviews of product architecture, source code, APIs, and software components. 
 - Conduct security testing including: 
 - SAST and SCA
 - DAST/API security testing
 - Vulnerability assessment
 - Fuzz testing
 - Penetration testing
 - Security regression testing
 - Review and analyze vulnerabilities identified through security tools and testing activities. 
 - Work with developers to triage, reproduce, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities. 
 - Develop security test cases and automation to improve security testing coverage. 
 - Support implementation of secure coding practices and security controls within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Participate in threat modelling and security risk assessments for new features and products. 
 - Review third-party and open-source components for security risks and support SBOM generation and maintenance. 
 - Support vulnerability remediation and security update processes throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Investigate security defects and perform root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence. 
 - Support security requirements, security acceptance criteria, and release security assessments. 
 - Collaborate with Product Security Architect, Product Security Specialist , Developers, QA, DevOps, and Product Managers to drive security improvements. 
 - Maintain evidence and documentation required for product security and regulatory compliance, including EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) requirements. 
Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's or master's degree in cyber security, Computer Science, Information Security, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 5+ years of experience in software development, application security, or product security. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in at least one programming language such as C/C++, Java, Python, or JavaScript. 
 - Good understanding of software development lifecycle and testing methodologies. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to read and understand source code and work closely with developers on remediation. 
 - Experience with security testing tools such as SAST, SCA, DAST, vulnerability scanners, fuzzing tools, and penetration-testing tools. 
 - Understanding of common application and product security vulnerabilities such as OWASP Top 10, CWE, injection, authentication/authorization issues, memory vulnerabilities, insecure configurations, and cryptographic weaknesses. 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Dev SecOps practices. 
 - Understanding of threat modelling, risk assessment, vulnerability management, and secure coding principles. 
 - Experience analyzing vulnerabilities using CVSS/CWE/CVE information. 
 - Good understanding of software composition analysis and open-source security. 

Good to Have

- Experience with embedded products, firmware, hardware-software products, or network/security products. 
 - Knowledge of SBOM formats such as SPDX or CycloneDX. 
 - Experience with tools such as Black Duck, JFrog, GitHub Advanced Security, Coverity, SonarQube, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or similar tools. 
 - Knowledge of cryptography, TLS, PKI, secure boot, code signing, and key management. 
 - Experience implementing security controls in CI/CD pipelines. 

Key Deliverables / Success Measures

- Security vulnerabilities identified early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Security testing integrated into CI/CD and product release processes. 
 - Timely remediation of product security vulnerabilities. 
 - Improved security test coverage and automation. 
 - Security requirements and threat-model findings addressed before product release. 
 - Accurate SBOM and vulnerability information maintained for products. 
 - Product security evidence available to support regulatory compliance requirements.

data.title: CPU Design Verification Engineer II
data.description:
About SiFive

As the pioneers who introduced RISC-V to the world, SiFive is transforming the future of compute by bringing the limitless potential of RISC-V to the highest performance and most data-intensive applications in the world. SiFive's unrivaled compute platforms are continuing to enable leading technology companies around the world to innovate, optimize and deliver the most advanced solutions of tomorrow across every market segment of chip design, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, automotive, data center, mobile, and consumer. With SiFive, the future of RISC-V has no limits. 

At SiFive, we are always excited to connect with talented individuals, who are just as passionate about driving innovation and changing the world as we are. 

Our constant innovation and ongoing success is down to our amazing teams of incredibly talented people, who collaborate and support each other to come up with truly groundbreaking ideas and solutions. Solutions that will have a huge impact on people's lives; making the world a better place, one processor at a time. 

Are you ready?

To learn more about SiFive's phenomenal success and to see why we have won the GSA's prestigious Most Respected Private Company Award (for the fourth time!), check out our website and Glassdoor pages. 

Job Description: 

About The Role

You'll verify high-performance out-of-order RISC-V CPU cores from RTL bring-up through tapeout. This is a hands-on role at the block and core level: you'll write testbench components, build constrained-random and directed stimulus, close coverage, and debug the hard failures that come out of nightly regressions - pipeline hazards, memory-ordering violations, speculation and flush corner cases, and co-simulation divergences between RTL and the golden ISA model. 

You'll work directly with core micro-architects and RTL designers, and you'll own verification of specific units (e. g. rename/dispatch, issue queues, load-store unit, MMU/TLB, branch prediction, or the retire/commit path) as well as core-level scenarios. 

What You'll Do

- Own the verification plan for one or more OOO core units: extract testable features from the micro-architecture spec, define stimulus and coverage requirements, and drive them to closure. 
 - Build and extend UVM testbench infrastructure - agents, drivers/monitors, scoreboards, reference models, functional coverage, and assertions (SVA). 
 - Develop constrained-random test generators and directed tests (C/assembly test programs plus SV stimulus) targeting deep pipeline states: speculative execution and misprediction recovery, replay and livelock scenarios, exception/interrupt injection, memory-ordering and coherence corner cases, and privilege/virtual-memory transitions. 
 - Debug regression failures end to end: triage waveforms, correlate RTL state against instruction-by-instruction co-simulation mismatches (PC, write-data, CSR state), and reduce failures to a minimal reproducer with a clear root-cause writeup for the designer. 
 - Drive coverage closure - code, functional, and assertion coverage - including analyzing holes, adding stimulus or coverage waivers with justification, and reporting progress against tapeout milestones. 
 - Maintain and improve regression health: keep failure signatures triaged and bucketed, reduce noise, and improve turnaround time and debuggability of the test flow. 
 - Contribute to the verification environment and tooling: build/run flows, log parsers, failure-signature classification, and CI integration. 
 - Review micro-architecture and RTL changes for verification impact; participate in spec reviews and file spec ambiguities. 

Required Qualifications

- BS or MS in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent. 
 - 2+ years of professional pre-silicon functional verification experience (MS with strong relevant internship/project experience considered). 
 - Strong SystemVerilog and UVM: you can write and extend testbench components independently, not just author tests in an existing environment. 
 - Solid computer-architecture fundamentals: pipelining, caches and cache hierarchy, branch prediction, register renaming, out-of-order issue and in-order retirement, memory consistency and coherence basics. 
 - Proficiency with a simulator (VCS, Questa, or Xcelium) and waveform debug (Verdi, Visualizer, or similar) - including independently debugging a failing test from log to waveform to root cause. 
 - Working knowledge of assembly and C at the bare-metal level; comfortable reading disassembly and reasoning about instruction streams. 
 - Scripting for automation and analysis: Python, plus shell/Makefile fluency. 
 - Version control and code review workflow (Git). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience verifying an out-of-order or superscalar core
 - RISC-V experience: familiarity with the unprivileged and privileged specs, and with extensions such as vector (V), hypervisor (H), or atomics (A). 
 - Experience with ISA co-simulation / lockstep golden-model flows (spike or equivalent) and with debugging scoreboard mismatches. 
 - Random instruction-stream test generators (e. g. Sting, RISCV-DV, force-riscv, or an in-house equivalent) - including constraining and extending a generator, not just running it. 
 - Formal property verification for control-logic blocks (JasperGold or VC Formal). 
 - Exposure to memory-model verification, litmus tests, or a coherence/ordering checker. 
 - Performance verification or performance-counter validation experience. 
 - Emulation/FPGA prototyping, or post-silicon bring-up exposure. 

Additional Information: 

This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in: 

India

Any offer of employment for this position is also contingent on the Company verifying that you are a authorized for access to export-controlled technology under applicable export control laws or, if you are not already authorized, our ability to successfully obtain any necessary export license(s) or other approvals.

The role focuses on platform bring-up, BSP and HLOS stability, virtualization, power and performance integration, defect resolution, and customer-facing technical execution. The engineer will work across platform, silicon, system, safety, security, and application teams to drive issues from problem isolation through root cause, corrective action, validation, and release readiness. 

This role requires strong hands-on debugging as well as the ability to lead technical investigations, influence cross-functional decisions, mentor engineers, and represent the QNX Platform domain in customer and internal reviews. 

Key Responsibilities

QNX Platform Technical Ownership

- Own technical execution for QNX platform domains including BSP, boot, kernel and system services, memory, interrupts, I/O, storage, networking, virtualization, power management, suspend/resume, and platform stability. 
 - Lead platform bring-up, integration, configuration, qualification, and release activities across automotive SoC and board platforms. 
 - Analyze complex failures involving boot, reset, suspend/resume, performance, memory, resource ownership, inter-process communication, and multi-VM or multi-domain interactions. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis using logs, traces, dumps, instrumentation, system behavior, and reproducible test cases; document technical conclusions and corrective actions. 
 - Review architecture, design, code, patches, test plans, and release criteria for robustness, maintainability, safety, security, and performance. 

Customer Engineering and Issue Resolution

- Act as a technical point of contact for QNX platform issues, escalations, integration blockers, and stability risks. 
 - Translate system-level customer symptoms into actionable engineering problem statements, reproduce issues, identify ownership, and coordinate closure across teams. 
 - Lead triage and prioritization of critical blockers, including clear impact assessment, containment, action plans, and status communication. 
 - Partner with customers, silicon/platform teams, QNX teams, and internal software organizations while maintaining technical clarity and accountability. 
 - Support release readiness and production milestones by tracking risks, validation gaps, regressions, and dependency closure. 

Technical Leadership and Collaboration

- Lead multi-domain investigations and drive alignment when issues span BSP, HLOS, hypervisor, firmware, hardware, power, security, or application layers. 
 - Mentor engineers in debugging methodology, QNX platform architecture, issue analysis, code quality, and customer-oriented execution. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, architecture notes, and reusable analysis practices. 
 - Participate in technical reviews, defect reviews, readiness assessments, and continuous-improvement activities. 
 - Identify recurring failure patterns and drive preventive actions in design, testing, automation, integration, and development processes. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Typically 6+ years of relevant embedded software, operating-system, BSP, platform, or automotive systems experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with QNX Neutrino or comparable real-time operating-system concepts and platform integration. 
 - Solid understanding of embedded system architecture: boot flow, BSP components, device drivers, kernel services, interrupts, memory management, scheduling, IPC, synchronization, and resource management. 
 - Experience debugging complex system failures using logs, traces, crash dumps, instrumentation, debuggers, and hardware/software observability mechanisms. 
 - Strong C and C++ programming skills, with ability to read, modify, review, and troubleshoot low-level system software. 
 - Working knowledge of ARM-based SoC systems, firmware interactions, device trees or equivalent hardware description mechanisms, and board-level integration. 
 - Experience with software development life cycle, code review, configuration management, defect tracking, regression testing, and release qualification. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with automotive platforms, vehicle compute systems, domain controllers, or production embedded products. 
 - Experience with QNX Hypervisor or equivalent virtualization technologies, including VM configuration, inter-domain communication, device assignment, and resource isolation. 
 - Knowledge of platform power management, low-power states, suspend-to-RAM, wake sources, thermal behavior, performance optimization, and power-aware debugging. 
 - Experience with SMMU/IOMMU, DMA, shared memory, ECC/EDAC. 
 - Experience with automated validation, continuous integration, stress testing, fault injection, long-duration stability testing, and system reliability metrics. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional technical programs or serving as a domain subject-matter expert.

We are currently seeking a RR Integration lead to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN). 

The SAP Integration Suite / CPI Developer will design, develop, test, document, deploy, monitor, and support integrations between SAP S/4HANA and multiple SAP and non-SAP systems in a global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. This role will work primarily with SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration, and must also support CPI-DS / SAP Cloud Integration for Data Services for SAP IBP data integration. The position requires strong hands-on technical skills, rigorous documentation discipline, structured testing support, cutover readiness, hypercare support, and knowledge transfer to support/COE teams. 

Day-to-Day Job Duties

- Design, build, test, deploy, monitor, and support integration flows using SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration for SAP-to-SAP and SAP-to-non-SAP integration scenarios. 
 - Design, build, schedule, monitor, and support CPI-DS jobs for SAP IBP integration, including master data and transactional data movement between SAP S/4HANA and SAP IBP. 
 - Support SAP IBP integration scenarios involving planning areas, key figures, attributes, planning levels, master data, transactional data, full/delta loads, job scheduling, monitoring, error handling, and reconciliation. 
 - Develop integrations involving SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network, SuccessFactors, Concur, BlackLine, OneSource, OpenText VIM/OCR, SAP Sales Cloud, SimpleMDG, SAP IBP, SAP PLM, SAP ECTR, SAP Integrated Product Development, MES platforms, Loftware, Enlabel, SAP Document Compliance/DRC, SAP Multibank Connectivity/MBC, SAP BCM, SAC, Datasphere, Power BI, Snowflake, Workday, Dayforce/Ceridian, Oracle EBS, Oracle Demand Management, Oracle intercompany, Legal Tracker, Kiosk, CTSI, Reliance, tax/e-invoicing platforms, supplier/customer EDI partner systems, and other enterprise applications. 
 - Create interface design documents, source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, routing logic, error handling designs, retry logic, reconciliation approach, monitoring procedures, runbooks, and deployment documentation. 
 - Support synchronous, asynchronous, file-based, API-based, message-based, EDI, B2B, cXML, and event-driven integration patterns. 
 - Develop integrations using adapters and protocols including IDoc, OData, REST, SOAP, cXML, ANSI X12, EDIFACT, SFTP, APIs, XML, JSON, OAuth, certificates, PGP/encryption, and related message formats. 
 - Support SAP Ariba Managed Gateway / Cloud Integration Gateway scenarios for purchase orders, purchase order changes, goods receipts, service entry sheets, invoices, invoice status, payment remittance, supplier collaboration, and Business Network processes. 
 - Support EDI scenarios for supplier and customer-facing transactions, including direct supplier/customer EDI where standard network connectivity is not sufficient. 
 - Support banking and treasury integrations including payment files, bank statements, inbound/outbound messages, SWIFT/EBICS connectivity, bank onboarding, format validation, certificate/security setup, exception handling, and bank connectivity testing. 
 - Monitor CPI and CPI-DS jobs, troubleshoot failures, analyze logs, coordinate data corrections, manage retries and reloads, and resolve integration defects during SIT, UAT, mock cutover, production cutover, and hypercare. 
 - Support formal integration testing including SIT1, SIT2, UAT, regression testing, performance testing, security testing, cutover rehearsals, production deployment, hypercare stabilization, and handover to support/COE teams. 

SAP BTP Integration Suite Capabilities

- SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration for integration flow development, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operations. 
 - SAP API Management for API exposure, proxy configuration, policy enforcement, and API lifecycle governance where applicable. 
 - Trading Partner Management and B2B capabilities where applicable for EDI and partner integration scenarios. 
 - SAP Event Mesh or event-driven integration concepts where applicable. 
 - SAP Cloud Connector, destinations, secure connectivity, OAuth, certificates, PGP/encryption, SFTP keys, principal propagation, and network/security coordination. 
 - Operational monitoring, alerting, retry/reprocess procedures, interface runbooks, production support handover, and COE enablement. 

Testing, Validation, Cutover, and Hypercare Responsibilities

- Support test preparation by creating integration test cases, test data needs, expected results, and interface readiness criteria. 
 - Support SIT1, SIT2, UAT, regression testing, performance testing, and integration validation using SAP Cloud ALM or approved project tools. 
 - Support GxP/CSV-aware delivery where applicable, including controlled documentation, traceability, test evidence, defect resolution notes, and approval support. 
 - Support cutover planning, endpoint readiness, certificate/key validation, partner readiness, job scheduling, interface freeze windows, mock cutover, production cutover, and post-load reconciliation. 
 - Provide hypercare support including triage, root cause analysis, monitoring, reprocessing, issue closure, knowledge transfer, and support handover documentation. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with SAP IBP integration using CPI-DS in global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs. 
 - Experience with data load performance tuning, job scheduling, dependency management, full/delta load strategies, and high-volume planning data reconciliation. 
 - Experience with SAP Document Compliance/DRC and statutory e-invoicing integrations across multiple countries. 
 - Experience with SAP Multibank Connectivity/MBC, SAP BCM, SWIFT/EBICS, bank onboarding, and bank statement/payment file integration. 
 - Experience in GxP/CSV-regulated environments and multi-country SAP deployments. 
 - Experience with monitoring dashboards, alerting, operational support transition, and COE knowledge transfer. 

Degree

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related field. Equivalent hands-on SAP integration project experience may be considered. 

Professional Competencies

- Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive assigned deliverables from design through hypercare.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical topics to functional and business stakeholders.

data.description:
AppLogic Networks powers the networks behind AI and the critical applications people rely on every day. We help network owners service providers and Enterprises understand how applications perform, how users experience them, and where action is needed to improve quality, efficiency, security, and profitability. Our software combines application intelligence, experience visibility, contextual insights, and real-time control to help customers elevate observability and do more with the networks they already run. As AI reshapes how the world works, connects, and communicates, AppLogic Networks helps ensure modern applications run smoothly across any network, from the consumer edge to the data center. Join our team and help build the software that makes networks smarter, more adaptive, and ready for what comes next. 

The next generation of enterprise networking and analytics products won't be built by teams that simply execute a roadmap, they will be built by engineers who combine deep technical expertise with modern AI-driven software development. At AppLogic Networks, we are looking for a Software Engineering Manager to lead the development of our high-performance data plane. This is an opportunity to build products that solve complex enterprise networking challenges while playing a direct role in shaping product strategy, technical direction, and customer success. 

We're looking for experienced engineers from organizations that build enterprise networking and analytics products, people who understand what it takes to develop software that is secure, scalable, reliable, and deployed in mission-critical enterprise environments. 

Why AppLogic Networks?

At AppLogic, engineering leaders help define what gets built, why it matters, and how it succeeds in the market. 

As an Engineering Manager, you'll have the opportunity to influence: 

- Product strategy and long-term roadmap
 - Architecture and technology direction
 - Customer-facing solutions
 - Feature prioritization and investment decisions
 - Engineering practices and team culture

Your ideas won't disappear into multiple layers of management. You'll work directly with senior engineering and product leadership, helping shape products that make a measurable difference for enterprise customers. This is an opportunity to help build the future of the company. 

Engineering in the Age of Generative AI

We believe Generative AI is fundamentally changing how great software is built. At AppLogic, we are investing in AI-assisted engineering across the software development lifecycle, from architecture and design through implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and operational excellence. 

We Are Looking For Leaders Who Are Excited To

- Actively use Generative AI to improve engineering productivity and software quality. 
 - Build engineering workflows that thoughtfully integrate AI into everyday development. 
 - Help teams adopt modern AI-powered development practices while maintaining high engineering standards. 
 - Explore new ways AI can accelerate innovation without compromising design quality or customer trust. 

If you're already using AI coding assistants, AI-driven testing, automated code reviews, design assistants, or other Generative AI tools as part of your daily engineering workflow, we would love to hear how you have applied them to deliver better products and stronger engineering outcomes. 

What You Will Do

- Lead a team developing high-performance data plane software for enterprise networking and analytic products. 
 - Drive feature development from concept through customer deployment. 
 - Partner closely with Product Management to influence roadmap, prioritization, and customer value. 
 - Collaborate with architects on scalable, resilient, high-performance networking solutions. 
 - Guide engineers through design, implementation, code reviews, testing, and successful delivery. 
 - Remain technically engaged through architecture reviews and key design decisions. 
 - Champion engineering excellence, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-enabled software development practices that improve speed, quality, and developer experience. 
 - Engage with customers and field teams to understand real-world enterprise challenges and translate them into impactful product capabilities. 

What We Are Looking For

We're looking for engineers who have built real products for enterprise customers, not just software applications. You should have experience developing one or more of the following: 

- Enterprise networking platforms
 - Network security products
 - Firewalls and secure gateways
 - Application delivery platforms
 - SD-WAN or SASE solutions
 - VPN technologies
 - High-performance packet processing systems
 - Deep packet inspection, traffic management, or network acceleration technologies

Basic Qualification

- 7-12 years of software development experience building enterprise infrastructure software. 
 - Recent technical leadership experience or experience leading a small engineering team. 
 - Strong C/C++ systems programming expertise. 
 - Deep understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, VPNs, QoS, and network security. 
 - Experience developing software in the data plane or other high-performance networking environments. 
 - Strong Linux systems programming experience. 
 - Excellent software architecture, design, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Practical experience incorporating Generative AI into software engineering workflows to improve productivity, quality, or innovation. 

Previous management experience is valuable, but we're equally interested in exceptional technical leaders who are ready to take the next step in their careers. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will: 

- Build and develop a high-performing engineering team. 
 - Deliver meaningful capabilities for enterprise customers. 
 - Influence product strategy and technical direction. 
 - Establish AI-enabled engineering practices that improve development velocity and quality. 
 - Help define the future of our data plane platform. 
 - Become a trusted technical and organizational leader across the company. 

Why Talented Engineers Join AppLogic

Because They Want

- Meaningful technical ownership. 
 - A direct voice in product and technology decisions. 
 - The ability to move quickly and see ideas become reality. 
 - Challenging engineering problems with enterprise-scale impact. 
 - The opportunity to work with modern AI-powered development practices. 
 - A collaborative environment where technical excellence is recognized and rewarded.

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

As a Staff SSD Validation Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc. , you will be responsible for defining and driving comprehensive validation strategies for Micron NAND-based SSD systems and solutions. You will lead development of test plans, test cases, and automation frameworks to validate SSD firmware across functional, system-level, performance, reliability, interoperability, and customer qualification domains. You will serve as a technical leader, driving validation excellence, automation, and innovation while collaborating closely with firmware, hardware, systems, product engineering, and hyperscale customers throughout the product lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in NVMe/PCIe technologies, SSD architecture, customer qualification requirements, and automated validation methodologies. This role also requires a strong focus on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advanced automation technologies to improve validation productivity, product quality, and time-to-market. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define validation strategies, test plans, test cases, and automation frameworks for SSD firmware validation. 
 - Develop and maintain automated test solutions covering functional, system, performance, reliability, interoperability, and customer qualification requirements. 
 - Lead validation efforts across all phases of the product lifecycle, including development, qualification, customer enablement, and sustaining activities. 
 - Demonstrate strong understanding of NVMe, PCIe, OCP Cloud SSD specifications, storage protocols, and customer-specific requirements. 
 - Partner with Micron's hyperscale and datacenter customers to improve product quality, customer satisfaction, and qualification cycle times. 
 - Drive issue identification, debug, root cause analysis, and closure through effective collaboration with firmware, hardware, system architecture, and product engineering teams. 
 - Analyze validation results, identify quality risks, and provide clear recommendations to stakeholders and leadership. 
 - Communicate validation status, technical risks, mitigation plans, and project progress effectively across organizations. 
 - Influence and lead cross-functional teams to execute validation strategies and achieve program milestones. 
 - Operate effectively in ambiguous environments and independently drive high-impact initiatives to completion. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote technical excellence, automation, and best practices across the validation organization. 
 - Leverage AI-powered engineering tools and approved enterprise AI solutions to improve test development, debug efficiency, data analysis, and reporting workflows. 
 - Identify opportunities to apply AI and machine learning techniques for automating validation workflows, failure analysis, anomaly detection, and predictive quality analytics. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort, enhance test coverage, accelerate issue triage, and improve validation throughput. 
 - Utilize Generative AI tools for code generation, test case development, log analysis, technical documentation, and productivity enhancement while adhering to company policies. 
 - Champion responsible and ethical AI practices, ensuring compliance with Micron AI governance, security, privacy, and data protection requirements. 
 - Mentor teams on effective AI adoption, prompt engineering techniques, and AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve organizational productivity and innovation. 

Required Experience

- 6-12 years of experience in Embedded Firmware, Storage Systems, or SSD Validation Engineering. 
 - 4+ years of SSD Firmware Validation experience is highly preferred. 
 - Strong understanding of SSD architecture, NAND Flash technologies, and storage subsystems. 
 - Deep knowledge of NVMe, PCIe, OCP Cloud SSD, and enterprise storage specifications. 
 - Experience with Datacenter Compute and Storage environments such as Microsoft Hyper-V, VMware vSphere, VSAN, and cloud infrastructure is a strong plus. 
 - Strong hands-on experience debugging NVMe/SAS protocol issues using protocol analyzers such as LeCroy and JDSU. 
 - Experience developing comprehensive validation plans involving I/O workloads, NVMe protocols, media management, endurance, and reliability testing. 
 - Experience using storage validation platforms and tools such as Medusa, SanBlaze, OakGate, UNH, PCIe-CV, and related qualification suites. 
 - Experience integrating tests into automated validation frameworks and continuous integration environments. 
 - Proven ability to drive complex technical issues to closure across multiple organizations. 
 - Experience reviewing, analyzing, tracking, and documenting validation results and product quality issues. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in driving validation strategies for large-scale programs and customer engagements. 

Successful Candidates Will Have

Technical Skills

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field. 
 - Strong programming expertise in Python and test automation framework development. 
 - Strong Linux and Windows debugging experience. 
 - Excellent knowledge of storage systems and platform architecture, including CPU, Memory, PCIe, Drivers, Operating Systems, Firmware, and Hardware interactions. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 
 - Experience with large-scale automation environments and continuous validation systems. 
 - Ability to analyze complex technical data and make informed engineering decisions. 

AI & Data-Driven Engineering Skills

- Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools to improve engineering productivity and technical decision-making. 
 - Understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and practical AI use cases within engineering workflows. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools for scripting, debugging, test generation, report creation, and knowledge discovery. 
 - Knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, data analytics, and AI-enabled automation techniques is highly desirable. 
 - Ability to critically review and validate AI-generated outputs and apply engineering judgment to ensure technical accuracy. 
 - Commitment to responsible AI usage, data governance, security, privacy, and ethical AI practices. 

Leadership & Professional Skills

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Strong project planning, execution, and organizational skills.

 - Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

data.title: Staff Digital Verification Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years building verification environments that have to catch the bugs no one else saw coming, the corner cases that only show up when three protocols collide and a timing edge goes the wrong way. You know that a test plan is only as good as the bugs it finds, and you have learned to think like the design, like the system integrator, and like the customer all at once. 

You are the engineer who sees a coverage hole at 95% and knows exactly which scenario is missing. Writing assertions is not a checkbox exercise for you, it is how you encode your understanding of what should never happen. You have debugged enough waveforms to know when something smells wrong three layers deeper than the symptom. 

Leading a verification effort means more than running regressions. You set the strategy, you review the test plans your team writes, and you make the call on what gets verified to what depth. You work directly with RTL designers and architects, not to rubber-stamp their work but to push back when the intent is unclear or the interface is going to be painful to verify. 

At Synopsys, you will work on DesignWare IP that ships into real products. The verification environments you build will be used across product generations, and the bugs you catch will never make it to silicon. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and evolve SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments for DesignWare synthesizable IP cores, ensuring they scale across multiple product generations and configurations
 - Define comprehensive test plans that cover corner cases, protocol compliance, and system-level interactions for serial interface protocols and memory controllers, including DDR and LPDDR where applicable
 - Write and debug complex testbenches, checkers, and assertions that catch real bugs in critical PHY blocks and interface logic
 - Develop software requirements for the PHY that scale across various configurations and use cases
 - Own verification closure for multiple critical blocks within DDR PHYs, including functional coverage, code coverage, and formal signoff
 - Collaborate directly with RTL designers, digital architects, and circuit teams to align verification scope with design intent and surface issues early in the design cycle
 - Manage regression infrastructure and work with the infra team to optimize verification cycles, debug failures, and keep the environment reliable

The Impact You Will Have

- Your verification environments will catch critical bugs before tapeout, directly affecting the quality and time-to-market of DesignWare IP used across the semiconductor industry
 - The test plans you define and review will set the verification standard for the team, ensuring consistent coverage and reducing escapes
 - Your coverage-driven approach will surface gaps that others miss, leading to more robust IP and fewer silicon respins
 - The assertions and checkers you write will become reusable verification IP, accelerating future projects and raising the quality bar
 - Your collaboration with RTL and architecture teams will shape design decisions early, making designs easier to verify and more reliable in the field
 - The regression strategies you implement will directly improve team productivity and reduce verification cycle time
 - Your ownership of critical PHY blocks will ensure that high-stakes features meet functional and performance requirements on schedule

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering or Electronics and Communication Engineering with 4+ years of hands-on verification experience
 - Proven track record leading verification teams through IP project delivery, including planning, execution, and signoff
 - Strong experience developing SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches from scratch and evolving them as designs grow in complexity
 - Deep expertise writing test plans, implementing checkers, and building assertions that catch real bugs, not just toggle coverage
 - Proficiency extracting and interpreting functional coverage and code coverage metrics, and using those insights to drive verification closure
 - Experience verifying serial interface protocols and working through IP design and verification processes, knowledge of DDR or LPDDR protocols is a strong plus
 - Demonstrated ability to own end-to-end verification deliverables, including metric closure and formal review signoff, experience with AI-assisted verification tools is a plus

Who You Are

- You can walk into a coverage review, spot the gap in the test plan, and articulate exactly what scenario is missing and why it matters
 - You write assertions that encode real design intent, not just the obvious cases, and you know the difference between a checker that catches bugs and one that just makes noise
 - You are comfortable leading technical discussions with RTL designers and architects, pushing back when verification scope is unclear or the interface is going to create downstream pain
 - You manage multiple verification efforts in parallel without losing track of what is at risk, what is on schedule, and what needs attention today
 - You debug with purpose, you do not just stare at waveforms hoping for insight, you form hypotheses, test them, and move systematically toward root cause
 - You treat verification infrastructure as a product, you care about regression efficiency, debug turnaround time, and whether your environment is actually usable by the rest of the team

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Staff/ Sr Staff DFT Solutions Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are

You are

You have spent years deep in the details of digital IC design, and you know that the difference between a chip that works and one that doesn't often comes down to decisions made during DFT planning. You are the engineer who catches those decisions early, who can look at a scan architecture and immediately see where the coverage gaps will show up three months later during silicon bring-up. You have debugged enough ATPG failures and MBIST issues to know that the best solutions start with understanding what the customer is actually trying to build, not just what they think they need. 

You operate at the intersection of deep technical work and customer collaboration. You can spend the morning implementing a complex test access network for a multi-IP SoC and the afternoon explaining to a customer why their current flow is leaving test coverage on the table, and you are equally comfortable in both modes. You do not wait for perfect specs. You ask the right questions, prototype quickly, and iterate based on what you learn. 

At Synopsys, you will work with customers designing some of the most complex chips in automotive, AI, and consumer electronics, and what you deliver will directly determine whether their silicon works on the first spin. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Deliver end-to-end DFT solutions for customer designs, from architecture planning and scan insertion through pattern generation, silicon bring-up, and diagnostics analysis
 - Implement and validate test solutions including scan, MBIST, and IEEE 1687 architectures for complex SoCs with multiple IP blocks
 - Participate in customer design reviews to understand their flows, identify gaps, and propose specific improvements that reduce test time or increase coverage
 - Prototype and validate new DFT methodologies in collaboration with Solution Architects, proving out viability before customer deployment
 - Provide technical support and training to customers, including hands-on problem resolution, methodology workshops, and account-level engagement
 - Conduct product demonstrations, competitive benchmarking, and evaluations to help win new customers and expand adoption of Synopsys test solutions
 - Analyze silicon test data, diagnose failures, and present findings to both internal teams and customer stakeholders with clear recommendations

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable first-time silicon success for customers by delivering robust, validated DFT solutions that catch issues before tapeout
 - Accelerate time-to-market for automotive and consumer electronics customers by optimizing their test flows and reducing pattern generation cycles
 - Expand Synopsys' footprint in next-generation test technologies by proving out new methodologies that become standard practice across accounts
 - Build long-term customer relationships that turn one-time engagements into strategic partnerships, increasing account value and retention
 - Raise the technical capability of customer teams through training and knowledge transfer, creating a multiplier effect beyond individual projects
 - Shape the direction of Synopsys test products by feeding real-world customer challenges and use cases back to R&D teams
 - Contribute to measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and silicon yield across diverse customer programs

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree with 7+ years or Master's degree with 5+ years in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - Hands-on experience with RTL coding, DFT insertion, ATPG pattern generation, and silicon bring-up for digital ICs
 - Deep knowledge of scan architectures, fault models, test access networks, and IEEE standards including 1149. 1, 1500, and 1687
 - Proven ability to handle scan implementation and validation for large, multi-IP SoCs with complex hierarchies and multiple clock domains
 - Experience with MBIST concepts, architecture planning, and integration in automotive or safety-critical design environments is a strong plus
 - Familiarity with industry-standard DFT tools and flows, exposure to Synopsys TetraMAX, DFT Compiler, or MBIST Architect is valuable
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills to translate technical concepts for both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders

Who You Are

- You can walk into a customer design review, absorb their methodology in real time, and walk out with three specific recommendations they can act on next week
 - You are comfortable working independently on complex technical problems while knowing when to pull in a Solution Architect or R&D engineer for a second opinion
 - You manage multiple customer engagements at once without dropping threads, keeping track of where each project stands and what needs to happen next
 - You prototype quickly and iterate based on feedback, treating customer pushback as useful signal rather than friction
 - You explain tradeoffs clearly, whether you are talking to a junior engineer learning DFT or a VP trying to understand why test time matters for their product schedule
 - You stay current on emerging test standards and methodologies because you are genuinely curious about where the technology is headed, not just what you need to know today

data.title: Lead Error Manager
data.description:
What's the role?

As a Lead Error Manager will own and continuously improve our end-to-end software error and defect management framework. This role combines operational leadership across multiple projects with process governance, Jira-based workflow and template ownership, reporting, and integration with external service and defect management systems. You will define the business and process requirements for workflows, fields, templates, dashboards and integrations. Platform-level configuration and changes will be assessed, approved and implemented in collaboration with the responsible IT, Jira administration, security and product teams. This is not a Jira system administrator position. 

- Own and continuously improve the complete defect lifecycle, from intake, classification and prioritisation through assignment, resolution, verification and closure. 
 - Own the functional definition and governance of common Jira-based error management templates, including workflows, issue types, fields, screens, statuses, transition rules and reporting requirements. 
 - Own the business process and functional mapping between Jira and connected third-party defect, customer support and enterprise service management systems, including ServiceNow where applicable. 
 - Define operational KPIs, SLA requirements, dashboards and management reporting for defect flows and process health. 
 - Act as the central point of contact and escalation for error management process and tooling topics. 
 - Be accountable for the functional design, governance and continuous improvement of the common error management process and associated Jira templates used company-wide. 

Who are you?

Qualifications

You are a fast learner, with an eye for detail, strong problem-solving and debugging skills. In addition you have the following qualifications: 

- BS or MS in Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field 
 - 7 to 10 years of overall industry expereicne including 5+ year experience in software & content error management, defect management, quality management or a comparable process leadership role in a complex software & content environment. 
 - Demonstrated experience managing defect lifecycles across multiple products, projects or organizational teams. 
 - Strong practical knowledge of Jira Cloud workflows, issue types, fields, screens, permissions, dashboards and reporting from a process-owner or advanced business-administration perspective. 
 - Experience defining and governing common workflows and templates in collaboration with Jira administrators and IT teams. 
 - Experience with integrations between Jira and external defect, support or enterprise service management systems, such as ServiceNow. 
 - Experience defining field, status, workflow and data synchronisation mappings between systems. 
 - Strong understanding of defect triage, severity and priority classification, backlog management, escalation, verification and closure practices. 
 - Experience defining KPIs, SLAs, dashboards and management reporting for defect or operational processes. 
 - Proven ability to lead cross-functional alignment and influence stakeholders without relying on direct line authority. 
 - Strong analytical, facilitation, communication and stakeholder-management skills. 

What We Offer

HERE offers an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge technology environment with challenging problems to solve! You can make a direct impact on delivery of company ́s strategic goals and the freedom to decide how to perform your work. We will support you in delivering your day-to-day tasks and achieving your personal goals and developing your skills. Personal development is highly encouraged at HERE. You can take different courses and training at our online Learning Campus and join cross-functional team projects within our Talent Platform. 

HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. 

Who are we?

HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes - from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely. 

At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people's lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel.
