Introduction to Arm

You know us. With 125 Arm-powered products shipped every second, we'll be in over a trillion smart devices by 2035. Your smartphone, award-winning VR gaming, the world's fastest supercomputer - our engineers are crafting the sophisticated core processors leading the race towards a connected, autonomous, hyper-performance future. 

ARM designs the technology that is at the heart of sophisticated digital products, from wireless, networking and consumer entertainment solutions to imaging, automotive, security and storage devices. ARM improves people's lives by enabling the intelligence in affordable, easy-to-use electronic products that transform the way we live and work. We work in partnership with a global network of leading technology companies which are using our smart low-power technology. Together we are enabling the future of a better world. 

ARM is well recognized as the market leader in the CPU and System IP industry and this has been achieved by consistently delivering reliable and high quality IP products. The cost of design and manufacturing is high and that warrants "right first time" approach for all IP and System products. Time-to-market is essential for our partners to take care of steadfast competition in the marketplace, being first would enable them to get premium value from the end products. In this context, Design Verification of CPU IPs is an exciting challenge requiring an engineering abilities that is both broad and deep. 

So, we promise you endless exciting opportunities to experiment and go even further in CPU IP design!

Job Description: Role and Responsibilities

As an Engineer responsible for CPU Random Tools for stress verification, you will work on a sophisticated Random Instruction Sequences (RIS) tool. With a combination of techniques, the tool verifies the functionality of our CPU cores, being designed in Austin (US), Cambridge (UK) or Sophia Antipolis (FR). The existing team ensures addition of new architecture features, its customization to specific CPU cores, and provides support. 

You will be based in Arm's Bangalore design centre in India. 

As Senior Verification Engineer, your role will cover the development of the tool from development to deployment, and accountable for: 

- Understanding the intricacies of the CPU micro-architecture and defining how to push the test boundaries; 
 - Architect and develop solutions to improve the generation of stimuli to produce programs to stress our next generation CPUs; 
 - Implementing and supporting the tool, from the early stages of CPU development to product maturity. 

Job Requirements

- Problem Ownership and ability to work from abstract requirements 
 - Good communication and presentation skills 
 - Self-motivated and willing to take up additional responsibilities 
 - Quick learner with a strong desire to learn and develop new skills

Qualification And Experience

- B. Tech/B. S. or MTech/M. S. in Computer/Electronics Engineering or Computer Science from a reputed institute 
 - 5-10 years of stable proven experience with significant project contributions

Crucial Skills

- You hold experience in software design, and should be comfortable working with low-level hardware 
 - You have good solid understanding of programming languages, such as C and Python 
 - You are knowledgeable about CPU architecture and micro-architecture concepts 
 - You are able to understand assembly language (ASM) 
 - You have strong interpersonal skills and ability to work well as part of a team with the willingness to tackle varied technical challenges. 

Desirable Skills

- Fundamentals of Processor Architecture. 
 - Basics of ARM Architecture. 
 - Familiarity with EDA tools and Hardware Design Verification. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you.

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . data.title: RCM Quality Auditor
data.description:
In Office - Shift Hours M-F 730pm IST to 430am IST

About The Role

The RCM Quality Auditor - AR & Denials checks the AR follow-up, denial and rejection work our Revenue Cycle Services teams produce and catches errors before they cost our clients money or create compliance risk. You will score work fairly and consistently, explain clearly what went wrong and why, and help teams fix the underlying problem so it does not keep happening. 

Qualifications

- 2 to 4 years of US healthcare revenue cycle experience in AR follow-up, denial management or AR QA. 
 - Strong working knowledge of CARC/RARC codes, payer appeal processes, timely filing limits, and payer portal and IVR follow-up. 
 - Familiarity with clearinghouse rejections, scrubber edits and common front-end denial causes (eligibility, authorization, registration). 
 - Strong Excel skills and clear written English for feedback and client-facing summaries. 
 - Preferred: experience with Medicare, Medicaid and major commercial payers for multi-specialty or surgical clients, and with Veradigm practice management products. 

Audit the work

- Audit plan. Run audits against the approved monthly plan, including random samples, targeted samples (high-dollar accounts, complex specialties, new payers and new clients) and 100% audits for new joiners or associates on a performance improvement plan. 
 - Source checks. Validate each audited account against claim history, ERAs/EOBs, payer portal and call records, and payer correspondence. 
 - Follow-up quality. Confirm that follow-up actions are correct, documented and on time, that account notes are clear enough for the next person to act on, and that next-action dates are set appropriately. 
 - Denials and appeals. Confirm that denials land in the right work queue, that the corrective action matches the denial reason, and that appeals and reconsiderations meet payer requirements and filing limits. 
 - Rejections and edits. Review clearinghouse rejections and scrubber edits, and confirm fixes were made correctly and on time. 
 - Gaps and leakage. Flag incorrect write-offs and adjustments, missed timely filing or appeal deadlines, unworked underpayments and accounts closed without resolution. 

Find the root cause and fix it

- Root cause analysis. Dig into repeat or high-impact errors, find the root cause, and help build and track corrective actions (CAPA) such as retraining, SOP updates and checklist changes. Then check that the fix worked. 
 - Training support. Spot skill gaps from audit data, recommend refresher training, help onboard new joiners, and keep job aids and payer reference guides current. 
 - Trends. Share payer-level patterns, such as denial spikes, recoupments and preventable front-end denials, with operations, AR and Denial Management leadership. 

Report, escalate and stay compliant

- Reporting. Publish daily, weekly and monthly quality reports and scorecards at associate, team and client level, including RCA reports and trend charts for leadership. 
 - Escalation. Escalate critical errors right away, especially anything with revenue, compliance or timely filing impact. 
 - Staying current. Track payer policy changes, appeal and timely filing rules, and annual code updates, and flag needed changes to SOPs and payer rule references. 

Help improve the process

- Automation. Point out repetitive QA tasks that could be automated, and take part in Lean, Six Sigma and AI-assisted audit pilots. 
 - Transitions. Support new client transitions, process documentation and knowledge assessments.

Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Microsoft's AI infrastructure is evolving rapidly to support the next generation of large-scale AI training and inference. The AI Frameworks (AIFx) Networking & Systems Tools (NeST) organisation develops foundational system software that enables Microsoft's Maia accelerator platforms across pre-silicon development, hardware bring-up, cloud integration and production cloud infrastructure that enables AI accelerators to operate reliably and efficiently at cloud scale. 

Within NeST, the India Development Centre is building end-to-end engineering competency across the Maia system software stack. Our work spans the boundary between distributed cloud systems and low-level accelerator software, including control-plane services, host and device management software, accelerator virtualisation, Kubernetes-based infrastructure, Developer/Debugger Infrastructure tools, hardware lifecycle management, reliability, telemetry and diagnostics. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer with deep expertise in systems software and distributed systems to help architect and build the software infrastructure for large-scale AI accelerator platforms. 

In this role, you will work across cloud services, operating systems, host agents, device interfaces and accelerator infrastructure. You will solve challenging problems involving hardware lifecycle management, orchestration, resource management, fault detection and recovery, virtualisation, observability and infrastructure reliability. 

This is an opportunity to influence the architecture of foundational AI infrastructure and build systems that operate across a diverse and evolving ecosystem of GPUs and AI accelerators. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

- Architect and develop distributed control-plane services for provisioning, orchestration and lifecycle management of AI accelerator infrastructure. 
 - Design scalable systems for state management, health monitoring, reconciliation and fault recovery. 
 - Build host and device management software connecting cloud infrastructure with operating systems, drivers, firmware and accelerator devices. 
 - Develop infrastructure supporting accelerator virtualisation, device assignment, isolation and resource management. 
 - Integrate accelerator infrastructure with Kubernetes and cloud-native platforms. 
 - Design robust APIs and abstractions across cloud services, host software and device interfaces. 
 - Drive improvements in reliability, security, observability, diagnostics, testing and operational readiness. 
 - Champion AI-assisted engineering practices across architecture, design, coding, testing, debugging, code reviews and documentation to improve engineering velocity and software quality. 
 - Apply AI-assisted workflows to accelerate code comprehension, root-cause analysis, test development, design exploration and engineering automation. 
 - Identify opportunities to integrate AI into engineering workflows to reduce repetitive work, shorten development feedback loops and improve developer effectiveness. 
 - Use AI-assisted learning together with engineering fundamentals to accelerate development of systems, hardware and AI infrastructure domain competency. 
 - Establish reusable engineering practices and mentor engineers on the responsible and effective application of AI throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Diagnose complex system issues spanning distributed services, operating systems, host software, drivers, firmware and hardware. 
 - Lead architecture and design reviews, solve complex cross-layer system issues and mentor engineers. 
 - Collaborate across hardware, firmware, OS, cloud infrastructure and AI platform teams to deliver end-to-end solutions. 
 - Partner with hardware, firmware, operating system, cloud infrastructure and AI platform teams to deliver end-to-end solutions. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to raising the technical capabilities and engineering standards of the broader organisation. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related technical discipline, or equivalent experience with at least 12+ years of relevant industry experience. 
 - Software engineering experience in C++, C, C#, Rust, Go or similar languages. 
 - Experience designing and developing distributed systems, cloud infrastructure or systems software. 
 - Understanding of concurrency, state management, asynchronous programming and failure recovery. 
 - Experience building reliable production software with strong debugging and problem-solving skills. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership across complex, multi-team engineering projects. 
 - Ability to leverage AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows, combined with strong engineering judgement, to improve software development effectiveness, quality and technical problem solving. 
 - Ability to rapidly develop expertise in complex technical domains and help raise engineering competency across the team through mentoring, technical guidance and knowledge sharing. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with cloud control planes, resource orchestration or infrastructure management systems. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, containers and cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - Experience with GPU, AI accelerator or heterogeneous compute infrastructure. 
 - Knowledge of PCIe, SR-IOV, PF/VF, device virtualisation or device passthrough. 
 - Experience with host/device agents, Linux systems software, device drivers or firmware interfaces. 
 - Experience with hardware lifecycle management, health monitoring and fault recovery. 
 - Experience with telemetry, observability and debugging large-scale production systems. 
 - Experience applying AI-assisted software engineering to design, development, code comprehension, debugging, testing, documentation or engineering automation. 
 - Experience identifying and developing AI-enabled engineering workflows that improve developer productivity and reduce repetitive engineering effort. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted approaches to accelerate understanding of large and complex codebases, system architectures and cross-layer technical issues. 
 - Experience establishing engineering practices that help teams adopt AI effectively while maintaining code quality, security, correctness and engineering accountability. 

#AIINFRA

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

data.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Data Center Cybersecurity & Commissioning
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, readiness, and execution of complex cybersecurity verification and validation activities across large-scale data center construction and commissioning programs. 

This is a highly technical program leadership role positioned at the intersection of data center construction, commissioning, controls engineering, operational technology, networking, cybersecurity, facility operations, and OEM/vendor management. 

The Technical Program Manager will coordinate activities across construction teams, commissioning organizations, data center operations, controls and automation teams, OEMs, system integrators, network teams, cybersecurity specialists, and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents. 

The successful candidate must be capable of understanding both the construction/commissioning lifecycle and the underlying technical systems being validated. This is not a general administrative project-management position. 

Key Responsibilities

- Program & Multi-Site Delivery Management
 - Lead technical program coordination across multiple concurrent data center projects. 
 - Align all sites with integrated program plans covering cybersecurity verification and validation, construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and technical dependencies. 
 - Coordinate activities across multiple geographic regions, sites, delivery teams, and Cybersecurity commissioning agents. 
 - Maintain visibility of site readiness, schedules, dependencies, risks, constraints, and required technical resources. 
 - Maintain program-level schedule, effort, resource utilization, budget, and financial health tracking. 
 - Own and coordinate program and site-level prerequisites required for successful execution. 
 - Develop standardized governance and execution processes that can scale across a large multi-site portfolio. 
 - Coordinate work allocation and execution across multiple cybersecurity assurance vendors while maintaining consistent program expectations. 
 - Construction & Commissioning Integration
 - Integrate cybersecurity V&V activities into the overall data center construction and commissioning lifecycle. 
 - Understand and coordinate dependencies between construction completion, equipment installation, controls integration, functional testing, commissioning, and cybersecurity validation. 
 - Work with General Contractors, commissioning teams, system integrators, technical PMOs, and site teams to determine when systems are sufficiently ready for cybersecurity activities. 
 - Prevent premature mobilization by establishing clear technical and operational readiness criteria. 
 - Coordinate cybersecurity activities around critical project milestones without unnecessarily affecting construction or commissioning progress. 
 - Controls / Data Center Engineering / OT Systems Coordination

Provide technical coordination across data center control and monitoring environments, including systems such as: 

- Building Management Systems (BMS)
 - Power Management Systems (PMS)
 - SCADA
 - DCS and industrial control platforms
 - PLCs and industrial controllers
 - RTUs, gateways, meters, relays, and IEDs
 - EPMS and electrical monitoring systems
 - Environmental and mechanical controls
 - Industrial networking infrastructure
 - Engineering workstations and management platforms
 - Associated servers, applications, interfaces, and communications infrastructure
 - Maintain sufficient technical knowledge of controls and OT platforms to understand system architecture, ownership, technical dependencies, testing prerequisites, and escalation requirements. 

 4. Data Center Operations Integration

- Establish strong coordination between project delivery teams and Data Center Operations. 
 - Ensure cybersecurity verification activities consider operational constraints and production-readiness requirements. 
 - Coordinate technical handover requirements between construction/commissioning teams and operations. 
 - Track ownership of systems, credentials, documentation, configurations, software, and technical artifacts necessary for validation. 
 - Help resolve gaps between global program objectives and actual site execution conditions. 
 - OEM, Vendor & System Integrator Coordination
 - Serve as the program-level coordination point for OEMs, system integrators, contractors, controls vendors, and Cybersecurity Commissioning Agent organizations. 
 - Identify the correct technical owner for equipment and systems requiring verification. 
 - Coordinate vendor availability during testing windows. 
 - Ensure required engineering software, documentation, configurations, credentials, access, technical SMEs, and testing support are available. 
 - Escalate unresolved vendor or technical dependencies before they affect execution. 
 - Coordinate common requirements across OEMs rather than repeatedly resolving the same issues independently at each site. 
 - Technical Logistics & Readiness

Own The Technical-readiness Process Covering

- Site access
 - Assessment workstations
 - Network connectivity
 - Engineering system access
 - Required documentation
 - Network and controls architecture
 - Asset inventories
 - Configuration documentation
 - OEM technical resources
 - System integrator resources
 - Cybersecurity commissioning agent requirements
 - Testing windows
 - Evidence collection
 - Technical repositories
 - Finding and workflow-management systems

Establish a formal readiness gate before site mobilization. 

- Cybersecurity Verification & Validation Program Coordination
 - Coordinate execution between program stakeholders and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents. 
 - Translate program objectives into executable site-level technical activities. 
 - Maintain consistent V&V expectations, evidence requirements, acceptance criteria, and reporting across multiple providers. 
 - Coordinate testing activities involving OT devices, controls platforms, industrial networks, applications, and supporting infrastructure. 
 - Track systemic findings and recurring issues across the portfolio. 
 - Facilitate escalation of findings requiring program-level rather than site-level resolution. 
 - Support integration of lessons learned into future design, procurement, commissioning, and operational requirements. 
 - Program Governance & Reporting
 - Maintain integrated RAID logs covering risks, actions, issues, dependencies, and decisions. 
 - Develop program dashboards covering readiness, execution status, testing progress, findings, dependencies, and blockers. 
 - Facilitate technical program reviews and readiness meetings. 
 - Maintain clear RACI across site teams, operations, controls teams, OEMs, integrators, Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents, and other stakeholders. 
 - Escalate systemic issues requiring enterprise or program-level decisions. 
 - Drive consistent methods across sites while accommodating genuine technical differences between facilities. 

Mandatory Experience

Candidates must demonstrate relevant experience across all of the following areas. These requirements represent the core technical and program-management capabilities necessary for the role. 

Data Center Experience

- Significant experience delivering technical programs within hyperscale, colocation, mission-critical, or similarly complex data center environments. 
 - Demonstrated understanding of data center construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and handover. 

Construction Experience

- Demonstrated experience working within major construction or infrastructure delivery programs. 
 - Strong understanding of construction schedules, contractor dependencies, site readiness, commissioning gates, and project controls. 

Controls / OT Experience

- Strong working knowledge of building automation, industrial control, power-management, SCADA/DCS, PLC, and related cyber-physical systems. 
 - Ability to interpret controls architecture, network diagrams, system interfaces, and technical dependencies. 

Networking Experience

Working understanding of: 

- TCP/IP
 - VLANs
 - Routing and switching
 - Firewalls
 - Network segmentation
 - Industrial Ethernet
 - Remote access
 - IT/OT integration

Demonstrated ability to engage effectively understand and interact with network engineering teams on architecture, segmentation, routing, switching, firewall, remote-access, and IT/OT integration requirements. 

Cybersecurity Experience

- Experience leading or coordinating cybersecurity programs involving OT, industrial systems, critical infrastructure, or cyber-physical systems. 
 - Understanding of cybersecurity verification, validation, assessment, risk management, remediation, and technical assurance. 
 - Ability to translate cybersecurity requirements into activities that engineering and commissioning organizations can execute. 

Commissioning Experience

- Direct experience working with commissioning organizations or commissioning programs. 
 - Understanding of FAT, SAT, functional testing, integrated systems testing, commissioning, acceptance, turnover, and operational readiness. 
 - Demonstrated ability to integrate additional assurance requirements into an active commissioning environment. 

Program Management Experience

- Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, multi-site technical programs. 
 - Experience managing multiple contractors, vendors, engineering organizations, and technical workstreams simultaneously. 
 - Strong dependency, escalation, risk, schedule, and stakeholder-management capabilities. 

Experience Level

12+ years of overall relevant industry experience, including substantial experience across data center construction/commissioning and technical infrastructure programs. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Electrical, Controls, Automation, Mechanical, Network, Computer, Systems, or related engineering degree. 
 - PMP or PgMP. 
 - Commissioning credentials such as CxA, CCP, CBCP, or equivalent experience. 
 - CISSP, GICSP, IEC 62443, or comparable cybersecurity certification. 
 - Experience with controls ecosystems from Schneider Electric, Siemens, Rockwell Automation, ABB, Honeywell, Johnson Controls, or similar OEMs. 
 - Experience with mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure. 
 - Experience coordinating third-party testing, assurance, validation, inspection, or commissioning organizations. 
 - Experience supporting global programs spanning multiple regions and delivery organizations. 

Critical Competencies

Technical credibility

Demonstrates sufficient technical depth to actively lead discussions with controls engineers, network engineers, commissioning teams, cybersecurity specialists, and data center operations personnel. 

Construction fluency

Demonstrates strong understanding of construction execution, commissioning sequences, schedule pressures, project dependencies, and operational-readiness milestones. 

Systems and Safety thinking

Identifies cross-functional dependencies affecting cybersecurity execution, including OEM contracts, construction schedules, controls integration, configurations, credentials, network readiness, technical ownership, and operational constraints. 

Execution discipline

Turns program requirements into owners, dependencies, readiness gates, dates, escalation paths, and measurable outcomes. 

Vendor orchestration

Can coordinate multiple Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents and technical vendors without allowing delivery methodology or quality to fragment between sites. 

Executive communication

Can convert complex construction, OT, commissioning, cyber, and vendor issues into concise program-level decisions. 

Technical curiosity

Demonstrates strong root-cause analysis and technical problem-solving skills to identify and resolve underlying readiness and execution constraints

Meet the Team

Looking for an exciting next step in your career? The Catalyst Engineering IOS XE Platform Independent team designs and develops high-performance system software for a wide range of Cisco platforms, including enterprise switches, routers, wireless controllers, Industrial IoT devices, and service-provider routing platforms. 

Our team is helping lead the enterprise networking industry through continuous innovation during an exciting period of rapid market evolution. The opportunities to learn, innovate, and make an impact are boundless-and your experience and perspective will add to the energy and strength of our team. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer, you will design and develop next-generation control-plane and data-plane software for Cisco IOS XE and its enterprise networking and security platforms. You will learn about groundbreaking technologies and platforms while developing software for industry-leading networking equipment. 

Using AI and AI-assisted technologies, you will translate complex requirements into secure, robust, and scalable solutions. You will lead significant features from development through integration, create innovative intellectual property, and directly influence the performance, reliability, and security of Cisco's global networking infrastructure. 

Responsibilities

- Lead large and complex features from requirements definition and architecture through implementation, validation, and production deployment. 
 - Drive technical decisions and system-level trade-offs for platform-independent database infrastructure, including data models and management frameworks that support switches, routers, wireless controllers, and IoT devices. 
 - Establish standards for developing clean, secure, scalable, and maintainable software. 
 - Lead architecture, design, and code reviews, as well as threat-modeling and production-readiness assessments. 
 - Develop strategies, tools, and processes that improve software quality, reliability, performance, and engineering productivity. 
 - Resolve complex customer and production issues by leading root-cause analysis and implementing sustainable corrective actions. 
 - Partner with product management and engineering leaders to establish best practices, influence product roadmaps, and contribute to strategic technology decisions related to telemetry, configuration management, and data modeling within the network operating system. 
 - Negotiate scope, architecture, timelines, and technical trade-offs with cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Mentor senior engineers, strengthen knowledge-sharing practices, and develop technical leadership across the organization. 
 - Represent the team in technical forums and clearly communicate strategic priorities, risks, decisions, and outcomes to leadership. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree with 9+ years, or a Master's degree with 6+ years, of relevant experience. 
 - Strong understanding of operating systems such as Linux, Unix, or RTOS, with experience in the Linux kernel, device drivers, and board support packages (BSPs). 
 - Proficiency in C programming and Python scripting for automation, tooling, code generation, and prototyping. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including modular design, clean coding, unit testing, and code reviews. 
 - Experience developing software or firmware for networking products. 
 - Excellent knowledge of software architecture and system design. 
 - Proven technical leadership experience guiding high-performing teams in designing and delivering high-quality features and solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience with generative AI assistants, natural language processing, and agentic AI technologies or frameworks such as OpenAI models, Gemini, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with networking protocols such as TCP/IP, BGP, and OSPF, along with complex system architectures. 
 - Implementation experience in one or more of the following areas: high availability, inter-process communication, memory management, distributed communication infrastructure, serviceability, containers, or virtualization. 
 - Experience with NETCONF, RESTCONF, gRPC, Protocol Buffers, cloud technologies, or network automation. 
 - Familiarity with Cisco platforms, IOS XE, and hardware architecture. 
 - Cisco certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE are a plus. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

About Five9

Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results. 

Role Overview

To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. 

In this role you will: 

- Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics
 - Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design
 - Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale
 - Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments
 - Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers
 - Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues

Key Responsibilities

- Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure
 - Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash
 - Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico
 - Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)
 - Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes

Qualifications & Skills

- 8+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)

 - Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico
 - Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale
 - Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet)
 - Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e. g. , F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS)

 - Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
 - Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics

data.title: GDS - Senior-AppSec-AI-Automation-Engineer
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY GDS - AI Automation Engineer - Senior, Technology Consulting

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

About the Role: 

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a highly skilled AI Automation Engineer - Senior to design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade AI automation solutions for global clients. This role emphasizes deep hands-on engineering expertise, focusing on optimizing AI systems, improving model performance, and delivering scalable, production-ready AI-enabled automation. 

You will work under architect guidance while owning key solution components, leading small workstreams, and delivering high-impact AI solutions across consulting engagements. The role requires a strong blend of software engineering, applied AI, optimization techniques, and secure development practices. 

The ideal candidate demonstrates the ability to independently implement and optimize AI-driven systems, contribute to reusable accelerators, and mentor junior engineers while operating in a client-facing consulting environment. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, and optimize AI-driven automation solutions using LLMs, agent frameworks, and orchestration platforms. 
 - Own and deliver end-to-end implementation of solution components, including integration into enterprise systems and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Optimize AI systems across dimensions such as latency, cost, accuracy, and scalability (e. g. , caching, batching, prompt optimization). 
 - Develop and enhance Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including chunking strategies, retrieval tuning, re-ranking, and embeddings optimization. 
 - Implement and optimize fine-tuning strategies, including dataset preparation, prompt tuning, and model evaluation workflows. 
 - Build and productionize agentic systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalents. 
 - Develop automated evaluation frameworks, benchmarking pipelines, and model performance metrics. 
 - Contribute to AI harness frameworks, reusable accelerators, and enterprise AI development standards. 
 - Lead small workstreams, client discussions, demos, and proof-of-concept (POC) implementations. 
 - Mentor and review work of junior AI Automation Engineers, ensuring engineering quality and best practices. 
 - Collaborate closely with architects to translate high-level designs into scalable implementations. 
 - Ensure adherence to secure coding, DevSecOps, and AI security best practices. 

Cyber Experience (Any One Preferred): 

- Application Security: 
 - Secure coding practices, SAST/DAST, DevSecOps integration, CI/CD pipeline automation
 - API security, OWASP Top 10, software supply chain security, secrets management, secure SDLC
 - Offensive Security: 
 - Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), red teaming, adversarial testing
 - Exposure to AI/LLM-specific risks such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and model misuse
Technical Skills and Expertise: 

- Programming: Strong proficiency in Python; exposure to JavaScript, TypeScript, or other languages
 - AI/LLM Tools: OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, and similar developer tools
 - AI Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalents
 - Cloud Platforms: Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP
 - AI Platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, Vertex AI, or similar
 - Vector Databases: Pinecone, FAISS, Azure AI Search, Weaviate, or equivalent
 - Observability & Evaluation: LangSmith, PromptLayer, Azure Monitor, or equivalent tools
 - DevOps & CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar
 - Prototyping Tools: Replit, notebooks, rapid experimentation frameworks
 - Core Concepts: RAG optimization, prompt engineering, embeddings, model fine-tuning (LoRA/basic), evaluation frameworks, agentic workflows

Soft Skills and Attributes: 

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
 - Ability to lead small teams and guide junior engineers
 - Effective communication and client interaction skills
 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments
 - Strong ownership mindset and focus on delivery excellence

Performance Expectations / KPIs: 

- Improvement in model performance metrics (accuracy, relevance, hallucination reduction)
 - Optimization of inference cost and latency
 - Number and impact of AI automation use cases delivered
 - Contribution to reusable assets, frameworks, and accelerators
 - Quality of mentoring and team capability uplift

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, or related field
 - 4-8 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML, or automation engineering
 - Strong hands-on experience in implementing and optimizing AI/LLM-based solutions
 - Experience working in client-facing consulting environments

Relevant certifications (preferred): 

- Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate
 - AWS Machine Learning Specialty
 - Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP)

What We Offer: 

- Opportunity to work on advanced AI engineering and optimization use cases
 - Exposure to global clients and large-scale enterprise AI transformations
 - Continuous learning through innovation programs, certifications, and hands-on delivery
 - Collaborative environment with strong focus on engineering excellence and growth

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Principal Engineering Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

- As a Principal Engineering Analyst, you will provide deep technical leadership within SURF (Subsea Umbilicals, Risers, and Flowlines) domain, leading large and complex multi-disciplinary projects while independently making high-impact engineering decisions and recognizing when to engage senior leadership. This role is critical to Oceaneering's delivery and growth strategy, acting as a single point of contact for assigned business units, influencing functional strategy, mentoring engineers and SMEs, and driving continuous improvement in engineering quality, processes, and customer value. 
 - We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement, enabling effective collaboration with global stakeholders while maintaining flexibility for focused technical leadership and strategic contribution across projects and functions. 
 - Ability to travel domestically and internationally, as required, to support multi-disciplinary project oversight, customer and business unit interactions, and enterprise-level technical initiatives. 

Responsibilities

Needs to perform following activities: 

- Lead a team of Engineering Analysts subsea SURF engineers on dynamic analysis of flexible flowlines . 
 - Lead multiple projects at the same time, including large and complex multi-disciplinary projects. 
 - Direct teams of SURF engineers to enable them handle dynamic analysis projects effectively . 
 - Review work carried out by SURF engineers . 
 - Approve deliveries made by the team. 
 - Ensure compliance to established engineering processes. 
 - Define functional processes and drive continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Act as account manager for one or more business units for subsea SURF projects. 
 - Communicate with business units to understand design and analysis requirements. 
 - Define scope of work, plan jobs, allocate resources, and share regular progress updates. 
 - Monitor performance against relevant KPIs and identify growth opportunities. 
 - Participate in governance meetings with business units. 
 - Approve engineering process documents and team timesheets. 
 - Prepare and conduct technical trainings. 
 - Maintain performance records and support performance management activities. 
 - Develop competency matrices and identify training needs. 
 - Provide engineering guidance to other disciplines. 
 - Keep abreast of industry trends and issues. 
 - Evaluate resource needs and provide recommendations. 
 - Work towards organizational objectives and ensure team members accomplish performance goals. 
 - Comply with HR, HSE, and organizational policies and procedures. 
 - Other duties as assigned. 

Safety

Ensure that the Safety policies and procedures are understood and adhered to so far as is reasonably practicable in order to ensure a safe working environment. 

Other

- Carry out work in accordance with the Company Health, Safety, Environmental and Quality Systems. 
 - Perform assigned tasks with due diligence regarding the Integrated Management Systems of the Company. 
 - Eliminate waste, promote environmentally friendly practices, and contribute to continuous environmental improvement. 

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position may be required to lead a team of Engineers / Engineering Analysts. 

Qualifications

Education & Experience: 

- Post Graduation (Master's degree) in Mechanical/Civil/Ocean/ Naval Architecture/ Subsea (or related) Engineering with minimum 8 years of relevant industry experience, OR
 - Graduation (Bachelor's degree) in Mechanical/Ocean/ Naval Architecture/ Subsea (or related) Engineering with minimum 10 years of relevant industry experience. 

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, And Other Characteristics

- Expert level knowledge of FEA and SURF Local and Global Analysis using relevant CAE software (e. g. , OrcaFlex, UFlex, ANSYS, RISA, Sesam). 
 - Strong knowledge of multiple applicable industry codes and standards (ASME, DNV, API, AISC, etc. ). 
 - Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications. 
 - Communication skills. 
 - Teamwork and interpersonal skills. 
 - Analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills. 
 - Organizing and planning skills. 
 - Team building, coaching and mentoring skills. 
 - Leadership abilities. 

About Us

Oceaneering is a global provider of engineered services and products, primarily to the offshore energy industry. We develop products and services for use throughout the lifecycle of an offshore oilfield, from drilling to decommissioning. We operate the world's premier fleet of work class ROVs. Additionally, we are a leader in offshore oilfield maintenance services, umbilicals, subsea hardware, and tooling. We also use applied technology expertise to serve the defense, material handling, aerospace, science, and renewable energy industries. 

Overview

Job Description

About the Role: 

The AWS AI Architect defines and owns the technical architecture for enterprise AI and GenAI solutions, from data foundations and model selection through deployment, governance, and monitoring. You work with business, data, engineering, and risk teams to turn use cases into scalable, secure, compliant production systems. Lead the design and development of our cloud-native applications. In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, turning complex requirements into resilient, secure, and cost-effective distributed systems. You will work closely with software developers, cloud engineers, and product owners to build high-performance applications leveraging modern AWS services. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design end-to-end AI/ML and GenAI architectures (RAG, agents, fine-tuning, model serving) that integrate with existing enterprise platforms. 
 - Evaluate and select LLMs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and MLOps tooling. 
 - Define reference architectures, patterns, and standards for reuse across teams. 
 - Partner with data engineering on pipelines, feature stores, and data quality for AI workloads. 
 - Build in responsible AI: model risk management, explainability, bias testing, audit trails, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Establish MLOps/LLMOps practices covering CI/CD, evaluation, observability, drift detection, and cost control. 
 - Lead proofs of concept and pilots, and move them to production. 
 - Advise stakeholders and executives on AI strategy, feasibility, and trade-offs. 
 - Mentor engineers and data scientists, and run architecture reviews. 

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years in software or data engineering, with 4+ years architecting AI/ML solutions in production. 
 - Hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, agent frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, LlamaIndex). 
 - Strong Python skills and fluency in ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn). 
 - Deep experience with at least AWS cloud sand its AI services (e. g. , SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI). 
 - Application Design: Design scalable, fault-tolerant, and high-availability cloud applications using core AWS services like Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, and DynamoD
 - Experience with MLOps tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD). 
 - Solid grounding in data architecture: data lakes/warehouses, streaming, APIs, and microservices. 
 - Knowledge of security, privacy, and governance for AI systems. 
 - Excellent communication, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical leaders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in banking, insurance, or asset/wealth management, including regulatory expectations (e. g. , SR 11-7 model risk). 
 - Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and fine-tuning or evaluation frameworks. 
 - Cloud or architecture certifications (e. g. , AWS ML Specialty, AWS AI Engineer, TOGAF). 
 - Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - RnD Enablement.
data.description:
The Opportunity

As a Staff Software Engineer on Hinge Health's Service Enablement team, you will build the platforms, services, and engineering practices that other teams at Hinge Health rely on to ship software safely and quickly. 

Service Enablement treats Hinge Health engineers as its customers. The team builds paved roads, automation, and platform capabilities in developer experience, cloud and service platforms, reliability, observability, security, CI/CD, and AI/ML enablement. The goal is to remove friction, improve operational maturity, and make the default path the easiest one for product and infrastructure teams. 

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will write production code, lead architecture and design reviews, participate in operational response, and coach engineers toward stronger technical ownership. Expect to turn broad engineering needs into technical strategy, lead initiatives that span several teams, and set standards that get adopted beyond your own pod. 

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Data, ML, and Infrastructure to balance delivery speed against reliability, security, cost, and maintainability. As Hinge Health expands its use of AI across the software development lifecycle and the care platform, you will also help make those AI and ML workloads reliable, cost efficient, and responsibly run. 

The problems in this role are foundational. Fixing them makes every engineering team at Hinge Health more effective, and the software they ship helps make healthcare more accessible and affordable. 

What You'll Accomplish

- Own a multi-quarter technical roadmap for one or more Service Enablement domains, based on what internal engineering teams actually need. 
 - Lead architecture and design for highly available, secure, and maintainable platforms and services that cross pod boundaries. 
 - Build and maintain paved roads for service development, deployment, observability, reliability, and operational ownership. 
 - Improve developer productivity with automation, reusable frameworks, self-service workflows, and documentation that people can follow. 
 - Set practical standards for SLOs, alerting, incident response, capacity management, service ownership, and production readiness. 
 - Work with product and engineering teams to run AI and ML workloads reliably and cost efficiently, including inference systems where they make sense. 
 - De-risk ambiguous problems with prototypes, spikes, and experiments that produce measurable results. 
 - Write and lead RFCs, design reviews, and technical decision records. Explain trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Take part in production operations and eliminate recurring failure modes with systemic fixes. 
 - Deliver large initiatives from strategy through production adoption, and measure the result: platform adoption, developer productivity, reliability, cost, or reduced operational toil. 
 - Mentor engineers, coach senior engineers into broader technical leadership, help with hiring, and raise the bar for engineering practice across the organization. 

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week. 

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA. 

- Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e. g. , 8am in San Francisco is 8: 30pm in Bengaluru). 
 - Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8: 30 pm - 10: 30pm IST). 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field
 - 10+ years of professional software development, or equivalent depth building and operating production systems. 
 - 4+ years with at least one modern programming language such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Python. 
 - 4+ years across the full software development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations. 
 - 4+years of experience in cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads such as AWS, Kubernetes, or EKS. 
 - Experience in software design and distributed systems fundamentals: reliability, scalability, performance, failure modes, and API or platform contracts. 
 - Experience operating production systems, including observability, incident response, root cause analysis, and reliability improvement. 
 - Experience treating internal platforms and developer experience as products, with attention to usability, adoption, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, Claude etc

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building internal developer platforms, service templates, golden paths, CI/CD systems, or self-service infrastructure. 
 - Experience with platform security, identity and access management, compliance controls, or secure-by-default engineering. 
 - Experience supporting AI/ML teams with inference infrastructure, model serving platforms, evaluation workflows, or cost and performance optimization. 
 - Experience defining and maintaining SLOs and SLAs, using error budgets, service-health metrics, alerting, on-call practices, incident response, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability. 
 - Experience with event-driven systems, workflow orchestration, service networking, or large-scale data and messaging infrastructure. 
 - Experience defining platform metrics such as adoption, deployment lead time, change failure rate, availability, developer satisfaction, or operational toil. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers or acting as technical lead for a platform migration, modernization effort, or organization-wide launch. 
 - Experience working in healthcare, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or otherwise high-trust environments. 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we're using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1. 7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2, 900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth. com.

data.title: Lead System Designer & Product Security Representative
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Lead System Designer / Product Security Representative (LSD/PSR) to lead compliance, quality, and security governance for Ethos Design System (EDS) by ensuring all components meet QMS, regulatory, and secure development requirements throughout their lifecycle. 

This role ensures that components are designed, developed, verified, released, and maintained in accordance with Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices, regulatory expectations, and enterprise security standards. You will serve as the primary compliance steward for EDS, partnering with Product Management, UX, Engineering, Architecture, and Product Security teams to maintain audit readiness, security posture, documentation completeness, and release compliance. This includes complete ownership of QMS documentation, review coordination, approvals, and process compliance activities. 

Job Description

About the Ethos Design System (EDS)

EDS is the unified digital platform that powers GE HealthCare's global software portfolio. It serves as a comprehensive library of reusable UI components, design patterns, and accessibility standards that bridge the critical gap between User Experience (UX) and Engineering. By fostering a philosophy of "reduce, reuse, and recycle, " EDS enables hundreds of product teams to eliminate redundant coding and design work. We provide the foundational building blocks that ensure our clinical and operational applications are intuitive, consistent, and accessible, allowing teams to focus on patient safety. 

The Mission: Scale and Empowerment

We are in a phase of hyper-growth, scaling from 25 adopting products to over 100. This requires a leader who thinks like a founder. You must look beyond simple backlog management to think about scale, growth, and empowerment. You will build a self-service ecosystem that allows teams to move fast without breaking the consistent standards required for patient safety and accessibility. 

Core Responsibilities

- Quality & Compliance
 - QMS Ownership: Own QMS-related activities across the EDS component lifecycle. Set and own the program Design History File (DHF) strategy. 
 - Documentation & Traceability: Develop, maintain, and govern required design, development, verification, and release documentation. Ensure traceability between requirements, design artifacts, implementation, verification, and releases. 
 - Audit Readiness: Coordinate reviews, approvals, and signoffs for quality records. Support audits, assessments, and inspection of readiness activities while maintaining compliance with organizational development processes and regulatory requirements. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement of quality processes, templates, and workflows. Ensure component Technical Design Reviews (cTDR/dTDR/eTDR) align with program plans and needs. 
 - Product Security & Secure Development
 - Security Governance: Serve as the Product Security Representative for EDS, ensuring adherence to Secure Development Lifecycle requirements. 
 - Risk Management: Coordinate security reviews, threat modeling, and security risk assessments. Track remediation of vulnerabilities, security findings, and compliance gaps. 
 - Release Validation: Ensure security controls, evidence, and documentation are completed before releases. 
 - Engineering Partnership: Partner with engineering teams to implement secure coding and dependency management practices. Coordinate penetration testing, security scans, SBOM generation, and vulnerability management activities. Track security metrics, remediation SLAs, and compliance status across components. 
 - Governance & Program Oversight
 - Release Readiness: Establish release readiness checklists covering quality and security requirements. Maintain audit-ready records and ensure documentation integrity. 
 - Strategic Liaison: Act as the primary liaison between EDS teams, Quality, Regulatory, and Product Security organizations. Collaborate with Product, Architecture, UX, and Engineering to identify compliance risks and mitigation plans. 
 - Automation: Drive automation of QMS and security compliance processes where practical. Monitor compliance with KPIs and provide status reporting to leadership. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 10+ years of experience with Quality Management Systems (QMS) and regulated product development. 
 - Mandatory: Strong understanding of Secure Development Lifecycle practices. 
 - Mandatory: Experience coordinating security reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and compliance activities. 
 - Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with design controls, traceability, audit readiness, and release governance. 
 - Process & Methodology: Experience in Agile Software Development, including associated concepts, tools, and practices. Ability to drive process improvements and compliance automation initiatives. 
 - AI Tooling: Experience using AI tools is a must to enhance workflows, optimize compliance checks, or assist in documentation generation. 
 - Leadership Skills: Strong cross-functional leadership, stakeholder management, and program coordination skills. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
Inclusion And Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviours: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

data.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

Role Overview

To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. 

In this role you will: 

- Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics
 - Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design
 - Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale
 - Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments
 - Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers
 - Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues

Key Responsibilities

- Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure
 - Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash
 - Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico
 - Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)
 - Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes
 - Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment
 - Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e. g. , NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization

Qualifications & Skills

- 8+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
 - Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM)
 - Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico
 - Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale
 - Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet)
 - Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e. g. , F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS)
 - Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing
 - CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays
 - Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
 - Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics
 - Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives
 - Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous
 - Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture

data.description:

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.   

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can't keep up. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster. 

We started in Manchester and now we're global - with teams across the UK, US and India. 

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We're here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we're looking for people who want to be part of it. 

About the role

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Billing team in Hyderabad, where you'll be the most senior technical voice on a team of five, guiding day-to-day delivery, unblocking the team, and acting as the main technical point of contact for the Engineering Manager and Product Manager. This role is based from our Hyderabad office four days a week, with one day working from home. 

You'll lead on third-party and marketplace integrations, help mature our microservices and observability practices, and work at pace across two-week sprints. You'll also collaborate closely with Finance, GTM and Data Science teams, including contributing to exciting ML capability work for Maia.

- Acting as technical lead for the Billing team, guiding and unblocking two junior engineers, two mid-level engineers and one QA engineer, and leading design reviews to set technology direction. 
  

- 
Owning integrations with third-party billing and marketplace platforms, with significant hands-on time across production services from design through to deployment and ongoing support. 

- 
Reviewing code and guiding the team to Matillion's engineering standards with a Product, Quality, DevOps and Security mindset, while translating sprint requirements from the Engineering Manager and Product Manager into clear technical direction. 

- 
Becoming the subject matter expert in the billing domain and architecture, supporting triage and incident response, participating in out-of-hours on-call, and proactively engaging customer-facing colleagues to avoid exposing customers to issues. 

- 
Mentoring team members, fostering a culture that aligns engineering and product strategy, and contributing to cross-team work such as ML capability development with Data Science for Maia. 

What we are looking for

- 
Proficient in Java (core priority for this role) with a solid grounding in object-oriented design, distributed systems and best practices such as testability, observability, scalability and security; working React knowledge in a full-stack capacity. 

- 
Experience across the full software development lifecycle via CI/CD tooling and agile methodologies (Kanban/Scrum), with hands-on experience in at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure). 

- 
Proven experience integrating with multiple third-party or marketplace platforms; billing or usage-based/credit-consumption experience is a bonus, not essential. 

- 
A clear bias for action, leading initiatives and mentoring others, with the autonomy to solve problems independently and the inquisitiveness to dig into root causes rather than just symptoms. 

- 
A proactive, self-sufficient technical leader with integrity and a growth mindset, comfortable representing the team cross-functionally and staying calm under pressure during incidents. 

More about Matillion

  

We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work-life balance, with benefits including: 

- Company Equity

- 27 days paid time off

- 12 days of Company Holiday

- 5 days paid volunteering leave

- Group Mediclaim (GMC)

- Enhanced Parental leave policies

- MacBook Pro

  

Your Safety

  

Matillion recruiters will only contact you from @matillion. com email addresses. We occasionally work with trusted recruiting partners; they will always tell you they are working on our behalf. We will never ask for money, fees, or bank details at any point in the hiring process. If something feels off, trust that instinct. Don't click any links. Go straight to  matillion. com/careers to verify open roles or reach us at talent@matillion. com. 

  

  

Want to know more?

  

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, not just experience. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch. 

Cannot find a suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at  talent@matillion. com. 

Find out more about life on #TeamGreen here.   

  

  

Matillion is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all of our team.
