data.title: Lead Manufacturing Process Engineer – AME & Testing
data.description:
Job Description Summary

The Lead Manufacturing Process Engineer - AME & Testing will provide technical leadership for process engineering, New Product Introduction (NPI), manufacturing test equipment, and automation supporting complex medical equipment. This role will lead and support the development, implementation, qualification, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes and test equipment, with a strong focus on test equipment automation, Special Purpose Machines (SPMs), electromechanical systems, troubleshooting, failure analysis, and operational performance. The engineer will also leverage technologies such as Power BI, AI/ML tools, IoT platforms, advanced analytics, and equipment data to improve testing effectiveness, enable predictive maintenance, and enhance manufacturing efficiency. 

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Own and lead manufacturing engineering activities for New Product Introductions (NPI) and manufacturing transfers for existing products, collaborating with global and local cross-functional teams including Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain. 
 - Lead and support process engineering activities associated with new product introductions, manufacturing readiness, production ramp-up, and implementation of new manufacturing and testing technologies. 
 - Design, develop, improve, and support manufacturing automation systems, test equipment, Special Purpose Machines (SPMs), fixtures, tooling, and manufacturing aids to enable efficient and reliable production. 
 - Support the transition from legacy testing systems to new testing platforms, software, automation tools, and testing infrastructure. 
 - Develop and support automated test equipment involving electromechanical components and control systems, including servo motors, encoders, ball screws, sensors, electrical and electronic circuits, and related machine control technologies. 
 - Apply knowledge of NI hardware programming and equipment control systems to support automated equipment functions such as motor control, operational sequencing, equipment run-time management, sensor integration, data capture, and automated machine operations. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and structured problem-solving activities to resolve complex medical equipment manufacturing and testing issues. 
 - Conduct root cause investigations and failure analysis to identify technical issues related to equipment, manufacturing processes, test systems, and product performance, and implement sustainable corrective actions. 
 - Own process qualification and validation of manufacturing processes, assembly-line tools, automation systems, and testing equipment to ensure robust and compliant manufacturing operations. 
 - Lead process risk assessments and drive factory, forward production, and field quality improvements through structured problem-solving, failure analysis, and Defects Per Unit (DPU) reduction initiatives. 
 - Champion Lean Manufacturing, automation, digital transformation, AI/ML, IoT, advanced analytics, and plant modernization initiatives in collaboration with central Advanced Manufacturing Engineering teams to improve operational excellence and productivity. 
 - Utilize Power BI and other appropriate data visualization and analytics tools to support equipment performance monitoring, manufacturing reporting, data analysis, and data-driven decision-making. 
 - Support the collection and analysis of manufacturing and equipment data to identify trends, understand equipment behavior, improve testing processes, and identify opportunities for productivity and quality improvement. 
 - Support the development and implementation of predictive maintenance approaches using equipment, sensor, and performance data to identify potential failures and enable a transition from reactive to data-driven maintenance strategies. 
 - Evaluate opportunities to apply AI/ML and advanced analytics to manufacturing and testing processes where these technologies can improve equipment performance, testing effectiveness, product quality, productivity, or engineering decision-making. 
 - Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on equipment upgrades, new testing infrastructure, manufacturing technology implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Manage engineering change requests and lead the effective implementation of approved changes on the manufacturing floor, including appropriate documentation and process updates. 
 - Support implementation and execution of Quality Management System (QMS) requirements on the manufacturing floor in accordance with applicable medical device regulations and internal quality requirements. 
 - Develop and maintain clear engineering documentation, equipment and process specifications, validation records, technical reports, work instructions, and other manufacturing process documentation. 
 - Provide technical leadership and coaching to Process Engineering team members in automation, process development, test equipment, risk analysis, structured problem-solving, and QMS requirements. 
 - Initially operate as an individual contributor while providing guidance and oversight to contractors and graduate trainees (GTs), with the potential to take on increased team leadership responsibilities as the organization and program grow. 
 - Support and guide small engineering teams, contractors, or trainees to ensure technical activities are executed effectively and aligned with program, quality, and delivery expectations. 
 - Manage multiple engineering priorities and deliver technical solutions on time while maintaining appropriate standards of quality, documentation, and regulatory compliance. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics & Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Minimum 6+ years of relevant experience in Process Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related core engineering environment. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in manufacturing or process engineering, including manufacturing process development, equipment development, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. 
 - Hands-on experience with test equipment automation and automated manufacturing or testing systems. 
 - Hands-on exposure to Special Purpose Machines (SPMs), including development, implementation, operation, integration, or troubleshooting. 
 - Practical understanding of electromechanical equipment and components, including servo motors, encoders, ball screws, sensors, electrical and electronic circuits, and equipment control systems. 
 - Knowledge or hands-on experience with NI hardware programming, hardware interfaces, or comparable equipment control systems used to integrate hardware and software for automated machine or test functions. 
 - Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and failure analysis capabilities. 
 - Knowledge and practical application of structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and data analysis. 
 - Exposure to Power BI, AI tools, IoT platforms, advanced analytics, or similar digital manufacturing technologies. 
 - Understanding of predictive maintenance concepts, equipment data analysis, sensor-based monitoring, and data-driven decision-making. 
 - Experience or working knowledge of manufacturing process and equipment qualification and validation. 
 - Knowledge of Quality Management System (QMS) requirements applicable to regulated manufacturing environments. 
 - Prior experience providing technical guidance or managing a small team, with experience supporting approximately two or more team members, contractors, or trainees. 
 - Strong focus on engineering documentation and the ability to develop clear technical reports, specifications, validation documentation, and manufacturing records. 
 - Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and deliver commitments on time while maintaining quality and compliance requirements. 

Desired Characteristics

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience in medical device or medical equipment manufacturing. 
 - Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), product industrialization, manufacturing transfer, production ramp-up, or similar product introduction programs. 
 - Experience working with complex medical equipment, capital equipment, or other highly engineered electromechanical products. 
 - Knowledge of PCB/electronics-related manufacturing, assembly, and testing. 
 - Experience supporting equipment upgrades or transitioning from legacy manufacturing/test equipment to new automated testing platforms. 
 - Experience applying Power BI or similar visualization tools to manufacturing, equipment, test, or operational data. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML-enabled manufacturing applications, IoT technologies, connected equipment, or advanced manufacturing analytics. 
 - Experience implementing or supporting predictive maintenance solutions using equipment, sensor, or operational data. 
 - Experience with manufacturing data collection, performance monitoring, reporting, and continuous improvement. 
 - Experience leading process risk assessments, manufacturing quality improvements, DPU reduction, and product reliability improvement initiatives. 
 - Experience collaborating with global Advanced Manufacturing Engineering, product engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, graduate trainees, technicians, or contractors and build technical capability within a manufacturing organization. 
 - Ability to adapt to evolving technologies, new manufacturing platforms, and changing program requirements while maintaining a strong focus on execution, quality, and compliance. 

Inclusion and Diversity

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

data.description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups. 

Our Culture

Who We Are

Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U. S. , creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500. 

How We Work

- We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company's and our clients' most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally. 
 - Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission. 
 - Passion for Invention: We're pushing the frontier of what's possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration. 
 - We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships. 

About The Role

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to take full, hands-on ownership of Blitzy's most critical production-grade systems and to deliver high-leverage features that materially improve customer outcomes and engineering velocity. 

This is the most senior individual contributor role at the company today. 

This is not a Senior-plus role, an architecture-only role, or a promotion-track role. We are looking for someone who has already operated at Principal / Staff+ scope in a highly technical environment and expects to spend their time writing, reviewing, and shipping production code. 

This role is 100% hands-on. Leverage comes from system ownership, execution quality, and durable technical decisions - not people management or process. 

Responsibilities

- Own mission-critical production systems end-to-end, ensuring correctness, scalability, performance, reliability, and operational excellence. 
 - Design, build, and ship high-impact backend systems and features that improve product reliability, performance, and customer value. 
 - Architect scalable services and cloud infrastructure using technologies such as Python, REST, gRPC, Kubernetes, and Terraform. 
 - Identify and resolve complex technical bottlenecks that limit engineering quality, system performance, or organizational velocity. 
 - Build and operate LLM-powered systems and validation loops that evaluate correctness, consistency, durability, and production performance. 
 - Design and evolve data architectures incorporating relational, NoSQL, graph, and vector databases to support complex enterprise applications and semantic retrieval. 
 - Modernize and improve complex enterprise systems while balancing reliability, maintainability, scalability, and delivery speed. 
 - Set and uphold engineering quality standards through hands-on technical leadership, sound technical judgment, and ownership of long-term technical decisions. 

Qualifications

- 12+ years of direct experience with Python as a primary language, including backend frameworks and microservices architecture at scale
 - Expertise in API architectures including REST and gRPC; working proficiency in Node. js and JavaScript
 - Advanced proficiency with cloud infrastructure: GCP required, with experience in at least one additional platform (AWS or Azure)
 - Advanced, production-grade experience with Kubernetes and Terraform
 - Proven experience operating highly available production systems, including monitoring, scalability, reliability, performance optimization, and operational tooling
 - Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, or DynamoDB
 - Familiarity with graph databases (e. g. , Neo4j) and vector databases/embedding infrastructure for semantic search and retrieval
 - Hands-on experience building and operating LLM-powered systems in production, including evaluation, validation, regression testing, tracing, and failure analysis
 - Working knowledge of LangSmith or comparable LLM observability/evaluation tooling; familiarity with model providers such as OpenAI or Anthropic is a plus
 - Full-stack capability, including strong frontend architecture fundamentals and the ability to design, debug, and ship across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI systems
 - Deep understanding of large-scale enterprise software systems: architecture, integration, deployment, modernization, and long-term maintainability
 - Proven track record operating at Staff+/Principal scope, independently driving complex technical initiatives and delivering high-impact outcomes with minimal supervision

Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy's good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer.  - Establish observability across agent reasoning paths, actions, integration failures, token/credit consumption and operational performance. 
 - Assess model and platform trade-offs across quality, latency, context window, cost, privacy and enterprise constraints. 
 - Architect resilient action layers and transactional integration patterns for revenue processes where consistency and recoverability are critical. 
 - Advise programs on consumption-based economics, AI credit/token optimization and architectural approaches to control run-time cost. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, design authorities and technical governance across global delivery teams. 
 - Mentor technical architects, developers and Agentforce specialists.

- Salesforce Agentforce and associated agentic architecture concepts. 
 - Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud Advanced / Revenue Lifecycle Management. 
 - Salesforce Sales Cloud and core platform architecture. 
 - Agent orchestration and tool/function calling. 
 - Multi-agent architectures, delegation and coordination patterns. 
 - Agent state, short/long-term memory and session/context management. 
 - MCP and agent-to-agent interoperability concepts/patterns. 
 - RAG, semantic/vector search, embeddings, chunking and retrieval optimization. 
 - Context engineering beyond basic prompt engineering. 
 - Evaluation frameworks and AI observability. 
 - AI safety, grounding, guardrails and least-privilege action design. 
 - LLM model selection and architectural trade-offs. 
 - Classic NLP concepts including intent classification, entity extraction, semantic similarity and ranking.

data.title: Associate Director, Medical Data Review
data.description:
JOIN AMGEN'S MISSION OF SERVING PATIENTS

At Amgen, our shared mission - to serve patients living with serious illnesses - drives all that we do. We combine science, technology, and the capabilities of our people to research, develop, and deliver innovative medicines. Our culture is collaborative, inclusive, and science-based, with a strong commitment to integrity, accountability, quality, and continuous learning. 

About The Role

The Associate Director, Medical Data Review leads people, capability, and portfolio delivery for an assigned TA-aligned or adjacent-portfolio group in alignment with CDD priorities. The role ensures that MDR teams have the capacity, skills, controls, and stakeholder support required for high-quality, risk-based delivery. 

Role Description

This is a people-manager and portfolio-delivery role accountable for people, capacity, portfolio delivery, quality oversight, and escalation. GCF6A owns project/molecule MDR strategy and integrated outputs; GCF5 owns study MDR strategy and delivery unless assigned otherwise; GCF4 performs assigned primary reviews. The Medical Monitor retains accountable medical oversight and medical decisions, while the Clinical Scientist supports study scientific execution. A typical planning span is approximately 12-15 direct reports where portfolio complexity, capability, and coverage needs permit; adjust for risk, workload peaks, or specialized expertise. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Lead and develop the MDR team; set clear expectations and maintain a fair, inclusive, accountable, and scientifically rigorous working environment. 
 - Own hiring, onboarding, goal setting, performance management, development planning, succession, readiness, recognition, retention, and appropriate performance intervention for direct reports. 
 - Translate portfolio demand into transparent capacity and allocation decisions using study complexity, phase, exposure, review strategy, milestone clustering, quality history, and demonstrated capability. 
 - Assign and rebalance MDR capacity across studies, projects, molecules, and adjacent therapeutic areas; resolve competing priorities and manage delivery risk. 
 - Assure portfolio delivery through oversight of quality, timeliness, milestone readiness, risk escalation, and fit-for-purpose MDR controls without duplicating L6A or L5 technical accountability. 
 - Review portfolio-level performance and risk indicators, identify repeated or systemic issues, and sponsor proportionate corrective or capability actions with accountable partners. 
 - Ensure that teams provide scientifically strong IDRP contributions and appropriate medical-interpretation inputs to Medical Monitoring Plans through the designated L6A and L5 roles. 
 - Lead portfolio adoption of ACT FAST, risk-based review, approved analytics, visualization, and digital capabilities; use evidence to sustain effective practices and stop low-value activity. 
 - Build effective relationships with TA/CDD and GDO leaders, Medical Monitors, Clinical Scientists, Medical Monitoring Groups, study teams, Data Management, Safety, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Quality, Regulatory, HR, and technology partners. 
 - Establish governance and communication cadences for portfolio capacity, delivery health, quality, risks, dependencies, and decisions. 
 - Escalate material participant, quality, delivery, compliance, or capacity risks promptly and ensure actions have clear owners and follow-through. 
 - Support audit and inspection readiness by ensuring role clarity, consistent practices, and availability of MDR evidence. 
 - Use portfolio insights to guide workforce planning, capability development, succession, and future hiring priorities. 
 - Responsible for people training, mentoring, and development as per career framework and supporting in individual development plan of each employee, with driving timely feedback
 - Responsible for team's performance management as per Amgen's MAP process and calibration. 
 - Responsibility for portfolio or program delivery capacity decisions, resource projection and efficient management, quality oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement. 
 - Role model Amgen culture and drive the same within the department
 - Responsible for participating in cross functional initiatives, process improvement, driving leadership activities, driving active change management and technology application advancement in MDR process
 - Owns MDR Business Process as assigned and drives operational implementation
 - Drives Scientific discussion (e. g. Journal Club) within TAs and encourage scientific and technical expertise for operation execution and efficiency

STAKEHOLDER RELATIONSHIPS AND ROLE BOUNDARIES

Acts as the MDR portfolio-delivery partner for TA/CDD and GDO leadership and maintains effective links with Medical Monitoring Groups and study teams. The Associate Director assures that the right MDR capability is deployed and that delivery and quality risks are addressed. The role does not take over accountable medical decisions, project/molecule MDR technical strategy, or study MDR strategy from the designated roles. 

Basic Qualifications And Experience

- MD/Diploma with 8-10 years of relevant experience
 - MBBS from an MCI/NMC-recognized medical institution in India with 10-12 years of relevant experience
 - Substantial experience in clinical development, medical data review, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance, clinical operations, or a closely related regulated environment. 
 - Demonstrated readiness to lead people, including evidence of setting expectations, giving feedback, supporting development, planning work, and addressing issues fairly. Prior formal line-management experience is preferred; first-time managers may be considered with a structured transition and support plan. 
 - Demonstrated responsibility for portfolio or program delivery, capacity decisions, resource projection and efficient management, quality oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement. 
 - Ability to interpret medical-review risks and make fair, evidence-based people and resource decisions. 

Placement reflects the breadth of portfolio accountability, leadership scope, complexity, and demonstrated competencies required for the role. 

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

- MBBS, MD/Diploma, or another relevant medical or clinical qualification. 
 - Experience managing medically or scientifically qualified professionals across multiple studies, projects, or therapeutic areas. 
 - Experience with RBQM, integrated data review, analytics, Spotfire, digital adoption, and inspection readiness. 
 - Experience partnering with Clinical Development, Medical Monitoring, Data Management, Safety, Quality, and HR. 
 - Experience leading organizational change, workforce planning, or capability build in a regulated environment.

Job Description

Job Summary

NextPower is seeking an experienced Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer to lead the transition of New Product Introduction (NPI) test solutions into stable, scalable, high-volume mass production test systems. This role is responsible for developing robust manufacturing test architectures, optimizing yield performance, and deploying standardized test systems across global Contract Manufacturers (CMs). 

The ideal candidate will drive Design for Test (DFT), oversee tester development through Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and ensure production test systems are capacity-optimized, change-controlled, and scalable to meet aggressive production yield and ramp targets. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead manufacturing test strategy development during NPI to ensure seamless transition into high-volume production environments. 
 - Partner with NPI Test Design Engineering to drive Design for Test (DFT) improvements that enhance coverage, reduce cycle time, and improve yield. 
 - Define and implement test coverage strategy across ICT, BFT, and SFT platforms to ensure robust product validation. 
 - Collaborate with Test Design team and tester suppliers during tester development, qualification, FAT, and SOP phases. 
 - Develop scalable test architectures capable of supporting high-volume manufacturing ramps and long-term production growth. 
 - Analyze installed tester capacity and forecast future capacity needs to support demand allocation plans. 
 - Optimize test cycle time, throughput, and station balancing to meet takt time and production targets with our CM partners. 
 - Lead structured change management processes for ECO/ECN product revisions, firmware updates, and test program releases. 
 - Evaluate impact of product updates on test coverage, cycle time, yield, and capacity, ensuring controlled global rollouts. 
 - Drive continuous test program optimization to reduce cycle time, eliminate non-value-added steps, and improve yield while maintaining full coverage. 
 - Maintain strict version control, validation, and regression testing processes for all test program changes prior to production release. 
 - Deploy and qualify standardized test systems across multiple CMs to ensure global consistency. 
 - Establish preventive maintenance, calibration, and long-term support strategies to ensure sustained tester performance and uptime. 
 - Monitor and improve First Pass Yield (FPY) and Final Yield (FY) across global manufacturing sites. 
 - Analyze test data to identify trends, systemic failures, and yield detractors, lead root cause and corrective action initiatives. 
 - Manage tester inventory, spare parts strategy, and documentation including BOMs, schematics, block diagrams, and electrical drawings. 
 - Maintain governance of test sequences and ensure compliance with quality management systems and regulatory standards. 
 - Develop dashboards and executive-level reporting to provide real-time production and yield visibility. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degrees in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. 
 - 5+ years of experience in manufacturing test engineering within power electronics or related high-volume industries. 
 - Experience transitioning NPI programs into high-volume mass production. 
 - Strong expertise in ICT, BFT, and SFT test methodologies. 
 - Demonstrated experience scaling test operations across multiple global manufacturing sites. 
 - Proficiency in at least one mainstream programming language: C#, Python, or C++. 
 - Proficiency with test automation platforms such as Python, LabVIEW, and TestStand. 
 - Ability to read schematics, identify test point requirements, and perform Design for Test (DFT) analysis. 
 - Experience with Quality Management tools and methodologies: PFMEA, PPAP, APQP, QRQC. 
 - Experience working with global contract manufacturers. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, leadership, and cross-functional communication skills.

Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we're building the foundation for the world's next generation of clean energy infrastructure.

• Embed security across the SDLC: SAST/DAST (SonarQube, Trivy, Checkov, Snyk), container/registry image

scanning, dependency and IaC scanning in pipelines. 

• Manage secrets properly (AWS Secrets Manager/KMS, Vault), enforce IAM least privilege, and harden

clusters to CIS benchmarks. 

• Own AWS security posture: WAF, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail audit logging; vulnerability

remediation SLAs. 

• Support compliance needs appropriate for a listed company (ISO 27001/SOC 2 posture), DR strategy, 

automated backups and restore drills. 

Observability & SRE

• Build full observability: CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana, centralized logging (OpenSearch/ELK), tracing and

alerting. 

• Define SLOs, run on-call with structured incident management and blameless RCAs; drive reliability

improvements. 

FinOps & Cost Optimization (Good to Have)

• AWS cost governance: tagging strategy, Cost Explorer/Budgets, CUR analysis; right-sizing, Spot Instances, 

Graviton, Savings Plans; showback reporting to engineering teams. 

• Optimize the cost of AI/ML inference (GPU utilisation, batching, endpoint autoscaling) - a big lever for an

AI-first platform. 

Must-Have Skills

• 5-9 years in DevOps/Platform/SRE roles, with 3+ years deep on AWS. 

• Strong hands-on Kubernetes (EKS/ECS) in production - you can debug a CrashLoopBackOff and design a

cluster from scratch. 

• Terraform (or equivalent IaC) and Git-based workflow discipline. 

• Solid Linux fundamentals, networking (VPC, DNS, TLS, load balancing) and scripting (Python, Bash). 

• CI/CD pipeline design and implementation at scale; container image best practices. 

• Hands-on DevSecOps: pipeline-integrated scanning, secrets management, IAM, and hardening. 

• Experience running AI/ML workloads on AWS - SageMaker, Bedrock, and/or deploying ML models to

EKS/Kubernetes (GPU scheduling, model serving). 

• Strong communicator who documents runbooks and works with product + AI teams without needing to be

managed. 

Good to Have

• FinOps experience - AWS cost dashboards, Savings Plans/Spot strategy, unit economics of LLM inference. 

• KServe/Seldon/Triton/vLLM, Ray on Kubernetes, MLflow, feature stores. 

• ArgoCD/Flux GitOps, Istio/service mesh, EKS Anywhere or hybrid cloud. 

• EdTech/LMS/high-traffic consumer platform experience; experience in a listed-company/compliance

environment. 

• Certifications: AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional, CKA, 

Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS).

Location: Bangalore, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we're driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Are you passionate about Automation and AI and eager to make a significant impact? We are seeking a highly motivated Automation & AI Solutions Lead with strong organizational and technical skills. You will work closely with architects, developers, and business stakeholders to translate real-world problems into robust AI systems. The role demands deep expertise in LangGraph, LangChain, and AWS-based deployments, with accountability from discovery through production. Success in this role means delivering reliable, scalable AI solutions that create measurable business impact. If you're excited to make real impact, apply now and be part of our innovative journey!

About The Role

In this role as an Automation and AI Developer, you will

- Engage internal SMEs to understand current processes and as-is workflows - translate into buildable AI requirements. 
 - Demo working solutions to internal stakeholders up to business leadership level. 
 - Support the Architect during feasibility and POC phases - contribute to rapid builds and validate fit. 
 - Maintain stakeholder communication throughout: progress updates, issue escalation, solution walkthroughs. 
 - Co-invest with the Architect in upfront solution design - design robustness directly determines build speed and test quality. 
 - Translate architecture into implementation plans - break down into assignable streams for Developer and Associate. 
 - Own day-to-day technical decisions during build when the Architect is focused on other projects. 
 - Identify architectural risks early and escalate before they become build or production problems. 
 - Build complex solution components end-to-end on AWS AgentCore and LangGraph - hands-on coding role. 
 - Scale solutions from POC to production: performance, reliability, monitoring, and cost management. 
 - Debug production failures: hallucination patterns, retrieval degradation, agent loops, latency regressions. 
 - Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline) to accelerate delivery. Own all generated code. 
 - Build Low Code automations (Copilot Studio, Power Automate) when use case and bandwidth allow. 
 - Guide Developer and Associate through implementation, code reviews, and debugging. 
 - Ensure the team uses AI tools effectively - accelerating delivery without sacrificing code understanding. 
 - Work Mode: Hybrid - 3 days from office. 
 - Shift Timing: 1pm IST to 10pm IST

About You

You're a fit for the role of Automation and AI Developer, if your background includes: 

- Experience - 3-5 years total; 2-4 years production GenAI/LLM; 12-24 months multi-agent LangGraph; 3+ systems owned post-deployment. 
 - LangGraph - multi-agent state machines, parallel execution, checkpointing, HITL - non-negotiable
 - AWS Bedrock - Model deployment, knowledge bases, guardrails. 
 - Database & AI Data Access - SQL proficiency, NL-to-SQL, LLM-powered query layers. Snowflake a plus. 
 - Systems Integration - REST API development, MCP awareness, enterprise system connectors. 
 - Advanced RAG - Hybrid search, re-ranking, query reformulation, retrieval evaluation. 
 - Evaluation Frameworks - RAGAS / TruLens, golden test sets, automated regression pipelines. 
 - Observability - LangSmith or LangFuse - agent tracing, production debugging. 
 - Python - Expert-level - design patterns, async, testing, CI/CD. 
 - Multi-Model - OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama - trade-offs at production scale. 
 - Pro Code vs Low Code - Working knowledge of Copilot Studio and Power Automate; build when use case fits. 
 - AI Development Tools - Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Cline - accelerate delivery; own and fix all generated code. 
 - Stakeholder Communication - Demo AI solutions to business stakeholders; translate SME knowledge into requirements. 
 - AWS AgentCore Deep - All services hands-on. 
 - MCP / A2A - Server/client production implementation. 
 - Document Intelligence - OCR, layout-aware chunking. 
 - Fine-Tuning - LoRA / QLoRA for domain adaptation. 
 - Certifications - AWS ML Specialty, Azure AI Engineer, GCP ML Engineer. 

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. 
 - Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow's challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. 
 - Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. 

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. 

We are powered by the talents of 26, 000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. 

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace. 

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

data.description:
Location: Bangalore, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we're driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. 

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India's growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. 

Thales India Engineering Competency Center is seeking a Senior / Technical Lead to be part of its Avionics Flight Display Systems. The Senior / Technical Lead is in charge of the software development activities (Requirement Capturing, Design, Code and V&V), in order to deliver software that meet requirements coming from a Business Lines (B/L), with the adequate quality and maturity level, within schedule and budget. 

Qualifications: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science & Engineering, Electronics & Communication or equivalent discipline with 7 to 12 years of relevant experience. 

Location: Thales India Private Limited, Richmond Town, Bengaluru / Hybrid

Job Responsibilities: 

As a Senior / Technical Lead, you will be a major actor in the software development phase using approach with C /Embedded C. In more details: 

- Development of Platform & Application Software with a good understanding of complex architectures, Scheduling, multi thread program development, RTOS, requirements, algorithms, interfaces and designs for avionics systems (Flight Display System) as per DO178B/C standards
 - Demonstrate the technical capabilities in software projects. 
 - Perform Peer reviews of high level Specifications & Dev artifacts. 
 - Debugging, bug fixing & enhancements on existing Software.

Minimum Skills/Experience: 

- EXPERT in Embedded C Programming Language. 
 - EXPERT in Memory usage, Scheduling and execution time allocation. 
 - Good understanding of Integrated Modular Avionics (IMA) and RTOS
 - Candidate should be Strong in RTRT OR LDRA or other Testing tools Unit Test language & hands on experience in verification. 
 - Knowledge in Data Structures and Data base management. 
 - Good experience on Cockpit Display and Graphics, Primary Flight Display, Multi-Functional Display, Flight Management System functionality
 - Knowledge in DO178B/C is required and Knowledge of Coding standards e. g. MISRA. 
 - Candidate should be strong in writing System Specification, High Level Requirements & Low Level Requirements. Also Strong in High Level Test & Low level Test definition procedure & hands on experience in verification. 
 - Should have overall engineering experiences in software development of Avionics embedded system and experience in software Development Life Cycles

At Thales, we're committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you'll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

As an FCT Lead within the Physical Design organisation, you will lead Full Chip Timing (FCT) execution and timing signoff activities for complex SoC and subsystem designs. You will work closely with Architecture, Design, PD, STA, DFT, CAD and Methodology teams to achieve first-pass silicon success and deliver timing closure for industry-leading products

The Person

A successful candidate will work with senior silicon design engineers. The candidate will be highly accurate and detail-oriented, possessing good communication and problem-solving skills. 

Key Responsiblities

- Lead the Full Chip Timing team responsible for timing constraints development and timing signoff. 
 - Own end-to-end timing closure and signoff for SoC and subsystem integration projects. 
 - Define, develop and validate SDC constraints, clocks and timing methodologies. 
 - Drive timing convergence across synthesis, P&R, CTS, route and post-route ECO stages. 
 - Partner with Architecture and STA teams to establish timing budgets, statistical timing targets and signoff criteria. Analyze and manage advanced-node timing margins including LVF, SSTA, OCV/AOCV/POCV and variation-aware signoff methodologies. 
 - Lead timing ECO planning and execution to ensure on-time tapeout. 
 - Collaborate with CAD and EDA vendors to improve timing closure flows, automation and methodologies. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership for timing closure activities across multiple projects. 
 - PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: 
 - 14+ years of experience in Physical Design, Static Timing Analysis, Constraints Development and Timing Signoff. 

Strong Expertise In

Full Chip Timing Closure

STA Signoff

Timing Constraints (SDC)

Timing ECO Methodologies

Advanced Node Timing Signoff

Clock Architecture and Clock Implementation

MCMM Timing Analysis

DFT Timing and MBIST Timing Verification

Hands-on experience with Synopsys PrimeTime (PT) and GCA. 

Experience with Fusion Compiler and/or ICC2 is highly desirable. 

Strong understanding of floorplanning, placement, CTS and routing interactions with timing. 

Proficiency in Tcl, Perl, Shell and Python scripting

- Provide technical leadership for Full Chip Timing execution across multiple programs.

You'll partner closely with engineering, platform, and product teams to shift reliability left and set the standard for performance and availability.

 - Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and blameless postmortems.

 - Containerization & Orchestration: Practical experience with Docker and Kubernetes for application deployment and management. 
 - CI/CD Management: Design, implement, and maintain Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines. 
 - Security & Compliance: Understand security best practices and compliance in infrastructure. 
 - High Availability & Scalability: Design and implement highly available, scalable, and resilient distributed systems. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Automation: Proficient in IaC tools and automating infrastructure provisioning and management. 
 - Disaster Recovery (DR) & High Availability (HA): Deep knowledge and practical experience with various DR and HA strategies. 
 - Observability: Implement and utilize monitoring, logging, and tracing tools for system health.

data.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader - we're changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We're committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. 

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

Job Type: Full-time

About The Team

Traffic Engineering powers secure, scalable, highly available traffic systems that support eBay's global commerce platform. We build and operate traffic management and security capabilities across edge and service layers, including PoP strategy, caching, Kubernetes networking, and reliability improvements based on monitoring insights. 

Role Summary

As a Traffic Engineering Architect, you will own architecture and technical direction across eBay's traffic engineering platform, spanning traffic management, load balancing, service connectivity, PoP/caching optimization, and traffic security (rate limiting, bot mitigation, etc. ). You will lead cross-team design, guide execution on critical initiatives, and drive measurable improvements in latency, availability, resilience, and security. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define architecture and technical strategy for global traffic systems: traffic management, load balancing, service connectivity, PoP optimization, caching, and traffic security controls. 
 - Architect and deliver rate limiting and bot mitigation solutions across edge/service layers in partnership with Security. 
 - Design and build high-performance, low-latency distributed systems using C/C++ and Go (Java in relevant components as needed). 
 - Drive Kubernetes networking and platform patterns at scale, including CNI integrations, service mesh, IPAM, and production-grade deployment models. 
 - Own technical tradeoffs across performance, scalability, reliability, security, operability, maintainability, and delivery timelines. 
 - Establish/advance observability and engineering metrics; use production signals to improve SLOs, reduce incidents, and increase efficiency. 
 - Lead operational excellence: incident prevention, resiliency design, capacity/performance tuning, and automated remediation where appropriate. 
 - Align roadmaps and execution across Product, Infrastructure, SRE/Operations, and Security; resolve cross-team dependencies and drive technical consensus. 
 - Mentor senior engineers/tech leads through architecture reviews, design reviews, and code reviews; raise engineering standards and consistency. 
 - Contribute to innovation via open-source engagement, patents, and forward-looking exploration relevant to traffic systems. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience with significant depth in networking/traffic engineering, distributed systems, and/or cyber security. 
 - Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Go (Java acceptable/valuable for specific subsystems); experience building production-grade, high-performance systems. 
 - Deep knowledge of Linux networking, traffic management fundamentals, and systems performance optimization. 
 - Strong experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure at scale. 
 - Proven experience designing secure, scalable, observable distributed platforms and operating them in production. 
 - Demonstrated cross-team technical leadership: driving architecture across multiple systems, influencing partners, and delivering large initiatives. 
 - Strong communication, mentoring, and technical decision-making skills in ambiguous environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Envoy, service mesh, control plane/data plane architectures, NGINX/HAProxy, SDN, eBPF, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with rate limiting, bot management, abuse prevention, and traffic security patterns (edge and service). 
 - Background in PoP design, caching strategies, and internet-scale traffic optimization. 
 - Vendor tool integration experience and operation in globally distributed environments. 
 - Open-source contributions, patents, or externally visible technical leadership. 

What Success Looks Like

- Improved global traffic platform outcomes (latency, throughput, availability, resilience, security). 
 - Reduced incident frequency/impact through architecture, observability, and operational rigor. 
 - Strong architectural alignment across teams with higher engineering quality and execution velocity. 

Additional Details

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. Nice to have

- Built or scaled an LMS, loan origination system, BRE, or collections platform.

data.title: Sr Staff High-Speed Interface Verification Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of mixed-signal verification, and you know that the hardest problems live at the boundary where digital meets analog. You are the engineer who can read a waveform, spot the timing violation that three others missed, and trace it back to a testbench assumption made two months ago. You do not just run regressions, you architect verification strategies that catch the subtle, the corner case, the thing that only shows up at 56 Gbps under specific PVT conditions. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead verification of high-speed SerDes IP using UVM and SystemVerilog testbenches in mixed-signal co-simulation environments
 - Define, track, and execute verification test plans for PCIE, Ethernet, USB3. 1, and other high-speed protocols from architecture through tapeout
 - Debug simulation failures across digital and analog domains, working directly with waveform viewers, mixed-signal simulators, and protocol analyzers
 - Build and extend UVM testbenches with constrained random sequences, coverage models, and checkers that target real-world corner cases
 - Collaborate daily with digital, analog, and mixed-signal design teams to align verification strategy with design intent and silicon bring-up realities
 - Manage customer escalations by reproducing issues, root-causing failures, and driving resolution with engineering and field teams
 - Drive pre-sales and post-sales technical discussions with customers, translating verification results into confidence and clarity

The Impact You Will Have

- Ensure that SerDes IP shipping to customers meets performance, functionality, and reliability targets before it ever reaches silicon
 - Reduce post-silicon debug cycles by catching mixed-signal integration issues early through rigorous co-simulation and coverage-driven verification
 - Set the technical direction for verification methodology across current and next-generation SerDes products
 - Accelerate customer adoption and satisfaction by resolving escalations quickly and providing clear, actionable technical guidance
 - Mentor and elevate the verification team by establishing best practices, code reviews, and a culture of ownership and quality
 - Contribute directly to Synopsys IP competitiveness by delivering verification environments that scale across protocol variants and process nodes
 - Influence product roadmaps by surfacing verification insights that shape architecture and design decisions upstream

What You'll Need

- MTech or BTech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent with 7+ years of hands-on verification experience in ASIC or mixed-signal environments
 - Deep expertise in UVM, SystemVerilog, and verification methodologies including constrained random testing, functional coverage, and assertions
 - Proven experience with digital/analog co-simulation tools and methodologies, including AMS simulators and mixed-signal verification flows
 - Working knowledge of high-speed interface protocols such as PCIE, Ethernet, or USB3. 1, including protocol-level verification and compliance
 - Strong understanding of the full ASIC development flow from architecture specification through RTL design, verification, and hardware bring-up
 - Experience writing complex system-level testbenches in UVM, including sequence libraries, scoreboards, and protocol monitors
 - Hands-on experience debugging waveform-level failures in both digital logic and analog circuit behavior

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room with analog designers discussing CDR loop dynamics and digital engineers debating clock domain crossings, and contribute meaningfully to both conversations
 - You have managed customer escalations before and know how to balance urgency with thoroughness, reproducing the issue, isolating root cause, and communicating status without overselling or underselling
 - You lead by setting the example, whether that is writing cleaner testbench code, asking the hard question in a design review, or staying late to close a critical bug before tapeout
 - You make decisions with incomplete information, prioritize what matters, and course-correct when new data arrives without losing momentum
 - You can explain a complex verification failure to a field applications engineer in two sentences and to a design lead in a ten-minute whiteboard session, adjusting depth and framing to the audience
 - You build relationships across functions because you know that the best verification strategies come from understanding what design, applications, and customers actually need

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will be part of a highly skilled team of digital, analog, and mixed-signal engineers responsible for delivering high-end mixed-signal designs from specification to implementation. This team thrives on collaboration, excellence, and pushing the boundaries of technology to deliver top-notch SerDes products to customers worldwide. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Summary

Position Summary

Artificial Intelligence & Engineering

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. 

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses. 

Level: Lead Managed Services Engineer II

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II, you will lead the design, implementation, and scaling of AI-powered and automation solutions across IT and business operations. This role requires a hands-on leader who can move from strategy to execution by identifying high-value opportunities, shaping solutions, and delivering production-grade outcomes. The ideal candidate combines experience in AI implementation with a strong background in infrastructure and operations and is comfortable leading teams and stakeholders in enterprise hybrid infrastructure environments. 

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for: 

- Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation by analyzing operational data, service trends, workflow bottlenecks, and business pain points. 
 - Lead end-to-end delivery of AI and automation initiatives, from discovery and design through deployment, stabilization, and continuous improvement. 
 - Design and implement AI-powered solutions, including AI agents, that leverage LLMs, enterprise tools, APIs, and workflow platforms to automate complex processes. 
 - Partner with business, operations, infrastructure, and security teams to translate requirements into practical implementation plans and technical roadmaps. 
 - Oversee environments, integrations, observability, incident handling, and deployment readiness for AI solutions in production. 
 - Lead client and stakeholder discussions, present operational insights, manage escalations, and drive adoption of new solutions. 
 - Improve operational performance across infrastructure and service delivery by applying automation to incident management, requests, knowledge access, monitoring, and remediation workflows. 
 - Establish KPIs and success metrics such as efficiency gains, latency, completion rates, user satisfaction, SLA performance, and service quality. 
 - Develop documentation, runbooks, and handoff materials to support long-term sustainment and scale. 

The team

At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing, and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate advanced connectivity with AI infrastructure and enterprise networks to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations. 

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Shift Timings: 24/7 as per business requirements

Qualifications

Required: 

- 10 - 14 years of hands-on experience in Proven experience leading AI and automation implementations in enterprise or production environments. 
 - Significant experience in IT operations, infrastructure, automation, AI engineering, or related technology delivery roles. 
 - Strong knowledge of infrastructure operations, including cloud, networks, servers, virtualization, backup, disaster recovery, and end-user support. 
 - Good understanding of observability frameworks , self-healing platforms , and AIOPS 
 - Experience using data and operational analytics to identify automation and AI opportunities and build business cases for change and own the execution to deliver automation to meet efficiency targets 
 - Ability to lead cross-functional teams and work effectively with engineering, operations, product, security, and business stakeholders. 
 - Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including experience managing expectations and driving executive-level conversations. 
 - Familiarity with ITIL-based service management, including incident, change, and problem management. 
 - Experience working in regulated environments with awareness of governance, risk, and compliance requirements such as SOX, HIPAA, or GDPR. 
 - Prior people leadership or program leadership experience in a manager-level role strongly preferred. 
 - ITSM and Hybrid Infrastructure experience 
 - Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation 
 - Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP 
 - APIs, webhooks, event-driven integrations, CI/CD, and containers 
 - Observability and monitoring platforms such as Dynatrace , ITOM or AppDynamics 
 - BE/B. Tech/M. C. A. /M. Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

Preferred -

- AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or CrewAI 
 - Vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or Qdrant
