data.title: Enterprise Agentic Automation Developer/Solutions Architect
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years building enterprise systems that actually solve business problems, not just demonstrate technical capability. You understand that the real challenge is not deploying an AI model, it is designing the solution architecture that makes it trustworthy, scalable, and maintainable across Finance, HR, Sales Operations, and Legal teams who need it to work every single day. You think in systems, not features. When someone describes a manual process, you are already mapping the integration points, data flows, governance requirements, and failure modes before they finish talking. 

You are equally comfortable whiteboarding an agentic AI architecture with a VP of Finance and writing Python code to integrate Azure OpenAI with SAP. You have built enough automation solutions to know when a workflow needs intelligent document processing versus a simple API call, and you can explain that tradeoff clearly. You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, prototype quickly, and iterate with stakeholders who may not speak your technical language but absolutely know their business pain. 

At Synopsys, you will architect AI and automation solutions that reduce manual work for 30, 000 employees across critical business functions, and the platform you build will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Design and build enterprise AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, and Copilot Studio that automate Finance, Sales Operations, HR, Order Management, and Legal processes
 - Architect and develop agentic AI systems and intelligent automation workflows on UiPath, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Functions that integrate with SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, and Workday
 - Lead end-to-end solution delivery from requirements gathering and architecture design through development, testing, deployment, and production support
 - Build reusable frameworks, integration patterns, and engineering standards for AI agent development that other developers can adopt across the enterprise automation portfolio
 - Partner directly with business stakeholders in Finance, GTM, HR, and Operations to identify automation opportunities, assess feasibility, prioritize initiatives, and translate requirements into technical solutions
 - Establish and enforce governance, security, Responsible AI practices, and DevOps standards using Azure DevOps or GitHub for CI/CD and source control
 - Mentor developers on AI solution design, Azure architecture, integration patterns, and automation best practices

The Impact You Will Have

- Reduce manual effort across Finance, Sales Operations, HR, and Order Management by deploying AI-powered automation that handles document processing, data extraction, workflow orchestration, and decision support at scale
 - Accelerate Synopsys' enterprise AI strategy by establishing reusable frameworks and patterns that enable faster, more consistent delivery of intelligent automation solutions across business functions
 - Improve operational accuracy and compliance by building governed, auditable AI systems with proper security controls, error handling, and monitoring
 - Enable business growth without proportional headcount increases by creating scalable automation platforms that handle increasing transaction volumes and process complexity
 - Strengthen cross-functional collaboration by translating technical capabilities into business value that Finance, HR, and Operations leaders can understand and trust
 - Build institutional knowledge and capability by mentoring developers and establishing engineering standards that raise the quality and maintainability of the entire automation portfolio
 - Drive measurable ROI through solutions that demonstrably save time, reduce errors, and improve process efficiency in production environments

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 - 8-12+ years building enterprise applications, automation solutions, or integration platforms, with at least 3 years working directly with AI or Generative AI technologies in production environments
 - Deep hands-on experience with Azure AI Services including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, and Azure AI Search, plus Azure Integration Services like Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus, and API Management
 - Proven ability to design and deploy intelligent automation using platforms like UiPath, Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, and Dataverse
 - Strong development skills in Python, C#, and JavaScript, with solid understanding of REST APIs, SOAP, webhooks, SQL, and data modeling
 - Direct experience integrating enterprise applications such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, or Workday in complex business environments
 - Working knowledge of AI governance, Responsible AI practices, cloud security, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and source control using Azure DevOps or GitHub, experience with JIRA for project management is a plus

Who You Are

- You can sit in a room with a Finance Director who describes a month-end close process and walk out with a solution architecture that addresses the real bottleneck, not just the symptom they mentioned
 - You write code that other developers can actually maintain, you document your integration patterns, you build error handling that helps operations teams diagnose issues without calling you at midnight
 - You push back when a stakeholder asks for an AI agent but the problem actually needs a well-designed workflow, and you can explain why in terms they understand and respect
 - You have shipped enough production systems to know that governance, security, and supportability are not afterthoughts, they are design constraints you bake in from the start
 - You mentor junior developers by showing them how you think through a problem, not just handing them the answer, and you genuinely care about raising the technical capability of the team
 - You stay current with AI and automation technology not because it is trendy but because you know the difference between a useful new capability and vendor hype, and you can evaluate both critically

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Enterprise Agentic Process Automation team, which drives business transformation through AI, intelligent automation, process optimization, and enterprise integration. The team delivers capabilities across Finance, Sales Operations, Order Management, HR, Business Operations, and other functions, with emphasis on operational efficiency, scalability, governance, and innovation. Current initiatives include AI agents, document intelligence, finance automation, process orchestration, and enterprise platform integrations. The team operates in Bengaluru and collaborates closely with business stakeholders and IT teams across Synopsys globally. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Engineering Manager (Frontend)
data.description:
Engineering Manager - Frontend (Mobile & Web)

Experience: 5-8 years

Reports to: 

Head of Engineering

About the role

You will own every screen a borrower, partner or internal user touches: the borrower app(Android/iOS), web loan journeys, the DSA/partner portal, and ops dashboards for credit, collections and customer support. Your work directly drives conversion from lead to disbursal, so speed, trust and drop-off are your core metrics. You stay hands-on (roughly40-50%) while leading the team. 

What you will do

- Own frontend architecture across mobile and web: a shared design system, reusable journey components and a config-driven flow engine so new loan products and lenders launch without rewrites. 
 - Build high-conversion onboarding: OTP login, consent capture, KYC (Aadhaar, PAN, selfie/liveness, Video KYC SDKs), Account Aggregator consent, bank account verification, eNACH/UPI AutoPay mandate set-up and e-sign. 
 - Deliver compliant borrower experiences: KFS and APR display before acceptance , cooling-off/exit options, loan statements, grievance flows, and clear lender (NBFC) disclosure on every screen per RBI Digital Lending rules. 
 - Keep the app lean and secure: minimal permissions (no contacts/media access), root/jailbreak detection, SSL pinning, secure storage, obfuscation, and DPDP-compliant consent handling. 
 - Drive performance on low-end Android devices and patchy networks: app size, cold-start time, crash-free rate, offline/retry handling. 
 - Instrument every funnel with product analytics and run A/B tests with Product andGrowth to reduce drop-offs. 
 - Set standards for code review, testing (unit, integration, E2E), release management, feature flags, staged rollouts and Play Store/App Store compliance (including GooglePlay's personal loan app policy). 
 - Hire, mentor and grow frontend engineers; run 1: 1s and performance reviews. 

What you bring

- 5-8 years in frontend/mobile engineering, including 1. 5+ years leading a team owning a consumer app end to end. 
 - Deep expertise in React Native or Flutter, plus strong React/Next. js and TypeScript for web. 
 - Native awareness (Kotlin/Swift) to integrate KYC, payment and device SDKs and debug native crashes. 
 - State management, offline-first patterns, deep linking, push notifications and WebView bridges. 
 - CI/CD for mobile (Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions), OTA updates(CodePush/Shorebird), crash and performance tooling (Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry). 
 - Shipped a consumer fintech, lending, payments or banking app at scale in India. 
 - Strong product sense and close working style with designers and backend teams. 

Nice to have

- Built a server-driven UI or low-code journey builder. 
 - Experience with micro-frontends or white-label/SDK journeys embedded in partner apps. 
 - Accessibility, vernacular (multi-language) support and Tier 2/3 user research. 
 - Mobile app security audits (OWASP MASVS) and VAPT remediation.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Builder Experience (ABX)
data.description:
Job Description

AI agents are transforming the way developers interact with software - and databases are no exception. We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our AI Interfaces team within AI Builder Experience (ABX), where you'll provide technical direction, shape architecture, and build the core products that make it seamless for developers and AI agents to work with MongoDB. Our team owns the surfaces through which humans and agents connect to MongoDB - including the MongoDB MCP Server, Agent Skills, our Intelligent Assistant Platform, and purpose-built agents. In short: if it's how an agent talks to MongoDB, we're building it. 

This is a new team charting new territory, and as a Senior Software Engineer here, you'll be right at the frontier - building the technologies that let AI applications and agentic workflows work seamlessly with MongoDB at scale. You'll integrate with fast-moving, often unproven technologies, make pragmatic calls in the face of ambiguity, and own high-visibility projects end to end with minimal guidance. We're looking for product-minded engineers who thrive on autonomy and take pride in shipping. MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day - we value intellectual curiosity and honesty, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. 

This position requires participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation to ensure business continuity and incident response capabilities. 

This role can be based out of our Gurugram office.

Job Description: 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Power Platform engineer to design and deliver complex enterprise solutions for clients while helping raise the technical capability of our broader Power Platform team. 

This is a hands-on player coach role with significant client delivery responsibility. The Manager will remain deeply involved in solution architecture, software development, troubleshooting, implementation, technical reviews, and client discussions. This is not a primarily administrative or people management position. 

The ideal candidate is a software engineer with deep Microsoft Power Platform expertise who can combine low code capabilities with custom development, enterprise architecture, and strong consulting skills. 

Key Responsibilities

- Serve as a hands-on engineer and technical lead for complex client engagements involving Microsoft Power Platform. 
 - Design and build enterprise applications using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, and related Microsoft technologies. 
 - Develop custom solutions using C#/. NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, and other extensibility approaches. 
 - Design scalable Dataverse architectures, including data models, security, integrations, business logic, and performance considerations. 
 - Integrate Power Platform solutions with Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, APIs, and other enterprise systems. 
 - Implement strong ALM practices including source control, solution management, deployment automation, environment strategy, and CI/CD. 
 - Lead technical discovery sessions and translate business requirements into practical, well-designed solutions. 
 - Communicate architecture decisions, tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
 - Provide technical leadership across multiple engagements and act as an escalation point for complex engineering challenges. 
 - Establish and promote engineering standards, reusable patterns, code quality expectations, and delivery best practices. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leads and help improve engineering quality across the broader team. 
 - Help teams determine when Power Platform is the right solution and when custom development or other technologies are more appropriate. 

Required Qualifications

- 8 or more years of professional software engineering, application development, solution architecture, or related technology experience. 
 - 4 or more years of substantial hands-on Microsoft Power Platform engineering experience. 
 - Strong software development experience using C#/. NET and JavaScript or TypeScript. 
 - Experience extending Power Platform through plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, or similar technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, security, data modeling, integration patterns, solution management, and performance. 
 - Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems. 
 - Experience with Azure services, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, and related technologies. 
 - Strong experience with ALM, source control, deployment automation, managed solutions, and CI/CD. 
 - Strong understanding of professional software engineering practices including code review, testing, debugging, monitoring, and production support. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on complex enterprise application projects. 
 - Strong client facing communication, consulting, and facilitation skills. 
 - Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, and provide clear recommendations. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team. 
 - Experience working with global clients and distributed delivery teams, including appropriate overlap with US based stakeholders when required. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Power Platform governance, environment strategy, security standards, or Center of Excellence practices. 
 - Experience with Azure technologies such as Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights. 
 - Experience working in consulting or professional services environments. 
 - Experience supporting presales, estimation, technical proposals, demonstrations, or workshops. 
 - Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications such as PL 400, PL 600, or related credentials. 

What Success Looks Like

Successful engineers in this role remain highly engaged in client delivery while also raising the technical capability of the broader team. They are trusted by clients, comfortable solving difficult engineering problems, able to make sound architecture decisions, and capable of guiding others through complex technical challenges. 

They approach Power Platform as an enterprise application development platform and combine its native capabilities with strong software engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions. 

What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes. 

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development. 

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

data.title: Manager, System Software Engineering - Infrastructure Engineering and Automation
data.description:
NVIDIA has transformed computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years, driven by groundbreaking technology and exceptional people. Today, we're shaping the next era of computing with AI-from research and model development to deployment and everyday applications. 

We are seeking an experienced, technically strong engineering leader to build and lead infrastructure and validation engineering teams supporting NVIDIA's Local AI and PC gaming R&D. These teams develop the software infrastructure, test automation, and debugging tools that enable reliable validation at scale. They also operate NVIDIA's largest hardware cluster dedicated to these domains, ensuring lab readiness, hardware health, and system recovery to keep engineering teams productive. In this role, you will define the infrastructure and validation strategy for current and next-generation platforms, including RTX PCs, RTX Spark, DGX Spark, RTX PRO systems, and DGX Station. You will lead the development of scalable automation and reliable infrastructure to validate AI inference frameworks, agents, kernel libraries, and DirectX gaming drivers-helping engineering teams move faster and deliver high-quality products. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead and grow infrastructure and validation engineering teams responsible for CI/CD, test development and automation, regression analysis, failure triage and debugging support, and lab operations, including hardware health, maintenance, and recovery. 
 - Define and drive the team's technical roadmap, priorities, and delivery commitments across Local AI and PC gaming, balancing long-term infrastructure improvements with day-to-day engineering needs. 
 - Drive the development and deployment of tests and benchmarks that reflect real-world usage, supported by automation for environment setup, test execution, log collection, and results analysis. 
 - Build tools that help reproduce failures and analyze logs and system metrics. Partner with engineering teams to identify root causes and resolve functional issues and performance bottlenecks across the hardware and software stack. 
 - Ensure build systems, CI pipelines, test orchestration, and hardware labs are reliable and scalable. Plan staffing, hardware capacity, schedules, and investments with infrastructure, security, and operations partners. 
 - Communicate strategy, progress, risks, and technical trade-offs to engineering teams and senior leadership. 
 - Partner with graphics, driver, platform, Local AI, product, and open-source teams to define requirements, align priorities, resolve dependencies, and deliver infrastructure that accelerates engineering productivity. 

What We Need To See

- Bachelor's or master's degree, in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. 
 - Min 3 years of exp in management and over all 10+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including substantial system software, platform, runtime, or systems infrastructure development. 
 - Proven record of managing large, high-performing software teams, setting direction, developing engineers, and delivering results through teams. 
 - In-depth knowledge of system programming and operating systems concepts, including APIs, processes and threads, concurrency, memory and resource management, and software-hardware interaction. 
 - Experience designing, debugging, profiling, or optimizing software across system boundaries, using instrumentation and performance data to improve correctness, reliability, and efficiency. 
 - Experience setting technical strategy and operational goals, leading multi-team engineering programs, and balancing staffing, capacity, schedules, and investments. 
 - Ability to communicate technical decisions to senior stakeholders and align partners across software and hardware disciplines. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Background with graphics software, GPU or device-driver stacks, DirectX, or Windows platform bring-up. 
 - Experience integrating or debugging local AI inference frameworks such as llama. cpp, Ollama, PyTorch, vLLM, or Windows ML; familiarity with CUDA or GPU programming is a plus. 
 - Experience building system software, runtimes, developer tools, test frameworks, or benchmark infrastructure used across diverse hardware configurations. 
 - Experience with system profiling, performance optimization, telemetry, diagnostics, or analysis of CPU and GPU workload behavior. 
 - Contributions to open-source software or experience supporting developer-facing software infrastructure and hardware-backed validation. 

Widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www. nvidiabenefits. com/

Here, you'll work in an AI-empowered engineering culture alongside passionate software engineers to turn complex network telemetry into seamless customer experiences.

- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance Java backend services and intuitive, responsive ReactJS front-end interfaces to simplify complex industrial and network management workflows.

 - Leverage modern AI development and code generation tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude) in daily engineering workflows to accelerate feature delivery, automate unit testing, and elevate code quality. 
 - Build, deploy, and maintain robust enterprise on-premise management solutions using Docker containers. 
 - Partner with cross-functional networking and software teams to develop features that monitor, configure, and manage industrial routers and network infrastructure. 
 - Champion clean code standards, comprehensive unit testing, and peer code reviews in an agile environment. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have Skills)

We are looking for a passionate Software Engineer with 8+ Years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

- Strong development experience in Java, with practical expertise in Spring Boot and application servers like JBoss
 - Proficiency in building modern, adaptable user interfaces using ReactJS (or Angular). 
 - Experience with relational databases (Oracle and PostgreSQL), including query optimization, along with developing and deploying on-premises software solutions using Docker container environments. 
 - Understanding of Network Management Systems (NMS), network protocols, or experience working on enterprise networking/router products. 
 - AI Tool Awareness: Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted coding and code generation tools (e. g. , Augment, Codex) to improve development efficiency, productivity, and code quality. 

Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)

- Scripting and automation experience in Python for tooling, test harnesses, or data processing. 
 - Familiarity with Cloud-Native technologies and architectures (e. g. , microservices, Kubernetes, REST APIs). 
 - Experience with industrial IoT protocols, device telemetry, or network routing/switching configuration. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

data.title: Senior Staff Azure Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
At Toku, we create bespoke cloud communications and customer engagement solutions that help enterprises deliver mission-critical customer experiences. Headquartered in Singapore, we combine strategic consulting, technology, regional infrastructure, connectivity and global reach to support enterprises across APAC and beyond. 

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to take on the most senior individual-contributor role within our Infrastructure team. Working alongside the VP of Infrastructure, you will help set technical direction, architecture and engineering standards while remaining deeply involved in solving complex technical challenges. 

This is a cloud-agnostic role with a strong current emphasis on Microsoft Azure. You will play a leading role in establishing and maturing our Azure platform while also working across our existing AWS environment. You will drive modern cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, observability, CI/CD and automation, combining strong architectural judgement with hands-on engineering capability. 

What you will be doing

- Azure cloud architecture: Lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable and highly available Azure infrastructure, including Landing Zone architecture, governance, networking, identity, security guardrails and reusable infrastructure patterns. 
 - Multi-cloud architecture: Apply strong cloud architecture principles across Azure and AWS, establishing appropriate standards for scalability, resilience, security and operational effectiveness. 
 - AWS platform architecture: Continue to evolve our AWS estate across multi-account / AWS Organizations architecture, networking, IAM, security guardrails and core production services. 
 - Technical direction: Act as a senior technical authority for Infrastructure, owning key architectural decisions, establishing engineering standards and identifying opportunities to improve existing approaches. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Own and improve Terraform-based infrastructure provisioning, developing reusable modules, consistent multi-environment patterns, testing and policy controls for reliable, repeatable deployment. 
 - Kubernetes: Architect, operate and improve production Kubernetes environments across Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Amazon EKS, ensuring they are scalable, resilient, secure and operationally robust. 
 - CI/CD & GitOps: Design and improve infrastructure delivery pipelines using technologies such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins, integrating IaC, version control, automated testing, policy enforcement and deployment automation. 
 - Observability: Build and improve monitoring and observability using technologies such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Cortex, Loki and Azure-native observability services, including dashboards, monitors, alerting and integrations. 
 - Automation & scripting: Use Python and automation to reduce repetitive operational work, integrate infrastructure tooling and improve reliability. Review automation code and provide technical direction on how infrastructure automation should be structured. 
 - Platform engineering: Build reusable infrastructure capabilities that enable engineering teams to provision, deploy and operate applications efficiently with less manual dependency on Infrastructure. 
 - Reliability & security: Engineer for high availability, disaster recovery and production resilience while embedding strong cloud security, IAM, networking, access controls and security guardrails into infrastructure design. 
 - Technical leadership: Mentor infrastructure engineers through hands-on collaboration, technical and design reviews and knowledge sharing, raising engineering capability while remaining an individual contributor. 
 - Cross-functional engineering: Work closely with Software Engineering, Security and other technical teams to understand requirements and design appropriate infrastructure solutions. 

We'd love to hear from you if you have

- Experience: Approximately 8-14 years of relevant cloud, infrastructure, DevOps or platform engineering experience, including significant hands-on responsibility for production cloud environments and experience operating at Staff, Senior Staff, Principal, Architect or equivalent technical level. 
 - Microsoft Azure: Strong hands-on Azure infrastructure architecture, implementation and operational experience. You should be comfortable designing and establishing Azure environments rather than only administering existing services. Azure Landing Zone, governance, networking, identity and security experience is particularly relevant. 
 - AWS: Good hands-on AWS architecture and production experience across services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront and Route53. Multi-account / AWS Organizations experience would be valuable. 
 - Terraform: Advanced hands-on Terraform experience, including reusable modules, state management, multi-environment infrastructure, testing and scalable IaC patterns. 
 - Kubernetes: Strong production Kubernetes experience, ideally across AKS and EKS, with the ability to architect, troubleshoot and improve containerised environments. 
 - CI/CD: Strong experience designing and operating infrastructure CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Jenkins or comparable technologies. ArgoCD, Flux, Helm or other GitOps experience would be advantageous. 
 - Observability: Hands-on experience configuring monitoring and observability using Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Cortex, Loki, Azure-native services or comparable platforms, including dashboards, alerting and integrations. 
 - Python & automation: Practical hands-on Python experience for infrastructure scripting and automation, with the ability to understand, develop and review automation code. 
 - Cloud architecture: Strong architectural judgement across cloud networking, security, IAM, scalability, availability, disaster recovery and production reliability, combined with the hands-on capability to implement and validate your designs. 
 - Technical leadership: Experience influencing architecture and engineering standards, reviewing technical designs and mentoring engineers while remaining deeply hands-on. 
 - Experience with policy-as-code, FinOps, service meshes, hybrid/on-premise infrastructure, or telecom/CPaaS and regulated/data-residency-sensitive environments would be an advantage. 
 - Location: This role can be remote, based in India or Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. 

Toku has been recognised as a LinkedIn Top Startup and by the Financial Times as one of APAC's Top 500 High Growth Companies. If you're looking to join a growing company where you can have meaningful technical influence while solving complex real-world infrastructure challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

data.title: Core Infrastructure Engineer 2
data.description:
Job Description

Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under guidance. Applies basic scalability requirements, conducts performance/load testing, and configures resiliency features (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts) to handle network variability. Builds telemetry, alerts, and runbook-driven procedures; delivers scoped features and fault-injection tests; and helps implement basic data replication and synchronization. Assists with on-call rotations, uses automation/IaC scripts to troubleshoot, and follows change, security, and compliance procedures (encryption, access controls, remediation plans) while escalating complex issues to senior engineers. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Assist in the implementation of components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling under the guidance of senior engineers. 

-Optimize code segments and/or systems for large-scale data processing with oversight from senior engineers. 

-Implement scalability requirements for assigned components. 

-Learn about the use of data plane platforms for large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Execute performance and load testing, with guidance. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborate with the team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by learning about redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Learn about recovery oriented computing principles and assist in applying them to component designs. 

-Configure and test retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability, with guidance

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implement testing and alarming configurations to detect issues/failures. 

-Support efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures, under guidance. 

-Help build dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Implement functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. 

-Implement test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness, under guidance. 

-Help implement basic data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Assist in diagnosing and debugging issues in system components to support ongoing operation, under supervision. 

-Follow protocols to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Run basic automation scripts and tooling to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participate in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Assist in implementing basic security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. 

-Assist in the execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, under supervision. 

-Support the creation and updating of documentation to ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Assist in maintaining basic automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)). 

-Adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, under guidance

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 

-Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

-Collaborate within the team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives. 

-Leverage a foundational understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build partnerships with limited guidance.

data.title: Senior Engineer
data.description:
Location: Bangalore, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we're driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. 

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India's growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. 

Engineer & SR Engineer -Avionics SW

Thales India Engineering Competency Center is seeking a Engineer/Sr Engineer to be part of its Avionics Flight Display Systems. The Engineer/Sr Engineer is in charge of the software development activities (Requirement Capturing, Design, Code and V&V), in order to deliver software that meet requirements coming from a Business Lines (B/L), with the adequate quality and maturity level, within schedule and budget. 

Qualifications: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science & Engineering, Electronics & Communication or equivalent discipline with 3 to 7 years of relevant experience. 

Location: Thales India Private Limited, Richmond Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025. 

Job Responsibilities: 

As a Engineer/Sr Engineer, you will be a major actor in the software development phase using approach with C /Embedded C. In more details: 

- Development of Application Software with a good understanding of architectures, multi thread program development, requirements, algorithms, interfaces and designs for avionics systems (Flight Display System) as per DO178B/C standards
 - Debugging, bug fixing & enhancements on existing Software. 
 - To perform Development free hands testing & regression on existing features. 
 - Ensure quality deliveries before hand-off to Quality Assurance teams for further testing and verification. 
 - Participate in an AGILE team involved in the development phases by respecting deadlines and contractual milestones. 

Minimum Skills/Experience: 

- EXPERT in Embedded C Programming Language. 
 - EXPERT in Memory usage & execution time allocation. 
 - Good understanding of Integrated Modular Avionics (IMA)
 - Candidate should be Strong in RTRT
 - Knowledge in Data Structures. 
 - Good experience on Cockpit Display and Graphics, Primary Flight Display, Multi-Functional Display, Flight Management System functionality
 - Knowledge in DO178B/C is required and Knowledge of Coding standards e. g. MISRA. 
 - Candidate should be strong in writing System Specification, High Level Requirements & Low Level Requirements. Also Strong in High Level Test & Low level Test definition procedure & hands on experience in verification. 
 - Should have overall engineering experiences in software development of Avionics embedded system and experience in software Development Life Cycles
 - Knowledge in configuration management tool git is required
 - Knowledge about avionics protocols (A429, A664 - AFDX, RS232, Arinc653)
 - Good organizational abilities. Good interpersonal skills, writing & verbal skills

At Thales, we're committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you'll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

data.title: Engineer II - Cloud
data.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn't changed - we're here to stop breaches, and we've redefined modern security with the world's most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We're always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. 

About The Role: 

We're hiring a Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform. 

Falcon Fusion - a core 'tier one' offering in our Flagship Platform, Falcon - is used by customers to automate breach remediations within their environments. It also serves as the runtime for apps built by our Foundry Module and is 'dogfooded' internally to automate workflows and accelerate development. Processing anywhere from 500M to 10B+ events per day, it is utilized by essentially every customer of the Falcon Platform.

- Develop production-grade SOAR connectors that integrate security platforms (SIEM, EDR, ticketing, IAM) with Falcon Fusion at scale, and contribute to the platform services that power connector execution, authentication, and orchestration. 
 - You'll work on connectors from design through deployment and production support, with guidance from senior team members on architecture and complex integration decisions, while contributing to platform capabilities (auth systems, testing frameworks, deployment pipelines) that all connectors depend on. 
 - Research and integrate new security platforms and APIs to expand our connector portfolio
 - Develop connectors and contribute to platform services, working with authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, API keys) at both the connector and platform layer. 
 - Contribute to automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines that ensure connector quality and reliability across multi-region deployments. 
 - Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues with existing connectors and platform services, working with senior engineers on incident resolution across our fleet of Falcon environments. 
 - Write technical documentation including integration guides, API specifications, and troubleshooting runbooks.

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience
 - 4+ years of experience designing, implementing, and maintaining software products/systems, preferably in a SaaS delivery model. 
 - Fluency in at least one programming language, preferably in Python or Go
 - Experience building distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs
 - Experience developing applications using SQL and NoSQL databases
 - Hands-on experience with distributed system architecture, scalability and availability
 - Strong debugging skills
 - Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

 - Strong communication skills; working collaboratively and confidently with internal stakeholders.

 - Contributions to the open source community

data.description:
Job Description

Leads one or more platform teams; defines tactical and key strategic elements for middleware evolution serving multiple consumers. Accountable for performance, cost control, and reliability outcomes; escalations for distributed debugging and upgrade safety. Drives significant cross-team improvements to observability, SLOs, and resilience patterns. Engages stakeholders inside and outside the group; socializes migration plans and adoption playbooks. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Lead multiple platform teams to standardize middleware patterns and client libraries used by several consumer teams. 
 - Establish group-level guardrails for APIs/SDKs, deprecation strategies, and upgrade playbooks; track adoption and risk. 
 - Sponsor shared observability frameworks and capacity models across teams; review error-budget posture and corrective actions. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Leads teams and provides technical recommendations and guidance in designing software solutions and identifying, analyzing and ensuring alignment with requirements. 
 - Manages the execution of processes to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code and/or functional reviews to drive improvements across a project. 
 - Leads and reviews teams to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues across multiple components or functional areas. 
 - Provides teams guidance to implement software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging. 
 - Utilizes an analytic approach to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Leads teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Leads teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Leads teams to design and develop software, systems, and services. 
 - Acts as a role model to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Leads teams to conduct periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards. 
 - Collaborates with cross-functional teams to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus. 
 - Leads teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 
 - Impacts teams to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates with stakeholders and external clients and/or partners to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - Leads team(s) to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues. 
 - Acts as a role model for teams to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Develops, modifies, and executes policies to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Leads teams through processes for handling customer issues and/or defects handling and directs them to training opportunities as needed. 
 - Manages the investigation and troubleshooting of complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions. 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with teams and other stakeholders within and outside of group to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, development industry best practices and processes, and coding standards. 
 - Ensures clarity of teams' operational objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria. 
 - Implements moderately complex secure software development practices requiring information gathering and analysis to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Leads teams in performing periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Delegates assignments to teams to implement and evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and for driving improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Drives cross-functional partnerships to align expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Drives team to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

- Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources.

data.title: Manager, Network Development
data.description:
Job Description

Guides team in the design and development of network systems for large-scale enterprise, data center, or cloud-based environments, leading strategy for production network and collaborating with vendors and internal quality assurance (QA) teams. Manages the maintenance of advanced automation frameworks for testing and operations, guiding the team in automating network tasks and monitoring health metrics. Guides moderately complex test strategies at the team level, driving testing protocol development, break-fix validation, and compliance with standards through cross-functional collaboration. Improves network health monitoring systems based on team feedback, connects with monitoring teams for anomaly detection enhancement, offers technical leadership during support rotations, and identifies tools for frontline support. Ensures team meets milestones, mentors technical excellence, guides customer-facing incident response and root cause analysis (RCA), contributes to roadmap execution, and resolves technical issues to meet networking standards. Provides guidance on network efficiency remediation strategies and collaborates for scalable solutions and capacity planning. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Network Design, Development, and Validation: 

- Offers guidance and direction on moderately complex test cases and test strategies that enhance network integrity at the team level. 
 - Acts as a technical resource for test practices and strategies, driving efforts towards the development of testing protocols within the team. 
 - Enables the team to perform break-fix validation support and post-event root cause analysis (RCA), offering solutions to resolve escalated issues and cascades lessons learned across the team. 
 - Guides the creation and completion of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) items. 
 - Attends change management and technical change advisory (TCAB) or review board meetings. 
 - Collaborates with stakeholders across the group (e. g. , engineering, quality assurance) to explain practices and procedures needed for compliance with standards prior to deployment. 
 - Reviews and communicates governance and security requirements. 

Automation and Scripting: 

- Gathers team feedback to improve dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor network health, including defining metrics, trends, and thresholds to ensure service level objectives (SLOs). 
 - Connects with monitoring teams to communicate feedback and enhance the detection and diagnosis of network anomalies for the team. 
 - Offers technical leadership on support rotations, and gathers details to develop solutions for moderately complex investigations. 
 - Leverages incident response protocols to provide guidance on root cause investigations. 
 - Helps others identify appropriate tools to support the frontline support team. 

Testing and Quality Assurance: 

- Ensures the team is able to meet critical test and deployment milestones, according to templated project plans for large projects. 
 - Provides mentorship and fosters technical excellence and growth across the team. 
 - Coaches others during standard customer-facing incident response and offers guidance on customer-facing root cause analysis (RCA). 
 - Contributes to the roadmap and software architecture, and helps the team execute according to documentation. 
 - Engages with vendors and internal teams to review, troubleshoot, and resolve product/equipment technical issues and ensure adherence to networking standards. 

Monitoring and Reliability: 

- Provides guidance on strategies to remediate network efficiency issues when network performance and service metrics (e. g. , latency, throughput, packet loss). 
 - Collaborates with vendors and business partners to develop scalable solutions. 
 - Collaborates with capacity planning teams to plan for and forecast team initiatives, integrating performance, security, and growth models to ensure future-ready infrastructure. 
 - Anticipates limitations of network technology and ensures the network is architected accordingly. 
 - Communicates limitations to the team. 

Cross-Team Collaboration and Leadership: 

- Ensures the team is able to meet critical test and deployment milestones, according to templated project plans for large projects. 
 - Provides mentorship and fosters technical excellence and growth across the team. 
 - Coaches others during standard customer-facing incident response and offers guidance on customer-facing root cause analysis (RCA). 
 - Contributes to the roadmap and software architecture, and helps the team execute according to documentation. 
 - Engages with vendors and internal teams to review, troubleshoot, and resolve product/equipment technical issues and ensure adherence to networking standards. 

Performance and Capacity Management: 

- Provides guidance on strategies to remediate network efficiency issues when network performance and service metrics (e. g. , latency, throughput, packet loss). 
 - Collaborates with vendors and business partners to develop scalable solutions. 
 - Collaborates with capacity planning teams to plan for and forecast team initiatives, integrating performance, security, and growth models to ensure future-ready infrastructure. 
 - Anticipates limitations of network technology and ensures the network is architected accordingly. 
 - Communicates limitations to the team. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Creates and owns the execution plan for the team's work and multiple projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines and budgets when applicable to ensure projects are completed on time and in adherence with requirements. Delegates work across the team and helps them prioritize their work. Identifies resource needs and adapts plans based on changing priorities and business needs. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Strengthens collaborative partnerships across teams to align on expectations and shared objectives. Guides team members to build relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure effective collaboration. Practices active listening and asks insightful questions to promote an inclusive culture. 

Problem Solving: 

- Leads the team to identify and address moderately complex operational and/or technical issues in accordance with standard practices, providing guidance as appropriate. Directs the team to analyze data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot moderately complex errors. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Actively seeks learning opportunities for self and team to enhance knowledge and skills in key areas and remain current with industry advancements. Uses feedback and training to elevate personal and team skills, modeling a commitment to learning. Identifies skill gaps within the team and supports team members in learning opportunities by providing resources and fostering an environment that encourages knowledge-sharing. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Identifies and recommends improvements as well as encourages the team to share ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Reviews and provides feedback on team member's ideas and seeks input from others on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

Performance and Development: 

- Coaches and provides direction to team members in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Facilitates goal setting discussions with team members, ensuring individual goals are aligned with broader team goals. Identifies development opportunities to help team members improve performance. Contributes to the talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, assessing promotion eligibility, and managing talent resources.

data.title: Lead Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. 

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2, 500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow. 

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA. 

PURPOSE

As a Lead Cloud Infrastructure Engineer in SITA's Airports Portfolio you will lead technical design, development and maintenance of the Azure Cloud platform and related services (using existing and emerging technologies) to enable the modernisation and efficient delivery of services to our customers. 

We are seeking a talented and experienced Azure Cloud Engineer to join our portfolio platform team - dedicated to developing and deploying our cloud solutions in the best possible way now and into the future. 

Key Responsibilities

Key contributor to the design, planning and implementation of our Azure cloud solutions and services to ensure optimum cloud performance and reliability across our cloud infrastructure, building in continuous process improvement and CI/CD pipelines. 

Works as part of a broader team of problem solvers helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution via automation. 

Acts as a key liaison with senior technology stakeholders and partners to ensure full delivery of software releases & product roadmaps. 

Interfaces with Developers Engineers Architects Ops and Support staff to design develop and implement cost effective Cloud Solutions using IaaS/PaaS/SaaS so that it is flexible extensible elastic secure and reliable at large scale. 

Recommends and participates in the selection of new technologies and technical processes working closely with the Architecture Team to implement the top cloud architecture solutions to successfully meet the strategic needs of the organization. 

Creates re-usable platform components for products, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines from development right though to production. 

Works within agile methodologies, following SITA coding guidelines and practices for all technical processes and documenting solutions. 

Mentoring and guiding junior team members on IaC practices, Kubernetes operations, and Azure platform engineering. 

Provides expert level support to Operational teams. 

Issue technical recommendations and guidelines for implementation and support. 

Qualifications

EXPERIENCE

6+ years Cloud Platform Engineering experience

- Experience designing, configuring & implementing infrastructure and network solutions in Azure. 
 - Experience with LAN & WAN networking, TCP/IP, load balancing principles. 
 - Experience with hub and spoke and landing zones. 
 - Experience with automating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps. 
 - Experience with production grade AKS clusters and associated challenges. 
 - Experience with creating application and infrastructure monitoring solutions. 
 - Experience creating and delivering Cloud Platform technology roadmaps

Knowledge & Skills

Ability to be the lead technical role on complex projects overseeing requirement analysis through implementation and/or support. Understand the customer's business objectives for assigned projects. Coordinate multiple technical streams of work to produce a complete solution with high-level designs. Understand the concept of IT security and its application to computer systems architecture. Sound knowledge of system integration and hardware. Sound understanding of agile methodologies and practices. Understand and articulate trade-offs and risks with technical choices. 

- Strong understanding of Azure networking VNet peering, NSGs, UDR, NAT Gateway, private DNS, service endpoints
 - Experience in managing and provisioning infrastructure through code (IaC). 
 - Experience with automating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps. 
 - Ability to quickly learn and understand new technologies or concepts, review functional and technical requirements, raising potential issues and participating actively in design discussions
 - Experience with creating application and infrastructure monitoring solutions. 
 - Experience creating and delivering Cloud Platform technology roadmaps
 - You thrive in a team environment, excellent communication skills, with the ability to work independently & as a member of the team. 

Experience And Skills In The Following Technologies

- Terraform experience with module authoring, state management, provider configuration, CI/CD integration
 - Azure DevOps CI/CD Pipeline Engineering. Own the Azure Pipelines template library (multi-stage YAML), self-hosted agent infrastructure, and automated testing integration

data.description:
Meet the Team

Cisco's Industrial IoT (IIoT) Business Unit powers the critical infrastructure of the world-connecting and securing the smart grids, automated factories, connected roadways, and energy systems that keep society running. We bridge the gap between complex industrial operational technology (OT) data and intuitive, high-performance software. 

We are a collaborative, forward-thinking global team building the next generation of user-centric management interfaces and on-premise solutions (such as Field Network Director) that manage industrial routing and switching networks. Here, you'll work in an AI-empowered engineering culture alongside passionate software engineers to turn complex network telemetry into seamless customer experiences. 

Your Impact

- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance Java backend services and intuitive, responsive ReactJS front-end interfaces to simplify complex industrial and network management workflows. 
 - Architect and optimize relational database models using Oracle and PostgreSQL, ensuring high data integrity, low-latency querying, and robust transaction handling. 
 - Leverage modern AI development and code generation tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude) in daily engineering workflows to accelerate feature delivery, automate unit testing, and elevate code quality. 
 - Build, deploy, and maintain robust enterprise on-premise management solutions using Docker containers. 
 - Partner with cross-functional networking and software teams to develop features that monitor, configure, and manage industrial routers and network infrastructure. 
 - Champion clean code standards, comprehensive unit testing, and peer code reviews in an agile environment. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have Skills)

We are looking for a passionate Software Engineer with 4+ Years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

- Strong development experience in Java, with practical expertise in Spring Boot and application servers like JBoss
 - Proficiency in building modern, adaptable user interfaces using ReactJS (or Angular). 
 - Experience with relational databases (Oracle and PostgreSQL), including query optimization, along with developing and deploying on-premises software solutions using Docker container environments. 
 - Understanding of Network Management Systems (NMS), network protocols, or experience working on enterprise networking/router products. 
 - AI Tool Awareness: Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted coding and code generation tools (e. g. , Augment, Codex) to improve development efficiency, productivity, and code quality. 

Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)

- Scripting and automation experience in Python for tooling, test harnesses, or data processing. 
 - Familiarity with Cloud-Native technologies and architectures (e. g. , microservices, Kubernetes, REST APIs). 
 - Experience with industrial IoT protocols, device telemetry, or network routing/switching configuration. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer - Trusted Data Platform
data.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company. 

Our office is in Bellevue, WA, but we offer flexibility for eligible candidates to work remotely across the West US. Whatever your preference - working from home, an office, or in between - you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle. We call this TEAM anywhere . 

Responsibilities

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader and hands-on contributor, designing and optimizing high-scale, distributed storage systems built on AWS storage technologies. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the architecture, performance, and reliability of backend storage solutions that power critical applications at scale. 

Your primary responsibilities will include designing, implementing, and optimizing backend storage services that support high throughput, low latency, and fault tolerance. You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to drive scalability, availability, and efficiency improvements in large-scale storage solutions. You will also lead technical deep dives, architecture reviews, and root cause analyses to resolve complex production issues related to storage performance, consistency, and durability. 

As a thought leader, you will drive best practices in distributed system design, security, and cloud cost optimization. You will also mentor senior engineers, contribute to technical roadmaps, and help shape the long-term storage strategy. Your expertise in storage consistency models, data partitioning, indexing, and caching strategies will be instrumental in improving system performance and reliability. 

Additionally, you will collaborate with Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to implement observability, monitoring, and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring high availability and compliance with industry standards. You will advocate for automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and DevOps best practices, leveraging tools like Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Kubernetes (EKS), and CI/CD pipelines to enable scalable deployments and operational excellence. 

Qualifications

Basic Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 8+ years of experience in backend software development, focusing on distributed systems and storage solutions. 
 - 5+ years of experience working with AWS storage services (S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, Glacier). 
 - Strong expertise in system design, architecture, and scalability for large-scale storage solutions. 
 - Proficiency in at least one major backend programming language (Kotlin, Java, Go, Rust, or Python). 
 - Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant, and cost-efficient storage architectures. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, replication strategies, sharding, and caching. 
 - Knowledge of data security, encryption best practices, and compliance requirements (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA). 
 - Experience leading engineering teams, mentoring senior engineers, and driving technical roadmaps. 
 - Proficiency with observability tools, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting at scale. 

Core Requirements

Expertise in Large-Scale Storage Systems

- Deep knowledge of AWS storage services (S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, Glacier) and their performance characteristics. 
 - Experience designing and optimizing object storage, block storage, and file storage solutions at scale. 
 - Strong understanding of storage durability, consistency models, replication, and erasure coding for fault tolerance. 
 - Experience implementing tiered storage solutions and cost-optimized data retention strategies. 

Distributed Systems & Scalability

- Deep understanding of distributed storage architectures, CAP theorem, and consistency models. 
 - Expertise in partitioning, sharding, and replication strategies for low-latency, high-throughput storage. 
 - Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems using consensus algorithms (Raft, Paxos, Gossip Protocol). 
 - Hands-on experience with high-performance NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, Cassandra, RocksDB). 

High-Performance Backend Engineering

- Strong programming skills in Kotlin, Java, Go, Rust, or Python for backend storage development. 
 - Experience building event-driven, microservices-based architectures using gRPC, REST, or WebSockets. 
 - Expertise in data serialization formats (Parquet, Avro, ORC) for optimized storage access. 
 - Experience implementing data compression, deduplication, and indexing strategies to improve storage efficiency. 

Cloud-Native & Infrastructure Automation

- Strong hands-on experience with AWS Well-Architected Framework and cloud storage best practices. 
 - Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes (EKS), serverless architectures (Lambda, Fargate), and containerized storage workloads. 
 - Expertise in CI/CD automation for storage services, leveraging GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, Jenkins, or ArgoCD. 

Performance Optimization & Observability

- Experience with benchmarking, profiling, and optimizing storage workloads. 
 - Proficiency in performance monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana) for storage systems. 
 - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills for latency bottlenecks, memory leaks, and concurrency issues. 
 - Experience designing observability strategies (tracing, metrics, structured logging) for large-scale storage systems. 

Security, Compliance, and Data Protection

- Deep knowledge of data security, encryption at rest/in transit, and IAM policies in AWS. 
 - Experience implementing fine-grained access controls (IAM, KMS, STS, VPC Security Groups) for multi-tenant storage solutions. 
 - Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP) and best practices for secure data storage. 
 - Expertise in disaster recovery, backup strategies, and multi-region failover solutions. 

Leadership & Architectural Strategy

- Proven ability to design, document, and drive large-scale storage architectures from concept to production. 
 - Experience leading technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and engineering best practices. 
 - Strong ability to mentor senior and mid-level engineers, fostering growth in distributed storage expertise. 
 - Ability to influence technical roadmaps, long-term vision, and cost optimization strategies for backend storage.

Senior Manager- AI Engineer

At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.
