data.title: AI Analyst, BI
data.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced AI & BI Automation Technical Lead to design, enhance and scale AI-powered Business Intelligence automation solutions. 

The role combines hands-on Microsoft Power Platform, Python, Azure and Generative AI engineering with technical ownership of BI automation, automated quality validation and report delivery capabilities. The individual will convert business and operational requirements into scalable, reliable and reusable technology solutions. 

The successful candidate will work closely with global BI hubs, Technology teams, architects and business stakeholders to automate BI processes, improve report quality, reduce manual effort and increase delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong balance of technical depth, BI domain understanding, solution ownership and stakeholder engagement. 

Key Responsibilities

1. AI and BI Automation Solution Ownership

- Own the technical design, enhancement and ongoing evolution of AI-enabled BI automation capabilities
 - Develop scalable solutions for report onboarding, scheduling, refresh, monitoring, quality validation and delivery
 - Convert manual BI processes into reusable and configurable automation workflows
 - Define and maintain the technical roadmap with BI, Technology and business stakeholders
 - Evaluate AI and automation opportunities based on business value, feasibility, scalability and adoption potential
 - Ensure solutions can support multiple regions, clients, report types and BI hubs2. Python and Application Engineering

- Design and develop scalable, cloud-native applications using Python
 - Build and maintain APIs, backend services and business-rule engines
 - Develop reliable solutions using object-oriented programming, reusable components and established design patterns
 - Perform automated data validation, missing-value detection, duplicate analysis, anomaly detection and variance analysis using Pandas, Polars or equivalent frameworks
 - Develop integrations across BI reporting, automation, quality-control and delivery platforms
 - Integrate Power Platform applications with Azure services, SQL Server, REST APIs, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Power BI and other enterprise systems
 - Optimize applications for performance, reliability, maintainability and scalability3. Generative AI and Intelligent Automation

- Develop and integrate enterprise Generative AI solutions using services such as Azure OpenAI, Llama, LangChain and vector search
 - Build AI-enabled solutions using Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI Builder, custom prompts, agent flows and generative actions
 - Apply Retrieval-Augmented Generation, prompt engineering and structured AI workflows to BI use cases
 - Use AI to generate executive summaries, business insights, recommendations and exception explanations
 - Design controls to validate AI-generated output before it is used in business processes
 - Evaluate Small Language Models for cost-efficient or low-latency deployments
 - Explore AI agents and intelligent workflows for report creation, quality validation, monitoring and operational support
 - Apply deterministic validation wherever accuracy, traceability and repeatability are required4. BI Process and Quality Automation

- Understand the complete BI report lifecycle, including requirement intake, report creation, refresh, validation, approval and delivery
 - Automate repeatable activities across Excel-based reporting and other BI platforms
 - Develop configurable quality rules for data checks, business validation and change detection
 - Support report-level and worksheet-level checks such as blanks, duplicates, formula continuity, reporting periods, product or market changes and variance thresholds
 - Design monitoring and exception-management capabilities that enable users to identify and resolve failures quickly
 - Partner with BI subject-matter experts to convert business validation requirements into scalable technical rules
 - Establish measurable quality controls and audit trails for automated processes5. Microsoft Power Platform Engineering

- Design, develop and support enterprise applications using Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse
 - Build user interfaces, workflow automation, approval processes and data-driven applications aligned with BI operational requirements
 - Design secure Dataverse data models, roles, permissions and integration patterns
 - Apply Power Platform governance, Data Loss Prevention policies, environment strategy and reusable solution standards
 - Use custom connectors and APIs to extend Power Platform capabilities and integrate with enterprise services6. Architecture, Cloud and DevOps

- Contribute to scalable, extensible and secure solution architecture
 - Develop distributed, event-driven and microservices-based solutions where appropriate
 - Work with Azure, AWS or GCP cloud services based on approved enterprise architecture
 - Develop and integrate Azure capabilities including Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Microsoft Entra ID and Azure Data Factory
 - Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and version-control practices using Git
 - Manage Power Platform Application Lifecycle Management using solutions, connection references, environment variables, service principals and controlled DEV-to-TEST-to-PROD deployments
 - Support containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes where required
 - Apply Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent tools
 - Implement logging, monitoring and observability using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry or equivalent tools
 - Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, access-control and engineering standards7. Production Reliability and Operational Support

- Monitor application performance, automation success rates and production reliability
 - Lead technical investigation and root-cause analysis for production incidents
 - Implement preventive actions to reduce recurring failures and operational dependency
 - Define alerts, recovery mechanisms and escalation processes for critical failures
 - Maintain appropriate backup, versioning and recovery capabilities
 - Ensure solutions are documented and are not dependent on individual team members
 - Balance new feature development with application stability, maintainability and technical-debt reduction
 - Independently manage the complete product development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring and production support8. Global Stakeholder Engagement and Adoption

- Work with global BI hubs to understand operational requirements and identify automation opportunities
 - Translate business requirements into clear functional and technical specifications
 - Conduct solution demonstrations, technical walkthroughs and user-training sessions
 - Support hub onboarding, testing, feedback collection and adoption
 - Communicate solution capabilities, limitations, dependencies and rollout requirements clearly
 - Coordinate with BI, Technology, architecture, infrastructure, security and business teams
 - Build stakeholder confidence through transparent progress reporting and measurable outcomes9. Technical Leadership and Team Development

- Provide technical direction to developers and BI automation specialists
 - Review solution designs, application code and testing approaches
 - Establish coding, documentation, testing and deployment standards
 - Mentor team members in Python, AI, cloud engineering and BI automation
 - Support work prioritization, release planning and dependency management
 - Promote approved AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot, to improve productivity
 - Create reusable frameworks, components and engineering patterns that can be adopted across the BI organization

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology or a related field
 - 6-8 years of experience in software development, data engineering, BI automation or AI application development
 - Demonstrated experience owning technical solutions from requirement gathering through production deployment and support
 - Experience working with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams
 - Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skillsMust-Have Skills

Technical Engineering

- Strong proficiency in Python and object-oriented programming
 - Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms and software design patterns
 - Hands-on experience developing APIs and backend services
 - Experience with Pandas, Polars or similar data-processing frameworks
 - Experience with Pytest or comparable automated testing frameworks
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
 - Experience with Azure, AWS or GCP
 - Practical experience with Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Microsoft Entra ID and Azure Data Factory
 - Understanding of distributed systems, microservices and event-driven architecture
 - Strong debugging, performance-optimization and root-cause-analysis skillsAI and Automation

- Hands-on experience developing Generative AI or language-model-based applications
 - Experience with Azure OpenAI, LangChain, Llama or equivalent technologies
 - Hands-on experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI Builder, custom prompts, agent flows or generative actions
 - Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector databases and vector search
 - Experience with prompt engineering and structured AI-output validation
 - Ability to combine AI capabilities with deterministic business rules
 - Understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, security and model limitationsBI and Data

- Experience with Business Intelligence or reporting automation
 - Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, especially Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse
 - Understanding of report refresh, data validation, quality-control and delivery processes
 - Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases
 - Strong practical knowledge of SQL Server, including complex queries, views, stored procedures, permissions, performance optimization and application integration
 - Experience handling structured data, Excel workbooks or comparable reporting outputs
 - Ability to translate BI and business requirements into scalable technical solutions
 - Experience developing configurable data-quality or business-validation rules
 - Experience with Power Platform Application Lifecycle Management, including solutions, connection references, environment variables, service principals and DEV-to-PROD deployment controls
 - Experience integrating Power Platform applications with Azure, SQL Server, APIs, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Power BI and other enterprise systemsLeadership and Stakeholder Management

- Experience owning technical features or solutions end to end
 - Ability to independently manage the complete product lifecycle, covering requirements, architecture, development, testing, deployment, monitoring and production support
 - Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in simple business language
 - Experience working with business stakeholders, architects and engineering teams
 - Ability to conduct solution demonstrations, requirement discussions and technical reviews
 - Ability to mentor developers and establish engineering standardsGood-to-Have Skills

- Experience with Power BI, Excel automation, Power Query or other enterprise reporting platforms
 - Experience developing automated report creation, report refresh or report-quality solutions
 - Experience with Small Language Model deployment or fine-tuning
 - Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL persistence models
 - Familiarity with Terraform, Pulumi or other Infrastructure as Code tools
 - Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry or comparable observability tools
 - Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
 - Familiarity with GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI-assisted development tools
 - Experience working in Agile or Scrum delivery models
 - Experience supporting enterprise applications in a production environment
 - Exposure to workflow automation, robotic process automation or agent-based solutionsKey Success Measures

- Percentage of eligible reports or processes automated
 - Reduction in manual effort and operational hours
 - Improvement in report quality and automated validation coverage
 - Reduction in recurring production failures
 - Automation success rate and application availability
 - Reduction in report refresh, validation and delivery time
 - Adoption of automation solutions across global BI hubs
 - Number of reusable AI and automation capabilities delivered
 - Successful release and adoption of Power Platform and Azure-integrated applications across controlled environments
 - Stakeholder satisfaction and realized business value
 - Quality of technical documentation, knowledge transfer and team capability developmentExpected Profile

The ideal candidate is not only a strong Python and AI engineer. The candidate should understand BI operations, identify automation opportunities and own solutions from concept through global adoption. The person should be comfortable moving between: 

- Business requirements and technical architecture

What you'll be doing

- Lead, grow, and mentor a cross-site team of power and infrastructure engineers across Pune and Bangalore - setting individual and team roadmaps, development plans, and clear ownership across all mandates. 
 - Drive the team's power profiling authority across the full product lifecycle: pre-silicon power engagement, power target qualification, regression monitoring, battery-life validation, and external software release qualification - including nightly development-branch and release-branch power and perf/watt monitoring across discrete GPU and data-center platforms. 
 - Own the physical lab - run a temperature-controlled, instrumented measurement lab across two sites, covering DUT fleet management, board procurement, intake and logistics, board instrumentation and rework, DAQ and power-path integrity, rack build-out, and cross-geo capacity planning. 
 - Shape measurability from pre-silicon through production - engage pre-silicon to challenge power modelling assumptions and establish measurement confidence levels; drive instrumented boards, rail maps, on-board sensors, and DAQ adapter design; specify, track, and escalate measurement prerequisites (telemetry, software build, validation, and agreed power targets with guard band policy), holding the requirement and escalating when it slips. 
 - Close power gaps and own release readiness - quantify and attribute power gaps to rail, IP, feature, and residency; drive debug and optimization alongside software and hardware power owners through experiments and recovery confirmation; deliver the power verdict that feeds program go/no-go decisions, backed by qualification data on every external software drop. 
 - Lead cross-company power engagement - converge measurement methodology and tooling with OEMs and software power owners; co-engineer shared battery-life targets, conduct joint root-cause analysis where measurements diverge, and maintain a common bug-and-analysis stream. 
 - Own the team's infrastructure portfolio and energy compliance - drive the in-house power profiling framework, power analytics dashboard, and automated power regression farm as production-grade shared assets; deliver energy-regulation compliance evidence (idle, standby, and off-mode power) required to clear product release gates. 

What we need to see

- BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 8+ years of overall industry experience. 
 - 5+ years of engineering management experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex software and infrastructure at velocity across distributed teams. 
 - Deep background in power systems, computer architecture, and SoC/platform power - with hands-on experience in power measurement, analysis, or power-stack debugging. 
 - Experience running or closely supporting a hardware measurement lab - instrumentation, device fleet, and the logistics that keep it productive. 
 - Demonstrated ability to engage across the full program lifecycle - from pre-silicon power modeling through bring-up, qualification, and post-commercialization sustaining. 
 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills to operate across engineering teams, program management, partner labs, OEM customers, and executive stakeholders. 
 - Commitment to measurement quality and the defensibility of data that drives product decisions. 

Ways to stand out from the crowd

- Hands-on power profiling experience - DAQ-based external rail capture, on-board sensor validation, or telemetry-driven regression root cause. 
 - Intimate knowledge of Windows on Arm or client SoC platforms - battery-life scenario methodology, Modern Standby measurement, or energy-efficiency regulatory compliance. 
 - Experience leading silicon bring-up power profiling - firmware sensor validation, first-power baselines, and bring-up-phase engagement with hardware teams. 
 - Track record of building or leading power regression infrastructure or automated test/analysis pipelines at scale. 
 - Experience with AI/agentic workflow development applied to lab automation, failure triage, or report generation. 
 - Prior cross-company lab convergence work - aligning methodology, build synchronization, and shared tooling between two or more power or validation labs.

data.title: AI QE
data.description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many products we use every day are conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software. 

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer with 5+ years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation to join our growing Quality Center of Excellence. 

In this role, you will design, develop, and execute automated tests across Siemens software products in a multiplatform environment. You will combine strong software testing fundamentals with programming and automation skills to improve product quality, test coverage, and release confidence. 

You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Applications Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, while also collaborating with other QA specialists across Siemens in areas such as automation, performance testing, and security testing. 

The ideal candidate is a logical thinker and strong problem solver who enjoys understanding how software works, identifying defects, automating repetitive activities, and continuously improving the way software is tested. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop test automation: Design, implement, maintain, and execute automated tests for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios using appropriate frameworks and programming languages for Teamcenter. 
 - Drive test coverage: Work with Product Managers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to understand requirements, identify risks, define test cases, and develop effective automation strategies for new features and product releases. 
 - Apply AI-assisted techniques to accelerate test-case generation, script development, test-data preparation, defect analysis, log analysis, troubleshooting, and regression optimization. 
 - Enable continuous testing: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback, detect defects early, and improve the efficiency and reliability of software delivery. 
 - Test APIs and data: Perform API testing using RESTful services and tools such as Postman or Swagger, and validate application data using SQL queries and SPARQL where applicable. 
 - Investigate and resolve quality issues: Execute automated and functional tests, analyze failures and results, identify defects, perform structured troubleshooting, and collaborate with development teams to drive resolution. 
 - Improve automation frameworks: Continuously enhance existing test frameworks, scripts, and utilities to improve maintainability, efficiency, reliability, and test coverage. 
 - Collaborate and contribute to quality excellence: Maintain clear test documentation, share knowledge, and collaborate with the Siemens Quality Center of Excellence to adopt effective quality engineering practices and emerging testing technologies. 

Qualifications

- Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Teamcenter quality engineering and test automation, including automated validation of Teamcenter applications, APIs, integrations, and containerized solutions. Strong programming or scripting skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language, with the ability to develop maintainable automation solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with API testing and database validation, including RESTful APIs, SQL queries, and tools such as Postman or Swagger. 
 - Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, with an understanding of integrating automated tests into pipelines. 
 - Strong understanding of software testing methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, TDD, and BDD, combined with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Exposure to AI agents, LLM-driven applications, or AI-assisted automation, including technologies such as Anthropic Claude or equivalent. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies. 
 - Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner. 
 - Familiarity with security testing practices such as DAST and penetration testing concepts. 
 - Experience testing browser-based applications, including functionality, performance, and cross-browser compatibility. 
 - Experience with defect and test management tools such as Polarion. 

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

The ideal candidate will serve as the primary Agile lead for Salesforce initiatives, facilitating Scrum ceremonies, managing sprint execution, aligning business priorities, and ensuring successful delivery of business value. In addition, the role will lead the implementation of Agentforce AI agents, Einstein AI capabilities, enterprise integrations, and DevOps practices while promoting Salesforce best practices, governance, security, and continuous improvement. This position partners closely with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and development teams to deliver intelligent customer, employee, and operational solutions that support business transformation objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead Agile/Scrum delivery for Salesforce projects, including sprint planning, backlog management, stakeholder coordination, and release execution. 
 - Design, develop, and support Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Salesforce platform technologies. 
 - Implement and optimize Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein AI, Data Cloud, and AI-driven automation solutions. 
 - Define and deliver scalable integration solutions using APIs, middleware, and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Drive Salesforce DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing, and release management. 
 - Ensure adherence to Salesforce architecture standards, security controls, governance policies, and Responsible AI principles. 
 - Mentor development teams, conduct code reviews, and promote Agile and Salesforce best practices.

Qualifications

data.title: ServiceNow Software Engineer Manager
data.description:
Software Engineering Manager, Associate Portal

Information Technology

As the Software Engineering Manager for our Associate Portal, you will lead the engineering team responsible for building and operating Ecolab's enterprise digital front door on ServiceNow Employee Center Pro within HR Service Delivery. You will own the quality, reliability, and technical delivery of an experience that helps associates find information, access services, complete tasks, and connect to enterprise workflows from one place. 

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You will lead the team and stay close to the work: shaping solutions, reviewing designs and code, removing delivery barriers, and ensuring what reaches production is secure, scalable, accessible, and supportable. You will establish the engineering practices that make quality repeatable rather than dependent on individual projects or implementation partners. 

You will partner closely with product, UX, architecture, Enterprise AI, HR, Communications, and business teams. You will translate the Associate Portal vision into an executable engineering roadmap and build the internal capability needed to operate and continuously improve the product after implementation. 

What you will do

Engineering Leadership and Team Development

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of ServiceNow engineers and technical leads responsible for the Associate Portal and related employee experience capabilities. 
 - Establish clear ownership, performance expectations, development plans, and engineering objectives for the team. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, technical excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, and strong customer focus. 
 - Manage work across employees, contingent resources, and implementation partners while retaining clear internal accountability for engineering outcomes. 
 - Develop the internal knowledge and capability required to own, operate, and enhance the portal following implementation and knowledge transfer. 

Associate Portal Engineering

- Own engineering delivery for the Associate Portal built on ServiceNow Employee Center Pro and HR Service Delivery. 
 - Lead the configuration, development, testing, deployment, and enhancement of portal pages, widgets, microsites, application launchers, navigation, taxonomy, and responsive experiences. 
 - Ensure a consistent, intuitive, and consumer-grade experience across desktop, mobile, manufacturing, field, and corporate environments. 
 - Guide the use of audience groups, user criteria, HR criteria, personas, roles, regions, and language preferences to deliver relevant and personalized experiences. 
 - Oversee capabilities including enterprise search, knowledge, content, services, requests, approvals, tasks, communications, and conversational assistance. 
 - Partner with UX leaders to ensure implemented experiences match approved designs and meet accessibility, usability, and performance expectations. 

Architecture and Technical Governance

- Partner with ServiceNow platform architecture and enterprise architecture to define and enforce technical standards for the Associate Portal. 
 - Translate complex business and experience requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly ServiceNow solutions. 
 - Apply a configuration-first approach and ensure custom development is used only where it creates clear business or experience value. 
 - Lead technical design reviews covering portal components, integrations, data flows, security, performance, and cross-platform dependencies. 
 - Maintain clear solution designs, integration specifications, data flows, operational documentation, and technical decision records. 
 - Actively manage customization risk, technical debt, unsupported components, platform upgrades, and lifecycle dependencies. 

Software Engineering Standards and Quality

- Establish and enforce standards for coding, peer review, source control, testing, documentation, deployment, and release management. 
 - Ensure solutions are designed for maintainability, reusability, security, performance, accessibility, and platform upgrades. 
 - Drive automated testing using ServiceNow Automated Test Framework and other approved testing capabilities. 
 - Implement quality gates across development, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and production deployment. 
 - Lead disciplined defect management, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and technical debt reduction. 
 - Ensure delivery partners meet Ecolab engineering, security, documentation, and quality standards before work is accepted. 

Agile Delivery and Execution

- Partner with Product Management and the Product Owner to translate roadmap priorities, user needs, and approved designs into an executable engineering backlog. 
 - Lead estimation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, dependency management, release planning, and delivery reviews. 
 - Ensure commitments reflect clear requirements, realistic estimates, available capacity, technical dependencies, and quality expectations. 
 - Coordinate delivery across portal development, UX, integrations, content, search, AI, testing, deployment, hypercare, and ongoing support. 
 - Communicate delivery status, technical risks, decisions, and blockers early, with clear ownership and a practical path to resolution. 

Integrations and Enterprise Experience

- Oversee integrations supporting employee data, content, services, requests, approvals, search, digital assets, communications, analytics, and workflow execution. 
 - Define reusable integration patterns using IntegrationHub, REST and SOAP APIs, MID Servers, and other approved enterprise technologies. 
 - Partner with system owners to define interface ownership, data contracts, security, monitoring, exception handling, and support responsibilities. 
 - Ensure integrations are observable, resilient, loosely coupled, and designed so failures do not become recurring user experience issues. 
 - Provide technical oversight for integrations with platforms such as Workday, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Viva Engage, enterprise content systems, and digital asset platforms. 

AI, Search, and Automation

- Partner with Enterprise AI and platform teams to integrate conversational assistance, enterprise search, knowledge-grounded responses, and task automation into the portal. 
 - Provide engineering leadership for the portal-side integration and presentation of EVA and other approved AI capabilities. 
 - Ensure AI and search capabilities meet enterprise requirements for security, privacy, governance, performance, observability, and supportability. 
 - Evaluate ServiceNow AI Search, Now Assist, Virtual Agent, and automation capabilities where they improve associate outcomes and align with platform strategy. 

Content, Knowledge, and Experience Governance

- Partner with content and business leaders to implement capabilities for content creation, approval, publishing, personalization, localization, lifecycle management, and archival. 
 - Provide engineering oversight for ServiceNow Knowledge Management, content experiences, searchability, metadata, and audience targeting. 
 - Establish clear technical ownership for templates, components, microsites, navigation structures, taxonomies, and reusable portal capabilities. 
 - Use analytics, user feedback, defects, and operational data with Product and UX teams to continuously improve the experience. 

Reliability and Operations

- Own engineering outcomes for portal availability, performance, stability, security, scalability, and maintainability. 
 - Define monitoring, alerting, support, release, and escalation practices for the portal and its integrations. 
 - Partner with platform operations and support teams to establish clear support boundaries, service expectations, and incident ownership. 
 - Ensure the team is prepared to support deployments, stabilization, hypercare, upgrades, and ongoing production operations. 
 - Lead proactive remediation of vulnerabilities, recurring incidents, unsupported technologies, and lifecycle risks. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
 - 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, enterprise application development, or platform engineering. 
 - 7+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience spanning solution design, configuration, development, integration, testing, and production support. 
 - 3+ years leading software engineers, technical leads, or complex cross-functional engineering delivery teams. 
 - Strong experience with ServiceNow Employee Center, Employee Center Pro, Service Portal, or comparable ServiceNow portal technologies. 
 - Experience with ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, including employee experiences, HR services, knowledge, user criteria, HR criteria, and related security considerations. 
 - Strong knowledge of JavaScript, Glide APIs, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST and SOAP APIs, UI Builder, and ServiceNow development practices. 
 - Experience delivering responsive, personalized, accessible, and high-performing user-facing enterprise applications. 
 - Demonstrated experience establishing coding standards, testing practices, quality gates, architecture guardrails, and release controls. 
 - Strong Agile delivery, stakeholder management, and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to executive and nontechnical audiences. 
 - Proven people leadership, including coaching, performance management, capability development, and work across globally distributed teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer, or Certified Implementation Specialist in HR Service Delivery. 
 - Experience implementing Employee Center Pro in a large, global enterprise. 
 - Experience with ServiceNow Knowledge Management, Content Experiences, Curated Experiences, taxonomy, audience targeting, AI Search, and analytics. 
 - Experience with Virtual Agent, Now Assist, generative AI, enterprise search, or conversational employee experiences. 
 - Experience integrating ServiceNow with Workday, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Viva Engage, content platforms, or digital asset management solutions. 
 - Experience with ServiceNow mobile capabilities, WCAG accessibility standards, multilingual experiences, and dynamic translation. 
 - Experience transitioning delivery from a systems integrator to an internal product engineering and operating model. 
 - Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams supporting enterprise portals, intranets, digital workplaces, or employee experience platforms. 

Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging

Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

These Winning Combinations accelerate time to market for automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT applications, enabling billions of connected, intelligent devices that enhance the way people work and live. We are the teams responsible for ensuring users can seamlessly interact with their work from any endpoint, anywhere in the world. 

  

Our organization is composed of engineers who thrive at the intersection of deep client-side platform engineering and massive-scale distributed systems. The work we do secures millions of enterprise endpoints globally, prevents modern identity attacks, and fundamentally changes how people work by making world-class security completely invisible to the end user.

Join Ingram Micro as a Sr. Principal Engineer and shape the future of global technology platforms by leading full-stack development initiatives using Microsoft technologies and Azure Cloud. Your expertise in production system stabilization, self-serve platforms, and ITAD will help us deliver reliable, innovative solutions that empower our partners worldwide.

data.description:
Why Choose TD SYNNEX

As a Fortune 500 global technology distributor operating in over 100 countries, TD SYNNEX connects the world's leading technology vendors with thousands of partners and customers. With over 22, 000 employees globally, we support complex digital platforms that power critical business operations every day. 

The Site Operations team plays a key role in ensuring platform stability, reliability, and continuous improvement across our Digital Business landscape. This role offers the opportunity to work close to production systems, influence operational standards, and have real impact on service quality across the organization. 

About The Role

As a SiteOps Engineer, you will be responsible for managing and resolving incidents and bugs across TD SYNNEX digital platforms. You'll combine hands-on technical skills with strong incident and stakeholder management, ensuring issues are triaged, investigated, communicated and resolved, with the underlying aim to prevent a re-occurance. 

You'll work closely with Engineering, DevOps, Security, QA, and Business teams, acting as a key operational representative within the Digital Business unit. This role can be based anywhere in Europe or APJ (subject to local hiring entity). 

What You'll Do

- Lead and manage incidents, ensuring correct triage, prioritization, investigation and resolution within SLAs
 - Perform root-cause analysis and collaborate with architects and developers on technical solutions for bugs
 - Ensure P1-P4 incidents are tracked, managed, and resolved within agreed SLAs
 - Identify recurring issues and platform trends to reduce incident volume and improve reliability
 - Act as change lead for bug fixes and operational improvements
 - Maintain high-quality incident and backlog management, ensuring accurate reporting and data hygiene
 - Mentor and support other SiteOps team members
 - Build strong working relationships with Security, DevOps, QA, Development, UX, Architecture, and Business teams
 - Continuously develop expertise in TD SYNNEX web solutions and operational processes
 - Support the in-house SiteOps development team with technical debt tasks to ensure a bug free platform

What We're Looking For

- 3+ years' experience developing or supporting web solutions using C# . NET
 - Solid understanding of incident and change management (ITIL v4 exposure is a plus)
 - Strong knowledge of C# (. NET Framework), ASP. NET MVC, and REST APIs
 - Experience using observability tools (e. g. Dynatrace, New Relic, Prometheus)
 - Experience with log analysis tools (e. g. Datadog, Graylog, Log Analytics, AppInsights)
 - Experience working in Agile / Scrum environments
 - Proven ability to lead incidents through to resolution
 - Comfortable working across distributed, multicultural teams
 - Fluent in English (written and spoken)

Nice to Have

- Strong stakeholder-facing experience in operational or customer-impacting roles
 - Experience governing and reporting on SLAs
 - Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
 - Relevant certifications in ITIL, cloud platforms, or observability tools

What We Offer

We provide competitive compensation with annual salary reviews. 

We value continuous learning and provide a clear progression plan. 

Hybrid work (3 days at the office per week)

We provide comprehensive benefits including, paid leave, retirement plans, and more. 

Key Skills

Ability to Coordinate, Bug Fix, Collaborating, Communication, Compuware dynaTrace, C Sharp (Programming Language), Deadline Management, Kubernetes, Operations Improvement, Teamwork

At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact. 

What's In It For You?

- Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle. 
 - Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses. 
 - Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program. 
 - Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities. 
 - Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program. 
 - Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives. 

Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway. 

At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

data.title: Lead Product Engineer
data.description:
Location: Bengaluru, India

Work Model: Hybrid

We're looking for a Lead Product Engineer to anchor our engineering team - someone who works across the full stack, owns the quality, performance, and reliability of the systems they build, and raises the bar for the engineers around them. We practice product-engineering-driven development: engineers work directly from customer problems to shippable prototypes, using modern AI tooling to move fast and iterate in the open. As a lead, you set the standard for how that is done well - shipping product yourself, defining how we validate and operate what we ship, and mentoring engineers as the team grows. 

Responsibilities

Product Engineering & AI-Driven Development

- Take ambiguous customer problems from discovery to production: partner directly with product and design, prototype quickly, validate with real users, and iterate to a shippable solution without waiting on fully specified requirements
 - Use AI coding tools (e. g. , Cursor, Claude Code) as a daily accelerant, and set the standard for using them responsibly - AI-generated code is reviewed, tested, and validated with the same rigor as hand-written code
 - Define and evolve the team's practices for AI-assisted development: prompting patterns, review gates, guardrails, and the metrics that show where the tooling actually helps
 - Own technical design and trade-off decisions for your area; balance product requirements against maintainability, release risk, and operational readiness

Full Stack

- Design, build, and ship features across the frontend and backend of our product, and own them through release and into production
 - Lead API design and data modeling decisions; write clean, well-tested code and hold the team to the same standard through code review
 - Identify cross-system dependencies early and drive solutions that work across services, teams, and environments
 - Debug and resolve issues surfaced by users or monitoring, and fix the class of problem rather than the single instance

Quality & Performance Engineering

- Own the quality strategy for your area: automated E2E, API, regression, and post-deployment validation integrated into CI/CD so releases ship on evidence, not manual sign-off
 - Plan and run load, performance, and soak testing ahead of peak-traffic periods; define load profiles from production telemetry, find and close bottlenecks before they become incidents, and sign off on environment readiness
 - Drive measurable efficiency gains - shorter regression cycles, fewer rollbacks, higher automated coverage of critical flows - and report on them

SRE & Production Operations

- Own system health for your services: define SLOs, set up and tune alerting, build the dashboards and runbooks on-call actually uses, and participate in the on-call rotation
 - Lead incident response and blameless postmortems; drive root-cause fixes and the follow-through that keeps them from recurring
 - Improve deployment pipelines, observability tooling, and infrastructure-as-code; contribute to Kubernetes/cloud migrations and infrastructure cost optimization
 - Identify reliability, performance, and scalability gaps proactively and get them on the roadmap with a clear business case

Technical Leadership

- Mentor and grow engineers across product, quality automation, and SRE practices; raise the team's bar through review, pairing, and example
 - Align Product, UX, Engineering, SRE, and Customer teams on scope, release activities, and cross-functional dependencies
 - Coordinate third-party engagements where needed (e. g. , penetration testing, static analysis), including scoping and remediation tracking

Qualifications

- 8+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on ownership of production systems and at least 2 years leading technical direction for a team or area
 - Strong proficiency in at least one modern backend language (e. g. , Java, Python, Go) and a modern frontend stack (e. g. , React/TypeScript); comfortable shipping across both
 - Proven track record building test automation frameworks (e. g. , Playwright, Selenium, Postman/Newman) and running performance/load testing programs for high-traffic systems
 - Production Kubernetes experience (EKS/GKE or similar), CI/CD ownership (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or similar), and cloud infrastructure on AWS/GCP/Azure
 - Daily, disciplined use of AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) with strong judgment about when to trust vs. verify output - and the ability to teach that judgment to others
 - Experience with monitoring/observability tooling (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, or similar), incident response, and postmortems
 - Strong bias toward prototyping and iteration, clear written and verbal communication, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
 - BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

- Experience preparing systems for seasonal or event-driven peak traffic (e. g. , 5-10X baseline) with zero-incident outcomes
 - Infrastructure cost-optimization or cloud-migration experience with measurable savings
 - Release engineering ownership: release cadence, deployment validation, rollback strategy
 - Security engineering exposure - coordinating pen tests, SAST/DAST, and remediation
 - Experience working across distributed US/India teams

We are the world's leader in timely, trusted, and actionable data using enhanced optical spectroscopy. Title: IoT Software Developer - Device Engineering Team-Husky(India) Guindy, Chennai

Id: 20963

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

IoT Software Developer

Do you want to work on software applications that connect industrial machines, edge devices, and cloud platforms?

As an IoT Edge Software Developer within the Device Engineering Team (DET), you will contribute to the development, maintenance, and support of software running on edge devices that collect machine data, communicate securely with cloud platforms, and enable remote management at scale. You will work with Windows-based edge devices, cloud-connected applications, and device lifecycle management processes that support customers worldwide. 

This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys hands-on software development, troubleshooting complex device and connectivity issues, and working at the intersection of industrial systems, edge computing, and cloud technologies. 

If you want to build software where industrial IoT, edge computing, and cloud technologies converge, the Device Engineering Team is where it happens. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Implement software components and features based on provided designs, specifications, and guidance. 
 - Contribute to the development of reliable, maintainable, and secure code within the assigned scope. 
 - Apply agreed coding standards, patterns, and best practices in daily development work. 
 - Make basic technical decisions within assigned tasks, escalating questions or uncertainties when needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate assigned requirements and tasks into working software. 
 - Complete development work in alignment with sprint goals and delivery commitments. 
 - Contribute to task breakdowns and effort estimates for assigned work. 
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, or implementation issues to the team. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable code and contribute to unit and integration tests. 
 - Participate in code reviews, incorporating feedback and learning from peers. 
 - Ensure individual contributions meet Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) criteria. 
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality practices. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects and issues in development and production environments. 
 - Support corrective (bug fixes) and evolutive (enhancements) maintenance of existing solutions. 

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate effectively with other developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads. 
 - Seek feedback and guidance to continuously improve technical skills. 
 - Actively learn the systems, tools, and technologies used by the team. 
 - Contribute positively to team culture and shared ownership of outcomes. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
 - Proficiency in C# and the . NET platform
 - Working knowledge of Python or other scripting languages
 - Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 - Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, and CI/CD pipelines
 - Familiarity with DevSecOps concepts
 - Familiarity with device communication protocols such as MQTT, OPC-UA, or similar technologies
 - Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Assets

- Hands-on experience with IoT, industrial automation, edge computing, or device lifecycle management
 - Experience with Azure IoTHub, DPS, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, or Azure Data Explorer
 - Experience supporting Windows based machines
 - Familiarity with OTA software and firmware update mechanisms
 - Knowledge of cybersecurity and data privacy controls for IoT environments

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

You'll partner with Product, Architecture, Security, and Business stakeholders to translate business needs into sustainable technical solutions, mentor engineers and Tech Leads, guide architectural decisions, and help modernize platforms through cloud, AI, and automation initiatives. Lead IT QA Analyst

Job Summary

We are seeking a Lead IT QA Analyst to lead quality assurance efforts for enterprise technology initiatives, with a strong focus on the ServiceNow platform. In this role, you will own QA planning and execution across projects, releases, enhancements, platform upgrades, and test automation enablement to ensure solutions meet business requirements, user expectations, and quality standards before deployment. You will partner closely with business stakeholders, process analysts, developers, and delivery teams to develop test strategies, coordinate testing activities, automate repeatable test scenarios, manage defects, support UAT, and drive continuous improvement in testing practices. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented QA leader who can translate business needs into testable outcomes, communicate risks clearly, and help deliver reliable, scalable technology solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Planning

- Define and own the end-to-end QA strategy for ServiceNow projects, releases, and enhancements in collaboration with the Lead Business Process Analyst. 
 - Develop test plans, test cases, and test scripts aligned to business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Establish and maintain QA standards, templates, and best practices for the ServiceNow platform. 
 - Define the automation approach for repeatable regression, smoke, and high-risk business process test scenarios, including prioritization criteria and expected coverage. 

Test Execution & Defect Management

- Lead functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for ServiceNow modules (e. g. , ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SPM). 
 - Identify, document, and track defects through the full lifecycle using ServiceNow or designated defect-tracking tools. 
 - Prioritize and manage defect resolution in partnership with development and configuration teams. 
 - Execute performance, load, and smoke testing as required. 
 - Build, execute, and maintain automated test scripts for critical workflows to reduce manual testing effort and improve release confidence. 

ServiceNow Platform QA

- Validate workflows, business rules, UI policies, notifications, and integrations configured in ServiceNow. 
 - Ensure data integrity and accuracy across ServiceNow tables and integrations with upstream/downstream systems. 
 - Review and test configuration changes, updates, and platform upgrades including ServiceNow version upgrades and patches. 

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

- Partner with the Lead Business Process Analyst to translate process requirements into testable acceptance criteria. 
 - Facilitate UAT sessions with business stakeholders; provide coaching and support to business testers. 
 - Communicate QA status, risks, and defect metrics to project teams and leadership in a clear and timely manner. 

Continuous Improvement

- Drive adoption of automated testing tools and frameworks within the ServiceNow environment. 
 - Actively expand automated test coverage across ServiceNow workflows, integrations, and regression suites using approved automation tools and frameworks. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and cycle time. 
 - Maintain QA documentation and contribute to a shared knowledge base. 

Mentorship & Leadership

- Provide guidance and mentorship to junior QA analysts and business testers. 
 - Serve as a QA subject matter expert for ServiceNow-related initiatives. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). 
 - 10+ years of QA/testing experience in enterprise IT environments. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience testing on the ServiceNow platform. 
 - Strong understanding of ServiceNow modules (ITSM required; HRSD, CSM, or ITOM a plus). 
 - Proficiency in writing test plans, test cases, and defect reports. 
 - Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies. 
 - Demonstrated experience creating, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts as part of enterprise QA delivery. 
 - Experience planning and executing system performance testing, including load, volume, scalability, and response-time validation for enterprise applications. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or equivalent ServiceNow certification. 
 - ISTQB or similar QA certification. 
 - Experience with automated testing tools (e. g. , ATF - Automated Test Framework within ServiceNow). 
 - Experience using performance testing or monitoring tools to analyze system behavior, identify bottlenecks, and validate readiness for production release. 
 - Familiarity with integration testing (REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server). 
 - Experience supporting large-scale ServiceNow implementations or platform upgrades. 

Competencies

- Attention to Detail
 - Collaboration and Stakeholder Communication
 - Accountability and Initiative
 - Critical Thinking and Root-Cause Analysis
 - Adaptability and ability to manage competing priorities
 - Continuous Improvement Mindset

Working Conditions

- Hybrid or remote-eligible per department guidelines. 
 - Occasional off-hours testing may be required during major releases or platform upgrades. 

Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging

Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. data.title: USB Lead Engineer
data.description:
USB Lead Engineer - Linux Enablement & AVV (Pre/Post-Silicon) - RISC‐V MPU Platform

Location: Pune / Bangalore, India

Own USB enablement on Linux - driver bring-up, compliance, and AVV from FPGA to first silicon. 

About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries make possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www. gf. com. 

About The Role

We're building a next-generation, application-class RISC‐V MPU SoC platform for Linux systems - bringing together multimedia, industrial connectivity, security, and high-speed I/O. 

In the Platform Software team, you will be the technical owner for USB across the stack: boot-to-user-space enablement, kernel/driver integration, and automated validation (AVV) on virtual platforms/FPGA and first silicon. You'll partner closely with architects and hardware teams to de-risk the USB subsystem, drive bring-up readiness and deliver a production-quality SDK experience. 

Key Responsibilities

- USB Linux enablement & integration: enable and maintain USB host/device/dual-role functionality on a 64-bit RISC‐V MPU Linux platform. 
 - Bring up USB controllers (e. g. , xHCI/EHCI for host, UDC for device/gadget), PHY integration, clocks/resets, and interrupts. 
 - Drive kernel/BSP enablement: Device Tree bindings, power management (runtime/PM QoS), suspend/resume, and performance tuning. 
 - Develop/debug USB drivers and related subsystems: USB core interactions, hub behavior, gadget framework, and class drivers as needed. 
 - Enable and validate user-space workflows: enumeration, throughput/latency, storage/networking classes, and reliability over hot-plug scenarios. 
 - Deliver USB-ready SDK releases: integration, regression validation, and developer-facing documentation/debug guides. 
 - AVV & silicon validation (pre/post-silicon): create test plans and automation to validate USB functionality, performance, and compliance on FPGA/emulation and first silicon. 
 - Contribute to shift-left validation using virtual platforms/emulation/FPGA; build reusable USB validation apps/tests to exercise data paths and corner cases. 
 - Debug and root-cause USB issues across HW/FW/kernel using logs, traces, and lab equipment (e. g. , JTAG, logic/protocol analyzers); drive fixes to closure. 
 - Cross-functional ownership: partner with architects, RTL/PHY, board, and platform teams to define requirements, de-risk schedules, and land USB features. 
 - Own USB feature planning: role/port matrix, power & charging considerations, compliance goals, and bring-up milestones. 
 - Provide bring-up and validation feedback that influences USB architecture decisions (controller/PHY selection, debug hooks, observability, testability). 
 - Align with internal and external stakeholders on deliverables, bug triage, and release readiness for USB enablement. 
 - Customer & ecosystem engagement: support early adopters and upstream fixes when appropriate (kernel, Device Tree, test collateral). 
 - Work with OEMs/Tier‐1s during bring-up and USB interoperability; contribute patches upstream when it improves maintainability. 
Required Qualifications

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Strong experience with minimum 8-15 years in Embedded Linux platform/BSP and device-driver development. 
 - Expert-level C programming; comfortable reading and modifying kernel, driver, and low-level firmware code. 
 - Strong Linux internals knowledge: boot flow, memory/interrupt subsystems, concurrency, and performance debugging. 
 - Hands-on SoC/platform bring-up experience, including high-speed I/O enablement and ownership mindset for subsystem quality. 
 - Hands-on with U‐Boot, Linux kernel, Device Tree, and Yocto/OpenEmbedded; experience integrating and validating USB in BSP/SDK releases. 
 - Strong debugging skills with GDB and at least one OpenOCD/JTAG, Lauterbach, or similar tools; able to debug complex HW/SW interactions. 
 - Experience working on FPGA, emulation, or early-silicon platforms for bring-up/validation. 

Good to Have

- Deep USB knowledge (USB2/USB3) and familiarity with Linux USB architecture (usbcore, HCD, gadget framework). 
 - Experience with USB compliance/interoperability testing and post-silicon triage (throughput, link stability, suspend/resume, hot-plug). 
 - Exposure to USB Type‐C/PD, retimers, and/or Alt Modes (e. g. , DisplayPort) is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with platform security boundaries relevant to USB (secure boot, firmware/OS boundaries, attack surface considerations). 
 - Experience with QEMU, virtual platforms, or emulation workflows used for early driver/test development. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD and automated validation (Python/shell test frameworks, dashboards, regressions) for continuous USB quality. 

What We Offer
