data.title: Lead Solution Architect – Digital Solutions
data.description:
Position Summary

Ecolab Digital develops connected, data-driven and AI-enabled solutions that improve customer operations, quality, compliance and decision-making. The Lead Solution Architect - Digital Solutions will provide hands-on, end-to-end architecture leadership for enterprise digital products and regulated operational workflows, working closely with Product, Engineering, Quality, Data & AI, shared-platform and enterprise technology teams. 

The role will initially focus on digital capabilities for regulated manufacturing and pharmaceutical operations, including electronic logbooks, guided/batch execution, cleaning validation and evidence workflows, together with AI-enabled inspection and edge/cloud solutions. The architect will independently drive bounded solution decisions from business intent through engineering-ready designs, within the portfolio architecture direction established by the Senior Director, Solution Architecture. The position remains part of a centrally managed Digital Solutions Architecture team. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own solution architecture for digital products and operational workflows, translating business, Product and intended-use requirements into implementable end-to-end designs. 
 - Architect modular digital workflow capabilities such as electronic logbooks, guided or batch execution, cleaning validation, exception handling, evidence capture, review and approval, with clear integration and data boundaries. 
 - Embed regulated-system needs into designs, including audit trails, electronic records/signatures where applicable, role-based access, data integrity, traceability, retention, controlled change and validation evidence; partner with Quality on control interpretation and acceptance. 
 - Define clean interfaces among enterprise digital platforms, shared identity/user services, domain applications, APIs/events, data services and operational systems; prioritize reuse and avoid duplicating enterprise capabilities. 
 - Partner closely with Engineering to establish architecture decision records, component boundaries, interface contracts, non-functional requirements, deployment patterns and engineering-ready solution guidance. 
 - Architect cloud-native and hybrid solutions spanning applications, event-driven integration, containerized services, data platforms and, where needed, customer-site edge processing with intermittent connectivity. 
 - Evaluate production AI/ML capabilities-including computer vision and inference-through clear service boundaries, model lifecycle, human review, decision traceability, monitoring and integration into trusted operational workflows. 
 - For edge-enabled use cases, define connectivity, local buffering/offline behavior, remote deployment and update, rollback, security, observability and recovery responsibilities across edge and cloud. 
 - Work with Product, Quality, Engineering and business stakeholders to distinguish product requirements, architecture decisions, validation responsibilities and delivery ownership. 
 - Assess build/reuse/buy and partner proposals; validate architecture assumptions, technical feasibility, delivery dependencies and alignment to Ecolab enterprise patterns without ceding architecture decision rights. 
 - Guide solution implementation and technical validation, surface architecture risks early, and support design decisions through release readiness and operational handover without taking on project management accountability. 
 - Contribute reusable patterns, reference designs and architecture decisions to the broader Digital Solutions portfolio; communicate trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders and globally distributed teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline. 
 - 15+ years of progressive technology experience, including at least 5 years in solution/technical architecture or comparable technical leadership roles. 
 - Demonstrated ability to independently architect complex enterprise digital solutions across application, integration, data, cloud and platform boundaries, and translate designs into executable engineering direction. 
 - Experience with regulated manufacturing, pharmaceutical, quality-controlled or similarly governed operational environments; practical understanding of GxP/GMP-style controls, auditability, traceability, data integrity and controlled change. 
 - Experience designing enterprise workflow or transactional applications with role-based access, review/approval, exception handling, evidence capture and integration to operational systems. 
 - Strong cloud and distributed-systems architecture experience, including APIs/microservices, event-driven patterns, secure integration, data services, containerized workloads and resilient application design. 
 - Ability to design security, identity/authorization, data protection, availability, scalability, observability, supportability and disaster-recovery requirements into production solutions. 
 - Practical understanding of production AI/ML integration, including model/service boundaries, data governance, monitoring, quality controls and human accountability; not necessarily hands-on model development. 
 - Ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Quality, Data & AI, cybersecurity, infrastructure, enterprise-platform teams and external technology partners. 
 - Strong architecture judgment: can make bounded day-to-day solution decisions independently and escalate cross-platform, enterprise or material regulatory decisions with clear options and trade-offs. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders in globally distributed teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology, medical devices, cleanrooms or other regulated production environments. 
 - Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+ principles, computer system validation/assurance and associated evidence expectations. 
 - Architecture experience with electronic logbooks, electronic batch records/execution, cleaning validation, eQMS, MES, LIMS or related digital manufacturing/quality systems. 
 - Hybrid edge/cloud and connected-site architecture, including camera/video systems, GPU inference, offline operation, remote fleet management or secure edge deployment. 
 - Experience with computer vision, AI-assisted inspection, MLOps/model lifecycle, human-in-the-loop workflows or AI governance in production. 
 - Experience with Azure, AWS, Databricks or equivalent enterprise cloud/data platforms, with a platform-agnostic architecture mindset. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy systems and defining reusable enterprise platform/service boundaries during phased coexistence and migration. 
 - Experience reviewing vendor-led solution proposals, technical proofs of concept, deployment readiness and integration/validation dependencies. 

Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging

Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

data.title: Sr Software Engineer,  Now
data.description:
Description

Amazon is building India's Quick Commerce offering - Amazon Now - delivering everyday essentials to customers in minutes. We build world-class technology that powers store launches at scale, curates hyper-local selection, and drives seamless operations across our network. We are looking for a seasoned Software Development Engineer to serve as the senior technical leader for the team, owning the architecture and engineering direction across all of our charters - with a primary focus on the Selection experience: how we curate, manage, and scale the right assortment for every customer, in every city. This is a high-impact role where your technical decisions directly fuel Amazon Now's expansion across India. You will set the technical bar for the team, drive the hardest design problems end-to-end, and multiply the impact of every engineer around you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Own the technical strategy and architecture for Selection - curating city-specific assortments, managing per-store catalogs, and simplifying the experience of listing and onboarding new items at scale
 - Provide senior technical oversight across all of the team's charters - store launches, catalog and selection, inventory, picking, staging, and store operations - ensuring architectural coherence across them
 - Architect systems that onboard new stores rapidly across cities, and that scale reliably to hundreds of stores while maintaining low operational latencies
 - Lead the hardest design decisions end-to-end: evaluate trade-offs, simplify complexity, and set patterns the rest of the team builds on
 - Mentor and coach engineers, raise the technical bar, and drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team
 - Partner closely with product, operations, and business teams to translate ambiguous, complex business problems into durable technical solutions
 - Champion operational excellence (CI/CD, monitoring, on-call), lead design reviews, and own a high quality bar for all deliverables

A day in the life

You'll review operational metrics to ensure system health across live stores, unblock engineers on their toughest technical challenges, and dive deep into system designs - weighing trade-offs and cutting complexity. You'll lead design reviews across the team's charters, mentor engineers on architecture patterns, and shape deployment plans for features rolling out across multiple cities, ensuring rollback strategies, monitoring, and alarms are in place before launch. As a senior, you'll help set technical direction and priorities, with Selection as your primary canvas. 

About The Team

Amazon Now builds the technology behind India's Quick Commerce experience - from the moment a store goes live, to how selection is curated for each neighborhood, to how every order is picked and staged for delivery in minutes. We work at the intersection of technology and physical retail, solving hard problems in real-time inventory, catalog and selection management, store automation, and partner enablement. Our work reaches millions of customers who count on us for everyday essentials, fast. 

This role is the senior technical anchor of the team, setting architectural direction across every charter we own - with Selection as the primary focus. It's a rare scope: deep ownership of one of our most important problem spaces, combined with technical influence across the whole team. 

We embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have employee-led affinity groups reaching thousands of employees globally. We are dedicated to supporting new members through mentorship and knowledge sharing, and we strive to assign opportunities that help each team member develop into a well-rounded contributor. 

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
 - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The Manager, Service Enablement, is a first-line people leader responsible for analysts across four individual-contributor levels, from developing analysts through lead professionals. The role translates business priorities into clear team objectives, assigns and reviews work based on complexity and risk, develops talent, and ensures services are accurate, timely, compliant, controlled, scalable, and reliable. This manager combines people leadership with functional knowledge of billing operations, business systems, access controls, customer communications, operational controls, validation, and issue resolution. The SAP BTP Integration Architect owns the architecture, engineering standards, and technical governance for integrations across Pall's global SAP and non-SAP landscape. The role leads secure, scalable integration design on SAP Business Technology Platform, with particular focus on SAP S/4HANA, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, business applications, external partners, and government e-invoicing platforms. 

This position reports to the IT Director, Enterprise Applications and is part of the global Information Technology team. The role is based in India, and will operate in a onsite work model, subject to local site requirements. 

In this role you will have the opportunity to

- Define and maintain the enterprise integration strategy and architecture, including standards, principles, reusable patterns, and governance using SAP Integration Suite and SAP best practices. 
 - Lead end-to-end integration architecture and solution design across SAP Integration Suite capabilities, selecting the appropriate API, event-driven, synchronous, asynchronous, batch, file, and B2B/EDI approaches based on business needs. 
 - Architect secure integrations across the SAP and enterprise technology landscape, including SAP S/4HANA, DRC, Ariba, BTP solutions, third-party applications, suppliers, customers, and government platforms. 
 - Establish integration, API, event, and security governance, including identity and access, authentication, authorization, encryption, versioning, lifecycle management, reuse, privacy, and segregation of duties. 
 - Enable AI-assisted and emerging technology solutions, including Joule and Joule Studio, by providing secure APIs, events, business context, appropriate controls, observability, and human oversight.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes. 

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises. 

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself. 

We are seeking a highly accomplished Lead Python Development Engineer to spearhead the technical execution and architectural evolution of our web applications and backend services. You will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of complex features, ensuring that our systems remain scalable, performant, and resilient. You will serve as the primary technical authority for our backend stack, working in close coordination with Product Management and Front-end Engineering teams to deliver mission-critical solutions. 

Core Responsibilities

1. Technical Execution and Architectural Oversight

- Feature Ownership: Lead the full lifecycle of feature development, from conceptual technical design and schema definition to deployment and production monitoring. 
 - Backend Development: Engineer high-performance, secure, and maintainable services using Python and modern frameworks (e. g. , FastAPI, Django, or Flask). 
 - Data Strategy: Architect and optimize complex relational schemas within PostgreSQL and manage large-scale analytical workloads using StarRocks. 
 - Database Governance: Oversee systematic database versioning and seamless schema evolution utilizing Alembic migrations. 

2. Collaboration and Integration

- Cross-Functional Synergy: Act as the primary technical liaison to the Product Team, translating business requirements into robust technical specifications and providing rigorous effort estimations. 
 - Front-end Alignment: Partner closely with frontend development teams to design and implement optimized API contracts, ensuring a high-performance user experience. 
 - Technical Communication: Articulate complex architectural decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders with clarity and precision.

- Quality Assurance: Establish and enforce rigorous engineering standards through comprehensive code reviews, automated testing frameworks, and continuous integration protocols. 
 - Team Development: Foster a culture of technical excellence by mentoring engineering staff, promoting professional growth, and facilitating knowledge-sharing sessions. 
 - Performance Optimization: Continuously identify and resolve bottlenecks in application logic, database queries, and infrastructure configurations.

- Professional Experience: A minimum of 8+ years in software engineering, with a proven track record of leading technical execution in a Senior or Lead capacity.

We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Payment Services
data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - 3, 000 Tideans globally
 - Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Team

The Accounts team is the platform layer behind how members open, manage, and understand their accounts at Tide. It owns account opening, regulatory compliance, account management, account switching (CASS), and the full transaction experience: the timeline at the centre of the app, transaction details and counterparty information, transaction history, statements, and exports. Every member who opens the app and looks at their balance or recent activity relies on this team. Tide is a global product used across regions, so the team works with different banking partners, regulatory regimes, and account structures, and it sits on top of Tide's core ledger. 

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will lead the Accounts team. You will set its technical direction, own its delivery and reliability, and grow its engineers across backend, mobile, and web. 

This is a product-facing platform team. A large share of the work shows up directly in the app, so you will work closely with product and design. It is also a financial system: a transaction that renders wrongly, a statement that does not reconcile, or an export that misses a record is a correctness problem, not a cosmetic one. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Leading the Accounts team across backend, Flutter mobile, and Angular web, setting its technical direction and holding it to delivery. 
 - Defining and maintaining the interface with the ledger: what the ledger guarantees, how Accounts services consume it, and who owns which data and schemas. 
 - Owning account opening, account management, and account switching (CASS), including the regulatory compliance that comes with them. 
 - Owning the member-facing transaction experience end to end: the timeline, transaction details, counterparty information, transaction history, statements, and exports. 
 - Setting technical direction for services that are read-heavy, data-rich, and tightly coupled to the app: performance, pagination and search at scale, data consistency with the ledger, and long-term architecture. 
 - Owning system stability and operational reliability for your services: SLOs, observability, on-call practice. 
 - Partnering with product, design, compliance, and operations to make sure what we ship is accurate, supportable, and compliant across all markets. 
 - Growing engineers at every level, across backend, mobile, and web. The team spans early-career through senior. 
 - Partnering with other teams at Tide that build on the Accounts platform, such as investment accounts and savings accounts, so the platform meets their needs. 
 - Aligning with other EMs across Banking on shared platform and infrastructure decisions. 

What We Are Looking For

Experience and background

- Meaningful engineering management experience. You have led teams through real delivery, not just been a strong tech lead. What matters is the quality of that experience, not the number of years
 - Experience leading product-driven teams. You have worked closely with product and design and been accountable for customer outcomes, not just output
 - A solid backend engineering foundation before moving into management, enough to earn credibility with the team and get into the detail when it matters
 - Experience leading distributed, remote-first teams across time zones
 - Proven experience aligning with senior leadership on deliveries and managing dependencies with neighbouring teams
 - Strong grasp of distributed systems: data consistency across services, reliability patterns, SLOs and SLAs, observability tooling

Technical depth

- Technically fluent: you can read the code, follow the architecture, and engage meaningfully with design decisions and production problems. You do not need to be shipping features regularly, but you need to understand what your team is building and why. 
 - Backend engineering in a strongly-typed language. Our stack is Java/Spring Boot, but Java experience is not a requirement. We want someone who can learn and work in our stack with confidence. 
 - Experience with microservices in a cloud-native environment (we are AWS heavy). 
 - Designing and operating APIs and data services that feed mobile and web clients: latency, pagination, caching, and backwards compatibility with released app versions. 
 - Relational database engineering, including data modelling and query performance for read-heavy workloads over large transaction histories. 
 - Event-driven and async systems experience. 
 - Familiarity with mobile and web delivery (Flutter and Angular, or similar), enough to make good trade-offs with client engineers. 
 - Exposure to agentic or AI-integrated systems, and engineering practises. 

How You Work

- You set technical direction and hold others to it. You are the person the team turns to when something is hard. 
 - You care about the member experience and about correctness in equal measure, and you do not let one erode the other. 
 - You are a good neighbour to other teams. You make interfaces explicit, agree expectations early, and treat partner teams across Banking as close collaborators. 
 - You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders (product, design, compliance, operations) without losing precision. 
 - You develop engineers at every level, with a plan for each person. 

Our Tech Stack

- Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!) 
 - Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable 
 - Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users) 
 - Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform 
 - DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
 - GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
 - Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
 - Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management

What You'll Get In Return

- Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

Tidean Ways of Working

At Tide, we're Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we're One Team. Our Working Out of Office (WOO) policy allows you to work from anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year. We are remote first, but when you do want to meet new people, collaborate with your team or simply hang out with your colleagues, our offices are always available and equipped to the highest standard. We offer flexible working hours and trust our employees to do their work well, at times that suit them and their team. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. 
 - All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. 
 - Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide. co email address. 
 - Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. 

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide. co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy. 

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Who We Are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation. 

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30, 000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability. 

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. 

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking an experienced integration professional with 7-10 years of experience to lead the setup, operational readiness and end-to-end technical delivery of Apache Kafka and AWS/Amazon MSK platforms. The role combines hands-on expertise across Kafka, Java, Spring Boot and integration technologies with technical leadership, production support, stakeholder management and engineering mentorship. Experience with TIBCO BusinessWorks (BW) would be advantageous. 

What You'll Do

- Lead Apache Kafka and Amazon MSK platform setup and operational readiness 
 - Define and implement networking, IAM, encryption and monitoring requirements for reliable Kafka environments 
 - Establish deployment automation and recovery planning for the platform 
 - Own end-to-end technical delivery, from design and development through testing and production release 
 - Conduct design and code reviews to maintain engineering quality 
 - Provide support for critical production issues and contribute to service recovery 
 - Apply Java, Spring Boot and integration expertise to solution design and implementation 
 - Mentor engineers and encourage effective engineering practices 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to maintain alignment on technical delivery and priorities 
 - Identify and manage technical and delivery risks 
 - Ensure timely and high-quality delivery throughout the development and release lifecycle

Who You Are

- You have 7-10 years of integration experience 
 - You have strong hands-on expertise in Apache Kafka 
 - You have experience setting up and operating AWS/Amazon MSK environments 
 - You understand networking, AWS IAM, encryption and monitoring within Kafka/MSK environments 
 - You have experience with deployment automation and recovery planning 
 - You have strong development expertise in Java and Spring Boot 
 - You have experience with integration technologies and patterns 
 - You can lead design and code reviews, testing, releases and critical production support 
 - You can mentor engineers and collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders 
 - You can identify and manage delivery and technical risks 
 - TIBCO BusinessWorks (BW) experience would be advantageous

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

- Opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of technically complex Apache Kafka and Amazon MSK platform delivery 
 - Exposure to cloud-based integration, automation, security, monitoring and recovery practices 
 - Opportunity to combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership and mentorship 
 - Experience working closely with technical and business stakeholders across delivery and production environments

What Skills You Will Learn

- Broader expertise in operating Amazon MSK and Apache Kafka environments at scale 
 - Enhanced knowledge of AWS networking, IAM, encryption and monitoring in an event-streaming environment 
 - Advanced deployment automation and recovery-planning practices 
 - Greater experience in technical leadership, stakeholder alignment, risk management and production support

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background. 

Join Us

At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this. 

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together. 

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference. 

Alert

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud. 

#JDEnhancedByTARA

Follow us on social media

- LinkedIn: https: //www. linkedin. com/company/vois/
 - Facebook: https: //www. facebook. com/voisglobal
 - Instagram: https: //www. instagram. com/voisglobal/

 - You are a good neighbor to other teams. You make interfaces explicit, agree expectations early, and treat partner teams across Banking as close collaborators. 
 - You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders (product, design, compliance, operations) without losing precision. 
 - You develop engineers at every level, with a plan for each person. 

Our Tech Stack

- Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!) 
 - Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable 
 - Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users) 
 - Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform 
 - DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
 - GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
 - Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
 - Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management

What You'll Get In Return

- Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

Tidean Ways of Working

At Tide, we're Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we're One Team. Our Working Out of Office (WOO) policy allows you to work from anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year. We are remote first, but when you do want to meet new people, collaborate with your team or simply hang out with your colleagues, our offices are always available and equipped to the highest standard. We offer flexible working hours and trust our employees to do their work well, at times that suit them and their team. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard.

data.title: Principal AI Engineer
data.description:
Company: TechGrove By Banyan Software

Website: Visit Website

LinkedIn: Visit LinkedIn

Business Type: Small/Medium Business

Company Type: Product

Business Model: B2B

Funding Stage: Private Equity

Industry: Information Technology

Job Description

Principal AI Engineer

TechGrove AI Engineering Pod

You build the intelligent features that make software feel like magic, and you make them work in production. You are equally at home shipping a clean API, standing up a RAG pipeline, evaluating an agent, or tuning guardrails so an LLM behaves safely at scale. You are excited by the current moment in AI and pragmatic about where it actually adds value. 

As Principal AI Engineer, you design and build the AI capabilities that differentiate an OpCo's modernized applications: GenAI features, agentic workflows, and ML-powered functionality, integrated safely and reliably. You work side by side with the Technical Lead / Architect, contribute as a strong full-stack engineer, and help the whole pod raise its game in AI-native development. 

If you want to turn the frontier of applied AI into shipped, dependable product features, this role is for you. 

About The Pod

A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan's AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match. 

A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan's India-based TechGrove. 

What You Will Do

- Ship production AI/ML features: Design, build, and deploy GenAI integrations, agentic workflows, RAG and GraphRAG systems, and ML-powered functionality into the OpCo's modernized applications. 
 - Orchestrate and integrate LLMs: Implement LLM orchestration, prompt and context engineering, guardrails, and evaluation to deliver reliable, safe, production-grade AI. 
 - Engineer cloud-native services: Build scalable, secure, resilient services that host and serve AI capabilities, as a strong hands-on contributor. 
 - Build agents and tooling: Develop AI agents and tooling, including building and connecting MCP servers and tools, and champion agentic development practices across the pod's SDLC. 
 - Own data and retrieval: Design the data, retrieval, and vector or knowledge-graph infrastructure that powers GenAI features, with quality, performance, and security built in. 
 - Own technical design and quality: Lead design and implementation for AI features, write clean, well-tested code, and uphold engineering standards, security, and observability. 
 - Collaborate and mentor: Partner with the Architect and senior engineers, and coach the team on AI/ML engineering best practices. 
 - Apply pragmatic judgment: Know where AI adds real value versus risk, and navigate a fast-moving landscape with a clear head. 

What You Bring

- Experience: 8+ years in software engineering, with significant hands-on experience implementing ML/AI features in production. 
 - Production experience on AWS or Azure (required): You have designed and built cloud-native applications on AWS or Azure, including containers, serverless, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform). Experience limited to GCP alone does not meet this requirement, although GCP in addition to AWS or Azure is a plus. 
 - Applied AI/ML: Demonstrated experience implementing GenAI capabilities (RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, prompt and context engineering, guardrail design) and/or ML features in production systems. 
 - Agentic and GenAI frameworks: Hands-on experience with GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), multi-agent frameworks (crewAI, AutoGen, or similar), and developing AI agents and MCP servers and tools. 
 - Software engineering depth: Strong full-stack ability with solid SQL/No-SQL and API design skills. 
 - Modern tech stacks: Hands-on production experience with at least two of: . NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java. 
 - AI-native tooling: Fluency with AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a daily, core part of your workflow. 
 - Engineering principles: Solid grounding in DDD, design patterns, clean code, test-driven development, and application security. 
 - DevSecOps: Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and cloud-native observability. 
 - Collaboration: Strong communication and an ownership mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to Have

- Deep LLM and vector database expertise: hybrid vector databases, knowledge graphs, and advanced prompt and guardrail design for enterprise AI safety. 
 - Experience fine-tuning or evaluating models, building eval harnesses, or implementing LLM observability. 
 - Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS at scale. 
 - Prior experience modernizing or re-platforming enterprise or B2B applications. 

What Success Looks Like

- First 90 days: You have shipped your first production AI feature, established reliable patterns for orchestration, retrieval, and evaluation, and the pod has a clear, safe approach to building with LLMs. 
 - First 6 months: AI capabilities are a dependable, differentiating part of the product, with measured quality and guardrails, and the team is meaningfully more capable in applied AI because of your mentorship. 

Why TechGrove, Why Banyan

- Permanent home, long-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip. 
 - Real ownership: You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the "what"; the pod owns the "how. "
 - AI-native by default: You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build. 
 - Variety with stability: Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you. 
 - Growth and excellence: A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time. 

Should You Apply?

We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that. 

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes.

Job Summary

As a Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize the software and systems that power OCI AI compute infrastructure, including the GPU control plane and GPU data plane. You will work with engineering, operations, and product teams to solve infrastructure problems, improve workload performance, and deliver a reliable customer experience.

- Design and develop scalable infrastructure services and features for the GPU control plane, GPU data plane, and bare metal systems supporting customer AI workloads.

 - Collaborate with development, operations, and product management teams to translate requirements into practical infrastructure and orchestration solutions. 
 - Define benchmarks and automate performance and reliability measurements across customer workloads and the underlying infrastructure stack.

 - 5+ years of software development experience using one or more languages such as Java, Go, C, C++, C#, or Rust.

 - At least 1 year of experience providing technical leadership and bringing clarity to cross-functional projects while collaborating with stakeholders. 
 - Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals, including system design, distributed systems concepts, and systematic troubleshooting across software and infrastructure. 
 - Clear communication, ownership of outcomes, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 - Experience developing software for bare metal systems or cloud infrastructure, providing a relevant foundation for GPU infrastructure work. 
 - Cloud native engineering experience, including Docker, Kubernetes, or related containerization and orchestration technologies.

Manager - Integration Solutioning & Technical Leadership (US Shift)

Department: Integrations

Reports To: Senior Manager / Director

Location: Hyderabad (Hybrid) - working with clients primarily in North America

Shift: US Shift (aligned to US business hours, 3: 00 PM - 12: 00 AM IST)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6-10 years

Team Size Managed: 2-4 Technical Consultants (US-shift and cross-region)

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Manager to lead Integrations for a portfolio of US-based clients, working in the US shift. You will lead and grow a team of Technical Consultants responsible for integration solutioning and development - owning technical direction, guiding solution design, and ensuring high-quality delivery of new and enhanced integration interfaces. You will be the primary integrations point of contact for client leadership during US business hours, drive periodic leadership connects through demos and meetups, and step in hands-on to help the team solve complex issues on integration interfaces when needed. Our team already uses AI for solutioning and writing code - as a quick learner, you will deepen and scale this practice across the team. 

Key Responsibilities

- 1. Lead and manage a team of 2-4 Technical Consultants - set priorities, plan capacity, run performance reviews, hire and develop talent, mentor on solutioning, and drive accountability for integration outcomes. 
 - 2. Own integration solutioning end to end - translate client requirements and change requests into robust designs (APIs, file-based flows, middleware patterns) and guide the team through build and delivery. 
 - 3. Lead and review the solutioning work done by Technical Consultants - ensure code quality, reusability, maintainability, and alignment with platform and integration standards. 
 - 4. Act as the technical lead for key integration engagements - drive architecture decisions, design reviews, and complex solutioning discussions with clients and internal stakeholders. 
 - 5. Drive client leadership connects with US clients through demos and meetups, in their time zone - showcase integration capabilities, walk through solution approaches, align on roadmap priorities, and strengthen executive-level confidence in delivery. 
 - 6. Own escalations and production issues on integration interfaces during US hours - debug failures, unblock consultants on complex interface problems, restore stable data flows, and communicate status to client stakeholders. 
 - 7. Stay hands-on with Python and integration tooling to review, guide, and when required , contribute to builds and troubleshooting on integration interfaces. 
 - 8. Build on the team's existing use of AI for solutioning and writing code - as a quick learner, strengthen AI-assisted design, coding, review, and documentation practices so the team delivers faster with consistent quality. 
 - 9. Partner with India-based Product/Engineering teams on platform capabilities, ensuring clean handoffs across time zones on integration patterns and enhancements needed for scalable client solutions. 
 - 10. Build and maintain solutioning standards, reusable patterns, and technical documentation so the team can deliver consistently as engagement volume grows. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 6-10 years of experience in technical consulting, integration solutioning/development, or similar roles within HRTech/SaaS or enterprise software. 
 - Proven experience managing Technical Consultants or similar delivery teams (3+ years in a people-management role) - including hiring, performance management, quality oversight, and owning delivery outcomes. 
 - Strong hands-on programming ability in Python - comfortable writing, reading, reviewing, and debugging integration code. 
 - Solid expertise in system integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, file-based integrations, middleware) with the ability to design and solution complex integration landscapes. 
 - Demonstrated ability to help teams diagnose and resolve issues on integration interfaces in production environments. 
 - Experience engaging client leadership through demos, technical meetups, and executive-facing solution discussions. 
 - Experience working with US/North American clients, and willingness to work the US shift on a sustained basis. 
 - A quick learner who already uses AI tools for solutioning and writing code (e. g. , LLM-based assistants, coding copilots) and can strengthen this practice across a delivery team. 
 - Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills - able to explain technical designs clearly and lead solution discussions with both technical and leadership audiences. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance leadership responsibilities and hands-on technical contribution. 

Good to Have

- JavaScript experience - a plus for integration builds, scripting, and related client-side or middleware work. 
 - Prior direct experience with the Darwinbox platform or similar HRMS/HCM products. 
 - Exposure to standard and custom integration patterns (SFTP, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware tools). 
 - Experience scaling AI-assisted solutioning and coding practices across a consulting or engineering team. 

What Success Looks Like

Within the first two quarters, this person will have become the trusted integrations lead for US client leadership, established clear ownership of integration solutioning and development quality across their team, built a strong rhythm of client leadership demos and meetups, helped stabilize and resolve complex integration interface issues, and strengthened the team's existing AI-driven approach to solutioning and coding - leaving behind a high-performing US-shift Technical Consultant team capable of scaling delivery with consistent quality.

We are seeking a highly experienced Hands‐On Technical Manager to lead our engineering team both technically and organizationally. This role requires deep, hands‐on expertise across the full technology stack, combined with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and technical strategy. 

You will remain actively involved in system design, critical code paths, architectural decisions, and complex problem‐solving while also managing, mentoring, and growing a team of engineers and Tech Leads. You will serve as a key bridge between Engineering, Product, Design, and Leadership, ensuring scalable, secure, and high‐quality solutions are delivered consistently to production. 

Duties and Responsibilities of the Manager, Software Engineering: 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership (Hands On)

- Define and own system architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy across products and platforms. 
 - Design, architect, and review complex full-stack solutions using Angular, . NET, Node. js, GraphQL, and REST-based microservices. 
 - Contribute to critical technical initiatives through architecture reviews, proof-of-concepts, technical spikes, and complex refactoring efforts. 
 - Guide teams in secure coding practices, scalability, performance optimization, maintainability, and operational excellence. 
 - Review and approve high-impact design decisions, code changes, and release strategies. 
 - Drive engineering quality through code reviews, automated testing, quality scans, and development best practices. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for adoption. 

Delivery & Execution

- Own end-to-end delivery of technical initiatives and ensure successful deployment into production environments. 
 - Partner with Product, Design, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Balance immediate delivery commitments with long-term architectural sustainability. 
 - Collaborate with Agile teams throughout the software development lifecycle including design, development, testing, deployment, and support. 
 - Ensure application reliability, maintenance, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive timely execution and resolution of complex technical challenges. 

People Leadership

- Lead, mentor, and develop engineers and technical leads. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. 
 - Drive technical excellence through coaching, knowledge sharing, and best practices. 
 - Support team growth through performance management, career development, and succession planning. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of professional hands-on software development and system design experience. 
 - Previous experience in an Engineering Manager or Technical Manager role with direct people management responsibilities. 
 - Proven track record of leading complex projects from concept through production delivery. 
 - Strong experience across all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies. 
 - Deep understanding of designing secure, scalable, extensible, and reusable software systems. 
 - Ability to effectively balance hands-on technical contributions with leadership responsibilities. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving capabilities. 

Technical Skills

Required

- Angular 19+ 
 - . NET / . NET Core
 - Node. js
 - TypeScript
 - REST API Microservices
 - GraphQL
 - GitLab (Source Control & CI/CD)
 - OpenSearch
 - AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude

Quality & Automation

- Automated testing frameworks including Jasmine and Karma
 - CI/CD and DevOps practices
 - Code quality and security scanning tools

Scripting & Automation

- PowerShell or equivalent scripting technologies

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience driving engineering standards across multiple teams or product lines. 
 - Experience scaling engineering teams or enterprise platforms. 
 - Experience in high-growth or enterprise software environments. 
 - Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline.

data.title: Principal Engineer/Sr. Principal Engineer - CQV
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

Design Manager-CQV is responsible for leading and delivering end-to-end commissioning, qualification, and validation (CQV) programs for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device projects. This role combines technical subject matter expertise with project leadership, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards while meeting project timelines, quality, and budget targets. 

The role requires deep experience in GxP environments, risk-based validation, and facility/equipment qualification, along with strong stakeholder and team management skills. The role will require an experienced, energetic, and committed CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals and having experience of >15 years. The person should have experience of leading CQV engineers for big projects and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle, from SLIA generation through to OQ/ PQ completion. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

- Lead and execute CQV activities across multiple CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - Act as an SME for CQV having technical authority for systems such as process equipments, process utilities, automation, HVAC and controlled environments. 
 - Manage multi-disciplinary teams including CQV engineers, vendors, and contractors. 
 - Serve as the primary CQV interface with clients, design teams and Quality & regulatory teams. 
 - Track project deliverables, budgets, risks, and timelines and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Drive decision-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client. 
 - Involve in GMP review of layouts and systems and ensure CQV requirements are embedded early in the design lifecycle. 
 - Review P&IDs, layouts, URS, FS/DS, equipment specifications and vendor documentation. 
 - Mentor and guide CQV engineers and junior staff. 
 - Establish best practices, templates, and standard methodologies. 
 - Drive continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team. 
 - Prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e. g. , FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e. g. , ISPE, ASTM) and meets data integrity (ALOCOA+) principles. Well versed in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc. 
 - 15+ year's experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

data.title: Lead GenAI SaaS / Platform Engineer
data.description:
About Company

At Delaplex, we believe true organizational distinction comes from exceptional products and services. Founded in 2008 by a team of like-minded business enthusiasts, we have grown into a trusted name in technology consulting and supply chain solutions. Our reputation is built on trust, innovation, and the dedication of our people who go the extra mile for our clients. Guided by our core values, we don't just deliver solutions, we create meaningful impact. 

Job Description

Job Title: Lead GenAI SaaS / Platform Engineer

Experience Level: 8-10+ Years

Location: [Insert Location / Remote / Hybrid]

About The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Lead GenAI SaaS / Platform Engineer to spearhead the administration, architecture, and governance of our enterprise generative AI footprint. In this role, you will be the technical owner responsible for integrating, securing, and scaling frontier LLM platforms (such as ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, and internal AI tooling) across our global enterprise environment. 

This is a SaaS platform engineering and automation role at its core. While you will occasionally partner with our endpoint engineering team on desktop rollout prerequisites (Intune/Jamf), this is not an MDM role-your focus is squarely on SaaS configurations, API connectors, enterprise identity, and operational scale. 

Key Responsibilities

- GenAI Platform Administration: Own the end-to-end administration, environment configuration, workspace segmentation, and lifecycle management for enterprise GenAI platforms (ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, etc. ). 
 - Integrations & Extensibility: Design and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors, API integrations, and secure data pipelines between LLMs and enterprise tools. 
 - Identity, Access & Governance: Implement enterprise-grade security models using SAML 2. 0, SCIM provisioning, OAuth, and granular RBAC via Okta / Microsoft Entra ID. Establish guardrails for data privacy, compliance, and acceptable AI use. 
 - Automation & Scripting: Build robust automation scripts and operational workflows using Python or PowerShell to streamline user provisioning, usage telemetry, and policy enforcement. 
 - Reliability & Operations: Monitor platform health, manage tier-3 incident escalation, track consumption/licensing metrics, and ensure high availability across multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure). 

What We're Looking For

- 8-10+ years of hands-on experience in Enterprise SaaS engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or Platform Administration. 
 - Strong Identity & Security Foundation: Deep familiarity with modern IAM architectures (Okta/Entra ID, SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, OAuth flows, and least-privilege RBAC). 
 - GenAI Familiarity: Practical experience with LLM toolchains, enterprise AI governance, and emerging standards like MCP. Direct administration of ChatGPT Enterprise or Claude Enterprise is a huge plus, but strong platform engineers eager to lean into GenAI are encouraged to apply. 
 - Scripting & APIs: Proven proficiency in Python or PowerShell, coupled with hands-on REST API integration experience. 
 - Cloud & Operational Excellence: Solid grounding in AWS or Azure environments, enterprise logging/monitoring, and incident resolution. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to partner effectively with Security, Workplace IT, and MDM teams to align endpoint delivery with SaaS architecture. 

Skills: python, llm, saas, iam, genai

data.title: ServiceNow Architect -SOMT-Manger
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY-ServiceNow Technical Architect - Telecom Sales & Order Management (SOMT) & Integrations

As part of EY GDS-ServiceNow team, you will be solving client problems using the ServiceNow platform. You will get the opportunity to work with a high-performing team and drive innovative solutions that address complex client needs. 

The opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on ServiceNow Technical Architect with deep expertise in Telecom Sales & Order Management (SOMT), enterprise integrations, and ServiceNow platform development. The ideal candidate will lead architecture and delivery while actively contributing to coding, configuration, troubleshooting, and mentoring teams. Experience with telecom OSS/BSS ecosystems, Performance Analytics, and AI capabilities is essential. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Architect and deliver ServiceNow Sales & Order Management (SOM/SOMT) solutions for telecommunications clients. 
 - Lead discovery sessions, requirements workshops, solution design discussions, and stakeholder reviews. 
 - Design and implement integrations using REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, Scripted APIs, and MID Servers with external OSS/BSS, CRM, ERP, billing, and inventory systems. 
 - Remain hands-on by configuring and developing ServiceNow solutions, including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, Flow Designer, Catalog Items, UI Actions, and custom applications. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex platform, integration, and production issues through root cause analysis and technical leadership. 
 - Lead development teams, conduct code reviews, enforce best practices, and drive technical governance. 
 - Mentor and train junior developers, providing technical guidance and capability development across the team. 
 - Leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities, automation, and Performance Analytics to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- ServiceNow SOM/SOMT, TSM, TNI, ITSM, CSM, FSM, CMDB/CSDM, integrations
 - Telecom OSS/BSS integration experience. 
 - Performance Analytics, Now Assist, AI Agents, and Agentic AI solutions. 
 - Strong communication, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills. 

To qualify for the role, you must have

- College degree in a related technology field (Computer Science, Engineering, etc. ) or equivalent experience
 - ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA). 
 - Minimum two (2) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications. 
 - 8+ years of ServiceNow experience, including architecture, development, and integration delivery. 
 - Strong hands-on scripting experience in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and IntegrationHub. 
 - Proven experience in telecom order management, order orchestration, fulfillment, and Lead-to-Cash processes. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Experience with tools like JIRA, ServiceNow Agile, or equivalent for backlog management
 - Exposure to ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, and release management
 - Experience in stakeholder management and client-facing roles
 - Knowledge of ServiceNow's latest features and roadmap

What We Look For

- A team player and Leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
 - Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
 - Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
 - Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. 

You get to work on inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You'll quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging assignments and be part of a collaborative environment focused on quality and innovation. 

Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced professionals

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data Processing
data.description:
Aliases: Principal Engineer, Senior Principal Engineer, Technical Architect, Principal Architect, Enterprise Architect (Engineering), Senior Technical Architect, Distinguished Engineer or Chief Architect at a smaller company

About Truveta

Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values. 

This opportunity

Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early members, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub. 

The Data Platform group in India owns parts of the pipeline that ingests, processes, stores, and serves healthcare data at a scale very few organizations operate at. Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve the same engineering rigor that has transformed other industries, and that is the work: correctness under volume, reliability under failure, and speed without cutting the corners that regulated health data does not allow anyone to cut. 

What You Will Do

- Define architecture across ingestion, processing, storage, serving, governance, and observability for the India-owned parts of the platform, aligned with Seattle. 
 - Set multi-platform technical strategy along with the sequencing that makes it achievable rather than aspirational. 
 - Remain hands-on where it counts: critical designs, prototypes, deep reviews, and the worst production problems. 
 - Resolve technical disagreements that span teams and write down the decision and it's reasoning so that it holds afterwards. 
 - Establish architecture governance that engineers experience as a useful framework. 
 - Raise the technical bar of the IDC through hiring, interview calibration, and mentoring of Senior and SDE3 engineers. 
 - Represent Truveta's engineering thinking to partners, candidates, and the wider technical community. 

Key Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10 to 16 or more years of professional software engineering experience, with eight considered exceptional candidates. 
 - Architecture ownership across multiple teams or platforms, with results that are demonstrably durable. 
 - Deep expertise in large-scale distributed data systems across the full lifecycle, from ingestion through serving. 
 - Continuing hands-on practice: you still write code and review designs in detail. This is an IC role, not a management role. 
 - Evidence of technical strategy that was adopted and executed, not only proposed. 
 - Sound judgment about build versus buy, migration risk, and technical debt at organization scale. 
 - Ability to influence senior engineering and product leadership across geographies and time zones. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Healthcare data, clinical informatics, or a comparably regulated domain. 
 - Experience as the most senior individual contributor at a site or within a platform organization. 
 - Track record of hiring and calibrating senior engineering talent. 
 - Prior work on privacy, security, or compliance architecture at scale.

About Rippling

Aeva's mission is to bring the next wave of perception to a broad range of applications from automated driving to industrial robotics, consumer electronics, consumer health, security, and beyond. Aeva 4D LiDAR sensors uniquely detect instant velocity in addition to 3D position, allowing autonomous devices like vehicles and robots to make more intelligent and safe decisions.

You will drive the architecture and development of software infrastructure used for testing LiDAR firmware, perception software and associated artifacts. You will also drive strategic technology management and future software solutions architecture that meets automotive compliance requirements. 

What you'll do

- Architect, design, and develop a robust and scalable Python based test automation framework for performing fully automated tests for embedded devices and providing traceable matrix for requirements to test-case to defect tracking. Develop automation features that allow end-to-end test coverage for all software and system components

- Mentor  a  team of skilled engineers dedicated to developing test cases, following standard coding practices. Drive code reviews to ensure consistent coding standards across all team members

- Develop, implement, and optimize test strategies and plans for automotive software, including functional, regression, performance, and security testing

What you'll have

- BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

- Expert proficiency in Python and C++ programming and relevant libraries/frameworks for test automation

- Prior experience architecting test frameworks

- Proficiency in test-case development with docker/Kubernetes

- Practical knowledge of verification and validation means using testbeds and simulators as well as experience with hardware in the loop (HIL) and software in the loop (SIL) test environments

- You have a problem-solving mindset and, able to mentor and guide juniors in solving daily development challenges

- Proven ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and projects simultaneously

What's in it for you

- Knowledge of automotive testing standards and frameworks, such as ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, ASPICE, etc

- Understanding of automotive software systems, including embedded systems, ADAS, infotainment, or electric vehicle control software

- Experience with JAMA for  requirements management software (or equivalent)

- Experience with JIRA for defect tracking and familiar with Agile methodologies
