Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3. 7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. 

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. 

THE ROLE

The Platform Engineering team creates the foundation that enables the industry's most innovative, high-performance, and highly available portfolio of Pure Storage products that are designed for the most demanding mission critical applications. We design, build and deliver hardware products, but over 90% of our engineering staff are software engineers. Our customers are the most important part of our business and they love our products for the simplicity of management, the constant flow of new and exciting upgrades, and ability to live on the cutting edge of technology while never taking downtime, ever. Pure's product portfolio enables our customers to leverage the agility of the public cloud for both traditional IT and cloud-native applications. 

What You'll Do

- Deliver manufacturing diagnostics and tools for Everpure Direct Flash Module product line
 - Collaborate with hardware, firmware, software and manufacturing test teams, and deliver support for our ambitious roadmap items. 
 - Collaborate with product managers and engineering teams in getting requirements. 
 - Responsible for the overall development life cycle of the solution and managing projects. 
 - Instill best practices of software development and documentation, assure designs meet requirements and deliver high quality work on tight schedules. 
 - Clearly and regularly communicate status on how projects are progressing. 
 - Managing day-to-day software engineering development activities. 
 - Hiring, managing, monitoring and motivating software development team members. 
 - Driving innovation while at the same time managing software development schedules. 
 - Integrate software with existing systems. 
 - Driving company culture and career development to individual contributors. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or equivalent. 
 - 3 plus years of technical lead or management experience, while staying hands-on in development
 - 5 plus years of Linux kernel or protocol development experience in servers, networking or storage, ideally on x86 NUMA systems. 
 - 2+ years experience collaborating with remote teams based in the US or some other country. 
 - Experience in technologies and industry standards such as NVMe, NFS, iSCSI, Fiber Channel, SCSI, or protocols such as SMB, NFS. 
 - Experience in Agile development and continuous integration in development projects. 
 - Proficiency in C/C++ and scripting languages such as python/shell
 - Working knowledge of Linux virtualization tools, or data path technologies such as DPDK
 - Proven expertise in managing projects throughout the entire SDLC, delivering products to market on schedule, and ensuring feedback loops from customers into development
 - Detail oriented, with experience in defining, partitioning, prioritizing software requirements across remote teams. Skilled in flushing out dependencies and roadblocks. 
 - Demonstrated skills of managing software innovation and meeting development deadlines in a product company. 
 - Data driven, with an ability to extract insights and make forecasts based on available information. 
 - Experienced in Agile and DevOps practices. 

What You Can Expect From Us

- Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers. 
 - Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in TechnologyTM, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay AreaTM, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
 - Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good. 

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http: //benefits. everpuredata. com/ for more information. 

Accommodations And Accessibility

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage. com if you're invited to an interview. 

Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team

We're forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn't just accepted but embraced. That's why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership. 

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire. 

Join us and bring your best. 

Bring your bold. 

Pure and simple.

data.title: BRIM Technical Architect
data.description:
What You'll Do: 

Own the technical architecture of the SAP BRIM platform - how it is built, integrated, and kept scalable over time. You define how the Order-to-Cash (O2C) solution is structured technically: the billing and subscription models at implementation level, the integration architecture, the cross-module technical coherence, and the extensibility patterns that keep the platform upgrade-safe and maintainable as Criteo's monetization evolves. 

Beyond delivery, you are a strategic thinking partner - contributing to the definition of the future billing platform: what monetization capabilities Criteo needs to build, what the platform should become, and how technical architecture choices today shape product options tomorrow. 

Main missions: 

- Own the end-to-end technical architecture across BRIM modules, ensuring cross-module coherence at implementation level (CI, SOM, CM, CC, FI-CA) within the O2C flow 
 - Define and own the billing and subscription model implementation: rating architecture, pricing and charging structures, contract and entitlement lifecycle at technical level. 
 - Own the integration architecture between BRIM, S/4HANA FI and non-SAP systems - interface contracts, data flows, error handling patterns, API and event-based integration. 
 - Ensure the platform remains extensible, upgrade-safe and Clean Core compliant - define the extensibility patterns (standard APIs, events) that govern how the ABAP Lead builds. 
 - Translate functional designs into implementable technical blueprints, surfacing constraints, trade-offs and platform limitations before build starts. 
 - Partner with the BRIM Product Lead to help defining the future billing platform vision - translating market, business and monetization evolutions into technical architecture directions and platform investment options. 

Tasks: 

- Define the technical implementation of monetization models: subscription structures, rating and pricing mechanics, billing cycle architecture, revenue and collection flows at system level. 
 - Design integration patterns and interface contracts (inbound/outbound, event-driven, API-based) between BRIM and adjacent systems; own technical decisions on error handling, retry, and reconciliation. 
 - Validate technical feasibility of functional designs produced by the Solution Architect; identify cross-module technical impacts and escalate conflicts or constraints before they reach build. 
 - Define extensibility standards and Clean Core guardrails for the ABAP Lead: which enhancement frameworks to use, where custom code is justified, how extensions are structured to remain upgrade-safe. 
 - Contribute to BRIM product roadmap discussions with the Product Lead: surface technical constraints, platform opportunities and build-vs-standard trade-offs that shape future product decisions. " 
 - Anticipate evolutions in Criteo's monetization model and translate them into forward-looking architecture options - new billing constructs, extensibility needs, integration patterns - before they become urgent delivery requirements. 
 - Provide technical architecture inputs to backlog refinement: effort drivers, implementation options, technical risks, dependency sequencing. 
 - Produce and maintain the BRIM technical architecture documentation: module interaction model, integration blueprint, master and transactional data architecture, key identifiers across BRIM and S/4HANA. 
 - Anticipate SAP platform evolutions (S/4HANA releases, BTP where applicable) and maintain a technical roadmap that keeps the BRIM estate extensible and forward-compatible. 
 - Lead and contribute to architecture workshops with Solution Architect, ABAP Lead and BRIM components Leads. 
 - Support delivery teams during complex build, test and hypercare phases on architecture-level technical issues. 

Who You Are: 

- 8+ years in SAP architecture and delivery, with deep end-to-end ownership of BRIM technical implementations. 
 - Strong cross-module expertise in SAP BRIM - with solid working knowledge of SOM, CC, CI and CM integration patterns. 
 - Proven track record designing and governing billing model architectures: subscription, rating, pricing, invoicing and collection flows at technical implementation level. 
 - Solid experience defining integration architectures between SAP BRIM / S/4HANA and cloud or non-SAP systems. 
 - Strong command of SAP extensibility frameworks (standard APIs, events) and Clean Core principles - able to set the standard others build to. 
 - Able to translate functional solution designs into technical blueprints and surface implementation constraints before they become delivery risks. 
 - Ability to think beyond delivery - engaging on product vision, monetization strategy and platform futures with business and product stakeholders, not just with engineering teams. 
 - Experience working in international, distributed and offshore environments; comfortable aligning remote technical teams to architectural decisions. 
 - Strong communication skills - able to engage both Business and Engineering stakeholders, and to make architecture trade-offs legible to non-architects. 

We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we'd love to see your application!

Who We Are: 

We're Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses. 

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3, 600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment. 

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs-never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics. 

What We Offer: 

🏢 Ways of working - Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both. 

📈 Grow with us - Learning, mentorship & career development programs. 

💪 Your wellbeing matters - Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support. 

🤝 A team that cares - Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected. 

💸 Fair pay & perks - Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level. 

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

Gracenote is the content business unit of Nielsen that powers the world of media entertainment. Our metadata solutions help media and entertainment companies around the world deliver personalized content search and discovery, connecting audiences with the content they love. We're at the intersection of people and media entertainment. 

With our cutting-edge technology and solutions, we help audiences easily find TV shows, movies, music and sports across multiple platforms. As the world leader in entertainment data and services, we power the world's top streaming platforms, cable and satellite TV providers, media companies, consumer electronics manufacturers, music services and automakers to navigate and succeed in the competitive streaming world. data.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated-combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership across our SaaS platforms and shared backend services. 

This role is for an engineer who combines deep expertise in Java, distributed systems, cloud architecture, and software design with a modern, AI-native approach to software engineering. 

You will lead complex initiatives across multiple teams, influence architecture and engineering standards, and remain deeply involved in implementation. You will also help define how engineering teams effectively use AI coding tools, including Claude Code, throughout the software development lifecycle-from understanding existing systems and designing solutions to implementation, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and modernization. 

This is not a purely architectural role. We are looking for a technical leader who designs, codes, prototypes, reviews, mentors, and leads by example. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Define and drive architecture for Java-based platform services, distributed systems, APIs, and event-driven applications across multiple product areas 
 - Lead complex technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams, services, and business domains 
 - Remain highly hands-on through architecture, prototyping, implementation of critical components, code reviews, debugging, and production troubleshooting 
 - Champion AI-native software engineering practices, using AI coding tools such as Claude Code to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, debugging, documentation, and system understanding 
 - Establish effective patterns and guardrails for using AI-generated code in production engineering environments 
 - Help engineering teams evolve from traditional development workflows toward AI-assisted and agentic software development 
 - Identify opportunities where AI can accelerate modernization of legacy systems, test creation, refactoring, migration, and technical debt reduction 
 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, and Architecture leaders to translate business priorities into scalable technical solutions 
 - Guide the evolution of cloud-native architectures, microservices, data flows, integrations, and shared platform capabilities 
 - Drive improvements in system performance, availability, observability, security, and operational readiness 
 - Establish engineering standards and reusable patterns for Java development, API design, testing, CI/CD, AI-assisted development, and production operations 
 - Mentor Senior and Staff Engineers through architecture reviews, technical guidance, hands-on collaboration, and modern AI-enabled engineering practices 
 - Evaluate emerging engineering and AI technologies and determine where they can meaningfully improve our products and engineering organization

Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of software engineering experience building production SaaS applications, distributed systems, or enterprise software platforms 
 - 4+ years of experience developing production backend services using Java 
 - Strong hands-on coding skills and the ability to design, implement, review, debug, and operate complex production software 
 - Proven experience providing technical leadership across multiple engineering teams or product areas 
 - Experience designing and operating distributed systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP 
 - Experience leading architecture reviews and establishing engineering standards or practices adopted across multiple teams 
 - Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted coding tools as part of real software engineering workflows 
 - Ability to use AI effectively for code generation, codebase exploration, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and technical problem-solving 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals and the ability to critically review, validate, test, and improve AI-generated code 
 - Ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction without relying solely on organizational authority

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar agentic AI coding tools 
 - Experience with Java technologies such as Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, Kafka, or similar frameworks 
 - Experience designing cloud-native, microservices-based, or event-driven architectures 
 - Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or Oracle 
 - Experience leading platform modernization, cloud migration, or large-scale re-architecture initiatives 
 - Experience using AI to accelerate modernization of large or legacy codebases 
 - Experience improving reliability, observability, performance, testing, or operational practices across production systems 
 - Experience integrating AI-enabled capabilities, LLMs, agents, or AI services into production software 
 - Experience developing engineering standards, workflows, or guardrails for AI-assisted software development 
 - Familiarity with modern AI engineering concepts such as LLM APIs, tool use, agents, RAG, evaluation, and prompt/context engineering 
 - Experience measuring and improving engineering productivity using AI-enabled development workflows

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Staff Engineer at Kaseya does more than design systems. You will: 

- Build: Stay close to the code and deliver critical technical solutions. 
 - Lead: Set technical direction and drive complex initiatives across teams. 
 - Modernize: Improve architecture, engineering practices, and legacy systems. 
 - Amplify: Use AI to increase the effectiveness and velocity of engineering teams. 
 - Mentor: Raise the technical capabilities of engineers around you. 
 - Own: Take responsibility for solutions from architecture and implementation through production operation. 

We are looking for engineers who see AI not as a replacement for engineering fundamentals, but as a powerful multiplier for exceptional engineers. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Job Title: Supplier Development Engineer

Job Description

The Supplier Development Engineer plays a key role in selecting, qualifying, and improving consumable suppliers to ensure reliable, high-quality components that support ongoing program design changes and new product development. This position focuses on assessing supplier capabilities, defining specifications and controls for critical parts, and driving data-informed performance improvements in close collaboration with internal teams and global manufacturing sites. 

Responsibilities

- Assess consumables supplier capabilities and provide input into new supplier selection, evaluation, and qualification during program design changes and development. 
 - Create and develop specifications and control plans for new critical parts to ensure consistent quality and performance. 
 - Plan and coordinate first article inspections for new critical parts as required. 
 - Identify and qualify secondary sources for new critical components to support supply continuity and risk mitigation. 
 - Define requirements for external quality controls and collaborate with suppliers to establish, track, and trend key supplier performance metrics. 
 - Use data analytics to interpret supplier performance data and make clear recommendations for corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Serve as the primary interface between suppliers and internal teams for issues related to specifications and performance. 
 - Review, approve, and release change orders to suppliers, ensuring alignment with internal requirements and standards. 
 - Identify, quantify, prioritize, and drive supplier improvement projects, including supplier-recommended design changes, by coordinating with internal engineering and quality teams. 
 - Champion internal requirements at the supplier while accurately representing supplier capabilities within the organization. 
 - Review supplier issues such as non-conforming material and corrective action requests, drive effective corrective actions, and provide formal approval of resolutions. 
 - Coordinate specification or performance changes at suppliers and communicate impacts and requirements to global manufacturing sites. 

Essential Skills

- 36 years of experience in supplier development, supplier quality, or a closely related engineering role. 
 - Hands-on experience with assay development and assay testing, particularly in environments involving consumables or chemical components. 
 - Strong experience working with chemical-based products, materials, or processes. 
 - Proven ability to develop and interpret technical specifications and control plans for critical parts. 
 - Experience planning and executing first article inspections for new or modified components. 
 - Demonstrated ability to use data analytics to monitor supplier performance and drive decisions. 
 - Effective communication skills for interfacing with suppliers and cross-functional internal teams. 
 - Ability to manage and approve change orders and coordinate specification changes across multiple stakeholders. 
 - Experience reviewing non-conforming material reports and driving corrective actions with suppliers. 

Additional Skills & Qualifications

- Experience leading supplier improvement projects from identification through implementation and verification. 
 - Experience in environments involving assay development and testing, which supports understanding of performance-critical consumables. 
 - Familiarity with establishing and trending key supplier performance metrics and quality indicators. 
 - Ability to represent internal requirements clearly while understanding and articulating supplier capabilities. 
 - Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills related to supplier quality and performance issues. 

Work Environment

This role operates in a collaborative, cross-functional environment that spans suppliers, internal engineering and quality teams, and global manufacturing sites. The Supplier Development Engineer works with technical documentation, specifications, and performance data, using analytical tools to evaluate supplier metrics and drive improvements. The position involves regular communication with external suppliers and coordination with worldwide manufacturing facilities, requiring clear documentation practices and structured follow-up on actions. The culture emphasizes continuous improvement, data-driven decision-making, and strong partnership with suppliers to ensure reliable, high-quality consumables that support critical assay development and testing activities.

data.title: Mobile Application Developer
data.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Native Mobile Performance Testing Engineer with deep expertise in Apache JMeter, BlazeMeter and BrowserStack to design, develop, execute, and analyze performance tests for enterprise-native Android and iOS applications. 

This position is specifically focused on native mobile applications installed and executed directly on Android and iOS devices-not mobile websites, mobile browsers, or responsive web applications. 

The ideal candidate will have strong proven experience testing native mobile application packages (APK/AAB and IPA), combining JMeter/BlazeMeter protocol-level load testing with BrowserStack real-device native application automation to assess end-user responsiveness, application stability, backend scalability, and overall performance. 

The successful candidate must be capable of independently developing performance test frameworks, implementing realistic native mobile application workloads, executing distributed load tests, automating native application user journeys on real devices, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks across the mobile device, application, network, APIs, and backend infrastructure. 

This is a hands-on technical engineering position requiring strong scripting, mobile automation, performance analysis, troubleshooting, and technical leadership capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

Native Android and iOS Application Performance Testing

- Design and execute performance tests for native Android and iOS mobile applications, rather than browser-based mobile applications. 
 - Test installable mobile application packages (APK/AAB and IPA) across real Android and iOS devices. 
 - Develop realistic workloads representing critical native application business transactions, user journeys, and production usage patterns. 
 - Measure native application startup and launch times, screen transition times, transaction completion times, responsiveness, and stability. 
 - Evaluate mobile application CPU utilization, memory consumption, rendering performance, battery impact, and application crashes using appropriate device-level instrumentation. 
 - Analyze native application performance under Wi-Fi, 4G, 5G, and varying bandwidth, latency, jitter, and packet-loss conditions. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks involving native application code, mobile SDKs, device resources, API communication, and backend infrastructure. 
 - Evaluate performance differences across device models, hardware configurations, Android/iOS versions, and network conditions. JMeter and BlazeMeter Performance Engineering

- Develop, enhance, and maintain sophisticated JMeter scripts that simulate backend API traffic generated by native Android and iOS applications. 
 - Implement advanced HTTP(S)/REST scripting, correlation, parameterization, JSON processing, authentication handling, and dynamic test data. 
 - Configure and execute distributed performance tests using BlazeMeter. 
 - Design and execute load, stress, spike, endurance, capacity, scalability, and resiliency tests. 
 - Establish realistic workload models covering concurrent users, transaction distribution, pacing, think time, and ramp-up/ramp-down patterns. 
 - Analyze response-time percentiles, throughput, transaction rates, error rates, and infrastructure utilization. 
 - Build reusable performance testing frameworks and integrate automated tests into Agile and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Correlate backend load-test results with performance observations from native Android and iOS devices. BrowserStack Native Mobile Application Testing

- Configure and execute automated native Android and iOS application tests using BrowserStack's real-device infrastructure. 
 - Use BrowserStack App Automate, App Live, and applicable real-device capabilities for testing installed mobile applications. 
 - Develop and maintain native mobile automation scripts using Appium or equivalent mobile automation frameworks. 
 - Automate application launches, native screen navigation, user interactions, and critical business transactions. 
 - Execute native mobile application automation scenarios in parallel with JMeter/BlazeMeter protocol-level load tests. 
 - Measure native application responsiveness and end-user experience while backend services are subjected to varying load conditions. 
 - Capture and correlate automation timings, native application logs, device diagnostics, and backend telemetry through supported BrowserStack capabilities and complementary instrumentation. 
 - Investigate performance differences across Android and iOS devices, operating system versions, and network configurations. Important: BrowserStack experience must involve testing native mobile applications installed on real devices. Experience limited to opening websites in mobile browsers through BrowserStack does not meet the primary requirement. 

Performance Analysis and Technical Leadership

- Define comprehensive native mobile application performance testing strategies, test plans, workload models, SLAs, SLOs, SLIs, and measurable acceptance criteria. 
 - Perform detailed performance diagnostics and root cause analysis using Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, Splunk, or comparable observability platforms. 
 - Correlate native application behavior with API latency, distributed traces, application logs, and infrastructure metrics. 
 - Evaluate performance risks associated with mobile application releases, operating system updates, SDK changes, and backend architecture modifications.

data.title: Oracle Business Systems & Test Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

Role Purpose

Support the Future-Ready Service Ecosystem program by validating Oracle-based business processes, transactions, integrations and application functionality; coordinating requirements and test feedback between business and technology teams; supporting master data quality; and ensuring release readiness across Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Fusion Cloud and related enterprise applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Execute end-to-end functional, system integration, regression and user acceptance testing for Oracle applications, enhancements, interfaces and reports.

 - Validate Oracle transactions, test Web ADI, workflows, approvals, notifications, scheduled jobs, reports, role-based access and downstream accounting or operational impacts. 
 - Perform requirements analysis, process mapping, gap analysis and impact assessment for enhancements, fixes, integrations

and automation initiatives. 

- Maintain requirements, test status, defect logs, decision logs, action trackers and traceability between business requirements, 

configuration, development and test outcomes. 

- Perform master data cleansing, validation, reconciliation, maintenance and migration support across customer, item, installed

base, branch, territory, contract and service-related data. 

- Validate inbound and outbound interfaces, API-based integrations, data conversions and reconciliation between Oracle and

connected enterprise applications. 

- Validate role-based access, permissions, and security profiles across EBS user roles.

communicate risks, dependencies and unresolved issues promptly. 

- Support cutover planning, smoke testing, go-live validation, hypercare tracking and post-implementation issue analysis.

Systems & Domain Exposure

- Strong working knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite and Oracle Fusion Cloud applications is preferred.

data.title: Senior Developer, Business Process Automation
data.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care. 

At Edwards Lifesciences, the Intelligent Automation team enables scalable, efficient, and compliant business operations through workflow orchestration, robotic process automation (RPA), and integration. As a Senior Automation Developer focused on low-code platforms (e. g. , Microsoft Power Platform, UiPath), you will serve as a technical lead who shapes solution design, delivery approach, and engineering standards across a portfolio of automations. You will partner with process owners, product owners, analysts, architects, and IT teams to translate requirements into secure, reliable solutions; build reusable components and frameworks; and establish best practices that accelerate delivery and reduce operational risk. If you thrive in complex enterprise environments, excel at influencing without authority, and are energized by building governed automation capabilities that deliver measurable business value, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a patient-focused, innovation-driven organization. 

How you will make an impact: 

- Own end-to-end delivery of automation solutions using approved low-code tools (e. g. , Power Automate cloud/desktop, Power Apps, UiPath), from discovery and solution design through release, hypercare, and steady-state operations. 
 - Lead stakeholder workshops to understand current-state processes, define future-state workflows, document user stories/acceptance criteria, and align on measurable outcomes (cycle time, accuracy, compliance, cost). 
 - Design integration patterns leveraging connectors, APIs, and data services (e. g. , Dataverse/SQL) and ensure solutions align to enterprise integration, data-handling, and audit requirements. 
 - Engineer for resiliency by implementing standardized exception handling, structured logging, alerting/notifications, retry strategies, and proactive monitoring. 
 - Define and evolve team standards and reusable assets (templates, child flows, libraries, solution packages, framework components) to improve delivery speed, quality, and maintainability across the automation portfolio. 
 - Establish and enforce quality practices (unit/integration testing, peer reviews, test evidence) and drive defect remediation through UAT to meet release and validation expectations. 
 - Partner with security, infrastructure, and application owners to implement least-privilege access, credential management, and secure connectivity; proactively identify and mitigate control gaps. 
 - Own operational readiness: produce solution designs, runbooks, support models; lead incident triage, root-cause analysis, and preventative actions to improve service stability. 
 - Continuously improve existing automations (performance, resiliency, cost) by analyzing telemetry, reducing technical debt, and recommending platform capabilities and roadmap enhancements. 
 - Provide technical leadership across project teams by guiding design decisions, unblocking delivery, mentoring developers, and ensuring solutions conform to architecture, quality, and security standards. 
 - Drive technical excellence and innovation by evaluating new platform capabilities, establishing patterns for adoption, and sharing recommendations that improve the team's delivery velocity, maintainability, and compliance posture. 
 - Enable the broader automation community through demos, documentation, and reviews; coach citizen developers and project teams to operate within governance, ALM, and security standards. 

What you will need (Required): 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field 
 - 8+ years of experience developing and supporting automation solutions using low-code platforms (e. g. , Microsoft Power Platform-Power Automate/Power Apps/Dataverse-or UiPath), including design, build, test, deployment, and support. 
 - Proven ability to translate business needs into fit-for-purpose solution designs (user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria) and deliver automations in an Agile/Scrum environment while managing dependencies and risk. 
 - Hands-on experience with connectors/integrations (REST APIs, HTTP actions, webhooks) and data sources (Dataverse, SQL, SharePoint, SAP/ServiceNow or similar). 
 - Relevant certifications (strongly preferred but not required), such as Microsoft Power Platform (PL-100/PL-200/PL-400/PL-500) and/or UiPath certifications. 
 - Deep knowledge of platform governance and ALM (environments, solutions, connection references, DLP policies) with demonstrated experience establishing guardrails and delivery patterns; plus, working scripting/coding skills (e. g. , JavaScript, PowerShell, Python, or C#) to extend automations when needed. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills 
 - Excellent documentation and communication skills and interpersonal relationship skills including negotiating and relationship management skills with ability to drive achievement of objectives and communicate to various levels of audience or to explain complex or technical matters in a manner suitable for non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong collaboration skills: ability to partner with business process owners, analysts, and IT teams to deliver automation outcomes and communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong SDLC ownership (analysis, development, QA/UAT support, deployment, and post-go-live support) with a focus on reliability, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. 
 - Practical understanding of authentication/authorization concepts (service accounts, OAuth, MFA) and secure handling of sensitive data within automations. 
 - Ability to produce clear technical documentation (solution designs, data mappings, test evidence, runbooks) appropriate for regulated environments. 
 - Knowledge of best practices related to IT governance, operations, and administration. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate with architects, platform administrators, and project/program managers to deliver automation solutions aligned to standards, roadmaps, and timelines. 
 - Demonstrated problem-solving skills, including troubleshooting production issues and identifying continuous improvement opportunities. 
 - Adhere to all company rules and requirements (e. g. , pandemic protocols, Environmental Health & Safety rules) and take adequate control measures in preventing injuries to themselves and others as well as to the protection of environment and prevention of pollution under their span of influence/control. 

What else do we look for (Preferred): 

- Experience establishing and operating DevOps/ALM for low-code at scale (pipelines, solution packaging, automated testing) and applying source control practices (Git) for automation assets. 
 - Experience building enterprise-grade solutions using Power Platform (custom connectors, Power Fx, plugins) and/or UiPath (REFramework, Orchestrator) in a governed environment, including reusable architecture patterns and operational support models. 
 - Exposure to intelligent automation capabilities such as document processing (OCR/IDP), process mining, and/or AI-assisted automation, with an understanding of validation and quality requirements 
 - 4 years of relevant industry experience (e. g. , medical device, pharmaceuticals, etc. ) or in highly regulated environments preferred. 

Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families. 

Recruiting scam alert: Read our notice about potential recruiting scams.

Build a better world

data.title: Manager- MEP
data.description:
Being the go-to MEP/CIVIL person

Are you considered to be the go-to person for all MEP/CIVIL matters? That's what you'll be in this role. You'll manage all activities related to mechanical, engineering and plumbing in terms of planning, designing, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and final handover. Your task is to fully understand, collect and deliver clients' MEP/CIVIL requirements. The design manager in MEP/CIVIL will depend on you to help schedule or plan establishment, value engineer, and design change management. You'll also assist the contract manager in MEP/CIVIL-related procurement and VO management. On top of that, you'll support the construction manager in MEP/CIVIL-related installation, site inspection and contractor management. 

Making visions come true

You'll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project-from initiating, designing, planning, controlling, executing, monitoring, and closing. You'll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients' needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, while also detailing all the necessary objectives to get there. 

While you do all of these, you'll need to keep tabs on company resources used in the projects, and to allocate these resources to complete the project within the budget. You'll also need to help clients organize and analyze all tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers; and represent them from the beginning to the end of a project. 

Building strong teams and business reputation

One of your priorities will be to produce high-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You'll also represent and promote the company throughout projects and in pursuit of more project opportunities. 

Keeping risks at bay

How do you deal with risks? You'll need to identify any potential risks in the MEP/CIVIL field and report them to the Project Manager. It will be critical to design a risk management and solution provision, particularly to identify health & safety issues. You will understand why this is your responsibility. 

Sound like you? To apply you need to be: 

An MEP/CIVIL pro

You have a degree in MEP/CIVIL engineering-related discipline or related field, and five years of combined educational and work experience. You also need to have sufficient experience in construction site management, as well as a strong understanding of all aspects of development management including, financial appraisal, risk management, negotiation, etc. 

Do you have a strong background of all aspects of MEP/CIVIL-related management-including the development of MEP/CIVIL project plan and procedures and construction schedules? Are you familiar with HVAC, electrical engineering, and BMS? Do you have knowledge of security system, AV system, and IT system? If your answers are yes, let's talk. 

A business savvy leader who can walk the talk

You understand the business well enough, particularly in terms of the systems and tools to use, the best practices and the safety requirements. You're also knowledgeable of key industries and local market, with the real estate and construction business above all. You also have a basic understanding of the key drivers that push the projects forward, while also considering the client's business requirements. 

You'll back up your business know-hows with the necessary communication skills, as you need to regularly do business development presentations to potential clients in both English and Chinese. You'll also manage site activities, negotiate with contractors, review the legal aspects of contracts, contribute to market analysis, and manage change orders. 

A flexible leader with superb interpersonal skills

Are you a people person with superb interpersonal skills? You'll need to create a proactive working environment that not only motivates your employees, but also encourages them to maintain good relationship with clients, communicate effectively with each other, and contribute enthusiastically to the project. You also need to be a results-oriented leader with good problem-solving skills, as well as someone who can nurture positive relationships with all stakeholders involved, including your team members and clients. 

What we can do for you: 

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package. 

Apply today!

As a Design Manager - Treatment, you will lead the multidisciplinary design delivery of complex water treatment, wastewater treatment, and desalination projects. You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, programme certainty, and quality compliance across all stages of project delivery. This includes overseeing process, civil, mechanical, chemical, electrical, and I&C interfaces, ensuring alignment across all design disciplines. 

You will work closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional leadership to plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of treatment projects while also mentoring and strengthening the capability of the broader design team. 

Key duties include

- Development and implementation of multidisciplinary design strategies for water/wastewater treatment and desalination projects, ensuring design integration and coherent execution. 
 - Lead and manage the preparation, coordination, and delivery of design packages for water treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants, desalination facilities, and associated process systems. 
 - Evaluate, compare, and select appropriate treatment technologies and processes for project-specific needs. 
 - Provide leadership in Design for Design‐Build (D for DB) models-ensuring constructability, staging, risk mitigation, and alignment with contractor expectations. 
 - Lead or support HAZOP/HAZID studies, interpret findings, and implement appropriate mitigation measures across treatment process designs.

 - Drives integrated, high‐quality design solutions across disciplines. 
 - Organised, proactive, and able to resolve complex issues promptly. 
 - Creative, flexible, dependable; champions safety and quality culture.

data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries - automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence. 

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record - ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure - the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly. 

Job Description

Ignite Your Future: 

At QAD, we are building intelligent, adaptive platforms that redefine manufacturing and supply chains. As Director of Engineering, you will lead a significant portion of the engineering organization responsible for QAD's Adaptive ERP. You will own multiple ERP platform and foundational capabilities while helping shape the continued evolution, modernization, quality, and operational readiness of a mature enterprise product used by manufacturers globally. 

A major part of your mandate will also be accelerating the transition of existing customers to Adaptive. You will lead foundational ERP capabilities and AI-driven transformation tooling designed to analyze, simplify, and reduce the complexity of customer upgrades and modernization. 

This role combines engineering leadership, technical depth, product thinking, and transformation. You will lead multiple teams and managers, work across internal and partner engineering organizations, and help define how AI can fundamentally change the way complex enterprise software is analyzed, modernized, and transformed. 

The Mission: What You'll Be Building

Your organization sits at the intersection of QAD's existing ERP estate and its future. You will lead teams responsible for: 

- ERP Engineering Leadership - Own and evolve a significant portion of QAD's ERP engineering portfolio, with accountability for product quality, architecture, delivery, modernization, and operational readiness. 
 - ERP Foundations & Extensibility - Own and evolve the foundational capabilities upon which ERP functional modules are built, ensuring a scalable foundation for the broader Adaptive Applications organization. 
 - AI-Driven Customer Transformation - Build intelligent tooling that analyzes and streamlines existing customer environments, reduces implementation and upgrade complexity, and accelerates transition to Adaptive. 
 - Customer Streamlining & Modernization - Partner across Engineering, Product, Services, and other QAD organizations to systematically reduce customer complexity while evolving a mature ERP estate toward a more standardized, scalable model. 

You will translate strategy into execution, ensuring predictable delivery, strong architecture, and engineering excellence. 

Your Impact/ What You Will Be Doing

- Engineering Leadership & Delivery: Lead multiple engineering teams through Managers and Senior Managers, ensuring timely, high‐quality delivery of complex SaaS capabilities. 
 - AI-Driven Transformation: Lead the development and evolution of AI capabilities that automate and accelerate the analysis, streamlining, and transformation of existing ERP customer environments. 
 - Customer Transformation: Work across Engineering, Product, Services, and other stakeholders to understand the complexity of existing customer environments and turn those challenges into scalable product capabilities. 
 - People & Talent Development: Build, coach, and develop Engineering Managers and senior engineers; create strong succession and growth paths. 
 - Agile Execution: Drive Agile and product‐centric delivery models, balancing speed, quality, and sustainability. 
 - Cross‐Functional Partnership: Partner with Product, Architecture, Security, and DevOps to align roadmaps, priorities, and outcomes. 
 - Operational Ownership: Own product quality, release readiness, reliability, engineering health, and delivery outcomes across the ERP areas you lead, establishing clear measures and driving continuous improvement. 
 - Partner & Vendor Leadership: Lead effectively across a hybrid model of internal and partner engineering teams, establishing clear technical direction, accountability, ownership, and quality expectations

Qualifications

Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience & Leadership

- 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years leading managers (Director/Senior Director scope) at an ERP product company (SAP, Oracle, Infor, Epicor, IFS, Microsoft Dynamics, Workday, Sage, Unit4 or comparable). Experience at SIs or consultancies alone does not qualify. 
 - Has owned a substantial module, platform, or product line of an ERP product, covering roadmap, quality, and delivery. 
 - Leads multiple teams through managers/senior managers. Not primarily a hands-on architect or single-team manager. 
 - Has worked with Product, Architecture, Services, and Support to turn customer problems into product capabilities. 

Core Technical Foundations & Team Delivery Model

- ERP Product Engineering: Experience with mature enterprise products: large legacy codebases, long-lived customers, customization/extensions, upgrades, backward compatibility, and modernization. 
 - AI & Software Engineering: Strong AI experience remains important. In particular, look for leaders who have applied AI to software development, modernization, or engineering transformation. 
 - Enterprise Software Architecture: Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, APIs, integrations, data, and distributed systems, with the ability to guide technical direction across a large and evolving enterprise product. 
 - Enterprise Product Evolution: Evidence of leading significant product or engineering transformation while continuing to serve an existing enterprise customer base. 
 - Cloud & Modern Engineering: Strong understanding of cloud architectures, preferably AWS, modern development practices, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, security, and modern SDLC practices. 
 - Technical Judgment: Ability to evaluate architectural alternatives and make pragmatic decisions that balance long-term technical direction with customer needs, delivery constraints, cost, risk, and business value. 
 - Partner Delivery Governance: Proven ability to establish technical direction, quality standards, engineering discipline, and accountability across blended internal and third-party engineering organizations. 

The Mindset

- Transformation-Oriented: Sees complexity as something to systematically eliminate rather than permanently accommodate. 
 - AI-Minded: Has a substantive point of view on how AI is changing software development and actively looks for opportunities to apply it to previously difficult problems. 
 - Customer-Focused: Understands that successful modernization must solve real customer problems, not simply produce cleaner technology. 
 - Pragmatic Decision-Maker: Balances future architecture and engineering ideals with the realities of mature enterprise software and existing customers. 
 - Coach & Multiplier: Develops managers and senior engineers and creates organizations capable of operating effectively without constant intervention. 
 - Ownership-Oriented: Takes accountability for outcomes, quality, reliability, and delivery. 
 - Continuous Improver: Consistently challenges existing systems and practices and looks for ways to make them simpler, more scalable, and more effective. 

Why QAD?

You'll be shaping the future of intelligent manufacturing platforms at global scale-working with ambitious leaders, modern cloud technologies, and AI‐driven innovation that delivers real‐world impact. 

Additional Information

- Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation. 
 - Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done. 
 - An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy. 
 - Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

About QAD

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars - Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) - QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days. 

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD's DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work. 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

Your impact will come from the software you build, the technical direction you establish, and your ability to turn uncertainty into progress.

- Own the design and delivery of core capabilities for a new AI-powered product, from exploring an approach to launching it and improving it with customer feedback. 
 - Turn ambiguous product problems into working software. Build prototypes to test assumptions, identify what matters, and make deliberate decisions about what to evolve, rebuild, or stop. 
 - Build LLM-powered workflows and agents, deciding where to use model reasoning, tools, or conventional software to achieve reliable outcomes. 
 - Define what good performance means for AI-powered capabilities. Build evaluations around realistic customer tasks, investigate failures, and use the results to guide improvements. 
 - Shape the backend services, APIs, and data models that let the product evolve quickly. Anticipate scaling needs while keeping early solutions simple. 
 - Partner with teams across Toast to deliver integrations, resolve technical dependencies, and establish clear ownership of shared capabilities. 
 - Work closely with Product and Design to make tradeoffs across customer experience, technical feasibility, reliability, latency, and cost.

 - Extensive experience with an object-oriented language such as Java or Kotlin, with a deep understanding of testing, software design, and engineering best practices. 
 - Experience building and scaling distributed systems and cloud-native services on AWS. 
 - Hands-on experience shipping and operating LLM-powered applications, including agents that use tools or APIs to complete multi-step tasks. 
 - Experience designing and implementing evaluations for AI systems, investigating failures, and using results to improve system behavior. 
 - Demonstrated proficiency using AI coding assistants and coding agents throughout the software development lifecycle, with clear practices for reviewing, testing, and validating their output. 
 - Experience balancing delivery speed with platform stability, security, and reliability, particularly when requirements are evolving.

Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. 

Vanguard India

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. 

Role Summary

This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards. 

An ideal candidate would have 5-8 years of experience in Java, Angular, AWS, springboot and microservices

Responsibilities

- Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products. 
 - Translates technical specifications into code for complex new or enhancement projects for internal clients. Writes programs, develops code, tests artifacts, and produces reports. Employs software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that support automation. 
 - Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads. 
 - Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency. 
 - Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic. 
 - Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards. 
 - Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences. 
 - Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents. 
 - Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. 
 - Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues. 
 - Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities. 
 - Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems. 
 - Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience. 

Qualifications

- Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture. 
 - Bachelor's degree (B. E. /B. Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master's degree/Diploma in Computer Science. 
 - Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning. 
 - Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS , AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python. 
 - Nice to have Skills- Python, Node JS, PostgreSQL, AEM
 - Preferred experience in using AI tools, and exposure in AWS Glue
 - Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows. 
 - AWS Cloud Practitioner certification preferred. 
 - Adobe Experience Manager, AWS Cloud background. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams. 

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered. 

Our mission

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success. 

Our commitment to you

Benefits

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success-at work and in life-with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life: 

Financial wellness

We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs. 

Physical wellness

We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness. 

Personal wellness

We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life. 

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

data.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

About the team

The Agentic AI team is a platform engineering group responsible for building ServiceNow's AI Agents framework, the foundational infrastructure that enables product teams and customers to create intelligent, autonomous agents. We design and develop agentic pipelines using Python and Java, delivering capabilities such as agent reasoning, memory, orchestration, and evaluation at enterprise scale. Beyond core platform development, engineers on this team have the opportunity to contribute to research initiatives in agent learning, agentic evaluation methodologies, and analytics. We embrace the rapidly evolving landscape of LLMs and Agentic AI while maintaining the reliability and performance standards required to operate at ServiceNow's scale. 

What You Get To Do In This Role

Lead the design and architecture of AI solutions, shaping how reasoning, memory, and orchestration come together in production systems. Own end to end delivery from design through deployment, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, and performant. Work hands on with modern AI frameworks and open source SDKs, with a strong emphasis on prompt engineering and pipeline optimization. Stay current with emerging advancements in LLMs and Agentic AI, integrating relevant techniques into our platform roadmap. 

Provide technical leadership by mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and defining best practices that foster a culture of innovation and quality. Partner with product managers, architects, and leadership to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions with measurable impact. Champion observability and evaluation for AI systems, building out logging, metrics, and automated evaluation frameworks for production workloads. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

- Experience leveraging AI or critically evaluating how to integrate AI into work processes, decision making, and problem solving. This may include using AI powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
 - 11 + years of experience designing and implementing complex enterprise applications, with proven success in conversational AI and NLP platforms. 
 - Strong development skills in Java and Python, including building production grade AI or ML systems. 
 - Hands on expertise in LLM powered applications and tooling, including frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph and vendor APIs such as OpenAI and Anthropic. 
 - Deep understanding of agentic reasoning pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and advanced NLP techniques. 
 - Strong problem solving abilities with a bias for action, a customer first mindset, and the ability to operate effectively in fast paced environments. 
 - Demonstrated analytical skills in evaluating model performance, optimizing inference latency and cost, and improving system efficiency end to end. 
 - Proven ability to translate complex AI concepts into clear business value and communicate effectively with both technical and non technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience providing technical leadership and guiding successful AI or ML engineering projects across teams or domains. 
 - Bonus qualifications include publications, technical blogs, conference talks, or open source contributions in LLMs, GenAI, or AI systems engineering. 

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys operational challenges and problem-solving in a dynamic cloud environment and wants to see their work through to completion.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Hardware Management and AI-Driven Fleet Reliability
data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring processMinimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e. g. , Go, Python, C/C++, Java, Rust, etc), and with data structures and algorithms. 
 - 3 years of experience designing and building distributed infrastructure software, bare-metal server lifecycle automation, hardware management integrations (e. g. , Redfish, BMC/iDRAC, Intelligent Platform Management Interface (IPMI), UEFI/BIOS, firmware management), or large-scale fleet monitoring and alerting systems. 
 - Experience with Linux systems programming, networking concepts, and container orchestration. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, a technical related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Experience integrating multi-generation bare-metal server fleets (e. g. , Dell PowerEdge, Google Compute Engine (GCE) Bare Metal, SmartNICs/DPUs, rack Power Distribution Units (PDUs)) with large-scale cloud or first-party fleet management, provisioning, and repair platforms. 
 - Experience architecting high-scale telemetry, monitoring, and alerting pipelines (e. g. , Prometheus/OpenTelemetry exporters, time-series databases, SLO-motivated alerting, automated triage) for physical infrastructure and virtualization stacks. 
 - Experience designing state-machine or workflow-orchestrated machine management pipelines. 
 - Experience with enterprise virtualization stacks (e. g. , VMware vSphere/ESXi, vSAN, NSX, VCF). 

About the jobGoogle Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Google Cloud accelerates every organization's ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google's cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. 

Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end, state-motivated workflows for bare-metal server provisioning, independent hardware/firmware bundle rollouts and secure physical hardware decommissioning. 
 - Build end-to-end hardware and infrastructure observability pipelines and design high-signal, low-noise alerting and Service Level Objective (SLO) dashboards that drive sub-30-minute incident detection. 
 - Design and build seamless software integrations and abstraction layers between Google Cloud VMware Engine (GCVE) bare-metal infrastructure and Google's first-party hardware lifecycle, provisioning, repair, fleet management platforms. 
 - Design and implement high-reliability recovery orchestration including one-click staggered rack/row power-up, automated thermal protection shutdowns, and deterministic host/cluster restoration. 
 - Apply Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) models, time-series anomaly detection, and agentic Root Cause Analysis (RCA) workflows over hardware telemetry, system logs, and crash dumps to predict imminent hardware failures. 

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .
