About Us

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here. 

Position Overview

As an Engineer - Compute Virtualization, you will join the engineering team responsible for building, supporting, and improving compute and

virtualization capabilities. Approximately 6 months or more of apprenticeship, internship, training, or equivalent hands-on experience in infrastructure, software engineering, cloud, virtualization, or related technologies. 

You should understand core concepts across compute infrastructure, virtualization, operating systems, networking, storage, automation, and cloud technologies. A successful engineer progressively builds a strong foundation in compute virtualization and infrastructure, becomes more confident troubleshooting technical problems, contributes to automation and engineering work, takes increasing ownership of assigned responsibilities, and becomes a dependable member

of the team. We value curiosity, accountability, teamwork, and a strong desire to learn and grow. 

What You Will Do

- Build practical knowledge of compute, server virtualization, and infrastructure through deployment, configuration, testing, and support. 
 - Troubleshoot Linux/Ubuntu, virtualization, networking, infrastructure, and application issues with guidance from experienced engineers. 
 - Gain hands-on experience with Ansible, infrastructure APIs, automation, and configuration management. 
 - Develop Go engineering practices, including Git, code reviews, testing, debugging, documentation, and design discussions. 
 - Use metrics, logs, dashboards, and alerts to monitor services and participate in production support. 
 - Document and share technical findings, procedures, troubleshooting steps, and lessons learned. 
 - Collaborate across teams, communicate progress and blockers, and take on increasingly complex responsibilities as skills grow. 

Technical Qualifications

Familiarity with some of the following areas is expected: 

- Server virtualization concepts and terminology, including virtual machines, hypervisors, hosts, clusters, CPU, memory, and resource allocation. 
 - Linux, preferably Ubuntu, including common commands and basic administration and troubleshooting. 
 - Fundamental compute, storage, and networking concepts, including IP addressing, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, load balancing, high availability, and persistent versus ephemeral compute. 
 - Git and basic software-development practices; exposure to at least one low level programming language. Go/Golang experience is an advantage, not a requirement. 
 - REST APIs; familiarity with gRPC is an advantage. 
 - Automation or configuration-management concepts; exposure to Ansible is preferred. 
 - Testing concepts such as unit, integration, and automated testing. 
 - Cloud infrastructure concepts and how compute resources are provisioned and managed. 
 - Container technologies such as Docker, containerd, or Kubernetes, and monitoring/logging tools such as Grafana, InfluxDB, or the ELK stack, are advantages.

- Curiosity & learning: You investigate how systems work, ask thoughtful questions, learn from experienced engineers, and apply feedback. 
 - Accountability: You take ownership of assigned tasks, communicate when blocked or when help is needed, follow through on commitments, and learn from mistakes. 
 - Teamwork: You collaborate respectfully with engineers and partner teams, share what you know, learn from others, and contribute where needed. 
 - Problem solving: You approach problems logically, gather evidence from logs, documentation, error messages, and system behavior, and break larger problems into manageable pieces. 
 - Communication: You communicate technical information clearly in written and verbal form, document what you learn, and openly share progress, questions, and blockers. 

Education & Experience

experience.

Do you firmly believe that code talks, and just about anything else walks?

At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, "Who are you working for?"-a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and deploy autonomous multi-agent workflows using orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, or similar, including complex state machines with conditional routing, parallel execution, and error recovery patterns. 
 - Architect graph-based agent workflows with 10+ nodes involving agent collaboration, task decomposition, and sequential/parallel execution across multiple business domains. 
 - Develop and maintain reusable agent node libraries, extensible platform patterns, versioning strategies, and testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end) for agent workflows. 
 - Build production-grade FastAPI applications with async I/O patterns, integrating PostgreSQL, Redis, and external enterprise services. 
 - Implement real-time agent streaming using Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSocket protocols, alongside RESTful and event-driven API architectures for agent orchestration. 
 - Integrate cloud-based LLM providers (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4) and design prompt management systems with versioning, templating, and dynamic compilation. 
 - Implement conversation state persistence using Redis checkpointing and build tool-calling protocols (Model Context Protocol, function calling) for external data sources and APIs. 
 - Develop hybrid intelligence patterns combining LLM reasoning with rule-based logic and statistical analysis, and build response transformation pipelines for structured analytical outputs. 
 - Integrate observability platforms (Langfuse, LangSmith, or similar) to enable end-to-end agent tracing, telemetry, performance monitoring, and cost optimization across production workflows. 
 - Implement evaluation frameworks measuring agent success rates, reasoning quality, and output accuracy, while continuously optimizing token usage and LLM costs. 
 - Ensure enterprise security integration (LDAP, SSO, access control), robust error handling, and compliance with data governance and Responsible AI standards. 
 - Partner with data engineers, business analysts, and UX teams to translate requirements into scalable agent workflows and streaming interfaces. 
 - Mentor junior engineers on async Python patterns, agent design, and LLMOps best practices; participate in architecture reviews and contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline. 
 - 9+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years building and deploying production LLM-powered applications. 
 - Proven experience with: 
 - Agentic orchestration frameworks: LangGraph (preferred), LangChain, CrewAI, Autogen, or similar. 
 - Cloud LLM providers: AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or OpenAI GPT-4. 
 - Production async web frameworks, particularly FastAPI. 
 - Docker containerization, Git version control, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 
 - Expert-level async Python programming (asyncio, async/await patterns). 
 - Demonstrated experience building autonomous agent systems performing multi-step tasks beyond simple chatbots, including conditional logic, state management, and tool-calling patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of agentic design patterns including ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and tool-use agents. 
 - Experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with LLMOps practices, observability tooling (Langfuse, LangSmith), and prompt engineering at scale (templating, versioning, optimization). 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams. 
 - Prior experience in global life sciences, especially in the GPS functional area, is a plus. 
 - Experience managing or collaborating with offshore technical development teams and diverse international stakeholders is a plus.

Company Details: 

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people's lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.

Job Details: 

Job Summary: Join Cubic Transportation Systems as a V&V Engineer, where you'll play an important role in validating product functionality, identifying defects, and ensuring reliable, high-quality solutions for our customers. 

In this role, you'll work across manual testing, system-level validation, and Hardware-Software Integration Testing (H-SIT), collaborating closely with engineering teams to investigate issues and improve product quality. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to test planning, requirements traceability, defect management, and customer-facing test reviews. 

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities: 

- Plan and execute tests: Develop test plans, test cases, and functional test specifications for subsystem, system, device, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Validate hardware and software integration: Perform H-SIT to verify that hardware and software components work together as expected. 
 - Drive product quality: Execute manual and exploratory tests, identify defects, investigate issues, and collaborate with development teams to resolve them. 
 - Manage testing activities: Track test progress, coordinate execution schedules, maintain requirements traceability, and report testing status, risks, and outcomes. 
 - Document and communicate results: Prepare test completion reports, daily status updates, and clear documentation of test findings. 
 - Collaborate across teams: Work closely with engineering teams, project stakeholders, and customers to support testing activities and resolve queries. 
 - Support customer-facing testing: Participate in test reviews and, where required, conduct testing in the presence of customers. 
 - Maintain test environments: Help configure and maintain test environments and support reliability and environmental testing activities. 
 - Share knowledge: Contribute to test documentation, training materials, and knowledge-sharing activities to strengthen team capabilities. 
 - Improve testing practices: Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, processes, and efficiency, including test automation where applicable. 
 - Support team development: Contribute to knowledge sharing, mentoring, and other team activities as needed. 

Minimum Job Requirements: 

Mandatory Skills And Experience

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in an engineering discipline, or relevant industry experience
 - Two (2)+ years years of relevant experience in product testing, software QA, or a Verification & Validation (V&V) environment. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in manual testing and exploratory testing. 
 - Practical experience with Hardware-Software Integration Testing (H-SIT). 
 - Experience preparing, maintaining, and executing test cases and test plans. 
 - Good understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and software testing methodologies.

data.description:
Job Description

Job Summary: 

At Emerson, we help the world run safer and smarter. As a global leader in automation, our Analytical Instruments organization develops advanced technologies and solutions that safeguard industries and keep critical systems running. 

Join our Liquid Analysis team in Pune, India, as an Embedded Software Test Engineer - where you'll work on testing new and legacy products for process analytical equipment that protects water quality, supports life sciences, strengthens industrial safety, and serves industries worldwide. 

If you enjoy software, automation, and understanding how complex systems really behave, this is an opportunity to help build the test capabilities behind our next generation of products and work side-by-side with development to engineer quality into the product from the beginning - become part of a team that's growing, learning, and focused on delivering results!

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test systems, frameworks, and tools for embedded products and software. 
 - Develop automated integration, system, regression, and verification tests, while supporting hands-on manual testing when needed. 
 - Partner with software, systems, hardware, and test engineers to build alignment, clarify requirements and risks, and develop effective test solutions with meaningful test coverage. 
 - Build test capabilities for embedded communications, networking, hardware interfaces, and complex system behaviors. 
 - Troubleshoot product and test-system failures using debugging, instrumentation, logs, data analysis, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Follow and help strengthen established test engineering practices aligned with our SDLA and IEC 62443-4-1, including requirements traceability, reviews, documentation, cybersecurity testing, and objective test evidence. 
 - Contribute to the test strategy and breakdown of verification work, helping define what to test, how to test it, and how testing can be automated effectively. 
 - Explore and apply AI, automation technologies, and engineering tools to improve test coverage, efficiency, maintainability, and problem solving. 

Who You Are: 

You take on the challenge of unfamiliar tasks. 

You deal constructively with problems that do not have clear solutions or outcomes. 

You grow from hardships and negative experiences

You partner with others to get work done. 

You admit mistakes and gain insight from experiences. 

Korn Ferry Competencies: Nimble Learning, Manages Ambiguity, Being Resilient, Collaborates, Demonstrates Self-awareness

For This Role, You Will Need: 

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science from an engineering school required. 
 - Minimum of six (6) years of applicable experience

Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart: 

- Strong programming skills in Python and C#, with experience building maintainable test automation software. 
 - Hands-on experience developing automated test frameworks, tools, and reusable test libraries for embedded products. 
 - Experience testing embedded systems, microcontrollers, hardware/software interfaces, and real-time systems. 
 - Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD or continuous integration environments. 
 - Experience with Ethernet/TCP-IP, serial interfaces, and industrial communication protocols. 
 - Experience with requirements-based verification, traceability, and secure software development lifecycle practices. 
 - Experience designing or integrating test fixtures, instrumentation, data acquisition, or hardware-in-the-loop test systems. 
 - Experience leading test automation or verification efforts, including developing test strategies and breaking complex verification work into executable test activities. 
 - Experience applying AI-assisted engineering tools to test development, test generation, failure analysis, or engineering productivity. 
 - Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and technical communication skills. 

Why Join Our Team?

We're building the next generation of Liquid Analysis products around a highly visible program with significant market potential. It's real embedded engineering across software, electronics, sensors, communications, automation, cybersecurity, and test. We're also growing the software team around it, so people joining now can influence not only the products, but architecture, automation, engineering practices, AI, and how the team works. 

Our Culture & Commitment to You: 

Clarity → Quality → Speed. We want curious people who jump in, learn fast, communicate openly, ask questions, challenge constructively, work through disagreements, and then align and move. Development and test are partners, and quality belongs to the whole engineering team. 

At Emerson, we are committed to fostering a culture where every employee is valued and respected for their unique experiences and perspectives. We believe a diverse and inclusive work environment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas and diversity of thoughts, that inspires innovation and brings the best solutions to our customers. This philosophy is fundamental to living our company's values and our responsibility to leave the world in a better place. Learn more about our Culture & Values and about Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Emerson. If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability. administrator@emerson. com.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform.

Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer - Agentic Systems to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Exposure Management & Security Operations department. 

In this role, you will lead the architecture and delivery of large-scale AI/ML infrastructure and production pipelines, mentor team members, and drive strategic technical initiatives across the organization. You bring a deep understanding of building and operating distributed AI systems at scale and translating business challenges into reliable, production-grade AI platforms.

 - You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust. 
 - You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Make Your Mark

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a crucial role in delivering high quality releases to our customers by defining application architecture, designing, developing, troubleshooting, maintaining, optimizing, and scaling BlackLine's cloud-based backend services and driving innovation into our product suite. In this role, you will work with management to identify strategic directions for system architecture. You will research, test, benchmark and evaluate new technologies, propose scaling solutions, collaborate with other teams to define, and build new features, optimize existing features while writing elegant code, coaching, and mentoring less experienced software engineers and communicating with people at all levels. In this position, every bit of your software design skill be drawn upon in order to drive towards and implement best of breed features in a rapid iterative environment. Your attention to detail, tenacity, and creative problem-solving and thinking ahead will directly impact the company's success, as well as the success of your peers across the organization. If you have a passion for delivering products that make a difference, are driven to make things better in all that you do and are eager to work in a collaborative agile environment where Developers are dedicated to solving customer problems and innovating, you will be a great fit for the team. 

You'll Get To

We are looking for an accomplished, hands-on Principal Engineer with 18+ years of software engineering experience and a strong record of setting technical direction in Agentic AI, Generative AI systems and Software/Data engineering. This is the most senior individual contributor role on the Agentic AI platform. You will set the multi-year technical vision and own the architecture across products, while staying close enough to the code to make the critical calls. You will guide Senior Staff Engineers, Staff Engineers and Technical Leads across several teams. 

The ideal candidate has led 5+ enterprise-scale AI programs from strategy and solution design through to production at scale, and has shaped platform architecture that several product teams build on. You can define an organization-wide AI architecture strategy and present it to executives, and you can also prototype and write production-grade Python when a problem needs it. You bring the vision to set direction across teams, the judgment to make high-stakes architecture and investment decisions, and the credibility to raise the engineering bar across the company. 

The role spans strategy, architecture and execution. You will set the AI platform roadmap, define the governance and trust frameworks that make agents enterprise-ready on a secure, compliant financial platform, and establish the engineering standards that every AI product team follows. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Strategy & Vision

- Define and own the multi-year technical strategy and architecture roadmap for the Agentic AI platform across all product lines. 
 - Make build-vs-buy, technology selection and platform investment decisions, and present the trade-offs, risks and ROI to executive leadership. 
 - Track the agentic AI landscape: frameworks, protocols, models, regulation. Turn those shifts into strategic bets and platform direction. 
 - Identify new opportunities where AI can deliver business value across product areas, and shape them into fundable programs. 

Architecture Leadership

- Own the end-to-end architecture of the Agentic AI system: agent registry, policy engine, metrics ingestion pipeline, anomaly detection and HITL orchestration. 
 - Define the reference architecture for multi-agent systems: trust tier boundaries (T0-T3), separation of concerns, fault isolation and full observability. 
 - Set organization-wide patterns for data flows, integrations (REST, gRPC, SSE, event-driven) and storage strategies for AI workloads in a multi-tenant FinTech environment. 
 - Own the design principles for durable DAG execution, pause and resume of long-running financial close workflows, event-sourced audit trails and SLA-tracked HITL approval gates. 
 - Run the architecture governance process: ADRs, cross-team design reviews and production readiness assessments for critical systems. 

Technical Leadership & Organizational Influence

- Split the platform into programs and workstreams. Assign ownership to Senior Staff and Staff Engineers, with clear API contracts, interface definitions and success metrics. 
 - Act as the senior technical authority for Engineering, Product, Security, Compliance, Finance and Data Platform leaders, and align architecture decisions across organizations. 
 - Represent the AI Platform in executive and cross-functional technical forums, and externally at industry events, through publications and in partner discussions. 
 - Find and resolve cross-team technical dependencies and systemic risks early in planning. 

Mentorship & Talent Development

- Grow Senior Staff Engineers, Staff Engineers and Technical Leads into the next generation of technical leaders through architecture working sessions, design clinics and 1: 1 coaching. 
 - Review designs from senior engineers. Find gaps in governance, observability or compliance thinking and guide them to better solutions rather than overriding them. 
 - Shape technical hiring standards and help attract top senior talent to the organization. 

Engineering Standards & Governance

- Define and drive adoption of engineering standards across all AI product teams: agent identity patterns, audit trail requirements, HITL design principles, Kafka topic design and eval harness setup. 
 - Set the quality bars: performance benchmarks, eval thresholds, observability standards and security posture. 
 - Own the agent governance and certification framework, including the T1 agent certification pipeline and its evaluation harnesses for model quality, factuality and safety at scale. 
 - Drive the production rollouts and release readiness for all releases
 - Support the on-call and be the first point of contact for any incidents reported internally or from customers

Hands-on Technical Depth

- Step in directly on the hardest problems with code, prototypes, design sketches or paired debugging: novel system design, complex integrations, critical production incidents. This is not a review-only role. 
 - Guide the design and delivery of intelligent agents for complex, multi-step financial reasoning, using ReAct, Plan-and-Execute and other advanced reasoning strategies. 
 - Set the orchestration strategy across LangGraph, Temporal, Google Workflows or equivalent, with documented architectural reasoning. 
 - Define deployment architecture on GCP (Vertex AI Agent Builder, Cloud Run, GKE) or AWS/Azure equivalents, including Kubernetes namespace isolation for T1 certified partner agents. 
 - Shape MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and client patterns for external agent integration (T2/T3 trust tiers via SSE/HTTPS). 
 - Guide RAG architecture with vector stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) for retrieval over domain-specific financial documents. 
 - Lead model strategy across foundation models (Gemini, GPT-4, Claude), covering fine-tuning, prompt engineering and evaluation for accounting tasks such as close commentary and variance explanation. 
 - Own the inference cost strategy: caching, batching, model routing and quantization. Keep token costs visible in Control Tower. 

Required

What You'll Bring: 

- 18+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time as a senior or principal-level technical leader. 
 - A record of setting technical strategy and architecture across multiple teams or product lines. 
 - Led 5+ enterprise-scale AI/ML or GenAI programs from strategy through to production at scale. 
 - Deep expertise in agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, LLM evaluation and AI governance. 
 - Strong hands-on proficiency in Python and distributed systems design. 
 - Extensive experience with cloud-native architecture on GCP, AWS or Azure, including Kubernetes and event-driven systems such as Kafka. 
 - Proven ability to influence executives and align technical direction across Engineering, Security, Compliance and Business stakeholders. 
 - Experience mentoring Senior Staff and Staff Engineers into senior technical leaders. 

Preferred

- Experience building AI systems in regulated industries: FinTech, financial close, accounting or audit. 
 - Familiarity with SOX, audit trail and compliance-by-design patterns. 
 - Industry visibility through patents, publications, conference talks or open-source contributions. 

Thrive At BlackLine Because You Are Joining

- A technology-based company with a sense of adventure and a vision for the future. Every door at BlackLine is open. Just bring your brains, your problem-solving skills, and be part of a winning team at the world's most trusted name in Finance Automation!
 - A culture that is kind, open, and accepting. It's a place where people can embrace what makes them unique, and the mix of cultural backgrounds and varying interests cultivates diverse thought and perspectives. 
 - A culture where BlackLiner's continued growth and learning is empowered. BlackLine offers a wide variety of professional development seminars and inclusive affinity groups to celebrate and support our diversity. 

BlackLine is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, race, ethnicity, age, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, ancestry, color, marital status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault or stalking, medical condition, genetic information, or any other protected class or category recognized by applicable equal employment opportunity or other similar laws. 

BlackLine recognizes that the ways we work and the workplace itself has shifted. We innovate in a workplace that optimizes a combination of virtual and in-person interactions to maximize collaboration and nurture our culture. Candidates who live within a reasonable commute to one of our offices will work in the office at least 3 days a week. 

Accommodations

BlackLine is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation that would better enable your success during the application or interview process, please complete this form.

The Role: 

We are looking for a deeply technical, hands-on Blue Prism specialist who can work across automation development, production operations, solution architecture, platform engineering, and technical problem-solving. 

This is an individual contributor role. It is not a delivery-management, project-management, or people-management position. The successful candidate will be expected to personally design, build, troubleshoot, deploy, support, and improve enterprise-grade Blue Prism solutions. 

This role is suited to engineers who enjoy working directly with technology, solving complex production issues, understanding systems end to end, and expanding their skills across multiple technologies as the automation landscape evolves. 

What You Will Get To Do: 

- Design, build, test, deploy, and support complex enterprise automation solutions using Blue Prism

 - Develop reusable, scalable, and maintainable Blue Prism processes and business objects

 - Ability to independently convert business requirements into technically sound automation designs

data.title: Principal AI Engineer nterprise Transformation
data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions. 

The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It sets architecture and standards, builds reusable capability, and delivers through a combination of internal engineering and external implementation partners. This is one of six foundational hires and the first dedicated engineering hire in the team. 

Job Description

The Senior AI Engineer is the primary builder in the CoE. You will take prioritised workflows from architecture and PRD through to working, evaluated, production-grade AI systems - and, just as importantly, factor what you build into a reusable component library so that the fifth workflow costs a fraction of the first. 

This is an applied engineering role with unusually high leverage. You are not building one product; you are building the components, patterns and reference implementations that internal engineers and external partner pods will use to build many. The work spans retrieval, agent orchestration, evaluation, and the unglamorous production engineering - latency, cost, failure handling, observability - that separates a demo from a system the business can depend on. 

Where this role sits

Reports to: Head of the AI Centre of Excellence

Technical direction from: Lead AI Architect - you will work alongside them daily, and you are expected to push back when a design will not survive contact with production

Works with: The functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the workflows, PRDs and quality bar for the business functions in scope

Also partners with QAD engineering teams, Data & Platform Engineering, Security & GRC, and external system integrators

Scope: Foundational engineering hire. Expect to set the engineering standard, mentor subsequent hires, and review partner-delivered code. 

Key Responsibilities

Building AI and agentic workflows

- Build production AI and agentic workflows end to end - from PRD and architecture through implementation, evaluation, release and iteration in production. 
 - Design and implement agent orchestration: multi-step flows, tool and API invocation, planning and routing, state and memory, retries, fallbacks, timeouts and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Make the judgement call on deterministic control flow versus model-driven control flow - and default to the former wherever it produces the same outcome more reliably and more cheaply. 
 - Integrate with enterprise systems - ERP, CRM, support, services delivery, knowledge and data platforms - including systems with imperfect APIs and imperfect data. 

Retrieval and context engineering

- Own the retrieval stack: corpus onboarding, document parsing, chunking strategy, embedding selection, hybrid lexical and vector search, reranking, metadata filtering and query transformation. 
 - Implement permission-aware retrieval so that a user or an agent can only ever retrieve what that identity is entitled to see - non-negotiable in an enterprise context. 
 - Handle freshness and incremental indexing so that retrieval reflects the state of the business rather than a snapshot from onboarding day. 
 - Measure retrieval quality explicitly and treat it as a tunable subsystem with its own metrics, not as an assumption. 

Model selection, tuning and evaluation

- Select, tune and route models across tiers based on measured quality, latency and cost - not on reputation or recency. 
 - Own prompt engineering, versioning, structured output and context strategy as versioned, tested artefacts under source control. 
 - Apply fine-tuning, adapters or distillation only where evidence shows the return justifies the operating burden - and be able to make that argument either way. 
 - Build the evaluation harness: golden datasets, offline evaluation, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, regression suites running in CI, and online quality monitoring with structured feedback capture. 
 - Work with the Engagement Specialists to turn a business quality bar into measurable criteria - and be honest when a workflow does not clear it. 

The reusable component library

- Design, build and maintain the shared component library - SDKs, shared services, templates, reference implementations and documentation - that both internal engineers and partner pods build against. 
 - Treat internal engineers and SI teams as customers of your library: versioning, backwards compatibility, examples, and documentation good enough that people use it without asking you. 
 - Review partner-delivered code and designs for conformance, quality and maintainability. 

Production engineering and operations

- Meet explicit latency and cost budgets per workflow, using caching, batching, streaming, model tiering and prompt efficiency. 
 - Build for graceful degradation: provider outages, rate limits, backpressure, partial failures and safe fallbacks. 
 - Implement observability for non-deterministic systems - full step-level tracing, token and cost telemetry, quality dashboards, and a triage path for incidents where nothing crashed but the output was wrong. 
 - Own infrastructure as code, CI/CD, environment promotion, secret and credential handling, and testing discipline for everything the CoE ships. 
 - Participate in the operational support model for live AI workflows, including post-incident review and remediation. 

Craft and team

- Set the engineering standard for the CoE and raise it as the team grows. 
 - Mentor subsequent engineering hires and partner engineers. 
 - Document decisions and trade-offs so that the next engineer inherits reasoning, not just code. 

Qualifications

What we are looking for

Essential

- 6+ years of professional software engineering, including 2+ years building and operating production LLM or GenAI systems - systems with real users and real operating cost, not notebooks or proofs of concept. 
 - Excellent Python, plus working competence in at least one other language (TypeScript, Go, Java or similar). 
 - Genuine production retrieval experience - you have built a RAG or hybrid search system, measured it, found it wanting, and improved it. 
 - Agent orchestration experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Google ADK, Strands, CrewAI or equivalent - together with the judgement to know when a framework is the wrong answer. 
 - Strong AWS and/or GCP experience, including managed AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Vertex AI or equivalent) alongside core compute, serverless, networking, IAM and managed data services. 
 - API design and enterprise integration, including authentication and authorisation patterns - OAuth 2. 0 / OIDC, service-to-service authentication, and delegated or on-behalf-of access. 
 - Containerisation, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK or equivalent), CI/CD and real testing discipline. 
 - Evaluation rigour - you can define what "good" means numerically for a subjective task, defend the definition, and act on the result. 
 - Cost and latency awareness as a design instinct, not an afterthought raised by finance. 
 - Clear written communication - design notes, documentation and honest status. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities in an early-stage function. 

Strongly Preferred

- Vector and hybrid search infrastructure at production scale - OpenSearch, pgvector, Vertex AI Search, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate or similar. 
 - Evaluation and observability tooling - LangSmith, Langfuse, Phoenix, Braintrust, Ragas, DeepEval or equivalent. 
 - Multi-tenant SaaS engineering, and the data isolation discipline that comes with it. 
 - ERP, manufacturing or supply chain data experience. 
 - Classical ML and MLOps background - feature stores, model registries, monitoring and drift. 
 - Fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, or model serving and optimisation. 
 - Experience building internal platforms or SDKs consumed by other engineers. 
 - Open-source contribution in the AI engineering ecosystem. 

The technical environment

A predominantly AWS estate with a meaningful GCP footprint, multi-tenant SaaS products, ERP and manufacturing data, and a heterogeneous set of enterprise systems across CRM, support, services delivery, marketing and data platforms. Engineering capacity is a mix of internal team and external implementation partners. 

The AI toolchain is not fixed. You will help select it - and then live with the consequences, which is the correct incentive. 

What This Role Is Not

- Not a prompt engineering role. Prompting is one component of a system that also has retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, infrastructure and an operating cost. 
 - Not a research scientist role. We are not training foundation models. We are shipping reliable systems on top of them. 
 - Not a specification-writing role. You will build, and you will read partner code line by line. 
 - Not a role where quality is somebody else's problem. If it goes to production, you own how well it works. 

What Success Looks Like

First 3 months

- The first prioritised workflow in production or at production readiness, with a working evaluation harness behind it. 
 - Baseline engineering standards operating - repository structure, CI/CD, environments, tracing, secret handling. 
 - A shared understanding with the architect and the Engagement Specialists of what "good" means, expressed as numbers. 

First 6 months

- The first version of the reusable component library in use - by you, by internal engineers, and by at least one partner pod. 
 - Multiple workflows live, with quality, latency and cost per transaction instrumented and visible. 
 - Regression evaluation running in CI, so a change that degrades quality fails before release rather than in front of a customer. 

First 12 months

- Demonstrably lower build cost and cycle time for each successive workflow, attributable to reuse. 
 - A production estate that is operable by the team - monitored, documented, supported, and not dependent on any one person. 
 - Partner-delivered code that meets the same standard as internal code, because the standard and the review are real. 

How We Assess

- Technical conversation on a production AI system you built - architecture, evaluation approach, what broke, what you would do differently. 
 - Practical exercise in retrieval or agent orchestration, discussed rather than graded in isolation. 
 - Code and design review - you review something of ours, we review something of yours. 
 - Collaboration interview with the CoE and a functional stakeholder. 

Additional Information

- Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation. 
 - Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done. 
 - An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy. 
 - Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

About QAD

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars - Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) - QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days. 

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD's DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work. 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

data.description:
We are seeking a Staff Specialist to join the Infrastructure, Methodology and Automation team. The team defines the methodologies, tools, and automation used for automotive microcontroller software development and validation

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

- Define and evolve development and validation methodologies for automotive microcontroller software, and turn them into practical tools, templates, and automated workflows. 
 - Gather requirements from software, validation, and platform teams, and translate them into architecture, detailed design, and high-quality implementation. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain Python-based frameworks, CLI tools, libraries, and services that automate build, configuration, code generation, test, and validation activities. 
 - Design and build **agentic AI pipelines** that automate engineering tasks
 - Build GenAI solutions using prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over specifications and code bases, embeddings and vector search, and tool-calling and multi-agent orchestration. Evaluate output quality, safety, latency, and cost. 
 - Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines for build, test, static analysis, coverage, packaging, and release. Apply MLOps/LLMOps practices for model, prompt, and agent versioning, evaluation, and deployment. 
 - Drive tools and frameworks that scale across multiple projects and sites, with a focus on robustness, operability, and supportability. 
 - Uphold coding standards, and conduct code and design reviews using OOP principles and design patterns. 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues across toolchains, pipelines, and embedded targets, and drive root-cause analysis and timely resolution. 
 - Collaborate with product owners, architects, software and validation teams, QA, and DevOps to define requirements, acceptance criteria, and release plans. 
 - Produce and maintain documentation for methodologies, frameworks, AI components, and pipelines. 
 - Promote continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and responsible AI adoption across the organization. 

Your profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

- 6-8 years of software engineering experience
 - 5+ years of hands-on Python development
 - 1-2+ years of applied AI/ML or GenAI experience in real project
 - Strong Python skills, including object-oriented design, design patterns, packaging, typing, and async/concurrency. 
 - CI/CD experience (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), including pipeline design, release automation, and artifact management. 
 - Experience building tools and automation for large-scale, multi-team or multi-site deployment. 
 - Understanding of Git and collaborative workflows (branching strategies, pull requests, code review). 
 - Clean, maintainable, well-documented code with strong attention to quality and reliability. 
 - Excellent communication skills, strong teamwork, and a proactive mindset. 

Preferred / Good-to-Have

- Knowledge of automotive development processes and standards, including ISO 26262 (functional safety) and Automotive SPICE. 
 - Experience with AUTOSAR and related tooling (e. g. , EB Tresos, Vector DaVinci Configurator). 
 - Experience with automotive microcontroller platforms (e. g. , Infineon AURIX, NXP S32, Renesas RH850) and their toolchains. 
 - Experience with SIL/HIL validation, test automation tools, and requirements/traceability tools (e. g. , DOORS, Polarion, Jama)

Title: Tech Lead - Azure Integration Services- Husky (Guindy, Chennai)

Id: 20855

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

Do you want to lead the integration backbone that connects systems, data, and business processes across the enterprise?

As Tech Lead for our API & Integration team, you'll drive the technical direction of a critical integration landscape built on the Azure integration stack. You'll shape integration architectures, set engineering standards, and lead by example in code-balancing new integration development with the stabilization and evolution of existing interfaces to ensure reliability, scalability, and security. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who enjoys designing clean APIs, building resilient event and message-driven integrations, and guiding teams through complex system landscapes-turning connectivity challenges into robust, well-governed Azure solutions. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
 - Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD. 
 - Technical direction for the product area. 
 - Contribute to coordinating cross team dependencies and integration points. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Contribute to the feature definition and review. 
 - Generate concepts and facilitate concept selection. 
 - Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks. 
 - Helping with estimation and sprint planning. 
 - Addressing technical impediments. 
 - Own production readiness (incl. non-functional requirements). 

Quality, Governance & Security

- Ensuring code quality. 
 - Conducting meaningful code reviews and ensuring adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) / DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Ensure adherence to applicable standards, policies, and practices (e. g. DevSecOps). 

Incident Response

- Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortems. 

Mentorship & Team Growth

- Mentoring team members. 
 - Documenting key design decisions. 
 - Participate in interviews and hiring decisions. 
 - Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement. 

Collaboration & Communication

- Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams. 
 - Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - Minimum of 10+ years of experience in software development, with at least 5 years focused on integration solutions. 
 - Solid understanding of integration patterns and practices. 
 - Experience with microservices and hybrid integration (On‐Prem/Cloud). 
 - Strong proficiency and hands-on experience in Azure Integration Services (including Azure API Management, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure Data Factory). 
 - Familiarity with RESTful API design, development and lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with programming languages such as C#, PowerShell, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET framework. 
 - Designing integrations with security-by-design principles. 
 - Experience with: Entra ID, Network security (Private Endpoints, VNET integration), Role-based access control (RBAC). 
 - Awareness of compliance and data protection requirements (e. g. , GDPR). 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. 

Assets

- Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Experience with BizTalk Server. 
 - Experience with MuleSoft. 
 - Domain experience in large enterprises (finance, manufacturing, engineering). 

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Technical Software Engineering Lead - Manager

Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)

About The Role

Level: Manager

Are you an experienced Software Engineer who has led the development of world-class software or digital products? Are you looking for an opportunity to expand your scope and lead products used by some of the biggest and most influential businesses around the world? If the answer to these questions is yes, we would like to talk with you. 

Key Responsibilities

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Lead who is not only an exceptional coder but also adept at high-level design and implementation. The ideal candidate will have over 10 years of collaborative development experience, with a proven track record of leading an 8-10-person team. This role involves debugging, performance design and optimization, and working on containerized solutions using Docker. Experience with FastAPI, Python, and React front-end is essential. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead and mentor an 8-10 person engineering team, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment. 
 - Own the architecture across UI, APIs, data, and cloud infrastructure - scalable, secure, resilient, observable
 - Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code in Python and React. 
 - Set and enforce engineering standards: design reviews, ADRs, code review expectations, testing strategy, release readiness. Oversee the development and deployment of containerized solutions using Docker. 
 - Debug and resolve complex technical issues across the full stack. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project requirements and deliverables. 
 - Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices and coding standards. 
 - Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends. 
 - Partner with Product Management and UX as a peer - challenge the "what, " not just deliver the "how. "
 - Drive end-to-end execution: design, build, test, deploy, and run in production. 
 - Be accountable for how the product handles consumer data: privacy, retention, access, and compliance obligations including India's DPDP Act. 
 - Communicate status, risk, and bad news early and clearly to stakeholders. 

The team

ConvergeCONSUMERTM is a product-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer-focused businesses improve decision-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world's largest professional services firm. 

Qualifications Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of professional experience in software development. 
 - Proven experience in leading and managing an engineering team. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and experience with FastAPI. 
 - Solid experience with React for front-end development. 
 - Expertise in high-level design, implementation, and performance optimization. 
 - Authentication and authorization (OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, JWT, SSO, RBAC, least privilege), secure coding, and threat modeling. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and relational data modeling. 
 - Experience building and deploying applications on GCP; working knowledge of Azure or AWS. 
 - Experience with Apache Spark for large-scale data processing. 
 - Working knowledge of quality gates and enforcing code quality standards in the delivery pipeline. 
 - Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills. 
 - Strong communication and leadership skills. 

Experience And Leadership

- 10+ years of end-to-end software development experience, including system design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - At least 2 years of demonstrated people management experience leading medium to large enterprise teams within a product-based organization is mandatory. 
 - Experience leading full-stack engineers with strong expertise across backend services and frontend web applications. 
 - Proven ability to independently drive end-to-end project execution, taking ownership of design, development, cross-team coordination, and delivery in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary development environment. 
 - Experience working in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment with globally distributed and diverse teams. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate with business and delivery teams, mentor engineers, and drive technical decisions from concept through production. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical teams. 

Architecture and Full-Stack Engineering

- Proven ability to design scalable, secure, resilient, and high-performance applications across user interfaces, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with FastAPI are required for backend development. 
 - Experience with microservices architecture, domain-driven design, and RESTful services using technologies such as Java, JavaScript, Node. js, and Spring Boot. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, PostgreSQL, data modeling, and enterprise system integration patterns. 
 - Experience with NoSQL data stores such as DynamoDB and relational data stores such as MySQL and Oracle. 
 - Experience defining technical standards, conducting design reviews, evaluating technology choices, and ensuring adherence to engineering best practices. 

Security, Cloud, and Engineering Excellence

- Deep knowledge of security engineering and authentication and authorization frameworks, protocols, and design patterns, including OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, JWT, single sign-on (SSO), role-based access control (RBAC), and least-privilege access. 
 - Strong understanding of application security, threat modeling, secure coding, vulnerability management, observability, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience working in distributed, cloud-based environments such as AWS services, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Google Compute Engine (GCE), and Azure. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with CI/CD using Jenkins and engineering hygiene practices, including GitHub workflows, branching strategies, pull request reviews, code quality, collaboration, and release readiness. 
 - Experience with test automation and integration testing using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber, and Playwright. 
 - Experience with observability, monitoring, and tracing tools such as New Relic, Splunk, SignalFx, Kibana, and Grafana. 

AI-Enabled Development and Delivery

- , to accelerate development and learning. 
 - Experience delivering generative AI-based solutions or projects. 

Additional Skills and Project Experience

- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. 
 - Experience with database technologies (SQL). 
 - Understanding of Agile methodologies. 

Education

BE/B. Tech/MS/M. Tech degree or equivalent from accredited university

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or another relevant discipline, or equivalent experience. 

Location

Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/Mumbai/Gurgaon/Kolkata

Shift Timings

11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. 

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India . 

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially-and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. 

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

The ideal candidate will have over 10 years of collaborative development experience, with a proven track record of leading an 8-10-person team. This role involves debugging, performance design and optimization, and working on containerized solutions using Docker. Experience with FastAPI, Python, and React front-end is essential. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead and mentor an 8-10 person engineering team, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment. 
 - Own the architecture across UI, APIs, data, and cloud infrastructure - scalable, secure, resilient, observable
 - Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code in Python and React. 
 - Set and enforce engineering standards: design reviews, ADRs, code review expectations, testing strategy, release readiness. Oversee the development and deployment of containerized solutions using Docker. 
 - Debug and resolve complex technical issues across the full stack. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project requirements and deliverables. 
 - Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices and coding standards. 
 - Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends. 
 - Partner with Product Management and UX as a peer - challenge the "what, " not just deliver the "how. "
 - Drive end-to-end execution: design, build, test, deploy, and run in production.

The team
