data.description:
About Rimini Street, Inc. 

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software. 

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects. 

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments. 

We are actively seeking a Sr. Java Full Stack Engineer, This role is based in India, Hyderabad. 

About Rimini Street, India, GCC. 

Rimini Street Inc, HQ : Las Vegas, NV, USA a disruptor in third party ERP support services, established undisputed leadership and as a natural progression, entered India with Rimini Street, India GCC India kick starting operations in Hyderabad, in 2013 with Global Client Onboarding Services, IT shared services and Global Service Development. In no time, Rimini Street, India GCC started Bengaluru operations going up the value chain with more complex product development (Oracle, SAP, Peoplesoft, JDE etc. ) & advanced services (Managed services, Professional services, Security Managed Services etc). 

Rimini Street, India GCC gained valuable share in bringing the reputation to Rimini Street Inc of being a global provider of unified support and managed service solutions for enterprise software. Today, Rimini Street, India GCC is a family of about 800+ full time talented individuals, thanks to the remarkable talent that has supported the expansion. 

Rimini Street, India has nicely emerged as Global Capability Centre (GCC), and proudly says, "if you are best of the best, you belong to Rimini". We are on a mission to contribute significantly to our "Rimini ONE" program, a turnkey Rimini Street service program that offers a comprehensive set of unified, integrated services that can run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize your Oracle and SAP ERP, database, and technology software. 

Position Summary

The Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) is a core member of the Product Delivery engineering team building Rimini Street's Agentic ERP Platform-a strategic product that enables AI agents to interact with legacy ERP systems including SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, and JD Edwards. This role contributes across the full technology stack, from backend platform services and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to AI agent integration and frontend user interfaces. 

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Engineering, this engineer will design, develop, and deliver production-quality software in a modern tech stack spanning Java, Python, and Angular. The ideal candidate is a versatile engineer who thrives working across layers of the stack, takes ownership of features end-to-end, and is energized by building a new platform from the ground up. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Backend Development

- Design and develop backend services using Java 21 and Quarkus, including MCP servers, REST APIs, and platform services. 
 - Build and maintain integration components that connect AI agents to enterprise ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, JD Edwards). 
 - Develop data access layers using PostgreSQL, including working with pgvector for vector storage and similarity search. 
 - Implement resilience patterns (circuit breakers, retries, bulkheads) using Resilience4j for production reliability. 
 - Write clean, testable, well-documented code following established engineering standards and architectural patterns. 

AI & Agent Integration

- Develop AI agent components using Python and frameworks such as Pydantic AI or LangChain4j. 
 - Integrate with LLM services through LiteLLM gateway, implementing prompt templates, tool calling, and response handling. 
 - Build and maintain RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines for contextual knowledge retrieval. 
 - Implement orchestration workflows using Restate for multi-step agent processes with human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 

Frontend Development

- Build user interfaces using Angular and TypeScript, contributing to the platform's component library and design system. 
 - Develop human-in-the-loop interfaces that allow users to supervise, approve, and intervene in agent actions. 
 - Implement responsive, modern layouts using CSS3, Tailwind CSS, and Angular Material or similar component frameworks. 
 - Create dashboards, admin panels, and monitoring views for agent performance and system health. 
 - Build reusable UI components with clean HTML5 semantics, SCSS/CSS architecture, and consistent styling patterns. 
 - Ensure accessible (WCAG compliant), performant frontend experiences across browsers and devices. 
 - Work with design specifications and wireframes to translate UX designs into pixel-accurate implementations. 

Engineering Practices

- Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical design reviews. 
 - Write unit tests, integration tests, and contribute to automated testing frameworks. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development and deployment automation. 
 - Instrument code with OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing, metrics, and logging. 
 - Collaborate with team members across time zones in a virtual team environment. 
 - Contribute to technical documentation, architecture decision records, and knowledge sharing. 

Experience

- 3. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience in full stack development. 
 - Strong backend development experience with Java (Java 11+); experience with Quarkus or Spring Boot. 
 - Working proficiency in Python; experience building services or scripts in Python. 
 - Frontend development experience with Angular (v14+), TypeScript, and modern CSS (Tailwind, SCSS, or CSS-in-JS). 
 - Experience building component libraries or contributing to design systems. 
 - Experience with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL. 
 - Familiarity with RESTful API design and microservices architecture. 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows. 
 - Experience working in agile teams with iterative delivery practices. 

Technical Skills

Required

- Java 11+ (Java 17/21 preferred) with strong understanding of modern Java features. 
 - Experience with Quarkus or Spring Boot for building microservices and REST APIs. 
 - Python proficiency for AI/ML integration work and scripting. 
 - Angular (v14+) and TypeScript for frontend development; strong component architecture skills. 
 - Solid CSS3/SCSS skills including responsive design, flexbox, and grid layouts. 
 - Experience with Tailwind CSS or similar utility-first CSS frameworks. 
 - Proficiency with HTML5 semantics and modern web standards. 
 - PostgreSQL and SQL; experience with data modeling and query optimization. 
 - RESTful API design and implementation; familiarity with OpenAPI/Swagger. 
 - Git version control and collaborative development practices. 
 - Understanding of containerization (Docker) and basic Kubernetes concepts. 

Preferred

- Experience with AI/ML frameworks: Pydantic AI, LangChain, or LangChain4j. 
 - Familiarity with LLM integration patterns, prompt engineering, and tool calling. 
 - Experience with vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant) and embedding models. 
 - Experience with Angular Material, PrimeNG, or similar Angular component libraries. 
 - Knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2. 1) and cross-browser compatibility. 
 - Experience with frontend testing frameworks (Jasmine, Karma, Cypress, or Playwright). 
 - Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent-tool integration patterns. 
 - Experience with Restate, Temporal, or similar workflow orchestration frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or Prometheus for observability. 
 - Experience with enterprise integration patterns: messaging, event-driven architecture, RFC/BAPI. 
 - Knowledge of SAP or Oracle EBS integration technologies. 
 - Experience with Resilience4j or similar resilience libraries. 
 - Familiarity with LiteLLM or similar LLM gateway tools. 

Skills & Competencies

- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to debug complex issues across multiple layers of the stack. 
 - Ownership mentality-takes responsibility for features from design through production deployment. 
 - Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies, frameworks, and domains. 
 - Good communication skills; able to discuss technical approaches clearly with team members. 
 - Attention to detail and commitment to code quality, testing, and documentation. 
 - Collaborative mindset; comfortable working in a distributed team across time zones. 
 - Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment. 
 - Fluent in English (written and verbal). 

Desired Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Experience in enterprise software or platform product development. 
 - Exposure to ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, JD Edwards) in any capacity. 
 - AWS or Kubernetes certifications. 
 - Contributions to open source projects. 

Location & Travel

Location: Hyderabad, India

Travel: Minimal; occasional travel for team meetings or training

Language: Fluent English required (written and verbal)

Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you. 

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs: 

- Company

- Colleagues
 - We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration. 

- Clients
 - We relentlessly pursue solutions that help clients achieve their goals. Our unmatched client care is rooted in our passion for exceptional service. 

- Community
 - We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we've made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities. 
Accelerating Company Growth

- Nasdaq-listed under ticker symbol RMNI since October 2017 
 - Over 6, 300+ signed contracts to date, including Fortune 500 and Global 100 companies
 - Over 2, 000 team members in 23 countries
 - US and international recognition for industry leadership and philanthropic efforts. See all of our awards and recognitions here: https: //www. riministreet. com/company/awards/

Rimini Street is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

To learn more about how Rimini Street is redefining the enterprise software support industry, visit http: //www. riministreet. com

data.description:
We are looking for an experienced Lead Software Engineer / Technical Architect (C13) to drive the technical design, backend architecture, and engineering execution for Vendor Master Central (VMC)-our enterprise platform responsible for centralizing vendor ecosystems, contracts, service catalogs, and complex data enrichment pipelines across Market Data Services. 

This role is backend-first, requiring deep expertise in modern Java microservices, high-volume data ingestion/reconciliation pipelines, relational data architecture, and resilient API design. While the core focus is backend, we are very open to candidates with solid full-stack experience (React/TypeScript) who can champion end-to-end architecture and collaborate seamlessly across the entire stack. 

As a senior technical leader, you will champion modern development practices and leverage cutting-edge GenAI tooling (Devin, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate engineering velocity and deliver robust, scalable platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Backend Leadership

- Architect & Scale Core Services: Lead the technical design and implementation of distributed, cloud-ready Java microservices (Java 21/25, Spring Boot) powering high-volume data ingestion, reconciliation, and enrichment. 
 - Data Pipelines & Ingestion Engines: Architect idempotent data ingestion workflows, transactional staging mechanisms, and validation engines processing heterogeneous financial datasets and hierarchy trees. 
 - API & Domain Design: Design secure, performant RESTful APIs, domain models, and caching strategies supporting high-concurrency enterprise interfaces and downstream consumers. 
 - Full-Stack Collaboration: Partner closely with UI engineers on frontend-backend contracts and state synchronization; provide architectural oversight on React/TypeScript integration for candidate profiles with full-stack capability. 

Engineering Velocity & GenAI Adoption

- Pioneer AI-Accelerated Engineering: Spearhead team-wide adoption of autonomous and assisted AI engineering tools (e. g. , Devin, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) for rapid prototyping, automated code generation, complex refactoring, and test suite creation. 
 - Code Quality & Best Practices: Enforce modern design patterns, domain-driven design (DDD), comprehensive test automation (TDD/BDD), clean architecture, and CI/CD pipelines. 

Technical Leadership & Governance

- Team Mentorship: Lead, coach, and elevate senior engineers (C11/C12) across technical design reviews, coding standards, and architectural decisions. 
 - Enterprise Controls & Security: Ensure system designs adhere to enterprise security standards, role-based access controls (RBAC), SSO authentication, and complete audit traceability. 

What We Are Looking For

Core Backend & Architectural Expertise: 

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with significant experience architecting and delivering enterprise-grade distributed systems. 
 - Deep Modern Java Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of Java 21 / 25, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, and Hibernate/JPA. 
 - Data Modeling & Storage: Strong experience in relational database design (PostgreSQL / Oracle / SQL), complex query optimization, indexing strategies, and transactional integrity. 
 - Pipeline & Ingestion Architecture: Proven track record designing batch/stream data ingestion pipelines, reconciliation logic, and asynchronous processing engines. 
 - RESTful API Architecture: Extensive experience creating well-documented, versioned, and secure REST APIs (OpenAPI / Swagger). 

Full-Stack Openness (Strong Advantage): 

- Experience or strong familiarity with modern frontend frameworks-specifically React, TypeScript, and modern state management-is a significant plus for driving cohesive, end-to-end architecture. 

Modern Tooling & AI Fluency: 

- Hands-on enthusiasm for modern AI-assisted engineering tools (Devin, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLM-driven coding workflows) to drive rapid delivery. 
 - Strong proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, CI/CD automation, and cloud-native observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). 

Leadership & Competencies

- Proven ability to operate with architectural autonomy, translating complex business requirements into elegant technical designs. 
 - Exceptional problem-solving skills and ability to lead incident resolution, performance tuning, and technical strategy. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, able to articulate technical trade-offs to senior leadership. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

We are looking for a QA Manager to own the QA function across Arcitech's product portfolio. This is the senior-most QA seat in the organization. You will set QA strategy across products, manage a team of 8 - 12 QA engineers (including the QA Lead who owns hands-on senior QA beneath you), run QA across 7 - 8 concurrent projects, and be the QA counterpart to product and engineering leadership. Reporting directly to the CEO, you are accountable for the release-readiness of everything Arcitech ships. 

This is a management role, not primarily a hands-on IC role. You are the strategist, the reviewer, and the leader of the function. Hands-on senior QA designing frameworks, running performance tests, writing critical automation sits with the QA Lead beneath you; your job is to set direction, hold the bar, grow the team, and represent QA at the leadership table. That said, on the hardest technical problems and the highest-risk releases, you will still be hands-on particularly on new-product launches and cross-product testing initiatives. Prior experience running QA at a SaaS / IT product company is non-negotiable. Prior experience genuinely managing a QA team of 8+ is non-negotiable. This is a role for someone who has already done this work before, not someone stepping up into it for the first time. 

You will report directly to the CEO. 

Key Responsibilities

QA Strategy & Direction

- Own the QA vision and strategy across the SaaS portfolio. 
 - Define what gets tested manually, what gets automated, and what needs performance testing per product, per release. 
 - Own release-readiness decisions in partnership with product and engineering leadership. 
 - Set priorities across 7-8 concurrent projects; make trade-offs on coverage vs speed explicit. 

Team Management

- Manage a team of 8-12 QA engineers, including the QA Lead as your direct report. 
 - Set clear expectations, run 1: 1s and reviews, and own performance conversations end-to-end. 
 - Grow the team's technical depth in manual, Python + Selenium automation, and performance testing. 
 - Own hiring for the QA team - who joins, at what level, and how they ramp up. 
 - Develop the QA Lead specifically as a senior report with their own career growth needs. 

Quality Bar & Review

- Define and hold the QA quality bar across the whole function. 
 - Review the QA Lead's work and the wider team's work on strategic / high-stakes releases; catch issues before ship. 
 - Own QA process, documentation, and best practices across the SaaS portfolio. 
 - Set the standard through your own review - not by out-executing the Lead. 

Cross-Team Leadership & Business Communication

- Partner with engineering and product leadership on release scope, quality trade-offs, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Represent QA to the CEO and leadership clearly - what's shipping, what's at risk, what needs decisions. 
 - Communicate quality risks in business terms, not QA jargon - impact, likelihood, mitigation, cost. 
 - Coordinate with DevOps on CI/CD integration of automated tests across products. 

Hands-On QA (Selective)

- Personally own the hardest technical problems on high-risk releases when it matters. 
 - Design or review critical automation frameworks and performance test strategies for new-product launches. 
 - Delegate day-to-day execution to the Lead and the team - stay in strategy and review mode by default. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Experience: 6+ years in QA, with at least 3 years in a QA management role
 - Team management (must-have, non-negotiable): proven experience managing a QA team of
 - 8+, including at least 2+ years directly leading a team - real people-management with 1: 1s, reviews, hiring, and performance calls; not just informal mentoring
 - SaaS / IT product background (must-have, non-negotiable): prior QA leadership at a technology / SaaS / IT product company
 - Manual QA depth (must-have): 6+ years of hands-on manual QA experience - deep, thorough process across test planning, execution, defect management, no shortcuts
 - Automation (must-have): 3+ years minimum, hands-on Python + Selenium (not Java). Real frameworks you have built and led teams to build. 
 - Performance testing (must-have): hands-on with performance / load testing tools (JMeter, 
 - Locust, K6, or similar); can design, run, analyze
 - QA strategy (must-have): genuine experience setting QA direction across multiple products or product lines
 - Multi-project (must-have): proven ability to run QA across 7-8 concurrent projects without dropping quality
 - CI/CD integration: hands-on with CI/CD integration of QA (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI); driven CI adoption at team level
 - Communication: clear, senior communicator; can represent QA to the CEO and cross-functional leadership

Nice to Have

- API testing depth (Postman, REST Assured with Python). 
 - SQL / database validation experience. 
 - Experience testing AI-driven products or non-deterministic outputs. 
 - Exposure to security-testing basics. 
 - Prior experience defining or scaling a QA function from small to mid-size. 
 - Experience with observability / monitoring integration for post-release quality signal. 

The Ideal Candidate

- Has genuinely managed a QA team of 8+, and can point to what specifically improved under their leadership. 
 - Has worked inside a technology / SaaS / IT product company for a meaningful part of their career. 
 - Is strong across all three testing disciplines - manual, automation, and performance - not just one. 
 - Can balance strategy, review, team management, and selective hands-on work. 
 - Communicates well with the CEO and leadership; represents QA as a business function, not a purely technical one. 
 - Runs a QA function with process and craft, not chaos and heroics.

data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

As a Design Manager - Treatment, you will lead the multidisciplinary design delivery of complex water treatment, wastewater treatment, and desalination projects. You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, programme certainty, and quality compliance across all stages of project delivery. This includes overseeing process, civil, mechanical, chemical, electrical, and I&C interfaces, ensuring alignment across all design disciplines. 

You will work closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional leadership to plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of treatment projects while also mentoring and strengthening the capability of the broader design team. 

Key duties include

- Development and implementation of multidisciplinary design strategies for water/wastewater treatment and desalination projects, ensuring design integration and coherent execution. 
 - Lead and manage the preparation, coordination, and delivery of design packages for water treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants, desalination facilities, and associated process systems. 
 - Evaluate, compare, and select appropriate treatment technologies and processes for project-specific needs. 
 - Provide leadership in Design for Design‐Build (D for DB) models-ensuring constructability, staging, risk mitigation, and alignment with contractor expectations. 
 - Lead or support HAZOP/HAZID studies, interpret findings, and implement appropriate mitigation measures across treatment process designs. 
 - Own and manage core design management documents Project Responsibility Matrix, Project Organisation Chart, Design Programme, Basis of Design, and Schedule of Deliverables. 
 - Identify and manage inputs from external specialists, JV partners, and sub‐consultants, ensuring their deliverables are fully integrated. 
 - Lead client engagement activities, including workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical discussions. 
 - Facilitate multidisciplinary coordination meetings and proactively manage resolution of design issues to maintain schedule and quality commitments. 
 - Ensure all design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, legislation, and HSE principles, promoting safe design practices. 

We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects. 

Here's what you'll need

Key software tools

- Planning & Coordination Primavera P6 / MS Project
 - Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
 - GIS ArcGIS Pro / QGIS
 - Treatment Modelling (exposure advantageous) RO/ion balance tools, process simulators
 - BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, Revizto

Key Behaviours

- Builds positive, collaborative relationships across diverse teams. 
 - Strong client‐facing presence; personable, approachable, and confident. 
 - Leads through coordination, communication, and engagement. 
 - Drives integrated, high‐quality design solutions across disciplines. 
 - Organised, proactive, and able to resolve complex issues promptly. 
 - Creative, flexible, dependable; champions safety and quality culture. 

Work Experience

- 20+ years of experience in design management within an engineering consultancy or EPC/Design‐Build environment. 
 - Proven experience managing multidisciplinary design teams delivering complex treatment facilities. 
 - Demonstrated capability in delivering Water Treatment/ Wastewater Treatment/ Desalination across preliminary, detailed, and construction design stages. 
 - Strong understanding of PFDs, mass balance development, hydraulic profiles, P&IDs, and preparation of process input documents. 
 - Strong experience in Design for Design‐Build (D for DB), including early contractor engagement, constructability review, and technical risk mitigation. 
 - Experience leading design delivery in BIM‐enabled environments. 
 - Demonstrated interest in digital delivery and innovation, including automation, data‐driven workflows, and continuous improvement. 
 - Strong communication, coordination, leadership, and organisational skills. 
 - Experience in client presentations, tender submissions, and stakeholder management. 
 - Experience in change management, including assessment of design changes, impact analysis, and stakeholder communication. 
 - Working understanding of MTO/BoQ development and coordination with discipline teams for quantity validation. 
 - Ability to develop Level‐of‐Effort (LOE) estimates and support bids, proposals, and design execution plans. 
 - Understanding of project financials, including forecasting, progress tracking, milestone monitoring, and invoicing. 
 - Experience with alternate delivery methods such as Design-Build, EPC, CMAR, or PPP/P3 is an asset. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)
 - Master's degree in relevant field
 - Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Engineer (CEng) is highly desirable

Preferred Attributes

- Experience delivering large multidisciplinary treatment programmes (water, wastewater, or desalination). 
 - Exposure to complex staging, commissioning planning, or brownfield facility expansions. 
 - Experience or understanding of PFAS treatment technologies (e. g. , GAC, IX, RO) is an added advantage. 
 - Awareness of sustainability, circularity, and low‐carbon treatment solutions. 
 - Ability to operate effectively in fast‐paced, contractor‐integrated environments. 

Hybrid Work Expectation Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Job Description

Who You'll Work With

AGNI (Arista Guardian for Network Identity) is Arista's cloud-native SaaS platform for network access control and zero-trust security. It is deployed by enterprises worldwide, both as a managed cloud service and on-premises. The platform handles authentication and authorization for every device that joins a network - using protocols like 802. 1X, RADIUS, EAP-TLS, TACACS+, and PKI - and must work correctly under real network conditions, at scale, every time. 

The AGNI engineering team operates with a strong ownership culture: engineers define the feature, write the code, write the tests, and are accountable for what ships. The test automation team is a first-class engineering function - not a handoff at the end of development, but an integral part of how the team designs and validates the product. 

You will work alongside backend engineers, network protocol specialists, and CloudOps/SRE to build and maintain the automated test infrastructure that validates the entire AGNI platform. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build end-to-end automated test suites for AGNI features - authentication protocol flows, REST API correctness, network policy enforcement, and device onboarding - primarily in Go. 
 - Own test coverage for one or more product domains (e. g. , RADIUS/EAP, TACACS+, captive portal, PKI) end to-end: derive test plans from feature specs, implement the cases, triage failures, and maintain them as the product evolves. 
 - Build and extend internal test utility libraries - simulated RADIUS/EAPOL clients, browser automation, certificate helpers, and REST API wrappers - and know when a gap in the utility layer is the right fix rather than working around it in the test. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis on test failures - distinguish a flaky test from a real product bug, reproduce the bug in a lab environment, and work with backend engineers to resolve it. 
 - Review feature design specifications and write test plans that cover happy paths, boundary conditions, and failure modes before the feature is implemented - shifting quality left, not bolting it on at the end. 
 - Own and improve the Jenkins CI pipelines that run nightly e2e suites against cloud and on-prem deployments: reduce flakiness, improve signal-to-noise, and shorten the feedback loop for engineers. 
 - Contribute targeted fixes to the platform codebase (testability improvements, log clarity, small bug fixes) when the test reveals a clear, bounded issue. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and interns on test design principles, debugging methodology, and the team's test framework. 
 - Participate in incident post-mortems and customer issue reviews - identify gaps in test coverage that allowed a bug to reach production and close them. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related engineering field. 
 - 3-6 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a significant portion in test automation or quality engineering - not just manual testing. 
 - Proficiency in Go or Python for writing production-grade automation code. Experience with Go is strongly preferred. 
 - Solid understanding of Linux from both an administration and debugging perspective: process management, networking tools (tcpdump, openssl, curl), and log analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of enterprise authentication protocols - 802. 1X, RADIUS, EAP variants (EAP-TLS, PEAP, TEAP), TACACS+, or PKI/certificate management. You need to be able to read a packet trace and understand what went wrong. 
 - Hands-on experience with REST API testing - designing test cases, validating responses, and building reliable API clients in code. 
 - Experience with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) - writing pipeline stages, triaging failures, and improving reliability. 
 - Strong debugging instinct: given a test failure and a log, you can form and test a hypothesis independently. Clear written communication - test plans, bug reports, and post-mortem write-ups that other engineers can act on without follow-up. 

Good To Have

- Experience with containerization (Docker) and basic cloud environments (GCP/AWS). 
 - Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana) - knowing which metrics to pull when a test exhibits unexpected behavior. 
 - Exposure to PKI infrastructure: certificate chains, SCEP/EST enrollment, TLS handshake failure modes. Experience with browser automation frameworks for UI/captive-portal test scenarios. 
 - Familiarity with database testing (PostgreSQL or equivalent) - validating that backend state changes are correctly persisted. 

Additional Information

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. 

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. 

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. 

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 

The Position

Job Description
We are looking for a Hands-on Data Architecture & Delivery Lead to define and lead the architecture of the data solution for our US Commercial pharma business. You will set the technical direction for how commercial data (claims, sales, specialty pharmacy, payer, CRM, patient services) is ingested, governed, modeled, and served to analytics, AI, and field-facing applications. You'll own both the platform (the shared foundation) and the solutions (the architecture for specific commercial use cases). You will guide engineering teams, work with business and IT leaders, and keep the platform secure, compliant, scalable, and cost-effective. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. 

Job Responsibilities

- Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context. Technical delivery owner, managing sprint velocity and engineering output alongside their architectural duties. Designing data pipelines, complex data modeling (Veeva, HCP, claims), AWS infrastructure decisions, and technical code reviews. Remains the ultimate technical authority for their domain
 - Accountability/Problem Solving: Accountability for technical delivery-sizing technical debt, breaking down their own architectures into actionable sprint tasks, and unblocking developers. Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
 - Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring

Qualifications
Technical Skills

- 10-14 years of IT/data experience, with 4+ years in a data architect or platform architect role
 - Deep AWS data architecture experience: S3, Glue, Lake Formation, Athena, Redshift, EMR/Spark, dbt, Lambda, Step Functions, MWAA (Airflow), DMS/DataSync, Kinesis/MSK, IAM, and KMS
 - Proven design of lakehouse and data warehouse platforms at scale (Iceberg/Delta/Hudi, medallion patterns, dimensional and data vault modeling)
 - Experience establishing data products and a semantic/metrics layer (e. g. , dbt, Cube, AtScale, or equivalent)
 - Experience with unstructured data architectures, including RAG and vector search
 - Strong grounding in governance, security, and privacy for regulated health data
 - 5+ years in US pharma/life sciences commercial analytics, with knowledge of data sources such as IQVIA, Symphony, Komodo, Veeva, specialty pharmacy, and payer data
 - Hands-on ability in SQL, Python, and PySpark. You should be able to review code and prototype designs
 - Experience with Terraform or CloudFormation, CI/CD, and DevOps/DataOps practices

Additional Qualifications

- Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to communicate difficult concepts and influence stakeholders to adopt different perspectives
 - Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value, improve existing solutions, manage technical debt, and lead teams in identifying innovative solutions
 - Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for multiple solutions, including conducting vendor assessments
 - Exposure to GenAI/agentic use cases in commercial (field copilots, NBA, natural-language analytics)

data.description:
Position Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

- This position Leads, develops and reviews control systems project design to meet all required input data and requirements for producing sustainable and functional control systems and building equipment supervision design. Manages engineering model design in Revit and prepares standard control documentation such as plans, sections, elevation views, I/O lists, riser diagrams, sequence of operations, equipment technical specifications, and material requirements. 
 - The scope of work for this position includes: 
 - Leading BMS documentation set 
 - Equipment and material specifications 
 - Creating "for construction" documentation 
 - BMS equipment setup (field equipment, network switches and PLCs, servers and operator workstation) 
 - Creating As-built documentation 
 - Support during FAT 
 - Support during on-site commissioning 
 - Design/validation of fire alarm system documentation set 
 - Design/validation of security system documentation set
 - Design of BMS systems for modular buildings (small/medium scale) according to input data, material and equipment specifications, and creation of construction documentation for Global AND/OR India region. 
 - Supporting internal testing and FAT in factory and/or SAT based on site location 
 - Supporting commissioning team on-site during commissioning process (Global and/or India Region). 
 - Defining fire alarm system design requirements and reviews from Sr. Engineer 
 - Defining security system design requirements and reviews from Sr. Engineer 
 - Engineer with Data Center Projects experience/background or similar Critical Infrastructure experience preferred. 
Responsibilities

- Creation of conceptual and detailed project solution 
 - Creation of electrical engineering project documentation based on input data (information, requirements, standards): riser and network diagrams, I/O lists, application and functional diagrams, sequence of operations, fire alarm system project drawings, security systems drawings and descriptions, instructions, material submissions, presentations and marketing materials, etc. 
 - During design, must follow and consider international, national, and company standards and good engineering practices
 - Using knowledge and experience to fulfill requirements set by project tasks 
 - Leading design control and mentoring other colleagues 
 - Participating in kick-off meeting, regular team meetings, and site coordination meetings 
 - Reporting project status to chief project engineer and project manager 
 - Proactive cooperation with all team members during project execution 
 - Control and support of BMS, fire alarm, and security systems integrators 
 - Communicates with stakeholders in North America, India, EMEA or Australia based on project & time overlap. 
 - Initiating Request for Information (RFI) when additional clarification is needed 
 - Creating defined documents according to document list (DLIST) 
 - Communicates with stakeholders in North America, India, EMEA or Australia based on project & time overlap. 
 - Checking and approving hall documentation created by subcontractors 
 - Determining material and service descriptions needed for project execution 
 - Specifying required certificates for materials to be ordered 
 - Supporting suppliers with additional information during bid phase (bid submission) 
 - Providing technical approval for received supplier bids 
 - Providing technical support to subcontractors and installers during production/assembly 
 - Collaboration with production team and on-site implementation team 
 - Collaboration with site manager during assembly, providing technical solutions for raised questions 
 - Collaboration with Quality Control during component/system quality control and site assembly 
 - Collaboration with commissioning engineer on test documentation creation 
 - Leading role in internal testing and support during FAT 
 - Creating installation and maintenance documentation 
 - In factory, on-site and/or remote commissioning and implementation of BMS

Authorities

- Review and approval of project documentation for BMS, fire alarm, and security documentation 
 - Approving/rejecting technically received supplier bids 
 - Approving/rejecting proposed changes by subcontractors on approved workshop documentation

Qualifications

- Education: B. E/Btech in Electrical/Instrumentation engineer (Automation) [OR Diploma with +3 years of experience] OR ME/Mtech 
 - 9+ years of experience 
 - Active knowledge of English language (oral and written), Hindi (preferred) 
 - Software - Revit, AutoCAD, ICT, Security Systems, SQL, PLC/DDC software package, SCADA software package, 
 - Technical skills - Programming, SCADA, PLC, DDC, Modbus/SNMP/BACnet protocols, ethernet networks, & NFPA , IS & NBC standard awareness. 
 - Other skills - independence, attention to detail, problem-solving ability, organization, creativity, teamwork, management and coordination of other projects assigned to control engineers

data.description:
Meet the Team

At Cisco Meraki, our mission is to simplify technology so passionate people can focus on their mission. Our intuitive cloud platform empowers organizations of all sizes-from local schools and hospitals to global enterprises-to deliver outstanding customer and employee experiences on a scale. 

We have built an unrivaled company culture centered on collaboration, flexibility, psychological safety, and technical autonomy. Our Dashboard Engineering teams build and maintain web applications that manage millions of network devices globally from the cloud. Every single day, tens of millions of people rely on infrastructure configured, secured, and monitored through the Meraki Dashboard. 

Your Impact

- Partner across firmware, backend, SRE, and product teams to design systems managing millions of global network devices. 
 - Develop high-performance backend services using Ruby on Rails, Python, and TypeScript, alongside adaptable and intuitive React. js frontends. 
 - Build efficient PostgreSQL models and fine-tune queries for low-latency, high-throughput operations. 
 - Author automated test suites, participate in architecture reviews, and uphold high coding standards. 
 - Work with UX and Product to convert complex network data into intuitive, accessible user workflows. 
 - Inclusive teamwork, knowledge sharing, and constructive peer code reviews. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have Skills)

We are seeking 7+ years of professional experience writing clean, maintainable, and test-driven production code for medium to large-scale distributed web applications. 

- Proven hands-on experience across the stack, using Ruby on Rails on the backend with ReactJS, JavaScript / TypeScript on the frontend

We are seeking an experienced Automotive AI Software Architect (12-15 years) to lead AI-driven software development for automotive MCU platforms. The role involves defining AI agent architectures, MCP integrations, and AI-assisted engineering workflows while ensuring compliance with ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, ASPICE, AUTOSAR, and MISRA C standards. Responsibilities include developing validation frameworks for AI-generated software, supporting automotive applications such as BMS, motor control, and vehicle networking, and driving quality, functional safety, cybersecurity, and technical leadership across engineering teams. Ideal candidates will have deep expertise in AUTOSAR, automotive ECUs, AI-assisted development, Python automation, HIL testing, functional safety, and automotive cybersecurity. 

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role: 

- Define and drive the architecture for AI agent skills, autonomous agents, and tool integrations (including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers) for automotive MCU platforms. This includes multicore system configuration, safety and security peripherals, low-level driver development, and AUTOSAR MCAL configuration. 
 - Establish and govern the integration of AI-assisted software development within automotive standards and processes, including ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, and Automotive SPICE (ASPICE). Ensure end-to-end traceability from requirements through implementation and testing, while defining review checkpoints and confidence frameworks for AI-generated outputs. 
 - Ensure that AI-generated software complies with MISRA C standards and project-specific coding guidelines, successfully passes static analysis checks, and correctly implements functional safety and security mechanisms. 
 - Define comprehensive evaluation frameworks for AI-generated firmware, including benchmark workloads, automated simulation testing, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation, and regression-testing strategies to assess the impact of changes in AI models, toolchains, and SDKs. 
 - Design and develop AI skills and automation capabilities for automotive applications such as electric motor control, Battery Management Systems (BMS), and vehicle communication networks including CAN FD, LIN, and Automotive Ethernet. 
 - Establish quality standards and best practices for AI-enabled development, conduct technical reviews of skills and solutions developed by engineering teams, mentor team members, and actively contribute to talent acquisition and team growth. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Management, Application Engineering, and customers to gather requirements, align expectations, and clearly communicate the capabilities, limitations, and reliability of AI agents in safety-critical automotive software development environments. 

Your profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

- 12-15 years of hands-on embedded software development experience, including at least 8 years in automotive ECU software development and 5+ years in technical leadership or architecture roles. 
 - Proven experience delivering software for ISO 26262-compliant automotive programs at ASIL-B or higher, including development of safety requirements, implementation of safety mechanisms, and creation of required safety work products. 
 - Strong expertise in AUTOSAR Classic Platform, particularly MCAL and Basic Software (BSW) configuration, with practical experience operating within ASPICE-assessed development processes. 
 - Deep understanding of multicore automotive MCU architectures from leading vendors, such as Infineon TriCoreTM, Arm Cortex-R, and Power Architecture-based platforms, including lockstep processing, memory protection schemes, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs). 
 - Hands-on experience implementing automotive cybersecurity solutions aligned with ISO/SAE 21434, including secure boot, secure flashing, and platform security mechanisms. 
 - Proficiency with industry-standard automotive development and validation tools, including Lauterbach TRACE32, Vector CANoe, TASKING or HighTec compilers, and static analysis tools such as Polyspace and Helix QAC. 
 - Strong Python programming skills for engineering automation, tooling, and workflow optimization. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in Generative AI applied to engineering workflows, evidenced by at least two of the following achievements, with at least one successfully led, deployed, and adopted by a broader team: 
 - Designed and implemented an AI-assisted engineering workflow that measurably improved development efficiency, product quality, or engineering productivity. 
 - Developed frameworks for evaluating AI-generated code using automated validation, testing strategies, and performance metrics tracked over time. 
 - Applied AI solutions for requirements analysis, traceability management, automated test generation, or code reviews within structured environments governed by ASPICE or ISO 26262. 
 - Established risk mitigation approaches for AI-generated software, addressing concerns related to licensing, cybersecurity, functional safety, tool confidence, and compliance. 
 - Ability to articulate a well-founded perspective on the adoption of AI in safety-critical software development, supported by practical examples and a clear understanding of verification, validation, and documentation requirements. 
 - Experience with Infineon AURIXTM TC3x/TC4x or TRAVEOTM T2G microcontroller platforms, including low-level driver development and platform-specific software libraries. 
 - Domain expertise in electric vehicle applications, particularly motor control systems and Battery Management Systems (BMS). 
 - Hands-on experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation platforms such as dSPACE, Vector VT System, or Typhoon HIL. 
 - Familiarity with Model-Based Development (MBD) using MATLAB/Simulink and Embedded Coder. 
 - Knowledge of automotive regulations and standards, including UN R155, UN R156, and ISO 21448 (Safety of the Intended Functionality - SOTIF). 
 - Contributions to the automotive software or AI engineering community through technical presentations, publications, conference talks, or open-source projects related to automotive tooling, embedded systems, or AI-assisted development.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Ruby on Rails
data.description:
About Us

Engineering Manager, WMS

Summary

Anchanto, a leading global B2B SaaS enterprise, seeks an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the critical development and operations of its Warehouse Management System (WMS). This platform is central to the daily operations of brands, retailers, and logistics partners, managing complex workflows including inventory control, order fulfillment, and omnichannel commerce. The Engineering Manager will drive the engineering and quality assurance teams, fostering a culture of outcome ownership rather than mere task oversight. Reporting to the Engineering Head of WMS, this leader is responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and technical excellence of a mission-critical system that supports high-volume, real-time warehouse operations across Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and AWS environments. The role demands a strategic partner who can balance technical innovation with operational stability while guiding the team through a transition to an integrated, AI-first working model. 

Responsibilities

- Delivery Management: Ensure predictable engineering output by managing capacity planning, identifying risks early, and executing recovery strategies to meet 90-day commitments with high accuracy and zero delays. 
 - Quality Engineering Leadership: Establish and maintain rigorous standards for code quality, test coverage (including RSpec, integration, and load testing), and deployment frequency. Own the metrics for change failure rates and ensure independent QA sign-off remains unaffected by delivery pressures. 
 - System Reliability & Performance: Directly manage service availability and latency, overseeing incident response and root cause analysis to resolve recurring issues. Target 99. 9% uptime for owned services and sub-200ms P95 latency for critical APIs while reducing Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). 
 - Technical Architecture & Security: Operate within established architectural and security guardrails to protect multi-tenant isolation and system performance. Enforce secure software development lifecycle practices, including threat modeling, static and dynamic analysis, and compliance with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 standards. 
 - Cost Optimization: Monitor and optimize engineering costs related to compute, storage, and AI tooling, ensuring that cost-per-delivered-item and infrastructure expenses trend downward without compromising quality. 
 - AI Integration: Drive the adoption of AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot) to shift the team toward spec-driven delivery. Lead the transition of AI-enabled features, such as intelligent slotting and capacity forecasting, from pilot programs to production-grade solutions. 
 - Team Development & Staffing: Manage the full lifecycle of team members, including hiring, performance reviews, and career growth planning. Foster a culture of continuous learning that encourages engineers to evolve from specialists into versatile product builders. 
 - Hands-on Technical Contribution: Engage directly in solution design, prototyping, and complex implementation tasks where necessary to unblock the team. Gradually increase team autonomy to reduce dependency on the manager for routine decisions. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with the Engineering Head, Product Management, Delivery Managers, and other technical leads to align on priorities, manage technical debt, and ensure smooth go-live processes. 
 - Stakeholder Alignment: Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, Implementation teams, and Security groups to manage customer commitments, handle escalations, and ensure release readiness. 

Requirements

Requirements: 

- Experience: 9 to 18 years of software engineering background, including a minimum of 4 years in a leadership role managing engineering teams and owning delivery outcomes. 
 - Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in Ruby on Rails backend development at scale, with strong knowledge of asynchronous processing (Sidekiq/Redis), PostgreSQL performance tuning, and high-throughput system architectures. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Proven experience building distributed, event-driven systems on AWS, including EKS/Kubernetes, ECS, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Aurora, S3, API Gateway, and Redis. 
 - System Design: Strong capability in designing scalable, multi-tenant architectures with robust handling of idempotency, retries, backpressure, and failure scenarios. 
 - Reliability Engineering: Solid background in observability (metrics, logs, traces), SLO/SLI definition, incident management, and maintaining strict on-call discipline. 
 - DevOps & Automation: Proficiency with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/Helm), and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, AWS CDK). 
 - Quality Assurance: Demonstrated experience leading QA engineers or quality practices, with a focus on maintaining independent sign-off and improving DORA metrics. 
 - AI & Modern Tooling: Practical experience utilizing AI coding tools to enhance productivity and a track record of transitioning teams to spec-driven workflows. 
 - Security Compliance: Familiarity with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls, GDPR, PII handling, and secure SDLC practices including threat modeling and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Leadership Skills: Ability to calibrate performance levels, coach team members, manage underperformance, and guide teams through organizational change. 
 - Preferred Qualifications: Experience with monolith-to-microservices migration and domain knowledge in WMS, OMS, TMS, or 3PL logistics. 
 - Core Behaviors: A mindset focused on outcome ownership, execution discipline, systems thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a structured leadership framework while maintaining the autonomy to solve problems proactively. 

Benefits Why Join Anchanto

At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business. 

- Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment. 
 - Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth. 
 - International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets. 
 - Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support your health and well-being. 
 - Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments. 
 - Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities. 
 - Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

data.description:
Senior IT QA Analyst

Job Summary

We are seeking a Sr IT QA Analyst to support quality assurance activities for enterprise technology initiatives, with a strong focus on the ServiceNow platform. In this individual contributor role, you will develop and execute test plans, validate requirements and user stories, document defects, support UAT, and contribute to reliable delivery across projects, releases, enhancements, and platform upgrades. You will partner closely with business stakeholders, process analysts, developers, and delivery teams to ensure solutions meet business requirements, user expectations, and quality standards before deployment. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented QA professional who can translate business needs into testable outcomes, communicate risks clearly, and help improve testing practices through strong execution and collaboration. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Planning

- Contribute to QA planning for ServiceNow projects, releases, and enhancements in collaboration with the Lead Business Process Analyst and delivery team. 
 - Develop test plans, test cases, and test scripts aligned to business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Apply established QA standards, templates, and best practices for the ServiceNow platform. 

Test Execution & Defect Management

- Execute functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing support for ServiceNow modules (e. g. , ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SPM). 
 - Identify, document, and track defects through the full lifecycle using ServiceNow or designated defect-tracking tools. 
 - Support defect prioritization and resolution by providing clear analysis, reproducible steps, and timely updates to development and configuration teams. 
 - Execute performance, load, and smoke testing as required. 

ServiceNow Platform QA

- Validate workflows, business rules, UI policies, notifications, and integrations configured in ServiceNow. 
 - Ensure data integrity and accuracy across ServiceNow tables and integrations with upstream/downstream systems. 
 - Review and test configuration changes, updates, and platform upgrades including ServiceNow version upgrades and patches. 

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

- Collaborate with the Lead Business Process Analyst to translate process requirements into testable acceptance criteria. 
 - Participate in UAT sessions with business stakeholders and provide testing support to business users as needed. 
 - Communicate QA status, risks, and defect trends to project teams in a clear and timely manner. 

Continuous Improvement

- Support the use of automated testing tools and frameworks within the ServiceNow environment. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and cycle time. 
 - Maintain QA documentation and contribute to a shared knowledge base. 

Subject Matter Expertise

- Serve as a QA subject matter contributor for ServiceNow-related initiatives by sharing testing knowledge, risks, and recommendations with the project team. 
 - Contribute to team knowledge-sharing by documenting lessons learned, reusable test scenarios, and platform-specific QA considerations. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). 
 - 8+ years of QA/testing experience in enterprise IT environments.

 - Strong understanding of ServiceNow modules (ITSM required; HRSD, CSM, or ITOM a plus). 
 - Demonstrated experience creating, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts as part of enterprise QA delivery. 
 - Experience planning and executing system performance testing, including load, volume, scalability, and response-time validation for enterprise applications. 
 - Proficiency in writing test plans, test cases, and defect reports. 
 - Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or equivalent ServiceNow certification. 
 - ISTQB or similar QA certification. 
 - Experience with automated testing tools (e. g. , ATF - Automated Test Framework within ServiceNow). 
 - Familiarity with integration testing (REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server). 
 - Experience supporting large-scale ServiceNow implementations or platform upgrades. 

Competencies

- Attention to Detail
 - Collaboration and Stakeholder Communication
 - Accountability and Initiative
 - Critical Thinking and Root-Cause Analysis
 - Adaptability and ability to manage competing priorities
 - Continuous Improvement Mindset

Working Conditions

- Hybrid or remote-eligible per department guidelines. 
 - Occasional off-hours testing may be required during major releases or platform upgrades. 

Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging

Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

ROLE SUMMARY

We are hiring a Lead Data Engineer for a strongly Python-first profile, complemented by solid depth across Databricks, data modelling, T-SQL,   and data architecture. You will design, build, and own production-grade Python codebases and frameworks at the core of our Databricks. Lakehouse platform, while also setting technical direction on pipeline architecture, data modelling, and platform performance, and mentoring  

a team of engineers.

schema validation, and testing frameworks (pytest, CI/CD).

pipeline-scale problems.

Databricks/Spark when Python alone won't scale. 

• Set and enforce Python engineering standards across the team: code reviews, packaging/versioning, structured logging, and exceptionhandling patterns. 

• Design and deliver Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion pipelines on Databricks - Delta Lake, Structured Streaming/Auto Loader, and Unity  

Catalog governance. 

• Own dimensional data modelling decisions - star/snowflake schema design and SCD strategy - for the platform's core data models. 

• Write and review advanced T-SQL for platform workloads - window functions, MERGE/upsert logic, and execution-plan-based  

performance tuning. 

• Partner with Data Architects and stakeholders on ETL vs. ELT, orchestration, and cost/performance trade-offs across the platform; mentor  

Data Engineers and Senior Data Engineers through design and code reviews. 

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

8-12 years in data engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical leadership or mentoring capacity. This role carries a strong Python emphasis,   

complemented by hands-on depth in: 

Python & Data Engineering (Primary Focus)

• Strong hands-on Python: OOP, generators, decorators, concurrency (multiprocessing/asyncio), exception handling, and unit testing  

(pytest). 

• Experience building production ETL/ELT pipelines, schema validation, and reusable internal Python packages/frameworks. 

• Proven ability to profile, debug, and optimize Python code for performance at data-pipeline scale. 

Databricks & Lakehouse

• Deep, hands-on Databricks experience: Delta Lake (ACID, time travel, OPTIMIZE/ZORDER/VACUUM), Structured Streaming, Auto Loader,   

and Unity Catalog. 

• Experience tuning Spark jobs at scale - data skew, cluster sizing/autoscaling, and cost optimization. 

Data Modelling & Warehousing

• Strong grounding in dimensional modelling: star/snowflake schema, SCD Types 1/2/3, fact/dimension grain, and conformed dimensions. 

• Working knowledge of Data Vault modelling and Kimball vs. Inmon trade-offs. 

T-SQL

• Advanced T-SQL: window functions, MERGE/upsert patterns, indexing strategy, and execution-plan-based query tuning. 

Data Architecture

• Proven experience designing Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architectures and evaluating ETL vs. ELT and batch vs. streaming trade-offs. 

• Experience with orchestration (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, or ADF) on Azure or AWS. 

GOOD TO HAVE

• PCEP / PCAP (Python Institute) or equivalent Python certification. 

• Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional (or equivalent) certification. 

• Experience with data governance/compliance (GDPR/HIPAA) and cost-governance (FinOps) practices. 

• Prior experience formally leading or mentoring a team of 3+ engineers. 

EDUCATION

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

SOFT SKILLS

Strong stakeholder communication; able to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering and business audiences; comfortable owning ambiguous, enterprise-scale design decisions end to end. 

Email : sameemma@youwinglobal. com

data.title: Compiler Performance Engineer
data.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM. 

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator. 

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance. 

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

- Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler

- Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime

- Improve code generation for x86_64 and AArch64

- Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions

- Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

- 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering

- Strong C++ design and coding skills

- Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations

- Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

Very Nice to Have

- Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8

- Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler

- Knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture

- Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals

- MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. 

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for a Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager in the Engineering department. You'll collaborate with a diverse team of engineers to design, build, and deliver an innovative zero-trust cybersecurity product as part of the world's largest cloud security platform. You will bring your vision and passion to our team of experts who are enabling organizations worldwide to harness speed and agility with a cloud-first strategy. 

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

- Collaborate with a diverse team of engineers to design, build, and deliver an innovative zero-trust cybersecurity product
 - Write production-quality code in C and C++ for Linux-based systems
 - Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve issues in complex distributed systems

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You thrive in ambiguity, comfortably building the path forward in a dynamic environment and viewing complex challenges as raw material to construct meaningful solutions. 
 - You act like an owner with a fierce passion for the mission, a strong bias for action, and the dynamic range to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution. 
 - You are a natural problem-solver who runs toward challenges, remaining laser-focused on finding innovative solutions to the hardest problems to deliver maximum impact. 
 - You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team's success, actively embracing a culture of candor, clarity, and mutual respect to build deep alignment. 
 - You are a lifelong learner with a true growth mindset, consistently seeking feedback to develop yourself, elevate your teammates, and execute your work with deep purpose. 

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
 - 8+ years of software development experience with fluency in C and C++
 - Demonstrated expertise in Linux/Unix kernel development
 - Strong understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP RFCs, and the Linux kernel networking stack
 - Experience in containerization technologies such as Kubernetes and Linux namespaces
 - Hands-on experience with unit testing and mocking frameworks like Google Test or JUnit

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience leveraging AI/ML models to automate identity threat detection, optimize access management policies, or enhance cloud security operationsn
 - Knowledge of Windows Installer packaging and tools such as WiX and Experience writing Windows Filtering Platform (WFP)
 - Knowledge of Linux distributions and package formats

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. 

Benefits

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: 

- Various health plans
 - Time off plans for vacation and sick time
 - Parental leave options
 - Retirement options
 - Education reimbursement
 - In-office perks, and more!

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.

Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.
