data.description:
About Freshworks: 

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of "solutions" that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done. 

There's another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works. 

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75, 000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations. 

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us. 

Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer to lead the design and evolution of the enterprise-scale platform architecture that powers Freshworks' multi-tier SaaS products. This role will define the architecture strategy for a major platform domain, drive modernization initiatives, and establish best practices across service design, reliability, engineering quality, and cost. 

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in distributed systems, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, microservices, event-driven design, and large-scale production operations with strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities - and remains genuinely hands-on, writing production code and leading deep debugging when it matters. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Strategy

- Define and own the platform architecture roadmap for your domain, including the target state and a realistic path to it. 

- Design scalable, secure, and cost-efficient architectures supporting high-throughput, low-latency, multi-tenant workloads. 

- Establish architecture standards, design principles, decision records, and review practices. 

- Evaluate emerging technologies and own build-versus-buy decisions with measurable outcomes. 

Platform Engineering

- Architect and build cloud-native services and APIs that scale with global growth. 

- Design service decomposition, API contracts, messaging and event-driven flows, caching strategies, and database-layer design. 

- Treat multi-tenancy as a first-class design concern: isolation models, noisy-neighbour control, per-tenant limits, and cost attribution. 

- Lead platform modernization - monolith decomposition, migrations, and deprecations carried through to completion. 

Reliability, Performance & Operations

- Drive platform reliability, availability, performance optimization, and observability. 

- Take ownership of complex production issues in distributed SaaS environments, leading deep root-cause analysis and implementing permanent preventive safeguards. 

- Define SLOs, failure modes, resilience patterns, and capacity planning for the systems you own. 

Engineering Excellence & Quality

- Write clean, maintainable, high-performance production code and build proof-of-concepts that settle architectural questions. 

- Establish rigorous engineering standards through code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD integration. 

- Identify architectural bottlenecks and technical debt, and drive practical, iterative refactoring without compromising business delivery. 

Security, Privacy & Compliance

- Ensure platform designs and team practices align with information security standards and regulatory requirements. 

- Design for tenant isolation, access control, auditability, and data residency from the outset. 

Technical Leadership

- Provide architectural guidance across multiple engineering teams. 

- Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making. 

- Mentor senior and staff engineers, raising the bar through reference implementations and sponsorship rather than authority. 

- Influence engineering strategy and long-term technology investments; articulate complex trade-offs to both technical panels and executive stakeholders. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline - or equivalent practical experience. 

- 14+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or systems architecture within modern distributed SaaS environments. 

- Expert-level backend engineering in Java, Python, Go, or equivalent - currently hands-on. 

- Proven experience designing and operating enterprise-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, with real numbers for throughput, latency, availability, and behaviour under failure. 

- Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency and idempotency, retries and backpressure, concurrency, caching, and database design and optimization. 

- Demonstrated ownership of large-scale migrations or modernization initiatives with measurable outcomes. 

- Advanced production debugging skills - Linux internals, profiling, log analysis, and telemetry in distributed cloud environments. 

- Experience leading cross-functional architecture initiatives in SaaS or product organizations. 

Good to Have

Data Platform & Analytics

- Batch and real-time data ingestion, transformation, and serving architectures; streaming and CDC (Kafka, Kinesis, Debezium). 

- Lakehouse and modern data platform technologies such as Delta Lake, Iceberg, Databricks, Snowflake, and cloud-native data services. 

- Reusable data models, semantic layers, and curated data products enabling self-service analytics. 

- Data governance practice - metadata management, cataloging, lineage, and data quality frameworks. 

- Feature and training data architectures supporting AI/ML initiatives. 

Adjacent Experience

- ClickHouse, OpenSearch, or similar analytical and search engines. 

- AI-native product capabilities - RAG, agentic workflows, and LLM integration in production. 

- FinOps practice: cost attribution, showback, and efficiency guardrails at platform scale. 

Additional Information

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you'll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries. 

We Are Proud Of

- The work we do and the innovation we drive 
 - Our values of share, care and dare 
 - A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy 
 - Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a . NET Software Architect, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what's possible. You bring 10+ YEARS of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact. 

You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are

- A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo 
 - A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing 
 - Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data 
 - Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role Responsibilities

- 
 - System Architecture: Design and maintain clean, decoupled ecosystem blueprints using Clean Architecture and Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) patterns to separate core domain business rules from external infrastructure. 
 - Event Streaming & Processing: Architect high-throughput, fault-tolerant event streams using Apache Kafka. Design partition strategies, consumer groups, schemas, and end-to-end messaging reliability configurations (e. g. , handling backpressure, atomicity, and idempotent messaging). 
 - Ultra-Low Latency API Engineering: Develop ultra-responsive ASP. NET Core Minimal APIs optimized for sub-second, real-time responses. Implement advanced caching topologies (output and distributed memory caches), optimized connection pooling, and resilient pipeline middleware. 
 - Frontend Architecture: Steer the strategy for modular web applications using Blazor. Define the best use of rendering modes (WASM, Server, and interactive interoperability) to deliver seamless, real-time user experiences. 
 - Cloud & Orchestration: Leverage . NET Aspire for distributed application orchestration, containerization (Docker), and multi-service lifecycle management. 
Technical Skills & Qualifications

Core . NET Mastery

- Expertise in C# & . NET 10: Deep understanding of the latest language specifications, compilation optimizations, and Central Package Management. 
 - Clean Architecture Practices: Proven experience building rigid dependency hierarchies (Domain → Application → Infrastructure → Web/API). [1]

Distributed Systems & Event Streaming

- Apache Kafka Ecosystem: Extensive hands-on experience building producers, consumers, and stream-processing infrastructure. Proficiency with Kafka Streams API, Confluent Schema Registry, or Avro contracts is a plus. 
 - Asynchronous Integration: Mastery over event-driven microservices, sagas, message routing, error queues, and eventually consistent database models. 

API Design & Optimization

- Sub-second REST/gRPC Engineering: Proven track record of configuring high-performance networking pipelines, async I/O handling, and low-latency payload serialization. 
 - Data Lifecycle Management: Proficiency with Entity Framework Core, complex query tuning, B-tree indexes, execution plans, and read/write optimization. 

Modern UI Frameworks

- Advanced Blazor Components: Full understanding of the Blazor component lifecycle, global state management, JavaScript Interop, and client-server security trade-offs. 

Preferred Experience

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 3+ years serving as a Software Architect or Technical Lead. 
 - Extensive experience deploying containerized microservices to cloud environments (AWS or Azure) via automated CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with distributed resiliency patterns, circuit breakers, and rate-limiting utilizing frameworks like Polly. 

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn. 

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we're intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we're creating a more equitable Valtech for all. 

The Benefits

This is a Fulltime position based in Bengaluru. 

Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer

- Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent) 
 - Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs 
 - Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process. 

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential. 

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud! Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech. com. 

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know. 

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world. 

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L'Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more. 

At Valtech, we don't just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate. 

Are you ready to create what's next? Join us.

Job Description - MEP Testing & Commissioning Manager

Construction Industry | 12+ Years of Experience

Job Title: MEP Testing & Commissioning Manager

Experience: 12-15 Years

Industry: Construction / Infrastructure / High-Rise Buildings / Airports / Data Centers

Qualification: B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering

Job Purpose

To lead and manage the testing and commissioning activities of all MEP systems in construction projects, ensuring that all installations, equipment, and systems are tested, commissioned, and handed over in accordance with project specifications, approved drawings, quality standards, and safety requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and manage end-to-end MEP testing and commissioning activities for large-scale construction projects. 
 - Prepare and implement testing and commissioning plans, procedures, schedules, and checklists. 
 - Coordinate with Electrical, Mechanical, HVAC, Plumbing, Fire Fighting, ELV, and BMS teams. 
 - Review technical specifications, approved drawings, method statements, and commissioning procedures. 
 - Ensure testing and commissioning of the following systems: 
 - HVAC systems - AHU, FCU, Chillers, Cooling Towers, Pumps and Ventilation Systems. 
 - Electrical systems - HT/LT Panels, Transformers, DG Sets, UPS, Bus Ducts and Power Distribution. 
 - Fire Fighting and Fire Alarm Systems. 
 - Plumbing and Drainage Systems. 
 - BMS, ELV, CCTV, Access Control and Security Systems. 
 - Conduct pre-commissioning inspections, functional performance testing, and integrated systems testing (IST). 
 - Coordinate with consultants, clients, subcontractors, vendors, and project execution teams. 
 - Monitor commissioning progress and ensure completion as per project timelines. 
 - Identify technical issues, troubleshoot system failures, and implement corrective actions. 
 - Ensure compliance with project specifications, international standards, and safety regulations. 
 - Prepare and maintain testing reports, commissioning records, snag lists, and handover documentation. 
 - Lead commissioning engineers, supervisors, and technicians to achieve project milestones. 
 - Ensure successful system handover to clients and facility management teams. 

Required Skills & Competencies

- Strong knowledge of MEP systems and testing & commissioning procedures. 
 - Experience in large-scale construction and infrastructure projects. 
 - Knowledge of HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Fighting, BMS and ELV systems. 
 - Hands-on experience in Integrated Systems Testing (IST). 
 - Strong coordination and team management skills. 
 - Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications. 
 - Knowledge of international standards such as NFPA, ASHRAE, IEC and relevant local codes. 
 - Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 

Preferred Project Experience

- Airport Projects
 - Data Center Projects
 - Commercial Buildings
 - High-Rise Buildings
 - Hospital Projects
 - Industrial and Infrastructure Projects

data.description:
Company Description K Drive Mobility Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (formerly AAM India Manufacturing Corporation Pvt. Ltd. ) is a leading Tier 1 automotive and technology company focused on designing, manufacturing, and supplying light, medium, and heavy-duty axles for both electric (EV) and internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicle segments. Headquartered in Pune, the company operates two manufacturing plants in Supa and Chennai, along with an Engineering Development Center in Wagholi, Pune. K Drive Mobility plays an active role in powering future mobility through innovation, quality, and advanced engineering capabilities. Team members collaborate across engineering, manufacturing, and quality functions to support global automotive customers. The organization offers opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge mobility solutions in a dynamic and evolving industry. 
Role Description The Quality Manager is a full-time, on-site role based at the Ahmednagar facility. This role is responsible for leading the quality function, including developing, implementing, and maintaining quality systems and standards for axle manufacturing. Day-to-day tasks include monitoring production quality metrics, conducting root cause analysis for defects, coordinating corrective and preventive actions, and ensuring compliance with customer and regulatory requirements. The Quality Manager collaborates closely with production, engineering, and supply chain teams to drive continuous improvement, reduce non-conformities, and enhance product reliability. The role also involves managing quality audits, guiding quality inspectors and engineers, supporting new product introduction from a quality standpoint, and preparing reports and documentation for internal and external stakeholders. 
Qualifications

- Strong background in quality management systems and standards (e. g. , IATF 16949, ISO 9001), including experience with internal and external audits and documentation. 
 - Expertise in core quality tools such as APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, MSA, and SPC, with the ability to apply these tools to automotive manufacturing processes. 
 - Hands-on experience with problem-solving and root cause analysis methods (e. g. , 8D, Fishbone, 5 Why), and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Knowledge of automotive manufacturing processes, preferably axles or drivetrain components, and familiarity with machining, assembly, and testing operations. 
 - Proficiency in data analysis, use of quality-related software and ERP systems, and preparation of clear, actionable quality reports and dashboards. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and engage with customers and suppliers on quality topics. 
 - Demonstrated leadership skills, including mentoring and guiding quality teams, setting performance expectations, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced qualifications in quality or reliability

Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that's as ambitious as it is authentic. Let's transform the future of fitness-together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That's why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work-because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact. 

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights-personally and professionally. 

One Team

From day one, you'll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. 

This role requires working from our Hyderabad office 2-3 days a week

What You Will Do

Lead distributed Data Quality, Reporting QA, Application QA, and automation teams across India and the USA. 

Define and own the Insights-wide quality operating model, standards, governance, and release gates. 

Establish automated validation for data completeness, accuracy, freshness, reconciliation, referential integrity, duplication, and anomaly detection. 

Lead quality strategy for Financial Data Mart and CMDM modernization, including Databricks, Synapse, Power BI, row-level security, workspace synchronization, and customer rollouts. 

Govern testing across the full release lifecycle: data pipelines, semantic models, reports, application workflows, APIs, embeds, scheduling, and production monitoring. 

Expand automated test frameworks using Playwright, Cucumber, TypeScript, Python, SQL, and CI/CD pipelines. 

Partner with Data Engineering, BI, Application Engineering, Product, Support, and SRE teams to resolve systemic quality issues. 

Use production-quality signals such as report load time, refresh failures, data incidents, defect escape rate, and customer-impact trends to prioritize improvements. 

Build talent across India and the USA through hiring, coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and consistent performance management. 

Create effective follow-the-sun operating practices with clear ownership, handoffs, escalation paths, and shared documentation. 

AI & Quality Engineering Leadership

Make AI a practical, measurable part of the quality strategy by: 

Driving AI-assisted test-case generation, test maintenance, and regression prioritization. 

Building intelligent defect triage, routing, root-cause investigation, and ticket-drafting workflows. 

Applying anomaly detection and AI-assisted reconciliation to data pipelines and reporting outputs. 

Using AI agents and natural-language workflows to improve quality operations while preserving human approval for consequential decisions. 

Defining evaluation standards for AI outputs, including accuracy, consistency, explainability, hallucination risk, business-rule compliance, and drift. 

Establishing guardrails for privacy, security, auditability, model governance, and safe use of enterprise data. 

What You Will Need

Significant experience leading QA, Data Quality, Data Engineering QA, BI QA, or Quality Engineering teams. 

Experience managing distributed teams across multiple geographies and time zones. 

Strong SQL expertise for data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting, and test-data preparation. 

Hands-on experience with Databricks and modern data-platform testing. 

Experience with Azure Data Factory, Synapse, or comparable data-pipeline platforms. 

Strong Power BI experience, including paginated reports, semantic models, row-level security, workspaces, refreshes, exports, and report validation. 

Demonstrated experience designing quality automation strategies across data, reporting, APIs, and applications. 

Strong AI, Generative AI, or machine-learning experience applied to software quality, data quality, analytics, or engineering productivity. 

Experience evaluating AI outputs for accuracy, consistency, bias, hallucination risk, and business-rule compliance. 

Knowledge of AI agents, LLM workflows, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls. 

Experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Python, TypeScript, or equivalent automation technologies. 

Experience with GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Jira, and release-management practices. 

Strong communication skills and the ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders. 

And It's Great to Have

Experience building configuration-driven Data Quality frameworks using ADF, SQL, Databricks, or Synapse. 

Experience with Power BI APIs, automated report comparison, and large-scale regression testing. 

Experience with OpenTelemetry, Honeycomb, Application Insights, or comparable observability platforms. 

Experience applying AI to ticket triage, incident investigation, test maintenance, or defect prioritization. 

Experience with data governance, metric standardization, master data, or customer-facing analytics platforms. 

Experience supporting high-availability reporting platforms and production incident management. 

Success in This Role

Reduced data and reporting defects reaching customers. 

Increased automated test coverage and faster regression cycles. 

Improved Financial Data Mart and reporting release confidence. 

Faster root-cause analysis and defect resolution. 

Measured adoption of safe, explainable AI quality workflows. 

Better coordination between India and USA teams. 

Improved production reliability and customer trust in Insights reporting. 

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: 

- Purpose led company with a Values focused culture - Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
 - Time Off - competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
 - 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect - once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
 - Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500, 000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
 - Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
 - Best Life Perk - we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
 - Premium Calm App - enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16

ABC'S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn't just the right thing to do-it's a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness. com. 

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients. 

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Company Description G M ENGINEERING PVT LTD is a leading manufacturer of industrial valves in India, operating since 1996. The company offers a wide product range including gate, globe, check, ball, plug, butterfly, and lined valves, with pressure ratings up to 2500# class and sizes up to 3000 mm. With a workforce of over 250 employees, the company manufactures more than 50, 000 valves per month and supplies to global customers who value its reliable quality and competitive costs. Its valves are used across diverse sectors such as power, oil and gas, chemicals, refineries, steel, pharmaceuticals, cement, paper, mining, and water treatment. The organization focuses on combining experience and technical expertise to deliver robust and cost-effective solutions for industrial valve requirements. 

Role Description The Head of Quality is a full-time, on-site position based in Rajkot (Gujarat), responsible for leading and overseeing all quality-related activities across the organization. This role includes establishing, implementing, and continuously improving quality management systems and standards for industrial valves, aligned with regulatory and customer requirements. The Head of Quality will plan and supervise quality control operations on the shop floor, monitor inspection processes, and ensure product compliance at every stage of manufacturing & Lead Team of 20 Engineers. Daily tasks involve conducting and reviewing internal quality audits, analyzing quality data and trends, managing corrective and preventive actions, and collaborating with production, design, and procurement teams to address quality issues. The role also includes managing quality documentation, guiding and mentoring the quality team, interacting with customers and external auditors on quality matters, and driving a culture of continuous improvement and safety. 

Qualifications

- Strong expertise in Quality Management and Quality Assurance, including developing, implementing, and maintaining quality systems and having deep knowledge of API Q1, & API 6D standard. 
 - Hands-on experience in Quality Control activities such as inspections, testing, and process validation in a industrial valve manufacturing environment. 
 - Proficiency in Quality Auditing, with the ability to plan and conduct internal audits and support external and customer audits. 
 - Well-developed Analytical Skills to interpret quality data, identify root causes, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Experience in industrial manufacturing, preferably in valves, engineering components, or related heavy industry. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced certifications in quality (e. g. , ISO, Six Sigma) are an advantage. 
 - Proven leadership skills with experience managing quality teams and working cross-functionally with production, design, and supply chain. 
 - Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with internal stakeholders and customers on quality topics.

Job Details

Job Description: 

The Role And Impact

As a SoC Functional Validation Engineer, you will play an integral role in ensuring the quality and reliability of Intel's state-of-the-art System-on-Chip (SoC) solutions. In this position, you will define, develop, and execute validation plans for integrated SoCs, focusing on post-silicon validation, debugging, and optimization. Through collaboration with cross-functional teams, your contributions will directly impact the performance and functionality of Intel products, driving innovation and excellence in the industry. 

Business Group

The Data Center Group (DCG) is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge technologies that enable high-performance computing and data-driven solutions. DCG focuses on creating advanced products and systems that power cloud, enterprise, and AI applications. By joining our team, you will contribute to Intel's broader mission of providing world-class solutions that shape the future of technology and computing. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans to ensure compliance with design specifications and requirements. 
 - Perform functional validation for integrated SoCs, focusing on IP integration, system-level features, and interaction between components. 
 - Collaborate with architects, RTL designers, firmware teams, and other engineering groups to understand system-level requirements and features. 
 - Design and implement directed and random test cases to validate hardware/software interactions and ensure functional coverage closure. 
 - Debug SoC failures, identify root causes, and implement solutions or workarounds as required. 
 - Utilize tools such as Python, C, or C++ for test development and automation scripting. 
 - Analyze and modify test results, adapt test codes, and address coverage gaps to improve validation accuracy. 
 - Prepare and track validation requirements in collaboration with firmware, hardware, and platform teams. 
 - Develop and optimize validation methodologies, tools, and automation frameworks to streamline testing processes. 
 - Participate in project meetings, provide regular status updates, and escalate critical issues to management and stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to the development of new validation tools and methodologies, offering feedback and technical inputs for improvement. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or related field, with 0 - 1 years of relevant experience in validation, test development, or debugging. Alternatively, a Master's degree in the relevant field with no prior professional experience. 
 - Proficiency in Python, C, or C++ for test content creation and automation scripting. 
 - Strong understanding of computer architecture, microarchitecture, and operating system concepts. 
 - Experience with pre-silicon platforms such as emulators or Virtual Prototypes for test code development. 
 - Demonstrated ability to debug software and hardware issues, identify root causes, and provide effective solutions. 
 - Knowledge of system hardware/software validation techniques and methodologies. 
 - Familiarity with data visualization tools (e. g. , Power BI) for reporting metrics and tracking progress. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Solid understanding of x86 architecture and its interactions with hardware and software components. 
 - Hands-on experience with silicon debug tools, failure analysis methods, or system-level validation infrastructure. 
 - Familiarity with AI-driven workflows or tools for test plan development and analysis. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with strong attention to detail. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a cross-functional team environment. 
 - Enthusiasm for innovation and advancing validation processes through new methodologies and tools.

data.title: Embedded QA & Test Engineer
data.description:
Major Responsibilities

Embedded Gateway & IoT Connectivity Testing: 

- Test embedded C++ firmware on Linux/RTOS-based IoT gateways. 
 - Validate Azure IoT Hub communication workflows, including: 
 - Telemetry messaging
 - Cloud-to-device (C2D) commands
 - Device Twins
 - Device Provisioning Service (DPS)
 - Certificate rotation and secure connectivity
 - Validate message queueing, offline buffering, reconnect logic, and retry behavior under real-world network conditions

Industrial Protocol Testing: 
 - Develop and execute test cases for: 
 - Modbus Serial (RTU): timing behavior, register maps, function codes, exception handling. 
 - Modbus TCP: multi-client scenarios, socket recovery, error handling. 
 - CAN bus: arbitration, extended/standard IDs, error frames, bus overload, and edge-case behavior. 
 - Uses protocol analyzers, CAN interfaces, Modbus simulators, and logic analyzers to capture and analyze traffic. 
Firmware Update & OTA Lifecycle Validation: 

- Test firmware and system updates using hawkBit (deployment orchestration) and SWUpdate (A/B updates, failover, signing, rollback)
 - Validate update workflows under stress, including: 
 - Interrupted updates (power loss, network drop)
 - Corrupted image scenarios
 - Update rollback and fallback behavior
 - Ensure secure update chain-of-trust, signature verification, and partition layout integrity. 
Automation & CI/CD Integration: 

- Develop automated test suites using Python or C++ to validate firmware, protocols, OTA processes, and system services. 
 - Build hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) automated test setups for regression, protocol simulation, and device behavior testing. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). 
 - Maintain automation tools for serial logging, bus capture, cloud message verification, and gateway diagnostics. 

Debugging & Quality Reporting: 

- Investigate firmware and system issues via logs, traces, core dumps, serial output, and protocol captures. 
 - Reproduce field issues in controlled environments and collaborate with engineering teams to diagnose root causes. 
 - Generate test reports, defect metrics, and release readiness assessments. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of testing tools, processes, and standards. 

Minimum Job Requirements

Education

- Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering or equivalent years of experience. 

Certification / License

Work Experience

- 3 years of experience in embedded system testing, QA engineering, or IoT device validation. 
 - Experience testing embedded Linux or RTOS-based gateways. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure IoT Hub (telemetry, C2D, twins, DPS), hawkBit and SWUpdate, Modbus Serial (RTU) and Modbus TCP, and CAN bus testing and analysis

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

- Strong understanding of C++ firmware behavior (reading & analyzing code, debugging tests). 
 - Strong Python scripting capability for automation and test tool development. 
 - Proficiency with lab equipment (CAN analyzers, Modbus simulators, USB-to-serial tools, oscilloscopes). 
 - Solid networking knowledge (TCP/IP, TLS, certificates, provisioning flows). 

Preferred Job Requirements

Education

Certification / License

Work Experience

- Experience with IoT cloud platforms, fleet management, or gateway deployments
 - Experience with MQTT, AMQP, REST APIs, or proprietary field protocols

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

data.title: Lead Security Research Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and technically exceptional Lead Security Research Engineer to drive our Vulnerability Detection Signature Research team. In this role, you will set the technical direction for how we research, develop, and deliver advanced vulnerability detection libraries for our scanning product suite, while mentoring engineers and raising the bar for detection quality across the team. 

Beyond hands-on research, you will own the roadmap for detection coverage, champion automation to scale our research capabilities, and partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to solve the hardest problems in vulnerability detection. Exposure to AI/ML is a strong plus. If you combine deep vulnerability research expertise with the ability to lead people and technical strategy, this role is for you. 

Responsibilities

- Set technical direction and own the roadmap for vulnerability detection libraries (signatures) across Qualys Scanner product suite. 
 - Lead the research, design, and development of new detection logic and the enhancement of existing content for databases, applications, operating systems, TCP/IP protocols, and network devices. 
 - Mentor and technically guide Senior and mid-level Research Engineers, conducting design and code reviews and establishing best practices and standards for high-quality detection content. 
 - Explore and, where valuable, drive the adoption of AI/ML techniques to accelerate research, development, and validation such as automated signature generation, false positive/negative reduction, anomaly detection, and intelligent triage of emerging vulnerabilities. 
 - Design and scale automation frameworks for recurring research, development, and validation tasks. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and threat trends, and collaborate with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to expand detection coverage. 
 - Partner with Customer Support and Research teams to lead the resolution of complex customer issues, such as false positives/negatives, and drive systemic fixes. 
 - Represent the team in cross-functional planning, providing technical estimates, risk assessments, and delivery commitments. 
 - Champion strong documentation, knowledge sharing, and a culture of engineering excellence. 

Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in network and systems security, including demonstrated technical leadership or team mentorship. 
 - Deep understanding of common protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP, SSH, SSL/TLS. 
 - Strong knowledge of common security vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques. 
 - Hands-on experience with Python and Bash scripting. 
 - Hands-on working experience with containers and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Familiarity with network analysis tools and packet capture analysis. 
 - Strong ability to prioritize, plan, and manage multiple workstreams and people in a fast-paced environment. 
 - System administration experience on Windows or Unix/Linux platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of VPNs, Firewalls, and IDS/IPS technologies. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. 

Additional Plus Competencies

- Exposure to applying AI/ML to security problems - e. g. , using machine learning for detection, classification, anomaly detection, or pattern recognition, or leveraging LLMs to automate research, code, or content-generation workflows.

 - Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMWare, VirtualBox, XEN, etc. 
 - Understanding of cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud), including their AI/ML services. 
 - Experience using or developing vulnerability scanners, IDS/IPS, and other security tools. 
 - Prior experience building security-related tools or automation at scale. 
 - Industry certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, and GIAC. 
 - Track record of leading projects and small teams independently with minimal supervision. 

Why Join Us?

- Lead cutting-edge security research and shape how AI/ML transforms vulnerability detection alongside a talented, collaborative engineering team. 
 - Directly influence the security posture of thousands of customers. 
 - Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and continuous learning. 
 - Inclusive culture that values innovation, ownership, and customer impact.

data.title: Staff Software Development Engineer - Yocto / Embedded Linux
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

Staff Software Development Engineer - Yocto / Embedded Linux

The Role

AMD is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer to join our Embedded System Software team, building the Yocto-based build infrastructure and board support software that enable AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGAs. You will own the layers, distributions, and toolchains that turn new AMD silicon into a buildable, supportable software platform for Linux, OpenBMC, and real-time workloads. 

Working alongside AMD silicon architects, hardware designers, kernel and firmware teams, and the Yocto and OpenEmbedded communities, you will take new silicon from first power-on to a supportable, upstreamable platform, and build the images, SDKs, and reference designs customers develop against. 

The Person

The ideal candidate is passionate about embedded Linux and build systems, and enjoys solving complex system-level challenges that span hardware and software boundaries. You possess strong software engineering fundamentals, deep expertise in Yocto and board support package development, and a proven ability to drive features from concept through silicon bring-up and into production. 

You are comfortable across the full stack, from a device tree node to a released SDK, and collaborate effectively with architects and engineering teams across AMD. 

Key Responsibilities

- Yocto Build Infrastructure: Design and maintain the Yocto and OpenEmbedded layers that enable new AMD silicon - SoC family definitions, machine configurations, tunes, and layer architecture across BSP and distro layers. 
 - Kernel, Bootloader and Boot Image Integration: Integrate recipes for the Linux kernel, U-Boot, TF-A, and platform firmware, and build the boot artifact pipeline - device tree packaging, flash layout, signing, secure boot, and golden-image recovery. 
 - Multi-Domain Builds and SDKs: Define multiconfig builds that produce Linux, RTOS, firmware, and programmable logic artifacts together, and deliver the SDKs and toolchains teams develop against. 
 - Adaptive SoC and Programmable Logic: Integrate programmable logic into the software stack, including bitstream packaging, device tree overlays, and enabling PL interfaces from Linux. 
 - Silicon and Board Bring-Up: Participate in new silicon and board bring-up from first power-on, holding the integrated image and driving issues to root cause with hardware and firmware teams. 
 - CI, Release and Technical Leadership: Maintain QEMU-based virtual platforms and continuous integration, deliver release artifacts and software bills of materials, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to architecture reviews. 

Required Qualifications

- Deep hands-on experience with the Yocto Project, OpenEmbedded, and BitBake - authoring recipes, bbappends, and classes, building BSP and distro layers, SDK generation, and diagnosing complex build failures. 
 - Strong embedded Linux and board support package background: the Linux kernel from a platform integration standpoint, device trees, kernel configuration and fragments, driver enablement, and bootloaders and early firmware such as U-Boot and TF-A. 
 - Familiarity with BMC products and the platform management domain, and interfaces such as I2C, SPI, eSPI, and PECI. 
 - Strong programming skills in C and C++, and proficiency in Python or shell scripting for build and automation work. 
 - Experience debugging complex system-level issues spanning build systems, operating systems, drivers, bootloaders, and firmware, and familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGA technologies, including AMD VivadoTM or VitisTM and hardware/software co-design. 
 - Zephyr or another embedded RTOS, and RISC-V or other non-x86 architectures, including board enablement and toolchain integration. 
 - Inter-processor communication frameworks such as OpenAMP in heterogeneous multi-core systems. 
 - Experience with OpenBMC or a comparable BMC software stack and its integration into a Yocto distribution. 
 - QEMU or comparable virtual platforms for pre-silicon development and continuous integration. 
 - Experience developing reference designs or proof-of-concept solutions, and release engineering at scale including SBOM and CVE triage. 
 - Contributions to the Yocto Project, OpenEmbedded, or Linux open-source projects, with strong analytical and communication skills and demonstrated technical leadership. 

Academic Credentials

Bachelor's degree + 8 years of experience or Master's degree + 6 years of experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. 

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants' needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. 

AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD's "Responsible AI Policy" is available here.

Job Title: Senior Manager - AI Platform Engineering

Job Summary: 

- The AI Platform Engineering Lead will own the architecture, build-out, and day-to-day operation of the enterprise AI platform, accountable for reference architecture, scale and observability, security, and FinOps for AI and data workloads. 
 - The role also carries Data & AI solution architecture accountability, defining target-state architecture and integration patterns across data platforms, model serving, agentic and RAG services, and enterprise applications, and setting the standards that delivery teams build to. 
 - This role reports to the Director of Applied AI and partners closely with applied AI and data engineering teams, cloud infrastructure, security, data governance, and Responsible AI to deliver a secure, cost-efficient, production-grade platform in a regulated MedTech environment. 

Key Responsibilities: 

AI Platform Architecture & Engineering: 

- Define and own the target-state architecture for the AI platform, covering data ingestion and storage, feature and vector stores, model training and serving, orchestration, agent frameworks, and API layers
 - Build and maintain shared platform services and reusable components: retrieval pipelines, model gateways, prompt and evaluation services, guardrail integration, and authentication and entitlement enforcement
 - Establish LLMOps and MLOps foundations, including evaluation harnesses, automated testing, quality gates, and release criteria for AI applications
 - Set engineering standards, coding practices, peer-review processes, and definition-of-done criteria for platform deliverables

Data & AI Solution Architecture: 

- Design enterprise data architecture across lakehouse, warehouse, streaming, and integration layers, including modeling standards, storage and compute patterns, and data contracts
 - Design AI solution architectures including multi-agent and orchestration patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, tool and function calling, and integration of LLMs with enterprise data and applications
 - Publish reference architectures, architecture decision records, blueprints, and reusable patterns that accelerate delivery and enforce consistency across teams
 - Define integration architecture and API standards across enterprise systems, and guide build-versus-buy and vendor technology evaluations

AI Platform Operations & Reliability: 

- Own end-to-end operations of the enterprise AI and data platform, including capacity, performance, availability, and incident and problem management. Own model and prompt versioning, artifact registries, deployment strategies (blue/green, canary), and rollback procedures for AI workloads
 - Establish runbooks, change management, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures for critical AI and data services
 - Design and operate the observability stack for AI and data workloads: logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and dashboards across pipelines, models, and applications. Instrument AI-specific telemetry, including accuracy and groundedness, latency, token consumption, cost per transaction, drift, guardrail triggers, and user feedback
 - Establish data quality and pipeline reliability monitoring with automated detection, alerting, and remediation workflows
 - Set cost guardrails, quotas, budget alerts, and tagging and allocation standards, and enforce them through platform controls

Security, Compliance & Governance: 

- Embed security by design into platform architecture, including identity and access management, secrets management, network isolation, encryption, and least-privilege enforcement
 - Ensure platform and AI workloads meet data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, and are auditable and traceable end-to-end
 - Partner with Responsible AI and data governance teams to operationalize guardrails, approved-model controls, registry integration, and human-in-the-loop enforcement at the platform layer
 - Support audits, assessments, and validation activities with platform evidence, controls documentation, and remediation plans

Leadership & Stakeholder Management: 

- Manage vendors and delivery partners end-to-end, including selection, contracting, and performance management
 - Manage senior stakeholders across business, functional, and technology leadership, communicating roadmap, risk, cost, and platform value
 - Collaborate across applied AI, data science, analytics engineering, and data engineering to share standards, patterns, and reusable components

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related quantitative field
 - 15+ years of hands-on experience in software, data, or platform engineering, including significant time in architecture and platform leadership roles

data.title: Senior Specialist, AI Data Engineer
data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery. 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

The Position

Role Overview

As a Senior Specialist, AI Data Engineer, you will lead a small team that designs and delivers AI-ready data platforms and GenAI data solutions on Azure and Databricks. You stay hands-on, writing code, reviewing designs and unblocking the team, while owning the technical direction, delivery quality and people development for one or two projects. You will make the architecture trade-offs that decide whether AI solutions are accurate, secure, governed and cost-effective in production. 

Role at a Glance

Experience: 9 to 12 years in data engineering, including 2+ years leading engineers and 2+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI data solutions to production

Team Leadership: Leads a team of 3 to 6 engineers; may line-manage some. Accountable for technical delivery and team health

Project scope: Leads 1 to 2 projects at a time

Stakeholder / client exposure: Primary technical point of contact for project stakeholders and client teams; presents designs, demos and progress

Hands-on expectation: About 50 to 70% hands-on engineering

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Architecture

- Own the end-to-end solution design for data and AI workloads on 1 to 2 projects: ingestion, lakehouse modelling, unstructured-data processing, retrieval, serving and evaluation. 
 - Make and document architecture decisions (for example, as architecture decision records) on trade-offs such as batch versus streaming, Databricks Vector Search versus Azure AI Search, chunking and embedding strategy, model and endpoint selection, and build versus buy. 
 - Define project engineering standards: coding conventions, testing strategy, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, environment promotion and release management. 
 - Stay hands-on: build critical or complex components, prototype new patterns and lead deep-dive troubleshooting of production issues. AI and GenAI Delivery

- Lead delivery of RAG, agentic and ML data pipelines from proof of concept to production, including permission-aware retrieval, freshness service levels and fallbacks. 
 - Set up evaluation and observability for AI solutions (golden datasets, offline and online evaluation, tracing, guardrails, quality dashboards) and use them as release gates. 
 - Design how governed data is exposed to AI agents (MCP servers, tools and functions, semantic layers, Genie spaces or Fabric data agents) with the right access controls and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Manage AI cost and capacity: token budgets, model routing, caching, AI gateway policies and GPU / serverless sizing. Governance, Security and Responsible AI

- Ensure solutions meet data governance, privacy and security requirements: Unity Catalog / Purview, classification, masking and de-identification, lineage and audit. 
 - Embed responsible-AI practices (risk assessment, data and model documentation, bias and quality checks, transparency) aligned to frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and applicable regulations. 
 - Work with information security and data protection teams on AI threat modelling, including prompt injection, data leakage and excessive agent permissions. Delivery and Stakeholder Management

- Translate business and client requirements into technical scope, estimates, plans and milestones; manage risks, dependencies and change. 
 - Act as the main technical contact for project stakeholders; present designs, demos and progress to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Work with product owners, data scientists, AI engineers, architects and platform teams to align priorities. People Leadership

- Lead a team of 3 to 6 engineers: allocate work, set clear goals, run code and design reviews, and remove blockers. 
 - Coach and develop team members through regular feedback and development plans, and contribute to performance reviews. 
 - Drive team adoption of AI-assisted engineering with clear guardrails (review standards, security, IP and data-handling rules) and measure its impact. 
 - Take part in hiring through interviews, technical assessments and onboarding. 

Candidate Profile

Required Qualifications

- 9 to 12 years in data engineering, with 2+ years leading a team or workstream of engineers. 
 - Expert Python, PySpark and SQL, with strong system design and distributed data processing fundamentals. 
 - Proven delivery of production lakehouse platforms on Azure and Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, streaming, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code). 
 - Proven delivery of at least two AI or GenAI data solutions to production (for example, RAG, document intelligence, agentic data access, feature / ML pipelines), including evaluation and monitoring. 
 - Strong retrieval design knowledge: embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking, index freshness and access control. 
 - Experience with MLOps / LLMOps tooling (MLflow, model serving, AI gateway, prompt management) and AI evaluation methods. 
 - Solid grasp of data governance, privacy, security and responsible-AI practices for sensitive data. 
 - Experience planning and estimating work, managing delivery risk and communicating with senior stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach engineers and to set and enforce engineering standards. 

Technology stack: Primary stack (Azure + Databricks)

- Cloud & storage: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake
 - Lakehouse & processing: Azure Databricks: Delta Lake, Lakeflow (Connect, Spark Declarative Pipelines, Jobs), Structured Streaming, Photon, serverless compute
 - Governance & catalog: Unity Catalog (lineage, tags, ABAC, row/column security), Microsoft Purview
 - AI, retrieval & agents: Databricks Vector Search, Model Serving, Agent Bricks, Lakebase; Azure AI Search; Microsoft Foundry (Azure OpenAI and other models, Agent Service); Azure AI Document Intelligence
 - MLOps / LLMOps: MLflow 3 (tracking, tracing, evaluation, prompt registry), Feature Store, Unity AI Gateway, inference tables
 - Engineering & DevOps: Python, PySpark, SQL, Git, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, Terraform / Bicep, Databricks Asset Bundles, Docker
 - AI-assisted engineering: GitHub Copilot, Databricks Genie Code / Assistant

Nice to have

- Multi-agent systems and MCP server design; Databricks Agent Bricks or Microsoft Foundry Agent Service. 
 - Microsoft Fabric and OneLake interoperability with Databricks. 
 - Ontology, knowledge graph or semantic layer design for AI agents. 
 - Experience in healthcare, insurance or other regulated industries; familiarity with HL7 FHIR and privacy regulations (for example, PDPA, HIPAA, GDPR). 
 - Agile delivery certification or formal leadership training. 

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional. 
 - Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure AI App and Agent Developer Associate (AI-103) or MLOps Engineer Associate (AI-300). 
 - HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (optional). 

How you Lead

- Lead by example: you still ship code and hold yourself to the standards you set. 
 - Clarity: you turn ambiguous requests into clear plans, decisions and trade-offs. 
 - Growth mindset: you invest in each team member's development and give honest, timely feedback. 
 - Responsibility: you make AI risk, quality and cost visible and act on them before release. 

How success is measured

- Projects delivered to the agreed scope, quality, timeline and budget, with production service levels met. 
 - AI solutions go live with defined evaluation thresholds, monitoring and guardrails, and keep meeting them in production. 
 - Engineering standards adopted across the team: test coverage, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and documentation. 
 - A motivated, growing team: engineers build new skills, earn certifications and stay engaged. 
 - Positive stakeholder and client feedback on technical leadership and communication. 
 - Measurable productivity or cost gains from AI-assisted engineering and platform optimisation. 

Join Us

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. 

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: Senior, Clinical Coding & Assets
data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery. 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

The Position

Role Overview

We are seeking a strategic and experienced healthcare leader to own the end-to-end Clinical Coding & Assets portfolio. 

The role combines leadership of clinical annotation and encoded-data optimization with the creation, acquisition, validation, integration, maintenance and governance of clinical coding assets, ontology development, crosswalks, reference lists and grouper systems. 

The successful candidate will ensure that the encoded clinical data is accurate, clinically meaningful, scalable and fit for use across products, analytics, automation and client implementations. This role requires deep expertise in international healthcare coding, billing and terminology standards, automation tools, together with strong leadership and stakeholder engagement across APAC and global markets. 

Responsibilities

1. Portfolio strategy, governance and roadmap

- Own the strategy, roadmap and operating model for the Clinical Coding & Assets portfolio. 
 - Prioritize portfolio initiatives based on client needs, market requirements, product value, regulatory considerations and scalability. 
 - Establish governance for asset development, acquisition, ingestion, annotation, validation, implementation, versioning, monitoring and retirement. 
 - Track portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve coverage, accuracy, usability, automation and operational efficiency. 
 - Prepare quarterly management updates and lead roadmap planning, sprint planning and backlog grooming. 

2. Clinical coding & encoded-data optimization

- Lead end-to-end clinical annotation and validation processes across international, regional and client-specific coding systems. 
 - Lead and manage initiatives to improve encoded-data coverage, clinical accuracy, usability and scalability across markets and implementations. 
 - Lead the definition of clinical and operational logic underpinning encoded data and supervise its alignment with business workflows and intended product use. 
 - Manage and supervise audits to assess completeness, accuracy and alignment with expected outputs, and lead resolution of escalated discrepancies or anomalies. 
 - Partner with coding, terminology, interface and data science teams to improve automation, modelling, ground-truth datasets and scalable data workflows. 
 - Support product teams in improving coding accuracy and enabling responsible use of generative AI and other automation models. 

3. Clinical assets ingestion, integration and lifecycle management

- Lead the onboarding of new clinical coding assets into the central database and ensure data integrity, consistency and alignment with established models and standards. 
 - Oversee the creation, acquisition, validation, maintenance and controlled release of classifications, code sets, reference lists, crosswalks and related terminology assets. 
 - Collaborate with terminology, engineering and data science teams to define and implement scalable schemas, properties and data structures. 
 - Serve as the subject matter expert for schema scalability and localization across countries, clients and products. 
 - Ensure seamless and traceable integration of clinical assets and encoded data into databases and downstream product workflows. 

4. Clinical Ontology development and governance

- Lead and manage the end-to-end development, implementation and lifecycle governance of clinical and billing ontologies that support coding, claims, analytics, automation and product use cases. 
 - Supervise the design of ontology domains, concept hierarchies, properties, relationships, modifiers and metadata, ensuring structures are clinically valid, mutually exclusive where required, scalable and reusable across markets. 
 - Lead the definition of ontology principles, modelling standards, naming conventions, semantic rules and acceptance criteria, and ensure consistent application across the team. 
 - Manage the mapping and alignment of ontology concepts to source terminologies, classifications, local code sets, reference lists and billing constructs while preserving provenance and traceability. 
 - Supervise clinical annotation, expert review, testing and quality assurance of ontology content, including the resolution of ambiguous, overlapping or conflicting concepts. 
 - Lead collaboration with product, engineering, data science, coding and operational teams to translate business and clinical requirements into implementable ontology schemas and data models. 
 - Manage ontology versioning, change control, release documentation, impact assessment and communication to downstream users and systems. 
 - Lead the development of reusable ontology assets and decision logic that improve semantic interoperability, encoded-data consistency, explainability and automation readiness. 
 - Supervise ontology performance monitoring and continuous improvement using coverage, accuracy, usability, consistency and implementation feedback. 

5. Clinical Assets - Crosswalks, classifications and grouper systems

- Lead and supervise the development, validation and refinement of crosswalks between coding systems, including SNOMED CT, ICD variants, CPT and other relevant classifications. 
 - Manage mapping governance, version control, traceability and documented rationale for mapping decisions. 
 - Lead comparative analyses of Diagnosis-Related Group systems and other clinical or reimbursement groupers across markets. 
 - Supervise documentation of differences between grouper methodologies and lead assessment of implications for product configuration, analytics, reimbursement and reporting. 
 - Translate international standards and methodologies into practical, market-relevant recommendations. 

6. Clinical data assessment and standardization

- Lead reviews of market-specific clinical and claims data and recommend suitable standardization and coding approaches. 
 - Define and validate schemas, property structures and data rules against clinical, operational and business requirements. 
 - Support harmonization of heterogeneous source data while preserving source meaning, traceability and market-specific requirements. 
 - Establish repeatable quality controls for data assessment, standardization and encoded-data releases. 

7. Product and solution enablement

- Lead cross-functional engagement with product, clinical, actuarial, analytics and data science teams during requirement gathering and solution design. 
 - Manage ongoing subject matter support for coding, terminology, ontology, assets and grouper-related queries across portfolios such as Provider Management, Member Risk Profile, Chronic Disease Management, Rules and Benefits, and Asset Management. 
 - Ensure that portfolio outputs are clinically relevant, usable by clients and aligned with product strategy. 
 - Lead clarification of coding, terminology and ontology logic, manage communication of updates, and supervise effective adoption by internal and external users. 

8. Research, licensing and external standards

- Monitor international and APAC developments in coding classifications, terminologies, crosswalks, reference lists, groupers, healthcare billing and regulatory standards. 
 - Lead and supervise structured research into concepts and methodologies from recognized healthcare organizations and regulatory bodies in leading jurisdictions. 
 - Recommend building, acquire or license strategies for priority assets, considering business value, scalability, permitted use and maintenance requirements. 
 - Manage licensing engagements, requirements gathering and vendor coordination, and supervise compliance with licensing terms and data-use agreements. 
 - Supervise evidence-based documentation of sources, assumptions, decisions and implementation implications. 

9. Stakeholder engagement

- Lead engagement with internal stakeholders, including product managers, data scientists, analysts, medical coders, clinicians and operational teams. 
 - Collaborate with clients, regulators, providers, vendors and industry bodies to align expectations and uphold applicable standards. 
 - Facilitate workshops, working groups and feedback loops to build shared understanding of requirements and drive continuous improvement. 
 - Act as the primary liaison for complex coding, terminology, assets and grouper matters across the organization. 

10. Leadership, team management and ways of working

- Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team of coding and terminology specialists, with the ability to operate across a large delivery function and smaller specialist asset teams. 
 - Set clear priorities, quality expectations and development plans, and provide regular coaching and constructive feedback. 
 - Develop and maintain SOPs, principles, guidelines and workflows covering the full portfolio lifecycle. 
 - Ensure documentation remains current with standards, regulatory expectations and operational practices. 
 - Deliver training on client and market requirements, coding validation, asset recommendation, grouper interpretation and subject matter standards. 
 - Promote international and regional knowledge sharing, consistency and collaboration across Clinical Informatics. 
 - Provide critical subject matter support to other clinical portfolios through expert review, actionable feedback and strategic alignment. 

Candidate Profile

Experience and Qualifications

Essential

- Graduate healthcare qualification, preferably a medical degree with at least 05 years of post-qualification experience. 
 - At least 8 years of relevant experience spanning health insurance, clinical coding and validation, healthcare data or database management, and stakeholder engagement. 
 - At least 3 years of experience in a leadership role. 
 - Deep knowledge of clinical terminologies, coding assets, healthcare billing practices, crosswalks, classifications and grouper systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading annotation, validation, data-quality or clinical asset lifecycle processes. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across clinical, product, operational, technical and regulatory domains. 

Preferred

- Master's degree in Health Informatics, Clinical Sciences, Public Health, Health Administration or a related discipline. 
 - Private healthcare or health insurance experience in Asia or other international markets. 
 - Experience managing distributed, multidisciplinary teams and supporting multiple concurrent products or markets. 
 - Experience with licensing, vendors and controlled use of third-party clinical content. 

Competencies & Core Characteristics: 

Technical Understanding

Core requirements

- Strong understanding of healthcare-specific data claims data and encoded clinical information. 
 - Detailed working knowledge of international coding systems and terminologies, including ICD, CPT, SNOMED CT, LOINC and ATC, together with client-specific classifications where relevant. 
 - Detailed knowledge of groupers, crosswalks, reference lists, coding schemas and version-control practices. 
 - Understanding of healthcare billing, patient health management, provider profiling, healthcare reporting and related technologies. 
 - Competence in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Access and PowerPoint. 

Advantageous

- SQL, Python and advanced Excel skills. 
 - Understanding of advanced statistics, risk adjustment, health outcomes indices and related metrics. 
 - Knowledge of data science and generative AI applications in healthcare. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Azure services such as Databricks, Synapse and Data Factory. 

Behavioral capabilities

- Strategic leadership with the ability to translate complex clinical content into scalable portfolio priorities. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, clinical judgment and rigorous problem-solving capability. 
 - High attention to detail and a consistent focus on quality, traceability and continuous improvement. 
 - Exceptional communication and facilitation skills across diverse stakeholder groups. 
 - Ability to challenge assumptions constructively and convert feedback into improved delivery. 
 - Resilience, energy, accountability and a positive, collaborative approach. 
 - Excellent planning and coordination skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

Join Us

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. 

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
